artists.b: Andrus Peegel (1955-2020) graafik, illustraator, ajalehe- ja raamatukunstnik.
artists.ben: Andrus Peegel (1955-2020), graphic artist, illustrator, newspaper and book artist.

artists.b: Aleksander PEEK (1915, Kunda – 1982, Tallinn) oli eesti teatri- ja maalikunstnik ning graafik, kes omandas lavakujunduse-alase hariduse Siberis Omski kunstikoolis. On olnud Estonia kunstnik, hiljem vabakunstnik. /tekst Liisi Aibel, 2013/.
artists.ben: Aleksander PEEK (1915, Kunda – 1982, Tallinn) was an Estonian theatre and painting artist and graphic artist, who obtained his education in stage design in Siberia at the Omsk Art School. He has been an artist at Estonia, later a freelance artist. /text by Liisi Aibel, 2013/.

artists.b: Aastatel 1915–1921 õppis Tartu algkoolides ja 1921–1926 Tartu Õpetajate Seminaris (joonistusõpetaja Mart Pukits). Aastatel 1926–1947 töötas õpetajana Tartumaa ja Tartu koolides. Õpinguid jätkas aastatel 1928–1932 Kõrgemas Kunstikoolis Pallases, 1942–1944 Kõrgematel Kujutava Kunsti Kursustel ja aastast 1945 Tartu Riiklikus Kunstiinstituudis, mille lõpetas 1948. aastal ning oli samas 1947–1949 ka õppejõud.
artists.ben: Between 1915–1921 he studied in Tartu primary schools and 1921–1926 at the Tartu Teachers' Seminary (drawing teacher Mart Pukits). Between 1926–1947 he worked as a teacher in schools of Tartu County and Tartu. He continued his studies in 1928–1932 at the Pallas Higher Art School, in 1942–1944 at the Higher Courses of Fine Art and from 1945 at the Tartu State Art Institute, which he graduated from in 1948, and was also a lecturer there in 1947–1949.

artists.b: Õppis 1933-34 Riigi Kunsttööstuskoolis keraamikat ja tarbegraafikat, 1932-33 ja 1934-39 Pallases N. Triigi juures maalimist ning A. Laigo ja R. Vaheri juures graafikat, lõpetas kooli 1939 graafikuna.1937 omandas Pallases joonistusõpetaja kutse.

Voldemar PEIL (1907, Narva – 1999) oli eesti teatrikunstnik, kes muuhulgas on viljelenud ka realistlikku tahvelmaali (lille- ja maastikupildid ning portreed). Lavakunstnikuna kujundanud umbes kolmsada lavastust. Tema laad on peamiselt olustikuline. Maalitud dekoratsioonide kõrval on Peil tulemuslikult kasutanud ka projektsiooni ja valgustust. Kunstihariduse omandas maalierialal Pallase kunstikoolis Jaan Vahtra, Voldemar Melliku, Villem Ormissoni ja Ado Vabbe käe all, lõpetas kunstikooli joonistusõpetaja kutsega. Stsenograafia alal täiendas end Moskva ja Leningradi teatrites. /tekst Liisi Aibel, 2013/.
artists.ben: Voldemar PEIL (1907, Narva – 1999) was an Estonian theatre artist who, among other things, also practised realistic easel painting (flower and landscape pictures as well as portraits). As a stage designer he designed about three hundred productions. His style is mainly of a genre character. Alongside painted scenery, Peil also made effective use of projection and lighting. He received his art education in the painting speciality at the Pallas Art School under Jaan Vahtra, Voldemar Mellik, Villem Ormisson and Ado Vabbe, graduating from the art school with the qualification of drawing teacher. In scenography he furthered his education at theatres in Moscow and Leningrad. /text by Liisi Aibel, 2013/.

grp: school:State Academy of Fine Arts Stuttgart

artists.b: Katrin Pere (s. 1952) on õppinud tollases ERKIs (praegune EKA) tekstiili erialal. Pärast lõpetamist (1977, cum laude) on ta esinenud kureeritud grupinäitustel Eestis, Soomes, Rootsis, Hollandis, Taanis, Belgias, Ungaris, Saksamaal, USAs, UKs, Jaapanis, Poolas, Lätis, Leedus, Prantsusmaal Itaalias. Töötab peamiselt kiudmaterjalidega autoritehnikas, on kasutanud ka klaasi, metalli, paberit, vett, mulda, elusloodusest pärinevaid materjale. Kunstniku teoseid leidub ETDMs, Rahvusraamatukogus, ühiskondlikes interjöörides ja erakogudes üle maailma. Perel on olnud ka mitmeid isikunäitusi Tallinna Kunstihoone Galeriis, Rahvusooper Estonia Talveaias, Rahvusraamatukogus. Ta on pälvinud Stuttgarti linna preemia(1988), Aasta Tekstiilikunstniku auhinna (1996, 1998, 2004, 2013) ning Kristjan Raua nim. aasta kunstipreemia(1999)
artists.ben: Katrin Pere (b. 1952) studied textile art at what was then ERKI (now EKA). After graduating (1977, cum laude), she has taken part in curated group exhibitions in Estonia, Finland, Sweden, the Netherlands, Denmark, Belgium, Hungary, Germany, the USA, the UK, Japan, Poland, Latvia, Lithuania, France and Italy. She works mainly with fibre materials in original technique, and has also used glass, metal, paper, water, earth, and materials derived from living nature. The artist's works can be found in the Estonian Museum of Applied Art and Design, the National Library, in public interiors and in private collections around the world. Pere has also had several solo exhibitions at the Tallinn Art Hall Gallery, in the Winter Garden of the National Opera Estonia, and at the National Library. She has been awarded the City of Stuttgart Prize (1988), the Textile Artist of the Year Award (1996, 1998, 2004, 2013) and the Kristjan Raud Art Prize of the Year (1999).

artists.b: Tegutses 19. sajandil Tallinnas maalijana, joonistusõpetajana, kunstikaupmehena ja litograafiate kirjastajana. Tuntuim teos litograafiate sari "Album von Reval" (max 29 erinevat lehte). Litograafiad trükiti F. Schwabe poolt Berliinis.
artists.ben: Active in the 19th century in Tallinn as a painter, drawing teacher, art dealer and publisher of lithographs. His best-known work is the series of lithographs "Album von Reval" (max 29 different sheets). The lithographs were printed by F. Schwabe in Berlin.

artists.b: Per William Petersen (s. 1955 Taanis) on kunstnik ja disainer, kes elab ja töötab alates 2006. a. Tartus. Ta on eksperimenteerinud mitmete meediumite ja tehnikatega, sh maal, 3D-maal, skulptuur, film, foto, jne. Petersen tegeleb teemadega, mis on seotud meid ümbritsevate inimestega – sootsiumiga. Teda huvitavad inimeste elamise viisid, unistused, ellujäämistaktikad. Kõige rohkem aga huvitab teda kõik, mis seostub vabadusega, õiguse ja võimalusega midagi vabalt teha, kuna vabadust võib pidada elu ning inimkonna arengu tähtsaimaks aluseks. Per Petersen on Eesti Kunstnike Liidu liige.
artists.ben: Per William Petersen (b. 1955 in Denmark) is an artist and designer who has lived and worked in Tartu since 2006. He has experimented with numerous media and techniques, incl. painting, 3D-painting, sculpture, film, photography, etc. Petersen deals with themes related to the people around us – society. He is interested in people's ways of living, dreams, survival tactics. But what interests him most is everything connected with freedom, the right and opportunity to do something freely, since freedom can be considered the most important foundation of life and the development of humankind. Per Petersen is a member of the Estonian Artists' Association.

artists.b: Sündis Rakvere maakonnaarsti pojana, oli Udriku mõisaomaniku krahv Rehbinderi kasupoeg. Õppis Tallinna toomkoolis ja 1812-1814 Tartu ülikoolis arstiteadust. 1814 asus õppereisile Berliini, edasi 1815-1816 Viini, elas 1817-1820 Itaalias, Saksamaal, Šveitsis, Inglismaal ja Prantsusmaal. 1821-1823 elas mitmel pool Eestis ja Lätis, 1823-1830 oli Peterburis Smolnõi instituudi kunstiõpetaja. 1827 reisis Soomes. 1839 sai Peterburi kunstiakadeemia akadeemiku kandidaadiks. Alates 1842 elas püsivalt Peterburis.
artists.ben: He was born as the son of a district doctor in Rakvere, and was the stepson of Count Rehbinder, the owner of Udriku manor. He studied at the Tallinn Cathedral School and, from 1812 to 1814, medicine at the University of Tartu. In 1814 he went on a study trip to Berlin, then in 1815-1816 to Vienna, and lived in 1817-1820 in Italy, Germany, Switzerland, England and France. In 1821-1823 he lived in various places in Estonia and Latvia, and in 1823-1830 he was an art teacher at the Smolny Institute in St. Petersburg. In 1827 he travelled in Finland. In 1839 he became a candidate for academician at the St. Petersburg Academy of Arts. From 1842 he lived permanently in St. Petersburg.

artists.b: Priit Piirmets on sündinud 15.03.1948. Hageri vallas. Rakvere tuli 1956.a. Õppis Rakvere I 8-kl. koolis. Lõpetas Rakveres Kaugõppe KK. Rakvere I 8.kl.koolis õpetas joonistamist õpetaja  Gustavson. Keskkooli ajal käis kultuurimaja kunstiringis, kus juhendas Ella Rajani. 1973. aastast oli ise kunstiringi juhendaja. Oli Kunstnike Liidu Noortekoondise liige. Oma õpetajaks ja eeskujuks peab Luulik Kokamägi`t. 1974. aastal asus elama Tallinna.; Asukoht: Eesti; Vabatekstiline asukoht: administratiivne üksus; Lääne-Viru - Rakvere;.

Akvarellist, loonud ka plakateid, lavakujundusi. Sündis Sevastoopolis, elas Jugoslaavias, aastast 1922 Eestis. Kunsti õppis A. Kaigorodovi stuudios ja 1938-41 Riigi kunsttööstuskoolis. 1941 mobiliseeriti punaarmesse, 1942-44 viibis Jaroslavlis. 1968-88 juhendas üleliidulist akvarellistide gruppi.
artists.wdesc: Estonian artist of Baltic German origin (1912-1989)

artists.b: 1767 sai paavst Clemens XIII'lt tiitli Cavaliere degli Speroni d'Oro (Kuldkannuste kavaler). Alates 1770 külastas regulaarselt Pompeid ja Herculaneumi ning jäädvustas sealseid muistiseid. Graafikust poeg Francesco Piranesi  (suri 1810) jätkas koos vend Pietroga trükkis Pariisis kuni surmani 1810 isa originaalplaatidelt. Ta viis oma isa töökoja Roomas õitsengule. Järeltrükke tegid ka tema pärijad, neist edukamalt Firmin Didot, kes sai sai plaadid oma valdusesse 1829. Vanemate uurimuste andmetel on ta välja andnud 28 (29?) köidet, milles on 2000 plaadi jäljendid. (L. Ficacci katalogiseerib vaid  u. 1000 teost! ) 1839 läksid plaadid paavstile kuuluvale Calcografia Cameralele, mis 1870 muudeti riiklikuks ning jätkas järeltrükkide tegemist. Praegu on peaaaegu kõik plaadid säilinud ja  Instituto Nazionale per la Grafica kogus. (L. Ficacci "Piranesi. The Complete Etchings"; TB, XXVII, lk. 80-83; Saur, 96, lk, 30-35; Dic. of Art, lk. 841-847; Seubert, lk. 75; Larousse, 12, lk. 1061; Meyer, 15, lk. 901; Kristaller, P. Istoria Evropeiskoi gravjürõ XV-XVIII veka, lk. 452; BSE (1940), 45, lk. 385-86)
artists.ben: In 1767 he received from Pope Clemens XIII the title Cavaliere degli Speroni d'Oro (Knight of the Golden Spur). From 1770 he regularly visited Pompeii and Herculaneum and recorded the antiquities there. His son, the printmaker Francesco Piranesi (died 1810), together with his brother Pietro, continued to print in Paris until his death in 1810 from his father's original plates. He brought his father's workshop in Rome to prosperity. Reprints were also made by his heirs, the most successful of whom was Firmin Didot, who acquired the plates in 1829. According to earlier studies, he published 28 (29?) volumes containing impressions of 2000 plates. (L. Ficacci catalogues only about 1000 works!) In 1839 the plates passed to the Calcografia Camerale, belonging to the Pope, which was made a state institution in 1870 and continued to produce reprints. At present almost all the plates are preserved in the collection of the Instituto Nazionale per la Grafica. (L. Ficacci "Piranesi. The Complete Etchings"; TB, XXVII, pp. 80-83; Saur, 96, pp. 30-35; Dic. of Art, pp. 841-847; Seubert, p. 75; Larousse, 12, p. 1061; Meyer, 15, p. 901; Kristaller, P. Istoria Evropeiskoi gravjürõ XV-XVIII veka, p. 452; BSE (1940), 45, pp. 385-86)

artists.b: Sündis Venemaal Smolenskis, 1914 tuli pere Eestisse. Elas Laeval. Õppis 1938-40 Tartus Pallase kunstikoolis, jätkas õpinguid kuni arreteerimiseni 1945 kevadel (õppejõud Aleksander Vardi jt). 1944 üritas koos Valve Janovi ja Kaja Kärneriga Läände põgeneda. Oli kuni 1954 Venemaal Arhangelski oblasti vangilaagris. Alates 1958 elas Tallinnas, kus ka suri. Maalikunstnik, akvarellist. 1937-39 oli Tartu Töölisteatris dekoraator. 1960. aastatel jõudis, nagu ka Lembit Saarts, loodusmotiividega lähedale abstraktsele maalikunstile. Bibl.: Eesti kunsti ajalugu 2, 1970, lk 89; Sirje Helme, Jaak Kangilaski, Lühike Eesti kunsti ajalugu. Tln: 1999, lk 128, 144, 196 (ill 98). Vt ka: Enn Lillemets "Enne valguse vaheaega", näitus Tartu Linnamuuseumis 2010.

Eesti vabariigi 1- ja 2- krooniste rahatähtede autor. Lõpetas 1962 Tartu Kunstikooli, 1970 Eesti Riikliku Kunstiinstituudi. Töötas Eesti Riiklikus Kirjastuses, Kunstitoodete Kombinaadis ARS, Kunstifondis. Alates 1978 vabakutseline kunstnik. Sündis Võrus.
artists.ben: Author of the 1- and 2-kroon banknotes of the Republic of Estonia. Graduated from Tartu Art School in 1962, and from the Estonian State Art Institute in 1970. Worked at the Estonian State Publishing House, the ARS Art Production Combine, and the Art Fund. A freelance artist since 1978. Born in Võru.

artists.b: 1989 Eesti NSV Ministrite Nõukogu poolt väljakuulutatud rahakavandite konkursil ja sai U. Ploomipuu kolmanda auhinna ja tema kujundusega trükiti Eesti 1- ja 2-krooniste sedelid. Viimaseid emiteeriti 1992, 2006, 2007 ja need olid käibel kuni eurole üleminekuni 2011.
artists.ben: 1989 at the competition for banknote designs announced by the Council of Ministers of the Estonian SSR, and U. Ploomipuu received third prize and his design was used to print the Estonian 1- and 2-kroon notes. The latter were issued in 1992, 2006, 2007 and were in circulation until the transition to the euro in 2011.

artists.b: Õppis aastatel 1856-1858 Tartu ülikoolis matemaatikat ja keemiat, tegeledes samaaegselt ka skulptuuriga. Õppis Weimari kunstikoolis ning professor Caueri juures Karlsruhes. Käte halvatuse tõttu oli sunnitud skulptuurist loobuma ning valis erialaks maalikunsti.
artists.ben: Studied mathematics and chemistry at the University of Tartu from 1856 to 1858, simultaneously also engaging in sculpture. Studied at the Weimar art school and under Professor Cauer in Karlsruhe. Due to paralysis of the hands he was forced to give up sculpture and chose painting as his profession.

artists.b: Mari Prekup (1984) keskendub viimastel aastatel pärimuskultuuri kihtidele ja nende tänapäevastele tõlgendustele, liikudes argirituaalidest ja hiiepuude tähendusväljast soome-ugri ning lähirahvaste maailmatajuni. Tema teosed ei paku valmis vastuseid, vaid avavad ruumi, kus mäletamine on korraga nii püha kui ka habras tegu. Prekupil on EKA magistrikraad graafika erialal (2015), ta on osalenud aktiivselt kunstielus nii näitustel, tegevuskunstniku kui ka korraldajana ning pälvinud muu hulgas Eduard Wiiralti noore autori preemia.
artists.ben: Mari Prekup (1984) has in recent years focused on the layers of traditional culture and their contemporary interpretations, moving from everyday rituals and the field of meaning of sacred groves toward the worldview of the Finno-Ugric and related peoples. Her works do not offer ready-made answers, but open up a space where remembering is at once both a sacred and a fragile act. Prekup holds a master's degree in printmaking from the Estonian Academy of Arts (EKA) (2015); she has been active in art life both as an exhibiting artist, performance artist and organiser, and has received, among other awards, the Eduard Wiiralt Young Author's Award.

artists.b: Rait Prääts (1952) alustas loometeed suurte vitraažide loomisega avalikku ruumi, muu hulgas Niguliste kiri- kusse ja Rahvusraamatukokku. Klaasis töötas ta välja oma autoritehnika, mis võimaldas n-ö kolmemõõtme- liselt maalida. Liikudes skulptuuri suunas, kasutab ta modelleerimiseks tsemendisegusid, millele lisab maali- tud klaasdetaile, saavutades omamoodi sünteesi maali ja skulptuuri vahel. Prääts on lõpetanud Eesti Riikliku Kunstiinstituudi klaasikunsti eriala (1975), osalenud paljudel näitustel nii Eestis kui ka rahvusvaheliselt ning pälvinud ka mitmeid tunnustusi, sh Kristjan Raua pree- mia (2013). Tema (tellimus)tööd on jõudnud mitmele poole maailma ja paljudesse kogudesse. Prääts on Eesti Klaasikunstnike Ühenduse liige ja Eesti Kunstnike Liidu auliige.
artists.ben: Rait Prääts (1952) began his artistic career by creating large stained-glass windows for public spaces, including for St. Nicholas' Church and the National Library. In glass he developed his own authorial technique, which allowed him to paint, so to speak, three-dimensionally. Moving in the direction of sculpture, he uses cement mixtures for modelling, to which he adds painted glass details, achieving a kind of synthesis between painting and sculpture. Prääts graduated from the Estonian State Art Institute in the speciality of glass art (1975), has taken part in numerous exhibitions both in Estonia and internationally, and has also received a number of accolades, including the Kristjan Raud Prize (2013). His (commissioned) works have reached many places around the world and many collections. Prääts is a member of the Estonian Glass Artists' Union and an honorary member of the Estonian Artists' Association.

artists.b: Mark Antonius Puhkan (s. 1994) on Eesti vabakutseline kunstnik, graafik, illustraator ja õppejõud. Ta on omandanud Graafika bakalaureusekraadi ja Kaasaegse kunsti magistrikraadi Eesti Kunstiakadeemias. Vaba loominguga on ta esinenud galeriides peamiselt joonistuste ja graafiliste tõmmiste meediumis nii Eestis kui ka välismaal. Illustraatorina on ta aktiivne nii ilukirjanduse, ajakirjanduse kui ka teadusliku illustratsiooni valdkonnas. On Eesti Kunstiakadeemias graafika ja joonistamise ainete õppejõud. Tema kunstnikupositsioonis on olulisel kohal inimeseks olemise jälgimine ning inimese ja metsiku looduse vaheliste füüsiliste ja vaimsete sildade taasloomine.
artists.ben: Mark Antonius Puhkan (b. 1994) is an Estonian freelance artist, graphic artist, illustrator and lecturer. He has obtained a Bachelor's degree in Graphic Art and a Master's degree in Contemporary Art from the Estonian Academy of Arts. In his free artistic practice he has exhibited in galleries mainly in the mediums of drawing and printmaking, both in Estonia and abroad. As an illustrator he is active in the fields of fiction, journalism and scientific illustration alike. He is a lecturer of graphic art and drawing subjects at the Estonian Academy of Arts. In his artistic position, an important place is held by the observation of being human and the recreation of physical and mental bridges between man and wild nature.

artists.b: Urmas Puhkan (1967) lõpetas 1992. aastal Eesti Kunstiakadeemia keraamika erialal. Juba õpingute ajal osales näitustel ning on 1988. aastast tegutseva kunstirühmituse Neoeksprepost asutaja. Ta on loonud skulpturaalset keraamikat, kureerinud keraamikanäitusi nii Eestis, kui ka välismaal, olnud üks ARS Keraamikakeskuse algatajaid.
artists.ben: Urmas Puhkan (1967) graduated from the Estonian Academy of Arts in ceramics in 1992. Already during his studies he participated in exhibitions and is a founder of the art group Neoeksprepost, active since 1988. He has created sculptural ceramics, curated ceramics exhibitions both in Estonia and abroad, and was one of the initiators of the ARS Ceramics Centre.

artists.b: On sündinud 3. oktoobril 1962. aastal Tartus. Ema Laine Pukk (sünd 1935-2023) oli üle 30. aasta Tartu Lastekunstikooli õpetaja. Isa, Aleksander Suuman (1927-2003) oli maalikunstnik ja luuletaja. Tartu Lastekunstikoolile järgnes Eesti Riiklik Kunstiinstituut (Eesti Kunstiakadeemia)1980-1986, kus õppis graafika erialal. Aapo on Ameerika Portreekunsti Ühingu (PSOA) liige aastast 1999 ja Signature Member aastast 2017. Rahvusvahelistelt portree konkurssidelt on Aapo Pukk toonud koju kümneid auhindu. Eesti Kunstnike Liidu liige aastast 2011. Aapo Pukk töötab Eesti Kunstiakadeemias lepingulise õppejõuna aastast 2012. Aapo tegeleb põhjalikult kunsti õpetamisega ja metoodikate väljatöötamisega omanimelises kunstikoolis. Viimase 15 aasta jooksul on Aapo andnud üle 200 kursuse. Ta ise ütleb, et armastab lillede ja maastiku maalimist sama palju kui portreteerimist.
artists.ben: He was born on 3 October 1962 in Tartu. His mother Laine Pukk (b. 1935-2023) was a teacher at the Tartu Children's Art School for over 30 years. His father, Aleksander Suuman (1927-2003), was a painter and poet. The Tartu Children's Art School was followed by the Estonian State Art Institute (Estonian Academy of Arts) 1980-1986, where he studied in the graphic art speciality. Aapo has been a member of the Portrait Society of America (PSOA) since 1999 and a Signature Member since 2017. Aapo Pukk has brought home dozens of awards from international portrait competitions. A member of the Estonian Artists' Association since 2011. Aapo Pukk has worked as a contracted lecturer at the Estonian Academy of Arts since 2012. Aapo is deeply engaged in teaching art and developing methodologies at his eponymous art school. Over the past 15 years Aapo has taught more than 200 courses. He himself says that he loves painting flowers and landscapes just as much as portraiture.

artists.b: August Pulst oli seotud Eesti Kunstimuuseumi, Eesti Teatri- ja Muusikamuuseumi, Tori Muuseumi, Eesti Vabaõhumuuseumi asutamise ja juhatamisega. 1915. aastal asutasid A. Pulst, Ants Laikmaa, Kristjan Raud, Mihkel Aitsam ja Peeter Parikas Eesti Rahva Muuseumi Tallinna osakonna, mis muudeti 1919 Tallinna Eesti Muuseumiks ning millest on välja kasvanud praegune SA Eesti Kunstimuuseum.
artists.ben: August Pulst was involved in the founding and management of the Estonian Museum of Art, the Estonian Theatre and Music Museum, the Tori Museum, and the Estonian Open Air Museum. In 1915 A. Pulst, Ants Laikmaa, Kristjan Raud, Mihkel Aitsam, and Peeter Parikas founded the Tallinn branch of the Estonian National Museum, which in 1919 was converted into the Tallinn Estonian Museum, from which the present-day SA Eesti Kunstimuuseum [Art Museum of Estonia Foundation] has grown.

artists.b: Kaisa Puustak (sündinud 1945 Tallinnas) on tunnustatud Eesti kunstnik, kelle looming keskendub vabagraafikale. Ta lõpetas 1969. aastal Eesti Riikliku Kunstiinstituudi graafika eriala (MA). Alates 1973. aastast on Puustak aktiivselt osalenud näitustel, ta on nii Eesti Kunstnike Liidu kui Eesti Vabagraafikute Ühenduse auliige.
artists.ben: Kaisa Puustak (born 1945 in Tallinn) is a recognised Estonian artist whose work focuses on free graphic art. She graduated in 1969 from the Estonian State Art Institute in the field of graphic art (MA). Since 1973, Puustak has actively participated in exhibitions, she is an honorary member of both the Estonian Artists' Association and the Estonian Print Society.

artists.b: Matti Pärk (s.1945) on lõpetanud Tartu Kunstikooli puitehistöö erialal ning ERKI raamatuillustraatori erialal. On töötanud ENE kunstilise toimetuse juhatajana ja EKA joonistamise kateedri õppejõuna (1984. aastast tänaseni). Ta on oma joonistuste ja pastellmaalidega esinenud paljudel isiknäitustel nii Eestis kui välismaal, samuti osalenud grupinäitustel. Ta on kujundanud, maketeerinud ja illustreerinud ligi 200 raamatut (millest mitmed on pälvinud tunnustust konkurssidel). Viimasel joonistustriennaalil oli Matti Pärk üks peaauhinna nominentidest. Praegu on pooleli isiknäituse koostamine Kuressaare Raegaleriisse.
artists.ben: Matti Pärk (b. 1945) has graduated from the Tartu Art School in the speciality of woodworking and from ERKI in the speciality of book illustrator. He has worked as the head of the art editorial department of the ENE [Estonian Soviet Encyclopaedia] and as a lecturer at the drawing department of EKA (from 1984 to the present). He has presented his drawings and pastel paintings at numerous solo exhibitions both in Estonia and abroad, and has also participated in group exhibitions. He has designed, laid out and illustrated nearly 200 books (several of which have received recognition at competitions). At the last drawing triennial, Matti Pärk was one of the nominees for the main prize. He is currently working on preparing a solo exhibition for the Kuressaare Town Hall Gallery.

artists.b: 1919. aastal astus ta 17-aastasena vastavatud Kunstiühingu Pallas kunstikooli. Ta õppis esialgu Konrad Mäe, seejärel Nikolai Triigi ja hiljem Ado Vabbe käe all. 1923. aasta kevad-suvel tegi ta Anton Starkopfi juhtimisel õppereisi Saksamaale.
artists.ben: In 1919, at the age of 17, he enrolled in the newly founded art school of the Art Society Pallas. He studied initially under Konrad Mägi, then under Nikolai Triik, and later under Ado Vabbe. In the spring-summer of 1923, he made a study trip to Germany under the guidance of Anton Starkopf.

artists.ben: Born 22.12.1941, Põltsamaa. Education: 1962–63, 1966–71 Estonian State Art Institute; 1957–62 Tartu Art School.

artists.b: Anu Põder (1947–2013) kasutas oma loomingus kõikvõimalikke materjale, sageli selliseid, millel pole traditsioonilise skulptuuriga midagi pistmist. Ta mõtles materjalis ja materjali kaudu: materjali tähenduslikkus nii isiklikus kui ka üldisemas mõttes on tema loomingu mõistmise üks võtmeid. Anu Põdra loomingut võib vaadata kui filosoofilist autobiograafiat, millest aimub konkreetset, vahetut, intiimset kogemust. Ta astus Eesti kunstiellu 1970. aastate teisel poolel, olles mõjutatud pop-kunsti arsenalist ning samas avatud sürrealistlikele mõtteseostele. Põderi aktiivsus kunstnikuna oli äärmiselt kõrge üle kolmekümne loominguaasta. Ta oli kauaaegne õppejõud kunstiakadeemias ning Tallinna Kunstikoolis. Lisaks pälvis ta Eesti Kunstnike Liidu noortekoondise preemia (1979), Eesti Kunstnike Liidu preemia (1990), Riia skulptuurikvadriennaali preemia (2000) ja Kristjan Raua preemia (2008). Põder lõpetas 1969. aastal Tartu Kunstikooli ja 1976. aastal ERKI skulptuuri erialal. Anu Põder on üks väheseid eesti skulptoreid, kes on äratanud kõige erinevate huvide ja hoiakute, erinevas vanuses kuraatorite-kriitikute tähelepanu. Teda on oma kuraatoriprojektidesse tahtnud tema eakaaslased, aga ta on olnud samavõrd köitev ka päris noortele kuraatoritele, kunstiteadlastele või kunstnikele. Ta on kasutanud oma loomingus kõikvõimalikke materjale, sageli selliseid, millel pole traditsioonilise skulptuuriga midagi pistmist. Ta mõtles materjalis ja materjali kaudu: materjali tähenduslikkus, nii isiklikus, aga ka üldisemas mõttes, on tema loomingu mõistmise üks võtmeid. Anu Põdra loomingut võib vaadata kui filosoofilist kollektiivset autobiograafiat, ühismälu, millest aimub konkreetset, vahetut, intiimset kogemust. Anu Põder omandas kunstihariduse kõigepealt Tartu Kunstikoolis, mille lõpetas 1970. aastal ja seejärel Eesti Riiklikus Kunstiinstituudis, mille lõpetas 1976. aastal skulptuuri erialal. 1989. aastast õpetas ta Tallinna Kunstikoolis, 1993. aastast Eesti Kunstiakadeemias. 1994. aastal pälvis ta aasta õpetaja aunimetuse, 2000. aastal Riia skulptuurikvadriennaali preemia ja 2008. aastal Kristjan Raua aastapreemia.
artists.ben:
Anu Põder (1947–2013) was an Estonian sculptor and installation artist. Throughout her career, she experimented with new abstract forms and a variety of materials from plaster and wood, charcoal and textile, to light, scent and taste. Põder's work was inspired by her own experience as well as her surroundings and environment in the city and in countryside, at home and at work. Põder's pieces were time and site specific and created to be exhibited as such – the presence of the artwork relied on a performative effect, meaning the artworks disintegrate over time.

Põder's work can be viewed in two chapters: the first, facing inward, looking at a young woman's journey to motherhood and being a middle aged woman at the very end of the Soviet period; the second chapter sees the artist slowly turning her gaze outward and commenting on social processes in the newly independent Estonia. Põder's early work did not fall in line with the principles of the so-called bronze age, when Estonian sculptors were casting an extraordinary number of monuments and portrait statues – she did not work with bronze, but followed the formal experimentation direction prevalent at the time, guiding her from Surrealism to depictions of pop culture and everyday life.

Already during her studies, Põder began depicting people as dolls, created by using wire structures, plaster, cotton and textile. In the second half of the 1980s she added plastic to her selection of materials – one of the earliest examples of that decade by Põder is “Big doll which was made to sit” (1982). Additionally, in the 1980s Põder created a number of abstract sculptures made of burlap, plastic, paint, tar, textile filling and metal, such as “Composition with a net”, “Composition with strings”, “Composition with red gloves” (all 1983) and “Very old memories” (1985). The sharp tips in these compositions seem to symbolise a defensive position that protects what is held dear from the robustness of the outside. In the second half of the 1980s Põder began experimenting with pinkish plastic sheets, used in medicine at the time. These plastic sheets were sewn together to create compositions of female torsos, such as “On one foot from Lasnamäe” and “With a brass wind instrument from Lasnamäe” (1988) as well as her most know works “Figure which was made to walk” and “Man’s head with a flag” (both 1984).

In the 1990s Anu Põder completed her series of dolls, including works like “Rolled-up figure” (1992), “Coiled” (1993), “Composition with a hanging head” (1994) and “Light Stuffed Figure” (2001). Põder's work went through a.

Laura Põld (1984) is an artist whose work deals with the history of materials and objects as well as the environment, exploring ways of organizing space and basic cross-species needs, such as security, habitat, and community. Põld’s installations seek a dialogue with their location and its historical and political context. Her works are created by combining textile, wood, found objects, ceramics, and video.

(2016), the artist opened up the veils of her poetic perception, allowing visitors to be simultaneously in a pine forest, on a dock, by salt water, in the mountains, and in a castle courtyard. Mixing different temporal and spatial experiences from Estonia, Austria, and Japan, she exhibited raku-fired ceramics, marble-effect installations, and painted sculptures whose patterned surfaces revealed shifts in perspective. In her later work, Põld has focused on the choice of materials and their historical context, using traditional craft techniques such as ceramics and embroidery, which are of interest to the artist as repositories of memory and experience.

Laura Põld’s exhibitions in recent years have focused mainly on the relationship between man and nature, and on environmental issues. As part of the Estonia 100 art project

(2018), Põld integrated an alternative environment into the permanent exhibition of the Kunda Cement Museum, examining the history of the town of Kunda, its manufacturing industry and its natural resources. She experimented with natural clay pottery techniques, creating monumental objects that incorporated both the town’s historical markers and found fossils. The desire to juxtapose man-made landscape elements with natural materials continued in the exhibition.

artists.b: Eesti maalikunstnik, pedagoog ja ühiskonnategelane Enn PÕLDROOS (1933, Tallinn) on viljelenud peamiselt figuraalkompositsiooni ja portreed (teda on nimetatud ka inimeste ja inimsuhete maalijaks). Lülitus kohe pärast õpingute lõpetamist kunstiellu ja püüdis väljendada enda ja oma põlvkonnakaaslaste uudseid seisukohti ning vastanduda senisele lihtsameelselt idealiseerivale või liialdatud suurejoonelisele tegelikkusekujutusele nähtuste olemuse kunstilise üldistusega. Põldroos äratas tähelepanu mõnevõrra rohmaka käsitluslaadiga; paljudes maalides avaldub 1960. aastate nn. karm stiil, millele on iseloomulikud lihtne vorm, selge terav kontuur ja napp värvivalik. Kümnendi vältel kujunevad välja Põldroosi loomingu eriomased jooned: silueti ja detaili rõhutamine, dissoneerival vastandusel (nt. mehaaniline-orgaaniline, geomeetriline-maaliline) rajanev kompositsioon, olukordade konfliktsuse ja dramaatilisuse esiletoomine. Loonud ka poeetilistel sümbolkujunditel põhinevaid eksistentsialistlikke teoseid. 1960. aastate lõpus kunstniku loomelaad muutub ning see avaldub hoogsas ekspressiivses pintslikäsitluses ja erksas koloriidis. Uue värvikäsitluse otsingud avalduvad eeskätt portreedes, milles rõhutab kujutatava rikast vaimuelu ja sisemist energiat; mõningatesse teostesse tekib groteski-varjund. Kunstihariduse omandas Põldroos ERKIs, töötas sealsamas ka õppejõuna (oli maalikateedri juhataja; aastast 1978 dotsent). /tekst Liisi Aibel, 2013/.

Alustas vabagraafika ja abstraktse maaliloominguga ("Kaarjas pingestatus" 1963). Oli rühmituse "Visarid" (1967-72) asutaja ja liidreid, lõi sel ajal pop- ja op-kunsti mõjulisi maale ("Kurbus" 1968), tegeles kineetilise kunsti ("Ringlemine IV" 1966), assamblaaþi ("Kandam" 1967), ready-mad'i ("Vaikus" 1968) ja kollaaþiga ("Meelerahu" 1968). Huvitus psühhedeelsest kunstist. hilisema, metsotintotehnikas graafika teemad seonduvad soome-ugri mütoloogiaga (sari "Kodalased" 1973-75), väljendavad eestlaste rahvusliku iseolemise püüdlusi (sari "Kalivägi" 1978-84), inimese ja maailmakõiksuse suhteid (sari "Taevas ja Maa" 1987-91) ja elu igavikulisust (sari "Kirgastumine" 1991-95). Aastast 1993 teinud ruumilisi objekte ("Mõtteseisund" 1998) ning maale, mille eesmärk on luua kolmemõõtmelisuse ("Kaugustesse" 1998) ja võimatute maailmade ("Astmed" 1999) pettekujutlus. Kujundanud raamatuid, teinud eksliibriseid. Uurinud aastast 1978 EKA üliõpilastega sugulashõimude rahvakunsti, kivilabürinte ja Karjala kaljujooniseid ning asutanud nendel uurimisreisidel osalenutest rühmitise "Ydi" (1998). Avaldanud oma loomingu ja uurimistöö teemalisi kirjutisi ("Kakskümmend soome-ugri uurimisreisi" 1999, "Hiiumaa rahvapärane ehituskunst" 2004).
artists.ben: He began with free graphic art and abstract painting ("Kaarjas pingestatus" 1963). He was a founder and one of the leaders of the group "Visarid" (1967-72), creating during that time paintings influenced by pop art and op art ("Kurbus" 1968), and worked with kinetic art ("Ringlemine IV" 1966), assemblage ("Kandam" 1967), ready-made ("Vaikus" 1968) and collage ("Meelerahu" 1968). He was interested in psychedelic art. The themes of his later graphic art, made in mezzotint technique, are connected with Finno-Ugric mythology (series "Kodalased" 1973-75), express the aspirations of Estonians' national self-existence (series "Kalivägi" 1978-84), the relations between man and the universe (series "Taevas ja Maa" 1987-91), and the eternity of life (series "Kirgastumine" 1991-95). From 1993 he has made spatial objects ("Mõtteseisund" 1998) as well as paintings, the aim of which is to create the illusion of three-dimensionality ("Kaugustesse" 1998) and of impossible worlds ("Astmed" 1999). He has designed books and made ex libris. From 1978 he has, together with EKA students, studied the folk art of kindred peoples, stone labyrinths and Karelian rock carvings, and founded, from among the participants of these research trips, the group "Ydi" (1998). He has published writings on his creative and research work ("Kakskümmend soome-ugri uurimisreisi" 1999, "Hiiumaa rahvapärane ehituskunst" 2004).

artists.b: Töötas õpetajana Põltsamaal ning Tartus kutse- ja keskkoolides, oli 1943–1944 Pallase ja 1944–1951 Tartu Riikliku Kunstiinstituudi dekaan 1951–1957 töötas ERKI-s ja aastast 1957 asus tööle Tartu ülikooli.
artists.ben: Worked as a teacher in Põltsamaa and in vocational and secondary schools in Tartu, was dean of Pallas in 1943–1944 and of the Tartu State Art Institute in 1944–1951, worked at ERKI in 1951–1957 and from 1957 took up work at the University of Tartu.

artists.b: Ede Raadik (s. 1989) on Tallinna kunstnik, kes kaitses 2015. aastal magistrikraadi Eesti Kunstiakadeemia graafikaosakonnas. Enamasti töötab ta kontseptualistlikule kunstile omases seeriaformaadis. Selaljuures kasutab ta fotograafiat selleks, et näitlikustada, kuidas me sageli (väär)tõlgendame visuaalset informatsiooni. Mahukas seerias.
artists.ben: Ede Raadik (b. 1989) is a Tallinn-based artist who defended her master's degree in 2015 in the Graphic Art department of the Estonian Academy of Arts. She mostly works in the series format typical of conceptualist art. In doing so she uses photography to demonstrate how we often (mis)interpret visual information. In the extensive series.

artists.b: Rein Raamat (s. 1931) on Eesti joonisfilmirežissöör, kunstnik ja stsenarist. Ta on esimene rahvusvaheliselt edukas eesti animaator ning koos Elbert Tuganoviga viidatakse Rein Raamatule sageli kui Eesti animatsiooni isale. Joonisfilmi ja animatsioonikunsti vallas alustas Raamat tegevust juba varastel 1970. aastatel; ta on ka enam kui 20 dokumentaalfilmi autor.
artists.wdesc: Estonian animation film director, artist and screenwriter (born 1931)
artists.ben: Rein Raamat (b. 1931) is an Estonian animated film director, artist and screenwriter. He is the first internationally successful Estonian animator, and together with Elbert Tuganov, Rein Raamat is often referred to as the father of Estonian animation. Raamat began his work in animated film and the art of animation as early as the early 1970s; he is also the author of more than 20 documentary films.

artists.b: Haridus: 2000–2003 Tallinna Pedagoogikaülikool, film ja video; 1993 Tallinna Sidekool, fotograafia.
artists.ben: Education: 2000–2003 Tallinn Pedagogical University, film and video; 1993 Tallinn School of Communications, photography.

artists.b: Sündinud 24.11.1968. Haridus: Õppinud Viljandi 5. Keskkoolis.
artists.ben: Born 24.11.1968. Education: Studied at Viljandi Secondary School No. 5.

artists.b: RANDEL, Felix (1901, Valga – 1977, Tallinn). Eesti maalikunstnik ja karikaturist, kes on viljelenud ekspressionismimõjulist vabagraafikat, intensiivsete värvidega kubistlikus stiilis maneristlikku figuurimaali ja hiljem ka realistlikus laadis maali. Karikatuuriloomingust on silmapaistvaimad kultuuriinimeste tabavalt karakteriseeritud saržid. Kunstihariduse omandas Randel Penza ning Pallase kunstikoolides; töötas J. Tombi nimelise Kultuuripalee peakunstnikuna, ajakirja Pikker karikaturistina ja Tarbekunsti Keskuse kujundustööde ateljee juhatajana. /tekst Liisi Aibel, 2013/.

artists.ben:
Tanel Rander (1980) is an artist, curator, and writer, whose creative work includes experimental practices based in language and psychology, and critical study of Eastern-European discourse and decolonisation. The focus of Rander’s work is the tension between subjectivity and the modifying pressure it experiences between interior and exterior.

One of Rander’s areas of focus is psycho-geography; in his work however, Rander removed the existing contextual specifics of the term, believing that identifying with the subjectivity of the western metropolis, in a post-socialist periphery, brings countless problems. Since 2010 his work has been exploratory and theoretical, focused on the discourse of Eastern-Europe, through the lens of decolonisation. Rander’s work has had three solo exhibitions relating to this area of study: ‘Decolonise This!’ (2012, Y-Gallery, Tartu), ‘No Borders – No Difference?’ (2013, Tartu Art House) and ‘The Frontline East (2015, LCCA, Riga). The solo exhibition ‘Third Way’ (2016, Tallinn City Gallery) can be taken as the mid-point of this six year survey. For the exhibition Rander considered the genealogy of institutional contemporary art and presented his view using a hybrid of a guillotine and K. Malevich’s Black Square as the central figure. The effect of the guillotine – as Rander puts it – lies in the cultural, yet not principal, revolution of Eastern-Europe in 1989, during which bronze heads fell instead of human heads. Among other things, Rander explores ways to bring those fallen heads of socialist monumental art back to a contemporary art context, retaining but re-contextualising their original significance. Third Way is an on-going process, which will develop according to the socio-political situation in Eastern-Europe and its accompanying mainstream discourse.

During 2017 and 2018 Rander will execute a collective survey in the border-town of Valga/Valka between Latvia and Estonia, titled ‘100 poplars’, paraphrasing the campaign ‘100 oaks’ run by the government of the Estonian Republic. The project focuses on national identity between borders, and asks if and how this is expressed in the nation-state of a common border-town.

Tanel Rander has collaborated with several artists and groups, including a long-term collaboration with language scientist and writer Erkki Luuk, resulting in the exhibitions ‘Kesktalvine hnott’ (2010, Tallinn City Gallery) and ‘Uridaadi lõpp’ (2010, Y-Gallery, Tartu), the book Tammeöö (2012) and a number of public performances. Rander has also worked with the creative collective 10x10m for the happening.

German engraver, steel engraver, illustrator and draftsman
Estonian textile artist, writer and university teacher (born 1943)

artists.b: National romantic draughtsman; his charcoal Kalevipoeg cycle defined how Estonians picture their epic.
artists.ben: National romantic draughtsman; his charcoal Kalevipoeg cycle defined how Estonians picture their epic.

artists.b: Aastal 1902 õpetaja Wieckmanni eestvõttel ja Konsistooriumi loal vahetati kappaltar (B. Notke, 1483) kui luterlikku kirikusse sobimatu katolikuaegne ese uue altariseina vastu välja. 1929 oli koguduse nõukogu nõus olnud kappaltarit Muuseumiühingule kinkima, aga seoses kiriku renoveerimistöödega 1933, hakati taotlema selle tagasisaamist. Muuseumiühing ei nõustunud, vaatamata eksperthinnangutele, mis pidasid hoiupaika Toomkirikus altarile sobimatuks. Alles 18. detsembril 1942 taaspühitseti kappaltar omal kohal. (allikas:Kultuurimälestiste riiklik register);.
artists.ben: In 1902, on the initiative of teacher Wieckmann and with the permission of the Consistory, the winged altarpiece (B. Notke, 1483), as a Catholic-era object unsuitable for a Lutheran church, was replaced with a new altar wall. In 1929 the parish council had agreed to donate the winged altarpiece to the Museum Society, but in connection with the church's renovation works in 1933, efforts began to have it returned. The Museum Society did not agree, despite expert assessments that considered the storage place in the Cathedral unsuitable for the altarpiece. Only on 18 December 1942 was the winged altarpiece reconsecrated in its own place. (source: National Register of Cultural Monuments);.

artists.b: Sündis Lätis Lugaži (Luke) vallas talus, õppis Valga linnakoolis ja Penza kunstikool. Osales Vabadussõjas. Töötas joonistusõpetajana 1920-25 Tartus, 1925-29 Tallinnas. Oli 1923 Eesti Kunstnike Rühma asutajaid. Tegi Vabadussõja mälestusmärkide kavandeid, skulptorina oli edukas ja andekas iseõppija.va.
artists.ben: Born on a farm in Lugaži (Luke) parish in Latvia, studied at Valga Town School and Penza Art School. Took part in the War of Independence. Worked as a drawing teacher 1920-25 in Tartu, 1925-29 in Tallinn. Was one of the founders of the Estonian Artists' Group in 1923. Made designs for War of Independence memorials, as a sculptor was a successful and talented autodidact.

artists.b: Oskar RAUNAM (1914, Paide – 1992, Tallinn) oli eesti maalikunstnik ja pedagoog, kes on loonud realistlikke maastiku-, lille- ja portreemaale ning figuraalkompositsioone; lisaks sellele avaldanud mitmeid õpikuid, nt „Akvarellimaal“ (1952) ja „Joonistamise ja maalimise õpik“ (1961, 1963). Kunstihariduse omandas Raunam dekoratsioonimaalierialal Riigi Kunsttööstuskoolis, joonistus- ja joonestusõpetaja erialal Tallinna Pedagoogiumis ning maalierialal Johannes Greenbergi juhendamisel Riigi Kõrgemas Kunstikoolis. Töötas ERKIs joonistus- ja maaliõppejõuna, õppe- ja teadusprorektorina ning üldmaalikateedri juhatajana. /tekst Liisi Aibel, 2013/.
artists.ben: Oskar RAUNAM (1914, Paide – 1992, Tallinn) was an Estonian painter and pedagogue who created realistic landscape, flower and portrait paintings as well as figural compositions; he also published several textbooks, e.g. "Akvarellimaal" (1952) and "Joonistamise ja maalimise õpik" (1961, 1963). Raunam obtained his art education in the decoration painting speciality at the State School of Applied Arts, in the drawing and draughting teacher speciality at the Tallinn Pedagogium, and in the painting speciality under the guidance of Johannes Greenberg at the State Higher Art School. He worked at ERKI as a teacher of drawing and painting, as vice-rector for study and research, and as head of the general painting department. /text by Liisi Aibel, 2013/.

artists.b: Aira Rautso (s. 1954) on eesti maalikunstnik ja kunstiõpetaja. Ta lõpetas Tallinna Ülikooli 1978. aastal ning on alates 1980. aastast töötanud kunstiõpetajana Jõhvi Kunstikoolis. Aira Rautso on Eesti Maalikunstnike Liidu liige alates 2008. aastast. Ta on osalenud arvukatel isiku- ja grupinäitustel Eestis ning välismaal, sealhulgas Skandinaavias ja Saksamaal.
artists.ben: Aira Rautso (b. 1954) is an Estonian painter and art teacher. She graduated from Tallinn University in 1978 and has worked since 1980 as an art teacher at the Jõhvi Art School. Aira Rautso has been a member of the Estonian Painters' Association since 2008. She has participated in numerous solo and group exhibitions in Estonia and abroad, including in Scandinavia and Germany.

artists.b: Loomingus (raamatukujundused, auaadressid, plakatid, eksliibrised, tarbegraafika) on määrav osa kunstilisel kirjal. Edendanud srifti, eriti gooti kirja ja antiikvat, muuseas lõi ruunikirja alusel algupärase hübriidkirja. Raamatukujundusi: G. Boccaccio "dekameron" (1957), W. Shakespeare'i "Kogutud teosed" (1959, ümbris), "Eesti graafika" (1963)
artists.ben: In his work (book design, testimonials of honour, posters, ex-libris, applied graphic art) artistic lettering plays a decisive role. He advanced type design, especially Gothic script and antiqua, and among other things created an original hybrid script based on runic writing. Book designs: G. Boccaccio's "Decameron" (1957), W. Shakespeare's "Collected Works" (1959, cover), "Estonian Graphic Art" (1963)

artists.b: Toomas Rein (s. 1940) on Eesti arhitekt ja akvarellist. Ta lõpetas Tallinna Polütehnikumi tööstus- ja tsiviilehituse erialal ning 1967. aastal Eesti Riikliku Kunstiinstituudi arhitektuuriteaduskonna. Pälvis 1986. aastal Riias toimunud Baltimaade akvarellitriennaalil peapreemia. 2011. aastal valmis režissöör Peeter Brambati film “Ehituskunstnik Toomas Rein”.
artists.ben: Toomas Rein (b. 1940) is an Estonian architect and watercolourist. He graduated from the Tallinn Polytechnic in industrial and civil construction and, in 1967, from the Faculty of Architecture of the Estonian State Art Institute. He received the grand prize at the Baltic Watercolour Triennial held in Riga in 1986. In 2011, director Peeter Brambat's film "Ehituskunstnik Toomas Rein" ("Architect Toomas Rein") was completed.

artists.b: Sündis tolliametniku peres, 1897 asus perekond elama Tallinna, 1914-1915 reisiti Prantsusmaal, Hispaanias ja Skandinaavias. 1915-1919 töötas Reindorff Petrogradis ja Moskvas väärtpaberitrükikojas. 1920 opteerus Eesti Vabariiki. 1920-1943 oli Riigi Kunsttööstuskooli õppejõud, algul õpetaja, alates 1922 graafika õppetöökoja juhataja ja 1936 graafika osakonna juhataja. Rajas kooli graafikaklassi, litograafia- (1920) ning trüki- ja tsinkograafiatöökoja (1923). 1922-1932 tegi konsultandina koostööd Riigi Trükikojaga, samuti töötas koos reklaamibüroodega Ilo, Ole ja Gravis. 1932 oli Rakenduskunsti ühingu RaKÜ asutajaliige. 1950-1958 ERKI (EKA) õppejõud (1951 professor)
artists.wdesc: Estonian and Soviet artist and graphic designer (1889–1974)
grp: school:Saint Petersburg Stieglitz State Academy of Art and Design
artists.ben: Born into the family of a customs official, in 1897 the family moved to Tallinn; in 1914-1915 he travelled in France, Spain and Scandinavia. In 1915-1919 Reindorff worked at a securities printing house in Petrograd and Moscow. In 1920 he opted for the Republic of Estonia. In 1920-1943 he was a lecturer at the State School of Applied Art, initially a teacher, from 1922 head of the printmaking workshop, and in 1936 head of the printmaking department. He founded the school's printmaking class, the lithography workshop (1920) and the printing and zincography workshop (1923). In 1922-1932 he worked as a consultant in cooperation with the State Printing House, and also worked with the advertising agencies Ilo, Ole and Gravis. In 1932 he was a founding member of the Applied Art Society RaKÜ. In 1950-1958 he was a lecturer at ERKI (EKA) (professor in 1951)

artists.b: Näitustel osaleb aastast 2003. On teinud viis isiknäitust ja osalenud grupi- ja ühis- näitustel ning projektides Eestis ja välismaal. Tööd on eksponeeritud mitmetes kodudes ja kontorites, samuti Tartu Teaduspargis ja Tartu Ülikoolis. Kuulub Eesti Maalikunstnike Liitu.
artists.ben: Has participated in exhibitions since 2003. Has held five solo exhibitions and taken part in group and joint exhibitions and projects in Estonia and abroad. Works have been displayed in various homes and offices, as well as in Tartu Science Park and the University of Tartu. Member of the Estonian Painters' Association.

artists.b: Lilli-Krõõt Repnau (s. 1982) on lõpetanud Eesti Kunstiakadeemia graafikaosakonna aastal 2005 ja magistriõpingud animatsiooni valdkonnas aastal 2015. Lisaks on ta end õpingute käigus täiendanud Šveitsis, Lutserni Ülikooli Kunsti- ja Disainikolledži videoosakonnas. Aastal 2010 tunnustati Lilli-Krõõt Repnau graafikaloomingut Edmund Valtmani stipendiumiga. Ta on Eesti Kunstnike Liidu ja Eesti Vabagraafikute Ühenduse liige.
artists.ben: Lilli-Krõõt Repnau (b. 1982) graduated from the Estonian Academy of Arts, Department of Graphic Art, in 2005, and completed her master's studies in the field of animation in 2015. She has also furthered her studies in Switzerland, at the video department of the Lucerne University of Art and Design. In 2010 Lilli-Krõõt Repnau's graphic art was recognised with the Edmund Valtman Scholarship. She is a member of the Estonian Artists' Association and the Estonian Association of Printmakers.

artists.b: Linda Rida loomingule on iseloomulik maaliline pehmus ja tundlik käsitluslaad. Ühenduses värvirõõmsa, elava, tundeerksa käsitlusega kõneleb see elujaatavast looduse ja ümbruse kunstilisest vastuvõtust, mis väärib rõhutavat väljatõstmist eriti praeguses karmis tõelisuses.
artists.ben: Linda Rida's work is characterised by a painterly softness and a sensitive manner of handling. Combined with a colour-joyful, lively, emotionally sensitive treatment, this speaks of a life-affirming artistic reception of nature and surroundings, which deserves particular emphasis especially in the present harsh reality.

artists.b: Tuntud eelkõige portretistina. Tema portreedele on omane 1960. aastatele iseloomulik jõuline tahuline vorm, mis aastakümne lõpus muutus lüürilisemaks ja natuurijärgivamaks, seda eelkõige naisi portreteerivates skulptuurides. Ta on loonud ka figuuriplastikat, peamiselt naisakte, samuti Tartu Ülikooliga seotud teadlaste portreereljeefe ülikooli hoonetes ning Eesti kultuuritegelaste mälestusmärke.
artists.ben: Known primarily as a portraitist. His portraits are characterised by the vigorous faceted form typical of the 1960s, which by the end of the decade became more lyrical and naturalistic, this above all in sculptures portraying women. He has also created figural plastic works, mainly female nudes, as well as portrait reliefs of scholars connected with the University of Tartu in the university's buildings, and monuments to Estonian cultural figures.

artists.b: Piret Rohusaar (1961) keskendub oma maalipraktikas muusikale, eeskätt jazzile, mille kaudu ta uurib rütmi, kohalolu, muusika ja kujutatava vahelist nähtamatut pin- gevälja. Kunstniku portreedes on ühendatud äratuntav kujutis ja muusikaline, voolavalt maaliline käsitlus, kus sulanduvad figuur ja atmosfäär. Rohusaar on lõpeta- nud ERKI maali eriala (1988) ning osalenud kunstielus nii arvukate isiku- kui ka rühmanäitustega. Ta on Eesti Maalikunstnike Liidu ja Eesti Kunstnike Liidu liige.
artists.ben: Piret Rohusaar (1961) focuses in her painting practice on music, especially jazz, through which she explores rhythm, presence, and the invisible field of tension between music and the depicted subject. In Rohusaar's portraits, a recognisable image is combined with a musical, fluidly painterly treatment, in which figure and atmosphere merge. Rohusaar graduated from ERKI in painting (1988) and has participated in art life with numerous solo and group exhibitions. She is a member of the Estonian Painters' Association and the Estonian Artists' Association.

artists.wdesc: English artist involved in printmaking and watercolour (1785-1863)

artists.b: 1943 lõpetas Tallinna Jakob Westholmi gümnaasiumi. 1944–1947 õppis Tartu Riiklikus Kunstiinstituudis (õppejõud Ado Vabbe ja Elmar Kits). 1947 sügissemestril õppis Tallinna Riiklikus Tarbekunsti Instituudis (õppejõud Johannes Võerahansu ja Lepo Mikko). 1956–1959 õppis Eesti Riiklikus Kunstiinstituudis, lõpetades selle maalikunstniku diplomiga.
artists.ben: In 1943 he graduated from the Jakob Westholm Gymnasium in Tallinn. In 1944–1947 he studied at the Tartu State Art Institute (lecturers Ado Vabbe and Elmar Kits). In the autumn semester of 1947 he studied at the Tallinn State Institute of Applied Art (lecturers Johannes Võerahansu and Lepo Mikko). In 1956–1959 he studied at the Estonian State Art Institute, graduating with a diploma in painting.

artists.b: 1939 kunstiühingu Pallas liige. 1941 oli J. Koorti nim. Riigi Rakenduskunsti Kooli õppejõud ja mobiliseeriti seejärel nõukogude armeesse. 1942-44 töötas Moskvas skulptorina. 1944-46 Tallinna Riikliku Kunstiinstituudi, 1947-83 ERKI õppejõud (alates 1958 professor, 1962-77 skulptuuri kateedri juhataja)
artists.ben: In 1939 member of the art association Pallas. In 1941 he was a lecturer at the J. Koort State School of Applied Art and was subsequently mobilised into the Soviet army. In 1942-44 he worked in Moscow as a sculptor. In 1944-46 lecturer at the Tallinn State Art Institute, in 1947-83 at ERKI (from 1958 professor, 1962-77 head of the sculpture department)

artists.b: Kasvas üles Järvamaal, Nõmküla vallas Remmiku talus. Kunsti õppis alates 1901 Paide Karskuse Kuratooriumi joonistuskursustel, mida juhatas Rudolf Lepik, 1906 Peterburis Stieglitzi kunsttööstuskoolis, 1907 Münchenis Michael Zeno Diemeri ja Heinrich Heidneri ateljeedes. 1910 jätkas õpinguid Peterburis, Kunstide edendamise seltsi kunstikoolis, kus ta õpetaja oli Ivan Bilibin. 1913 sai joonistusõpetaja kutse. 1909 esines esmakordselt kunstinäitusel Tartus. I maailmasõja ajal oli tsaariarmees, tegi rindejoonistusi. 1918 oli Roosileht Põltsamaa Reaalgümnaasiumi joonistusõpetaja, alates 1919 Paide gümnaasiumi õpetaja. 1920 abiellus Magda Angelusega. Hukkus 1941 augustis mahalaskmisel.
artists.ben: Grew up in Järvamaa, in Nõmküla parish, at Remmiku farm. Studied art from 1901 at the drawing courses of the Paide Karskuse Kuratoorium, led by Rudolf Lepik, in 1906 at the Stieglitz School of Technical Drawing in St. Petersburg, in 1907 in the studios of Michael Zeno Diemer and Heinrich Heidner in Munich. In 1910 continued his studies in St. Petersburg at the art school of the Society for the Encouragement of the Arts, where his teacher was Ivan Bilibin. In 1913 received the qualification of drawing teacher. In 1909 exhibited for the first time at an art exhibition in Tartu. During the First World War he served in the Tsarist army, making front-line drawings. In 1918 Roosileht was the drawing teacher at Põltsamaa Realgymnasium, from 1919 a teacher at Paide Gymnasium. In 1920 married Magda Angelus. Perished by shooting in August 1941.

artists.wdesc: Canadian painter, lithographer, and muralist of Estonian origin (1932-2026)

artists.b: Sündinud Tallinnas 1945. aastal. Kunstihariduse omandas Eesti Riiklikus Kunstiinstituudis, mille lõpetas maali erialal 1969. Eesti Kunstnike Liidu liige alates 1979. aastast. Näitustel esineb alates 1970. aastast.1992.aastast Eesti Kunstiakadeemia õppejõud. Eesti Maalikunstnike Liidu Eestseisuse liige alates 1997 aastast. Eesti akvarellistide ühenduse liige 2002 . 2006.a. Eesti Maalikunstnike Liidu esimees.
artists.ben: Born in Tallinn in 1945. He received his art education at the Estonian State Art Institute, graduating in painting in 1969. Member of the Estonian Artists' Union since 1979. Has taken part in exhibitions since 1970. Since 1992 a lecturer at the Estonian Academy of Arts. Member of the Board of the Estonian Painters' Association since 1997. Member of the Estonian Watercolourists' Association 2002. In 2006 chairman of the Estonian Painters' Association.

artists.b: Uno Roosvalt on tunnustust pälvinud kogu loometee vältel, sh on talle omistatud Moskva Noortenäituse diplom (1972, 1975), NSVL Rahvamajandusnäituse pronksmedal (1984), Pühajärve preemia (1993 ja 1994), Maalijate Liidu preemia (2000) ja Konrad Mäe preemia (2011)
artists.ben: Uno Roosvalt has received recognition throughout his creative career, including the diploma of the Moscow Youth Exhibition (1972, 1975), the bronze medal of the USSR Exhibition of Economic Achievements (1984), the Pühajärve Prize (1993 and 1994), the Prize of the Painters' Association (2000) and the Konrad Mägi Prize (2011).

artists.b: Oli Venemaa kõrge riigiametnik, asehalduskorra üks loojaid. OliVene saatkonna sekretär Kopenhagenis ja 1749-1755 Londonis. 1756 Vene sõjaväes major, ülemkortrermeister, 1764-1776 Novgorodi kuberner, 1776-1781 Tveri, 1777 ka Pihkva ja Novgorodi asevalitseja, salanõuni. 1793 sai Venemaa saafdikuks Varssavis, jne. Abiellus oma onutütre Elisabeth von Sieversiga, kellest lahutati, naine abiellus vürst Putjatiniga, kellega elasid Dresdenis.
artists.ben: Was a high-ranking Russian state official, one of the creators of the vicegerency system. Was secretary of the Russian embassy in Copenhagen and in 1749-1755 in London. In 1756 major in the Russian army, ober-quartermaster, 1764-1776 Governor of Novgorod, 1776-1781 of Tver, 1777 also vice-governor of Pskov and Novgorod, privy councillor. In 1793 became Russia's envoy in Warsaw, etc. Married his cousin Elisabeth von Sievers, from whom he was divorced; the woman married Prince Putyatin, with whom they lived in Dresden.

artists.b: Baltisaksa kirjamees, estofiil ja pastor. Isa oli postijaamapidaja. Töötas Tori ja Pärnu kogudustes pastorina. Toimetas aastatel 1813–32 esimest eestiainelist teaduslikku sariväljaannet, ajakirja Beiträge zur genauern Kenntniss der ehstnischen Sprache. Tema eestvedamisel ehitati 1821. a Pärnus teatrimaja. Asutas 1814. a Pärnus Eesti koolmeistrite kooli, mis oli esimene teadaolev pedagoogikaõppeasutus, kus õpetati eesti keeles. Andis välja kooliraamatuid ning korraldas esimeste eestikeelsete näidendite lavastamist. Kogus õpilaste ja leerilaste abiga rahvaluulet. Tegeles aastakümneid eestikeelsete raamatute ja käsikirjade kogumise ning bibliografeerimisega.
artists.ben: A Baltic-German man of letters, Estophile and pastor. His father was a postmaster. He worked as a pastor in the congregations of Tori and Pärnu. From 1813 to 1832 he edited the first scholarly serial publication on Estonian subjects, the journal Beiträge zur genauern Kenntniss der ehstnischen Sprache. Under his leadership a theatre building was built in Pärnu in 1821. In 1814 he founded a school for Estonian schoolmasters in Pärnu, which was the first known pedagogical institution where teaching was conducted in Estonian. He published schoolbooks and organised the staging of the first plays in Estonian. With the help of pupils and confirmands he collected folklore. For decades he was engaged in collecting and bibliographing Estonian-language books and manuscripts.

artists.b: Linda ROSIN (1904, Lesnoi, Peterburi – 1981, Tallinn) oli eesti kujur, kes skulptuuri kõrval harrastas ka õlimaali. Skulptuuris viljeles peamiselt portreed ja figuraalkompositsiooni, portreedes omane teatud maneristlik laad. Kunstihariduse omandas Rosin Riigi Kunsttööstuskoolis naiskäsitööerialal (omandas muuhulgas ka joonistusõpetaja kutse), rakendusskulptuuri erialal Tallinna Rakenduskunsti Koolis ja skulptuurierialal Tallinna Riiklikus Tarbekunsti Instituudis, kus asus pärast lõpetamist tööle õppejõuna.
artists.ben: Linda ROSIN (1904, Lesnoi, St. Petersburg – 1981, Tallinn) was an Estonian sculptor who, alongside sculpture, also practised oil painting. In sculpture she worked mainly in portraiture and figural composition, her portraits having a certain mannerist quality. Rosin received her art education at the State School of Applied Art in the women's handicraft speciality (also obtaining a drawing teacher's qualification), in applied sculpture at the Tallinn School of Applied Art, and in sculpture at the Tallinn State Institute of Applied Art, where after graduating she began working as a teacher.

artists.b: Lembe Ruben (s. 1974) on lõpetanud Eesti Kunstiakadeemia graafika eriala. Magistrikraad vabades kunstides 2002. Wiiralti noore kunstniku preemia 2011. Ta on õpetanud graafikat, joonistamist ja kompositsiooni Eesti Kunstiakadeemias ja huvialaringides; kujundanud ja illustreerinud ajakirju ja raamatuid; tegelenud ka animatsiooni, lavakujunduse ja näituste kureerimisega.
artists.ben: Lembe Ruben (b. 1974) graduated from the Estonian Academy of Arts in the field of graphic art. Master's degree in fine arts 2002. Wiiralt Young Artist Prize 2011. She has taught graphic art, drawing, and composition at the Estonian Academy of Arts and in hobby groups; designed and illustrated magazines and books; and has also engaged in animation, stage design, and exhibition curating.

artists.b: Leho Rubis on lõpetanud Tartu Ülikooli maalikunsti bakalaureuseõppe 2001. aastal ja kunstiajaloo magistriõppe 2010. aastal. Loomingus süveneb Rubis teadvuse, teksti ja tajuväljade suhetesse. Rubise isiknäitused on toimunud Eestis, Indias ja Egiptuses. 2010. aastal kureeris ta eesti kunstnike ühisnäituse „Kingitus Arvo Pärdile“. Aastatel 2005–2023 oli ta kultuurifestivalide „Kolmkõla“ ja „PaIDA“ kunstiline juht. Alates 2021. aastast on ta Eesti Klassikaraadio saatesarja „Raaga aeg“ autor.
artists.ben: Leho Rubis completed his bachelor's studies in painting at the University of Tartu in 2001 and his master's studies in art history in 2010. In his work Rubis delves into the relationships between consciousness, text and fields of perception. Rubis's solo exhibitions have taken place in Estonia, India and Egypt. In 2010 he curated the joint exhibition of Estonian artists „A Gift to Arvo Pärt“. From 2005 to 2023 he was the artistic director of the cultural festivals „Kolmkõla“ and „PaIDA“. Since 2021 he has been the author of the Estonian Classical Radio programme series „Raaga aeg“.

artists.b: Geometric abstractionist; her 1970s urban design projects were decades early.
artists.ben:
Sirje Runge (1950) is a painter and designer, recognised for her geometric abstract and minimalist paintings. In her earlier work Runge combined geometric balance and disciplined expressions to create repetitions of geometric shapes. In parallel to her interest in geometric elements the artist also has a deep interest in colour, which, over time, has become the main focus of her work.

Runge belongs among the artists who in the beginning of the 1970s created the new and more radical wave of Estonian avant-garde art. During this decade, as Runge was finding herself as an artist, she was experimenting with various styles. Works from her early creative period (e.g. “Pigeon above the city”, 1970; “Tigers in the city”, 1969) are characteristic of her generation, displaying architectural and design aesthetics. In 1975 Runge defended her diploma work “Possibilities for shaping the milieu of Tallinn city centre” that has since gained international attention. The work, executed in a colourful aesthetic, envisioned utopian futures for the city of Tallinn. Together with Leonhard Lapin and Raul Meel, Runge was one of the initiators of “Harku '75”, a landmark exhibition in the Estonian artistic renewal of the 1970s.

Soon figures in Runge's work were replaced by geometric shapes: triangles, quadrangles and circles. This period is characterised by a regular and structured approach to shapes and colours (e.g. “Geometry XI”, 1976; “Space II”, 1977). Focusing on colour, by the beginning of the 1980s the artist developed a vision based exclusively on colour sensitivity. Art historian Eha Komissarov has written that during this period the artist entrusted colour with conveying her message. The geometric forms she uses carry significance primarily as vessels of colour.

In the end of the 1980s Runge's work mainly consisted of abstract paintings in delicate tones. In the ethereal, deep and finely painted colour field the meaningful aspects were based on the limitations of the tonal scale (e.g. “Catastrophe III”, 1987; “Catastrophe VII”, 1988). In the 1990s Runge continued with minimalist painting and created large-format oil paintings, such as the series “Shadows” (1993–1994) and “Architectones” (1998). In the 2000s the artist created works that she considers among the most significant in her oeuvre: “Dance macabre” (2001–2003), “Great love” (2003) and “Battle flags” (2006), the last painting series before Runge quit painting.

artists.b: Martti Ruus (snd 1968) on õppinud Tallinna Kunstiülikoolis arhitektuuri ja sisearhitektuuri. Maalikunstiga alustas 2011. aastal Konrad Mägi ateljees Tartus. Ruus vaatleb ja stiliseerib loodust läbi arhitektuurse ja koloristliku prisma. Minimalistlikud motiivid, teineteisest eristuvad värvipinnad, varjatud seoste leidmine on loomingu märksõnadeks. Näitustel, peamiselt Tartus, osaleb alates 2013 a.
artists.ben: Martti Ruus (b. 1968) studied architecture and interior architecture at the Estonian Academy of Arts in Tallinn. He began painting in 2011 in Konrad Mägi's studio in Tartu. Ruus observes and stylises nature through an architectural and coloristic prism. Minimalist motifs, colour surfaces distinguishing themselves from one another, and the search for hidden connections are keywords of his work. He has participated in exhibitions, mainly in Tartu, since 2013.

artists.wdesc: Estonian artist, writer, photographer, and environmentalist (born 1974)

artists.b: Martin Rästa (s. 1980) on graafiline disainer, interdistsiplinaarne kunstnik ja muusik, kes keskendub enda töödes heli ja visuaalse kunsti sünteesile ja integratsioonile, kasutades selleks erinevaid eksperimentaalseid vorme ja meediume. Tema tegevus toetub kognitiivsetele protsessidele ja empiirilisele tajule, mida saadab huvi eksistentsiaalsete küsimuste ja tehnoloogia vastu.
artists.ben: Martin Rästa (b. 1980) is a graphic designer, interdisciplinary artist and musician, who in his works focuses on the synthesis and integration of sound and visual art, using various experimental forms and media for this purpose. His activity is based on cognitive processes and empirical perception, accompanied by an interest in existential questions and technology.

artists.b: Sündis Moskvas vene- ja poola juurtega haritlasperes ning saabus oma juristidest vanematega Tallinna aastal 1956. Lõpetanud Tallinna 19. keskkooli, astus ta Eesti Riiklikku Kunstinstituuti, lõpetades õpingud 1972. aastal skulptorina.
artists.ben: Born in Moscow into a family of intellectuals with Russian and Polish roots, he arrived in Tallinn with his lawyer parents in 1956. Having finished Tallinn Secondary School No. 19, he entered the Estonian State Art Institute, completing his studies in 1972 as a sculptor.

artists.b: Pärast nüüdse Pelgulinna Gümnaasiumi lõpetamist 1976. aastal asus ta tööle toonasesse Noorsooteatrisse reklaamikujundajana. Geomeetriliste guaššijoonistustega jõudis Andrus Rõuk 1977. aastal oma esimese ühisnäituseni Tartu Ülikooli vanas kohvikus.
artists.ben: After graduating from what is now Pelgulinna Gymnasium in 1976, he started working at the then Youth Theatre as an advertising designer. With his geometric gouache drawings, Andrus Rõuk reached his first joint exhibition in 1977 at the old café of the University of Tartu.

artists.b: Õppis Võru gümnaasiumis, 1928-30 ja 1934-1939 Tartus, kunstikoolis Pallas, mille lõpetas graafikuna. 1942 võitis Haridusdirektooriumi ideekavandite võistlusel I preemia graafilise sarja kavandi eest "Lõuna-Eesti inimene ja loodus". 21.09.1944 siirdus eksiili, elas mitmel pool Saksamaal DP laagrites, 1949 asus USA-sse. Juhatas 1958-1973 Eesti kultuurfondi New Yorgis.
artists.ben: Studied at Võru Gymnasium, 1928-30 and 1934-1939 in Tartu, at the art school Pallas, which he graduated from as a graphic artist. In 1942 he won the I prize in the Education Directorate's design competition for the design of the print series "Lõuna-Eesti inimene ja loodus" [South Estonian man and nature]. On 21.09.1944 he went into exile, lived in various DP camps in Germany, in 1949 moved to the USA. He directed the Estonian Cultural Fund in New York from 1958-1973.

Tõnis Saadoja (1980) is a painter, working with figurative analysis and matters of personal history (writings) and “small histories”. His works are described by their conceptual structure and quest for the technically exclusive form in everyday motives. The use of series are prevailing in Saadoja’s ouvre, the selected motive varies in a multiple sequence of works. Using photography as a starting point, he deals with the deceptive un-pretentiousness but also its capacity to shape reality.

In Saadoja’s early painting series “The Melting of an Ice cube” (2003) and “Exercise” (2004) and “Exercise 2” (2010) which depict a wooden plank, it’s possible to notice a scale of instrumentality that also pops up in his later work. “The Melting of an Ice cube” depicts with conceptual consistency the process in which the invested energy and volume is in contradiction with the choice for undistinguished motive. Methodical repetitiveness and obsessive attention to detail are also expressed in his later work. With the series “Mainstream I-XX” (2005) Saadoja paraphrased Gerhard Richter’s painting series “48 portraits” which was exhibited in 1972 at the Venice Biennial. The basis of those paintings was a single portrait of a smiling Richter, depicted through different painting techniques and figure deformations.

Saadoja displays urban views in the series “Hometown Tallinn” (2007-2008), “14.06.09” (2009) and “Candle” (2011). “Hometown Tallinn” is a 94-part series of miniature aquarelles, which offer a cross-section of the development of urban space and different social reference points in the format of a souvenir. “14.06.09” is a 9-part light box series, which by blinking in sync, depict neglected nightly crossroads of Tallinn city centre. “Candle”, shown from a carousel, exposits a sequence of 64 photos of deterioratingurban settings, taken in similar geometrical composition.

Saadoja has created a painting, which is situated on the ceiling of a Stalinist building in Tallinn city centre, address Sakala 3. This 50-square metre artwork is one of the few contemporary monumental paintings in a public space. The circular painting depicts pine treetops, Saadoja binds the fleeting nature of monumental artworks derived from traces of degradation and pale monochromatic colouring.

artists.b: Sven Saag (s. 1968) on Eesti maali- ja graafikakunstnik. Ta on õppinud maalikunsti Tartu Ülikoolis maali õppetoolis aastatel 1991-1994. Kunstnik on osalenud arvukatel näitustel nii kodus- kui ka välismaal. Oma maalimisest räägib kunstnik: “Nagu restauraator, kes eemaldab värvikihte ja leiab nende alt järjest uusi figuure, vaateid, nägusid, võib ka oma maalidele läheneda sügavuti – kraapida maale ja avastada värvikihtide alt järjest uusi ja vanu pilte.” Aastast 2001 Eesti Kunstnike Liidu liige ja aastast 2008 Eesti Maalilkunstnike Liidu liige.
artists.ben: Sven Saag (b. 1968) is an Estonian painter and graphic artist. He studied painting at the Chair of Painting of the University of Tartu from 1991 to 1994. The artist has participated in numerous exhibitions both at home and abroad. The artist says of his painting: "Like a restorer who removes layers of paint and finds ever new figures, views, faces beneath them, one can also approach one's own paintings in depth — scrape the paintings and discover ever new and old images beneath the layers of paint." Since 2001 a member of the Estonian Artists' Association and since 2008 a member of the Estonian Painters' Association.

artists.b: Tartu maalikunstnik ja pedagoog. 1949 asus õppima Tartu Riiklikku Kunstiinstituuti maalikunsti erialale, 1955 lõpetas Eesti Riikliku Kunstiinstituudi. 1957-1992 töötas Tartu kunstikoolis joonistusõpetajana, seejärel, kuni pensionini minekuni ka maaliõpetajana.Näitustel hakkas esinema alates1956. aastast.
artists.ben: A Tartu painter and pedagogue. In 1949 he/she began studying painting at the Tartu State Art Institute, in 1955 graduated from the Estonian State Art Institute. From 1957-1992 he/she worked as a drawing teacher at the Tartu Art School, and thereafter, until retirement, also as a painting teacher. He/she began exhibiting at exhibitions from 1956.

artists.b: Õppis alates 1947. aastast Tartu Riiklikus Kunstiinstituudis, lõpetas 1953. aastal ERKI. Töötas aastatel 1953-1954 Tartu linna kultuurimajas ja 1954-1967 Kunstifondi Tartu osakonnas kunstnikuna ning 1967-1992 Tartu Kunstikoolis maaliõpetajana. Alates 1963. aastast Kunstnike Liidu liige.
artists.ben: He studied from 1947 at the Tartu State Art Institute, graduated from ERKI in 1953. He worked in 1953-1954 at the Tartu town culture house and in 1954-1967 at the Tartu department of the Art Fund as an artist, and in 1967-1992 as a painting teacher at the Tartu Art School. Member of the Artists' Union from 1963.

artists.b: Sten Saarits (s. 1987 Tallinnas) on installatsioonikunstnik, kelle loometöö peamiseks uurimisobjektiks on indiviidi suhestumine materiaalsusega ja enese positsioneerimine ruumis ning sündmuste ahelas. Sten kasutab oma teoste mõju vahendamiseks vaatajale erinevaid meediume. Peamiselt esineb kunstnik teostega, kus ta kasutab heli kui materjali erinevate vormide loomiseks, mida saab tajuda vaid akustilisel moel. Sten Saarits on õppinud Viini Kaunite Kunstide Akadeemias ja Eesti Kunstiakadeemias. Kunstnik on ka ennast täiendanud arvukate rahvusvaheliste workshopide ja praktika raames. Sten Saarits on pälvinud Noore Skulptori preemianäitusel teise koha (2012) ning grand prix (2013). Ta on saanud ka Eduard Wiiralti stipendiumi. Sten on osalenud näitustel ja grupiprojektides Eestis, Austrias, Rootsis, Taanis, Prantsusmaal ja Leedus.
artists.ben: Sten Saarits (b. 1987 in Tallinn) is an installation artist whose creative work primarily investigates the individual's relationship with materiality and self-positioning in space and in the chain of events. Sten uses various media to convey the effect of his works to the viewer. The artist mainly presents works in which he uses sound as a material to create various forms that can only be perceived acoustically. Sten Saarits has studied at the Vienna Academy of Fine Arts and at the Estonian Academy of Arts. The artist has also furthered his education through numerous international workshops and practical training. Sten Saarits has won second place (2012) and the grand prix (2013) at the Young Sculptor Award exhibition. He has also received the Eduard Wiiralt scholarship. Sten has taken part in exhibitions and group projects in Estonia, Austria, Sweden, Denmark, France and Lithuania.

artists.b: * 16.12. (vkj.); teistel andmetel sündis Mestnitsis (Kaluga kub.), kuid see võib oll vaid ta pärisorjuse aegse emanda pärusmõis.
artists.ben: * 16.12. (O.S.); according to other information he was born in Mestnitsy (Kaluga Governorate), but this may only be the hereditary estate of his mistress from the time of serfdom.

artists.b: Richard Sagrits alustas kunstiõpinguid 1928. aastal Riigi Kunsttööstuskoolis, kus õppis Roman Nymani juures dekoratsioonimaali ja Günther Reindorffi juures graafikat. 1930. aastal läks ta üle Pallasesse ja jätkas maaliõpinguid N. Triigi ning graafikaõpinguid A. Vabbe juhendusel. Kooli lõpetas R. Sagrits 1936. aastal.
artists.ben: Richard Sagrits began his art studies in 1928 at the State School of Applied Art, where he studied decorative painting under Roman Nyman and graphic art under Günther Reindorff. In 1930 he transferred to Pallas and continued his painting studies under N. Triik and graphic art studies under A. Vabbe. R. Sagrits graduated from the school in 1936.
