works.d: Eest vasemalt taha paremale looklev jõgi sillaga esiplaanil. Vasakul ja paremal jõe kaldal hooned.
works.de: A river winding from left to right in front, with a bridge in the foreground. Buildings on the left and right riverbanks.

works.d: Esiplaanil naise ja mehe figuurid vikatitega, paremal vankri juures hobune ja kaks inimfiguuri.
works.de: In the foreground figures of a woman and a man with scythes, on the right a horse and two human figures by a cart.

works.d: Esiplaanil lootsiku juures kolm meest vestlemas. Tagapool vasakul kaks naist, paremal mees tule ääres. Keskel jõekallas lotjadega, taamal linnamaju.
works.de: In the foreground, by a boat, three men talking. Further back on the left two women, on the right a man by a fire. In the centre a riverbank with barges, in the distance town houses.

works.d: Esiplaanil küntud põllulapp. Taamal veekogu ääres hoonete grupp. Horisondil mets.
works.de: In the foreground a ploughed field patch. In the distance a group of buildings by a body of water. Forest on the horizon.

works.d: Esiplaanil kaks palki maas, keskel üksiku männi juures maas istuv mees piibuga, selle kõrval püsti naine lapsega süles. Taamal ehitusel oleva maja juures töötav mees.
works.de: In the foreground two logs on the ground, in the middle a man sitting on the ground by a lone pine with a pipe, next to him a standing woman with a child in her lap. In the distance a man working by a house under construction.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal kivivedamise vanker, keskel kaks püstiseisvat inimkuju. 'nende taga vanker hobusega ja teisi seisvaid inimkujusid. Taamal üksik mänd ja talu õlgkatus.
works.de: In the foreground on the right a cart for hauling stone, in the middle two standing human figures, behind them a cart with a horse and other standing human figures. In the distance a solitary pine and a farm's thatched roof.

works.d: Paremal metsa ääres grupp mehi püsside ja sini-must-valgete käelintidega. Vasakul kaks üksikut meesfiguuri, neist üks ülessirutatud käega. Tagapool kaks naisfiguuri.
works.de: On the right, at the edge of the forest, a group of men with guns and blue-black-white armbands. On the left two single male figures, one of them with an arm raised. Behind them two female figures.

works.d: Laual maalitud teekann, pudel ja taldrik kahe sidruniga.
works.de: On the table, a painted teapot, a bottle and a plate with two lemons.

works.d: Esiplaanil muinasaegseid sõjamehi istumas, püsti ja hobustel, paremal ääres kaks naist seljaga vaataja suunas. Taamal hooneid.
works.de: In the foreground ancient warriors sitting, standing and on horseback, on the right edge two women with their backs to the viewer. Buildings in the distance.

works.d: Ees vasakul kuue haralise lehtpuu all pink ja laud toidunõudega. Laua juures kolme naise figuur. Paremal ees kivil istuv naine. Keset õue kaev loomajootmise künaga ja kahe inimfiguuriga. Taga õlgkatusega talumaja. Selle parempoolse nurga juures vanker ja kaks hobust.
works.de: In front on the left, under a six-branched leafy tree, a bench and a table with food vessels. By the table, the figures of three women. On the right in front, a woman sitting on a stone. In the middle of the yard, a well with a trough for watering animals and two human figures. Behind, a thatched-roof farmhouse. At its right-hand corner, a cart and two horses.

works.d: Ees vasakul jõekaldal kaks hoonet ja puid. Tagapool künklik maastik jõgede, puude ja üksikute hoonetega.
works.de: In front on the left on the riverbank two buildings and trees. Behind a hilly landscape with rivers, trees and individual buildings.

works.d: Esiplaanil kaks naist viljakottidega; (pisut tagapool) grupp mehi tegevuses - ühed veoautole kotte laadimas, teised kotte kaalumas; vasemal naisi ja mehi hobuste ja vankridega. Taga keskel töötajad viljapeksumasina juures, paremal kaks kõrget õlerõuku ja talumaja.
works.de: In the foreground two women with grain sacks; (a little further back) a group of men at work - some loading sacks onto a lorry, others weighing sacks; on the left women and men with horses and carts. Behind in the centre workers by a threshing machine, on the right two tall straw stacks and a farmhouse.

works.d: Maali keskel inimeste grupid. Parempoolne grupp koosneb neljast inimesest, kellest kolm, otsevaates, vaatavad plaani, neljas selgvaates, vaatab vasakule. Vasempoolne grupp koosneb kahest töölisest, kellest üks on sirutanud oma käe. Parempoolses nurgas töötavad suure vasktoru kallal kaks teineteise poole olevat meest. Neist vasakul, toru suu ees, seisab esiplaanil selgvaates mees.(eesti)
works.de: In the centre of the painting groups of people. The right-hand group consists of four people, three of whom, in frontal view, are looking at a plan, the fourth, in profile, looks to the left. The left-hand group consists of two workers, one of whom has stretched out his arm. In the right corner two men facing each other are working on a large copper pipe. To the left of them, in front of the pipe's opening, stands a man in profile in the foreground.

works.d: Lõuna-Eesti maastik. Vaade kollendavalt viljapõllult madalamal asetsevale maastikule koos põldude, hoonete, üksikute puude ja metsaga. Metsa taga veepind. Horisonti piirab helesinine riba.
works.de: A South Estonian landscape. View from a yellowing grain field onto a landscape lying lower, with fields, buildings, single trees and forest. Beyond the forest a body of water. The horizon is bordered by a light-blue strip.

works.d: Esiplaanil õitsva niidu riba, taga põllud rõukudega, kaugemal puud, põõsad. Vasakul vilja peksmine. Silmapiir sinavasse uttu kaduv.
works.de: In the foreground a strip of blossoming meadow, behind it fields with stacks, further away trees, bushes. On the left threshing of grain. The horizon disappearing into a bluish haze.

works.d: Esiplaanil laual valge draperii; kõrval keraamiline kann, kitarr, noodiraamatud.
works.de: In the foreground on a table a white drapery; next to it a ceramic jug, a guitar, sheet music books.

works.d: Esiplaanil all vasakul hall raamat paksu klaasiga, milles punane vedelik. Taga astmevõrra kõrgemal musta- ja punasekirjul draperiil sidrunid, pruun pudel, valge lame kann ja nende taga püsti punane ja pruun raamat. Hall foon.
works.de: In the foreground lower left a grey book with thick glass, containing a red liquid. Behind it, one step higher, on a black-and-red-patterned drapery lemons, a brown bottle, a white flat jug, and behind them a red and brown book standing upright. Grey background.

works.d: Esiplaanil paralleelselt pildipinnale suur rühm muistseid sõdureid piikidega. Rühma keskel osa mehi hobuste seljas. Fooniks järvede ja metsatukkadega maastik.
works.de: In the foreground, parallel to the picture plane, a large group of ancient soldiers with pikes. In the middle of the group some men on horseback. Background a landscape with lakes and clumps of forest.

works.d: Esiplaanil merekallas, paremal rühm naisi seismas, kellest üks käed ettesirutatult kummardab. Vasakul lammas süles sisev naine ja kõrval laps. Tagapool lambakari ja lambaid pesevad naised vees.
works.de: In the foreground a seashore, on the right a group of women standing, one of whom is bowing with hands stretched forward. On the left a woman sitting with a lamb in her lap, and a child beside her. Further back a flock of sheep and women washing sheep in the water.

works.d: Esiplaanil põld viljarõukudega ja kahe hobusega. Sellest tagapool puude ja põõsaste vahel madalad hooned. Silmapiiril sinakad metsaga künkad. Taevas hele kuu.
works.de: In the foreground a field with grain stacks and two horses. Beyond it, among trees and bushes, low buildings. On the horizon bluish forested hills. A bright moon in the sky.

works.d: Lapse rinnapilt en face, sinise ruudulise kaelarätikuga.
works.de: Child's bust portrait en face, with a blue checkered neckerchief.

works.d: Noore, sinise kübara ja jakiga naise täisfiguur poolprofiilis vasemale. Vasakul ees tool toolipadjaga. Figuuri taga riiulil sinine vaas lilledega.
works.de: Full figure of a young woman in a blue hat and jacket, in half-profile to the left. In front on the left a chair with a chair cushion. Behind the figure on a shelf a blue vase with flowers.

works.d: Esiplaanil kivine rand üksiku lootsiku ja roigastulpadega; tagaplaanil meri.
works.de: In the foreground a stony shore with a lone boat and pole stakes; in the background the sea.

works.d: Esiplaanil põllud kollendava viljaga, tagapool heinamaa puutukkadega. Tagaplaanil mets.
works.de: In the foreground fields with yellowing grain, behind a meadow with clumps of trees. In the background a forest.

works.d: Esiplaanil üksikud raagus puud. Tagaplaanil kivihoonete varemed.
works.de: In the foreground single bare trees. In the background ruins of stone buildings.

works.d: Kõrvaga vaas mitmevärviliste õitega.
works.de: Vase with handle with multicoloured blooms.

works.d: Esiplaanil lumine tänav. Plankaia taga aedades maju ja raagus puid.
works.de: In the foreground a snowy street. Behind the plank fence, houses in gardens and bare trees.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal veekogu kolme purjekaga. Vasakul kallas puudega. Tagaplaanil majade rida.
works.de: In the foreground on the right a body of water with three sailboats. On the left a bank with trees. In the background a row of houses.

works.d: Esiplaanil üle ruumi vasakult paremale suunduv töölaud riiulitega selle taga. Laual põlevaid gaasilampe; riiulitel mitmesuguseid pudeleid, katseklaase ja instrumente. Paremal üle riiuli paistmas kaks akna ülaserva.
works.de: In the foreground a workbench with shelves behind it, running from left to right across the room. On the table burning gas lamps; on the shelves various bottles, test tubes and instruments. On the right, above the shelf, the upper edges of two windows are visible.

works.d: Ees paremal tool üle seljatoe visatud riideesemega. Keskel vasakul ümmargune laud ühele servale kuhjatud linaga, vaasi, tassi ja väikese töökorviga. Laua taga tool. Taga paremal avatud ukse ees lamamistool. Avatud uksest vaade aeda.
works.de: In front on the right, a chair with a garment thrown over its back. In the centre on the left, a round table with a cloth heaped to one side, a vase, a cup and a small work basket. Behind the table a chair. At the back on the right, a chaise longue in front of an open door. Through the open door a view of the garden.

works.d: Ees vasakul töötav viljapeksumasin. Ümber masina askeldavad inimesed. Keskel kaks härga viljakokkuveosaani ees. Tagapool põhuvirnad. Tagaplaanil mäed.
works.de: In front on the left a working threshing machine. People bustling around the machine. In the middle two oxen in front of a grain-hauling sledge. Further back stacks of straw. In the background, mountains.

works.d: Tõmmunahalise tütarlapse portree - rinnapilt peaaegu en face. Peas rätik. Kaelas tume helmerida.
works.de: Portrait of a dark-skinned girl - bust almost en face. A scarf on her head. A dark string of beads around her neck.

works.d: Vasakul toolide najale seatud lõuendite ees reas istuvad Roos, Soonpää, Lukats, Hoidre, Semper, Adamson, Aavik, Sagrits; taga akna ees seisavad Sannamees ja Okas.
works.de: On the left, in a row in front of canvases set against chair backs, sitting are Roos, Soonpää, Lukats, Hoidre, Semper, Adamson, Aavik, Sagrits; behind, standing in front of the window, are Sannamees and Okas.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul tihe rühm demonstrante punase lipu ja loosungitega; nende esiridadest hulk langenuid kivisillutisel maas. Rühma ees keskel noor naine püsti, surudes vasaku käega oma ees seisvat tüdrukukest enda vastu. Parem käsi sajatavalt kõrgele tõstetud. Pildi paremal äärel rühm laskmiseks rivistunud soldateid, püssid palgel; püsside kohal laskmisest tekkinud suitsuvine. Tagapool paremale suunduval tänaval verise sündmuse juurest pagevaid inimesi. Taustaks vasakul puuderühm, keskel ja paremal maju.
works.de: In the foreground on the left, a dense group of demonstrators with a red flag and slogans; in their front ranks, a number of fallen lying on the stone pavement. In front of the group, in the middle, a young woman stands upright, pressing a little girl standing in front of her against herself with her left hand. Her right hand is raised high, cursing. On the right edge of the picture, a group of soldiers lined up for shooting, rifles at the cheek; above the rifles, the wisp of smoke from firing. Further back, on a street leading to the right, people are fleeing from the bloody event. In the background on the left a group of trees, in the middle and on the right, houses.

works.d: Esiplaanil rahulik, keskplaanil valges vahus tõusev vesi. Taustal kõrge kallas sügisese taimestikuga.
works.de: In the foreground calm, in the middle ground water rising in white foam. In the background a high bank with autumn vegetation.

works.d: Vanema istuva mehe 3/4 figuur otsevaates, pea kerges pöördes paremale. Käed toetuvad tooli käsipuudele. Hallitriibuline ülikond, must lips.
works.de: Three-quarter figure of an elderly seated man in frontal view, head slightly turned to the right. Hands resting on the armrests of the chair. Grey-striped suit, black tie.

works.d: Viiulit mängiva seisva poisi täisfiguur pöördes vasakule. Seljataga peegel, vasakul noodipult.
works.de: Full figure of a standing boy playing the violin, turned to the left. Behind him a mirror, to the left a music stand.

works.d: Lage rand. Vasakul meri. Esiplaanil väikesed kivid ja rannataimed.
works.de: Bare shore. On the left the sea. In the foreground small stones and shore plants.

works.d: Esiplaanil laud lillede ja puuviljadega. Selle ees näoga vaatja poole valge kübaraga naine õun (?) käes. Laua otsas lõuendi parempoolses osas seljaga vaataja poole tumedajuukseline figuur istumas; tema taga meesfiguur. Tagaplaanil linna siluett kiriku ja tornidega. Koloriit rohekas-hall.
works.de: In the foreground a table with flowers and fruit. In front of it, facing the viewer, a woman in a white hat with an apple (?) in her hand. At the end of the table, in the right part of the canvas, a dark-haired figure sitting with their back to the viewer; behind them a male figure. In the background a city silhouette with a church and towers. The colour scheme greenish-grey.

works.d: Mehe portree otsevaates, seljas tuulepluus tõmbelukuga. Koloriit hallikas-pruun.
works.de: Frontal portrait of a man, wearing a windbreaker with a zipper. The colouring is grayish-brown.

works.d: Esiplaanil laud. Sellel avatud raamat. Raamatul tikutoos ja kinnas, tindipott, likööripudel, sinine email-kann ja valge email-kann lilledega, kerajas likööripudel ja punase oriendi karp. Taustaks draperii kirjust ja sinisest rätikust.
works.de: In the foreground a table. On it an open book. On the book a matchbox and a glove, an inkpot, a liqueur bottle, a blue enamel jug and a white enamel jug with flowers, a spherical liqueur bottle and a red oriental box. The background is a drapery of a mottled and blue cloth.

works.d: Roheka varjundiga seinte ja põrandaga ruumis, ümmarguste laudade ääres mees- ja naisfiguur. Paremal suur aken. Taga vasakul orkester.
works.de: In a room with greenish-tinted walls and floor, a male and female figure by round tables. On the right a large window. In the back on the left an orchestra.

works.d: Ees vasakul istuvad naine ja poiss. Nende taga kaks seisvat noormeest, paremal kaks meest kalakorviga. Taga purjekas.
works.de: In front on the left a sitting woman and boy. Behind them two standing young men, on the right two men with a fish basket. A sailboat in the background.

works.d: Esiplaanil madal kallas, põõsaga paremal ääres. Keskel veekogu purjekaga, taamal vees peegelduv linna siluett kirikutorniga.
works.de: In the foreground a low shore, with a bush at the right edge. In the middle a body of water with a sailboat, in the distance the silhouette of a city with a church tower reflected in the water.

works.d: Triibulisel riidel pruun vaas kirjude põllulilledega.
works.de: On striped fabric a brown vase with colourful meadow flowers.

works.d: Esiplaanil jõel laev, selle lael kaks inimkuju. Keskel sild, taamal maju.
works.de: In the foreground a ship on the river, with two human figures on its deck. A bridge in the middle, houses beyond.

works.d: Esiplaanil neli inimest rehade ja vikatitega õlal. Keskplaanil paremal puu, vasakul kolm puud, mille ees kolm hobust rohtu söömas. Tagaplaanil künklik maastik.
works.de: In the foreground four people with rakes and scythes on their shoulders. In the middle ground on the right a tree, on the left three trees, in front of which three horses are grazing. In the background a hilly landscape.

works.d: Esiplaanil lage lumine tänav, tagapool ja vasakul ning paremal majad.
works.de: In the foreground an empty snowy street, behind and on the left and right houses.

works.d: Esiplaanil käänuline oja vesikuppude ja rohtukasvanud kallastega. Paremal kasesalu, vasemal vaade künklikule maastikule metsaga.
works.de: In the foreground a winding stream with water-lilies and grassy banks. On the right a birch grove, on the left a view of a hilly landscape with forest.

works.d: Toolil seisev kirju vaas, milles kimp mitmesuguseid lilli: rukki-, mooni-, nisuõisi jt. Taust valge, kahel pool pruunikad pinnad.
works.de: A patterned vase standing on a chair, holding a bouquet of various flowers: rye, poppy, wheat blossoms, etc. Background white, with brownish planes on both sides.

works.d: Esiplaanil valge linaga kaetud laud, mille taga vasakul istub naise poolakt otsevaates. Paremal profiilis teine istuv naine kollase- ja mustatriibulises kleidis, kohvitassiga käes; tema vastupeegeldus näha peeglis. Foon tumepunane.
works.de: In the foreground a table covered with a white cloth, behind which on the left a woman's half-nude figure sits in frontal view. On the right, in profile, a second seated woman in a yellow- and black-striped dress, holding a coffee cup; her reflection visible in a mirror. Background dark red.

works.d: Alasti naise istuv põlvfiguur, parem käevõruga käsi kuklal, vasak suu juures, maalitud heledalt. Foonil punane ja roheline draperii. Vasakul ümmargusel laual tumedates toonides natüürmort kannuga.
works.de: Sitting knee-length figure of a nude woman, right hand with a bracelet on the back of the neck, left hand near the mouth, painted in light tones. In the background red and green drapery. On the left, on a round table, a still life in dark tones with a jug.

works.d: Kollases interjööris esiplaanis kaks seisvat rohekasmusta naisfiguuri. Neist vasakul ja paremal lauad istuvate figuuridega. (eesti)
works.de: In a yellow interior, in the foreground two standing greenish-black female figures. To their left and right tables with seated figures.

works.d: Esiplaanil keskel musta rõivastatud daam valges kübaras punase laua taga. Temast vasakul mustas rõivastuses otsevaates mees punase laua taga.
works.de: In the foreground centre a lady dressed in black wearing a white hat behind a red table. To her left a man dressed in black, seen frontally, behind the red table.

works.d: Hallika balustraadi ja sinise taeva foonil mees ja naine lamamistoolides. Vasakul kaetud laud.
works.de: Against a background of a greyish balustrade and blue sky, a man and a woman in deck chairs. To the left a set table.

works.d: Kompositsioon heledas kleidis naise ja kolme maskeraadikostüümis mehega.
works.de: Composition with a woman in a light-coloured dress and three men in masquerade costumes.

works.d: Oranžil foonil istuv naise figuur. Pea pööratud paremale, parema käega toetub toolile, vasak lebab vabalt süles. Tooli kõrval ornamendiga kaetud kann.
works.de: A seated female figure on an orange background. Head turned to the right, resting with the right hand on a chair, the left lying freely in the lap. Beside the chair a jug covered with ornament.

works.d: Ümmargusel, osaliselt roosa linaga kaetud laual tagaplaanil kaks suurt kõrgekaelalist keraamilist kannu, nende kõrval paremal kõrvuti kaks väikest vaasi. Viimaste ees laual vasakul tume, kõrgel jalal tühi puuviljavaas, selle ees laual kaks kirssi. Helesinine foon.
works.de: On a round table partly covered with a pink cloth, in the background two large tall-necked ceramic jugs, next to them on the right two small vases side by side. In front of the latter on the table on the left a dark, empty fruit bowl on a high stem, in front of it on the table two cherries. Light blue background.

works.d: Geometriseeritud vormides kompositsioon: esiplaanil keskel külgvaates, tumedate juustega ja sinise näoga naine profiilis, musta kontuuriga ümbritsetud. Seljas hele kleit, käte asemel nelinurgad. Vasakul servas musta kontuuriga geomeetrilistest kujunditest konstruktsioon. Foonil mitmevärvilised nelinurgad üksteisesse põimumas. Peamiselt roosakas-pruunides, sinistes ja kollastes toonides.
works.de: A composition in geometrized forms: in the foreground in the centre, in side view, a dark-haired woman with a blue face in profile, surrounded by a black contour. She wears a light-coloured dress, and instead of arms there are quadrangles. On the left edge a construction of geometric shapes with a black contour. In the background multicoloured quadrangles interlocking with one another. Mainly in pinkish-brown, blue and yellow tones.

works.d: Allservas diagonaalselt üle pildi allosa jooksev kollane tee, millest kahel pool suured põlised puud. Foonil tumedam sinine rahutu taevas. Sügav sinakasroheline koloriit.
works.de: In the lower part a yellow road running diagonally across the bottom of the picture, with large old trees on both sides. In the background a darker restless blue sky. Deep bluish-green colouring.

works.d: Akna all ümara laua serv, millel vaas rikkaliku, üksteise kõrval asetsevaist erinevaist õitest buketiga. Üksik lill laual vasakul. Paremas ülanurgas aknast paistmas kollakas täiskuu. Ruumis lummav sinkjas valgus. Lillakassinised, rohekad mürgised toonid. Vaas lilledega aluspapile kleebitud, sellele omakorda kleebitud õisi.
works.de: Below the window, the edge of a round table on which stands a vase with a rich bouquet of various flowers placed side by side. A single flower on the table to the left. In the upper right corner, a yellowish full moon showing through the window. A captivating bluish light in the room. Purplish-blue, greenish poisonous tones. The vase with flowers is glued onto the backing paper, with flowers glued on top of it in turn.

works.de: Against a background of city houses in greenish, grey, brown tones and a light, bluish sky, a large fish in profile facing left, made of pasted coloured paper cut-outs. Background painted, paper cut-outs mostly sharp-angled triangles.

Vasakul all sinakas-kirju ketas, paremal ülal lilla, keskelt hajuvalt heledam ketas.
works.de: On a bluish-grey spatter-technique background, glued-on diagonal, coloured, narrow paper strips, most of which run from lower right to upper left, one broken blue one from lower left to upper right. At lower left a bluish-mottled disc, at upper right a purple disc, diffusely lighter in the centre.

works.dm: kõrgus: 38.0 cm (vm, läbi klaasi); laius: 37.2 cm (vm, läbi klaasi)
works.d: Laiade, mustade, hõredate pintslitõmmetega moodustatud ruudulistest ja kaarjatest pindadest foonile kleebitud pruunist, valgest ja hallist paberist väljalõigatud kujundid. Vasakul, keskel sinakas-roheline kera trükisest välja lõigatud ja peale kleebitud.
works.de: Shapes cut out of brown, white and grey paper glued onto a background formed of broad, black, sparse brushstrokes forming chequered and arched surfaces. On the left, in the centre, a bluish-green sphere cut out of a printed matter and glued on top.

works.dm: kõrgus: 28.0 cm (vm, läbi klaasi); laius: 30.2 cm (vm, läbi klaasi)
works.d: Heledal, sinise-pruuni-kirjul foonil domineerib must, ebakorrapärane võrgustik, mille peale kleebitud rohkesti ebakorrapäraseid, värvitrükiste lõikeid mitmesuguste kujutistega. Mõned selgemad kujutised: vasakul keskel mootori osa; vasakul all kivi pind ja osa puutüvest; paremal all triibulise riide kangas veidi lahti rullitud; paremal keskel osa sinisest kaelakeest pruunide nööride foonil; ülal paremal osa kuue varrukast ja hele, triipudega sall; peaaegu keskel osa kivi pinnast.
works.de: On a light background mottled in blue-brown, a black, irregular network dominates, onto which numerous irregular cuttings of colour prints with various images are glued. Some clearer images: in the middle left, a part of an engine; lower left, the surface of a stone and part of a tree trunk; lower right, a striped fabric slightly unrolled; middle right, part of a blue necklace against a background of brown cords; upper right, part of a coat sleeve and a light-coloured striped scarf; almost in the centre, part of a stone surface.

works.dm: kõrgus: 27.5 cm (vm, läbi klaasi); laius: 38.7 cm (vm, läbi klaasi)
works.d: Heleroheka-laigulisel foonil, kollakasrohekate ja pruunide joontega, korrapäratu võrgustik. Keskel peale kleebitud, korrapäratu, trükisest lõigatud, hele-tumepruun kujund. Viimase all, vasakul, peale kleebitud, trükistest lõigatud - torude virn, sama motiiv väiksemalt ka ülal keskel.
works.de: On a light-greenish, mottled background, with yellowish-green and brown lines, an irregular network. In the middle, an irregular light-to-dark brown shape cut from a print and pasted on. Below the latter, on the left, a pile of pipes cut from prints and pasted on, the same motif also smaller at the top center.

works.d: Kahe abstraktse maali ees seisavad tagantvaates rohekas seelikus naine ja rohekas pintsakus habemik mees pea pöördes vasakule.
works.de: In front of two abstract paintings stand, seen from behind, a woman in a greenish skirt and a bearded man in a greenish jacket, his head turned to the left.

works.d: Poolabstraktne motiiv kahe peaga helesinise taeva taustal. Nii figuurid kui taust edasi antud vabakäelises geomeetrilises abstraheeringus.
works.de: Semi-abstract motif of two heads against a light blue sky background. Both the figures and the background are rendered in a freehand geometric abstraction.

works.d: Ruudulisel linikul seisab valge piimapütt, kaks võõrkeelset raamatut ja roheline teekann. Vaikelu taustal ahjuplaadid, vasakul ripub must kangas.
works.de: On a checkered cloth stands a white milk churn, two foreign-language books and a green teapot. In the background of the still life, stove tiles; on the left hangs a black cloth.

works.de: Valve Janov oil/cardboard, 40x50 Kammeljas 1960. Location on object: on the back, in pencil

works.d: Akna juures istuva tütarlapse poolfiguur. Punane, valgete täppidega kleit, valge krae. Tume juus kahes patsis. Käed süles.
works.de: Half-figure of a girl sitting by a window. Red dress with white dots, white collar. Dark hair in two braids. Hands in her lap.

works.d: Heledal aknalaual kollakas kann roosaõieliste okstega. Selle kõrval madal roosakas klaasvaas laia kannikeste kimbuga. Üldine koloriit hele, hallikas.
works.de: On a light windowsill a yellowish jug with pink-flowered branches. Beside it a low pinkish glass vase with a wide bunch of violets. The overall colouring is light, greyish.

works.d: Valge kraega, punane kleit/pluus, millel sinine põll/kleit punaste nööpidega.
works.de: With a white collar, a red dress/blouse, over which a blue apron/dress with red buttons.

works.d: Naise poolfiguur pöördes vasakule, pea otsevaates. Must jakk ja kollane pluus.
works.de: Half-figure of a woman turned to the left, head in frontal view. Black jacket and yellow blouse.

works.d: Avatud akna ees istuva tütarlapse kolmveerand figuur, käes õmblustöö. Temast paremal toolil istumas teine tütarlaps. Vasakul toolil seljaga istuv vanem naine.
works.de: Three-quarter figure of a girl sitting in front of an open window, sewing work in her hands. To her right another girl sitting on a chair. On the left an older woman sitting with her back turned, on a chair.

works.d: Diagonaalselt asetatud väiksel nelinurksel laual kolm lindu. Paremal lauanurgal võrk, mille peal kaks sidrunit. Üks sidrun veel vasakul lindude vahel.
works.de: Three birds placed diagonally on a small rectangular table. At the right corner of the table a net, on which two lemons. One more lemon between the birds on the left.

works.d: Tripiptühhon. Keskosal rühm inimesi, esiplaanil punakas kleidis naine kahe lapsega. Vasakul külgtiival ahervaremete taustal vana naine seljaga vaataja poole. Paremal külgtiival rühm triibulises rõivais meesvange traataia taga.
works.de: Triptych. In the central part a group of people, in the foreground a woman in a reddish dress with two children. On the left wing an old woman with her back to the viewer against a background of ruins. On the right wing a group of male prisoners in striped clothing behind barbed wire.

works.d: Valge riidega kaetud laual 1 suurem ja 2 väiksemat täpilist kala. Vasakul nurgas üleval tükk sinakat-rohekat draperiid, keskel silndrikujuline toos ja pudel, paremal 2 sibulat ja nuga.
works.de: On a table covered with white cloth, 1 larger and 2 smaller spotted fish. In the upper left corner a piece of bluish-greenish drapery, in the middle a cylindrical box and a bottle, on the right 2 onions and a knife.

works.d: Hallis plisseeritud seelikus ja sinises jakis istuva tütarlapse täisfiguur heledal foonil. Käed süles, juuksed keskelt lahku kammitud.
works.de: Full figure of a girl sitting in a grey pleated skirt and blue jacket, against a light background. Hands in lap, hair parted in the middle.

works.d: Esiplaanil avara akna all viis laudade ääres istuvat figuuri. Paremal seisev mees, vasakul ettekandja kandikuga. Aknast paistab punaseid lippe kandev rahvahulk.
works.de: In the foreground, under a wide window, five figures sitting at tables. On the right, a standing man; on the left, a waiter with a tray. Through the window, a crowd carrying red flags can be seen.

works.d: Väljalõige orkestriruumist teatris mängivate viiuldajate ja tšellistidega. Noodipultidelt langeb valgus figuuridele. Punakad, kollakad ja tumedad toonid, iseloomulik kraapimismaneeri kasutamine.
works.de: A cutout from the orchestra pit of a theatre with violinists and cellists playing. Light falls on the figures from the music stands. Reddish, yellowish and dark tones, characteristic use of the scraping technique.

works.d: Noore naise põlvportree istuvas asendis. Lühikesed juuksed, vasakul lahku kammitud; seljas hele jakk avatud hõlmadega. Käed külgedel.
works.de: Knee-length portrait of a young woman in a seated position. Short hair, parted to the left; wearing a light-coloured jacket with open lapels. Hands at her sides.

works.d: Peegli taustal kolm tütarlast balletikingades ja lühikeses tantsukleidis, paremad käed sirutatud, parem jalg varbal. Kahvatud toonid.
works.de: Against the background of a mirror, three girls in ballet shoes and short dance dresses, right arms extended, right foot en pointe. Pale tones.

works.d: Suures plaanis kolm tööriiestuses kolhoosinaise täisfiguuri, keskmine selgvaates, käed puusas, vasakpoolsel käes roheline taim. Vasemal istutatud taimi, tagaplaanis suures vähenduses töötavaid figuure.
works.de: In a large view three full figures of kolkhoz women in work clothes, the middle one in a frontal view, hands on hips, the one on the left holding a green plant. On the left planted plants, in the background figures at work greatly reduced in size.

works.d: Hallil taustal punaseruudulisel linikul kuus punast ja üks roheline piprakaun.
works.de: On a grey background, on a red-checkered cloth, six red and one green pepper pod.

works.d: Poisipea ja tukaga vanema istuva naise figuur otsevaates. Seljas punakas kleit, foon pruunjas.
works.de: Figure of an older seated woman with a boyish haircut and fringe, in frontal view. Wearing a reddish dress, background brownish.

works.d: Roheline metsatee puude ja põõsaste vahel.
works.de: Green forest path between trees and bushes.

works.d: Hallikas-sinakal foonil kimp kirjusid lilli klaasvaasis.
works.de: On a greyish-blue background, a bunch of colourful flowers in a glass vase.

works.d: Tiheda rohelise metsaserval kadakapõõsad ja õitsvad kibuvitsad.
works.de: At the edge of a dense green forest, juniper bushes and blooming dog roses.

works.d: Kirjul foonil lai hele vaas lillakates toonides lilledega.
works.de: On a patterned background a wide light-coloured vase with flowers in purplish tones.

works.dm: kujutise laius: 160.4 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 130.0 cm

works.d: Maali allservas ridastikku stiliseeritud kadakavormid. Pikad ja sihvakad vahelduvad madalatega. Kontuurid hajuvad, koloriit kahvatu, värvikiht pastoosne.
works.de: Along the lower edge of the painting, a row of stylised juniper forms. Tall and slender ones alternate with low ones. Contours diffuse, colouring pale, paint layer impasto.

works.d: Pildi keskel justkui kahed suured punased huuled, ühed teiste vahel. Foon kollakashall. Maalitud kohati pastoosselt, otsekui huulte läiget ja ümarust rõhutades.
works.de: In the middle of the picture, as if two large red lips, one inside the other. Yellowish-grey background. Painted in places impastoed, as if emphasising the sheen and roundness of the lips.

works.d: Sinakasrohelisel, alt ülespoole tumedamaks muutuval foonil suur hall muna, terav ots ülespoole. Allservas toetub muna samasugusele hallile munale, millest aga on vaid osa näha. Suure muna alumine kolmandik pragunenud.
works.de: Against a bluish-green background darkening from bottom to top, a large grey egg, pointed end upward. At the lower edge the egg rests on a similar grey egg, of which only part is visible. The lower third of the large egg is cracked.

works.d: Värtna- ja munakujuliste võradega puudest koostatud kompositsioon. Foon sinistes ja rohekates toonides. Silmapiir helendab kollakalt.
works.de: A composition made of trees with spindle- and egg-shaped crowns. The background in blue and greenish tones. The horizon glows yellowish.

works.d: Tumerohelisel foonil valkjasbeežidest, pruunidest ja punastest munadest, kolm- ja nelinurkadest kompositsioon. Kujundeile langevast valgusest tunduvad need helendavat.
works.de: Composition of whitish-beige, brown and red eggs, triangles and quadrangles on a dark green background. The light falling on the shapes makes them appear to glow.

works.d: Reljeefse faktuuriga sinakaslillal foonil kolm kujundit: vasakul servas roheline läätse meenutav kujund vertikaalselt, keskel all punane kera ja paremal, otsekui kepi otsas pruun horisontaalne läätse kujund. All kollakaspruun, maapinda meenutav riba.
works.de: On a bluish-lilac background of relief texture, three shapes: at the left edge a green lentil-like shape positioned vertically, in the middle below a red sphere, and on the right, as if on the end of a stick, a brown horizontal lentil-like shape. Below, a yellowish-brown strip resembling the ground.

works.d: Üksteisesse lõikuvate sinakate munade foonil värtnaid meenutavad tumedad, reljeefina mõjuva pastoosse värvikasutusega kujundid ning keskel kollased ja punased helendavaina tunduvad pallikesed. Kogu kompositsiooni foon tumeroheline.
works.de: On a background of intersecting bluish ovals, dark, relief-like shapes with a pastose use of colour resembling spindles, and in the middle small yellow and red balls that appear to glow. The background of the whole composition is dark green.

works.d: Tumehallil foonil väga pastoosselt antud põimuvate hallikasroheliste joonte rägastik.
works.de: On a dark grey background a very pastose tangle of interweaving greyish-green lines.

works.d: Sinakasrohelisel, pastoosselt maalitud foonil, kompositsioonilise raskuspunktiga keskpunktist pisut paremale, neljaks tükiks jaotatud hall muna. Nurkapidi üksteist puudutavad tükid moodustavad keskel helehalli ruudu. Muna detailid antud väga ruumiliselt.
works.de: On a bluish-green, pastosely painted background, with the compositional centre of gravity slightly to the right of the centre point, a grey egg divided into four pieces. The pieces, touching each other at the corners, form a light grey square in the centre. The details of the egg are given very spatially.

works.d: Rohelistes ja sinistes toonides laigulisel foonil keskel suur kala. Kala selg roheline, kõhualune kollakas, uimed ja saba sinistes ja lillades toonides. Paremale jäävas peas teravate hammastega avatud suu, millest paistab allaneelatud kala sabaots.
works.de: A large fish in the centre against a mottled background in green and blue tones. The fish's back is green, its underside yellowish, its fins and tail in blue and lilac tones. In its head, positioned to the right, an open mouth with sharp teeth, from which the tail end of a swallowed fish protrudes.

works.dm: kõrgus: 50.0 cm; laius: 33.7 cm (vm); kõrgus: 48.7 cm (vm); laius: 35.0 cm
works.d: Maastiku taustal olev, punast peakatet ja riietuseset kandev mehe poolportree profiilis; suu-silma, nina-kõrva, silma-huule hübriidid.(eesti)
works.de: A man's half-portrait in profile wearing a red headdress and item of clothing, against a landscape background; hybrids of mouth-eye, nose-ear, eye-lip.

works.d: Kunstniku naeratav ja lehvitav autoportree veerandpöördes paremale. Peas sinine müts ja prillid, suus suitsev piip ja seljas hallikas riideese. Maalitud realistlikus laadis, taust rohekas-hallikas.
works.de: The artist's smiling and waving self-portrait in a quarter-turn to the right. On the head a blue cap and glasses, a smoking pipe in the mouth and a grayish garment. Painted in a realistic style, background greenish-gray.

works.d: Kunstniku siilisoengus autoportree poolpöördes paremale. Ilme tõsine, peas prillid ja seljas sinine riideese. Maali käsitluslaad kergelt ekspressiivne.
works.de: The artist's self-portrait with a spiky hairstyle, in half-turn to the right. Serious expression, wearing glasses and a blue garment. The painting's style is slightly expressive.

works.d: Tõsine portree mütsi ja prillidega otsevaates. Peas hall müts ja seljas hall rõivas, nägu maalitud valgusküllaselt.
works.de: A serious portrait with a hat and glasses, in a frontal view. On his head a grey hat and wearing grey clothing, the face painted in bright light.

works.d: Pintslit käes hoidev autoportree sõjaväemundris. Seljas hall univorm ja peas hall vormimüts, maalitud impressionistlikus täppivas tehnikas.
works.de: Self-portrait in military uniform, holding a brush. Wearing a grey uniform and a grey uniform cap, painted in an impressionistic dotted technique.

works.d: Piibu ja prillidega siilisoengus autoportree kerges pöördes paremale. Seljas sinine, eest lahtine pluus, käsi hoiab suus piipu. Taust roosa, vasakul rohelise triibuga.
works.de: Self-portrait with a pipe and glasses, hair in a crew cut, in a slight turn to the right. Wearing a blue blouse open at the front, hand holding a pipe in the mouth. Background pink, with a green stripe on the left.

works.d: Piibu ja prillidega otsevaates autoportree. Taust pastelsetes toonides, säbruline.
works.de: Frontal self-portrait with pipe and glasses. Background in pastel tones, wavy.

works.d: Pikemas potisoengus prillidega autoportree veerandpöördes paremale. Seljas kollakas-pruunikas ruuduline särk, taustal kevadine rohelus.
works.de: Self-portrait in a longer bowl haircut with glasses, in a three-quarter turn to the right. Wearing a yellowish-brown checked shirt, spring greenery in the background.

works.dm: lehe laius: 14.4 cm; kujutise laius: 14.0 cm (selgelt piiritletud kujutis ristikujulises raamistuses); kujutise kõrgus: 18.9 cm; lehe kõrgus: 19.3 cm
works.d: Sälule sarnaneva tüdruku pea profiilis vasakule. Lühikeste juuste vahel paistmas terav kõrv
works.de: The head of a girl resembling Sälu in profile to the left. Between the short hair a sharp ear is visible

works.d: Kõrge sangaga korv täis punaseid ja valgeid astreid. Ees vasakul tühi pruun vaas.
works.de: A basket with a tall handle full of red and white asters. In front on the left an empty brown vase.

works.d: Ees, maali keskel seisab peaaegu pildi ülemise servani ulatuv tüdruk profiilis paremale. Kleit tume, põll hele, rätik peas sinine. Karjuse taga ja mõlemal pool külgedel heledad lambad. Paremal all jalgade juures lilled. Tagaplaanil kaldariba ning selle taga kitsas veekogu, mis lõpeb silmapiiril metsaga. Silmapiir väga kõrge. Pinnad ümbritsetud tumedate kontuuridega.
works.de: In front, in the middle of the painting, stands a girl reaching almost to the top edge of the picture, in profile to the right. The dress is dark, the apron light, the kerchief on her head blue. Behind the shepherd and on both sides light-coloured sheep. Below right, at her feet, flowers. In the background a strip of shore and beyond it a narrow body of water ending on the horizon in a forest. The horizon is very high. The surfaces are surrounded by dark contours.

works.d: Kaks tütarlapse täisfiguuri interjööris. Vasakpoolne, hallis kitlis ja punases pluusis tumedapäine tütarlaps toetub seljaga vastu rohelist ahju. Teine, selgvaates, tumedas seelikus ja lillakas jakis heledapäine tütarlaps, seisab eelmise ees, pildi paremal poolel. Paremal helesinise linaga lauanurk. Paremal ülal nurgas punane lambivari, mis saadab kollast ja punast valgust.
works.de: Two full-length figures of girls in an interior. The one on the left, dark-haired, in a grey smock and red blouse, leans her back against a green stove. The other, seen frontally, fair-haired, in a dark skirt and lilac jacket, stands in front of the previous one, on the right side of the picture. On the right a corner of a table with a light blue cloth. In the upper right corner a red lampshade emitting yellow and red light.

works.d: Roosas jakis ja kirjus seelikus istuva tütarlapse täisfiguur otsevaates. Käed toetuvad lauakesele, jalad sirutatud vasakule.
works.de: Full figure of a girl sitting in a pink jacket and a colourful skirt, in frontal view. Hands resting on a small table, legs stretched out to the left.

works.d: Istuva noormehe täisfiguur otsevaates. Ülakeha ettepoole kummardunud, ristatud käed põlvede vahel. Foon sinine-oranž.
works.de: Full figure of a seated young man in frontal view. Upper body bent forward, arms crossed between the knees. Background blue-orange.

works.d: Esiplaanil, kõrge vundamendiga laudhoone ees kaks meest, kes pikkade lattidega juhivad vees palke. Paremal ja vasemal palkide virnad, taamal hooned.
works.de: In the foreground, in front of a high-foundation plank building, two men guiding logs in the water with long poles. On the right and left piles of logs, buildings in the distance.

works.d: Esiplaanil neli figuuri - kolm selgvaates, üks tütarlaps en face vaatlemas tuledes linna. Vasemal neljakorruseline maja ja ehituselolev hoone kraanaga, paremal kaugvaates linn.
works.de: Four figures in the foreground - three in profile, one girl en face, observing the city in lights. On the left a four-storey building and a building under construction with a crane, on the right the city in the distance.

works.d: I Malin Asukoht objektil: alusraami vasakul serval all
works.de: I Malin Location on object: on the lower left edge of the stretcher

works.d: Kaks tübeteikades tüdrukut suure kollase ratta taustal. Parempoolne sinises, vasakpoolne punases kleidis.
works.de: Two girls in tubeteikas against a background of a large yellow wheel. The right one in a blue dress, the left one in a red dress.

works.d: Kaheksa eeslit lillakaspunasel foonil paremalt vasakule liikumas.
works.de: Eight donkeys moving from right to left against a purplish-red background.

works.d: Esiplaanil kolm figuuri - üks naine ja kaks meest tööülikondades. Nende ümber mitmesugused torud, seadistused; põrand ruuduline.
works.de: In the foreground three figures - one woman and two men in work overalls. Around them various pipes, installations; the floor chequered.

works.d: Töölisnaise täisfiguur tehaseseadeldiste taustal. Naine seisab otsevaates, käed vaheliti, püksid jalas, õlgadel jakk.
works.de: Full figure of a working woman against a background of factory equipment. The woman stands facing forward, arms crossed, wearing trousers, a jacket on her shoulders.

works.d: Istuv prillidega noor naine teatrilava foonil. Vasakul serval 12 väikest gravüüri.
works.de: Seated young woman with glasses against a theatre stage background. On the left edge 12 small engravings.

works.d: Punases toolis istuva täidlase mehe kolmveerandfiguur, keha pöördes paremale, nägu en face. Foon rohekas-sinine.
works.de: Three-quarter figure of a stout man sitting in a red chair, body turned to the right, face en face. Background greenish-blue.

works.d: Rohekas-sinises veelaviinis ja selle ümber tumedad ebakorrapärased kujundid.
works.de: A greenish-blue water stain and around it dark irregular shapes.

works.d: Rohekas-sinises veelaviinis ja selle ümber tumedad ebakorrapärased kujundid.
works.de: A greenish-blue water stain and around it dark irregular shapes.

works.d: Keskel pisut paremale nihutatud mehe otsevaates kolmveerandfiguur, õlgadeni ulatuvad, pisut lainjad šatäänid juuksed, vuntsid, väike terav habe, tumesinine sviiter, tumehallid püksid. Parem pisut ette sirutatud, pöial ja nimetissõrm moodustavad rõnga. Vasakul alumises nurgas lillakassinises heledas kleidis, heleda peaga tüdruku poolpöördes kolmveerandfiguur. Ülal neli erinevaid poosides valgete särkide ja pruunide pükstega mehefiguuri. Foon allosas pruunikaskollastes toonides.
works.de: In the middle, slightly shifted to the right, a three-quarter figure of a man in full-face view, shoulder-length, slightly wavy chestnut hair, moustache, small pointed beard, dark blue jumper, dark grey trousers. His right hand is slightly extended forward, thumb and index finger forming a ring. In the lower left corner, a three-quarter figure in a half-turn of a girl in a light lilac-blue dress, with a light-coloured head. Above, four male figures in various poses, wearing white shirts and brown trousers. The background in the lower part is in brownish-yellow tones.

works.d: Rohelisel, keskpaiga poole helendaval foonil, istuvas asendis, vasaku serva suunda nihutatud vana naise poolfiguur. Nägu ja vasak käsi plastiliselt modelleeritud, lühikesed hallid juuksed, lillavärvilist pluusi katab õlgadele asetatud kirju sall.
works.de: On a green background lightening toward the middle, in a seated position, the half-figure of an old woman shifted toward the left edge. The face and left hand are modeled plastically, short grey hair, a purple-colored blouse covered by a colorful shawl placed on the shoulders.

works.d: Tumedate varjudega samblarohelisel taustal sürrealistlik moodustis. Keskel sinakaksroheline kikilipsu kujuga vorm, vardad läbi. Ülemisel osal needitud plaat. Keskosa läbib kumer vars-tugi, eest pruun, tagant must-valge. Tagapool laines draperii kujund.
works.de: A surrealist formation on a moss-green background with dark shadows. In the middle, a bluish-green bow-tie shaped form, with rods through it. On the upper part a riveted plate. Through the middle passes a curved stem-support, brown in front, black-and-white behind. Behind it, a wavy drapery-like shape.

works.dm: kõrgus: 30.0 cm; laius: 16.5 cm; sügavus: 16.5 cm
works.d: Installatsioon  klaaskupli ja metallist konstruktsiooniga, mille tipust ripub alla sinisest klaasist tilgakujuline pendel, selle all musta sametiga kaetud alusel paikneb inimese selgroolüli ja muid detaile
works.de: Installation with a glass dome and metal construction, from the top of which hangs a blue glass drop-shaped pendant; below it, on a base covered with black velvet, is a human vertebra and other details

works.d: Punakaspruunile kummutile visatud jakk, sall ning pruun kübar. Paremal, kübara taga, punakaspruunis kitsas raamis ovaalne pilt.
works.de: A jacket, a scarf and a brown hat thrown on a reddish-brown chest of drawers. On the right, behind the hat, an oval picture in a narrow reddish-brown frame.

works.d: Panoraammaastik: esiplaanil jõekäär etüüdilikult antud puuderiviga, keskplaanis künkad väikeste metsatukkadega, ülal hallikassinine taevas. Kõik tuhmides rohelistes toonides.
works.de: Panoramic landscape: in the foreground a river bend with a row of trees rendered in a sketch-like manner, in the middle ground hills with small groves of trees, above a greyish-blue sky. Everything in muted green tones.

works.d: Öises valguses, pikkade varjudega tänav. Vasakul ookrikarva maja ja tara, sealt edasi rohekashallid majad. Paremal pruuni maja nurk. Paremal tänavapoolel tumeroheliste lehtpuude rida, vasakul üksik elektripost. Taevas sügavalt sinine.
works.de: A street in night light, with long shadows. On the left an ochre-coloured house and a fence, further on greyish-green houses. On the right the corner of a brown house. On the right side of the street a row of dark green deciduous trees, on the left a solitary electricity pole. The sky deep blue.

works.d: Vaade kõrvalisele tänavale: vasakul avatud aknaga roosa maja, keskel otsekui mäest alla suunduv tänav, paremal üksik suurem puu, telefonipost ja põõsad. Keskplaanis väikeste majade nurgad, mõned inimesed, liiklusmärk. Taamal heledate majadega uue linnaosa fragment. Ülal raske hallikassine taevas.
works.de: View of a side street: on the left a pink house with an open window, in the middle a street seemingly descending down a hill, on the right a single larger tree, a telephone pole and bushes. In the middle ground, corners of small houses, some people, a traffic sign. In the distance, a fragment of a new district with light-coloured houses. Above, a heavy greyish-blue sky.

works.d: Panoraamne künklik maastik: esiplaanil lähedaltvaates puud, eemal küngaste ja põllulappide vahel metsatukad. Taevas ühtlaselt rohekashall. Roheline ja hallikassinine koloriit, maalitud pintslitööd paista lastes.
works.de: Panoramic hilly landscape: in the foreground trees seen close up, in the distance patches of forest between hills and fields. The sky is uniformly greenish-grey. Green and greyish-blue colour scheme, painted with brushwork left visible.

works.d: Linnatänav nelja figuuriga esiplaanil: keskel pruunis, karvase kraega palitus, käekoti ja kõrgekontsaliste hallide kingadega naine poolprofiilis, pruun madal kübar peas. Naise ümber kolm valgetes kitlites ja hallides sonides meest. Vasakpoolsel, vaataja poole seljaga seisval mehel ning parempoolsel, profiilis antud leivavedajal on käes kollased ovaalsed leivakorvid. Meeste taga paremal paistab pruuni leivafurgooni tagumine ots. Taamal kõrge kollane aiamüüritis, mille tagant paistavad pruunide katustega majad. Paremas ülaservas jupike hallikassinist taevast.
works.de: A city street with four figures in the foreground: in the centre a woman in half-profile, in a brown coat with a furry collar, with a handbag and grey high-heeled shoes, wearing a low brown hat. Around the woman three men in white smocks and grey caps. The man on the left, standing with his back to the viewer, and the bread carrier on the right, shown in profile, hold yellow oval bread baskets. Behind the men, on the right, the rear end of a brown bread van can be seen. In the background a tall yellow garden wall, behind which houses with brown roofs can be seen. In the upper right corner a piece of greyish-blue sky.

works.d: Hallide pindade ja triipudega markeeritud interjööris, pruunil põrandal ümarapõhjaline viini tool. Üle ümara tooli seljatoe on heidetud sinakasroheline kangas. Toolil halli serva ja pruuni põhjaga kübar kollakashallil riidel ja peene kaela ja kandilise sangaga keraamiline vaas (ülaosas punakaspruun, all hall glasuur).
works.de: In an interior marked by grey surfaces and stripes, on a brown floor a round-seated Vienna chair. Over the round back of the chair a bluish-green cloth is thrown. On the chair a hat with a grey brim and a brown crown on a yellowish-grey cloth, and a ceramic vase with a thin neck and square handle (reddish-brown glaze at the top, grey glaze below).

works.d: Värvilistest geomeetrilistest kujunditest (paiguti purjesid meenutavaist) koostatud abstraktne kompositsioon. Osa värvilisi kujundeid akvarellilikult läbikumavad, osa mati värviga antud. Domineerivad kollased, hallid ja rohelised toonid.
works.de: An abstract composition made up of coloured geometric shapes (in places reminiscent of sails). Some of the coloured shapes are translucent like watercolour, some are given in matte paint. Yellow, grey and green tones dominate.

works.d: Värvilistest geomeetrilistest kujunditest koostatud abstraktne kompositsioon. Ülaservas keskel roosa ja sinisega antud silmamotiiv. Värvilised pinnad kohati akvarellilikult läbikumavad.
works.de: An abstract composition made up of coloured geometric shapes. At the top centre an eye motif rendered in pink and blue. The coloured surfaces are in places translucent, watercolour-like.

works.de: paper torn to an extent of ca 7 cm. Location on object: at the bottom edge, centre

works.d: Linnavaade, esiplaanil sinise uksega madal majal. Ukse kohal slaavi tähtedega TIR.
works.de: Cityscape, in the foreground a low house with a blue door. Above the door the letters TIR in Slavic script.

works.d: Figuraalne kompositsioon sauna riietusruumis, paremal valgetes kitlites istuvad saunanaised, vasakul end kuivatavad ja riietuvad erinevates asendites saunalised.
works.de: Figural composition in a sauna dressing room, on the right sauna attendants sitting in white smocks, on the left bathers drying themselves and dressing in various poses.

works.d: Figuraalne kompositsioon suusavõistluste stardipaigast. Esiplaanil puhkpillioskester, paremal ja vasakul rühmadesse kogunenud inimesed, stardinumbrid rinnal ja seljal. Majaseintele toetuvad suusapaarid, maja ukse kõrval punased lipud. Heldur Viirese väitel on tegemist I Tartu Maratoni stardiga, kus osales ka kunstniku poeg.
works.de: A figural composition of a ski race starting point. In the foreground a brass band, on the right and left people gathered in groups, start numbers on their chests and backs. Pairs of skis leaning against the house walls, red flags beside the house door. According to Heldur Viires, this depicts the start of the 1st Tartu Marathon, in which the artist's son also took part.

works.d: Figuraalne kompositsioon. Pildi keskmes kahe mehe poolfiguurid, kellest parempoolsel suits suus, vasakpoolsel habemega mehel valge rätik õlgadel. Pildi vasakus servas lilleline kardin, paremal arvatavasti must piaano.
works.de: Figural composition. In the centre of the picture, half-figures of two men, of whom the one on the right has a cigarette in his mouth, and the bearded man on the left has a white cloth on his shoulders. On the left edge of the picture a floral curtain, on the right presumably a black piano.

works.d: Kubistlik kompositsioon erinevat kuju ja värvi kujunditega. Domineeriv punane kammitaoline kujund vasakul servas.
works.de: Cubist composition with shapes of various forms and colors. A dominant red comb-like shape on the left edge.

works.d: Kubistlik kompositsioon erinevate värvi kujunditega. Üldtonaalsus tume. Domineerivad punakad, oranžid kujundid ja elektrisinine kujund vasakul all servas.
works.de: Cubist composition with variously coloured shapes. Overall tonality dark. Reddish, orange shapes and an electric-blue shape in the lower left corner dominate.

works.d: Esiplaanil lagedad tasased põllud kollakates-rohekates-pruunikates toonides. Taamal vasakul ja paremal puude ja põõsaste rühmad taluhoonetega. Kauguses sinetav mets. Taevas hallikas-kollane.
works.de: In the foreground bare flat fields in yellowish-greenish-brownish tones. In the distance on the left and right groups of trees and bushes with farm buildings. In the distance a bluish forest. Sky greyish-yellow.

works.d: Ühtlasel ooker-sinisel udusel foonil kollakaspruun tagajalgadele tõusnud hobune kübaras ratsanikuga. Neid ümbritsevad vasakult kolm istuvat, paremalt kaks seisvat pikkades rohekaskollastes seelikutes naist. Maalitud hajuvalt, summutatud toonides.
works.de: On an even ochre-blue hazy background, a yellowish-brown horse reared up on its hind legs with a hatted rider. They are surrounded on the left by three seated and on the right by two standing women in long greenish-yellow skirts. Painted diffusely, in muted tones.

works.d: Esiplaanil molbertite taga vasakul üks, paremal kaks seisvat figuuri, nende vahel istub neljas. Figuurid on maalitud hajuvalt pruunikates rohelistes toonides. Keskosas, helesinisel foonil seisev hele naisakt, tõstetud kätega. Tema kohal, aimataval draperiil valge öökull.
works.de: In the foreground, behind easels, one standing figure on the left, two standing figures on the right, with a fourth seated between them. The figures are painted diffusely in brownish-green tones. In the middle section, against a light blue background, stands a light-toned female nude with raised arms. Above her, on a barely discernible drapery, a white owl.

works.d: Abstraktne kompositsioon, mille keskosas paiknevad erksad pinnad ning seda ümbritsevad pastelsed toonid.
works.de: Abstract composition, in the middle part of which are located bright surfaces surrounded by pastel tones.

works.d: Veerandpöördes paremale istuva naise portree. Figuuri paremat kätt paistab molberti nurk, seintel ripub paar maali.
works.de: Portrait of a woman seated in a three-quarter turn to the right. Near the figure's right hand the corner of an easel is visible, a couple of paintings hang on the walls.

works.d: Veerandpöördes vasakule vaatava naise portree helerohelisel taustal. Figuuri nägu katab tume vari ning ta kannab lillat triibulist särki rohelise prossiga ja violetset mütsi.
works.de: Portrait of a woman seen in a three-quarter turn to the left, against a light green background. The figure's face is covered by a dark shadow, and she wears a purple striped shirt with a green brooch and a violet hat.

works.d: Olmestseen kohvikus, kus on valgustatud välja pühapaistega naine, kes ulatab kolmele lastele oranži objekti.
works.de: A genre scene in a café, where a sunlit woman is lit up, handing an orange object to three children.

works.d: Vasakul madala õlgkatusega palkhoone ees grupp inimesi: lävepakul kannelt mängiv vanamees, madalal järil kala puhastav naine, vanamehe kõrval seisev naine. Tare seina ääres seisab Kreutzwald. Taga paremal värav, mille juures kookpuuga ämbrit kandev naine
works.de: On the left, in front of a log building with a low thatched roof, a group of people: on the threshold an old man playing the kannel, a woman cleaning fish on a low stool, a woman standing beside the old man. Kreutzwald stands by the wall of the cottage. Behind, on the right, a gate, by which a woman carries a bucket with a yoke

works.t: Mõis ja töö. Illustratsioon: Lauluema Marile. 1965

works.d: Väikese nelinurkse laua pind diagonaalvaates. Esiplaanil keskel kaks sigaretti ja tikutoos. Tagapool vasakul sanga ja valge korgiga klaaspudel.
works.de: The surface of a small rectangular table in diagonal view. In the foreground in the middle two cigarettes and a matchbox. Behind on the left a glass bottle with a handle and a white cork.

works.d: Õhtune suvemaastik. Esiplaanil roheline põld. Tagapool paremal hoonete grupp. Kaugemal vasakul teine rühm hooneid. Nende taga tume metsatukk. Metsa taga peaaegu kogu pildi laiuses helesine väike järv. Silmapiiril sinine viirg. Taevas kaugemal hele, soojema varjundiga. Kogu maali ulatuses kumab läbi ultramariinsinine krunt.
works.de: Evening summer landscape. Green field in the foreground. A group of buildings further back on the right. Another group of buildings further away on the left. A dark clump of forest behind them. Behind the forest, a small light-blue lake almost across the entire width of the painting. A blue streak on the horizon. The sky farther off is light, with a warmer tint. A ultramarine-blue ground shows through the whole extent of the painting.

works.d: Tumesinisel foonil kõrge vaas punaste moonidega. Paremal triibuline riie, esiplaanil klaas kahe väikese õiega.
works.de: Tall vase with red poppies on a dark blue background. Striped fabric on the right, glass with two small flowers in the foreground.

works.d: Rahvapeo stseen. Keskel jaanilõke, esiplaanil kaks lõõtspillimängijat ja rahvariietes tantsupaar, nende taga teised tantsijad. Vasakul pildi keskel vägikaikavedu, paremal alumises nurgas kaks istuvat vanameest (üks neist piibuga). Vanameeste taga vestlevad kaks naist ja üks mees. Foonil öine mets. Rohekashall koloriit peegelduvate tulehelkidega. Paremal kiikujad.
works.de: A folk festival scene. In the centre a midsummer bonfire, in the foreground two accordion players and a dancing couple in folk costume, other dancers behind them. On the left in the middle of the picture a tug-of-war, on the right in the lower corner two seated old men (one of them with a pipe). Behind the old men two women and a man conversing. In the background a nocturnal forest. Greenish-grey colouring with reflecting glimmers of fire. On the right, people on swings.

works.d: Mitmetest materjalidest vormitud ja üle maalitud reljeefne, abstraktne, sürrealistliku ruumimudelit meenutav kujutis. Keskmes kolmest ribast koosnev peegel, sellest vasakul drapereeritud marli, alumine parem nurk värvikamatest vormidest, ülemine kolmandik tumesinine, mustjas pind. Karbikujulises raamistuses.
works.de: A relief, abstract image, moulded of various materials and painted over, resembling a surrealist spatial model. In the centre a mirror consisting of three strips, to its left draped gauze, the lower right corner made of more colourful forms, the upper third a dark blue, blackish surface. In a box-shaped frame.

works.d: Abstraktsete maalipindade taustal all ääres madalad reljeefsed vormid ning ülemaalitud rohukõrred ja oksad. Koloriidis enamasti punakaspruunid ja sinised toonid.
works.de: Against abstract painted surfaces, at the lower edge low relief forms and overpainted blades of grass and branches. The colour scheme is mostly reddish-brown and blue tones.

works.d: Kubistlik ühe silma ja mustade vuntsidega mehe portree otsevaates. Intensiivsed punased ja tumesinised värvid.
works.de: Cubist frontal portrait of a man with one eye and a black moustache. Intense red and dark blue colours.

works.d: Lillakates-oranžides toonides abstraktne kompositsioon. Aimatava hoone ees vasakule suunduv tume inimkogu.
works.de: Abstract composition in purplish-orange tones. In front of a discernible building a dark crowd of people moving to the left.

works.d: Abstraktne kompositsioon tumepunasel taustal sinistes-rohekassinistes toonides tiivataolised motiivid ümber musta (seest sinise) keskpunkti.
works.de: Abstract composition on a dark red background, wing-like motifs in blue-greenish-blue tones around a black (blue inside) central point.
