works.d: Vasakul oranzil vaibal itsub seljaga vaataja poole punases kampsunis naine. Tema vastas vaibal laps mängimas. Taga paremal toolil istuv ettepoole kummardunud naine.
works.de: On the left on an orange rug sits, back to the viewer, a woman in a red sweater. Opposite her on the rug a child playing. Behind on the right a woman sitting on a chair, leaning forward.

works.d: Künklik maastik, looklev tee. Paremal metsatukk, kauguses metsaga kaetud mäed. Ees vasakul üks ja kaugemal paremal kaks taluhoonet.
works.de: Hilly landscape, a winding road. On the right a small wood, in the distance mountains covered with forest. In front on the left one, and further on the right two farm buildings.

works.d: Tehasehooned nelja suure tumeda tuhamäe taustal. Esiplaanil teel sõitev mootorrattur.
works.de: Factory buildings against the backdrop of four large dark ash heaps. In the foreground a motorcyclist riding on the road.

works.d: Noore mehe poolfiguur otsevaates. Vasak, sigaretti hoidev käsi toetatud lauale. Tumedad juuksed, kollakates toonides maalitud nägu, valge särk.
works.de: Half-figure of a young man in frontal view. Left hand, holding a cigarette, resting on the table. Dark hair, face painted in yellowish tones, white shirt.

works.d: Hallikas - lillakates toonivarjundeis jõgi, mida keskplaanil ületab sild. Vasakule jääb rannalõik paatidega, paremal ümariku kaldajoonega alal linna ehitisi, taga linn, kauguses kõrged mäed.
works.de: A river in greyish-purplish tone shades, crossed by a bridge in the middle ground. On the left a stretch of shore with boats, on the right in an area with a rounded shoreline city buildings, behind it the city, in the distance high mountains.

works.d: Esiplaanil paadisillal neli jässakat kaluririietuses meest selgvaates. Taga paremal ja ees vasakul laev, tagaplaanil meri.
works.de: In the foreground on a jetty four stocky men in fishermen's clothing, seen from behind. On the right at the back and on the left in front a ship, sea in the background.

works.d: Esiplaanil punane metallkonstruktsioon, millel inimesed. Eemal hooneid ja kõrgeid korstnaid.
works.de: In the foreground a red metal structure with people on it. In the distance buildings and tall chimneys.

works.d: Valgega maalitud vertikaalsed pildi ülaservani ulatuvad ehituspostid, mida paigaldavad töölised, ja horisontaalsed pinnad. Inimfiguurid maalitud suures üldistuses, eriti massiivselt mõjub esiplaanil istuv figuur. Servades ja ülal sinist tooni.
works.de: Vertical construction posts reaching to the upper edge of the picture, painted in white, being installed by workers, and horizontal surfaces. Human figures painted in broad generalisation, the seated figure in the foreground appearing especially massive. Blue tones at the edges and above.

works.d: Avar kartulipõld. Esiplaanil kaks kastidel istuvat naist, vasakpoolne selgvaates, parempoolne külgvaates.
works.de: A broad potato field. In the foreground two women sitting on boxes, the left one in full face view, the right one in profile.

works.d: Punakas-pruunikates toonides künklik maastik nooljate puudegruppidega. Eemal üksikud palkhooned.
works.de: A hilly landscape in reddish-brownish tones with groups of slender trees. Individual log buildings in the distance.

works.d: Vaade Niguliste kirikule Harju tänavalt. Vasakul lumiste katustega majad ja vene kiriku kuplid.
works.de: View of Niguliste Church from Harju Street. On the left houses with snowy roofs and the domes of a Russian church.

works.d: Õhtune Budapesti vaade kõrge tumeda kaarsillaga. Esiplaanil tänavalõik tramm ja inimestega, eemal heledad hooned, taevas, kuu.
works.de: Evening view of Budapest with a high dark arch bridge. In the foreground a street section with a tram and people, in the distance light-coloured buildings, sky, moon.

works.d: Kaks mehefiguuri ääsi juures. Parempoolne lõõtsa tõmbamas, vasakpoolne hoiab pihkude vahel hõõguvpunast rauatükki.
works.de: Two male figures at an anvil. The one on the right pulling the bellows, the one on the left holding a glowing red piece of iron between the tongs.

works.d: Heledal toolil istuv vana mees poolpöördes vasakule, paremas käes pliiats. Figuur ja foon on maalitud tumedais toonides.
works.de: Old man sitting on a light-coloured chair in half-turn to the left, pencil in his right hand. Figure and background painted in dark tones.

works.d: Kollakal pinnal valge punase tikandiga linik, sellel kaks puidust topsi ja ovaalne kauss.
works.de: On a yellowish surface a white cloth with red embroidery, on it two wooden cups and an oval bowl.

works.d: Kollasel laual paremal valge vaas, vasakul kohvikann alusel ja puuviljad. Nende taga kolm ikooni.
works.de: On a yellow table, on the right a white vase, on the left a coffee pot on a saucer and fruits. Behind them three icons.

works.d: Pikkade pruunide juustega noore naise rinnaportree poolpöördes paremale heledal foonil.
works.de: Bust portrait of a young woman with long brown hair, in a half-turn to the right, against a light background.

works.d: Punakaspruunis ülikonna seisev mehefiguur, keha otsevaates, pea poolpöördes paremale. Vasakus käes piip, parem käsi taskus. Heledal foonil figuuri taga suur pruunides toonides ruut.
works.de: A standing male figure in a reddish-brown suit, body in frontal view, head in three-quarter turn to the right. In his left hand a pipe, right hand in his pocket. Behind the figure against a light background a large square in brown tones.

works.d: Kaks seisvat ja üks istuv mees võrke parandamas. Kõigil näod ja kehad päevitusest punased.
works.de: Two standing and one seated man mending nets. All have faces and bodies red from sunburn.

works.d: Punakaspruunide juustega, kollakasrohelises kleidis naise pea kerges pöördes paremale. Foon sinine.
works.de: The head of a woman with reddish-brown hair, in a yellowish-green dress, turned slightly to the right. The background is blue.

works.d: Noore naise rinnafiguur profiilis paremale. Seljas kollane kleit, pikad tumedad juuksed rohelise lindiga kuklasse seotud. Foon sinine.
works.de: Bust figure of a young woman in profile to the right. Wearing a yellow dress, long dark hair tied at the nape with a green ribbon. Background blue.

works.d: Üks selgvaates, üks külgvaates ja üks otsevaates alasti naisfiguur hallikas-sinises vees.
works.de: One in back view, one in side view and one in front view - nude female figures in greyish-blue water.

works.d: Smaragdroheline metsalagendik lookleva oja ja üksikute lehtpuude ning põõsastega. Taamal tihe mets. Helesinises taevas kaks pilvekest.
works.de: Emerald-green forest clearing with a winding brook and scattered deciduous trees and bushes. Dense forest in the distance. Two small clouds in the light blue sky.

works.d: Pruunijuukselise, kahvatu naise portree en face. Foon sinine.
works.de: Portrait of a brown-haired, pale woman, en face. Background blue.

works.d: Toolil istuv heledapäine alasti tütarlaps poolpöördes paremale. Foon pruunikas, põrand hall. Maalitud heledates, õrnades toonides.
works.de: A fair-haired nude girl sitting on a chair, in a half-turn to the right. The background is brownish, the floor grey. Painted in light, delicate tones.

works.d: Ülepea kammitud pikkade, õlgadeni ulatuvate, tumedate juustega tütarlapse rinnaportree, kerges pöördes vasakule. Suured pruunid silmad, teravalõikelised kulmud, seljas sidrunivärviline kleit. Taust tumeroheline.
works.de: Bust portrait of a girl with long, dark, shoulder-length hair combed straight back, in a slight turn to the left. Large brown eyes, sharply cut eyebrows, wearing a lemon-coloured dress. The background is dark green.

works.d: Esiplaanil jõgi, kaldal kasvavate mändidega. Kaldapealsel niidul valge lehm. Tagaplaanil männik.
works.de: In the foreground a river, with pines growing on the bank. A white cow on the meadow by the bank. A pine forest in the background.

works.d: Pildi keskel kaks õitsevat viljapuud. Nende all teerajal seisab punases kleidis noor naine. Tagaplaanil lehtepuhkenud puud ja põõsad.
works.de: In the centre of the picture two flowering fruit trees. Beneath them, on a path, stands a young woman in a red dress. In the background trees and bushes in leaf.

works.d: Rohelisel foonil pikkade tumedate juustega, terava lõua ning ninaga noore naise portree pöördes vasakule. Seljas punane pluus.
works.de: Portrait of a young woman with long dark hair, a sharp chin and nose, turned to the left, against a green background. Wearing a red blouse.

works.d: Ümaranäolise, suurte sinakas-hallide silmadega tütarlapse rinnaportree, kerges pöördes vasakule. Satäänid juuksed kukla taha köidetud. Seljas pruun kleit, rinnas rahvuslik sõlg. Ülal vasakus nurgas aknaavaus, millest paistavad Vana-Tallinna hooned.
works.de: Bust portrait of a round-faced girl with large bluish-grey eyes, in a slight turn to the left. Satin-like hair tied behind the neck. Wearing a brown dress, a national brooch at the chest. In the upper left corner a window opening through which the buildings of Old Tallinn can be seen.

works.d: Rohelisel foonil pikkade valkjas-blondide juustega, väikese terava lõuaga ning laiade põsesarnadega noore naise portree, poolpöördes paremale. Seljas samblaroheline kleit. Kaelas punane rätt.
works.de: Portrait of a young woman with long whitish-blonde hair, a small pointed chin and broad cheekbones, against a green background, in half-turn to the right. Wearing a moss-green dress. A red kerchief around the neck.

works.d: Kahvatu, peente näojoontega noore naise rinnaportree, kerges pöördes vasakule. Tumedad juuksed patsi keeratud, õlad längus. Seljas telliskivivärvi ümara kaelusega kleit.
works.de: Bust portrait of a pale young woman with fine facial features, in a slight turn to the left. Dark hair twisted into a braid, shoulders sloping. Wearing a brick-red dress with a round collar.

works.d: Suure kahara lehtpuu võra ja selle taga avaneva metsaviiruga lagendiku taustal (vasakul tagaplaanil üksik kõrge lehtpuu) sinises sviitris noor naine en face, pea kerges pöördes vasakule, pilk suunatud vaatajale. Suured helepruunid mandlisilmad, peen nõrk sirge nina, väikesed tundelised huuled, vabalt õlgadele langevad lainjad pruunid juuksed ja helesinine pearätt kuklal. Parem käsi, kirsiga sõrmede vahel, rinna kohal.
works.de: Against the background of a large, spreading deciduous tree crown and a clearing opening beyond it with a strip of forest (a single tall deciduous tree in the left background), a young woman in a blue sweater, en face, her head turned slightly to the left, her gaze directed at the viewer. Large light-brown almond-shaped eyes, a fine, delicate, straight nose, small sensitive lips, wavy brown hair falling freely onto the shoulders, and a light-blue headscarf at the back of the neck. The right hand, with a cherry between the fingers, is held above the chest.

works.d: Kolme tütarlapse rinnafiguurid madala horisondiga kõrge sinise taeva taustal. Vasakul ümara avara kaelusega rohelises džempris poolprofiilis paremale pikkade juustega blondiin, keskel poolprofiilis vasemale punases, nelinurkses avara kaelusega džempris kastanpruun brünett, paremal profiilis vasemale valges, nelinurkse ja tumeda kandiga kaelusega džempris šatään.
works.de: Bust figures of three girls against a background of high blue sky with a low horizon. On the left, in half-profile to the right, a long-haired blonde in a green jumper with a round wide neckline; in the centre, in half-profile to the left, a chestnut-brown brunette in a red jumper with a square wide neckline; on the right, in profile to the left, an auburn-haired girl ["šatään"] in a white jumper with a square, dark-edged neckline.

works.d: Rohelisel, rohupuhmastega ülekülvatud rannal lamab pikki üle pildipinna (pea paremal) noor alasti naine pöördega vaatajale, käed üle pea tõstetud, pikad lahtised juuksed langevad maapinnale. Tahaplaanile jääb kitsas merelõik, mida valgustab silmapiiril helenev taevas. Maastikus valitsev ideaalne rahulikkus.
works.de: On a green shore overgrown with clumps of grass lies a young naked woman stretched lengthwise across the picture surface (head on the right), turned towards the viewer, arms raised above her head, long loose hair falling to the ground. In the background a narrow stretch of sea, lit by a glowing sky on the horizon. An ideal calm reigns in the landscape.

works.d: Künkal lehtpuu all istub, üle pildipinna ulatuv, kollases kleidis paljasjalgne noor naine. Pikad šatäänid juuksed langemas kiharatena õlgadele. Pea veidi vasakule kaldu, pilk langetatud. Käes meelespeaõitest pärg. Paremal maastik sinise jõelindiga.
works.de: On a hill under a deciduous tree sits a young woman in a yellow dress, barefoot, extending across the picture surface. Long chestnut-brown hair falling in curls onto the shoulders. Head tilted slightly to the left, gaze lowered. In her hands a wreath of forget-me-not flowers. On the right a landscape with a blue ribbon of a river.

works.d: Suvine maastik lookleva jõega. Esiplaanil kaks alasti naisefiguuri - üks tumedajuukseline istub kitsal, kaugele jõkke ulatuval paadisillal, teine heledapäine seisab vööni vees.
works.de: Summer landscape with a winding river. In the foreground two female nude figures - one dark-haired sitting on a narrow boat bridge extending far into the river, the other fair-haired standing waist-deep in the water.

works.d: Sinakashalli talvemaastiku taustal noore neiu rindportree vaatega vasakule, pikad õlgadele laskuvad juuksed, peas valkjas müts, seljas punakaslilla mantel heleda krae ja ääristusega, selle alt paistab roheline pluusikrae. Tumeroheline, kuldse liistuga raam.
works.de: Against the background of a bluish-grey winter landscape, a bust portrait of a young girl looking to the left, long hair falling to the shoulders, a whitish hat on her head, wearing a reddish-purple coat with a light collar and trimming, beneath which a green blouse collar is visible. Dark green frame with a gold moulding.

works.d: Päikesest põlenud, sinepikollases lahtises kleidis naise rinnaportree, Teravate joontega nägu, tumedad juuksed, peas must, kollase lillega kübas. Roheline foon.
works.de: A bust portrait of a sun-tanned woman in a loose mustard-yellow dress. A face with sharp lines, dark hair, wearing a black hat with a yellow flower. Green background.

works.d: Talvine linnaserva vaade kuuvalgel: kahel pool teed majaderühmad, paremal kolmekorruseline roheline maja; tagapool vabrikukorpus; esiplaanil üksik miniatuurselt mõjuv mehefiguur.
works.de: Winter view of a town edge in moonlight: on both sides of the road groups of houses, on the right a three-storey green house; beyond it a factory building; in the foreground a solitary, miniature-looking male figure.

works.d: Hallikal rohelise triibuga alusel valge vaas mitmevärviliste lopsakate õitega. Foon oranž.
works.de: On a greyish base with a green stripe, a white vase with multicoloured lush blossoms. Background orange.

works.d: Kollakal laual hall kann kollaste tulpidega.
works.de: On a yellowish table a grey jug with yellow tulips.

works.d: Ümaras, helesinakas vaasis kaks punast lilleõit ja kaks punga. Foon kollakashall.
works.de: In a round, light bluish vase two red flower blooms and two buds. Background yellowish-grey.

works.d: Esiplaanil neli tumedat lumiste katustega maja. Taevas suur roosa kuu.
works.de: In the foreground four dark houses with snowy roofs. In the sky a large pink moon.

works.d: Sinise mütsi ja lillakashalli kampsuniga tumedapäise neiu rinnaportree veerandpöördes paremale. Foon rohekassinine.
works.de: Bust portrait of a dark-haired girl in a blue cap and lilac-grey sweater, in a quarter-turn to the right. Background greenish-blue.

works.d: Kollakad ja pruunikad lumiste katustega majad. Kõrge silmapiir, vaade majadele ülevalt alla.
works.de: Yellowish and brownish houses with snowy roofs. High horizon, view of the houses from above.

works.d: Rohekates, pruunikates ja sinakates toonides panoraamne künklik maastik.
works.de: A panoramic hilly landscape in greenish, brownish and bluish tones.

works.d: Esiplaanil kanarbikulagendik lillakates ja pruunikates toonides laikudena. Taga mets rohekais-sinakais toonides laikudena. Taevas sinakaid, beezhikaid ja hallikaid toone.
works.de: In the foreground a heather clearing in patches of purplish and brownish tones. Behind it a forest in patches of greenish-bluish tones. The sky in bluish, beige and greyish tones.

works.d: Kõrge horisondiga meremaastik, esiplaanil rohekates, tagapool tumesinistes toonides.
works.de: A seascape with a high horizon, in the foreground in greenish tones, behind in dark blue tones.

works.d: Rohelisel alusel valge linik, kollane ja valge kann ning pruunikas silindilise vormiga nõu. Foon oranž.
works.de: On a green base a white cloth, a yellow and white jug, and a brownish cylindrical vessel. Background orange.

works.d: Tumehall merepind tumehalli taeva all. Silmapiir poolitab pildi horisontaalselt kaheks võrdseks osaks. Esiplaanil osaliselt rohuga kaetud liivane kallas.
works.de: Dark grey sea surface under a dark grey sky. The horizon divides the picture horizontally into two equal parts. In the foreground, a sandy shore partly covered with grass.

works.d: Heleroheline maastik helesinise taeva all. Esiplaanil lagendik, eemal lehtpuid ja põõsaid.
works.de: Light green landscape under a light blue sky. In the foreground a clearing, in the distance deciduous trees and bushes.

works.d: Helepruunil laual valge vaas kollaste, punaste, roosade ja lillade gladioolide ning teiste lilledega.
works.de: On a light brown table a white vase with yellow, red, pink and purple gladioli and other flowers.

works.d: Summutatud toonides maastik kollase lagendiku ja tuhmroheliste lehtpuudega. Taevas hallid rünkpilved.
works.de: Landscape in muted tones with a yellow clearing and dull green deciduous trees. In the sky grey cumulus clouds.

works.d: Esiplaanil roheline aas, taga lehtpuud ja põõsastik; rohekassinine taevas.
works.de: In the foreground a green meadow, behind it deciduous trees and shrubbery; greenish-blue sky.

works.d: Pruunil foonil, rohelisel laual vasakul pruun kõrvaga kruus ja selle ees lehter; keskel kollakas kaanega nõu, esiplaanil kaks oranži kera; paremale poole jääb pruun kopsik.
works.de: On a brown background, on a green table on the left a brown mug with a handle and in front of it a funnel; in the middle a vessel with a yellowish lid, in the foreground two orange spheres; to the right a brown scoop.

works.d: Sinakas-hallides toonides merepind, tume silmapiir, hele taevas, esiplaanil rannariba.
works.de: Sea surface in bluish-grey tones, a dark horizon, a bright sky, a strip of shore in the foreground.

works.d: Heleda linaga kaetud laual sinine, sangaga kann kirjude lilledega.
works.de: On a table covered with a light-coloured cloth, a blue jug with a handle, with colourful flowers.

works.d: Kahel pool majad, millede vahel paremal tõuseb trepp. Keskel trepil üles sammuv naise figuur.
works.de: Houses on both sides, between which a staircase rises on the right. In the middle, a female figure walking up the stairs.

works.d: Istuva tütarlapse poolfiguur en face helesinisel foonil. Kleit tumesinine, juuksed punakad.
works.de: Half-figure of a seated girl en face on a light blue background. Dress dark blue, hair reddish.

works.d: Künklik maastik. Silmapiiril kõrged mäed. Esiplaanil põõsaste taga orus punase katusega maja, mõned küpressid.
works.de: Hilly landscape. High mountains on the horizon. In the foreground, behind bushes in the valley, a house with a red roof, some cypresses.

works.d: Lumine maastik. Tumeda metsa foonil vasakul punases džempris suusataja, paremal punane maja.
works.de: Snowy landscape. Against the background of a dark forest, on the left a skier in a red sweater, on the right a red house.

works.d: Mustjaspunasel foonil telliskivipunane paber, millel kuus kala.
works.de: On a blackish-red background, brick-red paper with six fish on it.

works.d: Tumedal pinnal eralduvad üksikud värvilised puudegrupid. All paremal valge pink istuva mehefiguuriga.
works.de: Against a dark surface individual colourful groups of trees stand out. In the lower right a white bench with a seated male figure.

works.d: Esiplaanil pruunides toonides lage väli, millele on antud kruntimisega reljeefne faktuur. Ees paremal üksik raagus puu, eemal varemed.
works.de: In the foreground a bare field in brown tones, given a relief texture through priming. In front on the right a solitary bare tree, ruins in the distance.

works.d: Läbi avatud akna vaade suveöisesse aeda. Vasakul inimese tume siluett.
works.de: View through an open window into a summer night garden. On the left the dark silhouette of a person.

works.d: Paremal grupp inimfiguure mitmesugustes poosides. Vasemal osa majast avatud aknaga ja helesinine lapsevanker.
works.de: On the right a group of human figures in various poses. On the left part of a house with an open window and a light blue pram.

works.d: Üks seisev mehefiguur otsevaates, üks selgvaates ja üks kükitav mees külgvaates traktori ümber tegutsemas.
works.de: One standing male figure in frontal view, one in side view and one squatting man in side view working around a tractor.

works.d: Rohelisel foonil äralõigatud segmendiga kera, sinine lill ja kitsas sinine pilu.
works.de: Against a green background a sphere with a cut-off segment, a blue flower and a narrow blue slit.

works.d: Tumedajuukselise naise pea profiilis paremale, juustes punane lill. Ülal paremal mesilane.
works.de: Head of a dark-haired woman in profile facing right, a red flower in her hair. Upper right a bee.

works.d: Pildi allääres roheline maariba. Ülejäänud osa pildi pinnast katab võsa, mille vahel kitsa viiruna paistab kollane lagendik. Must raam.
works.de: At the bottom edge of the picture a green strip of land. The remaining area of the picture surface is covered with scrub, among which a narrow strip of yellow clearing is visible. Black frame.

works.d: Hallil taustal, pildi keskkohani ulatuv keskealise mehe, kergelt ettepoole hoiakuga poolfiguur. Vasakus käes sigaret. Seljas sinakas ülikond ning kollakaspunane lips. Siin-seal figuuri juures kontuurid hajuvad. Must raam.
works.de: Against a grey background, a half-figure of a middle-aged man, reaching to the middle of the picture, with a slightly forward-leaning posture. A cigarette in his left hand. Wearing a bluish suit and a yellowish-red tie. Here and there the contours of the figure blur. Black frame.

works.d: Pildi altäärest suunaga tsentrisse hele kolmnurk, millel taldrik poole leivapätsiga.  Kolmnurk ümbitsetud visandlikus laadis maalitud meesfiguuridega. Paremal ülal mehe poolfiguur vaagnaga.
works.de: From the bottom of the picture toward the centre a light triangle, on which a plate with half a loaf of bread. The triangle is surrounded by male figures painted in a sketchy manner. Upper right a half-figure of a man with a pelvis.

works.d: Üle suure pildipinna inimnäod erinevate ilmetega. Maalitud erksates toonides, etüüdlikult maaliliste plekkidena.
works.de: Human faces with different expressions spread across the large picture surface. Painted in vivid tones, as sketch-like painterly patches.

works.d: Altservast kuni umbes 1/3 maali kõrgusest tee, mis lõpeb heleda ruudukujulise avausega. kahel pool teed lapiti paletinoaga markeeritud rohelised puud.
works.de: From the bottom edge up to about 1/3 of the height of the painting, a road ending in a light-coloured square-shaped opening. On both sides of the road, green trees marked with a palette knife in patches.

works.d: Tumedal foonil punase laudlinaga kaetud laual rohekas vaas punaste ja roosakate lilledega.
works.de: On a dark background, on a table covered with a red tablecloth a greenish vase with red and pinkish flowers.

works.d: Vaade õhtusele tuledes asulale, mida piiravad kõrged mäed.
works.de: View of a settlement lit up at evening, surrounded by high mountains.

works.d: Esiplaanil sakiline kaldaäär, tagapool virvendav vesi väikeste saarekestega selles, kauguses kitsas taevaserv.
works.de: Jagged shoreline in the foreground, shimmering water with small islets behind it, a narrow strip of sky in the distance.

The composition in brown tones, from which the men's orange faces and hands, and a couple of building details of the same colour, rise in contrast.

works.d: Illustratsioonil ratsul istuv Kalevipoeg, jalutu, käes paberileht kirjaga: ARMSAD EESTI VENNAD JA ÕED. Tagaplaanil tellistest laotud ehitis. Hobuse esijalgu varjab paberileht, millel teose andmed: Enn Vetemaa KALEVIPOJA MÄLESTUSED.
works.de: In the illustration, Kalevipoeg sitting on horseback, legless, holding a sheet of paper with the text: ARMSAD EESTI VENNAD JA ÕED [Dear Estonian Brothers and Sisters]. In the background a brick-built structure. The horse's front legs are obscured by a sheet of paper bearing the work's details: Enn Vetemaa KALEVIPOJA MÄLESTUSED.

works.d: Kollastes toonides interjöör. Esiplaanil vasakul istub punaseruudulises särgis noormees, paremal kirjus kleidis tütarlaps.
works.de: Interior in yellow tones. In the foreground on the left sits a young man in a red-checked shirt, on the right a girl in a colourful dress.

works.d: Ees vasakul taburetil istuv mehefiguur seljaga, pea pööratud vaatajale, käsi taha sirutatud. Paremal pildiraamid sinise rätiga ja pildid, ühel neist alasti naisefiguur. Ateljee vasakus seinas aken, tagaseinas tugitool.
works.de: In front on the left a male figure sitting on a stool with his back turned, head turned towards the viewer, hand stretched out behind. On the right picture frames with a blue scarf and pictures, on one of them a nude female figure. In the studio's left wall a window, in the back wall an armchair.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul heledasse riietatud naisefiguur, tass käes, istub tugitoolis. Temast vasemale jääb püstloodis hele seinaosa, paremale interjöör punasetäpiliste seinte ja tugitoolidega ning kollase vaibaga. Paremal pildipoolel on kujutatud vaade aeda.
works.de: In the foreground on the left, a female figure dressed in light clothing, cup in hand, sitting in an armchair. To her left is a vertical light-coloured wall section, to the right an interior with red-spotted walls and armchairs and a yellow carpet. On the right side of the picture, a view of the garden is depicted.

works.d: Esiplaanil poolprofiilis vasemale tumedapäine istuv mees valges särgis, parem käsi küünarnukist kõverdatuna ette sirutatud, peopesaga vaataja poole, vasak käsivars küünarnukist kõverdatud, vabalt rippuva käelabaga. Tema ees fragment Palladio fassaadijoonistustest, sellel heraldilise roosi kujuline kuldne metalltaldrik sellel lebava roosa daaliaõiega. Figuuri selja taga punakates varjundites paarissammastega poolkaarekujuline kolonnaad, maali paremal äärel sammastiku taga tantsivad noormehed ja neiud värvilistes kitoonides.
works.de: In the foreground, in three-quarter profile facing left, a dark-haired seated man in a white shirt, his right arm bent at the elbow and stretched forward, palm toward the viewer, his left arm bent at the elbow with the hand hanging freely. In front of him a fragment of Palladio's facade drawings, on which lies a golden metal plate in the shape of a heraldic rose, with a pink dahlia flower resting on it. Behind the figure, in reddish shades, a semicircular colonnade with paired columns; on the right edge of the painting, behind the colonnade, young men and women dance in colourful chitons.

works.d: Tasasel, madala horisondiga abstraktsel hallil väljal kõrgest ja lähedasest rakursist vaadatuna üleelusuurused köögiviljad - keskel hulk roosasid kapsalehti, vasemal punane peet ja selle peal petersell, juures oakaunad ja lõik rohelisest kapsapeast, taga puuviljad. Paremal petersellilehed porgandite ja naeriga. Esiplaanil kummalgi kompositsioonipoolelkõrvitsalõik, nende vahel kaks lauanuga. Natüürmordi taga avaneb vaade kõrgelt horisondilt üksikutele Tallinna ehitistele: vasakul Toompea nõlv ning projekteerimisinstituudi hoone, paremal hotell "Viru" Olevist kiriku torniga. Helesinine taevas valkjashallide rünkpilvedega.
works.de: On a flat, abstract grey field with a low horizon, viewed from a high and close vantage point, are over-life-size vegetables — in the centre a mass of pink cabbage leaves, on the left a red beet with parsley on top of it, beside it bean pods and a section of a green cabbage head, fruits in the back. On the right, parsley leaves with carrots and a turnip. In the foreground, on each side of the composition, a slice of squash, with two table knives between them. Behind the still life, a view opens from a high horizon onto individual buildings in Tallinn: on the left the slope of Toompea and the building of the design institute, on the right the hotel "Viru" with the tower of St. Olaf's Church. A pale blue sky with whitish-grey cumulus clouds.

works.d: Pildi keskosas kõrged metallpostid, traatide rägastik ja mitmesugused elektriseadmed. Nende vahel paar inimfiguuri. Esiplaanil (paremal 2 ning vasakul 1) palja ülakehaga noormeest mõõteriistadega.
works.de: In the middle of the picture tall metal poles, a tangle of wires and various electrical devices. Between them a couple of human figures. In the foreground (2 on the right and 1 on the left) bare-chested young men with measuring instruments.

works.d: Vasakul heledas, rohekas-kollases kleidis istuva noore naise täisfiguur, pöördes vasakule. Süles hoiab ta heledapäist, alasti poisslast. Naise põlvedelt langeb pehmetes voltides põrandani valge riie. Pildi keskel ja paremal eredates punastes, rohelistes, roosakates toonides. Kompositsioon arhitektuurse dekoori elementidest ning abstraktsetest pindadest, mille vahel lendlevad esiplaanil kaks ja paremas servas üks väike lind. Tagaplaanil hallide vertikaalsete talade vahelt avaneb vaade sügavsinisele merele.
works.de: On the left, the full figure of a young woman seated, wearing a light, greenish-yellow dress, turned to the left. In her lap she holds a fair-haired, naked boy child. From the woman's knees, white fabric falls to the floor in soft folds. The middle and right of the picture are in bright red, green, and pinkish tones. A composition of architectural decorative elements and abstract surfaces, between which two small birds fly in the foreground and one in the right edge. In the background, between grey vertical beams, a view opens onto the deep blue sea.

works.d: Mustal foonil tumedas kootud kampsunis kolmveerandfiguur. Pea kergelt vaataja poole pööratud, valvas pilk, tume väike habe ja vuntsid. Varrukasuust paistavad helevalged mansetid, mõlema käe sõrmed laiali sirutatud. Foonil üksikud värvilised  jooned.
works.de: Three-quarter figure against a black background, in a dark knitted jumper. Head slightly turned towards the viewer, watchful gaze, small dark beard and moustache. Bright white cuffs show from the sleeve ends, the fingers of both hands spread wide. In the background isolated coloured lines.

works.d: Rohelistes ja tumesinistes toonides park, puudekroonid dekoratiivse üldistusega maalitud. Puude all ristuvad, tumehalli pinnakattega alleed, keskel purskkaev.
works.de: A park in green and dark blue tones, tree crowns painted with decorative generalisation. Under the trees crossing avenues with a dark grey surface, a fountain in the centre.

works.d: Laua taga istuv, keskealine mees otsevaates, kolmveerandfiguurina, veidi naerul näoga, hallide, lühikeste juustega, seljas tume, lipsuga ülikond, käed vaheliti süles, paremas käes valge paberileht. Esiplaanil, veidi diagonaalis, heleda paberiga pruun lauaplaat, kujutise laiuselt. Laual vasakult paremale: valgeid paberilehti, tume-lillakas telefoniaparaat, pruunide raamidega prillid, heledam, avatud prillitoos, avatud raamat ja kollane täitesulepea. Laua taga tumehall foon, kuni kujutise ülemise servani helesinine taevas horisontaalse, valge pilveribaga, mille sees ümmargune, päikese ketas.
works.de: A middle-aged man sitting at a table, facing forward, as a three-quarter figure, with a slightly smiling face, grey short hair, wearing a dark suit with a tie, hands folded in his lap, a white sheet of paper in his right hand. In the foreground, slightly diagonal, a brown tabletop with light-coloured paper, spanning the width of the image. On the table, from left to right: white sheets of paper, a dark-purplish telephone set, brown-framed glasses, a lighter, open glasses case, an open book and a yellow fountain pen. Behind the table a dark grey background, up to the upper edge of the image a light blue sky with a horizontal white cloud band, within which a round solar disc.

works.d: Markeeritud ruum roosa-valge-ruudulise põranda ja tagaseinaga, külgseinad helesinised (klaas), lagi rohekas-hall, keskel valge ovaal. Maali alaääres rohekas-hallid triibud. Kruvidega lõuendile kinnitatud viis figuuritaolist pleksiklaasist siluetti.
works.de: A marked-off space with a pink-white checkered floor and back wall, side walls pale blue (glass), ceiling greenish-grey, a white oval in the centre. At the lower edge of the painting, greenish-grey stripes. Five figure-like plexiglass silhouettes attached to the canvas with screws.

Rohekal veel 9 sõudepaati, ees paremal mootorpaat kolme sõitjaga (kaks seisvat noormeest, istuv noorik). 1/3 alumisest maalist kujutatud veepinda- põhja ruumilisena. Keskel perforeeritud plastikplaat, kahel pool ülemaalitud drapeeritud tekstiili- ja lõuendivoldid.
works.de: A three-dimensional composition of a river view with boats in the evening glow with the sun's reflection in the water. A boat harbour bordered by dark green shrub bushes, on the right a harbour building with a red frame. On the greenish water 9 rowing boats, in front on the right a motorboat with three passengers (two standing young men, a sitting young woman). 1/3 of the lower part of the painting depicts the water surface–bottom as three-dimensional. In the middle a perforated plastic sheet, on both sides overpainted folds of draped textile and canvas.

works.d: Kunstnik Andres Toltsi istuv otsevaates täisfiguurportree. Pruunis pintsakus, ruudulises särgis ja valgetes pükstes kunstnik istub valges käetugedega toolis, taustal avaus, kust paistavad mustrilisi kangarulle või kõrghooneid meenutavad heledates toonides objektid. Kunstniku ümber värvilisi konstruktivistlikke vorme, kollane lauake kirjus vaasis potilillega ja lehviv punaste täppidega kardin.
works.de: A full-length, frontal seated portrait of the artist Andres Tolts. Dressed in a brown jacket, checked shirt and white trousers, the artist sits in a white armchair, with an opening in the background from which patterned rolls of fabric or objects in light tones resembling tall buildings can be seen. Around the artist colourful constructivist forms, a small yellow table with a patterned vase with a potted flower, and a flowing curtain with red dots.

works.de: City view with a basin and a fountain, at the centre of which four jets of water spray high up. In the foreground a basin full of water, in the background grey asphalt and a stone wall. The picture is divided diagonally into three surfaces by two pairs of red-and-white lines.

works.de: An installation consisting of male and female figures wearing swimwear and two cats. A small ball in the woman's hand moves with the help of an electric motor. On one cat the tail moves, on the other the tongue moves in and out of the mouth. The figures are adapted from plastic mannequins, repainted in white and pinkish tones, with white stickers resembling seed cells glued onto the man's trousers and onto the ball in the woman's hand. The figures wear glasses. The figures rest on round metal stands

works.de: Tower-like structures with numerous arches, filled with depictions of bells and cats. In the middle two figures combining motifs of shells and classical architecture. Below, a field covered with shells

works.de: Composition with plants under domes. Beside them, constructions resembling glass domes or cages, each with a seated seagull on top, inside pairs of shapes resembling giant matches. Below, smaller mechanisms with numerous wheels.

works.de: Two structures resembling amphitheatres, with owls sitting in the regular cylindrical sections at their upper edges. Below, a line of turtles, above which a flock of wings and two bees, at the top strange flying apparatuses lined up

works.d: Mustal pinnal puur putukate ja taimedega, keskteljeks kübarat ja rõngast ühendava motiiviga tipnev selgrooga meenutav struktuur. Puuris all vasakul ja paremal paar jalajäljest ja kingloomast; keskel vasakul hakklihamasin ja mannekeen-riidenagi, ülal kahel pool rõngast kameeleonid
works.de: On a black surface a cage with insects and plants, with a spine-like structure as the central axis, connecting a hat and a ring motif, culminating at the top. In the cage, at the bottom left and right, a pair of footprints and a shoe-like creature; in the centre left a meat grinder and a mannequin-clothes hanger, at the top on both sides of the ring, chameleons.

works.d: Esiplaanil suur lamav kass, kõhu ja selja peal kassipojad ning esikäppade juures hiir. Kassi taga, väikeste puude kroonidele asetatuna, rida televiisorikaste, mille sees hiired ja peal vertikaalasendis hiirelõksud. Kirjeldatud motiiv tervikuna kordub taga väiksemana, kahanedes ruumi perspektiivis. Seintel suured hiirelõksud, laes ava, mille kaudu maanduvad langevarjuhüppajad
works.de: In the foreground a large lying cat, with kittens on its stomach and back and a mouse near its front paws. Behind the cat, placed in the crowns of small trees, a row of television boxes containing mice, with mousetraps in vertical position on top. The described motif as a whole repeats behind, smaller, diminishing in the perspective of the space. On the walls large mousetraps, an opening in the ceiling through which parachutists land

works.d: Esiplaanil lumise talvemaastiku taustal silinderjas sooniline postament, millelt tõusevad käed fotoaparaatide ja kivikildudega, keskel olev käsi hoiab õuna, selle kohal väiksem käsi punutud korviga. Taust koosneb horisontaalsetest mustadest ja valgetest triipudest, valgetel mustade täppide rida, mis kõrgenedes üha suuremad mõõtmed võtab
works.de: In the foreground, against a background of a snowy winter landscape, a cylindrical fluted pedestal from which hands rise holding cameras and stone fragments, the hand in the middle holding an apple, above it a smaller hand with a woven basket. The background consists of horizontal black and white stripes, on the white ones a row of black dots which grow larger in size as they rise.

works.dm: graafikaplaadi kõrgus: 48.5 cm; graafikaplaadi laius: 12.1 cm; lehe laius: 76.9 cm; kujutise laius: 60.5 cm (viielt plaadilt kõrvuti trükitud)
works.d: Kujutis koosneb ühelt plaadilt üksteise kõrvale trükitud viiest ühesugusest vertikaalset osast. All kaks kätega paremast jalast kinnihoidvat väikelapse figuuri, nende kohal televiisoritest koosnev kõrghoone, ülal kummaski ääres katkend langevarjust. Kompositsiooni keskmine vertikaalosa tumedam (fotosöövitus negatiivis)
works.de: The image consists of five identical vertical parts printed side by side from one plate. Below, two infant figures holding their right foot with both hands, above them a high-rise building composed of televisions, at the top on either edge a fragment of a parachute. The middle vertical part of the composition is darker (photo-etching in negative)

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 60.2 cm; lehe laius: 79.8 cm; kujutise laius: 60.0 cm (kahelt plaadilt kõrvuti trükitud); graafikaplaadi laius: 30.0 cm
works.d: Kujutis koosneb ühelt plaadilt teineteise kõrvale trükitud kahest ühesugusest vertikaalsest osast: külgedel sümmeetriliselt paigutatud kõrghooned, esiplaanil keskel stiliseeritud puud; tagaplaanil madalad suitsevad korstnad ning põlevad elektripirnid postide otsas. Hoonete foonil üksteise kohal kaks stiliseeritud puud
works.de: The image consists of two identical vertical parts printed side by side from one plate: high-rise buildings symmetrically arranged on the sides, a stylised tree in the middle in the foreground; in the background low smoking chimneys and burning light bulbs at the tops of poles. Against the background of the buildings, two stylised trees one above the other

works.d: Sümmetriline kompositsioon, mille keskel astmeline püramiiditaoline ehitis, selle otsas sfäär. Püramiidi alumise astme sisemuses kohviveski grammofoni kõlatorudega, ülemistel astmetel orvad kaabudes ning kiivrites inimpeadega. Sfääri keskel ülestikku kaks munajat motiivi tiivapaariga, sääfri ümber võru lõvide ja poolikute taskukelladega. Mõlemil küljel elektripirnid, nende all telefonide fragmendid. Kujutise allosas vaheldumisi pead kaabudes, kiivrites ning sidemetes, nende kohal ovaalsete puukroonide rida
works.de: A symmetrical composition, at the centre of which is a stepped, pyramid-like structure topped with a sphere. Inside the lowest step of the pyramid is a coffee grinder with the horns of a gramophone; on the upper steps, orphans in bowler hats and helmets with human heads. In the middle of the sphere, two egg-shaped motifs stacked with a pair of wings; around the sphere a wreath of lions and half pocket watches. On both sides, electric light bulbs, below them fragments of telephones. In the lower part of the image, alternating heads in bowler hats, helmets and bandages, above them a row of oval tree crowns.

works.d: Sinakasrohekal, veidi varjundatud pinnal mustad, valged ja kollakad kujundid.
works.de: On a bluish-green, slightly shaded surface, black, white and yellowish shapes.

works.d: Soojades punakaspruunides toonides interjööris esiplaanil ümmargune laud viie sidruniga. Taga ovaalne peegel ja draperii.
works.de: In an interior in warm reddish-brown tones, a round table with five lemons in the foreground. Behind it an oval mirror and drapery.

works.d: Punakaspruunides toonides läbilõige mullapinnast. Alumised, pragudega kihi maalitud väga pastoosselt.
works.de: Cross-section of soil in reddish-brown tones. The lower, cracked layers painted very impasto.

works.d: Viie punases-lillas riietuses nooruki kolmveerand-figuuri sinisel foonil. Esimesel käes kitarr.
works.de: Three-quarter figures of five youths in red-purple clothing on a blue background. The first holds a guitar in his hand.

works.d: Pildi allääres lamav naine, käed pea all, alumine kehapool kuni rinnani valgustatud, ülaosa varjus. Tema kõrval balustraadile toetuv, seisev naine, ülakeha varjus. Figuuride vahel sinise riidega kaetud alus, sellel valge taldrik. Paremas nurgas all üksik puuleht. Rõdult avanev taevas ühtlaselt sinine.
works.de: At the bottom edge of the picture, a reclining woman, hands under her head, the lower part of her body up to the chest illuminated, the upper part in shadow. Beside her, a standing woman leaning on a balustrade, her upper body in shadow. Between the figures, a stand covered with blue cloth, on which is a white plate. In the lower right corner, a single leaf. The sky opening from the balcony is uniformly blue.

works.d: Tumepruunil foonil alt servast kuni keskjooneni ulatuv pind, mille vasak nurk tugevalt kollaselt valgustatud, Sellest taga hajuvate piirjoontega punane ring. Esiplaanil all servas kaks kujundit, üks vertikaalis, teine horisontaalis.
works.de: On a dark brown background, a surface extending from the lower edge to the centre line, its left corner strongly lit in yellow. Behind it, a red circle with diffuse outlines. In the foreground at the lower edge, two shapes, one vertical, the other horizontal.

works.d: Pildil kaks ristkülikukujulist pinda: ülemisel paremas servas kumer sisselõige, pind maalitud faktuurselt. Alumisel ala- ja ülaserval laineliselt. Ülal sinine, kolmnurkadeks jaotatud ovaal. Pildil vasakul läbi mõlema pinna rohelise ja valgega maalitud ebakorrapärastest pindadest kujundid.
works.de: The picture shows two rectangular surfaces: in the upper right edge a curved indentation, the surface painted texturally. On the lower and upper edges, wavy. Above, a blue oval divided into triangles. On the left of the picture, shapes painted in green and white with irregular surfaces run through both surfaces.

works.d: Abstraktselt kaheosaline kompositsioon, lahutatud valge horisontaalse vöödiga. Alumisel kolmveerandil karmiinvioletne sõiduauto külgvaates, selle kõrval karmiinpunases sportlikus ülikonnas ettekummardunud noormees profiilis vasemale. Vasakul alumisel äärel kummulikeeratud lahtine kohver ning kortsutatud paberi taoline abstraktne vorm. Alumises paremas nurgas silmile tõmmatud valge kübaraga, veidi langetatud peaga mehe ülakeha, paremas käes valge vai. Tema taga kõrgemal vaatajale suunatud pilguga, kollaste varjunditega sinine noormehe pea avatud suuga Kolmveerandi ülaosas paremal ümberpööratuna abstraktsete silma- ja peakattega enesel hõlmu rebiv mees mootorratta esiosaga. Ülemisel veernadil
works.de: An abstractly two-part composition, divided by a white horizontal band. In the lower three-quarters a carmine-violet automobile in side view, beside it a young man in a carmine-red sporty suit, bent forward, in profile facing left. On the lower left edge an overturned open suitcase and a crumpled-paper-like abstract form. In the lower right corner the upper body of a man with a white hat pulled down over his eyes, head slightly lowered, a white stake in his right hand. Behind him, higher up, with a gaze directed at the viewer, the head of a young man in blue with yellow shadings, mouth open. In the upper part of the upper three-quarters, on the right, turned upside down, a man with abstract eyes and headgear, tearing at his own lapels, with the front of a motorcycle. In the upper quarters

works.d: Ühefiguuriline kompositsioon rinnuli kukkunud ning uduvines hõljuvast sõdurist, kes on riietatud valkjas-pruunikas-kollasesse, pruunide teravate varjudega suvisesse sõdurivormi. Jalad ja pea hajuvad värvitoone kaotades uduvinesse. Jalad kõverdatud, õlad peaaegu selgvaates. Üle kogu kompositsiooni T-kujuline punane liist ülemises servas kraplakk-punane, vertikaalne liist, mis jaotab kompositsiooni kaheks võrdseks osaks, erkpunase varjundiga ning keskel tumepunase, osalt musta kitsa kesktriibuga. Hallikas-kollakas neutraalses foonis ülal, vasemal pool liistu kahe, paremal nelja kuuliauguga.
works.de: A single-figure composition of a soldier falling forward, chest-first, hovering in a hazy mist, dressed in a whitish-brownish-yellow summer soldier's uniform with sharp brown shadows. The legs and head dissolve into the haze, losing their tones. The legs bent, the shoulders almost in profile. Across the whole composition a T-shaped red border, at the upper edge a madder-lake-red vertical border, dividing the composition into two equal parts, with a bright red tint and in the middle a narrow dark red, partly black central stripe. In the greyish-yellowish neutral background, above, to the left of the border two bullet holes, to the right four.

works.d: Kollase-punasel ühtlasel foonil plastiliselt, ruumilise illusiooniga maalitud mitmesugused esemed: sinised kindad, autokumm, päikesevarjud jne. ning sinistes toonides saabastes naise jalad, käed. Üle pildipinna diagonaalne joon.
works.de: Against a uniform yellow-red background, various objects painted plastically, with spatial illusion: blue gloves, a car tyre, parasols, etc., and a woman's legs and hands in boots in bluish tones. A diagonal line across the picture surface.

works.d: Pildipind valge vertikaalse joonega jaotatud kaheks. Vasakul pruunid pika säärega saapad, ovaalne peegel, kaabu, taldrik kalaga. Paremal korduvad samad esemed, kuid maalitud tumedas sinises, nii et esemed vaid kumavad värvides.
works.de: The picture surface is divided into two by a white vertical line. On the left, brown high-legged boots, an oval mirror, a hat, a plate with a fish. On the right the same objects are repeated, but painted in dark blue, so that the objects only glimmer through the colours.

works.d: Pruunil alusel, millel kolm patja (kollane, sinine, roheline) lebab seljaga vaataja poole alasti naine. Taust sinine, järk-järgult heledamaks muutuv kuni valgeni välja.
works.de: On a brown base, on which three pillows (yellow, blue, green) lie, a nude woman lies with her back to the viewer. Background blue, gradually becoming lighter until white.

works.d: Maali pind jagatud kolmeks, nii et kitsas ülaosa tähistaeva kujutisega eraldatud horisontaaljoonega, vasemale jääb intensiivne sinine ühtlane pind, paremal voodi  milles lamab figuur, kes kaetud voldilise riidega. Valgel linal lamab sinine käsi, mis tuleb veelgi esile sellega külgneva oranži tooni tõttu.
works.de: The surface of the painting is divided into three parts, so that the narrow upper part with the depiction of the starry sky is separated by a horizontal line; to the left remains an intense blue uniform surface, on the right a bed in which lies a figure covered with folded cloth. On the white sheet lies a blue hand, which stands out even more due to the adjacent orange tone.

works.d: Suures plaanis punases riietuses mehefiguur, valgustatud ainult keha (muu on sulatatud tumedusse), istumas sinisel mootorratal, millest näha esiosa, ümbritsetud heleda teravalt murtud voltides riidega. Kujutus kordub kolmel osal, eraldajaks valge värviga tõmmatud sirgjoon.
works.de: A man's figure dressed in red in a large close-up, only the body illuminated (the rest dissolved into darkness), sitting on a blue motorcycle, of which the front part is visible, surrounded by light-coloured fabric in sharply broken folds. The depiction repeats across three parts, separated by a straight line drawn in white paint.

works.d: Kogu pildipinna suurune ring. Horisontaalselt pooleks jagatud ringi ülemises osas tähistaevas siniste pilvedega. Alumises osas heledal riidel neli sinisetoonilist, täpilist linnumuna.
works.de: A circle the size of the entire picture surface. In the upper part of the circle, divided horizontally in half, a starry sky with blue clouds. In the lower part, on light-coloured fabric, four speckled bird's eggs in blue tones.

works.d: Tumesinisel  foonil kaks elektrisinist pinda teineteise suhtes täisnurga all. Pindade ees, vertikaalsel keskjoonel, peamiselt tumepunastest segmentidest, roosadest väänlevaist lintidest ja pingist koostatud abstraktne kompositsioon. Sellest kõrgemal ja külgedel vormitud reljeefsed, siniseks värvitud kipsist kujundid. All servas keskel kolm värvitud kipsist, reljeefset palli meenutavat kujundit.
works.de: On a dark blue background two electric-blue surfaces at right angles to one another. In front of the surfaces, on the vertical centre line, an abstract composition composed mainly of dark red segments, pink winding ribbons and a bench. Above this and at the sides, moulded relief shapes of plaster painted blue. At the bottom edge in the middle, three painted plaster relief shapes resembling balls.

works.d: Figuraalne kompositsioon, mille üksikud elemendid öises valguses heledamalt valgustatud. Paremal ülal kaks mustade kontsentriliste ringidega tahvlit, milledest vasakul sinises pluusis, kaabus, figuur seljaga vaataja poole ning erkpunase suu, päikeseprillide ja keelavalt väljasirutatud käega naine, kelle juures kõveras mehefiguur. Ringidest paremal naise sinises ning paremal all hüüdeks käed suu juurde tõstnud mees. All vasakul ja keskel lamava valgetes pükstes mehe ning paljaste õlgadega naise figuuri fragmendid. Allservas keskel suur kägardatud paberi nutsak. Foon tume, domineerivad valged, mustad ja sinised toonid.
works.de: A figural composition, whose individual elements are more brightly lit in the night-time light. Upper right two panels with black concentric circles, of which the left one shows, from behind, a figure in a blue blouse and hat, a woman with a bright red mouth, sunglasses, and a hand outstretched in a forbidding gesture, next to whom is a bent male figure. To the right of the circles, in blue, a woman, and lower right a man with his hands raised to his mouth as if calling out. Lower left and centre, fragments of the figure of a reclining man in white trousers and a woman with bare shoulders. At the bottom centre a large crumpled wad of paper. The background is dark, with white, black and blue tones dominating.

works.d: Esiplaanil klaasuks, millest läbi astumas rohelise inimfiguurid. Ülaosas sinised ja valged pastoossed värvilaigud figuuride vahel. All vasakul pruuni riietatud mehe torso.
works.de: In the foreground a glass door, through which green human figures are stepping. At the top, blue and white pastose patches of colour between the figures. At the bottom left, the torso of a man dressed in brown.

works.d: Vaade linnulennult üle maastiku: paremal servas all vahutavate laineharjadega sügavsinine meri mitmete lahesoppidega ülaservas. Vasakul all ja keskel teede ja tikukarbi suuruste majakestega kollastes ja pruunides toonides maastik, mille kohal hõljub valge lennuk. Vasakus ülanurgas roheline metsatukk. Valge ja kollasega on väga pastoosselt maalitud.
works.de: A bird's-eye view over a landscape: at the lower right edge a deep blue sea with foaming wave crests, with several bay inlets at the upper edge. At the lower left and centre, a landscape in yellow and brown tones with roads and matchbox-sized little houses, above which a white aeroplane hovers. In the upper left corner a green patch of forest. The white and yellow are painted very impastoly.

works.d: Pildi ülaosas sinise taeva foonil rauast ja betoonist (hallid, valged, punased) diagonaalselt üksteisesse lõikuvad sillakonstruktsioonid. All paremas nurgas pruun sillakaar. Vasakul jõgi, mille kohal kulgeva raudteesilla hallidele betoonsammastele on ülal kinnitatud ažuursed metallpiirded. Taamal, väga madalal asuval silmapiiril heledates toonides linn. Keskel, punaseks värvitud metallsõrestiku käänukohas kollas ja punase värvi pritsmed.
works.de: In the upper part of the picture, against a blue sky background, diagonally intersecting bridge structures made of iron and concrete (gray, white, red). In the lower right corner a brown bridge arch. On the left a river, above which airy metal railings are attached to the gray concrete pillars of a railway bridge running above. In the distance, on a very low horizon, a city in light tones. In the middle, at the bend of the metal lattice painted red, splashes of yellow and red paint.

works.d: Kollakates ja rohekates toonides taimelehti ja öisi. Vasakul tumeroheline ja paremal kollane vertikaalne triip.
works.de: Leaves and blossoms of plants in yellowish and greenish tones. On the left a dark green vertical stripe and on the right a yellow one.

works.d: Vasakul ja paremal pruunis ülikonnas noormeeste poolfiguurid, keskel punases lillelises kleidis tütarlapse poolfiguur.
works.de: Left and right, half-figures of young men in brown suits, in the centre a half-figure of a girl in a red floral dress.

works.d: Tumesinisel foonil vasakul lillades ja kollastes toonides lillede grupp. Ülevalt servast jookseb lilla diagonaal, mis eraldab lillede grupist paremale äärde jäävat üht liiliat ja kaht kollast õit.
works.de: On a dark blue background, on the left a group of flowers in purple and yellow tones. From the upper edge runs a purple diagonal, separating from the group of flowers one lily and two yellow blossoms remaining on the right edge.

works.d: Esiplaani erkrohelist maapinda läbib kitsas punane diagonaal. Keskplaanil mets - paremal pool metsa ääres valge maja. Taevas intensiivne sinine.
works.de: A narrow red diagonal runs through the bright green ground in the foreground. In the middle ground a forest - to the right at the edge of the forest a white house. The sky is intense blue.

works.dm: kõrgus: 120.6 cm (vasakpoolne osa); laius: 80.2 cm (parempoolne osa); laius: 80.4 cm (vasakpoolne osa); kõrgus: 120.7 cm (parempoolne osa)
works.d: Kompositsiooni vasakpoolsel osal paremal rohelise riidega laudjat katval punasel hobusel vaataja suunas ratsutav kollases särgis ja oranžides lühikestes pükstes, lehvivate juustega neiu. Ees ja vasemal tumesinised abstraktsed tõkked, üksikud kressilehed. Paremal osal tumesiniste abstraktsete tõkete ees punane hobune lehviva lakaga poolprofiilis paremale, pea poolprofiilis vasemale. Ülaosas üle kogu kompositsiooni vabalt lainetav vikerkaar. Helesinine foon.
works.de: On the left part of the composition, on a red horse covered with a green cloth over the croup, a girl in a yellow shirt and orange short trousers, with flowing hair, riding toward the viewer on the right. In front and to the left, dark blue abstract barriers, single nasturtium leaves. In the right part, in front of dark blue abstract barriers, a red horse with flowing mane in three-quarter profile to the right, head in three-quarter profile to the left. At the top, a freely undulating rainbow spans the whole composition. Light blue background.

works.d: Esiplaanil rohekate varjunditega rohekassinise tasase välja taustal paremal all pruuni hobuse pea ning sellest paremal, vaatajale lähemal, kollaste rakmetega punase hobuse pea, mõlemad profiilis vasemale. Keskplaanil vasakul profiilis paremale punases kombenesioonis seisev neiu. Tagaplaanil lainjas maastik lehtpuude ja põõsastega, keskel kaks lihtsates geomeetrilistes vormides madalat halli hoonet. Horisondi kohal, keskteljest veidi vasemal hõljuvad kaks loomulikus suuruses maikellukest. Valge, horisondile lähenedes kreemjas taevas.
works.de: In the foreground, against a background of a flat greenish-blue field with green shades, at the lower right the head of a brown horse, and to the right of it, closer to the viewer, the head of a red horse with yellow harness, both in profile facing left. In the middle ground on the left, in profile facing right, a maiden standing in a red combination. In the background an undulating landscape with deciduous trees and bushes, in the middle two low grey buildings in simple geometric forms. Above the horizon, slightly to the left of the central axis, two life-size lilies of the valley float. Above the horizon the sky is white, becoming creamy as it approaches the horizon.

works.d: Kolmeosaline maal. Kesktahvlil paremal punane hobusepea, lillekimp ja puuviljad, vasemal puuviljade järele sirutuv käsi. Keskosa ülemist kolmandikku läbivad kaks tumesinist triipu, neist kõrgemal vertikaalsel keskjoonel pruun nelinurkne pind. Parempoolsel külgtahvlil õun rohelisel, vasakpoolsel puuviljad beežil foonil.
works.de: A three-part painting. On the central panel on the right a red horse's head, a bouquet of flowers and fruits, on the left a hand reaching for the fruits. The upper third of the central part is crossed by two dark blue stripes, above which on the vertical centre line is a brown rectangular surface. On the right-hand side panel an apple on a green background, on the left-hand one fruits on a beige background.

works.d: All keskel ultramariinsinisel pinnal heledapäise naise rinnaportree (profiilis). Paremal erkrohelisel roosa roosiõis, pirn, õun, ploom ja sõstrakobar. Naisest ülalpool kaks pikavarrelist lehte. Ülal, vasakus nurgas kolm punast siplegat. Neist veidi allpool läbib pildi pinda 2/3 ulatuses horisontaalne punane joon.
works.de: At the bottom centre, on an ultramarine blue surface, a bust portrait of a fair-haired woman (in profile). On the right, on a bright green ground, a pink rose blossom, a pear, an apple, a plum and a bunch of currants. Above the woman two long-stemmed leaves. Above, in the left corner, three red butterflies. Slightly below them a horizontal red line runs across 2/3 of the surface of the picture.

works.d: Ülemine osa: tumesinisel foonil ülal üksik märtsikelluke ja sidrun, nende all suureõielised amarüllised, punased tulbid, paar märtsikellukest,
works.de: Upper part: on a dark blue background above a single snowdrop and a lemon, below them large-flowered amaryllises, red tulips, a couple of snowdrops,

works.d: I osa (ülemine): mustjaspunasel, alumisest ning vasakust servast heledamalt kumaval foonil all keskel piibeleheõis.
works.de: Part I (upper): on a blackish-red background, lighter at the lower and left edges, a lily-of-the-valley blossom at the lower centre.

works.d: Tumerohelisel foonil, töö paremas servas elusuuruses noore naise põlvportree. Heledate poolpikkade juuste ja sirge ninaga naisel seljas pruunist karusnahast poolkasukas, mille kaelusest paistab kollane pluus. Seelikul suured värvilised puuviljad: kaks kollast sidrunit, kaks rohelist jõmmelgat ja kaks punast õuna ühes kolme kahvatu talvise maikellukesega. Foonil, otsekui sügavikus hõljumas kaks punast ja üks beež kruus, millest ühel on portreeritava pulmapilt, teisel perekonnapilt pojaga.
works.de: Against a dark green background, on the right edge of the work, a life-size knee-length portrait of a young woman. The woman, with light-coloured medium-length hair and a straight nose, is wearing a half-length coat of brown fur, from the collar of which a yellow blouse can be seen. On the skirt large colourful fruits: two yellow lemons, two green greengages and two red apples together with three pale winter lilies of the valley. In the background, as if floating in the depths, two red mugs and one beige mug, on one of which is the sitter's wedding photo, on another a family photo with her son.

works.d: Erksinisel foonil rohelises kleidis naise poolfiguur kerges pöördes paremale. Naisel ruuged poolpikad, otstest kergelt kaarduvad juuksed, suured, pisut pungis sinised silmad, kitsad kulmukaared. Pika sirge nina all kaunilt vormitud suu.
works.de: Half-figure of a woman in a green dress against a bright blue background, slightly turned to the right. The woman has reddish, shoulder-length hair curling slightly at the ends, large, somewhat bulging blue eyes, narrow eyebrow arches. Beneath the long straight nose a beautifully shaped mouth.

works.d: Mustjasrohelisel foonil, keskjoonest pisut allpool paikneb juurviljade ja okstel rippuvate õunte jada. Selle taga vasakul paljastatud õlgadega noor naine poolpöördes vasakule. Naisel kastanpruunid poolpikad juuksed, paokil suu, pärani silmad. Paremal ülemisel neljandikus puude vahel talu sinise taeva ja ererohelise maa vahel, eespool mees koeraga.
works.de: On a blackish-green background, slightly below the centre line, there is a row of vegetables and apples hanging on branches. Behind it on the left, a young woman with bared shoulders in a half-turn to the left. The woman has chestnut-brown shoulder-length hair, a slightly open mouth, wide-open eyes. In the upper right quarter, between trees, a farmhouse between the blue sky and bright green ground, in front a man with a dog.

works.d: Ühtlasel mustal taustal digonaalselt paigutatud hulk vilju: viinamarjakobarad, maasikad, ploomid, õunad, sidrun, hernekaun, punane roosiõis nende vahel. Vasakus alumises nurgas läbib vilju sinine kaldjoon.
works.de: On an even black background, a number of fruits arranged diagonally: bunches of grapes, strawberries, plums, apples, a lemon, a pea pod, a red rose blossom among them. In the lower left corner a blue diagonal line runs through the fruits.

works.d: Hallikas-sinine, kaldaääres, loojuvas päikeses, kuldselt helklev meri. Taevas ülal tinahall, allosas oranžkollane, selles kahvatu päikeseketas.
works.de: Greyish-blue sea by the shore, in the setting sun, gleaming golden. The sky above tin-grey, below orange-yellow, with a pale disc of the sun in it.

works.de: In red, purple and pink tones, circles dynamically converging towards the centre. The concentric circles, becoming ever lighter, end in the centre with yellow and white.

works.de: An oval slightly to the left of the vertical centre line, whose rainbow-coloured arcs curve toward the centre line. The right side of the background is in rainbow-coloured waves, the left side in green and purple horizontal stripes.

works.de: A romantic lava landscape in grayish-blue, yellow and pink tones: in the foreground a plateau covered with stones and stunted tufts of grass. On the horizon, low snow-covered mountains lit by the evening sun. Above the mountains the sky is yellow, higher up heavily leaden gray.

works.d: Ülaltvaade avarale lauskjate nõlvade, veekogudega maastikule õhtuvalguses. All orus heledad hooneteblokid. Silmapiiril kolm lumist, pilvedesse tõusvat mäetippu. Kõrge sinine taevas, maa kohal lillakasoranž pilvede kiht õhtupäikese kumas.
works.de: A view from above of an open landscape of flat slopes and bodies of water in evening light. Below, in the valley, light-coloured blocks of buildings. On the horizon three snowy mountain peaks rising into the clouds. A high blue sky, above the land a layer of purplish-orange clouds glowing in the evening sun.

works.d: 3/4 maali alumisest osast kujutab kahvatuhalli madalat merd, ees üksikud kõrkjavarred, kaugemal lamedad kivid veest välja paistmas. Ühtlaselt piimjas taevas sulab veega peaaegu kokku.
works.de: 3/4 of the lower part of the painting depicts a pale grey shallow sea, in front single sedge stems, further away flat rocks showing above the water. The uniformly milky sky almost merges with the water.

works.de: In front, a shoreline with greyish snow clumps and smooth water, further away wave stripes are visible. A high greyish-blue sky with isolated cloud masses reflected in the water.

works.d: Seitsmeosaline heledavärviline dekoratiivne kompositsioon rakkude ühinemisest. I Hõbedasel pinnal paremal kaarjas erekollane pind. II Kuldsel taustal vasakul helesinine kaarjas pind. III Kollase ja helesinise kumera pinna lõikumine beežil foonil, lõikepind hele värvitriibuline. IV Kollane laevukese kujund helesinisel, vasakul kollasel sinine diagonaalne, lainelise joonega lõppev kujund. V Kollasel laevukesel ülal hõbedane viil kolme heledatriibulise kujundiga. VI Helesinisel taustal sinistes ja kollastes üleminekutoonides laevukese kujund. VII Türkiissinisel all triibuline kaarjas pind.
works.de: A seven-part light-coloured decorative composition on the merging of cells. I On a silvery surface, a bright yellow arched surface on the right. II On a golden background, a light blue arched surface on the left. III The intersection of a yellow and a light blue convex surface on a beige background, the intersection surface with light-coloured stripes. IV A yellow boat-shaped figure on light blue, on the left on yellow a blue diagonal figure ending in a wavy line. V On a yellow boat shape, above, a silvery wedge with three light-striped figures. VI On a light blue background, a boat-shaped figure in transitional shades of blue and yellow. VII A turquoise-blue arched surface with stripes at the bottom.

works.d: Pilvedetaguse vaevunähtava päikesekettaga kahvatu taeva all peaaegu sama hele õhtune sile meri, valguse peegeldus veel, madalad lained rullumas ranna poole. Keset vett vasakul suur ja väike kivi. Esiplaanil, läbi madala vee paistab pruunikas liivapõhi.
works.de: Under a pale sky with a barely visible sun disk behind clouds, an almost equally light evening smooth sea, still with a reflection of light, low waves rolling toward the shore. In the middle of the water on the left, a large and a small rock. In the foreground, through the shallow water, a brownish sandy bottom shows through.

Two standing figures look out of a window, their faces in profile are purplish next to the intense yellowish-orange.

works.d: Esiplaanil seljaga vaataja poole seljakotti kandva inimese poolfiguur, käed õlgade kõrgusele tõstetud. Keha kergelt vasakule kaldu. Tagaplaanil maastiku foonil 2 inimfiguuri. Üks neist suure seljakotiga. Domineeriv sume roheline toon.
works.de: In the foreground, seen from behind, the half-figure of a person carrying a backpack, arms raised to shoulder height. The body slightly tilted to the left. In the background, against a landscape, 2 human figures. One of them with a large backpack. Dominant muted green tone.

works.d: Esiplaanil keskteljel üle kogu kompositsiooni kõrguse rohelises käisteta kleidis tantsiva noore naise figuur, viljavihk peas, kehaga poolprofiilis paremale, pilguga vaataja suunas. Parem käsi rippuva käelabaga vaatajale suunatud, vasak väljasirutatuna paremale. Keskplaanil kummalgi pool figuuri kolmeliikmelised inimgrupid ja kaks punast põllutöömasinat. Horisondil meri, maapind helepruun, valkjasroosa taevas. Häguste kontuuridega ja pehme vormikäsitlusega maalimismaneer.
works.de: In the foreground, on the central axis, spanning the entire height of the composition, the figure of a young woman dancing in a green sleeveless dress, a sheaf of grain on her head, her body in half-profile to the right, gaze directed towards the viewer. Her right hand, with a hanging palm, directed towards the viewer, her left extended to the right. In the middle ground, on either side of the figure, groups of three people and two red agricultural machines. On the horizon, the sea, the ground light brown, the sky whitish-pink. Painting manner with hazy contours and soft treatment of form.

works.d: Üksikute heledate värvisähvatustega (kollane, prantsuse roheline) tumedas, hämaras üldtoonis maalitud noore naise portree looduses. Maali suuremas parempoolses ning enamas alumises osas istub kumera seljatoega leentoolis poolprofiilis vasemale lühikeste tumedate juustega modell, jalg üle põlve, käelabad vabalt rippumas. Riietatud tumelillasse, tumeroosade õitega kleiti õrnade värvikujunditega heleda žabooga. Kleidi peal avatud hõlmadega õlgadelt langenud tumeroheline mantel pruuni voodriga. Kompositsiooni vasakus ülemises osas roheline orasepõld, vasakust servast keskel diagonaalselt üles kulgeva kollakaspruuni teega, sellest vasakul, temaga paralleelselt, lillakas kitsas, piklik salu üksiku
works.de: A portrait of a young woman in nature, painted in a dark, dim overall tone with a few bright flashes of colour (yellow, French green). In the larger, right-hand and mostly lower part of the painting sits, in an armchair with a curved back, in half-profile facing left, a model with short dark hair, one leg crossed over the other, hands hanging loosely. She is dressed in a dark purple dress with dark pink flowers and delicate colour patterns on a light-coloured jabot. Over the dress, a dark green coat with open lapels has slipped from her shoulders, with a brown lining. In the upper left part of the composition, a green field of young grain, with a diagonal yellowish-brown path running upward from the middle of the left edge; to the left of it, parallel to it, a purplish narrow, elongated grove with a solitary

works.d: Hallil foonil helerohelises kleidis tütarlapse rinnaportree. Pea kerges pöördes paremale. Lühikesi tumedaid juukseid ehivad kõrvade juurest lilla sireliõiekobar ning kollakasrohelised lilleoksad (õied).
works.de: Chest portrait of a girl in a light green dress on a grey background. The head in a slight turn to the right. Her short dark hair is adorned near the ears with a cluster of lilac flowers and yellowish-green flower sprigs (blossoms).

works.d: Erkroheliste, ookerjate ja lillakate värvilaikudega ühte sulavate kaskede taustal hoogsalt sammuva naise täisfiguur kerges pöördes vaataja poole. Figuur maalitud hallides toonides, ainsaks eredaks laiguks kollase ja punas värviline rinnaehe. Kontuurid hajuvad.
works.de: A full figure of a woman walking briskly, turned slightly towards the viewer, against a background of birches merging into bright green, ochre and purplish patches of colour. The figure is painted in grey tones, the only bright spot being a yellow and red coloured brooch. The contours are blurred.

works.d: Ühtlasel ultramariinsinisel foonil keskel hoiab tumehallis riides mehefiguur oma paremal õlal punases kleidis naist. Naise parem käsi vabalt rippu, vasakuga hoiab mehel pea ümbert kinni; pea profiilis vasakule. Figuuride kontuurid hajuvad; koloriit tume.
works.de: On an even ultramarine-blue background, in the centre a male figure dressed in dark grey holds on his right shoulder a woman in a red dress. The woman's right hand hangs freely, with her left she holds the man's head; the head in profile to the left. The contours of the figures blur; the colouring is dark.

works.d: Pildi keskosa võtab enda alla paadis, küljega vaataja poole istuva, sinises rüüd noore naise figuur. Paremast, väljasirutatud käest, pudenevad vette valkjad õied. Vasak käsi ühe õiega tõstetatud õla juurde. Naise kõrval paadis suur kimp lilli. Tagaplaanil kahe paadi ning inimeste ähmased siluetid. Maalitud sinistes, kollastes, valkjates toonides; kontuurid hajuvad.
works.de: The centre of the picture is occupied by the figure of a young woman in a blue robe, sitting sideways to the viewer in a boat. From her outstretched right hand, whitish flowers are falling into the water. Her left hand is raised to her shoulder holding one flower. Beside the woman in the boat, a large bunch of flowers. In the background, blurred silhouettes of two boats and people. Painted in blue, yellow, whitish tones; contours blurred.

works.d: Helenduval sinakal-rohelisel foonil, erkrohelisel nõlvajul  paremal kaheksast figuurist grupp, esiplaanil olevad kolm on lapsed. Inimesed maalitud rohekas-sinistes toonides diagonaalsete pintslitõmmetega, hajuvate kontuuridega.
works.de: On a glowing bluish-green background, on a bright green slope, on the right a group of eight figures, the three in the foreground being children. The people are painted in greenish-blue tones with diagonal brush strokes, with diffuse contours.

works.d: Esiplaanil keskel varvastel astuva noore naise täisfiguur, seljas erkroheline lühikeste varrukatega pluus, jalas sama värvi kand-lahti kingad. Naise pikkades tumedates juustes roheline õis. Taustal heledates hallides toonides uduvines looklev jõgi kahe sillaga ja metsatukk.
works.de: In the foreground, in the centre, the full figure of a young woman walking on tiptoe, wearing a bright green short-sleeved blouse, on her feet shoes of the same colour with open heels. A green blossom in the woman's long dark hair. In the background, in light grey tones, a winding river shrouded in mist with two bridges and a small forest.

works.d: Parempoolses servas kaarjal merekaldal punastes mütsides ning pükstes ujujate ja rohekas riietuses kohtunike ülesrivistatud figuurid. Koloriit helehall, kontuurid hajuvad.
works.de: In the right-hand edge, on a curved seashore, lined-up figures of swimmers in red caps and trousers and judges in greenish clothing. The colouring is light grey, the contours diffuse.

works.d: Rohelise mütsiga tütarlapse täisfiguur. Paremas käes valges paberis, rohelise lindiga seotud pakk. Maalitud hallis värviskaalas; kontuur hajutatud.
works.de: Full figure of a girl with a green cap. In her right hand a package wrapped in white paper, tied with a green ribbon. Painted in a grey colour scale; the contour diffused.

works.d: Hajutatud kontuurjoontega pastelltoonides paljufiguuriline kompositsioon. Esiplaanil kirjus pluusis, halli mantli, kübara ja kingadega prillitatud naine, tema kõrval otsevaates halli mantli ja kübaraga, pikkade pruunide pükstega naine, käsi kõrvalseisva lapse õlal. Lapsest paremal valgusfoor ja tumepunases kleidis istuv tüdruk. Neljast esiplaanil olevast figuurist kahel pool ja ülal erinevas vanuses ja erinevas üksikasjalikkuses teostatud lapsefiguurid. Pastelse läbipaistvuse juures on mõnda üksikdetaili rõhutatud. Kohati pastoosne.
works.de: A multi-figure composition in pastel tones with diffused contour lines. In the foreground a bespectacled woman in a colourful blouse, a grey coat, hat and shoes, next to her a woman seen frontally in a grey coat and hat, with long brown trousers, her hand on the shoulder of the child standing beside her. To the right of the child, a traffic light and a girl sitting in a dark red dress. Besides the four figures in the foreground, there are children's figures of various ages, executed with varying degrees of detail, on both sides and above. Amid the pastel transparency some individual details are emphasised. In places the paint is applied pastosely.
