works.d: Koosneb kahest osast. Sinakashallides, pruunides toonides müstiline tehismaastik arhitektuurimotiivide ja draperiidega. Vasakul oranžika kumaga öötaeva foonil püramiidjas objekt ühtlaselt kaetud langeva draperiiga. Selle taga vasakul ja paremal sammastega väravaorvad. Esiplaanil, heledale lagedale langevad pruunikad varjud, ees keskel tume siidja läikega volditud draperii. Paremal pool üle terve pinna lähivaates sammastega ehituse osi, paremas ülanurgas ringikujuline detail.
works.de: Consists of two parts. A mystical artificial landscape in bluish-grey, brown tones with architectural motifs and draperies. On the left, against a night sky background with an orange glow, a pyramid-shaped object evenly covered with a falling drapery. Behind it, on the left and right, gateways with columns. In the foreground, brownish shadows falling on a bright open area, in front in the centre a dark, silky-glossy folded drapery. On the right, across the entire surface, a close-up view of parts of a building with columns, in the upper right corner a circular detail.

works.d: Sinine taust muutub ülaltpoolt sujuvalt mustjaks. Tausta keskel nelinurkne metafüüsiline kujund-vaade: terashall ühtlane sein-pind all vasakul, üle selle heidetud siidise voldustikuga tumesinine draperii. Halli pinna paremal nurgal kollakasroheline kera, lummav valgus keral ja draperiivoldil. Tagapool sinkjashall avarus.
works.de: The blue background gradually turns blackish toward the top. In the centre of the background a rectangular metaphysical shape-view: a steel-grey uniform wall-surface at the lower left, over which a dark-blue drapery with silky folds is cast. At the right corner of the grey surface, a yellowish-green sphere, a captivating light on the sphere and on the drapery fold. Behind it, a bluish-grey expanse.

works.d: Illusioon ribikardinaga aknavaatest valgus-varju triipudega. Maalipind jaotatud vertikaalselt pooleks. Vasakul, maali keskme suunas ühtlaselt laienevad valgustriibud vaheldumisi varjuga. Paremal, varjupoolel tumedamad sinkjashallide toonide üleminekud.
works.de: An illusion of a window view through venetian blinds with stripes of light and shadow. The painted surface is divided vertically in half. On the left, stripes of light evenly widening toward the center of the painting alternate with shadow. On the right, the shadow side, darker transitions of bluish-grey tones.

works.d: Illusioon ribikardinaga aknavaatest valgus-varju triipudega. Maalipind jaotatud vertikaalselt kaheks, 1/3 osa vasakul varjupool. Paremal, valgustriibud muutuvad keskme suunas laiemaks ja heledamaks. Sinkjad ja hallid üleminekutoonid.
works.de: Illusion of a view through a window with a ribbed blind, in stripes of light and shadow. The painted surface is divided vertically into two, 1/3 on the left being the shaded side. On the right, the stripes of light become wider and lighter towards the centre. Bluish and grey transitional tones.

works.d: Kaheosaline kompositsioon. Robustsele püstpuitraamistuselekinnitatud tõrvapapp ja roostetanud plekkalus (ülal vasakul, all paremal), millele valge värviga markeeritud kahest kõverdatud käest ja kahest jalast koosnev haakristitaoline propelleri kujund. Taust maalitud hõbe-, pronks- ja punaka värviga. Kahe osa vahele kinnitatud saeleht.
works.de: A two-part composition. Tar paper and a rusted sheet-metal base (upper left, lower right) fastened to a robust upright wooden frame, on which a swastika-like propeller shape composed of two bent arms and two legs is marked in white paint. The background is painted in silver, bronze and reddish colour. A saw blade is fastened between the two parts.

works.d: Kaheosaline, sinisel pinnal olev kujund saab alguse ülalt vasakult. Ümarjas punane kujund evib poolkuu kujulist vasakut serva mis on valge. Punane ebaühtlane joon kulgeb kaarjalt maali keskossa kus paikneb keskteljest veidi paremal roosakas-valge kolmnurgasarnane kujutis, millest kasvavad välja kaks sinistes toonides jalgu meenutavat osa; mille vahelt väljub punane värv nõrguvate niredena. "Jalad" on põlvedest kõverdatud, kahele poole kõrvale väänatud.
works.de: A two-part shape on a blue surface begins at the upper left. A rounded red form has a crescent-shaped left edge that is white. An uneven red line curves into the middle of the painting, where a pinkish-white triangle-like image is located, slightly to the right of the central axis, from which grow two leg-like parts in blue tones; between them red paint emerges in trickling drips. The "legs" are bent at the knees, twisted out to either side.

works.d: Suur avatud suuga nägu, musta suuava ümbritsevad leekidest huuled. Näo alaosa rohekais-kollastes toonides, nina roosakais toonides. Nina meenutab ilma peata tagurpidi tordot. Rombilaadsed silmad on kollased ilma täpsema detailinguta. Laup sinine, laubal 4 lainjat, valget, lendavaid linde meenutavat kortsu. Oimud oranžid, ninajuurel reljeefsed värvitükid.
works.de: A large face with an open mouth, the black mouth opening surrounded by lips made of flames. The lower part of the face in greenish-yellow tones, the nose in pinkish tones. The nose resembles an upside-down cake without a top. The rhombus-like eyes are yellow without more detailed articulation. The forehead is blue, with 4 wavy white wrinkles resembling flying birds. The temples are orange, with relief-like patches of paint at the root of the nose.

works.d: Illusoorne kaksikfiguur alasti noorest habemikust mehest (autoportree) külgvaates. Heledal alusel põlvili asendis, kõverdatud käed, ülakeha ja pea kummargil ette alusele. Pea pööratud vaatajale, silmad suletud. Tõstetud istmikust kasvab välja teine pea profiilis paremale. Illusioon tõstetud ülakehaga figuurist, kõverdatud käte asemel varvastele toetuvad jalad. Lillakashall ühtlane taust, heledale alusele langevad varjud. Figuur modelleeritud pruunikate, ookertoonidega. Metafüüsiline atmosfäär.(eesti)
works.de: An illusory double figure of a naked young bearded man (self-portrait), in profile. In a kneeling position on a light-coloured pedestal, with bent arms, the upper body and head bowed forward onto the pedestal. The head turned towards the viewer, eyes closed. From the raised buttocks grows a second head, in profile, facing right. An illusion of a figure with a raised upper body, with feet resting on toes instead of bent arms. A uniform lilac-grey background, shadows falling onto the light-coloured pedestal. The figure is modelled in brownish, ochre tones. A metaphysical atmosphere.

works.t: Tee São Paulosse (Way to São Paulo)
works.dm: aeg/ kestus: 44.0 sekund; aeg/ kestus: 10.0 minut
works.d: Teos koosnes kahest osast: a) klaaskuubi ujutamine aprillist oktoobrini 1994 (aktsioonid, performance'id); b) video-installatsioon Brasiilias, Sâo Paulo biennaalil. Dokumentaalvideo kujutab suure peeglitest kuubi ujutamist Emajõel ja Vltava jõel, Prahas. Klaaskuup reflekteerib vett, taevast, möödavilksatavaid puid, inimesi, kaarsildu.
works.de: The work consisted of two parts: a) floating a glass cube from April to October 1994 (actions, performances); b) a video installation in Brazil, at the São Paulo Biennial. The documentary video depicts the floating of a large mirrored cube on the Emajõgi River and the Vltava River in Prague. The glass cube reflects water, sky, flashing trees, people, arched bridges.

works.dm: aeg/ kestus: 35.0 sekund; aeg/ kestus: 2.0 minut
works.d: Kunstnik uisutab alasti üle jäätunud mere. Ta teeb oma 10-aastase poja koraalilaulu saatel mitu ringi ümber vaataja, kuni uisutab tagasi sinna kust ta tuli, kadudes valgesse olematusse. Esmakordselt eksponeeriti 1998. a personaalnäitusel Tallinnas Linnagaleriis
works.de: The artist skates naked across the frozen sea. Accompanied by his 10-year-old son's chorale singing, he makes several circles around the viewer, until he skates back to where he came from, disappearing into white nothingness. First exhibited at his 1998 solo exhibition at the Tallinn City Gallery.

works.dm: aeg/ kestus: 42.0 sekund; aeg/ kestus: 1.0 minut
works.d: Alasti mees on valge riideribaga seotud tokki otsa, mis asetseb keset mudast põldu. Mehel jalas vaid vanad nahksed jalatsid. Riideriba, mis on seotud mehe suguelundite ümber, tirib neid mehe liikumisel tahapoole, nii et eestpoolt pole neid enam näha. Aeglaselt ja valuliselt komberdab mees ringiratast, ulatudes nii kaugele, kui riideriba võimaldab. Helitaustaks on puukiige vms. kääksumine. Taevas pilvine ja madal.
works.de: A naked man is tied by a white strip of cloth to a stick standing in the middle of a muddy field. The man wears only old leather footwear. The strip of cloth, tied around the man's genitals, pulls them backward as the man moves, so that they are no longer visible from the front. The man slowly and painfully hobbles round and round, reaching as far as the strip of cloth allows. The sound background is the creaking of a wooden swing or the like. The sky is cloudy and low.

Malbe, äraoleva ilmega näod pööratud vaatajale. Parempoolse pea kohal roheline, vasakpoolsel sinine värvilaik.
works.de: On a predominantly yellowish-green background, painted in places with expressive bright-coloured strokes, in places with flowing streams of colour, two nude female figures in a colourful embrace, in each other's lap. Meek, absent-looking faces turned toward the viewer. Above the head on the right, a green colour patch, on the left one a blue colour patch.

works.d: Kahvatutes toonides alasti meesfiguur veerandpöördes paremale, pea vasakule. Vasakus käes kirves, parema käe kohal tiivataoline kujutis. Mees suure kala taustal-seljas. Kujundid ümbritsetud laiade värviliste kontuurjoontega.
works.de: In pale tones a nude male figure in a three-quarter turn to the right, head to the left. In his left hand an axe, above his right hand a wing-like image. The man against the background of, and on the back of, a large fish. The figures are surrounded by broad coloured contour lines.

works.d: Heledal, värviliste vertikaalsete vööndite foonil, pea alaspidi alla paremale, jalad täisnurkselt vasakule, kollases rõivas üldistatult noore naise figuur rohekas-kollakate juustega; kõhu juures mesilane. Keskel horisontaalselt üle naise figuuri alasti selili inimese figuur, helerohekas toonis ja ilma peata, põlvist murtud jalad täisnurkselt alla vasakule.
works.de: Against a light background of coloured vertical bands, head upside down toward the lower right, legs at a right angle to the left, a generalized figure of a young woman in yellow clothing with greenish-yellowish hair; a bee near her stomach. In the middle, horizontally across the woman's figure, a nude human figure lying on its back, in light greenish tones and without a head, legs bent at the knee at a right angle downward to the left.

works.d: Heledaks krunditud pinnal savi, orgaaniline aine ja värvi pritsmeid, hõõrutud mööda alust. Pastoosne moodustis rohust, savist, ograanilisest materjalist ja liimainest kompositsiooni vasakul ülemises kolmandikus kinnitatud pinnale kruvidega.
works.de: On a lightly primed surface, clay, organic matter and splashes of paint, rubbed over the base. A pasty formation of grass, clay, organic material and adhesive substance fixed to the surface with screws in the upper left third of the composition.

works.d: Heledale pinnale määritud, hõõrutud orgaaniline aine, kinnitatud liimainega (?), pastoosseid ruumilisi moodustisi savist, sõnnikust, õlgedest, kuivanud rohust.
works.de: Organic matter smeared and rubbed onto a light-coloured surface, attached with an adhesive (?), pasty spatial formations of clay, dung, straw, dried grass.

works.d: Püstistest viimistlemata laudadest alusele maalitud kaks diagonaalselt  asetsevat sinkjashalli ellipsikujulist pinda. Mõlema kujundiga liitub altpoolt ruumiliselt maalitud  2 kirsipruuni lõigatud torumotiivi.
works.de: Two diagonally placed bluish-grey elliptical surfaces painted on a base of upright, unfinished planks. Both shapes are joined from below by 2 cherry-brown cut pipe motifs painted with spatial effect.

works.d: Püstistest viimistlemata laudadest alusel diagonaalselt paigutatud kaks valget, üksteist veidi katvat ellipsikujulist pinda. Ülemise vasakpoolsega liitub must-valge ruumiliselt kujutatud torujupi motiiv. Alumise ellipsi suunas pikem sama motiiv.
works.de: Two white, slightly overlapping elliptical surfaces placed diagonally on a base of unfinished vertical boards. The upper left one is joined by a black-and-white spatially depicted motif of a pipe section. The same motif, longer, extends towards the lower ellipse.

works.d: Hallikal plangul keskel suur sinakas-hallikais toonides tangide kujutis. Tangide vahel (maali paremas servas) jalgupidi ripnemas väike, suure ümmarguse peaga, hallikas-sinine "kriipsumehike". Plangus mõned suured (sepistatud?) raudnaelad.
works.de: On a greyish plank, in the centre, a large depiction of pliers in bluish-grey tones. Between the pliers (at the right edge of the painting), hanging by its feet, a small, greyish-blue "stick figure" with a large round head. In the plank a few large (forged?) iron nails.

works.d: Helehallil ehitusplangul keskel ülaosas suur sinine kandiline elektripistiku pesa, mille valgetest aukudest väljaulatuvate traatide otsas ripub jalgupidi väike sinakais-lillakais toonides suure ümmarguse peaga "kriipsumehike". Plangu sees mõned suured (sepistatud?) raudnaelad.
works.de: On a light grey construction board, in the centre at the top a large blue rectangular electrical socket, from whose white holes protruding wires hang a small "stick figure" in bluish-purple tones with a large round head, hanging by its feet. Inside the board some large (forged?) iron nails.

works.d: 6-osaline maalisari mehekätest paberist kriipspoissi valmistamas, joonistamas, maalimas. Valgel taustal fotolikult monokroomselt maalitud käed, parem hoiab poolviltu lehte, vasak maalib pintsliga halli kriipspoisi pead-kera.
works.de: A 6-part painting series of men's hands making, drawing, painting a paper stick figure. On a white background, photo-like monochromatically painted hands, the right holding a sheet at an angle, the left painting with a brush the grey stick figure's head-sphere.

works.d: 6-osaline maalisari mehekätest paberist kriipspoissi valmistamas. Vasak käsi hoiab lehte, parem kääridega terashalli, kera-peaga kriipspoissi paberist välja lõikamas. Valge taust, monokroomne fotolik kujutamisviis.
works.de: 6-part painting series of a man's hands making a paper matchstick figure. The left hand holds a sheet, the right cuts a steel-grey, ball-headed matchstick figure out of the paper with scissors. White background, monochrome photographic manner of depiction.

works.d: 6-osaline maalisari mehekätest paberist kriipsipoissi valmistamas. Vasak käsi hoiab välja lõigatud, volditud terashalli värvi kera-peaga astuvat kriipspoissi parema käe peopeal. Valge taust, monokroomne fotolik kujutamisviis.
works.de: 6-part painting series of a man's hands making a matchstick figure out of paper. The left hand holds, on the palm of the right hand, a cut-out, folded, steel-grey ball-headed striding matchstick figure. White background, monochrome photographic manner of depiction.

works.d: 6-osaline maalisari mehekätest kriipspoissi valmistamas. Lõuendil vasakul kera-peaga, volditud kehaga terashalli tooni kriipspoiss punktiirjoonena parema käe pihku pissimas. Valge taust, monokroomne fotolik kujutamisviis.
works.de: A 6-part painting series of a man's hands making a stick figure. On the left of the canvas a steel-grey stick figure with a ball-shaped head and folded body, urinating in a dotted line into the palm of the right hand. White background, monochrome photo-like manner of depiction.

works.d: 6-osaline maalisari mehekätest kriipspoissi valmistamas. Vasakul alumises neljandikus kätepaar randmeni, sõrmed vaheliti koos. Valge taust, monokroomselt halliga fotolikult maalitud käed.
works.de: 6-part painting series of male hands making a cardboard-tube figure ("kriipspoiss"). In the lower left quarter a pair of hands to the wrists, fingers interlaced together. White background, hands painted photorealistically, monochromatically in grey.

works.d: 6-osaline maalisari mehekätest paberist kriipspoissi valmistamas. Valgel taustal poolpõigiti hele leht, parem käsi hoiab lehel kollakat joonlauda, vasak pliiatsiga kriipspoisi kontuure joonistamas. Fotolik kujutamisviis.
works.de: A 6-part painting series of a man's hands making a paper cut-out boy. On a white background a bright sheet lies diagonally, the right hand holds a yellowish ruler on the sheet, the left hand draws the contours of the cut-out boy with a pencil. A photographic manner of depiction.

works.d: Vaade auto tagaistmelt: vasakul rooli taga osa sinises jopes mehest (Mäetamm), kõrvalistmel osa noorest mehest (Ole) sõrmega osutamas läbi esiklaasi avanevale rohelisele maastikule, millel valgetest plokktähdest kiri: HOLOCAUST. Maali ülemine osa hall, autolage kujutav, keskel peegel, mis varjab osaliselt CA tähti.
works.de: A view from the back seat of a car: on the left, behind the wheel, part of a man in a blue jacket (Mäetamm), on the passenger seat part of a young man (Ole) pointing his finger at the green landscape opening through the windshield, on which there is text in white block letters: HOLOCAUST. The upper part of the painting is grey, depicting the car ceiling, in the centre a mirror, which partly conceals the letters CA.

works.d: Valgel foonil vasakus servas suur, maalipinnast reljeefina eenduv hollandi ahi Kadrioru lossist. Ahju kahlid sinise koobaltmaalinguga, lillemustris. Ahju otsas kahvaturoheline lipp ja ees mänguautona mõjuv roheline kastmisauto, tohutu hallikasbeež suitsusammas taga.
works.de: On a white background in the left edge a large Dutch stove from Kadriorg Palace, protruding as a relief from the paint surface. The stove's tiles with blue cobalt painting, in a floral pattern. On top of the stove a pale green flag and in front a green watering truck resembling a toy car, an enormous grey-beige column of smoke behind it.

works.t: Kunstnik R. Rajangu ja abiliste saabumine Viljandisse
works.dm: kõrgus: 182.0 cm; sügavus: 4.0 cm; laius: 286.0 cm
works.d: Ülaosas kujutatud kahte vaipa tsitaatidega vene maalikunstist (Kolm vene vägilast. Aljonuška) vaipkattele maalituna. Keskosas Viljandi kesklinna risttee heleda kahekorruselise hoonega nurgal, reljeefselt vormitud. Maja katusel tumepunane sametlipp. Hoone ees vasakul reljeefne tänavavalgustuspost, vasakult lähenemas veoauto musta sargaga. Maali allosas nurk kireva ornamendiga vaibast. Sellel karnevalikostüümis väike tüdruk kollase olevusega, kiri all: "Õ-JUTA". Paremas alumises nurgas alusel paiknev palmipuu ja lapsekäega joonistatud auto.
works.de: In the upper part, two carpets are depicted with quotations from Russian painting (Three Bogatyrs, Alyonushka) painted onto the carpet coverings. In the central part, the crossroads of Viljandi town centre, at the corner of a light-coloured two-storey building, formed in relief. On the roof of the building a dark red velvet flag. In front of the building on the left a relief street lamp post, a truck with a black box approaching from the left. In the lower part of the painting, the corner of a carpet with colourful ornament. On it, a small girl in a carnival costume with a yellow creature, with the inscription below: "Õ-JUTA". In the lower right corner, a palm tree on a stand and a car drawn with a child's hand.

works.d: Kompositsioon Tartu vana anatoomikumi ja lumememmega. Vasakul roheline kolmnurkse frontooni, pseudosammaste ja rõduga anatoomikumi keskosa, mille külge kinnitatud pärg ning mille ees seisab pruutpaar koos käivitatud auto ja ehitud kuusepuuga. Stseenile peale, anatoomikumi kohale lohakalt maalitud helesinine lumememm ja kaks loomade ja kuusepuudega pilti.
works.de: Composition with the old Tartu Anatomicum and a snowman. On the left, the green central part of the Anatomicum with a triangular pediment, pseudo-columns and a balcony, to which a wreath is attached, and in front of which stands a bridal couple together with a running car and a decorated fir tree. Over the scene, above the Anatomicum, a carelessly painted light blue snowman and two pictures with animals and fir trees.

works.d: Dekoratiivne autoukse kujutis auto seestpoolt vaadatuna. Valgel taustal paksude mustade ümardatud kontuuridega markeeritud ukse üldkuju, akna sulgur, hinged, ukse käepide, aknalink, sisetasku, millest paistab ajakirja nurk kirjaga: NEW SP(EED). Ukse polster ühtlaselt helesinist tooni. Värvid kantud valmis kujundite järgi tagantpoolt. Töö ülal paremal mustaga kiri: "UKS"
works.de: A decorative depiction of a car door viewed from inside the car. The overall shape of the door, marked on a white background with thick black rounded contours, the window latch, hinges, door handle, window crank, inner pocket, from which the corner of a magazine is visible with the text: NEW SP(EED). The door upholstery is a uniform light blue tone. The colours are applied from behind according to ready-made shapes. At the top right of the work, in black: "UKS"

works.d: Mustal taustal dekoratiivselt kujutatud auto armatuurlaua andurid-näiturid. Vasakul spidomeeter: kollasel poolkaarel punasega näidud 200-st 700-ni, roheline osuti sinikollases sõõris. Selle all hodomeeter näiduga 5721. Paremal tulede- ja bensiininäidik kollase, valge, punasega kujutatud. Värv kantud šablooni järgi pleksiklaasi teisele poole. Allservas valgega kiri: "MEASURING INSTRUMENTS"
works.de: Against a black background, decoratively depicted car dashboard sensors-gauges. On the left a speedometer: on a yellow semicircle readings in red from 200 to 700, a green needle in a blue-yellow circle. Below it an odometer with reading 5721. On the right a lights and fuel gauge depicted in yellow, white, red. The colour is applied by stencil onto the other side of the plexiglass. At the bottom edge, in white, text: "MEASURING INSTRUMENTS"

works.d: Ühtlaselt valgel taustal küpskollase mängukaru pea õlgadeni otsevaates. Sõõridest ümmarguste silmade all kummalgi kolm pisarat. Pea kohal taustal küsimärk - ?.
works.de: On an evenly white background the head of an amber-yellow teddy bear, shown frontally down to the shoulders. Under each of the round, ring-shaped eyes three tears. Above the head in the background a question mark - ?.

works.d: Valge ühtlane taust peene leinaraamistuse ja musta lindiga diagonaalselt paremal alumises nurgas. Keskosas leinakaunistustega puusärk, selles traksipükstes poisi kuju külgvaates, kujutatud must-valgelt. Ülal paremal punases vestis kollane piilupart leinamas. Valmiskujundi koomiksilaadne kujutamisviis.
works.de: A white, even background with a fine mourning frame and a black ribbon diagonally in the lower right corner. In the central section, a coffin with mourning decorations, in which lies the figure of a boy in braced trousers seen in profile, depicted in black and white. Above right, a yellow duckling in a red waistcoat, mourning. The finished design is rendered in a comic-like manner.

works.d: Sinkjasroheline ühtlane taust, millel pastellvärvides leinaküünla kujutised, üla- ja alaääres pitsiline valge kaunistus. Keskmest vasakul tumpunasel-mustal polsteralusel poisi peaga karu kuju istumas otsevaates, must-valgelt kujutatud. Pea juures nn mõttepilved, milles kiri: TRY Me! All paremal kiri: AND SEE WHAT HAPPENS! Valmiskujundi koomiksilaadne dekoratiivne kujutamisviis. Must kontuurjoon ümbritseb kujutatut.
works.de: A uniform bluish-green background, with pastel-coloured depictions of mourning candles, and a lacy white decoration at the top and bottom edges. Left of centre, on a dark red-black upholstered base, the figure of a bear with a boy's head sits, viewed frontally, depicted in black and white. Near the head, so-called thought bubbles, in which is written: TRY Me! Below, on the right, the text: AND SEE WHAT HAPPENS! A comic-like decorative manner of depicting the finished design. A black contour line surrounds the depicted figure.

works.de: The soundless installation gives, through three video cannons (projectors), an image of the rise and fall of the water level. (The mirror has a grey frame, the aquarium a frame of brownish metal.)

works.d: Kompositsioon jalgu harkis hoidvast naisest vaataja suunas ja kellamehhanismi tema üska ühendavatest kätest. Mongoliidse näoga naise suu pärani, suu juures trükikiri: Victory or death. Popilikult dekoratiivne pinnaline kujutamisviis. Valgel taustal musta kontuuriga ümbritsetud: keha uduroosa, riietes sinist ja musta.
works.de: Composition of a woman standing with legs apart facing the viewer, and of the hands joining a clock mechanism to her lap. The mouth of the woman with a Mongoloid face is wide open, printed text beside the mouth: Victory or death. A pop-like decorative, flat manner of depiction. Surrounded by black contour on a white background: the body a hazy pink, the clothing blue and black.

works.d: Pihtimuslik dialoog ema ja poja vahel, kus viimane justkui iseennast sundides üritab midagi väga olulist emale ära öelda. Mustvalges, dokumentaalsust rõhutava kareda ülesvõttega video põhiosas – esitatud piklikus kinoformaadis, mis lähtematerjalile omakorda  võõritusefekti lisab – domineerib poja dramaatiline eneseavamisponnistus ja ema ning ka vaataja venitatud ootus, et see miski, lõpuks ära öeldud saaks. Seda raamib argisem, värviline ja tavaformaadis lõik kaamera, valguse ja "esinejate" ülessättimisest.
works.de: A confessional dialogue between mother and son, in which the latter, as if forcing himself, tries to say something very important to his mother. In the main part of the video, shot in black and white with a rough, documentary-emphasizing style – presented in an elongated cinematic format, which in turn adds an alienation effect to the source material – the son's dramatic effort at self-disclosure dominates, along with the prolonged expectation of the mother, and also the viewer, that this something will finally be said. This is framed by a more everyday, colour, standard-format segment showing the setting up of the camera, lighting and "performers".

works.d: Fotofilm remiksib arhiivfotosid Kreenholmi Manufaktuurist kuuldemänguga Elfriede Jelineki näidendist „Mis juhtus pärast seda, kui Nora oma mehe maha oli jätnud ehk Ühiskondade toed“. 1950.-1960. aastatest pärit propagandistlikud mustvalged fotod tekstiilitööstuses töötavatest naistest on asetatud näidendi 15. stseeni konteksti, milles Nora on tulnud vabrikusse, et hoiatada naistöölisi ettevõtte peatse sulgemise eest ja kutsuda neid üles emantsipatsioonile. Teos kuulus 2012. aasta Manifesta kunstibiennaali näitusekomplekti, mille eest Marge Monkole eraldati rahvusvaheliselt mainekas Kesk-Ida-Euroopa kaasaegse kunsti toetamiseks asutatud Henkeli kunstipreemia.
works.de: The photo-film remixes archival photographs from the Kreenholm Manufaktuur with a radio play based on Elfriede Jelinek's play "What Happened After Nora Left Her Husband or Pillars of Society". Black-and-white propagandistic photographs from the 1950s–1960s of women working in the textile industry are placed in the context of the play's 15th scene, in which Nora has come to the factory to warn the female workers of the company's impending closure and to call on them to embrace emancipation. The work was part of the exhibition package of the 2012 Manifesta art biennial, for which Marge Monko was awarded the internationally prestigious Henkel Art Award, established to support contemporary art in Central-Eastern Europe.

works.de: A photo installation on a tall four-wheeled structure made of light-coloured wood. The photo shows a workroom with greenish-yellowish walls and a barred window, in which a pile resembling a steam locomotive is composed of various objects, plastic tanks stacked on top of each other, and folded cardboard boxes. On the front of the pile a map of Estonia is attached, a round seat plate and a wheel are leaned against the side, and at the end an object resembling a weapon built from transparent glass vessels from a chemistry lab, and at the very top a broom handle holding a wash basin.

works.de: A photo installation on a tall five-legged light wood construction. works.d: Dokumentaalfilm Cubus Larviku etendusest Soodevahe linnakus asunud Vatiteatris 2011. aasta sügisel. Õhtupäikeses koguneb seltskond inimesi aknaklaasideta ning laest rippuvate vatiribadega Vatiteatri hoone ümber. Hoonet ümbritsevast kõrgest rohust ilmub üleni vatti mähitud pruuniks võõbatud näoga Cubus Larvik, kes viskab enda ees suuri kilepampusid ja siseneb hoonesse, kus improviseerib erinevate seal leiduvate esemetega. Operaator Sergei Trofimov. Montaaž Timo Toots ja Marika Agu. Helitaust Karl Saks.
works.de: A documentary film of Cubus Larvik's performance at the Vatiteater [Cotton Wool Theatre] located in the small town of Soodevahe in the autumn of 2011. In the evening sunlight, a group of people gathers around the Vatiteater building, which has no window panes and strips of cotton wool hanging from the ceiling. From the tall grass surrounding the building emerges Cubus Larvik, entirely wrapped in cotton wool with his face painted brown, who throws large plastic bundles ahead of himself and enters the building, where he improvises with various objects found there. Camera operator Sergei Trofimov. Editing by Timo Toots and Marika Agu. Sound by Karl Saks.

works.de: In the foreground a farmyard enclosed by a pole fence, in the centre a low dwelling house with a small window, a well with a sweep and a barn. On the path leading to the yard, a female figure in frontal view with a white kerchief and blouse, in a skirt with a red pattern, carrying a load on her back.

works.d: Lihtsailmelises interjööris istuvate kolme mehe poolprofiilis. Vasakul mütsi kandev põskhabemega mees peaaegu täisprofiilis paremale, vasaku käega osutamas vastasistuvate suunas, kuna parem käsi hoiab põrandale toetuvat kaheraudset püssi. Paremal vanem mees läkiläki tüüpi mütsiga profiilis vasakule. Parem käsi hoiab hambus olevat kõverat piipu, vasak käsi põlvedel. Nende kahe vahel otsevaates noor talumees viltkaabus ja rahvarõivais.
works.de: Three men sitting in a plain interior, shown in half-profile. On the left a man with a cap and side whiskers, almost in full profile to the right, pointing with his left hand towards those sitting opposite, while his right hand holds a double-barrelled shotgun resting on the floor. On the right an older man wearing a lakki-type cap, in profile to the left. His right hand holds a curved pipe in his teeth, his left hand rests on his knees. Between the two, seen frontally, a young peasant man in a felt hat and folk costume.

In the foreground on the left, under the birches, a gnome with a beer jug. Around the round picture, three curled leaves. Above left a depiction of a gate, on the right a church, below a landscape.

In the right part of the painting, a view opens over a flat landscape into the distance, where a single sail shows white through the blueing forest.

Pildi mõlemal äärel paistvaid majandushooneid ühendava tara tagant paistab talu puhasõu ja õlgkatusega rehielamu. Visand teostatud üldjooneliselt.
works.de: In a farm cattle yard, on the right foreground, a woman in milking position by a black-and-white patterned cow, facing left. In the centre, in full view, a woman in a reddish-coloured skirt standing beside a cow of the same breed. On both edges of the picture, farm outbuildings connected by a fence can be seen, behind which the farmyard and a straw-roofed threshing barn are visible. The sketch is executed in general outlines.

works.d: Kiilaspäise, hallide vurrudega vanemas eas mehe põlvportree istuvas asendis, poolprofiilis vasakule. Vasak käsi nõjatub tooli külgtoele kusjuures sõrmed puudutavad reit, parem käsi hoiab kinni tooli külgtoest. Riietuseks tume pintsakülikond ja tärgeldatud püstkrae ja kätistega särk. Taust punast tooni; vasakul ülal perekonna vapi kujutis - lõvi kõveral mõõgal - selle kõrval pealkiri "Baron Waldemar Uexkuell Naumhof MDCCCC XII"
works.de: Knee-length portrait of an elderly bald man with grey moustaches, seated, in three-quarter profile to the left. The left hand rests on the side support of the chair, with the fingers touching the thigh, the right hand holds onto the side support of the chair. Dressed in a dark suit jacket and a shirt with a starched stand-up collar and cuffs. The background is a red tone; at upper left, a depiction of the family coat of arms - a lion on a curved sword - next to it the title "Baron Waldemar Uexkuell Naumhof MDCCCC XII"

works.de: In the foreground a field in grey tones, with baskets and a bag on it, a male figure standing at the edge of the field. Behind it a narrow greenish strip of land, separated from the sea by a fence. In the light sky, clouds marked with darker brushstrokes.

works.d: Lopsakate pintslilöökidega maalitud tükike rohelist maastikku, milles eralduvad kolm jämedat puutüve keskplaanil ja hõre põõsas paremal.
works.de: A patch of green landscape painted with lush brushstrokes, in which three thick tree trunks stand out in the middle ground and a sparse bush on the right.

works.d: Hallides toonides foonil pruunis ümaras vaasis kimp sireleid. Vaasi all tumesinine, - punaste laikudega riie. Vaasil suur ovaalne sinine laik.
works.de: Against a background in grey tones, a bunch of lilacs in a round brown vase. Under the vase a dark blue cloth with red spots. On the vase a large oval blue spot.

works.d: Pildi keskel lookleva sillutamata tänava ääres vasakul hoogsate pintslilöökidega maalitud pruun ning selle kõrval valge akendeta maja. Pildi paremas servas valge maja ots, mille katust varjab pooleldi paremat ülanurka täitev roheline lehestik. All paremal laiade pintslilöökidega markeeritud kiviaed. Vasakul ülanurgas sinist, valkjashallide pilvedega taevast.
works.de: In the centre of the picture, along a winding unpaved street, on the left a brown house painted with sweeping brushstrokes, and next to it a white house without windows. On the right edge of the picture, the end of a white house, whose roof is half-hidden by green foliage filling the upper right corner. Lower right, a stone wall marked with broad brushstrokes. In the upper left corner, a blue sky with whitish-grey clouds.

works.d: Taluõuel, vasakul, kaevul mees vett pumpamas, samas kõrval, joogiküna juures kaks lehma. Pildi paremas servas naisefiguur tema juures rüselevate lammastega. Taamal, lattaia taga taluhooned. Värvigammas valdavad pruunid toonid.
works.de: In the farmyard, on the left, at the well a man pumping water, next to him, at the drinking trough two cows. On the right edge of the picture a female figure with sheep jostling around her. In the distance, behind a picket fence, farm buildings. Brown tones predominate in the colour range.

works.d: Esiplaanil põllusiilul kummargil figuur, tema taga seisev mees ning sinises seelikus naine. Siin-seal maas rukkivihud. Taamal tuulik. Maalimislaad etüüdlik. Värvipilt - hele.
works.de: In the foreground a figure bent over a stack of grain in the field, behind her a standing man and a woman in a blue skirt. Sheaves of rye lie here and there on the ground. A windmill in the distance. Sketch-like painting style. Bright colour scheme.

works.d: Hallide, õlgadele langevate juuste ning habemega vanamehe peaetüüd, pöördega vasakule. Pea kummardatud ette, suu kergelt avatud.
works.de: Head study of an old man with grey hair falling to the shoulders and a beard, turned to the left. Head bowed forward, mouth slightly open.

works.d: Esiplaanil kasetüvi, vasakul oksa küljes ripub punutud häll. Selles istukile tõusnud valges särgis laps veerandpöördes paremale, vaatab ja naeratab oksal istuvale kirjule linnule. Tagapool lagendikul heina riisuv noor naine poolkummargil, pilk pööratud linnule. Naisel seljas valge pluus ja peakate, pikitriibuline seelik. Taamal, heleda, üksikute pilvedega taeva all lagendikku piiravad käharad puud. Maal pastelses rohekas koloriidis, värvikiht õhuke.
works.de: In the foreground, a birch trunk, on the left a woven cradle hangs from a branch. In it, a child in a white shirt, having risen to a sitting position, turned a quarter to the right, looks and smiles at a mottled bird sitting on the branch. Further back in the clearing, a young woman raking hay, bent halfway over, her gaze turned toward the bird. The woman wears a white blouse and a headscarf, a longitudinally striped skirt. In the distance, under a light sky with isolated clouds, curly trees border the clearing. The painting is in a pastel greenish colouring, the paint layer thin.

works.d: Esiplaanil kiviaiaga ääristatud karjatee, sellel kaks lehma. Ees paremal, aia ääres seisev naine. Tagapool vasakul taluhooned, paremal mereäärne. Maal pruunikashallis koloriidis.
works.de: In the foreground a cattle path bordered by a stone wall, with two cows on it. In front on the right, a woman standing by the wall. Beyond, on the left, farm buildings, on the right the seaside. The painting in a brownish-grey colour scheme.

works.d: Hämaras ruumis toolil istuv mees profiilis vasakule. Mehel pikemad ülepea kammitud juuksed, põskhabe. Seljas tume kuub, põlvpüksid punaste tuttidega, pastlad jalas. Käed süles, paremaga hoiab kollakat karpi. Vasak jalg kõverdatult tooli jala juures. Tagapool paremal naise figuur. Maal tihketes hallides toonides.
works.de: A man sitting on a chair in a dim room, in profile to the left. The man has longer hair combed back over his head, a beard on the cheeks. Wearing a dark coat, knee breeches with red tassels, sandals on his feet. Hands in his lap, holding a yellowish box with the right. Left leg bent by the leg of the chair. Behind, on the right, a woman's figure. The painting in dense grey tones.

works.dm: kujutise kõrgus: 28.0 cm (km); lehe laius: 47.5 cm; lehe kõrgus: 38.6 cm; kujutise laius: 34.0 cm (km)
works.d: Pruunikashallil põllul paremal kolm mustendavat kartulivagu. Kaks naist äärmisel vasakpoolsel vaol, eespoolne kummargil, toetub parema käega korvile, selgvaates, tagumine otsevaates. Tagapool, paremal mees hobusega. Silmapiiril vasakul lage maastik, paremal puudegrupp ja talu. Maal hallikaspruunis, samblarohelises koloriidis.
works.de: On a brownish-grey field, three blackening potato furrows on the right. Two women on the leftmost furrow, the one in front bent over, resting with her right hand on a basket, seen in profile, the one behind in a frontal view. Further back, on the right, a man with a horse. On the horizon, on the left an open landscape, on the right a group of trees and a farm. The painting is in a greyish-brown, moss-green colour scheme.

works.d: Mustal taustal hallipäise, vuntsidega mehe pea veerandpöördes paremale. Mehel sinised silmad, heledad kulmud, sirge nina. Nägu piklik, roosakas jumega. Punakas kaelus. Näo osas maal pastoossem.
works.de: Against a black background, the head of a grey-haired, moustached man in a quarter-turn to the right. The man has blue eyes, light eyebrows, a straight nose. The face is elongated, with a rosy complexion. Reddish collar. The face area of the painting is more pastose.

works.d: Vanema mehe rinnaportree, profiilis. Tugev, veidi kongus nina, kitsad, kokkusurutud huuled, väikesed, sügaval asetsevad silmad. Suu ümbruses teravalt väljajoonistatud kortsud. Peas kaabu, seljas tume, pruunikas kuub. Värvigamma tume.
works.de: Chest portrait of an older man, in profile. Strong, slightly hooked nose, narrow, pressed-together lips, small, deep-set eyes. Sharply defined wrinkles around the mouth. Wearing a hat on his head, a dark, brownish coat. Dark colour scheme.

works.d: Heledapäise tütarlapse portree. Pea poolpöördes vasakule. Suurte, sügaval asetsevate, tumedate silmade pilk suunatud vaatajale. Lõua otsas lohk. Seljas lillakasroosa ja valge triibuline rõivastus.
works.de: Portrait of a fair-haired girl. Head in a half-turn to the left. The gaze of large, deep-set, dark eyes directed at the viewer. A dimple at the tip of the chin. Wearing purplish-pink and white striped clothing.

works.d: Vanema naise kolmveerandfiguur. Ülakeha veidi vasakule painutatud, pea kergelt ette kallutatud; käed rüpes. Seljas valged käised, mille kinniseks silmadega prees. Pead katab tumepruun rätt. Koloriit tume.
works.de: Three-quarter figure of an older woman. Upper body bent slightly to the left, head tilted slightly forward; hands in her lap. Wearing white sleeves fastened with an eyelet brooch. Head covered with a dark brown kerchief. Dark colouring.

works.t: Onu Paul punases kampsunis ja ema. Lõpetamata
works.d: Esiplaanil istuva mehe kolmveerandfiguur, keha pöördes vasakule, vaade otse. Seljas punane, peente tumedate triipudega kampsun, peas karusnahkne müts. Taga vasakul seisab tumedas rõivastuses naine, pea poolpöördes paremale, käed kõverdatud vöökoha kõrgusele.
works.de: In the foreground, three-quarter figure of a seated man, body turned to the left, gaze straight ahead. Wearing a red sweater with fine dark stripes, a fur cap on his head. Behind, on the left, stands a woman in dark clothing, head in a half-turn to the right, arms bent at waist height.

works.d: Heledate vurrudega noore mehe rinnaportree. Vaade otse, keha kergelt vasakule pööratud. Seljas tume kuub ning hele särk, kaelas must kikilips. Peas, veidi üles koolutatud servadega kaabu. Maalimislaad etüüdlik.
works.de: A bust portrait of a young man with light-colored moustache. Facing straight ahead, body turned slightly to the left. Wearing a dark coat and a light shirt, a black bow tie at the neck. On his head, a hat with slightly upturned brim. Sketch-like painting style.

works.d: Vasakul, lahtiaetud kartulivagude vahel, viis naisefiguuri. Esiplaanil olev seisab, käed külgedel, keha kergelt pöördes paremale; seljas roosakas jakk. Taustaks kitsas meretriip ja pilvine taevas.
works.de: On the left, between opened-up potato furrows, five female figures. The one in the foreground stands with her hands at her sides, body turned slightly to the right; wearing a pinkish jacket. Background a narrow strip of sea and a cloudy sky.

works.d: Vanema mehe profiilportree. Suu kergelt avatud, pilk suunatud otse ette. Kaelas ookritoonis kaelarätt, seljas tume kuub. Foon hele, paremal tume.
works.de: Profile portrait of an older man. Mouth slightly open, gaze directed straight ahead. An ochre-toned scarf around the neck, wearing a dark coat. Background light, dark on the right.

works.d: Paremal, pildi sügavusse looklev hall teelint. Vasakul, teeveerul valge hobune vankriga. Paremas servas paistab tükike kiviaeda ning maja otsasein. Taamal puud-põõsad, paar inimfiguuri, kooguga kaev.
works.de: On the right, a grey road winding into the depth of the picture. On the left, at the roadside, a white horse with a cart. In the right margin a piece of stone wall and the gable end of a house are visible. In the distance trees and bushes, a couple of human figures, a well with a sweep.

works.d: Kahvatusinise taeva taustal kerkib madala kellatorniga kirik. Kirikuesisel suuremate ja väiksemate gruppidena värvikates rahvariietes inimesed. Esiplaanil, all vasakus nurgas, valge hobune reega, selles istuva naise ning rakendi kõrval sammuva pruunis pikkkuues mehega. Koloriit hele. Maalitud etüüdlikult.
works.de: Against a background of pale blue sky rises a church with a low bell tower. In front of the church, larger and smaller groups of people in colourful folk costumes. In the foreground, in the lower left corner, a white horse with a sledge, in which a woman sits, with a man in a brown long coat walking beside the harness. Light coloring. Painted in a study-like manner.

works.dm: laius: 86.0 cm; kõrgus: 102.0 cm (Pilt on raamitud ja klaasitud)
works.d: Koidueelse taeva taustal, käed rinnal kaugusesse vaatava mehe poolfiguur, profiilis vasakule.
works.de: Against the background of a pre-dawn sky, a half-figure of a man with hands on chest looking into the distance, in profile facing left.

works.d: Kikkhabemega mehe poolprofiil paremale. Tume, mustjas-lillakas taust.
works.de: Half-profile of a man with a goatee, facing right. Dark, blackish-purple background.

works.d: Ees vasakul rannariba maasse taotud pikkade vaiadega. Tagapool, vasakul, merre tungiv maanina üksiku männiga. Horisondil kollane viirg.
works.de: In the front left a strip of shore with long stakes driven into the ground. Further back, on the left, a headland extending into the sea with a solitary pine. On the horizon a yellow strip.

works.d: Istuva vana naise poolfiguur väikses püüdega paremale. Tumedas kleidis. Käed ristamisi süles.
works.de: Half-figure of a seated old woman, small, striving to the right. In a dark dress. Hands crossed in her lap.

works.d: Eest vasakult taha paremale suunduv tee kiviaiaga ja üksikute raagus puudega vasakul. Paremal ja vasakul tee ääres sulamata lume laike. Vasakul, kiviaia taga väike õlgkatusega hoone. Horisondil mets.
works.de: A road leading from the front left to the back right, with a stone wall and single bare trees on the left. On the right and left along the road, patches of unmelted snow. On the left, behind the stone wall, a small building with a thatched roof. Forest on the horizon.

works.d: Vanamehe rinnapilt, poolprofiilis paremale, pikkade juuste, kõrviku ja piibuga.
works.de: Bust portrait of an old man, in half-profile to the right, with long hair, sideburns and a pipe.

works.d: Esiplaanil lagendiku keskel reas neli puud, taamal aed, hooned. Horisondil mets.
works.de: In the foreground, in the middle of a clearing, four trees in a row, further back a garden, buildings. Forest on the horizon.

works.d: Pikajuukselise vana mehe rinnapilt en face. Valge lühike lõuahabe, kaabu peas.
works.de: Bust of a long-haired old man en face. White short chin beard, wearing a hat.

works.d: Esiplaanil rannariba männiga, taga veekogu. Horisondil kaldariba metsaga.
works.de: In the foreground a strip of shore with a pine tree, behind it a body of water. On the horizon a strip of shore with forest.

works.dm: kõrgus: 27.2 cm (arm); laius: 32.4 cm (vm); kõrgus: 26.3 cm (vm); laius: 33.3 cm (arm)
works.d: Ees heinamaa küüniga paremal. Taga metsatukad, millede taga veekogu. Taamal metsaviir.
works.de: In front a meadow with a barn on the right. Behind, patches of forest, beyond which a body of water. In the distance a forest edge.

works.d: Keskealise mehe pea poolprofiilis vasakule. Peas must nokaga müts, seljas must kuub. Foon oranž.
works.de: Head of a middle-aged man in half-profile to the left. Wearing a black peaked cap, black coat. Background orange.

works.d: Esiplaanil põlde viljahakkidega, põldude taga vasakult paremale suunduva punaka müürtarandi taga lehtpuid, milledest üle paistab teravavõlvilise kiriku katus.
works.de: In the foreground fields with grain stooks, behind the fields a reddish wall enclosure running from left to right, behind it deciduous trees, above which the roof of a church with a pointed vault can be seen.

works.d: Esiplaanil küpressid. Kaugemal järsud, kõrged mäed. Keskel oleva kõige kaugema mäe tipp kaetud igilumega.
works.de: Cypresses in the foreground. Steep, high mountains in the distance. The peak of the farthest mountain in the middle is covered with eternal snow.

works.dm: lehe laius: 7.5 cm; lehe kõrgus: 10.5 cm
works.d: Mehe rindportree, vaade paremale
works.de: Man's bust portrait, view to the right

works.dm: lehe laius: 8.7 cm; lehe kõrgus: 12.0 cm
works.d: Lapse pea poolprofiilis vasakule
works.de: Child's head in half-profile to the left

works.dm: lehe laius: 7.0 cm; lehe kõrgus: 9.5 cm (Aluspapi ava 13,3x10,5 cm)
works.d: Mehe rindportree poolprofiilis vasakule. Poolpikad lokkis juuksed, suus piip
works.de: Chest portrait of a man in half-profile to the left. Half-long curly hair, a pipe in the mouth

works.dm: lehe laius: 30.2 cm; lehe kõrgus: 33.0 cm
works.d: Vanema mehe pea poolprofiilis paremale, vaade suunatud üles
works.de: Head of an elderly man in half-profile to the right, gaze directed upward

works.d: Paremal järsk merre tungiv klajumassiiv. Taamal paremal ja vasakul sügavalt merre ulatuvad kaljusiluetid.
works.de: On the right a steep cliff massif jutting into the sea. In the background, on the right and left, rock silhouettes reaching deep into the sea.

works.d: Maastik vasakule mäkke tõusva teega. Esiplaanil kaks puud, taamal hooned.
works.de: A landscape with a road rising to a hill on the left. In the foreground two trees, in the distance buildings.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal kõrgendik üksiku suure puuga. Taamal hoonied ja vaade merele.
works.de: In the foreground on the right an elevation with a solitary large tree. Further back buildings and a view of the sea.

works.d: Esiplaanil tänaval kaks inimfiguuri, ümberringi kõrged ehitiste müürid
works.de: In the foreground on the street two human figures, surrounded by tall building walls

works.d: Esiplaanil lauskmaal üksikuid puid ja teid. Taamal tõusval künkal siniseid täppe ja laigukesi.
works.de: In the foreground on flat ground scattered trees and roads. In the distance on a rising hill blue dots and patches.

works.d: Hallipäise, moka- ja väikses lõuahabemega mehe rinnapilt. Keha poolprofiilis paremale. Pea kerge pöördega samas suunas. Taust sinine.
works.de: Bust of a grey-haired man with a moustache and small chin beard. Body in three-quarter profile to the right. Head slightly turned in the same direction. Blue background.

works.d: Lokkis juustega kolmveerandprofiilis, pöördega paremale, naise rinnapilt. Tumedas, valge kraega kleidis.
works.de: With curly hair in three-quarter profile, turned to the right, a woman's chest portrait. In a dark dress with a white collar.

works.d: Esiplaanil üksikute noorte kuuskede vahelt vasakule kulgev lumine rada. Taamal hooneid.
works.de: In the foreground a snowy path leading to the left among scattered young spruces. Buildings in the distance.

works.d: Esiplaanil kivine rannajoon, keskel avar veteväli, ankrus oleva purjepaadiga. Taamal silmapiiril sinetav saare kontuur.
works.de: In the foreground a stony shoreline, in the middle an open expanse of water with an anchored sailboat. In the distance on the horizon the bluish outline of an island.

works.d: 7/8 tööst võtab enda alla eest tahapoole kõrgenev mägismaastik. Mäeharjad kaetud metsadega. Nõlvakuil üksikuid hooneid. Kõige kaugemad ja kõrgemad tipud kaetud igilumega.
works.de: 7/8 of the work is taken up by a mountainous landscape rising from front to back. The mountain ridges are covered with forests. On the slopes single buildings. The farthest and highest peaks are covered with eternal snow.

works.d: Metsane mägimaastik. Taamal üksikute taeva poole ulatuvate mäeteravikkudega.
works.de: A forested mountain landscape. In the distance, individual mountain peaks reaching towards the sky.

works.d: Esiplaanil ojaäär, kallastel hilissügiseses värvuses lehtpuud (kased, haavad jne). Taamal vasakul põllulappe ja kasesalusid, üldiseks tagapõhjaks okaspuu mets.
works.de: In the foreground the edge of a stream, on the banks deciduous trees (birches, aspens, etc.) in late-autumn colours. Further away on the left patches of fields and birch groves, the general background a coniferous forest.

works.d: Ees (ca pool lõuendist) kõrgendik suurte kivide ja üksikute põõsastega. Kõrgendiku taga madalamal alal, vasakul punase katusega gooti maakirik, paremal põldude riba ja taamal metsa veeres üksikud hooned.
works.de: In front (about half the canvas) a rise with large stones and single bushes. Behind the rise, on lower ground, on the left a Gothic country church with a red roof, on the right a strip of fields and, further away, single buildings at the forest's edge.

works.d: Vaade teelt taluõuele: Esiplaanil eest otse taha kulgev tee piiratud suurtest puudest. Tagapool kaks taluhoonet.
works.de: View from the road to a farmyard: In the foreground a road running from front to back, bordered by large trees. Behind, two farm buildings.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul väike kõrge võlviga kivisild ja looklev jõgi. Taamal, teiselpool jõge üksikuid põõsaid ja talumaju.
works.de: In the foreground on the left, a small stone bridge with a high arch and a winding river. Beyond, on the other side of the river, scattered bushes and farm buildings.

works.d: Esiplaanil veekogu. Taamal lehtpuumets.
works.de: Body of water in the foreground. Deciduous forest in the distance.

works.d: Vasakul varemed. Selle taga tõusval mäeküljel puid. Paremal madalikul järv. Taamal vaade põldudele.
works.de: On the left, ruins. Behind them, trees on a rising hillside. On the right, in the lowland, a lake. In the distance a view of fields.

works.d: Esiplaanil mets , keskel särav päike.
works.de: In the foreground a forest, in the centre a shining sun.

works.d: Esiplaanil kivid ja põõsad, taamal puude vahel valged hooned. Taustaks mets.
works.de: In the foreground stones and bushes, further off white buildings among trees. Forest as background.

works.d: Esiplaanil aiad ja hooned. Taamal mäed.
works.de: Gardens and buildings in the foreground. Mountains in the distance.

works.d: Noore naise pea profiilis vasakule. Peas kuklatagant sõlmitud sinist tooni rätt.
works.de: Head of a young woman in profile facing left. Wearing a bluish-toned scarf tied at the back of the neck.

works.d: Esiplaanil kallas puudega, keskel ümbrust ja taevast peegeldav järv, taamal järve vastaskaldal hooneid, puudesalku, kiriku torn.
works.de: In the foreground a shore with trees, in the middle a lake reflecting the surroundings and the sky, in the distance on the opposite shore of the lake buildings, groves of trees, a church tower.

works.dm: kõrgus: 58.5 cm; laius: 75.2 cm; kõrgus: 67.5 cm (raamiga); laius: 84.5 cm (raamiga)
works.d: Soo maastik üksikute puudega esiplaanil. Keskosas laukaid.
works.de: Marshland landscape with solitary trees in the foreground. Pools in the middle section.

works.d: Künklikul maastikul kolm sinist veeloiku; tsagapool üksikud põõsad ja puude grupid.
works.de: Three blue puddles on a hilly landscape; on the left side single bushes and groups of trees.

works.d: Esiplaanil maas kägaras istuva naise kuju, must-valge linikuga üle pea. Kummaski ääres lehtpuid. Keskel valgeid lilleõisi.
works.de: In the foreground the figure of a woman sitting huddled on the ground, with a black-and-white cloth over her head. Deciduous trees on either side. White flower blossoms in the middle.

works.d: Paremal kõrge hoonetegrupp, esiplaanil tänavalatern. Vasakul madal aed väravaga, mille taga hoonetegrupp. Taevas tumesinine. Koloriit ergas, värvirõõmus.
works.de: On the right a tall group of buildings, in the foreground a street lantern. On the left a low fence with a gate, behind which a group of buildings. The sky is dark blue. The colouring is vivid, joyful.

works.d: Esiplaanil sügav sinine järv, kaldanõlvakuil suuri puid, paremal põlluriba. Taevas rahutult pilvine. Koloriit rohekas-sinine.
works.de: In the foreground a deep blue lake, large trees on the sloping banks, a strip of field on the right. Restlessly cloudy sky. Greenish-blue colouring.

works.d: Keskel väike veekogu, ümber põllud, nõlvadel taamal mets, taevas lapiline. Eredad värvid: sinine, kollane, roosa.
works.de: In the centre a small body of water, fields around it, forest on the slopes in the distance, patchy sky. Bright colours: blue, yellow, pink.

works.d: Esiplaanil kitsas looklev jõekäär. Vasakul kolm lillakat põõsast. Paremal üksikute kollaste lehtedega raagus puu. Keskel kaks kollast kaske. Taga silmapiiril metsad.
works.de: In the foreground a narrow winding river bend. On the left three lilac bushes. On the right a bare tree with a few yellow leaves. In the middle two yellow birches. Behind, forests on the horizon.

works.d: Esiplaanil väike ümar järv, selle taga künkad punakate põlluribade ja põõsastega. Taevas valged pilved.
works.de: In the foreground a small round lake, behind it hills with reddish strips of fields and bushes. White clouds in the sky.

works.d: Vasakul esiplaanil üksikute kollaste lehtedega puuoksad, all jõgi, mis voolab paralleelselt pildipinnaga. Jõe kaldal kollased ja punased puud, taga põllud ja kaugel mets.
works.de: In the foreground on the left branches with single yellow leaves, below a river flowing parallel to the picture plane. On the riverbank yellow and red trees, behind fields and in the distance a forest.

works.d: Esiplaanil künklik lumine maastik mõne raagus puuga. Vasakul rühm raagus puid punakates-lillakates toonides ja väike kääruline oja. Taamal vasakul suurem metsatukk. Horisondil ähmased metsa piirjooned. Taevas kollakates-hallikates toonides.

works.d: Vasakul järv, paremal puid, teekäänak. Domineerivad sinakas-rohelised tumedad toonid, vormikäsitlus nurgeline. Suurt tähelepanu pööratud taeva maalimisele.
works.de: On the left a lake, on the right trees, a bend in the road. Dark bluish-green tones dominate, the treatment of form is angular. Great attention has been paid to painting the sky.

works.de: In the foreground the crowns of flowering trees, behind which rises a building with two white bell towers. In the background to the left the jagged ridges of mountains remain, and to the right the sky.

works.d: Lahesopp kahe vasakule merre ulatuva neemega, üksikute põõsagruppidega. Tagaplaanil kogu pildilaiust läbiva lahesopi kaldal tume metsaserv, keskel kaugemal kõrgendikuga. Taevas lillakates toonides rünkpilved.
works.de: A bay inlet with two headlands extending left into the sea, with isolated groups of bushes. In the background, along the shore of the bay stretching across the whole width of the picture, a dark forest edge, with a rise further in the middle. Sky in lilac-toned cumulus clouds.

works.d: Lahekäär. Esiplaanil madal klint sellel kasvate taimedega, mis pildivälja keskel ulatub liigendatud neemena paremale merre; ees paremal moodustub väike lahesopp. Tagaplaanil ulatub pika kitsa ribana paremale merre neem. Üleval väga kitsas taevaosa.
works.de: A bay inlet. In the foreground a low bluff with plants growing on it, which in the centre of the picture field extends as an articulated headland to the right into the sea; on the right in front a small bay inlet is formed. In the background a headland extends as a long, narrow strip to the right into the sea. Above, a very narrow strip of sky.

works.t: a) Otepää maastik; b) Daami portree
works.d: Tagaplaanil vasakus kuldlõikes kuppel üksiku kase ja ees vasakul jalamil kasvavate sihvakate kuuskedega. Esiplaanil paremal künka jalam selle tagant paistvate kuusekroonidega. Ees vasakul looklev oja. Tagaplaanil lainjas metsasiluett. Taevas valged ja roosakad rünkpilved.
works.de: In the background, on the left in the golden section, a dome with a solitary birch and, in front on the left, slender spruces growing at its base. In the foreground on the right, the foot of a hill with spruce crowns visible behind it. In front on the left a winding stream. In the background a wavy forest silhouette. The sky with white and pinkish cumulus clouds.

works.d: Pildipinna keskel lohkjas tasandik pikliku kujuga järvega esiplaanil künkjaste vallide vahel, üksiku majaga puude vahel tasandiku vasakus servas. Esiplaanil vasakul järvesopp selle taga kasvavate kaskedega. Ees paremal künka jalam, selle taga kaks kaske. Silmapiiril kõrgendikel lehtpuude salud. Taevas pastoossed ebamäärased pilved. Maalil hele värvigamma.
works.de: In the centre of the picture surface, a hollow plain of elongated shape with a lake, in the foreground between hillocky ridges, with a solitary house among trees on the left edge of the plain. In the foreground on the left, a bay of the lake with birches growing behind it. In front on the right, the foot of a hill, behind it two birches. On the horizon, on elevated ground, groves of deciduous trees. The sky has pastose, indistinct clouds. The painting has a light colour palette.

works.d: Lohkjas maastik madalate laugjate küngaste vahel, kitsa lookleva jõekesega diagonaalselt maali vasakust alumisest nurgast. Pildivälja keskplaanil paremast äärest vasaku kuldlõikeni kulgev kitsas põõsastesalu kahe heledama lehtpuuga selle lõpus. Tagaplaanil paremas kuldlõikes maja puude vahel. Silmapiiril kogu maali laiuse ulatuses sinetav metsatriip. Taevas lillakasroosad valged rünkpilved. Maali värvigamma - heledates toonides.
works.de: A hollowed landscape between low, gently sloping hills, with a narrow winding river running diagonally from the lower left corner of the painting. In the middle ground of the picture plane, from the right edge to the left golden section, a narrow grove of bushes with two lighter-coloured deciduous trees at its end. In the background, at the right golden section, a house among trees. On the horizon, across the whole width of the painting, a bluish strip of forest. In the sky, purplish-pink white cumulus clouds. The painting's colour scheme is in light tones.

works.d: Tüüpiline Lõuna-Eesti järve-, metsatukkade-, nõlvakutega maastik: esiplaanil rohekad, kollakad ja punakad põllulapid, keskplaanil järv, millesse ulatub vasakul, peaaegu pildi servani, maanina; keskel ümarakujuline metsane saar; tagaplaanil uuesti punakad nõlvakud, taevas rahutuis pilvedes.
works.de: A typical South Estonian landscape with a lake, groves and slopes: in the foreground greenish, yellowish and reddish plots of farmland, in the middle ground a lake, into which, on the left, a spit of land extends almost to the edge of the picture; in the centre a rounded, wooded island; in the background reddish slopes again, the sky with restless clouds.

works.d: Kitsa, peenejoonelise näoovaali ja suurte siniste silmadega naise poolprofiilis rinnaportree. Keskelt lahkukammitud blondid juuksed kuklal sõlmes. Avaralõikelise, pehmete voltidena langeva kleidi kaeluses oranžikas ja kollane roos.
works.de: Half-profile bust portrait of a woman with a narrow, finely lined oval face and large blue eyes. Blonde hair parted in the middle and gathered in a knot at the back of the head. In the neckline of a loosely cut dress falling in soft folds, an orangish and yellow rose.

works.d: Kõrgemate ja madalamate põimuvate küngastega Lõuna-Eesti maastik. Keskplaanis laiem org paari sinise järvesilmaga keskel. Esiplaanil lilleline aas hallide kivide ja kuuskedega vasakul nurgas. Silmapiir väga kõrgel. Silmapiiril keskel ja paremal metsaviirg. Vasakul ülanurgas helesinine taevas pilvedega. Maalitud erksates värvitoonides hõredalt täppivas laadis.
works.de: A South Estonian landscape with higher and lower intertwining hills. In the middle ground, a wider valley with a couple of blue lake-eyes in the centre. In the foreground, a flowery meadow with grey stones and spruce trees in the left corner. The horizon is very high. At the horizon, centre and right, a strip of forest. In the upper left corner, a light blue sky with clouds. Painted in bright colour tones in a sparsely dabbing manner.

works.d: Pikkade täppivate pintslilöökidega maalitud, suurte värvipindade mõjule põhinev kompositsioon: keskel stiliseeritult antud jõgi, millest paremal üksikud pika puukrooniga tumerohelised puud, vasakul metsast ümbritsetud järvesilm, metsatukk ja kõrgemal lage väli. Silmapiiril ribake merd, ülal hall taevas. Hallikasroheline üldkoloriit.
works.de: A composition painted with long, precise brushstrokes, based on the effect of large colour surfaces: in the middle a stylised river, to the right of which single dark green trees with tall crowns, on the left a lake eye surrounded by forest, a copse and, higher up, an open field. On the horizon a strip of sea, above a grey sky. Overall grayish-green colour scheme.

works.d: Esiplaanil laud, mis kaetud oranžikas-punaste lillede ja väänlevate mustritega kollasel foonil. Laual sinise-punasekirju vaas suure puhma lillade ja valgete sirelitega. Foonil erinevate mustritega vaibad või tapeedid. Fooni silmatorkavalt suur ja efektne muster annab tugeva dekoratiivse mõju. Laudlina ja foon maalitud pikkade täppivate pintslilöökidega.
works.de: In the foreground a table, covered with orange-red flowers and winding patterns on a yellow background. On the table a blue-and-red patterned vase with a large bush of lilac and white lilacs. In the background carpets or wallpapers with various patterns. The strikingly large and effective pattern of the background creates a strong decorative effect. The tablecloth and background are painted with long, dabbing brushstrokes.

works.d: Madalal silmapiiril punane ja valge maja. Nende vahel kõrgub sihvakas korsten. Hoonete ees rivi pügatud puid. Sinises taevas, majade kohal, valkjad pilved. Maalipind kergelt faktuurne.
works.de: A red and white house on a low horizon. A slender chimney rises between them. In front of the buildings a row of trimmed trees. In the blue sky, above the houses, whitish clouds. The paint surface is slightly textured.

works.d: Täppivalt maalitud ainisekirju veekogu, keskel türkiissinine looklev joon. Esiplaanil rohelise-lillakirju kallas. Vastaskaldal, roosakaspunase taeva foonil heleroheline aimatav mets.
works.de: A precisely painted, variegated body of water, in the middle a turquoise-blue winding line. In the foreground a green-purplish variegated shore. On the opposite bank, against a pinkish-red sky background, a faintly discernible light green forest.

works.d: Maalipinna jagab kaheks paarikorruseliste majade rivi, suunaga vasakult servast üles paremale. Rahutus pintslikirjas taevas maalitud intensiivsetes sinistes toonides.
works.de: The painted surface is divided in two by a row of two-storey houses, running from the left edge upward to the right. A restless sky painted in intense blue tones with agitated brushwork.

works.d: Keskel suurt, paelaga köidetud kivi kandva naise kuju. Seljas tume seelik ja sõlega kaunistatud sinine pluus, lopsakad juuksed lehvimas. Fooniks ereda päikeseketta särast erksates toonides taevas ning veekogu. Esiplaanil tumedad kivid, mille vahel üksikud viljapead ja pildi kummaski servas paar kidurat kuuske.
works.de: In the centre a figure of a woman carrying a large stone bound with a ribbon. She wears a dark skirt and a blue blouse decorated with a buckle, her luxuriant hair fluttering. As a background, a sky in bright tones with the glow of a bright solar disc, and a body of water. In the foreground dark stones, among which individual ears of grain, and on each edge of the picture a couple of stunted spruces.

works.d: Nikerdustega punakaspruunis tugitoolis istub poolpöördes kõhukas mees, käed süles puhkamas. Seljas tume rohekashall ülikond, valge särk ja lips. Juuksed pisut lokkis, paksud vuntsid ja kergelt kongus nina. Figuurist paremal ümmargune madal laud sigaretihoidja, sigarite ja sigarettidega. Foon helebeež, põrandal kirju vaip.
works.de: In a reddish-brown carved armchair sits a portly man in half-turn, hands resting in his lap. He wears a dark greenish-grey suit, a white shirt and a tie. His hair is slightly curly, with a thick moustache and a slightly hooked nose. To the right of the figure, a low round table with a cigarette holder, cigars and cigarettes. Background light beige, a patterned carpet on the floor.

works.d: Esiplaanil lagendik, üksik kivi keskel. Tagapool üldistatult lahendatud puukroonid rohekassinise, lillaka taeva taustal. Tume mets kaugeneb paremale.
works.de: In the foreground a clearing, a single stone in the middle. Behind it, generalised tree crowns against a greenish-blue, purplish sky. A dark forest recedes to the right.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul, kõrgemal kaldal helerohelised lehtpuukroonid, tumedate sihvakate tüvedega männid. Paremal, madalamate puude tagant paistab sinakasroosa vesi ja silmapiiril tume vastaskalda triip. Taevas õrnroosa, - sinine, -roheline. Maalitud jõuliselt, vorme üldistavalt. Puude osas maal faktuurne.
works.de: In the foreground on the left, on a higher bank, light green deciduous tree crowns, pines with dark slender trunks. On the right, behind lower trees, bluish-pink water is visible and, on the horizon, a dark strip of the opposite bank. The sky is pale pink, blue, and green. Painted vigorously, generalising the forms. The painting is textured in the area of the trees.

works.d: Üle nõlvaku mere äärde viiv liivatee, paremal pool seda kaks jändrikku mändi taeva taustal, vasakul üks puu. Taevas kuu. Silmapiiril meretriip. Hallikas, samblaroheline koloriit. Jõuline vormiv pintslikäik, kohati väga pastoosne maal.
works.de: Across a slope a sandy road leading to the sea, on the right side of it two stunted pines against the sky, on the left one tree. In the sky the moon. On the horizon a strip of sea. Greyish, moss-green colouring. A vigorous, form-giving brushstroke, in places a very pastose painting.

works.d: Esiplaanil üksikud tumerohelised põõsad lumelaikudega nende vahel. Väikesel künkal keskplaanis punane tuuleveski, millest vasakul liivane kallas. Paremal üksik puu, ülal lillakashall taevas. Tume üldkoloriit.
works.de: In the foreground isolated dark green bushes with patches of snow between them. On a small hillock in the middle ground a red windmill, to its left a sandy shore. On the right a lone tree, above a lilac-grey sky. Dark overall colour scheme.

works.d: Punasest puust lainelise käetoega toolis istub tumedas ülikonnas keskealine mees 3/4 pöördes vasakule, jalg üle põlve. Parem käsi toetub põlvele, vasak tooli seljatoele. Tumedal vestil jäme uurikett, valgel püstkraega särgil lai tume kaelaside. Mehel väikese kühmuga nina, vuntsid ja laubalt taandunud juustepiir. Foon tumehall.
works.de: A middle-aged man in a dark suit sits in a red wooden chair with a wavy armrest, in a 3/4 turn to the left, leg crossed over knee. His right hand rests on his knee, his left on the back of the chair. On the dark waistcoat a thick watch chain, on the white stand-up collar shirt a wide dark necktie. The man has a small hump on his nose, a moustache, and a receding hairline. Background dark grey.

works.d: Esiplaanil lahesopp veest väljaulatuvate kividega. Keskplaanis liivane rand, õhtupäikeses männitukk, millest paremal väike majake. Servades vasakul ja paremal silmapiiril roheline metsaviirg. Ülal kahvatusinine taevas.
works.de: In the foreground a bay inlet with stones jutting out of the water. In the middle ground a sandy beach, a pine grove in the evening sun, with a small house to its right. On the left and right edges a green forest strip on the horizon. Above, a pale blue sky.

works.d: Erksates värvides dekoratiivne maastikumaal kujutab vaadet kõrgendikult alla fjordile. Taustaks sinine taevas roosakas-lillakate pilvedega. Ees all keskel rohelistes-oranžides toonides stiliseeritud okaspuud, vasakul veidi kaugemal on väiksemad tumedavärvilised puud. Maapind rohelistes-oranžides-sinistes toonides, kohati maali alaosas paremal markeeritud kinist kaljupinda. Madalal horisondil lillakais-rohekais toonides vastaskallas.
works.de: A decorative landscape painting in vivid colours depicts a view from a height down onto a fjord. The background is a blue sky with pinkish-purple clouds. In the foreground at the bottom centre stylised coniferous trees in green-orange tones, on the left slightly farther away smaller dark-coloured trees. The ground in green-orange-blue tones, in places at the bottom right of the painting a bluish rocky surface is indicated. On the low horizon the opposite shore in purplish-greenish tones.

works.d: Vanema mehe pea poolpöördes vasakule, pilk vaatajale suunatud, pealagi paljas, külgedel juuksed, nina väikese kühmuga, põsed pisut lohus, suunurgad kaarduvad allapoole, kaelas punane rätik. Paremas käes pintsel. Foonil vasakul tume klaasustega kapp ja kaks maali, paremal foon helesinine ja hall.(eesti)
works.de: The head of an older man in half-turn to the left, gaze directed at the viewer, the top of the head bare, hair at the sides, the nose with a small bump, cheeks slightly hollow, the corners of the mouth curving downward, a red scarf at the neck. A brush in the right hand. In the background on the left a dark cabinet with glass doors and two paintings, on the right the background is light blue and grey.

works.d: Ees istub rohelises seelikus, punases avaras jakis ja kollases pearätikus neegrinaine, süles alasti laps (valgel mähkmel), kes sirutab käed puuvilja poole, mida hoiab käes ema. Taga seisab mees kõvera kepiga.(eesti)
works.de: In front sits a Negro woman in a green skirt, a wide red jacket and a yellow headscarf, on her lap a naked child (on a white diaper) reaching its hands towards a fruit held by the mother. Behind stands a man with a crooked stick.

works.d: Maali servadel maalitud pruunikas-punastes, paremal ultramariinsinistes toonides kangialune, tagapool, maali keskel, tume rinnatis ja trepikoda. Joonistuses rõhutatud nurgelisust. Sellest avausest toodud väiksena fookusesse erksates toonides alllinna punased katused, Oleviste, erksinine meri ja rohekas taevas. Esiplaanil nurgeline inimfiguur kandamiga.(eesti)
works.de: At the edges of the painting, painted in brownish-red, on the right in ultramarine blue tones, an archway, behind which, in the centre of the painting, a dark parapet and a stairwell. The drawing emphasises angularity. Through this small opening, brought into focus in bright tones, are the red roofs of the lower town, St Olaf's Church, a bright blue sea and a greenish sky. In the foreground, an angular human figure with a burden.

works.d: Tänava ääres paremal oranžikaspunase viilkatusega maja valge müüriaiaga, tagapool roheluses hallikas kirik tumeda tornikiivriga (Toomkirik). Vasakul, tänava varjupoolel kõrgete tumedate kivimajade vahel paar madalamat hoonet. Maalitud värvikalt, laiemate pintslitõmmetega.(eesti)
works.de: By the street on the right a house with an orangish-red gabled roof and a white boundary wall, behind it in the greenery a greyish church with a dark spire (the Cathedral). On the left, on the shaded side of the street, between tall dark stone buildings a couple of lower buildings. Painted colourfully, with broader brushstrokes.
