works.d: Paremal neli figuuri - kaks seisvat ja kaks istuvat. Vasakul maalija molberti ees.
works.de: On the right four figures - two standing and two sitting. On the left a painter before an easel.

works.d: Hallil foonil väga tinglikud pruunikates ja hallikates toonides figuurid.
works.de: Against a grey background very conventionalised figures in brownish and greyish tones.

works.d: Keskel vasakul Lenini figuur, parem käsi tõstetud rinna kõrgusele. Paremal keskel kolm meest, kaks sõduri- ja üka madruseriietes. Vasakul- ning allääres stseenid Lenini elust. Üleval ääres ja ülal paremal nurgas sõdurid.
works.de: In the centre left, the figure of Lenin, right hand raised to chest height. To the right in the centre, three men, two in soldier's and one in sailor's clothing. On the left and lower edges, scenes from Lenin's life. At the top edge and in the upper right corner, soldiers.

works.d: Ruumi sisevaade; vasakul laua ääres istub mees, vasakus käes avatud raamat, paremaga toetub lauale. Paremal seisab mees, käes pintsel ja palett.
works.de: Interior view of a room; on the left a man sits at the table, in his left hand an open book, with the right he leans on the table. On the right stands a man, holding a brush and palette.

works.d: Pastelsetes, põhiliselt pruunides ja rohelistes toonides pinadade kompositsioon. Kompositsiooni keskel valged pinnad.
works.de: A composition of planes in pastel, mainly brown and green tones. White planes in the centre of the composition.

works.d: Tumedates pehmetes toonides heledale taustale maalitud kompositsioon. Keskel laud paari heleda pudeli ja tassiga, selle taga üks naise ja kaks mehe figuuri. Kompositsiooni paremal serval veel üks figuur.
works.de: A composition painted in dark, soft tones against a light background. In the centre a table with a pair of light-coloured bottles and a cup, behind it one female and two male figures. At the right edge of the composition, one more figure.

works.d: Vasakul seisva, viiluit mängiva tütarlapse figuur. Paremal valge riidega kaetud laua ääres kaks istuvat figuuri. Tagaplaanil paistab aken.
works.de: Figure of a girl standing on the left, playing the violin. On the right, by a table covered with white cloth, two seated figures. In the background a window is visible.

works.d: Rohekal foonil sinise tooniga antud kompositsiooniline grupp inimese ülakeha ja hobuse alakehaga figuuridest. Grupi tsentris, samuti äärtel rohkesti mustjaspruune ja mustjassiniseid pindu.
works.de: On a greenish background, given in blue tones, a compositional group of figures with human upper bodies and horse lower bodies. In the centre of the group, as well as at the edges, plenty of blackish-brown and blackish-blue planes.

works.d: Fooniks mustad ja pruunid pinnad. Esiplaanil valgete ja mustade joontega antus neli inimfiguuri. Vasakpoolse figuuri pea kallutatud vasakule.
works.de: Background of black and brown surfaces. In the foreground four human figures rendered with white and black lines. The head of the left figure tilted to the left.

works.d: Rohekad ja pruunikad jooned ning pinnad moodustavad abstraktsete inimfiguuride grupi. Siin-seal üle kogu pildi pinna sinakaslillad pinnad.
works.de: Greenish and brownish lines and surfaces form a group of abstract human figures. Here and there over the whole surface of the picture bluish-purple surfaces.

works.d: Kompositsioon pruunikas-hallis koloriidis, mõne roosaka pinnaga. Esiplaanil terrass, millel mehe ja naise seisvad figuurid. Nende ees terrassil kaks valget tuvi. Tagaplaanil majad.
works.de: Composition in brownish-grey coloring, with some pinkish surfaces. In the foreground a terrace, on which stand the figures of a man and a woman. In front of them on the terrace two white doves. In the background houses.

works.d: Beežika taeva ja pruunides toonides maastiku taustal, pildi keskel rohekatest, pruunidest, valgetest ning oranžidest pindadest ja joontest moodustuv kolmefiguuriline grupp.
works.de: Against a beige sky and a landscape in brown tones, in the middle of the picture a three-figure group formed of greenish, brown, white and orange planes and lines.

works.d: Kollasel taustal, sinistest, rohelistest ja punastest pindadest moodustuv fantastiliste, abstraktsete figuuride grupp. Nende keskel kaks inimfiguuri, parempoolsel pea kallutatud paremale.
works.de: On a yellow background, a group of fantastical, abstract figures formed from blue, green and red surfaces. Among them two human figures, the one on the right with its head tilted to the right.

works.d: Rohekas-pruunil foonil sinistest, mustadest ja valkjatest joontest ning pindadest kompositsioon. Kompositsiooni ülemises pooles ülekaalus tumedad toonid, allosas heledad.
works.de: A composition of blue, black and whitish lines and surfaces on a greenish-brown background. Dark tones predominate in the upper half of the composition, light tones in the lower part.

works.d: Kolm pikaksvenitatud, tugevasti stiliseeritud figuuri heledal foonil.
works.de: Three elongated, strongly stylised figures on a light background.

works.d: Tumedas koloriidis kompositsioon kolmest figuurist. Keskmise figuuri juures üksikud ookerjad ning oranžikad pinnad.
works.de: Composition of three figures in a dark colour scheme. Near the middle figure, individual ochre and orangish areas.

works.d: Vana naine ja mees kartuleid koorimas. Naine paremal pool profiilis, valges rätis, punakas seelikus. Kartulikauss kahe vahel taburetil. Kogu maal tumedates pruunides toonides, valgus helendab kartulitel ja pearätil.
works.de: An old woman and man peeling potatoes. The woman on the right in profile, in a white headscarf, reddish skirt. A bowl of potatoes on a stool between them. The whole painting in dark brown tones, light gleaming on the potatoes and the headscarf.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremas ääres soniga mehe poolfiguur ning osa majast. Vasakul pikad müügilauad juurviljadega ning müüjad ja ostjad. Tagaplaanil linna hooned.
works.de: In the foreground on the right edge the half-figure of a man with a cane and part of a house. On the left long sales tables with vegetables, and sellers and buyers. In the background city buildings.

works.d: Tumedal foonil punases laiaäärse kübaraga, mõtliku ilmega naise istuv poolfiguur; kerge pöördega paremale. Käed asetatud vaheliti rinnale; õlgadel hele triibuline jakk.
works.de: On a dark background a seated half-figure of a pensive-looking woman in red, in a wide-brimmed hat; with a slight turn to the right. Hands placed crossed on the chest; on the shoulders a light striped jacket.

works.d: Värvilisel foonil heledad, mitmesugused ebakorrapärased kujundid.
works.de: Against a coloured background, light-coloured, various irregular shapes.

works.d: Heledal taustal tume, ebakorrapärane kujund. Sellel valkjad, sinised, punased moodustised.
works.de: On a light background, a dark, irregular shape. On it whitish, blue, red formations.

works.d: Üle pildipinna maalitud laiade hoogsate pintslilöökidega sinistes ja ookertoonides rahutu meri, millel laeva kujutis mustade, punaste, siniste pintslitõmmetega visandatud.
works.de: Painted over the picture surface with broad, sweeping brushstrokes in blue and ochre tones a restless sea, on which the image of a ship is sketched with black, red and blue brush strokes.

works.d: Hõbehallilt kumaval foonil neli tantsivat naisfiguuri, käes täpilised lehvikud, pikad seelikud alt volangilised.
works.de: Four dancing female figures against a shimmering silvery-grey background, holding spotted fans, long skirts with flounces at the bottom.

works.de: In the foreground a large boat with sails, half-figures of rowing men on the sides. Against the background of a rectangular sail, a male figure with raised hands

works.d: Noore naise kolmveerandfiguur, käes avatud kirju päevavari. Seljas õrnlilla kleit, peas tume kübar kahe valge kunstlillega.
works.de: Three-quarter figure of a young woman, holding an open patterned parasol. Wearing a pale lilac dress, a dark hat on her head with two white artificial flowers.

works.d: Raamaturiiuli ees istuva mehe kolmveerandfiguur poolpöördes, üks käsi puusas, teine põlvel, lillakassinine särk küünarnukini üleskeeratud käistega, kaelus avatud, helehallid püksid, tumedad juuksed, kõrge laup, sirge nina.
works.de: Three-quarter figure of a man sitting in front of a bookshelf, in a half-turn, one hand on his hip, the other on his knee, a purplish-blue shirt with sleeves rolled up to the elbow, collar open, light-grey trousers, dark hair, high forehead, straight nose.

works.d: Pruunikas-rohelistes, keskosas pastelsetes roosakais ja kollastes toonides joontest ning pindadest abstraktne kompositsioon.
works.de: Abstract composition of lines and surfaces in brownish-green, in the middle part in pastel pinkish and yellow tones.

works.d: Suur figuraalne kompositsioon. Esiplaanil viljakottide juures seisvad pearätikutes naised, ühel neist märkmik ja punane pliiats käes. Keskplaanil paremal viljapeksumasin, millel kolm inimest, kelle kätte jangub mees hobusekoormalt viljavihke. Kaks meest koguvad vilja kottidesse. Keskplaanil vasakul sinises kleidis ja pearätikus naine seljaga vaataja poole hangule toetumas. Temast vasakul kaal viljakottidega ja mehed viljakotte autole laadimas. Tagaplaanil õlekuhi, vasakul ja paremal maastik.
works.de: A large figural composition. In the foreground, women in headscarves standing by grain sacks, one of them holding a notebook and a red pencil. In the middle ground on the right a threshing machine, at which three people are handing sheaves of grain to a man from a horse-drawn load. Two men are collecting grain into sacks. In the middle ground on the left a woman in a blue dress and headscarf, with her back to the viewer, leaning on a pitchfork. To her left a scale with grain sacks and men loading grain sacks onto a truck. In the background a haystack, landscape to the left and right.

works.d: Naise põlvportree pöördes paremale. Tumedatel juustel punane kübar. Seljas samas toonis seelik ja vest sinisekirju pluusiga. Foon helepruun.
works.de: Knee-length portrait of a woman turned to the right. A red hat on dark hair. Wearing a skirt and vest of the same tone with a blue-patterned blouse. Background light brown.

works.d: Esiplaanil roheline maapind, millel kerge pintslitõmbega visandatud looklev teerada. Vasakule jäävad kõrged kadakad ja põõsad ning paremale põõsad. Madalamal keskplaanil metsa ja natukene näha merd. Taevas hallikaid pilvi. Etüüdilikult maalitud.
works.de: In the foreground a green ground on which a winding path is sketched with a light brush stroke. To the left are tall junipers and bushes, and to the right, bushes. Lower in the middle ground, forest and a bit of the sea can be seen. In the sky, grayish clouds. Painted in an etude-like manner.

works.d: Esiplaanil jõgi sinakasmustade põõsapuhmastega alumistes nurkades. Üle jõe mõned tuules kooldunud tumedad puud punaka paadiga nende vahel. Taamal rohekashall väli, väga kõrge horisont. Koloriit tume, peamiselt sinakates ja rohelistes toonides, pilvisest taevast varjutatud.
works.de: In the foreground a river with bluish-black bush clumps in the lower corners. Across the river some dark trees bent by the wind, with a reddish boat between them. In the distance a greenish-grey field, a very high horizon. The colouring dark, mainly in bluish and green tones, shaded by an overcast sky.

works.d: Pruunides, hallides, sinistes ja kollastes toonides abstraktne, väga dünaamiline kompositsioon, mille jooonterägust on aimatavad vaataja poole pööratud näod ja ülestõstetud käed. Hoogsate, selgelt eristuvate, impulsiivsete pintslilöökidega maalitud.
works.de: Abstract, highly dynamic composition in brown, grey, blue and yellow tones, in whose linear texture faces turned toward the viewer and raised hands can be discerned. Painted with vigorous, clearly distinguishable, impulsive brushstrokes.

works.d: Esiplaanil pruunil toolil istuva noore naise portree kerges pöördes paremale. Seljas mustast ja hallist riidest kombineeritud valge kraega kleit. Poolpikad kastanpruunid juuksed on otsmikult tagasi kammitud. Naise parem käsi toetub küünarnukiga lauale, millel pikk rida raamatuid. Käes rohekas-hallist savist tass alustassiga. Foon täppivalt mustaga kaetud, alt kumab läbi roheline toon. Kohati pastoosne, selgelt eristuvate pintslijälgedega.
works.de: In the foreground, a portrait of a young woman sitting on a brown chair, slightly turned to the right. Wearing a dress combined of black and gray fabric with a white collar. Her shoulder-length chestnut-brown hair is combed back from her forehead. The woman's right hand rests with the elbow on a table, on which there is a long row of books. In her hand a cup with a saucer made of greenish-gray clay. The background is covered with dotted black, through which a green tone shows below. Somewhat pastose, with clearly distinguishable brushstrokes.

works.d: Kolmest naisfiguurist koosnev kompositsioon: tumedate puude all paremal vilepilli puhuv, vasakul lamav ja vasakul ülal lambatallega naisakt. Tumedad hallikaspruunid värvitoonid, maalitud piirjooni hajutavalt.
works.de: A composition of three female figures: under dark trees, on the right a nude woman playing a pipe, on the left a reclining one, and above on the left a nude woman with a lamb. Dark greyish-brown colour tones, painted with diffused contour lines.

works.d: Suvine maastik pildi sügavusse suubuva väikese, tumedate varjude ja peegeldustega veepinnal, jõega esiplaanil. Jõe kallastel suured puud ja põõsad, vasakul kaldal väike suvitusseltskond. Foonil tume metsaviirg. Ülaservas riba valkjaskollaste pilvedega kaetud taevast.
works.de: Summer landscape with a river in the foreground, its surface receding into the depth of the picture with dark shadows and reflections. On the riverbanks large trees and bushes, on the left bank a small group of vacationers. In the background a dark strip of forest. At the upper edge a strip of sky covered with whitish-yellow clouds.

works.d: Erinevatest geomeetrilistest pindadest abstraktne kompositsioon: horisontaalsel keskteljel punane ja roosa triip, millest vasakule alla suunduvad punased ja kollased triibud. Triipudel sinise triibuga ääristatud seest punase-kollasetriibulised ja siniste laikudega pinnad. Paremas ülemises nurgas punase laubapaelaga profiilis indiaanlane, kellest vasemal suure halli laigu sees punakas laik. All paremal neljakandiline, seest labürindijoontega kaetud kujund.
works.de: An abstract composition of various geometric surfaces: on the horizontal central axis a red and pink stripe, from which red and yellow stripes descend to the left. On the stripes, surfaces bordered by a blue stripe, striped red-yellow inside with blue spots. In the upper right corner, an Indian in profile with a red headband, to his left a reddish spot within a large grey spot. Below on the right a quadrangular figure filled inside with labyrinth lines.

works.d: Erkrohelisel ja kollasel foonil värvilised laigud ja geomeetrilised kujundid. Kollasel, lisaks kujundile, mustade joonte rägastik.
works.de: Coloured patches and geometric shapes on a bright green and yellow background. On the yellow, in addition to the shape, a tangle of black lines.

works.de: On a marble-like pinkish-orange background, four large abstract shapes in the centre, each containing its own system of coloured geometric shapes.

works.d: Abstraktne kompositsioon, mille keskosas üks poolik ja üks terve roosa ring (otsekui aastaringidega kaetud). Ülaservas paremal osa vikerkaarest. Piki paremat serva hallikaslilla triip, ülalt heledam, alt tumedam. Üle pildi pinna otsekui suurendatud jäälilled, millest paistab läbi roosa, tumesinine ja kollakas foon.
works.de: An abstract composition, in the middle part of which one half and one whole pink circle (as if covered with annual rings). At the top right part of a rainbow. Along the right edge a greyish-purple stripe, lighter at the top, darker at the bottom. Across the surface of the picture as if enlarged frost flowers, through which a pink, dark blue and yellowish background shows.

works.d: Suurtest värvilistest kujunditest koosnev kompositsioon: keskosas ülalt alla kollakas, servades heleroheline pind. Kollasel ja rohelisel foonil kirjud ja triibulised geomeetrilised kujundid.
works.de: A composition consisting of large coloured shapes: in the central part a yellowish surface from top to bottom, light green surface at the edges. On the yellow and green background, mottled and striped geometric shapes.

works.d: Värviline abstraktne kompositsioon: ülal vasakul ja vertikaalteljel kahvatukollane pind. All vasakul kirev abstraktsete kujunditega pind, domineeriva ringi kujundiga. Paremal mitme erineva abstraktsete kujundite süsteemi vööndid.
works.de: Colourful abstract composition: upper left and on the vertical axis a pale yellow surface. Lower left a colourful surface with abstract shapes, with a dominant circle shape. On the right, zones of several different systems of abstract shapes.

works.de: A combination of abstract coloured surfaces partially overlapping one another.

works.d: Erksates värvides abstraktne kompositsioon: allosas keskel roheline, otsekui sügavusse suunduv silmapiiril ahenev pind, kollakasrohelised triibud kahel pool koonduvad samas suunas. Keskel neljakandiline ümarate nurkadega kujund peamiselt roosades, rohelistes ja kollastes toonides. Kujundi foon on roosakaspunane, roheliste ja kollaste suurte laikudega kahel pool. Ülaosas peamiselt sinistes ja punastes toonides abstraktsete kujundite süsteem.
works.de: An abstract composition in bright colours: at the bottom centre, a green surface that seems to recede into depth, narrowing toward the horizon, with yellowish-green stripes converging in the same direction on both sides. In the centre, a quadrangular shape with rounded corners, mainly in pink, green and yellow tones. The background of the shape is pinkish-red, with large green and yellow patches on both sides. In the upper part, a system of abstract shapes mainly in blue and red tones.

works.d: Kohvikustseen: esiplaanil paremal valge linaga kaetud laud, millele parema, sigaretti hoidva käega, toetub mustas pintsakus, hallide pükste ja kikilipsuga mees. Mehe ees poolik õllekruus. Laua taga seisab mustas ülikonnas kelner, valge rätik üle parema käe ning kirjutab tellimust üles. Vasakus servas istub sinepikollases kleidis ja sama värvi kübaras daam, punakaspruun sall tooli käetoel. Foonil üksikuid külastajate ja kelnerite figuure. Foon sinakaroheline, ülalt paremalt punakaspruun.
works.de: A café scene: in the foreground on the right a table covered with a white cloth, on which a man in a black jacket, grey trousers and a bow tie leans with his right hand holding a cigarette. In front of the man a half-finished glass of beer. Behind the table stands a waiter in a black suit, a white towel over his right arm, writing down the order. On the left edge sits a lady in a mustard-yellow dress and a hat of the same colour, a reddish-brown scarf on the armrest of the chair. In the background isolated figures of guests and waiters. The background is bluish-green, reddish-brown from the upper right.

The woman's elbow rests on a blue-green-patterned rug.

works.t: Graafika. Vahetiitel KALEVIPOJALE: VANEMUISE LAUL /KALEVIPOEG SOOME SEPA JUURES MÕÕKA PROOVIMAS.
works.d: Lehel 2 pilti. Vasakpoolne pilt VANEMUISE LAUL. Pikajuukseline ja pika habemega vanamees põlvedel lebava kandlega. Taevas kuu ja tähed.
works.de: Two pictures on the sheet. The left-hand picture SONG OF VANEMUINE. A long-haired old man with a long beard, with a kannel resting on his knees. Moon and stars in the sky.

works.d: Lehel 3 pilti. Esimene pilt vahetiitel "Kalevipoja" XII loole. Esiplaanil kolm sortsipoega. Tagaplaanil kuused. Keskmine pilt vahetiitel "Kalevipoja" XIX loole. Esiplaanil istub mees, paremal kaks istuvat naist. Nende taga tantsivad paarid. Ridva otsas põleb tõrvatünn. Kolmandal pildil lamab mees maas, käed risti rinnal. Tema kõrval seisab naine.
works.de: 3 pictures on the sheet. The first picture is a half-title for canto XII of "Kalevipoeg". In the foreground, three sons of the sorcerer. In the background, spruce trees. The middle picture is a half-title for canto XIX of "Kalevipoeg". In the foreground a man sits, on the right two seated women. Behind them, couples dancing. At the end of a pole, a tar barrel is burning. In the third picture, a man lies on the ground, arms crossed on his chest. Beside him stands a woman.

works.d: Lehel 8 pilti. Vasakpoolsel ülemisel pildil päisliist järelsõnale. Esiplaanil kiviaed, paremal puu. Tagaplaanil maja katus. Tagaplaanil mõned puud. Vasakult teine pilt päisliist sissejuhatusele. Esiplaanil ohvrikivi kolme auguga, keskmisest tõuseb suitsu. Vasakult kolmandal pildil päisliist I loole. Esiplaanil jäme puu. Tagaplaanil täiskuu. Vasakpoolsel alumisel pildil päisliist XII loole. Sild, mida uhuvad lained. Parempoolsel ülemisel pildil vinjett XV loole. Esiplaanil kivid, tagaplaanil põlev taluhoone. Parempoolsel teisel pildil vinjett järelsõnale. Esiplaanil Kalevipoeg, rinnaportree, profiil paremale. Paremalt kolmas pilt vinjett sissejuhatusele. Esiplaanil osa puust üksikute harudega
works.de: 8 pictures on the sheet. In the upper left picture, a header strip for the afterword. In the foreground a stone wall, on the right a tree. In the background the roof of a house. In the background a few trees. The second picture from the left, a header strip for the introduction. In the foreground a sacrificial stone with three holes, smoke rising from the middle one. The third picture from the left, a header strip for Tale I. In the foreground a thick tree. In the background a full moon. In the lower left picture, a header strip for Tale XII. A bridge being washed by waves. In the upper right picture, a vignette for Tale XV. In the foreground stones, in the background a burning farmhouse. In the second picture on the right, a vignette for the afterword. In the foreground Kalevipoeg, a bust portrait, profile facing right. The third picture from the right, a vignette for the introduction. In the foreground part of a tree with individual branches

works.d: Lehel 2 pilti. LINNA EHITAMINE. Vasakul seisab Kalevipoeg, profiil paremale, käes rulli keeratud paber. Paremal ja tagaplaanil mehed, käes kirved.
works.de: Two pictures on the sheet. THE BUILDING OF THE CITY. On the left stands Kalevipoeg, profile to the right, holding a rolled-up paper. On the right and in the background, men holding axes.

works.de: Frontispiece for "Kalevipoeg". In the foreground a shore with stones. A person on the shore. Full moon in the sky.

works.d: Illustratsioon "Kalevipoja" V loole. "Kättemaks Tuuslarile". Vasakul Tuuslari sõdalased, paremal Kalevipoeg, käes hoiab mõlema käega rasket tümikat.
works.de: Illustration to the 5th song of "Kalevipoeg". "Revenge on Tuuslar". On the left Tuuslar's warriors, on the right Kalevipoeg, holding a heavy club with both hands.

works.d: Illustratsioon "Kalevipoja" X loole. "Jõukatsujad". Vasakul ülemises nurgas Vetevaim, tema vastas Kalevipoeg, veavad vägikaigast.
works.de: Illustration for the 10th canto of "Kalevipoeg". "The Contenders". In the upper left corner the Water Spirit, opposite him Kalevipoeg, engaged in a tug of strength.

works.d: Illustratsioon "Kalevipojale". Kalevipoeg, kellel on turjal lauakoorem ja paremal õlal kott, sammub vees.
works.de: Illustration for "Kalevipoeg". Kalevipoeg, with a load of boards on his back and a sack on his right shoulder, wading through water.

works.t: Graafika. Vahetiitel ja illustratsioon KALEVIPOJA XI loole.
works.d: Lehel 2 pilti. Esimene pilt vahetiitel "Kalevipoja" XI loole. Pilt kujutab sortsi Kalevipoja mõõka varastamas. Sorts hoiab mõõga pidemest kahe käega kinni ja tirib seda jõe poole. Teisel pildil illustratsioon "Kalevipojale". Pilt kujutab Kalevipoega lauakoormaga turjal, vesi ulatub põlvini.
works.de: Two pictures on the sheet. The first picture is a half-title for chapter XI of "Kalevipoeg". The picture depicts a sorcerer stealing Kalevipoeg's sword. The sorcerer holds the sword by the hilt with both hands and drags it towards the river. The second picture is an illustration for "Kalevipoeg". The picture depicts Kalevipoeg with a load of timber on his back, the water reaching up to his knees.

works.de: Illustration to canto XIII of "Kalevipoeg", "Descent into the Underworld". Kalevipoeg steps into the underworld, a knife sheath hangs on his left hip.

works.de: Illustration for the 14th song of "Kalevipoeg", "The First Battle with Old Sarvik". In the foreground Kalevipoeg, who has lifted Sarvik high above his head. In the background three hell-maidens.

works.d: Illustratsioon "Kalevipoja" XVII loole "Assamalla lahing". Kalevipoeg istub hobusel, paremas käes mõõk. Ümberringi lahinguväli langenud sõdalastega.
works.de: Illustration to the 17th song of "Kalevipoeg" "The Battle of Assamalla". Kalevipoeg sits on a horse, a sword in his right hand. All around a battlefield with fallen warriors.

works.d: Illustratsioon "Kalevipojale". Esiplaanil sõdalased, kellel õlal odad. Nende ees Kalevipoeg hobuse seljas, paremas käes mõõk.
works.de: Illustration for "Kalevipoeg". In the foreground warriors with spears on their shoulders. In front of them Kalevipoeg on horseback, sword in his right hand.

works.d: Illustratsioon "Kalevipoja" XX loole "Kalevipoja surm". Esiplaanil Kalevipoeg on vajunud tagurpidi vette, parem käsi rusikas.
works.de: Illustration for canto XX of "Kalevipoeg", "The Death of Kalevipoeg". In the foreground Kalevipoeg has sunk backwards into the water, right hand clenched into a fist.

works.de: Wrapping paper for "Kalevipoeg". In the foreground a field, on the right Kalevipoeg, holding a sowing vessel in his left hand and sowing with his right. Sky in the background.

works.d: Keskel suur anum punaste ja kollakas-punaste tulpidega, sellest paremal vaas nartsissidega. Esiplaanil all paremal klaasvaas punaste, kollaste ja roosade krüsanteemidega. Vasakul esiplaanil plekknõu punaste tulpidega, tagaplaanil vasakul kollased ja valged nartsissid, nende taga valged kallad. Fooniks valkjashall toasein aknaga ülal paremal.
works.de: In the centre a large vessel with red and yellowish-red tulips, to its right a vase with narcissi. In the foreground below on the right a glass vase with red, yellow and pink chrysanthemums. On the left in the foreground a tin vessel with red tulips, in the background on the left yellow and white narcissi, behind them white calla lilies. Background of a whitish-gray interior wall with a window above on the right.

works.d: Ülakehaga en-face, pea poolprofiilis vasemale kollakate juuste, habeme ja vuntsidega noormehe portree rohelisel foonil. Peen, veidi kongus nina, heledate silmade terav pilk, tugevad madalad kulmukaared heledate väikeste kulmudega.
works.de: Portrait of a young man en-face from the upper body, head in half-profile to the left, with yellowish hair, beard and moustache, on a green background. A fine, slightly hooked nose, a sharp gaze of light eyes, strong low brow arches with light small eyebrows.

works.d: Muhu lillelise vaiba foonil otsevaates väikese poisi rinnaportree. Seljas hele kampsun, mille alt paistab sinine särgikaelus.
works.de: Frontal chest portrait of a small boy against the background of a Muhu floral carpet. Wearing a light-coloured jumper, from under which a blue shirt collar shows.

works.d: Lähivaates fragment inimhulgast: osa nägudest otsevaates, osa profiilis, allservas üks pea kukla poolt. Mõned naisenäod ilmselt portreeliselt antud: all vasakul prillidega, pikkade heledate juustega ja pearätikuga. Kompositsiooni keskpunktis heledapäine lühikeste juuste ja sirge ninaga naine, parem käsi rinna kohale tõstetud. Domineerivad sinised ja kollakasrohelised toonid.
works.de: Close-up view of a fragment of a crowd of people: some faces frontal, some in profile, at the lower edge one head seen from the back. Some women's faces apparently given as portraits: at lower left a woman with glasses, long light hair and a headscarf. At the centre of the composition a fair-haired woman with short hair and a straight nose, right hand raised to chest level. Blue and yellowish-green tones dominate.

works.d: Puidust tugitoolis istuv hallide kiharatega hallis kampsunis daam. Käed sülle asetatud. Kaelas lilla gaasrätik. Kogu maali koloriit lillakas-hall.
works.de: A lady with grey curls, in a grey cardigan, sitting in a wooden armchair. Hands placed in the lap. A purple chiffon scarf around the neck. The colouring of the whole painting is purplish-grey.

works.d: Otsevaates istuva vanema naise kolmveerandfiguur. Parem käsi toetub tooli käsitoele, vasak lebab süles. Naisel on lühikesed tumedad juuksed, sügavad silmad. Seljas valge laiade mantsettidega ning žabooga pluus, pruunikas pihikseelik. Žaboo on kinnitatud kollase ristküllikukujulise prossiga, vasakus käes on suure roheka kiviga sõrmus. Taust rohekais toonides.
works.de: A three-quarter-length figure of an older woman sitting in a frontal view. Her right hand rests on the armrest of the chair, her left lies in her lap. The woman has short dark hair, deep-set eyes. She wears a white blouse with wide cuffs and a jabot, and a brownish bodice skirt. The jabot is fastened with a yellow rectangular brooch; on her left hand is a ring with a large greenish stone. The background is in greenish tones.

works.d: Toolil istuva vanema naise otsevaates kolmveerandportree. Parem käsi toetub toolileenile, vasak süles. Õlgadel väike lillakas toonis rätik. Seljas rohekas-hallikas toonis pluus, pruun seelik. Naise pea on veidi paremale kallutatud. Juuksed kollakad, silmad sinised. Taust sinakas-halli koloriidiga.
works.de: Frontal three-quarter portrait of an older woman sitting on a chair. Her right hand rests on the chair back, her left hand is in her lap. A small shawl in a purplish tone on her shoulders. She wears a greenish-grey blouse and a brown skirt. The woman's head is slightly tilted to the right. Hair yellowish, eyes blue. Background in a bluish-grey colour scheme.

works.d: Hallikas-pruunides toonides köögiinterjööris keskel otsevaates seismas naine pliidi taga. Pilk suunatud alla pliidile, kus keeb midagi suures potis. Tagapool akna all seisab väike heledapäine punases kleidis tüdruk. Vasakul soemüüril ripuvad hallid sokid ja must pann. Ees all seina ääres seisavad kummikud ning kirves. Aknast paistab suvine loodus. Vaba visandlik pintslikäsitlus.
works.de: In a kitchen interior in greyish-brown tones, in the middle, facing frontally, a woman stands behind the stove. Her gaze is directed down at the stove, where something is boiling in a large pot. Further back, under the window, stands a small fair-haired girl in a red dress. On the left, on the warming wall, grey socks and a black pan are hanging. In front, below, by the wall, stand rubber boots and an axe. Through the window, summer nature can be seen. Free, sketchy brushwork.

works.d: Molberti taga istuva noore naise ¾ figuur, pilk vaatajale suunatud, paremas käes kaks pintslit. Naisel pruunid silmad, lahkukammitud pikad pruunid juuksed õlgadeni. Tumesinise maalikitli kaelusest paistmas kollased pärlid. Maalil paremal molberti nurk, istet katab tumepunane draperii, taust ookertoonides.
works.de: ¾ figure of a young woman sitting behind an easel, gaze directed at the viewer, two brushes in her right hand. The woman has brown eyes, long brown hair parted and combed to shoulder length. Yellow beads visible at the collar of her dark blue painting smock. On the right of the painting the corner of the easel, the seat covered with a dark red drapery, the background in ochre tones.

works.d: Udurohelise metsa vahel sügavusse suunduv heledam-kirkam alusmets. Ees paremal teravatipuliste lehtedega heleroheline võrse. Maalil ebakorrapäraselt paigutatud kuus väikest oranži neljakandilist kujundit.
works.de: Amid the misty green forest, a lighter, brighter undergrowth receding into the depth. In the front right, a light green shoot with sharp-pointed leaves. In the painting, six small orange quadrangular shapes are irregularly placed.

works.d: Maali keskmes sinistest, mustadest konksudest, ristidest, pulkadest, paeltest kujundeist pundar-pall udusinise laotuse taustal.
works.de: In the centre of the painting a tangled ball of figures made of blue and black hooks, crosses, sticks, ribbons, against a background of a hazy blue expanse.

works.d: Maali keskmes üksteise vastu surutud kuivanud kadaka rootsudest grupp, mida katab diagonaalne uduroosa laineline joon. Sinkjas-hallikas üksikute eredamate värvitriipudega taust.
works.de: At the centre of the painting, a group of dried juniper twigs pressed against each other, covered by a diagonal, hazy-pink wavy line. Bluish-greyish background with a few brighter colour streaks.

works.d: Üks üldine rahva pidupäev (olustikumaal), 1971. Stiliseeritud paljufiguuriline kompositsioon laulu- ja tantsupeost, mille esiplaanil on uhke puhkpilliorkester, neist natuke tagapool rahvatantsurühmi ja päris kaugel, laulukaare all lauljaid. Üle lageda maa avaneb vaade Tallinna lahele, kus seilavad uhked täispurjeis laevad, ning tornitippudega palistatud Tallinna linnale. Maali koloriit on pidupäevale kohaselt erk ja rõõmus. /tekst Liisi Aibel, 2013/
works.de: A general festive day of the people (genre painting), 1971. A stylised multi-figure composition of a song and dance festival, in the foreground of which is a magnificent brass band, somewhat behind them folk dance groups, and quite far away, singers under the song festival arch. Over the open ground a view opens onto Tallinn Bay, where magnificent full-sailed ships are sailing, and onto the city of Tallinn lined with tower spires. The colouring of the painting is bright and joyful, as befits a festive day. /text by Liisi Aibel, 2013/

works.d: Punakaslilla taust, mis maali keskmes muutub heledamaks. Selle keskel kummuli neerukujuline mattmust kujund ümbritsetud eenduva sakiliste servadega oranži pärjaga, mille ebaühtlane äär kooldub musta pinna peale. Viimane kaetud luminiseeruva hõõguva värviga, nired voolamas taustale. Maali allosas mustjashall maapinna läbilõige, rakukujulised pinnasekihid ebaühtlaste triipudena.
works.de: A reddish-purple background, which becomes lighter towards the centre of the painting. In its centre an upside-down kidney-shaped matte black form surrounded by a projecting, jaggedly edged orange wreath, whose uneven edge curls over the black surface. The latter is covered with a luminescent, glowing paint, with rivulets flowing onto the background. In the lower part of the painting a blackish-grey cross-section of the ground, cell-shaped soil layers in uneven stripes.

works.d: Mustal taustal keskel heledafooniline abstraktne kujutis, mille allosas kirkad sinised laigud. Ülaosa värvilised pintslilöögid koonduvad lõuendile kleebitud, roosakates toonides ajaleheväljalõikel oleva kujutise ümber. Maalilaad ekspressiivne.
works.de: Against a black background, in the centre a light-toned abstract image, with vivid blue patches in its lower part. In the upper part, coloured brushstrokes gather around an image on a pinkish-toned newspaper cutting glued to the canvas. The painting style is expressive.

works.d: Töö on peegelpildis tõmmis illustratsioonist lk. 18. Paremal kujutatud Fr. R. Kreutzwaldi, paber käes, üles kirjutamas rahvaluulet tema ees seisvatelt 3 setu naiselt. Naised on rahvariietes, sõlg rinnas, ees põlled, peas rätikud. All sõna Friedrich (peegelpildis).
works.de: The work is a mirror-image print of the illustration on p. 18. On the right Fr. R. Kreutzwald is depicted, paper in hand, writing down folklore from 3 Seto women standing before him. The women are in folk costume, a brooch on the chest, aprons in front, kerchiefs on their heads. Below the word Friedrich (mirror-image).

works.d: Pilt valgel taustal. Nõid rahvariietes, peas tanu - keskelt valge, punase võruga selle ümber, taga triibulised paelad. Vöö ja seelik punastes, pruunides toonides. Triipudega särk. Nõia käed toetuvad kõverale hallile kepile, suus piip.
works.de: A picture on a white background. A witch in folk costume, on her head a bonnet - white in the middle, with a red band around it, striped ribbons behind. Belt and skirt in red, brown tones. A striped shirt. The witch's hands rest on a curved grey stick, a pipe in her mouth.

works.d: Pilt valgel taustal. Pildil vasakul nõid rahvariietes, peas tanu, taga triibulised paelad. Vöö ja seelik punastes, pruunides toonides. Triipudega särk. Nõia käed üles tõstetud (5 kätt), suu avatud. Üleval nõia pea kohal triibuline ümarkaar.
works.de: Picture on a white background. In the picture, on the left, a witch in folk costume, on her head a headdress, behind her striped ribbons. Belt and skirt in red, brown tones. Striped shirt. The witch's hands raised (5 hands), mouth open. Above, over the witch's head, a striped arch.

works.d: Pilt valgel taustal. Kolm piigat istumas kolme voki taga ja ketravad. Neiud rahvariietes - põlledes, laiatriibulised seelikud, peas võrud, millel taga lindid. Üleval triipudega ümarnõlv.
works.de: Picture on a white background. Three maidens sitting behind three spinning wheels and spinning. The girls in folk costumes - in aprons, wide-striped skirts, wreaths on their heads with ribbons at the back. Above, a rounded hillock with stripes.

works.d: Neiud tumedal pruunil taustal, mida ümbritseb triibuline ümarkaar. Kolm piigat istuvad kolme voki taga. Neiud rahvariietes - põlledes, laiatriibulised seelikud, peas võrud, millel taga lindid.
works.de: Maidens against a dark brown background, surrounded by a striped arch. Three maidens sit behind three spinning wheels. The maidens are in folk costume - in aprons, wide-striped skirts, on their heads wreaths with ribbons at the back.

works.d: Pildil üleval triibuline ümarkaar (2 tükki). Pilt rohelistes toonides. Keskel uppuv neiu, juuksed laiali, jalad ülespidi. neiul seljas rahvariided. Ümberringi vesikuppude lehed ja teised veetaimed. Ümber ujuvad kalad.
works.de: In the upper part of the picture a striped semicircular arc (2 pieces). The picture in green tones. In the centre a drowning maiden, hair spread out, legs upturned. The maiden is wearing folk costume. Around her leaves of water lilies and other water plants. Fish swimming around.

works.d: Pildil valgel taustal ratsahobusel kuningapoeg, peas kroon. Ratsul kaunistustega sadul. Paremal osa kuningalossist ja tarast. Aia sees rohelised puud. Pildil üleval triibuline ümarkaar.
works.de: In the picture on a white background a king's son on horseback, wearing a crown. The horse has a decorated saddle. On the right part of a royal castle and a fence. Inside the fence green trees. At the top of the picture a striped arch.

works.d: Ümarkaarelise ja triibulise võlvi all, pildil paremal, istuvad vana kuningapaar ja noored. Kuningapoeg seisab ja neiu istub. Vana kuningapaar rahvariietes. Kuninganna peas punane, rohelise kaunistusega müts, rinnas sõlg, seljas triipudega seelik, valge põll, kaelas rätik. Kuningas pikas kuues, mis seotud triibulise vööga, peas kroon. Neiul triipudega seelik, peas pärg, kaelas helmed. Kuningapojal peas kroon, üle õla heidetud triibuline sall ja hoiab neiul käest kinni.
works.de: Under a round-arched and striped vault, on the right of the picture, an old royal couple and young people are seated. The king's son stands and a maiden sits. The old royal couple are in folk costume. The queen has on her head a red cap with green trim, a brooch on her breast, a striped skirt, a white apron, and a kerchief around her neck. The king wears a long coat tied with a striped belt, and a crown on his head. The maiden has a striped skirt, a wreath on her head, and beads around her neck. The king's son has a crown on his head, a striped shawl thrown over his shoulder, and holds the maiden by the hand.

works.d: Elo Tamul (portreemaal), dateerimata. Vanemuise teatri näitleja, ooperi- ja operetisolisti Elo Tamuli (1913 – 1994) portree kujutab näitlejannat end oma buduaaris peegli ees etenduseks valmis seadmas. Tamul seisab nõtkelt naiselikus poosis pilk kaugusesse suunatud ja käsi peeglilauale toetatud. Mahe valgus ja nikerdatud jalgadega ning vanaaegse lähivalgustuslambiga peeglilaual oleval vaasis paistvad neli punast roosi muudavad portree üldmulje sulniks ja romantiliseks. /tekst Liisi Aibel/
works.de: Elo Tamul (portrait painting), undated. The portrait of Vanemuine Theatre actress, opera and operetta soloist Elo Tamul (1913–1994) depicts the actress preparing herself for a performance in front of a mirror in her boudoir. Tamul stands supplely in a feminine pose, her gaze directed into the distance, her hand resting on the dressing table. The soft light and the four red roses visible in a vase on the dressing table, which has carved legs and an old-fashioned close-up lighting lamp, give the overall impression of the portrait a gentle and romantic quality. /text by Liisi Aibel/

works.de: Northern Russian landscape with bright green hillocks in the foreground. Beyond, forested hills and houses clustered together. Sky bluish-green, with many white cumulus clouds.

works.d: Siniste silmade ja sinise kleidiga naise portree, pea kerges pöördes vasakule. Heledad juuksed maalitud pastoosselt.
works.de: Portrait of a woman with blue eyes and a blue dress, head turned slightly to the left. Light hair painted in impasto.

works.d: Rohelisel alusel punakas vaskkann, kummaline valgete täppidega ese ja madal vaas sinililledega. Nende taga punasel foonil ikoon.
works.de: On a green base a reddish copper jug, a strange object with white dots and a low vase with hepaticas. Behind them an icon on a red background.

works.d: Pruunikal foonil tumepruun korv viie rohelise pirniga.
works.de: Dark brown basket with five green pears on a brownish background.

works.d: Lumisel mäenõlval grupp sõdureid suusatamas. Esiplaanil keskel selgvaates sõdurid mäkke tõusmas, paremal mäest laskuvad sõdurid.
works.de: On a snowy mountain slope a group of soldiers skiing. In the foreground in the middle, seen from the front, soldiers climbing the mountain, on the right soldiers descending the mountain.

works.d: Künklik maastik kollaste põldudega ja üksikute puudegruppidega.
works.de: Hilly landscape with yellow fields and single groups of trees.

works.d: Linnavaate foonil kaks töörõivastuses tütarlast, veoautod ja ekskavaator auku kaevamas.
works.de: Against the background of a city view, two girls in work clothes, trucks and an excavator digging a hole.

works.d: Vasakule sammuvate inimeste grupp punase lipu all. Paremal jooksva lapse figuur.
works.de: Group of people striding to the left under a red flag. On the right the figure of a running child.

works.d: Esiplaanil laud einega ja selle ümber neli mehe ja üks naise figuur. Fooniks helesinine taevas.
works.de: In the foreground a table with a meal and around it four male figures and one female figure. Background a light blue sky.

works.d: Oranzil foonil esiplaanil pruunikas laud. Laual pruun, punutud korv õuntega ja selle taga üks rohekas nõu. Paremal serval paistab pool kederlauast.
works.de: On an orange background in the foreground a brownish table. On the table a brown, woven basket with apples and behind it a greenish vessel. On the right edge half of a potter's wheel is visible.

works.d: Pildi keskel kollasel alusel lühikese varrega metallist nõu, millele üksteise otsa kuhjatud pirnid. Sellest paremale jääb kaanega nõu ning vasakule silindrikujuline toos. Taustaks ikoon.
works.de: In the centre of the picture, on a yellow base, a short-handled metal vessel, on which pears are heaped one upon another. To the right of it is a vessel with a lid and to the left a cylindrical box. Background an icon.

works.d: Esiplaanil roheline laineline maariba, mille tagant paistavad kaks reha. Keskosas heinamaa heinasaadudega. Paremal grupp heinalisi ja hobune. Tagaplaanil mets. Taevas kollane.
works.de: In the foreground a green wavy strip of land, behind which two rakes can be seen. In the middle section a hayfield with haycocks. On the right a group of haymakers and a horse. In the background, forest. Sky yellow.

works.dm: kõrgus: 130.5 cm (Vasak tiib); laius: 99.5 cm (Vasak tiib); laius: 102.5 cm (Parem tiib); laius: 144.0 cm (Keskosa)
works.d: Parempoolne tiib: esiplaanil pingil istuv last süles hoidev naisfiguur, kõrval istub lapsefiguur. Tagaplaanil keskel punane kraana.
works.de: Right-hand wing: in the foreground a female figure sitting on a bench holding a child in her lap, beside her a child figure sitting. In the background, centre, a red crane.

works.d: Rohelisele murule laotatud valgel linal samovar, nõusid ja leivapätse. Paremal istub naine, laps süles. Taga palkidest madal talumaja, mille tumedal ukseaval figuur. Maja ees pingil korv marjadega. Pildiservadel palkseinad ja talad.
works.de: On a white cloth spread on green grass a samovar, dishes and loaves of bread. On the right a woman sits with a child on her lap. Behind, a low log farmhouse with a figure in its dark doorway. In front of the house a basket of berries on a bench. Log walls and beams at the edges of the picture.

works.d: Valgel foonil kollasel alusel ebakorrapärase kujuga kauss selle sees oleva puust kulbiga. Ülal vasakul väike pruunis toonis nelinurga-kujuline laik.
works.de: On a white background, on a yellow base, an irregularly shaped bowl with a wooden ladle inside it. Above on the left a small brownish-toned rectangular-shaped patch.

works.d: Rohekal foonil valgel riidel kaks tumedat vasknõud ning kolm pirni.
works.de: Against a greenish background, on white cloth two dark copper vessels and three pears.

works.d: Ees paremal servas pastoosselt maalitud mustriga kederlaud ja võtmemustriline kangatükk. Tagaplaanil korvid, ühes neist kolm rohelist lõngakera.
works.de: In the front right margin, a spinning-wheel distaff painted with a pattern in a pastose manner and a piece of fabric with a key pattern. In the background, baskets, in one of them three green balls of yarn.

works.d: Ees keskel vasknõu punaste õuntega, sellest paremal ja vasakul kaks etnograafilist eset. Tagaplaanil kolm ikooni. Neist keskmisel kujutatud stseen Kristuse elust (Templisse toomine).
works.de: In the front center a copper vessel with red apples, to its right and left two ethnographic objects. In the background three icons. The middle one depicts a scene from the life of Christ (Presentation at the Temple).

works.d: Viiefiguuriline kompositsioon. Vasakul, rohelise palktare foonil profiilis paremale valgesse riietatud neiu broshüüriga käes. Paremal äärel õlgadele heidetud pintsakuga lokkispäine noormees poolprofiilis vasemale.Foonika künklik maastik majade ja heinasaadusega. Suured sõõrjad, kohati figuure toonivad värvipinnad kompositsiooni keskel.
works.de: A five-figure composition. On the left, against the background of a green log house, a girl in profile facing right, dressed in white, with a brochure in her hand. On the right edge a curly-haired young man with a jacket thrown over his shoulders, in half-profile to the left. The background a hilly landscape with houses and haystacks. Large round colour planes, in places toning the figures, in the centre of the composition.

works.d: Valge laudlinaga ümmargusel laual kaks koonilise kujuga vaskkannu, nende vahel tagaplaanil mandlitega täidetud metallnõu, esiplaanil vasakus kuldlõikes suur kollane, kahe rohelise lehega aivaa.
works.de: On a round table with a white tablecloth two cone-shaped copper jugs, between them in the background a metal vessel filled with almonds, in the foreground in the golden section on the left a large yellow pineapple with two green leaves.

works.d: Vasakus servas allpool väga väikesed värvikihi varingud ja üksikud peened kriimustusjäljed.
works.de: In the lower left edge, very small losses of paint layer and a few fine scratch marks.

works.d: Esiplaanil mitmes kujus leivapätse, millede kohalt tõuseb triibuna taeva poole heledus, kus kombainide siluette, üleval pilvemoodustusi; paremal ja vasemal kollakas läbipaistev heledus sümboliseerimaks viljapõlde, taevas hallsinine.
works.de: In the foreground several shapes of loaves of bread, above which rises a strip of brightness towards the sky, with silhouettes of combine harvesters, cloud formations above; on the right and left a yellowish transparent brightness symbolising grain fields, the sky grey-blue.

works.d: Ümaral laual kaks pruuni, koonilise kujuga kannu. Nende ees kollane puuvili, vasakul suur arbuus, millest on sektor välja lõigatud ning asetseb viimase ees. Vasakul osa aknast, millest avaneb vaade kollakas-rohelistes toonides maastikule. Aknalaual kaks kolletanud puulehte.
works.de: On a round table two brown, conically shaped jugs. In front of them a yellow fruit, on the left a large watermelon, from which a section has been cut out and placed in front of it. On the left part of a window, from which a view opens onto a landscape in yellowish-green tones. On the windowsill two yellowed leaves.

works.d: Aknalaual pruun kann punakaspruunides toonides heinakõrte ja punaste kuivanud hiina laternatega. Tagaplaanil paistab läbi aknaklaasi kolletanud rohuväli ähmaste puudega ja tuhmsinise taevaga.
works.de: On a windowsill a brown jug in reddish-brown tones with straws of hay and red dried Chinese lanterns. In the background, through the windowpane, a yellowed meadow with hazy trees and a dull blue sky is visible.

works.d: Alusraamil ülal punasega: autori nimi, töö nimetus, mõõdud, daatum ja tehnika. Samas vasakus nurgas KF lipik.
works.de: On the stretcher, above, in red: the author's name, the title of the work, measurements, date and technique. In the same, left corner a KF label.

works.d: Valgel riidel kuus sügavpunast granaatõuna ning valkjas peeker. Vorm kergelt deformeerunud.
works.de: On a white cloth six deep red pomegranates and a whitish goblet. The form slightly deformed.

works.d: Esiplaanil oranzikaskollase pinnana viljapõld. Taamal kõrgendik puudesaluga.
works.de: In the foreground, a grain field as an orange-yellowish surface. In the distance, an elevation with a grove of trees.

works.d: Esiplaanil nukrailmeline pikas rohekashallis kleidis naine, tume rätik tihedalt ümber pea seotud. Vasakus käes peene kaelaga hele kann, mis toetub servapidi ookrikarvalisele puupingile. Vasakul, naise selja taga, linaga kaetud laud, paremal maja piirjooned. Maja ees kõveraks kooldunud, vähese rohelusega puu. Kannuga pingi ees maas mõned puuviljad.
works.de: In the foreground, a woman with a mournful expression in a long greenish-grey dress, a dark shawl tightly wrapped around her head. In her left hand a light-coloured jug with a slender neck, resting by its rim on an ochre-coloured wooden bench. On the left, behind the woman's back, a table covered with linen, on the right the outlines of a house. In front of the house, a tree bent into a curve, with sparse foliage. On the ground in front of the bench with the jug, some fruit.

works.d: Roosa linaga kaetud, ümberpööratud perspektiivis antud laual ümmargune metallkandik kolme suure kollase ning kolme väikese punase puuviljaga. Kollased puuviljad peegelduvad kandiku metalselt pinnalt. Kandiku taga samuti metallist elegantse joonega kann, millel nupuga kaas. Foon sinakaslillades toonides, pintslitööd selgelt paista laskev.
works.de: On a table covered with a pink cloth, rendered in inverted perspective, a round metal tray with three large yellow and three small red fruits. The yellow fruits are reflected on the metal surface of the tray. Behind the tray also a metal jug with an elegant line, with a knobbed lid. Background in bluish-lilac tones, the brushwork clearly showing through.

works.d: Rõhutatult dekoratiivselt ja ümaralt antud roheliste küngaste vahel keskel tume terava torniga puukirik ja selle taga väikese saleda torni ja pruuni katusega valge kirik. Valgest kirikust paremal üksik puu. Taevas sinine, keskosa pilved antud valgete komataoliste pintslilöökidega.
works.de: Emphatically decoratively and roundly rendered among green hills, in the centre a dark wooden church with a sharp tower, and behind it a white church with a small slender tower and a brown roof. To the right of the white church a solitary tree. The sky is blue, the middle part with clouds rendered with white comma-like brush strokes.

works.d: Keskel vertikaalselt ülespoole sööstev lennuk valget juttu maha jätmas. Üle pildi pinna taevas, valged pilved, kahelt poolt servast paistavad lennukitiivad, vasakpoolsel punane viisnurk. Ülaserv roosa, vasakul punane päike. Maalitud pastoosselt, kohati spaatliga värvi hõõrudes.
works.de: In the centre, an aircraft shooting vertically upward, leaving white trail behind. Across the picture surface, sky, white clouds, aircraft wings visible from both edges, a red five-pointed star on the left side. Upper edge pink, red sun on the left. Painted pastosely, with the paint rubbed in places with a palette knife.

works.d: Esiplaanil laual läbipaistvas alt avarduvad vaasis kimp kuivanud kõrsi. Vaas ümaral madala servaga alusel, millest paremal õun ja väike uhmer uhmrinuiaga. Interjööri kollakaspruunil seinal fooniks maal, mille all roheline tugitool.
works.de: In the foreground, on a table, a bunch of dried stalks in a transparent vase widening from the bottom. The vase stands on a round base with a low rim, to the right of which is an apple and a small mortar with a pestle. On the yellowish-brown wall of the interior, a painting serves as background, beneath which stands a green armchair.

works.d: Esiplaanil hele korv hiina laternate teiste kuivatatud viljade ning kõrtega oranzikas-kollastes toonides. Korvi fooniks püsti asetatud must, laineliste servade ja maalitud lilledega kandik. Paremal kitsas riba akent. Foon ja esemete alus hall.
works.de: In the foreground a light-coloured basket with Chinese lanterns and other dried fruits and stalks in orangey-yellow tones. The background of the basket is a black tray with wavy edges and painted flowers, standing upright. On the right a narrow strip of window. The background and the base of the objects are grey.

works.d: Esiplaanil keskel kunstiteadlase Mai Levini poolfiguurportree; seljas hele pluus ja rinna kohale tõstetud kätes helesinine sall. Pea pisut vasakule pööratud, lõug tõstetud, näo parempoolsele osale langeb hele valgus. Figuuri taga foonil upakil sambaid, paremal osa arkaadist, vasakul kapiteeliga antiikne sammas ja peata antiikskulptuur. Foonil vasakul värvilistes rõivastes grupp inimesi sammumas silmapiiril asuva antiiktempli varemete suunas. Hele, pastelne värvigamma.
works.de: In the foreground, centre, a half-length portrait of the art historian Mai Levin; she wears a light blouse and holds a light-blue shawl in her hands, raised to her chest. Her head is turned slightly to the left, her chin raised, and bright light falls on the right side of her face. Behind the figure, in the background, leaning columns, on the right part of an arcade, on the left an antique column with a capital and a headless antique sculpture. In the background on the left, a group of people in colourful clothing walking towards the ruins of an antique temple on the horizon. Light, pastel colour range.

works.d: Peamiselt rohelistes ja roosakaspunastes toonides figuraalne kompositsioon, mille esiplaanil vasakul hallis ülikonnas mees, käed vaheliti rinnal ja paremal rohelises ülikonnas, sinises kampsunis, tugeva lõuaga mees, käed kõhul. Esiservas osa verandast. Foonil keskplaanis meeste vahel väike pink, marjakorvid ja pruun samovar. Tagaplaanil valge linaga kaetud laud, mille taga vasakul seisab hallis ülikonnas ja sinises lipsus vana kuivetu mees, kimp roosasid gladioole süles. Temast paremal istub laua taga, klaas käes, tumesinises ülikonnas mustade raamidega prillides mees. Laua vasakus otsas tüdruk - korv ühes ja lilled teised käes, kollastest lilledest pärg peas. Laua paremas otsas punane tabur
works.de: A figural composition mainly in green and pinkish-red tones, in the foreground of which, on the left, is a man in a grey suit with his arms crossed on his chest, and on the right a man with a strong jaw in a green suit and blue jumper, hands on his stomach. In the front edge, part of a veranda. In the background, in the middle ground, between the men, a small bench, berry baskets and a brown samovar. In the background a table covered with a white cloth, behind which on the left stands an old, gaunt man in a grey suit and blue tie, holding a bunch of pink gladioli in his arms. To his right, seated at the table with a glass in hand, is a man in a dark blue suit and black-framed glasses. At the left end of the table a girl - a basket in one hand and flowers in the other, a wreath of yellow flowers on her head. At the right end of the table a red stool

works.d: Maalipind jagatud digonaaljoontega kolmeks. Keskosas vanikuga auvärava vahelt läbi sõitmas kuldjuustega ehitud hobune kaarikuga, kus istuvad setu rõivais toekas naine ja mees. Taga ja kõrval paistmas inimesi, hobune. Paremal osa palkseinast, seisva setu mehe tinglik kujutis, vikat käes. Vasakul valge hobune tagantvaates, maas hobuseriistu.
works.de: The painting surface is divided by diagonal lines into three parts. In the central section, a horse adorned with golden hair, pulling a cart through a garlanded honorary gate, in which sit a sturdy woman and man dressed in Setu costume. Behind and beside them, people and a horse are visible. On the right part of a log wall, a conventional depiction of a standing Setu man with a scythe in hand. On the left a white horse seen from behind, harness lying on the ground.

works.d: Keskel, punakaspruunide küngaste vahel mustjashallide ehituspostide grupp. Taga, silmapiiril uusrajooni paneelmajade müür, selle ees lehviv pesu, paremal katkine lapsevanker. Taga vasakul, mustendava taeva taustal heledad ehituspostid.
works.de: In the middle, among reddish-brown hillocks, a group of blackish-grey construction posts. Behind, on the horizon, the wall of panel houses of a new district, in front of it fluttering laundry, on the right a broken pram. Behind on the left, against a blackening sky, light-coloured construction posts.

works.d: Esiplaanilt paremast nurgast vasakule pildi sügavusse suunduv uus halli teekattega tee. Teeservas betoonist kanalisatsioonitorud ja punased piirdevaiad. Teest vasakul ja paremal puid ja põõsaid, mille lehekroon õhukeselt, skitseerivalt maalitud. Taamal, tee kohal heledate viilkatustega majadekobar. Ülal rohekashall taevas. Maalitud kahvatutes rohelistes, hallides ja roosades toonides.
works.de: A new road with a grey road surface running from the right corner of the foreground to the left, into the depth of the picture. At the roadside, concrete sewage pipes and red boundary posts. To the left and right of the road, trees and bushes whose foliage is painted thinly, sketchily. In the distance, above the road, a cluster of houses with light-coloured gable roofs. Above, a greenish-grey sky. Painted in pale green, grey and pink tones.

works.d: Õuel, puu all linaga kaetud laual kolm kollast puuvilja. Ümber laua kolm meest vestlemas: vasakpoolne noormees kollases särgis, veinikann süles; keskel peakattes habemik vaataja suunas, klaas käes; paremal poolkiilaspäine mees selgvaates. Istujate kohal viljapuude võrad, taustal majanurk. Tagaplaanil vasakul kauged sinetavad mäed.
works.de: In the yard, under a tree, on a table covered with linen, three yellow fruits. Around the table three men conversing: the man on the left in a yellow shirt, with a wine jug in his lap; in the middle a bearded man wearing headgear, facing the viewer, glass in hand; on the right a half-bald man in profile view. Above those seated the crowns of fruit trees, in the background the corner of a house. In the background on the left, distant bluish mountains.

works.d: Hallikaslilla pilvevahus taeva all vaade metsaäärsele lagendikule. Ees samblarohekais toonides maapind, keskel pruunikad, kollakas lehtpuud, kohati tüved kollasega markeeritud.
works.de: View of a clearing at the edge of a forest under a sky of grayish-purple cloud foam. Ground in mossy green tones in the foreground, brownish, yellowish deciduous trees in the middle, trunks in places marked with yellow.

works.d: Pronksise läikega hõbedasel taustal murdunud puu tüvi üksikute roheliste võrsetega. Selle ees väike puupink, millel vaas õunapuuoksaga. Pingi ees hele linik õuntega ümberläinud korvist. Puutüve taga paremal korv puuviljadega, rohelisi vilju maas. Laotuses poolringi kujuline värviline pind.
works.de: Against a silvery background with a bronze sheen, the trunk of a broken tree with a few green shoots. In front of it a small wooden bench, on which stands a vase with an apple-tree branch. In front of the bench a light-coloured cloth with apples spilling out of a tipped-over basket. Behind the tree trunk on the right a basket of fruit, with some fruit lying loose on the ground. The layout has a semicircular coloured area.

works.d: Kuldse-hõbedase läikega fooni keskel avatud suuga kartulikott. Selle ees vasakul sangaga nõu, kartulid pillatud ümber. Paremal maas vartega peete, sibulaid, muid juurvilju. Pildi ülaservas osa loperguse äärega värvilisest pilvest.
works.de: In the middle of a background with a golden-silvery sheen, an open-mouthed potato sack. In front of it on the left, a vessel with a handle, potatoes scattered around. On the right, on the ground, beets with stems, onions, other root vegetables. At the top edge of the picture, part of a colourful cloud with a ragged edge.

works.d: Maalil kujutatud tumesinisel lainetaval merel draakonipeaga laev, mille moodustavad hallid kivid. Laeval keskel mänd, äärtel kadakad. Männi all kolm inimfiguuri ja hobuse seljas Kalevipoeg, mõõk puusal. Sinises taevas paremal pilved, vasakul lind.(eesti)
works.de: The painting depicts a dragon-headed ship on a dark blue rippling sea, formed by grey stones. In the centre of the ship a pine tree, junipers at the edges. Under the pine three human figures and Kalevipoeg on horseback, sword at his hip. In the blue sky, clouds on the right, a bird on the left.

works.d: Pikkade blondide juustega tütarlapse nägu poolprofiilis vasakule, kitsas sirge nina, kitsas teravajooneline suu. Seljas tumeroheline jakk ja pruun pluus. Foonil suvine maastik heinaküüniga vasakus servas ja helesinine õrnade pilvedega taevas.
works.de: Face of a girl with long blond hair in half-profile to the left, narrow straight nose, narrow sharp-lined mouth. Wearing a dark green jacket and a brown blouse. In the background a summer landscape with a hay barn at the left edge and a light blue sky with delicate clouds.

works.d: Noore naise portree profiilis. Poolpikad punakasblondid juuksed kuklasse kammitud, sirge terav nina, selge suujoon. Seljas vanaroosat värvi kleit. Foon tumeroheline.
works.de: Portrait of a young woman in profile. Shoulder-length reddish-blond hair combed back into the nape. Straight, sharp nose, a clear line of the mouth. Wearing an old-rose coloured dress. Background dark green.

works.d: Valges kitlis ja mütsis kirju (oranžid lillekimbud kollasel foonil) traksidega põllega, roosa näojumega naine. Kõrvas punane kõrvarõngas, helepruunid juuksed taha kokku seotud. Väljasirutatud paremas käes roosa, kikkis kõrvadega seapea. Foon eest hall, ülalt tumepruun.
works.de: A woman in a white smock and cap patterned with orange bunches of flowers on a yellow background, wearing an apron with straps, with a rosy complexion. A red earring in her ear, light brown hair tied back. In her outstretched right hand a pink pig's head with perky ears. The background is grey in front, dark brown above.

works.d: Esiplaanil pruunide juustega naise rindkere ning kollaste jalgade ja pika sabaga pruuni linnu tagaosaga olevus hallil kaljunukil. Tagaplaanil erksinise veega lahesopp, liivarand ning mets. Ülal valgete pilvedega taevas.
works.de: In the foreground the chest of a woman with brown hair and the rear part of a brown bird with yellow legs and a long tail, a creature on a grey rocky outcrop. In the background a bay inlet with bright blue water, a sandy beach and a forest. Above, a sky with white clouds.

works.d: Otsekui külma sinise valgusega ülekallatud figuraalne kompositsioon: kivide, rohututtide ja üksikute põõsastega kaetud mereäärsel kaljuplatool vasakul erkroosa ihuga alasti naine, pikad punased juuksed lehvivad tuules, vaade üle õla vaataja poole, käte vahel valge lina. Paremal tõttab suurte sammudega naise poole hallides toonides maalitud musklis mees, juuksed tuules lehvimas. Foonil tumesinise veega lahesopp, ülal hõredalt pilvedega kaetud taevas. Pildi allservas keskel hülge pealuu.
works.de: A figural composition as if drenched in cold blue light: on a seaside rocky plateau covered with stones, tufts of grass and solitary bushes, on the left a bright pink-bodied nude woman, long red hair fluttering in the wind, gaze over her shoulder toward the viewer, a white cloth between her hands. On the right, a muscular man painted in grey tones hurries toward the woman with great strides, his hair fluttering in the wind. In the background a bay inlet with dark blue water, above a sky sparsely covered with clouds. In the lower centre of the picture, a seal's skull.

works.d: Hallikal poodiumil, pruuni draperii ees tumedapäine sihvakas naisakt seismas otsevaates, vasak käsi toetub punase draperiiga kaetud postamendile, parem rippu küljel. Selgelt piiritletud pinnad, hele figuur tumedal taustal. Näo osa detailselt välja maalitud.
works.de: On a greyish podium, in front of a brown drapery, a slender dark-haired female nude stands in frontal view, left hand resting on a pedestal covered with red drapery, right hand hanging at her side. Clearly delineated surfaces, a light figure against a dark background. The facial area painted out in detail.

works.d: Mustjasrohekal taustal tumesinises pintsakus, sinises särgis musta lipsuga noore mehe poolfiguur, pea pööratud vasakule, käed süles. Mehel kõrge laup, tumedad juuksed, kulmud, vuntsid ja lõuahabe, kurvavõitu ilme.
works.de: Against a blackish-greenish background, a half-figure of a young man in a dark blue jacket, blue shirt and black tie, head turned to the left, hands in his lap. The man has a high forehead, dark hair, eyebrows, moustache and chin beard, a somewhat sad expression.

works.d: Kadakapuhmastega suvisel maastikul kahest tihedast põõsast ülakeha ulatuses välja kasvavat alasti figuuri: vasakul habeme ja lehvivate pikkade juustega mees, kerges pöördes paremale, elavas vestluses heledapäise pikajuukselise noore naisega. Viimasel žestideks tõstetud käed.
works.de: In a summer landscape with juniper bushes, a nude figure grows out to the upper body from two dense bushes: on the left a man with a beard and long flowing hair, in a slight turn to the right, in lively conversation with a fair-haired, long-haired young woman. The latter's hands are raised in gestures.

works.d: Lumeväljal harkisjalu seisev vuntsidega noorepoolne mees otsevaates käsi laiutamas. Mehel seljas valge särk, sinised traksipüksid, must lips, paremal ette sirutatud käes sinine pintsak. Taustal talvemaastik raagus puuga paremal. Kõrge sinine taevas kolme pilvega, silmapiiril metsatriip.
works.de: A rather young moustached man standing with legs apart on a snowfield, facing forward, arms spread. The man wears a white shirt, blue braced trousers, a black tie, in his right hand stretched forward a blue jacket. Background a winter landscape with a bare tree on the right. High blue sky with three clouds, a strip of forest on the horizon.

works.d: Kollastes ja mustades toonides kompositsioon Kalevipojaga maa-aluses koopas. Kompositsiooni keskmes alasti, lehvivate juustega Kalevipoja täisfiguur, käes põlev kadakaoks ja jalg loomapealuuga kivikuhilal. Taustal mustav koopasuu, stalaktiidid, paekivisein ja kivikuhilad.
works.de: A composition in yellow and black tones with Kalevipoeg in an underground cave. At the centre of the composition, the full figure of the naked Kalevipoeg with flowing hair, holding a burning juniper branch and a foot on an animal skull on a pile of stones. In the background, the blackening mouth of the cave, stalactites, a limestone wall and piles of stones.

works.d: Murul, puudesalu taustal seisva hallide juustega, tumesinises ülikonnas vanema mehe täisfiguurportree kerges pöördes paremale. Vasakul silmal monokkel. Parem käsi taskus, vasakus ripuvad palvehelmed ristiga.
works.de: Full-length portrait of an elderly man with grey hair, in a dark blue suit, standing on grass against a background of a grove of trees, in a slight turn to the right. A monocle on the left eye. Right hand in pocket, in the left a rosary with a cross hangs.
