works.d: Rohtunud, üksikute kividega rannariba ja sinakas-roheline meri. Kaldaääres kaks murdlainete riba. Taevas 1/3, keskelt helenev.
works.de: A grassy coastal strip with scattered stones and a bluish-green sea. Along the shore two bands of breaking waves. Sky 1/3, glowing from the centre.

works.d: Rohelisel alusel keskel viis tumepunast väikest õuna, munapeeker munaga ning plekist piimanõu. Paremale jääb kõrvaga suur savikruus; vasakule kõhukas sangaga kann.
works.de: On a green base in the middle five small dark red apples, an egg cup with an egg, and a tin milk vessel. To the right a large clay jug with a handle; to the left a bulbous jug with a handle.

works.d: Ümaral alusel keskel tume, peaaegu mustjas pudel ja väike tumehall teekann; nende taga kägardunud valge paber. Pudeli ees sinine riie, millel kahes grupis viis rohelist pirni.
works.de: In the centre on a round base a dark, almost blackish bottle and a small dark grey teapot; behind them crumpled white paper. In front of the bottle a blue cloth on which five green pears in two groups.

works.d: Väike, vanadest äärelinna majadest ja madalatest kuuridest tihedalt ümbritsetud lumine hoov. Vasakul kahe maja vahel kõrgub üle katuste üksik puu. Taevas hele.
works.de: A small snow-covered yard densely surrounded by old suburban houses and low sheds. On the left, between two houses, a solitary tree rises above the roofs. The sky is light.

works.d: Roosal alusel tume klaaspudel ja roheline savikauss punaste õuntega, kaks õuna kausi ees.
works.de: On a pink base a dark glass bottle and a green clay bowl with red apples, two apples in front of the bowl.

works.d: Esiplaanil diagonaalselt roheline kividega ääristatud rannariba. Merepind tasane, tinajas, silmapiiri poole tumenev. Taevas kaetud madalate sinakas-hallide pilvedega.
works.de: In the foreground diagonally a green coastal strip bordered with stones. The sea surface calm, pewter-coloured, darkening towards the horizon. The sky covered with low bluish-grey clouds.

works.d: Vaade kitsale äärelinna tänavale ja madalate kivimajade rägastikule.
works.de: View of a narrow suburban street and a maze of low stone houses.

works.d: Tumesinisel alusel mahukas vaskne kohvikann, savipurk ning hele tass koos alusega. Kontrastse laigu üldises tumedas koloriidis moodustavad kaks oranži apelsini. Esemed peenelt modelleeritud.
works.de: On a dark blue base a voluminous copper coffee pot, a clay jug and a light-coloured cup with its saucer. Two orange oranges form a contrasting spot in the generally dark colour scheme. The objects are finely modelled.

works.d: Rohekasbeežil, laiade pintslitõmmetega maalitud alusel ja samades toonides tumedamal foonil paremal kuldlõikes valge korgiga taimeõli pudel; sellest vasemal kuldlõikes valge koorekann; paremal, veidi eespool sarnaste vormidega piimakann. Pudeli ja koorekannu ees kuus sidrunit.
works.de: On a greenish-beige base painted with broad brushstrokes and against a darker background in the same tones, on the right a bottle of vegetable oil with a white cork in golden section; to its left a white cream jug in golden section; on the right, slightly further forward, a milk jug of similar form. In front of the bottle and the cream jug, six lemons.

works.d: Sinakal laual valge, rohekates voltides draperii. Selle taga valge email-kohvikann, päts leiba, teeklaas ja erkkollased sidrunid - üks terve, teine lahtilõigatud.
works.de: On a bluish table a white drapery in greenish folds. Behind it a white enamel coffee pot, a loaf of bread, a tea glass and bright yellow lemons - one whole, the other cut open.

works.d: Tumedal foonil punase linaga kaetud laual natüürmort: sinaka helgiga valge teekann ja kaks kruusi, kolm klaasi, viis punast õuna, vasktaldrik ja ultramariinsinine draperii. Maalitud reljeefselt ja esemete materiaalsust rõhutavalt, läigete ja refleksidega. Punane lame ja läikiv raam. Tugev lakikiht.
works.de: A still life on a table covered with a red cloth against a dark background: a white teapot with a bluish sheen and two mugs, three glasses, five red apples, a copper plate, and an ultramarine blue drapery. Painted in relief, emphasising the materiality of the objects, with gleams and reflections. Red flat and glossy frame. Thick layer of varnish.

works.d: Keskealise, tumedate pikemate juuste ja habemega mehe rinnaportree. Seljas tuhmroheline džemper ja sinine pintsak. Foon džemprikarva roheline, näole langeb vasakult valgus.
works.de: Chest portrait of a middle-aged man with dark, longer hair and a beard. Wearing a dull green sweater and a blue jacket. Background green like the sweater, light falling on the face from the left.

works.d: Keskealise, tumedate pikemate juuste ja habemega mehe rinnaportree. Seljas tuhmroheline džemper ja sinine pintsak. Foon džemprikarva roheline, näole langeb vasakult valgus.
works.de: Chest portrait of a middle-aged man with dark, longer hair and a beard. Wearing a dull green sweater and a blue jacket. Background green like the sweater, light falling on the face from the left.

works.d: Geomeetrilistest ja ruumiliselt mõjuvatest värvilaikudest koosnev kompositsioon. Üksikud pintslilöögid selgelt eristatavad, värvitoonide hulgast hoolimata domineerib summutatud pruunikashall koloriit.
works.de: A composition consisting of geometric and spatially effective patches of colour. Individual brushstrokes are clearly distinguishable, and despite the variety of colour tones, a muted brownish-grey colouring dominates.

works.d: Tumedal foonil kollasel alusel valge silindriline vaas suure kimbu punaste ning kollaste tulpide ja kolme nartsissiga. Vaasi ees kõrge, kaarja sangaga koorekann ja lusikas; paremale jäävad tühi joogiklaas ning pildiservaga äralõigatud valge taldrik. Valgus langeb paremalt.
works.de: Against a dark background, on a yellow base, a white cylindrical vase with a large bunch of red and yellow tulips and three narcissi. In front of the vase a tall cream jug with an arched handle and a spoon; to the right an empty drinking glass and a white plate cut off by the edge of the picture. Light falls from the right.

works.d: Liivakarva riidega kaetud alusel, pruunil taustal valge, lühikese tilaga kann nelja, punase, avatud õiega tulpidega. Kannu ees paremal pool pätsi vormileiba, sibul ning valge riidetükk. Taustal, paremal langeb pehmetes voltides valkjas draperii. Valges langeb paremalt.
works.de: On a stand covered with sand-coloured fabric, against a brown background, a white jug with a short spout with four open red tulip blossoms. In front of the jug on the right, a loaf of bread, an onion and a piece of white cloth. In the background, on the right, a whitish drapery falls in soft folds. Light falls from the right.

works.d: Tumedal punakaspruunil taustal, mis vasakus ülemises nurgas veidi helendab, vaevu aimatav ühtlane pruun laua fragment, millel vasakult nurgeliselt drapereeritud valge riie, vaskne uhmer nuiaga, kollakaspruun ülespoole laienev savikauss, nupulise korgiga klaaskarahvin veega ja osa pruunist savinõust. Karahvini ees erkvalge munapeeker munakoorega, vasakul veel kolm poolikut koort.
works.de: Against a dark reddish-brown background, which glows slightly in the upper left corner, a barely discernible, uniformly brown fragment of a table, on which, draped in an angular fashion from the left, a white cloth, a copper mortar with a pestle, a yellowish-brown clay bowl widening upward, a glass carafe with a knobbed stopper filled with water, and part of a brown clay vessel. In front of the carafe a bright white egg cup with an eggshell, on the left three more halved eggshells.

works.d: Rohelistes, kollastes ja punastes värvitoonides maastik, komponeeritud erinevate värvipindade koosmõju arvestades. Pildi allosas lagendik, keskel puudemassiiv, ülal taevas, kõik tugevas geomeetrilises üldistuses antud, hoogsad pikad pintslilöögid.
works.de: A landscape in green, yellow and red tones, composed with regard to the interaction of different colour planes. At the bottom of the picture a clearing, in the middle a mass of trees, above the sky, all rendered in strong geometric generalisation, with vigorous long brushstrokes.

works.d: 2/3 pildi pinnast võtavad enda alla allääres roheline-pruun kaldariba ning hall, silmapiiri juures tumenev peegelsile merepind. Taevas sinakashall, horisontaalsete pilvejoontega; ülal vasakus nurgas hele laik üksiku halli pilvetutiga.
works.de: 2/3 of the picture's surface is taken up, along the lower edge, by a green-brown coastal strip and a grey, mirror-smooth sea surface darkening near the horizon. The sky bluish-grey, with horizontal cloud lines; in the upper left corner a light patch with a single grey cloud tuft.

works.d: Samblarohelisel alusel, pildi keskel hall kõhukas, väikese sangaga kann suure kimbu lillades toonides astrite ja kahe oranži saialillega. Kannust paremal roheline plekk-kruus. Valgus langeb vasakult. Foon tume.
works.de: On a moss-green base, in the middle of the picture a grey-bellied jug with a small handle holding a large bouquet of purplish-toned asters and two orange marigolds. To the right of the jug, a green tin mug. Light falls from the left. Dark background.

works.d: Heledajuukselise, poisipeaga noore naise rinnaportree. Pea pöördes paremale. Seljas roheline kampsun. Taust tumepruun.
works.de: Bust portrait of a fair-haired young woman with a boyish haircut. Head turned to the right. Wearing a green jumper. Dark brown background.

works.d: Pehmetes beežides ja pruunides toonides maalitud teravajoonelise pika lõua, sirge nina ja sügaval asetsevate silmadega naise portree. Naisel kohevad poolpikad juuksed, seljas hall kleit, millel pitsäärisega valge krae, kleidil punakaspruun kolmnurkse kaelaaugu ja laia kraega mantel või jakk.
works.de: A portrait, painted in soft beige and brown tones, of a woman with a sharp-lined long chin, straight nose and deep-set eyes. The woman has fluffy shoulder-length hair, wears a grey dress with a lace-edged white collar, and over the dress a reddish-brown coat or jacket with a triangular neckline and wide collar.

works.d: Vaikelu suure vaskkastruli, väikese vaskkopsiku ja klaasist karahviniga tumedal laual. Suurest kastrulist paremal terrakotakarva draperii. Laua taga tume viini tool, laua ees põrandal kastrulikaas. Foon tumehall.
works.de: Still life with a large copper saucepan, a small copper scoop and a glass carafe on a dark table. To the right of the large saucepan, a terracotta-coloured drapery. Behind the table a dark Vienna chair, in front of the table on the floor a saucepan lid. Background dark grey.

works.d: Kollase valgusega ülekallatud vaikelu: valgel, pisut kortsus linal keskel suur, lahtilõigatud kõrvits. Kõrvitsa taga suur punane savipott; ees kaks sibulat, väljastpoolt kollane plekk-kruus, paremal pika kaelaga pruun savipudel sibulaga viimase ees. Vasakul nurgas kummuli plekist lehter (sibul selle taga) ja valge plekk-kruus, mille alt glasuur osaliselt pudenenud. Foon kuldpruun.
works.de: A still life bathed in yellow light: on a white, slightly wrinkled cloth, in the middle, a large cut-open pumpkin. Behind the pumpkin a large red clay pot; in front two onions, a yellow tin mug seen from outside, on the right a long-necked brown clay bottle with an onion in front of it. In the left corner an upturned tin funnel (an onion behind it) and a white tin mug, from which the glaze has partly chipped off. Background golden brown.

works.d: Pruunides toonides vaikelu heleda riidega kaetud laual: keskel kollane kõrvits pruunil riidel ja apelsin; kõrvitsa taga tumepruun kõhukas keraamiline nõu; vasakul äralibisenud kaanega vaskkastrul. Kõrvitsast ja apelsinist paremal veeklaas ja sangaga, alt laienev vasktoop. Foon ookerkollane.
works.de: A still life in brown tones on a table covered with a light-coloured cloth: in the centre a yellow pumpkin on a brown cloth and an orange; behind the pumpkin a dark brown, bulbous ceramic vessel; on the left a copper saucepan with a slightly displaced lid. To the right of the pumpkin and the orange a water glass, and a copper jug with a handle, widening towards the bottom. The background is ochre-yellow.

works.d: Sinistes ja rohelistes toonides, kolmnurgakujulise küljega hulktahukatest koosnev abstraktne kompositsioon.
works.de: Abstract composition in blue and green tones, consisting of polyhedra with triangular-shaped sides.

works.d: Pruunides toonides, otsekui roosa valgusega ülekallatud interjöör figuuridega. Ümarate otsapatjadega diivanil istub vasakul O. Maran - seljas pruun, kõrge kraega kampsun, lillakaspunane sall, hall mantel. Temast paremal täpilises seelikus ja sinises rüüsidega pluusis S. Liiberg, heegeldatud villane pitsrätik õlgadel. Figuuride taga seinal O. Marani valges raamis merevaade, viimase kohal tumedas raamis pildi serv. Paremal, poikvel ukse vahelt avaneb vaade kõrvalruumi pimedusse.
works.de: An interior in brown tones with figures, as if overlaid with pink light. On a sofa with round end cushions, O. Maran sits on the left - wearing a brown, high-collared jumper, a lilac-red scarf, a grey coat. To his right, S. Liiberg in a spotted skirt and a blue blouse with frills, a crocheted woollen lace shawl on her shoulders. Behind the figures on the wall, O. Maran's seascape in a white frame, above the latter the edge of a picture in a dark frame. On the right, through a door ajar, a view opens into the darkness of an adjoining room.

works.d: Ülal keskel on lõuendile kleebitud paberist märklaud, tumeda ümara kujundi foonile. Märklaua alt voolab välja roosa, tilka meenutav kujund. Keskel, horisontaalse keskjoone kohal, kummaski servas kaks vastakuti pööratud läätsemotiivi, mida ühendab peen valge horisontaaljoon. Allservas keskel on mustale, läätse meenutavale pinnale kleebitud lambanaha tükike. Külmades sinistes toonides. Must paspartuu.
works.de: In the upper centre a paper target is glued to the canvas, against the background of a dark round shape. From under the target flows a pink, drop-like shape. In the centre, above the horizontal midline, on each side two lens motifs turned towards each other, connected by a fine white horizontal line. In the lower centre, a piece of sheepskin is glued to a black, lens-like surface. In cold blue tones. Black mount.

works.d: Esiplaanil, pildi ala- ja ülaservas kolm musta roigast; paremal servas pikale, roigast meenutavale käele toetuv mustade juuste ja näota pea. Tagaplaanil all vaade üle järve, järve taga tumesinine metsaviirg; ülal roosa, kõrgemal halliks üleminev taevas raskete pilvedega järve kohal.
works.de: In the foreground, at the lower and upper edges of the picture, three black poles; on the right edge, a long hand resembling a pole supporting a faceless head with black hair. In the background below, a view across a lake, beyond the lake a dark blue strip of forest; above, a pink sky turning grey higher up with heavy clouds over the lake.

works.d: kompositsioon meenutab otsevaates inimest, kel näha siseelundid
works.de: the composition, viewed frontally, resembles a person whose internal organs are visible

works.d: Sügavpruunil taustal lauaplaat esemetega: ees vasakul tume küünlajalg, kaks kookospähklit ja kaks sidrunit. Paremal kookospähkel ning üks koonusekujuline, teine roosa siseküljega spiraalikujuline merekarp. Tagapool vasakul vaskkann ja sangadega pott. Esemete vahel sinise ääretriibuga rätt ja kuivanud oks. Maalil hallikaspruunid summutatud toonid.
works.de: On a deep brown background, a tabletop with objects: in front on the left a dark candlestick, two coconuts and two lemons. On the right a coconut and two sea shells, one cone-shaped, the other spiral-shaped with a pink interior. Behind on the left a copper jug and a pot with handles. Among the objects a cloth with a blue border stripe and a dried branch. The painting is in muted greyish-brown tones.

works.d: Põhiliselt sinistest, rohelistest ja hallidest vabadest värvilaikudest ja geomeetrilistest kujunditest koosnev abstaktne kompositsioon.
works.de: An abstract composition consisting mainly of free patches of colour and geometric shapes in blue, green and grey.

works.d: Peamiselt sinistest, hallidest ja punakaspruunidest geomeetrilistest kujunditest koosnev abstraktne kompositsioon, kus üksteisest kohati läbipõimuvate kujunditega luuakse ruumilisuse illusioon.
works.de: An abstract composition consisting mainly of blue, grey and reddish-brown geometric shapes, where the illusion of spatiality is created with shapes that partly interweave with one another.

works.d: Peamiselt pruunides, punakates, sinistes ja kollastes toonides värvilaikudest koosnev abstraktne kompositsioon, servadest tumepruun, keskel värviline ja kumav.
works.de: Abstract composition consisting of patches of colour mainly in brown, reddish, blue and yellow tones, dark brown at the edges, coloured and glowing in the centre.

works.d: Valdavalt rohelistes, roosades ja kollastes toonides abstraktne kompositsioon, mille ülaosas moodustub värvilaikudest inimnägu meenutav kujund.
works.de: Predominantly green, pink and yellow toned abstract composition, in the upper part of which the patches of colour form a shape resembling a human face.

works.de: Large collage of pieces of coloured paper in mixed technique, an elephant on the left, a torso on the right, lips etc.

works.de: A purple house made of colored papers, with a person on its roof. A tree on the right, with a person hanging from it

works.d: Tumepruuni draperii taustal, tumedal laual klaasnõu lillakate väikeseõieliste krüsanteemidega, lillede kõrval vasakul vaskne kõrge jalaga kiriklik anum, millel on peal väikese ristiga kaas. Anuma kõrval tume, hallikas, savist madal vaas. Lilledest paremale jäävad kaks üksteise otsa asetatud paksemat raamatut, kompositsiooni ees, valgel linikul kolmas, väiksem raamat kolme õunaga.
works.de: Against a background of dark brown drapery, on a dark table, a glass vessel with small purplish chrysanthemum flowers; beside the flowers, on the left, a tall-footed copper ecclesiastical vessel with a lid topped by a small cross. Beside the vessel a dark, greyish, low clay vase. To the right of the flowers are two thicker books placed one on top of the other, and in front of the composition, on a white cloth, a third, smaller book with three apples.

works.d: Abstraktne kompositsioon valdavalt kollastes-roosades toonides.
works.de: Abstract composition predominantly in yellow-pink tones.

works.de: Marani's last abstraction. Abstract composition predominantly in blue tones.

works.de: Abstract composition predominantly in red - greenish tones.

works.d: Abstraktne voolavate joontega must-valge kompositsioon.
works.de: Abstract black-and-white composition with flowing lines.

works.de: Portrait of a dark-haired woman in a white blouse against a pinkish background, head turned slightly to the right. She wears a pink beret.

works.d: Abstraktne kompositsioon valdavalt lillades toonides.
works.de: Abstract composition predominantly in purple tones.

works.dm: lehe laius: 24.0 cm; lehe kõrgus: 33.0 cm
works.d: Punakas-kollasel foonil naeratava mehe poolfiguur - seljas pintsak, peas kaabu, käes kala. Ülal paremal tagurpidi lilleoks
works.de: Half-figure of a smiling man on a reddish-yellow background - wearing a jacket, a hat on his head, a fish in his hand. Upper right an upside-down flower branch

works.dm: lehe laius: 22.5 cm; lehe kõrgus: 32.0 cm
works.d: Mustjas-pruunil foonil naise poolfiguur - sinine, avara kaeluse ja lühikeste käistega pluus, heledad lühikesed juuksed, ilme tõsine ning eemalolev. Taevas noorkuu. Kahel pool figuuri liiliamotiiv. Neist parempoolsel lillel istumas väike valge lind
works.de: On a blackish-brown background a half-figure of a woman - a blue blouse with a wide neckline and short sleeves, light short hair, a serious and distant expression. In the sky a crescent moon. On both sides of the figure a lily motif. On the right-hand flower sits a small white bird

works.d: Abstraktne kompositsioon roosakates ja sinakates toonides, mille keskmes ümar piklike jätketega vorm.
works.de: Abstract composition in pinkish and bluish tones, at its centre a round shape with elongated extensions.

works.d: Sinise rätiga punapäise naise poolfiguur otsevaates sügisese pargi foonil.
works.de: Half-figure portrait of a red-haired woman with a blue kerchief, frontal view, against a background of an autumn park.

works.d: Arvutusmasina taustal pildi paremas servas kolme seisva ja ühe prillidega istuva mehe kolmveerandfiguurid. Samas tool, millel tuhatoos põleva sigaretiga. Vasakul ning ülal servas punased, roosad, sinised ebakorrapärased laigud.
works.de: Against the background of a calculating machine, in the right part of the picture, three-quarter figures of three standing men and one seated man with glasses. In the same place a chair on which stands an ashtray with a burning cigarette. On the left and upper edge irregular red, pink, blue patches.

works.d: Tumepruunil foonil kitsa erkpunase ribaga maali allääres kerges pöördes vasemale põlvini kujutatud seisev naisakt, puusast kerge paindega vasakule. Näo ees lai, õlgadeni ulatuv valge draperii. Vasak käsivars sirgena, käega reiel, parem üle vöökoha küünarnukist murtuna hoiab kergelt teist küünarvart.
works.de: Against a dark brown background, along the lower edge of the painting with a narrow bright red stripe, a standing female nude depicted to the knees in a slight turn to the left, with a slight bend at the hip to the left. In front of the face, a wide white drapery reaching to the shoulders. The left arm straight, hand on the thigh, the right bent at the elbow above waist height, lightly holding the other forearm.

works.d: Kompositsiooni vasakpoolsel kahel kolmandikul, vaadatuna ülalt alla, kogu antud pinda täitvalt rohekaspruunidena maalitud grupp sõdureid (ülakehad) lillekimpudega käes. Paremal all, seljaga vaataja poole, musta looriga naise pea. Parempoolsel kolmandikul mustal, valkjashallide pindadega lõhutud foonil alumises nurgas musta leinalooriga naise profiil (vasemale), punase nelgiga rinna kohale tõstetud kätes. Ülal paremal äärel fragment hallist urnist mustas nišis.
works.de: In the left two-thirds of the composition, viewed from above, filling the entire given surface, a group of soldiers (upper bodies) painted in greenish-brown with bouquets of flowers in their hands. On the lower right, back to the viewer, the head of a woman in a black veil. In the right third, against a black background broken up with whitish-grey surfaces, in the lower corner the profile of a woman in a black mourning veil (facing left), with a red carnation in hands raised to the chest. In the upper right edge a fragment of a grey urn in a black niche.

works.d: Habemiku mehe poolfiguur pöördes paremale, lahendatud heledates, kohati ulatuslikes värvilaikudes, vältides sealjuures kontuure. Foonist eendub plastilisemalt keha hallis särgis kuna käed on sulatatud fooni. Värvidest domineerivad kollane ja roosa pea ümber, milledele kontrasteeruvad sinine, roheline ja lilla näopartiis. Kuldne liist.
works.de: Half-figure of a bearded man turned to the right, rendered in light, at times extensive patches of colour, avoiding contours in the process. The body in a grey shirt projects more plastically from the background, since the hands are merged with the background. Yellow and pink dominate around the head, contrasted by blue, green and purple in the face area. Golden frame moulding.

works.d: Esiplaanil hallides toonides valge ja kollasega joonestatud sõidutee käänak, mille taga madal hoonestik intensiivsetes toonides (kollane, sinine, oranž) siltide ja plakatitega.
works.de: In the foreground, in grey tones, a bend of a road drawn in white and yellow, behind which low buildings in intense tones (yellow, blue, orange) with signs and posters.

works.d: Kadrioru motiiv Luigetiigiga, maalitud erksa rohelise tooniga - vesi ja puud; üksikud aktsendid erinevates toonides.
works.de: Motif of Kadriorg with the Swan Pond, painted in vivid green tones - water and trees; individual accents in various tones.

works.d: Valge linaga kaetud laual klaaskannus punased, lillad ja roosad astrid. Laudlinale on kukkunud üks astrileht. Erksinisel foonil, horisontaalsest keskjoonest veidi allpool, servades kaks valget nelinurka.
works.de: On a table covered with a white cloth, a glass jug with red, purple and pink asters. One aster leaf has fallen onto the tablecloth. Against a bright blue background, slightly below the horizontal centre line, two white rectangles at the edges.

works.d: Esiplaanil all keskel helepruunis mantlis või pintsakus, kirju salliga, punakaspruuni kaabuga mehe portree. Vasak õlg välja maalitud, parem tumeroosa punktiirjoonega markeeritud. Foon roosa, kaetud tooni võrra tumedamate väikesi kepikesi meenutavate pintslilöökidega. Fooni ülemises neljandikus kaks lillakasroosat jämedamat ning peenike punane rõhttriip.
works.de: In the lower centre foreground, a portrait of a man in a light brown coat or jacket, with a patterned scarf and a reddish-brown hat. The left shoulder is painted in, the right marked with a dark pink dotted line. The background is pink, covered with brushstrokes resembling small sticks in a slightly darker tone. In the upper quarter of the background two thicker purplish-pink horizontal stripes and one thin red one.

works.d: Vaskpunaste juustega, heleda näoga, hästi vormitud suujoonega tütarlapse rinnaportree. Seljas punakaspruun jakk, pitskraega valge pluus, roosa kohev kaunistus rinnaesisel. Foon hall.
works.de: Bust portrait of a girl with copper-red hair, light face, well-formed mouth line. Wearing a reddish-brown jacket, a white blouse with a lace collar, a pink fluffy decoration on the chest. Background gray.

works.d: Rohelisel murul kirju rahvamass suvistes rõivastes. Esiplaani viis figuuri selgemalt antud: vasakul sinistes pükstes, valges särgis ja nokkmütsis, punast ja rohelist triipu lipsuga mees, pruun jakk paremal põlvel. Temast paremal vasekarva juustega kollases kleidis naine, käed taha toetumas ja kott kõrval. Edasi käsipõsakil istuv lühikeste juustega tütarlaps. Paremal all servas naeratava näoga punase-rohelisekirjus pihikus blondiin, kelle kõrval profiilis tumedapäine naine. Kompositsiooni keskplaanis on inimesed antud eredate värvilaikude mänguna. Ülaosas erksinine taevas.
works.de: On green grass a colourful crowd of people in summer clothing. Five figures in the foreground given more clearly: on the left a man in blue trousers, white shirt and peaked cap, tie in red and green stripes, brown jacket over his right knee. To his right a woman with copper-coloured hair in a yellow dress, hands leaning back, a bag beside her. Further on a short-haired girl sitting with her chin resting on her hand. In the lower right corner a smiling blonde in a red-and-green patterned pinafore, beside her a dark-haired woman in profile. In the middle ground of the composition, people are rendered as a play of bright colour patches. Above, a bright blue sky.

works.d: Valges kaunivormilises vaasis erinevat liiki ja värvitooni lopsakad kollased õied. Foon rohekashall.
works.de: In a beautiful white vase, lush yellow flowers of different species and colour tones. Background greenish-grey.

works.d: Kollaselt helklevas kampsunis ja punases särgis keskealise, halli habemega mehe rinnaportree erkpunase narrimütsiga, mille otsas kelluke, peas. Foon valkjassinistes ja roosades toonides.
works.de: Chest portrait of a middle-aged man with a grey beard in a shimmering yellow jumper and red shirt, wearing a bright red jester's cap with a bell at its tip. Background in whitish-blue and pink tones.

works.d: Keskel ülalt tugevasti aheneva kaelaga suures pudelis sinised, punased, rohelised ja pruunid suled, antud peaaegu abstraktselt mõjuvate värvilaikude kombinatsioonina. Foon ooker-beežides ja sinakates toonides värvipindade sulam.
works.de: In the middle, in a large bottle with a strongly narrowing neck at the top, blue, red, green and brown feathers, rendered as a combination of almost abstractly effective colour patches. Background a blend of colour areas in ochre-beige and bluish tones.

works.d: Sinistes, hallides ja punastes toonides keskealise naise poolfiguurportree. Poolpikad vasekarva juuksed kergelt laines, vaade paremale, näoilme endassepööratult tõsine. Foon valkjashall. Otsmik ja riided maalitud kirevate, peaaegu abstraktselt mõjuvate värvilaikude kombinatsioonina. Kohati värvikiht pastoosne.
works.de: A half-figure portrait of a middle-aged woman in blue, grey and red tones. Semi-long copper-coloured hair in a slight wave, gaze to the right, facial expression introspective and serious. Background whitish-grey. The forehead and clothing are painted as a combination of vivid, almost abstractly effective colour patches. In places the paint layer is impasto.

works.d: Figuraalne kompositsioon, kus vasakul kirstus kaks verise valge linaga kaetud surnukeha. Esiplaanil paremal valgesse mässitud surnu valgesse rõivastatud leinava naisega vasakul ning valge turbani ja habemega vana mehega paremal. Paremal servas kaks seisvat figuuri raamijoonega otsekui läbi lõigatud. Foonil keskel kaartega valge ehitus. Paremal ülal värvilised abstraktsed laigud, vasakul ülal sinine taevas.
works.de: A figurative composition in which two blood-covered bodies wrapped in white linen lie in a coffin on the left. In the foreground on the right a body wrapped in white, with a mourning woman dressed in white on the left and an old man with a white turban and beard on the right. On the right edge two standing figures seemingly cut through by the frame line. In the background at the centre a white building with arches. Upper right coloured abstract patches, upper left blue sky.

works.d: Hallis ülikonnas, heledate juuste ja habemega, prillidega noore mehe täisfiguurportree. Prillidest vaatavad otse vaatajale hallikassinised silmad. Foon hall, parempoolses servas keskel kolm kollast ruutu ja sellest kõrgemal punastes toonides abstraktne värvilaikude kombinatsioon. Ülikond maalitud lopsakate pintslitõmmetega, eredate värvilaikudena.
works.de: Full-length portrait of a young man in a grey suit, with light-coloured hair and beard, wearing glasses. Behind the glasses, grey-blue eyes look directly at the viewer. The background is grey, in the middle of the right-hand edge three yellow squares, and above that an abstract combination of colour patches in red tones. The suit is painted with lush brushstrokes, as bright patches of colour.

works.d: Lopsakates eredates värvilaikudes komponeeritud portree. Noorel mehel hall ülikond, must ja bordoopunane lips valgel särgil, punane nina ja rohelised juuksed. Vasakul foon antud pruunikashallides toonides pikkade pintslitõmmete reana, ülal foon helepruun.
works.de: A portrait composed in lush bright patches of colour. The young man wears a grey suit, a black and burgundy-red tie on a white shirt, a red nose and green hair. On the left the background is given in brownish-grey tones as a row of long brush strokes, above the background is light brown.

works.d: Suurtest kirevatest värvilaikudest koosnev kompositsioon: vasakul profiilis noormehe pea, ninajoon kaardus, suu avatud. Paremal allnurgas otsevaates noormees, parem käsi kõrva juurde tõstetud, seljas sinise-valgetriibuline spordisärk.
works.de: A composition consisting of large, vividly coloured patches of colour: on the left in profile a young man's head, the nose line curved, mouth open. In the lower right corner, seen head-on, a young man, right hand raised to the ear, wearing a blue-and-white striped sports shirt.

works.d: Suurtest värvilistest laikudest koosnev jalalaba ühtlaselt hallil foonil.
works.de: A foot consisting of large coloured spots on an evenly grey background.

works.d: Vana mehe poolfiguurportree otsevaates: mehel hallid juuksed, tugev, pisut kühmus nina, lähestikku asetsevad silmad. Maalitud erksate värvilaikude dekoratiivse kombinatsioonina. Foon valge, sinakate ja roosade varjudega.
works.de: A frontal half-figure portrait of an old man: the man has grey hair, a strong, slightly hooked nose, closely set eyes. Painted as a decorative combination of vivid patches of colour. The background is white, with bluish and pinkish shadows.

works.d: Helesinistes ja lillakates toonides maalitud meri, pildi allservas kolm rida siniseid ja roosasid katkendlikke jooni. Silmapiiril erksinine triip. Silmapiirist kõrgemal hallikas taevas.
works.de: A sea painted in light blue and purplish tones, at the bottom edge of the picture three rows of broken blue and pink lines. On the horizon a bright blue stripe. Above the horizon a grayish sky.

works.d: Erinevates sinistes toonides, üksteisesse sulavate horisontaalsete triipudena maalitud meri. Esiplaanil all katkendlike siniste ja oranžide joonte read. Ülal helesinine pilvitu taevas.
works.de: The sea painted in various shades of blue as horizontal stripes merging into one another. In the foreground below, rows of broken blue and orange lines. Above, a light blue cloudless sky.

works.d: Hallil taustal, tumedal alusel kaks pikasäärelist saabast, vasakpoolne avatud lukuga viltu vajunud. Laiade pintslitõmmetega lopsakas maalilaad, saapad värviliste laikudega modelleeritud.
works.de: On a grey background, on a dark base two knee-high boots, the left one open with the buckle askew. Lush painting style with broad brushstrokes, the boots modelled with patches of colour.

works.d: Ees heledalt valgustatud maariba, rohekaspruun tume aimatav puudemass taga, üksikud eredad laigud lehestikul. Puulatvade tagant paistab veidike pilvetupsudega kakaobeeži taevast. Hoogne, laiade pintslitõmmetega maal.
works.de: In front, a brightly lit strip of land, behind it a dark greenish-brown mass of trees can be made out, isolated bright patches on the foliage. Beyond the treetops a slightly cocoa-beige sky with tufts of cloud is visible. A vigorous painting with broad brushstrokes.

works.d: Beežikasroosa taeva taustal püramidaalselt paigutatud värvikad puud-põõsad, ees keskel väike lagendik. Laiade pintslitõmmetega lopsakas maalilaad.
works.de: Against a background of a beige-pink sky, colourful trees and bushes arranged pyramidally, in the centre in front a small clearing. A lush painting style with broad brushstrokes.

works.d: Hallikasbeežil taustal heledavärviliste laikudega modelleeritud keskealise naise poolfiguur veerandpöördes paremale. Naisel lühikesed juuksed, huuled kokku pigistatud, pilk otse suunatud. Lopsakas, laiade pintslitõmmetega maal.
works.de: Half-figure of a middle-aged woman in three-quarter turn to the right, modelled with light-coloured patches on a greyish-beige background. The woman has short hair, lips pressed together, gaze directed straight ahead. A lush painting with broad brushstrokes.

works.d: Ühtlaselt helesinise taeva all värvikas figuuride grupp üheksast noorest, napilt riietatud naisest koosnev. Ees, aimatava spordiraja kõrval, vaataja suunas ette kummargil kolm ergutavat, hõiskavat neidu. Nende taga, värvilaikude vahel vehklevad, juubeldavad kujud. Taga keskel, taeva taustal tõstetud kätega naine. Hallikasbeežiga modelleeritud figuuride vahel säravad, erksad toonid. Hoogne lopsakas maalilaad.
works.de: Under a uniformly light blue sky a colourful group of figures consisting of nine young, scantily dressed women. In front, next to a suggested sports track, three cheering, exclaiming young women lean forward towards the viewer. Behind them, amid patches of colour, figures wave and rejoice. In the background centre, against the sky, a woman with raised arms. Between the figures modelled in greyish beige, bright, vivid tones shine. A vigorous, lush painting style.

works.d: Erksate värvilaikudega lahendatud kompositsioon istuvast naisaktist otsevaates, jalad kõverdatult käärasendis, käed ees süles, roosa laiaäärne kübar silmadel. Valdavalt sinakasrohelised, lillakasroosad toonid.
works.de: A composition rendered with vivid patches of colour, of a seated female nude in frontal view, legs bent in a crossed position, hands in her lap, a pink wide-brimmed hat over her eyes. Predominantly bluish-green, purplish-pink tones.

works.d: Keskel, vertikaalsel keskteljel, punakaspruunide pindade vahel sinine, kord ahenev, teisal laienev pragu. Prao allosas varda otsas seisev valge kuulike. Ülaserv süsimust. Pruuni fooni paremas ülemises neljandikus samades toonides mandlikujuline, väga pastoosselt maalitud pind.
works.de: In the centre, on the vertical central axis, between reddish-brown surfaces a blue crack, narrowing in places, widening in others. At the bottom of the crack, a small white ball standing on a rod. The upper edge pitch-black. In the upper right quarter of the brown background, in the same tones, an almond-shaped surface, painted very pastosely.

works.d: Vertikaalselt üle pildi pinna ulatuva naise torso: keskjoon jagab keha kaheks pooleks, millest vasakpoolne on ookerpruun, parem pool kuldpruun. Ülaservas stiliseeritud rinnapartii, niuete kohal suur hall kuul. Foon punakaspruun.
works.de: A woman's torso extending vertically across the picture surface: a central line divides the body into two halves, of which the left is ochre-brown, the right side golden-brown. At the upper edge a stylised bust area, above the hips a large grey ball. Background reddish-brown.

works.d: Süsimustas kuues mehefiguur: suurte kõrvadega pea, kahvatu näojume, tuhmid helepruunid juuksed püsti, pilk otse vaatajale suunatud. Keskel, musta kuue hõlmade vahel punase haavana mõjuv pilu, millest paistab helesinine lips. Kuue parempoolsel hõlmal seitse pildi pinnale kleebitud ehtsat nööpi (valged, kuldse servaga). Kuue vasakpoolsele hõlmale on maalitud nööpaugupilud. Foon lillakaspruun.
works.de: A male figure in a coal-black coat: a head with large ears, a pale complexion, dull light-brown hair standing up, gaze directed straight at the viewer. In the middle, between the flaps of the black coat, a slit resembling a red wound, from which a light blue tie shows. On the right flap of the coat seven genuine buttons (white, with a gold edge) glued to the surface of the picture. On the left flap of the coat buttonhole slits are painted. Background purplish-brown.

works.d: Hallides ja pruunides toonides figuraalne kompositsioon: paremal ja ülal suured kivimürakad, vasakul alasti lihaseline mehefiguur. Mehe parem käsi ülal kaljus, pea kuklas, pärani silmade ja suuga nägu taeva poole suunatud. Figuuritagune foon tumepruun.
works.de: A figural composition in grey and brown tones: on the right and above, large rock masses, on the left a naked muscular male figure. The man's right hand is up on the rock, his head thrown back, his face with wide-open eyes and mouth turned toward the sky. The background behind the figure is dark brown.

works.d: Värvikas kompositsioon erinevas mastaabis inim- ja loomafiguuridega. Keskel valgel foonil Niguliste kiriku torn, eespool sinisetriibulise särgiga mehe poolfiguur profiilis, tema vastas rohelisega markeeritud jänes. Kaks naist, kaabu, prillide ja portfelliga mees paremal. Vasakul hallikasroosal laigulisel taustal elevandipeaga kuju, tagapool naise pea.
works.de: A colourful composition with human and animal figures of varying scale. In the centre, against a white background, the tower of St Nicholas' Church; in front, in profile, the half-figure of a man in a blue-striped shirt, facing him a hare marked in green. Two women, a man with a hat, glasses and a briefcase on the right. On the left, against a greyish-pink mottled background, a figure with an elephant's head, behind it a woman's head.

works.d: Pildi parempoolses osas kolmest naisest koosnev figuuridegrupp: parempoolne kujutatud kaelast põlvedeni, seljas valge, kitsaste õlapaeltega suvekleit. Keskmine, kollaste punasetäpiliste juustega naine on antud profiilis, käes valge kohvitass. Vasakul, keskmise figuuri taga kirevate värvilaikude abil modelleeritud kolmas naisefiguur, näoosa kujutab endast valget laiku. Kolme esiplaanil asuva figuuri taga on aimata veel üht, siniste juustega naisekujutist. Foon vasakul helesinine.
works.de: In the right-hand part of the picture, a group of three female figures: the right-hand one depicted from the neck to the knees, wearing a white summer dress with narrow shoulder straps. The middle woman, with yellow, red-speckled hair, is shown in profile, holding a white coffee cup. On the left, behind the middle figure, a third female figure modelled with colourful patches of colour, the facial area represented as a white patch. Behind the three figures in the foreground, another female figure with blue hair can be discerned. The background on the left is light blue.

works.d: Punakaslilla valgusega estraadilava tautsal kolme noore naise kolmveerandfiguurid mikrofoni ees, miimika ja žestide järgi andunud laulmisele. Pildi all vasakul kahe meeskuulaja nägu. Üldistav maalilaad.
works.de: Against a purplish-pink lit variety stage background, three-quarter figures of three young women in front of a microphone, their mimicry and gestures showing devoted singing. At the bottom left of the picture, the faces of two male listeners. A generalizing painting style.

works.d: Pruunikais-hallikais toonides maali all vasakul profiilis tumedapäise mehe rinnaportree vaatega paremale. All paremal talle vastu vaatav sarnane pikkade tumedate juustega profiilne naiseportree. Naisel punakas-roosakas rõivastus, mehel valge krae, tume ülikond. Ülal keskel tume, aknaava meenutav ruut, millesse asetatud punakaspruun ümar vaas väikese valge lillega. Maali keskpinda moodustavad tantsivad inimfiguurid, kubistlikus laadis maalituna.
works.de: In brownish-grey tones, lower left of the painting, a bust portrait of a dark-haired man in profile facing right. Lower right, a similar profile portrait of a woman with long dark hair looking back at him. The woman wears reddish-pink clothing, the man a white collar and a dark suit. Upper centre, a dark square resembling a window opening, in which is placed a reddish-brown round vase with a small white flower. The central area of the painting is formed by dancing human figures, painted in a cubist manner.

works.t: 1470-1475. Verocchio e Leonardo. Battessimo di Cristo
works.d: Kompositsioon kahest täis- ja kahest poolfiguurist valgel taustal. Keskel Kristuse alastifiguur (sini-kollase triibuline niudevöö ümber) veerandpöördes paremale käed palveks rinnal. Temast paremal külgvaates pühak hoiab Kr. pea kohal valitsusõuna. Ülal keskel kaks õnnistavat kätt ja tuvi kujutis. Maali vas. alumises neljandikus kaks poolfiguuri, neist ülal palmi kujutis. Kõikide kujutatute peade kohal hõmedased nimbused. Maal lahendatud negatiivfoto laadis halli-mustaga markeerides.
works.de: A composition of two full and two half figures on a white background. In the centre, a nude figure of Christ (with a blue-yellow striped loincloth around the hips) in a three-quarter turn to the right, hands folded in prayer on the chest. To his right, in side view, a saint holds the orb of dominion above Christ's head. Above in the centre, two blessing hands and the image of a dove. In the lower left quarter of the painting, two half figures, above them the image of a palm. Above the heads of all the figures depicted are faint nimbuses. The painting is executed in the manner of a negative photograph, marked in grey-black.

works.d: Sürrealistlik kompositsioon, mis on jaotatud horisontaalselt kaheks eri värvi pinnaks. Ülemisel valgel pinnal külg külje kõrval sirgus neli kirjut triibulist ja ruudulist lipsu. Alumisel roostekarva pinnal pastoosselt maalitud vagiinamotiiv, mille sees lusika kujutis.
works.de: Surrealist composition divided horizontally into two areas of different colour. On the upper white area, four colourful striped and checked ties stand side by side. On the lower rust-coloured area, a vagina motif painted pastosely, containing the depiction of a spoon.

At the top centre, in relief print, two shapes resembling "!".

Below, on a white surface, symmetrically on the left and right, glasses, tie, key, socks, umbrella and bird in relief print. In the middle section symmetrically a turtle, msk, cane, gloves, key, tie, glasses, heart.

Puu kohal lilleline pilv (? kübar) pintsliga. Paaristähtedena puu okste tipus asuvate raamatute lehtedel: EX LIBRIS. Tiiki ümbritseval võreaial: NB! VÄIKE VEEKOGU
works.de: A round body of water surrounded by a net, with a tree growing in the middle, on every branch of which is an open book. Stairs lead from the edge of the body of water to the left and to the right. Above the tree a floral cloud (? a hat) with a brush. As paired letters on the pages of the books at the tips of the tree's branches: EX LIBRIS. On the lattice fence surrounding the pond: NB! VÄIKE VEEKOGU

works.d: Tumedal foonil aktifiguur, otsevaates, õlgadest alates. Kätele, rindadele ja kõhule langeb hele valgus, alakehale kaabuga mehe vari. Vasakul reie ja põlve piirkonnas ookerkollase värvi pritsmed.
works.de: Against a dark background a nude figure, frontal view, from the shoulders up. A bright light falls on the hands, breasts and stomach, the shadow of a man in a hat falls on the lower body. On the left, in the area of the thigh and knee, splashes of ochre-yellow paint.

works.d: Pime toanurk: vasakul sinakaks öises valguses laud, millel punasel riidel must telefon, juhe üle laua vonklemas. Paremal ülal, osalt lauale toetumas ovaalne peegel, selles peegeldub vertikaalne punase valguse riba ja heledasti valgustatud naiserind. Peegli paremas servas, umbes horisondi keskjoone kohal paunase värvi pritsmed.
works.de: A dark corner of a room: on the left a table bathed in bluish night light, on which a black telephone lies on red cloth, the cord winding across the table. On the upper right, an oval mirror, partly resting on the table, reflecting a vertical strip of red light and a brightly lit woman's breast. In the mirror's right edge, roughly at the level of the horizon's midline, splashes of a buff colour.

works.d: Kompositsioon omavahel lõikuvate pikkade aknaridadega hoonetest, paremapoolse klaasukse kohal poolnähtav kiri: APK M... All keskel purskkaev, selle kohal rippumas hõõguvoranžid, kollased värvikuhilate triibud. Kahel pool äärtel sinistes ülikondades, diplomaadikohvritega meeste kolmveerand-figuurid pildi pinnalt välja astumas.
works.de: A composition of buildings with long, intersecting rows of windows, above the glass door on the right a half-visible inscription: APK M... At the bottom centre a fountain, above it hanging strips of glowing orange and yellow colour masses. On both edges, three-quarter figures of men in blue suits with diplomat briefcases step out of the picture plane.

works.dm: kõrgus: 120.0 cm; sügavus: 15.0 cm; laius: 120.0 cm
works.d: Vappepitaafi meenutav kompositsioon: valge aluse keskel puidust rohekas draperiid meenutava reljeefiga segment, selle kohal pruun mask ja pool väiksest ümarast lauaplaadist, all kaks paari valgeks värvitud nahkkindaid musta kummirõngaga. Kahelt poolt ümbritsetud musta villase draperiiga.
works.de: A composition reminiscent of a coat-of-arms epitaph: in the centre of a white base, a wooden segment with a relief resembling greenish drapery, above it a brown mask and half of a small round tabletop, below two pairs of white-painted leather gloves with a black rubber band. Surrounded on both sides by black woollen drapery.

works.d: Allservas pruun triip, millest vaatab välja lõvi nägu. Triibust kõrgemal pime ruum, mida kahelt poolt vertikaalselt piiravad mererohelised triibud. Pimedas ruumis sinisega maalitud lõvi kroon ja lõvi õrnalt markeeritud keha. Loomast paremal tõuseb pimedusest pruun pind, mille kohal voluudiga konstruktsioon, vaasid, pudelid jm. esemed peal. Konstruktsioonist vasakul ripub pungil niidist võrk.
works.de: In the lower part a brown stripe from which a lion's face looks out. Above the stripe a dark space, vertically bounded on both sides by sea-green stripes. In the dark space a lion's crown painted in blue and the lion's faintly marked body. To the right of the animal a brown surface rises from the darkness, above which a construction with volutes, vases, bottles and other objects on top. To the left of the construction hangs a net of taut thread.

works.d: Pildi pind pikitriibuliselt jagatud kaadriteks linnaelust nähtuna läbi sõrestiku. Vasakul all triibulistes bikiinides naisekeha, keskel fragmente mootorratturist, paremal neoonreklaami, autokummide jm. detaile.
works.de: The surface of the image is divided lengthwise into stripes forming frames of urban life seen through a lattice. Lower left, a woman's body in striped bikini, in the middle fragments of a motorcyclist, on the right neon advertising, car tires and other details.

works.d: Kägardatud ja rebitud paberitaolise heleda pinna vahel, mustja taustal kollakasroheline sisalikutaolise olevuse skelett, punased küüniste jäljed kahel pool. Ülal keskel punane sõõr, paremal koobaltsinine romb.
works.de: Between a crumpled and torn, paper-like light surface, on a blackish background, a yellowish-green skeleton of a lizard-like creature, red claw marks on both sides. At the top centre a red disc, on the right a cobalt blue rhombus.

works.d: Selgepiiriliselt kaheks jagatud foon: all, helesinisel taustal hõõguvpunase südamikuga plahvatuskolle, mustad killud kiirekujuliselt laiali paiskumas, äärtel mustad labakäe jäljed. Ülemisel, strontsiumkollasel pinnal valkjas ketas. Keskel, enamasti kollasel taustal must kokkukägardatud sõiduk.
works.de: A clearly divided background: below, against a light blue background, an explosion centre with a glowing red core, black fragments scattered in a ray-like pattern, black handprints at the edges. On the upper, strontium-yellow surface a whitish disc. In the middle, mostly against a yellow background, a black crumpled vehicle.

works.d: Punakaspruunil foonil keskel erkpunaste läikivate huultega pärani avatud suu. Ülemise valge, alumise hallikas toonis hammasterea vahel lahtikeeratud huulepulk. Suu ümbrus helesinine, servades pritsmetena foonile valguv.
works.de: On a reddish-brown background, in the centre a wide-open mouth with bright red glossy lips. Between the upper row of white teeth and the lower greyish-toned row of teeth an unwound lipstick. The area around the mouth light blue, flowing onto the background as splashes at the edges.

works.dm: kõrgus: 115.0 cm; sügavus: 3.0 cm; laius: 95.0 cm
works.d: Keskjoonest ülalpool mustjaspruunist taustast vormub sujuvalt välja hõõguvpunane drapeeritud reljeefne kujund, paksult värviga kaetud. Kujundi voltide vahel üks tilgakujuline meresinine, teine kollakas pind. Kujundi alumine pool aheneb ja muutub pinnaliseks keskjooone suunas. Kompositsiooni alumisel poolel tumepruunil taustal sama värvi vineerist saetud ja kihiti astmeliselt üksteise peal asetatud nurksed ja kaarja servaga vormid. Kolm metallneetidest poolkaart all keskel, väiksem vasakul äärel ja paremal vineerikujundil.
works.de: Above the midline, out of a blackish-brown background, a glowing red draped relief-like form emerges smoothly, thickly covered with paint. Between the folds of the form, one drop-shaped sea-blue area and another yellowish area. The lower half of the form narrows and becomes flat toward the midline. In the lower half of the composition, on a dark brown background, angular and curved-edged forms sawn from plywood of the same colour are placed in stepped layers one on top of the other. Three semicircles of metal rivets at the bottom centre, a smaller one on the left edge and on the right on the plywood form.

The upper body is stylised, above the left shoulder a square of about 6.5x7 cm made of white pearls. The right arm straight at the side, resting on the chair. The walls, floor and ceiling of the room are in red-blue tones. In the upper left corner of the chair's blackish-red backrest are two darker profile-like patches.

Paremal, naise kuklaosas vertikaalne heledam joon. Jõuline ekspressiivne maalilaad.
works.de: Across the entire painting, composed in an oval, two women's faces merging into one another, turned to the left: the one behind has a slightly open mouth, bulging eyes, a strong nose, wrinkles at the bridge of the nose. In front, a dark shadow-like profile, a glowing cheekbone, an earring in the ear. On the right, at the back of the woman's head, a vertical lighter line. A powerful, expressive painting style.

works.de: White male nude with a narrow face, glass eyes deep in the eye sockets, viewed from the front. The right hand is bent up to the ear (originally the hand held a book-like plate, which has since been lost), the left hand is extended forward. The right foot rests on the base plate, the left foot has sunk into a "rock mass", from which the toes protrude. The athletic man's body is shown frontally, consisting of two parts joined together above the waist, the musculature worked out in detail.

works.d: Esiplaanil keskel madal vaas kimbu nurmenukkudega. Vasakus servas piimapudel ühe nurmenukuga. Kontuurid hajutatud. Foon maalitud üksteisesse sulatatud lillades-hallides toonides. Paremas alumises nurgas kaarjas, ühtlane tume pind.
works.de: In the middle of the foreground, a low vase with a bunch of cowslips. In the left margin, a milk bottle with one cowslip. Contours diffused. Background painted in purple-grey tones blended into one another. In the lower right corner, an arched, even dark surface.

works.d: Viiest figuurist koosnev kompositsioon: ühe käsipõsakil ja teise jalg üle põlve istuva naise vahel mehefiguur. Paremal servas seljaga vaataja poole kollakasrohelises kleidis tumedate juustega naine rohelist rätikut õlgadel kandmas. Vasakul ülal foon tume, all paremas nurgas kollane. Iste bordoopunane.
works.de: A composition of five figures: between one woman sitting with her cheek resting on her hand and another with her leg crossed over her knee, a male figure. On the right edge, a dark-haired woman in a yellowish-green dress, seen from behind, wearing a green shawl over her shoulders. Upper left the background is dark, lower right corner yellow. The seat is burgundy red.

works.d: Tumeda figuraalse kompositsiooni alumises osas vastandsuundades liikuvad hallid inimfiguurid. Ülaosas keskel tumedas pikas kuues ja pükstes mehefiguur, kellest vasakul pruunil foonil ähmaselt markeeritud teised figuurid. Maalitud hajusalt, otsekui läbi udu.
works.de: In the lower part of a dark figural composition, grey human figures moving in opposite directions. In the upper part, in the middle, a male figure in a dark long coat and trousers, to the left of whom other figures are vaguely marked against a brown background. Painted diffusely, as though through fog.

works.d: Paremal servas teineteist hoidev paar: lillakashallis ülikonnas mees ja pruunis sviitris ja rohelises seelikus tumedajuukseline naine seisavad käest kinni hoides. Vasakul foonil veel üks ähmane naisefiguur kollases. Foon ülalt ookrikarva, alt punane. Näod antud peaaegu valgete laikudena.
works.de: In the right edge, a couple holding onto each other: a man in a lilac-grey suit and a dark-haired woman in a brown sweater and green skirt stand holding hands. In the left background another blurred female figure in yellow. Background ochre-coloured above, red below. Faces given as almost white patches.

works.d: Erkrohelisel foonil laua taga kaks figuuri: hallis kuues habeme ja harjasjuustega mees toetub vasaku küünarnukiga lauale. Tema süles heledamas hallis sviitris tumedate juustega poiss, kes, parem põlv laua vastu tõstetud, istub isa süles, käsi ümber isa kaela ning paremas käes väike tops.
works.de: On a bright green background, two figures behind a table: a man in a grey coat with a beard and bristly hair leans with his left elbow on the table. In his lap a dark-haired boy in a lighter grey sweater, his right knee raised against the table, sits on his father's lap, arm around his father's neck, and a small cup in his right hand.

works.d: Helesinise taeva taustal otsekui alt sügavikust vaadatuna ähmaselt antud figuurid pildi keskpunkti poole perspektiivselt koondumas. Selgemini eristatavad üks embav paar ja rohelises pearätikus ning pruunis rüüs naine. Helesinistes, hallides ja rohelistes toonides.
works.de: Against a background of light blue sky, figures given hazily as if seen from a depth below, converging in perspective towards the centre point of the picture. More clearly distinguishable are one embracing couple and a woman in a green headscarf and brown robe. In light blue, grey and green tones.

works.d: Esiplaanil keskel hallis riides ebamääraselt antud inimene maalimispuki taga. Valkjashallil foonil üksikud suured tumehallid laigud.
works.de: In the centre foreground a vaguely rendered person in grey clothing behind a painting easel. Individual large dark grey patches on a whitish-grey background.

works.d: Hallil foonil tumedate silmadega noor naine. Keha osa külgvaates, pea pööratud näoga vaataja poole. Naise seljal pikk tume pats, peas valge, rohelise lõngaga kirjatud kootud müts.
works.de: Against a grey background, a young woman with dark eyes. Part of the body in side view, head turned with the face towards the viewer. On the woman's back a long dark braid, on her head a white knitted cap patterned with green yarn.

works.d: Hallikasrohelisel foonil keskel pruun hallikasmusta lakaga hobune kõrvalseisva poisi pihust midagi nosimas. Poisi vasak käsi hobuse kaelal, ülakeha paljas, jalas hallid püksid. All vasakus nurgas sadul, rakmed ja valge rätik.
works.de: Against a greyish-green background in the centre a brown horse with a greyish-black mane eating something out of the lap of a boy standing beside it. The boy's left hand is on the horse's neck, his upper body bare, wearing grey trousers. In the lower left corner a saddle, harness and a white towel.

works.d: naise pea ülalpool kaela ära lõigatud, juuksed suunduvad taha, kaarjad kulmud, silmalaud suletud, pikem sirge nina, tundlik suu. Tugev üldistus
works.de: the woman's head cut off above the neck, hair going backwards, arched eyebrows, closed eyelids, longer straight nose, sensitive mouth. Strong generalisation

works.de: Stylised head of a young man with a narrow face, strong nose, wreath of hair, cut off above the neck

works.d: Esiplaanil kaks sinkjasmusta sulestikuga, pika noka ja koheva kuklatutiga marabuud. Vasakpoolsel linnul jalad põlvist kõverdatud (kükitab), parempoolne seisab püsti. Foon esiplaanil keskel heleroheline, paremal lillakas, ülalt helesinine.
works.de: In the foreground two marabou storks with bluish-black plumage, long beaks and fluffy crests at the back of the head. The left-hand bird has its legs bent at the knee (crouching), the right-hand one stands upright. The background is light green in the centre foreground, purplish on the right, light blue above.

works.d: Hallis vines mereäärse avara maastiku taustal neljast figuurist koosnev grupp: vasakul keskel otsevaates tikksirgelt seisev mees, pilk suunatud üles. Tema eest vasakule mööduv noore naise kuju. Naisel pikad tumedad juuksed, pilk kohkunud, paokil suu. Paremal otsevaates seisev noor naine sinises õlapaeltega kleidis, pikad pruunid juuksed langemas seljale. Tema eest paremale möödavilksatav varjutaoline meesfiguur.
works.de: Against the background of a grey, hazy, spacious seaside landscape, a group of four figures: on the left in the middle, seen frontally, a man standing ramrod straight, his gaze directed upward. Past him, to the left, the figure of a young woman passing by. The woman has long dark hair, a startled look, her mouth slightly open. On the right a young woman standing, seen frontally, in a blue dress with shoulder straps, long brown hair falling down her back. Past her, to the right, a shadow-like male figure flitting by.

works.d: Hallides-sinistes toonides foonil, pildi vertikaalsel keskteljel veinpunases särbiga seelikus ja sussides naine. Silmad pruunid, peas suur tumepruun juuksepahmakas. Rinna kohale tõstetud käte vahel hoiab püstloodis halli kahe teraga mõõka.
works.de: Against a grey-blue background, on the vertical central axis of the picture, a woman in a wine-red apron-skirt and slippers. Brown eyes, a large dark brown mass of hair on the head. Between the hands raised to chest level she holds a grey double-edged sword upright.

works.t: Nemad vaatavad teda, tema vaatab merele
works.d: Kolm figuuri allservas asuva vee ääres: vasakpoolsel seljas kollane särk ja hallid püksid; parempoolsel lilla pluus ja sinine pikk seelik, kingad näpus. Äärmiste figuuride silmist suunduvad kollased kiired keskel seisva, pildist välja vaatava mehe suunas. Foon ähmane, kollakas rohelistes ja helelillades toonides.
works.de: Three figures near water at the bottom edge of the picture: the one on the left wears a yellow shirt and grey trousers; the one on the right wears a purple blouse and a long blue skirt, holding shoes in her hand. Yellow rays extend from the eyes of the outer figures towards the man standing in the middle who looks out of the picture. Background blurred, in yellowish green and light purple tones.

works.d: Vasakul tumedas kuues mehe kuju õlgadeni kaabut kergitamas, pea suunatud vasakule alla. Temast paremal laia äärega kübaras heledapäise naise pea profiilis paremale. Tumedad summutatud toonid. Ülaosas heledam, aimatav taevafoon.
works.de: On the left, the figure of a man in a dark coat lifting his hat to shoulder height, his head turned down to the left. To his right, the head of a fair-haired woman in a wide-brimmed hat, in profile facing right. Dark muted tones. In the upper part a lighter, suggested sky background.

works.d: Ülalt ööhall kuusirbiga vasakul, alt sügavroheline, keskelt pruunika kumaga taust, millel neli erinevas poosis kiitsakat meesfiguuri. Parem ülemine ja vasak alumine valgesse mässitud sigaretiga kuju, lummav valgus näol. Parem alumine erepunastes pükstes vaataja suunas astumas. Vasak ülemine figuur eelmisega samas suunas, pruunikas rõivas, rohekas kuma näol.
works.de: At the top, a night-grey background with a crescent moon on the left, at the bottom dark green, in the middle a background with a brownish glow, on which four lanky male figures in different poses. Upper right and lower left figure wrapped in white with a cigarette, alluring light on the face. Lower right figure in bright red trousers stepping toward the viewer. Upper left figure moving in the same direction as the previous one, in brownish clothing, greenish glow on the face.

works.d: Valkjashall rand üksikute põõsatuttidega, vasakul osake merest kollakashalli taeva all. Ees, keskjoonest veidi paremal pikas tumedas mantlis prillidega mees seismas külgvaates vasakule. Mehel üks käsi taskus, teine rinnal. Tagapool paremal paistab astuv figuur.
works.de: A whitish-grey shore with isolated tufts of bushes, on the left a small piece of sea under a yellowish-grey sky. In front, slightly right of the centre line, a man in a long dark coat with spectacles standing in profile facing left. The man has one hand in his pocket, the other on his chest. Behind, on the right, a walking figure is visible.

works.d: Alt kollase, ülalt halliga markeeritud ruumis neli istuvat meest: vasakul profiilis kollaste juustega mees, jalad välja sirutatud, temast paremal otsevaates lillas särgi mees, vuntsidega mees (lõug käele toetatud), lõpuks punastes üleriietes õrnalt antud näoga mees. Vorme hajutav maalimislaad.
works.de: In a room marked yellow below and grey above, four seated men: on the left in profile a man with yellow hair, legs stretched out, to his right in frontal view a man in a purple shirt, a man with a moustache (chin resting on hand), and finally a man in red outer clothing with a softly rendered face. A form-diffusing painting style.

works.d: Lillakates ja kollakasrohelistes voogudes aerupaat ülaltvaates. Aerudel vanem mees. Ühel pool paadi päras eit lambaga, taga kahe lambaga poisike. Kõik maalitud uduselt, vorme hajutavalt.
works.de: In purplish and yellowish-green swells a rowboat seen from above. An older man at the oars. On one side at the stern of the boat an old woman with a sheep, behind her a boy with two sheep. Everything painted hazily, dissolving forms.

works.d: Pastelsetes toonides fooni taustal keskel suur rohekashall kuhjatis, mida parema jalaga tõukab vaataja poole seljaga seisev naine. NAisel juuksed kuklas krunni keeratud, laubal tukk, seljas punane jakk ka hallikasroheline seelik.
works.de: Against a pastel-toned background, in the middle a large greyish-green heap, which a woman standing with her back to the viewer pushes with her right leg towards the viewer. The woman's hair is twisted into a bun at the back of the head, with a fringe on the forehead, wearing a red jacket and also a greyish-green skirt.

works.d: Esiplaanis veepind ning sellest väljaulatuvad kolm lillakat kivi. Kõige suuremal neist seisab hallides pükstes palja ülakehaga poiss, käed laiali sirutatud. Foon ülaosas rohekaskollane.
works.de: In the foreground a water surface with three purplish stones protruding from it. On the largest of them stands a boy with a bare torso wearing gray trousers, arms spread wide. The background is greenish-yellow in the upper part.

works.de: On a round stone stands a boy with long trousers and a bare upper body, arms away from the body, bent at the elbow, forearms raised
