works.d: Pildil ruum, kus allääres esiplaanil valge, katkise linaga kaetud laud. Laual hülge pealuu, nöör, värvituub. Lauast vasakul alumises nurgas pruuni elektriradiaatori osa, millele on tilkunud sinist värvi. Suurema osa pildist võtab enda alla maastikumaal ruumi pruunil seinal. Sellel on kujutatud meri, liivarand, kivid ja tuules kooldunud rohupuhmad. Rohututtide piirkonnas pruuni värvi voolamise laike.
works.de: The picture shows a room, at the bottom in the foreground a table covered with a white, torn cloth. On the table a seal's skull, a cord, a tube of paint. In the lower left corner from the table part of a brown electric radiator, onto which blue paint has dripped. Most of the picture is occupied by a landscape painting on the brown wall of the room. It depicts the sea, a sandy beach, stones and grass tufts bent by the wind. In the area of the grass tufts there are stains of brown paint running down.

works.d: Heleda tellisseina taustal massiivne, kumerate vormidega diivanitaoline kujund. Ümaral käetoel sinistes toonides draperiisid meenutavad pehmed vormid, seljatoe polster värvikatest rakutaolistest vormidest. Parempoolse käetoe kohal erkkollane ühtlane kaarjas pind.
works.de: Against the background of a light-coloured brick wall a massive, curved-form sofa-like shape. On the rounded armrest soft forms resembling drapery in blue tones, the backrest upholstery of colourful cell-like forms. Above the right armrest a bright yellow, evenly curved surface.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul molbert poolelioleva lõuendiga, sinise pintsakuga, näota mees pildist välja astumas. Vasakul õlgadelt tugevasti kroogitud pruunis kleidis naise rinnaportree. Temast kõrgemal, valgel seinal, hallides toonides naise portree. Esiplaanil olevast pildist paremal paljugiruudiline kompositsioon (grupiportree), millel eriti silma hakkavad ülespandud juustega naisakt, temast paremal olev pikkade mustade juuste ja prillidega naine ning allservas paažisoengus ja mustas kleidis naine. Väga maaliline, kohati pastoosne.
works.de: In the foreground on the left an easel with an unfinished canvas, a faceless man in a blue jacket stepping out of the picture. On the left the bust portrait of a woman in a brown dress strongly gathered at the shoulders. Above her, on a white wall, a portrait of a woman in grey tones. To the right of the picture in the foreground is a multi-square composition (group portrait), in which especially striking are a female nude with upswept hair, to her right a woman with long black hair and glasses, and at the bottom edge a woman with a pageboy hairstyle in a black dress. Very painterly, in places pastose.

works.d: Keskosas noor pikkade tumedate lokiliste juustega naine külgvaates paremale mustas pükskostüümis ja laia äärega kübaras. Figuur lõigatud põlvede kohalt. Pea kergelt pööratud vasakule, pilk suunatud ette. Naisel säravad silmad, naerumuiges suu. Parema käega hüpitab valget, väikest palli. Tema selja taga vasakul sinistes pükstes poolakt veerandpöördes vasakule, vasak käsi tõstetud kukla juurde. Kroomrohelisel foonil vasakul aimatav figuur, postamendil seisev valge vaas taimemotiividega. Foonil allpool valkjad säpsud, allääres kirevad, energilised pintslitõmbed. Maalitud kohati pastoosselt lühikese pintslilöögiga, kohati laiade siledate spaatlitõmmetega.
works.de: In the centre, a young woman with long dark curly hair, in profile facing right, in a black trouser suit and a wide-brimmed hat. The figure is cropped at knee level. The head is turned slightly to the left, the gaze directed forward. The woman has sparkling eyes, a smiling mouth. With her right hand she is bouncing a small white ball. Behind her, on the left, in blue trousers, a semi-nude figure in a three-quarter turn to the left, left hand raised to the back of the neck. On the chrome-green background, on the left, a figure can be discerned, a white vase with plant motifs standing on a pedestal. Below in the background whitish flecks, at the lower edge colourful, energetic brushstrokes. Painted at places pastosely with short brushstrokes, at places with broad smooth palette-knife strokes.

works.d: Esiplaanil keskel, heledate seintega ruumis, pruunides pükstes ja tumedas jakis sirgete juustega poiss viiulit mängimas. Poisi viiulit hoidval käel pika saba ja hallikaspruuni sulestikuga lind. Poisi ees valge kolmnurkne taburet, millel avatud kunstialbum, poisi selja taga avaus rahutusse, kirevasse asjade maailma. All vasakus nurgas ümberläinud värvipurgist värv voolamas.
works.de: In the foreground centre, in a room with light walls, a boy with straight hair, wearing brown trousers and a dark jacket, playing the violin. On the boy's hand holding the violin a bird with a long tail and greyish-brown plumage. In front of the boy a white triangular stool on which lies an open art album, behind the boy's back an opening into a restless, colourful world of objects. In the lower left corner paint pouring from an overturned paint can.

works.d: Ülaservas panoraamselt antud osa Tallinna vanalinnast Niguliste ja Toomkirikuga. Esiplaanil pastoossete värviplekkide spontaanne segadus. Ülal helesinine taevas.
works.de: In the upper edge, a panoramic view of part of Tallinn's Old Town with St. Nicholas' Church and the Cathedral. In the foreground, a spontaneous jumble of pastose patches of colour. Above, a light blue sky.

works.d: Maalil ülal ja vasakul avatud aknaid meenutavad hallid konstruktsioonid. Vasakul alumises neljandikus kaks inimest: vasakpoolsel paistavad jalad ja alakeha peaaegu vöökohani. Parempoolne - kollases sportliku lõikega pluusis mees hoiab käes valget paberilehte või plaati, mida ümbritsevad värvilised spiraaljooned.
works.de: In the painting, above and to the left, grey constructions resembling open windows. In the lower left quarter two people: on the left the legs and lower body are visible almost to the waist. On the right - a man in a yellow sportily cut blouse holds a white sheet of paper or a board, surrounded by colourful spiral lines.

works.d: Keskel all valge juga, millest vasakul ja paremal ookrikarva ja pruunid pinnad. Ülal tume, halli-mustakirju, tiiba meenutav kaar hallikasvalgel foonil.
works.de: In the centre below a white waterfall, to the left and right of which ochre-coloured and brown surfaces. Above, a dark, grey-black mottled, wing-like arch on a greyish-white background.

works.d: Kolmest naisfiguurist koosnev, ringile ülesehitatud figuraalne kompositsioon (grupiportree?). Naiste käed ühendatud. Riietuse konkreetsete reaalide (sinine ring vasakul, pintsak ja lips, hõbesõlg) kõrval on enamus rõivastusest antud abstraktsete, ekspressiivsete värvilaikude kombinatsioonina. Paremas alumises neljandikus mustafiguuriline kreeka vaas. Foon ülalt sinine, servas värvilaikude riba.
works.de: A figural composition consisting of three female figures, built up in a circle (a group portrait?). The women's hands are joined. Besides the concrete realia of the clothing (a blue circle on the left, a jacket and tie, a silver brooch), most of the clothing is rendered as a combination of abstract, expressive patches of colour. In the lower right quarter a black-figure Greek vase. Background blue at the top, a strip of colour patches at the edge.

works.d: Horisontaalselt üle pildi pinna kohev punakaspruun rebasenahk. Rebase saba, ninots ja kõrvaotsad süsimustad, nina ja laup kollased. Paremal puhkab nahal otsekui foonist väljakasvav erkpunaseks lakitud küüntega käsi. Foon rebase taga roosa, ülaserva hallile fooniosale voolavad kollased värvijoad. Vasakul servas peene punase joogega eraldatud valge triip.
works.de: A fluffy reddish-brown fox fur lies horizontally across the picture surface. The fox's tail, nose tip and ear tips are jet black, the nose and forehead yellow. On the right, resting on the fur, as if growing out of the background, is a hand with nails lacquered bright red. The background behind the fox is pink, yellow streaks of paint flow into the grey part of the background at the upper edge. On the left edge a white stripe separated by a thin red line.

works.d: Abstraktsest punase-sinise-rohelise värvi ollusest ümbritsetud kummargil naisakt, heledatest juustest ümbritsetud kirsspunase suuga nägu vaataja poole pööratud. Vasak käsi silitab allservas lamavat, mustade kõrvadega helebeeži siiami kassi. Paremale, taha sirutatud käele, laskub mustade tiibadega, sinise kõhualusega lind. Foon allosas mereroheline, ülal lillakashall. Kohati väga pastoosne, pahtlabidaga maalitud.
works.de: A female nude bent forward, surrounded by an abstract substance of red-blue-green colour, her face, framed by light hair with a cherry-red mouth, turned towards the viewer. Her left hand strokes a light beige Siamese cat with black ears lying in the lower edge. Onto her right hand, stretched out backward, descends a bird with black wings and a blue underside. The background is sea-green in the lower part, lilac-grey above. In places very pastose, painted with a palette knife.

works.d: Roosa ja tumepunase, pikkade lehtedega rootaimestiku kohal nelinurksel puualusel valge kajaka topis, sinine silm peas kiiskamas. Topise all roostikus tumepunane, topise puualuse nelinurgast jäänud jälg. Ülal valge, kohati sinisega varjutatud foon. Ülal vasakust servast valgub foonile tumesinine värvilaik.
works.de: Above pink and dark red, long-leaved reed vegetation, on a square wooden base a stuffed white gull, blue eye gleaming in its head. Under the mount, in the reeds, a dark red trace left by the square wooden base. Above, a white background, in places shaded with blue. From the upper left edge a dark blue patch of colour spreads onto the background.

works.d: Keskel suur, vormitu, pisut jõehobu meenutav loom. Esiplaanil ja taga tumepruunid trellid. Looma taga vasakul sinine merd meenutav piirkond. Ülal sinine, keskel ähvardava ilmega taevas, ümberringi hallikad pilved.
works.de: In the centre a large, shapeless animal, somewhat resembling a hippopotamus. In the foreground and background dark brown bars. Behind the animal on the left a blue, sea-like area. Above, blue, in the middle a sky with a menacing look, surrounded by greyish clouds.

works.d: Ühtlaste laiade püst-, rõht- ja diagonaaljoonte taga maastikuelementidega põimitud kolme naise kuju. Vasakpoolne, paokil suuga ja keskmine, avatud hõlmadega, vaataja suunas. Luaba kohalt katab päid ühtlane must pind. Parempoolne külgvaates paremale. Neli ühesugust selgepiirilist pinda kahel pool. Alumine äär punane.
works.de: Behind uniform broad vertical, horizontal and diagonal lines, the figures of three women interwoven with landscape elements. The left one, with mouth ajar, and the middle one, with open lapels, facing the viewer. From the hairline the heads are covered by a uniform black surface. The right one in profile facing right. Four identical clearly bounded surfaces on either side. The lower edge red.

works.t: Suur valge lind ja suudlevad kalad
works.d: Heledatest kujunditest peaaegu abstraktne kompositsioon. Ülaservas laialiaetud tiibadega kajakas, pea pööratud vaateks selja taha. Kajaka punaste jalgade vahel valge roos. Umbes horisontaalse keskjoone kohal nurgeliseks stiliseeritud heleroosad kalad. Vasakul ja paremal servas keskel tumedad suured laigud. Maalitud paiguti hõredalt, krunti vabaks jättes, kohati väga pastoosselt.
works.de: An almost abstract composition of light-coloured shapes. At the top edge a seagull with outspread wings, its head turned to look back over its shoulder. Between the seagull's red legs a white rose. Just above the approximately horizontal centre line, pale pink fish stylised into angular forms. In the middle of the left and right edges, dark large patches. Painted in places sparsely, leaving the ground bare, in places very impasto.

works.d: Töö koosneb kahest horisontaalsuunas pooleks jaotatud osast. Ülemisel poolel all, üle kogu pildi pinna ja osalt väljapoole raami ulatuvatele lõuendijuppidele maalitud pikkade roosade uimede ja tumeda seljaga kala. Kala keskelt kasvab välja alasti naisefiguur, selg kumeras, käed toetuvad küünarnukkidega kala seljale, samal ajal otsekui punast koonust emmates. Naise valge, lokkis juustega pea on antud profiilis, sinakas suu on pärani. Figuuri ümber on maalipind hoolikalt läbi maalitud, ülejäänud fooniosas valged ja sinakad pinnad. Töö alumisel poolel keskel hele, laiali sirutatud kätega aktifiguur. Peaosa etüüdlikult läbi maalitud, suu tume ja teravate piirjoontega. Naise käsivarred kasvavad a
works.de: The work consists of two parts divided horizontally in half. On the upper half, below, painted across the entire surface of the picture and onto canvas pieces extending partly beyond the frame, a fish with long pink fins and a dark back. From the middle of the fish grows a nude female figure, back arched, hands resting with elbows on the fish's back, while at the same time seemingly embracing a red cone. The woman's head, with white, curly hair, is shown in profile, the bluish mouth wide open. Around the figure the paint surface is carefully worked through, while the rest of the background consists of white and bluish areas. In the lower half of the work, in the middle, a light-coloured nude figure with arms spread wide. The head is worked through in a sketchy manner, the mouth dark and sharply outlined. The woman's arms grow

works.d: Kolmeosaline. Laiemal kesktahvlil oranžil taustal värviliste laiade pintslijoontega piiritletud südame kuju, milles näiliselt vana naivistlik maastikupilt öisest jõeorust jahimehega kappaval valgel hobusel jänest taga ajamas. Pildil kahel pool puudekulisside vahel jahilossid, kuupaiste langeb veele. Kitsad külgtahvlid mõlemad ülaosas oranžid pastoossed pinnad, alumistel osadel plastikust inimese siseorganite anatoomilised mudelid kirevalt abstraktselt üle maalitud. Vasakpoolsel tahvlil südame mudel roosaks toonitud.
works.de: Three-part work. On the wider central panel, against an orange background, outlined by wide coloured brush strokes, the shape of a heart, within which is a seemingly old naivist landscape image of a nocturnal river valley with a huntsman galloping on a white horse chasing a hare. In the picture, on both sides, between the tree wings, hunting lodges, moonlight falling on the water. The narrow side panels are both orange pastose surfaces in the upper part, and in the lower parts plastic anatomical models of human internal organs, painted over in a garishly abstract manner. On the left-hand panel the heart model is tinted pink.

works.de: A girl in a skirt and jacket sitting on a stool, turned to the left, head turned to the right, a kerchief on her head

works.d: Poolabstraktne kompositsioon valges pluusis noore naisega. Heledal taustal tume kirju abstraktne maalipind, millest tulevad esile naise nägu, rind ja käed. Pastoosselt teostatud abstraktne maalipind moodustab maali keskel vertikaalse samba.
works.de: A semi-abstract composition with a young woman in a white blouse. On a light background a dark, mottled abstract painted surface, from which the woman's face, chest and hands emerge. The pastose abstract painted surface forms a vertical column in the middle of the painting.

works.d: Helesinine kompositsioon grupi inimestega. Esiplaanil neli seljaga vaataja poole seisvat täiskasvanut, kellest üks vaatab tagasi. Neist vasakul ja nende ees üks ja sama hüppava poisslapse figuur korduses ning paremal toolil istuv prillidega mees, jalg üle põlve. Inimgrupi vahelt paistavad eemalt kahe naise figuurid, taust helesinine, nurkadest roosatriibuline.
works.de: A light blue composition with a group of people. In the foreground, four adults standing with their backs to the viewer, one of whom looks back. To their left and in front of them, one and the same figure of a jumping boy repeated, and on the right a bespectacled man sitting on a chair, one leg crossed over the other. Between the group of people, the figures of two women can be seen further away; the background is light blue, striped pink at the corners.

works.d: Poolabstraktne kompositsioon nelja naisega. Kolme seisva ja ühe istuva naise näod, õlad ja osaliselt ka käed välja maalitud, alakehad sulavad kokku abstraktsete säbruliste värvipindadega. Abstraktsetest värvipindadest moodustub kompositsiooni keskel sammas, taust helesinine.
works.de: Semi-abstract composition with four women. The faces, shoulders and partly also the hands of three standing women and one seated woman are painted out, their lower bodies merge with abstract wrinkled colour surfaces. The abstract colour surfaces form a column in the centre of the composition, background light blue.

works.d: Dekoratiivne kompositsioon lopsaka lainetava veetaimestikuga, milles jalgupidi kahe supelpükstes lapse alakeha paistmas. Maali piiravad sümmeetriliselt kahelt poolt kumerad käsipuud meenutavad puna-kollase triibulised torud. Erksavärviline, selgepiiriline popilik kujutamisviis.
works.de: A decorative composition with lush undulating water plants, in which the lower bodies of two children in swimming trunks, standing feet-down, are visible. The painting is symmetrically bordered on both sides by curved handrails resembling red-yellow striped pipes. Brightly coloured, sharply defined, pop-like manner of depiction.

works.d: Mees seisab keset maastiku, taustaks puud.
works.de: A man stands in the middle of a landscape, with trees in the background.

works.d: Esiplaanil ühevärvilise erkrohelise pinnana maalitud muru taustal punasekollase triibuline tõkkepuu, paremal pool üles tõstetud. Taamal ühtlase ribana mets. Selle kohal taevas, millel vasakust nurgast viltu paremale üle kogu taeva laia ribana kollakasmust suur suitsupilv. Taevas pilvest allpool maalitud ühtlase helesinise pinnana, pilve kohal tumesinise pinnana.
works.de: In the foreground, against a background of grass painted as a monochrome bright green surface, a red-yellow striped barrier pole, raised on the right side. Beyond it, forest as an even band. Above it, sky, on which a large yellowish-black cloud of smoke stretches diagonally from the left corner to the right across the whole sky as a wide band. Below the cloud the sky is painted as an even light blue surface, above the cloud as a dark blue surface.

works.d: Peata naise figuur tekstiilist pealsetega platvormkingadega. Keha on kaetud ribadena mähitud pruuni tekstiiliga (värvitud tüllkardina ribad), sellele kleebitud kummeeritud tekstiilist mõõdulindi ribad (ready-made) jaotavad keha, käed ja jalad osadeks, nagu lihakeha (omaaegsetes lihapoodides rippusid seintel veiste ja sigade pildid selliselt jaotatuna erineva kulinaarse väärtusega osadeks); kehale on valge värviga kaetud mõõdud ning kleebitud baberist numbrid
works.de: A headless female figure with platform shoes with textile uppers. The body is covered with brown textile wrapped in strips (strips of dyed net curtain), onto which strips of gummed textile measuring tape (ready-made) are glued, dividing the body, arms and legs into parts, like a carcass of meat (in butcher shops of the time pictures of cattle and pigs hung on the walls divided in this way into parts of different culinary value); onto the body measurements are applied in white paint and numbers cut from wrapping paper are glued on

works.d: Kolmeosalisel maalil kujutatud ühtlastest punakaspruunidest aialippidest plank, mille kohal eresinine taevatriip. Keskosal, plangu vastas rohelise kattega pruun lauaplaat, sellel paremal karikakujuline sinine vaas kitsaleheliste lilledega, vasakul püramiidi-taoline ažuurne kujund. Keskel, puuduva plangulaua vahelt avaneb vaade heleda maja nurgale puude vahel.
works.de: A three-part painting depicting a fence of uniformly reddish-brown pickets, above which a bright blue strip of sky. In the central section, opposite the fence, a brown tabletop with a green covering, on which, on the right, a chalice-shaped blue vase with narrow-leaved flowers, on the left a pyramid-like openwork form. In the centre, through the gap of a missing picket, a view opens onto the corner of a light-coloured house among trees.

works.d: Kolmeosalise kompositsiooni keskmisel tahvlil hallikassinine ekraan, millel väike kollane ring ja kollased-rohelised joonekesed. Ekraani taga pruun laudadest plank, mille tagant ülal paistavad üksteisest läbipõimunud geomeetrilised kujundid. Pruun plank ja helesinine taevas jätkuvad ka vasak- ja parempoolsel tahvlil. Kummagi tiiva planguosa taga paistavad hallides ja kollakaspruunides toonides geomeetrilised konstruktsioonid. Nii vasak- kui parempoolse tiiva välisservades roheline niit ja põõsastik tagaplaanil.
works.de: In the middle panel of the three-part composition a greyish-blue screen with a small yellow circle and yellow-green lines. Behind the screen a brown wooden plank fence, behind which, above, interwoven geometric shapes appear. The brown fence and the pale blue sky continue also on the left and right panels. Behind the fence part of each wing, geometric constructions in grey and yellowish-brown tones appear. Along the outer edges of both the left and right wings, green thread and bushes in the background.

works.d: Interjööri nurk õrnkollaste seinte ja roostepruuni põrandaga. Ülaosas, seina taustal sinisel torul rippuv oranžide vabakäejoontega must tahvel. Ees avatud sahtliga tumepruun laud, millel roheline alus peene triibulise varrega sinise kolmnurkse lipukesega. Kahel pool põrandal kõverdatud torujad kujundid.
works.de: A corner of an interior with pale yellow walls and a rust-brown floor. In the upper part, against the wall, a black board with orange freehand lines hanging on a blue pipe. In front, a dark brown table with an open drawer, on which stands a green stand with a thin striped shaft and a blue triangular flag. On both sides on the floor, curved pipe-like shapes.

works.d: Kompositsiooni vertikaalsel keskteljel üle pildi hele, punaste triipudega ääristatud pind, mis on fooniks suurele pruunis potis kasvavale kaktusele. Pott koos kaktusega seisab kolmejalgsel sinkjasmustal taburetil. Kaktusest vasakul ja paremal asuvad rohelised pinnad, millel peentest punastest joontest kompositsioon.
works.de: On the vertical central axis of the composition, running across the picture, a light surface bordered with red stripes, which serves as background to a large cactus growing in a brown pot. The pot with the cactus stands on a three-legged bluish-black stool. To the left and right of the cactus are green surfaces on which a composition of fine red lines is placed.

works.d: 2/5 maali vasakust poolest kujutab punast tellisseina. Paremal, tara taga paiknevad punastest tellistest vabrikuhooned: kandiline torn kahe viilkatusega ja paljude akendega madalama ehituse vahel. Ees, vaataja pool teedest ümbritsetud muruplats, kaks lehtpuud aia ääres.
works.de: 2/5 of the left side of the painting depicts a red brick wall. On the right, behind a fence, are factory buildings of red brick: a square tower with two gable roofs and many windows between a lower structure. In front, on the viewer's side, a lawn surrounded by paths, two deciduous trees along the fence.

works.d: Esiplaanil kaks mustades poksikinnastes meest: vasakpoolsel kaitsevärvi roheline ülikond, punane lai triip varrukail ning pükstel, vasak käsi löögiks välja sirutatud ja puudutab vastase pead, parema käe poksikinda all kollane täpp. Parempoolsel mehel rohelised püksid (punane triip küljel), ülakeha paljas, juuksed roosakaspunased. Parempoolse mehe seljas kulgev punane joon jätkub meeste taga ringi piiravatel valgetel nööridel. Vasakul ülal jupike ehitust. Foon roheline, ülal erksinine taevas.
works.de: In the foreground two men in black boxing gloves: the one on the left in a khaki green suit with a wide red stripe on the sleeves and trousers, left hand extended for a punch and touching the opponent's head, a yellow dot under the right boxing glove. The man on the right has green trousers (red stripe on the side), bare upper body, pinkish-red hair. A red line running across the back of the right-hand man continues on the white cords encircling the men behind them. Upper left a fragment of a building. Background green, bright blue sky above.

works.d: Tumedast puust voodiots, millele maalitud kollasel pinnal jooksevad kaks horisontaalset valget triipu. Viimaste kohal kaks valget rööpkülikut, neist parempoolse lõikab läbi voodiotsa serv. Vasakul vanaaegne öökapp, millel seisab väike seenekujuline, valge lülitusnupuga roosa laualamp.
works.de: A dark wood bedstead end, on which is painted on a yellow surface two horizontal white stripes running across. Above these two white parallelograms, of which the right-hand one is cut through by the edge of the bedstead end. On the left an old-fashioned nightstand, on which stands a small mushroom-shaped pink table lamp with a white switch knob.

works.d: Ühtlane valge taust raamistatud selgepiirilise musta triibuga. Triip jaotab maali ülaosa kitsaks horisontaalseks ja parema külje kaheks ülestikku asetsevaks nelinurgaks. Kastide sees punase, musta, rohelisega maalitud marmoreeritud pinnad. Valgel taustal vasakul vaba käega kujutatud koobaltsinine oksataoline kujund.
works.de: A uniform white background framed by a clearly bounded black stripe. The stripe divides the upper part of the painting into a narrow horizontal rectangle and the right side into two rectangles placed one above the other. Inside the boxes marbled surfaces painted with red, black, green. On the white background on the left, a cobalt blue branch-like form depicted with a free hand.

works.d: Ühtlane valge taust raamistatud selgepiirilise musta triibuga. Triip jaotab maali ülaosa kitsaks horisontaalseks, vasaku serva kaheks ülestikku asetsevaks nelinurgaks. Kastide sees punase, musta, rohelisega maalitud marmoreeritud pinnad. Valgel taustal paremal vaba käega kujutatud koobaltsinine kaarekujuline taimemotiiv.

The stripe divides the upper part of the painting into a narrow horizontal band, and the left edge into two rectangles placed one above the other. Inside the boxes are marbled surfaces painted in red, black and green. On the white background at right, a cobalt-blue arc-shaped plant motif rendered freehand.

Taustal servast servani punane telliskivisein, mille najal seisab sinine pulk.

In the lower part of the composition two small cupboard tops, on the left of which is placed a tall white flowerpot vase and five apples, on the right a small empty glass vase, a tomato and dried flowers. In the background, a red brick wall from edge to edge, against which a blue stick leans.

works.d: Pimedal maanteel sõidab suur veoauto, mille taga on valgustatud ekraan. Ekraanil jookseb film, mis näitab Ameerika? maanteeäärseid vaateid, aga päeva ajal, päikest on palju. Veoautot on filmitud selle taga sõitvast bussist. Ekraan kord kaugeneb kord läheneb, autod tulevad vastu ja sõidavad mööda. Lõpupoole minnakse ekraanile nii lähedale, et öist maanteed pole näha, ja ruttu tagasi. Lõpuks jääb eessõitev masin seisma. Toomik räägib masinas istuvate politseinikega ja siis sõidab see ära. Buss masinale ei järgne. Helitaust: nõrgalt kuuldavad bussisõitjate kommentaarid
works.de: A large truck is driving on a dark road, with an illuminated screen at its rear. On the screen a film is running, showing roadside views of America?, but during the daytime, with plenty of sunshine. The truck has been filmed from a bus driving behind it. The screen alternately moves further away and closer, cars come towards it and pass by. Towards the end, the approach to the screen becomes so close that the night-time road is no longer visible, and then quickly pulls back. Finally, the vehicle ahead comes to a stop. Toomik talks with the policemen sitting in the vehicle and then it drives off. The bus does not follow the vehicle. Soundtrack: faintly audible comments from the bus passengers.

works.t: Heliinstallatsioon näitusele "Endel Kõks. Vapruse, vabaduse ja rõõmuga"
works.dm: aeg/ kestus: 38.0 aasta; aeg/ kestus: 16.0 aasta
works.d: Kohaspetsiifiline soundscape-installatsioon Endel Kõksi näitusele püüab ühendada Pallase-taustaga maalija loomingus olevaid kaugeid peegeldusi huvist elektroonika ja elektroonilise muusika ning väliseesti helilooja Udo Kasemetsa vastu (kes oli üks esimesi John Cage ideede järgijaid), Cage'i post-muusikalisi ideid seoses vaikusega ning Kõksi näituse toimumise fakti kontseptuaalselt vulgaarmaterialistlikust aspektist.
works.de: A site-specific soundscape installation for Endel Kõks's exhibition attempts to combine the distant reflections, present in the work of this Pallas-trained painter, of an interest in electronics and electronic music and in the Estonian-born émigré composer Udo Kasemets (who was one of the first followers of John Cage's ideas), Cage's post-musical ideas connected with silence, and the fact of Kõks's exhibition taking place, from a conceptually vulgar-materialist perspective.

works.d: Ruumiinstallatsioon. Ruumi eraldab kaheks laest maani ulatuv pastelsetes toonides ribadeks lõigatud kardin. Põrandal asetsevad erinevad sarnastes toonides üle värvitud objektid - tekstiilid, valmisesemed, alusraamile tõmmatud lõuendist sirm, jms. Põrand kaetud valge kattega.
works.de: Spatial installation. The space is divided in two by a curtain reaching from ceiling to floor, cut into strips in pastel tones. On the floor lie various objects repainted in similar tones - textiles, ready-made items, a canvas screen stretched on a stretcher frame, etc. The floor is covered with a white cover.

works.d: Esialal keskel kaks naisfiguuri rannaliival kalu sorteerimas. Nende taga neli püsti meest: ühel paljastatud ülakehaga noormehel on püsti puss, tema kõrval habemik rauk võrgulinaga, kuna parempoolsem näitab kahele paremal äärel rannaliival istuvale tütarlapsele suuremat kala. Tagapool vasakul rannaliiva jooksnud purjeka juures kaks noormeest askeldamas, kaugemal merel teine purjekas, millel näha kolm figuuri.
works.de: In the foreground centre two female figures on the beach sand sorting fish. Behind them four standing men: one young man with a bared upper body holds a knife upright, beside him a bearded old man with a net cloth, while the one on the right shows a larger fish to two girls sitting on the beach sand at the right edge. Further back on the left, by a sailboat run up on the beach sand, two young men busy themselves, further out at sea a second sailboat, on which three figures can be seen.

works.t: Maailma lõpus I (At the End of the World I)
works.d: Vees hõljuv noor naine, pead pole näha. Ülaosas keha peegeldus veepinnal, allosas pilved. Pildi pinnal üheksa sümmeetriliselt asetsevat musta risti.
works.de: A young woman floating in water, her head not visible. In the upper part a reflection of the body on the water's surface, in the lower part clouds. On the surface of the picture nine symmetrically placed black crosses.

works.t: Maailma lõpus II (At the End of the World II)
works.d: Vees hõljuv vanem  naine, pead pole näha. Ülaosas keha peegeldus veepinnal, allosas pilved. Pildi pinnal üheksa sümmeetriliselt asetsevat valget risti.
works.de: An older woman floating in water, her head not visible. In the upper part the reflection of the body on the water surface, in the lower part clouds. On the surface of the picture nine symmetrically placed white crosses.

works.t: Maailma lõpus III (At the End of the World III)
works.d: Vees hõljuv kõhn alasti naine. Otsevaates, käed ja jalad laiali, tumedad juuksed näo ees. Pildi pinnal üheksa sümmeetriliselt asetsevat helesinist risti.
works.de: A thin naked woman floating in water. Frontal view, arms and legs spread, dark hair in front of the face. On the surface of the picture, nine light blue crosses arranged symmetrically.

works.d: Mustvalgel kolmeks horisontaalseks kaadriks jaotatud säbrulisel fotokujutisel kordub istuv alasti naine, kätega peast hoidmas, juuksed sassis, taustal vasakul hele ristkülik. Keskmisel kaadril all paremal punase tindiga pealkiri "Ühtki piiska pärast sadu", alumisel kaadril all vasakul punase tindiga signatuur ja daatum.
works.de: In a black-and-white photographic image divided into three horizontal frames, with a crumpled surface, a seated naked woman is repeated, holding her head with her hands, hair dishevelled, with a light rectangle at left in the background. In the middle frame, lower right, the title "Ühtki piiska pärast sadu" ["Not a Drop After the Rain"] written in red ink; in the bottom frame, lower left, a signature and date in red ink.

works.d: Otsevaates foto kägaras meesaktist taburetil. Käed ümber jalgade, nägu toetub põlvedele. Käelabadel tumedad ümmargused armid.
works.de: Frontal photo of a crouched male nude on a stool. Arms wrapped around the legs, face resting on the knees. Dark round scars on the hands.

works.d: Värvifotol anonüümne tuba, mille otsaseinas läbikumavate sinakate klaasustega kapp, vasakul voodiots, millele asetatud riidepuudel triiksärgid, paremal tühi kirjutuslaud tooliga. Läbi kapiuste kumab kapisistuva, näoga vaataja poole pööratud alasti kunstniku figuur.
works.de: In the colour photo an anonymous room, with a cabinet with translucent bluish glass panes on the end wall, on the left a bed end with dress shirts placed on hangers, on the right an empty writing desk with a chair. Through the cabinet doors the figure of a nude artist inside the cabinet, turned face towards the viewer, is glowing through.

works.d: Värvifotol valge pind, millel vertikaalselt väljasirutatuna kaks päikesepõlenud kätt, foto alumises osas mehe rindkere, pea väljaspool kaadri ulatust. Käte vahel valgel pinnal afroameerika kirjaniku James Baldwin`i raamat „Keegi ei tea minu nime“, mille kaanel kirjaniku foto.
works.de: In the colour photograph, a white surface on which two sunburnt hands are stretched out vertically, in the lower part of the photo a man's chest, his head outside the frame. Between the hands, on the white surface, the book "Keegi ei tea minu nime" ["Nobody Knows My Name"] by the African American writer James Baldwin, with the writer's photograph on the cover.

works.d: Tagantvaates seisev musta riietunud kunstnik, kes nõjatub valgele metallist terrassipiirdele. Pilk suunatud ümberkaudsetele elamutele. Taamal sinise taeva taustal rohealad ja elamute katused. Mehe kõrval paremal põrandal lillepott kaktusega.
works.de: Seen from behind, an artist dressed in black leaning against a white metal terrace railing. Gaze directed toward the surrounding buildings. Beyond, against a blue sky, green areas and roofs of buildings. Next to the man, on the right, a flowerpot with a cactus on the floor.

works.d: Heledates värvides ruumis lebab küljel mustas riietuses kunstnik valge voodipesuga kaetud kušetil. Mehe silmad on suletud, suu paokil, pea toetub ühele käele, pealmine jalg sirutatult õhus. Teise käega hoiab külili asetsevast kaktuselise taime potist.
works.de: In a room in light colours, an artist dressed in black lies on his side on a couch covered with white bedding. The man's eyes are closed, mouth ajar, head resting on one hand, the upper leg stretched out in the air. With the other hand he holds a pot with a cactus-like plant lying on its side.

works.d: Kunstniku autoportree otsevaates. Mehe paremat silma katab tume ning vastupeegelduv päikeseprillidelt murtud klaas. Taustaks heledatest toonides kahhelkividest pind.
works.de: Artist's self-portrait in full-face view. The man's right eye is covered by a dark, reflective broken lens from sunglasses. The background is a surface of light-toned tiles.

works.d: Heledal kahhelplaatidest taustal kolmes korrapärases rivis kuivanud taime lehed. Esiplaanil paljad meesterahva labajalad ning kuivanud lehte hoidev käsi.
works.de: On a light background of tiles, dried plant leaves in three regular rows. In the foreground, a man's bare feet and a hand holding a dried leaf.

works.d: Fotol on kiila soenguga ja musta habemega mees. Ta kannab musta kampsunit. Mees hoiab mõlemaid käsi laua peal.
works.de: In the photo, a man with a shaved head and black beard. He is wearing a black sweater. The man is holding both hands on the table.

works.d: Fotol on mehe osa mehe ülakehast. Kaelas kannab ta kahte kaelaehet. Näha on poolt nägu.
works.de: The photo shows part of a man's upper body. He wears two neck ornaments. Half of the face is visible.

works.d: Fotol on lühikese soenguga mees. Ta istub poolprofiilis. Tema üks kätest on kaetud tätoveeringuga. Seljas on tal hele särk.
works.de: The photograph shows a man with short hair. He sits in half-profile. One of his hands is covered with a tattoo. He is wearing a light shirt.

works.d: Fotol on vuntsidega mees. Esiplaanil on tema käsi, mis on kaetud tätoveeringutega. Foto on lähivaates.
works.de: The photo shows a man with a moustache. In the foreground is his hand, which is covered with tattoos. The photo is a close-up.

works.d: Fotol on naeratav mees, kes kannab adidase dressipluusi. Mehel on tumedad juuksed.
works.de: In the photo a smiling man wearing an Adidas tracksuit top. The man has dark hair.

works.de: The photo shows a dark-haired man with a moustache. The man holds his hands clasped together. He is wearing a dark-coloured jacket.

works.d: Fotol on tumedate juustega ja vuntsidega mees. Mehel on tumedad silmad. Foto on lähivaates.
works.de: The photo shows a man with dark hair and a moustache. The man has dark eyes. The photo is a close-up.

works.d: Fotol on lühikeste juustega mees. Tema ülakeha on kaetud tätoveeringutega. Mees hoiab käsi üleval.
works.de: The photo shows a short-haired man. His upper body is covered with tattoos. The man is holding his hands up.

works.d: Fotol on lühikeste juustega naeratav mees. Ta kannab tumedat pusa.
works.de: In the photo a smiling man with short hair. He is wearing a dark sweatshirt.

works.d: Fotol on lähivaade mehest, kes ühe käega puudutab oma põske.
works.de: The photograph shows a close-up of a man touching his cheek with one hand.

works.d: Atlasskangale trükitud mustvalge talvine foto hüljatud välibasseinialast Kadriorus. Basseini ümbrus ja tribüün kaetud lumega, basseini seintel grafiti ja põhi üleni täidetud tikitud sätendavate torukujuliste helmestega. Töö kuulub autori 2005. aastal Eesti Kunstiakadeemias graafika erialal kaitstud bakalaureusetöö komplekti "Basseinid".
works.de: A black-and-white winter photograph printed on satin fabric, showing an abandoned outdoor pool area in Kadriorg. The surroundings of the pool and the stand are covered with snow, the pool walls bear graffiti and the bottom is entirely filled with embroidered sparkling tube-shaped beads. The work belongs to the author's set of works "Basseinid" ["Pools"], the bachelor's thesis defended in graphic art at the Estonian Academy of Arts in 2005.

works.d: Atlasskangale trükitud mustvalge sügisene foto hüljatud välibasseinialast Kadriorus. Basseini ja liumäe vaheline kiviplaatidega ala kaetud sambla, muru ja lehtedega, basseini seintel, tribüünil ja tribüüniga külgneval hooneosal grafiti, väikese basseini põhi üleni kaetud tumedate sätendavate torukujuliste helmestega. Töö kuulub autori 2005. aastal Eesti Kunstiakadeemias graafika erialal kaitstud bakalaureusetöö komplekti "Basseinid".
works.de: Black-and-white autumnal photograph printed on satin fabric of an abandoned outdoor swimming pool area in Kadriorg. The area with stone slabs between the pool and the water slide is covered with moss, grass and leaves; on the pool walls, the stand and the part of the building adjoining the stand there is graffiti, the bottom of the small pool is entirely covered with dark shimmering tube-shaped beads. The work belongs to the author's set of works "Basseinid" ("Pools"), defended as a bachelor's thesis in the printmaking speciality at the Estonian Academy of Arts in 2005.

works.d: Videoinstallatsioon koosneb kahest seinaga eraldatud ruumist. Esimeses suurel ekraanil äreva helitaustaga videoprojektsioon, millel vahelduvad inimtühja äärelinna hämarad, ent realistlikud kaadrid. Teises öise äärelinna mängumakett kahe osaliselt tuledes kortermaja, valgustatud tänavate, vilkuva foori, tühja parkimisplatsi, pargiala ning kahe linnavaateid projitseeriva kuvariga, mida salvestavad maketi erinevatesse osadesse asetatud ning kordamööda sisse lülituvad veebikaamerad.
works.de: The video installation consists of two rooms separated by a wall. In the first, on a large screen, a video projection with an anxious soundtrack, alternating dim but realistic shots of an empty suburb devoid of people. In the second, a night-time suburb play model with two partially lit apartment buildings, lit streets, a flashing traffic light, an empty parking lot, a park area, and two screens projecting city views, recorded by webcams placed in various parts of the model and switching on in turn.

works.d: Filmiplanšetil kujutatud kükitavat kilplast, käed sirutatud alla enda toetamiseks. Seljas roosakas ülikond, peas pruun mütsilotu.
works.de: A film storyboard panel depicting a squatting Kilplane, arms stretched down to support himself. Wearing a pinkish suit, a brown cap on his head.

works.d: Filmiplanšetil kujutatud helerohelist longus tiivaga kägu, helepunane nokk kinni, hallikassinise parema jala varbad asetatud silmile.
works.de: On a film storyboard a light green cuckoo with a drooping wing is depicted, its light red beak closed, the toes of its grayish-blue right foot placed over its eyes.

works.t: Planšett joonisfilmile KILPLASED. Laulev võõras kägu.
works.d: Filmiplanšetil kujutatud rõõmsalt kukkuv tumehall kägu, helehalli noka ja ovaalsete kollaste silmadega, millel must silmatera. Tiivanukid püsti, rohekashallide jalgade varbad harali.
works.de: A joyfully falling dark gray cuckoo depicted on a film storyboard, with a light gray beak and oval yellow eyes with a black pupil. Wing tips upright, toes of the greenish-gray legs spread apart.

works.d: Filmiplanšetil kujutatud ettepoole kummardunud kilplast, käed üles tõstetud, suu pärani. Seljas roosakas ülikond ja pruun mütsilotu.
works.de: A stooped kilplane figure depicted on a film storyboard sheet, arms raised, mouth wide open. Wearing a pinkish suit and a floppy brown cap.

works.t: Planšett joonisfilmile KILPLASED. Kilplased palgivirna juures.
works.d: Filmiplanšetil kujutatud pruunivärviliste palkide virna ümber kuus kilplast, vasakult teisel käed üles tõstetud, temast kaks järgmist lükkavad palke. Kõik kilplased tegevuses, suud pärani.
works.de: On a film storyboard, around a pile of brown-coloured logs, six Kilplased [Numbskulls], second from the left with hands raised, the next two after him pushing logs. All the Kilplased in action, mouths wide open.

works.t: Planšett joonisfilmile KILPLASED. Kilplane palki mäkke tõmbamas.
works.d: Filmiplanšetil kujutatud vasakus nurgas roosakas ülikonnas kilplast nööri, mille küljes palk, üles tirimas. Kilplase kõrval maas kollane nööriots. Planšeti keskel suur pruun palk, mis kõigub köie otsas.
works.de: The film storyboard depicts in the left corner a Kilplane in a pinkish suit pulling up a rope with a log attached to it. Beside the Kilplane, a yellow rope end lies on the ground. In the centre of the storyboard, a large brown log swings at the end of the rope.

works.d: Filmiplanšetil kujutatud 18 kilplast oma roosakas ülikonnas ja pruunides mütsides seisavad üllatunud nägudega ümber palgi ja seda veeretava kilplase. Kilplaste selja taga palgivirn.
works.de: On a film storyboard 18 Kilplased [Fools of Kilp] in their pinkish suits and brown caps stand with astonished faces around a log and the Kilplane rolling it. Behind the Kilplased a pile of logs.

works.d: Filmiplanšetil kujutatud kahte kilplast oma roosakas ülikonnas ja pruunides mütsides istuvad mõttesse vajunult kõrvuti, nägudega vastassuunas. Mõlemad toetuvad käele.
works.de: On a film storyboard two Kilplased are depicted, in their pinkish suits and brown caps, sitting side by side lost in thought, facing opposite directions. Both are leaning on a hand.

works.d: Filmiplanšetil kujutatud kaheksa kilplast, oma roosakas ülikonnas ja pruunides mütsides, istuvad ja mõtlevad.
works.de: The film panel depicts eight Kilplased, in their pinkish suits and brown hats, sitting and thinking.

works.d: Filmiplanšetil kujutatud seitse hunti, kuid ükski pole kujutatud tervenisti: mõnel ainult pea, mõnel selg, mõnel pool keha. Hundid hallid, seljalt tumedamad, hambad irevil.
works.de: Seven wolves depicted on a film storyboard, but none is depicted whole: some only the head, some the back, some part of the body. The wolves are grey, darker on the back, teeth bared.

works.d: Filmiplanšetil kujutatud rammus kollane pruunilakaline hobune. Hobusel hirmunud ilme, saba jalgade vahel, suu avatud.
works.de: A robust yellow, brown-maned horse depicted on a film storyboard. The horse has a frightened expression, tail between its legs, mouth open.

works.d: Filmiplanšetil kujutatud oranžikas kass, sabaots valge, valmis hüppeks.
works.de: An orangish cat depicted on an animation cel, tail tip white, ready to jump.

works.d: Filmiplanšetil kujutatud luurav oranžikas kass, sabaots valge. Kassil valged silmaavad, vurrukarvad, valge ninaots ja veidi avatud suu. Otsaesine kortsus, saba püsti.
works.de: On the film storyboard, a lurking orangeish cat is depicted, with a white tail tip. The cat has white eye openings, whiskers, a white nose tip and a slightly open mouth. The forehead is wrinkled, the tail upright.

works.d: Filmiplanšetil kujutatud sõjakat kilplastejõuku, kaikad üles tõstetud. Mitmel kilplased suud pärani.
works.de: On the film storyboard a warlike gang of Kilplased is depicted, clubs raised. Several of the Kilplased have their mouths wide open.

works.d: Filmiplanšetil kujutatud sõjakat kilplastejõuku, kaikad üles tõstetud, suud pärani, maja seina vastu jõudnud.
works.de: A film storyboard depicting a warlike gang of Kilplased, clubs raised, mouths wide open, having reached the wall of a house.

works.d: Filmiplanšetil kujutatud kilplast, seljas tohutu suur pruun paigatud terakott. Kilplasel suu lahti.
works.de: A kilplane depicted on a film storyboard, wearing a huge brown patched sack of grain on his back. The kilplane's mouth is open.

works.d: Filmiplanšetil kujutatud tohutu suur pruun paigatud terakott, sellest tagapool on ettepoole kummardunud kilplane.
works.de: On the film storyboard a huge brown patched sack of grain is depicted, behind it a tortoise bent forward.

works.t: Planšett joonisfilmile KILPLASED. KILPLANE TERAKOTIGA HOBUSE SELJAS.
works.d: Filmiplanšetil kujutatud kilplaste beež hobune, kelle seljas istub terakotiga kilplane. Paigatud terakoti otsas kägu (tumehall, nokk helehall, jalad sinakad).
works.de: On the film storyboard the Kilplased' beige horse is depicted, on whose back sits a Kilplane in a terracotta sack. On the end of the patched sack a cuckoo (dark grey, beak light grey, legs bluish).

works.d: Filmiplanšetil kujutatud oranžikas kass, kes kõnnib, saba püsti.
works.de: An orangish cat depicted on a film storyboard panel, walking, tail raised.

works.d: Filmiplanšetil kujutatud esiplaanil suur pruun pealt lame mullakuhilik. Tagapool vasakul veel üks ja paremal teine väiksem kuhilik.
works.de: On a film storyboard in the foreground a large brown flat-topped mound of earth. Further back on the left another one and on the right another smaller mound.

works.d: Filmiplanšetil kujutatud suur ümmargune roosa pruunide laikudega siga, kes songib mulda.
works.de: A large round pink pig with brown spots, rooting in the soil, depicted on a film storyboard.

works.d: Filmiplanšetil kujutatud suur ümmargune roosa pruunide laikudega siga, laisalt istukil. Seal saba rõngas, sööb kilplaste orast, aidates sõraga orast suhu.
works.de: On a film storyboard a large round pink pig with brown spots, sitting lazily. There a curly tail, eating a sprouting turnip, helping with its hoof to push the sprout into its mouth.

works.d: Filmiplanšetil kujutatud vasakul üleval nurgas roosaka vammusevarrukaga kilplase pruun käsi, milles tugev malakas sea jaoks.
works.de: Depicted on the film storyboard, in the upper left corner, a brown hand of a Kilplane in a pinkish jerkin sleeve, holding a strong club for a pig.

works.d: Filmiplanšetil paremal kilplane kõhuli, hoiab üht kätt pea juures ja vaatab silmad-suud pärani ettepoole. Tema kõrval, planšetil vasakul, kilplane istukil, käed üles tõstetud, suu pärani lahti.
works.de: On the film storyboard, on the right a turtle-being lying on its stomach, holding one hand by its head and looking forward with eyes and mouth wide open. Next to it, on the left of the storyboard, a turtle-being sitting, arms raised, mouth wide open.

works.d: Filmiplanšetil kujutatud roosakas ülikonnas kilplane kükakil (planšetil ainult keha ülemine osa), pea kallutatud selga, suu lahti.
works.de: On the film storyboard, a turtle depicted in a pinkish suit, squatting (only the upper part of the body shown on the storyboard), head tilted back, mouth open.

works.d: Filmiplanšetil kujutatud suures plaanis kilplase poolportree avatud terakotiga. Kilplane hoiab ühe käega ümber koti, teisega võtab kotist teri.
works.de: On the film storyboard, depicted in close-up, a half-portrait of a Kilplane with an open sack of grain. The Kilplane holds the sack with one hand, taking grains from the sack with the other.

works.d: Filmiplanšetil kujutatud kilplane kükakil asendis, sõrm suus.
works.de: A Kilplane depicted on a film storyboard in a crouching position, finger in mouth.

works.t: Planšett joonisfilmile KILPLASED. KILPLASED KÖIT HARUTAMAS.
works.d: Filmiplanšetil kujutatud kaks kilplast seisavad vastamisi ja tegelevad nende vahel oleva kollaka köiega. Parempoolne kilplane tõstab köit kõrgele, vasakpoolne kisub ka nööri, endal silmad ja suu pärani.
works.de: The film storyboard depicts two Kilplased standing facing each other, dealing with a yellowish rope between them. The Kilplane on the right lifts the rope high, while the one on the left also pulls the rope, his eyes and mouth wide open.

works.d: Filmiplanšetil kujutatud kilplase pea, väikeses formaadis.
works.de: A kilplane's head depicted on a film storyboard, small format.

works.d: Filmiplanšetil kujutatud langev pisaratilk. Ülemine ots terav, valkjas, altosas ümmargune ja sinakas.
works.de: A falling teardrop depicted on a film plate. The upper end sharp, whitish, the lower part round and bluish.

works.d: Filmiplanšetil kujutatud nirisemas kilplaste pisaraid. Üleval väikesed valkjad nired ja nende keskelt saavad alguse kolm pikka sinakat niret.
works.de: On a film storyboard the tears of the Kilplased trickling. Above small whitish trickles, from the middle of which three long bluish trickles begin.

works.d: Filmiplanšetil kujutatud roosakas ülikonnas kilplane, kes on tõstnud helekollase varrega lilla labida kõrgele löömisasendisse.
works.de: A Kilplane depicted on a film storyboard, wearing a pinkish suit, who has raised a purple shovel with a light yellow handle high into a striking position.

works.t: Planšett joonisfilmile KILPLASED. KILPLASED TOETAVAD SEINA.
works.d: Filmiplansetil kujutatud kahte kilplast, kes kogu jõuga hoiavad oma peade ja kätega palkseina püsti.
works.de: Depicted on a film storyboard are two Kilplased, who with all their strength hold up a log wall with their heads and hands.

works.d: Filmiplanšetil kujutatud roosakates ülikondades kilplasi, kes seisavad suures ringis, hoiavad kätest kinni, suud lahti. Kokku 27 kilplast.
works.de: Kilplased depicted on a film storyboard in pinkish suits, standing in a large circle, holding hands, mouths open. 27 kilplased in total.

works.t: Planšett joonisfilmile KILPLASED. Kilplased siga taga ajamas.
works.d: Filmiplanšetil kujutatud neli kanderaami hoidvat ja jooksvat kilplast, suud pärani. Kanderaamil põlvili viies kilplane, kes on tõstnud nuia kõrgele pea kohale. Ees lippab suur ümmargune roosa siga, suu pärani lahti, saba püsti.
works.de: On the film storyboard, four kalevipoeg [ancient hero] figures depicted holding and running with a stretcher, mouths wide open. On the stretcher a fifth kalevipoeg kneeling, having raised a club high above his head. In front runs a large round pink pig, mouth wide open, tail upright.

works.t: Planšett joonisfilmile KILPLASED. Kilplased siga taga ajamas.
works.d: Filmiplanšetil kujutatud neli kanderaami hoidvat ja jooksvat kilplast, suud pärani. Kanderaamil põlvili viies kilplane, kes äigab ees sibavale suurele ümmargusele roosale seale nuiaga.
works.de: On a film storyboard, four Kilplased (people of Kilp) are depicted holding and running with a stretcher, mouths wide open. Kneeling on the stretcher is a fifth Kilplane, who is swinging a club at a large round pink pig scurrying in front.

works.d: 162-l A4 lehel punase või roosa tähe kujutis - üksik või mitmekordne, prinditud kas lehe ühele või mõlemale poole. Vastavalt printeri värvikasseti tühjaks saamisele muutub tähe kujutis heledamaks, ebaüthlaseks. Lõpuks jääb alles peenikestest triipudest koosnev kujutis.
works.de: On 162 A4 sheets, a depiction of a red or pink star - single or multiple, printed on one or both sides of the sheet. As the printer's ink cartridge runs empty, the image of the star becomes lighter, uneven. In the end, only an image consisting of thin stripes remains.

works.de: Portrait of a young, brown-haired and brown-eyed man in half-profile to the right. Curly hair in a style leaving the ears half exposed. Long, pointed moustache and a small goatee. Dark-toned attire with a wide, white, starched ruff collar.

works.d: Kollakate ja punakate puude vahelt paistab roosa maja. Esiplaanil kuivav pesu.
works.de: Between yellowish and reddish trees a pink house is visible. In the foreground drying laundry.

works.d: Sinises kleidis valge põllega naine. Pesurulli väntamas.
works.de: A woman in a blue dress with a white apron. Cranking a laundry roller.

works.de: Bust portrait of a middle-aged man with sidewhiskers in half-profile to the right, wearing an open black coat and a reddish-brown waistcoat. A black band at the neck.

works.de: A dog sitting on its hind legs in profile facing left. Front paws placed on the ground. A chain collar around its neck.

works.de: In the foreground and middle ground, in greyish and whitish tones, coastal dunes and dark pines. Behind, a greyish, faintly blue-tinged calm sea surface and a grey strip of sky.
