works.d: Pruunide juuste, põsk- ja tugeva piiratud lõughabemega kaugusesse vaatava mehe poolfiguur pöördega vasakule. Foon punane. Kujutis ovaalis.
works.de: Half-figure of a man with brown hair, sideburns and a full trimmed beard, gazing into the distance, with a turn to the left. Background red. Image in an oval.

works.d: Vanema mehe rindportree poolprofiiis paremale. Tumedais juusteis ja pöetud lõuahabemes halli vinet.
works.de: Bust portrait of an older man in half-profile facing right. Dark hair and a trimmed goatee with gray streaks.

works.d: Esiplaanil murupind üksikute madalate pääsastega, paremal diagonaalis pildi keskele suunduv püst-tara, mille ääres põõsas-puid, keskel suurem sopiline veekogu, mille madalail kallastel segametsa.
works.de: In the foreground a grassy area with a few low junipers, on the right a diagonal upright fence leading to the centre of the picture, with bushes and trees along it, in the middle a larger indented body of water, with mixed forest on its low banks.

works.d: Esiplaanil muru ja liivane rada, keskel paremal roigastara. Taamal keskel õlgkatusega hooned ja üksikuid puid, hoonete kõrvalt paistab meri.
works.de: In the foreground grass and a sandy path, in the middle right a pole fence. In the distance in the middle thatched-roof buildings and single trees, the sea is visible beside the buildings.

works.d: Esiplaanil rohtunud liivane maapind, taga mets.
works.de: Grassy sandy ground in the foreground, forest behind.

works.d: Tumedajuukselise, keskealise naise rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale. Punases pluusis.
works.de: Half-length portrait of a dark-haired, middle-aged woman in half-profile to the right. Wearing a red blouse.

works.d: Keskealise naise rinnapilt otsevaates. Õlgadel roosavärviline karusnahkse kraega mantel, peas laiaääreline kübar.
works.de: Bust portrait of a middle-aged woman in frontal view. On her shoulders a pink coat with a fur collar, a wide-brimmed hat on her head.

works.d: Ees sügisene kartulipõld töölt tulevate inimestega, korvid täis. Tagapool põhuga kaetud kuhjad, pruunikad ja samblarohelised põllusiilud, majakesed veekogu ääres. Sünge taeva taustal kahe suitseva korstnaga massiivsed tehasehooned.
works.de: In the foreground, an autumn potato field with people coming from work, baskets full. Behind, stacks covered with straw, brownish and moss-green field silos, small houses by a body of water. Against a gloomy sky, massive factory buildings with two smoking chimneys.

works.d: Esiplaanil jõgi kõrge sillaga. Kahel pool kallastel majad abihoonetega, puud. Teisel pool silda tehasehooned paljude suitsevate korstnatega. Pruunikashallid toonid, jõuline pintslilöök.
works.de: In the foreground a river with a high bridge. On both banks houses with outbuildings, trees. On the other side of the bridge factory buildings with many smoking chimneys. Brownish-gray tones, vigorous brushwork.

works.d: Ees astmelise kaldaga kaiäärne, pardid vees ujumas. Vasakul neid jälgivad inimesed. Tagapool kai ääres kalapaatide rida, hulk rahvast tänaval hoonete taustal. Pruunikas, hallikad küllastunud toonid, kohati pahtliga maalitud.
works.de: In front, a quay with a stepped bank, ducks swimming in the water. On the left people watching them. Further back, along the quay, a row of fishing boats, a crowd of people on the street against the background of buildings. Brownish, greyish saturated tones, in places painted with a palette knife.

works.d: Suvine vaade jõele. Ees poolenisti vette uppunud paadisild kõrkjate vahel. Paremal kaldal tume metsatukk. Vasakul päikesest valgustatud kaldal puud, kaugemal kaldalagendikul hooned. Maaliline laad.
works.de: Summer view of a river. In front a boat landing half-sunk in water among sedges. On the right bank a dark patch of forest. On the left bank, lit by the sun, trees, further away on the clearing by the bank buildings. Painterly style.

works.d: Sombus-halli taeva all avar sügisene maastik veekoguga. Esiplaanil vasakul lillakaspruun küntud põld. Põlluveerel paremal looklev tee, sellel kaks naisfiguuri istumas.
works.de: Under a gloomy grey sky an expansive autumn landscape with a body of water. In the foreground on the left a purplish-brown ploughed field. At the edge of the field on the right a winding road, on which two female figures are sitting.

works.d: Paremal nurgas esiplaanil mäenõlvak, millel kasvab hallide tüvede ja tumerohelise okstetihnikuna antud kuusemets. Taamal paistab läbi tüvede heledamini valgustatud lagendik.
works.de: In the right corner, in the foreground, a mountain slope on which grows a spruce forest rendered as grey trunks and dark green thicket of branches. Further back, a more brightly lit clearing shows through the trunks.

works.d: Vaade Tallinna vanalinnale Tornide väljaku lähedalt. Keskplaanis viis punase katusekiivriga linnamüüri kaitsetorni. Vasakul, kahe torni vahelt, paistab Niguliste kiriku torni osa. Ees kahekorruseline valge, planguga ümbritsetud kivimaja ning raagus puud.
works.de: View of Tallinn's Old Town from near Tornide Square. In the central plan five city-wall defence towers with red tiled roof helmets. On the left, between two towers, part of the tower of St. Nicholas' Church is visible. In front a two-storey white stone house surrounded by a plank fence, and bare trees.

works.d: Pikliku näoga noormehe rinnaportree, pea pööratud kergelt vasakule, kõrge laup, heledad, lühikesed, sirged juuksed. Seljas kollakaspruun kuub, sinise-valgeruuduline särk  lipsuga. Kokku sulatatud erinevaid toone, kohati pastoosne. Foonil selgelt eristatavad pintslilöögid, hallid, sinised, lillad ja külmrohelised toonid.
works.de: Bust portrait of a young man with an elongated face, his head turned slightly to the left, a high forehead, light-coloured, short, straight hair. He is wearing a yellowish-brown coat, a blue-and-white checked shirt with a tie. Different tones are blended together, in places pastose. In the background, clearly distinguishable brushstrokes in grey, blue, purple and cold-green tones.

works.d: Esiplaanil keskel oja, millest paremal jupike männimetsa. Ojast vasakul põllulapid ja heinamaa. Taamal üksikud majad, millede taga metsamassiiv. Ülal sinine taevas. Maalitud erivärvilisi pintslilööke mõjuda lastes. Koloriit rohelistes, sinistes ja punastes toonides.
works.de: In the foreground centre a stream, to the right of which a patch of pine forest. To the left of the stream fields and a meadow. In the distance solitary houses, behind which a forest mass. Above a blue sky. Painted letting varicoloured brushstrokes take effect. Colouring in green, blue and red tones.

works.d: Kitsa näoga, õlekarvaliste, ülepea kammitud juustega noore mehe rinnaportree. Pea pöördes paremale, pilk suunatud otse. Särk eest avatud. Maalitud jõulise pintslilöögiga.
works.de: A bust portrait of a young man with a narrow face and straw-coloured hair combed straight back. Head turned to the right, gaze directed straight ahead. Shirt open at the front. Painted with vigorous brushstrokes.

works.d: Esiplaanil haljasala, kus jalutavad inimesed. Taga kõrgub Tallinna vanalinn linnamüüri tornide ja majadega. Vasakule jääb Oleviste kirik.
works.de: In the foreground a green area where people are walking. Behind it rises Tallinn's Old Town with the towers and houses of the town wall. To the left is St. Olaf's Church.

works.d: Esiplaanil ridastikku diagonaalis paremalt raagus puud, mis lõikavad ülaserva. Tagapool tara, inimfiguurid ja ülaservaga lõikuvad majad.
works.de: In the foreground, bare trees in a row diagonally from the right, cutting the upper edge. Behind them a fence, human figures and houses cutting the upper edge.

works.d: Kõrgete kallaste vahel voolav kivise sängiga jõgi. Vasakul servas kaheksa hobust. Paremal kaldaserv lehtpuudega ja põõsastega.
works.de: A river with a stony bed flowing between high banks. On the left edge eight horses. On the right the bank edge with deciduous trees and bushes.

works.d: Esiplaanil, merel, paat aerutava naise ja võrke paati tõmbava mehega. Eemal teisi paate ja rannariba.
works.de: In the foreground, at sea, a boat with a woman rowing and a man pulling nets into the boat. In the distance other boats and a shoreline.

works.d: Esiplaanil osa laevast, tekil kolm meest, neist parempoolseimal käes köis.
works.de: In the foreground part of a ship, on deck three men, the rightmost holding a rope.

works.d: Kalapaat kolme mehega. Neist kaks võrke välja tõmbamas, üks aerutamas.
works.de: A fishing boat with three men. Two of them pulling out nets, one rowing.

works.d: Esiplaanil kõrgendikul männid, tagapool metsad ja järveserv, taevas pilved.
works.de: In the foreground, pines on a rise, forests and the lakeshore behind, clouds in the sky.

works.d: Esiplaanil liivane nõlvak üksikute puuvõsudega. Vasakul rohupuhmad. Tagaplaanil tumeroheliste mändidega kaetud madalad künkad. Vasakul peale mändide mõned kased. Taevas kollakates-lillakates toonides.
works.de: In the foreground a sandy slope with solitary shrubs. On the left tufts of grass. In the background low hills covered with dark green pines. On the left, beyond the pines, a few birches. Sky in yellowish-purplish tones.

works.d: Kaks halli kala pruunil laual, milledest esimene katki lõigatud ja punane mari paistab. Tagapool kauss.
works.de: Two grey fish on a brown table, the first of which is cut open and a red roe can be seen. Behind, a bowl.

works.d: Esiplaanil diagonaalselt paremalt vasakule näha osa laeva pardast kahe mastiga. Paremal üks mees ja vasakul kaks meest purjeid üles tõmbamas. Paremal meri. Kõrge horisont.
works.de: In the foreground diagonally from right to left part of a ship's side with two masts is visible. At right one man and at left two men hoisting the sails. At right the sea. High horizon.

works.d: Diagonaalselt vasakult paremale sõitev paat kümne mehega. Paremal ülanurgas näha tükk punakat
works.de: A boat with ten men sailing diagonally from left to right. In the upper right corner a piece of reddish [is visible].

works.d: Esiplaanil tänaval, paralleelselt tornide reaga, ruttavad inimesed. Vasakul seisvate autode tagant, vanade puumajade tagant, paistab elektrijaama korsten, keskel Oleviste kiriku torn.
works.de: In the foreground on the street, parallel to a row of towers, people are hurrying. Behind the parked cars on the left, behind old wooden houses, the chimney of a power plant is visible, in the middle the tower of St Olaf's Church.

works.d: Keskel tahasuunduv tee, millel liikumas sõdureid ja veokeid.
works.de: In the middle a road receding into the distance, with soldiers and trucks moving on it.

works.d: Rutja. Esiplaanil kivise kaldaga jõgi. Paremalt maanteetamm ja sillapostide rida suunaga metsa poole. Kaugemal männimets, põõsastik. Metsa ja kalda vahelisel maaribal inimesed heina rõngu panemas. Taevas süngelt pilves.
works.de: Rutja. In the foreground a river with a stony bank. On the right a roadway embankment and a row of bridge posts leading towards the forest. Further away a pine forest, shrubbery. On the strip of land between the forest and the bank people making hay bundles. The sky darkly overcast.

works.d: Esiplaanil liivaselt rohtunud rannalt vaade vahutavate lainetega merele. Vasakul tuulest painduvate okstega puude vahel võrke kandvad mehed ja paat. Paremal puud.
works.de: In the foreground a view from a sandy, grassy shore to the sea with foaming waves. On the left, among trees with branches bending in the wind, men carrying nets and a boat. Trees on the right.

works.d: Esiplaanil diagonaalselt vasakult paremale lahtiaetud kartulivagude kohale kummardunud inimfiguurid. Keskel hobune kastiga, selle ees kartuleid noppiv mees. Paremal poolik kartulikuhi, selle juures korvi tühjendav mees, kummarduv naine. Kaugemal kollendavad põllud ja puud.
works.de: In the foreground, diagonally from left to right, human figures bent over opened potato furrows. In the middle a horse with a cart, in front of it a man picking potatoes. On the right a partial pile of potatoes, next to it a man emptying a basket, a bending woman. In the distance yellowing fields and trees.

works.d: Esiplaanil põld, tagapool paistab mets.
works.de: A field in the foreground, a forest visible behind.

works.d: Esiplaanil vaataja suunas voolav oja jäätükkidega. Kallastel tükati lund. Tagaplaanil segamets kuuskedega, mis varjab silmapiiri.
works.de: In the foreground a stream flowing towards the viewer with pieces of ice. On the banks patches of snow. In the background a mixed forest with spruces obscuring the horizon.

works.d: Esiplaanil väike riba kallast ja jõgi paatidega. Paremal meri ja eemalt paistev Tallinna siluett. Vasakul lipumast punase lipuga ja hooned ning puud.
works.de: In the foreground a small strip of shore and a river with boats. On the right the sea and, visible from a distance, the silhouette of Tallinn. On the left a flagpole with a red flag, and buildings and trees.

works.d: Jõeorg kõrgete kallastega vasakul ja parema, millel mets. Esiplaanil vasakul madalal luhal lehmad söömas. Paremal jõele ehitatud tamm.
works.de: River valley with high banks on the left and on the right, the latter with forest. In the foreground on the left, on a low water-meadow, cows grazing. On the right a dam built on the river.

works.d: Suur järv rohkete saartega. Paremal kallas kõrgete kaljurahnudega, millel kasvamas üksikud männid. Samuti vasakul kaljune kallas mändide ja kaskedega. Kõrge silmapiir. Järvel laev palgiparvega.
works.de: A large lake with numerous islands. On the right a shore with tall boulder rocks, on which single pine trees are growing. Likewise on the left a rocky shore with pines and birches. High horizon. On the lake a ship with a log raft.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal mägisel maastikul kivide vahel valged kitsed. Sellest vasakul üksikute puudega mägi. Tagaplaanil kõrged mäed, mille tipud ulatuvad pilvedesse.
works.de: In the foreground on the right, white goats among rocks on a mountainous landscape. To the left of it, a mountain with solitary trees. In the background, high mountains whose peaks reach into the clouds.

works.d: Esiplaanil oja, mille kaldal vasakul spinninguga õngitsev mees, seisvas asendis, profiilis paremale. Oja käänaku kohal üksik suur kivi vees. Parempoolne tõusev kallas kaetud tiheda põõsastikuga. Maali keskosas teisel pool kallast küün. Pilvine taevas.
works.de: In the foreground, a stream, on whose bank on the left a man is fishing with a spinning rod, standing, in profile to the right. Above a bend in the stream, a single large stone in the water. The rising bank on the right is covered with dense bushes. In the middle part of the painting, on the other side of the bank, a barn. Cloudy sky.

works.d: Lumise maastiku keskel tee, viis last. Paremal, metsatukk. Taga vasakul hooned. Piki teed vasakul telefonipost.
works.de: In the middle of a snowy landscape a road, five children. On the right a small patch of forest. In the background on the left buildings. Along the road on the left a telephone pole.

works.d: Ees vasakul kahe suure kivi vahel kolm last tule juures. Kaugemal keskelt paremale must-valget tõugu kari metsa ääres söömas. Pilvine taevas.
works.de: In the foreground on the left, between two large stones, three children by a fire. Further away, from the centre to the right, a black-and-white herd grazing by the edge of a forest. Cloudy sky.

works.d: Esiplaanil niitmata, tagapool niidetud põld. Põldude  keskel, pildi keskel tumeroheline põõsas. Taustal üksikuid puid ja hooneid. Nende taga mets. Kõrge hallikas taevas.
works.de: In the foreground an unmown field, behind it a mown field. In the middle of the fields, in the middle of the picture, a dark green bush. In the background solitary trees and buildings. Behind them a forest. A high, greyish sky.

works.d: Esiplaanil kahe laudsilla vahel veekogu. Vasakul silla lähedal kalapaat kaluriga. Temast vasakul seisab sillal mees, käes kalavõrk. Kaldal, kahe silla vahel, mootorpaat. Taamal kolme kuuri juures inimesed askeldamas. Taevas pilvine.
works.de: In the foreground a body of water between two plank bridges. On the left, near the bridge, a fishing boat with a fisherman. To his left a man stands on the bridge, holding a fishing net. On the shore, between the two bridges, a motorboat. Further off, people busy near three sheds. Cloudy sky.

works.d: Vasakul keskaegsete majade taga, Tallinna raekoja punane katus torniga. Majade taga vasakul Pühavaimu kiriku torn. Esiplaanil Harju väljak jalutajatega.
works.de: On the left, behind medieval houses, the red roof with tower of Tallinn Town Hall. Behind the houses on the left the tower of the Church of the Holy Spirit. In the foreground Harju Square with strollers.

works.d: Peaaegu maali keskel oleva palkidest ehitatud, rohelise loosungiga ehitud värava taga paremal, keset veiste karja, askeldamas neljast inimesest koosev grupp. Nende taga paremal ajavad kaks naist kaht lehma (üks punane, teine valge) sindlikatusega kivilauta. Värava taga vasakul selgvaates sinise rätikuga naine ja tema kõrval vasakul lehm. Värava ees vasakul, raagus kase all, kaks tütarlast lüpsikutega. Paremal veab naine kettipidi lehma. Lehmast paremal kaabuga mees, piibuga paremas käes. Nende taga näha osaliselt punast lehma, valget hobust, kelle päitseid hoiab mõlema käega kinni nokkmütsiga mees. Taamal männiokste varjus, heinakuhja otsas, tõstavad kaks meest heina lakka. Heina võtab lakas
works.de: Almost in the middle of the painting, behind a gate built of logs and decorated with a green slogan banner, on the right, amid a herd of cattle, a group of four people busy at work. Behind them on the right two women are driving two cows (one red, the other white) toward a stone barn with a shingle roof. Behind the gate on the left, in full view, a woman with a blue kerchief, and beside her on the left a cow. In front of the gate on the left, under a bare birch, two girls with milk pails. On the right a woman is leading a cow by a chain. To the right of the cow a man in a hat, with a pipe in his right hand. Behind them a red cow is partly visible, as well as a white horse whose halter is held with both hands by a man in a peaked cap. In the distance, in the shade of pine branches, on top of a haystack, two men are lifting hay onto the stack. Hay is being taken on the stack

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal kaares tahapoole suunduva süvendamisel oleva oja (või magistraalkraavi) kummalgi kaldal ekskavaator töös, parempoolsel kopp alla lastud, vasakpoolsel üleval. Vasakul kaldal kuus inimfiguuri, neist üks naine, kellede olekust ilmneb seotust tööprotsessiga - käes plaan, mille järgi uuritakse ümbrust. Üks töömees labidaga, teine teiba ja kirvega. Tagapool vesine madalik hõredate puudega.
works.de: In the foreground on the right, on both banks of a stream (or main drainage ditch) being deepened and curving backward, an excavator is at work, on the right one with its bucket lowered, on the left one raised. On the left bank six human figures, one of them a woman, whose actions show they are involved in the work process - one holds a plan, according to which the surroundings are being examined. One workman with a shovel, another with a pole and an axe. Further back a watery lowland with sparse trees.

works.d: All paremast nurgast diagonaalselt keskele suunduv katus, millest vasemal varemeis linn. Tagaplaanil paistab Tallinna raekoja torn, sellest vasakul Pühavaimu kiriku torni kiiver ja paremal Oleviste torn.
works.de: A roof running diagonally from the lower right corner to the centre, to the left of which a ruined town. In the background the tower of Tallinn Town Hall is visible, to its left the spire of the Church of the Holy Spirit and to the right the tower of St. Olaf's Church.

works.d: Esialal vasakul rannaliival suuri lõhesid ja suuri kalakaste. Keskel kaldale uhutud kalapaat täis kalu. Paadi juures askeldamas mehi ja naisi. Tagapool vasakul täidetud kalakastide taga, kuivanud võrke, paremal paadisillal kalapüügi vahendeid, sillast tagapool asetsevat paati tõmbab mees merre tõmbamas. Taga vasakul metsane rand ja paremal avameri.
works.de: In the foreground on the left, on the beach sand, large salmon and large fish crates. In the middle, a fishing boat full of fish washed up on the shore. Men and women busying themselves by the boat. Further back on the left, behind filled fish crates, dried nets; on the right on a jetty, fishing implements; behind the jetty a man is pulling a boat into the sea. Further back on the left a forested shore and on the right the open sea.

works.d: Hoonete keskel vasakul kõrge torn, paremal teistest hoonetest kõrgemale tõusev kuppelkatusega torniga ehitus.
works.de: Among the buildings, on the left a tall tower, on the right a structure with a domed-roof tower rising higher than the other buildings.

works.d: Ees paremal mees kaamliga ja kolm ratsurit eeslitel, vasakul mees eeslil. Keskel loss, lossi sissekäik kahe tornitaolise ehituse vahel.
works.de: In front on the right a man with a camel and three riders on donkeys, on the left a man on a donkey. In the middle a castle, the castle entrance between two tower-like structures.

works.d: Kivine rannik. Vasakul maalipoolel: ees kaks mängivat last, grupp mehi nendes üks ajalehte ette lugemas. Tagapoolt paistab tükike merd, kaldal üksik mänd, inimfiguure. Keskel kaldale tõmmatud paate. Paremal: tagaplaanil majade grupp, ees ristpuudele riputatud esemeid, inimfiguure. Taevas rahutuis pilveis.
works.de: A rocky coast. On the left side of the painting: in front two children playing, a group of men, one of them reading a newspaper aloud to the others. Behind, a piece of sea is visible, on the shore a solitary pine, human figures. In the middle, boats pulled up onto the shore. On the right: in the background a group of houses, in front objects hung on crossbars, human figures. Sky with restless clouds.

works.d: Ees mereäärsel rannikul kolm harkidega meest ja naine. Nende taga hobune reega. Paremal vee ääres kaks inimfiguuri. Taamal sügavsinine meri.
works.de: In front on a seaside coast three men with pitchforks and a woman. Behind them a horse with a sledge. On the right by the water two human figures. In the distance a deep blue sea.

works.d: Ees vasakul eesti talupoja riietuses mees sarve puhumas. Tema taga mees odaga. Paremal suurte okaspuude all grupp odadega varustatud mehi.
works.de: In front on the left a man in Estonian peasant dress blowing a horn. Behind him a man with a spear. On the right, under large conifers, a group of men equipped with spears.

works.d: Ees paremal ristleja külg linnapoole suunatud kahuritorudega. Taga vasakul laevu, paremal linn (Tallinn).
works.de: In front on the right, a cruiser's side with cannon barrels aimed towards the town. In the back on the left, ships, on the right the town (Tallinn).

works.d: Esiplaanil keskel tütarlapse laip, vasakul taluhoone ees kolm mundris ja üks tsiviilrõivastuses fašist. Paremal seljataha seotud kätega mehe taga okupantide sõdur laskevalmis revolvriga käes.
works.de: In the centre foreground the corpse of a girl, on the left in front of a farmhouse three fascists in uniform and one in civilian clothing. On the right, behind a man with hands bound behind his back, an occupying soldier with a revolver at the ready.

works.d: Esiplaanil eesti sõjameeste ja hobuse laibad. Ees paremal ülestõstetud rusikaga maas istuva naise figuur. Taga paremal põlevad varemed, vasakul lahkuvate ordulaste grupp.
works.de: In the foreground, the corpses of Estonian soldiers and a horse. In front, on the right, the figure of a woman sitting on the ground with a raised fist. Behind on the right burning ruins, on the left a group of departing Knights of the Order.

works.d: Vasakul mändide all kaks lehma, paremal raiutud puid. Taga mets.
works.de: On the left under pines two cows, on the right felled trees. Forest behind.

works.d: Esiplaanil jõe kaldal istuv mees õngitsemas. Tema taga seisev naine. Pildi keskosas lehtpuude vahelt avaneb vaade metsamaastikule.
works.de: In the foreground a man sitting on the riverbank fishing. A woman standing behind him. In the middle of the picture a view of the forest landscape opens between deciduous trees.

works.d: Pikajuukseline blond naisakt külgvaates kollasetriibulisel kušetil  istumas, kuivatuslina kätel, pesukauss ees põrandal. Ümbritseb tubane interjöör: paremal kollane kapp, ümar lauake vaasiga, taga roosatriibuline sirm, vasakul rohekad kardinad. Pastelsed roosad-rohelised toonid, valgus-varjuga modelleeriv maalilaad.
works.de: A long-haired blonde female nude in side view, sitting on a yellow-striped chaise longue, a towel in her hands, a washbasin in front on the floor. Surrounded by an indoor interior: on the right a yellow cabinet, a round little table with a vase, behind it a pink-striped screen, on the left greenish curtains. Pastel pink-green tones, a painting style modelling with light and shadow.

works.d: Pastelsetes toonides sfäärilised kujundid mustja lõikejoone ja -pinnaga ruumilise mõjuga kompositsiooniks põimitud. Vasakus ülemises neljandikus, aimataval silmapiiril punaka viilkatusega hele maja perspektiivis nähtuna.
works.de: Spherical forms in pastel tones interwoven into a composition with a spatial effect through blackish cutting lines and surfaces. In the upper left quarter, on a discernible horizon, a bright house with a reddish gable roof is seen in perspective.

works.d: Ruumilise mõjuga värvikas kompositsioon, valdavalt rohekassinistest, kollakaist sfäärilistest, koonilistest üksteisesse rulluvatest ja lõikuvatest kujunditest.
works.de: A spatially effective, colourful composition, predominantly of greenish-blue, yellowish spherical and conical shapes rolling into and intersecting one another.

works.d: Stiliseerivas laadis kujutatud otsevaates istuva noore naise kolmveerandfiguur. Näoovaali ümbritseb tumedate pikkade juuste kaar, sama vormi kordab foonil olev ukseorva motiiv. Noorikul seljas punane lühikeste käistega pluus, kaeluses valge krae paistmas, ja sinine seelik. Üks käsi toetub istmele, teine kõverdatult ees. Taustal sinakashallid mustjassinised selgepiirilised pinnad.
works.de: A stylised, three-quarter-length figure of a young woman shown seated, facing frontally. Her oval face is framed by an arc of dark long hair, the same shape being echoed in the background by a doorway motif. The young woman wears a red short-sleeved blouse, with a white collar showing at the neckline, and a blue skirt. One hand rests on the seat, the other, bent, in front. In the background, bluish-grey, blackish-blue clearly outlined areas.

works.d: Stiliseeritud kupliline maastik veekoguga paremal, vasakul katusevill, üksikud arvatavad puud. Küpsed kollakaspruunid, roosakad, sinakasrohelised sfäärilised ja koonilised vormid põimuvad üksteisega.
works.de: Stylised domed landscape with a body of water on the right, on the left a roof ridge, a few presumed trees. Ripe yellowish-brown, pinkish, bluish-green spherical and conical forms intertwine with one another.

works.d: Keskel kahel helesinisel padjal lamav noor naine. Naisel mahagonikarva juuksed, selga paljaks jättev roosa-mustakirju kleit, jalad risti, käed põlvedel, vasakus käes punaste kaantega raamat, pilk suunatud vaatajale. Voodi ees ümmargune madal laud, millel pruun sangaga keraamiline nõu. Foon läbi maalitud tihedate pintslilöökidega, valdavalt sinakashallides toonides.
works.de: In the centre, a young woman lying on two light blue pillows. The woman has mahogany-coloured hair, wears a pink-and-black patterned dress that leaves her back bare, legs crossed, hands on knees, in her left hand a book with red covers, gaze directed at the viewer. In front of the bed a round low table on which a brown ceramic vessel with a handle. The background is painted through with dense brushstrokes, mainly in bluish-grey tones.

works.d: Õhtuse kohviku interjöör, ümmarguste, valge linaga kaetud laudade taga seltskonnad. Esiplaanis tumerohelises, vöötatud kleidis, mustas kübaras, pruunide juustega daam, näoga vaataja poole. Pooleldi tema selja taga, paremal, lillakaspunases kleidis, valge tanu ja kandikuga ettekandja. Vasakul all paistab osa lauast, millel kõhukas napsipudel ja laua taga istuja vasak käsi klaasiga. Taamal vasakul istub laua taga roosas ja kollases kleidis daamidest ning sinises ülikonnas härrast koosnev seltskond. Foonil, hallikassinisel seinal kaks seinalampi.
works.de: Interior of an evening café, groups of people at round tables covered with white cloths. In the foreground, a lady with brown hair, in a dark green striped dress and black hat, her face turned toward the viewer. Half behind her, on the right, a waitress in a purplish-red dress with a white cap and a tray. At lower left part of a table is visible, on which stands a squat little bottle of spirits, and the left hand, holding a glass, of the person sitting at the table. In the background at left, at a table, sits a company consisting of ladies in pink and yellow dresses and a gentleman in a blue suit. In the background, on a greyish-blue wall, two wall lamps.

works.d: Kolmest osast koosnev suurema kompositsiooni kavand.
works.de: Sketch for a larger composition consisting of three parts.

works.d: Kumeratest, otsekui kerast väljalõigatud tükkidest koosnev abstraktne kompositsioon. Valdavalt lillades, punastes ja kollastes toonides, otsekui hõõguvates värvides.
works.de: Abstract composition consisting of curved pieces, as if cut out of a sphere. Predominantly in shades of purple, red and yellow, as if in glowing colours.

works.d: Peamiselt sinakashallides toonides figuraalne kompositsioon: keskel paremal must, heleda lakaga hobune ja hall varss. Neist vasakul triibulises särgis ja pruunis kuues mees hoiab tumepruuni hobuse suitsetest, ise näoga vaataja poole. Tagapool, palja ülakeha ja siniste pükstega mees, kaabu peas, seljaga vaataja poole, hoiab suitsetest helehalli hobust. All paremas nurgas istub kivil piipu popsutav noor mees, tema kõrval paistab osa seisvast mehefiguurist. Taamal hall meri paadiga, ülal roosa taevas.
works.de: A figural composition mainly in bluish-grey tones: in the centre right, a black horse with a light mane and a grey foal. To their left, a man in a striped shirt and brown coat holds the reins of a dark brown horse, facing the viewer. Further back, a bare-chested man in blue trousers and a hat, with his back to the viewer, holds the reins of a light grey horse. In the lower right corner, a young man sits on a rock smoking a pipe; beside him part of a standing male figure is visible. In the distance, a grey sea with a boat, above it a pink sky.

works.d: Keskel, suures kollases tugitoolis, istub kollaste sirgete juustega naine, mõlemad käed toolileenil puhkamas. Naisel seljas helesinine, ülalt mustade triipude, seelikuosas mustade täppidega kleit. Foonil, otse naise selja taga roheline nelinurk, ülejäänud foon mitut tooni lilla. Kohati vormi musta kontuuriga rõhutatud.
works.de: In the middle, in a large yellow armchair, sits a woman with yellow straight hair, both hands resting on the arms of the chair. The woman is wearing a light blue dress with black stripes at the top and black dots on the skirt part. In the background, directly behind the woman's back, a green rectangle, the rest of the background in several shades of purple. In places the form is emphasised with a black contour.

works.d: Peenemustrilises, mustades-valgetes toonides kleidis priskete roosade käsivartega noor  naine diivanil istumas. Naisel pikk sirge nina, pisut viltused silmad ja pikad tumepruunid juuksed. Naisel süles must kass. Foon ülaosas halliruuduline, all helesinine. Maalitud peene pintsliga.
works.de: A young woman in a finely patterned black-and-white dress with plump pink arms sitting on a sofa. The woman has a long straight nose, slightly slanted eyes and long dark brown hair. On the woman's lap a black cat. The background is grey-checked at the top, light blue below. Painted with a fine brush.

works.d: Kompositsiooni keskpunktis teineteist embavad mees ja naine. Mehel seljas must ülikond, naisel veinpunane kleit. Fooniks olevas interjööris, armastajapaarist paremal, valge lina, pudelite ja karahvinidega täidetud laud. Laua kohal seinal kübaraga daami portree. Figuuridest vasakul voodi,  viimase taga raadio ning kirjude lillade kardinatega piiratud aken. Interjööris palju valgust ja helke.
works.de: At the centre of the composition a man and a woman embracing each other. The man wears a black suit, the woman a wine-red dress. In the background interior, to the right of the pair of lovers, a table with a white cloth, covered with bottles and carafes. Above the table on the wall a portrait of a lady with a hat. To the left of the figures a bed, behind it a radio and a window bordered with colourful lilac curtains. The interior is full of light and reflections.

works.d: Hallikasrohelisel foonil noore, tumedajuukselise neiu büst. Neiul pikad lokkis juuksed, punakas kübar, triibulise rinnaesisega, täpiliste varrukatega hall kleit. Vaade silmanurgast. Valgust ja helke üle kogu figuuri.
works.de: On a greyish-green background, the bust of a young, dark-haired girl. The girl has long curly hair, a reddish hat, a grey dress with a striped front and dotted sleeves. Viewed from the corner of the eye. Light and reflections over the whole figure.

works.d: Ülaltvaade hilissuvistele rannaäärsetele, roigasaedadega piiratud põllusiirule. Mere pool vasakul rukkihakid, üksikud puud vee piiril, rannal paate. Helesinise, pilvevines taeva all meretriip, silmapiiril laeva siluett. Õhuline skitseeriv maalilaad.
works.de: Bird's-eye view of a late-summer field by the seashore, enclosed by pole fences. On the sea side to the left, sheaves of rye, single trees at the water's edge, boats on the shore. Under a pale blue, cloudy-hazy sky a strip of sea, the silhouette of a ship on the horizon. Airy, sketch-like painting style.

works.d: Paremas servas istub tumedal toolil blond, käharate juustega noor naine, seljas helesinine lühikeste varrukatega pluus ja lilleline pihikseelik, käed süles vaheliti, pilk suunatud naise ees olevale, vaataja poole seljaga seisvale, poisile. Poisil heledad lühikesed juuksed, seljas sinine pluus ja pruuni traksidega püksid. Vasakul on pruuni ja halliga markeeritud toahämarus.
works.de: On the right edge sits a blonde, curly-haired young woman on a dark chair, wearing a light blue short-sleeved blouse and a floral pinafore skirt, her hands folded in her lap, her gaze directed at the boy in front of her, who stands with his back to the viewer. The boy has light short hair, wears a blue blouse and brown trousers with braces. On the left the twilight of the room is marked in brown and grey.

works.d: Madala horisondiga rannavaade: esiplaanil liivane rand, vasakul mõned pruunid paadid, paremal allservas kaldale uhutud paat. Keset liiva seisab oranžis pearätikus, rohekas pluusis ja tumepruunis seelikus naine, seljaga vaataja poole, aer käes. Taamal paremal üksik vahutavasse kaldavette lükatud paat. Silmapiiril tumesinine mereviirg, ülal hele, kõrge, kohati hallikate ja roosade pilvedega kaetud taevas.
works.de: A low-horizon coastal view: in the foreground a sandy beach, on the left a few brown boats, at the bottom right a boat washed ashore. In the middle of the sand stands a woman with an oar in her hand, wearing an orange headscarf, a greenish blouse and a dark brown skirt, with her back to the viewer. In the background on the right a solitary boat pushed into the foaming water at the shore. On the horizon a dark blue strip of sea, above a bright, high sky, in places covered with greyish and pink clouds.

works.d: Neljakandilisel laual valgusega ülekallatud esemed: esiplaanil hallikas taldrik, mille taga vasakul roosa tass ja värviliste  puuviljadega täidetud kauss. Tassi taga kaks tumesinist pudelit. Seadeldise taga aken, aknalaud ja lillakasroosa kardin. Kohati maalitud pisikeste säpsivate pintslilöökidega.
works.de: On a square table, objects bathed in light: in the foreground a greyish plate, behind it to the left a pink cup and a bowl filled with colourful fruit. Behind the cup, two dark blue bottles. Behind the arrangement, a window, windowsill and a lilac-pink curtain. Painted in places with small, brisk brushstrokes.

works.d: Lillakaspunaste draperiidega kaetud alusele nõjatuv naisakt: alakeha vaataja suunas, ülakeha pööratud vasakule, toetub taha küünarvartele, pea kallutatud vasakule alla. Hoogne skitseeriv maalilaad, keha heledatele kontrastiks tausta tumedad hallikaspruunid toonid.
works.de: A female nude leaning against a base covered with purplish-red drapery: lower body towards the viewer, upper body turned to the left, resting back on the forearms, head tilted down to the left. Vigorous sketch-like painting manner, contrasting with the light body dark greyish-brown tones of the background.

works.d: Üle kogu pildipinna majade viilkatused. Vasakul ülal servas paistab veekogu, kaldal kaks inimfiguuri. Kontuurid musta värviga tugevalt rõhutatud.
works.de: Gabled rooftops of houses cover the entire picture surface. In the upper left corner a body of water is visible, with two human figures on the shore. Contours strongly emphasized with black colour.

works.d: Kivine mererand kadakate ja murdunud puutüvega. Meri külmades rohelistes toonides.
works.de: Rocky sea shore with junipers and a broken tree trunk. The sea in cold green tones.

works.d: Heledapäine naine rohekassinises kleidis ja tumedapäine naine lillas kleidis vaatavad punasekaanelist ajakirja. Foon sinavates, rohekates ja kollakates toonides.
works.de: A fair-haired woman in a greenish-blue dress and a dark-haired woman in a lilac dress are looking at a magazine with a red cover. The background in bluish, greenish and yellowish tones.

works.d: Suvises maastikus kolm inimest raudteerööbaste juures. Esiplaanil naise ja mehe kolmveerand-figuurid en face, paremal naise figuur profiilis paremale.
works.de: In a summer landscape three people near railway tracks. In the foreground three-quarter figures of a woman and a man en face, on the right a woman's figure in profile to the right.

works.d: Tänava vaade üksikute jalakäijatega. Esiplaanil keskel tunkedes mees, elektripuuriga töötamas.
works.de: A street view with a few pedestrians. In the foreground, in the center, a man in overalls working with an electric drill.

works.d: Malelaua-ruudulisel põrandal ümmargune laud. Sellel kaks pudelit, vaas puuviljadega, valge riie ja üks apelsin.
works.de: On a chessboard-patterned floor a round table. On it two bottles, a vase with fruit, a white cloth and an orange.

works.d: Laual paremal pool valge kann, pudel, vaas ja kaks sidrunit. Vasakul heledal draperiil taldrik puuviljadega. Esemed musta kontuuriga piiratud.
works.de: On the table on the right a white jug, bottle, vase and two lemons. On the left, on a light drapery, a plate with fruit. Objects outlined in black contour.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul kaks laudseinale naelutatud kala, paremal laudhoone nurk. Keskelt paistab rand paatidega ja veekogu.
works.de: In the foreground on the left two fish nailed to a plank wall, on the right the corner of a plank building. In the middle the shore with boats and a body of water is visible.

works.d: Esiplaanil sinakas-rohekas virvendav veepind. Veepinnal paat kolme inimesega. Veekogu taga liivane rand majadega. Taamal mets. Üle metsa paistavad kolm kõrget suitsevat korstent ja paremal tööstushooned. Taevas sinine valgete pilvedega. Toonitatud kontuur.
works.de: In the foreground a bluish-green shimmering water surface. On the water a boat with three people. Beyond the body of water a sandy shore with houses. In the distance a forest. Above the forest three tall smoking chimneys are visible and on the right industrial buildings. The sky is blue with white clouds. Tinted contour.

works.d: Diagonaalselt paremalt vasakule suunduv kivine merekallas. Paremal üksik puu. Vasakul kaldale tõmmatud punane paat. Taeval üksik valge pilv.
works.de: A rocky sea shore running diagonally from right to left. On the right a single tree. On the left a red boat pulled up on the shore. A single white cloud in the sky.

works.d: Lage mererand. Esiplaanil teivasaed ja madalad kadakapõõsad. Tagapool vasakul üksik kuur. Eemal meri.
works.de: Open seashore. In the foreground a stake fence and low juniper bushes. Behind on the left a single shed. In the distance the sea.

works.d: Lagendik metsaserval, mille keskel ilma tiibadeta pukktuulik.
works.de: A clearing at the forest edge, in the middle of which a wingless post mill.

works.d: Esiplaanil seisev naine mannergust joomas. Vasakul istuv grupp, mehel lõõtspill. Paremal töötavaid inimesi.
works.de: Woman standing in the foreground drinking from a tankard. On the left a seated group, a man with an accordion. On the right people working.

works.d: Maastik rohtukasvanud veekoguga esiplaanil. Paremal paistab puude seest talumaja katus vasakul põõsas ja paat ühe selgvaates inimfiguuriga.
works.de: Landscape with a grass-grown body of water in the foreground. On the right, the roof of a farmhouse is visible through the trees; on the left a bush and a boat with one figure seen in profile.

works.t: Pastor Arnold Friedrich Johann Knüpfferi portree
works.d: Hallide käharate juustega mehe rindportree poolprofiilis paremale. Seljas oleval luteri vaimuliku ametikuuel valge kaelus ja kaks kaelaskantavat risti, neist üks pika metall-kee küljes, teine, kõrgemal asetsev, must-punase lindi küljes.
works.de: A bust portrait of a man with grey curly hair, in three-quarter profile to the right. On the clerical robe of a Lutheran clergyman a white collar and two crosses worn around the neck, one of them on a long metal chain, the other, positioned higher, on a black-and-red ribbon.

works.d: Esiplaanil keskel seljaga vaataja poole seisev mees, paremal puude vahelt nähtav majakatus,  taga järv ja vaade maastikule.
works.de: In the foreground centre a man standing with his back to the viewer, on the right a house roof visible through the trees, behind it a lake and a view of the landscape.

works.d: Esialal virvendaval merepinnal keskel paat kahe sõudjaga, kaugemal purjekaid. Üle vee paistab kogu pildi laiust haaravalt Tallinna panoraam. Kergelt pilvitatud taeva taustal lendavate lindude parv.
works.de: On the shimmering surface of the sea in the foreground a boat with two rowers, further away sailing boats. Across the water, spanning the entire width of the picture, a panorama of Tallinn is visible. Against a slightly clouded sky a flock of flying birds.

works.dm: lehe laius: 12.5 cm; lehe kõrgus: 15.2 cm
works.d: Keskealise ümmarguse näoga mehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis vasakule. Seljas sinakasmust kuub. Foon tumehall.
works.de: Bust portrait of a middle-aged, round-faced man in half-profile facing left. Wearing a dark bluish-black coat. Background dark grey.

works.d: Esialal pargivaade, künkal Haapsalu linnuse varemed, mis osaliselt nähtavad ka keskel ja paremal pargi puude vahelt.
works.de: Foreground park view, on a hill the ruins of Haapsalu Castle, which are also partially visible in the centre and on the right through the park trees.

works.dm: lehe laius: 50.1 cm; lehe kõrgus: 21.6 cm
works.d: Ees paremal madal kivine rannariba üksikute kidurate mändidega, kaugemal kuusik. Vasakul kuni silmapiirini ulatuv meri, kaldaäärne kividerohke, üksiku lootsikuga.
works.de: In the foreground on the right a low stony strip of coast with scattered stunted pines, further away a spruce grove. On the left the sea extending to the horizon, the shoreline stony, with a single boat.

works.dm: lehe laius: 32.9 cm; lehe kõrgus: 17.5 cm
works.d: Esiplaanil Pezoldi maja õu kahe joova hobusega. Taga aiad põõsaste ja puudega, üle puude näha maja katuseid. Taga vasakul kõrgendikul Rakvere linnuse varemed.
works.de: In the foreground the courtyard of the Pezold house with two trotting horses. Behind, gardens with bushes and trees, above the trees the roofs of the house can be seen. In the background on the left, on a height, the ruins of Rakvere Castle.

works.d: Esiplaanil lehtpuude latvu ja mets, taga vasakul Tallinna panoraam, paremal meri.
works.de: In the foreground treetops of deciduous trees and forest, behind on the left a panorama of Tallinn, sea on the right.

works.d: Vaade ülalt kõrgelt kaldalt merele. Ees vasakul üksiku kuuse juures selgvaates mees. Paremal kuuskede grupp. Taamal meri.
works.de: View from a high shore down onto the sea. In front on the left, by a solitary spruce, a man seen clearly. On the right a group of spruces. In the distance, the sea.

works.d: Mehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale, lühikesed vurrud, tumedad juuksed langusega paremale pool. Seljas must kuub, kaelas must eest seotud kaelaside. Valge rinnaesine kahe musta nööbiga ja värvipaelaga (sinine, violetne, valge) Taust pruunikashall.
works.de: Bust portrait of a man in half-profile to the right, short moustache, dark hair falling to the right. Wearing a black coat, a black cravat tied at the front around the neck. White shirt front with two black buttons and a coloured ribbon (blue, violet, white). Background brownish-grey.

works.d: Valges lõua alt sõlmitud tanuga vanema naise rinnapilt peaaegu en face. Seljas valge kraega tumeroheline rüü.
works.de: A bust portrait of an older woman wearing a white bonnet tied under the chin, almost en face. Wearing a dark green robe with a white collar.

works.d: Käed rüpes toolil istuv noor naine poolprofiilis vasakule. Soeng kahe käharrulliga ülalpool kõrva, mõlemal pool keskel olevast (?) lahku. Seljas tume maani ulatuv kleit, mille pihiku osa lõpeb ees nurgaga. Kleidil valge poole rinnani ulatuv ja õlgu kattev krae, mille üle kitsam kahekordne kroogitud krae.
works.de: A young woman sitting on a chair with her hands in her lap, in half-profile to the left. Hairstyle with two curled rolls above the ear, parted on both sides from the middle (?). Wearing a dark dress reaching to the ground, the bodice part of which ends in a point at the front. On the dress a white collar reaching halfway to the chest and covering the shoulders, over which a narrower double gathered collar.

works.d: Mehe rinnapilt, poolprofiilis paremale. Sinine kuub ja aumärk-rist kaelas.
works.de: Bust portrait of a man, in half-profile to the right. Blue coat and a cross-shaped medal on his neck.

works.d: Esiplaanil linnuse varemed, taga keskel paistab üle katuste kirikutorn, paremal rida lehtpuid.
works.de: In the foreground the ruins of a fortress, behind in the center a church tower is visible above the roofs, on the right a row of deciduous trees.

works.dm: lehe laius: 43.3 cm; lehe kõrgus: 28.0 cm
works.d: Ees paremal näha üksikuid  põllu- ja maakivist varemeis müüri ja mäekallakul kasvava lehtpuu-tuka latvu. Vasakul all madal rohtunud järvekallas. Keskel eest vasakult taha paremale laiuv järv. Taamal vasakul vastaskallas põldudega metsaviirg.
works.de: In the foreground on the right, isolated ruined walls of field- and quarry-stone and the tops of a stand of deciduous trees growing on a hillside are visible. At the bottom left, a low, grassy lake shore. In the middle, a lake widening from left to right in the foreground. Beyond, on the left, the opposite shore with fields and a strip of forest.

works.dm: lehe laius: 32.7 cm; lehe kõrgus: 16.0 cm
works.d: Üle lagendiku vaade taga kõrgendiku jalal olevale linnale ja selle tipul olevatele lossivaremetele. Kolmveerandiku tööst moodustab pilvine taevas.
works.de: A view across a clearing to a town in the background on the foot of a rise and, on its summit, castle ruins. Three-quarters of the work is made up of a cloudy sky.

works.d: Vanema mehe rinnapilt en face. Hallid juuksed, must kuub, vest ja kaelasida. Rohekas taust.
works.de: Bust portrait of an older man en face. Grey hair, black coat, waistcoat and cravat. Greenish background.

works.d: Vanema mehe rinnapilt, poolprofiilis paremale. Põskhabe, seljas must kuub ja must kaelaside.
works.de: Bust portrait of an older man, in half-profile to the right. Side-whiskers, wearing a black coat and a black cravat.

works.d: Pikkajuukselise habemiku mehe poolfiguur istuvas asendis pöördega vasakule, seljas must talaar, peas laiaääreline kaabu, vasak käsi toetub toolikorjule.
works.de: Half-figure of a long-haired, bearded man in a seated position turned to the left, wearing a black gown, a wide-brimmed hat on his head, his left hand resting on the back of a chair.

works.d: Vanema tumedajuukselise mehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis vasakule, mustas kõrge kraega kuues, millel kõrge valge kaelus. Kaelas ja rinnal rida ordeneid.
works.de: Bust portrait of an older dark-haired man in half-profile facing left, in a black garment with a high collar, on which a high white collar. On the neck and chest a row of orders.

works.d: Suure puu all istuva noore naise põlvepilt, poolprofiilis vasakule. Seljas suure dekolteega roosa kleit. Vasakus süles lebavas käes kimbuke lilli.
works.de: Knee-length portrait of a young woman sitting under a large tree, in half-profile to the left. Wearing a pink dress with a large décolleté. In her lap, resting in her left hand, a small bunch of flowers.

works.dm: lehe laius: 33.2 cm; lehe kõrgus: 24.0 cm
works.d: Esiplaanil kivine rand üksikute hoonetega ja paremal keskel meri purjekatega ja saartega. Taamal kaldajoon.
works.de: Rocky shore in the foreground with a few isolated buildings, and on the right in the middle the sea with sailboats and islands. Coastline in the distance.

works.d: Noore naise rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale. Sinises kleidis, väikeste kõrvarõngastega.
works.de: Bust portrait of a young woman, half-profile to the right. In a blue dress, with small earrings.

works.d: Keskel punase linaga kaetud laua ümber perekond. Laua taga sohval istuvad isa ja ema, nende ees laual väike tüdruk ja laua kõrval seismas teine. Käsitoel, ema selja taga kolmas. Eespool lauda vasakul toolil istub üliõpilase vormis noormees. Paremal kolm poissi, neist üks koolpoisi vormikuues. Poiste selja taga seismas vana naine.
works.de: In the middle, a family around a table covered with a red cloth. Behind the table, father and mother sit on a sofa, in front of them on the table a small girl and another standing beside the table. On the armrest, behind the mother's back, a third one. In front of the table on the left, a young man in a student's uniform sits on a chair. On the right three boys, one of them in a schoolboy's uniform coat. Behind the boys' backs stands an old woman.

works.t: Pastor Arnold Friedrich Johann Knüpfferi portree
works.d: Pastori talaaris mehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale.
works.de: Breast-length portrait of a man in a pastor's cassock, in half-profile facing right

works.d: Keskealise rohelises ülikonnas mehe kolmveerandfiguur kerges pöördes vasakule, nägu en face. Foonis rohekates, roosakates ja ruugetes toonides sein kolme aknaga.
works.de: A three-quarter figure of a middle-aged man in a green suit, in a slight turn to the left, face en face. In the background, a wall with three windows in greenish, pinkish and brownish tones.

works.d: Erksates toonides natüürmort avatud akna juures. Sinises vaasis kimp lilli, samas valge alustass apelsiniga.
works.de: A still life in bright tones by an open window. A bouquet of flowers in a blue vase, next to it a white saucer with an orange.

works.d: Keskaegse linna vaade kuldfoonil. Esiplaanil kaks ümarat puud ja tiiger.
works.de: View of a medieval town on a golden background. In the foreground two round trees and a tiger.

works.d: Suvine mererand õitsvate kibuvitsadega. Esiplaanil lillakas-sinises kleidis istuv naine, tema ees linal pudel, kruus ja keerusai.
works.de: A summer seashore with blooming dog-roses. In the foreground a woman sitting in a purplish-blue dress, in front of her on a cloth a bottle, a mug and a twisted bun.

works.d: Paljaste ülakehadega mehed töötamas. Eemal rohekaskollane lagendik ja punane linn.
works.de: Bare-chested men at work. In the distance a greenish-yellow open area and a red town.

works.d: Esiplaanil kollakas jopes otsevaates mees ja must koer. Taga paremal meri, vasakul lehtpuumets ja hooneid.
works.de: In the foreground a man in a yellowish jacket in frontal view and a black dog. Behind on the right the sea, on the left deciduous forest and buildings.

works.d: Nurk interjöörist valge linaga kaetud laua ja roosa tooliga. Laual vaas heledate lilledega, toidunõud, sidrun, tumeroheline pudel ja mingi roosakas ese.
works.de: A corner of an interior with a table covered with a white cloth and a pink chair. On the table a vase with pale flowers, tableware, a lemon, a dark green bottle and some pinkish object.

works.d: Sinakasrohelises husaaririietuses mees valge hobuse seljas. Paremal käsi rohelise maastikuga kulissi toetamas.
works.de: A man in bluish-green hussar's dress on a white horse. On the right a hand supporting a wing with a green landscape.

works.d: Heleda linaga kaetud laual valge veinikann, vaskne puuviljavaas, punakas purk ja kolm õuna.
works.de: On a table covered with a light cloth, a white wine jug, a copper fruit bowl, a reddish jar and three apples.

works.d: Punasel ja sinisel draperiil lamav naisakt. Vasakul sinine rippuv draperii. Paremal valge laud kausi ja puuviljadega. Fooniks kollakasroheline maastik.
works.de: A female nude reclining on red and blue drapery. On the left a hanging blue drapery. On the right a white table with a bowl and fruit. Background a yellowish-green landscape.

works.d: Punasel vaibal seisev naisakt otsevaates sinise interjööri taustal.
works.de: Standing female nude in front view on a red carpet against a blue interior background.

works.d: Esiplaanil heledas kleidis tumedapäise tütarlapse kolmveerandfiguur otsevaates. Tema taga intensiivsetes rohelistes toonides künklik maastik jõe ja maanteega.
works.de: In the foreground a three-quarter figure, in direct view, of a dark-haired girl in a light-coloured dress. Behind her a hilly landscape in intense green tones with a river and a road.

works.d: Istuva, sinises kleidis pruunijuukselise tüdruku kolmveerandfiguur otsevaates. Foonis rohekates toonides interjöör. Läbi vasakul astuva ukse avaneb vaade kollastes toonides maastikul.
works.de: Three-quarter figure of a seated brown-haired girl in a blue dress, in frontal view. In the background an interior in greenish tones. Through a door opening on the left a view onto a landscape in yellow tones opens up.

works.d: Nuppudega puuvoodis kollakal draperiil lamav naisakt. Taamal maastikuvaade roosakates toonides veekoguga.
works.de: A female nude lying on a yellowish drapery in a wooden bed with knobs. In the distance a landscape view with a body of water in pinkish tones.

works.d: Kollase põrandaga ruum. Esiplaanil laud, voodi, pesukauss, keskel toolil istuv naine.
works.de: A room with a yellow floor. In the foreground, a table, a bed, a washbasin, and in the middle a woman sitting on a chair.

works.d: Heleda põrandaga ruum ümmarguse laua ja tooliga. Akna- ja ukseavadest paistab kolane maastik.
works.de: A room with a light floor, a round table and a chair. Through the window and door openings a yellowish landscape is visible.

works.d: Rohelise kleidi ja roosa kübaraga naine ning punase pintsakuga mees laua taga istumas. Laual pudel ja vaas puuviljadega.
works.de: A woman in a green dress and pink hat, and a man in a red jacket, sitting at a table. On the table a bottle and a vase with fruit.

works.d: Valgel riidel esiplaanil valge kõrvaga kann, kahe punase amarüllisega. Samas kõrval rohelised õunad. Tagapool valge paber.
works.de: On white cloth in the foreground a jug with a white handle, with two red amaryllises. Next to it green apples. White paper in the background.

works.d: Esiplaanil põllul kaks vankrit juurviljadega, kõrval seljaga vaataja poole sinise jakiga naisefiguur. Taga sügisene mets ja majad. Eskiisilik käsitluslaad.
works.de: In the foreground in a field two carts with vegetables, beside them a female figure with her back to the viewer, wearing a blue jacket. Behind, an autumn forest and houses. Sketch-like manner of treatment.

works.d: Rohelises maastikus esiplaanil viis istuvat meesfiguuri ümber rohule laotatud lina, millel pudel, leivapäts ja taldrikud. Puude vahelt paistavad majad ja taga veekogu paadiga.
works.de: In a green landscape, in the foreground five seated male figures around a cloth spread on the grass, on which a bottle, a loaf of bread and plates. Houses can be seen between the trees, and a body of water with a boat behind.

works.d: Akna alla istuva prillidega vanema naise rinnaportree, kerges pöördes vasakule. Seljas eest nööbitav pruun kampsun. Näos tugevad kortsud. Vasakusse serva jääb potis kasvav toataim. Aknast paistavad õitsvad viljapuud.
works.de: Bust portrait of an elderly woman wearing glasses, sitting below a window, in a slight turn to the left. Wearing a brown cardigan buttoned at the front. Strong wrinkles on the face. In the left edge a potted houseplant. Blossoming fruit trees are visible through the window.

works.d: Esiplaanil heledal alusel kuldne kauss mitmevärviliste puuviljadega. Taustaks oranžikais-punastes toonides maastik.
works.de: In the foreground, on a light-coloured stand, a golden bowl with multicoloured fruits. Background a landscape in orangish-red tones.

works.d: Pildil esiplaanil neli erivärvilist kohvitassi ning kaks potilille, vasakpoolne valgete, parempoolne punaste õitega.
works.de: In the foreground of the picture four coffee cups of different colours and two potted flowers, the left one with white blossoms, the right one with red blossoms.

works.d: Esiplaanil valge riidega kaetud laud, millel paremal vasakul vaas kirjude astritega. Tagaplaanil, üle kogu pildipinna rohelistes toonides kattel lamav ookerja kehatooniga naisakt, nägu ärapööratud.
works.de: In the foreground a table covered with a white cloth, on which, on the right and left, a vase with colourful asters. In the background, across the whole picture surface, on a green-toned blanket lies an ochre-toned female nude, her face turned away.

works.d: Pruunikas ovaalis esiplaanil üks istuv mees-ja naisfiguur. Nende taga keskel kaks seisvat meesfiguuri ning üks naisfiguur. All paremal nurgas teekann ja tassid, vasakul kauss puuviljadega. Ülal valge draperii ja mitmevärvilised lilled.
works.de: In a brownish oval, in the foreground one seated male and one female figure. Behind them in the middle two standing male figures and one female figure. Lower right corner a teapot and cups, on the left a bowl with fruit. Above, a white drapery and multicoloured flowers.

works.d: Kummutil istub mürkrohelises seelikus paljasjalgne naine, kuklaga vaataja poole. Peas kollakas-roheline kübar. Tema kõrval kummutil vaas valgete lilledega. Tagaplaanil kaarjas avaus, millest paistab kahvatutes toonides maastik.
works.de: On a chest of drawers sits a barefoot woman in a poison-green skirt, her back with the nape of the neck towards the viewer. On her head a yellowish-green hat. Beside her on the chest of drawers a vase with white flowers. In the background an arched opening, through which a landscape in pale tones is visible.

works.d: Pruunikais toonides foonil hele laua nelinurk, millel valge kann oranžides, roosades, lillades värvides lilledega ja punane klaasnõu valgete õitega. Esiplaanil sinisemustriline kruus ja kaks kastanimuna.
works.de: Against a brownish background, a light rectangle of a table on which stands a white jug with flowers in orange, pink and purple tones, and a red glass vessel with white blossoms. In the foreground a blue-patterned mug and two chestnuts.

works.d: Vaade beežikalt, punase käsipuuga valge barjääriga vasakul, terassilt mererannale. Esiplaanil kolm fragmenti valge linaga kaetud laudadest, vasakul keskel valge laud, kaetud kahele inimesele, selle all magav koer. Paremal laual vaas kollaste lilledega, selle ees avatud vihmavari ja viini tool. Paremas kuldlõikes tagapool linata tühi laud ning selle taga kahe valgustiga laternapost. Vahetult terrassi taga lehtpuudegrupp. Tagaplaanil sopiline merelaht, vasemal puude vahel väike punane maja. Äiksepilvine taevas.
works.de: View from a terrace with a white barrier with a beige, red handrail on the left, to the seashore. In the foreground three fragments of tables covered with white cloth, on the left in the middle a white table, set for two people, under it a sleeping dog. On the right table a vase with yellow flowers, in front of it an open umbrella and a Vienna chair. In the right golden section, further back, an empty table without a cloth and behind it a lamppost with two lights. Immediately behind the terrace a group of deciduous trees. In the background a jagged sea bay, on the left among the trees a small red house. A thundery cloudy sky.

works.d: Intensiivsetes toonides pilt suvisest loodusest: esiplaanil paremal tütarlaps sinises kleidis, paremal heinaniidumasin ja veenõu. Paremalt viib tee avatud ukseni. Maali keskel punases seeliku tüdruk redelil puu otsa küünitamas. Vasakpoolsel pildipoolel kollased viljaväljad ja hobune.
works.de: A picture of summer nature in intense tones: in the foreground on the right a girl in a blue dress, on the right a hay mower and a water vessel. A path leads from the right to an open door. In the middle of the painting a girl in a red skirt reaching up into a tree on a ladder. On the left side of the picture yellow grain fields and a horse.

works.d: Punases tugitoolis istub alasti tütarlaps, parem käsi toetub põsele, vasak toolileenile. Keha käsitletud teravalt varja ja heledusega, kusjuures vari on sügavalt sinine. Taustas intensiivseid toone: sinised, punased, pruunid, rohelised. Paremalt paistev servaga lõigatud vaas ja kuu peegeldus.
works.de: A nude girl sits in a red armchair, her right hand resting on her cheek, her left on the armrest of the chair. The body is treated with sharp contrasts of shadow and light, the shadow being deeply blue. Intense tones in the background: blues, reds, browns, greens. On the right a vase cut off at the edge is visible, and the reflection of the moon.

works.d: Helesinisel riidel lamab alasti naisefiguur diagonaalselt üle pildipinna, selg vaataja suunas, vasak labajalg pööratud parema peale põlve kohal, pea roosakal padjal, ümber pea asetatud vasak käsi, parem küünarnukist ette sirutatud. Tagapool valge post, ülalt alla rippuv valge rõivas, muu isa maalitud rohekates ja pruunikates toonides. Must tuhm raam.
works.de: A nude female figure lies diagonally across the picture plane on light-blue cloth, back turned toward the viewer, left foot turned over the right above the knee, head on a pinkish pillow, left arm placed around the head, right arm bent at the elbow and extended forward. Behind, a white post, white clothing hanging from top to bottom, the rest painted in greenish and brownish tones. A dull black frame.

works.d: Valgel riidel paremal punastes toonides pind, istukil väga hele naisakt. Käed tõstetud üle pea, mis pööratud profiili. Jalad pahkluu lähedalt helerohelise lainelise ribaga ära lõigatud. Fooniks sinistes toonides maastik, silmapiiril helendava veekoguga.
works.de: On white fabric, on the right a surface in red tones, a very light-toned female nude sitting. Arms raised above the head, which is turned in profile. Legs cut off near the ankles by a light green wavy band. Background a landscape in blue tones, with a glimmering body of water on the horizon.

works.d: Pruunikatoonilisel laual keskel valge sangaga kann valkjate lilledega, sellest vasakul jäävad kaks purki pintslitega ja raamatuvirn. Paremal lauanurgal sinakas rätik, millel klaasvaas saialilledega ning taldrik õuntega. Ees, lauaserval merikarp. Foon pruunikates-sinakates toonides.
works.de: On a brownish-toned table in the middle a jug with a white handle with whitish flowers, to its left two jars with brushes and a stack of books. On the right corner of the table a bluish towel, on which a glass vase with marigolds and a plate with apples. In front, on the edge of the table, a sea shell. The background in brownish-bluish tones.

works.d: Maali esiplaanil asuvas punakas-pruunis nahkkattega tugitoolis istuv naisakt. Keha kallutatud vasakule, pea toetub käsivarrele. Lühikesed heledad juuksed. Tooli taga roheliste lehtedega palm. Interjöör maalitud külmades toonides, etüüdlikult.
works.de: Female nude in the foreground, sitting in an armchair with reddish-brown leather upholstery. Body leaning to the left, head resting on the arm. Short light hair. A palm with green leaves behind the chair. Interior painted in cool tones, in an étude-like manner.

works.d: Paremal ülemises pildineljandikus avatud uksel helesinises lahtises suvekleidis blond noor naine korviga, maalitud pinnalises, skitseerivas, vähe läbimaalitud maneeris, figuur mõjub pigem siluetina. Allosas valge laua fragment, millel erksinine kirevate põllulilledega vaas ning lillakasroosa kauss. Vasakul osa toast punakaspruunil, kummuti ja laias raamis peegliga rohelisel, selgelt eralduvate pintslilöökidega maalitud foonil. Toa põrand ookritoonides.
works.de: In the upper right quarter of the painting, in an open doorway, a blonde young woman in a light blue loose summer dress with a basket, painted in a flat, sketch-like, thinly painted manner, the figure appears more like a silhouette. Below, a fragment of a white table on which stands a bright blue vase with colourful meadow flowers and a lilac-pink bowl. On the left, part of a room painted in a reddish-brown background with a chest of drawers and a mirror in a wide frame, against a green background with clearly distinguishable brushstrokes. The floor of the room is in ochre tones.

works.d: Esiplaanil fragment valge linaga kaetud lauast, millel hele kann punakates toonides lilledega. Laua kõrval pruun viini tool, millest näha ainult 1/4. Tagaplaanil seisab avatud uksel külgvaates naisfiguur. Foon on antud erksate värvilaikudega, tugevate pintslilöökide abil.
works.de: In the foreground a fragment of a table covered with a white cloth, on which a light-coloured jug with flowers in reddish tones. Next to the table a brown Vienna chair, of which only 1/4 is visible. In the background, in an open doorway, a woman's figure seen in side view. The background is rendered with vivid patches of colour, with strong brushstrokes.

works.d: Vasakul punakaspruunide käsipuudega kivist kaldarinnatis ja jõgi, millel paistab kollakaspruuni paadi nina. Keskel, peaaegu küljega, valges suvekübaras naisakt, käed kübara serva kohendama tõstetud. Akti foonil tumeroheliste kroonidega puud ja kaks helesinistes suvekleitides naist, üks neist puust kinni hoidmas. Paremal all suurte ratastega käru, millel roosa-valgetriibuline madrats ning pruun kaabu. Paremal ülanurgas suurte klaasakende, rõdu, trepi ja kaaruksega maja, mille poole kõnnib kaabuga mees, väikesel kollase kleidiga tüdrukul käest kinni hoides. Vasakul ülanurgas punakaspruunides ja ookerjates toonides linna siluett, mille väljaku keskel postamendil skulptuur.
works.de: On the left, a stone embankment parapet with reddish-brown handrails, and a river on which the bow of a yellowish-brown boat can be seen. In the centre, almost in profile, a female nude in a white summer hat, her hands raised to adjust the brim of the hat. Against the background of the nude, trees with dark green crowns and two women in light blue summer dresses, one of them holding on to a tree. Below on the right, a cart with large wheels, on which lies a pink-and-white striped mattress and a brown hat. In the upper right corner, a house with large glass windows, a balcony, a staircase and an archway, towards which a man in a hat is walking, holding by the hand a small girl in a yellow dress. In the upper left corner, the silhouette of a town in reddish-brown and ochre tones, with a sculpture on a pedestal in the middle of the square.

works.d: Keskel neljakandilise laua nurgal istub noor kätega lauale toetuv punaste paksude paažisoengus juustega naine, tukk silmil. Otsevaates naise on seljas lühikeste varrukatega erkroosa pluus ning rohekassinised retuusid. All foonil sinised, rahutud, nagu keerlevad pinnad. Keskjoonest kõrgemal soojades ookerjates, roheliste ja kollastes toonides kaarja pinnad.
works.de: In the middle, at the corner of a square table, sits a young woman with hands resting on the table, with thick red hair in a pageboy cut, fringe over the eyes. In frontal view the woman wears a bright pink short-sleeved blouse and greenish-blue tights. In the background below, blue, restless, swirling-like surfaces. Above the middle line, arched surfaces in warm ochre, green and yellow tones.

works.d: Pildi keskel mererannal pikk kalamõrd pruunikates toonides. Esiplaanil hallil liivaluitel kuus roosakaspruuni  merepoid. Pildi keskjoonest kõrgemal sinakashall kergelt lainetav meri, paremal veepiiril pruun kast. Ülal roosakasvalgete rünkpilvedega taevas.
works.de: In the middle of the picture, on a seashore, a long fish trap in brownish tones. In the foreground on a grey sand dune six pinkish-brown seals. Above the centre line of the picture a bluish-grey slightly rippling sea, on the right at the waterline a brown box. Above, a sky with pinkish-white cumulus clouds.

works.d: Pildi ülemises paremas osas sopiline kaarakendega valge kivimaja, mille ukse kohal sepistatud tugedele toetuv varikatus. Maja jätkab pruuni katusega kivimüür, mille kõrgest kaarväravast paistavad rohekad-sinised puud ja põõsad. Pildi keskel seisab päevitunud kollase kübara ja valge rüüga mees seljaga vaataja poole. Mehest vasakul erkroheline puudemassiiv. Keskjoonest kõrgemal on foonil kollakasrohelistes toonides aimatav maastik, mille kohal valgete pilvedega taevas. All punased, rohelised ja kollased kandilised pinnad.
works.de: In the upper right part of the picture an irregular, arcaded white stone house, above whose door a canopy rests on forged supports. The stone wall continues from the house with a brown roof, through whose high arched gate greenish-blue trees and bushes are visible. In the centre of the picture stands a tanned man in a yellow hat and a white robe, his back to the viewer. To the left of the man a bright green mass of trees. Above the midline, in the background, a landscape can be discerned in yellowish-green tones, above which a sky with white clouds. Below, red, green and yellow rectangular surfaces.

works.d: Keskel, valge maja taustal, pisut paremale pöördunud, pea ümber põimitud kätega naisakt, nägu profiilis, lühikesed juuksed punakaspruunid. Akt maalitud modelleerivas, kumerusi rõhutavas laadis. Aktist paremal all lasipuu ning musta lehviga kingituskorv, ülal vasakul vanamoodsa auto nina. Auto taga olev foon on ooker-punane, ülejäänud fooni moodustavad põhiliselt külmrohelised ja sinakad pinnad.
works.de: In the centre, against the background of a white house, a female nude turned slightly to the right, hands interlaced around the head, face in profile, short reddish-brown hair. The nude is painted in a modelling manner emphasising curves. Below right of the nude a wisteria and a gift basket with a black bow, above left the nose of an old-fashioned car. The background behind the car is ochre-red, the rest of the background consists mainly of cold green and bluish surfaces.

works.d: Suurtest värvilistest maalilistest värvilaikudest maastik, vaid kaudselt motiivile vihjav. Domineerivad külmad sinised ja rohelised toonid üksikute ookrilaikudega.
works.de: A landscape made of large, colorful, painterly patches of color, only indirectly hinting at the motif. Cold blue and green tones dominate, with occasional ochre patches.

works.d: Abstraktsetest värvilaikudest koosneval foonil (kujutatud stiliseeritud maastikku) esiplaanil, pildi vertikaalsel keksteljel alasti naisfiguur, käed pisut kehast eemal. Ihul erinevad kirevad värvitsoonid, otsekui langeks figuurile mitut erinevat värvi valgust.
works.de: Against a background of abstract patches of colour (depicting a stylised landscape), in the foreground, on the vertical central axis of the picture, a nude female figure, arms slightly away from the body. On the body various vivid colour zones, as if light of several different colours were falling onto the figure.

works.d: Ateljees, avatud akna all selili asendis naisakt: pea pööratud akna poole, parem käsi kõverdatult õla juures, vasak lebab küljel heledal draperiil, mis ulatub üle aknalaua välja. Parem jalg põlvest kõverdatud, vasak sirgelt teisel lebamas. Modelli pea juures nahktugitooli nurk, osa kannust. Aknast langev valgus muudab keha heledaks, luues siniseid varje. Ümbritsev foon maalitud sinakaspruunide abstraktsete laikudena. Ligi pool ülemisest pildiosast kujutab aknast ülaltvaadet roosakaspruunile, rohekale männimetsa-alusele, mis peegeldub aknaklaasidel.
works.de: In a studio, under an open window, a female nude lying on her back: her head turned towards the window, her right arm bent at the shoulder, her left lying on her side on a light-coloured drapery that extends over the windowsill and out. Her right leg is bent at the knee, her left lying straight on the other. Near the model's head is the corner of a leather armchair, part of the heel visible. The light falling from the window makes the body pale, creating blue shadows. The surrounding background is painted as abstract patches of bluish brown. Almost half of the upper part of the picture depicts a view from above through the window onto a pinkish-brown, greenish forest floor under pines, which is reflected in the window panes.

works.d: Poolabstraktne põllusiilude ja metsatukkadega panoraame maastikuvaade. Keskel selgvaates seisva naisakti 3/4 figuur, parem tõstetud käsi lebab pealael. Figuurist vasakul maastikule langev tume vari lõikub esiplaanil pastelsetesse pindadesse.
works.de: A semi-abstract panoramic landscape view with strips of fields and stands of forest. In the middle, a clearly rendered 3/4 figure of a female nude, the raised right hand resting on the top of the head. To the left of the figure a dark shadow falling onto the landscape intersects with pastel-toned surfaces in the foreground.

works.d: Eredavärviline abstraktne kompositsioon omavahel põimuvatest, kattuvatest, osalt ruumilistest, osalt pinnalistest kujunditest. Allääres meresinisel sinakasvalge loperdava servaga pind, millesse tungib ülalt diagonaalsuunaline tumeroosa vööt, beežikas tahukas, sirgeid ja kõveraid torude motiive. Vasak ülemine neljandik tumerohelise-oranži-valge kombinatsioonis.
works.de: A brightly coloured abstract composition of intertwining, overlapping forms, partly three-dimensional, partly flat. Along the lower edge, a sea-blue surface with a bluish-white loose edge, into which a diagonal dark pink band penetrates from above, a beige block, and motifs of straight and curved tubes. The upper left quarter is in a combination of dark green, orange and white.

works.d: Heledal linal lamav aktifiguur: parem käsivars õla kohale kõverdatud, vasak pea all; vasak jalg tugevasti, parem kergelt põlvest kõverdatud. All- ja ülaservas abstraktsete värvilaikude kombinatsioonist foon. Domineerivad sinakad ja pruunid toonid.
works.de: A nude figure lying on a light-coloured sheet: right arm bent above the shoulder, left hand under the head; left leg strongly bent at the knee, right leg slightly bent. At the lower and upper edges a background made of a combination of abstract colour patches. Bluish and brown tones dominate.

works.d: Suvemaastiku fragmentide ja abstraktsete värvipindade keskel jäme männitüvi, millest paremal seisev naisakt veerandpöördes vasakule, käed tõstetud. Figuuri taga ja ees all lokkav hall draperii. Ülal vasakul sirge veekanal silmapiiri suunas ahenemas, õhtuvalgus peegeldumas vette. Ülal paremal valgete majade rida, telefonipost.
works.de: In the midst of fragments of a summer landscape and abstract colour surfaces stands a thick pine trunk, to the right of which a female nude in a quarter-turn to the left, arms raised. Behind and in front of the figure below, a billowing grey drapery. Upper left, a straight water canal narrowing towards the horizon, evening light reflecting in the water. Upper right, a row of white houses, a telephone pole.

works.d: Geomeetrilistest kujunditest ja maastikumotiividest poolabstraktne kompositsioon: vasakul ülal kaarsilda meenutav objekt kauge sinkjasrohelise maastiku taustal. Paremal roosad, rohelised, mustad värvid, ülal maalilisemad pinnad. Maali alumine osa valdavalt valkjates ja summutatud gammas selgepiirilistest geomeetrilistest enamasti teravnurksetest pindadest koosnev.
works.de: A semi-abstract composition of geometric shapes and landscape motifs: upper left an object resembling an arched bridge against the background of a distant bluish-green landscape. On the right pink, green, black colours, more painterly surfaces at the top. The lower part of the painting mainly consists of clearly bounded, mostly sharp-angled geometric surfaces in whitish and muted tones.

works.dm: kõrgus: 77.0 cm; laius: 59.7 cm; kõrgus: 91.5 cm (raamiga); laius: 74.5 cm (raamiga)
works.d: Keskealise naise poolfiguur enface. Seljas särgilõikega hall ürp. Mõlema käega hoidmas kirvest enda ees. Taustaks lahe rannikumaastik.
works.de: Half-figure of a middle-aged woman en face. Wearing a grey shirt-cut garment. Holding an axe in front of her with both hands. Background a coastal landscape with a bay.

works.d: Esiplaanil lage muru, piiratud keskosas risti üle pildi kulgeva kivimüüriga. Viimase taga künkalisel niidul üksikuid ja puuderühmi, taamal mets.
works.de: In the foreground, open grass, bounded in the central part by a stone wall running crosswise across the picture. Behind it, on a hilly meadow, isolated trees and groups of trees, further back a forest.

works.d: Sinise- ja valgetriibulises kleidis istuva tütarlapse poolfiguur otsevaates. Vasakul laual lebav käsi.
works.de: Half-figure of a girl sitting in a blue and white striped dress, in frontal view. On the left a hand lying on the table.

works.d: Naise rindportree otsevaates. Juuksed taga kammitud, prillid. Tume rõivastus.
works.de: Frontal bust portrait of a woman. Hair combed back, glasses. Dark clothing.
