Vasakul suurem pruun kauss, veidi tagapool tume anum, millele asetatud madalam kollakas-pruunikais toonides savist kauss puulusikaga. Paremale poole jääb väike plekk-kruus.
works.de: A naturalistically true still life in brownish-grey tones with a light background and a dark base. Vessels are arranged in a triangular composition in the middle of the picture. On the left a larger brown bowl, slightly behind it a dark vessel on which a lower clay bowl in yellowish-brownish tones with a wooden spoon is placed. To the right there is a small tin cup.

works.d: Ülaosas vasakul osa taluhoonest, avatud väravad. Tumedas ukseavas paistmas esemeid. Paremal ukse peal ripub vikat, vasakul ukse küljes riideesemeid. Ukse ees murul istub punases rätis laps. Seina ääres vasakul osa alumist maalipinda katmata. Hallikad, rohelised summutatud toonid.
works.de: In the upper part on the left, part of a farm building, an open gate. Objects visible in the dark doorway. On the right a scythe hangs above the door, on the left items of clothing hang by the door. In front of the door a child in a red kerchief sits on the grass. Along the wall on the left part of the lower painting surface is left uncovered. Greyish, green muted tones.

works.d: Metsamaastiku eelplaanil rohul magav naine põllel istuva lapsega, vasakult kaks lähenevat ingel-last, teisel lillepärjake käes, taga paremal rohelise metsa all veisekari.
works.de: In the foreground of a forest landscape, a woman sleeping on the grass in a field with a child sitting nearby, from the left two approaching angel-children, one holding a little wreath of flowers, behind on the right a herd of cattle under a green forest.

works.d: Ateljeenurga vaade ülalt nähtuna: pruunil poodiumil kipstorso selgvaates vaarikapunase draperii taustal. Eespool kollase linaga kaetud taburetil punaseõieline potilill. Vasakul ülal paistmas helesinise raamiga pildinurk, paremal all osa alusest maalivahenditega. Esemeid jälgiv laad, erksad puhtad toonid.
works.de: A view of a studio corner seen from above: on a brown pedestal a plaster torso in profile against a raspberry-red drapery background. In front, on a stool covered with a yellow cloth, a potted flower with red blossoms. Upper left, a corner of a picture with a light blue frame is visible, lower right part of a stand with painting materials. A style attentive to objects, vivid pure tones.

works.d: Esiplaanil eest taha vasakule suunduva tänava ääres aiad. Paremal aedades maju üksikuid põõsaid ja puid. Taamal suitsev vabriku korsten. Taustaks suitsune taevas.
works.de: In the foreground gardens along a street running from front to back towards the left. On the right houses in gardens, scattered bushes and trees. In the distance a smoking factory chimney. Background of smoky sky.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul varemed, paremal rusuhunnik. Taga purustatud Niguliste kiriku varemed.
works.de: In the foreground on the left ruins, on the right a heap of rubble. Behind, the ruins of the destroyed Niguliste Church.

works.d: Mehe poolfiguur; pea profiilis vasakule; muistse sõjamehe rõivastuses. Paremas käes piik. Taga kaks sõjameest.
works.de: Half-figure of a man; head in profile to the left; dressed as an ancient warrior. In his right hand a pike. Behind him two warriors.

works.d: Ees keskel kolme laiba vahel selgvaates valges Liivi ordu riides mees odaga. Vasakul kaks ordutüütli figuuri. Paremal ordurüütlid hobustel. Taga keskel grupp inimesi.
works.de: In the front centre, among three corpses, a man in white Livonian Order attire with a spear, seen clearly. On the left two figures of Order sergeants. On the right Order knights on horses. Behind, in the middle, a group of people.

works.d: Ees kaks meest kivi kangutamas. Nende taga mehi kandmas kive ja palke. Taustaks linnamajad.
works.de: In front, two men prying up a stone. Behind them, men carrying stones and logs. City houses in the background.

works.d: Esiplaanil kaks raagus puud, latt-tara, hoonete lumised katused. Härmanud.
works.de: In the foreground two bare trees, a lath fence, snowy roofs of buildings. Frosted.

works.d: Esiplaanil naine lapsega kõndimas piki puutaraga äärestatud tänavat. Tara taga viis raagus puud, lumine lagendik ja majade siluetid. Koloriit beežikas hall.
works.de: In the foreground a woman with a child walking along a street lined with a wooden fence. Behind the fence five bare trees, a snowy open area and silhouettes of houses. Colouring beige-grey.

works.d: Noore naise rindportree kerges pöördes paremale. Tumedad sirged õlgadele langevad juuksed. Punaseruuduline jakk, valge krae.
works.de: Bust portrait of a young woman in a slight turn to the right. Dark straight hair falling to the shoulders. Red-checked jacket, white collar.

works.d: Keskealise mehe rinnaportree otsevaates. Juuksed mustad, silmad mustjaspruunid, ilmekad. Ülikond külmas pruunis toonis, särk roosaka varjundiga, lips rohelise-valge triibuline. Fooniks terashall, voltides pruunikat tooni draperii.
works.de: Bust portrait of a middle-aged man, frontal view. Black hair, dark brownish-black expressive eyes. Suit in cold brown tone, shirt with a pinkish shade, tie striped green and white. Background steel-grey, drapery in brownish tone in folds.

works.d: Vaade kõrgemalt järveäärsele maastikule: ees majade katused, vasakule jääb helendav järv, tagapool nõlvakud metsaviirgudega. Sumedad toonid.
works.de: View from above onto a lakeside landscape: in front the roofs of houses, to the left a glimmering lake, behind slopes with strips of forest. Soft tones.

works.d: Esiplaanil üle kogu pildi pinna roheka mere taustal suur mitmeharuline puutüvi.
works.de: In the foreground, across the entire surface of the picture, against a background of a greenish sea, a large multi-branched tree trunk.

works.d: Kõhuli lamav noore alasti naise kolmveerandfiguur külgvaates. Kõverdatud käte all kõrgem padi, pea puhkab kätel, nägu pööratud vaatajale. Foonil rikkaliku voldistikuga türkiissinistes, roosades pastelsetes toonides draperii. Keha maalitud helebeežides toonides, vorme pehmelt modelleerides, piirjooni hajutavalt.
works.de: A three-quarter figure of a young naked woman lying on her stomach, seen from the side. A higher pillow lies beneath her bent arms, her head rests on her hands, her face turned toward the viewer. In the background a richly draped fabric in turquoise-blue, pink pastel tones. The body is painted in light beige tones, its forms softly modelled, with diffused contours.

works.d: Põskhabemega mehe poolfiguur 3/4 profiilis pöördega paremale, mundris, epolettidega.
works.de: Half-figure of a man with sideburns in 3/4 profile turned to the right, in uniform, with epaulettes.

works.d: Mehe poolfiguur, pea poolprofiilis vasakule. Põskhabe, juuksed püstihoidvana. Mundris, ordenipaela ja ordenitega. Käed kehast eemal.
works.de: Half-figure of a man, head in half-profile to the left. Side whiskers, hair standing upright. In uniform, with an order ribbon and orders. Hands held away from the body.

works.d: Mehe täisfiguur, poolprofiilis paremale, paremas käes valged kindad, kõrgeis säärikuis, taustaks maastik veekogu ja lossiga.
works.de: Full figure of a man, in half-profile facing right, white gloves in his right hand, in tall boots, with a landscape with a body of water and a castle as background.

works.d: Poolfiguur, peaaegu enface, pea kallutatud vasakule, mustas kleidis, valge rüüškrae ja pika uuriketi ja uuriga, taustaks vasakul veidi akent ja potililli.
works.de: Half-figure, almost en face, head tilted to the left, in a black dress, white ruffled collar and a long watch chain with a watch, background with a bit of window and potted flowers on the left.

works.d: Tütarlapse poolfiguur istuvas asendis, käed süles. Pea en face, pisut kallutatud. Seljas valge kleit rüüžkaelusega ja tume jakk. Õlgadel pikk taskukellakett.
works.de: Half-figure of a girl in a seated position, hands in her lap. Head en face, slightly tilted. Wearing a white dress with a ruffled collar and a dark jacket. A long pocket-watch chain on her shoulders.

works.t: Simuna kiriku altarimaali kavand. Kristus templis
works.d: Kompositsioon piibli ainetel. Ees keskel võlvistikus preester lapsukesega kätel. Paremal sinises rüüs naine (Maria) vasakul mees (Joosep) ja põlvitav vanaeit kepp käes.
works.de: Composition on biblical themes. In the front centre, under a vault, a priest with a small child in his arms. On the right a woman in a blue robe (Mary), on the left a man (Joseph), and a kneeling old woman with a stick in her hand.

works.d: Hallipäise, ebasümmeetrilise näoga mehe rinnapilt peaaegu en face. Pea kallutatud kergelt ette, paremale.
works.de: Bust portrait of a grey-haired man with an asymmetrical face, almost en face. Head tilted slightly forward, to the right.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal kolm kajakat. Taamal bulvar raagus puudega ja majade rida.
works.de: In the foreground on the right, three gulls. In the distance, a boulevard with bare trees and a row of houses.

works.d: Öises maastikus, ees paremal veekogu paadiga ja kahe sõudjaga. Vasakul kaldavõsa. Tagapool, keskel, kuust valgustatud loss.
works.de: In a night landscape, in front on the right a body of water with a boat and two rowers. On the left shoreline brush. Further back, in the centre, a castle lit by the moon.

works.d: Vaade maastikule ülalt alla: ees lehtpuu-metsa ladvad; üle nende tõuseb vasakul kaks kirik-ehitist kõrgete tornidega. Pilvistatud taevas ehapunas.
works.de: View of a landscape from above downward: in front the tops of a deciduous forest; above them rise on the left two church buildings with tall towers. Clouded sky in sunset red.

works.d: Noorepoolse mehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis vasakule, mustade pikkade juuste ja valge kraega.
works.de: A bust portrait of a youngish man in half-profile to the left, with black long hair and a white collar.

works.d: Ees vasakul madal kallas, millelt paremal silmupüüdmise aed. Vastaskaldal vasakul kindlus, paremal lehtpuude taustal maju.
works.de: In the front on the left a low bank, from which on the right an eel-trap fence extends. On the opposite bank on the left a fortress, on the right houses against a background of deciduous trees.

works.d: Ees paremal õu kuivava pesuga ja ühekordse puuhoonega selle taga; vasakul suur raagus puu ja selle kõrval tünnid.
works.de: In front on the right a yard with laundry drying and a single-story wooden building behind it; on the left a large bare tree and barrels beside it.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal üksikud suured puud ja põõsad. Vasakult nõlvakult vaade alla jõele. Vastaskaldal lage maastik, horisondil mets.
works.de: In the foreground on the right, solitary large trees and bushes. From the slope on the left a view down to the river. On the opposite bank open landscape, forest on the horizon.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremas nurgas veekogu. Taamal lumine kallas üksikute suurte puudega.
works.de: In the foreground in the right corner a body of water. In the distance a snowy shore with solitary large trees.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul raudaiaga piiritletud kivikõnnitee. Paremal vesi. Jõe vastaskaldal üksikuid hooneid ja puid. Taamal väljad.
works.de: In the foreground on the left a stone pavement bounded by an iron fence. On the right water. On the opposite bank of the river individual buildings and trees. In the distance fields.

works.d: Esiplaanil veekogu, paremal kaldal olevate suurte puude ja põõsaste tugeva vastupeegeldusega.
works.de: In the foreground a body of water, on the right bank large trees and bushes with strong reflection.

works.d: Paremal tänava äärse plangu taga lehtpuid. Vasakul tänava nurgal kõrge kivimüür. Tagapool madal kivihoone.
works.de: On the right deciduous trees behind a fence along the street. On the left a high stone wall at the street corner. Behind it a low stone building.

works.d: Paremal nurgas väike veekogu. Üle välja looklemas tee. Tagapool kaks üksikut kuuske. Horisondil mets.
works.de: In the right corner a small body of water. A road winding across the field. Behind, two solitary spruces. On the horizon a forest.

works.d: Esiplaanil rühm lumistunud noori kuuski. Taustaks sinendav mets.
works.de: In the foreground a group of snow-covered young spruces. Bluish forest as background.

works.d: Esiplaanil liivaluide, tagapool muru äärestav põõsastik. Taustaks hall-sinine taevas.
works.de: In the foreground, sand dunes, behind them bushes bordering grass. In the background, a grey-blue sky.

works.d: Esiplaanil veekogu paatidega, taga kõrgenev rand.
works.de: Body of water with boats in the foreground, rising shore behind.

works.d: Vasakul rohtunud kallas põõsastega. Paremal veekogu. Vastaskaldal hooneid.
works.de: On the left a grassy bank with bushes. On the right a body of water. Buildings on the opposite bank.

works.d: Paremal veekogu, vasakul ja taga madal rand liivaluidete ja madalate põõsastega.
works.de: On the right a body of water, on the left and in the background a low shore with sand dunes and low bushes.

works.d: Vasakul meri. Paremal kergelt rohtunud kallas.
works.de: On the left, the sea. On the right, a slightly overgrown shore.

works.d: Suvises maastikus ees vasakul grupp kuuski. Horisondil mets.
works.de: In a summer landscape, in front on the left a group of spruces. A forest on the horizon.

works.d: Vasakult paremale suunduv tänav. Ees vasakul kivimüür. Tagapool kahekordne kivihoone.
works.de: A street running from left to right. In the foreground on the left, a stone wall. Behind it, a two-storey stone building.

works.d: Rohekal veel kaks lotja. Vaskapoolsem väiksem, parempoolsem suurem.
works.de: On the greenish water two more barges. The one on the copper side smaller, the one on the right larger.

works.d: Kaheksa grupis seisva poisi ja tütarlapse poolfiguuri; parempoolsel naeratava näoga poisil käes helepruun õun. Värv pastoosne, eriti maali allosas.
works.de: Half-figures of eight boys and girls standing in a group; the boy on the right, with a smiling face, holds a light brown apple. The paint is pasty, especially in the lower part of the painting.

works.d: Keskealise naise rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale, keha täisprofiilis paremale. Taust kollane.
works.de: A middle-aged woman's bust in three-quarter profile facing right, the body in full profile facing right. Background yellow.

works.d: Eest vasakult taha paremale suunduv kääruline jõgi moodustab võsastunud heinamaal "s" tähe kuju. Ees vasakul väike heinaküün. Keskel talumaja. Taga lehtpuumets.
works.de: A winding river running from the front left to the back right forms the shape of the letter "s" in an overgrown meadow. In the front left, a small hay barn. In the middle, a farmhouse. Behind, a deciduous forest.

works.d: Esiplaanil (peaaegu pool maalipinnast) rohekates toonides jõgi (Narva), millel kolm sõudepaati, ilmselt sõjameestega (ajaloost). Keskel horisontaalselt heledatooniline kindlus, mille jalal rohelist. Taevas ühtlaselt lilla.
works.de: In the foreground (almost half of the painting's surface) a river (Narva) in greenish tones, on which three rowing boats, apparently with soldiers (from history). In the middle, horizontally, a light-toned fortress, with green at its base. The sky uniformly purple.

works.d: Seisev naisefiguur, keha pööratud paremale, peapööre vasemale. Juustes helepunane pael, seljas pikk, kehaligi liibuv, vööga seotud kleit. Foon figuuri taga sinine, osa tuhmunud.
works.de: Standing female figure, body turned to the right, head turned to the left. Light red ribbon in the hair, wearing a long, body-hugging dress tied with a belt. Background behind the figure blue, partly faded.

works.d: Esiplaanil, kahel pool, sini-rohelised kõrged puud, paremal, puude all viilkatusega hoone otsavaade. Taevas kollane, ülal siniste pilve-laikudega.
works.de: In the foreground, on both sides, tall blue-green trees, on the right, under the trees, the gable end view of a building with a pitched roof. Sky yellow, with blue cloud patches above.

works.d: Ees keskel ja paremal algab rohekates toonides neem, mis lõpeb käänuga vasakule. Ees keskel ja vasakul üksikud sinakad kivid. Taamal, neeme tipu lähedal keskel suur kollakas kogu (kivi?). Silmapiiril veekogus erk-sinine viirg. Taevas kollakas-rohekas.
works.de: In the front middle and right, a greenish-toned headland begins, ending with a bend to the left. In the front middle and left, isolated bluish stones. Further back, near the tip of the headland in the middle, a large yellowish mass (a stone?). On the horizon in the body of water, a bright blue streak. The sky is yellowish-green.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul kaljune rannariba; keskel ja paremal vesi. Vastas järsk ja kaljune kallas. Kõrgemail tippudel lumelaike.
works.de: In the foreground on the left a rocky strip of shore; in the centre and on the right water. Opposite a steep and rocky bank. Patches of snow on the higher peaks.

works.d: Vaade merele. Ees keskel ja taga suured kivid. Kaugemal lainetel vahused harjad.
works.de: View of the sea. In the foreground centre and background large rocks. In the distance, foamy crests on the waves.

works.d: Esiplaanil kännustik suurte üksikute kuuskedega. Kaugemal saetud puud. Vasakult paremale (diagonaalselt) kulgev tee. Taamal mets.
works.de: In the foreground a clearing with tree stumps and large solitary spruces. Further away sawn trees. A road running diagonally from left to right. In the distance a forest.

works.dm: lehe laius: 28.0 cm; lehe kõrgus: 19.6 cm
works.d: Vasakul, paremast nurgast taha vasakule suunduv kivine rannaviirg, paremal lainetav meri. 1/3 tööst taeva all.
works.de: On the left, a rocky coastline running from the right corner into the background to the left, on the right a rippling sea. 1/3 of the work is sky.

works.d: Esiplaanil oja, ümbritsetud raagus põõsastest. Keskplaanil põllu keskel lumi. Tagaplaanil lagedad põllud, suletud metsaga horisondil.
works.de: In the foreground a stream, surrounded by bare bushes. In the middle ground snow in the middle of a field. In the background open fields, closed off by forest on the horizon.

works.d: Esiplaanil algav ja taha vasakul suunduv mäeseljandik. Seljandiku külgedel puid ja põõsastikke. Paremal puude vahelt paistmas veekogu.
works.de: A mountain ridge beginning in the foreground and receding to the left in the back. Trees and bushes on the sides of the ridge. On the right a body of water visible among the trees.

works.d: Ees keskel rohumaa piiratud vasakult suurte lehtpuude grupiga. Tagapool paremal rida mesipuid ja õlgkatusega talumaja nurk paistmas puude tagant.
works.de: In the front centre a meadow bordered on the left by a group of large deciduous trees. Behind on the right a row of beehives and the corner of a straw-roofed farmhouse visible behind the trees.

works.d: Esiplaanil heinamaa, oja ja üle selle suunuva purdega. Keskel vasakul lehtpuid ja küün. Taamal mets.
works.de: In the foreground a meadow, a brook with a footbridge crossing it. In the centre-left deciduous trees and a barn. In the background a forest.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul kolm kaske, paremal kaks laiakroonilist vana lehtpuud, nende taga põõsastik. Puutüvede ja kroonide vahelt vaade veekogule (keskel ja paremal); vasakul kitsas, vette tungiv maariba. Taamal metsad.
works.de: In the foreground on the left three birches, on the right two broad-crowned old deciduous trees, behind them shrubbery. Between the tree trunks and crowns a view of a body of water (in the middle and on the right); on the left a narrow strip of land reaching into the water. In the distance forests.

works.d: Paremal ja vasakul ääres heinasoo serv, vasakpoolses ääres tihedasti teineteise kõrval naise ja mehe figuurid. Taamal loomad.
works.de: On the right and left edge the border of a hay marsh, in the left edge closely side by side the figures of a woman and a man. In the background animals.

works.d: Keskel puude vahel niit heinasaatudega, esiplaanil puude vari; vasakul saatude taga õhtuses poolvalguses mets.
works.de: In the middle among trees a strip of meadow with haystacks, in the foreground the shadow of trees; on the left, behind the haystacks, a forest in evening half-light.

works.d: Esialal lausik heinamaa, millel rida heinasaade. Tagapool, lattaia taga, paremal lehtpuude salu, vasakul põllud, millede tagant paistab metsamassiiv. Taevas hallis pilves.
works.de: In the foreground flat hayfield with a row of haystacks. Further back, behind a picket fence, at right a grove of deciduous trees, at left fields, behind which a forest mass is visible. The sky is grey and cloudy.

works.d: Vasakul taluhooned, mille taga kõrge puu ja kaugemal mets. Esiplaanil tee, mis läheb otse pildi sügavusse. Teest paremal põõsad ja järv.
works.de: On the left, farm buildings behind which a tall tree and further away a forest. In the foreground a road going straight into the depth of the picture. To the right of the road bushes and a lake.

works.d: Esiplaanil õitsev aas, selle taga heledam riba. Taga vasakul ja ees paremal suured puud. Õhtune valgustus.
works.de: In the foreground a blooming meadow, behind it a lighter strip. Behind on the left and in front on the right large trees. Evening lighting.

works.d: Esiplaanil oja purdega. Tagapoolt paistab puude vahelt küün. Looduses õhtune hämarus, kerge uduvine, taevas horisondi kohal roosatab. Pruunikas üldtoon, õhuke värvkate.
works.de: In the foreground a stream with a footbridge. Behind, a barn is visible through the trees. Evening dusk in nature, a light haze, the sky glows pink above the horizon. Brownish overall tone, thin paint layer.

works.d: Paremal jõgi, vasakule tõuseb nõlvak viljapõlluga, keskplaanile jääb õlgkatusega talumaja ja kõrged puud.
works.de: On the right a river, on the left a slope rises with a grain field, in the middle ground a thatched-roof farmhouse and tall trees.

works.d: Vasakul kääruline oja, paremal kaks heinarõuku. Keskplaanil puude varjus pikk talumaja suitsva korstnaga.
works.de: On the left a winding brook, on the right two haystacks. In the middle ground a long farmhouse with a smoking chimney in the shade of trees.

works.d: Paremal külavahetee, mille ääres puuderida ja majad, vasemal ülaservaga läbilõigatud männid, tahapoole jääb viljapõld.
works.de: On the right a village road with a row of trees and houses along it, on the left pines cut off by the upper edge, behind lies a grain field.

works.d: Maastik jõega, mis suundub diagonaalselt vasakult alt paremale üles. Käänukohal paremal kaldal puudegrupp ning heledamas toonis põlluviirg.
works.de: Landscape with a river running diagonally from lower left to upper right. At the bend, on the right bank, a group of trees and a lighter-toned strip of field.

works.d: Esiplaanil oja, mille kaldail heinamaa ja kaugemal viljapõld. Keskel puude vahel maja, keskplaanil vasakul puudegrupp.
works.de: In the foreground a stream, with meadows on its banks and a grain field further away. In the middle, a house among trees, in the middle ground on the left a group of trees.

works.d: Suvine maastik: keskosas suur lehtpuu, tumeda varjuga, mille all paremal väike veekogu. Puust vasakule - rohumaa, paremale rohumaa väikese ojaga. Tagaplaanil vasakul väike küün üksiku kase kõrval.
works.de: A summer landscape: in the central part a large deciduous tree with a dark shadow, beneath which at right a small body of water. To the left of the tree - meadow, to the right meadow with a small stream. In the background at left a small barn next to a solitary birch.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal osa rohtunud müürist, mille ääres kasvab lehtpuude salu. Vasakul kitsas tee, mis kaob puude vahele. Tagapool kõrged puud ning punase katusega maja. Silmapiiril paistab meri.
works.de: In the foreground on the right part of a grass-grown wall, along which grows a grove of deciduous trees. On the left a narrow path disappearing among the trees. Further back tall trees and a house with a red roof. The sea is visible on the horizon.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul pildi ülaservani kolm kaske. Keskplaanil viljapõld, paremale jäävad heinasaod. Kaugemal vanad taluhooned puude vahel.
works.de: In the foreground on the left, three birches reaching to the upper edge of the picture. In the middle ground a grain field, haystacks to the right. Further away old farm buildings among trees.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremalt vasakule kalduv nõlvak, selle taga kahe taluhoone katused ja kooguga kaev. Tagaplaanil üksikud suured puud, vasemal metsaviirg. Sinises taevas üksikud pilved.
works.de: In the foreground a slope inclining from right to left, behind it the roofs of two farm buildings and a well with a sweep. In the background solitary large trees, on the left a row of forest. In the blue sky solitary clouds.

works.d: Puudega kaetud künklik maastik: vasakus servas männid, nende tagant laskub pildi esiplaanile tee, teispool teed küngas puudesaluga, paremal puude rühm.
works.de: Hilly landscape covered with trees: in the left edge pines, from behind which a road descends into the foreground of the picture, on the other side of the road a hill with a grove of trees, on the right a group of trees.

works.d: Esiplaanil keskelt algab tee, mis kitsenedes jõuab taluhoonete grupini. Kahelpool teed kivid. Paremal paralleelselt teega kulgev oja; mõlemal kaldal kasvavad üksikud kased.
works.de: In the foreground a road begins in the middle, narrowing as it reaches a group of farm buildings. Stones on both sides of the road. On the right a stream runs parallel to the road; single birches grow on both banks.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal kolm mändi, vasakul kaks kaske, mille taga paistab veekogu. Siinpoolsel kaldal näha kaks majakatust. Paremal puude vahel küün.
works.de: In the foreground on the right three pines, on the left two birches, behind which a body of water is visible. On the near shore two roofs of houses can be seen. On the right, among the trees, a barn.

works.d: Esiplaanil neli rukkihakki, nende taga põimitud pihtaed. Keskplaanil pikk talumaja kõrvalhoonetega.
works.de: Four rye stooks in the foreground, behind them a woven wattle fence. A long farmhouse with outbuildings in the middle ground.

works.d: Pildi keskosas järv, milles peegeldub mets. Esiplaanil kaldariba, kus kasvavad männid, poolitatud pildi ülaservaga.
works.de: In the middle of the picture a lake, in which a forest is reflected. In the foreground a strip of shore where pines grow, bisected by the upper edge of the picture.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul kolm viljahakki ja aed. Keskplaanil talumaja, paremal suured kased.
works.de: In the foreground on the left three stooks of grain and a garden. In the middle ground a farmhouse, on the right large birches.

works.d: Esiplaanil kollakas rohumaa, kus kasvavad sarapuu puhmad, heites tumedaid varje. Taga küün ja  sinetav veepiir.
works.de: In the foreground a yellowish meadow where hazel bushes grow, casting dark shadows. In the background a barn and a bluish waterline.

works.d: Esiplaanil neli heinasaadu; oja purdega. Kaugemalt paistab talu koos kõrvalhoonetega.
works.de: In the foreground, four haystacks; a stream with a footbridge. In the distance, a farm with outbuildings can be seen.

works.d: Õhtumaastik: esiplaanil tee, tagaplaanil põõsastik ja metsaviirg. Taevas tume, metsa kohal roosatav.
works.de: Evening landscape: in the foreground a road, in the background shrubbery and a strip of forest. The sky dark, growing pinkish above the forest.

works.d: Hilissuvine maastik; esiplaanil heinasaod kollakal maapinnal. Pildi keskel taluhooned kõrgete puude varjus.
works.de: Late-summer landscape; haystacks on yellowish ground in the foreground. In the middle of the picture farm buildings in the shade of tall trees.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal kõrge puu tumeda varjuga rohelisel maapinnal. Vasakul oja. Keskplaanil maju ja puudegruppe. Kauguses sinetab veekogu.
works.de: In the foreground on the right, a tall tree with a dark shadow on green ground. On the left a stream. In the middle ground houses and groups of trees. In the distance a body of water shows blue.

works.d: Esiplaanil tükike niidust ja viljapõld. Selle taga suurte puude ning põõsaste vahel talu paari kõrvalhoone ja kaevuga.
works.de: In the foreground a patch of meadow and a grain field. Behind it, among large trees and bushes, a farm's outbuilding and a well.

works.d: Paremas ääres esiplaanil heinasaad ja küün, vasakus ääres osa lehtpuude grupist. Kaugemal paistavad veel kolm heinakuhja, viljapõld ning taluhoone.
works.de: On the right edge in the foreground a haystack and a barn, on the left edge part of a group of deciduous trees. Further away three more haystacks, a grainfield and a farmhouse can be seen.

works.d: Pildil keskel suurte puude all vana, rookatusega taluhoone. Tagaplaanil paremas servas paistab teise sarnase hoone ots.
works.de: In the middle of the picture, under large trees, an old farmhouse with a thatched roof. In the background on the right edge the end of a similar building can be seen.

works.d: Pruunikates ja pruunikaskollastes toonides pastoosselt maalitud puisniidumaastik. Keskplaanil vasakust pildiäärest keskosani puudesalu, selles vasakus kuldlõikes madal palktare kõrge katusega. Esiplaanil vasakul üksik puu tumerohelisetes toonides, paremal äärel osa suurest lehtpuudt ja selle taga kaarjalt paremast äärest keskele horisondini ulatuv salu.
works.de: A wooded meadow landscape painted in a pastose manner in brownish and brownish-yellow tones. In the middle ground, from the left edge of the picture to the middle, a grove of trees, in which, at the left golden section, stands a low log cottage with a high roof. In the foreground on the left a solitary tree in dark green tones, at the right edge part of a large deciduous tree, and behind it a grove curving from the right edge to the middle, reaching the horizon.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul, tumerohelisel kanarbikuga künkal neli kõrget mändi väikese kuusega nende vahel. Keskplaanil massiivsemalt ning üldistatumalt antud puud ja põõsad, vasakul servas jupike sinist merd, ülal hallikassinine taevas. Domineerivad rohelised, lillad ja pruunid toonid. Mändide latvades loojuva päikese kuma.
works.de: In the foreground on the left, on a dark green hillock with heather, four tall pines with a small spruce between them. In the middle ground, more massively and generally rendered trees and bushes, on the left edge a small patch of blue sea, above a greyish-blue sky. Green, purple and brown tones dominate. In the tops of the pines the glow of the setting sun.

works.d: Esiplaanil keskel pildi sügavusse suubuv väike jõgi. Jõe ääres vasakul tilluke punase katusega maja, millel suured põlised puud ja pruuni katuse ning valge korstnaga suurem maja. Jõest paremal põõsad, tagaplaanis karjamaad ja metsaviirg. Ülal tihedalt hallikate pilvedega kaetud taevas. Maalitud summutatud rohelistes ja kollastes toonides.
works.de: In the foreground, in the centre, a small river flowing into the depth of the picture. By the river on the left a tiny house with a red roof, with large old trees, and a larger house with a brown roof and white chimney. To the right of the river bushes, in the background pastures and a strip of forest. Above, the sky densely covered with greyish clouds. Painted in muted green and yellow tones.

works.d: Muhedailmelise, valge habeme ja vurrudega vanamehe portree, 3/4 pöördes paremale. Heledad juuksed kammitud paremale küljele. Seljas beežikas kuub. Maalitud etüüdlikult.
works.de: Portrait of a good-natured-looking old man with a white beard and moustache, in 3/4 turn to the right. Light hair combed to the right side. Wearing a beige coat. Painted in an étude-like manner.

works.d: Vanema mehe rinnaportree, pea poolpöördes vasakule. Suu ümber sügavad kurrud, lõug veidi etteulatuv. Peas pruun, vasakule viltu vajutatud nokkmüts. Mütsi alt, külgedelt, paistavad heledad juuksekahlud. Seljas tumehall kuub ja pruunikas kaelarätt. Foon tume.
works.de: Bust portrait of an older man, head in half-turn to the left. Deep creases around the mouth, chin slightly protruding. On his head a brown peaked cap tilted to the left. Light hair locks visible from under the cap at the sides. Wearing a dark grey coat and a brownish neckerchief. Background dark.

works.t: Magav koer. Visand kompositsioonile "Kalevipoeg ema otsimas"
works.d: Kägarasse tõmbunud magav, valge, üksikute tumedate laikudega koer. Pea pruun, kõrvad lontis. Foon rohekas-beežikasis värvides.
works.de: A sleeping white dog curled up into a ball, with a few dark spots. Head brown, ears drooping. Background in greenish-beige tones.

works.d: Tumedal foonil istuv naisakt. Jalad ristatud, ülakeha otsevaates, ettekallutatyd, mõlemad käed maha toetatud. Pea 3/4 pöördes vasakule.
works.de: Seated female nude on a dark background. Legs crossed, upper body in frontal view, leaning forward, both hands resting on the ground. Head in 3/4 turn to the left.

works.d: Keskplaanis vasakul joogiküna samas seisva figuuriga. Viimasest vasakul lehm, teda kaelaümbert hoidva inimfiguuriga. Taamal talumajad. Koloriit hele, pruunikas-beežides toonides; käsitluslaad etüüdlik.
works.de: In the middle ground on the left a drinking trough with a figure standing by it. To the left of the latter a cow, with a human figure holding it by the neck. Farmhouses in the distance. The colouring is light, in brownish-beige tones; the treatment is study-like.

works.d: Paremal profiilis mehe rinnaportree. Peas laiaääreline kaabu. Tema kõrval otsevaates tüseda, vanema naise poolfiguur, käed puusas. Peas hele rätik. Taustaks maja otsasein ning kahvatusinine taevas. Allääres oleval pruunil pinnal paremal värvikihti kraabitud halvasti loetava käekirjaga justkui kellegi allkiri.
works.de: On the right a bust portrait of a man in profile. On his head a wide-brimmed hat. Beside him a frontal half-figure of a stout, elderly woman, hands on hips. On her head a light-coloured headscarf. The background is the gable wall of a house and a pale blue sky. On the brown surface at the lower edge, on the right, a signature-like scraped paint layer in barely legible handwriting, as if someone's signature.

works.d: Heledate vuntsidega noore mehe portree, profiilis. Pilk suunatud otse ette. Pruunid juuksed pehme lainena üle pea kammitud. Foon hall.
works.de: Portrait of a young man with light moustache, in profile. Gaze directed straight ahead. Brown hair combed in a soft wave over the head. Background grey.

works.d: Paremal kaks madalat, rookatustega taluhoonet. Majade juures suured heinakuhilad, samas askeldavad inimesed. Koloriit hele. Maalimislaad etüüdlik.
works.de: On the right two low farm buildings with thatched roofs. Large haystacks by the houses, people busy about them. Colouring light. Painting manner sketch-like.

works.d: Viljapõld rukkihakkidega. Vasakult lõikab põllusiilu kaheks kivine, rohetav riba. Taamal paremal paar viljakoristajat, vasakul puudesalu. Värvigamma hele, maalimislaad etüüdlik.
works.de: Grain field with rye stooks. From the left, a stony, greenish strip cuts the field strip in two. In the distance on the right, a couple of harvesters, on the left a grove of trees. Colour palette light, sketch-like manner of painting.

works.d: Heledates, säravates toonides maalitud mereäärne põllutükk viie naisefiguuriga, kes korvidega vagude vahel askeldavad. Maalimislaad etüüdlik.
works.de: A seaside field painted in light, bright tones with five female figures busying themselves with baskets between the furrows. Study-like painting manner.

works.d: Paremal pesuküna kohale kummardunud naine. Vasakul, alumises nurgas, lamav koer. Taustaks pruunides toonides maalitud kolm taluhoonet ja sinine taevalaik. Käsitluslaad etüüdlik.
works.de: On the right, a woman bent over a washtub. On the left, in the lower corner, a lying dog. Background painted in brown tones with three farm buildings and a patch of blue sky. Sketch-like handling.

works.d: Seljaga vaataja poole seisev, veidi ette kummardunud, pruunis vammuses, paljasjalgne naine. Peas hele tanu. Taustaks taluhoone.
works.de: A barefoot woman standing with her back to the viewer, slightly bent forward, wearing a brown smock. A light cap on her head. A farmhouse in the background.

works.d: Tumedas koloriidis, etüüdlikult maalitud linnavaade. Paremal keskjoone lähedal paistab üle katuste Oleviste kiriku torn /tornikiivri osa pildi ülaservaga äralõigatud/. Allääres madalad hooned ning paar puudegruppi.
works.de: Cityscape painted in a dark colour scheme, in a sketch-like manner. On the right, near the centre line, the tower of St. Olaf's Church appears above the roofs /part of the spire cut off by the upper edge of the picture/. Along the lower edge low buildings and a couple of groups of trees.

works.dm: kujutise kõrgus: 33.5 cm (km); lehe laius: 56.0 cm (lm); lehe kõrgus: 37.2 cm (lm); kujutise laius: 52.7 cm (km)
works.d: Esiplaanil kummuli paat, mida värvivad 4 meest. Samas seisab valges pearätis ja sinakas pluusis naine, käes mingi nõu. Paremas servas 2 figuuri. Taustaks taluhooned. Koloriit hele, osaliselt näha alusjoonis.
works.de: In the foreground, an overturned boat being painted by 4 men. Also present, a woman in a white headscarf and bluish blouse, holding some kind of vessel. On the right edge, 2 figures. Farm buildings in the background. The colouring is light, the underdrawing is partially visible.

works.d: Suurte lehtpuude vahelt paistab valge kabel. Mööda teed liigub viimase suunas väike grupp inimesi, kandes oma õlgadel valget kirstu. Siin-seal paistavad haudade ristid. Koloriit tume. Maalimislaad etüüdlik.
works.de: A white chapel can be seen among tall deciduous trees. Along the road toward it moves a small group of people, carrying a white coffin on their shoulders. Here and there grave crosses can be seen. Dark colouring. Sketch-like painting manner.

works.d: Vaade murule üksikute puudega.
works.de: View of a lawn with solitary trees.

works.d: Pastelsetes toonides 4 figuurist koosnev kompositsioon. All paremas nurgas punakaspruunis seelikus ja pluusis istuv noor naine, paberisse mähitud lillekimp kõrval. Naisel lühikesed sirged juuksed, ristatud jalad paljad. Vasakus servas valged särgis profiilis mehefiguur, käed taskutesse surutud. Tema ees palja ülakehaga poolprofiilis mees, nägu otsevaates, käes rõivas. Meestest paremal, selgvaates heleda patsiga väike tüdruk, kaelas kroogitud valge krae ja jalas sinakad püksikesed. Foonil valge lehviv draperii.
works.de: A composition in pastel tones consisting of 4 figures. In the lower right corner a young woman sitting in a reddish-brown skirt and blouse, a bouquet of flowers wrapped in paper beside her. The woman has short straight hair, crossed bare legs. In the left edge a man figure in a white shirt in profile, hands pressed into pockets. In front of him, a bare-chested man in three-quarter profile, face in frontal view, holding a garment. To the right of the men, in frontal view, a small girl with a light-coloured braid, a white gathered collar around her neck and bluish shorts. In the background a white billowing drapery.

works.d: Kollendaval viljapõllul valges särgis mehe täisfiguur; pea pöördes vasakule, peas nokkmüts. Paremas käes sirp, vasakus vili. Taamal, vasakus servas kaks viljahakki. Silmapiiril rohetav metsaviir. Koloriit hele.
works.de: A full figure of a man in a white shirt in a yellowing grainfield; head turned to the left, wearing a peaked cap. In his right hand a sickle, in his left grain. Further back, on the left edge, two grain stacks. On the horizon a greenish strip of forest. Bright coloring.

works.d: Keskel kohal kaks mehefiguuri, mõlemate vaade suunatud vasakule. Vasakpoolsel, habemega, pruunis pikk-kuues vanamehel vasakus käes vastu rinda tõstetud müts. Noormehe figuur toetub, kergelt ettekummardudes, väravale. Koloriit tume.
works.de: In the middle ground, two male figures, both gazing to the left. The left one, bearded, an old man in a long brown coat, holds his cap raised to his chest in his left hand. The young man's figure leans, slightly bending forward, against the gate. Dark colour scheme.

works.d: Istuva mehe kolmveerandfiguur, profiilis vasakule. Parem jalg üle põlve tõstetud. Kõrge laup, peenejooneline nina, satäänid juuksed ülepea kammitud. Seljas tume ülikond. Maalitud etüüdlikult.
works.de: Three-quarter figure of a seated man, in profile to the left. Right leg raised over the knee. High forehead, finely drawn nose, sleek hair combed back over the head. Wearing a dark suit. Painted in a sketch-like manner.

works.d: Poole pildipinnast võtab enda alla rohekas-beežides toonides maalitud maapind. Keskel, lattaia taga rookatusega taluhoone. Maja juures kaks suurt heinakuhja. Vasakus servas lehtpuu. Taevas sinine.
works.de: Half of the picture surface is taken up by ground painted in greenish-beige tones. In the middle, behind a pole fence, a farm building with a thatched roof. Two large haystacks near the house. A deciduous tree at the left edge. Sky blue.

works.d: Vasakult paremale läbib pilti diagonaaljoonena madal, osalt roigas-, osalt kiviaed. Silmapiiril, paremal grupp suuri lehtpuid ja nende vahelt paistvaid maju. Esiplaanil paremal kaks naisefiguuri. Koloriit hele.
works.de: A low fence, partly made of poles, partly of stone, runs diagonally across the picture from left to right. On the horizon, on the right, a group of large deciduous trees with houses visible among them. In the foreground on the right, two female figures. Bright coloring.

works.d: Lagedal põllul, pildi keskel hobune harkadra ning adrakurgi hoidva naisega. Silmapiiril, vasakul puude grupp ja madal, pikk taluhoone. Taevas pilves, horisondil selge. Koloriit hele, maalilaad etüüdlik.
works.de: In an open field, in the middle of the picture a horse with a forked plough and a woman holding the plough handles. On the horizon, on the left, a group of trees and a low, long farm building. The sky cloudy, clear at the horizon. The colouring bright, the painting style sketch-like.

works.d: Paremal, keskplaani jäävate talumajade taustal kaks naisefiguuri. Ühel käes korv kartulitega, teine kummardumas vao kohale. Silmapiiril vasakul metsaviirg, paremal merelaht. Poole pildi pinnast võtab enda alla üksikute valkjate pilveräpsudega taevas.
works.de: On the right, against the background of farmhouses receding into the middle ground, two female figures. One holds a basket of potatoes, the other bending over a furrow. On the horizon at the left a strip of forest, at the right a sea bay. Half of the picture surface is taken up by a sky with scattered whitish wisps of cloud.

works.d: Kangaspuude taga istub küljega vaataja poole heledas pluusis ning rätis keskealine naine. Temast vasakul istuv mehefiguur. Koloriit hele.
works.de: Behind the loom sits, in profile toward the viewer, a middle-aged woman in a light blouse and headscarf. To her left sits a male figure. Light colouring.

works.d: Avara maastiku taustal nõlvakul lahtise haua ääres 13 leinajat, meest-naist-last. Keskel otsevaates lauluraamatuga jutlustaja, tema taga mees ristiga. Maal pruunikashallis koloriidis.
works.de: Against the background of an expansive landscape, on a slope beside an open grave, 13 mourners - men, women, a child. In the centre, facing forward, a preacher with a hymnal, behind him a man with a cross. The painting is in a brownish-grey colour scheme.

works.t: a) Naise portree. Lõpetamata b) Istuv naisakt. Lõpetamata
works.d: a) Noore naise rinnaportree, pea pöördes paremale. Satäänid juuksed kammitud kokku pealaele. Foon tumeroheline. b) 3/4 pöördes, seljaga vaataja poole istuv alasti naise figuur. Ülakeha veidi ette painutatud; parem käsi toetub vasakule reiele. Juuksed kinnitatud kuklal suure musta seosega.
works.de: a) Bust portrait of a young woman, head turned to the right. Satiny hair combed up onto the crown. Background dark green. b) Seen from a 3/4 angle, a seated nude female figure with her back to the viewer. The upper body slightly bent forward; the right hand rests on the left thigh. The hair is fastened at the nape with a large black bow.

works.d: Kollakal viljapõllu siilul neli inimfiguuri. Silmapiiril puudegrupid. Taevas tume, pilves.
works.de: On a yellowish grain field ridge four human figures. Groups of trees on the horizon. The sky is dark, cloudy.

works.d: Rohetaval künkal viis heledatüvelist kaske. Taustaks madal põõsastik ning pool maalipinnast enda alla võttev sinine taevas.
works.de: On a greenish hill five light-trunked birches. In the background low shrubbery and a blue sky taking up half of the painting's surface.

works.d: Esiplaanil, pooleldi seljaga vaataja poole istuv heleda juustekrunniga valges pluusis ja hallis seelikus tütarlaps toolil (istumas), parem käsi villakoonlal. Tüdrukust vasakul triibulises rahvariideseelikus, pruunis jakis ja tumepunases pottmütsis vanem naine, käsi tütarlapse õlal, tema kohale kummardumas. Foon tumehall.
works.de: In the foreground, a girl with a light-coloured hair bun, in a white blouse and grey skirt, sitting half turned with her back to the viewer on a chair, her right hand on a skein of wool. To the left of the girl, an older woman in a striped folk-costume skirt, a brown jacket and a dark red pot-shaped cap, her hand on the girl's shoulder, bending over her. The background is dark grey.

works.d: Lillakaspunaste võrade ja heledate tüvedega kaskede all kalmistu. Muruplatsidel üksikud ristid, platside vahelt kulgevad jalgrajad. Taamal vasakul valgete seinte ja halli suletud uksega kabel. Esiplaanil, vertikaalsest keskjoonest pisut paremal, tumedas seelikus ja punakas mütsis üksik naisefiguur. Ülal paremal tuhmsinine taevas.
works.de: A cemetery beneath purplish-red crowns and pale trunks of birches. Individual crosses on the grass plots, footpaths running between the plots. In the background on the left, a chapel with white walls and a closed grey door. In the foreground, slightly right of the vertical centre line, a single female figure in a dark skirt and reddish cap. Above on the right, a dull blue sky.

works.dm: kõrgus: 56.7 cm; laius: 72.0 cm (km); kõrgus: 56.0 cm (km); laius: 72.1 cm
works.d: Esiplaanil paremal, keset rohelist niitu, tuhmrohelise lehestikuga väike puudegrupp. Silmapiiril metsaviirg, mille kohal vasakul kõrguvad Rakvere lossivaremed. Hele päikesepaisteline päev, helesinises taevas ülal pole ühtegi pilve.
works.de: In the foreground on the right, amid a green meadow, a small group of trees with dull green foliage. On the horizon, a strip of forest, above which, on the left, rise the ruins of Rakvere castle. A bright sunny day, no clouds in the pale blue sky above.

works.dm: kujutise kõrgus: 48.0 cm (km); lehe laius: 37.5 cm (lm); lehe kõrgus: 50.0 cm (lm); kujutise laius: 36.0 cm (km)
works.d: Esiplaanil keskel valge kasetüvi rohelise, valgete lilledega niidu ja tagaplaanil markeeritud metsatuka foonil. Kasetüvest vasakul sirelipõõsa lopsakas oks.
works.de: In the foreground in the centre a white birch trunk against a background of a green meadow with white flowers and, in the background, a marked patch of forest. To the left of the birch trunk a lush branch of a lilac bush.

works.d: Pruunides toonides kompositsioon: vasakul nurgas üks istuv ja teine tema ees seisev (kaabudes ja pikkades kuubedes) talumees. Taamal vasakul hall kaev, millest vasakul tõrs ja jupike teivasaeda. Kaevu ääres istub pottmütsis naine ja tema juures, seljaga vaataja poole, seisab pruunis vammuses mees. Taamal visandlikult antud taluhooned. Ülal sinine pilvine taevas.
works.de: A composition in brown tones: in the left corner, a peasant man sitting and another standing in front of him (both wearing hats and long coats). Beyond, on the left, a grey well, to the left of which is a trough and a piece of pole fence. By the well sits a woman in a bonnet-shaped hat, and next to her, with his back to the viewer, stands a man in a brown jerkin. Farm buildings are given sketchily in the background. Above, a blue cloudy sky.

works.d: Sinise pastelliga visandatud maastik. Vasakul paar suuremat puud, paremal oja ning üks kõrgem puu. Ees paremal all pikas rõivas naisfiguur hoidmas selja taga keppi. Tagaplaanil ülal pilvine taevas.
works.de: A landscape sketched with blue pastel. On the left a couple of large trees, on the right a brook and one taller tree. In front, lower right, a female figure in a long garment holding a stick behind her back. In the background above a cloudy sky.

works.d: Lilla kontuuriga raamistatud roheline maastik. Esiplaanil keskel kollased suuremad kivid. All vasakul ja paremal lillakad kivid. Paremal küljel markeeritud metsaserv, keskel kuni silmapiirini killakates rohelistes toonides rohumaa. Silmapiiril markeeritud lillaga üksikud puud. Taevas rohekas-lilla. Ülaservas keskel kollane kuu.
works.de: A green landscape framed by a purple contour. In the foreground in the middle, larger yellow stones. Below on the left and right, purplish stones. On the right side a stylised forest edge, in the middle up to the horizon a meadow in patchy green tones. On the horizon, individual trees marked in purple. The sky is greenish-purple. At the top in the middle a yellow moon.

works.d: Esiplaanil sinistes toonides veeväli kuu kollase peegeldusega. Taamal madal rohekas kollakas kallas. Vasakul eemal rohekad-sinakad puud, sekka mõned pruunid. Metsatuka peegeldus hägusalt ka veepinnal. Taevas tuhmjas heledam sinine. Impressionistlikus laadis romantiline suvemaastik.
works.de: In the foreground a body of water in blue tones with the yellow reflection of the moon. Beyond, a low greenish-yellowish shore. Far away on the left greenish-bluish trees, among them a few brown ones. The reflection of the grove is hazy also on the water's surface. The sky a dull lighter blue. A romantic summer landscape in an impressionistic manner.

works.d: Tugevate mustade kontuuridega raamistuses lillal taustal ovaalne stiliseeritud tammelehtedest pärg. Pärja keskel valge (paberi värvi) päikese taustal lendu tõusmas pika nokaga lind. Nii lilla lind kui ka päike stiliseeritud. All mustas raamistuses tekst SIURU III. Lehe paremal allserval punased, mustad, pruunid kriidiproovid.
works.de: Within a frame of strong black contours on a purple background an oval stylised wreath of oak leaves. In the centre of the wreath a bird with a long beak rising in flight against a white (paper-coloured) sun. Both the purple bird and the sun are stylised. Below, in a black frame, the text SIURU III. At the lower right edge of the sheet, red, black, brown chalk trials.

works.d: Sinise pastellkriidiga joonistatud ovaalne kompositsioon. Ülal keskel stiliseeritud suurem hoone puude vahel. Kummalgil küljel suured puulehed. Hoone ees tiik. Ovaali alumises osas samuti veesilm aimatavate peegeldustega majast ning puudest.
works.de: An oval composition drawn with blue pastel chalk. At the top centre, a stylised larger building among trees. Large leaves of trees on either side. A pond in front of the building. In the lower part of the oval, likewise a body of water with discernible reflections of the house and trees.

works.dm: kõrgus: 27.1 cm; sügavus: 4.0 cm; laius: 31.2 cm
works.d: Kolmnurkne, 4 cm paksune plaat, kahel pool ja servadel, sinakas-hallil foonil sinistes-rohelistes-oranžides-punastes toonides geomeetrilised pinnad. Ühel küljel kolmnurk värvilistest, kolmnurksetest pindadest, väljaspool kolm, punaste äärtega ovaali, kaks seest sinised, kolmas punane. Teisel küljel sinistest pindadest ruut, mille peal osaliselt roheline ruut. Viimase sees punase äärega ovaal. All, osaliselt sinisel pinnal, vasakul ja paremal punase äärega ovaal. Piki külgi pikaks venitatud kolmnurgad, põhjal sini-punane ruut ja kaks ovaali - roheline-sinine ja punane-roheline.
works.de: A triangular plate, 4 cm thick, on both sides and edges, on a bluish-grey background geometric surfaces in blue-green-orange-red tones. On one side a triangle of coloured, triangular surfaces, outside three oval shapes with red edges, two blue inside, the third red. On the other side a square of blue surfaces, on top of which a partially green square. Inside the latter an oval with a red edge. Below, partly on a blue surface, on the left and right an oval with a red edge. Along the sides, elongated triangles, at the bottom a blue-red square and two ovals - green-blue and red-green.

works.dm: kõrgus: 27.2 cm; sügavus: 4.0 cm; laius: 27.2 cm
works.d: Kaheksanurkne, 4 cm paksune plaat, kahelt poolt maalitud sinistes-punastes-rohelistes toonides, geomeetriliste pindadega. Ühel küljel kaheksanurkne meandri motiiv, selgepiiriliselt eraldatud, värvilistest ribadest. Teisel küljel kaheksanurkne täht, mis moodustub sinakas-hallil foonil värvilistest kolmnurkadest. Küljed ühevärvilised, sinakas-hallid.
works.de: An octagonal, 4 cm thick plate, painted on both sides in blue, red and green tones, with geometric surfaces. On one side an octagonal meander motif, clearly delineated, of coloured stripes. On the other side an octagonal star, formed of coloured triangles against a bluish-grey background. The sides are monochrome, bluish-grey.

works.d: Eredavärviliste pastellidega tihedalt läbi töötatud portreepea veerandpöördes paremale. Tütarlapsel seljas kirju pluus, rõhutatult punaste põskedega. Foon tumedam, kohati hõõguvpunane.
works.de: A portrait head worked densely in bright-coloured pastels, in a quarter-turn to the right. The girl is wearing a colourful blouse, with emphatically red cheeks. The background is darker, in places glowing red.

works.d: Istuv tüdruk punaka riide taustal. Valge pluus, rohekashall seelik. Vasakule pööratud pea toetatud käele.
works.de: A seated girl against a reddish cloth background. White blouse, greenish-grey skirt. Head turned to the left, resting on her hand.

works.d: Vanema, valgejuukselise mehe tugitoolis istuv põlvpilt. Küünarnukid toetatud toolileenidele, käed süles. Vasakult näha tiibklaveri serv.
works.de: Knee-length portrait of an older, white-haired man sitting in an armchair. Elbows resting on the chair arms, hands in his lap. The edge of a grand piano visible from the left.

works.d: Prillidega vanema mehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale. Peas hall kaabu, õlgadel kapuutsiga keep.
works.de: Chest portrait of an older man with glasses, in half-profile to the right. Grey hat on his head, a hooded cape on his shoulders.

works.d: Tumedajuukselise keskealise sõjaväelase rinnapilt poolprofiilis vasakule. Avatud sineli all näha tumesinine kindrali esindusvormi kuub. Rinnas rida aumärke.
works.de: Bust portrait of a dark-haired middle-aged military man, half-profile to the left. Under the open greatcoat a dark blue general's dress uniform coat is visible. A row of decorations on the chest.

works.dm: kõrgus: 76.3 cm (arm); laius: 65.5 cm (lm); kõrgus: 79.4 cm (lm); laius: 63.5 cm (arm)
works.d: Tumedajuukselise keskealise mehe rinnapilt peapöördega paremale. Mustaraamiliste prillidega, sinises ülikonnas.
works.de: Bust portrait of a dark-haired middle-aged man with head turned to the right. Wearing black-framed glasses, in a blue suit.

works.d: Vanema mehe rinnapilt kolmveerand vasakule madalate hallide juustega sinise särgikraega, ookerkollasel foonil.
works.de: Bust portrait of an older man three-quarters to the left, with low grey hair, blue shirt collar, on an ochre-yellow background.

works.d: Kiilaspäise keskealise mehe põlvpilt kerge pöördega vasakule. Avatud kaelusega tööpluusi katab rinnuni ulatuv tugev sepa tööpõll. Tööle asumiseks kindaid kätte tõmbavast mehest vasakul ees sepavasar, kuna tagant paistavad sepikoja mehaanilised seadmed.
works.de: Knee-length portrait of a bald-headed middle-aged man with a slight turn to the left. An open-collared work blouse is covered by a sturdy blacksmith's apron reaching to the chest. To the left in front of the man, who is pulling on gloves to start work, a blacksmith's hammer, while behind him the mechanical equipment of the smithy can be seen.

works.d: Noore naise 1/4-figuur 1/2 pöördega paremale. Tumedad juuksed ja silmad. Vaade suunatud vaatajale. Peas helesinine rätik. Seljas helesinakas pluus punase dekooriga.
works.de: 1/4-figure of a young woman with a 1/2 turn to the right. Dark hair and eyes. Gaze directed at the viewer. A light blue kerchief on her head. Wearing a light bluish blouse with red decoration.

works.d: Vanamehe rinnakujutis kerges pöördes vasakule. Lühike juus. Seljas karvase kraega lambanahkne, sissepoole karvaga kasukas.
works.de: Bust portrait of an old man in a slight turn to the left. Short hair. Wearing a sheepskin coat with a shaggy fur collar, fur turned inward.

works.d: Esiplaanil laud valge kattega. Laual puukirn puulusika ja võiga. Laua kõrval paremal sinise jaki, pruuni kuue ja valge pearätiga vanem naine suurt leiba lõikamas. Paremal nurgas tool, fooniks tume talutoa palksein.
works.de: In the foreground a table with a white cloth. On the table a wooden butter dish with a wooden spoon and butter. Beside the table on the right an older woman in a blue jacket, brown coat and white headscarf cutting a large loaf of bread. In the right corner a chair, background a dark log wall of a farmhouse room.

works.d: Kahe kaevuri kolmveerandfiguurid.Parempoolne kaevur pöördes vasakule, teine peaga otse. Ta paremal õlal puur mootori ja juhtmega.
works.de: Three-quarter figures of two miners. The right-hand miner turned to the left, the other with his head facing straight ahead. On his right shoulder a drill with a motor and cable.

works.d: Vasakul ümmargune laud, mille ümber istuvad kaks meest ja nende vahel üks naine. Vasakpoolsel mehel käes suits.
works.de: On the left a round table, around which two men are sitting with a woman between them. The man on the left has a cigarette in his hand.

works.d: Mehe portree profiilis vasakule pingil istumas. Käed püksitaskus, peas barett. Foon hallikas-roheline.
works.de: Portrait of a man in profile facing left, sitting on a bench. Hands in trouser pockets, a beret on his head. Background greyish-green.

works.d: Mehe poolfiguur en face toetumas parema käega kruustangidele, vasak puusas. Pruunjad juuksed, valge särk, sinine kittel.
works.de: Half-figure of a man en face, leaning with his right hand on a vice, left hand on his hip. Brownish hair, white shirt, blue smock.

works.d: Prillidega keskealise mehe portree. Keha profiilis, nägu poolprofiilis paremale. Suus suits. Tume kuub, sinine särk.
works.de: Portrait of a middle-aged man with glasses. Body in profile, face in half-profile to the right. Cigarette in mouth. Dark coat, blue shirt.

works.d: Vanema piibuga mehe rinnafiguur kerges pöördes vasakule. Seljas karusnahkse kraega mantel, kaelas kirju sall. Foon tume.
works.de: Chest-length figure of an older man with a pipe, in slight turn to the left. Wearing a coat with a fur collar, a colourful scarf around the neck. Dark background.

works.d: Tütarlapse rinnaportree poolpöördes vasakule, heleda kraega sinises kleidis, tumedatel juustel väike kirju rätik.
works.de: Bust portrait of a girl in half-turn to the left, in a blue dress with a light collar, a small patterned scarf on her dark hair.

works.d: Tumedapäise, tumedas rõivastuses mehe rinnaportree kerges pöördes vasakule. Pilk suunatud alla, suus sigaret.
works.de: Bust portrait of a dark-haired man in dark clothing, in a slight turn to the left. Gaze directed downward, a cigarette in his mouth.

works.d: Lühikeste tumedate juustega keskealise mehe poolfiguur poolpöördes vasakule. Karusnahkse kraega mantli hõlmad lahti, paremas tõstetud käes klaas. Mehe pea pisut ette kallutatud, pilk vaatajal. Foon ja rõivastus heledais hallikais toonides, nägu, käsi punakais, ookertoonides kantud lühikeste pintslilöökidega.
works.de: Half-figure of a middle-aged man with short dark hair, turned half-way to the left. The flaps of his fur-collared coat are open, in his raised right hand a glass. The man's head is slightly bent forward, gaze on the viewer. The background and clothing are in light greyish tones, the face and hand in reddish, ochre tones applied with short brushstrokes.

works.d: Vanema mehe rinnafiguur pooleldi tagantvaates, pea pööratud vaataja poole profiili. Mehel seljas kollakasrohelistes toonides ruuduline särk ja läikiva seljaga vest. Hallid vuntsid ja pealaelt hõrenenud juuksed, tugev nina ja lõug. Foon rohekates ja ookritoonides.
works.de: The bust of an elderly man, half seen from behind, head turned towards the viewer in profile. The man wears a chequered shirt in yellowish-green tones and a vest with a shiny back. Grey moustache and thinning hair at the crown, strong nose and chin. Background in greenish and ochre tones.

works.d: Tumehallil foonil kolmveerandpöördeskeskealise mehe rinnaportree: mehel juustepiir meelekohtadel taandunud, väikese kühmuga sirge nina. Seljas valge särk, tumesinine kuub ja tumepunane lai lips. Maalitud etüüdlikult, laiade pintslilöökidega.
works.de: Bust portrait of a middle-aged man in three-quarter turn against a dark grey background: the man's hairline receding at the temples, a straight nose with a small bump. Wearing a white shirt, a dark blue coat and a wide dark red tie. Painted in an étude-like manner, with broad brushstrokes.

works.d: Hallikal taustal ja alusel seadeldis mustjaspruuni lähkri ja avatud kaanega külili puust õllekapaga paremal. Laiade pintslilöökidega hoogne maalilaad.
works.de: On a greyish background and base, an arrangement with a blackish-brown flagon and, on the right, a wooden beer tankard lying on its side with an open lid. Vigorous painting style with broad brushstrokes.

works.d: Esiplaanil hobuste ja vankritega mehed palke rannal seisvaist virnadest paatidesse vedamas. Paremal paar puud, ranna ääres vees paadid palkidega. Foonil rohekashall meri kahe purjekaga. Taevas merekarva, hallide pilvedega.
works.de: In the foreground men with horses and carts carrying logs from piles standing on the shore into boats. On the right a couple of trees, boats with logs in the water by the shore. In the background a greenish-grey sea with two sailboats. The sky sea-coloured, with grey clouds.

works.d: Esiplaanil rehealuses kaks naist lambaid pügamas. Neist paremal väike poiss villakorvi juures. Rehealusest avaneb maastikuvaade, kelpkatusega taluhoonega paremal. Talumaja ümber puud ja roigasaed. Taamal vasakul väike puumaja, silmapiiril mets. Majadevahelisel karjamaal, rehealuse läve juures sööb kari lambaid, punane lehm ning vasikas, pisut kaugemal must lehm. Erinevates toonides roheline üldkoloriit.
works.de: In the foreground under the threshing barn's shelter two women are shearing sheep. To their right a small boy by a wool basket. From the shelter a landscape view opens up, with a hip-roofed farm building on the right. Trees and a pole fence around the farmhouse. In the distance on the left a small wooden house, forest on the horizon. On the pasture between the houses, by the threshold of the shelter, a flock of sheep is grazing, a red cow and a calf, a little further away a black cow. General colour scheme in various shades of green.

works.d: Paljufiguuriline rannastseen: maaninal kolm võrgukuuri, millel vankriga hobune ja skitseerivalt antud inimgruppe. Esiplaanil keskel rannanaiste ja kalurite grupp kalu võrgust välja võtmas. Neist vasakul kolm, paremal nurgas üks paat nende juures askeldavate kaluritega. Kõrgel asetseva silmapiiri kohal rohekashall pilvine taevas ning tumedamas toonis meri laineharjadega ning merre ulatuvate maaribadega. Muidu värvilaikudena maalitud figuuride kehaosi piiritletud pruuni joonega.
works.de: A multi-figure beach scene: on the headland, three net sheds, with a horse and cart and sketchily rendered groups of people. In the foreground in the middle, a group of beach women and fishermen taking fish out of a net. To their left three, in the right corner one boat with fishermen busying themselves nearby. Above the high-set horizon, a greenish-grey cloudy sky, and the sea in a darker tone with wave crests and strips of land reaching into the sea. Otherwise the body parts of the figures, painted as patches of colour, are outlined with a brown line.

works.d: Vaade kaldanõlvakul paiknevale rannaäärsele talule. Vasakul madalate mändide vahelt paistab punase viilkatusega hoone ots. Sellest paremal, lattaedade vahel madal hallikas maja ümbritsetud puude-põõsastega. Taamal paremal kääruline lahesopp. Taevas hele, rohekassiniste pilvedega. Maalitud hoogsalt sinakas-, beežikas-rohelistes toonides.
works.de: A view of a coastal farm situated on a sloping bank. On the left, between low pines, the end of a building with a red gable roof is visible. To the right of it, between pole fences, a low greyish house surrounded by trees and bushes. In the distance to the right a winding bay. The sky is bright, with greenish-blue clouds. Painted vigorously in bluish and beigish-green tones.

works.d: Vaade sadamale mere poolt. Kai ääres otse ja vasakul väiksemad sõudepaadid, sadamasillal inimesi. Paremal kõrgete mastidega suuremad laevad. Taamal ühe- ja mitmekorruselised majad. Vasakul, helesinise taeva foonil kaks suitsevat korstnat, keskel Oleviste siluett. Maal sinises, hallis, pruunides toonides.
works.de: A view of the harbour from the sea. Directly at the quay and on the left smaller rowing boats, people on the harbour pier. On the right larger ships with tall masts. Beyond, one- and multi-storey houses. On the left, against a light blue sky background, two smoking chimneys, in the middle the silhouette of St. Olaf's Church (Oleviste). The painting in blue, grey and brown tones.

works.d: Esiplaanil veekogu ääres heinamaa kirevate lilledega esiplaanil, vasakul triibulises särgis ja mütsis mees niitmas, tema taga valges pluusis korviga naine, reha õlal. Paremal luiskab roosas pluusis naine vikatit, temast paremal ja vasakul kaks inimest niitmas. Veekogu ääres põõsaid, taamal heinamaa ja metsatukad. Sinakasrohelistes külmades värvitoonides.
works.de: In the foreground, by a body of water, a meadow with colourful flowers in the foreground, on the left a man in a striped shirt and cap mowing, behind him a woman in a white blouse with a basket, a rake on her shoulder. On the right a woman in a pink blouse whets a scythe, to her right and left two people mowing. Bushes along the water, further away a meadow and small woods. In cold bluish-green tones.

works.d: Esiplaanil kidura taimestikuga liivane rannaäärne jämedatüvelise männiga keskel. Viimase läheduses karjatab laps lambakarja. Vasakul servas väike palkmaja halli tara ning paari lehtpuuga. Paremas servas helepruun viilkatuse ja roheline, kelpkatusega maja kuuskede vahel. Pildi rõhtjoonel lippidest aed. Taamal kooguga kaev, mõned majad ja sügavsinine meri. Ülal üksikute pilvedega taevas.
works.de: In the foreground a sandy shore with sparse vegetation and a thick-trunked pine tree in the centre. Near it a child herds a flock of sheep. On the left edge a small log house with a grey fence and a couple of deciduous trees. On the right edge a light brown gable-roofed house and a green hip-roofed house among spruces. On the horizontal line of the picture a fence made of pickets. Further back a well with a sweep, a few houses and a deep-blue sea. Above, a sky with scattered clouds.

works.t: a) Viimane lumi; b) Vaas pojengidega
works.dm: kõrgus: 55.3 cm; laius: 55.3 cm (b külje kujutise mõõt); kõrgus: 62.2 cm (b külje kujutise mõõt); laius: 62.2 cm
works.d: a. Külatänav lattidest taraga, tagaplaanil mõned majad ja puud, maapinnal lumelaigud. Hallikas koloriit.
works.de: a. Village street with a pole fence, in the background some houses and trees, patches of snow on the ground. Greyish colouring.

works.d: Naised kalu puhastamas, paati tühjendamas, mehed hobusevankri juures, keskel ees väike poiss korviga. Paremal meri, kalda ääres purjekad, tagaplaanil hooned.
works.de: Women cleaning fish, emptying a boat, men by a horse cart, in the centre foreground a small boy with a basket. At right the sea, sailboats along the shore, buildings in the background.

works.d: Mees ja kolm naist heina riisumas ja saadudesse panemas, paremal ees kaks last ja koer sao ääres. Tagaplaanil taluhooned ja puud. Tuhm, rohekas koloriit.
works.de: A man and three women raking hay and putting it into stacks, in front on the right two children and a dog by the stack. In the background, farm buildings and trees. Dull, greenish colouring.

works.d: Helerohelistes toonides heinamaa, millest läbi lookleb jalgrada, mõned mändidegrupid. Tagaplaanil üksikud majad ning tume metsaviirg, vasakul veekogu nurk.
works.de: A meadow in light green tones, through which a footpath winds, some groups of pines. In the background scattered houses and a dark strip of forest, on the left a corner of a body of water.

works.d: Tumerohelised männid, neli madalat puithoonet, pilves hall taevas.
works.de: Dark green pines, four low wooden buildings, a cloudy gray sky.

works.d: a. Kalarand. 1940
works.de: a. Fish beach. 1940

works.d: Rohekashallides toonides heinamaa ümmarguste saadude ja metsatukkadega. Ülal keskel kollakas täiskuu.
works.de: Meadow in greyish-green tones with round haystacks and clumps of forest. At the top centre a yellowish full moon.

works.d: Kirev sügisene maastik veekoguga pilvise taeva all. Ees keskel jõekäänaku vaheline rohune kallas. Tagapool, kõrgema päikesest valgustatud kalda peal üksikud kollased kased. Puude vahelt paistmas hoonete nurki. Realistlik kujutamislaad.
works.de: A colourful autumn landscape with a body of water under a cloudy sky. In the front, in the middle, a grassy bank between a river bend. Behind, on a higher, sun-lit bank, solitary yellow birches. Between the trees, corners of buildings are visible. Realistic manner of depiction.

works.d: Rannamaastik väikese lahe ning neemega. Maali keskteljel, paremal puithoonekobarad. Vasakul ja taga, silmapiiril meri, ees mõned suuremad kivid. Paremal pool märgata ka maju ümbritsevaid aedu ning paari üksikut puud. Paremal on ka üks kummuli paat. Maali ülapoole moodustab pilvetupsudega taevas. Koloriidilt hallides toonides. Esiplaanil veidi enam värvielavust. Markeeriv, veidi impressionistlik pintslijoon.
works.de: A coastal landscape with a small bay and a headland. On the central axis of the painting, on the right, clusters of wooden buildings. On the left and behind, on the horizon, the sea, in front some larger rocks. On the right, gardens surrounding the houses and a couple of solitary trees can also be seen. On the right there is also an upturned boat. The upper part of the painting is formed by a sky with tufts of cloud. The colouring is in grey tones. In the foreground slightly more vividness of colour. A marking, somewhat impressionistic brushstroke.

works.d: Sinakashall meri sulab silmapiiril kokku sama halli taevaga. Üle kogu merepinna kaootiliselt paigutunud kaluripaadid, milledes mehed askeldavad võrkudega. Kokku on 19 paati. Taamal, pildi paremal poolel asuvad kolm heisatud purjedega vaevumärgatavat paati. Paatide kohal tiirlevad kajakad. Impressionistliku maalilaadiga.
works.de: The bluish-grey sea merges with the equally grey sky on the horizon. Fishing boats with men busy with nets are chaotically scattered across the entire sea surface. In total there are 19 boats. In the distance, on the right side of the picture, three barely noticeable boats with raised sails. Seagulls circle above the boats. In an impressionistic painting style.

works.dm: lehe laius: 27.4 cm; lehe kõrgus: 33.5 cm
works.d: Ees risti alusel kivisambale toetuv noor naine. Temast vasakul istuv koer, paremal laps. Vasakul lainetav meri kahe kajakaga.
works.de: In front, a young woman leaning on a stone pillar on the base of a cross. To her left a sitting dog, to the right a child. On the left a wavy sea with two seagulls.

works.d: Punast pottmütsi kandev vana naise rinnapilt, poolprofiilis vasakule. Valge pluusi kaelus kinnitatud sõelaga.
works.de: Bust portrait of an old woman wearing a red pot hat, in half-profile to the left. The collar of the white blouse fastened with a brooch.

works.d: Vana naise rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale, peas sinine pottmüts.
works.de: A bust portrait of an old woman in half-profile to the right, wearing a blue pot hat.

works.d: Ees paremal pajupõõsas. Selle taga vasakult paremale suunduv lattaed. Tahapoole kerkiva künka tagant näha taluhoone õlgkatust. Taamal üle puulatvade vaade merele.
works.de: In the foreground on the right a willow bush. Behind it a plank fence running from left to right. Behind the rising hill the straw roof of a farm building is visible. In the distance a view of the sea over the treetops.

works.d: Kivisel rannikul paremal väike kõrgendik, millel linnuse varemed. Linnuse taga paistab kaugemal oleva maja katus. Ees paremal kuivama riputatud kalavõrgud. Linnuse ümber karjatara. Vasakul madal lahesopp, milles varemete peegeldus. Eespool paar suuremat kivi, taga kaugemal üksik purjekas. Taevas maastiku kohal ühtlaselt helesinine, kahvatukollane päike loojumas.
works.de: On a rocky coast, on the right, a small elevation with the ruins of a castle. Behind the castle, the roof of a more distant house is visible. In front, on the right, fishing nets hung out to dry. Around the castle, a pasture fence. On the left, a shallow bay inlet, in which the ruins are reflected. In front, a couple of larger stones, further back a solitary sailboat. Above the landscape, the sky is evenly light blue, with a pale yellow sun setting.

works.d: Süngetes toonides öine maastik kahe seisva figuuriga. Puudega ääristatud surnuaed, hauakivid rohus, keskel mees ja naine otsevaates, ülakehad paljastatud. Mees kivi peale pissimas, tema kõrval punases seelikus ja peakattes naine sellele sõrmega osutamas, teises käes avatud raamat. Ekspressiivne kujutamisviis, mustjad, sünged toonid.
works.de: A nocturnal landscape in somber tones with two standing figures. A cemetery bordered by trees, gravestones in the grass, in the middle a man and a woman seen frontally, upper bodies bared. The man is urinating onto a stone, beside him a woman in a red skirt and headdress pointing at it with her finger, in her other hand an open book. Expressive manner of depiction, blackish, somber tones.

works.d: Kaunistustega kõrge seljatoega istmel noor naine otsevaates, pea pööratud vasakule, käed leenil, paljajalu; seljas sinine rüü, hõlmad vaheliti, ümber pea mässitud punane rätt. Mõlemal pool naist suured pruunid koerad: vasak istub, paremapoolne lamab. Üldkoloriit tume, mustjast taustast joonistuvad välja figuurid.
works.de: Young woman frontally seated on a high-backed decorated seat, head turned to the left, hands on the armrests, barefoot; wearing a blue robe with the flaps crossed, a red scarf wrapped around her head. Large brown dogs on both sides of the woman: the left one sits, the right one lies. Overall colouring dark, the figures stand out against a blackish background.

works.d: Pildil keskel tumedal foonil, valgel riidel, tumesinine vaas nartsisside ja krookustega.
works.de: In the middle of the picture, against a dark background, on white cloth, a dark blue vase with narcissi and crocuses.

works.d: Hämar, sumedalt elektrilampidega valgustatud ruum, laes mitut tüüpi valgustatud ruum, laes mitut tüüpi valgusteid. Vasakus nurgas heledapäine, roosa pluusiga ja tumedapäine rohelises naine. Tagaplaanil paistab läni klaasuste ja -akende hele päev. Sees domineerivad kuldpruunid toonid, kõik piirjooned on hajutatud.
works.de: Dim room softly lit by electric lamps, several types of light fixtures on the ceiling, several types of light fixtures on the ceiling. In the left corner a fair-haired woman in a pink blouse and a dark-haired woman in green. In the background bright daylight is visible through glass doors and windows. Golden-brown tones dominate inside, all contours are diffused.

works.d: Peamiselt punastes ja rohelistes toonides abstraktne kompositsioon: keskel ja ülal punane, tihedalt puäntillistlikus pintslitehnikas täppidega kaetud laialivalguv kujund. Viimase all, üksteisesse sulavad toonid, mida elustavad kollased ja oranžid valgussähvatused.
works.de: Abstract composition mainly in red and green tones: in the centre and above a red, spreading form covered with densely pointillist brushwork dots. Below it, tones merging into one another, enlivened by yellow and orange flashes of light.

works.d: Tumepruunil foonil allservas, vertikaalsest keskjoonest pisut paremal punakate krässus juustega, pisut kumera ninajoone ja etteulatuva suupartiiga, väikeste silmadega tütarlapse portree profiilis. Tütarlapsel seljas ookrikarva ümara kraega kleit või pluus.
works.de: On a dark brown background at the lower edge, slightly to the right of the vertical centre line, a portrait in profile of a girl with reddish curly hair, a slightly curved nose line and a protruding mouth area, small eyes. The girl is wearing an ochre-coloured dress or blouse with a round collar.

works.d: Esiplaanil Kalini ümber koondunud neli mehe figuuri. Paremal tööpink. Tagapool vasakul veel üks seisev ja üks istuv mehe figuur.
works.de: In the foreground four male figures gathered around Kalinin. On the right a workbench. Further back on the left another standing and one seated male figure.

works.d: Harkisjalu seisev deformeeritud, eriti pea ja jalad, alasti naisfiguur otsevaates dekoratiivsete puude vahel oleva helesiniste pilvedega kaetud virsikutooni ekraani ees. Aktil üks käsi puusal, teine kuklas, jalgealusel erkkollane ruut, millel paremal kõverate jalgadega taburet, sangaga pott üksiku punase õiega platel. Figuuri ja esemete selged varjud langemas alusele. Kujutatu ühtlasel erkoranžil taustal. Ühtlane peen oranž kontuurjoon ümbritseb plastiliselt vormitud figuuri ja kujundeid.
works.de: A standing, straddle-legged, deformed – especially the head and legs – nude female figure in frontal view among decorative trees, in front of a peach-toned screen covered with light blue clouds. The nude has one hand on her hip, the other at the back of her neck, on the base beneath her feet a bright yellow square, on which stands, to the right, a stool with curved legs, a pot with a handle on a plate with a single red flower. Clear shadows of the figure and objects fall onto the base. The subject is set against a uniform bright orange background. An even, thin orange contour line surrounds the plastically shaped figure and forms.

works.d: Lage rohumaa lendavatparti jälgiva musta-valgekirju linnukoeraga. Taga kuusemets.
works.de: Bare grassland with a black-and-white spotted bird dog watching a flying duck. Spruce forest behind.

works.d: Pastelsel sinakasrohelisel foonil kolmest 3/4-figuurist grupp. Paremal, punakas udus kaks vastakuti seisvat kuju, vasakul üksik figuur.
works.de: On a pastel bluish-green background a group of three 3/4-figures. On the right, in a reddish haze, two figures standing facing each other, on the left a single figure.

works.d: Esiplaanil lage väli, tagaplaanil kõrged tehasehooned, millede poole suundub esiplaanilt paremalt autode kolonn.
works.de: In the foreground an open field, in the background tall factory buildings, towards which a column of cars moves from the right foreground.

works.d: Talvine tehasevaade. Paremal kõrge hoone ja kaks suitsevat korstent. Keskel balastik ja hooneid, vasakul kõrge tornitaoline maja ja vedur.
works.de: Winter view of a factory. On the right a tall building and two smoking chimneys. In the centre a ballast area and buildings, on the left a tall tower-like building and a locomotive.

works.d: Suvine vaade piki äärelinna veelompidega kaetud tänavat. Kahel pool teed planktaraga piiratud roheliste puude-põõsastega aiad. Vihmavines taevas.
works.de: Summer view along a suburban street covered with puddles of water. On both sides of the road, gardens with green trees and bushes enclosed by picket fences. Rainy sky.
