From the foreground a road leads into the depth of the picture. Between the houses, on the hills, clumps of forest. Above, a dark greyish-blue sky. Painted with colour surfaces, forms slightly emphasised with shading.

works.d: Kollakasroosades toonides, kõrgele pildi serva tõstetud silmapiiriga maastik: esiplaanilt keskelt suundub pildi sügavusse väike oja, mille kaldal esiplaanil laugjad, tagaplaanis järsumat kallakut moodustavad. Esiplaanil vasakul, aga ka tagapool silmapiiril ookerkollaste puude grupid. Maalitud hajusate pintslilöökidega, kontuure igati ähmastada püüdes.
works.de: A landscape in yellowish-pink tones, with the horizon raised high toward the edge of the picture: from the centre foreground a small brook runs into the depth of the picture, its banks gentle in the foreground and forming a steeper slope in the background. On the left in the foreground, as well as further back on the horizon, groups of ochre-yellow trees. Painted with diffuse brushstrokes, striving throughout to blur the contours.

works.d: Vaade hoovi. Keskel punase katusega majad. Vasakul ja paremal heledad seinad, neist vasakpoolse küljes latern.
works.de: View of a courtyard. In the middle houses with red roofs. On the left and right pale walls, with a lantern on the left-hand one.

works.d: Laiade ekspressiivsete pintslilöökidega maalitud abstraktne kompositsioon. Allosas rohekaspruun varjundirikas pind, millesse tungib paremalt hele kolmnurk ja üksikud mustad-valged pintslitõmbed. Ülemine maaliosa heledas gammas, tumedamad risti-rästi jooned läbi kumamas.
works.de: An abstract composition painted with broad expressive brushstrokes. In the lower part a greenish-brown surface rich in nuance, into which a light triangle intrudes from the right along with isolated black-and-white brushstrokes. The upper part of the painting in a light range, with darker criss-crossing lines shining through.

works.d: Ruudukujulistel, erivärvilistel alustel, ajalehtedest välja lõigatud ja riidele kleebitud kujundid siluettidena: 1. Kollasel foonil, keskel, vertikaalselt nool, teravikuga ülesse.
works.de: On square bases of various colours, shapes cut out of newspapers and glued onto fabric as silhouettes: 1. On a yellow background, in the centre, a vertical arrow, point upwards.

works.d: Noore tumedajuukselise naise põlcportree, käed vaheliti rinnal. Tumeda kleidi kaelus ja varrukad kitsa valge pitsääristusega. Sõrmeküüned punased.
works.de: Knee-length portrait of a young dark-haired woman, hands crossed on her chest. The collar and sleeves of the dark dress trimmed with narrow white lace. Fingernails red.

works.d: Ees paremal näha suure kuuse tüvi ja alumine osa oksastikust vasakul vana kase tüve osa.
works.de: In front on the right the trunk of a large spruce and the lower part of its branches; on the left part of the trunk of an old birch.

works.d: Esiplaanil lagendik pikkade madalate koertega. Taga hallikas-sinised mäed.
works.de: In the foreground a clearing with long low dogs. Behind, grayish-blue mountains.

works.d: Suured lillad kivid rohekas-sinise taeva taustal.
works.de: Large purple stones against a greenish-blue sky background.

works.d: Lopsakate pastoossete pintslilöökidega maalitud väike maastik. Esiplaanil keskel pildi sügavusse suunduv väike jõgi. Silmapiiril tuhedalt üksteise kõrval pruunide katustega majad, rohelised puukroonid katuste kohal. Ülal  lillakashall, üksikute pilvekiududega taevas.
works.de: A small landscape painted with lush pastose brushstrokes. In the foreground in the center, a small river receding into the depth of the picture. On the horizon, brown-roofed houses standing close together, green treetops above the roofs. Above, a purplish-grey sky with a few wisps of cloud.

works.d: Laual pruun savivaas eredavärviliste lilledega. Vaasi kõrval grupp rohelisi seenekesi. Fooniks roosakas tapeet ja rohekas kardin.
works.de: On the table a brown clay vase with brightly coloured flowers. Beside the vase a group of green mushrooms. Background of pinkish wallpaper and a greenish curtain.

works.d: Laual suur punane vaas valgete ja kollaste krüsanteemidega. Raamat ja õunad. Vasakul aknast vaade linnale.
works.de: On the table a large red vase with white and yellow chrysanthemums. A book and apples. On the left, a view of the city through the window.

works.d: Ees künka harjal kännustik seenelistega. Paremalt alla vasakule suunduva teega. Horisondil mäed.
works.de: In front, on the crest of a hill, a cluster of tree stumps with mushroom pickers. With a path leading from the right down to the left. Mountains on the horizon.

works.d: Esiplaanil taraga ümbritsetud muruplats üksikute vanade puudega, millede vahelt paistab mansartkorrusega ja kõrge eestrepiga suvila. Maja viilul pärjastatud nimi ja daatum: LYBERTY 1798. Vasemal majake, mille kõrvalt näha tükike merd Tallinna siluetiga. Taga paremal pargipuud.
works.de: In the foreground, a fenced lawn with a few old trees, between which a summer house with a mansard storey and a tall front staircase can be seen. On the gable of the house, a wreathed name and date: LYBERTY 1798. On the left, a small house, beside which a piece of sea with the silhouette of Tallinn is visible. In the background on the right, park trees.

works.dm: kõrgus: 47.5 cm (maal "Matuselised" mõõdud); laius: 47.5 cm; kõrgus: 60.0 cm (maal "Sirelid" mõõdud); laius: 60.0 cm
works.d: Pruunil poleeritud ja ümbritsevat oma pinnal peegeldaval laual sinine ümar vaas suure lillade sireliokste kimbuga. Foon rohekaskollane. Maalitud kergete säpsivate pintslilöökidega.
works.de: On a brown polished table reflecting its surroundings on its surface, a blue round vase with a large bunch of lilac lilac branches. The background yellowish-green. Painted with light, brisk brushstrokes.

works.d: Lapse rinnapilt otsevaates, vasak õlg ettepoole pööratud, peal kerge kallak paremale.
works.de: Chest portrait of a child in frontal view, left shoulder turned forward, head slightly tilted to the right.

works.d: Vaade Pikale tänavale. Kollaka ja pruunikas-oranži viilkatusega maja fassaadid. Nende ees tänaval inimesi ja kass.
works.de: View of Pikk Street. Facades of houses with yellowish and brownish-orange gable roofs. In front of them, on the street, people and a cat.

works.d: Istuva naise poolfiguur - en face. Peas valge, rüüžidega tanu. Käed vaheliti rüpes.
works.de: Half-figure of a seated woman, en face. On her head a white bonnet with ruffles. Hands crossed in her lap.

works.d: Majade taustal, lagedal platsil, monument. Taga paremal jõgi purjekaga. Platsil grupp inimesi. Monumendil tekst: AN. MDCCCXII MEMORABLE PAR LA CAMPAGE CONTRE LES RUSSES. VUETAPPROUVÉ BAD NOUS COMMAND RUSSE DE COBLENCE LE I: JANUIER 1814
works.de: Against a background of houses, on an open square, a monument. Behind, on the right, a river with a sailboat. A group of people on the square. Text on the monument: AN. MDCCCXII MEMORABLE PAR LA CAMPAGE CONTRE LES RUSSES. VUETAPPROUVÉ BAD NOUS COMMAND RUSSE DE COBLENCE LE I: JANUIER 1814

works.d: Ees keskel veekogu. Vasakul, kergelt kõrgenev kallas põõsastiku ja puude reaga. Kaugemal väike osmik. Keskel ja paremal viljapõllud koristajatega. Taamal, horisondil, üksik tuuleveski.
works.de: In the front centre a body of water. On the left, a slightly rising bank with a row of bushes and trees. Further away a small hut. In the centre and on the right grain fields with harvesters. In the distance, on the horizon, a solitary windmill.

works.d: Esiplaanil müüriäärsel rohuplatsil kaks figuuri koeraga, tagapool tõusval maapinnal puud ja punaste kivikatustega majad ning keskaegne ümmarik kindlustorn, kaugemal kerkib Oleviste kiiver.
works.de: In the foreground on a grassy plot by the wall two figures with a dog, further back on rising ground trees and houses with red tile roofs and a medieval round fortification tower, further away the spire of Oleviste rises.

works.d: Ees ja vasakul kivine, lage rand haokubu kandva vanamehe ja väikese lapsega. Taamal, silmapiiril, vastaskaldal linnavaade.
works.de: In the front and on the left a stony, bare shore with an old man carrying a bundle of brushwood and a small child. In the distance, on the horizon, a townscape on the opposite bank.

works.d: Esiplaanil liivane rand, kaks kaldale tõmmatud paati ja paremal paljajalu paatide suunas sammuv mehefiguur, kandam seljas; taga avameri.
works.de: In the foreground a sandy shore, two boats pulled up onto the shore, and on the right a barefoot male figure walking towards the boats, a burden on his back; behind, the open sea.

works.d: Ees keskel vahuste laineharjade vahel purjelaeva vrakk. Vasemal läbi laintevahu näha sadamamuul. Teos lõuni viimata
works.de: In the centre foreground, a wreck of a sailing ship among foaming wave crests. On the left, a harbour mole visible through the foam of the waves. The work is unfinished

works.d: Vasakul rannaliival suuri kive. Paremal, merel, üksik purjekas. 2/3 tööst pilvise, loojuva päikesega taeva all.
works.de: On the left large stones on the beach sand. On the right, at sea, a lone sailboat. 2/3 of the work a cloudy sky with a setting sun.

works.d: Kolme väikese tüdruku poolfiguurid grupina istumas. Parempoolsel süles pikakarvaline koer.
works.de: Half-figures of three small girls sitting as a group. On the right one's lap a long-haired dog.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasemal jõekallas puude, paadi ja figuuridega, keskel jõgi kaluritega, taga mäed ja loss, loojuva päikese valguses.
works.de: In the foreground left a riverbank with trees, a boat and figures, in the middle a river with fishermen, behind mountains and a castle, in the light of the setting sun.

works.d: Lillelise vaiba ja roosa seina foonil istuva, hallis riietuses vana mehe kolmveerandfiguur otsevaates.
works.de: Three-quarter figure of an old man dressed in grey, seen frontally, against a background of a floral carpet and a pink wall.

works.d: Kasukas ning sõdurimütsis mehe poolfiguur, vasak käsi risti üle kõhu.
works.de: Half-figure of a man in a fur coat and soldier's cap, left hand crossed over the stomach.

works.d: Esiplaanil töökitlis ja valges särgis mees pintsli ja paletiga käes. Lühikesed sirged juuksed liibuvad vastu pead, sirge nina, prillid. mehest vasakul laual liivakell, selja taga aken, millest paistab kirikutornide ja katustega Tallinna vanalinn. Maalitud pastelsetes roosades, sinistes ja hallides toonides.
works.de: In the foreground a man in a work smock and white shirt, holding a brush and palette. Short straight hair combed close to the head, straight nose, glasses. To the man's left on a table an hourglass, behind him a window through which the Tallinn Old Town with its church towers and roofs can be seen. Painted in pastel pink, blue and grey tones.

works.d: Keskealise mehe poolfiguur poolpöördes vasakule. Istuva mehe lühikesed juuksed on hallid, seljas kollakaspruun pintsak ja erksinine särk, käed põlvel ristatud, vasakus käes kaks pintslit. Foon sinine, vasakust servast rohelistes toonides.
works.de: Half-figure of a middle-aged man in half-turn to the left. The seated man's short hair is grey, he wears a yellowish-brown jacket and a bright blue shirt, his hands crossed on his knee, two brushes in his left hand. The background is blue, in greenish tones from the left edge.

works.d: Sinistes ja lillakaspunastes toonides ülaltvaade Tallinna vanalinnale Niguliste kiriku kiivrita torniga paremal. Ülal tume pilvine taevas.
works.de: A bird's-eye view of Tallinn's Old Town in blue and purplish-red tones, with the spireless tower of St. Nicholas' Church (Niguliste) on the right. Above, a dark cloudy sky.

works.d: Kõrgest vaatepunktist antud rannamaastik, kus esiplaanil liivariba üksiku põõsapuhmaga keskel ning taamal tumesinine meri. Ülal sinakasrohelistes ja kollastes toonides taevas. Maaliline, pintslilöök lopsakas ja selgesti eristatav.
works.de: A coastal landscape given from a high viewpoint, with a strip of sand with a single bush in the middle of the foreground and the dark blue sea further away. Above, sky in bluish-green and yellow tones. Painterly, the brushstroke lush and clearly distinguishable.

works.d: Esiplaanil, paralleelselt alumise servaga jõgi, mille ääres, vert. keskjoonest pisut vasakul punakaspruun, veevaadi ette rakendatud hobune. Hobuse ja vaadi juures valges pluusis naine jõest vett ammutamas ja sonis mees vett vaati valamas. Hobuse juurest viib kitsas liivane tee mäkke, mäel teest paremal elektripost, vasakul suured rohelised puud ja põõsad. Jõe ääres, teel, heledapäine naine, temast paremal kolm jões sulistavat last. Mäe otsas, silmapiiril keskel, kaks valget torni või korstent, vasakul serval puudetukk. Ülal helesinine, kiudpilvedega taevas.
works.de: In the foreground, parallel to the lower edge, a river, by which, slightly to the left of the vertical centre line, a reddish-brown horse harnessed to a water barrel stands. By the horse and the barrel a woman in a white blouse draws water from the river, and a man in a cap pours water into the barrel. From the horse a narrow sandy path leads up the hill; on the hill, to the right of the path, an electricity pole, to the left large green trees and bushes. By the river, on the path, a fair-haired woman, to her right three children splashing in the river. At the top of the hill, in the centre of the horizon, two white towers or chimneys, on the left edge a clump of trees. Above, a light blue sky with cirrus clouds.

works.d: Tinahallides toonides merevaade kahe väikese paadiga paremal serva ees ja hulga suuremate kalapaatidega (purjepaatidega) keskplaanis. Silmapiiril tumehall viirg. Ülal helehallide pilvedega kaetud kahvatusinine taevas.
works.de: In tin-grey tones a sea view with two small boats at the front edge on the right and a number of larger fishing boats (sailboats) in the middle ground. On the horizon a dark grey streak. Above, a pale blue sky covered with light grey clouds.

works.d: Väikestest põimuvatest ja üksteist katvatest värvilaikudest (sinised, kollakad ja punased toonid) koosnev abstraktne kompositsioon.
works.de: An abstract composition consisting of small interweaving and overlapping patches of colour (blue, yellowish and red tones).

works.t: Kunstnikud, J. Pulitzeri preemia laureaat Edmund Valtman ja Juhan Hennuste Metropolitan Muuseumis 1988. a
works.d: Hämaras interjööris Vana-Egiptuse vaaraoskulptuuride ees kaks keskealist meest seismas-vestlemas. Näitusesaalis vasakul kaks istuvas asendis vaaraofiguuri poolkülgvaates paremale. Nende kohal, taustast joonistub välja kolme skulptuuri pead. Skulptuuride ees paremal kahe prillidega mehe kolmveerandfiguurid:vasakpoolne külgvaates, süvenenult vaatlemas skulptuure, käed püksitaskus, tema kõrval veidi lühem habemik mees pöördunud vaataja poole, žestiks tõstnud vasaku käe. Rohekashallid, ookertoonid, markeeriv laad.
works.de: In a dim interior, in front of Ancient Egyptian pharaoh sculptures, two middle-aged men standing and conversing. In the exhibition hall on the left two seated pharaoh figures in semi-profile facing right. Above them, against the background, the heads of three sculptures stand out. In front of the sculptures on the right, three-quarter figures of two bespectacled men: the left one in profile, engrossed in observing the sculptures, hands in trouser pockets, beside him a slightly shorter bearded man turned towards the viewer, raising his left hand in a gesture. Greenish-grey, ochre tones, sketchy style.

works.d: Sajandialguse perekonnapilti meenutav maal, maja ees pingil istuv ja fotograafile poseeriv pere. Vasakul pereisa tumedas ülikonnas, hoiab põlvedel lamedat ovaalset eset, tema kõrval suurem poiss, kelle ees pikkade heledate juustega laps väikesel pingil, madruseülikond seljas, poisi kõrval pereema, valges kleidis beebi süles, ema kõrval seisab madruseülikonnas väike poiss, vasak käsi mänguhobusel. Taustal vasakul, valge majaseina ääres punakad tellised, virn torusid, lillepõõsas ja hulk mitmesuguseid keraamilisi nõusid. Maali ülemisel poolel kujutatud vaadet maakohale, kus kaks talumaja kahe kõrge korstnaga valge hoone vahel. Valdavalt kahvaturohelised toonid.
works.de: A painting reminiscent of a family portrait from the turn of the century, depicting a family sitting on a bench in front of a house, posing for the photographer. On the left the father of the family in a dark suit, holding a flat oval object on his knees, next to him a larger boy, in front of whom a long fair-haired child sits on a small bench, wearing a sailor suit; next to the boy the mother of the family, in a white dress, with a baby in her lap; next to the mother stands a small boy in a sailor suit, his left hand on a toy horse. In the background on the left, along the white wall of the house, reddish bricks, a pile of pipes, a flowering bush and a number of various ceramic vessels. The upper half of the painting depicts a view of a rural area, with two farmhouses between a white building with two tall chimneys. Predominantly pale green tones.

works.d: Ees rida õitsevaid tulpe. Vasakult nurgast diagonaalselt paremale suunduv tee üksikute roheliste põõsastaimedega servadel. Teest vasakul ja paremal peenramaa. Taga paremal väike helesiniseks võõbatud hoone üksikute suurte puudega, vasakul roheline madal puuhoone. Taga keskel kollane hoone. Lilla taevas.
works.de: In front, a row of blooming tulips. A path leading diagonally from the left corner to the right, with individual green shrubby plants at its edges. To the left and right of the path, a flower bed. Behind, on the right, a small building painted light blue with individual large trees, on the left a green low wooden building. In the middle at the back, a yellow building. Purple sky.

works.d: Ees paekivipõrand, paremal akna all nurgas puukapp. Ülal rida portreid. Keskel trepp balustraadiga vasakul. Vasakul seljaga vastu trepi käsipuud kapp, selle juures tool ja pikas kleidis naise figuur.
works.de: In front, a limestone floor, on the right under the window in the corner a wooden cabinet. Above, a row of portraits. In the middle a staircase with a balustrade on the left. On the left, with its back to the staircase handrail, a cabinet, next to it a chair and the figure of a woman in a long dress.

works.d: Vaipadega kaetud põrandaga toa nurk: ees paremal ümmargune laud. Samas seinas kahe tooli vahel raamaturiiul, sellel lilli, kell ja keraamikat. Nurgas kapp. Seinal maalid.
works.de: A corner of a room with a carpeted floor: in front, on the right, a round table. On the same wall, between two chairs, a bookshelf with flowers, a clock and ceramics on it. A cupboard in the corner. Paintings on the wall.

works.d: Kirjul kattel asuvas tumedas kõrvaga kruusis kirevad (heledais punastes, kollastes, lillades toonides) lilled. Kõrval vasakul pokaal. Värv kohati väga pastoosne.
works.de: On a mottled saucer, in a dark jug with a handle, colourful flowers (in light red, yellow, lilac tones). To the left, a goblet. The paint is in places very pastose.

works.d: Tallinna vaade "Paksu Margarite" juures, esiplaanil end. Rosengarteni küngas, taga linnamajad Paksu Margareta ja Bremeni torniga, keskel Oleviste kirik.
works.de: A view of Tallinn near "Paks Margareeta", in the foreground the former Rosengarten hill, behind city buildings with Paks Margareeta and the Bremen Tower, in the middle St. Olaf's Church.

works.d: Eest taha suunduva jõe künklikel kallastel vasakul: üksikuid hooneid, mägede taustal, paremal asula kirikuhoonega. Keset jõge neem kindluse müüride ja torniga. Taevas pilvistatud.
works.de: On the hilly banks of a river receding from front to back, on the left: individual buildings, against a background of mountains, on the right a settlement with a church building. In the middle of the river a headland with fortress walls and a tower. The sky is clouded.

works.d: Rohke rüüžiga äärestatud tanus keskealise naise poolfiguur peaaegu en face. Taga vasakul ja paremal stiliseeritud kuused.
works.de: Half-figure of a middle-aged woman almost en face, in a bonnet trimmed with abundant ruching. Behind, on the left and right, stylised spruces.

works.d: Lumme mattunud surnuaia vaade: esiplaanil vasakul kaks lumist risti ja raagus puud. Paremal servas, sepisaiaga piiratud hauaplatsil üks suurem rist. Madalat silmapiiri jumestab loojuva päikese puna. Ülalpool taevas hall.
works.de: A view of a snow-covered cemetery: in the foreground on the left two snowy crosses and bare trees. On the right edge, on a grave plot enclosed by a wrought-iron fence, one larger cross. The low horizon is tinged with the red of the setting sun. Above, the sky is grey.

works.d: Ees, pargis, fontääni kõrval jalutav neiu ja noormees. Taustaks suured lehtpuud.
works.de: In front, in a park, beside a fountain, a strolling girl and young man. Large deciduous trees in the background.

works.d: Ees paremal kõrge kaljurahn. Keskel ja vasakul rohtunud maa-ala hiigelsuure kiviga vasakpoolses osas. Taga kaljuahelik.
works.de: In front on the right a tall rocky crag. In the middle and on the left a grassy area with a huge stone in its left part. Behind, a mountain range.

works.d: Vasakul esiplaanil kolm tugevat mändi - lillakashallis toonis tagaplaanis päikesest valgustatud mets paremal ees valguslaikudega teerada.
works.de: On the left in the foreground three sturdy pine trees - in the background a sunlit forest in lilac-grey tones, on the right in front a forest path with patches of light.

works.d: Eest taha paremale suunduv ja tõusev teekurv ääristatud kivimüüriga. Üle vasakpoolse müüri näha kellatorni. Taamal kõrged mäed.
works.de: A road curve, walled with stone, running from front to back and rising to the right. Over the wall on the left a bell tower is visible. High mountains in the distance.

works.d: Paremal kivihoone sein uksega, millest tagapool eendub väljaehitus. Vasakul plank, millest üle ulatuvad õitsevad sireli puhmad. Risti üle õue nöör kuivava pesuga. Pisut eespool, keset õue korv pesuga.
works.de: On the right a stone building's wall with a door, behind which an extension projects. On the left a fence, over which blooming lilac bushes reach. A line with drying laundry stretched across the yard. A little further forward, in the middle of the yard, a basket with laundry.

works.d: Ees keskel pruun rohtu sööv lammas. Fooniks põõsastik.
works.de: In the front center, a brown sheep grazing. Bushes in the background.

works.d: Molberti ees istuva keskealise, tumedajuukselise habemiku mehe põlvpilt, veerandprofiilis paremale. Vasakus käes palett ja pintsleid, parem pintsliga värvi segamas.
works.de: Knee-length portrait of a middle-aged, dark-haired bearded man sitting in front of an easel, in quarter-profile to the right. A palette and brushes in his left hand, the right hand mixing paint with a brush.

works.d: Eest paremalt nurgast taha, keskel läbi teivasaia värava suunduv, rohumaasse tallatud teerada. Keskel, paremal, aia ääres kaks suurt puud.
works.de: In front, from the right corner, a footpath trodden into the grass leads towards the back through a gate in a pole fence in the centre. In the centre, on the right, by the fence, two large trees.

works.d: Esiplaanil liivane küngas kolme suurema männiga selle keskel. Taga männik.
works.de: In the foreground a sandy hill with three large pines in its middle. Behind, a pine forest.

works.d: Interjööris laua ümber istuv perekond isa, ema ja kolm tütart. Taga seinal tumedajuukselise noormehe portree istuvas asendis.
works.de: In the interior a family sitting around a table: father, mother and three daughters. On the wall behind, a portrait of a dark-haired young man in a sitting position.

works.d: Keskel kahe suure puu all istumas grupp inimesi. Vasakul naine rehaga üle õla sammumas grupi poole, pisut kaugemal naine riisumas. Horisondil mets.
works.de: In the middle, under two large trees, a group of people sitting. On the left a woman walking with a rake over her shoulder towards the group, a little further away a woman raking. On the horizon a forest.

works.d: Kuus ukraina rahvarõivais last esiplaanil vasakus kuldlõikes profiilis paremale istuva, karusnahkse mütsiga ja pikka pruuni mantlisse riietatud jutustava ja žestikuleeriva meje ümber. Tema ees, kompositsiooni paremal poolel, istuvad kaks tumesinisesse riietatud tütarlast, nende selja taga seisavad vitstest punutud aiale toetuv valges pluusis vanem, ja kompositsiooni paremas servas väravapostile nõjatuv pika patsiga noorem tütarlaps. Jutustaja vasakul käel kaks poissi pruunides poolpikkades kuubedes, karusnahksetes mütsides. Nende taga avaneb jõemaastik.
works.de: Six children in Ukrainian folk costume in the foreground, on the left in golden section, around a narrator gesturing while seated in profile facing right, wearing a fur cap and a long brown coat. In front of him, on the right side of the composition, sit two girls dressed in dark blue, behind them stand an elder in a white blouse leaning on a wicker fence, and at the right edge of the composition a younger girl with a long braid leaning against a gatepost. To the narrator's left hand are two boys in brown half-length coats and fur caps. Behind them a river landscape opens up.

works.d: Esiplaanil nõlvaku all lehtpuude keskel kahe hoone katused. Tagapool laiad lagedad aasad. Taamal üle vee mets ja hoonete grupp. Maastik kujundatud ovaali.
works.de: In the foreground, under a slope, amid deciduous trees, the roofs of two buildings. Further back, broad open meadows. In the distance, across the water, a forest and a group of buildings. The landscape is composed in an oval.

works.t: Tehase "Võit" vormija stahhaanovlase sm. Ivanovi portree
works.d: Noorema mehe poolfiguur kerge pöördega vasemale. Hoiab käes hammasratast.
works.de: Half-figure of a younger man, slightly turned to the left. Holding a gear wheel in his hand.

works.d: Tütarlaps otsevaates toolil, rohelise lehestiku taustal istumas. Süles avatud raamat. Sinisekirju kleit, kaks patsi roosa paelaga.
works.de: A girl in frontal view sitting on a chair, against a background of green foliage. An open book in her lap. A blue-patterned dress, two braids with a pink ribbon.

works.d: Lõuendi parempoolses osas valge kitli ja mütsikesega noore naise istuv poolfiguur. Vasakul hele ümmargune arstimite lauake pudelite ja riistadega. Üldkoloriit hele.
works.de: In the right-hand part of the canvas, a seated half-figure of a young woman in a white smock and cap. On the left a light round medicine table with bottles and instruments. The overall colouring light.

works.d: Perspektiivselt pildi sügavusse suunduv avar tehase interjöör üldvaates. Paremal põlev ahi, vasakul mitmesugused seadmed, millede juures mitmed töölisfiguurid.
works.de: Perspectival view of a spacious factory interior receding into the depth of the picture, in a general view. On the right a burning furnace, on the left various installations, with several worker figures near them.

works.d: Esiplaanil kolm kraanat, mõned laevad ja paadid. Nende taga heledates toonides virvendav vesi laevadega. Silmapiiril sinetavad mäed. Taevas sinine valgete pilvedega.
works.de: In the foreground three cranes, some ships and boats. Behind them shimmering water in light tones with ships. On the horizon bluish mountains. The sky blue with white clouds.

works.d: Istuva vanema mehe poolfiguur profiilis vasakule. Paljas lagipea, prillid, tume ülikond, helesinine särk musta lipsuga. Vasak käsi toetatud laual. Taga vasakul raamaturiiul. Foon tumedates toonides.
works.de: Half-figure of a seated older man in profile to the left. Bald crown, glasses, dark suit, light blue shirt with black tie. Left hand resting on the table. Behind on the left a bookshelf. Background in dark tones.

works.d: Esiplaanil lõkke kohale riputatud teekann. Paremal vanamees kõrvikmütsis, vasakul kaks naist, kelledest parempoolsel süles laps. Kujutatavad kuuluvad mongoloidsesse rassi. Foon tume.
works.de: In the foreground a teakettle hung above a campfire. On the right an old man in a fur cap, on the left two women, one of whom has a child in her lap. The figures belong to the Mongoloid race. Background dark.

works.d: Prillidega mehe istuv põlvportree, parem käsi toetub põlvele, vasak on lõua juurde viidud, ilme mõtlik. Fooniks teatriafišš.
works.de: Sitting knee-length portrait of a bespectacled man, right hand resting on the knee, left brought up to the chin, pensive expression. Background a theatre poster.

works.d: Keskealise tüseda mehe poolfiguur otsevaates. Parem käsi toetub vaadile, vasak hoiab põlletraksidest. Foon heleroheline.
works.de: Half-figure of a stout middle-aged man in frontal view. Right hand resting on the easel, left hand holding his apron straps. Light green background.

works.d: Sinise draperii taustal lillakas-valge krüsanteem pruunis potis.
works.de: Against a blue drapery background a purplish-white chrysanthemum in a brown pot.

works.d: Voodil istuva roosakas triibulises pidžaamas poisikese täisfiguur. Foon rohekas.
works.de: Full figure of a boy sitting on a bed, in pinkish striped pyjamas. Greenish background.

works.d: Hallides ja pruunides toonides maastik: esiplaanil pisut künklik maapind pooleldi raagus põõsaste ja puudega tuule käes. Keskplaanis kahvatusinine meri, mis ülal läheb üle kollaseks, valkjas-siniste, kohati pastoosselt antud pilvedega taevaks.
works.de: Landscape in gray and brown tones: in the foreground somewhat hilly ground with half-bare bushes and trees in the wind. In the middle ground a pale blue sea, which above turns into a yellow, whitish-blue sky with clouds rendered at places impasto.

works.d: Esiplaanil keskel setu rahvarõivais (sõba ja suure rinnasõlega) vana naine, kass süles, istumas. Naisest vasakul esiplaanil tormilatern, 5 lehmakella ja nöörile aetud kalad. Naisest paremal kimp lillasid ja valgeid lilli. Taamal lattidest aiad, karjamaad ja taluhooned puudega vaheldumisi. Ülal roosakashall taevas.
works.de: In the centre foreground an old woman in Setu folk costume (with a sõba shawl and a large breast brooch), a cat in her lap, sitting. To the left of the woman in the foreground a storm lantern, 5 cowbells and fish strung on a string. To the right of the woman a bunch of purple and white flowers. Beyond, fences of poles, pastures and farm buildings alternating with trees. Above, a pinkish-grey sky.

works.d: Suvine vaade merele. Alumine pool maalipinnast kujutab rohtu kasvanud, liivalaikudega randa. Vee piiril kive, kõrkjaid. Kitsal rohekal mereosal valged lainevahu triibud. Õrn kollakassinine taevas silmapiiri kohal kaetud pilvedega. Maalitud hoogsalt, suure üldistusega.
works.de: Summer view of the sea. The lower half of the painting depicts a grassy shore with patches of sand. Stones and rushes at the water's edge. On the narrow greenish sea area, white streaks of wave foam. A delicate yellowish-blue sky above the horizon covered with clouds. Painted vigorously, with great generalisation.

works.d: Tihedalt hallide ja pruunide pintslilöökidega läbitöötatud abstraktne kompositsioon, millest kirkaina eralduvad üksikud kollased ja punased laigud.
works.de: A densely worked abstract composition of grey and brown brushstrokes, from which individual yellow and red patches vividly stand out.

works.d: Abstraktne kompositsioon, mille foon on diagonaalis jaotatud kaheks: vasakult foon valge, paremalt hall. Üle töö pinna värvilised erikujulised pintslilöögid, kohati väga pastoossed.
works.de: Abstract composition, the background of which is divided diagonally in two: from the left the background is white, from the right grey. Over the surface of the work coloured brushstrokes of various shapes, in places very impasto.

works.d: Kollastest, rohelistest, pruunidest ja sinistest suurtest värvipindadest koosnev peaaegu abstraktselt mõjuv kompositsioon, millesse tumedate joontega on vaevu aimatavalt joonistatud profiilis pea ja ülakeha.
works.de: An almost abstract-seeming composition consisting of large colour areas of yellow, green, brown and blue, into which a head and upper body in profile are barely discernibly drawn with dark lines.

works.d: Abstraktne, lõpuni viimistlemata kompositsioon: heledal foonil punased, hallid ja ookritoonides jooned ja geomeetrilisteks kujunditeks vormitud pinnad.
works.de: Abstract, unfinished composition: on a light background red, grey and ochre-toned lines and surfaces shaped into geometric forms.

works.dm: kujutise kõrgus: 66.0 cm; kujutise laius: 48.0 cm; laius: 50.0 cm; kõrgus: 69.7 cm
works.d: Laiadest hoogsatest pintslilöökidest moodustuv abstraktne kompositsioon, peamiselt punastes, sinistes ja pruunides toonides. Vasak alumine nurk mõjub heledalt ja kergelt, kompositsioon muutub diagonaalselt parema ülanurga suunas üha raskemaks ja pastoossemaks.
works.de: An abstract composition formed of broad sweeping brushstrokes, mainly in red, blue and brown tones. The lower left corner appears light and airy, the composition grows increasingly heavy and pastose diagonally towards the upper right corner.

works.d: Värvilistest geomeetrilistest kujunditest koostatud abstraktne kompositsioon. Peamiselt kasutatud ringi, poolringi ja kolmnurka, mida piiravad pruunid või rohelised jooned. Rohelised, hallid, punased toonid.
works.de: Abstract composition composed of coloured geometric shapes. Mainly circles, semicircles and triangles are used, bordered by brown or green lines. Green, grey, red tones.

works.d: Vaade mereäärsele paadisadamale, paadikuuride, tünnide, meremärkide, paatidega vee piiril. Inimesed kõikjal tegevuses. Esiplaanil paremal kolm meest vestluses, neist parempoolne selgvaates roosakas pluusis mees toetumas jalgrattale. Üldistav laad, kontrastsed värvid.
works.de: View of a seaside boat harbour, with boat sheds, barrels, sea marks, boats at the water's edge. People everywhere, occupied with various activities. In the foreground on the right, three men in conversation, of whom the one on the right, shown in full front view in a pinkish blouse, is leaning on a bicycle. Generalising style, contrasting colours.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal rühm inimesi rannal, vasakul meri, kaldal paadid.
works.de: In the foreground on the right a group of people on the beach, on the left the sea, boats on the shore.

works.d: Tumedas koloriidis talvine rannamaastik. Esiplaanil paremal ja vasakul madalad kalurihütid ning tuulest sasitud latvadega puud. Taamal, rannas kobaras koos laevad. Tagaplaanil ujuvate jääpankadega meri ning pilvine taevas. Värvipind osaliselt faktuurne.
works.de: A winter coastal landscape in dark coloring. In the foreground on the right and left, low fishermen's huts and trees with wind-tousled tops. Further back, on the shore, ships clustered together. In the background, a sea with floating ice floes and a cloudy sky. The paint surface is partly textured.

works.d: I. Vasakpoolsel tiival must nikerdatud jalgadega laud, mille ees suur sangadega vaskkatel ja vitstest korv valge palakaga paremal. Laual mitut sorti puust ja maalitud sihverplaadiga vanaaegseid kelli ja kellade osi. Paremas ülanurgas kimp kirjuid õielilli.
works.de: I. On the left wing a table with black carved legs, in front of it a large copper kettle with handles and a wicker basket with a white cloth on the right. On the table various old clocks made of wood with painted dials, and clock parts, of several kinds. In the upper right corner a bunch of colourful flowers.

works.d: Figuraalne kompositsioon, mille esiplaanil vasakul seisavad kaks vana kihnu rõivastes naist ja nende ees istub blond neiu punasetriibulises seelikus, kass süles. Paremal, poidest ja võrkudest ümbritsetud, rehavarrele toetuv seisev naine. Vasakul servas, keskplaanis, valges rätikus naine, reha õlal. Fooniks Kihnu maastik üksikute puude, põõsaste ja kadakatega, taga kahvatusinine meri ja roosakas taevas. Roosakaspunane ja hall üldkoloriit.
works.de: A figural composition, in the foreground on the left two old women in Kihnu costume are standing, and in front of them a blonde girl in a red-striped skirt is sitting, with a cat in her lap. On the right, a standing woman surrounded by buoys and nets, leaning on a rake handle. On the left edge, in the middle ground, a woman in a white headscarf, with a rake on her shoulder. The background is the Kihnu landscape with solitary trees, bushes and junipers, behind it a pale blue sea and a pinkish sky. Overall pinkish-red and gray colouring.

works.d: Paremas servas neljast vanast ja ühest nooremapoolsest naisest koosnev figuuride grupp kihnu rahvarõivastes (triibulistes seelikutes, tumedates jakkides ja pearättides). Kahel naisel käes roosade õitega õunapuuoksad. Vasakul nurgas all, triibulistel kihnu tekkidel, klaaspoid võrgus, tormilatern, sump, poi, puust kalakühveödamise labidas. Foon roosakasoranž.
works.de: In the right-hand part, a group of figures consisting of four old women and one younger woman in Kihnu folk costumes (striped skirts, dark jackets and headscarves). Two women hold apple-tree branches with pink blossoms. In the bottom left corner, on striped Kihnu blankets, glass floats in netting, a storm lantern, a fish trap, a buoy, a wooden fish-scooping shovel. The background is pinkish-orange.

works.d: Maali vasak pool ja parem neljandik kujutab valdavalt sinkjaid, hallikaid, rohekaid, beeže ühtlaselt maalitud geomeetrilisi pindu, jooni. Nende vahel interjööri motiiv kraanikausi, ukse, aknavaatega, silindrilise heleda valgustiga ülal.
works.de: The left half and right quarter of the painting depict predominantly bluish, greyish, greenish, beige, evenly painted geometric surfaces and lines. Between them an interior motif with a view of a sink, a door, a window, and a cylindrical light-coloured lamp above.

works.d: Tinglikult lahendatud uste-akende, interjööri motiividesse lõikuvad mustad geomeetrilised pinnad. Vasakul aimatav aknavaade aeda raagus puu kujutisega. Keskel püstne, all paremal ühtlaselt must kaldpind. Paremal klaasuste, akende kujutisi, peegeldusi neis. Kollakasooker, sinkjashallid segatud toonid.
works.de: Black geometric surfaces intersecting conventionally rendered motifs of doors, windows and interiors. On the left a suggested window view into a garden with the image of a bare tree. In the centre an upright, below right a uniformly black sloping surface. On the right images of glass doors, windows, and reflections in them. Yellowish ochre, bluish-grey mixed tones.

works.d: Roosal taustal valged laigud. Musta-halliga üle pildi pinna mitmesugused joonkujundid, mis moodustavad abstraktse näo joonise. Ülal keskel kaks sõõrjat silma, keskel markeeritud nina ning all avatud ümar suu. Paiguti markeerivalt maalitud ka näo piirjooni.
works.de: White patches on a pink background. Black-and-grey various linear forms across the surface of the picture, forming an abstract drawing of a face. Above in the middle two round eyes, a marked nose in the centre, and below an open round mouth. In places the contours of the face are also marked in paint.

works.d: Abstraktne, veidi pastoosne, voolavate värvijugade ning -pritsmetega maali keskosas paikneb suur tumelillas-violetses toonis sõõr, mida läbib diagonaal. Taust heledam, kollastest toonides. Mitmel pool punaseid, siniseid, valgeid värvilaike.
works.de: An abstract, slightly pastose painting with flowing streams and splashes of paint; in the middle of the picture a large circle in dark purple-violet tones, crossed by a diagonal. Background lighter, in yellowish tones. In several places patches of red, blue, white paint.

works.d: Abstraktne, mitut tooni kollased ümaravormilised kujundid. Vasakul keskel vertikaalselt suur must ebakorrapärane laik. Paremal all sarnane motiiv valkjas-kollakas toonis. Maali üla- ja alaosal tumeda värviga kohati pastoossed "kammi" jäljendid. Keskel horisontaalne ebasümmeetriline kollastes toonides kujund. Maalil hõljuv-voolav meeleolu, mikroorganisme meenutav.
works.de: Abstract, yellow rounded shapes in several tones. In the middle left a large irregular black blotch, vertical. Lower right a similar motif in whitish-yellow tone. In the upper and lower parts of the painting, dark-coloured, occasionally impasto "comb" traces. In the centre a horizontal asymmetrical shape in yellow tones. The painting has a hovering, flowing mood, reminiscent of microorganisms.

works.d: Meri. Keskel, vasakult paremale merre tungival maaninal kalurimaju, paate ja purjekaid.
works.de: The sea. In the middle, on a headland jutting into the sea from left to right, fishermen's houses, boats and sailboats.

works.d: Hallipäise, halli habeme ja prillidega mehe rinnaportree akna foonil. Mehe keha profiilis ja nägu veerandpöördes paremale.
works.de: Bust portrait of a grey-haired man with a grey beard and glasses against the background of a window. The man's body in profile and face in a quarter-turn to the right.

works.d: Naise poolfiguur poolprofiilis paremale. Kaelus kõrge, heleda krookega ja tumeda laia pitsiga. Kaelas ripub medaljon.
works.de: Half-figure of a woman in semi-profile to the right. High collar, with a light ruff and a dark wide lace. A medallion hangs from her neck.

works.d: Esiplaanil eest taha suunduv oja, kallastel puud, tagaplaanil mets.
works.de: A stream running from front to back in the foreground, trees on the banks, forest in the background.

works.d: Esialal neli meesfiguuri: keskmine, hallipäine mees kasukas ja papaahhas, hoiab käes paberit nagu näidates midagi tema kõrval seisvale noorele tumedajuukselisele nokkmütsis mehele. Paremal noor mees, kasukas ja läkiläkis, padrunivööd üle õla, rihma küljes käsigranaate, profiilis vasemale. Keskel seisvate meeste taga noor mees, punane lint ümber vasema käsivarre, pea suunatud vasakule. Tagapool vasemal raskekuulipildujat vedavad mehed, silmapiiril leekides hoone. Paremal raudteevaguni ees rühm sõjaväe vormis mehi askeldamas.
works.de: In the foreground four male figures: the middle one, a grey-haired man in a fur coat and papakha, holds a piece of paper in his hand as if showing something to the young dark-haired man in a peaked cap standing beside him. On the right a young man, in a fur coat and forage cap, cartridge belts over his shoulder, hand grenades attached to his belt, in profile facing left. Behind the men standing in the middle a young man, a red ribbon around his left arm, his head turned to the left. Further back on the left men pulling a heavy machine gun, on the horizon a building in flames. On the right, in front of a railway carriage, a group of men in military uniform busy at work.

works.d: Raamaturiiuli kirjul foonil mehe istuv täisfiguur. Kerge peapööre vasakule, pealagi paljas, ees prillid; põlvedele toetuvad käed suitseva sigaretiga ees. Ülikond ühtlaselt hall. Maalitud õhukeselt suures pinnas, figuur piiratud musta kontuurjoonega.
works.de: Full figure of a seated man against a motley background of a bookshelf. Slight turn of the head to the left, bald crown, glasses in front; hands resting on the knees with a smoking cigarette held in front. Suit uniformly grey. Painted thinly over a large surface, the figure bounded by a black contour line.

works.d: Esiplaanil hulk raudteerööpaid ja vaguneid. Eemal maju ja Toompea siluett.
works.de: In the foreground a number of railway tracks and wagons. In the distance houses and the silhouette of Toompea.

works.d: Sinakas-lilla laigulisel foonil, roosaka riidega kaetud pingil istuv naisakt otsevates, helepruunide, õlgadeni juustega, vasak käsi toetub istme servale.
works.de: A female nude sitting on a bench covered with pinkish cloth, against a bluish-purple mottled background, with straight, light brown hair to the shoulders, left hand resting on the edge of the seat.

works.d: Tormisel, lainetaval merel keskel aurik, süngelt tumedais pilveis taeva taustal.
works.de: On a stormy, wavy sea, a steamship in the middle, against a background of gloomily dark clouds in the sky.

works.d: Naise rinnapilt poolprofiilis vasakule. Peas pitstanu lillega, õlgadel valge rätik.
works.de: Bust of a woman in half-profile to the left. On her head a lace bonnet with a flower, on her shoulders a white kerchief.

works.d: Esiplaanil veekogu. Tagapool aeglaselt kõrgenev liivane kallas hõreda okas- ja lehtpuumetsaga. Vee ääres inimgruppe.
works.de: In the foreground, a body of water. Behind it, a slowly rising sandy shore with sparse coniferous and deciduous forest. Groups of people by the water.

works.d: Ees vasemal ja keskel veepind suurte peegeldustega, mille taga madal pruun kõrkjane maapind raagus põõsaste ja puurühmaga vasemal ning (tagant võsaga palistatud) väiksema veepinnaga keskel. Paremal roheline nõlvak raagus metsaga. Taga keskel ja paremal raagus mets.
works.de: In front on the left and in the centre a water surface with large reflections, behind which low brown sedge-covered ground with bare bushes and a group of trees on the left and (bordered behind by scrub) a smaller water surface in the centre. On the right a green slope with bare forest. Behind, in the centre and on the right, bare forest.

works.d: Punase pearätikuga ümarat pesukorvi käes hoidva vana naise täisfiguur poolprofiilis vasakule.
works.de: Full figure of an old woman in half-profile to the left, holding a round laundry basket, wearing a red headscarf.

works.d: Ees keskel tee, millest paremal ja vasakul siniste ja kollaste õitega lillepuhmad. Paremal taga lehtpuu tukk.
works.de: In the front, in the middle, a road, to the right and left of which are flower clumps with blue and yellow blossoms. Behind on the right, a clump of deciduous trees.

works.d: Eest, keset okaspuu metsa, taha paremale suunduv kitsas lagendik. Tagapoolsed männikroonid ja taevas lillaka varjundiga.
works.de: In front, in the middle of a coniferous forest, a narrow clearing leading away to the right. Pine crowns further back and a sky with a purplish tinge.

works.d: Ees lagedal jääväljal kaks selgvaates meest ja hobune vankril istuva mehega. Horisondil (vasakul) asula siluett. Üle maastiku päikeseloojandust punetav taevas.
works.de: In front, on an open ice field, two men in clear view and a horse with a man sitting on a cart. On the horizon (left) the silhouette of a settlement. Over the landscape a sky reddening with sunset.

works.d: Ees veekogu. Tagapool kallas hoonete ja puudegrupiga.
works.de: In front a body of water. Behind, a bank with buildings and a group of trees.

works.d: Esiplaanil peaaegu peegelsile merepind. Horisondil rannaäär. 3/4 tööst rünkpilvedega taeva all.
works.de: In the foreground an almost mirror-smooth sea surface. Coastline on the horizon. 3/4 of the work under a sky with cumulus clouds.

works.d: Ees paremal nurgas paremale tõusvad trepiastmed. Ülal kõrgemal kaldal teivasaia taga lumme mattunud hooned.
works.de: In front, in the right corner, steps rising to the right. Higher up on the bank, behind a picket fence, buildings buried in snow.

works.d: Esiplaanil lillelise muru keskel looklev tee. Keskel, vasakul ja paremal, kuni töö ülaservani, näha suurte lehtpuude ladvaoksi. Taamal keskel, puude ja põõsaste vahel torniga maja katus.
works.de: In the foreground, amid flowery grass, a winding path. In the middle, left and right, up to the top edge of the work, the crowns of large deciduous trees can be seen. In the distance, in the middle, between trees and bushes, the roof of a house with a tower.

works.d: Mustajuukselise punases kleidis naise poolfiguur pruunil taustal. Keha poolprofiilis, pea täisprofiilis paremale.
works.de: Half-figure of a dark-haired woman in a red dress against a brown background. Body in half profile, head in full profile to the right.

works.d: Mustas laiaäärses kübaras heledapäise tütarlapse täisprofiil paremale (rinnapilt). Taust pruun.
works.de: Full profile to the right of a fair-haired girl in a black wide-brimmed hat (bust portrait). Brown background.

works.d: Noorepoolse naise rinnapilt en face, õhukese, looritaoliselt seljale langeva rätikuga juustel.
works.de: The bust portrait of a young woman en face, hair with a thin, veil-like kerchief falling down her back.

works.d: Noore naise alasti täisfiguur, en face, lehvikuga paremas käes, vasak käsi toetumas ebamäärase kujuga postamendile.
works.de: Full figure of a young nude woman, en face, with a fan in her right hand, her left hand resting on a vaguely shaped pedestal.

works.d: Lühikestes rohelistes pükstes mehe täisfiguur profiilis paremale. Ettepoole kummardunult hoiab käes pikavarrelist piiki.
works.de: Full figure of a man in short green trousers, in profile to the right. Bent forward, holding a long-shafted pike in his hands.

works.d: Esiplaanil looklev lumine tee. Taga lumine mets.
works.de: In the foreground a winding snowy road. Behind it a snowy forest.

works.d: Ees väike, rohtunud platsike eest otse taha suunduva teerajaga. Tagapool, kahel pool teerada üksikud kõrged, vanad puud. Nende taga võsastik.
works.de: In the foreground a small, grassy patch with a path leading straight into the distance. Further back, on both sides of the path, single tall old trees. Behind them a thicket.

works.d: Ees keskel ja paremal veekogu. Vasakul madal kivine kallas. Vastaskaldal järsuseinalised kaljud.
works.de: In front, in the middle and on the right, a body of water. On the left a low stony shore. On the opposite shore steep-walled cliffs.

works.d: Esiplaanil veekogu kivisillaga keskel, paremal hoone palkoniga ja kirik, vasakul võsastunud kallas. Päikesepaisteline hommik.
works.de: In the foreground a body of water with a stone bridge in the middle, on the right a building with a balcony and a church, on the left an overgrown shore. A sunny morning.

works.dm: kõrgus: 95.0 cm (vm.); laius: 141.0 cm (arm.); kõrgus: 96.5 cm; laius: 133.5 cm (vm.)
works.d: Esiplaanil, keskel, tantsijate grupp rahvarõivais, vasemal mehefiguurid viiuldajaga keskel, paremal laua taga istuv noorpaar - peigmees helesinises kuues, mõrsja pärjastatud. Talutuba rohelisega kaunistatud.
works.de: In the foreground, in the centre, a group of dancers in folk costume, on the left male figures with a violinist in the middle, on the right a young couple sitting at a table - the groom in a light blue coat, the bride wreathed. The farmhouse room decorated with greenery.

works.d: Esiplaanil puudest ümbritsetud üksiku onni ees kolm mehefiguuri tulelõkke ümber. Vasemal söemiil, mille tagant tõuseb suitsusammas. Eemal lumine mets kuuvalgel.
works.de: In the foreground, three male figures around a fire in front of a lone hut surrounded by trees. On the left a charcoal kiln, behind which a column of smoke rises. In the distance a snowy forest in moonlight.

works.d: Esiplaanil jõekallas, vasemal tara ja majanurga kõrval naine seakarjaga, ratsanik ja väike poiss pardikarjaga, nende taga sild, küün ja palgivirnad; paremal veepinnale kummardunud puud. Taamal mets, vasakul poolpilves taevas.
works.de: In the foreground a riverbank, on the left a fence and, beside the corner of a house, a woman with a herd of pigs, a rider and a small boy with a flock of ducks, behind them a bridge, a barn and stacks of logs; on the right trees bending over the water's surface. In the distance forest, on the left a partly cloudy sky.

works.d: Esiplaanil keskel aiaga piiratud tee, vasakul ja paremal puudega kaetud künkad, taga keskel Tallinna siluett kaugvaates.
works.de: In the foreground, in the centre, a fenced path, hills covered with trees on the left and right, in the background in the centre a distant view of the Tallinn skyline.

works.d: Keskealise naise täisfiguur toolil istuvana, pööre 3/4 profiilis vasakule. Taustaks paremal punane draperii, vasakul üle balustraadi näha puude latvu.
works.de: Half-length... wait, full figure of a middle-aged woman seated on a chair, turned 3/4 profile to the left. Background with red drapery on the right, on the left tree tops visible over a balustrade.

works.t: Nunna värav Tallinnas. (Vana postijaam Nunnavärava juures)
works.d: Esialal keskel õu, milles kahe vankri juures mees hobusega, paremal lattaia ääres üksikud puud. Keskel vasakul punase telliskatusega kivimaja, mille taga ja kõrval linnamüüri torne. Tornidest paremal Toompea nõlvakule kerkiv linnamüür, milles nõlvaku jalal väravaava. Selle ees poollagunenud eelvärava ehitis, milles asuvat värava ava linna suunas läbib talunaine vankris. Paremal ülal, Toompea nõlval veel maju.
works.de: In the foreground centre a yard in which a man with a horse stands by two carts, on the right by a plank fence solitary trees. In the centre left a stone house with a red tiled roof, behind and beside it towers of the town wall. To the right of the towers the town wall rising up the slope of Toompea, at the foot of the slope a gate opening. In front of it a half-ruined outer gate structure, through the gate opening leading towards the town a peasant woman passes in a cart. Above on the right, on the slope of Toompea, more houses.

works.d: Tumedajuukselise noore naise rinnapilt poolprofiilis vasakule. Seljas sinine valgete rüüžidega kleit. Kõrvas kõrvarõngad. Portree kujutatud ovaalis.
works.de: Bust portrait of a dark-haired young woman in half-profile facing left. Wearing a blue dress with white ruffles. Earrings in her ears. The portrait depicted in an oval.

works.d: Paremal tiik, milles neli hani. Vasakul tiigi kaldal neli hani. Taga puud ja hooned.
works.de: On the right a pond with four geese in it. On the left, on the pond's shore, four geese. Behind, trees and buildings.

works.d: Esiplaanil nõlvak, vasemal ja paremal puud. Tagapool punase katusega ümarik kindlustustorn, Kiek in de Kök Tallinnas.
works.de: In the foreground a slope, trees on the left and right. Behind, a round fortification tower with a red roof, Kiek in de Kök in Tallinn.

works.d: Noor naine valges siidikleidis kinkidega laua taga. Vasakus käes kollane siidirätik. Laual tort, roosid ja karp ehetega. Naise vaade suunatud kollase siidirätiku ülemise serva poole.
works.de: A young woman in a white silk dress at a table with gifts. In her left hand a yellow silk scarf. On the table a cake, roses and a box with jewelry. The woman's gaze directed toward the upper edge of the yellow silk scarf.

works.d: Esiplaanil viljapõld kuue rukkilõikajaga: viis naist Hiiu valgetes, punaste peakatetega rahvariietes, vasakul mees kübaraga. Tagapoole põldu ääristav kiviaed ja tee viib külla. Pildi keskosas, suurte puude vahel kahekorruseline kelpkatusega valge hoone, sellest vasakul väiksem maja ja kooguga kaev, mille tagant paistmas terava tornikiivriga kirik. Ca 2/3 maali pinnast on rünkpilvine kõrge äikeseeelne taevas, heledad valguselaigud langevad rukkilõikajatele.
works.de: In the foreground a grain field with six rye reapers: five women in white Hiiumaa folk costumes with red headwear, on the left a man with a hat. Behind, a stone wall borders the field and a road leads to the village. In the middle part of the picture, between large trees, a two-storey white building with a hipped roof, to its left a smaller house and a well with a sweep, behind which a church with a sharp spire is visible. About 2/3 of the painting's surface is a high, cumulus, pre-thunderstorm sky, bright patches of light falling on the rye reapers.

works.d: Noore mehe poolfiguur poolprofiilis vasakule, valges rokokoo parukas. Karusnahkse krae ja äärestusega mantel, suur ordenitäht, üle rinna lai punane ordenipael, nööpaugus sinivalge lindi otsas rist. Kujutus ovaalis.
works.de: Half-figure of a young man in three-quarter profile to the left, in a white rococo wig. Coat with fur collar and trimming, large order star, wide red order ribbon across the chest, cross on the end of a blue-white ribbon in the buttonhole. Depiction in an oval.

works.d: Mehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis vasemale, pilk suunatud paremale. Rinnas krooniga order monogrammiga.
works.de: Bust of a man in half-profile to the left, gaze directed to the right. On his chest an order with a crown and monogram.

works.d: Esiplaanil jäätunud tiik kolme uisutajaga. Tagapool, paremal ja vasemal, tiigi kaldail raagus tihnik. Taga keskel valgustatud akendega maja.
works.de: In the foreground a frozen pond with three skaters. Behind, on the right and left, bare thickets on the pond's shores. In the back in the middle a house with lit windows.

works.d: Ees, keset lumelagendikku, veeloik. 2/3 tööst päikese loojangust punetava taeva all.
works.de: In front, in the middle of a snowy expanse, a puddle. 2/3 of the work under a sky reddening from the sunset.

works.d: Eest tahapoole kõrgeneval kallakul hõredate raagus puude all ees paremal roheline sammaldunud kivi. Taga vasakul, kallaku harjal, sammaldunud kivirahnud.
works.de: On a slope rising from front to back, under sparse bare trees, a green mossy stone in the foreground on the right. Behind on the left, on the ridge of the slope, mossy boulders.

works.d: Ees promenaad. Vaatleja poolsel promenaadi ääristaval murul paremal kolm last, keskel kolm mängivat koera. Tagapool laudade ümber inimeste grupid. Taustaks lehtpuu mets (park).
works.de: In front, a promenade. On the lawn bordering the promenade on the viewer's side, three children on the right, in the middle three playing dogs. Behind, groups of people around tables. In the background, a deciduous forest (park).

works.d: Esiplaanil lainetav meri, vasakul purjekas, horisondil aurik.
works.de: In the foreground a wavy sea, on the left a sailboat, on the horizon a steamer.

works.d: Esiplaanil madalas kaldavees grupp suuri kive. Tagapool vahutav meri. Horisondil loojuvast päikesest punetav taevas.
works.de: In the foreground, in shallow shore water, a group of large stones. Behind it, a foaming sea. On the horizon, a sky reddened by the setting sun.

works.d: Keset lagedat heinamaad vasakult paremale voolav jõgi. Vastaskaldal kari. Taamal üksik hoone. Silmapiiril mets.
works.de: In the middle of an open meadow a river flowing from left to right. On the opposite bank a herd. In the distance a lone building. On the horizon a forest.

works.d: Keset peegeltasast merd purjelaev. Horisondil aurik.
works.de: In the middle of a mirror-smooth sea a sailing ship. On the horizon a steamer.

works.d: Kristus istuvas asendis valgel linal, mida inglid servadest kannavad. Eskiis.
works.de: Christ in a seated position on a white cloth, carried by angels at the edges. Sketch.

works.d: Aopunas merelaht, kaugemal sadamahooned, suitsevad korstnad vasakul. Esiplaanil kai, paremal ankrus seisev punase-musta triibuline laev külgvaates. Selle taga laevamaste. Maal pruunikasbeežis, sinakashallis toonis.
works.de: Sea bay at sunset glow, further away harbour buildings, smoking chimneys on the left. In the foreground a quay, on the right a red-and-black striped ship at anchor seen from the side. Behind it ship masts. Painting in brownish-beige, bluish-grey tones.

works.d: Ees kalda ääres rida paate ja purjepaat. Vastaskallas lage rohtunud liivamaa. Horisondil mets.
works.de: In front by the shore a row of boats and a sailboat. The opposite shore bare grassy sandy land. Forest on the horizon.

works.d: Esiplaanil kivine rannik, vasemal laht purjekatega, paremal kõrgendik. Koloriit tume.
works.de: In the foreground, a rocky coastline, on the left a bay with sailing boats, on the right an elevation. Dark colouring.

works.d: Esiplaanil naine-karjus tumedas riietuses, ees sinakas põll; ümber lambad (8). Tagapool lage heinamaa, taamal metsapiir. Taevaserv punakalt valgustatud.
works.de: In the foreground a woman shepherd in dark clothing, a bluish apron in front; around her sheep (8). Further back open meadow, beyond a forest edge. The edge of the sky lit reddishly.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal kallas, vasakul veekogu, keskplaanil veekogus üksikute suurte kividega. Tagaplaanil maastik.
works.de: In the foreground on the right a shore, on the left a body of water, in the middle ground a body of water with individual large stones. In the background a landscape.

works.d: Sügavalt otsmikul istuva pärlitikandiga peakattes noore neiu rinnapilt; õlad pöördega vasakule, pea paremale.
works.de: Bust portrait of a young girl wearing a pearl-embroidered headdress sitting low on the forehead; shoulders turned to the left, head to the right.

works.d: Esiplaanil kaks poissi kirsse ostmas noorelt naiselt, kelle kõrval seisab noormees, paremal sammastega hoone.
works.de: In the foreground two boys buying cherries from a young woman, next to whom stands a young man, on the right a building with columns.

works.d: Tumepruuni värvi hobuse figuur täisprofiilis vasakule, seotud posti külge.
works.de: Figure of a dark brown horse in full profile to the left, tied to a post.

works.d: Keskel ees must pikakarvaline koer, ilmse huviga jälgimas paremal õhus lendlevat kirjut liblikat, taustaks meri purjekatega kauguses.
works.de: In the centre foreground a black long-haired dog, watching with evident interest a patterned butterfly fluttering in the air to the right, background a sea with sailboats in the distance.

works.d: Rokokoo mööbliga sisustatud toa nurk. Parempoolses seinas kaks suurt akent. Esimese akna juures harfi kõrval seisva daami figuur.
works.de: The corner of a room furnished with rococo furniture. In the right-hand wall two large windows. By the first window the figure of a lady standing next to a harp.

works.d: Tumedajuukselise poisikeseohtu noormehe rinnapilt, käsipõsakil nõjatuvana paremale küünarnukile. Peas lai, madal kübar, seljas tume metallnööpidega kuub ja valge särk punase kaelarätikuga. Vasakul äärel viinamarjaväät. Kujutis ovaalis.
works.de: Bust portrait of a dark-haired boyish young man, leaning on his right elbow with his cheek resting on his hand. On his head a wide, low hat, wearing a dark coat with metal buttons and a white shirt with a red neckerchief. On the left edge a vine garland. The image is in an oval.

works.d: Naise poolfiguur peaga poolprofiilis paremale. Rõivastuseks rohekassinine kleit avara dekolteega, punane mantel õlgadel.
works.de: Half-figure of a woman with her head in three-quarter profile to the right. Dressed in a greenish-blue dress with a wide décolletage, a red coat over her shoulders.

works.d: Kaks vaevu markeeritud nägudega naisefiguuri kummaski pildi servas. Mõlemal seljas kraedega rohelisekirjud kleidid ja peas tanu või turbanit meenutavad peakatted. Naiste vahel hele, pealt punane, torti meenutav kujund. Foon koosneb tihedalt üksteise kõrvale tipitud rohelistest, punasega ümbritsetud rõngastest.
works.de: Two female figures with barely marked faces on each edge of the picture. Both wear green-patterned dresses with collars and headwear resembling a bonnet or a turban. Between the women a light form, red on top, resembling a torte. The background consists of green rings tightly stitched next to one another, surrounded by red.

works.d: Hallijuukselise põskhabemega mehe rinnapilt en face. Vasakus sõrmustatud käes pruun portsigar.
works.de: Bust portrait en face of a grey-haired man with side-whiskers. In his left ringed hand a brown cigarette case.

works.d: Topograafiliselt kaunis, üksikasjalikult esitatud Narva jõe vaade kahe kindlusega teine teisel pool jõge. Esiplaanil viiest mehest ja väikesest valgesse rõivastatud tüdrukust koosnev figuuridegrupp. Jõe kaldal esiplaanil puumaju, aedikuid, loomi ja põõsaid. Vasakul ja paremal servas puudegrupid. Silmaüiiril, kindlusehitustest vasakul ja paremal, laialipillatult maastikus väikesi maju. Ülal sinine, hallides pilveviirgudes ja valgetes pilvekuhilates taevas.
works.de: A topographically beautiful, detailed view of the Narva river with two fortresses, one on each side of the river. In the foreground a group of figures consisting of five men and a small girl dressed in white. On the riverbank in the foreground, wooden houses, enclosures, animals and bushes. Groups of trees on the left and right edges. On the skyline, to the left and right of the fortress buildings, small houses scattered in the landscape. Above, a blue sky with grey cloud streaks and white cloud masses.

works.d: Esiplaanil veekogu. Selle tagumisel kaldal, paremalt äärelt kuni keskosani ulatuva võsastiku taga taluhooned mäekuplite taustal.
works.de: In the foreground a body of water. On its far shore, behind bushes extending from the right edge to the middle, farm buildings against a background of hill peaks.

works.d: Hallijuukselise mehe rinnapilt, kerge pöördega vasakule.
works.de: Chest portrait of a grey-haired man, slightly turned to the left.

works.d: Hallijuukselise, vurrude ja väikese lõuahabemega mehe poolfiguur. Laua taga istuvana. Keha kerge pöördega vasakule. Vasakus, lauale toetuvas käes paber.
works.de: Half-figure of a grey-haired man with a moustache and small chin beard. Seated behind a table. Body turned slightly to the left. In his left hand, resting on the table, a paper.

works.d: Avatud aknal istuva, heledapäise, heledas kleidis naise kolmveerandfiguur, raamat süles. Aknast paistab suvine aed.
works.de: Three-quarter figure of a fair-haired woman in a light-coloured dress sitting at an open window, a book in her lap. A summer garden is visible through the window.

works.d: Kuljas klaasvaasis kimp lillasid sireleid.
works.de: A bouquet of purple lilacs in a golden glass vase.

works.d: Künklik maastik. Esiplaanil üksikuid mände ja okaspuid. Keskel veekogu (järv). Taamal kõrgenev maastik metsatukkadega.
works.de: Hilly landscape. In the foreground solitary pines and conifers. In the middle a body of water (a lake). Behind, rising terrain with clumps of forest.

works.d: Esiplaanil Riia tn. Tartus üksiku hobuse ja vankriga seisvana parempoolsel tänavaäärel, millel kujutatud majaderivi puiesteega selle ees piirab vasakult Pauluse kirik, kõrgele tõusva torniga. Puiesteel jalutavaid inimfiguure.
works.de: In the foreground Riia Street in Tartu, with a single horse and cart standing on the right side of the street, on which a row of houses with a boulevard is depicted, bordered on the left by St. Paul's Church with its tall rising tower. Figures of people strolling on the boulevard.

works.d: Vasakul lippude taustal viiulit mängiv mees, paremal kuulavad sõdurid püssidega. Maalitud punastes toonides.
works.de: On the left a man playing the violin against a background of flags, on the right soldiers with rifles listening. Painted in red tones.

works.d: Tumedates mustades ja punastes toonides pildipinda läbivad heledad teravad kolmnurksed kujundid. Allosas heledas kolmnurgas seisab prillides mehe poolfiguur, käed kõrval.
works.de: Light, sharp triangular shapes cross the picture surface in dark black and red tones. In the lower part, in a light triangle, stands the half-figure of a man wearing glasses, arms at his sides.

works.d: Valges kitlis keskealise mehe poolfiguur punasel foonil. Otsevaates, vasaku käe nimetissõrm vasakul põsel.
works.de: Half-figure of a middle-aged man in a white smock against a red background. Frontal view, the index finger of the left hand on the left cheek.

works.d: Kaksikportree sinakais-rohekais toonides. Kaks keskealise mehe rinnafiguuri otsevaates.
works.de: A double portrait in bluish-greenish tones. Two chest-length figures of a middle-aged man in frontal view.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul, poolprofiilis paremale, seisev mees kaitsekiivriga, ülestõstetud paremas käes keevitusjuhe, mida ta hoiab puusa kõrguselt vasema käega. All vasakul kükitav keevitaja kaitseprillides. Alumises vasemas nurgas väike transportöör. Paremas kuldlõikes avaneb vaade keskplaanile (meri kaide vahel) ning tagaplaanile (dokis seisev laev tellingutega taglase osas). Domineerib sinine ja rohekassinine ültoon.
works.de: In the foreground on the left, in half-profile facing right, a standing man with a protective helmet, in his raised right hand a welding cable which he holds at hip height with his left hand. In the lower left a crouching welder wearing protective goggles. In the lower left corner a small conveyor. In the right golden section a view opens onto the middle plane (sea between quays) and the background (a ship standing in dock with scaffolding around part of the rigging). Blue and greenish-blue overtone dominate.

works.d: Paremas nurgas esiplaanil pruunis laia kraega mantlis ja pruuni salliga mehe rinnaportree. Hall lopsakas habe, peas sonimüts. Foonil talvised, härmatisega kaetud raagus puud. Foon hall.
works.de: In the right corner in the foreground a chest portrait of a man in a brown coat with a wide collar and a brown scarf. A lush gray beard, wearing a fur hat. In the background winter, frost-covered bare trees. The background is gray.

works.t: Pärnu kalurikolhoosi "Vaal" kalur Johannes Kull (Mehe portree)
works.d: Sonimütsis ja rohekas vattkuues mees küünarnnukkidega toetumas mootorpaadi kajuti katusele. Taustal vasakul meri ja hele taevas.
works.de: A man in a sou'wester hat and greenish quilted coat leaning with his elbows on the roof of a motorboat cabin. In the background on the left the sea and a bright sky.

works.d: Esiplaanil suur kollakasroheline kast, mille kohal vasakul värvilised laigud ja jooned, paremal avatud raamat reprodukstioonidega. Silmapiiril Tallinna panoraami, sadamaga esiplaanil, kujutav maal. Foon allosas tumesinine valgete pastoossete laikudega, ülal ühtlaselt helesinine. Maalitud kohati pritsimistehnikat kasutades, kohati pastoosselt.
works.de: In the foreground a large yellowish-green box, above which on the left coloured patches and lines, on the right an open book with reproductions. On the horizon a painting depicting a panorama of Tallinn, with a harbour in the foreground. The background in the lower part is dark blue with white pastose patches, above it uniformly light blue. Painted in places using a splattering technique, in places pastosely.

works.d: Tumehallil taustal roosakaspunase näoga tõsise-karmi ilmega vanema mehe portree veerandpöördes vasakule. Juuksed, lopsakas habe, vuntsid hallid. Seljas tume kuub, valge kaelus. Maalitud ühtlaste siledate pintslilöökidega, näo osas pastoossemalt, detaili jälgivalt.
works.de: Portrait of a serious-stern-faced elderly man with a pinkish-red face against a dark grey background, in a quarter-turn to the left. Hair, luxuriant beard, moustache grey. Wearing a dark coat, white collar. Painted with even smooth brushstrokes, more pastose and detail-attentive in the face area.

works.d: Vaade Tallinna Toomkiriku kooriruumi vappidega seinale.
works.de: View of the wall with coats of arms in the choir of Tallinn Cathedral.

works.d: Paremal nõlvak mändide ja kanarbikuga; vasemal org, taga mände.
works.de: On the right a slope with pines and heather; on the left a valley, pines behind.

works.d: Esiplaanil kanarbikuline lammorg. Taga paremal kalda nõlvakul mänitukk. Taamal mets.
works.de: In the foreground a heathland valley. Behind on the right, on the slope of a bank, a juniper bush. Beyond, a forest.

works.d: Esiplaanil lumine küngas raagus puudega. Taga vallil kivihooned.
works.de: In the foreground a snowy hillock with bare trees. Behind, stone buildings on a rampart.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal kivine rannik ja meri. Vasemal tahapoole suunduv kõrge paekallas lehtpuudega.
works.de: In the foreground on the right a rocky coast and sea. On the left a high limestone bank receding backward, with deciduous trees.

works.d: Paremal meri. Vasakul kivine rand ja põõsas. Keskel vees suur kivi.
works.de: Sea on the right. Rocky shore and bush on the left. A large stone in the water in the middle.

works.d: Vaade Toompeale Snelli tiigi äärest sellise vaatenurga all, et kindlusest on näha vaid Pilstickeri torn.
works.de: View of Toompea from the edge of Snelli Pond, from an angle such that only the Pilsticker Tower can be seen of the fortress.

works.d: Liivaluidete ja männimetsaga maastik: paremal keskel kolm mändi, vasakul nurgas väike männipuhmas, taamal liivasel kõrgendikul männitukk, millele tumedate pilvede vahelt langeb päikesevihk.
works.de: Landscape with sand dunes and pine forest: on the right in the middle three pines, in the left corner a small pine bush, further back on a sandy elevation a pine grove, on which a ray of sunlight falls through dark clouds.

works.d: Esiplaanil roheline luhta meenutav rannaäär, silmapiiril mereviirg, mida hõbetab ülalt pilvede vahelt alla langev valgus. Paremal mere poole suunduv väike jõgi või oja. Ülal hallide pilvedega kaetud taevas.
works.de: In the foreground a green, meadow-like shoreline, on the horizon a strip of sea, silvered by light falling from between clouds above. On the right a small river or stream flowing toward the sea. Above, a sky covered with grey clouds.

works.d: Romantiline, tumedates ja erksates rohelistes toonides metsamaastik. Kummalgi pool puud, keskel kännud ja veekogu. Taamal helesinine taevas ja roosakas silmapiir.
works.de: A romantic forest landscape in dark and vivid green tones. Trees on both sides, in the middle tree stumps and a body of water. In the distance a light blue sky and a pinkish horizon.

works.d: Pruunil laual vasakul sinisel tikutoosil suitsev sigaret, keskel pooleldi täis pudel ja klaas, nende taga valgel paberil või linal poolik leib ja tükeldatud kala, paremal nuga. Taust tumesinine.
works.de: On a brown table on the left a smoking cigarette on a blue matchbox, in the middle a half-full bottle and a glass, behind them on white paper or cloth a partial loaf of bread and a cut-up fish, on the right a knife. Dark blue background.

works.d: Lillakashallides ja rohekates toonides kivine ja vetikane rand. Vasakul hele veeriba. Taevas hallid, horisondi kohal lillad rünkpilved, vasakul eemal hele laik.
works.de: A stony, seaweed-covered shore in lilac-grey and greenish tones. On the left a bright strip of water. Sky grey, above the horizon lilac cumulus clouds, in the distance on the left a bright patch.

works.d: Kollakas-pruunikas lainetav viljapõld, keskel puuderühm ja taluhooned, milleni viib rada. Vasakul veeriba. Helesinises taevas suured hallikasvalged rünkpilved.
works.de: Yellowish-brown undulating grain field, in the middle a group of trees and farm buildings, to which a path leads. On the left a strip of water. In the light blue sky large greyish-white cumulus clouds.

works.d: Esiplaanil rohekaspruunides ja lillakates toonides kivine maastik, keskosas tihe männitukk, taevas helesinine kollaste laikudega.
works.de: In the foreground a stony landscape in greenish-brown and purplish tones, in the middle a dense pine grove, the sky light blue with yellow patches.

works.d: Esiplaanil pruunides toonides künkanõlv, vasakul tihe tumeroheline männitukk, paremal paar põõsast. Taevas ühtlaselt hallides ja roosakas-lillades toonides.
works.de: In the foreground a slope of a hillock in brown tones, on the left a dense dark green pine thicket, on the right a couple of bushes. Sky evenly in grey and pinkish-lilac tones.

works.d: Rohelistes ja pruunides toonides lage küngas, taamal keskel grupp taluhooneid. Vasakul tumesinine mereviirg, taevas helesinine, pilved lillades toonides.
works.de: A bare hill in green and brown tones, in the distance in the middle a group of farm buildings. On the left a dark blue strip of sea, the sky light blue, clouds in purple tones.

works.d: Ees veekogu, tagapool, kaldal oleva kindluse peegeldusega. Tagapool kivimüüri taga kõrge torniga kindlus.
works.de: In front a body of water, with the reflection of a fortress on the bank behind it. Behind, beyond a stone wall, a fortress with a tall tower.

works.d: Parkettpõrandaga toa nurk, kus vasakul valge taburet, millel avatud pappkast (siniste triipudega) ja rohelist ning halli värvi termoskann. Taburetist paremal maalimispukk valgeks krunditud lõuendiga, viimase ees kaht meest (üks neist kunstnik I. Torn) kujutav foto ja must fotoümbrik. Maalimispuki all beež pappkast, mille kaanel sinine triip. Lõuendi paremast ülanurgast diagonaalis üle lõuendi ja edasi põrandale jooksev punane niit. Ruumifragment kõigist külgedest piiratud lillakashallide pindadega.
works.de: The corner of a room with a parquet floor, on the left a white stool with an open cardboard box (with blue stripes) and a green and grey thermos flask. To the right of the stool, an easel with a canvas primed white, in front of it a photograph depicting two men (one of them the artist I. Torn) and a black photo envelope. Under the easel a beige cardboard box with a blue stripe on the lid. From the upper right corner of the canvas a red thread runs diagonally across the canvas and further onto the floor. The room fragment is bounded on all sides by lilac-grey surfaces.

works.d: Ees keskel kummuli keeratud toobril istuv mees. Vasakus, väljasirutatud käes vahutav õlleklaas. Taga järsk, rohtunud nõlvak.
works.de: A man sitting on an upturned barrel in the centre foreground. In his outstretched left hand, a foaming beer glass. Behind, a steep, grassy slope.

works.d: Esiplaanil (karjamaal) üksik kõrge tamm. Vasakul ja taga keskel ja paremal lehtpuu mets.
works.de: In the foreground (on a pasture) a solitary tall oak. On the left and in the background, middle and right, a deciduous forest.

works.d: Vasakul Hermani ja üle jõe paremal taga Ivangorodi kindlus. Esiplaanil keskel rohelisel aasal kaks väikest mehe figuuri istumas. Vasakpoolne nendest sõjaväelane.
works.de: On the left, Hermann Castle, and across the river on the right in the back, Ivangorod Fortress. In the centre foreground, on a green meadow, two small male figures sitting. The one on the left is a soldier.

works.d: Tagapool keskel oleva vana puutüve ees rohuplatsil tantsivad lapsed, ühel neist liblika tiivad seljal. Taga vasakul pruunil lehel istuv maani kleidis noor naine; puutüvest raiutud oksakännul orav.
works.de: Behind, in the middle, in front of an old tree trunk children dance on a grassy area, one of them with butterfly wings on the back. Behind at left a young woman in a long dress sitting on a brown leaf; on a branch stump cut from the tree trunk a squirrel.

works.d: Teise korruse aknast vaade talvisele tänavale. Paremal esiplaanil ja vasakul kaugemal maja nurk. Nende vahel tänav, kus liigub arvukalt inimesi mitmes suunas. Taamal lumine mäenõlv, millel üksikud pingid.
works.de: View of a wintery street from a second-floor window. The corner of a house in the right foreground and further away on the left. Between them a street where numerous people are moving in several directions. In the distance a snowy hillside with a few benches.

works.d: Esiplaanil Narva jõepind, mille kaldalt tõuseb Hermani kindlus.
works.de: In the foreground the surface of the Narva river, from whose bank Hermann Castle rises.

works.d: Metsaserval hallikaspruunide tüvedega kroomrohelised männid, paremal osa metsateest. Läbi puukroonide helendab taevas. Maal õpilaslik-kobav.
works.de: At the edge of the forest chrome-green pines with grayish-brown trunks, on the right part of a forest road. Through the treetops the sky glows. The painting is student-like and hesitant.

works.d: Kollase linaga kaetud klaveril kolm vaasi mitmevärviliste lilledega. Nende ees hele kübar tumeda paelaga, mille peal roosa sall. Taga vasemal ja paremal rippuvad maastikumaalid.
works.de: On a piano covered with a yellow cloth, three vases with multicoloured flowers. In front of them, a light hat with a dark ribbon, on which lies a pink scarf. Behind, on the left and right, hanging landscape paintings.

works.d: Esiplaanil veekogu vastaskaldal oleva hoonestiku peegeldusega veepinnal. Vastaskaldal - lehtpuude vahel rida hooneid.
works.de: In the foreground a body of water with a reflection on its surface of the buildings on the opposite shore. On the opposite shore - a row of buildings among deciduous trees.

works.d: Esiplaanil lumine aed kolme kõrge raagus puuga. Tagaplaanil mitmekorruselised lumiste katustega majad.
works.de: In the foreground a snowy garden with three tall bare trees. In the background multi-storey houses with snowy roofs.

works.d: Laual pruun vaas suure segalilledest kimbuga.
