works.de: On the table a brown vase with a large bouquet of mixed flowers.

works.d: Paremal pildi äärel osa kahekorruselisest punase viilkatusega heledast hoonest, mille juurest lähtuv pruunikaskollane tee ümbritseb vasakult lopsakaid õitsvaid põõsaid ja paremalt kirevat lillepeenart. Viimase ees seisab otsevaates helepunases kleidis naine, käes kastekann. Figuurist paremal pruun kaherattaline käru veevaadiga. Kaugemal, üldises erksas roheluses üksikud puud, paremal aimatav veesilm. Silmapiiril, üksikute rünkpilvedega kaetud helesinise taeva all madalad punaste katustega majad aedade varjus.
works.de: On the right edge of the picture part of a two-storey light-coloured building with a red gable roof, from which a brownish-yellow path leads, surrounded on the left by lush flowering bushes and on the right by a colourful flower bed. In front of the latter stands, in frontal view, a woman in a bright red dress, holding a watering can. To the right of the figure a brown two-wheeled cart with a water barrel. Further away, in general vivid greenery, solitary trees, on the right a discernible patch of water. On the horizon, under a pale blue sky covered with scattered cumulus clouds, low houses with red roofs sheltered by gardens.

works.d: Esiplaanil suvine heinamaa: vasakul, veel niitmata heinamaa osas, söövad punakaspruunid lehmad ja viis valget lammast, parempoolses osas ees veetakse hobusega heina pooleliolevasse rõuku, taga neli valmis rõuku. Heinamaa veeres keskel kaks kõrget puud, tagant ja paremalt piirab nurme roheliste põõsaste rivi. Paremal servas paistab jupike küntud põldu, tagaplaanil silmapiiril hulk puudest ja põõsastest ümbritsetud taluhooneid. Ülal kahvatu kollastes ja sinistes toonides taevas.
works.de: In the foreground, a summer hayfield: on the left, in the part not yet mown, reddish-brown cows and five white sheep are grazing; in the right-hand part, in front, hay is being carted by horse to an unfinished stack, behind it four finished stacks. At the edge of the hayfield in the middle, two tall trees; the field is bordered at the back and on the right by a row of green bushes. On the right edge, a patch of ploughed field is visible; in the background on the horizon, a number of farm buildings surrounded by trees and bushes. Above, the sky is in pale yellow and blue tones.

works.d: Esiplaanil keskel heledas keraamilises vaasis lopsakas kimp lilla- ja siniseõielistest lupiinidest ning oranžidest liiliatest. Taustal ookerkollane, kerges laines draperii ja osa ruudulise linaga kaetud lauast.
works.de: In the middle foreground, in a light-colored ceramic vase, a lush bouquet of purple and blue lupines and orange lilies. In the background, an ochre-yellow, gently waving drapery and part of a table covered with a checkered cloth.

works.t: a) Lilled sinises vaasis; b) Naise portree
works.d: Veidi pealtvaates nelinurksel, pruunil laual, keskel, kõhukas, sinine vaas, mille sees seitse, peaaegu valget astri-õit; vasakul kimp kollaseid, väikse-õielisi lilli; paremal punaseõielisi; paremalt murdub alla oks kollaste õitega. Laual, vaasi ees õun, paremal, valgel taldrikul punane õun. Foon helesinine. Lilleõitel kohati värv paksult kujutisele kantud.
works.de: On a rectangular brown table seen slightly from above, in the middle, a bulbous blue vase containing seven almost white aster blossoms; on the left a bouquet of yellow, small-flowered blooms; on the right red-flowered ones; from the right a branch with yellow blossoms hangs down. On the table, in front of the vase, an apple, on the right, on a white plate, a red apple. The background is light blue. In places the paint on the flower blossoms is applied thickly to the image.

works.d: Kõrge seljatoega tugitoolis, kerges pöördes vasakule istuva, heledate, väga lühikeseks lõigatud, otsmikul tukkadega juustega istuva, väikese tüdruku kolmveerandfiguur, seljas punane, põlvi paljaks jättev, pikkade varrukatega, väikese, ümarnurkadega, valge kraega kleit. Lapse käed süles. Foon sinakas-lilla, tooli seljatugi rohekas-kollakas. Üksikutes kohtades värv paksemalt peale kantud.
works.de: A three-quarter figure of a little girl sitting in a high-backed armchair, turned slightly to the left, with light-coloured, very short-cut hair with a fringe on the forehead, wearing a red dress with long sleeves that leaves the knees bare, a small dress with rounded corners and a white collar. The child's hands are in her lap. The background is bluish-purple, the back of the chair greenish-yellow. In a few places the paint is applied more thickly.

works.d: Lahtisest aknast avanev vaade üle tänava gooti portaaliga maja fassaadile. Maja üks uksepool on avatud, parempoolsel uksetahvlil ülaossa kinnitatud vaskne silt. Uksest vasakule jääb suur paljude väikeste ruutudega aken. Akna all, paremal kollakas tahvel kirjutisega (J. Ramsalu?). Maali esiplaanil troonivad aknalaual vasakul punaste õitega fuksialaadne potilill, paremal, suuremas potis roheliste nooljate lehtedega toataim.
works.de: View from an open window across the street to the façade of a house with a Gothic portal. One leaf of the house's door is open, on the right-hand door panel a copper sign fastened at the top. To the left of the door is a large window with many small panes. Below the window, on the right, a yellowish plaque with an inscription (J. Ramsalu?). In the foreground of the painting, enthroned on the windowsill, on the left a fuchsia-like potted plant with red flowers, on the right, in a larger pot, a houseplant with green arrow-shaped leaves.

works.d: Ees keskel fontään. Taga küpress ja eluhoone. Vasakul servas palm.
works.de: In the front center a fountain. Behind it a cypress and a residential building. A palm at the left edge.

works.d: Mägimaastik, keskel kõrgendikul kabel torniga.
works.de: Mountain landscape, in the middle on a height a chapel with a tower.

works.dm: kõrgus: 32.2 cm (lõuend); laius: 23.3 cm (papp); kõrgus: 33.0 cm (papp); laius: 22.4 cm (lõuend)
works.d: Vaade Karja tänavalt vanale turule. Lumine tänav mitmekordsete, lumiste katustega majadega vasakul ja paremal vastas, keskel. Kahest majast parempoolne kaubahoone poekestega alumisel ja luukuksega pööningu kohal. Tallinna Raekoja sale torn allpool sinaka, ülal roosaka taeva taustal.
works.de: A view from Karja Street to the old market. A snowy street with multi-storey, snow-covered houses on the left and opposite on the right, in the middle. Of the two houses, the right one is a trading house with small shops on the ground floor and a hatch above the loft. Tallinn Town Hall's slender tower against a bluish sky below and pinkish above.

works.d: Eest otse taha suunduv puude ja põõsastega ääristatud teerada, mis suundub läbi kõrges müüris oleva võlvitud kaarvärava.
works.de: A path bordered with trees and bushes leading straight from the front to the back, passing through an arched gate in a high wall.

works.d: Esiplaanil liivasel pinnasel kõrge rohi ja lehised põõsad. Tagapool hoonete rida. Taustaks mäeahelikud.
works.de: In the foreground, tall grass and leafy bushes on sandy ground. Behind, a row of buildings. Mountain ranges as the background.

works.d: Vasakul ja keskel kaldaäärne kivine meri. Paremal järsk rohtunud kallas üksiku lehtpuuga. Tagapool metsaga kaetud maanina.
works.de: On the left and in the middle a stony sea along the shore. On the right a steep grassy bank with a solitary deciduous tree. Behind, a forested headland.

works.d: Maastikupilt Itaaliast. Paremal meri. Vasakul kõrge kaljune kallas üksikute kidurate puudega. Taamal kallas taimkatteta kaljuahelikega.
works.de: Landscape from Italy. On the right the sea. On the left a high rocky shore with isolated stunted trees. In the distance a shore with rocky ranges devoid of vegetation.

works.d: Esialal küljelt laskuv kallas üsikute kidurate puudega, taga sinav meri mida silmapiiril piirab mäeahelik suitseva Vesuv´iga keskel.
works.de: A shore descending from the side with a few stunted trees, behind it a bluish sea bordered on the horizon by a mountain range with a smoking Vesuvius in the middle.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul suurem veekogu. Paremal nurgas näha väikene nurk kivist kallast. Taamal vastaskaldail, järskude mägede jalameil hooneteread.
works.de: In the foreground on the left a larger body of water. In the right corner a small corner of a stone shore is visible. In the distance on the opposite shores, at the foot of steep mountains, rows of buildings.

works.d: Esialal vasakul müüritud kaldaäär, mis ulatub kaarjalt kaugusse. Samas aiamüür üleulatuva lehtpuude latvadega. Kaugemal kuni parema ääreni ulatuv ehitiste rida siin-seal esilekerkivate tornidega. Ees paremal tasane veepind, millel kaugemal näha rida laevu ja lootsikuid. Keskel veepinna kohal üksik kajakas.
works.de: In the foreground on the left a walled shoreline, curving into the distance. In the same area a garden wall with the tops of deciduous trees rising above it. Further away, reaching to the right edge, a row of buildings with towers rising here and there. In front on the right a calm water surface, on which further away a row of ships and boats can be seen. In the middle above the water surface a lone seagull.

works.dm: kõrgus: 33.2 cm (vm); lehe laius: 27.9 cm; lehe kõrgus: 38.7 cm; laius: 22.6 cm (vm)
works.d: Ees keskel suur ristkülikukujuline bassein kiviääristusega pügatud põõsastega paremal ja vasakul. Taga keskel arkaadidega ühendatud sammastikuga loss.
works.de: In the centre foreground a large rectangular pool with a stone edging, with trimmed bushes on the right and left. At the back in the centre a castle with a colonnade connected by arcades.

works.d: Ees kivine rannavesi. Tagapool kallas liivale tõmmatud paatidega ja kuivavate võrkudega. Taga vasakul kaks võrgukuuri.
works.de: In front, stony coastal water. Behind it a shore with boats drawn up on the sand and drying nets. Behind on the left two net sheds.

works.d: Vasakul kivine rand üksiku männiga luite harjal. Paremal kuni silmapiirini meri.
works.de: On the left a rocky shore with a solitary pine on the crest of a dune. On the right the sea extends to the horizon.

works.d: Esiplaanil rohtunud kallastega veekogu. Tagapool vasakul madal, rohtunud lehtpuutukkadega kallas.
works.de: In the foreground a body of water with overgrown banks. Further back on the left a low bank overgrown with clumps of deciduous trees.

works.d: Esiplaanil kivisillutisega hoov, paremal majasein, vasakul maja ees suur puu.
works.de: In the foreground a courtyard with stone paving, on the right a house wall, on the left a large tree in front of the house.

works.d: Paremal tormine meri. Vasakul poolrohtunud kivine rand üksikute paatide ja purjekatega. Tagapool väikene hoone.
works.de: On the right a stormy sea. On the left a partly overgrown stony shore with individual boats and sailboats. Further back a small building.

works.d: Ees niit põõsastikuga vasakul ja veekoguga paremal. Tagapool keskel kaks talumaja väikese kõrvalhoonega. Vasakpoolse maja otsas kask, majade vahel kooguga kaev. Paremal metsasalu, vasakul põllud.
works.de: In front, a meadow with bushes on the left and a body of water on the right. Behind, in the centre, two farmhouses with a small outbuilding. At the end of the left-hand house a birch, between the houses a well with a sweep. On the right a copse, on the left fields.

works.d: Esiplaanil hoov - paremal majadegrupp, vasakul tara ja puu. Taga kaks vana linnamüüri kindlustorni, majade katused ja Oleviste kiiver.
works.de: In the foreground a yard - on the right a group of houses, on the left a fence and a tree. Behind, two old town wall fortification towers, the roofs of houses and the spire of Oleviste.

works.d: Võsamaastikul sinetaval lumel puid peegeldav veelõik, tagafoonil üksikud hoonete siluetid, õhtuehas taevas.
works.de: A stretch of water reflecting trees on bluish snow in a scrubland landscape, isolated silhouettes of buildings in the background, sky in evening glow.

works.d: Mereäär tagaplaanil paremal mägedega, esiplaanil kaldal üksikud vanad puud, valguse laikudega puude all maas.
works.de: The seashore in the background, on the right with mountains, in the foreground on the shore solitary old trees, patches of light on the ground under the trees.

works.d: Paremal varemed, vasakul taimestik-aedvili (ka üksikuid päevalilli) ja hobune vankriga. Tagapool aiamüür, mille taga puid ja põõsaid ning kaugemal kellatorn. Taevas pilves.
works.de: On the right ruins, on the left vegetation-garden produce (also single sunflowers) and a horse with a cart. Behind, a garden wall, behind which trees and bushes, and further away a bell tower. Cloudy sky.

works.d: Tumeda linaga kaetud laual roheline vaas kollaste ja valgete lilledega, kaks õuna ja vaasist vasakul alustassile asetatud kohvitass.
works.de: On a table covered with a dark cloth, a green vase with yellow and white flowers, two apples and, to the left of the vase, a coffee cup placed on a saucer.

works.d: Esiplaanil madal kivine rand; vasakul luited üksikute põõsastega; paremal avameri.
works.de: In the foreground a low rocky shore; on the left dunes with single bushes; on the right open sea.

works.d: Esiplaanil avatud värava poole viiv tee; paremal väänistega müürisein; vasakul üksik kõrge küpress õitsvate põõsastega.
works.de: In the foreground a path leading to an open gate; on the right a wall with vines; on the left a solitary tall cypress with flowering bushes.

works.d: Paremal järv kivise kaldaga, vasakul, kaldal mägionnid, taga kõrgemad roosalt helkivate latvadega. Põhitoonid: lillakas sinine, sinine, pruun.
works.de: On the right a lake with a stony shore, on the left, on the shore, mountain huts, behind them higher ones with pinkish glowing tops. Main tones: purplish blue, blue, brown.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal kõrgenev kallas, raagus puude ja põõsastega, vasakul jääkattes veekogu. Taga kirik ja valgustatud akendega majad.
works.de: In the foreground on the right a rising bank with bare trees and bushes, on the left a body of water covered in ice. Behind, a church and houses with lit windows.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal kalurid kalavõrke korraldamas. Tagapool kivitrepp ja majamüürid. Vasakul kollakas valguses virvendav lahesopp paadiga, eemal varemeis lossimassiiv.
works.de: In the foreground on the right fishermen arranging fishing nets. Behind them a stone staircase and house walls. On the left a bay shimmering in yellowish light with a boat, in the distance a castle mass in ruins.

works.d: Esiplaanil rannariba kividega ja puudegrupiga vasakul. Taga virvendav meri tõusva päikese valguses.
works.de: A stretch of shore with stones and a group of trees on the left in the foreground. Behind, a shimmering sea in the light of the rising sun.

works.d: Polügonaalse torniga kirik roheliste puude vahel, tugipiitadega kiviaiaga esiplaanil jalgrada rohus. Põhitoonid: roheline, sinakas hall.
works.de: A church with a polygonal tower among green trees, a stone wall with buttresses, a footpath in the grass in the foreground. Main tones: green, bluish grey.

works.d: Kahelpool järskude kaljuseinte vahel veekogu - esiplaanil, taga keskel kitsas kaljulõhe taeva ja mägimaastikuga. Vasakul esiplaanil kaldal rohelisi lehttaimi. Põhitoonid: lilla, punakaspruun, sinine.
works.de: On both sides, between steep cliff walls, a body of water - in the foreground, at the back in the middle a narrow cliff crevice with sky and mountain landscape. On the left in the foreground on the shore, green leafy plants. Main tones: purple, reddish-brown, blue.

works.d: Ees õhtupäikesest valgustatud jõgi, vasakul kaldaäärel paadid. Taga metsasalud ja üksikud majad, paremalt näha tuuleveski.
works.de: In the front a river lit by the evening sun, on the left along the bank boats. Behind, groves of trees and solitary houses, on the right a windmill can be seen.

works.dm: kõrgus: 50.0 cm (lm); laius: 64.3 cm (arm); kõrgus: 46.0 cm (arm); laius: 67.0 cm (lm)
works.d: Esiplaanil lumiste kallastega jõgi paadiga vastaskaldal, taga metsalagenikul poolkelpaga maja üksikute kuuskedega.
works.de: In the foreground a river with snowy banks, with a boat on the opposite bank, behind it in a forest clearing a house with a half-hip roof and single fir trees.

works.d: Ümarakujulises heledas vaasis bukett sireleid. Maalitud hõredate pintslilüketega, lastes kõlada heledal aluspinnal.
works.de: A bouquet of lilacs in a round light-coloured vase. Painted with sparse brushstrokes, letting the light ground show through.

works.d: Süngeilmelise mehe poolfiguur tumedal foonil. Seljas avatud hõlmadega kasukas, peas talimüts. Figuur kerges pöördes paremale.
works.de: Half-figure of a grim-looking man against a dark background. Wearing a fur coat with open flaps, on his head a winter hat. The figure in a slight turn to the right.

works.d: Malelaua taga paremal mõtliku ilmega poiss, kelle parem käsi malenupul, vasak toetub lõuale; patsidega tütarlaps tema vastas kuklaga vaataja poole, figuuri poolitab maali vasakserv. Foon tume.
works.de: At a chess table on the right a boy with a thoughtful expression, his right hand on a chess piece, left hand resting on his chin; a girl with braids sits opposite him with the back of her head toward the viewer, the figure is bisected by the left edge of the painting. Dark background.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul tugeva kehaehitusega alasti mehefiguur kaljukünkal istumas; mehel käes paaniflööt. Paremal veekogu kolme alasti naisefiguuriga delfiini ümber. Keskmine naistest istub suures merekarbis, roosakat tooni riidekangas lehvimas kaarjalt pea kohal.
works.de: In the foreground on the left a strongly built nude male figure sitting on a rocky hillock; the man holding a pan flute. On the right a body of water with three nude female figures around a dolphin. The middle woman sits in a large seashell, a pinkish fabric fluttering in an arc above her head.

works.d: Räpakas riietuses mehe täisfiguur. Peas vormitu, laiaäärega kübar. Katkiste varrukatega ruuduline pluus, paigatud püksid. Vööl padrunivöö revolvritega.
works.de: Full figure of a man in scruffy clothing. On his head a shapeless, wide-brimmed hat. A checked shirt with torn sleeves, patched trousers. On his belt a cartridge belt with revolvers.

works.d: Harkisjalu, käed puusas seisva mehe figuur poolprofiilis paremale. Jalas kintspüksikud. Vööl padrunivöö revolvriga. Kaela sõlmitud kolmnurkne punane rätik, nurgaga rinnal.
works.de: Figure of a man standing with legs apart, hands on hips, in half-profile to the right. Wearing breeches. A cartridge belt with a revolver at the waist. A triangular red kerchief tied around the neck, with the point on the chest.

works.d: Roosal foonil rebitud servadega rohelised värvilaigud. Keskel ebakorrapärane kujund, mis jaguneb erinevates toonides pindadeks.
works.de: Green patches of colour with torn edges on a pink background. In the middle an irregular shape divided into surfaces of various tones.

works.d: Lage lumine maastik külmsinise taeva ja kaugusse kaduva maanteega.
works.de: A bare snowy landscape with a cold blue sky and a road disappearing into the distance.

works.d: Esiplaanilt keskelt kääruline kivimüüridega ääristatud tee suundumas kõrgendikule. Keskplaanil kolm lameda katusega maja rõdudega. Vasakul müüri ääres kuristik. Foonil tumedalt kõrged mäed. Küpresse. Üldkoloriit hele-roosakas-lilla, maalitud spaatliga.
works.de: In the foreground, from the middle, a winding road bordered by stone walls leading up to a height. In the middle ground, three flat-roofed houses with balconies. On the left, along the wall, a ravine. In the background, dark high mountains. Cypresses. Overall colouring light pinkish-purple, painted with a palette knife.

works.d: Esiplaanil veepind, eemal keskel kaks paati. Vasakul paistab kaldariba majadega.
works.de: In the foreground a water surface, with two boats in the distance at the centre. On the left a strip of shore with houses is visible.

works.d: Esiplaanil pesukauss, mille sees külili kastekann. Sellest paremal sinine ämber. Vasakul teine suurem kastekann. Fooniks lilled.
works.de: In the foreground a washbasin, inside which a watering can lying on its side. To its right a blue bucket. On the left another, larger watering can. Flowers as background.

works.d: Esiplaanil pisut diagonaalse suunaga jõgi. Maali vasakul äärel, esiplaanil jõe kaldal raagus puud. Maali vasakul poolel üle jõe viiv sild. Paremal poolel jõel mõned laevad, nende taga hall hoone. Kaugemal udus metsad. Taevas hall.
works.de: In the foreground, a slightly diagonally directed river. On the left edge of the painting, in the foreground on the riverbank, bare trees. On the left half of the painting, a bridge crossing the river. On the right half, on the river some ships, behind them a grey building. Further away, forests in mist. The sky grey.

works.d: Neli punast korstent, nende kohal suitsupilv. Esiplaanil vasakul neli väikest inimfiguuri.
works.de: Four red chimneys, above them a cloud of smoke. In the foreground on the left four small human figures.

works.d: Vasakul, metallkonstruktsioonide vahel kolm keevitusmaskides meest töötamas. Esiplaanil paremal töölise poolfiguur, mask tõstetud, punaka poolkaarekujulise vormi ees. Nurgelises, üldistavas laadis kompositsioon.
works.de: On the left, between metal structures, three men in welding masks at work. In the foreground on the right, the half-figure of a worker, mask raised, in front of a reddish semicircular form. Composition in an angular, generalized manner.

works.d: Esiplaanil all ruudukujuline metallnelinurkadest ja suurtest kruvikujulistest kraanidest koosnev kompositsioon. Paremal ülanurgas relssidest konstruktsioonid, keskel kollane kumav pind, millest paremal pritsib kollast auru. Ülaosas foon sinine. Allservas vasakul kükitab pruun jänes.
works.de: In the foreground below, a composition consisting of square metal quadrangles and large screw-shaped cranes. In the upper right corner, structures of rails, in the middle a shimmering yellow surface from which yellow steam sprays on the right. The background at the top is blue. At the bottom left a brown hare is crouching.

works.d: Esialal madal kivine rannariba, mis ümber vasakult sisse ulatuva lahesopi kulgevana näitab kaugemal ka taimestikku. Silmapiiril metsakontuur. Õhtuvalguses roosastuv taevas peegeldub vees, mille kohal kaks kajakat lennul.
works.de: In the foreground a low, stony strip of shore, which, running around a bay indenting from the left, also shows vegetation further away. On the horizon the outline of a forest. In the evening light the sky, turning pink, is reflected in the water, above which two gulls are in flight.

works.d: Paremal tormine meri purjekatega, vasakul rand hoonetega ja figuurigruppidega piki rannikut.
works.de: On the right, a stormy sea with sailboats, on the left a shore with buildings and groups of figures along the coastline.

works.d: Pilves taeva taustal paremal kõrge, järsk, lõhestatud ja alt õõnes pankkallas. Tagapool veepind, mille taustal rannal rusud. Mere kohal parv kajakaid.
works.de: Against a cloudy sky background on the right a high, steep, cracked and hollow-based cliff bank. Behind it a water surface, on the background of which are ruins on the shore. Above the sea a flock of gulls.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul palgiparved vees, keskel ja paremal rand purjeka ja paatidega, taga kõrgel kaldas valge hoone.
works.de: In the foreground on the left log rafts in the water, in the middle and on the right a beach with a sailboat and boats, behind on a high bank a white building.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal kivine rand kaldale veetud purjepaadiga. Vasakul meri. Paadi taga kuivatussaadustel võrgud. Taevas pilvine.
works.de: In the foreground right a stony shore with a sailing boat drawn up onto it. On the left the sea. Behind the boat nets on drying racks. Sky cloudy.

works.d: Vasakul kitsas, kivine, kaugemal kaljuseinaks muutuv rannariba. Paremal meri purjekatega ranna läheduses ja kaks paati sõudjatega. Kaks kolmandikku maalist kaetud rünkpilvituses taevaga.
works.de: On the left a narrow, stony strip of shore that further away turns into a rock face. On the right the sea with sailboats near the shore and two boats with rowers. Two thirds of the painting is covered with a sky full of cumulus clouds.

works.d: Rohelisega polsterdatud toolil istuva noore naise täisfiguur. Tumedad, keskelt lahuga siledad juuksed; punases sügava dekolteega kleidis. Käed süles.
works.de: Full figure of a young woman sitting on a chair upholstered in green. Dark hair, parted in the middle and smooth; wearing a red dress with a deep décolleté. Hands in her lap.

works.d: Kolmveerandpöördes, tumesinise riide foonil, istuva naise figuur. Seljas tuhmpruun kollase, pisut kroogitud krae ja kätistega, kolmnurkse kaelaväljalõikega kleit, peas punane barett, mille alt paistavad helepruunid juuksed. Vasakul servas riba lillakaspruuni foonil.
works.de: Figure of a seated woman in a three-quarter turn, against a dark blue cloth background. Wearing a dull brown dress with a slightly gathered yellow collar and cuffs, a triangular neckline, a red beret on her head, from under which light brown hair shows. On the left edge a strip against a purplish-brown background.

works.d: Plikakese rinnapilt kerge peapöördega paremale, rinnal juuksepalmik roosa lindiga, vaöges kleidis. Pasparteeritud, nurgeti nelikurnsel alusraamil.
works.de: Chest-length picture of a little girl with a slight turn of the head to the right, on her chest a hair braid with a pink ribbon, in a striped dress. Mounted, in a rectangular frame set at an angle.

works.dm: lehe laius: 37.3 cm; lehe kõrgus: 46.0 cm
works.d: Karvamütsiga keskealise mehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis vasakule. Üle parema õla kasukas.
works.de: Bust portrait of a middle-aged man with a fur hat, in half-profile to the left. A fur coat over the right shoulder.

works.d: Tumesinised mäed helesinise taeva taustal. Esiplaanil riba lillakates ja pruunikates toonides künklikku maastikku.
works.de: Dark blue mountains against a light blue sky background. In the foreground a strip of hilly landscape in purplish and brownish tones.

works.d: Vasakul ja keskel taraga piiratud majadegruppe ja puid. Esiplaanil lumel pikad sinised puude varjud.
works.de: On the left and in the centre groups of houses enclosed by fences and trees. In the foreground on the snow, long blue shadows of trees.

works.d: Paremal tumedad raagus puud, vasemale jäävad allavaates sinakates toonides Katused, taga paremal tõuseb linnamüüri torn. Taevas hele.
works.de: On the right dark bare trees, to the left in a bird's-eye view roofs in bluish tones, behind on the right a city wall tower rises. Sky bright.

works.d: Laual samovar ja punutud korv lõngakeradega. Paremal osa sisselõigatud ornamendiga tooli seljatoest.
works.de: On the table a samovar and a woven basket with balls of yarn. On the right part of the backrest of a chair with cut-out ornament.

works.d: Neli inimest ühte, lamavat inimest kandmas.
works.de: Four people carrying one, a lying person.

works.d: Sinise-valgekirjul alsusel vasakul roheline, punaste refleksidega samovar. Paremal pruun kann ja õunad.
works.de: On a blue-and-white patterned tablecloth on the left, a green samovar with red reflections. On the right a brown jug and apples.

works.d: Kollase taeva ja siniste kauguste foonil kolm meest ja üks naine tumeda masina peal.
works.de: Against the background of a yellow sky and blue distances, three men and one woman on a dark machine.

works.d: Kõrged sinised, osaliselt lumega kaetud mäed peegelduvad esiplaanil olevas veekogus.
works.de: Tall blue, partly snow-covered mountains reflected in the body of water in the foreground.

works.d: Tumeda, roheka taeva foonil kõrged tehasehooned. Ühest korstnast tuleb kollast suitsu.
works.de: Tall factory buildings against a dark, greenish sky background. Yellow smoke coming from one chimney.

works.d: Kõrged, metsaga kaetud künkad, mis peegelduvad esiplaanil olevas järves. Taevas hallides toonides.
works.de: High, forest-covered hills reflected in a lake in the foreground. Sky in grey tones.

works.d: Hallide kaljumägede vahel tume veekogu, taustaks kauged mäed.
works.de: A dark body of water between grey rocky mountains, with distant mountains in the background.

works.d: Hallil foonil ning pruunil aluspinnal tumeda keskosaga ja hallikasvalgete, pastoosselt maalitud servadega küna. Selle ees sinakate ja lillade varjunditega poolik käsikivi. Käsikivi ees vslge, stiliseeritud lille kujutis.
works.de: On a grey background and brown underlying surface, a trough with a dark middle section and greyish-white, pastosely painted edges. In front of it a half hand-mill with bluish and lilac shades. In front of the hand-mill, the image of a white, stylised flower.

works.d: Ühele horisontaalile ning vertikaalile rajatud kompositsioon mustadest, valgetest ning hallidest pindadest. Osa ühe vertikaalse kujundi pinnast krobeline. Taust tume; alt üles järk-järgult heledamaks minev.
works.de: A composition built on a single horizontal and vertical, of black, white and grey planes. Part of the surface of one vertical form is rough. Background dark; gradually becoming lighter from bottom to top.

works.d: Vasakul esiplaanil must teravatipuline teetulp. Maastiku plaanidel kolm pruunikas-hallikais toonides lainelist riba; esiplaanil olev faktuurse pinnaga. Taevas pruunides toonides, silmapiiri poole helenev.
works.de: In the left foreground a black sharp-pointed roadside post. In the planes of the landscape, three wavy strips in brownish-greyish tones; the one in the foreground has a textured surface. The sky is in brown tones, brightening towards the horizon.

works.d: Parempoolne kolmnurk pildi pinnast viljapäid markeeriv fraktuurne pind, ookrivärvis. Vasemale jääb ühtlaselt tumeda värviga kaetud veepind, mida piiravad silmapiiril kolm erineva kõrgusega rannarahnu. Kaugus hele, taevas läheb järk-järgult tumedamaks, ülaservas ripub faktuurse pinnaga, sakiliste servadega raske pilve moodustis.
works.de: The right-hand triangle of the picture surface is a fractured surface marking ears of grain, in ochre colour. To the left is a uniformly dark-coloured water surface, bounded on the horizon by three shore boulders of different heights. The distance is light, the sky gradually becomes darker, at the top edge hangs a heavy cloud formation with a textured surface and jagged edges.

works.d: Poole pildipinnast võtab enda alla kaheks osaks jaotatud rannariba. Esiplaanil kasutatud kollaži kolme pitsist kujundiga. Tagaplaanil silmapiiri poole helenev sinine mereviig.
works.de: Half of the picture surface is taken up by a strip of beach divided into two parts. In the foreground a collage of three lace-like shapes is used. In the background a blue sea strip growing lighter towards the horizon.

works.d: Öine industriaalmaastik. Vasakul pildiääre keskelt ja paremal ülemisest nurgast horisondini kulgevad kaks suure läbimõõdulist torejuhet, ees keeruliselt ümber musta vertikaalvaia painutatud tumesinine  peen toru. Vasakul pool all maapinnal üksik punane tuleleek, taamal neli vabrikukorstent. Horisondil keskel kolm horisontaalset rohelist triipu. Ülal vasemal täiskuu.
works.de: A night industrial landscape. On the left from the middle of the picture edge, and on the right from the upper corner, two large-diameter pipelines run to the horizon; in front, a thin dark blue pipe bent intricately around a black vertical stake. On the lower left, on the ground, a single red flame, further off four factory chimneys. In the middle of the horizon three horizontal green stripes. Above left, a full moon.

works.d: Keskel kanelüüritud hall sammas, sellest paremal, esiplaanil kannelüürideta hall sammas. Ees paremal ja vasakul pruunikashallid, sambatüükaid meenutavad, ajahambast puretud ülespidi pürgivad vormid, neist paremas kuldlõikes asuv vorm on kroonitud tuleleeki meenutava pruunika-kollase massiga. Maali vasakpoolsel kolmandikul kogu kompositsiooni kõrgust täitvad kaks struktuuritut vabalt vooglevat sambataolist vormi, mis alt ja ülevalt on omavahel horisontaalselt ühendatud. Nende vahel kitsas kindlapiiriline, ülal kõverduv värvitriip (all rohekassinine, ülevalt tumedaks rohekassiniseks muutuv). Helesinine taevas, horisondil tume. Maapind tume sinakasroheline. Faktuurne, pastoosne, kohati hangunud
works.de: In the middle a grey fluted column, to its right, in the foreground, a grey column without fluting. In front, on the right and left, brownish-grey forms resembling column stumps, weathered by time and striving upward; the form situated at the right golden section is crowned by a brownish-yellow mass resembling a flame. In the left third of the painting, filling the entire height of the composition, two structureless, freely undulating column-like forms, connected to each other horizontally at the bottom and top. Between them a narrow, clearly bounded strip of colour curving upward (greenish-blue below, turning into a dark greenish-blue above). Light blue sky, dark at the horizon. The ground surface is dark bluish-green. Textured, impasto, in places congealed

works.d: Kompositsiooni kõiki servi piiravad industriaalsed vormid, mille vahelt avaneb vaade kaugusesse (ülalt tumepunane, läbi oranži alla jõudes kollane). Selle taustal vasemas kuldlõikes ülestõstetud kinnastatud kätega mees selgvaates, valgete varjunditega mererohelises alussärgis ja punastes pikkades pükstes. Alumises vasakus nurgas tumesiniste ja lillade refleksidega kaks suurt metalset, madalate hammastega ratast, paremas alumises nurgas viis paralleelselt kulgevat S-kujulist vormi. Ülemises paremas nurgas kaarjalt kulgev suur ventilatsioonitoru. Mehe pea kohal metalltala kolme punakollase ümaravaga.
works.de: All edges of the composition are bordered by industrial forms, between which a view opens into the distance (dark red at the top, passing through orange down to yellow). Against this background, in the golden section on the left, a man seen frontally with gloved hands raised, in a sea-green undershirt with white shading and long red trousers. In the lower left corner, two large metal wheels with low teeth, with dark blue and purple reflections; in the lower right corner, five parallel S-shaped forms. In the upper right corner, a large curving ventilation pipe. Above the man's head, a metal beam with three reddish-yellow round protrusions.

works.d: Paremal poodiumil istuv modell, tagapool, varju taga, teine modell; vasakul kunstnik tööl.
works.de: On the right a model sitting on a podium, further back, behind a shadow, a second model; on the left the artist at work.

works.d: Toolil istuv tütarlapse täisfiguur profiilis paremale. Käes avatud raamat. Taustaks balustraad ja puid.
works.de: Full figure of a girl sitting on a chair, in profile to the right. An open book in her hands. Background with a balustrade and trees.

works.d: Selili lamava naise poolfiguur (vasakult paremale) käed tõstetud kukla taha.
works.de: Half-figure of a woman lying on her back (from left to right), hands raised behind the back of her head.

works.d: Naise poolfiguur poolprofiilis vasakule, paljastatud õlgadega, milledest alla libisenud must mantel.
works.de: Half-figure of a woman in profile facing left, with bared shoulders, from which a black coat has slipped down.

works.d: Vaade Petseri kloostri õue. Vasakul üks kirikuid, paremal kellatorni nurk.
works.de: View of the courtyard of Petseri monastery. On the left one of the churches, on the right the corner of a bell tower.

works.d: Kitsas lõik kiriku interjöörist: paremale jääb eredates punastes, kollastes ja rohelistes toonides altariosa. Etüüdlik käsitluslaad.
works.de: A narrow section of a church interior: on the right the altar area in bright red, yellow and green tones. Study-like manner of treatment.

works.d: Lõuna-Eesti nõlvakuline maastik metsatukkadega (tumedal metsapiiril eralduvad heledatüvelised puudegrupid), põllulappidega. Mööda teed läheb üksik figuur.
works.de: A hilly South Estonian landscape with small groves (groups of light-trunked trees stand out against the dark forest edge), with patches of fields. A lone figure walks along the road.

works.d: Vaade Emajõele Vabadussillaga. Vasakul kaldaäär majadega, paate; tagant paistab majade grupp.
works.de: View of the Emajõgi River with the Vabadussild [Freedom Bridge]. On the left the riverbank with houses, boats; behind it a group of houses is visible.

works.d: Vasemal peegel, mille all pingil vaas lilledega, paremal võlvitud ruum, mille alumine osa erksinine. Seinal maale.
works.de: On the left a mirror, under which on a bench a vase with flowers, on the right a vaulted room, the lower part of which is bright blue. Paintings on the wall.

works.d: Esiplaanil õu, maalitud kollasena, vasakule jääb sinine pind. Maali ülaosas valge majasein, punase sissekäigu ja rõduga. Trepil kaks inimest, ees istub kolmas.
works.de: In the foreground a yard, painted yellow, with a blue surface remaining on the left. In the upper part of the painting a white house wall, with a red entrance and balcony. On the stairs two people, in front a third one sitting.

works.d: Vasakul järv, kaldal paremal kaks suurt puud (järve poole kaldu), rõheline tara, puid.
works.de: A lake on the left, on the shore on the right two large trees (leaning towards the lake), a green fence, trees.

works.d: Otsevaates toolil istuv naisakt. Taga roheline draperii.
works.de: A female nude sitting on a chair in frontal view. Green drapery behind.

works.d: Hallikassinise draperii foonil vasakule käele nõjatuv lamav naisakt selgvaates.
works.de: Reclining female nude seen frontally, leaning on her left hand, against a background of greyish-blue drapery.

works.d: Vaade Pariisi Pont Neuf´üle. Esiplaanil vasakul suured lehtpuud, paremal kraana. Taga hallides toonides sild.
works.de: View of the Pont Neuf in Paris. In the foreground on the left, large deciduous trees, on the right a crane. Behind, a bridge in grey tones.

works.d: Esiplaanil roheline murusõõr kõrgete puudega keskel ja valge tee. Taga heleda hoone kontuurid.
works.de: In the foreground a green circle of lawn with tall trees in the middle and a white road. Behind it the contours of a light-coloured building.

works.d: Pilvine taevas katab sügiseselt kirjut võsamaastikku, millest kerkivad esile vasakul pool maali osas paar suuremat puud. Keset maali näha võsastikust taeva poole tõusev suits. Vasakul kauge lagendik.
works.de: A cloudy sky covers an autumnally colourful shrubland, from which a couple of larger trees rise in the left part of the painting. In the middle of the painting smoke can be seen rising from the shrubland towards the sky. On the left, a distant clearing.

works.d: Esiplaanil veekogu, mille vasak nurk rohtu kasvanud. Vasakul üksik jändrik kask. Taga teisel kaldal kauged puude ja põõsaste grupid. Horisont pildi keskel.
works.de: In the foreground a body of water, its left corner overgrown with grass. On the left a solitary stunted birch. Behind, on the other shore, distant groups of trees and bushes. Horizon in the middle of the picture.

works.d: Paremal liivane rannariba, vasakul meri. Esiplaanil suured kivid, millede vahel keskel paistab paat.
works.de: On the right a sandy strip of beach, on the left the sea. In the foreground large stones, between which in the centre a boat is visible.

works.d: Esiplaanil madal vesi kividega. Vasakul kaldariba üksiku hoone ja puudega.
works.de: In the foreground shallow water with stones. On the left a strip of shore with a solitary building and trees.

works.d: Esiplaanil rohkete veetaimedega veekogu sinna peegelduva kaldarohelusega. Üle vee madal kallas mitut liiki kõrgete puudega. Helehallis taevas valged pilved. Maalitud kroomrohelistes toonides detailitäpselt.
works.de: In the foreground a body of water with abundant water plants, with the greenery of the bank reflected in it. Beyond the water, a low shore with several kinds of tall trees. In a light grey sky, white clouds. Painted in chrome-green tones with detailed precision.

works.d: 28 Asukoht objektil: tagaküljel, kleebisest allpool
works.de: 28 Location on object: on the reverse, below the label

works.d: Peamiselt hallides toonides antud maastik: vasakul kergelt õhtuvalgusest varjutatud mäed, paremal helendav lahevesi ning neli kaldale tõmmatud purjepaati (ühel neist purjed veel üleval).
works.de: A landscape rendered mainly in grey tones: on the left mountains lightly shadowed by evening light, on the right the glimmering bay water and four sailboats drawn up on the shore (one of them still with its sails up).

works.d: Hallikasvalgete seintega ja pruuni värvitud põrandaga toas pikas roosas kleidis tütarlaps viiulit mängimas. Kleidi kaeluses ja laiade küünarnukkideni ulatuvate varrukate otstes pits. Tütarlapse satäänid juuksed on kuklasse seatud. Paremal maalimispukki meenutav noodipult noodivihikuga, viimase kohal seinal on näha poolt kuldses raamis pildist.
works.de: In a room with grayish-white walls and a floor painted brown, a girl in a long pink dress is playing the violin. Lace at the neckline of the dress and at the ends of the wide sleeves reaching to the elbows. The girl's satiny hair is gathered at the nape of the neck. On the right a music stand resembling an easel with a sheet music book, above which part of a picture in a gilded frame can be seen on the wall.

works.d: Mustades toonides abstraktne kompositsioon, mis koosneb mustast foonist eristuvast kolmest, üksteisega külgnevast, eri tooninüanssides nelinurgast.
works.de: A black-toned abstract composition consisting of three adjoining quadrangles in various shades, standing out from a black background.

works.d: Abstraktne kompositsioon üksteisele vasakult paremale liidetud ebakorrapärastest nelinurkadest erinevates valgetes, hallides ja mustades toonides. Siin-seal pisut kollast ja punast. Foon valge.
works.de: An abstract composition of irregular quadrangles joined from left to right in various white, grey and black tones. Here and there a little yellow and red. Background white.

works.d: Üksikutest, tihedalt läbimaalitud värvilaikudest koosnev abstraktne kompositsioon: ülaserv roheline, parem serv must, allservas keskel valge ja kollane kujund, vasakul kolmnurk, mida rohelisest ülaosast eraldab must joon.
works.de: Abstract composition consisting of individual, densely painted-through patches of colour: the upper edge green, the right edge black, in the lower edge centre a white and yellow shape, on the left a triangle, separated from the green upper part by a black line.

works.d: Kontseptualistlik maal, kus monokroomsele reproduktsioonile on peale maalitud hallid geomeetrilised pinnad. Vasakul ülal ja paremal heledam hall, all pruunikam. Keskosas püstine tumedam ristkülik, millel must ja valge U-laadne kujund moodustab veelkord ristkülikulaadse elemendi. Allääres trükikiri: Rembrandt Harmensz van Rijn. 1606-1669. Young woman with earrings 1657. Paremas nurgas: THE HERMITAGE. LENINGRAD
works.de: A conceptualist painting in which grey geometric surfaces have been painted over a monochrome reproduction. Upper left and right a lighter grey, below a brownish tone. In the centre a vertical darker rectangle, on which a black and white U-shaped form once more forms a rectangular element. At the bottom printed text: Rembrandt Harmensz van Rijn. 1606-1669. Young woman with earrings 1657. In the right corner: THE HERMITAGE. LENINGRAD

works.d: Reporduktsioonile maalitud must-valge geomeetriline sõrestikulaadne kujund. Taust hall. Maali ülaosas, sõrestiku kohal must ebakorrapärane poolring. Maali alaosas, keskel must nelinurk, mille peal veidi väiksem valge ristkülik. Allääres trükikirjas: ANTHONY VAN DYCK 1566-1641. SELF-PORTRAIT. late 1620s-early 1630s. Paremal allääres: THE HERMITAGE. LENINGRAD.
works.de: A black-and-white geometric lattice-like form painted onto a reproduction. The background is grey. In the upper part of the painting, above the lattice, an irregular black semicircle. In the lower part of the painting, in the centre, a black quadrangle, on top of which a slightly smaller white rectangle. Along the lower edge, in printed text: ANTHONY VAN DYCK 1566-1641. SELF-PORTRAIT. late 1620s-early 1630s. Lower right: THE HERMITAGE. LENINGRAD.

works.d: Reproduktsioonile maalitud mustal taustal valged ebamäärase kujuga, pilvi meenutavad pinnad. Taustast kohati pruune toone läbi kumamas. Allääres trükikirjas: CASPAR DAVID FRIEDRICH. 1774-1840. ON A SAILING SHIP. paremal THE HERMITAGE. LENINGRAD
works.de: Painted onto the reproduction, on a black background, white surfaces of indeterminate shape resembling clouds. In places brown tones show through the background. Along the lower edge in printed lettering: CASPAR DAVID FRIEDRICH. 1774-1840. ON A SAILING SHIP. on the right THE HERMITAGE. LENINGRAD

works.t: Artist of the Pieter Breughel the Elder circle. Sarjast "Kunstialbum"
works.d: Reproduktsioonile maalitud musta, halli ja valgega abstraktses laadis nelinurkne kujund. Taust pruunikas-hall. Nelinurga alaosas domineerib must, ülaosas valge. Alaääres trükikirjas: ARTIST OF THE PIETER BRUEGHEL THE ELDER CIRCLE. Early 17th century. WINTER LANDSCAPE
works.de: A rectangular abstract-style shape painted in black, grey and white on a reproduction. Background brownish-grey. Black dominates the lower part of the rectangle, white the upper part. In print at the lower edge: ARTIST OF THE PIETER BRUEGHEL THE ELDER CIRCLE. Early 17th century. WINTER LANDSCAPE

works.d: Maali keskmest paremal ülalt valgustatud kera punaka omavarjuga ühtlaselt mustal taustal, millesse sissekraabitud kiri "valgus" ja noolemärk osutamas alla kerale. Kuulist alumine osa laia pintsliga maalitud kirsipunane, heledat läbi kumav pind. Ülaservas väiksem ja allservas suurem valge neljakandiline templimärk.
works.de: Right of the centre of the painting, a ball lit from above with reddish self-shadow on an evenly black background, into which the word "valgus" (light) and an arrow pointing down at the ball are scratched. The lower part of the ball is painted with a broad brush in cherry red, a bright, translucent surface. In the upper edge a smaller and in the lower edge a larger white square stamp mark.

works.d: Vasakul järsk paekallas väikeste põõsastega, paremal lahtine meri õhtuse pilvistaevaga. Põhitoonis rohekashall, sinine, oranž.
works.de: On the left a steep limestone bank with small bushes, on the right the open sea with an evening cloudy sky. Main tones greenish-grey, blue, orange.

works.d: Esiplaanil künklik kaldamaastik põõsapuhmastega üksiku noore puuga, keskel snetav järv, tagaplaanil vasakul lameda koonusena mägi, taevas valgeid pilvis.
works.de: In the foreground a hilly shore landscape with bushes and a solitary young tree, in the middle a gleaming lake, in the background on the left a mountain like a flat cone, sky with white clouds.

works.d: Töö allääres kaks halli, roosade uimede ja sabadega lestakala, tumehallil, tugevasti reljeefse faktuuriga foonil. Horisontaalsest keskjoonest ülalpool hallid liivaluited, erksinine meri, mis silmapiiril läheb üle halliks taevaks.
works.de: At the bottom edge of the work two grey flatfish with pink fins and tails, on a dark grey, strongly relief-textured background. Above the horizontal centre line grey sand dunes, bright blue sea, which on the horizon turns into a grey sky.

works.d: Maal jaotatud vertikaalselt kaheks. Paremal noore naise kolmveerandfiguur otsevaates, pea pööratud vasakule. Naisel päevitunud nägu, pikad juuksed seljal. Pea taga, mustal taustal neljakandiline ava helesinise, valgete pilvedega taevaga. Naise käisteta kleit reljeefselt vormitud. Maali vasak pool must-valges gammas tehismaastik silmapiiri suunas aheneva ruudustiku ja musta, avadega seinaga.
works.de: The painting is divided vertically into two. On the right a three-quarter figure of a young woman in frontal view, head turned to the left. The woman has a tanned face, long hair down her back. Behind her head, against a black background, a rectangular opening with a light blue sky with white clouds. The woman's sleeveless dress is shaped in relief. The left side of the painting, in a black-and-white scale, an artificial landscape with a grid narrowing towards the horizon and a black wall with openings.

works.d: Esiplaanil tumesinistes ja hallides toonides merepõhi, mis all segatehnikas reljeefseks markeeritud. Põhjas lillakate ja sinakate õitega lilled, varred püsti, väga pastoosselt maalitud. Lillede kohal erinevates sinistes toonides merevesi. Mere kohal valkjassinine, ülal tublisti tumenev sünge taevas.
works.de: In the foreground, a seabed in dark blue and grey tones, marked in relief below using mixed media. On the bottom, flowers with lilac and bluish blossoms, stems upright, painted very impasto. Above the flowers, sea water in various shades of blue. Above the sea, a whitish-blue, at the top considerably darkening, gloomy sky.

works.d: Kõhetu näoga mehe rindportree otsevaates punakas-ruskel taustal.
works.de: Frontal bust portrait of a gaunt-faced man against a reddish-brown background.

works.d: Mehe pea poolprofiilis vasakule, pikkadele õlgadele langevate juustega.
works.de: Man's head in three-quarter profile to the left, with hair falling onto long shoulders.

works.d: Paremal figuur löögiks tõstetud mõõgaga; keskel figuur enda ees seisja õlale langetatud mõõgaga. Vasakul ja taga inimfiguure.
works.de: On the right a figure with a sword raised for a strike; in the middle a figure with a sword lowered onto the shoulder of the one standing in front of him. On the left and in the background human figures.

works.d: Esialal rühm mehi muistses sõdurivarustuses paremalt vasakule astumas. Tagapool paremal leekides linnuse taga rohkesti mehi, vasakul lumine nõlvak vasakult linnuse poole suunduvate meestega tagaplaanil.
works.de: In the foreground a group of men in ancient soldier's equipment stepping from right to left. Further back on the right many men behind a burning castle in flames, on the left a snowy slope with men in the background moving from left towards the castle.

works.d: Esiplaanil roigasaed, jooksvaid ja ratsa inimsiluette. Keskel üksikuid onne. Taamal künka otsas leegitsev tuli.
works.de: In the foreground a pole fence, silhouettes of running and mounted people. In the middle individual huts. In the distance on top of a hill a blazing fire.

works.d: Istuva sõjaväelase põlvpilt poolprofiil vasakule.
works.de: Half-length portrait of a seated serviceman, three-quarter profile to the left.

works.d: Ateljee interjööris ees keskel laua serv teekannu, klaasi ja paletiga (värvide ja pintslitega). Vasakul kolm üksteise taga seisvat meest. Keskel grupp kolmest mehest. Paremal vasakul seisev mees.
works.de: In a studio interior, in front, centre, the edge of a table with a teapot, a glass and a palette (with paints and brushes). On the left three men standing one behind the other. In the centre a group of three men. On the right a man standing on the left.

works.d: Kirikuhoov vanas Jaroslavis: eespool madalate majadega, paremal keskel avatud värava ja selle taga oleva kiriku torniga.
works.de: A churchyard in old Yaroslavl: with low houses in the foreground, an open gate in the middle right and behind it a church tower.

works.d: Postidele tugineva laega ruumis vasakul rida supikatlaid, mille juures askeldavad sõdurid. Tagaseinas avatud uks.
works.de: In a room with a ceiling resting on posts, on the left a row of soup kettles, with soldiers busying themselves nearby. An open door in the back wall.

works.d: Sõjatander, kus esiplaanil punker, millest väljumas kaks meest. Esimesel kiiver peas ja mantlikrae vahelt paistmas SS korpuse tunnusmärk. Vasemal 6 meest punkri kõrval ja paremal 2. Lumise välja taga on nähtav purustatud hoonete rida.
works.de: A battlefield, in the foreground a bunker, from which two men are emerging. The first with a helmet on his head and, between the coat collar, the insignia of the SS corps visible. On the left 6 men beside the bunker and on the right 2. Behind the snowy field a row of destroyed buildings is visible.

works.d: Võiduväljakul, vasakult sügavusest ette paremale liikuva rongkäigu kolonni esireas kolm rahvarõivais naist, lilled peos. Nende taga sammub rahvarõivais naisi ja mehi. Paremal ja vasakul pool kolonni lehvivad punased lipud. Üle kolonni horisontaal punasel kangal loosung "ELAGU EESTI NÕUKOGUDE SOTSIALISTLIK VABARIIK". Taustaks on kujutatud Võiduväljaku äärsed hooned Kunstihoonega keskel.
works.de: On Victory Square, in the front row of a procession column moving from the left background to the right foreground, three women in folk costume, flowers in their hands. Behind them walk women and men in folk costume. On the right and left of the column red flags flutter. Above the column, on a horizontal red banner, the slogan "LONG LIVE THE ESTONIAN SOVIET SOCIALIST REPUBLIC". In the background the buildings around Victory Square are depicted, with the Art Hall in the centre.

works.d: Esiplaanil kivine rand, mille keskel üks suur kivi. Paremal veepind üksikute kividega, vasemal taamal mets ja järsu kaldaga neem.
works.de: In the foreground a stony shore with one large stone in the middle. On the right a water surface with isolated stones, on the left in the distance a forest and a headland with a steep bank.

works.d: Esiplaanil õitsva taimestikuga aas. Keskplaanil vasakul mõned puud ja põõsad. Taustal paremal mõned elektri kõrgepinge postid.
works.de: In the foreground a meadow with flowering vegetation. In the middle ground on the left a few trees and bushes. In the background on the right a few electric high-voltage poles.

works.d: Vaikne merepind. Esiplaanil vasakul kaks kivi merel, paremal kolm kajakat lendamas. Horisondil vasakul hulk laevu ja paate.
works.de: A calm sea surface. In the foreground on the left two rocks in the sea, on the right three seagulls flying. On the horizon on the left a number of ships and boats.

works.d: Kahe sõduri poolfiguurid seisvas asendis poolprofiilis paremale. Peas kiivrid, käes raamat. Õhus näha kuus lennukit.
works.de: Half-figures of two soldiers in standing position, in half-profile to the right. Helmets on their heads, a book in hand. Six aeroplanes visible in the air.

works.d: Esiplaanil kõrge rohuga väike lagendik. Taga vasakul ja paremal kõrgemad puud, keskosas põõsad. Vasakul rohus teerada kahe väikese figuuriga. Mees mustas. Naine roosas riietuses.
works.de: In the foreground a small clearing with tall grass. Behind, on the left and right, taller trees, in the middle section bushes. On the left in the grass a path with two small figures. A man in black. A woman dressed in pink.

works.d: Esiplaanil põlvili mees. Teine habemes mees kaikaga hoogu võtmas. Tagapool edasi tormavad inimesed.
works.de: A kneeling man in the foreground. Another bearded man gathering momentum with a club. Behind, people rushing forward.

works.d: Vaade lahesopile vasakul. Esiplaanil paremal kiviaed, põõsastik, viljapõllu riba, liivane rand, mets. Kiviaia juures naine punase seeliku ning valge pluusi ja rätiga, tema järel väike poiss mustas ülikonnas. Kaugemal mets.
works.de: View of a bay inlet on the left. In the foreground on the right a stone wall, shrubbery, a strip of grain field, a sandy beach, forest. By the stone wall a woman in a red skirt and white blouse and headscarf, behind her a small boy in a black suit. Forest further away.

works.d: Esiplaanil keskel kaugusse viiv tee, sellest paremal ja vasakul varemed, viltused postid, lennukirusud. Taevas lillakas-hall, paremal punane.
works.de: In the foreground, in the centre, a road leading into the distance, to the right and left of it ruins, tilted posts, aircraft wreckage. Sky purplish-grey, red on the right.

works.d: Esiplaanil tee, vasemal väike küngas suurte kividega ja üksikute põõsastega, paremal kaks tuulikut ja mõned hooned.
works.de: A road in the foreground, on the left a small hillock with large stones and a few bushes, on the right two windmills and some buildings.

works.d: Ehitusplats kujutatud rõhutatud joonte ja pindadega, kollakas-ooker ja pruunid toonid. Taga punane lipp.
works.de: A construction site depicted with emphasised lines and planes, yellowish-ochre and brown tones. A red flag in the background.

works.d: Üle maalipinna laiub mäekülg, mille allosas (vastu allserva) majade rida, kust kerkivad üles lehvivad kangad. Maalitud pruunikates ja sinakates toonides helepunaste aktsentidega.
works.de: A mountainside spreads across the painting's surface, at its lower part (against the lower edge) a row of houses, from which fluttering cloths rise up. Painted in brownish and bluish tones with light red accents.

works.d: Vana naise figuur otsevaates, kelle kortsunud näos tühjad silmakoopad. Seljas violetne kimano. Fooniks Jaapani linnapilt.
works.de: Frontal figure of an old woman, her wrinkled face showing empty eye sockets. Wearing a violet kimono. Background a Japanese cityscape.

works.d: Üle pildi pinna vaade linnale, mis on maalil üles ehitatud joonterütmile; koloriidis domineerib tume, vaheldatud siniste ja punaste toonidega, kauguses kerkivad heledad majablokid.
works.de: A view over the picture surface to a city, which in the painting is built up on a rhythm of lines; the colouring is dominated by dark tones, alternating with blue and red shades, in the distance light blocks of houses rise.

works.d: Jaapani tütarlapse põlvportree otsevaates, kirjus kimanos, sõrmed ees seoses.
works.de: Knee-length portrait of a Japanese girl in a frontal view, in a patterned kimono, fingers clasped in front.

works.d: Veekogul seisavad paljud paadid, millede mastid tõusevad paralleelselt ülaservani. Taha vasemale jäävad punasekatuselised majad.
works.de: Many boats are standing on the water, their masts rising parallel to the upper edge. Behind them to the left are houses with red roofs.

works.d: Pildi alumises osas kolm jaapanlanna pead, tihedalt üksteise kõrvale paigutatud, kõrgetes, ehitud soengutes. Fooniks heledates toonides templikujutis.
works.de: In the lower part of the picture three heads of Japanese women, placed closely next to one another, in tall, adorned hairstyles. Background a temple depiction in light tones.

works.d: Peaaegu kogu pildi ulatuses Colosseumi interjööri kujutis, maalitud tumedate pruunikate ja valkjate toonidega, rõhutades ümarakujulist keskosa ringjoonega. Ülaossa jääb kitsas sinine taevariba.
works.de: Almost the entire extent of the picture shows the interior of the Colosseum, painted in dark brownish and whitish tones, emphasising the round central part with a circular line. A narrow blue strip of sky remains at the top.

works.d: Öine vaade üle Seine'i Notre-Dame'i valgustatud fassaadile.
works.de: A night view over the Seine to the illuminated façade of Notre-Dame.

works.d: Kirevas riietuses jaapanlanna kolmveeranfiguur selgvaates, nägu profiilis vasakule. Taga paremal osa teisest figuurist.
works.de: Three-quarter figure of a Japanese woman in colourful clothing, seen frontally, her face in profile facing left. Behind on the right part of another figure.

works.d: Kirjul foonil tumedanahalise, idamaises rõivastuses naise seisev kolmveerandfiguur, keha otsevaates, nägu profiilis.
works.de: Against a colourful background, a standing three-quarter figure of a dark-skinned woman in oriental dress, the body in frontal view, the face in profile.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul valkjates toonides Constantinuse triumfikaar. Paremal pruunikasrohelised arkaadidega varemed.
works.de: In the foreground on the left, the Arch of Constantine in whitish tones. On the right, brownish-green ruins with arcades.

works.d: Tumesinisel taustal heledad vertikaal- ja horisontaaljooned ning nelinurgad.
works.de: On a dark blue background, light vertical and horizontal lines and quadrangles.

works.d: Pildi keskel käetugedega toolis istuva tumedajuukselise, pika kitsa nina, väikese suu ja kitsaste silmadega, tütarlapse kolmveerandfiguur. Seljas punane pikkade käistega kleit. Mõlemad käed hoidmas kinni tooli käetugedest.
works.de: In the middle of the picture a three-quarter figure of a dark-haired girl with a long narrow nose, small mouth and narrow eyes, sitting in a chair with armrests. Wearing a red long-sleeved dress. Both hands holding onto the armrests of the chair.

works.d: Kolmeosalisel maalipinnal kujutatud meeletult tormavaid hobuseid lehvivate lakkadega punastes, sinistes, roosades toonides. Nende vahel figuure.
works.de: The three-part painted surface depicts frantically galloping horses with flowing manes in red, blue, pink tones. Figures between them.

works.d: Paremas kuldlõikes sinises teksaülikonnas ja kollases triibulises avatud kaelusega särgis prillidega noormehe poolfiguur en face, käed püksitaskutes, ulatudes pealaega perspektiivjooneni. Tumedad vurrud, pikad, kergelt lainetavad tumedad juuksed. Ees vasakul, noormehe kõrval laud joonestusvahenditega. Fooniks abstraktne ruum, mis on perspektiivis sirgjoonte ja värvipindadega kärjetaoliselt jaotatud mõttelisteks kuubikukujulisteks ruumiosadeks. Sinaks-roosa-rohekas taevas joonestatud geomeetriliste kujunditega.
works.de: In the right golden section, the half-figure of a bespectacled young man in blue jeans and a yellow striped open-collared shirt, en face, hands in trouser pockets, reaching with the crown of his head to the perspective line. Dark moustache, long, slightly wavy dark hair. In front on the left, beside the young man, a table with drafting instruments. The background is an abstract space divided in perspective by straight lines and colour surfaces into honeycomb-like conceptual cube-shaped spatial sections. A bluish-pink-greenish sky with drawn geometric shapes.

works.d: Kompositsioon suitsevast lahinguväljast, millel on äsja lõppenud võistlus. Esiplaanil keskel suur kõrge, paremal äärel servani, vasemal vaatajast veidi kaugemal põlenud, väändunud, deformeerunud püstjased teraserusud, mis on maalitud sirgete, kohati ümarate, paindunud teravate joontega (peamiselt pruunide ja mustade, tumedatel suurematel pindadel ka helesiniste, punaste, kollaste, roheliste jt.). Maapind sirge pruuni joonena kujutatud horisondini kaetud mitmevärviliste värvipindadega. Pilvine ning suitsune taevaas, milles väikeste laikudena paistab helesinist. Keskmise ning vasakpoolse rusukuhila vahel horisondil - põlev tank.
works.de: A composition of a smoking battlefield on which a contest has just ended. In the foreground in the centre, large and tall, reaching to the edge on the right, and slightly further from the viewer on the left, burnt, twisted, deformed upright piles of steel wreckage, painted with straight, in places rounded, bent sharp lines (mainly brown and black, with light blue, red, yellow, green and other colours also on the larger dark surfaces). The ground, depicted as a straight brown line up to the horizon, is covered with multicoloured patches of colour. A cloudy and smoky sky, in which light blue shows through as small patches. Between the middle and left-hand piles of wreckage, on the horizon - a burning tank.

works.d: Armeenia mägine maastik. Vasemast alumisest nurgast kompositsiooni suhtes diagonaalselt, sügava sängina kulgev tee sügavasse kitsasse orgu, rohetava nõlvaga tagaplaanil paremal poolel, lõikudes tasasesse, avarasse platoosse ning jaotades selle kompositsioonil tinglikult kahte ossa: tagaplaanil roosakaks väljaks, esiplaanil paremal kolmnurkseks, suurte kividega kaetud maaribaks. Sellel, pildivälja äärel, fragment kergest kahekordsest vaiadest puitelamust balustraadiga balkoniga teisel korrusel, millel nööril kuivavad punased taimed. Teed, millel kõnnib üksik naine, piiravad vasakult kõrged kaljud. Horisondil paremal sinetav lame mägi.
works.de: Armenian mountain landscape. From the lower left corner, running diagonally in relation to the composition, a road runs as a deep track into a deep narrow valley, with a greenish slope in the background on the right side, cutting into a flat, spacious plateau and conditionally dividing it into two parts in the composition: a pinkish field in the background, and in the foreground on the right a triangular strip of land covered with large stones. On this, at the edge of the picture field, a fragment of a light two-storey wooden pile dwelling with a balcony with a balustrade on the second floor, on which red plants are drying on a line. The road, on which a lone woman is walking, is bordered on the left by high cliffs. On the horizon on the right, a bluish flat mountain.

works.d: Kogu pildi pinna võtab enda alla kahe kupliga kirikuhoone; kaunistatud rohkete skulptuuridega. Esiplaanil, sissekäigu juures miniatuursed inimfiguurid. Koloriit tume, ülekaalus sinised toonid.
works.de: The whole surface of the picture is occupied by a two-domed church building, decorated with numerous sculptures. In the foreground, by the entrance, miniature human figures. Dark colour scheme, blue tones predominant.

works.d: Suureformaadiline kompositsioon, millest umb. 6/7 võtab enda alla rohelus: puud, põõsad, rikkalikult kõikvõimalikke taimi ja lilli. Paremas alumises neljandikus äratuntavalt antud kolm helelillat astrit; vasakul all, horisontaalsest keskjoonest veidi allpool neli tumepunast roosiõit kandilises vaasis või pudelis. Sellest vasakul suur klaaspurk lillekimbuga. Alumises servas keskel nukk ja klaaskauss õuntega, neist paremal üksik klaas kollase lilleoksaga. Ülaservas aimatav, rangeil horisontaalidel ja vertikaalidel põhinev linnavaade. Töö tihedate pintslilöökidega läbi maalitud, valdavalt tumerohelises koloriidis.
works.de: A large-format composition, of which about 6/7 is taken up by greenery: trees, bushes, an abundance of various plants and flowers. In the lower right quarter, three recognisably rendered light-purple asters; lower left, slightly below the horizontal centre line, four dark red rose blossoms in a rectangular vase or bottle. To its left a large glass jar with a bouquet of flowers. At the bottom edge, centre, a doll and a glass bowl with apples, to their right a single glass with a yellow flower branch. At the top edge a cityscape based on strict horizontals and verticals can be discerned. The work is painted throughout with dense brushstrokes, predominantly in dark green colouring.

works.d: Punasel taustal tõmmunahalise, tugevate näojoontega jaapani mehe portree. Pea kerges pöördes vasakule, pilk suunatud üles. Ümber pea seotud kitsa ribana valge rätt.
works.de: Against a red background, portrait of a swarthy Japanese man with strong facial features. The head in a slight turn to the left, gaze directed upward. A narrow strip of white cloth tied around the head.

works.d: Heledates toonides maalitud Ateena Akropoli vaade pildi keskel sügavsinise taeva taustal. Pildi alumises pooles tume maastik aimatavate puude siluettidega, all pildi servas üksikud reaaliad: kaks antiikset skulptuurpead, coca-cola pudeli silt. Värvimulje annab paljude erivärviliste pintslilöökide kokkusulamine.
works.de: A view of the Athenian Acropolis painted in light tones, in the centre of the picture against a deep blue sky. In the lower half of the picture a dark landscape with the suggested silhouettes of trees, at the bottom edge of the picture a few individual realia: two antique sculpture heads, a label from a Coca-Cola bottle. The colour impression is created by the fusion of many differently coloured brushstrokes.

works.d: Peaaegu täisprofiilis sinistes toonides tütarlapse pea, näo vasak pool jääb varju, juuksed kuklalt üles kammitud. Profiil jätab punasele foonile tugeva sinise varju. Etüüdilikult maalitud.
works.de: Almost full-profile head of a girl in blue tones, the left side of the face left in shadow, hair combed up from the nape. The profile casts a strong blue shadow on the red background. Painted in an etude-like manner.

works.dm: laius: 300.0 cm (kolm osa koos); kõrgus: 200.0 cm
works.d: Vasak tiib: Hoogsalt maalitud smaragdrohelise lopsaka taimestiku taustal puhmastena pruunikaspunased lilled, nende vahel skulptuurpea. Ülemises neljandikus heledal taustal sõrestikulised ehituskonstruktsioonid, vasakus äärs pea fragment profiilis.
works.de: Left wing: Boldly painted brownish-red flowers in clusters against a background of lush emerald-green vegetation, among them a sculptural head. In the upper quarter, against a light background, skeletal building structures, in the left margin a fragment of a head in profile.

works.d: Pildi keskel seda kaheks jaotav ehituskonstruktsioonide kuhil. Sellest paremal ja vasakul õrnalt valgega märgitud kraanade kontuurid. Silmapiiril, mürkrohelise maapinna taustal paremas nurgas uue linnaosa siluett, vasakul jupike tööstusmaastikku väävlisuitsu ajava korstnaga. Ülaääres tumesinine taevas.
works.de: In the middle of the picture, a pile of building constructions dividing it in two. To its right and left, faintly white-marked outlines of cranes. On the horizon, against a poison-green ground, in the right corner the silhouette of a new city district, on the left a piece of an industrial landscape with a chimney emitting sulphurous smoke. At the top edge, a dark blue sky.

works.d: Sinakate arhidektuuridetailide taustal ühteistkümnest inimesest grupiportree. Keskosas lühikeste heldate juustega istuv vana naine otsevaates, parem käsi süles. Tema ees paremal helepunases kleidis seisev tüdruk. Tüdruku taga paremal seisavad prillidega noor mees, käed vaheliti rinnal ja helepruunide juustega noor naine. Nende vahel taga paistab vanema mehe (E. Okas) pea veerandpöördes paremale. Keskosast vasakul lühikeste heledate juustega üle keskea naise portree veerandpöördes paremale. Naise taga tumedates prillides noor mees otsevaates. Esiplaanil vasakul lamav hundikoer ja istuv suur must  koer. Koerte taga poolselgvaates, pea pööratud vaatajale, noor naine, imik süles. Tagapool vasaku
works.de: Against a background of bluish architectural details, a group portrait of eleven people. In the centre, a seated old woman with short light hair, seen frontally, right hand in her lap. In front of her, on the right, a girl in a light red dress. Behind the girl, on the right, stand a young man with glasses, arms crossed on his chest, and a young woman with light brown hair. Between them, further back, the head of an older man (E. Okas) is visible, turned in a quarter profile to the right. To the left of the centre, a portrait of a woman past middle age with short light hair, in a quarter turn to the right. Behind the woman, a young man with dark glasses, seen frontally. In the foreground on the left, a lying wolfhound and a sitting large black dog. Behind the dogs, in half profile, head turned toward the viewer, a young woman with an infant in her lap. Further back on the left

works.d: Osa siniste seinte ja kollase põrandaga toast avatud aknaga. Aknast vasakul laud lillevaasiga.
works.de: Part of a room with blue walls and a yellow floor, with an open window. To the left of the window a table with a flower vase.

works.d: Sini-valgel foonil noormehe pea poolpöördes paremale, kaelas valged pärlid.
works.de: On a blue-white background the head of a young man in half-turn to the right, white pearls at the neck.

works.d: Ruugetes, rohelistes, kollastes ja lillakates toonides pargivaade. Paremal osa hoonest, vasakul skulptuure.
works.de: Park view in brownish, green, yellow and purplish tones. On the right part of a building, on the left sculptures.

works.d: Pruunides toonides interjöör kirjutuslaua, tabureti ja raamaturiiuliga. Keskel aken, millest avaneb vaade linnale.
works.de: Interior in brown tones with a writing desk, a stool and a bookshelf. In the middle a window through which a view of the town opens.

works.d: Sinakal foonil suurte pindadena maalitud roosa kraega, pruunis kleidis noore naise kolmveerandfiguur, kerge peapööre vasakule.
works.de: Against a bluish background, painted in large planes, the three-quarter figure of a young woman with a pink collar, in a brown dress, head turned slightly to the left.

works.d: Maali keskplaanil pildivälja parempoolses osas sinakashall supelmaja kahe musta ukseavaga selle vasakpoolses osas, mõlemast väljuva suplejaga. Äärmise ukse kohal vette ulatuv trepp. Fooniks rohelised puud. Esiplaanil vees kaks vaia paatide kinnitamiseks; parempoolse juures kaks paati. Supelmaja ees vees kaks suplejat.
works.de: In the middle ground of the painting, in the right-hand part of the picture field, a bluish-grey bathhouse with two black door openings in its left-hand part, with a bather emerging from each. Above the outermost door a stairway reaching down into the water. Green trees form the background. In the foreground in the water two posts for mooring boats; by the right-hand one two boats. In front of the bathhouse in the water two bathers.

works.d: Ookrikarva toolil istub poolprofiilis sügavsinises kleidis naine. Naisel vasekarva pikemad juuksed, parem käsi süles, pea toetub vasakule käele. Tooli käetoel roheline rätik. Foon vasakul ülal hallikassinine, paremal servas ja allosas valge. Maalitud eskiisilikult.
works.de: On an ochre-coloured chair sits, in half-profile, a woman in a deep blue dress. The woman has longer copper-coloured hair, right hand in lap, head resting on left hand. A green scarf on the armrest of the chair. Background greyish-blue at upper left, white at the right edge and lower part. Painted in a sketch-like manner.

works.d: Lühikeseks pöetud juustega pikliku näoga noormehe pea otsevaates. Tõsine ilme, tumedate kontuuridega rõhutatud selged näojooned. Tume koloriit, üldistav maalilaad. Jäme korniline lõuend tausta ja õlgade piirkonnas osaliselt katmata.
works.de: Head of a young man with a long face and short-cropped hair, in frontal view. Serious expression, clear facial features emphasised with dark contours. Dark colouring, generalising painting manner. Coarse-grained canvas partially left uncovered in the background and shoulder area.

works.d: Esiplaanil jõgi üksiku sõudjaga. Paremal lage, sügavale vette tungiv kaldariba. Tagapool, vastaskaldal, üsna vee ligi puude-põõsaste vöönd. Kaugemal lagedad heinamaad. Taamal mets ja mäeahelik.
works.de: In the foreground a river with a solitary rower. On the right an open strip of shore reaching deep into the water. Further back, on the opposite bank, a belt of trees and bushes quite close to the water. Further away open meadows. Beyond that forest and a mountain range.

works.d: Vaarikapunasel taustal kirsipruunis suvekleidis, laia äärega kollase kübaraga noore naise rindportree veerandpöördes paremale, käed vaheliti rinnal. Naisel tõsine ilme, suured silmad, sirge nina, kübara vari langeb vasakule näopoolele. Kleidi ovaalse kaeluse juures kolm nööpi. Üldistatud, napp markeeriv laad, kohati kontuurjooni maalipinda sisse kraabitud.
works.de: Against a raspberry-red background, a bust portrait of a young woman in a cherry-brown summer dress with a wide-brimmed yellow hat, in a three-quarter turn to the right, hands crossed on her chest. The woman has a serious expression, large eyes, a straight nose, the shadow of the hat falling on the left side of her face. Three buttons at the oval neckline of the dress. Generalized, sparse, marking manner, in places contour lines scratched into the paint surface.

works.d: Beežikal laudpõrandal lamab tõstetud põlvedega naisakt. Naise padjale toetuv pea on suunaga vaataja poole. Pilk suunatud diagonaalselt vasakule üles. Naise käed on kuklale kõverdatud. Tagaplaanil vasakul punaste - roheliste laikudega eesriie, keskel sinistes toonides taust, paremal määrdunud beež seinakate.
works.de: On a beige plank floor lies a female nude with raised knees. The woman's head, resting on a pillow, faces the viewer. Her gaze is directed diagonally up to the left. The woman's arms are bent behind her head. In the background on the left a curtain with red-green patches, in the centre a background in blue tones, on the right a soiled beige wall covering.

works.dm: kõrgus: 42.3 cm; sügavus: 15.0 cm; laius: 60.0 cm
works.d: Musta pappaluse keskele kinnitatud vineerist kast, mis omakorda vaheseinaga pikuti pooleks jagatud. Kasti siseseinad peegelduvast metallist, põhja maalitud erksavärvilised portreesiluetid. Mõlemal kastipoolel sarnane, erinevas värvikombinatsiooniskujutis: paremal kaabuga mehe selg-, vasakul otsevaade sinise, kollase, rohelise ja punasega pinnaliselt maalituna. Kastipõhjal, figuuride all roosa vööt, millele kinnitub pruun lehekestega metallist puuoks. Mustal alusel kahel pool külgedel valgusfoori kujund kolme üksteise all paikneva rohelisest klaasist märgiga-tulega.
works.de: A plywood box fastened to the centre of a black cardboard base, itself divided lengthwise into two by a partition. The inner walls of the box are of reflective metal, with brightly coloured portrait silhouettes painted on the bottom. Both halves of the box show a similar depiction in different colour combinations: on the right the back view of a man in a hat, on the left a frontal view painted flatly in blue, yellow, green and red. On the bottom of the box, beneath the figures, a pink strip, to which a brown, leafed metal tree branch is attached. On the black base, on both sides, a traffic light figure with three green glass signal lights placed one below the other.

works.t: Tartu III Keskkooli abiturient - eesrindlik õpilane Hilla Jaakson
works.d: Heledajuukselise tütarlapse - komnoore 3/4 figuur, otsevaates kriidiga paremas, raamatuga vasakus käes. Figuuri taga oleval seinatahvlil trigonomeetrilisi arvutusi.
works.de: 3/4 figure of a fair-haired girl - a Young Pioneer, frontal view, with chalk in the right hand and a book in the left. On the wall panel behind the figure trigonometric calculations.

works.d: Punavalge triibulisel alusel poolkülili lebav noor naine, käed kuklal, jalad konksus, seljas vanaroosat tooni käisteta kleit. Ülakeha all sinine riie. Tagapool paremal türkiisrohelisel taustal kipstorso, vasakul hele-, keskel tumehall draperii. Markeeriv maalilaad, erksad toonid.
works.de: A young woman lying half on her side on a base covered with red-and-white striped cloth, hands behind her head, legs bent, wearing a sleeveless dress in an old-rose tone. Under her upper body a blue cloth. Behind her on the right, against a turquoise-green background, a plaster torso; on the left a light-coloured drapery, in the middle a dark grey one. Sketchy painting style, bright tones.

works.d: Laiaservalises kübaras noore naise rinnapilt. Beežil taustal.
works.de: Bust of a young woman in a wide-brimmed hat. On a beige background.

works.d: Laual esiplaanil tumeda paelaga hele kaabu.
works.de: In the foreground on the table, a light-coloured hat with a dark ribbon.

works.d: Pannoo kavand. Esiplaanil pallivõrgu ees neli spordiriietuses seisvat noormeest: vasakult esimene odaga, teine kuuli ja kolmas kettaga käes, neljandal käed ristamisi rinnal. Võrgu taga, paremal kaks jooksjat. Taustaks meri purjekate ja laevadega.
works.de: Sketch for a panel. In the foreground, in front of a ball net, four young men standing in sportswear: from the left the first with a javelin, the second holding a shot put and the third a discus, the fourth with arms crossed on his chest. Behind the net, on the right, two runners. The background shows the sea with sailboats and ships.

works.d: Naise ja mehe poolfiguurid, mõlemad peakatetes, mehel käes avatud ajaleht. Koloriit hele - valkjas, nägudel ja kätel varjudes roosakas-lilla toon. Katmisviis ühtlane, sile.
works.de: Half-figures of a woman and a man, both wearing headwear, the man holding an open newspaper. Light colour scheme - whitish, with a pinkish-lilac tone in the shadows on faces and hands. Even, smooth application of paint.
