works.d: Kolmnurgale ülesehitatud kahefiguuriline kompositsioonigrupp, esiplaanil naise kuju. Pead pöörates üleõla paremale. Sinisel foonil kaheksa tähte.
works.de: A two-figure composition group built on a triangle, in the foreground the figure of a woman. Turning her head over her shoulder to the right. Eight stars on a blue background.

works.d: Tiik, paremal laugjalt tõusva kõrge kaldapealsega. Taamal puude allee. Koloriit hele, valdav roheline toon.
works.de: A pond, on the right a high bank rising gently. An avenue of trees in the distance. Colouring light, predominant tone green.

works.de: a) River landscape in spring.

works.d: Ees keskel pilvedel kaarik, mille ees neli hobust. Kaarikus seisev naise täisfiguur, ohjad käes ja kaks lapsefiguuri. Paremal kolme mehe figuurid lippudega.
works.de: In the centre foreground a chariot on clouds, drawn by four horses. In the chariot the full figure of a standing woman, holding the reins, and two child figures. On the right the figures of three men with flags.

works.d: Kiilaspäise keskealise mehe rinnafiguur poolpöördes vasakule. Mehe riietus: sinine särk, must pintsak ja lips. Taust tume.
works.de: Bust figure of a bald middle-aged man in a half-turn to the left. The man's clothing: a blue shirt, a black jacket and a tie. Dark background.

works.d: Ees künkaline rohumaa, keskel oleva puude ja põõsaste rea vahelt ja üle paistmas hoonete grupid.
works.de: In front, hilly grassland, in the middle groups of buildings visible through and above a row of trees and bushes.

works.d: Keskel paljukäelise ja paljujalalise tantsijanna alasti figuur tantsimas. Tema ümber hiiglasuured tumerohelised lehed ja kasvud. Paremal pool ees hallil lausel jumaluse pea punases toonis rohelise peakattega. Vasakul pool ees sinisel alusel kaks tumedat alasti naisfiguuri. Foon helekollane.
works.de: In the centre, a nude figure of a dancer with many arms and many legs, dancing. Around her, gigantic dark-green leaves and growths. On the right in front, on a grey slab, the head of a deity in a red tone with a green headdress. On the left in front, on a blue pedestal, two dark nude female figures. The background is light yellow.

works.d: Ees, sammastikule toetuva kaaristu ees grupp rooma sõdureid ja kaks seisvat naisfiguuri. Läbi parempoolse kaarestiku näha Kristuse kohtumõistmise stseeni; läbi vasakpoolse lagedat maastiku palmiga.
works.de: In front, before an arcade resting on a colonnade, a group of Roman soldiers and two standing female figures. Through the right-hand arch the scene of Christ's judgement is visible; through the left-hand one an open landscape with a palm tree.

works.d: Ees jõgi kahe paadiga. Vastakallas lage, üksikute põõsastikega lauskmaa. Horisondil mets.
works.de: In front a river with two boats. The opposite bank bare, flat land with occasional bushes. Forest on the horizon.

works.d: Noore, käed puusadel seisva naise poolfiguur kerges pöördes vasakule. Tumedad lühikesed juuksed, lillakas - punane jakk.
works.de: Half-figure of a young woman standing with hands on hips, in a slight turn to the left. Dark short hair, purplish-red jacket.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal istub punastel patjadel kuldsel toolil naisfiguur, keha 1/4 pöördes vasakule. Vasak käsi tõstetud. Naisel seljas pruunikas drapeeritud rõivas, pea kohal kuldne nimbus, millesse kirjutatud kirillitsas Maria. Vasakul seisab 3/4 pöördes paremale hoogsas poosis ingel. Ingel hoiab ühes käes peenikest saua, teine on tõstetud õnnistamaks Maarjat. Ingli nimbusesse on kirjutatud kirillitsas Gabriil. Seljas on tal punane mantel, mille all rohekas rüü, tiivad punase ja rohelisega. Figuuride taustaks on kaks hoonet, vasakul punane, paremal roheline, taust pruunikas - kuldne. Ülaosas Püha Vaimu sümbol - väike valge tuvi suundumas tuvi poole.
works.de: In the foreground on the right sits a female figure on red cushions on a golden chair, the body in a 1/4 turn to the left. The left hand is raised. The woman is wearing a brownish draped garment, above her head a golden halo, on which is written in Cyrillic "Maria". On the left stands an angel in a 3/4 turn to the right, in a dynamic pose. The angel holds a thin staff in one hand, the other is raised to bless Mary. On the angel's halo is written in Cyrillic "Gabriil". He wears a red cloak, under which a greenish robe, wings in red and green. The background to the figures consists of two buildings, on the left red, on the right green, the background brownish-gold. In the upper part the symbol of the Holy Spirit – a small white dove heading towards the dove.

works.d: Pruunides, rohelistes ja ookritoonides mererand, toikaid ja adruseid kivisid täis. Nende kohal kõrguvad kolm fantastilistes voolavates vormides valget kändu. Tagaplaanil kalda ääres tumesinine, taamal pruunides toonides meri. Ülal, kõrge silmapiiri kohal helesinine taevaviirg.
works.de: In brown, green and ochre tones, a seashore full of driftwood and seaweed-covered stones. Above them rise three white stumps of fantastic flowing forms. In the background by the shore, dark blue, and further away the sea in brown tones. Above, over the high horizon, a light blue strip of sky.

works.d: Istuva tütarlapse poolfiguur en face rohekal-pruunikal foonil. Heledad juuksed sinise paelaga taga. Helesinine kroogetega kleit, kaela ümber valge ääris.

works.de: In the middle a hollow covered with greenish-grey forest, surrounded on the sides and in the background by a grey mountain range.

works.d: Kollakasroheliste põllusiiludega avara maastiku taustal grupp unelev-tõsiseid inimesi. Esiplaanil lauanurk kruusi, kausi, selle ümber noored einestamas: vasakul valges särgis noormehe, selgvaates tumedajuukselise naise, otsevaates nokkmütsis mehe, paremal tõstetud kätega naise ja mehe poolfiguurid. Tagapool vasakul külitav naine ja istuv mees. Säravad toonid, tihke vorme üldistav, pehmelt modelleeriv maalilaad.
works.de: Against the background of a spacious landscape with yellowish-green field strips, a group of dreamy-serious people. In the foreground the corner of a table with gravel, a bowl, around which young people are dining: on the left the half-figures of a young man in a white shirt, a dark-haired woman seen frontally, a man in a peaked cap seen frontally, on the right a woman and a man with raised hands. Further back on the left a reclining woman and a sitting man. Bright tones, a painting style generalising dense forms, softly modelling.

works.d: Esiplaanil kaks figuuri alusservaga poolenisti lõigatud; parempoolne alasti en face, vasakpoolne rohelises pluusis seljaga. Nende taga rand geometriseeritult pindadeks maalituna, domineerib heleroheline, vasakus servas intensiivset oranži, sinist. Tagaplaanil sügavates rohelistes toonides meri ja kitsas taevariba.
works.de: In the foreground two figures cut off at the lower edge; the one on the right nude en face, the one on the left in a green blouse, seen from the back. Behind them a beach painted in a geometricised manner as planes, dominated by light green, with intense orange and blue in the left edge. In the background, the sea in deep green tones and a narrow strip of sky.

works.d: Rohekates, sinakates toonides foonil kaheksa naist eredavärviliste lillenuppudega.
works.de: Against a background in greenish, bluish tones eight women with brightly coloured flower buds.

works.de: Eight human figures - two in profile, one from the back, and five en face.

works.de: Hilly landscape with red and green fields. In the foreground a river in intense blue tones.

works.de: On the left three half-figures of men in the light of a forge fire. Of these the one on the right en face, the middle one and the one on the left in profile. The middle one holds long tongs in his hand. On the right a reddish furnace opening, in front of which a half-figure of a man in clear view.

works.d: Esiplaanil seisva mehe kolmveerandfiguur toetumas tooli najale. Paremas käes piip, vasak toetub tooli korjule. Vasakul laud paberite ja trükilaokastidega. Taga vasakul varjus näha seisva mehe figuur pruunis kitlis seljaga vaataja poole.
works.de: Three-quarter figure of a man standing in the foreground, leaning on the back of a chair. In his right hand a pipe, his left hand resting on the chair frame. On the left a table with papers and printer's type-cases. In the background on the left, in shadow, the figure of a standing man in a brown smock, his back to the viewer.

works.d: Hallides ja pruunides toonides kompositsioon, mille horisontaalsel keskteljel punakaspruunidest kividest linnamüür. Paremal servas keskel on viis väheldast meest ametis kivide kandmise ja ladumisega. Müüri taga tumehallist paekivist vanalinna majad, tornid ja kirikud. Kompositsiooni alumises nurgas, linnamüüri ees neli meest (ühel neist kollane turban, teisel baretid) kuulamas punase laubapaela ja viipeks tõstetud parema käega ookrikarva rüüs meest.(eesti)
works.de: A composition in grey and brown tones, with a city wall of reddish-brown stones along the horizontal central axis. On the right edge, in the middle, five smallish men are occupied with carrying and laying stones. Behind the wall, old-town houses, towers and churches of dark grey limestone. In the lower corner of the composition, in front of the city wall, four men (one of them with a yellow turban, another with berets) are listening to a man in an ochre-coloured robe with a red headband, gesturing with his raised right hand.

works.d: Punasel foonil keskealise, tugevate näojoontega mehe rinnaportree. Paksud, tumedad juuksed laubalt taha kammitud. tihedate, ülemist laugu katvate kulmude alt suunatud vaatajale uuriv pilk; huuled veidi avatud. Käed vaheliti rinnal. Seljas tumepruun pallon ning valge kittel. Allääres lai punakaspruun horisontaalne pind.(eesti)
works.de: On a red background, a bust portrait of a middle-aged man with strong facial features. Thick, dark hair combed back from the forehead. From beneath dense eyebrows covering the upper eyelid, an inquiring gaze directed at the viewer; lips slightly parted. Hands crossed on the chest. Wearing a dark brown paletot and a white smock. A broad reddish-brown horizontal surface at the lower edge.

works.d: Esiplaanil kaks karahvinide, pitside ja taldrikutega kaetud lauda. Parempoolse laua taga istub mustas ülikonnas valge särgiga mees, käsi toetub tema kõrval asuvale punase sametiga kaetud tooli või diivani seljatoele. Mehe pea on kergelt pööratud paremale, pisut väljakutsuv pilk vaataja poole pööratud. Foonil kaks portreed, üks narri -, teine klounikostüümis.
works.de: In the foreground, two tables covered with carafes, lace and plates. Behind the table on the right sits a man in a black suit with a white shirt, his hand resting on the back of a chair or sofa covered in red velvet beside him. The man's head is turned slightly to the right, his gaze somewhat provocatively turned toward the viewer. In the background two portraits, one of a jester, the other in a clown costume.

works.d: Otsekui lavale, dekoratsioonide vahele on asetatud kaks jalutut (puujalgadega) karnevalikostüümides figuuri. Vasakpoolsel punase põhjaga müts, kellukesed servas, must mask, lai pitsiline krae, punane hõlst, valge põll, kaelas must rätik, käes puust mõõk. Parempoolsel kuldkollane parukas, näo asemel tohutu suu, valge pitsiline krae, sinine pluus, punane kuub ja püksid. Kuue varrukas suure haaknõelaga dekoratsiooni külge kinnitatud. Paremas nurgas vineerist välja lõigatud valge hani ratastel; keskel dekoratsiooni serval seemnetega kaetud sai.
works.de: As if placed on a stage, among the scenery, are two legless (with wooden legs) figures in carnival costumes. On the left one, a hat with a red base, bells on the edge, a black mask, a wide lace collar, a red doublet, a white apron, a black scarf around the neck, a wooden sword in hand. On the right one, a golden-yellow wig, an enormous mouth instead of a face, a white lace collar, a blue blouse, a red coat and trousers. The sleeve of the coat is attached to the scenery with a large safety pin. In the right corner, a white goose on wheels cut out of plywood; in the centre, at the edge of the scenery, a loaf of bread covered with seeds.

works.d: Lamava tütarlapse poolfiguur, pea üleval vasakus nurgas, rinnale kokku pandud käed all paremal. Punane jakk, käte all valge vaiba äär.
works.de: Half-figure of a reclining girl, head at the upper left corner, hands folded on her chest at the lower right. A red jacket, the edge of a white blanket under the hands.

works.d: Neljaosaline, igal osal erivärvilises lahenduses sarnastest kujunditest kompositsioon: keskel lainelise äärega ülalt ahenev kujund, selle tipus ring.
works.de: Four-part composition, each part in a different colour solution of similar forms: in the centre a shape narrowing upward with a wavy edge, a circle at its tip.

works.d: Keerulise pinna- ja ruumistruktuuriga abstraktne geomeetriline kompositsioon, mille peamisteks elementideks erinevas suuruses nelinurgad ja triibud. U. vertikaalse kesktelje kohal ülal vaba käega tõmmatud hall spiraaljoon. Töö keskel, must-hall abstraktne kujund. Värviline, hoolikalt omavahel tasakaalustatud värvipinnad.
works.de: An abstract geometric composition with a complex surface and spatial structure, whose main elements are rectangles and stripes of varying sizes. Above the approximately vertical central axis, a freehand-drawn grey spiral line. In the centre of the work, a black-and-grey abstract shape. Colourful, carefully balanced colour surfaces.

works.d: Koosneb neljast võrdsest kõrvuasetatud tahvlist, kruntimata lõuend. Maali alumisel osal, valdavalt valgel taustal musta kontuuriga mitmesuguse suurusega ruudud, rombid, vabakäejooned. Maali ülapoolsel, puhtal lõuendil mustad, kollased, sinised abstraktsed pinnad vaheldumisi väiksemate geomeetriliste kujundite ja märkidega. Nelja tahvlit läbib keskpaigast lainekujuline põikisuunaline, tuubist vajutatud valge värviga väga reljeefne pind.
works.de: Consists of four equal side-by-side panels, unprimed canvas. In the lower part of the painting, predominantly on a white background, black-outlined squares, rhombi and freehand lines of various sizes. In the upper part of the painting, on clean canvas, black, yellow, blue abstract surfaces alternating with smaller geometric shapes and signs. Through the middle of the four panels runs a wave-shaped transverse, highly relief surface pressed from a tube in white paint.

works.d: Punases kleidis tütarlapse rinnafiguur heledal, soojades toonides foonil. Pea kerges pöördes paremale, pilk langetatud, pikad juuksed kuklasse kokku kammitsetud.
works.de: A bust portrait of a girl in a red dress against a light, warm-toned background. The head slightly turned to the right, gaze lowered, long hair combed together at the back of the head.

works.d: Tuba, tagaservas lai aken, mille ees seisev naine maalib. Vasakul klaver, paremal laud, selle ääres vanem istuv naine. Akna lähedal kolm last.
works.de: A room, at the back a wide window, in front of which a standing woman is painting. On the left a piano, on the right a table, beside it an older sitting woman. Near the window three children.

works.d: Vasakul kaks apelsini, paremal kann valgete ja kollaste õitega.
works.de: Left two oranges, right a jug with white and yellow flowers.

works.d: Esiplaanil järve kallas üksikute suurte puudega. Taamal üle vee paistab kaldariba.
works.de: In the foreground the shore of a lake with individual large trees. In the distance a strip of shore is visible across the water.

works.d: Esiplaanil muru üksikute põõsastega. Taga põõsastik ja puud.
works.de: In the foreground grass with single bushes. Behind, shrubbery and trees.

works.d: Esiplaanil suured sügiskirjudes lehtedes puud.
works.de: In the foreground large trees with autumn-coloured leaves.

works.d: Vasakul puude all istuv naisfiguur. Paremal seisev ja istuv figuur. Keskel valges rüüs ülestõstetud kätega naisfiguur.
works.de: On the left a female figure sitting under trees. On the right a standing and a sitting figure. In the middle a female figure in a white robe with raised hands.

works.d: Ees keskel istuva, punases rüüs, õnnistamiseks ülestõstetud käega mehe jalge juures põlvele laskunud alasti meesfiguur. Õnnistaja taga kolm naisfiguuri. Taustaks õitsvad puud.
works.de: In front, in the centre, a naked male figure kneeling at the feet of a man in a red robe with his hand raised for blessing. Behind the one giving the blessing, three female figures. In the background, flowering trees.

works.dm: kujutise laius: 8.3 cm; lehe laius: 11.3 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 8.6 cm; lehe laius: 12.5 cm
works.d: Kohe jõekaldal istuva kahe tütarlapse figuurid. Üks neist sinises, teine roosas rüüs.
works.de: Figures of two girls sitting right on the riverbank. One of them in a blue robe, the other in a pink one.

works.d: Veekohal purdel kaks istuvat last.
works.de: Two sitting children on a footbridge over water.

works.d: Esiplaanil veekogu ääres joova kitse seljas alasti lapse figuur. Tagapool suurte puude vahel ettepoole ruttav naine.
works.de: In the foreground, by a body of water, the figure of a naked child on the back of a drinking goat. Behind, among large trees, a woman hurrying forward.

works.d: Esiplaanil grupp kahest lamavast täiskasvanust ja kahest istuvast lapsest. Nende kohal õhus fantastilised, kihutavas ratsanikud.
works.de: In the foreground a group of two reclining adults and two sitting children. Above them in the air, fantastic, galloping horsemen.

works.d: Vasakul ja paremal suur puu, mille kroonid ülal keskel kokkuulatuvad. Vasakpoolse puu ääres alasti naisfiguur peaaegu en face; parempoolse puu all profiilis seisev inimfiguur.
works.de: On the left and on the right a large tree, their crowns meeting at the top centre. Beside the tree on the left a nude female figure almost en face; under the tree on the right a human figure standing in profile.

works.d: Vasakul ebamääraste tõmmude inimfiguuride keskel paremal, pikas tumedas rüüs seisvale mehele karikat ulatav alasti naisfiguur.
works.de: On the left, amidst vaguely sketched human figures, on the right a naked female figure offers a goblet to a man standing in a long dark robe.

works.d: Punakal vaibal selili lamav naisakt, parem käsi rätikuga tõstetud.
works.de: A female nude lying on her back on a reddish carpet, right hand raised with a scarf.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal suur korstnapühkija täisfiguur, ümberringi punased majakatused.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground on the right a large full figure of a chimney sweep, surrounded by red roofs of houses.

works.d: Kõrvuni lühikeseks lõigatud tumedate juustega vana naise rinnakujutus otsevaates. Katmata pea, juuksed paremal lahku kammitud. Tõsine, mõtteisse süvanenud ilme. Sinakas pluus, ülekoloriit beežikas - hall, laiad pintslitõmbed.(eesti)
works.de: Bust portrait of an old woman with dark hair cropped short up to the ears, in frontal view. Bare head, hair parted on the right. Serious, pensive expression. Bluish blouse, overall colouring beige-grey, broad brushstrokes.

works.d: Esiplaanil avar rohuväli. Taamal lehtpuumets.
works.de: In the foreground an open grassy field. In the distance a deciduous forest.

works.d: Esiplaanil muru. Vasemal hekk ja lehtpuid. Paremal põõsastiku taga hoone katus.
works.de: Grass in the foreground. On the left a hedge and deciduous trees. On the right the roof of a building behind shrubbery.

works.d: Murul kuus lamavat pruuni jahikoera.
works.de: Six lying brown hunting dogs on the grass.

works.d: Kaks alasti ratsurit lillakatel hobustel (profiilis). Taustaks rohelisel aasal lehtpuid.
works.de: Two nude riders on purplish horses (in profile). Deciduous trees on a green meadow in the background.

works.d: Esiplaanil kaks supelpükstes ratsurit valgetel hobustel. Taustaks metsaviirg.
works.de: In the foreground two riders in swimming trunks on white horses. Forest strip in the background.

works.d: Aiapingil istuva naise põlvpilt. Käed ristamisi rüpes.
works.de: Knee-length portrait of a woman sitting on a garden bench. Hands crossed in her lap.

works.d: Valkjal taustal kolm banaani, nende taga kaks apelsini. Apelsinide vahel õun. Taga banaan.
works.de: Three bananas on a whitish background, behind them two oranges. An apple between the oranges. A banana behind.

works.d: Esiplaanil lagendik, taga puude vahel kahekordne hoone.
works.de: In the foreground a clearing, behind among trees a two-storey building.

works.d: Esiplaanil kaks neljakandilist palkidest ehitust, paremal laevad. Taevas kollane.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground two square log constructions, ships on the right. Yellow sky.

works.d: Noore mehe rinnapilt kerges pöördes paremale. Seljas sõduripluus, peas punase tähega pilotka.(eesti)
works.de: Bust portrait of a young man, turned slightly to the right. Wearing a soldier's blouse, on his head a garrison cap with a red star.

works.d: Peaaegu abstraktsete värvilaikude kombinatsioonina mõjuv rannavaade: esiplaanil rohttaimedega kaetud luited, keskel kergelt lainetav meri. Ülal sinine, üksikute valgete pilvedega taevas, mis silmapiiril merega kokku puutudes roosalt kumab. Erksates toonides, lopsakate pintslilöökide ja kohati spaatliga maalitud.
works.de: A beach view that appears as an almost abstract combination of colour patches: in the foreground dunes covered with grass, in the middle a slightly rippling sea. Above, a blue sky with individual white clouds, glowing pink where it meets the sea at the horizon. In bright tones, painted with lush brushstrokes and in places with a palette knife.

works.d: Esiplaanil läbipaistvaks ja peegelsiledaks maalitud veepind. Taga paremal seisavad kalalaevad ja neist veidi eespool valge, purjedeta jaht. Vasakul kõrguvad kolm vabrikukorstent. Käsitlus eskiislik, kohati kasutatud laia pintslitõmmet.
works.de: In the foreground, a water surface painted transparent and mirror-smooth. Behind on the right stand fishing boats, and slightly ahead of them a white yacht without sails. On the left three factory chimneys rise. Sketch-like handling, in places using broad brushstrokes.

works.d: Laiade pastoossete pahtlitõmmetega maalitud sügavsinine järvepind ning erksates toonides kõrged kaljused kaldad, taevast on näha ainult kitsa ribana ülaservas.
works.de: Deep blue lake surface painted with broad pastose strokes of putty, and high rocky shores in vivid tones, of the sky only a narrow strip is visible at the top edge.

works.d: Munajad üksteisest läbikasvanud kujundid, maalitud üksteisesse sulavates toonides. Tumepunased, roosad ja sinised kujundid terava musta kontuuriga piiritletud. Väga laseeritud, sile maalipind.
works.de: Egg-shaped forms growing through one another, painted in tones blending into each other. Dark red, pink and blue forms bounded by sharp black contours. Very glazed, smooth paint surface.

works.d: Paremal jõgi, vasakul esiplaanil jõe kallas, mille ääres paadisild hulga inimeste ja paatidega. Silla juures pikk lipuvarras punase lipuga. Üle jõe näha tihe rohtunud kallas, mille taga mets.
works.de: On the right a river, on the left in the foreground the riverbank, along which a pontoon bridge with a number of people and boats. By the bridge a tall flagpole with a red flag. Across the river a dense grassy bank is visible, with a forest behind it.

works.d: Tumedapäise noore naise poolfiguur otsevaates. Seljas valge avara kaelusega käisteta kleit punaste nööpidega.
works.de: Half-figure of a dark-haired young woman, frontal view. Wearing a white sleeveless dress with a wide collar and red buttons.

works.d: Esiplaanil veekogu. Paremalt ulatub veekogusse metsaga kaetud kallas; vasakult küngas, millel puude vahel rida hooneid. Taga künklik kallas, millel metsatihnikute tukad.
works.de: A body of water in the foreground. From the right a forest-covered bank extends into the water; from the left a hill on which stands a row of buildings among trees. Behind, an undulating bank with clumps of dense forest.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal puu, vasakul palkide virn. Keskplaanil paremal veekogu, millel siinpool kaldal palgid, sellest vasakul maas lebavate palkide taga kiviaed, mille keskkoht lagunenud. Kiviaia taga lehtpuud. Tagaplaanil kõrged mäed.
works.de: In the foreground on the right, a tree, on the left a stack of logs. In the middle ground on the right, a body of water, with logs on the near shore, to the left of which, behind logs lying on the ground, a stone wall whose middle part is dilapidated. Behind the stone wall, deciduous trees. In the background, high mountains.

works.d: Esiplaanil habemega mees punases rüüs suuldeb Kristust punase mantlis. Temast paremal tagapool kolm inimfiguuri, vasakul kaks sõjameest, kellest esimene hoiab paremas käes tõrvikut.
works.de: In the foreground a bearded man in a red robe accuses Christ, who is in a red cloak. To his right, further back, three human figures, on the left two soldiers, the first of whom holds a torch in his right hand.

works.d: Keskealise mehe rinnaportree en face, habeme ja vurrudega. Kaelas valge krae, krae vahel kraenööp.
works.de: Bust portrait of a middle-aged man en face, with beard and moustache. A white collar at the neck, with a collar stud between the collar.

works.d: Abstraktses laadis värvirõõmus maal. Vasaku serva ülaosa kollane, alaosa sinine. Üldpinnal domineerivad sinakas-hallid ja heledada toonid. Maali keskpinnal mitmetes erksates toonides värvijooni. Parem serv rahuliku, helehalli pastelse koloriidiga.
works.de: An abstract painting joyful in colour. The upper part of the left edge yellow, the lower part blue. Bluish-grey and light tones dominate the overall surface. In the centre of the painting colour lines in various bright tones. The right edge has a calm, light grey pastel colouring.

works.d: Esiplaanil vaibal valge teekann, õunad, kõrvitsad. Veidi kaugemal korv õunte või tomatitega, selle kõrval valge linik, mille tagaserval osa maalist.
works.de: In the foreground on a rug a white teapot, apples, pumpkins. A little further away a basket with apples or tomatoes, next to it a white cloth, on the rear edge of which part of a painting.

works.d: Vanema mehe pea otsevaates, peas läkiläki, kaela ümber karusnahast krae.
works.de: Head of an older man in frontal view, wearing a lakilaki on his head, a fur collar around his neck.

works.d: Heleda rätikuga naise rinnafiguur ruumis akna taustal. Aknalaual potilill, seinal pommidega kell.
works.de: Bust of a woman with a light-coloured headscarf in a room against the background of a window. A potted flower on the windowsill, a clock with weights on the wall.

works.d: Esiplaanil suured hallid pahklikud palgid roosakal rannaliival. Paremal seisab rannas valges särgis langetatud peaga mees, käed rohekate pükste taskus. Taamal silmapiirini rohekas sillerdav meri. Ülal rohekashall taevas läbi pilvehämu paistva päikesega.
works.de: In the foreground, large grey knotty logs on pinkish beach sand. On the right stands a man on the beach in a white shirt with lowered head, hands in the pockets of greenish trousers. Further back, a greenish shimmering sea reaching the horizon. Above, a greenish-grey sky with the sun shining through a haze of clouds.

works.d: Sügavsinisel foonil paremal kahvatu, otsekui öises kuuvalguses antud aktifiguur, tumedate ripsmetega silmad langetatud, naeratus huultel, valge rätik niude ümber. Naisefiguurist vasakul pildi all servas roheline pudel ja pruun nõu. Vasakul servas, pildi servaga läbilõigatud profiilis mees, lillepärg peas. Foonil keskel aknaava, millest paistab öine tähistaevas, aknalaual väike punane öis. Paremas servas lillakas-valge draperii.(eesti)
works.de: On a deep blue background on the right, a pale nude figure as if given in nocturnal moonlight, eyes with dark lashes lowered, a smile on the lips, a white cloth around the hips. To the left of the female figure, at the bottom edge of the picture, a green bottle and a brown vessel. At the left edge, a man in profile cut off by the edge of the picture, wearing a wreath of flowers on his head. In the centre of the background a window opening through which the night starry sky is visible, on the windowsill a small red blossom. At the right edge a purplish-white drapery.

works.d: Esiplaanil keskel kirsipunases kleidis naise kolmveerandfiguur. Naise nägu ja käed lubivalged, silmad suletud, sõrmede vahel hoiab täiskasvanu olemisega väikest last. Vasakul hallikasrohelise, avara kaelaväljalõikega kleidis, kollakate juuste ja rohelise näoga naine, laps paremal käsivarrel.
works.de: In the foreground, a three-quarter figure of a woman in a cherry-red dress. The woman's face and hands are chalk-white, eyes closed, holding a small child with an adult-like presence between her fingers. On the left, a woman in a greyish-green dress with a wide neckline, with yellowish hair and a green face, the child on her right arm.

works.d: Esiplaanil kõrge liivane kallas üksikute mändidega, eemal meri. Taevas lilla.
works.de: In the foreground a high sandy bank with a few pines, the sea in the distance. The sky purple.

works.dm: laius: 118.1 cm (parem   ); kõrgus: 204.2 cm (vasak   ); kõrgus: 204.2 cm (parem   ); laius: 118.4 cm (vasak   )
works.d: Vasak: istuv alasti vanamees, jalad laiali, parem käsi kõrval, vasak põlvel, vaatab enda ette; vasak jalg välja maalimata. Kujutisel tugev kontuur, pruunid ja lillad toonid; taust hall.
works.de: Left: a seated naked old man, legs apart, right hand at his side, left hand on his knee, looking straight ahead; the left leg unpainted. The image has a strong contour, brown and purple tones; the background gray.

works.d: Rohekas-hallil roosade laikudega foonil tugevate tumedate piirjoontega abstraktne kujund. Kujundist väljuvad rohekad torujad moodustised, keskosal on punased ja roosad pinnad. Maali ülaservas vasakul markeerivale maalitud veel üks torujas detail, põhitoonilt rohekas-must, punase aktsendiga ülaosas.(eesti)
works.de: Against a greenish-grey background with pink patches, an abstract shape with strong dark contour lines. Greenish tubular formations emerge from the shape, the central part having red and pink surfaces. In the upper left edge of the painting, painted in a marking manner, one more tubular detail, mainly greenish-black in tone, with a red accent at the top.

works.d: Esiplaanil aiaga piiratud teel ratsanik ja jalakäija jahivarustuses ning koertega. Tagapool (primitiivses perspektiivis) nõlvakul pargi servas mõisahooned. Paremal kõrts; vasakul korstnata õlgkatustega majad. Samas sillakese kõrval künkal mingi mälestustähis - sale ja valge ampiirstiilis.
works.de: In the foreground, on a fenced road, a horseman and a pedestrian in hunting gear with dogs. Further back (in primitive perspective) on a slope at the edge of a park, manor buildings. On the right an inn; on the left thatched-roof houses without chimneys. By the same small bridge, on a hillock, some kind of memorial - slender and white, in Empire style.

works.d: Mitmesuguste seadedistega varustatud tehase siseruumis kaks töölist (üks vasemas, teine paremas seinas) töötamas.
works.de: Inside a factory space equipped with various devices, two workers (one at the left wall, the other at the right wall) at work.

works.d: Naise poolfiguur istuvas asendis. Süles Kristuslaps, keda toetab vasema käega. Paremal lapse poolfiguur profiilis vasemale.
works.de: A half-figure of a woman in a sitting position. The Christ Child on her lap, supported with her left hand. On the right a half-figure of a child in profile to the left.

works.d: Rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale, langetatud silmadega, roheline kleit.
works.de: Bust in three-quarter profile to the right, with lowered eyes, green dress.

works.d: Noore naise rinnapilt. Peas valge rätik, selle all tanu. Seljas valge pikkkuub. Pealmine hõlm ääristatud punase, valge ja musta triibuga.
works.de: Bust portrait of a young woman. On her head a white headscarf, beneath it a bonnet. Wearing a white long coat. The upper flap trimmed with a red, white and black stripe.

works.d: Kolmes osas figuraalne kompositsioon. Keskel pasunat puhuv karjane. Vasakul külvaja. Paremal naine sirbiga ja mees vikatiga üle õla.
works.de: A figurative composition in three parts. In the centre a shepherd blowing a horn. On the left a sower. On the right a woman with a sickle and a man with a scythe over his shoulder.

works.d: Kiviseinas ümar kaareline värav, millest avaneb vaade viljapõllule. Väravast siseneb eesti rahvariietes paljasjalgne naine, paremas käes sirp. Pildi vasakus servas istub maas rahvariietes naine, pilk väravast siseneja poole.
works.de: In a stone wall a round arched gate, opening onto a view of a grain field. Through the gate enters a barefoot woman in Estonian national costume, a sickle in her right hand. At the left edge of the picture sits a woman in national costume on the ground, her gaze directed towards the one entering through the gate.

works.d: Lehe keskel ratsanik valgel hobusel kahe suure puu all. Tagaplaanil vasakul taluhoone. Esiplaanil paremal murdunud puutüvi.
works.de: In the centre of the sheet a horseman on a white horse under two large trees. In the background on the left a farm building. In the foreground on the right a broken tree trunk.

works.d: Esiplaanil madal vesi, millesse keskel kaldalt astumas noor tumedajuukseline naine, kergitades parema käega oma punast pihikuga seelikut, mille ees põll. Põllel ülal- ja alaääres lai aplikatsioonitikand. Seljas sügava kaelalõikega pluus, kaelas kaherealine korall - helmekee. Vasakus käevangus tühi punasest vasest veekann, pea peal lamedapõhjaline korv, milles istub heledapäine laps. Naise kõrval vasakul tumedajuukseline poisike jalgupidi vees, parema käega kergitades oma särki üle naba, vasakuga hoides kinni naise seelikust. Tagaplaanil mägine maastik,  vasakul heidab suur lehtpuu  figuurigrupile mõningast varju, pilt üldiselt päikeseline.
works.de: In the foreground, shallow water, into which, from the shore in the centre, a young dark-haired woman is stepping, lifting with her right hand her red-bodiced skirt, in front of which is an apron. On the apron, at the upper and lower edges, a broad appliqué embroidery. She wears a blouse with a deep neckline, on her neck a two-row coral bead necklace. In her left arm's crook an empty red copper water jug, on her head a flat-bottomed basket in which sits a fair-haired child. Next to the woman, on the left, a dark-haired little boy stands with his feet in the water, with his right hand lifting his shirt above his navel, with his left holding onto the woman's skirt. In the background a mountainous landscape; on the left a large deciduous tree casts some shade on the group of figures, the picture is generally sunny.

works.d: Ees meri üksiku purjepaadiga. Taga lumiste varjudega mäed.
works.de: Sea in front with a lone sailboat. Mountains with snowy shadows behind.

works.d: Esiplaanil vana kaluri poolfiguur aerudega õlal. Keskel mees ja vana naine pukile asetatud kangi tõukamas. Taga figuure, paadi - ja mastisiluette.
works.de: In the foreground the half-figure of an old fisherman with oars on his shoulder. In the middle a man and an old woman pushing a lever placed on a trestle. Behind, figures, boat and mast silhouettes.

works.d: Ees rohtukasvanud jõesopp heinamaaga. Taga mets. Koloriit hele, domineerib heleroheline.(eesti)
works.de: In front, a grassy river inlet with a meadow. Behind, a forest. The colouring is light, light green dominating.

works.d: Esiplaanil metsatukk, taga vasakul metsastunud mäeveerg, mis kõrgemal muutub lagendikuks; keskel ja paremal samasugused kaljud, mille vahelt paistavad kaugemal lumised mäetipud ja jääliustikud.
works.de: In the foreground a small forest, behind it on the left a forested mountain slope, which higher up turns into open ground; in the centre and on the right similar rocks, between which further away snowy mountain peaks and glaciers are visible.

works.d: Vasakul kõrgem, paremal madalam lillakaspunane kaljurahn.
works.de: On the left a higher, on the right a lower purplish-red rock boulder.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 32.2 cm; lehe laius: 48.0 cm
works.d: Ees paremal veekogu, lehtpuumetsaga vastaskaldal. Vasakul visand põõsastikust (punase pliiatsiga). Üle maastiku pilvine taevas.
works.de: A body of water in the foreground on the right, with deciduous forest on the opposite bank. On the left a sketch of shrubbery (in red pencil). Over the landscape a cloudy sky.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 37.5 cm; lehe laius: 52.7 cm
works.d: Ees paremalt taha vasakule suunduv majaderida (pliiastiga), taustaks lumiste harjadega mäed (õlimaal).
works.de: In the front a row of houses (in pencil) receding from right to left, background mountains with snowy ridges (oil painting).

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 15.2 cm; lehe laius: 23.4 cm
works.d: Ees veekogu. Tagapool paremalt pooldiagonaalis taha vasakule suunduv mäeahelik.
works.de: In the foreground a body of water. Behind it, a mountain range running in a half-diagonal from right to left into the distance.

works.d: Geomeetrilistest kujunditest kompositsioon: keskosa erinevatest valgetest ja helehallidest kujunditest, paremas servas tumedamas hallis, vasakul eri heledusastmetes kollased kolm- ja nelinurgad.
works.de: A composition of geometric shapes: the central part made up of various white and light grey shapes, on the right edge in a darker grey, on the left yellow triangles and quadrangles in various degrees of lightness.

works.d: Valgete pikemate juustega prillidega vanema mehe rinnaportree poolpöördes avasakule. Mehel kõrge paljas otsmik, suunurgad pisut allapoole. Lahtiste hõlmade vahelt paistmas sinakas sall, tume kuub sinise särgi ja heleda lipsuga. Jõuline maalilaad, kohati väga pastoosne.
works.de: Bust portrait of an older man with longer white hair and glasses, in a half-turn to the left. The man has a high bare forehead, the corners of his mouth turned slightly downward. A bluish scarf visible between the open lapels, a dark coat with a blue shirt and light-coloured tie. Vigorous painting style, at times very impasto.

works.d: Paremal grupp jämedatüvelisi puid künkal, keskel looklev oja, vasakul üksik puu.
works.de: On the right a group of thick-trunked trees on a hillock, in the middle a winding brook, on the left a solitary tree.

works.d: Valdavalt rohelistes-oranžides toonides taluõue motiiv. Paremal majanurk, ees keskel aed, selle taga paistmas hoonete viilkatused. Vasakul piiravad õue kõrged puud.
works.de: A farmyard motif predominantly in green-orange tones. On the right the corner of a house, in the front centre a garden, behind it the gable roofs of buildings visible. On the left tall trees border the yard.

works.d: Pruuni põranda ja siniste seintega toa nurgas lillepotid, lopsakate lehtede ja sinakaslillade õitega taimed sees. Domineerivad külmad rohelised ja pruunid toonid, maalitud värvilaikude maalilist kokkukõla silmas pidades.
works.de: In the corner of a room with a brown floor and blue walls, flower pots with plants with lush leaves and bluish-purple blossoms inside. Cold green and brown tones dominate, painted with an eye to the picturesque harmony of the patches of colour.

works.d: Hoogsa, laia pintslitõmbega, osaliselt pastoosselt maalitud lopsakas lillekimp, valkjatest, roosakaspunastest ning kollakaist õitest.
works.de: A lush bouquet of flowers painted with bold, broad brushstrokes, partly impasto, with whitish, pinkish-red and yellowish blossoms.

works.d: Esiplaanil maariba, paremale ning vasakule jäävad kolletavad puud ja põõsad. Puude vahelt paistab maja ja katused.
works.de: In the foreground a strip of land, to the right and left yellowing trees and bushes. Through the trees a house and roofs can be seen.

works.d: Pildi keskel alumises osas majadevaheline aianurk üksikute puude ja põõsastega. Paremal, vasakul ja keskplaanis mitmesugused, geomeetrilist mahtu rõhutavad majad. Majade taga lage väli, silmapiirist kõrgemal hall, kohati heledalt läbikumav taevas. Rohelus paksu värviga, pintslilööke paista lastes maalitud, mõnede majade külgi valguse ja varju abil modelleeritud. Domineerivad rohelised, kollased ja pruunid toonid.
works.de: In the middle of the picture, in the lower part, a garden corner between houses with individual trees and bushes. On the right, left and in the middle plane various houses emphasising geometric volume. Behind the houses an open field, above the horizon a grey sky, in places translucent and light. The greenery is painted with thick paint, brushstrokes visible, the sides of some houses modelled with light and shadow. Green, yellow and brown tones dominate.

works.d: Mees ja naine jõesillal. Stiliseeritud vormikäsitlusega kujutisel, esiplaanil, vasakul seisev naine, kerges pöördes vasakule; tumedas, lühikeste varrukatega pluusis ja heledas põlvedeni seelikus, käed külgedel.Temast paremal veidi tagapool, otsevaates seisev mees, käed pükste taskutes, peas kaabu, seljas tume pullover ja veidi tumedamad püksid. Paremal keskel, maja trepil, profiilis paremale seisva inimese figuur. Tagaplaanil jõgi, vasakul kahe mastiga paat, vastaskaldal maju, kaks kõrget suitsevat korstnat.
works.de: A man and a woman on a river bridge. In a depiction with stylised treatment of form, in the foreground, on the left a standing woman, slightly turned to the left; in a dark, short-sleeved blouse and a light-coloured knee-length skirt, hands at her sides. To her right, somewhat further back, a man standing in frontal view, hands in trouser pockets, a hat on his head, wearing a dark pullover and slightly darker trousers. In the middle right, on the steps of a house, the figure of a person standing in profile facing right. In the background a river, on the left a two-masted boat, on the opposite bank houses, two tall smoking chimneys.

works.d: Tumesinise kardina taustal pruun lauaplaat linikuga. Sellel paremal klaasvaagen kollakasoranzide õuntega. Tagapool karikakujuline vaas. Õhuline maalilaad.
works.de: Against a dark blue curtain backdrop, a brown tabletop with a cloth. On it, on the right, a glass dish with yellowish-orange apples. Further back a jug-shaped vase. Airy painting style.

works.dm: kõrgus: 46.5 cm (tervik, vm.   ); laius: 58.0 cm (tervik, vm.   )
works.d: Kõrges vaasis kollased ja roosakad daalia õied.(eesti)
works.de: Yellow and pinkish dahlia flowers in a tall vase.

works.d: Tihedalt lillakaspruunides, sinistes, ookritoonides läbimaalitud kompositsioon keskel tumesinistes pükstes, tumepunases kampsunis, beežis särgis ja lillas lipsus vanem mees kirjul toolil, käed süles, istumas. Juuksed tumedad, hallisegused, oimu kohalt kahelt poolt juuksepiir taandunud, pilk suunatud vaatajast mööda, vasakule. Foon kirju, paremal ristuvatest taladest konstruktsioon.(eesti)
works.de: A composition painted densely in purplish-brown, blue, ochre tones, in the centre an older man in dark blue trousers, a dark red jumper, a beige shirt and a purple tie, sitting on a patterned chair, hands in his lap. His hair is dark, greying, receding at the temples on both sides, his gaze directed past the viewer, to the left. The background is patterned, on the right a construction of crossing beams.

works.d: Esiplaanil lumine väljak. Paremal tänav majadega. Kaugemal paistavad katused ja tornid. Vasakul raagus puud.
works.de: A snowy square in the foreground. On the right a street with houses. Roofs and towers visible in the distance. Bare trees on the left.

works.d: Esiplaanil mööda lumist teed suunaga tahapoole sõitev regi talumehega. Üksikute raagus puude taga paistavad lumiste katustega majad. Paremale jääb kahekorruseline hoone. Taevas tumehall.
works.de: In the foreground a sledge with a peasant man, driving along a snowy road, heading away from the viewer. Behind the solitary bare trees, houses with snowy roofs can be seen. To the right there is a two-storey building. The sky is dark grey.

works.d: Vanema naise poolfiguur en face, kehapöördega vasakule, parem käsi ees. Tanu, kaelus ja kätised valged, tumedal kleidil pross.
works.de: Half-figure of an elderly woman en face, body turned to the left, right hand in front. Cap, collar and cuffs white, a brooch on the dark dress.

works.d: Noore astuva tütarlapse kolmveerandfiguur veerandpöördes paremale. Naise ülakeha veidi painutatud tahapoole, pööratud vaatajale. Vasak käsi kõverdatult tõstetud, parem küljel. Neiul seljas käisteta, kahara seelikuga, lopsaka kraega hele kleit, peas punaste - valgete lilledega küber. Kirev foon ja kleit maalitud pastoosselt, nägu ja käed siledamalt, vormi ümarusi järgivalt.
works.de: Three-quarter figure of a young girl stepping forward, in a quarter-turn to the right. The woman's upper body slightly bent backward, turned towards the viewer. Left arm raised bent, right at her side. The girl wears a sleeveless light dress with a full skirt and a lush collar, and a cap with red and white flowers on her head. The colourful background and dress are painted pastosely, the face and hands more smoothly, following the roundness of the form.

works.d: Lage, tumedas värvigammas maastik. Ees küntud põlluriba, horisondil seitse puud.Taevas pilveribad. Maalitud hoogsate, laiade pintslilöökidega.
works.de: Open landscape in a dark colour scheme. In front a ploughed strip of field, on the horizon seven trees. Cloud strips in the sky. Painted with vigorous, broad brushstrokes.

works.d: Tumeroheline nõlvak, siluetselt lahendatud puudega heleda taeva foonil. Esiplaanil paremal kolm, vasakul üks rohtu sööv lammas.
works.de: A dark green slope with trees rendered in silhouette against a light sky. In the foreground, three sheep grazing on the right and one on the left.

works.d: Ookrites - kollastes toonides, üksikute roheliste laikudega sügismaastik. Esiplaanil söömas kaks pruuni - valge ning üks musta - valge kirju lehm. Lehmade grupi ees valge, paari tumeda laiguga vasikas. Taevas kaetud valkjate pilvedega. Koloriit hele. Maastiku osas kasutatud täppivat maalimislaadi.
works.de: An autumn landscape in ochre - yellow tones, with occasional green patches. In the foreground, two cows grazing - a brown-and-white one and a black-and-white one. In front of the group of cows a white calf with a few dark patches. The sky covered with whitish clouds. Bright colouring. A pointillist painting technique used in the landscape section.

works.d: Esiplaanil käed puusas seisva naise poolfiguur. Naisel kastanikarva poolpikad juuksed, otsmikul tukk, tumedad silmad ja tugev, pisut kongus nina. Teravate piirjoontega suu kergelt muigel. Naisel seljas suure kaelaväljalõikega, kolmveerandvarrukatega must liibuv džemper ja tumepunane seelik. Valdavalt sinistes toonides foonil ateljeenurk riiulite, piltide ja pintslipurgiga.
works.de: In the foreground the half-figure of a woman standing with hands on her hips. The woman has chestnut-coloured, medium-length hair, a fringe on the forehead, dark eyes and a strong, slightly hooked nose. A mouth with sharp contours in a slight smile. The woman wears a black fitted jumper with a large neckline and three-quarter sleeves, and a dark red skirt. Against a background predominantly in blue tones, a studio corner with shelves, pictures and a brush jar.

works.d: Rannaäärse kalarappimise stseen: ees keskel istub tünnide vahel beezhis pluusis ja seelikus paljasjalgne naine, valge pearätik kuklasse seotud, käed sorimas kõrvalasuvas kaladega täidetud kastis. Naisel ees põll ja põlvedel lõikelaud noa ja kalarapetega. Vasakul toetab põlle ja pearätikuga noor naine kaladega kuhjatud kasti tünnile. Vasakpoolse naise taga võrgukuur. Kuuri kõrval seisab keskplaanis poolproofiilis kõhn vana mees, soni peas ja piip hambus. Paremal alumises nurgas istub heledakarvaline koer, pea kalakastide alla peidetud. Tagaplaanil paremal meri ja paatidega rannaviirg kaldale tõmmatud paatidega. Kohati pastoosne faktuur.(eesti)
works.de: A seaside fish-cleaning scene: in the centre foreground, between barrels, sits a barefoot woman in a beige blouse and skirt, a white headscarf tied at the nape of her neck, her hands rummaging in a nearby box filled with fish. The woman has an apron in front and a cutting board with a knife and fish scraps on her knees. On the left, a young woman with an apron and headscarf supports a box heaped with fish on a barrel. Behind the woman on the left a net shed. Next to the shed, in the middle ground, stands a thin old man in half-profile, a cap on his head and a pipe in his mouth. In the lower right corner sits a light-coloured dog, its head hidden under the fish boxes. In the background on the right the sea and a shoreline with boats, with boats drawn up onto the shore. The texture is pastose in places.

works.d: Lage maapind silmapiiril punava taevaga. Esiplaanil paremal tume purjeka siluett, vasakul vette ulatuv paadisild.
works.de: Bare ground on the horizon with a reddish sky. In the foreground on the right the dark silhouette of a sailboat, on the left a boat pier reaching into the water.

works.d: Šarž kunstnikust: mehe rinnapilt profiilis paremale; pilvedes. Seljas väikesed tiivad.
works.de: Caricature of the artist: bust portrait of a man in profile to the right; in the clouds. Small wings on his back.

works.d: Siledapinnalisel merel kaks purjekat longus purjedega. Pilvine taevas silmapiiril loojuva punase päikesega, mis peegeldub meres.
works.de: On a smooth-surfaced sea, two sailboats with drooping sails. Cloudy sky with a red setting sun on the horizon, reflected in the sea.

works.d: Esiplaanil kaks istuvat naist lillekorvidega, tagapool üksikuid figuure. Maalitud kerges, skitseerivas laadis.
works.de: In the foreground two seated women with flower baskets, further back solitary figures. Painted in a light, sketch-like manner.

works.d: Ees kivine kallas paatidega. Paremal veekogu. Taga keskel laevade siluetid (kirjeldus poolik, kuna töö on kattunud läbipaistmatu valkja kihiga).
works.de: In front, a stony shore with boats. On the right, a body of water. In the back, centre, silhouettes of ships (description incomplete, as the work is covered with an opaque whitish layer).

works.d: Kaks tiigrit profiilis vasakule metsa taustal.
works.de: Two tigers in profile facing left against a forest background.

works.d: Punases kleidis prillidega naise rinnaportree otsevaates tumadel foonil.
works.de: Bust portrait of a woman in a red dress with glasses, in frontal view against a dark background.

works.dm: laius: 301.0 cm; kõrgus: 5.0 cm; kõrgus: 2.0 cm; laius: 190.0 cm
works.d: Kaheosaline kompositsioon viiest naisaktist hallikasrohelisel, mustade ja tumepunaste laikudega foonil. Vasakpoolse osa esiplaanil üle pildi pinna sirutuv-astuv naisfiguur, justkui põlvini vees, kõverdatud käed kuklasse heidetud pea kohal. Parempoolsel osal naisfiguur põlvili, pea kohal midagi rasket hoidmas. Tagapool kolm erinevais asendites figuuri, heledatoonilised püstjooned foonil kujude vhel. Jõulises ekspressiivses laadis laia pintsliga maalitud.(eesti)
works.de: A two-part composition of five female nudes against a greyish-green background with black and dark red patches. In the foreground of the left part a female figure stretching-stepping across the picture surface, as if knee-deep in water, bent arms above the head thrown back onto the nape. In the right part a female figure kneeling, holding something heavy above the head. Further back three figures in different poses, light-toned vertical lines in the background between the figures. Painted with a broad brush in a forceful, expressive manner.

works.d: Kasvuhoone katuse all kreemikad krüsanteemid ja valged alpikannid.
works.de: Under the greenhouse roof creamy chrysanthemums and white edelweiss.

works.d: Ees keskel laastudest punutud sangata korvis lillad ja valged viinamarjakobarad ja õunad. Korvi ees laual üksik pirn.(eesti)
works.de: In the centre foreground, purple and white grape clusters and apples in a handleless basket woven from wood shavings. In front of the basket on the table, a single pear.

works.d: Pikliku näo, veidi krimpsus ilmega, poolpalja pealaega mehe 4 portreed erinevais vaadetes. Vasakpoolne otsevaates, keskmine profiilis paremale, taga otse, taga keskel pea poolpöördes vasakule. Ühtlaselt värvikas laad heledate valguslaikudega, kohati katmata lõuend läbi kumamas.(eesti)
works.de: 4 portraits, in different views, of a man with an elongated face, a slightly wrinkled expression, and a half-bald crown. The left-hand one frontal, the middle one in profile to the right, behind it straight on, behind in the middle the head in half-turn to the left. A uniformly colourful manner with light patches of light, in places the uncovered canvas shining through.

works.d: Tütarlapse põlvpilt istuvas asendis pöördega vasakule. Põlvedel lahtine raamat.
works.de: Knee-length portrait of a girl seated, turned to the left. An open book on her knees.

works.d: Vasakul ees liivasel rannal selgvaates üksik lehm, paremal lamav pruuni-valgekirju lehm. Temast tagapool kaks lehma.(eesti)
works.de: On the left in front on a sandy shore in clear view a solitary cow, on the right a lying brown-and-white spotted cow. Behind her two cows.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal kolm alastifiguuri, keskmine selgvaates kiviheiteasendis. Keskplaanil veekogu, millel luigeparv. Tagaplaanil mets.
works.de: In the foreground on the right three nude figures, the middle one seen frontally in the pose of throwing a stone. In the middle ground a body of water with a flock of swans. In the background forest.

works.d: Puukiriku madal interjöör, vasakul ja paremal pingid. Tagaplaanil keskel altar.
works.de: Low interior of a wooden church, pews on the left and right. Altar in the center background.

works.d: Rohekashall raam
works.de: Greyish-green frame

works.d: Vana naise rinnapilt eestvaates. Pea kallutatud ettepoole, peas valge pitsääristusega tanu. Keskelt lahku kammitud juuksed ripuvad lahtiselt õlgadele. Seljas tume vammus ja valge laia kraega särk, mille kaelus kinnitatud ristsõlega.
works.de: Bust portrait of an old woman, frontal view. Head tilted forward, wearing a bonnet with white lace trim. Hair parted in the middle hangs loose onto the shoulders. Wearing a dark jerkin and a white shirt with a wide collar, its neckline fastened with a cross-knot.

works.d: Esiplaanil lage kivisillutis, keskel sammuvaid inimfiguure, tagaplaanil majad; mille ees voorimehed hobustega. Kesksel kohal Tallinna vana raekoda.
works.de: In the foreground an open stone pavement, in the middle walking human figures, in the background houses, in front of which are cabmen with horses. In the central place, the old Tallinn Town Hall.

works.d: Esiplaanil pisut klassitsistlikus stiilis alasti naise figuur lõunamaise maastiku taustal istumas. Naise käed külgedel, pea pisut paremale kallutatud, põlvel valge lina. Fooniks helesinise veega lahesopp purjekatega, kaljud ja taamal silmapiiril aimatavad majad.
works.de: In the foreground a nude female figure in a somewhat classicist style, seated against the background of a southern landscape. The woman's arms are at her sides, her head tilted slightly to the right, a white cloth on her knee. The background shows a bay of light blue water with sailing boats, cliffs, and houses faintly visible on the horizon in the distance.

works.d: Ees järvekallas puudega. Keskel järv. Vastaskaldal hooneid.
works.de: In the front a lake shore with trees. In the middle a lake. Buildings on the opposite shore.

works.d: Rannamaastik kahe alasti naisfiguuriga, kellest vasakpoolne tumedajuukseline kummardunud rohust põgenevat päkapikku püüdmas; parempoolne blond naine imestunult teist jälgimas. Vasakul puu, naiste taga keelikuna maasse ulatuv lahesopp, selle taga ähmane rannaviirg.(eesti)
works.de: A seaside landscape with two nude female figures, the dark-haired one on the left bending down in the grass trying to catch a fleeing gnome; the blonde woman on the right watching the other in astonishment. On the left a tree, behind the women a cove reaching into the ground like a string, behind that a hazy shoreline.

works.d: Kompositsioon koosneb kolmest istuva naise poolfiguurist, vasakpoolne profiilis, temale suunatud teiste pilgud. Maalitud laiade ja pikkade pintslitõmmetega, riietuse osas küllalt eskiislikult ja üldistavalt, lillakates ja punakates toonides, näod ühtlaselt punakad.
works.de: The composition consists of three half-figures of a seated woman, the left-hand one in profile, the gazes of the others directed at her. Painted with broad and long brushstrokes, rather sketchy and generalised in the clothing, in purplish and reddish tones, faces uniformly reddish.

works.d: Tumedates toonides kubistlike vormidega hooned ja laevad. Ees keskel sadamakraana vagonetiga, millest näha vaid tagumine osa. Teine kaubavagonett paistab all paremas nurgas. Maali vasakusse poolde jäävad kaks laeva ning kraana kolmnurkne torn. Suur tumepunane laev on lossimisel. Tema kõrval vasakul asub väike ühe korstnaga alus. Suure laeva kolm korstent paiknevad maali keskosas. Korstnatest tulev suits meenutab tumedavärvilisi kettakesi. Maali värvigammas domineerivad määrdunud sinised, hallid ja lillad toonid.(eesti)
works.de: Buildings and ships in dark tones with cubist forms. In front, in the centre, a harbour crane with a wagon, of which only the rear part is visible. Another cargo wagon appears in the lower right corner. Two ships and the triangular tower of the crane are in the left half of the painting. A large dark-red ship is being unloaded. Beside it on the left is a small vessel with one funnel. The three funnels of the large ship are located in the central part of the painting. The smoke coming from the funnels resembles dark-coloured discs. Dirty blue, grey and purple tones dominate the painting's colour range.

works.d: Noore tõmmu naise poolfiguur poolprofiilis vasakule, kollasele padjale nõjatuv. Ehitud idamaiselt.
works.de: Half-figure of a young dark-haired woman in half-profile to the left, leaning on a yellow pillow. Adorned in an oriental manner.

works.d: Kääruliste kallastega veekogu, mis silmapiiril sulab ühte taevaga. Vasak kallas ja sellel asetsevad hooned kaetud lumega. Vees paate.
works.de: A body of water with winding banks that merges with the sky on the horizon. The left bank and the buildings on it are covered with snow. Boats on the water.

works.d: Tuhmi sinise tonaalsusega maal. Kubisminüanssidega abstraktselt kujutatud Laokooni võitlust maoga. Pruunikais, mustades ja sinistes toonides kompositsioon täidab suure osa maali pinnast. Figuuriosa on paigutatud maali keskteljest veidi vasakule. Maokujutis kulgeb vasakult keskelt servast üle pildi pinna paremasse ülemisse nurka.
works.de: A painting of dull blue tonality. The struggle of Laocoön with the snake depicted abstractly with cubist nuances. A composition in brownish, black and blue tones fills a large part of the painting's surface. The figural part is placed slightly to the left of the painting's central axis. The depiction of the snake runs from the left middle edge across the surface of the picture to the upper right corner.

works.d: Helesinise, õrna lillaka vinega taeva all lõunamere lahesopp. Esiplaanil hele rand, mere ääres kaks alasti seisvat naist, kaugemal paremal kaks istuvat figuuri. Pildil paremal kõrge lehtpuu, põõsad. Teispool lahte madalate puudega kaetud lausik mägi. Silmapiiril lillakas mägeda harjad. Maalitud lühikeste pintslilöökidega, esiplaanil pastoossemalt.
works.de: Under a light blue sky with a delicate purplish tinge, a bay of a southern sea. In the foreground a light-coloured beach, by the sea two women standing naked, further away on the right two seated figures. On the right of the picture a tall leafy tree, bushes. On the other side of the bay, a flat mountain covered with low trees. On the horizon, purplish mountain ridges. Painted with short brushstrokes, more impasto in the foreground.

works.d: Pika kollase laua taga esiplaanil kuus ja teisel pool lauda seitse meest. Erinevates poosides, kõikides värvitoonides juustega, kolm habemega. Laual üheksa kollase joogiga täidetud pokaali, vasakul laua servas roheline korvpudel punase korgiga, paremal lauaserval kitarr, millest on pruun riie üle visatud. Esiplaanil paremalt kolmanda mehe vööl pussnuga pruunis tupes, mehe kõrval valge lill. Foon sinine, võlvistikku markeeriv.
works.de: Behind a long yellow table, six men in the foreground and seven men on the other side of the table. In various poses, with hair of all colours, three with beards. On the table nine goblets filled with yellow drink, on the left edge of the table a green wickerwork bottle with a red cork, on the right edge of the table a guitar with a brown cloth thrown over it. On the belt of the third man from the right in the foreground a sheath knife in a brown sheath, beside the man a white flower. Background blue, marking a vaulted structure.

works.d: Esiplaanil tänav, mille ääres vasakul väike kollane hoone. Kaugemal, terashalli taeva taustal tara taga kolmekorruseline telliskivi värvi katusega maja.
works.de: In the foreground a street, along which on the left stands a small yellow building. Further away, against a steel-grey sky, behind a fence a three-storey house with a brick-coloured roof.

works.d: Esiplaanil sile veepind, taamal mets.
works.de: In the foreground a smooth water surface, forest in the distance.

works.d: Ümar roheline vaas kirjude lilledega rohekaspruunil taustal.
works.de: A round green vase with colourful flowers on a greenish-brown background.

works.dm: laius: 67.6 cm; kõrgus: 79.5 cm; kõrgus: 79.3 cm; laius: 68.0 cm
works.d: Vana mehe täisfiguur klaveri ees istuvas asendis, kerge pöördega paremale. Taga paremal aken, vasakul raamaturiiul.
works.de: Full figure of an old man sitting in front of a piano, slightly turned to the right. Behind him, a window on the right, a bookshelf on the left.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul väike rohtunud kallastesse uppuv jõeke, paremal mäekünkale tõusev jalgrada. Künkal neli maja. Siin-seal väikesi puid ja põõsaid, ülal sünge äikseline taevas. Töö ümbritsetud tindiga joonistatud ornamentaalse raamistusega.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground on the left a small stream sinking into overgrown banks, on the right a footpath rising to a hillock. Four houses on the hillock. Here and there small trees and bushes, above a gloomy, thundery sky. The work is surrounded by an ornamental frame drawn in ink.

works.d: Hallid, punased, kollased kolme  - ja neljakorruselised majad telliskivipunaste korstendega. Taevas valkjas - hall.
works.de: Grey, red, yellow three- and four-storey houses with brick-red chimneys. The sky whitish-grey.

works.d: Noore tumedajuukselise naise rinnapilt veerandprofiilis paremale, mustas valge kaelarüüsidega kleidis, kõrvas kõrvarõngad.
works.de: Bust portrait of a young dark-haired woman in a quarter-profile to the right, in a black dress with white collar frills, wearing earrings.

works.d: Paremal istuva naise poolfiguur rätik peas suuri mitmevärvilisi õiekobaraid korraldamas. Üle laua neli kübarates naist otsevaates.
works.de: The half-figure of a woman sitting on the right with a kerchief on her head, arranging large multicoloured flower clusters. Across the table four women in hats in frontal view.

works.d: Tumedas riietuses kaabuga ja heleda salliga vanema mehe rinnafiguur otsevaates. Vasak käsi rinnale tõstetud.
works.de: Frontal chest-length figure of an older man in dark clothing with a hat and a light-coloured scarf. Left hand raised to the chest.

works.d: Jõeäärsel rinnatisel istuvad kolm naist: äärmistel sinine kleit ja käsipõsakil poos, keskmine oranzis kleidis ja mõlemad käed pihkudega rinnatisele toetumas. Parempoolse naise ees roheline, väikeste sangadega urn. Foonil jõgi ja mäerinnakul tihedalt kivimaju. Maalitud heledates sinistes ja kollakais toonides vorme tahkudena modelleerides.
works.de: Three women sit on a riverside parapet: the outer ones in blue dresses in a chin-in-hand pose, the middle one in an orange dress with both hands resting palms-down on the parapet. In front of the right-hand woman a green urn with small handles. In the background a river and a hillside densely covered with stone houses. Painted in light blue and yellowish tones, modelling the forms as facets.

works.d: Keskel palkidega vanker, mille otsas istub kaabuga talumees. Temast vasakul kaks hobust, kellest ühel ratsamees piitsaga paremas käes. Taga paremal sepikoda. Maali vasakus osas esiplaanil aia juures lambakari, nende taga vaataja poole sammuv naine vaati madalal vankril vedamas.(eesti)
works.de: In the centre a cart loaded with logs, on the end of which sits a farmer wearing a hat. To his left two horses, one of which is ridden by a horseman with a whip in his right hand. Behind on the right a smithy. In the left part of the painting, in the foreground by a fence, a flock of sheep, behind them a woman walking towards the viewer, hauling a barrel on a low cart.

works.d: Madal poolsoostunud maastik veeloiguga ees keskel ja taga paremal. Silmapiiril põõsastik, millest tõusevad esile männid. 3/4 tööst loojuva päikesega taeva all.
works.de: Low, partly marshy landscape with a puddle of water in the middle foreground and at the back on the right. On the horizon, shrubbery, from which pines rise above. 3/4 of the work under a setting sun sky.

works.d: Lokkisjuukselise keskealise mehe figuur kirjutuslaua taga istumas (peaaegu en face). Kirjutuslaual hulk raamatuid ja kirjatarbeid. Mehe paremas käes pliiats, vasakul ta ees avatud raamatu serval.
works.de: Figure of a curly-haired middle-aged man sitting behind a writing desk (almost en face). On the writing desk a number of books and writing implements. A pencil in the man's right hand, in his left, in front of him, the edge of an open book.

works.d: Ergastes toonides punakas-oranži maapinnaga loodusvaade, mille esiplaanil paiknevad kolm pruunides toonides suurt puud. Tausta moodustavad lillad, kollased ja rohelised toonid. Kõrgemal helesinise ja roosaga pilved.
works.de: A landscape in vivid tones with reddish-orange ground, in the foreground of which are three large trees in brown tones. The background is formed by purple, yellow and green tones. Higher up clouds in light blue and pink.

works.d: Esiplaanil ümmargused lillepeenrad, taga puumaja ja paremal rannal paviljonid.
works.de: In the foreground round flower beds, behind a wooden house and on the right pavilions on the beach.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal ja vasakul puud ja põõsad, taamal põllud ja mets.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground right and left trees and bushes, in the distance fields and forest.

works.d: Pealtvaade üksikute lumiste katustega majadele, nende vahel raagus puud, silmapiiril keskel suitsev korsten. Hooned tihketes hallikaspruunides ja sinakas-rohelistes tooonides beežikashalli taeva all. Maalitud laiade pintslitõmmetega, kohati pastoosselt.
works.de: A view from above of scattered snow-roofed houses, bare trees between them, a smoking chimney in the middle of the horizon. Buildings in dense grayish-brown and bluish-green tones under a beigish-grey sky. Painted with broad brush strokes, in places impasto.

works.d: Toas pingil istuva mehe täisfiguur üle vasaku põlve maha rippuvat purjeriiet parandamas. Pabeross suus, sonimüts peas.
works.de: Full figure of a man sitting on a bench indoors, mending a piece of sailcloth hanging over his left knee. A cigarette in his mouth, a knitted cap on his head.

works.d: Sarvedega olevused lamajal kõhtu lõhki lõikamas. Teos tumedal taustal pruunis koloriidis.
works.de: Horned beings cutting open the belly of a lying figure. The work in a dark background with brown coloring.

works.dm: kujutise laius: 41.1 cm (km.); lehe kõrgus: 38.4 cm (lm.); kujutise kõrgus: 28.0 cm (km.); lehe laius: 55.2 cm (lm)
works.d: Ees lai, lumine väli (3/4 kogu tööst), silmapiiril, metsariba taustal, lumine hooneterühm.(eesti)
works.de: In front, a wide, snowy field (3/4 of the whole work), on the horizon, against the background of a strip of forest, a snowy group of buildings.

works.d: Pruunis nõus peaaegu kogu pildi pinda kattev karikakarde ja rukkilillede kimp. Foon beežides ja pruunides toonides. Väga pastoosne maalifaktuur.(eesti)
works.de: In a brown vessel a bouquet of daisies and cornflowers covering almost the entire surface of the picture. Background in beige and brown tones. Very pastose painting texture.

works.d: Süngetes sinistes ja lillades toonides temaatiline kompositsioon. Esiplaanil lapivad neli talvemütsides kalurit võrku. Nende taga vasakul seisab pearätikus naine, kalakast kummaski käes. Naise tagant paistavad kalalaeva mast ja vaierid. Paremas servas all hunnik puust kalakaste, ülal osa võrgukuurist, mille lävel seisab mees küljega vaataja poole. Taamal tumesinine meri ja taevas, mida teineteisest eraldab tõusva päikese erkpunane viirg.(eesti)
works.de: A thematic composition in gloomy blue and purple tones. In the foreground, four fishermen in winter caps mend a net. Behind them on the left stands a woman in a headscarf, holding a fish crate in each hand. Behind the woman, the mast and rigging of a fishing boat are visible. Lower right, a pile of wooden fish crates; upper right, part of a net shed, in whose doorway a man stands sideways to the viewer. In the distance, a dark blue sea and sky, separated from each other by a bright red streak of the rising sun.

works.d: Hallides ja pruunides toonides agulimaastik: esiplaanil pildi servaga paralleelselt kulgev tänav, vasakul suundub tänav esiplaanis olevaga risti silmapiiri poole. Vasakul ja paremal madalad puumajad ja pikad tuimad plangud. Siin-seal mõned elektripostid, tagaplaanis kaks heledat kõrget maja. Tänavalt liigub üks väike mehe- ja teine naisfiguur. Horisondist kõrgemal hall taevas.
works.de: A suburban landscape in grey and brown tones: in the foreground a street running parallel to the edge of the picture, on the left the street runs perpendicular to the one in the foreground towards the horizon. On the left and right low wooden houses and long dull fences. Here and there a few electricity poles, in the background two light-coloured tall houses. On the street a small male figure and another female figure are moving. Above the horizon a grey sky.

works.d: Suurte värviliste abstraktsete värvilaikudega antud panoraamne maastik. Paremal servas erksinine järvesilm, esiplaanil ja silmapiiril on aimata künkaid ja metsatukki. Ülal kitsas riba sinistes ja lillades toonides maalitud taevast.
works.de: A panoramic landscape given in large coloured abstract patches. On the right edge, a bright blue patch of a lake; in the foreground and on the horizon, hillocks and small groves can be discerned. Above, a narrow strip of sky painted in blue and purple tones.

works.d: Peenikese jalaga tumesinises vaasis tohutu erinevat liiki roosakasvalgetest ja punastest õitest koosnev lillekimp. Vasakus nurgas ülal on näha osa seinal rippuvast pildist. Foon hallikassinine.
works.de: In a thin-stemmed dark blue vase, an enormous bouquet of flowers of various kinds in pinkish-white and red. In the upper left corner part of a picture hanging on the wall can be seen. Background greyish-blue.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 31.2 cm; laius: 51.4 cm (tervik, lm.   )
works.d: Lagedal, lumisel väljakul kahes reas, eest taha suunduvad ostjate-müüjate read.
works.de: On an open, snowy square in two rows, rows of buyers and sellers extending from front to back.

works.d: Keskplaanil visandlikult maalitud kaks punaste katustega valget ja nende vahel kollane hoone. Kõrval lillades toonides puud. Esiplaanil punakas-pruunikas tee. Taevas helesinine. Kohati on värvipinna alt näha aluspapil olevat teksti.
works.de: In the middle ground, sketchily painted, two white buildings with red roofs and a yellow building between them. Trees in purple tones beside them. In the foreground a reddish-brown road. Sky light blue. In places text on the underlying cardboard is visible beneath the paint layer.

works.d: Esiplaanil istuv naine (Greenbergi tüüp), rõhutatult tugevate käte vahel hoiab last, taga mees. Paremal kõrgete jalgadega laud rohelise kupliga lambiga. Käsitlus etüüdilik, maaliline.
works.de: In the foreground a seated woman (Greenberg type), holding a child between markedly strong arms, a man behind. On the right a table on tall legs with a lamp with a green shade. Treatment sketch-like, painterly.

works.d: Ees veekogu ääres kivid. Vastaskaldal madal talumaja puudega paremal.
works.de: Stones by a body of water in front. A low farmhouse with trees on the right on the opposite bank.

works.d: Ees lagedal rohtmaal kaks seisvat ja üks lamav lehm ja vasikas. Ees paremal laialeheliste taimede keskel jänes. Horisondil Tallinna siluett. Taevas pilvine.
works.de: In the foreground on open grassland two standing cows and one lying cow, and a calf. In the foreground on the right, among broad-leaved plants, a hare. On the horizon the silhouette of Tallinn. Sky cloudy.

works.dm: kõrgus: 47.7 cm (ovaalne kujutis); laius: 42.3 cm (ovaalne kujutis)
works.d: Väikese tüdruku rinnapilt kerge pöördega paremale. Otselahuga shatäänid juuksed lahtiselt seljale rippumas. Seljas punane pluus rohekat tooni kaelusega, millest paistab valge särgi kaelus.
works.de: Bust portrait of a little girl with a slight turn to the right. Straight-parted chestnut-brown hair hanging loose down her back. Wearing a red blouse with a greenish-toned collar, from under which a white shirt collar shows.

works.d: Helehallil foonil keskealise mehe rinnaportree kerges pöördes paremale. Heledad, pisut lokkis juuksed, prillid. Seljas kollane särk, käe peal kell, kaelas keti otsas rippuv azuurne kaelaehe. Parem käsi hoiab ketti.
works.de: Chest portrait of a middle-aged man against a light grey background, turned slightly to the right. Light, slightly curly hair, glasses. Wearing a yellow shirt, a watch on the hand, an azure pendant hanging from a chain around the neck. Right hand holding the chain.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 32.4 cm; lehe laius: 36.8 cm
works.d: Ees paremal kaldaliival üksik mänd. Vasakul rühm suuri kive. Taga vasakul, kõrgeneval kaldapervel haraline mänd ja kaks hoonet.
works.de: A lone pine on the sandy shore in the foreground on the right. A group of large stones on the left. In the back on the left, on a rising bank, a branching pine and two buildings.

works.d: Varakevadine maastik. Siin-seal lumelaike. Järve kaldal, vasakul pildiserval, väike maja ja lumine heinasaad. Tagaplaanil metsatukk.
works.de: Early spring landscape. Patches of snow here and there. On the shore of a lake, on the left edge of the picture, a small house and a snowy haystack. A clump of forest in the background.

works.d: Tumedal taustal, toolil istuva hallipäise, vurrudega mehe kolveerandfiguur kerge pöördega paremale, vasaku jala peale pandud parema jalaga, toolikorjule toetuva vasema käega. Seljas sinakas-hall kuub, hallid püksid ja vest. Rinnaesine valge, kaelaside tume, mille üle valge krae nurgad.(eesti)
works.de: Against a dark background, a three-quarter figure of a grey-haired, moustached man seated on a chair, in a slight turn to the right, right leg crossed over the left, left hand resting on the arm of the chair. He wears a bluish-grey coat, grey trousers and a waistcoat. The shirt front is white, the necktie dark, over which the corners of a white collar show.

works.d: Kaks rahvarõivais raamatuid lugevat tütarlast. Ees, parempoolne, toolil istuv profiilis vasakule, tagapool, vasakul olev, seisev, poolprofiilis vasakule.
works.de: Two girls in folk costume reading books. In front, the right-hand one, sitting on a chair in profile to the left; behind, the one on the left, standing, in three-quarter profile to the left.

works.d: Esiplaanil lumine aianurk raagus puuga vasakul. Selle taga vasakul kõrge kivihoone nurk. Keskel ja paremal lumised katused.
works.de: In the foreground a snowy corner of a garden with a bare tree on the left. Behind it on the left the corner of a tall stone building. In the centre and on the right snowy roofs.

works.d: Hallikais-pruunides toonides puud erksinise veekogu kaldal. Ees vasakul kollakas heinamaa kahe kuhjaga. Puude kohal hall taevas. Laia pintsliga hoogsalt maalitud.
works.de: Trees in greyish-brown tones on the shore of a bright blue body of water. In the foreground on the left a yellowish meadow with two haystacks. Grey sky above the trees. Painted vigorously with a broad brush.

works.d: Rohtunud tänavanurk kahekordsete majadega. Üle esiplaanil oleva ärklikorrusega majakatuse paistmas puulatv.
works.de: A grassy street corner with two-storey houses. A treetop visible above the mansard roof of the house in the foreground.

works.d: Kimp valgeid ja punaseid kibuvitsaõisi, üksik suure punase õiega keskel.(eesti)
works.de: Bouquet of white and red dog-rose blossoms, a single large red bloom in the center.

works.d: Tänavanurk madalate majadega, mille tagant paistmas osa koonusekujulisest tornist. Pildil vasakul liiklusmärk, paremal kõrged lehtpuud.
works.de: A street corner with low houses, behind which part of a cone-shaped tower is visible. On the left of the picture a traffic sign, on the right tall deciduous trees.

works.d: Lillakal foonil tüseda, roosade põskede ning tumedate, veidi laines juustega naise otsevaates rinnaportree. Seljas must, seosega kleit ja õlgadel valge sall.
works.de: Against a lilac background, a frontal bust portrait of a stout woman with rosy cheeks and dark, slightly wavy hair. Wearing a black, patterned dress and a white shawl on her shoulders.

works.d: Künklik talvemaastik. Esiplaanil paremal värav, vasakul külmunud veeloigud. Keskosas teel liikumas jalakäijad ja hobusemehi, suunaga taamal asetsevate linnuse varemete poole, mille tagant paistab kirik.
works.de: A hilly winter landscape. In the foreground on the right a gate, on the left frozen puddles. In the middle part, on the road, pedestrians and horsemen moving, heading towards castle ruins situated in the distance, behind which a church is visible.

works.d: Kollastes ja rohelistes toonides lõunamaa maastik: keskplaanis paremal hele, madala katuse, rõdude ja kaaruksega maja. Maja ees antiikajast samba ülaosa. Maja taga järv või lahesopp, mille kallastelt tõusevad silmapiirile madalad mäed. Ülanurgas paremal on näha osa majast, vasakul keskplaanil hulk siredaid küpresse ja akvedukti varemed.
works.de: A southern landscape in yellow and green tones: in the middle ground on the right a bright house with a low roof, balconies and an arcade. In front of the house the upper part of an antique column. Behind the house a lake or bay, from whose shores low mountains rise to the horizon. In the upper right corner part of a house is visible, on the left in the middle ground a number of slender cypresses and the ruins of an aqueduct.

works.d: Sinisel lauanurgal esiplaanil kaks pronksjalt helkivat skulptuuri (näod profiilis). Nende kohal suurte valgete ja kohevate pallidena lilled. Foon helesinine, roosade ja lillade helkidega.
works.de: On the blue corner of a table in the foreground two sculptures gleaming bronze (faces in profile). Above them flowers as large white and fluffy balls. Background light blue, with pink and lilac glimmers.

works.d: Noore vurrudega mehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale, pea kerge kallakuga parema õla suunas. Peakatteks lame, laiaääreline õlgkübar, laia tumeda paelaga.
works.de: Bust portrait of a young man with a moustache, in half-profile to the right, head slightly inclined toward the right shoulder. Headwear a flat, wide-brimmed straw hat with a wide dark ribbon.

works.dm: laius: 99.0 cm (vm); kõrgus: 77.0 cm; kõrgus: 75.5 cm (vm); laius: 100.0 cm
