works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul mänd, kõrval noor kuusk, keskel põõsas. Tagaplaanil lambakari ja lehm väikese karjusetüdrukuga. Taga vasakul ja keskel õlgkatusega taluhooned ja tara; maja taga ning paremal puid. Taevas rünkpilves. Hele koloriit.
works.de: In the foreground on the left a pine, beside it a young spruce, a bush in the middle. In the background a flock of sheep and a cow with a small shepherd girl. Behind, on the left and in the middle, thatched-roof farm buildings and a fence; trees behind the house and on the right. Cumulus clouds in the sky. Light colouring.

works.d: Esiplaanil mererannal kõrkjais figuur, taamal ratsanik ja meri.
works.de: In the foreground on the seashore a figure among reeds, in the distance a rider and the sea.

works.d: Ees vasakul, liivasel rannal, kolm viilkatusega onni. Paremal taga veekogu, horisondil mets.
works.de: In front on the left, on a sandy beach, three gable-roofed huts. On the right behind, a body of water, forest on the horizon.

works.d: Naise rinnapilt en face. Seljas avara dekolteega kleit, vasakus käes sinine mask.(eesti)
works.de: Bust portrait of a woman en face. Wearing a dress with a wide décolletage, holding a blue mask in her left hand.

works.d: Esiplaanil diagonaalis paremalt vasakule sügavusse suunduvate telliskivi katuste rida kõrgete korstnatega. Vasakul näha elumaja seinad akendega. Katuste tagant paistavad Tallinna linna tornid, millest tagapool näha ähmaseid elumajade siluette.
works.de: In the foreground a row of brick roofs with tall chimneys running diagonally from the right into the depth toward the left. On the left the walls of a dwelling house with windows are visible. Behind the roofs the towers of the city of Tallinn appear, behind which blurred silhouettes of dwelling houses can be seen.

works.d: Esiplaanil oleva metsamassiivi keskelt paistab roosakas katus valge suitseva korstnaga. Sellest vasakul mäe nõlva tagant paistab punase katusega maja punase väravaga. Metsamassiivi tagant kerkib Tallinna linna panoraam, millest paremal pool Toompea koos linnusega, vasakul pool meri.
works.de: From the middle of the forest mass in the foreground a pinkish roof with a white smoking chimney can be seen. To its left, behind the slope of a hill, a house with a red roof and a red gate is visible. Behind the forest mass rises the panorama of the city of Tallinn, with Toompea and its castle on the right, and the sea on the left.

works.d: Eest vasakult taha paremale suunduv jõgi. Keskel kivisild. Taga vasakul näha puulatvu ja hoonete katuseid.
works.de: A river running from the front left to the back right. A stone bridge in the middle. In the background on the left, treetops and roofs of buildings can be seen.

works.d: Esiplaanil pruunides toonides maapind, mis keskel läheb järsult üle roheliseks. Vasakule jääb heinaküün. Ülal diagonaalselt taevariba. Värv kantud lõuendile laiade pintslilüketega, horisontaalselt.
works.de: In the foreground ground in brown tones, which in the middle changes abruptly to green. On the left is a hay barn. Above, a diagonal strip of sky. The paint is applied to the canvas in broad, horizontal brushstrokes.

works.d: Panoraam taastamistöödest Tartu kesklinnas. Esiplaanil Aia tn. kallak, millel käimas prahi koristamine ja äravedu ning tänavaäärsete puude istutamine tõstemehhanismi abil. Kaugemal mäekallakul rohkesti töötavaid inimesi, tagaplaanil asetsevate majade taustal. Vasakul pildipoolel üle katuste näha raekoja ja kiivrite Jaani kiriku torni.
works.de: Panorama of restoration works in central Tartu. In the foreground the slope of Aia Street, where rubble is being cleared and removed, and trees are being planted along the street with the help of a lifting mechanism. Further away on the hillside many people at work, against the background of houses situated further back. On the left side of the picture, the tower of St John's Church with its helm roofs can be seen above the roofs, together with the town hall.

works.d: Esiplaanil müür ja vanade majade viilkatused. Vasakul ja paremal puud. Katuste tagant paistab osa Oleviste tornist.
works.de: In the foreground a wall and the gabled roofs of old houses. Trees on the left and right. Part of the tower of Oleviste is visible behind the roofs.

works.d: Esiplaanil, vertikaalsest keskjoonest pisut vasakul kroogitud kaelusega, keskelt taljes ja alt kohevas kleidis punapäine poolpikkade juustega tantsijanna. Parem käsi kõrva juurde tõstetud ja hoiab värvilist lehvikutaolist eset. Naise selja taga vasakul seisab mustas keebis ja laia servaga kübaras mees ning hoiab naisel kätest. Naise peas must, pisikese põhja ja laia servaga kübar, punane lint ümber. Fooniks erksavärvilisi kujundeid.
works.de: In the foreground, slightly to the left of the vertical centre line, a red-haired dancer with shoulder-length hair, in a dress gathered at the neckline, fitted at the waist and full below. Her right hand is raised to her ear and holds a coloured fan-like object. Behind the woman on the left stands a man in a black cloak and a wide-brimmed hat, holding her by the hands. On the woman's head a black hat with a small crown and wide brim, with a red ribbon around it. The background consists of brightly coloured shapes.

works.d: Kaarjate käetugedega istmel istuva noore naise täisfiguur, kere kergelt paremale pööratud, pea otse, vaade pisut vasakule. Parem käsi toetub paremale reiele, vasak istmele. Naisel seljas paksemal voodril mustast sifoonist dekolteeritud õhtukleit, jalas mustad sukad ja kingad. Fooniks pruun põrand ja punakaspruun sein, vasakus servas foonil tumehall pind.(eesti)
works.de: A full figure of a young woman seated on a seat with curved armrests, her torso turned slightly to the right, her head straight, her gaze slightly to the left. Her right hand rests on her right thigh, her left hand on the seat. The woman wears a black chiffon evening gown with a heavier lining, décolleté, black stockings and shoes on her feet. The background is a brown floor and a reddish-brown wall, with a dark grey surface in the background at the left edge.

works.d: Vaade liivakünka tagant üles, vastvalminud paneelmaja nurgale erksinise taeva taustal. Taamal paremal näha veelgi uusehitiste ülakorruseid. Esiplaanil suured liivakünkad, millest turritav välja oksarämu.
works.de: View from behind a sand dune upward, to the corner of a newly completed panel building against a bright blue sky background. Further away on the right, the upper floors of more new buildings are visible. In the foreground large sand dunes, with brushwood sticking out of them.

works.d: Etüüdilikult antud, tumedates  sinistes ja pruunides toonides vnema mehe rinnaportree. Mehel pikk sirge nina, endasse pööratud pilk ja õlgadeni ulatuvad hallid juuksed. Suu tugevaks kriipsuks kokku pigistatud.
works.de: A study-like bust portrait, in dark blue and brown tones, of an older man. The man has a long straight nose, an inward-turned gaze and grey hair reaching to his shoulders. His mouth is pressed firmly into a line.

works.d: Ees taha majade vahele suunduva kanali ääres oleval kail naised pesu loputamas.
works.de: Women rinsing laundry on a quay beside a canal running between houses from front to back.

works.d: Erksa sinise taeva all hoogsate laiade pintslitõmmetega pastoosselt maalitud mägine maastik. Keskosas heledamal taustal harulise puu võra, paremal kolm saledat männitüve, tagaplaanil vasakul grupp mände.
works.de: A mountainous landscape painted impastoly with bold broad brushstrokes under a bright blue sky. In the centre, against a lighter background, the crown of a branching tree, on the right three slender pine trunks, in the background on the left a group of pines.

works.d: Oranži sakilise lagipea, pikliku venitatud näoga keppjalgadel figuur mustjas-sinises ümbruses. Üks käsi kõverdatult pea juures, teises pikk nupuga kepp suunatud ette paremale, aimatavasse sinisesse loiku. Figuuriga läbi põimunud mitmesugused kujundid, vasakul pea ja käelaba konditaolise moodustisega. Ekspressiivne maalilaad.
works.de: An orange jagged-crowned, elongated-face figure on stilt-like legs in a blackish-blue setting. One hand bent near the head, the other holding a long knobbed staff pointed forward to the right, into a suggested blue puddle. Various shapes intertwined with the figure, on the left a head and a hand with a bone-like formation. Expressive painting style.

works.d: Lineaarperspektiivi reeglite järgi üles ehitatud kompositsioon, mis koondub silmapiiril asuvate punaste koonuste suunas. Kahe heleda horisontaalse tasapinna vahel keskel asuv konstruktsioon koosneb erksates toonides silindritest, pindadest ja torudest. Keskel kollastest kumavatest ruutudest koosnev tasapind. All hall, otsekui ukseava moodustav nelinurk. Ülaservas foon sinine ja lilla.
works.de: A composition built according to the rules of linear perspective, converging towards red cones located on the horizon. Between two light horizontal planes, the construction in the centre consists of cylinders, surfaces and pipes in bright tones. In the middle, a plane composed of glowing yellow squares. Below, a grey quadrangle forming what looks like a doorway. At the top edge the background is blue and purple.

works.d: Õunapuuridadega taluaia vaade õrnroosades, mürkrohelistes toonides. Taga, helenduva taeva taustal paistab taluhoone katus.
works.de: View of a farm garden with rows of apple trees, in delicate pink and poisonous green tones. Behind, against the background of a glowing sky, the roof of a farmhouse is visible.

works.d: Kitsas tumedas vaasis mitmevärvilised põllulilled koos gladioolidega.
works.de: Multicoloured field flowers with gladioli in a narrow dark vase.

works.d: Vaade talvisele turuplatsile. Esiplaanil keskel heinu sööv must hobune heinaveovankriga. Tagapool hulk hobuseid vankritega, inimeste grupid nende ümber. Taamal keskel kahekorruseline hoone, paremal torniga ja väiksemad majad. Taevas ja maa sulavad ühtlaseks helehall-valkjaks pinnaks, lumel üksikuid sinakad ja pruunid varjud. Maalitud siledalt, maapind veidi pastoossemalt.
works.de: View of a winter market square. In the foreground centre a black horse eating hay, with a hay cart. Further back a number of horses with carts, groups of people around them. In the distance in the centre a two-storey building, on the right one with a tower and smaller houses. The sky and ground merge into a uniform light grey-whitish surface, with occasional bluish and brown shadows on the snow. Painted smoothly, the ground somewhat more pastose.

works.d: Sinakas-rohekast valgusest täidetud taluõu, paremale jääva madala majaga. Taamal metsasiluett. Taevas täiskuu.
works.de: A farmyard filled with bluish-green light, with a low house on the right. In the distance a forest silhouette. In the sky a full moon.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakult taha paremale suunduva plangu ääres laasipuu ees kaks hobust regedega. Taga keskel plangu taga ühekordne hoone ja puid.
works.de: In the foreground, by a fence running from left to back to right, a woodpile in front of which are two horses with sledges. In the background centre, behind the fence, a single-storey building and trees.

works.d: Pastelsel rohekal foonil blondi tüdruku rinnaportree otsevaates, pea pistut pööratud paremale, pilk suunatud paemale küljele. Tüdrukul seljas roosakas pluus, parem, heleroosa lehviga pats rinnal, vasak seljal. Maalitud siledalt rohekasroosades toonides.(eesti)
works.de: Frontal bust portrait of a blonde girl on a pastel greenish background, the head turned slightly to the right, the gaze directed to the right. The girl wears a pinkish blouse, a light pink bow-tied plait on her chest on the right, on her back on the left. Painted smoothly in greenish-pink tones.

works.d: Laugjas, lumine mäenõlv, kolme, sinakaid varje heitva puuga. Tagaplaanil paremal üksik inimfiguur.
works.de: A gently sloping, snowy mountainside, with three trees casting bluish shadows. In the background on the right a solitary human figure.

works.d: Niidetud viljapõld, keskel kaks rida rõuke. Silmapiiril sinerdab metsaviirg.
works.de: A mown grain field, in the middle two rows of stooks. On the horizon, a strip of forest shows blue.

works.d: Suvises, päikesepaistelises maastikus heledas rõivastuses noormees kurni mängimas. Keha hoovõtul ettekummardunud, käed kepiga heitevalmilt õlajoonele tõstetud. Tagaplaanil paistab puudevahelt veekogu. Koloriit hele.
works.de: In a summer, sunlit landscape a young man in light-coloured clothing playing kurni (a throwing game). Body bent forward on the run-up, arms raised to shoulder level with a stick ready to throw. In the background a body of water is visible through the trees. Bright colouring.

works.d: Telkide, hobuste, vankrite ja inimgruppidega ääristatud laadaplatsil tumedajuukseline naine külgvaates. Roosad lehvid juustes, hoiab helesinist salli. Temast paremal otsevaates mees, ülakeha paljastatud, käed vaheliti rinnal. Maalitud etüüdlikult, maalikiht õhuke, paber kumab läbi.
works.de: At a fairground bordered by tents, horses, carts and groups of people, a dark-haired woman in profile. Pink ribbons in her hair, holding a light blue scarf. To her right, a man seen frontally, upper body bare, arms crossed over his chest. Painted in a sketchy manner, the paint layer is thin, the paper shows through.

works.d: Vana naise rinnaportree otsevaates. Hallisegused juuksed üle pea kammitud. Suu juures nägu sissevajunud, huuled surutud kitsaks jooneks. Tumedate, sügaval asetsevate silmade pilk mõtlik. Ees ümarate raamidega prillid; seljas hall kleit, kaelus kinnitatud tumeda, ovaalse prossiga. taustaks kõrge toolileen.
works.de: Bust portrait of an old woman in frontal view. Greying hair combed back over the head. Near the mouth the face is sunken, lips pressed into a narrow line. The gaze of the dark, deep-set eyes is thoughtful. In front, round-framed glasses; wearing a grey dress, the collar fastened with a dark, oval brooch. Background a high chair back.

works.d: Talvine linnavaade. Vasakul pool tänava ääres ühe- ja mitmekorruselised majad, paremal lumine maa, raagus puud, teel mõned figuurid. Maalitud heledates hallides, pruunides toonides.
works.de: A winter view of a city. On the left along the street one- and multi-storey houses, on the right snowy ground, bare trees, on the road a few figures. Painted in light grey, brown tones.

works.d: Esiplaanil keskel figuuride grupp. Paremal kõrgendikul karjus kitsedega, vasakul põõsastik. Taamal meri ja vaade Tallinnale.
works.de: A group of figures in the centre foreground. On the right on a rise, a shepherd with goats, on the left shrubbery. Beyond, the sea and a view of Tallinn.

works.d: Noore naise rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale. Seljas valge sügava dekolteega kleit. Üle õlgade heidetud roosa rätik.
works.de: Chest portrait of a young woman in half-profile to the right. Wearing a white dress with a deep décolletage. A pink shawl thrown over the shoulders.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul väikesemõõdulise ovaalse peegli tagakülg; selle ees istuv tütarlaps sinises kleidis. Tütarlapse seljataga püsti seisev naine.
works.de: In the foreground on the left, the back of a small oval mirror; in front of it a girl in a blue dress sitting. Behind the girl a standing woman.

works.d: Esiplaanil rohumaa; taga lehtpuude ja pöösaste vöönd.
works.de: In the foreground grassland; behind, a belt of deciduous trees and bushes.

works.d: Kaks tumedas riides kolmveerandfiguuri istumas, vasakul naine, paremal mees. Mehe ees taldrik küünlaga ja roheline pärg.
works.de: Two three-quarter figures dressed in dark clothing seated, a woman on the left, a man on the right. In front of the man a plate with a candle and a green wreath.

works.d: Keskel asemel lamab sinises alusrüüs ning punakas  - pruunis pealisrüüs naine. Tema ümber kummardavad inglid ja pühakud. Voodi taga keskel kuldses kiirtevihus kuldne Kristus, kes hoiab väikest Jumalaema käe peal. Teda ümbritsevad neli hallikas  - sinises sõõris inglit, nende kohal punane keerub.
works.de: In the middle, on a bed, lies a woman in a blue undergarment and a reddish-brown outer garment. Around her angels and saints are bowing. Behind the bed, in the centre, in a golden ray of light, the golden Christ, holding the small Mother of God on his hand. He is surrounded by four angels in a greyish-blue orb, above them a red swirl.

works.d: Heledal hallikal foonil keskealise mehe portree, pea kerges pöördes vasakule. Mehel seljas tumepunane sviiter ja hall lühikeste revääridega kuub, poolpikad juuksesalgud langevad kõrvadele. Kõrge laup, kulm kortsus, terane pilk vaatajale suunatud.(eesti)
works.de: On a light greyish background, a portrait of a middle-aged man, head slightly turned to the left. The man wears a dark red sweater and a grey coat with short lapels, half-long strands of hair falling over the ears. High forehead, furrowed brow, sharp gaze directed at the viewer.

works.d: Šarž kunstnikust: seisva mehe põlvpilt en face, käed ristamisi rinnal.
works.de: Caricature of the artist: a knee-length portrait of a standing man en face, arms crossed on the chest.

works.d: Šarž kunstnikust: seisva mehe põlvpilt profiilis vasemale. vasaku kaenla all mapp. Peas kaabu.
works.de: Caricature of the artist: knee-length portrait of a standing man in profile to the left, a folder under his left arm. A hat on his head.

works.d: Šarž kunstnikust: seisva mehe täisfiguur profiilis vasemale. Vasak käsi taskus.
works.de: Caricature of the artist: full figure of a standing man in profile facing left. Left hand in pocket.

works.d: Šarž kunstnikust: seisva mehe täisfiguur profiilis vasakule. Käed kokkupandult kõhul.
works.de: Caricature of the artist: full figure of a standing man in profile to the left. Hands clasped on the stomach.

works.d: Paremal meri paatidega rannal, vasakul kallas metsaga, kuuriga ja üksikute inimfiguuridega.
works.de: On the right, the sea with boats on the shore, on the left a bank with a forest, a shed and solitary human figures.

works.d: Šarž kunstnikust: mehe poolfiguur profiilis vasakule. taustaks sendine kirjamark.
works.de: Caricature of the artist: half-figure of a man in profile facing left, background a brownish stamp.

works.d: Šarž kunstnikust: vasakul õhus hõljuv naisfiguur asetamas pärga paremal seisva mehe pähe.
works.de: Caricature of the artist: on the left a female figure hovering in the air placing a wreath on the head of a man standing on the right.

works.d: Seisva noormehe täisakt. Parem kõverdatud käsi toetub postamendile, mis on kaetud punase riidega.
works.de: Full nude figure of a standing young man. The right, bent arm rests on a pedestal covered with red cloth.

works.d: Istuva vanema naise poolfiguur otsevaates. Valge tanu, must jakk.
works.de: Half-figure of a seated elderly woman, frontal view. White bonnet, black jacket.

works.d: Peaaegu profiilis antud ajalehte lugev vanem talumees. Mehel hallisegused, pisut pikemad juuksed, lihav nina. Seljas tume vammus ja valge särk. Vasak küünarnukk toetub esiplaanil olevale lauale, ajaleht on silmade ette tõstetud. Laual tume pudel, punaka vedelikuga täidetud klaas ja pudelikork. Vasakul nurgas paistab osa tooli seljatoest. Seinale langeb lugeva mehe kerge vari. Foon hall.
works.de: An older peasant man reading a newspaper, given almost in profile. The man has greying, somewhat longer hair, a fleshy nose. He wears a dark tunic and a white shirt. His left elbow rests on a table in the foreground, the newspaper is raised in front of his eyes. On the table a dark bottle, a glass filled with reddish liquid and a bottle cork. In the left corner part of a chair's backrest is visible. A light shadow of the reading man falls on the wall. The background is grey.

works.d: Heledapäise, punases-lillas riietuses noormehe poolfiguur otsevaates. Foon punakas.
works.de: Half-figure of a fair-haired young man in red-purple clothing, frontal view. Background reddish.

works.t: a) Kaks naist; b) Mehe portree
works.d: Kaks istuvat naist, neist vasakpoolne heleda kleidi ja punaka kübaraga.
works.de: Two seated women, the one on the left in a light-coloured dress and a reddish hat.

works.d: Suvemaastik. Ees jõekäär pilliroopuhmastikuga vasakul. Ees paremal nurgas näha paadisilla nurk, keskel lootsik. Vastaskaldal puid, heinamaad.
works.de: Summer landscape. In the foreground a river bend with reed thickets on the left. In the foreground right corner the corner of a boat landing is visible, a rowboat in the middle. On the opposite bank, trees, meadows.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal veekogu, selle kaldal vasakul hurtsik suitseva korstnaga. Tagakaldal lehtpuuvõsa. Taamal kaugemal mets.
works.de: In the foreground on the right a body of water, on its bank on the left a hovel with a smoking chimney. On the opposite bank deciduous scrub. In the distance further away a forest.

works.d: Ees lage rohumaa. Keskel põõsastike vöönd. Taamal põõsaste vahelt näha põlde ja horisondil olevat metsa.
works.de: Open grassland in the foreground. A belt of bushes in the middle. Beyond, fields and a forest on the horizon are visible through the bushes.

works.d: Ees keskel madalas merevees suur hulk kokkukuhjatud suuri kive. Keskel rannikuribal lehtpuumets. Taamal vasakul vaade üle meresopi kauguses olevale metsajoonele.
works.de: In the front centre, in shallow sea water, a large number of piled-up large stones. In the centre, on the coastal strip, a deciduous forest. In the distance on the left, a view across a bay to a distant forest line.

works.d: Eest taha suunduv jõgi. Vasakul kaldal kuused ja madalamad lehtpuud. Parempoolsel kaldal ees rida hooneid, taga lehtpuid.
works.de: A river receding from front to back. On the left bank spruces and lower deciduous trees. On the right bank in front a row of buildings, behind them deciduous trees.

works.d: Tänavanurk lameda - astmelise katusega ja rõdudega kollase kivimajaga. Esiplaanil paremal palm.
works.de: Street corner with a yellow stone house with a flat, stepped roof and balconies. In the foreground on the right a palm tree.

works.d: Mustlase portree en face õlgadeni. Mehel on vuntsid ja põskhabe, peas punaste paeltega müts.
works.de: Portrait of a gypsy en face to the shoulders. The man has a moustache and side-whiskers, on his head a cap with red ribbons.

works.d: Prillidega vanema mehe rinnaportree, nägu peaaegu otsevaates, rindkere kerges pöördes vasakule. Mehe pealagi hõredate juustega kaetud, tagant juuksed pisut pikemad, kõrvadest allapoole ulatuvad. Seljas sinine särk, mille ülemine nööp on lahti ja kergelt viltuhoidev punane lips. Foon rohelise - , sinise - ja punasekirju.
works.de: Bust portrait of an older man with glasses, his face almost frontal, his chest slightly turned to the left. The man's crown is covered with thinning hair, longer at the back, reaching below the ears. He is wearing a blue shirt with the top button undone and a slightly askew red tie. The background is mottled in green, blue and red.

works.d: Sinakashallides ja lillakais toonides maastik hoonetegrupi ja suure kahvatukollase kuuga. (eesti)
works.de: Landscape in bluish-grey and purplish tones with a group of buildings and a large pale yellow moon.

works.d: Mererannal paat ja üksik puutüvi, mis ülalpool mutub joonia sambaks. (eesti)
works.de: On the seashore, a boat and a solitary tree trunk, which above turns into an Ionic column.

works.d: Istuva, rohelise baretiga mehe portree kerges pöördes paremale.
works.de: Portrait of a seated man with a green beret, in a slight turn to the right.

works.d: Terve maali ulatuses tõsise ilmega habemiku täisfiguur, pikk rüü seljas, peakattega, paljad jalad. Käte vahel hoiab raamatut. Punakaspruunid toonid, foon allosas tume, pea taustal heledam punane.(eesti)
works.de: Over the entire extent of the painting a full figure of a serious-looking bearded man, wearing a long robe, with a headdress, bare feet. Holding a book between his hands. Reddish-brown tones, the background dark in the lower part, lighter red behind the head.

works.d: Heledale, kruntimata vineerile maalitud valge vaas lopsakate punaste ja kollaste õitega.
works.de: A white vase with lush red and yellow blossoms, painted on light, unprimed plywood.

works.d: Lumine tänav madalate puumajadega paremal. Esiplaanil vasakul lumel tugevad sinised varjud.
works.de: A snowy street with low wooden houses on the right. In the foreground on the left, strong blue shadows on the snow.

works.d: Lillas, lühikeste käistega kleidis istuva noore naise poolfiguur poolpöördes vasakule.
works.de: Half-length figure of a young woman sitting in a lilac, short-sleeved dress, in half-turn to the left.

works.d: Laua taga, millel on kolm suitsetamisraami ning kalad, istuvad kaks vanemat, valge ja roosa pearätiga naist ning lükivad kalu vardasse. Värvitoonid pastelsed.
works.de: Behind a table on which there are three smoking racks and fish, sit two elderly women wearing white and pink headscarves, threading fish onto skewers. The colour tones are pastel.

works.d: Esiplaanil jäätunud veekogu ja paat kahe inimesega. Kai ääres üks suurem ja üks väiksem aurulaev. Nende taga hooneid.
works.de: In the foreground a frozen body of water and a boat with two people. By the quay one larger and one smaller steamship. Buildings behind them.

works.d: Habeme ja vuntsidega keskealise mehe rinnaportree poolpöördes paremale. Tume pintsak, valge krae.
works.de: Bust portrait of a middle-aged man with beard and moustache, in three-quarter view to the right. Dark jacket, white collar.

works.d: Ees paremal metsa suunduv tee, vasakul hõre karjatare. Tagapool puud, puude vahel loojangu valgus.
works.de: In front on the right a road leading into the forest, on the left a sparse herder's hut. Behind, trees, with the light of the sunset among the trees.

works.d: Väga pastoossete, peaaegu reljeefina mõjuvate esemetega vaikelu: keskel hõõguvpruun potsaka vormiga vaas suurte punaste moonide ja valgete liiliatega. Esiplaanil kolm apelsinikarva vilja. Foon soojades pruunides toonides. Kõik viljad ja õied on maalitud otsekui seestpoolt helendavatena.(eesti)
works.de: A still life with very pastose, almost relief-like objects: in the centre a glowing brown vase of a squat form with large red poppies and white lilies. In the foreground three orange-coloured fruits. The background in warm brown tones. All the fruits and flowers are painted as if glowing from within.

works.de: In front, a nude female figure resting on her left knee on a high riverbank. Pressed against her a swan with outspread wings.

works.d: Tänav madalate majadega. Esiplaanil läbi rohelise avatud värava avaneb vaade õuele. Tagaplaanil keskel sinise taeva taustal kollane vabrikukorsten.
works.de: A street with low houses. In the foreground, a view of a courtyard opens through a green open gate. In the background, in the middle, a yellow factory chimney against a blue sky.

works.d: Esiplaanil pruunil laual suures klaaspurgis kuivanud lilledest ja rohtudest bukett, millest vasakul väike klaasist pudel kuivanud lillega. Paremal rohelisest klaasist puuviljavaas punase roosiga; taga pikk, kandiline, ülalt ahenev pudel kuivanud kõrrega. Allservas klaasnõu ja punane roos. Foon rohekas-sinine paremal, pruunikas vasakul.
works.de: In the foreground on a brown table, in a large glass jar, a bouquet of dried flowers and grasses, to the left of which a small glass bottle with a dried flower. On the right a green glass fruit vase with a red rose; behind it a tall, angular bottle narrowing at the top, with a dried stalk. At the bottom edge a glass vessel and a red rose. Background greenish-blue on the right, brownish on the left.

works.d: Tumedajuukselise, sinises kleidis tütarlapse rinnafiguur kerges pöördes paremale. Pruunid silmad, tugev nina, täidlane suu.
works.de: The bust of a dark-haired girl in a blue dress in a slight turn to the right. Brown eyes, a strong nose, a full mouth.

works.de: Three-quarter figure of a seated elderly woman in frontal view, hands in her lap. Dressed in Setu folk costume. Greenish-brown background.

works.d: Lillakas rõivastuses noore naise õlgadeni portree veerandpöördes vasakule.
works.de: Shoulder-length portrait of a young woman in purplish clothing, in a quarter-turn to the left.

works.de: A street running from left to right with small old houses. On the street, in front on the left a girl, behind an older woman with a dog.

works.d: Inimtühi maastik tumeda mere kaldal. Vasakul servas valge, mustendavate aknaavade ja ukseauguga torn, millel punakaspruun katus ja selles kaarjad aknaavad. Keskmisest aknast vaatab välja kahkjas naisefiguur. Keskplaanis, otsekui klaasist künka otsas, väiksem torn. Esiplaanil üksikud väikesed nuditud puud. Taevas hall, ülaosas ähvardavalt sinakasmust.
works.de: An uninhabited landscape on the shore of a dark sea. On the left edge, a white tower with blackened window and door openings, with a reddish-brown roof and arched window openings in it. From the middle window a pale female figure looks out. In the middle ground, as if atop a glass hill, a smaller tower. In the foreground, a few solitary pollarded trees. The sky grey, threateningly bluish-black at the top.

works.d: Valgele foonile paigutatud värvilistest sakiliste servadega kujunditest koosnev kompositsioon: vasakul ülal katavad üksteist kollane, sinine ja lilla laik, keskel punane ja roheline ning viimastest välja kasvav suur oranž kujund, all paremas nurgas must ja lilla laik.
works.de: A composition of colourful jagged-edged shapes placed on a white background: upper left, a yellow, blue and lilac patch overlapping one another, in the center a red and green patch with a large orange shape growing out of them, lower right corner a black and lilac patch.

works.d: Punasest, kollasest, rohelisest ja sinisest pinnast koosnev abstraktne kompositsioon valgel foonil. Värvilised pinnad ümbritsetud musta kontuurjoonega. Musta joonega on antud fooniosas väikesed ruudud ja abstraktsed pinnad, üksikud jooned ja katkendlikud kriipsud.
works.de: Abstract composition consisting of red, yellow, green and blue surfaces on a white background. The coloured surfaces are surrounded by a black contour line. In the background area small squares and abstract surfaces, individual lines and broken dashes are given with a black line.

works.d: Tumedal foonil rohekal alusel vaas suure kimbu karikakardega.
works.de: A vase with a large bunch of daisies on a greenish stand, against a dark background.

works.d: Esiplaanil keskel seisev poisi figuur, profiilis vasakule. Tumepunased püksid, valge särk. Vasakul pruun laud. Foon ebamäärane, maalitud soojades kollakates-pruunikates toonides.
works.de: In the foreground, in the centre, a standing boy figure, in profile to the left. Dark red trousers, white shirt. On the left a brown table. The background indefinite, painted in warm yellowish-brownish tones.

works.d: Rohtunud ja puudesse kasvanud kallastega jõgi, kaugemal sillakaar. Esiplaanil kaks last, vasakul purre, mille ääres paate ja inimesi.
works.de: A river with grassy, tree-grown banks, in the distance the arch of a bridge. In the foreground two children, on the left a footbridge, by which boats and people.

works.de: In the foreground a yellowish field with seven grain stacks. Behind, hills, covered by forest on the left.

works.d: Kireval taimemotiiviga foonil hallipäise prillidega mehe poolfiguur otsevaates, barett peas. Mehel tugev nina, näos sügavad kortsud. Ülakeha valkjate toonidega markeeritud taustale. Mehe käed toetuvad aimatavale toolileenile. Maalitud lühema nõtke pintslilöögiga.(eesti)
works.de: Against a colourful background with a plant motif, a half-length figure of a grey-haired, bespectacled man in frontal view, wearing a beret. The man has a strong nose, his face marked by deep wrinkles. The upper body marked against a whitish-toned background. The man's hands rest on a barely discernible chair arm. Painted with short, supple brushstrokes.

works.d: Valges nõus lopsakate roheliste lehtedega valged jasmiiniõied.
works.de: In a white vessel, white jasmine flowers with lush green leaves.

works.de: In the foreground a flat greenish clearing with a group of bushy trees on the left. In the centre a yellow, sunlit strip, bordered behind by forest.

works.d: Paremal looklev jõgi; vasakul jõekaldal suure puu oksal ettepoole kummarduv ja puu all istuv alasti inimfiguur, jalad vees.
works.de: On the right a winding river; on the left riverbank, on the branch of a large tree leaning forward, and under the tree a seated naked human figure, feet in the water.

works.d: Ees mererannal lebav figuur. Samas meesfiguuri maast tõstev ingel. Taga meri.
works.de: In front a figure lying on the seashore. Also an angel lifting a male figure from the ground. Behind, the sea.

works.d: Vasakul tõmmunahksete figuuride grupp, millest eendub paremal istuvale mehele karikat ulatav naine.
works.de: A group of tanned figures on the left, from which a woman handing a goblet to a seated man on the right stands out.

works.d: Keskealise, taha kuklasse kammitud juustega naise rinnapilt poolprofiilis vasakule. Foon roheline.
works.de: Bust of a middle-aged woman with hair combed back into a bun, in half-profile to the left. Green background.

works.d: Ees paremal veekogu. Vasakul kaldapervel istuv alasti naisfiguur, vasak jalg vees.
works.de: In front on the right a body of water. On the left a nude female figure sitting on the bank, left leg in the water.

works.d: Tagant paremalt ette vasemale suunduv rühm lauldes rändavaid mehi värvirõõmsas riietuses. Eelsammuja mängib kitarri. Taga paremal suur puu pingiga selle all ja inimfiguure. Taga vasemal paistavad orust punased majakatused ja kirik ning taamal oru taga mäestik.
works.de: A group of men travelling and singing, moving from the back right towards the front left, in colourfully joyous clothing. The one leading the way plays a guitar. In the back on the right a large tree with a bench beneath it and human figures. In the back on the left, red roofs of a valley and a church can be seen, and beyond, mountains behind the valley.

works.d: Üle pildi pinna suures plaanis kolm meest kannavad õlal tala, suund paremale.(eesti)

works.de: Portrait of an older woman in frontal view, wearing a dark beret, a scarf around the neck, jacket flaps open.

works.d: Esiplaanil lagendik. Tagapool vasemal üksik puu. Silmapiiril põõsaid.

works.d: Esiplaanil lage rohumaa; tagapool põõsastiku ääres lehmi ja sigu.

works.de: In the foreground on grassland, a lying wolfhound; further back on the right a cow grazing on grass, on the left a turkey. In the distance, solitary bushes.

works.d: Paremal all osa jõest. Ülejäänud pildipinna võtab enda alla künklik maastik paari madala majaga kaldapealsel. Värv kantud lõuendile laiade pintslilöökide ja pahtliga.
works.de: Lower right part of a river. The rest of the picture surface is taken up by a hilly landscape with a couple of low houses on the bank. Paint applied to canvas with broad brushstrokes and palette knife.

works.d: Leegitsevates kollastes, punastes ja sinakasrohelistes toonides maastik rukkihakkidega esiplaanil ja madalate pikkade talumajadega taamal. Vasakul ja paremal servas aimata puudegruppe. Taevas läheb majade katuste kohal olevast kollasest ülaservas üle ähvardavaks tumesiniseks.
works.de: In blazing yellow, red and bluish-green tones, a landscape with rye stooks in the foreground and low, long farmhouses further back. Groups of trees can be discerned on the left and right edges. The sky, yellow above the roofs of the houses, turns into a menacing dark blue at the upper edge.

works.d: Esiplaanil keskel ja paremal tihe tumedates toonides antud teravatipuliste taimede rägastik roostikku meenutamas. All paremas nurgas roostikku tõugatud paadi nina. Vasakul servas elektrisinine meri, kivid ja rannaliiv. Töö keskel õrnalt maalitud sinistes ja rohelistes toonides suur põõsas. Taevas peamiselt valkjaskollane, rahutute pilvedega.
works.de: In the foreground, centre and right, a dense thicket of sharp-tipped plants in dark tones reminiscent of reeds. In the lower right corner the bow of a boat pushed into the reeds. On the left edge electric blue sea, stones and beach sand. In the middle of the work a large bush painted delicately in blue and green tones. The sky mainly whitish-yellow, with restless clouds.

works.d: Talvemaastik lume seest paistvate hallikasroheliste kadakatega. Esiplaanil vasakus nurgas üks suurem kadakapõõsas ja lagunenud lattidest aed lume all. Taamal, keset kadakavälja, veel kaks lagunenud aiajuppi, ülal servas kitsas riba sinakashalli taevast.
works.de: A winter landscape with greyish-green junipers showing through the snow. In the foreground, in the left corner, a larger juniper bush and a dilapidated pole fence under snow. Further back, amid the juniper field, two more dilapidated fence fragments, at the top edge a narrow strip of bluish-grey sky.

works.d: Erksinistes ja punastes toonides kompositsioon. Keskel kolm punast inimfiguuri teravatipulistes mütsides.
works.de: Composition in bright blue and red tones. In the middle three red human figures in pointed caps.

works.de: Three-quarter figure of a woman with buckets and a yoke, turned to the left. Behind the woman a pole fence. In the background a landscape with bushes and trees hiding the sky and horizon.

works.de: In the foreground a horse harnessed to a sled and a human figure sitting on the sled, seen in profile. On the left a wooden fence and a long building. In the background a tree, a house and a mill.

works.d: Esiplaanil madal kivine rand paadisillaga ja veekogu.
works.de: In the foreground a low stony shore with a boat pier and a body of water.

works.d: Vasakul tormine meri. Paremal eest astmeliselt tahapoole kõrgenev kaljukallas metsatukaga alumisel platool. Ees, paremal kaks raudrüüs ratsanikku; vasakult neile vastu tulev tumehalli linikusse mähkunud meeste kolmik ehmatatud, tõrkuvail hobusteil.
works.de: On the left a stormy sea. On the right a rocky shore rising in tiers, with a patch of forest on the lower plateau. In front, on the right, two armoured horsemen; from the left, coming toward them, a trio of men wrapped in dark grey cloths, startled, on rearing horses.

works.d: Linnamotiiv (Müürivahe tänav Tallinnas) esiplaanilt majade vahel sügavusse suunduva kitsa tänavaga.
works.de: An urban motif (Müürivahe Street in Tallinn) with a narrow street receding into the depth between houses in the foreground.

works.d: Kolmest küljest kivimajadega ümbritsetud platsil töötamas inimesed ja ekskavaator. Esiplaanil raagus puu.
works.de: People working with an excavator on a site surrounded on three sides by stone buildings. In the foreground a bare tree.

works.d: Naise stiliseeritud poolakt, pea profiilis paremale. Naise nahk oranžikas-punane. Peas stiliseeritud kollased, punaste südamikega lilled. Keha meenutab viiuli kõlakasti. Taust kirevates sinistes likkakates ning pehmes ooker-toonis.
works.de: Stylised female half-nude, head in profile facing right. The woman's skin is orangish-red. On her head, stylised yellow flowers with red centres. Her body resembles the sound box of a violin. The background is in vivid blue lilac-ish tones and a soft ochre tone.

works.d: Mehe poolfiguur klaasilihvimispingi juures. Käes kristallvaas.
works.de: Half-figure of a man at a glass-grinding bench. Holding a crystal vase.

works.d: Talvine maastik kadakate ja tuulikutega, abstraheeritud vormides. Rajatud siniste toonide ja valge kontrastile, kuu kollakas.
works.de: A winter landscape with junipers and windmills, in abstracted forms. Built on the contrast of blue tones and white, the moon yellowish.

works.d: Ovaali paigutatud noore naise poolfiguur, keha pöördes paremale, pea vasemale, pilk alla suunatud. Pea mähitud pruunikasse rätti, paremal õlal heleroheline rüü. Käes rinna kohale tõstetud madal vaas.
works.de: The half-figure of a young woman placed in an oval, body turned to the right, head to the left, gaze directed downward. Head wrapped in a brownish scarf, light green robe on the right shoulder. Holding a low vase raised to chest level.

works.d: Paremal hoone nurk ja kõrge korsten, keskel tõstekraana, vasakul ehitusel olev vaatetorn.
works.de: On the right the corner of a building and a tall chimney, in the middle a crane, on the left an observation tower under construction.

works.d: Esiplaanil muru kolme suure puuga. Nende taga külgvaates kirikuvaremed.
works.de: In the foreground, grass with three large trees. Behind them, church ruins in side view.

works.de: In the centre, between the treetops, a view opens onto a body of water whose low banks are bordered by shrubbery on the right, forest on the left. In the forest a white house. On the horizon on the right a bluish forest.

works.d: Esiplaanil lumine õu, paremal servas hoone kõrge kiilkatusega. Pildi keskosas lumiste puude vahelt paistab roosa kohekordne hoone, vasakul mäkketõusev trepp.
works.de: In the foreground a snowy yard, at the right edge a building with a tall pointed roof. In the middle of the picture, a pink two-storey building is visible among snowy trees, at left stairs leading up the hill.

works.d: Esiplaanil lumine tee, mis läheb diagonaalselt paremale. Kahel pool tee ääres puud ja põõsad. Pildi keskosas teel kaks hobust reedega. Paremal taluhoone. Teest vasakul tagaplaanil puude vahelt paistmas teine hoone.
works.de: In the foreground a snowy road leading diagonally to the right. On both sides of the road trees and bushes. In the middle of the picture on the road two horses with a sleigh. On the right a farm building. To the left of the road, in the background, another building visible among the trees.

works.d: Vasemal allee, taga mets ja mäed.
works.de: An alley on the left, forest and mountains behind.

works.d: Mehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis vasemale. Pikkade, õlgadele langevate juustega ja kõrge valge kaelusega.
works.de: Chest-length portrait of a man in half-profile facing left. With long hair falling to his shoulders and a high white collar.

works.d: Kolmveerandprofiilis paremale tugitoolis istuv tütarlaps, sinise kübara ja seelikuga, sini - punases vöödilises pluusis; vasak käsi tooli korjul, parem toolitoel; rohekas - karmiin foon. Tüdrukul rüpes astrid ja kollased lilled.
works.de: A girl seated in three-quarter profile to the right in an armchair, with a blue hat and skirt, in a blue-red striped blouse; left hand on the armrest of the chair, right hand on the chair back; greenish-carmine background. The girl has asters and yellow flowers in her lap.

works.d: Paremalt vasakule kerge tõusuga lagedal rohtmaal vasakul rõhtpalkidest, ristnurkadega kolmejärguline ehitus, mille keskmine osa katuseta, kuna mõlemaid otsmisi osi katab püstlaudadest katus. Vasakpoolses osas tõuseb katuse küljelt välja madal korsten. Kogu ehitis tundub mahajäetud. Paremal taga näha merd. Taevas kerges rünkpilves.
works.de: On open grassland rising gently from right to left, on the left a three-part building of horizontal logs with cross-corners, whose middle section is without a roof, while both end sections are covered by a roof of upright boards. In the left section a low chimney rises from the side of the roof. The whole structure appears abandoned. In the background on the right, the sea is visible. The sky has light cumulus clouds.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal veekogu, mille vasakult poolelt kuni pildi keskosani ulatuva kalda äärsel kivil kükitav tütarlaps, allapoole väljasirutatud paremas käes oleva savikannuga vett võtmas. Taustaks lehtpuud.
works.de: In the foreground on the right a body of water, on the bank of which, extending from the left side to the centre of the picture, a girl crouches on a stone, drawing water with a clay jug held in her outstretched right hand below her. Deciduous trees in the background.

works.d: Künklik talvemaastik paremal ja keskel noorte kuuskedega; esiplaanil heinaküün lattaias, vahepeal künka kallakul lehtpuuvõsa ja küün.(eesti)
works.de: A hilly winter landscape with young spruces on the right and in the middle; in the foreground a hay barn with a pole fence, in between on the slope of the hill deciduous scrub and the barn.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul taluhoone nurk avatud uksega ja nooleotstega ukse kõrval ja ees. Hoone ees vasakul talupoja rõivastatud meesfiguur vibu pingutamas. Temast paremal mõõgaga varustatud seisev talupoja figuur. Paremal keskel mees vibuga üle õla ja nooltega käes seljaga vaataja poole. Taga paremal taluhoone nurk ja kõrge värav suurema grupi meesfiguuridega.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground on the left, the corner of a farm building with an open door, with arrowheads beside and in front of the door. In front of the building on the left, a male figure in peasant dress drawing a bow. To his right, a standing peasant figure equipped with a sword. In the centre right, a man with a bow over his shoulder and arrows in hand, his back to the viewer. Behind, on the right, the corner of a farm building and a tall gate with a larger group of male figures.

works.d: Rohtunud kaldakallak, vasakul puud ja põõsad, paremal üksik puu, tagaplaanil meri kajakatega, rünkpilvedega taevas.
works.de: A grassy slope of the shore, trees and bushes on the left, a solitary tree on the right, in the background the sea with gulls, cumulus clouds in the sky.
