works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul ja keskel töötavaid töölisi palgivirna ja tõstekraana ümber, kail kaks väikest laeva. Paremal suur tõsteseadeldis. Taga vaade linnale.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground on the left and in the centre, workers working around a pile of logs and a hoisting crane, on the quay two small ships. On the right a large hoisting apparatus. Behind, a view of the city.

works.d: Esiplaanil valged, punaste põhjade ja kajutitega suured paadid, kahel neist mastid purjede tarvis. Vasakul tagaplaanil tume, vaid markeeritud akendega maja. Esiplaanil paremal kuni silmapiirini vesi, ülal sinine taevas. Hallikassinised, valged ja mustad toonid, maalitud ekspressiivsete laiade, asjade mahtusid vaid üldiselt määravate pintslilöökidega.
works.de: In the foreground, large white boats with red hulls and cabins, two of them with masts for sails. In the background on the left, a dark house marked only by its windows. In the foreground on the right, water extending to the horizon, blue sky above. Greyish-blue, white and black tones, painted with expressive broad brushstrokes that only generally define the volumes of things.

works.d: Ees mahalangenud okaspuid, taga vasemal kaks küüni. Tagaplaanil segamets.
works.de: In front fallen conifer trees, behind on the left two barns. In the background a mixed forest.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 28.2 cm; lehe laius: 51.4 cm
works.d: Ees paremal mäeahelike vahel org kiriku ja hoonetega. Silmapiiril kaljumäed.
works.de: In front on the right, between mountain ranges, a valley with a church and buildings. On the horizon, rocky mountains.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 38.2 cm; lehe laius: 52.5 cm
works.d: Esiplaanil olevate kõrgete kaljurahnude tippude vahelt vaade all orus olevale veekogule ja selle vastaskaldaks olevale lumisele mäeahelikule. Horisondil päikesest valgustatud mäeharjad.
works.de: Through the peaks of the high cliff boulders in the foreground, a view of a body of water below in the valley and, on its opposite shore, a snowy mountain range. On the horizon sun-lit mountain ridges.

works.dm: kujutise kõrgus: 20.8 cm; lehe laius: 23.4 cm
works.d: Pildi alumine osa kaetud ühtlase roosaka tooniga. Ülaosas mäeahelikke ja pilves taevas.
works.de: The lower part of the picture is covered with a uniform pinkish tone. Mountain ranges and a cloudy sky above.

works.d: Mustad, sinised, punased ja valged üksteisega ristuvad geomeetrilised pinnad.
works.de: Black, blue, red and white geometric planes intersecting one another.

works.d: Punase põhja ja ribidest seljatoega toolil istub tütarlaps, kelle mõlemad käed toetuvad toolipõhjale ning vaade on suunatud vaatlejale. Kõrvu katavad kollakaspruunid juuksed, seljas punase-mustaruuduline seelik, mis jätab põlved osalt katmata ning roheline laiade revääridega pluus. Foon sinistes ja pruunides toonides, tiheda nähtava pintslitööga maaliline käsitlus, domineerivad külmad toonid.
works.de: On a chair with a red seat and a ribbed backrest sits a girl, both of her hands resting on the seat of the chair, her gaze directed at the viewer. Her ears are covered by yellowish-brown hair, she is wearing a red-and-black checked skirt, which partly leaves the knees uncovered, and a green blouse with wide lapels. Background in blue and brown tones, a painterly treatment with dense visible brushwork, cold tones dominating.

works.d: Esiplaanil õu, millel ristuvad kividest laotud teerajad. Keskplaanil vana lossiehitus trepi, võlvialuse ja punasest kivist katusega. Päikesest valgustatud osa ja varjukülg teravalt rõhutatud. Ülaservast paistab kitsas taevariba.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground a courtyard with crossing stone-paved paths. In the middle ground an old castle building with a staircase, an archway and a roof of red brick. The sunlit part and the shaded side are sharply emphasised. From the upper edge a narrow strip of sky is visible.

works.d: Vaade Toompeale ja sinna viivale Lühikesele jalale Kullassepa tänavalt. Esiplaanil vasakul grupp raagus puid ja E. Vilde mälestusmärk.
works.de: View of Toompea and the Short Leg leading to it, from Kullassepa Street. In the foreground on the left a group of bare trees and the E. Vilde monument.

works.d: Sinisel taustal sopilise kuklapoolega mustjas pea profiilis vasakule. Erkpunaste huultega suu paokil, punane silmatera. Punaserombilisel kostüümil roosa kroogetega krae.(eesti)
works.de: Against a blue background, a blackish head in profile facing left, with a bulging back of the head. Mouth ajar with bright red lips, red iris. Pink pleated collar on a costume with red rhombuses.

works.d: Punakaspruunides toonides metsamotiiv teega esiplaanil. Taga keskel, heleda õhtutaeva foonil haralise puu tume siluett, millest vasakul punetav päikeseketas. Spontaanne maalilaad, pastoosselt maalitud.
works.de: A forest motif in reddish-brown tones with a road in the foreground. Behind in the middle, against a light evening sky, the dark silhouette of a branching tree, to the left of which a reddening disc of the sun. Spontaneous painterly style, painted in impasto.

works.d: Sinisel alusel lopsakate lehtede ning oranžide õitega begoonia. Foon hele - kollakas-beežides toonides. Kontuur rõhutatud.
works.de: On a blue base a begonia with lush leaves and orange flowers. The background is light - in yellowish-beige tones. The contour is emphasized.

works.d: Sinistes toonides maalitud alusele kinnitatud mitmesuguseid, erinevatest materjalidest, ruumilisi esemeid, mis katavad tihedalt aluspinda. Ülemisel poolel, vasakul, nelinurksel puutahvlil metallplaat, millel lilleõiekujuliselt sisselõiked, samas plastmassist pudelikork. Ülal keskel metallist kinnise küljes liikuv, soontega, 19,7 cm pikkune ora. Ülal paremas kõrvuti kaks robustset puulusikat, värvitud puust rattaid, koltse. Alumisel poolel, vasakul, metalliribadest keeratud, azuurseid kujundeid. Paremal all fooliumi foonil traadist ümmargune, lame karkass. Paremal keskel puust kuubik arvuga "7". Alt vasakult üles paremale kaks paralleelset, puust riba, mis moodustavad sinisepõhjalise kanali.(
works.de: Various three-dimensional objects made of different materials are attached to a base painted in blue tones, densely covering the base surface. In the upper half, on the left, on a rectangular wooden panel, a metal plate with flower-shaped cutouts, and next to it a plastic bottle cap. At the top in the middle, a grooved awl 19.7 cm long, movable, attached to a metal fastening. At the top right, side by side, two rough wooden spoons, painted wooden wheels, cogwheels. In the lower half, on the left, azure-coloured shapes twisted from metal strips. At the bottom right, against a foil background, a round, flat wire frame. In the middle right, a wooden cube with the number "7". From the bottom left to the top right, two parallel wooden strips forming a blue-based channel.(

works.d: Tänavanurk viilkatustega majadega. Esiplaanil oleva majadegrupi kõrval posti otsas latern. Vasakul valge kivimaja.
works.de: Street corner with gable-roofed houses. Next to the group of houses in the foreground a lantern on top of a post. On the left a white stone house.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremalt vasemale suunduva oja kaldal raagus pajud. Taga lumine vooremaastik.
works.de: In the foreground, on the bank of a stream running from right to left, bare willows. Snowy hilly landscape behind.

works.d: Esiplaanil meri, kaldaäärsete valgete murdlainetega. Vasakul taeva kohal neli lendavat kajakat.
works.de: In the foreground the sea, with white breaking waves along the shore. On the left, above the sky, four flying gulls.

works.d: Esiplaanil kollakaspruun trepiosa, mille väikesel lillal platvormil kükitab roosa olevus, kummaski käes lilla hantlit meenutav ese. Tema taga erinevates sinistes toonides trepid ja hambulised müüriosad. Intensiivselt sinises taevas ülemises paremas servas kolm sinist tuututaolist objekti.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground a yellowish-brown section of stairs, on whose small purple platform a pink being crouches, in each hand an object resembling a purple dumbbell. Behind it, stairs and toothed wall sections in various shades of blue. In the intensely blue sky in the upper right corner, three blue horn-like objects.

works.d: Väga keeruliselt liigendatud, tiheda geomeetrilise struktuuriga kompositsioon, milles kasutatud kõiki geomeetrilisi kujundeid. Värvidest domineerivad sinine, punane, hall, must, valge ja kollane.
works.de: A very intricately articulated composition with a dense geometric structure, in which all kinds of geometric forms are used. Among the colours, blue, red, grey, black, white and yellow dominate.

works.d: Esiplaanil all kaks vestlevat figuuri: vasakul tumedas pluusis, pruunide juustega noormees, parem käsi välja sirutatud, paremal heledapäine bordoopunases pluusis nooruk. Toolid sinepikarva. Foonil keerulise struktuuriga geomeetriline kompositsioon triipudest, ringidest, kolm- ja nelinurkadest. Domineerib valge, hall, must ja sinine toon üksikute eredate aktsentidega.
works.de: In the foreground below, two conversing figures: on the left a young man with brown hair in a dark blouse, right hand stretched out, on the right a fair-haired youth in a wine-red blouse. The chairs are mustard-coloured. In the background a geometric composition of complex structure made of stripes, circles, triangles and squares. White, grey, black and blue tones dominate, with a few bright accents.

works.d: Tumedal foonil, paremal tumepruun vaas kollase- ja punaseõieliste lillede kimbuga. Maalipind faktuurne.
works.de: On a dark background, on the right a dark brown vase with a bouquet of yellow- and red-flowered flowers. The painted surface is textured.

works.d: Ees keskel kõrgendikul neljajalgsel olevusel sabakuues ja kübaraga ratsanik selgvaates kaugusesse vaatamas, käsi tõstetud. Tagapool avar värvikas maastik.(eesti)
works.de: In the front centre, on an elevation, a rider in a tailcoat and hat on a four-legged creature, looking into the distance in direct view, hand raised. Behind, an expansive, colourful landscape.

works.d: Istuv naisefiguur. Käed asetatud risti sülle, pea pööratud veidi vasakule. Temast vasakul väike, kirju, lendav liblikas.(eesti)
works.de: A seated female figure. Hands placed crossed in her lap, head turned slightly to the left. To her left a small, mottled, flying butterfly.

works.d: Täppivalt, rohelistes - kollastes toonides maalitud maastik. Puudealune metsatee ülekülvatud sillerdavatest päikeselaikudest. Puude kontuurid kergelt rõhutatud.
works.de: A landscape painted in dotted technique, in green-yellow tones. A forest road under the trees strewn with shimmering patches of sunlight. The contours of the trees slightly emphasised.

works.d: Kitsas, lumine vanalinna tänav. Kahel pool paari - kolmekordsed majad, mis koonduvad madalal silmapiirijoonel, vasakul ühte punkti. Vasakul üksik inimfiguur.
works.de: A narrow, snowy old-town street. On both sides two- to three-storey houses that converge on a low horizon line, towards a single point on the left. A solitary human figure on the left.

works.d: Paremalt vasakule läheb diagonaalselt kitsas tee, tehes vasakus servas kaare ning kadudes keskplaanis kasvava suure puu juures pildi sügavusse. Esiplaanil, tee veerel, maapinnale sinakaid varje heitev puu; paremal tee ääres, madal valge pink. Intensiivsed rohelised toonid, teelint roosa.
works.de: A narrow path runs diagonally from right to left, curving at the left edge and disappearing into the depth of the picture near a large tree growing in the middle ground. In the foreground, at the edge of the path, a tree casting bluish shadows on the ground; on the right by the path, a low white bench. Intense green tones, the path a pink ribbon.

works.d: Pildi sügavusse suunduv sirge tänav. Vasakul kõrge müür ja majad, paremal puuderivi. Tänaval paarikaupa jalakäijaid. Üle puude ning majakatuste paistab laik sinist taevast.
works.de: A straight street receding into the depth of the picture. On the left a high wall and houses, on the right a row of trees. Pedestrians walking in pairs on the street. A patch of blue sky shows above the trees and rooftops.

works.t: a) Igavesti naiselik; b) Tütarlaps harmoonikuga
works.d: Tugitoolis istuv sinises kleidis naine. Pea poolpöördes vasaku õla suunas.
works.de: Woman in a blue dress sitting in an armchair. Head half-turned towards the left shoulder.

works.d: Pikkade tumedate juustega punases kleidis tütarlapse poolfiguur profiilis vasakule.
works.de: Half-figure of a girl with long dark hair in a red dress, in profile to the left.

works.d: Tuhkjal veekogul esiplaanil kaks paati. Paremal osa kollasest hoonest, mille vari langeb vee pinnale. Taamal kallas majadega.
works.de: On an ashen body of water in the foreground two boats. On the right part of a yellow building, whose shadow falls on the surface of the water. In the background a shore with houses.

works.d: Visand viiest õunast.
works.de: Sketch of five apples.

works.d: Vaade Laialt tänavalt Oleviste kiriku poole. Esiplaanil päikesepaisteline tänav, ääristatud kõrgete viilkatustega majadega. Vasak tänavapool jääb varju. Tagaplaanil keskel kõrgub kirik, mille torn on pildi üleservaga äralõigatud.
works.de: View from Lai Street towards St. Olaf's Church. In the foreground a sunlit street, lined with houses with high gabled roofs. The left side of the street remains in shadow. In the background in the middle rises the church, whose tower is cut off by the upper edge of the picture.

works.d: Kaks alasti ratsurit pruunidel hobustel (profiilis). Taamal lehtpuid.
works.de: Two naked riders on brown horses (in profile). Deciduous trees in the distance.

works.d: Kiilaspäise mehe rinnapilt, en face, punase kaelasidemega.
works.de: Bust portrait of a bald man, en face, with a red necktie.

works.d: Esiplaanil osa laevast ja seitse meest võrkude ning nööridega.(eesti)
works.de: Part of a ship and seven men with nets and ropes in the foreground.

works.d: Esiplaanil võitlevate sõjameeste poolfiguurid, keskel linnus, taga talvine maastik.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground half-figures of fighting warriors, in the middle a fortress, behind a winter landscape.

works.d: Pruunijuukselise laulva tütarlapse poolfiguur poolprofiilis vasakule. Peas roheline turban, seljas valge, rindu paljaksjättev pluus. Selle üle tumelilla rüü. Paremas käes kokkukeeratud noodirull, vasakus avatud noodileht.
works.de: Half-figure of a brown-haired singing girl in half-profile to the left. On her head a green turban, wearing a white blouse leaving the chest bare. Over it a dark purple robe. In her right hand a rolled-up sheet of music, in her left an open sheet of music.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal meri, vasakul kallas purjekatega.
works.de: In the foreground on the right the sea, on the left the shore with sailboats.

works.d: Vanema mehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis, peapöördega vasaku õla suunas. Täishabemes halli vinet. Riietus tumedat värvi.
works.de: Bust portrait of an elderly man in half-profile, head turned towards the left shoulder. Full grey beard. Dark-coloured clothing.

works.d: Vasakul lumega kaetud kõrge kaljusein. Paremal, tunduvalt madalamal kaljurahnul lumised okaspuud.
works.de: On the left a high snow-covered rock face. On the right, considerably lower, snowy conifers on a rocky boulder.

works.d: Tallinna vanalinna vaade, mille esiplaanil Tolli tänav majadega ja tagaplaanil Oleviste kiriku torn.
works.de: View of Tallinn's Old Town, in the foreground of which Tolli Street with houses and in the background the tower of St Olaf's Church.

works.d: Peamiselt hallides toonides maalitud kompositsioon: esiplaanil paremal noore, kahkjas valguses naise aktifiguur toolil istumas. Vasakul all laud pudelite, värvituubide ja tuhatoosiga. Laua taga profiilis musta-valgetriibulises ürbis mehefiguur (A. Hoidre?). Fooniks abstraktsetest värvilaikudest kujundatud pindadega interjöör. Vertikaalse keskjoone kohal ülalt lilla, alt roosa väikest kuradit meenutav figuur. Paremal servas kaks perforatsiooniauku.
works.de: Composition painted mainly in grey tones: in the foreground on the right, a young woman's nude figure sits on a chair in pale light. On the lower left, a table with bottles, paint tubes and an ashtray. Behind the table, in profile, a male figure in black-and-white striped attire (A. Hoidre?). The background is an interior formed of abstract colour patches. Above the vertical centre line, a figure resembling a small devil, purple at the top and pink at the bottom. Two perforation holes on the right edge.

works.d: Pildi keskel lai liivane maantee kaugusesse suundumas. Vasakul teeservas puud, paremal maanteekraav tükikese rohelise aasaga. Taevas hallikasinine. Pildi paremas ülanurgas üksik valge pilvetutt. Pastoossed tugevad pintslilöögid, mitmes rohelises toonis üldkoloriit.
works.de: In the centre of the picture a wide sandy road heading into the distance. On the left edge of the road trees, on the right a road ditch with a small piece of green meadow. Sky greyish-blue. In the upper right corner of the picture a single tuft of white cloud. Pastose strong brushstrokes, overall colouring in several shades of green.

works.d: Esiplaanil istuva naise poolfiguur, sülle asetatud kätega. Tumedad, keskelt lahku kammitud lainelised juuksed. Roosal põhjal sini-punaste lilledega kleit pitskraega. Taustaks toa interjöör.
works.de: Half-figure of a seated woman in the foreground, with hands placed in her lap. Dark, wavy hair parted in the middle. Dress with blue-red flowers on a pink background, with a lace collar. Background a room interior.

works.d: Õhtune suvine maastik tumeda pilvise taevaga. Vasakus kuldlõikes õlgkatusega talumaja kõrge lävepakuga otsauksest väljuva lapsega, taamal paremal kaks rehehoonet ja väliköök, pildi paremas ääres puudegrupp puitaiaga; nende juures naine punase rätikuga peas. Esiplaanil paremas kuldlõikes kana poegadega, sellest paremal rebane kukega hambus. Pildi vasakus ääres puude vahel piirdeaiaga ümbritsetud õlgkatusega hoone. J. Köleri samateemalise akvarelliga võrreldes on erinevused väga üksikutes detailides.
works.de: An evening summer landscape with a dark cloudy sky. In the left golden section, a straw-roofed farmhouse with a child emerging from the high-threshold end door; further back on the right two threshing barns and an outdoor kitchen, at the right edge of the picture a group of trees with a wooden fence; near them a woman with a red kerchief on her head. In the foreground, in the right golden section, a hen with chicks, to its right a fox with a rooster in its jaws. At the left edge of the picture, among the trees, a straw-roofed building surrounded by a fence. Compared to J. Köler's watercolour on the same theme, the differences are only in very few details.

works.d: Esiplaanil madal liivane rannikuriba lautrile tõmmatud lootsikuga. Lautri kõrval hargil kuivavad purjed. Paremalt ulatub vette kitsas paadisild otsal asuva supelonniga. Vasakul laiub meri horisondini, paremal näha kauguses sinavat rannaviirgu.
works.de: In the foreground a low sandy coastal strip with a rowboat pulled onto the shore. Next to the boat, sails drying on a rack. From the right a narrow footbridge extends into the water with a bathing cabin at its end. On the left the sea stretches to the horizon, on the right a bluish coastline is visible in the distance.

works.d: Paremal asetseva laua kõrval oleval toolil istuv poisike poolprofiilis paremale. Jalad jalgpingil. Vasakus, küünarnukiga kõrvalolevale lauaservale toetatud käes keedetud vähk.(eesti)
works.de: A boy sitting in half-profile to the right on a chair beside a table on the right. Feet on a footstool. In his left hand, with the elbow resting on the edge of the adjoining table, a boiled crayfish.

works.dm: kõrgus: 381.0 cm (+ raam); laius: 160.5 cm (+ raam)
works.d: Ülestikku asetatud kaheosaline kompositsioon, vasakul äärel lai mustade siksak lõigetega valge raam. Alasti naise kolmveerandfiguur veerandpöördes paremale. Naise pea kuklas, ülakeha pisut tahapoole kallutatud, silmad suletud. Parem käsi hoiab rinna alt rohekat rõivast koomale, vasak rippu küljel. Figuuri jalad lõigatud sääremarja kohalt. Taust ülalt tuhmhall, punakas, alt rohekas markeeritud laia pintslilöögiga.(eesti)
works.de: Two-part composition placed one above the other, with a wide white frame with black zigzag cuts on the left edge. Three-quarter figure of a nude woman in a quarter-turn to the right. The woman's head is turned back, the upper body leaning slightly backwards, eyes closed. The right hand holds a greenish garment together under the breast, the left hangs at the side. The figure's legs are cut off at the calf. Background pale grey and reddish at the top, greenish at the bottom, marked with broad brushstrokes.

works.d: Istuva tüdruku põlvportree kerges pöördes paremale. Tüdrukul tumedates juustes punane pael, seljas valge särk, sinine kleit ja lillakaspunane vest. Tüdruku parem käsi puhkab süles, vasak puusa juures. Paremal alumises nurgas kauss puuviljadega, ülanurgas pruunikirju kann suure lillekimbuga. Vasakul foon üksteisesse sulavates pruunides, beezides, sinakates toonides.
works.de: Knee-length portrait of a seated girl in a slight turn to the right. The girl has a red ribbon in her dark hair, wears a white shirt, a blue dress and a purplish-red vest. The girl's right hand rests in her lap, the left near her hip. In the lower right corner a bowl with fruit, in the upper corner a brownish patterned jug with a large bouquet of flowers. On the left, the background merges into browns, beiges, bluish tones blending into one another.

works.d: Ees madal, kitsas ja rohtunud kanarbikupõõsastega kaetud kaldariba. Taga vasakul kõrge, järsuseinaline merre tungiv maanina. Keskel kuni silmapiirini laiub meri. Vasakul kalda lähedal purjekas ja lootsikud. 2/3 tööst kergelt pilvituva taeva all.
works.de: In front, a low, narrow shoreline strip overgrown with grass and covered with heather bushes. Behind, on the left, a high, steep-walled headland reaching into the sea. In the centre, the sea stretches to the horizon. On the left, near the shore, a sailboat and rowboats. 2/3 of the work under a slightly clouding sky.

works.d: Beežika maja ees seisavad kaks eakat naist. Vasakpoolne seisab ukselävel, peas punane rätik, seljas kollakas pluus, sinine vest ja sinakas toonis sitsseelik; jalas mustad sokid ja rohelised kingad. Naise käsi on küünarnukist tõstetud ning peos hoiab pikka, pliiatsilaadset eset. Teine naine seisab maali keskosas. Tema käed on kõhul, peod koos. Seljas kannab ta helesinist pluusi, punast vesti, sinist seelikut ning rohekat põlle. Jalas sinised kingad. Maalitud naiiv-realistlikus laadis.
works.de: In front of a beige house stand two elderly women. The one on the left stands in the doorway, a red kerchief on her head, wearing a yellowish blouse, a blue vest and a bluish-toned chintz skirt; black socks and green shoes on her feet. The woman's arm is raised at the elbow and her hand holds a long, pencil-like object. The other woman stands in the centre of the painting. Her hands are on her stomach, palms together. She wears a light blue blouse, a red vest, a blue skirt and a greenish apron. Blue shoes on her feet. Painted in a naive-realist style.

works.d: Kollakaspruunil lauatahvlil, mis katab maali alumise kolmandiku, asetsevad lillkapsas, selle ees paremal kolm kurki. Nende taga kaks suurt sibulat. Esiplaanil vasakus kuldlõikes kaks redist. Pildi vasakul poolel tühi laiakaelaline pudel, selle ees suur supilusikas ja poolik sidrun.
works.de: On a yellowish-brown table board covering the lower third of the painting lie a cauliflower, in front of it to the right three cucumbers. Behind them two large onions. In the foreground, in the golden section to the left, two radishes. On the left side of the picture an empty wide-necked bottle, in front of it a large soup spoon and half a lemon.

works.d: Roosakas taevas peegeldumas veekogule, millel esiplaanil paadisild paatidega. Taamal paremal purjekas. Vastaskallas laugjas.
works.de: A pinkish sky reflected on a body of water, on which in the foreground a boat dock with boats. In the distance on the right a sailboat. The opposite shore is gently sloping.

works.d: Seadeldise keskel ülalt ahenev pruun, tumeda dekooriga keraamiline vaas kolme roosaõielise lillega. Vasakul korvpudel ja tume tops. Paremal punaste lehtedega potilill ja osa mingist esemest. Taustal sinisekirju kangas vertikaalsete täppidena maalitud, ees roosakaspunane draperii.
works.de: In the centre of the arrangement a brown ceramic vase with dark decoration, narrowing towards the top, with three pink-flowered blooms. On the left a wicker basket and a dark cup. On the right a potted plant with red leaves and part of some object. In the background a blue-patterned fabric painted as vertical dots, in front a pinkish-red drapery.

works.d: Seina ääres osa madalast raamaturiiulist poolviltu nähtuna. Sellel ultramariinsinine ülalt ahenev kandiline vaas suure buketi punase ja ühe valge pojengiga, õielehti pudenenud riiulile. Taha, beezikale seinale, heidavad lilled varje, paremal nurk seinal rippuvast maalist.
works.de: By the wall, part of a low bookshelf seen at an angle. On it an ultramarine blue, angular vase tapering upward with a large bouquet of a red and a white peony, fallen petals on the shelf. Behind, on the beige-ish wall, the flowers cast shadows, on the right the corner of a painting hanging on the wall.

works.d: Tööpõlles ja tumedas pluusis istuv vanem mees poolpöördes vasakule. Mehel peas tume barett, hallid vuntsid ja väike habe. Mehe käed süles risti. Foon hallikaspruunides ja ookritoonides.
works.de: An older man in a work apron and dark blouse sitting in a half-turn to the left. The man wears a dark beret on his head, gray moustache and a small beard. The man's hands are crossed in his lap. The background in grayish-brown and ochre tones.

works.d: Kastil istuva  sasipäise tütarlapse täisfiguur. Tütarlapse käed kokkupandult süles.(eesti)
works.de: Full figure of a tousle-haired girl sitting on a box. The girl's hands folded in her lap.

works.d: Kitsas päikesest valgustatud hoovinurk madalate majade vahel.
works.de: A narrow, sun-lit courtyard corner between low houses.

works.d: Talutuba avatud uksega tagaseinas. Ees paremal seisev naine, vasakul maas kirves.
works.de: A farmhouse room with an open door in the back wall. In front on the right a standing woman, on the left an axe on the floor.

works.d: Lapsed ümber tüseda, suurte rindadega naise, kelle süles laps rinda imemas. Tagapõhi tume, naise paljale ülakehale langeb valgus.
works.de: Children around a stout woman with large breasts, a child at her breast suckling. The background dark, light falling on the woman's bare upper body.

works.d: Esiplaanil hooned puudega, taga vasakul veekogu ääres kirikud, taamal mäed.
works.de: In the foreground buildings with trees, behind on the left churches by a body of water, in the distance mountains.

works.d: Akna all laua ääres habemik mees ja lehte lugev naine. Laual mitmesugused tööriistad. Paremal riiul mitmesuguste esemetega, vasakul madal kapp, millel teekann.
works.de: Under the window, at the table, a bearded man and a woman reading a page. On the table various tools. On the right a shelf with various objects, on the left a low cabinet, on which a teapot.

works.d: Poolpimedas talutoas pildipinna keskel kaks naisefiguuri ja laps. Üks naistest, seljaga vaataja poole, ketrab; teine istub kõrval en face. Tagaservas laual küünal, mis heidab nõrka valgust figuuridele ja toaseintele.
works.de: In a half-dark farmhouse room, in the middle of the picture surface, two female figures and a child. One of the women, back to the viewer, is spinning; the other sits beside her en face. On a table at the back a candle, casting faint light on the figures and the walls of the room.

works.d: Sinisel taustal esiplaanil üleval neli inimpeadega olevust. Keskel vasakul sinistes toonides aasiapäraselt riietatud naisolevus. Tema taga kollakas toonis vanem nägu, kõrval kaks väikesemat figuuri roosakates rõivastes. Olendid on grupina vesikasvude (?) vahel. All keskel roosakates ja hallides toonides abstraktne kujutis.
works.de: Against a blue background, in the upper foreground, four beings with human heads. In the centre left, a female being in blue tones, dressed in an Asian-like manner. Behind her an older face in yellowish tones, beside it two smaller figures in pinkish garments. The beings are grouped among aquatic plants (?). At the bottom centre, an abstract image in pinkish and grey tones.

works.d: 60`aastate laadis kompositsioon stiliseeritud nelja inimfiguuriga. Kõik figuurid otsevaates ja täispikkuses. Keskel veidi lühem. Paremal serval seisva otsevaates figuuri pea on suunatud vasakule. Koloriidilt maalil domineerivad määrdunud pruunid, hallid, heledamad rohelised toonid. Helesinine värviaksent maali keskosas.
works.de: A composition in the style of the 1960s with four stylised human figures. All figures are shown frontally and full-length. The middle one is a little shorter. The head of the frontal figure standing at the right edge is turned to the left. The colour scheme of the painting is dominated by dirty brown, grey and lighter green tones. A light blue colour accent in the middle part of the painting.

works.d: Maalipind valdavalt tumesiniste, mustjas-roheliste voogavate lainekujunditega, vahel hõõguvpunased leegid, sädemed. Paremal all leekiva peaga leekivpunane poolakt, kõverdatud käed, parem jalg tõstetud, pimedusest esile kerkimas. Figuur niuete kohal käe embuses, temast paremal all avatud suuga suur hirmunud nägu. Ekspressiivne laad, läikiv maalipind, pahtlimaali faktuur, värviga vormiv.(eesti)
works.de: The painted surface predominantly with dark blue, blackish-green flowing wave shapes, at times glowing red flames, sparks. Below right a flaming red half-nude with a blazing head, bent arms, right leg raised, emerging from the darkness. The figure embraced by an arm at the hips, to its right below an open-mouthed large frightened face. Expressive manner, glossy painted surface, impasto texture, form-giving through colour.

works.d: Tumedajuukselise tõmmunahalise naise seisev täisfiguur keha en face, pea kerge pöördega vasakule. Seljas tume maani ulatuv seelik, üle õlgade roheline vöö vahele kinnitatud õlarätt. Peas valge seljale langev rätik.
works.de: Standing full figure of a dark-haired, dark-skinned woman, body en face, head turned slightly to the left. Wearing a dark ankle-length skirt, over the shoulders a green sash fastening a shoulder shawl. On the head a white kerchief falling onto the back.

works.d: Stseen turult. Esiplaanil talupoja vanker, hobune paremal. Vankrist paremal seisab kübaraga talumees põrsas kätel. Vankri taga kolm naist, üks päevavarjuga, teine lõua all seotud kübaraga, kolmas korv käevangus - põrsast vaatamas. Esiplaan varjus, tagaplaan valgustatud - seal heledad laubalaudade katted ja õrnsinine riba taevast.
works.de: A scene from the market. In the foreground a peasant's cart, a horse on the right. To the right of the cart stands a peasant man in a hat holding a piglet in his arms. Behind the cart three women, one with a parasol, another with a hat tied under the chin, a third with a basket on her arm - looking at the piglet. The foreground is in shadow, the background is lit - there, pale gable-board roof coverings and a faint blue strip of sky.

works.d: Ees paremal tiigi nurk partidega. Vasakul, kaldal, kintspükstes, sabakuues ja kõvas kübaras, seljapaunaga turjal, "graatsilises" poosis mees partidele toitu pakkumas. Taga paremal üksik eluhoone.
works.de: In front, on the right, a corner of a pond with ducks. On the left, on the bank, a man in knee-breeches, a tailcoat and a top hat, with a knapsack on his back, in a "graceful" pose, offering food to the ducks. Behind, on the right, a solitary dwelling house.

works.d: Vasakul istub nukrailmeline tumedas ülikonnas noormees, temast paremal sinises riietuses ja kübaras naine, kes hoiab enese ees laual lillekimpu.
works.de: On the left sits a sad-looking young man in a dark suit, to his right a woman in blue clothing and a hat, holding a bouquet of flowers on the table in front of her.

works.d: Must kitsas raam
works.de: Black narrow frame

works.dm: laius: 11.3 cm; kõrgus: 15.8 cm; kõrgus: 17.1 cm; laius: 10.9 cm
works.d: Kurruline maastik, esiplaanil nõos seisvate palkmajadega kerkib keskplaanil liivase mäenõlvakuna kõrgendikuks. Sellel paistab taamal õigeusu kiri ja lehtpuude salu.
works.de: A folded landscape, in the foreground log houses standing in a hollow, rising in the middle ground as a sandy hillside into an elevation. On it, in the distance, an Orthodox church and a grove of deciduous trees can be seen.

works.d: Pildi kompositsioonilises keskpunktis kaks järve: esiplaanil asuva järve ääres üks kask pildi servas ees ja kaks kaske paremas servas. Järvede ääres vasakul ja paremal majad, vasakul servas tume metsatukk, silmapiiril sinakas metsaviirg. Ülal helehallide pilvedega tihedalt kaetud taevas.
works.de: At the compositional centre of the picture two lakes: by the lake in the foreground one birch at the edge of the picture in front and two birches at the right edge. Houses by the lakes on the left and right, a dark clump of forest at the left edge, a bluish strip of forest on the horizon. Above, a sky densely covered with light grey clouds.

works.d: Pildil esiplaanil lumine tänav. Paremale jääb osa müürist ning madal, punase katusega maja; vasakule kollaseks värvitud maja nurk. Tänava otsas avaneb vaade Toomkirikule.
works.de: A snowy street in the foreground of the picture. On the right is part of a wall and a low house with a red roof; on the left the corner of a house painted yellow. At the end of the street, a view of Toomkirik (the Dome Church) opens up.

works.d: Esiplaanil keskel pika kuuega mees ema järel lehma tirimas, temast vasakul tahapoole suunduv vanker kahe figuuriga, kellest üks tagantvaates. Vankri kõrval vasakul lehm. Maali esiplaanil paremal varjualune mitme figuuriga laua ümber. Tagaplaanil hulk inimesi, vankreid ja hobuseid.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground, in the centre, a man in a long coat pulling a cow after his mother; to his left a cart heading backward with two figures, one seen from behind. Beside the cart on the left a cow. In the foreground on the right of the painting a shelter with several figures around a table. In the background a number of people, carts and horses.

works.t: Paldiski rand. Vaade Pakri saarelt Paldiskile.
works.d: Vasakul meresopp, mille tagant paistab rannaviirg majadega. Paremal kõrge poolmurenenud paekallas. Taevas pilvitatud.(eesti)
works.de: On the left a sea inlet, behind which a coastal strip with houses is visible. On the right a high, partly weathered limestone bank. The sky is clouded.

works.d: Mustas kuues ja sinistes pükstes istuva noorema mehe poolfiguur. Parem käsi süles, vasak püksitaskus.
works.de: Half-figure of a younger man sitting, in a black coat and blue trousers. Right hand in his lap, left hand in his trouser pocket.

works.d: Bordoopunasel ja sinistes toonides draperiidel istuv aktifiguur; sääred ristatud, käed toetavad külgedel peopesadega toolile. Pruunide lokkis juustega pea pisut vasemale kallutatud, lõug tõstetud. Foon sinakashall, ookrikarva õrnade triipidega. Aktifiguur maalitud kollastes ja lillaes toonides.(eesti)
works.de: A nude figure sitting on burgundy-red and blue-toned drapery; legs crossed, hands resting on the chair at the sides with palms down. The head with brown curly hair tilted slightly to the left, chin raised. The background is bluish-grey, with delicate ochre-coloured stripes. The nude figure is painted in yellow and lilac tones.

works.d: Paremalt alt hargnev lehtpuu oksastik lopsakate lehtedega. Okste vahel suurelehelisi viinamarjavääte. Lõuendi vasakpoolne alumine nurk 26 x 8,5 cm ulatuses värviga katmata krunt.
works.de: A branch of a deciduous tree with lush leaves, branching from the lower right. Between the branches large-leaved grapevine tendrils. The lower left corner of the canvas has an area of 26 x 8.5 cm of unpainted ground.

works.dm: kujutise kõrgus: 30.5 cm; lehe laius: 27.9 cm
works.d: Kuust valgustatud lainetav meri. Ees vasakul kaljul istuv pikkade õlgadele langevate juustega vanamees selgvaates. Paremal lainete kohal kaks hoogsalt ettepoole liikuvat nägemuslikku figuuri.
works.de: A moonlit, undulating sea. In front, on the left, on a cliff, an old man seen from the back, with long hair falling to his shoulders. On the right, above the waves, two visionary figures moving briskly forward.

works.d: Tumedajuukselise valges õlgu pljaks jätvas kleidis noore naise poolfiguur peaaegu en face. Üle õlgade õhuline sall.
works.de: Half-figure, almost en face, of a young dark-haired woman in a white off-the-shoulder dress. A light scarf across her shoulders.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremalt vasakule langusega nõlvaku jalal hulk inimesi tihedalt koos istumas; vasakul pool ees murul istuvad inimesed, nende taga, teel, talumees hobuse ja vankriga. Vankri järel kaks meest jalutut naist kandmas. Nõlvakul, puude ja põõsaste vahel istuvaid inimesi väiksemate rühmadena koos. Paremal äärel habemik vanamees ja puu otsa roninud poiss. Taga vasakul näha kauguses peegelduvat järve pinda.
works.de: In the foreground, at the foot of a slope descending from right to left, a crowd of people sitting closely together; on the left in front people sitting on the grass, behind them, on the road, a peasant man with a horse and cart. Behind the cart two men carrying a lame woman. On the slope, among trees and bushes, people sitting together in smaller groups. At the right edge a bearded old man and a boy who has climbed a tree. In the background on the left the reflecting surface of a lake can be seen in the distance.

works.d: a) Esiplaanil külatänav, paremal kaks rookatusega talumaja. Vasakul suur tiibadega kiviveski ja selle kõrval madal punase katusega hoone. Kolmveerand pildipinnast võtab enda alla pilvine taevas.
works.de: a) In the foreground a village street, on the right two thatched-roof farmhouses. On the left a large stone windmill with wings and next to it a low building with a red roof. Three-quarters of the picture surface is taken up by a cloudy sky.

works.d: Vasemapoolne külglööv, paremal peielaud.
works.de: Left-side aisle, on the right a funeral table.

works.d: Istuva noor naise poolportree otsevaates: naisel tumedad, kergelt laines juuksed, heledate kulmude ja väikeste, teineteisest lahus asetsevate silmadega nägu. Naisel seljas valge pluus, tume jakk või keep ja kollane seelik. Foon kollasega tembitud roosa.
works.de: A frontal half-portrait of a seated young woman: the woman has dark, slightly wavy hair, a face with light eyebrows and small eyes set apart from each other. The woman wears a white blouse, a dark jacket or cape and a yellow skirt. Background pink tinged with yellow.

works.d: Mehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale, halli habeme ja turbaniga.(eesti)
works.de: Bust portrait of a man in half-profile to the right, with a grey beard and a turban.

works.d: Tumedajuukselise poisikese rinnapilt. Pea kerge pöördega paremale. Seljas kõrge kraega koolipoisi vormikuub.
works.de: Bust portrait of a dark-haired boy. Head turned slightly to the right. Wearing a high-collared schoolboy's uniform coat.

works.d: Valgel pinnal valdavalt all ja paremal sakiliste servadega hõbehall pinnaline kujund. Sellel paiknevad omakorda värvilised, justkui paberist välja lõigatud dekoratiivsed laigud. Vasakult alates kahvatuhall, väiksem must, küpskollane, millel koobaltsinine ja paremal ülal punane kujund.
works.de: On a white surface, mostly at the bottom and on the right, a silver-grey planar shape with jagged edges. On this in turn lie coloured decorative patches, as if cut out of paper. Starting from the left a pale grey, a smaller black, cadmium yellow, on which a cobalt blue, and on the upper right a red shape.

works.d: Esiplaanil grupp kätega žestikuleerivaid mehi hobust kauplemas, vasakpoolsed kaks vaataja suunas, parempoolne profiilis. Tagapoolt kaabuga talumehi, vasakpoolne ratsa. Esiplaan varjus, tagaplaan valgustatud, siin heledaid kaubalaudade katteid ja kolmnurkne osa õrnsinist taevast.
works.de: In the foreground a group of men gesturing with their hands while trading a horse, the two on the left facing the viewer, the one on the right in profile. Behind them peasants in hats, the one on the left mounted. The foreground is in shadow, the background is lit, here light-coloured coverings of market stalls and a triangular patch of pale blue sky.

works.dm: laius: 39.4 cm (arm.   ); kõrgus: 28.3 cm (vm.   ); kõrgus: 29.6 cm (arm.   ); laius: 37.7 cm (vm.   )
works.d: Esiplaanil puude ja põõsaste vahel asuvad majad. Vasakul suurel kivil kaks meest istumas. Keskel veekogu - lahesopp paari ankrus purjekaga. Taamal üle vee mäejalal asula, mille parempoolseks piiriks mäel asuva linnuse varemed.
works.de: In the foreground houses among trees and bushes. On the left two men sitting on a large rock. In the centre a body of water - a bay inlet with a sailing boat at anchor. In the distance, across the water, a settlement at the foot of a mountain, its right-hand boundary the ruins of a fortress on the mountain.

works.d: 2-osaline, parem ca 1/3 vasakust. Laia pintsli ja spaatliga maalitud erksavärviline abstraktne kompositsioon vaarikapunase, erksinise, kollase, helerohelise kombinatsioonis. Heledate värvipindade vahel jõuliste punase joontega markeeritud kujundeid, pindu, jooni.(eesti)
works.de: 2-part work, right part approx. 1/3 of the left. Brightly coloured abstract composition painted with a wide brush and palette knife, in a combination of raspberry red, bright blue, yellow, light green. Between light-coloured areas of colour, forms, surfaces and lines marked with forceful red lines.

works.d: Keskel neli hirve põõsastiku keskel. Ülal linnud okstel.
works.de: In the centre four deer amid bushes. Birds on branches above.

works.d: Rangelt geomeetrilisteks pindadeks jaotatud kompositsioon majadest, mille mahud põimudes moodustavad dünaamilise struktuuri, kuhu tungivad kiilutaolised kujundid. Tumedates sinistes, hallides, rohelistes ja mustades toonides.(eesti)
works.de: A composition strictly divided into geometric planes of houses, whose volumes interlace to form a dynamic structure, into which wedge-like shapes intrude. In dark blue, grey, green and black tones.

works.d: Keskealise mehe rinnaportree otsevaates: kõrge laup, tõstetud kulmud, kurrud laubal, pealagi poolpaljas, kergelt muigel ilme. Seljas karusnahkse kraega talvemantel, valge sall kaelas. Ühtlaselt rohekashallis gammas realistlikus laadis maal.
works.de: Bust portrait of a middle-aged man in frontal view: high forehead, raised eyebrows, wrinkles on the forehead, top of the head half bald, expression with a slight smirk. Wearing a winter coat with a fur collar, a white scarf around the neck. A painting in realistic style in a uniform greenish-grey gamut.

works.d: Esiplaanil madalal rannal vasakul võrgumajad, paremal kaldale veetud paate ja purjekaid. Taga keskel purjekaid, nende taga maja. Paremal meri.
works.de: In the foreground on a low shore, on the left net houses, on the right boats and sailboats pulled up onto the shore. Behind, in the middle, sailboats, behind them a house. On the right the sea.

works.d: Esiplaanil parempoolsete madalate kaljurüngaste vahel puudesalu ja väike onn. Pisut tagapool, vasakul kuuskede rida. Taustaks kõrged mäeahelikud.
works.de: In the foreground, among low rocky crags on the right, a grove of trees and a small hut. A little further back, on the left, a row of spruces. High mountain ranges in the background.

works.d: Esiplaanil kolmest küljest madala, avadega müüriga piiratud plats, mille taga sinise taeva taustal kellatornidega hoone.
works.de: In the foreground a square enclosed on three sides by a low wall with openings, behind it against a blue sky background a building with bell towers.

works.d: Keskealise mehe portree kerges pöördes vasakule. Tumedad juuksed, põskhabe. Tume kuub, beež vest, valge kaelaside.
works.de: Portrait of a middle-aged man in a slight turn to the left. Dark hair, side-whiskers. Dark coat, beige waistcoat, white necktie.

works.d: Istuva tumedate poolpikkade juustega tütarlapse portree: seljas tumesinine seelik ja heledam sinine pullover. Käed süles risti, nägu profiilis. Foon sinine, kogu pilt tihedalt pintsliga läbi töötatud pintslilööke paista lastes.
works.de: Portrait of a seated girl with dark medium-length hair: wearing a dark blue skirt and a lighter blue pullover. Hands crossed in her lap, face in profile. Background blue, the whole picture densely worked through with the brush, letting brushstrokes show.

works.d: Pikkade looklevate pintslilöökidega maalitud panoraamne maastikuvaade. Esiplaanist jookseb pildi sügavusse looklev jõgi, mille kaldail ookritoonides luht. Keskplaanis tihe põõsastik, mille taga laiuvad silmapiirini kollased põllud. Silmapiiril väikesed lillades ja sinistes toonides antud puud ja põõsad, ülal erksinine taevas kollaka pilvesäbruga.(eesti)
works.de: A panoramic landscape view painted with long winding brushstrokes. A winding river runs from the foreground into the depth of the picture, its banks a meadow in ochre tones. In the middle ground dense bushes, behind which yellow fields extend to the horizon. On the horizon small trees and bushes given in purple and blue tones, above a bright blue sky with a yellowish fringe of clouds.

works.d: Kalalaeva pardal, paremal kastide peal istuvad kaks meest; nende kõrval üks seisev mees. Taga vasakul laevad.
works.de: On board a fishing boat, on the right two men sitting on crates; next to them one standing man. Behind on the left, ships.

works.d: Halli juuste ja põskhabemega vanema mehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale. Peas kalott. Parem käsi rinnal.
works.de: Bust of an elderly man with grey hair and side-whiskers, in half-profile facing right. Wearing a skullcap. Right hand on chest.

works.d: Esiplaanil plats inimfiguuridega, vasakul park, paremal ja taga majad, tagaplaanil vasakul veeriba ja mäed.
works.de: In the foreground a square with human figures, on the left a park, on the right and behind houses, in the background on the left a strip of water and mountains.

works.d: Esiplaanil kolm noort lehtpuud, nende taga kitsas põlluriba. Põllu taga üksikute suurte puude vahelt valendamas viljaväljad.
works.de: In the foreground three young deciduous trees, behind them a narrow strip of field. Beyond the field, grain fields showing pale between individual large trees.

works.d: Künklik maapind. Keskplaanil väike lehtpuusalu. Maali pind faktuurne. Maastik maalitud rohelistes, pruunides ja kollastes toonides.(eesti)
works.de: Hilly terrain. In the middle ground a small grove of deciduous trees. The surface of the painting is textured. The landscape is painted in green, brown and yellow tones.

works.d: Rohelisel, veetaimedega kaetud foonil ümmargused ja sigarikujulised, ülalt ahenevad miinid. Ülaosas kolm tehnilist konstruktsiooni ja punased suitsupilved spektritaolisel foonil.(eesti)
works.de: On a green background covered with water plants, round and cigar-shaped mines tapering at the top. In the upper part three technical constructions and red clouds of smoke on a spectrum-like background.

works.d: Butafoorne maastik: esiplaanil vasakul klumbil kooniliseks pügatud põõsad, neist keskmise ümber hekk ja suured roosad õied. Pildi sügavusse suunduvast pargiteest vasakul sirges reas korrapäraseks pügatud põõsad, teest paremal suurele nelinurgale maalitud jupp maastikku kadakatega. Ruumi tagaseinas roheline mets, lael kujutatud pilvist taevast.
works.de: A stage-set landscape: in the foreground on the left a flowerbed with bushes trimmed into cone shapes, around the middle one a hedge and large pink flowers. To the left of a park path leading into the depth of the picture, a straight row of regularly trimmed bushes; to the right of the path a fragment of landscape with junipers painted onto a large rectangle. In the rear wall of the space a green forest, on the ceiling a cloudy sky is depicted.

works.dm: kõrgus: 80.0 cm; laius: 41.0 cm; laius: 41.0 cm; kõrgus: 80.0 cm
works.d: Kahest osast koosnev kompositsioon: siniste, roheliste ja punaste draperiide taustal mänguasjad - kollaste juuste ja kleidiga nukk, punane kala, kollane ratastel lambatall, roheline ninasarvik ja lambipirn.
works.de: A composition of two parts: against a background of blue, green and red draperies, toys - a doll with yellow hair and a dress, a red fish, a yellow sheep on wheels, a green rhinoceros and a light bulb.

works.d: Koosneb kahest teineteise peale asetatud lõuendist. Ülemise ruudu allääre lähedal kauge, tumeda metsatriibuga silmapiir, kuhu koonduvad ähvardav hallikas-punakas toonis pragunenud maa taoline taevas ja erepunane, sinkjasvalgete lumelaikudega soomaastik, esiplaanil tumedad kõrkjad. Kaugemal, kahel pool pruunikas-hallid põõsapuhmad.
works.de: Consists of two canvases placed one above the other. Near the lower edge of the upper square, a distant horizon with a dark strip of forest, where a threatening greyish-reddish, cracked-earth-like sky and a bright red bog landscape with bluish-white patches of snow converge, with dark sedges in the foreground. Further away, on both sides, brownish-grey clumps of bushes.

works.d: Horisontaalsel keskjoonel traatvõrgust aed, millest tagapool üksteisesse sulavates rohelistes toonides puud ning leekivpunaste taimede viirg. Esiplaanil valge trepiaste punaste sulgjate taimetuttidega kahel pool. Astmest viib vertikaalsel keskjoonel asetsev autoratta jälgedega aiatee kaarvärava suunas. Aiatees kahel pool rohelised muruplatsid. Pildi ülaosas heleroheline akvarellilaadselt antud taevas.
works.de: On the horizontal centre line a wire-mesh fence, behind which trees in blending green tones and a strip of flaming red plants. In the foreground a white step with tufts of red feather-like plants on both sides. From the step, along the vertical centre line, a garden path with car-wheel tracks leads toward an arched gate. On both sides of the garden path green lawns. In the upper part of the picture a light green, watercolour-like sky.

works.d: Ees Tartumaa rahvarõivais seisva mehe ja naise täisfiguurid. Ülal paremal nurgas taluhoone.
works.de: In front, full figures of a man and a woman standing in Tartumaa folk costume. In the upper right corner, a farm building.

works.d: Võrumaa rahvarõivais seisva mehe (en face) ja selgvaates naise täisfiguurid. Ülal paremal nurgas jõesuudme motiiv kahe kuusega.
works.de: Full figures of a man standing (en face) and a woman seen from the side, in the folk costume of Võrumaa. In the upper right corner a motif of a river mouth with two spruces.

works.d: Esiplaanil ümarakaareliste aknaorvadega lossi varemed. Vasakul sammastik. Kaugemal lage maastik, silmapiiril laugjad mäed. Maal osaliselt katmata, alusjoonis kumab läbi.
works.de: In the foreground ruins of a castle with round-arched window bays. Colonnade on the left. Farther away an open landscape, gently sloping mountains on the horizon. The painting is partly unfinished, the underdrawing shows through.

works.t: a) Moonid kollases vaasis; b) Maastiku etüüd
works.dm: laius: 60.5 cm (b); kõrgus: 60.5 cm (a); kõrgus: 37.7 cm (b); laius: 37.7 cm (a)
works.d: a) sinakasmustal taustal helekollane ülalt ahenev vaas suure punastes-roosades õites kimbuga. Maalitud hoogsalt, pastoosselt.
works.de: a) against a bluish-black background a light yellow vase narrowing at the top with a large bouquet of red-pink flowers. Painted vigorously, pastose.

works.d: b) Kaks naist. Etüüd. Keskosas heledas kleidis seisev naine, pea profiilis, tõstetud. Paremal, tema taga teine naine kallutab üle esimese õla. Maal pruunikasrohelises koloriidis, figuurid sulavad tausta.
works.de: b) Two women. Study. In the centre a woman standing in a light-coloured dress, her head in profile, raised. On the right, behind her, another woman leans over her shoulder. The painting is in a brownish-green colour scheme, the figures merging into the background.

works.d: Ühtlaselt halli talvetaeva taustal lumiste  katustega majad. Peaaegu poole maali pinnast võtavad enda alla esiplaanil olevad külmades värvivarjundeis lumehanged.
works.de: Against a uniformly grey winter sky, houses with snowy roofs. Almost half the surface of the painting is taken up by the snowdrifts in the foreground, in cold colour shades.

works.d: Sügismaastik kahe, valge - pruuni laigulise, kirjakuga. All vasakus nurgas koer, keha 3/4 pöördes vasakule, pea pööratud paremale. Ülemises paremas 1/4 kuldkollane kask; taga vasakul suured kivid ning mõned põõsad. Värvigamma hele.
works.de: Autumn landscape with two dogs, white with brown patches, with markings. In the lower left corner, a dog, its body turned 3/4 to the left, head turned to the right. In the upper right 1/4, a golden-yellow birch; behind, on the left, large stones and a few bushes. Light colour scheme.

works.d: Ees vasakul veekogu, milles peegelduvad kaldaäärsed põõsad. Veidi eemal seitse raagus puud ning madal metsaviirg. Koloriit pruunikas - hallides tiinides. Pintslikiri täppiv.
works.de: In the front on the left a body of water in which the bushes along the shore are reflected. A little further away, seven bare trees and a low strip of forest. Colouring in brownish - grey tones. Precise brushwork.

works.d: Heinamaal, põõsastiku taustal valge, pruuni peaga lehm, pofiilis paremale. Paremas servas tumeda lehestikuga põõsas. Kontuur kohati rõhutatud.
works.de: In a meadow, against a background of bushes, a white cow with a brown head, in profile to the right. In the right edge a bush with dark foliage. The contour emphasised in places.

works.d: Esiplaanil rohetavate samblalaikudega kaetud suuremad ja väiksemad kivid. Nende vahel kasvamas paar puud. Tagaplaanil kollendav viljapõld.
works.de: In the foreground larger and smaller stones covered with greenish moss patches. A couple of trees growing among them. In the background a yellowing grain field.

works.d: Kogu pildipinna võtab enda alla sihvaka tüvega männi haraliste okstega latv. Taust diagonaalselt kaheks pinnaks, mets roheliseks ning taevas siniseks jagatud.
works.de: The entire picture surface is occupied by the treetop with spreading branches of a slender-trunked pine. The background is divided diagonally into two areas, the forest green and the sky blue.

works.t: a) Lamav akt; b) Lilled aknal
works.dm: kõrgus: 22.0 cm (a) km ); laius: 25.8 cm (lm); laius: 25.2 cm (a) km); kõrgus: 24.2 cm (lm)
works.d: a) Punasel taustal selili lebav alasti naisefiguur. Parem käsi küljele väljasirutatud, vasak kõverdatud pea juurde. Pea pöördes paremale.
works.de: a) A naked female figure lying on her back against a red background. Right arm stretched out to the side, left arm bent toward the head. Head turned to the right.

works.d: Rohelisel foonil, seljaga vaataja poole vasakul küljel lamav naisakt. Figuur joonistatud sinise pastelliga.
works.de: On a green background, a female nude lying on her left side, back to the viewer. The figure is drawn with blue pastel.

works.d: Vanema naise 3/4 figuur, pöördes paremale. Pea kergelt ette kallutatud, käed vaheliti rinnal. Tumedaid juukseid katab pottmüts, ümber õlgade sügavsinine rätt. Taust ooker.
works.de: 3/4 figure of an older woman, turned to the right. Head slightly bowed forward, hands crossed on the chest. Dark hair covered by a pot-shaped cap, a deep blue shawl around the shoulders. Background ochre.

works.d: Valges särgis mehefiguur, paremas käes paljastatud mõõk. Vasak käsi pistetud vöövahele. Taustaks mets.
works.de: Figure of a man in a white shirt, a bared sword in his right hand. Left hand tucked into his belt. Background of forest.

works.d: Vaade Rataskaevu tänavale. Paremale jäävad Mihkli ja Niguliste kiriku hooned; vasakul punasekatuselised elumajad. Värvigamma hele, hallika üldtooniga.
works.de: View of Rataskaevu Street. On the right are the buildings of St Michael's and St Nicholas' churches; on the left residential houses with red roofs. Colour range light, with a greyish overall tone.

works.d: Heledal draperiil selili asendis naisakt, pea pööratud vaataja poole, silmad suletud. Vasak, kõverdatud käsi kukla taga, parem näo juures. Tumedad lahkukammitud juuksed langevad punasele draperiile. Jalad põlvest kõverdatud, alakeha pööratud vaataja poole. Foonil vasakul sinakas draperii. Akt maalitud hallikasbeezides toonides plastilist vormi rõhutades.
works.de: A female nude lying on her back on a light drapery, head turned towards the viewer, eyes closed. The left, bent arm behind the back of the head, the right near the face. Dark hair, parted and combed, falls onto the red drapery. Legs bent at the knee, the lower body turned towards the viewer. In the background on the left a bluish drapery. The nude is painted in greyish-beige tones, emphasizing the plastic form.

works.d: Laual, vasakul punutud korv täis viinamarju. Paremal, korvi kõrval lahtilõigatud arbuus.
works.de: On a table, on the left a woven basket full of grapes. On the right, next to the basket, a cut-open watermelon.

works.d: Fantastilise peakattega pea pöördes paremale. Näha sõlmitud juuksepalmik. Ümber stiliseeritud taimi ja lehti.
works.de: A head with a fantastical headdress, turned to the right. A knotted plait of hair is visible. Surrounded by stylised plants and leaves.

works.d: Heledapäise rohelises pluusis poisikese rinnapilt poolprofiilis vasakule.
works.de: Bust portrait of a fair-haired boy in a green blouse, in half-profile to the left.

works.d: Esiplaanil liival kaks istuvat naisefiguuri, eemal kaldal paate ja meeste figuure, paremal meri purjekatega.
works.de: In the foreground on the sand two seated female figures, in the distance on the shore boats and figures of men, on the right the sea with sailboats.

works.d: Künklik talvine maastik üksikute raagus puudega esiplaanil. Taamal puude vahelt paistab lagedaid künkaid.
works.de: A hilly winter landscape with solitary bare trees in the foreground. In the distance, bare hills visible among the trees.

works.d: Kõrge, pruun hobune külgvaates; paremal puu. Taustaks puid.
works.de: A tall, brown horse in profile; a tree on the right. Trees in the background.

works.t: Vaade Pirita jõele ja kloostri varemetele
works.d: Üle puulatvade esiplaanil paistab Pirita jõe Kase-poolne kallas, kus seisavad kaks meest ühe poisikesega (keskel). Teiselpool jõge, tagapool, mäekünkal Pirita kloostri varemed. Eemal taustal meri ja Viimsi poolsaare siluett.
works.de: Over the treetops in the foreground can be seen the Kose side of the bank of the Pirita River, where two men stand with a boy (in the middle). On the other side of the river, further back, on a hill knoll the ruins of Pirita Convent. In the distance in the background the sea and the silhouette of the Viimsi peninsula.

works.d: Esiplaanil karjamaa, vasakul suured kivid, karjapoiss; keskel põõsad; taga Toompea nõlvak Toomkiriku ja Pika Hermaniga.
works.de: In the foreground, a pasture, on the left large stones, a shepherd boy; in the middle bushes; behind, the slope of Toompea with the Cathedral Church and Pikk Hermann.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasemal grupp murul istuvaid inimesi, paremal põõsastik. Tagapool keskel, vasemal puud (maali ülaservale ulatuvad) ja kivise kaldaga lahesopp. Taamal Tallinna siluett.
works.de: In the foreground on the left a group of people sitting on the grass, on the right shrubbery. Beyond, in the middle, on the left, trees (reaching to the upper edge of the painting) and a bay with a stony shore. In the distance the silhouette of Tallinn.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 18.1 cm; lehe laius: 14.0 cm
works.d: Ampiir soengus ja riietuses seisva noore naise poolfiguur. Taustaks süngetes toonides mägine maastik.
works.de: Half-figure of a young woman standing, in an Empire-style hairdo and dress. Background a mountainous landscape in sombre tones.

works.d: Keskel hallikas - valgel eeslil ratsutav Kristus. Tema kuju külg - asendis, pea pööratud vaatega üle vasaku õla tagasi. Seljas rohekas rüü. Nii Kristuse ees kui ka taga inimeste grupid teda saatmas ja tervitamas. Paremal taga linna kujutis. Linna ees olevatel inimestel käes väikesed palmioksad. Vasakul pool taga pruunid mäed, keskel suur puu.
works.de: In the centre, Christ riding a grayish-white donkey. His figure in profile, head turned looking back over his left shoulder. Wearing a greenish robe. Both in front of and behind Christ, groups of people accompany and greet him. In the back on the right, a depiction of a city. The people in front of the city hold small palm branches in their hands. In the back on the left, brown mountains, a large tree in the centre.

works.d: Keskel seisab jõevees meesfiguur, valge rätik ümber puusade, keha pöördes vasakule. Vasakul seisab kummargil teine mees - Ristija Johannes, kes puudutab parema käega vees seisva Kristuse pead. Johannese riietus rohelistes - punastes toonides. Paremal pool jõge seisavad kolm kummarduvat inglit, suunaga Kristuse poole. All vasakus nurgas seisab väike puu, mille võras on horisontaalselt asetatud must kirves. Ülal keskel Püha Vaimu sümbol - valge tuvi.
works.de: In the middle, a male figure stands in the river water, a white cloth around his hips, his body turned to the left. On the left, another man stands bent over - John the Baptist, touching with his right hand the head of Christ standing in the water. John's clothing is in green-red tones. On the right side of the river stand three bowing angels, facing toward Christ. In the lower left corner stands a small tree, in whose crown a black axe is placed horizontally. At the top centre, the symbol of the Holy Spirit - a white dove.

works.d: Keskel, paksust klaasist, ülasuunas kooniliselt ahenevas vaasis, suur kimp värviliste sügislehtedega oksi, mõne küljes musta aroonia kobarad. Vaasi taga vasakul beez keraamiline kauss, arooniaoks üle ääre rippumas. Esiplaanil paremal mõned lauale pudenenud punased lehed. Foon hallikasroheline.
works.de: In the centre, in a thick glass vase tapering conically upward, a large bunch of branches with colourful autumn leaves, some with clusters of black chokeberries. Behind the vase on the left a beige ceramic bowl, with a chokeberry branch hanging over its rim. In the foreground on the right some red leaves fallen onto the table. The background greyish-green.

works.d: Ülaltvaade Tallinna vanalinna katustele ja kaugemal paistvale sadamale, lahele. Summutatud toonides, geometriseerivas laadis maal lähestikku asetsevate majade katuste, korstnate, müüride tahukatest, üks heledamalt valgustatud majasein paremal. Majade taga veepiiril paistab kraananokki, laevu reidil, kaugemal lahel kaks valget purje. Silmapiiril kaldatriip ja riba sinkjat taevast.
works.de: A bird's-eye view of the roofs of Tallinn's Old Town and, further away, the visible harbour and bay. A painting in muted tones, in a geometrising style, of the closely placed cubic shapes of house roofs, chimneys, and walls, with one more brightly lit house wall on the right. Behind the houses, on the water's edge, crane booms and ships in the roadstead can be seen, further away on the bay two white sails. On the horizon a strip of shoreline and a band of bluish sky.

works.d: Vanema mehe rinnaportree en face. Must ülikond valge rinnaesise ja ristlipsuga, hall habe ja pruunikad juuksed.
works.de: Bust portrait of an elderly man en face. Black suit with white shirt front and cross tie, grey beard and brownish hair.

works.d: Esiplaanil vesi, all keskel näha paadinina. Vasakul tagapool majad.
works.de: Water in the foreground, a boat's bow visible below in the middle. Houses further back on the left.

works.d: Šarž kunstnikust: istuva naise poolfiguur en face; käes ees vaheliti, peas kübar.
works.de: Caricature of the artist: half-figure of a seated woman en face; hands crossed in front, hat on head.

works.d: Šarž kunstnikust: koolipingis istuva mehe figuur profiilis vasemale. Seinal tahvel arvutusega 1 x 1 = 1
works.de: Caricature of the artist: the figure of a man sitting at a school desk, in profile to the left. On the wall a board with the calculation 1 x 1 = 1

works.d: Šarž kunstnikust: mehe põlvpilt profiilis vasakule. Käed kõhul kokku pandud.
works.de: Caricature of the artist: a knee-length portrait of a man in profile facing left. Hands folded on the stomach.

works.d: Ees, rohumaal kaks lehma ja vasikas. Taga lehtpuumets.(eesti)
works.de: In front, two cows and a calf on grassland. Behind, deciduous forest.

works.d: Ees keskel mööda teed vaataja poole sammuv talunaine. Tagapool: paremal roigasaed, õlgkatusega talumaja. Taga vasakul üle plangu paistmas hoone õlgkatus.(eesti)
works.de: In front, in the centre, a peasant woman walking along the road towards the viewer. Behind: on the right a pole fence, a thatched-roof farmhouse. Further back on the left, the thatched roof of a building visible over the fence.

works.d: Habemiku mehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale. Esindusmundris.
works.de: Bust of a bearded man in half-profile to the right. In dress uniform.

works.d: Esiplaanil kõrrepõld. Paremal ja vasakul reas rukkihakid. Nendest tagapool näha üksikud kuused. Taevas roosakad pilved.
works.de: In the foreground, a stubble field. On the right and left, rows of rye stooks. Beyond them, single spruce trees are visible. Pinkish clouds in the sky.

works.dm: laius: 81.0 cm (arm   ); kõrgus: 100.2 cm; kõrgus: 100.0 cm (arm ); laius: 81.2 cm
works.d: Istuva kiilaspäise mehe portree poolprofiilis vasemale. Käed risti rinnal.
works.de: Portrait of a seated bald man in half-profile to the left. Arms crossed on chest.

works.dm: laius: 76.5 cm (arm   ); kõrgus: 99.5 cm; kõrgus: 99.0 cm (arm   ); laius: 76.5 cm
works.d: Toolil istuva daami poolfiguur pöördega vasakule. Fooniks hele eesriie. Pruunikad laines juuksed ja suured pruunid silmad. Valge käisteta kleit, kaelas merevaiguhelmed.
works.de: Half-figure of a lady seated on a chair, turned to the left. Background a light curtain. Brownish wavy hair and large brown eyes. White sleeveless dress, amber beads around the neck.

works.d: Eesti rahvariietes noore neiu rindportree. En face, kerge pöördega paremale; lahtised juuksed, peas kõrge pruuditanu rippuvate lintidega. Parem käsi hoiab sõrmust.
works.de: Bust portrait of a young girl in Estonian folk costume. En face, with a slight turn to the right; loose hair, a tall bridal cap with hanging ribbons on her head. Her right hand holds a ring.

works.d: Mehe rinnapilt, poolprofiilis, pea pöördega vasakule, keha paremale. Tumesinises kuues, valge kaelasideme ja ordeniga.
works.de: Bust portrait of a man, in half-profile, head turned to the left, body to the right. In a dark blue coat, with a white cravat and an order.

works.d: Tumepunane roosiõis
works.de: Dark red rose blossom

works.d: Ees veekogu. Tahapoole kõrgeneval kaldal üksik hoone.
works.de: In front a body of water. On the bank rising towards the back, a single building.

works.d: Ees ( ca 1/2 lõuendist) veekogu keskel oleva silla peegeldus. Vasakult silla alt vaade rohtunud põõsastikuga kaldale.
works.de: In front (ca 1/2 of the canvas) the reflection of a bridge in the middle of a body of water. From the left, under the bridge, a view of a bank overgrown with bushes.

works.d: Ees vasakul eest taga kulgev voore taoline küngas raudtee ja kaubavagunitega selle harjal. Paremal veekogu. Taamal linna siluett.
works.de: In front on the left a ridge-like hill running from front to back with a railway and freight wagons on its crest. On the right a body of water. In the distance the silhouette of a town.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremalt nurgast vasakule keskele suunduval veekogul vesiveski (ratasveski). Vasakul, kaldal näha palkhoone nurka ja õlgkatust. Taga vastaskaldal, roigastega piiratud põllunurk, selle taga lehtpuumets.
works.de: In the foreground, on a body of water running from the right corner to the centre-left, a water mill (wheel mill). On the left, on the bank, the corner of a log building and a thatched roof are visible. Behind, on the opposite bank, a corner of a field enclosed by poles, behind it a deciduous forest.

works.d: Keskaelise naise rinnapilt poolprofiilis vasemale. Seljas pruun kleit valge pitskraega.
works.de: Bust of a middle-aged woman in half-profile to the left. Wearing a brown dress with a white lace collar.

works.d: Madalale maalitud silmapiiriga panoraamne merevaade. Esiplaanil keskel läbi vee paistavaid kive ja laeva küljest tormis murdunud küljeosa. Taamal vasakul veel üks laeva osadest, silmapiiril paremal väike aurik. Meri terashall, madalate vahuste lainetega. Silmapiiri kohal valkjate, esiplaanil hallide pilvedaga selginev taevas.
works.de: A panoramic sea view with a low-painted horizon. In the foreground in the centre, stones visible through the water and a side section broken off from a ship's hull in a storm. Further back on the left another section of the ship, on the horizon on the right a small steamer. The sea steel-grey, with low foamy waves. Above the horizon a clearing sky, whitish, grey in the foreground with clouds.

works.d: Kaks figuuri puu all  - istuv naine vasakul, kruus käes; mees paremal, käes piip. Lihtsustatud vormid, kahvatud toonid, maalitud pastoosselt jämedale lõuendile.
works.de: Two figures under a tree – a seated woman on the left, holding a jug; a man on the right, with a pipe in hand. Simplified forms, pale tones, painted pastosely on coarse canvas.

works.t: Ma ei ole tantsinud sinuga valssi Wienis
works.d: Paremas servas seisab küljega alasti naisefiguur, pikkade tumepunaste küüntega käed allservaga paralleelselt välja sirutatud. Naisel tugevasti mingitud nägu, mustad lühikesed juuksed hoiavad laubal siilisoengusse. Naise ümber hall, siniste säpsivate pintslilöökidega kaetud foon. Maali vasakus servas otsekui aimatav mehefiguur: must ülikond, valge frakisärk, punane lips ja kaabu. Mehe ümber must, väikesi valgeid kolmnurki täispikitud foon. Mustale raamile on kleebitud kolm- ja nelinurksed peegiltükid. Maalipind kohati paksu värvikihi tõttu reljeefne.
works.de: On the right edge stands a nude female figure seen from the side, hands with long dark red nails stretched out parallel to the lower edge. The woman has a heavily made-up face, black short hair held in a hedgehog-style hairdo on the forehead. Around the woman a grey background covered with jagged blue brushstrokes. In the left edge of the painting, as if only suggested, a male figure: black suit, white dress shirt, red tie and a top hat. Around the man a black background densely filled with small white triangles. Triangular and quadrangular pieces of mirror are glued onto the black frame. The painting surface is in places relief-like due to the thick layer of paint.

works.d: Paremal meri. Keskel ja vasakul madal liivane rand pooleldi veest välja tõmmatud paatidega, kuivavate köitega ja askeldava inimgrupiga. Tagapool vasakul kõrge paekallas lehtpuudega.
works.de: On the right the sea. In the centre and on the left a low sandy beach with boats half pulled out of the water, drying ropes and a group of people busy at work. Further back on the left a high limestone bank with deciduous trees.

works.d: Tumedas rõivastuses istuv vana naine kerges pöördes vasemale, süles valged, punased ja lillad lilled. Maalitud pastoosselt.(eesti)
works.de: An old woman in dark clothing sitting in a slight turn to the left, white, red and purple flowers in her lap. Painted pastosely.

works.d: Esiplaanil murul kaks tütarlast ja poiss lamavad seljaga vaataja poole. Nende tähelepanu on pööratud tagapool künka otsas istuvale vanamehele, kes vasakus käes hoiab kannelt, parem käsi on üles tõstetud. Vanamehest vasakul puud.
works.de: In the foreground on the grass, two girls and a boy lie with their backs to the viewer. Their attention is directed toward an old man sitting further back on top of a hill, holding a kannel in his left hand, his right hand raised. To the left of the old man, trees.

works.d: Esiplaanil lumine maapind, maalitud laiade pintslitõmmetega, rõhutades maapinna pisut künklikku profiili; taevas antud sama valkjate pintslilöökidega; keskplaanil männimets, tumedates toonides, sünge, müstiline.
works.de: In the foreground, snowy ground, painted with broad brushstrokes, emphasizing the slightly hilly profile of the ground; the sky rendered with the same whitish brushstrokes; in the middle ground a pine forest, in dark tones, gloomy, mystical.

works.d: Seisva mehe kolmveerandfiguur otsevaates, käed püksitaskuis.
works.de: Three-quarter figure of a standing man in a frontal view, hands in trouser pockets.

works.d: Istuva noore naise poolfiguur otsevaates. Käed süles olevas muhvis. Punane jakk, mille all must kleit.
works.de: Half-figure of a seated young woman in a frontal view. Hands in a muff on her lap. Red jacket, under which a black dress.

works.d: Tumeda viiruna silmapiiril, lilla-rohekas vaikne meri üksiku valge kiviga paremas kuldlõikes ning roosaka leetseljakuga vasemas kuldlõikes ning paremal äärel. Esiplaanil taganenud veest paljastatud kollakas-roosakas-rohekas merepõhi üksikute lompide ja kividega, üleni kaetud teravate vesitaimedega. Vormitute rünkpilvedega helesinine taevas.
works.de: A dark streak on the horizon, a purple-greenish calm sea with a lone white stone in the right golden section and a pinkish sandbank ridge in the left golden section and on the right edge. In the foreground, the sea floor exposed by the receded water, yellowish-pinkish-greenish, with occasional puddles and stones, entirely covered with sharp aquatic plants. Light blue sky with shapeless cumulus clouds.

works.d: Kõrged männitüved. Maalil sügavusse kulgev teerada. Sellele langevad vasakult pikad varjud. Tüvede vahelt paistab kerges pilves taevas. Horisondil mere sillerdav vöönd.(eesti)
works.de: Tall pine trunks. In the painting a path running into the depth. Long shadows fall on it from the left. Between the trunks a lightly clouded sky can be seen. On the horizon a shimmering band of sea.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 17.0 cm; lehe laius: 28.0 cm
works.d: Vasakul öö hämaruses trepist alla sööstva naise figuur. Paremal tume mehe figuur.
works.de: On the left, in the darkness of night, the figure of a woman rushing down the stairs. On the right a dark male figure.

In a room with black walls and a dark brown floor, a lamp with a green funnel-shaped shade burns on the ceiling, at the top left an opening to the outside, through which a cloudy sky can be seen.

works.de: Composition with two indistinct running figures. In the background a depiction of a castle.

works.d: Kõrgete pruunides toonides raamaturiiulite vahel kolm tütarlast; üks pruunis kleidis seljaga, teine seelikus ja pluusis kolmveerandpöördes, näoga vaataja poole, kolmas vasemal kirjus kleidis, küljega. Taamal suur aken, millest paistavad puud ja stiliseeritud inimfiguurid. Keskel reas kaks perspektiivselt koonduvat tala, maas lillad vaibad. Ruumiliselt kogu pildi pinna ulatuses puuvõra.(eesti)
works.de: Between tall bookshelves in brown tones three girls; one in a brown dress with her back turned, the second in a skirt and blouse in a three-quarter turn, face towards the viewer, the third on the left in a patterned dress, in profile. In the distance a large window, through which trees and stylised human figures can be seen. In the middle, in a row, two beams converging in perspective, on the floor purple carpets. Spatially, throughout the whole surface of the picture, a tree crown.

works.d: Kompositsiooni keskel sõõrjas, vaataja poole liikuv grupp inimesi, kelledest igaüks on ülestõstetud käega. Esiplaanil, keskel naine ülestõstetud kätega, temast veidi espool, vasakul, üleskääritud käistega lillakasroosas pluusis, pilguga vaataja suunas ja paremal peaga profiilis paremal, noormees. Abstraksed värvilaigud fooniks, mis kohati toonivad ka figuure. Õrnhele värvigamma.(eesti)
works.de: In the centre of the composition a circular group of people moving toward the viewer, each of whom has a raised hand. In the foreground, in the centre, a woman with raised hands, slightly in front of her, on the left, a young man in a purplish-pink blouse with rolled-up sleeves, gaze directed toward the viewer, and on the right, his head in profile facing right. Abstract patches of colour form the background, at places also tinting the figures. A delicately light colour range.

works.d: Vaade aknast tuppa. Ees vasakul rohelisel aknalaual munajas pruunikates ja punakates toonies vaas, keskplaanil paremas kuldlõikes profiilis paremale kuklale kammitud juustega kahvatu naine kaelaehtega. Paremal mitmevärvilistes varjundites tume kardin. Tagaplaanil draperiid ning aknaraamistiku kujuliselt paigutatud geomeetrilised värvipinnad.(eesti)
works.de: A view from a window into a room. In front on the left, on a green windowsill, an egg-shaped vase in brownish and reddish tones; in the middle ground, in profile in the golden section to the right, a pale woman with hair combed back to the nape, wearing a necklace. On the right a dark curtain in multi-coloured shades. In the background draperies and geometric colour surfaces arranged in the shape of a window frame.

works.d: Rohekates toonides tellingutega maastiku taustal punane kraana punasel alusel.(eesti)
