works.d: Vanema mehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis vasakule. Kõrget laupa raamib tume, meelekohalt hallinev ja lagipeal hõre juus tahapoole kammituna. Nägu ilmestab tugev mokahabe. Seljas üherealine tumedast riidest pintsak, mis on ääristatud musta paelaga.
works.de: Bust portrait of an older man in three-quarter profile to the left. The high forehead is framed by dark hair, greying at the temples and thin on the crown, combed back. The face is accentuated by a strong moustache. Wearing a single-breasted jacket of dark cloth, trimmed with black braid.

works.d: Selgepiirilistest, üksteisega põimuvatest abstraktsetest värvipindadest kompositsioon, kus domineerib oliivkollane, must, punane, helesinine, roosa toon. Sakiliste ja kumerate servadega pinnad eraldatud ühtlase, ca 1 cm laiuse kontrastse kontuurjoonega. Dünaamiline kompositsioon meenutab värvilistest paberitest kollaaži.
works.de: A composition of clearly delineated, interlocking abstract colour surfaces dominated by olive-yellow, black, red, light blue and pink tones. The surfaces, with jagged and curved edges, are separated by a uniform contrasting contour line about 1 cm wide. The dynamic composition resembles a collage of coloured papers.

works.d: Pildi ülemises paremas osas rohekas tehasehoone suure, väikestest ruutudest koosneva aknaga. Selle ees seisab punane traktor, millest paremal esiplaanil viiest inimesest koosnev grupp. Esiplaanil vasakul seisva noormehe poolfiguur otsevaates, seljas punane pluus, peas roheline müts.  Maali pinnale on kruvidega kinnitatud üksikud puidust nikerdused, mis on kohati üle maalitud.(eesti)
works.de: In the upper right part of the picture a greenish factory building with a large window made up of small squares. In front of it stands a red tractor, to the right of which, in the foreground, a group of five people. In the foreground on the left the half-figure of a young man in frontal view, wearing a red blouse, a green cap on his head. Individual wooden carvings are attached to the surface of the painting with screws, in places painted over.

works.d: Tormine meri kõrgete vahuste lainetega. Vasakul rannakaljud. Paremal merehädas laev, mille ees paat inimestega.(eesti)
works.de: Stormy sea with high foamy waves. Rocky shore on the left. On the right a ship in distress, with a boat full of people in front of it.

works.d: Osa laevast. Esiplaanil neli meest võrke välja tõmbamas. Koloriit lillakas-rohekas-punakas.(eesti)

works.de: Against a bluish grey background with brownish reflections, a three-quarter figure of a boy with dark hair, frontal view. He is wearing an orange blouse with white ruffles.

works.d: Keskealise mehe rinnaportree, peaaegu otsevaates. Kaelas kõrge krae ristlipsuga. Kuue alt paistab punane lint, mis suundub vasakule õlalt ülevalt alla paremale. Vasakul pool kuuel orden; paremal ülikooli lõpumärk, millel keskel sinine rist. Valge kraealuse keskel kullapeaga nõel.
works.de: A bust portrait of a middle-aged man, almost frontal. A high collar with a cross-tie around the neck. A red ribbon shows beneath the coat, running from the left shoulder diagonally down to the right. On the left side of the coat an order; on the right a university graduation badge with a blue cross in the centre. A gold-headed pin in the centre beneath the collar.

works.d: Pikkade juuste, habeme ja vurrudega vanamehe poolportree 3/4 profiilis paremale. Seljas hall kuub. Kaelusest näha mustade-punaste põikitriipudega rõivas.
works.de: Half-portrait of an old man with long hair, beard and moustache, in 3/4 profile to the right. Wearing a grey coat. Visible at the collar is a garment with black-red cross stripes.

works.d: Ees keskel rohtunud puudest ümbritsetud lagendikul väike suvemaja. Vasakul puude all seisvaid ja istuvaid figuure.
works.de: In front, in the middle, on a grassy clearing surrounded by trees, a small summer house. On the left, figures standing and sitting under the trees.

works.d: Esiplaanil vanad õlgkatusega taluhooned puude vahel. Tagaplaanil lumeväljal taluhoone. Silmapiiril metsaviirg, vasakul künkal põlispuud. Paremal üksik teeline reega sõitmas.
works.de: In the foreground, old thatch-roofed farm buildings among trees. In the background, a farm building on a snow field. On the horizon a strip of forest, on the left on a hillock ancient trees. On the right a lone traveller riding a sledge.

works.d: Peamiselt rohelistes, hallides ja punastes toonides abstraktne kompositsioon. Kohati musta ja valge värviga tõmmatud pintslilööke ja pritsmeid. Foon üleservast valge, altservast must.
works.de: Abstract composition mainly in green, grey and red tones. Here and there brushstrokes and splashes drawn with black and white paint. Background white along the top edge, black along the bottom edge.

works.d: Kahkjates sinistes, hallides ja roosades toonides kompositsioon: esiplaanil pingil lebav, hallis kerges rüüs, vasekarva juustega naine, vasak põlv kõverdatud, pea toetumas küünarnukist kõverdatud käele. Parem, erksinises sukas jalg on välja sirutatud. Tagapool kolm erinevates poosides seisvat alasti naisfiguuri. Foon tumehall, vasakul üleni lehvivasse valgesse rüüsse mässitud kõndiv figuur.
works.de: A composition in pale blue, grey and pink tones: in the foreground, lying on a bench, a copper-haired woman in a light grey robe, left knee bent, head resting on an arm bent at the elbow. The right leg, in a bright blue stocking, is stretched out. Behind, three standing nude female figures in different poses. Background dark grey, on the left a walking figure entirely wrapped in a fluttering white robe.

works.d: Esiplaanil rangeilmelise talupoja poolfiguur, püss käes. Tema kõrval kaks poissi ja tagapool tütarlaps. Keskel ratsanik, kõrval sõjaväelasi jala ja ratsa, paremal talupojad. Kogu pind kaetud eredate lillakate ja sinakate laikudega, silmapiiril punane triip.
works.de: In the foreground a half-figure of a stern-looking peasant, gun in hand. Beside him two boys and, further back, a girl. In the middle a horseman, beside him soldiers on foot and on horseback, on the right peasants. The whole surface covered with bright purplish and bluish patches, on the horizon a red stripe.

works.d: Punastes, mustades, valgetes toonides maali domineeriv värv on kollane. Abstraktses laadis. Kollaseid horisontaalseid lainjaid jooni on paigutatud üle kogu pildipinna. Kujunduselementidena mõjuvad ka siin-seal vedela värvi valgumisest tekkind joad, mis on ka veidi reljeefsed.
works.de: In red, black and white tones, the dominant colour of the painting is yellow. In an abstract style. Yellow horizontal wavy lines are placed all over the picture surface. Streams formed by the dripping of liquid paint, which are also slightly relief-like, also function as design elements here and there.

works.d: Ees keskel ümberlükatud taburett ja laelambist valgustatud laua ümber kolm meest; paremal leti ees seisev mees, vasemal seina ääres seisev mehefiguur.
works.de: In the centre foreground an overturned stool and three men around a table lit by a ceiling lamp; on the right a man standing at the counter, on the left a male figure standing by the wall.

works.d: Esiplaanil kividega rand purjekatega, mees- ja naisefiguuridega. Vasakul võrgumaja. Tagaplaanil vasakul sügavalt merre ualtuv neem majade ja metsaga.
works.de: In the foreground a stony beach with sailboats, with male and female figures. On the left a net house. In the background on the left a headland extending deep into the sea, with houses and forest.

works.d: Lillelise linaga kaetud laual vasakul avatud raamat ja pott nuikaktusega. Paremal kolm apelsini ja vaas puuviljadega.
works.de: On a table covered with a floral cloth, on the left an open book and a pot with a cactus. On the right three oranges and a vase with fruit.

works.d: Pikkade pruunide juustega noormehe rinnapilt, keha selgvaates, pea poolprofiilis paremale.
works.de: Chest portrait of a young man with long brown hair, body in frontal view, head in half-profile to the right.

works.d: Noore pruunisilmse naise rinnapilt poolprofiilis vasakule. Pikad tumedad juuksed eest keskelt siledalt lahku kammitud ja langevad kõrva vabaks jätvalt kuklasse. Väljatöötatud pea kohal antud ovaalis rohekaspruun tume taust, kuna rinnapartii alates kaelast näha ainult katmata krundi heledama laiguna - teos lõpetamata.
works.de: Bust portrait of a young brown-eyed woman in half-profile facing left. Long dark hair combed smoothly apart from the centre at the front and falling to the nape of the neck, leaving the ear exposed. Above the finished head, within an oval, a dark greenish-brown background, whereas the chest area, from the neck down, shows only a lighter patch of uncovered ground - the work is unfinished.

works.d: Maali keskosas kaks inimest valgetes kitlites ja mütsides operatsiooni teostamas. Nende ees sinises kleidis, valges põlles ja tanus naine selgvaates istumas, ümberringi hulk inimesi. Paremas nurgas alusega pesukauss ja arstiriistade trummel alusega. Vasakus nurgas naine valges kitlis ja tanus otsevaates pudelit käes hoidmas.
works.de: In the centre of the painting two people in white coats and caps performing an operation. In front of them, in full view, a woman in a blue dress, white apron and bonnet, sitting, surrounded by a number of people. In the right corner a washbasin on a stand and a drum of surgical instruments on a stand. In the left corner a woman in a white coat and bonnet, in frontal view, holding a bottle.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal alasti mehe figuur heina niitmas. Tagaplaanil lamav naisakt ja põõsad. Mõlemad figuurid intensiivselt oranžid.
works.de: In the foreground on the right the figure of a naked man mowing hay. In the background a reclining female nude and bushes. Both figures intensely orange.

works.d: Pildi keskel kollases sviitris heledapäise tantsiva tütarlapse täisfiguur, ümbritsetud nelja tantsupaariga. Pildi allääres olevate tantsijate poosid ning ilmed staatilised; teised kaks paari kujutatud rütmilises liikumises. Koloriit särav; toonid kontrastsed.
works.de: In the middle of the picture, the full figure of a fair-haired dancing girl in a yellow sweater, surrounded by four dancing couples. The poses and expressions of the dancers at the bottom edge of the picture are static; the other two couples are depicted in rhythmic movement. The coloring is bright; the tones are contrasting.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 34.7 cm; lehe laius: 46.7 cm
works.d: Eest tahapoole kõrgenev mäekallas suure kaljurahnuga vasakul. Kaljurahnu ääres väike osmik, roigastara ja laialeheliste taimede ribaga. Ees paremal teravnurgana väike veenire.
works.de: A hillside rising from the front backwards, with a large boulder on the left. Beside the boulder a small hut, a pole fence and a strip of broad-leaved plants. In front on the right a small sharp-angled stream.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal kaljurahnud, taga veekogu ja lumine mäestik.
works.de: In the foreground on the right, boulders, behind a body of water and a snowy mountain range.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 36.0 cm; lehe laius: 50.5 cm
works.d: Ees veekogu kitsa kivise kaldaribaga. Vasakult taha paremale kulgeb kallast moodustav mägede ahelik.
works.de: In front, a body of water with a narrow rocky strip of shore. From left to right in the background runs a mountain range forming the shore.

works.d: Poollamavas asendis naise alastifiguur: toetub paremale käele, vasak on üles tõstetud oksa haarama, vasak jalg üle parema. Figuuri all punane ja valge draperii, tagapool markeeritud lehestikku. Maalitud õhukeselt peene pintsliga, vasak käsi on algselt olnud teises asendis, hiljem kergelt üle maalitud.
works.de: A semi-reclining female nude figure: resting on the right hand, the left raised to grasp a branch, the left leg over the right. Below the figure, red and white drapery, behind it indicated foliage. Painted thinly with a fine brush, the left arm was originally in a different position, later slightly overpainted.

works.d: Naise figuur istukil asendis, ülakeha paljas, käed ees vasakul paralleelselt, pea tahapoole kallutatud, paljas vasak jalg ulatub diagonaalselt maali paremasse nurka. Tugeva tumeda lakikihi alt kumavad heledad ihutoonid; sinakas rüü ja punakas tuli taga paremal.
works.de: A female figure in a seated position, upper body bare, arms in front, parallel on the left, head tilted backward, bare left leg extending diagonally into the right corner of the painting. Light flesh tones glimmer beneath a thick dark layer of varnish; a bluish robe and a reddish flame behind on the right.

works.d: Lageda maastiku taustal noormehe poolfiguur külgvaates paremale, kes hoiab vastu rinda seljakotti, millest kõvera nokaga lind välja upitamas. Mehel pikemad ülepea kammitud juuksed, muigel nägu suunatud linnule, seljas roostepruun särk. Realistlikult kujutatud, summutatud beežikaspruunid toonid.
works.de: Against the background of an open landscape, the half-figure of a young man in side view facing right, holding against his chest a backpack, out of which a bird with a curved beak is peeking. The man has longer hair combed back over the head, his smiling face turned towards the bird, wearing a rust-brown shirt. Realistically depicted, subdued beigish-brown tones.

works.d: Kõhna näoga keskealise mehe poolfiguur poolpöördes vasakule, parem õlg pisut tõstetud, kõverdatud käes sigaret. Mehel must barett kuklas, tumeda pintsaku alt paistmas punakas särk, sinine sviiter. Valdavalt lillakashallid, roostepruunid toonid.
works.de: Half-figure of a gaunt-faced, middle-aged man, in a half-turn to the left, right shoulder slightly raised, cigarette in his bent hand. The man wears a black beret pushed to the back of his head, a reddish shirt showing beneath his dark jacket, blue jumper. Predominantly lilac-grey, rusty-brown tones.

works.d: Pimedusse mähkunud maastikku valgustab kergelt heledam taevariba silmapiiri taha laskuva päikesega.
works.de: A landscape shrouded in darkness is lit slightly by a lighter strip of sky where the sun is setting behind the horizon.

works.d: Hele kirikuhoone kuue sibulkupliga kõrgetel tambuuridel. Paremal neljatahuline kellatorn.
works.de: A light-coloured church building with six onion domes on tall drums. On the right a four-sided bell tower.

works.d: Punakaspruunis vaasis kaks suurt helekollast krüsanteemi.
works.de: In a reddish-brown vase two large light-yellow chrysanthemums.

works.d: Keskmest veidi vasakul, toolil istuva heledapäise poisi kolmveerandfiguur otsevaates, käed süles. Poisil kirju pluus, tumesinised pihikpüksid. Paremal ruumi nurka markeeriv sinakasrohelistes toonides foon, vasak pool värelevalt maalitud ookertoonides.
works.de: Slightly left of centre, a three-quarter figure in frontal view of a fair-haired boy sitting on a chair, hands in his lap. The boy wears a colourful blouse, dark blue overall trousers. On the right, a background in bluish-green tones marking the corner of the room, the left side painted shimmeringly in ochre tones.

works.d: Suvemaastik jämeda puuga vasakul. Puu all valge linaga kaetud ümar laud õunte ja klaaskannuga. Laua ääres, viini toolil istub heledas suvekleidis väike tüdruk poolpöördes vasakule, käed süles, jalad vaheliti rippu. Tema kõrval seisev tütarlaps otsevaates, parem käsi toetub tooli seljatoele. Taga paremal, puude vahel talumaja nurk. Rohekaspruun gamma, lühikeste peente pintslilöökidega maalilaad.
works.de: A summer landscape with a thick tree on the left. Under the tree a round table covered with a white cloth, with apples and a glass jug. At the table, on a Vienna chair, sits a small girl in a light summer dress, half-turned to the left, hands in her lap, legs crossed and dangling. Beside her a standing girl in frontal view, right hand resting on the back of the chair. Behind on the right, between the trees, the corner of a farmhouse. Greenish-brown gamut, painting manner with short fine brushstrokes.

works.d: Laual valge emaileeritud kann ja pruun pikakaelaline pudel. Nende ees leivapäts ning valgel riidel kaks sidrunit. Foon rohelistes-sinistes toonides.
works.de: On the table a white enamelled jug and a brown long-necked bottle. In front of them a loaf of bread and two lemons on a white cloth. Background in green-blue tones.

works.d: Vasakus ja paremas servas tohutud, üleelusuurused tumedad profiilis naiste rinnafiguurid. Figuuride vahel keskel on hallide, rohekate ja roosade abstraktsete värvilaikudena maalitud embav paar. All vasemas nurgas musta värviga kirjutatud tekst: Per Portas.(eesti)
works.de: In the left and right margins huge, over-life-size dark female busts in profile. Between the figures in the centre an embracing couple is painted as abstract patches of grey, greenish and pink colour. In the lower left corner text written in black paint: Per Portas.

works.d: Kiilaspäise, tumedasse rõivastatud mehe poolfiguur kerge pöördega paremale helesinisel foonil. Paremal osa teisest figuurist, kelle väljasirutatud, lõpuni maalimata käsi ulatub esimese rinna kohale.
works.de: Half-figure of a bald-headed man in dark clothing, in a slight turn to the right, on a light blue background. On the right part of another figure, whose outstretched, unfinished arm reaches to above the first figure's chest.

works.d: Nooremapoolse mehe profiilportree; tahapoole kammitud satäänid juuksed, mille piir laubal kaarjalt taandunud, sirge nina, lõual juustega ühte värvi habemetutt. Seljas tume kuub, kaelas roheline rätik või lips. Foon kahe tooni piiriga diagonaalselt läbi lõigatud: ülalt sinakashall, altpoolt rohekasinine.
works.de: A profile portrait of a younger man; satiny hair combed back, its line receding in an arch at the forehead, a straight nose, a tuft of beard on the chin matching the hair colour. Wearing a dark coat, with a green scarf or tie at the neck. The background is cut diagonally by a border between two tones: bluish-grey above, greenish-blue below.

works.d: Patsidega tütarlapse rinnaportree poolpöördes paremale. Nägu en face. Foon sinakas.
works.de: Bust portrait of a girl with braids, in half-turn to the right. Face en face. Background bluish.

works.d: Pildi servades esiplaanil madalad, kerakujuliste kapiteelidega sinised sambad ja nende taga helesinised, rohekate varjudega, koonilised põõsatse siluetid. Keskel paarikaupa oranžid-punased-pruunid meeste ja naiste laialivalguvate piirjoontega grotesksed siluetid. Taustaks tumesinine taevas veidi heledamate rünkpilvedega.(eesti)
works.de: At the edges of the picture in the foreground, low blue columns with spherical capitals, and behind them light blue, greenish-shadowed, conical silhouettes of bushes. In the middle, in pairs, grotesque silhouettes of men and women in orange-red-brown tones with blurred outlines. The background is a dark blue sky with slightly lighter cumulus clouds.

works.d: Rohelise lageda maastiku ja üksikute heledate pilvedega sinise taeva taustal kuldse vormitu ülakehaga ning ilma kaelata karmiinpunase sopilise peaga figuur. Näost hargnevad oranžid, kollased, pruunid, rohelised sopitaolised võsud. Tumepunased ebakorrapärasel paigutatud silmad hallide silmakoobastega.(eesti)
works.de: Against a background of open green landscape and a blue sky with scattered light clouds, a figure with a golden, formless upper body and a crimson-red, lobed head without a neck. From the face branch orange, yellow, brown, green lobe-like shoots. Dark red irregularly placed eyes with grey eye sockets.

works.d: Valdavalt valgel taustal värvilistest siksak-, vabakäejoontest, sakiliste servadega pinnalistest kujunditest, täppidest, triipudest kombineeritud abstraktne maal. Töö ülemisel poolel kulgeb kaarjalt koobaltsinine, värviliste täppidega sakiline riba, sellega paralleelne punane lint. All sini-puna-mustavärvilistest kujunditest nurk mustade täppidega valges raamistuses.
works.de: An abstract painting predominantly on a white background, composed of coloured zigzag and free-hand lines, flat shapes with jagged edges, dots and stripes. In the upper half of the work runs a curving cobalt-blue jagged band with coloured dots, parallel to it a red ribbon. Below, a corner of blue-red-blackish shapes with black dots in a white frame.

works.d: Sinakas koloriidis foonil vaas kimbu pastellroosade roosidega.
works.de: On a background in bluish colouring a vase with a bouquet of pastel pink roses.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal bordoopunase sametiga kaetud laud, millel veiniklaas, valge taldrik viinamarjadega, kristallist kann. Esiplaanil vasakul, laua taga, seljaga vaataja poole, kitarri mängiv mees tumedast puust käetugedega toolis. Mehel lühikesed juuksed, tumedad lopsakad kulmud ja vuntsid, seljas tumesinine ülikond ja valge särk. Mehe vastas teisel pool lauda õhtukleidis ja karusnahas daam, pea viltu, pilk malbelt maha suunatud, aluale toetuvad vasakus käes viinamari. Daamist paremal, seinal, ovaalses nikerdatud raamis peegel või maal. Mehest vasakul kõrge tumeroheline toataim. Foon tumehall.
works.de: In the foreground on the right a table covered with burgundy-red velvet, on which stands a wine glass, a white plate with grapes, a crystal jug. In the foreground on the left, behind the table, with his back to the viewer, a man playing guitar in a dark wood armchair. The man has short hair, dark bushy eyebrows and a moustache, wearing a dark blue suit and a white shirt. Opposite the man, on the other side of the table, a lady in an evening gown and fur, her head tilted, gaze gently lowered, holding a grape in her left hand resting on the table. To the right of the lady, on the wall, a mirror or painting in an oval carved frame. To the left of the man a tall dark green houseplant. The background dark grey.

works.d: Avaral maastikul kähara puu all vasakul pikas punases seelikus naine, laps käel. Naine veidi pööratud paremale, tema vastas seisev alasti poiss. Paremal istuv mees otsevaates, käed toetuvad põlvedele. Maalitud rõhutades värvipinda sissekraapimise teel, lastes vineeril läbi kumada.
works.de: In an open landscape, under a curly tree on the left, a woman in a long red skirt, a child on her arm. The woman is turned slightly to the right, facing a standing naked boy. On the right a seated man seen frontally, hands resting on his knees. Painted emphasizing the paint surface through scratching-in, letting the plywood show through.

works.t: a) Jaan Linnamäe portree; b) Rahvahulk kahe puu all (visand)
works.d: a) rohekashallil foonil lühikeste tumedate juuste ja vuntsidega keskealise mehe portree poolprofiilis paremale. Pilk suunatud otse ette. Mehel seljas tume pintsak, kaelas punasekirju rätt. Nägu modelleeritud pehmelt kontuurjooni värvipinda sisse kraapides.
works.de: a) on a greenish-grey background a portrait of a middle-aged man with short dark hair and a moustache, in half-profile to the right. Gaze directed straight ahead. The man wears a dark jacket, a red-patterned scarf around his neck. The face modelled softly, with contour lines scratched into the paint surface.

works.d: Rohelisel mustrilisel vaibal lamav pruunikarvaline koer. Pea lebab väljasirutatud vasakul käpal. Koloriit tume; maalipind kergelt faktuurne.
works.de: A brown-furred dog lying on a green patterned rug. The head rests on an outstretched left paw. The colouring is dark; the painting surface is slightly textured.

works.d: Pöördega paremale lamav valkjas, pikakarvaline linnukoer. Silmade ümbrus ning kõrvad mustad. Pilk suunatud paremale üles. Taust helepruun.
works.de: A whitish, long-haired bird dog lying with a turn to the right. The area around the eyes and the ears black. Gaze directed upward to the right. Background light brown.

works.d: Vaade altarile, taga vasemal kantsel.
works.de: View of the altar, with the pulpit at the back left.

works.d: Esiplaanil madal liivarand üksikute rohutuustidega. Rannal liikumas mehi ja naisi. Veepiirile veetud paate, nende juures askeldavaid inimesi. Paatide lähedal rannas lõkke ääres inimesi.
works.de: In the foreground a low sandy beach with scattered tufts of grass. Men and women moving about on the beach. Boats pulled up to the waterline, people busying themselves around them. Near the boats, people around a campfire on the beach.

works.d: Voki ees istuva noore naise figuur profiilis vasakule. Käed linakoonlast lõnga tõmbamas, parem jalg voki tallalaual. Hiiu naise rõivastus vaskvööga, mille küljes vasakul poolel noatupp ja nõelakodu. Tagaseinas vasakul avatud aken, millest näha väljas noort meest püsside vahel ära viidavat.
works.de: The figure of a young woman sitting at a spinning wheel, in profile facing left. Her hands drawing thread from a linen distaff, her right foot on the wheel's treadle. The Hiiumaa woman's attire includes a copper belt, on the left side of which hangs a knife sheath and a needle case. In the back wall on the left an open window, through which a young man can be seen being led away between rifles outside.

works.d: Vasakult paremale kulgeva aia taga suured lehtpuud (ca 4/5 lõuendist aia ja puude all).
works.de: Behind a fence running from left to right, large deciduous trees (approx. 4/5 of the canvas under the fence and trees).

works.d: Kaljune mererand istuva naise ja poisi figuuridega esiplaanil vasakul. Vaiksel merel paremal üksik purjepaat. Taevas kergelt pilves.
works.de: A rocky sea shore with the figures of a seated woman and a boy in the foreground on the left. On the calm sea on the right a lone sailing boat. The sky slightly clouded.

works.d: Lauanurgal ümarik sinine vaas, milles suur kimp mitmesuguseid erivärvilisi lilli. Peegeldus peeglis.
works.de: A round blue vase on the corner of a table, containing a large bouquet of various coloured flowers. Reflection in a mirror.

works.d: Esiplaanil veekogu ääres lambakari. Eemal metsariba. Taevas kollakais - punakais toonides.
works.de: In the foreground a flock of sheep by a body of water. A strip of forest in the distance. Sky in yellowish-reddish tones.

works.d: Pruunis potsakas vaasis kogu pildi pinda kattev valgete, punaste, roosade õite meri. Maalitud tihedalt, väikeste pastoossete pintslilöökidega läbi. Foon roosaga varjutatud hall.(eesti)
works.de: In a squat brown vase, a sea of white, red, pink blossoms covering the whole surface of the picture. Painted densely, worked through with small pastose brush strokes. Background a grey shaded with pink.

works.dm: laius: 36.0 cm (lm.); kõrgus: 20.2 cm (km.); kõrgus: 20.9 cm (lm.); laius: 36.0 cm (km.)
works.d: Suvine lehtpuumaastik lageda niiduga vasemal, mille taga kaks hobust metsa taustal. Paremal esiplaanil näha suure puu ees tüvi, latv ulatub pildi pinnast välja.(eesti)
works.de: Summer deciduous landscape with open meadow on the left, behind which two horses against a forest background. On the right in the foreground the trunk of a large tree can be seen, its top extending beyond the picture surface.

works.d: Visand kaheksast õunast: viis punast ja kolm kollakat.
works.de: Sketch of eight apples: five red and three yellowish.

works.d: Esiplaanil veekogu pruuni ja rohelise sillakaarega. Ülal, tumesinise taeva taustal, hooned ja tehasekorstnad.
works.de: In the foreground, a body of water with a brown and green bridge arch. Above, against a dark blue sky, buildings and factory chimneys.

works.d: Murul viis lamavat koera, neli pruuni ja vasakul taga üks valge.
works.de: Five dogs lying on the grass, four brown and at the back left one white.

works.d: Esiplaanil üksikud põõsad ja muru; taga puude vahel maja.
works.de: In the foreground single bushes and grass; behind, a house among trees.

works.d: Esiplaanil kurruline niit üksikute põõsastega. Taamal kaugel horisondil metsaviirg.
works.de: In the foreground a furrowed field with isolated bushes. In the distance on the horizon a strip of forest.

works.d: Linaga kaetud laual istuva naisakti täisfiguur profiilis paremale. Jalgade juures vaas lilledega.
works.de: Full figure of a female nude sitting on a table covered with linen, in profile to the right. A vase with flowers at her feet.

works.d: Esiplaanil lagendik raagus põõsastega; taga mets.
works.de: Clearing with bare bushes in the foreground; forest behind.

works.t: Lõuna-Saksa maastik. Maastik silla ja veskiga
works.d: Keskel ees üle oja viiv sild mehe ja koeraga, taga kingukesel vesiveski; selle kõrval vasemal veskitamm. Hoone otsaseinas oleva ukse ees üks seisev ja paar istuvat figuuri; koer ja kanad. Taga mets, paremal ees suur puu jändriku tüviga.
works.de: In the centre foreground a bridge over a stream with a man and a dog, behind on a hillock a water mill; beside it on the left a mill dam. In front of the door in the gable wall of the building one standing and a couple of sitting figures; a dog and chickens. Behind, forest, in front on the right a large tree with a gnarled trunk.

works.d: Istuv naine poolprofiilil paremale. Käed rüpes. Vasaku rinna kohal kaks medalit. Peas valge rätik.
works.de: A seated woman in half-profile to the right. Hands in her lap. Above her left breast two medals. A white kerchief on her head.

works.d: Vaibal, tugitooli ees poolprofiilis vasakule seisva tüdruku täisfiguur. Vasakus käes pall, paremas mänguvankri ais.
works.de: Full figure of a girl standing in half-profile facing left on a carpet in front of an armchair. A ball in her left hand, the shaft of a toy pram in her right.

works.d: Lausk lage roheline maastik tagaplaanil kiviseintega ehitused.(eesti)
works.de: A vast open green landscape, buildings with stone walls in the background.

works.d: Rohekashallides toonides, kerges kubistlikus stilisatsioonis antud vaade Tallinna linnamüürile, Paksule Margareetale, Suurele Rannaväravale ja Oleviste kirikule. Esiplaanil bastionid ja põõsad, ülal hallis taevas on üksikute joonte abil markeeritud pilved. (eesti)
works.de: A view of the Tallinn town wall, Fat Margaret, the Great Coastal Gate and Oleviste Church, given in greenish-grey tones, in a slight cubist stylisation. Bastions and bushes in the foreground, clouds marked with individual lines in the grey sky above.

works.d: Esiplaanil veekogu saarekestega. Taga madal rohtunud kallas taluhoonetega.
works.de: In the foreground a body of water with small islands. Behind, a low grassy bank with farm buildings.

works.d: Laia äärega kübaras noore naise poolfiguur. Keha kerge, pea tugeva pöördega paremale.
works.de: Half-figure of a young woman in a wide-brimmed hat. Body slightly turned, head with a strong turn to the right.

works.d: Tänava ääres madal kollane punase viilkatusega maja antenniga katusel. Vasakult paistmas kõrgema kivimaja otsafassaad.
works.de: A low yellow house with a red gable roof and an antenna on the roof, by the street. On the left, the end façade of a taller stone building can be seen.

works.d: Madalad majad tänava ääres. Esiplaanil punane puumaja, millest vasakul, taraga piiratud õuel, kaks lehtpuud.
works.de: Low houses along a street. In the foreground a red wooden house, to the left of which, in a fenced yard, two deciduous trees.

works.d: Mehe rinnapilt peapöördega vasemale. Rikkalik parukas langeb paremale õlale, vasemalt poolt pitsšaboole ja brokaatvestile. Üle parema õla on heidetud roheline mantel pruunikas toonis brokaatääristustega. Foonina kujutatud eesriide tagant tuleb paremal esile ebamäärane maastikuriba.
works.de: Bust portrait of a man with his head turned to the left. A rich wig falls onto the right shoulder, from the left side a lace jabot and a brocade waistcoat are visible. Over the right shoulder is thrown a green coat in brownish tones with brocade trimmings. As background, from behind a depicted curtain, an indistinct strip of landscape appears on the right.

works.d: Kollakates ja rohekates toonides maalitud naisakt, punaste kräsus juustega pea pisut paremale kallutatud, silmad pruunid, kulmud peeneks kriipsuks raseeritud, meelas punane suu. Foon keskelt helesinine, vasakul sinistes ja punastes toonides mustriga drapeering, paremal punastes ja kollastes toonides draperii, mille servast hoiab naine mõlema käega kinni.
works.de: A female nude painted in yellowish and greenish tones, the head with red curly hair tilted slightly to the right, brown eyes, eyebrows shaved into a thin line, a sensuous red mouth. The background is light blue in the middle, on the left a patterned drapery in blue and red tones, on the right a drapery in red and yellow tones, the edge of which the woman holds with both hands.

works.d: Vanema, täidlase naise rinnaportree, kergelt vasakule pöördes. Keskendunud nägu raamivad hallisegused lühikesed juuksed. Seljas pruun, heleda kraega kleit. Nägu maalitud hoolikalt, modelleerivate pintsilöökidega, kleit ja foon kohati läbipaistvalt, etüüdlikult maalitud.
works.de: Bust portrait of an older, plump woman, turned slightly to the left. Her focused face is framed by short greyish hair. Wearing a brown dress with a light-coloured collar. The face is painted carefully, with modelling brushstrokes, the dress and background painted somewhat transparently, in an étude-like manner.

works.d: Kõrge kaelusega mundrikuues noormehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale.
works.de: Bust portrait of a young man in a high-collared uniform coat, in half-profile to the right.

works.d: Tumedate prilliraamidega vanema mehe kolmveerandfiguur interjööris. Mehel seljas valge särk, must lips ja liivakarva püksid. Paremas käes sõrmus, mõlema käega hoiab lipsust kinni. Fooniks laud, millel vasakul kollane vaas ja paremal lillepott roosaõielise toataimega. Ruumi sein hallikasroheline, ülaserva aken.
works.de: Three-quarter figure of an older man with dark eyeglass frames in an interior. The man wears a white shirt, black tie and sand-coloured trousers. A ring on his right hand, holding the tie with both hands. In the background a table with a yellow vase on the left and a flowerpot with a pink-flowered houseplant on the right. The wall of the room is greyish-green, a window at the top edge.

works.d: Osa tänavast majadegrupiga ääres. Esiplaanil vasakul hall madal ärklikorrusega maja, paremal kolmekorruseline kollane lameda katusega kivimaja. Üle majade katuste paistmas sügiseses värvitoonis puulatv. Taevas valkjas.
works.de: Part of a street with a group of houses along it. In the foreground on the left a grey, low house with an attic storey, on the right a three-storey yellow stone house with a flat roof. Above the roofs of the houses a treetop in autumn colours is visible. The sky is whitish.

works.d: Keskealise, kõhna kondise näoga mehe rinnaportree. Mehel seljas beez pluus, must, punaste triipudega kikilips ja valge pagarimüts. Foon sinakasroheline, keskjoonel kollaste aktsentidega.
works.de: Chest-length portrait of a middle-aged man with a thin, bony face. The man is wearing a beige blouse, a black bow tie with red stripes and a white baker's cap. The background is bluish-green, with yellow accents along the centre line.

works.d: Mustas, punaste revääridega vormikuues, tugitoolis istuva heledajuukselise, vurrudega mehe põlvpilt en face. Keha kerge pöördega vasakule.
works.de: Knee-length portrait of a fair-haired, moustached man sitting in an armchair, en face, wearing a black uniform coat with red lapels. Body with a slight turn to the left.

works.d: Vasakul veeloik, keskel tee suurte tammede all sammuva naise figuuriga selgvaates.
works.de: On the left a puddle, in the middle a road under large oaks with the figure of a walking woman in clear view.

works.d: Esiplaanil madala puukai ääres purjelevad ja paadid. Vasakul, kaldal näha hoonete katuseid.
works.de: In the foreground, sailing boats and boats by a low wooden pier. On the left, rooftops of buildings visible on the shore.

works.d: Heledapäise, lokkisjuukselise, pruunis rüüs viiuldava tütarlapse põlvpilt poolprofiilis paremale. Seljas suured inglitiivad. Pea ümber oreool. Foon helesinine.
works.de: Knee-length portrait of a fair-haired, curly-haired girl in a brown robe playing the violin, in half-profile to the right. Wearing large angel wings on her back. A halo around her head. Background light blue.

works.dm: kõrgus: 129.3 cm; laius: 109.7 cm; laius: 108.8 cm; kõrgus: 225.5 cm
works.d: Kaks söega tumedaks töödeldud vineertahvlit, pind kulunud, selles väikesed ümmargused augud ja naelad.
works.de: Two plywood panels charred with coal, the surface worn, with small round holes and nails in it.

works.d: Kitsas vanalinna tänav. Vasakul avatud akende ja rippsildiga maja, paremal madalad aknaluukidega majad, mille kohal jupike linnamüüri poolümara katuseta torniga. Domineerivad hallikaspruunid toonid, eriti müür ja majade katused pastoosselt maalitud. (eesti)
works.de: A narrow old-town street. On the left a house with open windows and a hanging sign, on the right low houses with window shutters, above which a piece of the town wall with a semicircular, roofless tower. Greyish-brown tones dominate, especially the wall and the roofs of the houses painted in a pastose manner.

works.d: Naise rinnapilt profiilis vasakule. Rikkalikel blondidel juustel kollane lilleline tanu, samast materjalist varrukate ülaosa, mustal vestil valge žaboo jämeda kuldketiga.
works.de: A bust portrait of a woman in profile to the left. On her rich blonde hair a yellow floral bonnet, the upper part of the sleeves of the same material, a white jabot with a thick gold chain on a black vest.

works.d: Laual vaas kirjude lilledega, mille ees mõned lilleõied ja rohelised õunad. Vaasi taga kummuli asetatud korv. Koloriidis rohkesti punaseid ja lillakaid toone.
works.de: On the table a vase with multicoloured flowers, in front of it a few flower blossoms and green apples. Behind the vase an upturned basket. The colouring contains many red and purplish tones.

works.d: Elevandi luukarva liist
works.de: Ivory-coloured moulding

works.d: Visandlikult antud vanema naise rinnaportree. Naise tumedad juuksed on keskel lahku kammitud ja kuklasse kokku pandud, ninal peente kuldsete raamide ja väikeste ümarate klaasidega prillid. Seljas tume kleit, samast riidest krae on tagant üles tõstetud, rinnal kamee. Suurem osa kleidist ja foon lõpetamata.
works.de: A sketchily rendered bust portrait of an elderly woman. The woman's dark hair is parted in the middle and gathered at the back of the head, on her nose glasses with thin gilt frames and small round lenses. Wearing a dark dress, a collar of the same fabric raised at the back, a cameo on the chest. Most of the dress and the background left unfinished.

works.d: Tütarlapse poolfiguur, poolprofiilis vasakule, punases baretis ja halli karusnahkse kraega.
works.de: Half-figure of a girl, in half-profile to the left, wearing a red beret and a grey fur collar.

works.d: Keskel, madala kiviaia taga kündja (mees). Adra ees kaks hobust. Kiviaia vasakul ja paremal raagus puud.
works.de: In the centre, behind a low stone wall, a ploughman (a man). Two horses in front of the plough. Bare trees to the left and right of the stone wall.

works.d: Žanristseen. Ees vasakul, laua ääres, toolil istuv tütarlaps. Seljas maani seelik. Ta vastas küünarnukkidega lauale toetuv laia äärega kübaras meesterahvas. Nende taga paremal selgvaates vanem naine oma ees seisvate meestega žestikuleerides. Ees paremal kassi peale haukuv koer.(eesti)
works.de: Genre scene. In front on the left, sitting on a chair by a table, a girl. Wearing a floor-length skirt. Opposite her a man in a wide-brimmed hat leaning on the table with his elbows. Behind them on the right, seen frontally, an older woman gesturing with the men standing in front of her. In front on the right a dog barking at a cat.

works.dm: laius: 111.5 cm; kõrgus: 83.0 cm; kõrgus: 82.5 cm; laius: 112.0 cm
works.d: Esiplaanil mööda külateed vasemalt paremale sõitev taluvanker naisega, vankri taga lehm. Tagaplaanil õlgkatustega taluhooned puude vahel. Hele koloriit.
works.de: In the foreground a farm cart with a woman driving along the village road from left to right, behind the cart a cow. In the background farm buildings with straw roofs among trees. Light colouring.

works.d: Heledate kahlus juustega madruseülikonnas poisikese rinnapilt en face.
works.de: Bust portrait, en face, of a boy in a sailor suit with light bushy hair.

works.dm: kõrgus: 44.7 cm (pm); laius: 30.8 cm (km); kõrgus: 22.8 cm (km); laius: 58.7 cm (pm)
works.d: Esiplaanil väljak monumendiga vasemal, mingid lauad, inimfiguurid. Taga katedraal, paremal kõrge maja nurk, nende vahelt paistab kaugemalt tornikesega ehitis.
works.de: In the foreground a square with a monument on the left, some tables, human figures. Behind, a cathedral, on the right the corner of a tall building, between them, farther away, a building with a small tower can be seen.

works.d: Kahekorruseliste majade ja puukuuride vahel hoov. Taevas valkjas - hall.
works.de: A courtyard between two-storey houses and woodsheds. The sky whitish-grey.

works.dm: laius: 100.5 cm (arm); kõrgus: 72.5 cm; kõrgus: 72.5 cm (arm    ); laius: 101.0 cm
works.d: Esiplaanil paremal lai jõgi üksikute kergelt rohetavate leppade ja kaskedega kaldal. Vasakul üksik hoone. Keskel puude vahelt paistmas kivihoone. Taga paremal puud.
works.de: In the foreground on the right a broad river with single slightly greening alders and birches on the bank. On the left a single building. In the middle a stone building visible among the trees. Behind on the right trees.

works.d: Maali keskel Vanemuine kandlega punases rüüs, puutüve taustal. Vasakul tütarlaps profiilis pikkade juustega, valges kleidis, sinises rüüs. Paremal lehm ja lambad, jänes, kaks luike, vasakul pruunikas kukk.
works.de: In the centre of the painting, Vanemuine with a kannel in a red robe, against the background of a tree trunk. On the left a girl in profile with long hair, in a white dress, in a blue robe. On the right a cow and sheep, a hare, two swans, on the left a brownish rooster.

works.d: Esiplaanil tänav, keskel plankaed, mille tagant näha punaste katustega majade grupp.
works.de: In the foreground a street, in the middle a plank fence, behind which a group of houses with red roofs is visible.

works.d: Neli meest laua ümber, kaks vasakul, kaks teisel pool lauda, üks neist karvamütsis. Laual pudelid ja tubakakotid, täidetud klaasid tõstetud. Hallikal seinal nagi jalutuskepiga.
works.de: Four men around a table, two on the left, two on the other side of the table, one of them wearing a fur hat. On the table bottles and tobacco pouches, filled glasses raised. On the greyish wall a coat hook with a walking stick.

works.d: Hallides ja pruunides toonides maalitud mererand: esiplaanil rohututid, kaldale tõmmatud ja vaia külge kinnitatud paat (valges tanus naine paadis külitamas) ja postidel kuivavad mõrrad. Esiplaanil keskel pruunis seelikus, mustas jakis, valges tanus ja põlles naine, kalakorv kaenla all. Foonil silmapiirini ulatuv tüüne meri üksikute paatidega ja sinine, ülalt heledasti valgustatud pilvedega taevas.
works.de: A sea shore painted in grey and brown tones: in the foreground grass tufts, a boat drawn up onto the shore and fastened to a stake (a woman in a white bonnet lying sideways in the boat) and fish traps drying on posts. In the foreground centre a woman in a brown skirt, black jacket, white bonnet and apron, a fish basket under her arm. In the background a calm sea reaching to the horizon with a few boats, and a blue sky brightly lit from above with clouds.

works.d: Kaks poisikest hobuste seljas.
works.de: Two boys on horseback.

works.d: Mustas frakis noormehe põlvpilt poolprofiilis paremale.
works.de: Knee-length portrait of a young man in a black tailcoat, in half-profile to the right.

works.d: Pastoosselt, laiade jämedate pintslitõmmetega maalitud maastik kirgastes värvitoonides, mille ümardatud vorme piiritlevad põhitooniga hele - tumeduselt kontrasteeruvad jämedad kontuurid. Vaatepunktiga kõrgemalt kui silmade kõrgus vaade üle sinepikollase rohumaa, millele esiplaanil langevad ümarad värvikirkad puudevarjud. Tagaplaanil vasakul suurte võradega lehtpuude taustal punakaspruun ait nurgaga vaataja poole.
works.de: A landscape painted pastosely, with broad, thick brushstrokes, in bright colour tones, whose rounded forms are delimited by thick contours contrasting in light-dark with the base tone. From a viewpoint higher than eye level, a view over a mustard-yellow meadow, onto which, in the foreground, fall the round, brightly coloured shadows of trees. In the background on the left, against the background of deciduous trees with large crowns, a reddish-brown barn with its corner facing the viewer.

works.d: Pruunil alusel küljeli olev anum, millest välja kukkunud: (paremal) kimp sibulaid pealsetega, (vasakul) kapsapea. Pilt rohelises, pruunis koloriidis.
works.de: A vessel lying on its side on a brown base, from which have fallen: (right) a bunch of onions with tops, (left) a head of cabbage. Picture in a green, brown colour scheme.

works.d: Vasakul alumises nurgas kaarsild, millest eespool kraanad ja kaks kollast liivahunnikut, taamal linna siluett. Paremal betooniga ääristatud kaldarinnatis, tee, mis kauguses lõppeb ümmarguse aiamajakesega. Kahel pool teed puuderida (raagus). Paremal kolmnurkne kaldpind, mille taga tumeroheline kuppel. Taevas helesinine, vasakus ülemises nurgas kollaselt kumav. Puude võrad, liivahunnikud, tee pastoosselt, paksu värvikihiga maalitud, õrn läbipaistev üldkoloriit.(eesti)
works.de: In the lower left corner an arched bridge, in front of which cranes and two yellow sand heaps, in the distance the silhouette of a city. On the right a concrete-edged embankment parapet, a path that ends in the distance at a round garden pavilion. On both sides of the path a row of trees (bare). On the right a triangular sloping surface, behind which a dark green dome. The sky is light blue, glowing yellow in the upper left corner. The crowns of the trees, the sand heaps, and the path are painted impasto, with a thick layer of paint, the overall colour range delicate and transparent.

works.d: Ees keskel kuplitaoline mäeküngas kahe jändriku männiga tipul. Künka jalal lõkketule ääres kaks meest, vanker, rohtusööv hobune. Paremal, tagapool, küün. Muu ümbrus kuni silmapiirini lage tasandik. 3/4 tööst kuust valgustatud taeva all.(eesti)
works.de: In the front center a dome-like hillock with two gnarled pines at its top. At the foot of the hill by a campfire two men, a cart, a horse grazing on grass. On the right, further back, a barn. The rest of the surroundings up to the horizon a bare plain. 3/4 of the work under a sky lit by the moon.

works.t: a) Teatri interjöör; b) Mehe portree
works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul ja paremal rühm rohekates ja pruunides palitutes, teravatipuliste kübaratega, muhvidega ja boadega naisi. Tagaplaanil teatri interjöör peeglitega: vasakul aktiskulptuur, paremal sinakasrohelises õhtukleidis, paljaste õlgadega ja punaste juustega daam, kelle selg peegeldub ta selja taga asuvas peeglis. Fooniosa külmades sinistes, rohelistes ja lillades toonides.
works.de: In the foreground, on the left and right, a group of women in greenish and brown coats, with sharply pointed hats, muffs, and boas. In the background a theatre interior with mirrors: on the left a nude sculpture, on the right a lady in a bluish-green evening gown, with bare shoulders and red hair, whose back is reflected in the mirror behind her. The background area in cold blue, green, and lilac tones.

works.d: Suvine vaade agulile. Esiplaanil paremal kirikuaiaga ääristatud tee. Aia taga vasakul rukkihakid, kooguga kaev, tagapool kaks rookatusega taluhoonet, punase maja ots. Hoonete taga keskel, pilvise taeva taustal paistab punase kiivriga kirikutorn. Lopsakas pintslikäik, tumeda kontuuriga vorme jälgiv.
works.de: A summer view of a suburb. In the foreground on the right a road bordered by a churchyard. Behind the fence on the left, sheaves of rye, a well with a sweep, further back two thatched farm buildings, the gable end of a red house. Behind the buildings in the centre, against the backdrop of a cloudy sky, the red-helmeted church tower is visible. Lush brushwork, following forms with dark contours.

works.d: Esiplaanil mererand. Keskel neli meest noota harutamas. Läbi vee läheneb rannale kalur. Merel näha paati.
works.de: A seashore in the foreground. In the middle four men untangling a fishing net. A fisherman approaching the shore through the water. A boat visible at sea.

works.d: Roosades ja lillades toonides mägede ning järve või lahesopi taustal seitse meeletus hoos ringi kappavat ratsanikku. Hobused enamasti tagajalgadel, ratsanikud erinevates kunstilistes poosides, nurgelised figuurid ja liigutused.
works.de: In pink and lilac tones, against the background of mountains and a lake or bay, seven riders galloping around in frantic motion. The horses mostly on their hind legs, the riders in various artistic poses, angular figures and movements.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 21.6 cm; lehe laius: 30.0 cm
works.d: Ees vasakul oleva täiskuust valgustatud veekogu ääres kaks vaaraode kolossaalset skulptuuri. Nende juures tule ümber inimfiguure. Taamal paremal templi varemed, vasakul sammastike read.
works.de: In the front, beside a body of water lit by a full moon on the left, two colossal sculptures of pharaohs. Around them, near a fire, human figures. In the distance on the right, ruins of a temple, on the left rows of colonnades.

works.d: Esiplaanil, sinakashallil veekogul paat. Paremal: kraanad ja telliskivipunane kuuritaoline ehitis, mille taga kivisöe hunnik (?). Vasakul kaks maja.
works.de: In the foreground, on a bluish-grey body of water, a boat. On the right: cranes and a brick-red shed-like building, behind which a pile of coal (?). On the left two houses.

works.d: Põskhabemega mehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis vasemale. Peakatteks punakat tooni, halli ääristusega kottmüts, mille sopp ulatub rätitaoliselt rippuvana õlgadeni. Riietuseks pintsakülikond heleda särgiga, mille rinnaesisel näha tumedat värvi pikk kaelaside.
works.de: Chest portrait of a man with side-whiskers in three-quarter profile to the left. As headwear, a reddish-toned, grey-trimmed fur cap, whose flap hangs down to the shoulders like a shawl. Clothing consists of a suit jacket with a light shirt, on the front of which a long dark-coloured necktie can be seen.

works.d: Kõrge laubaga hallijuukselise mehe pea, kerge pöördega paremale. Riietuseks sinakat tooni särk pruunja pintsaku all.
works.de: Head of a grey-haired man with a high forehead, slightly turned to the right. Clothing a bluish-toned shirt under a brown jacket.

works.d: Esiplaanil lage rohumaa. Tagaplaanil paremal küngas puudega. Kaugemal puudegrupp.
works.de: In the foreground bare grassland. In the background on the right a hill with trees. Further away a group of trees.

works.d: Osa tänavast majadegrupiga ääres. Esiplaanil keskel raagus puu. Taustaks terashall taevas.
works.de: Part of a street with a group of houses along it. In the foreground in the middle a bare tree. Steel-grey sky as background.

works.d: Keskealise mehe põlvpilt istuvas asendis, poolprofiilis vasakule. Täishabe ja vurrud. Seljas sinine kuub.
works.de: Knee-length portrait of a middle-aged man in a sitting position, in half-profile to the left. Full beard and moustache. Wearing a blue coat.

works.d: Päikesepaisteline taluõu: esiplaanil vasakul kooguga kaev, paremal roigasaed ja küüniots. Tagapool matsakas õlgkatusega, palkidest talumaja, millest kahel pool suured rohelised puud. Silmapiiril paremal, kahe hoone vahel, on näha jupike järvest. Ülal sinine, valgete pilvekuhilatega kaetud taevas.(eesti)
works.de: A sunny farmyard: in the foreground on the left a well with a sweep, on the right a pole fence and the end of a barn. Behind, a stout log farmhouse with a thatched roof, flanked by large green trees. On the horizon on the right, between two buildings, a small piece of a lake can be seen. Above, a blue sky covered with white cloud heaps.

works.d: Esiplaanil paadisild, millel lühikeste juustega valges särgis ja seelikus tütarlaps kükitades vees pesu loputab. Tütarlapse kõrval paadisillal kauss punase pesutükiga. Vasakul foonil paat ühe aeruga, taga kõrkjad. Paremal foonil tükike lagedat vett, kõrkjaid ning valged pardid.
works.de: In the foreground a boat jetty, on which a short-haired girl in a white shirt and skirt rinses laundry in the water while squatting. Beside the girl on the jetty a bowl with a piece of red laundry. In the background on the left a boat with one oar, behind it reeds. In the background on the right a patch of open water, reeds and white ducks.

works.d: Esiplaanil varemed. Taga vasakul mäed.
works.de: Ruins in the foreground. Mountains at the back left.

works.dm: kõrgus: 79.0 cm (km.   ); laius: 66.7 cm (pm.   ); laius: 57.0 cm (km.   ); kõrgus: 82.0 cm (pm.   )
works.d: Mehe poolfiguur poolprofiilis vasemale, istuvas asendis. Paremas käes pintsel, vasemas pabeross. Taga seinal rippuv maal.
works.de: Half-figure of a man in three-quarter profile to the left, in a seated position. A brush in his right hand, a cigarette in his left. Behind him a painting hangs on the wall.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal naine kahe lehmaga, vasakul jalgrada. Tagaplaanil hooned ja lehtpuu.
works.de: In the foreground on the right a woman with two cows, on the left a footpath. In the background buildings and a deciduous tree.

works.d: Naise poolfiguur poolprofiilis paremale. Hallis kleidis.
works.de: Half-figure of a woman in half-profile to the right. In a grey dress.

works.d: Pruunijuukselise noore naise rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale. Ümber õlgade mässitud sinine rüü.
works.de: Bust portrait of a young brown-haired woman in half-profile facing right. A blue robe wrapped around her shoulders.

works.d: Mehe täisfiguur poolprofiilis paremale, tugitoolis istuvana; põlvede vahel valge rinna ja käppadega koer.
works.de: Full figure of a man in half-profile to the right, sitting in an armchair; between his knees a white-chested and white-pawed dog.

works.d: Naise rinnapilt poolprofiilis vasakule. Pitsidega tanu pikad lindid ulatuvad sinisele, dekolteega kleidil kantavale pruunikas toonis mantlile.(eesti)
works.de: Bust portrait of a woman in half-profile to the left. The long ribbons of a lace-trimmed bonnet reach onto a brownish-toned coat worn over a blue dress with a décolleté.

works.d: Vaade ülalt pruunile lauale ja sellel asuvatele esemetele: keskel piklik punaste õunte, pirnide ja kollakate ploomidega täidetud korv ja vineerist silindrikujuline kohvrike, kaas lahti, siniseid ploome täis (rätiku peal). Esiplaanil kaks teravat nuga ja kaks suurt pirni. Foon ülaosas tume, sinakashall.
works.de: A view from above of a brown table and the objects on it: in the middle an oblong basket filled with red apples, pears and yellowish plums, and a veneer cylindrical small case, lid open, full of blue plums (on a cloth). In the foreground two sharp knives and two large pears. The background is dark, bluish-grey in the upper part.

works.d: Valge raamiga
works.de: With a white frame

works.d: Hallijuukselise rauga rinnapilt eestvaates. Põskhabemest piiratud nägu kallutatud ettepoole, silmad suletud. Seljas valge särk, mille kaelus kinnitatud ristsõlega ja tume kuub.
works.de: Bust portrait of a grey-haired old man, frontal view. Face framed by side-whiskers, tilted forward, eyes closed. Wearing a white shirt with the collar fastened with a cross-knot, and a dark coat.

works.d: Esiplaanil lage mäekallak, keskel avar järv, taamal künklikul maastikul metsatukk.
works.de: In the foreground a bare mountain slope, in the middle a wide lake, in the distance a grove in a hilly landscape.

works.t: Vaade Tallinnale Patkuli trepi juurest (Tallinna vaade linnamüüriga)
works.d: Esiplaanil vasakust nurgast diagonaalselt paremale orgu läbiv kivine müür. Müüri taga paremalt diagonaalselt sügavusse suunduv linnamüür ümmarguste tornidega. Müüri taga telliskatusega majad ja Oleviste kiriku torn. Linna müürist vasakul alumisest nurgast sügavusse kulgeb siksaki kujuline nõlvak.
works.de: In the foreground, a stone wall running diagonally from the left corner to the right through a valley. Behind the wall, a city wall with round towers running diagonally from the right into the depth. Behind the wall, houses with tiled roofs and the tower of St. Olaf's Church (Oleviste). To the left of the city wall, a zigzag-shaped slope runs from the lower corner into the depth.

works.d: Keskealise naise rinnafiguur kerges pöördes vasakule. Seljas hall avara dekolteega kleit, peas pitstanu.
works.de: Bust figure of a middle-aged woman in a slight turn to the left. Wearing a grey dress with a wide décolletage, a lace cap on her head.

works.d: Valged lamedate katustega astmelised hooned laugjal mäenõlval. Maastik lillas - rohelises - pruunis koloriidis, taevas sinine.
works.de: White, flat-roofed, stepped buildings on a gently sloping hillside. Landscape in a colour scheme of lilac - green - brown, sky blue.

works.d: Esiplaanil hele sadamakai ning raske sadamakraana, mille ees pruun vagun ning sügavsinine lossitav laev. Taamal Tallinna siluett, laevast paremal tõuseb eriti esile Oleviste kirik. Linna kohal kollaste ja siniste säpsivate pintslilöökidega antud taevas. Domineerivad sinised ja pruunid toonid.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground a light-coloured harbour quay and a heavy harbour crane, in front of it a brown wagon and a deep blue ship being unloaded. In the distance the silhouette of Tallinn, to the right of the ship the Oleviste Church stands out especially. Above the city a sky rendered with brisk yellow and blue brushstrokes. Blue and brown tones dominate.

works.d: Esiplaanil lõigatud viljaga ja vihkudega viljapõld, neli inimest (kaks meest ja kaks naist) rehadega vilja vihkudesse köitmas. Tagaplaanil vasakul järv põõsastega selle siinpoolsel kaldal, paremal rukkihakid ja metsasalu. Silmapiiril tumesinine metsaviirg, ülal sinine, valgete pilvedega kaetud taevas.
works.de: In the foreground a grain field with cut grain and sheaves, four people (two men and two women) binding grain into sheaves with rakes. In the background on the left a lake with bushes on its near shore, on the right rye stooks and a small wood. On the horizon a dark blue strip of forest, above a blue sky covered with white clouds.

works.d: Natüürmort kahe kannu ja tassiga.
works.de: Still life with two jugs and a cup.

works.d: Naisakt istuvas asendis. Parema käega maski näo ees hoidmas, vasak käsi vabalt alla rippumas. Pildi ülanurgas maske.
works.de: Female nude in a seated position. Holding a mask in front of her face with the right hand, the left hand hanging freely down. Masks in the upper corner of the picture.

works.d: Pealtvaade värvikatele viilkatustega majadele, paremal kirikutorn. Tagaplaanil vasakul lahesopp tumeda, rohekassinise taeva all. Maalitud hoogsalt, visandlikult.
works.de: A bird's-eye view of houses with colourful gable roofs, on the right a church tower. In the background on the left a bay under a dark, greenish-blue sky. Painted boldly, sketchily.

works.d: Õue kivimajade vahel keskel plankudest aed avatud väravaga; taga kõrge viiluga maja taustal lumine puu; vasakul ees maja uste ees regi, paremal katuse all vanker.
works.de: A yard among stone houses, in the middle a plank fence with an open gate; behind it a house with a high gable against a background of a snowy tree; on the left in front a sledge by the house doors, on the right a cart under the roof.

works.d: Perspektiivis kujutatud plangutaolise, vertikaalsete triipudega pinna taustal hõljuvad oranžikad, helesinised mügarjad kujundid, piiritletud tumeda kontuurjoonega. Paremal, pildi äärel mutrivõtmed, haamer jm. tööriistade kujutised.(eesti)
works.de: Against a background depicting a plank-like surface with vertical stripes rendered in perspective, orange and light blue lumpy shapes float, delineated with a dark contour line. On the right, at the edge of the picture, depictions of wrenches, a hammer and other tools.

works.d: Esiplaanil torude, purkide, vaaside, vana mööbli jms. ülekuhjatud tühermaa. Vasakul küngas, millel kasvab kollase-rohelisega maalitud puu. Teine, pikem puu on paigutatud paremasse serva. Parempoolse puu all vana mannerg. Äravisatud asjad hallikassinistes ja punastes toonides, nende kujutamisel on kohati kasutatud kangast. Künka taga horisontaalselt üle pildi pinna meri, künkast paremal puudega kaetud saar. Ülal rasketes kollastes, punastes ja sinistes toonides triibuline taevas.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground a wasteland overpiled with pipes, jars, vases, old furniture etc. On the left a hillock on which grows a tree painted in yellow-green. Another, taller tree is placed at the right edge. Under the tree on the right an old milk can. The discarded objects in greyish-blue and red tones, in their depiction fabric has been used in places. Behind the hillock, horizontally across the picture surface, the sea; to the right of the hillock an island covered with trees. Above, in heavy yellow, red and blue tones, a striped sky.

works.d: Üksteisesse lõikuvate munajate vormide mass sinistes, punastes, lillades ja roosades toonides esiplaanil. Foonil tumesinine, ülaltpoolt helendav kosmiline ruum.
works.de: A mass of intersecting egg-shaped forms in blue, red, lilac and pink tones in the foreground. In the background a dark blue, cosmic space glowing from above.

works.d: Pruunides ning rohelistes toonides ebakorrapärastest pindadest kompositsioon. Paremal heledas toonis kolm geomeetrilist kujundit. Ülal keskel ning esiplaanil vasakul kaks kolletanud vahtralehte.
works.de: A composition of irregular surfaces in brown and green tones. On the right, in a light tone, three geometric shapes. At the top centre and in the foreground on the left two yellowed maple leaves.

works.d: Ees keskel Petserimaa rahvarõivais naise ja mehe täisfiguurid. Taga paremal Petseri kloostri motiiv.
works.de: In the front centre, full figures of a woman and a man in Petserimaa folk costume. In the back on the right, a motif of the Petseri monastery.

works.d: Töö keskel, kaljusaarel, punases valguses lossi varemed. All paremal vees kolm näkki. Taevas kaetud purpurselt kumavate pilvedega.
works.de: In the middle of the work, on a rocky island, the ruins of a castle in red light. Below on the right in the water three nixies. The sky covered with purple-glowing clouds.

works.d: Lühikeste, tumedate juustega noore mehe portree, poolpöördes paremale. Suus piip. Ninajuurel sügav kurd; uuriv pilk suunatud vasakule. Kontuur rõhutatud. Koloriidis valdavad sinised-punased värvivarjundid.
works.de: Portrait of a young man with short, dark hair, in a three-quarter turn to the right. A pipe in his mouth. A deep furrow at the bridge of his nose; a searching gaze directed to the left. The contour is emphasized. The colour scheme is dominated by blue-red hues.

works.d: Tumedal, roheka varjundiga foonil kimp punaseõielisi daaliaid. Värvipind pastoosne.
works.de: On a dark background with a greenish tinge, a bouquet of red-blossomed dahlias. Paint surface pastose.

works.d: Talvine linnavaade. Tänava ääres 2-3 korruselised majad. Paremal kõnnitee servas neli lumist puud. Tänavaristmikul kaks hobust regedega. Taustaks Toompea, Pika Hermaniga paremal ning kirikutorniga vasakul. Taevas sinakashall, maalitud erinevalt arhitektoonikast laiade pintslitõmmetega. Värvipind kohati faktuurne.
works.de: Winter cityscape. 2-3 storey buildings along the street. On the right, at the edge of the pavement, four snowy trees. Two horses with sledges at the street crossing. In the background Toompea, with Pikk Hermann on the right and a church tower on the left. Sky bluish-grey, painted differently from the architecture with broad brushstrokes. Paint surface textured in places.

works.d: Keskel püsti noor tõmmu naine itaalia rahvarõivais. Tema ees paremal mättal istuv poisike, käes pasun. Taamal vasakul meri ja kauguses sinav kõrge mäeahelik, paremal telk kaugete mägede taustal.(eesti)
works.de: In the middle, standing, a young dark-haired woman in Italian folk costume. In front of her on the right a boy sitting on a hillock, holding a horn. In the distance on the left the sea and a bluish high mountain range in the distance, on the right a tent against the background of distant mountains.

works.dm: laius: 153.0 cm (II osa (reljeefi kõrgus 12 cm)); kõrgus: 153.0 cm; kõrgus: 153.0 cm; laius: 153.0 cm (I osa (reljeefi kõrgus 12 cm))
works.d: Kaheosaline ruumiline kompositsioon vineeralusel, millele kinnitatud hulk erinevast materjalist olmejääke, esemeid: plastikvormid, õllepurgid, plastikrosett, riideribad, puitdetailid, ažuursed metalliribad jm. Esemete kuhi kulgeb alt vasakult üles paremale. Paremal äärel plastikrõngaste rida. Vineeralus veidi toonitud.
works.de: A two-part spatial composition on a plywood base, to which a number of household waste items and objects of various materials are attached: plastic moulds, beer cans, a plastic rosette, strips of cloth, wooden details, openwork metal strips etc. The heap of objects runs from the bottom left up to the right. On the right edge a row of plastic rings. The plywood base is slightly tinted.

works.d: Lumine äärelinna tänavanurk, vaadatuna veidi kõrgemalt. Esiplaanil suurte, laotud kivipostide ning sepisvõrega aia ees paremale liikuv grupp musta riietatud neljast naisest: vasakul rauk, tema ees kõnnivad kõrvuti kaks vanemat daami, kõige ees noor naine. Tänavanurgal, eelmisega ristuval tänaval musta riietatud rauk. Tagaplaanil vasakul rohekaspruun hoone, paremal ühekorruselise maja otsafassaad, keskplaanil vasakus kuldlõikes männitüvi. Ümar, pehme, juugendlik vormikäsitlus.
works.de: A snowy suburban street corner, viewed from slightly above. In the foreground, in front of a fence with large, built-up stone posts and a wrought-iron grille, a group of four women dressed in black moving to the right: on the left an old woman, in front of her two older ladies walking side by side, at the very front a young woman. At the street corner, on the intersecting street, an old woman dressed in black. In the background on the left a greenish-brown building, on the right the end façade of a single-storey house, in the middle ground on the left, in the golden section, a pine trunk. A rounded, soft, Art Nouveau treatment of form.

works.d: Noore, alasti naise enam - vähem väljamaalitud rinnapartii ja nagu kaitseks väljasirutatud vasak käsi harali sõrmedega. Ümber käsivarre heledad juuksed. Parem väljasirutatud käsivars näha kuni pildi vasakpoolsesse alumisse nurka ulatuva küünarnukini. Naise nägu visandatud kergete söejoontega. Lõuendi ülemisel poolel vaba krunt. Väljamaalitud osas antud tume taust.
works.de: A young, naked woman's more or less painted-out breast area and, as if in defence, an outstretched left hand with spread fingers. Light hair around the arm. The outstretched right forearm is visible up to the elbow, which extends into the lower left corner of the picture. The woman's face is sketched with light charcoal lines. The upper half of the canvas is a bare ground. In the painted-out area a dark background is given.

works.t: a) Maastik heinakuhjaga; b) Pariisi motiiv (lõpetamata)
works.d: Veidi vasakule tõusval lamedal nõlvakul esiplaanil koonusekujuline pruunikas heinakuhi, tagapool kolm kuhja. Silmapiiril, rünkpilvise taeva foonil vasakul kähar puu, paremal metsatriip. Maalitud lühikeste jõuliste pintslilöökidega.
works.de: On a flat slope rising slightly to the left, in the foreground a conical brownish haystack, with three stacks behind. On the horizon, against a cumulus-clouded sky, a curly tree on the left, a strip of forest on the right. Painted with short, vigorous brushstrokes.

works.d: Musta-rohelise-punase-sinise-lilla-roosa triibulisel riidel kuus kooritud kartulit.
works.de: On a black-green-red-blue-purple-pink striped cloth, six peeled potatoes.

works.d: Punase-lilla-musta mustrilisel riidel viis virsikut.
works.de: Five peaches on a red-purple-black patterned cloth.

works.t: Küüslaugud kirjul vaibal. (Natüürmort. Sibulad ja kooritud kartulid kirjul vaibal)
works.d: Punase-rohelise-sinise mustrilisel vaibal kolm küüslagu mugulat. Nende kõrval, vasakul kartulid. Foon tumepunane. Maalipind faktuurne.
works.de: Three garlic bulbs on a carpet with a red-green-blue pattern. Beside them, on the left, potatoes. Dark red background. Textured painting surface.

works.d: Esiplaanil veekogu. Kaldal rohelise-kollasekirjud puud-põõsad. Üle nende paistab heleda hoone siluett. Taevas pilvitu. Värvigamma hele. Maalimislaad impressionistlik.
works.de: In the foreground a body of water. On the bank green-yellow mottled trees and bushes. Above them the silhouette of a bright building is visible. The sky is cloudless. Bright colour range. Impressionist painting style.

works.dm: kõrgus: 28.7 cm (km   ); laius: 29.8 cm (lm  ); laius: 28.5 cm (km); kõrgus: 30.9 cm (lm)
works.d: Esiplaanil paremal, veekogu kaldal lamava figuuri siluett. Tagaplaanil, vastaskladal paistavad mäed. Valdav sinine värvigamma.
works.de: In the foreground right, the silhouette of a figure lying on the shore of a body of water. In the background, on the opposite shore, mountains are visible. Predominant blue colour range.

works.d: Noore naise rinnaportree, profiilis vasakule. Näo osa väljamaalitud. Juuksed, rohekas kõrge kaelusega kleit ning bordoopunane foon lõpetamata.
works.de: Bust portrait of a young woman, in profile to the left. Part of the face is painted in. Hair, greenish high-collared dress and burgundy-red background unfinished.

works.d: Seljaga vaataja poole seisab kaarja avause ees heledapäine mees. Üle vasaku õla loomanahk, paremas käes paljastatud mõõk. Avausest paistab kosk ning punetav taevas.
works.de: A fair-haired man stands with his back to the viewer before an arched opening. An animal hide over his left shoulder, a bared sword in his right hand. Through the opening a waterfall and a reddening sky are visible.

works.d: Ookril alusel, lillakas-roosal foonil uhmer koos uhmrinuiaga.
works.de: On an ochre stand, against a purplish-pink background, a mortar with a pestle.

works.d: Esiplaanilt, keskelt suubub väikese kaarega pildi sügavusse kitsas tee. Kahel pool puude tüvid, nende vahelt paistab madal aiamüür. Koloriit tume.
works.de: From the foreground, in the middle, a narrow path recedes into the depth of the picture with a slight curve. On both sides tree trunks, between which a low garden wall is visible. Colouring dark.

works.d: a) "Mees ahviga"
works.de: a) "Mees ahviga"

works.d: Esiplaanil rohuala ja paremalt kaugusse suunduv tee. Mõlemal pool teed valgetüvelised kased ja okaspuud. Paremal tagaplaanil majad.
works.de: In the foreground a grassy area and a road leading into the distance from the right. On both sides of the road white-trunked birches and conifers. In the background on the right, houses.

works.d: Vasakul pruunika õlgkatusega talumaja ots, mille ees kuurid, puuridad. Esiplaanil õuemurul kanad. Tagaplaanil, läbi roheliste puukroonide paistab veetriip. Maal kroomrohekais, pruunides toonides.
works.de: On the left the gable end of a farmhouse with a brownish straw roof, in front of it sheds, woodpiles. In the foreground, hens on the yard's grass. In the background, a strip of water shows through green treetops. The painting in chromium-green, brown tones.

works.d: Tumedajuukselise ning -silmse poisi portree otsevaates, suu kergelt avatud. Maalitud hoogsate, laiade pintslilöökidega. Värvipind kohati kergelt faktuurne.
works.de: Portrait of a dark-haired, dark-eyed boy in frontal view, mouth slightly open. Painted with vigorous, broad brushstrokes. The paint surface is in places slightly textured.

works.d: Lillakaspruunil foonil hallide vuntside ja habemega mehe rinnaportree otsevaates. Mehel ovaalsed kuldraamidega prillid ees, ninajuurel kaks sügavat kortsu. Tumedad hallisegused juuksed üle pea kammitud. Seljas tume kuub. Maalitud lühikese sileda pintslilöögiga.
works.de: Frontal bust portrait of a man with grey moustache and beard on a purplish-brown background. The man wears oval gold-framed glasses, two deep wrinkles at the bridge of the nose. Dark greyish hair combed back over the head. Wearing a dark coat. Painted with short smooth brushstrokes.

works.d: Keskealise mehe poolprofiilis rinnapilt, pöördega vasakule; triibulise lipsuga.
works.de: Chest-length portrait of a middle-aged man in three-quarter profile, turned to the left; wearing a striped tie.

works.d: Näpitsprillidega mehe portree, poolprofiilis paremale.
works.de: Portrait of a man with pince-nez, in half-profile to the right.

works.d: Noore naise pea täisprofiilis vasakule, otsaesisel väike tukk.(eesti)
works.de: Head of a young woman in full profile to the left, a small fringe on the forehead.

works.d: Vanema mehe rinnaportree veerandpöördes vasakule. Mehel kõrge paljas laup, hallid juuksed, sügav kurd ninajuurel, altkulmu pilk suunatud vaatajale. Seljas mustjas sallkraega jakk, selle kaelusest roosakas rõivas paistmas. Rohekashallid tumedad toonid.
works.de: Chest portrait of an older man in a quarter-turn to the left. The man has a high bare forehead, grey hair, a deep furrow at the bridge of the nose, a gaze directed at the viewer from under his brows. Wearing a blackish jacket with a scarf collar, from whose collar a pinkish garment can be seen. Greenish-grey dark tones.

works.d: Tumedas rõivastuses istuva naise poolfiguur kerges pöördes paremale. Paremal pool naise süles kollakas rõivastuses laps.
works.de: Half-figure of a seated woman in dark clothing, in a slight turn to the right. On the right, in the woman's lap, a child in yellowish clothing.

works.d: Alumine pool kujutisest sügavsinine meri valgete laineharjadega. Ülemine pool peaaegu valge taevas, sinakate, paremal valgest läbikumavate, punakate kaldpintslitõmmetega - meenutab jäämäge, mille tipp kujutise ülemise servaga ära lõigatud.
works.de: The lower half of the image is deep blue sea with white wave crests. The upper half is an almost white sky, with bluish, reddish diagonal brushstrokes shining through white on the right - reminiscent of an iceberg, whose peak is cut off by the upper edge of the image.

works.d: Ülal kiirtesõõris kahe ingli vahel trooniv Kristus. All keskel Maarja, Kristus ja kaks kuldsete tiibadega inglit õnnistamas kahel pool seisvat ja kummardavat rahvast.
works.de: Above, Christ enthroned in a halo of rays between two angels. Below in the centre Mary, Christ and two angels with golden wings blessing the people standing and bowing on both sides.

works.d: Maali pind jagatud kuueks erivärviliseks püstiasendis ristkülikuks. Ülareas rohekas - kollane, punane, tumesinine, all ooker, lilla, roheline. Värvilistel pindadel väikesed lõigatud laigukesed, mis toovad nähtavale alumised värvikihid, moodustades samal ajal teat. rütmilise mustri. Ülemises reas kahel äärmisel värvipaneelil ning all keskmisel on lõikelaigukesed sümmeetriliselt ridades. Nende vastasolevatel ristkülikutel on augukesed koondunud tsentrumisse, moodustades nii väikese kobara.
works.de: The surface of the painting is divided into six vertically oriented rectangles of different colours. In the upper row: greenish-yellow, red, dark blue; below: ochre, purple, green. On the coloured surfaces small cut-out spots reveal the lower layers of paint, at the same time forming a certain rhythmic pattern. On the two outermost colour panels in the upper row and on the middle one below, the cut spots are arranged symmetrically in rows. On the opposite rectangles the small holes are concentrated in the centre, forming a small cluster.

works.d: Kahest poolest koosnev abstraktne kompositsioon: vertikaalsest keskjoonest vasakul on oranžile foonile maalitud must, valge, sinine, heleroosa ja roheline laik. Roheline kujund jätkub paremal, punasel foonil mustana. Parempoolsel osal, punasel foonil tumepunane, viimasega horisontaalne kollane, sinine ja külmroheline laik.
works.de: A composition in two halves: to the left of the vertical centre line, black, white, blue, light pink and green blotches are painted on an orange background. The green shape continues on the right, as black on a red background. On the right-hand part, on a red background, a dark red blotch, alongside a horizontal yellow, blue and cold-green blotch.

works.d: Esiplaanil põõsad, mille taga paremal paistab plank ja kahe aknaga viilkatusega maja ots. Vasakul näha punane katus. Keskel üksik puu. Vasakus nurgas lilled.
works.de: In the foreground bushes, behind which on the right a fence and the gable end of a house with two windows can be seen. On the left a red roof is visible. A solitary tree in the centre. Flowers in the left corner.

works.d: Šarž kunstnikust: kujutatud kassina naise peaga. Esimeste käppade vahel värvituub.
works.de: Caricature of the artist: depicted as a cat with a woman's head. Between the front paws a tube of paint.

works.d: Šarž kunstnikust: sammuva mehe täisfiguur profiilis vasemale. Vasak käsi taskus. Peas kaabu.
works.de: Caricature of the artist: full figure of a walking man in profile to the left. Left hand in pocket. A hat on his head.

works.d: Šarž kunstnikust: naise täisfiguur profiilis vasemale; sammuvas asendis. Parema kaenla all mapp. Vasakus käes kandekott.
works.de: Caricature of the artist: full figure of a woman in profile to the left; in a walking pose. A folder under the right arm. A carrying bag in the left hand.

works.d: Šarž kunstnikust: mehe põlvpilt poolprofiilis paremale. Vasak käsi kaabuga tõstetud üles, paremas käes kepp.
works.de: Caricature of the artist: knee-length portrait of a man in half-profile to the right. Left hand raised with a hat, a cane in the right hand.

works.d: Pruunikas-kollastes toonides, võrdlemisi lagedal külamaastikul aiaga ääristatud külavahetee, millel kõndimas kaks lehma. Paremal pool visandlikult markeeritud kooguga kaev ning hobusevanker kaevu juures. Kõrval ka taluhoone. Taamal kummalgil pool teed puudesalud ning hoone.
works.de: In brownish-yellow tones, a fairly open village landscape with a fenced village road, on which two cows are walking. On the right side a sketchily marked well with a sweep and a horse cart by the well. Beside it also a farm building. Further back on both sides of the road groves of trees and a building.

works.d: Sonimütsi ja paletiga valges särgis mehe rinnaportree tumepunasel, siniste ja roheliste laikudega foonil. Esiplaanil sinine molbert. Maalitud pastoosselt, fooni ja molberti osas võrdsete paralleelsete pintslilöökidega.
works.de: Bust portrait of a man in a white shirt wearing a beret, with a palette, against a dark red background with blue and green patches. In the foreground a blue easel. Painted in an impasto manner, with equal parallel brushstrokes in the background and easel areas.

works.d: a) Esiplaanil keskel kõrge jalaga sinine klaaspokaal suurte valgete õitega. Kollane foon.
works.de: a) In the foreground in the middle a tall-stemmed blue glass goblet with large white flowers. Yellow background.

works.d: Keskel kõrge lõke, mille ümber inimesed. Esiplaanil vasakul kaks vaataja suunas sammuvat madrust. Taga mets ja poole serva ulatuses tumesinine pilv.(eesti)
works.de: In the middle a tall bonfire, around which people. In the foreground on the left two sailors walking towards the viewer. Behind, a forest and, extending across half the edge, a dark blue cloud.

works.d: Poolpimedas talutoas, mida valgustavad laual asetsevad kaks küünalt, vasakus seinas akna all voodi lamajaga, mille ees istub mees, vasak käsi toetab pead, paremas käes raamat; paremal seisavad kaks figuuri - üks mees paljastatud peaga, pikas rüüs, teine naine. Toas mitmesuguseid majatarbeid, lae all kuivamas puuhalud.
