works.de: In a half-dark farmhouse room, lit by two candles standing on a table, in the left-hand wall under a window a bed with a person lying in it, in front of which sits a man, his left hand supporting his head, in his right hand a book; on the right stand two figures - one a man with a bare head, in a long robe, the other a woman. In the room various household implements, under the ceiling firewood drying.

works.d: Vaade Forum Romanumi lääneosale. Ees vasakul Marcus Aureliuse sammas, selle kõrval Septimus Severuse triumfikaar ja paremal Diocletianuse termidest ümber ehitatud Santa Maria degli Angeli kirik.
works.de: View of the western part of the Forum Romanum. In front on the left the Column of Marcus Aurelius, next to it the Arch of Septimius Severus, and on the right the Church of Santa Maria degli Angeli, converted from the Baths of Diocletian.

works.d: Esiplaanil veekogu kahekorruselise sillaga. Taamal tornidega linna siluett.
works.de: In the foreground a body of water with a two-storey bridge. In the distance the silhouette of a city with towers.

works.d: Neli punastes sportpükstes mehefiguuri väljasirutatud kätega punast palli püüdmas.
works.de: Four male figures in red sports trousers with outstretched arms catching a red ball.

works.d: Kuklasse kammitud juustega vana naise pea poolprofiilis paremale. Taustaks maastik kirikutorniga.
works.de: Head of an old woman with hair combed back, in semi-profile to the right. Landscape with a church tower as background.

works.d: Eesti rahvarõivais noore naise rinnapilt peaaegu en face. Peas pottmüts, lahtised juuksed.
works.de: Chest portrait of a young woman in Estonian folk costume, almost en face. Pot-shaped cap on head, loose hair.

works.d: Esiplaanil merel kalapaat allalastud purjedega, paadis istuv naisfiguur, punane rätt peas ja püstiseisev habemik mees, laiaäärelises kübaras ja pikkades kalurisaabastes võrku veest välja tõmbamas. Paadil vööris märk: DL. 23. Taamal näha mitmesuguses kauguses asuvaid purjepaate ning vasakult ja paremalt pildi keskosa suunas silmapiirilt kaduv mägine kaldaviirg, mille kohal vasakul näha tõusva päikese ketas.
works.de: In the foreground at sea a fishing boat with lowered sails, in the boat a seated female figure with a red kerchief on her head, and a standing bearded man in a wide-brimmed hat and long fisherman's boots pulling a net out of the water. On the bow of the boat a mark: DL. 23. In the distance sailing boats at various distances are visible, and from left and right toward the centre of the picture a mountainous coastline vanishing on the horizon, above which on the left the disc of the rising sun is visible.

works.d: Laual kõrges klaasist vaasis ja vaasi kõrval lebamas punased nelgid.
works.de: On the table, in a tall glass vase and lying beside the vase, red carnations.

works.d: Esiplaanil keskel tee, paremal suur kivi, taamal talumaja keskel ja puud.
works.de: In the foreground in the middle a road, on the right a large stone, in the distance a farmhouse in the middle and trees.

works.d: Esiplaanil tasane rohumaa põõsastega. Tagapool mets.
works.de: In the foreground flat grassland with bushes. Behind it a forest.

works.d: Ees vasakul kivine rand kahe kaldale tõmmatud venega. paremal meri. (Mere ja ranna piirjoon jookseb diagonaalselt paremast nurgast vasakule keskele).
works.de: In the foreground left a rocky shore with two boats pulled up onto the bank, right the sea. (The outline between sea and shore runs diagonally from the right corner to the centre left).

works.d: Paremal meri üksikute purjekatega horisondil. Vasakul järve kaljune kallas teda üleval ääristava müüriga. Üle müüri näha leht- ja okaspuude latvu. Horisondil mäeahelik.(eesti)
works.de: On the right the sea with solitary sailboats on the horizon. On the left a rocky shore of a lake bordered above by a wall. Over the wall the tops of deciduous and coniferous trees can be seen. On the horizon a mountain range.

works.d: Ees, kõrgete kividega servistatud kallaste vahel väike veekogu. Tagaplaanil tihe segamets.
works.de: In front, a small body of water between banks edged with tall stones. Dense mixed forest in the background.

works.d: Tumedas maani riietuses istuv naine, pilk vaatajale suunatud. Heleda kandiga rätik langeb pikalt õlgadele, süles hoiab punast raamatut ja heledat salli; seeliku alt ulatuvad välja punased kingad. Vasemal punane vaas, milles pildi ülemise servani ulatuv punaste õitega taim. Taevas kuu.
works.de: A woman sitting in dark floor-length clothing, gaze directed at the viewer. A shawl with a light-coloured edge falls long over her shoulders, on her lap she holds a red book and a light-coloured scarf; red shoes peek out from under her skirt. On the left a red vase, in which a plant with red flowers reaches to the upper edge of the picture. In the sky a moon.

works.d: Panoraammaastik kollaste viljapõldude ja talumajadega nende vahel. Silmapiiril tume metsaviirg, keskjoonest kõrgemal kõrge lopsakate valgete pilvedega taevas. Eriti viljapõld esiplaanil ja pilved taevas väga pastoosselt maalitud.(eesti)
works.de: Panoramic landscape with yellow grain fields and farmhouses among them. On the horizon a dark strip of forest, above the midline a tall sky with lush white clouds. The grain field in the foreground in particular, and the clouds in the sky, painted very pastosely.

works.d: Kollastest, lilladest, sinakashallidest ja mustadest värvilaikudest moodustuv inimese nägu. (eesti)
works.de: A human face formed of yellow, purple, bluish-grey and black patches of colour.

works.d: Keskel sinisel pinnal pruunikas roosa otsaga maja, vasakul ja paremal osad teistest majadest.(eesti)
works.de: In the centre on a blue surface a house with a brownish-pink end, on the left and right parts of other houses.

works.d: Erinevad geomeetrilised pinnad moodustavad keskosas tingliku inimfiguuri kaelaseotud käega. Esiplaanil vasakul all tikutoos ja tikk, paremal potilill, ülal paremal pilt inimfiguuridega. (eesti)
works.de: Different geometric surfaces form a conventional human figure with a tied neck in the central part. In the foreground at the bottom left a matchbox and a match, on the right a flowerpot, above on the right a picture with human figures.

works.d: Ees paremal kiduva taimestikuga jõeäärne lauskmaa. Vasakul nurgast taha, paremale keskele suunduv jõgi. Tagaplaanil paremal Riia linna siluett.
works.de: In the foreground on the right, a riverside flatland with sparse vegetation. On the left, a river leading from the back to the middle right. In the background on the right, the silhouette of the city of Riga.

works.d: Esiplaanil madal liivarand mida paremalt piiarb sopina vasakule ulatuv meri, kesosas vasakul järsult kõrgenev kallas okaspuuvõsaga. Taga paremal jätkub madal liivarand. Taevas kaugelt pilvine.
works.de: In the foreground a low sandy beach bordered on the right by the sea extending in a bay toward the left, in the middle section on the left a steeply rising bank with coniferous scrub. Further back on the right the low sandy beach continues. The sky is cloudy in the distance.

works.dm: kõrgus: 72.5 cm (tervik, arm.    ); laius: 86.0 cm (tervik, arm.   )
works.d: Esiplaanil varemed, varemete taga tänav sammuvate inimestega. Teisel pool tänavat näha Tallinna vanalinna maju, vasakul üle katuste paistva raekoja torniga. Taga, mere taustal suitsevad tehasekorstnad. Taevas pilvine.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground ruins, behind the ruins a street with walking people. On the other side of the street the houses of Tallinn's Old Town can be seen, on the left the tower of the Town Hall visible above the rooftops. Behind, against the background of the sea, smoking factory chimneys. The sky cloudy.

works.d: Valges, lahtise kaelusega särgis ja hallides pükstes istuva mehe põlvportree. Mehel vasekarva, keskelt lahus juuksed, tugevad põsesarnad, nina ja lõug.Süles külgedelt punakaspruun, pealt kollane kitarr, mille varrest mees vasaku käega kinni hoiab. Parema käe sõrmedega näpib kitarrikeeli. Foon ühtlaselt tume.
works.de: Knee-length portrait of a man sitting in a white, open-collared shirt and grey trousers. The man has copper-coloured hair parted in the middle, strong cheekbones, nose and chin. In his lap, reddish-brown on the sides and yellow on top, a guitar, whose neck the man holds with his left hand. With the fingers of his right hand he plucks the guitar strings. The background is uniformly dark.

works.d: Trapetsikujuline roheline pilt, millele on maalitud sinine nelinurk. Viimased kaks teineteise suhtes diagonaalselt asetsevat nurka on ära lõigatud.
works.de: A trapezoidal green picture, on which a blue quadrangle is painted. The latter's two diagonally opposite corners have been cut off.

works.d: Noore naise kahvatu nägu poolpöördes paremale pitsilise servaga valges peakattes-rätis, mis on drapereeritud ümber pea, kaela ja õlgade. Pead ümbritseb ovaalse kujuga kollane taust. Seljas purpurpunane, eest kollane, musta ornamendiga rüü, tupsudega seos kaeluses. Ümbritsevatel osadel sinisel pinnal must ornament. Vasakul alumisel nurkmisel tükil osa puutüvest, taimemotiive.
works.de: The pale face of a young woman, turned half-way to the right, in a white headcovering-scarf with a lace edge, draped around the head, neck and shoulders. An oval yellow background surrounds the head. Wearing a purple-red robe, yellow in front, with black ornament, a tasseled seam at the neckline. On the surrounding parts, black ornament on a blue surface. In the lower left corner piece, part of a tree trunk, plant motifs.

works.d: Kaheosaline värvikas abstraktne kompositsioon. Ülemise maaliosa helesinisel taustal mustad, hallid konstruktsioonid segunevad valgete horisontaaljoonekeste, pilvevahu tortide, täpikeste, vabakäejoontega. Keskosa valdavalt ookerpruunide, bravuurselt maalitud pindade, joonte kombinatsioon, mis allosas kollakale taustale moodustab värviniresid, plekke.
works.de: A two-part colourful abstract composition. In the upper part of the painting, against a light blue background, black and grey constructions mix with white horizontal little lines, cloud-foam cake shapes, dots, and freehand lines. The middle section is predominantly a combination of ochre-brown, boldly painted surfaces and lines, which in the lower part form colour streaks and stains against a yellowish background.

works.d: Ees paremal sanatooriumi hoone lehtpuude taustal. Vasakul eest taha kulgev teerada ja üksikud suured puud.
works.de: In the foreground on the right, a sanatorium building against a background of deciduous trees. On the left, a path running from front to back and solitary large trees.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasemal liivale laotatud vaibal pisike õlgkübarat kandev tüdruk mängimas ja tema kõrval istumas tumedajuukseline, paljasjalgne käsitööd tegev tütarlaps. Mõlema taga valges ülikonnas poisike püsti, käes lilled. Grupi ees, pooleldi paremas nurgas paistval veepiiril haukuv koer. Tagapool lehtpuutihnik, mida läbistaval sihil näha taga taustal kahte naisefiguuri.
works.de: In the foreground on the left, on a rug spread on the sand, a small girl wearing a straw hat is playing, and next to her a dark-haired, barefoot girl doing needlework is sitting. Behind both of them, a boy in a white suit stands, holding flowers. In front of the group, partly visible in the right corner at the waterline, a barking dog. Further back, a thicket of deciduous trees, through which a path passes, showing two female figures in the background beyond it.

works.dm: laius: 39.6 cm (arm.   ); kõrgus: 26.8 cm (vm.   ); kõrgus: 27.0 cm (arm.   ); laius: 37.7 cm (vm.   )
works.d: Esiplaanil rohtunud, pool-metsik aed vana lehtpuuga paremal. Taga keskel valge kivihoone.
works.de: In the foreground an overgrown, semi-wild garden with an old deciduous tree on the right. Behind in the middle a white stone building.

works.d: Veekogu ääres kolm valget hobust, kahel neist ratsanik seljas, üht hoiab alasti mehefiguur suistest. Neljas valge hobune alasti ratsanikuga seisab vees. Paremal kaldal istub valgel linal alasti tumedapäine naine ja lamab valge, pruunide laikudega koer. Paremas ülanurgas üldistatud massiividena antud puud ja põõsad, ülal pilves taevas. Nii inimeste kui hobuste kehad on valguse ja varju abil üksikasjalikult modelleeritud. Rohekashallid ja kollakaspruunid värvitoonid.
works.de: By a body of water, three white horses, two of them with riders on their backs, one held by the bridle by a naked male figure. A fourth white horse with a naked rider stands in the water. On the right bank, a dark-haired naked woman sits on a white cloth, and a white dog with brown spots lies. In the upper right corner, trees and bushes given as generalised masses, above a cloudy sky. Both the bodies of the people and of the horses are modelled in detail with the help of light and shadow. Greenish-grey and yellowish-brown colour tones.

works.d: Pildi keskosas lamaskleb täidlane alasti naisefiguur külgvaates, ülakeha kõrgemal, vasak käsi toetab pead, pikad juuksed langevad seljale. Keha käsitletud varjude ja valgusega, pea sulab tumedusse, mis katab tihedalt pildi keskosa. Esiplaanil suured roosad õied, mis samuti varjus. Ülaosas lehestik, milles üksikud lehe suurelt välja joonistatud ja ka valguslaikudega esile toodud.
works.de: In the centre of the picture reclines a full-bodied nude female figure in profile, upper body raised, left hand supporting the head, long hair falling onto her back. The body is rendered with shadow and light, the head merges into darkness, which densely covers the middle part of the picture. In the foreground large pink flowers, also in shadow. In the upper part foliage, in which individual leaves are drawn out on a large scale and also brought out with patches of light.

works.dm: laius: 190.0 cm (III); laius: 190.0 cm (II); kõrgus: 90.0 cm (I); kõrgus: 190.0 cm (III)
works.d: Kolmest, vasakult paremale järjest kõrgemaks tõusvast osast koosnev kompositsioon: parempoolses osas kägaras alasti naise figuur, selja- ja peajoon moodustab uhke kaare. Kahel vasakpoolsel osal pooleldi külili naisefiguur, kel parem käsi piki külge, vasak kukla taga, pea kuklasse löödud. Maalitud tumedates rohelistes, lillades, pruunides toonides.(eesti)
works.de: A composition consisting of three parts rising progressively higher from left to right: in the right-hand part a nude female figure curled up, the line of the back and head forming a proud arc. In the two left-hand parts a half-turned female figure, with the right arm along her side, the left behind the back of her head, her head thrown back. Painted in dark green, purple, brown tones.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 45.8 cm; lehe laius: 36.5 cm
works.d: Heledate, lokkis, rinnale langevate juustega noore neiu rinnapilt. Nägu otse, keha pöördes vasakule.
works.de: Bust portrait of a young girl with light, curly hair falling onto her chest. Face turned straight ahead, body turned to the left.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 19.0 cm; lehe laius: 24.5 cm
works.d: Öises maastikus grupp ratsutajaid jooksvatel kaamelitel. Taamal taevas särab täht.
works.de: In a night landscape, a group of riders on running camels. In the distance a star shines in the sky.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 44.1 cm; lehe laius: 34.0 cm
works.d: Naise poolfiguur-akt en face, pea kallutatud paremale. Vasak käsi asetatud rinnale, parem tõstetud kõrvale üles.
works.de: Woman's half-figure nude en face, head tilted to the right. Left hand placed on the chest, right raised up to the side.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 39.8 cm; lehe laius: 32.3 cm
works.d: Esiplaanil paremal vees ja vasakul kaldaserval kolm fantastilist poollamavat figuuri. Vastaskaldal lamav naisakt, üle niuete heidetud helesinine läbipaistev rätik.
works.de: In the foreground, on the right in the water and on the left at the edge of the shore, three fantastical, half-reclining figures. On the opposite shore a reclining female nude, a light blue transparent cloth thrown over the hips.

works.dm: lehe laius: 19.0 cm; lehe kõrgus: 30.0 cm
works.d: All servas ülespööratud peadega figuurid. Ülal kuusirbil istuv alasti naisfiguur.
works.de: At the bottom edge figures with upturned heads. Above, a nude female figure sitting on a crescent moon.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 29.8 cm; lehe laius: 33.5 cm
works.d: Paremal veekogu. Vasakul, kaldal istuva naise akt (akt asetatud diagonaalile vasakpoolsest ülanurgast all paremale). Üle naise põlvede kerge kollane rüü. Akti kõrval laiali tiibadega luik.
works.de: On the right a body of water. On the left, the nude of a woman sitting on the bank (the nude placed on a diagonal from the upper left corner down to the lower right). Over the woman's knees a light yellow drape. Beside the nude a swan with outspread wings.

works.dm: lehe laius: 30.3 cm; lehe kõrgus: 25.6 cm
works.d: Esiplaanil naise figuur, kelle seljale toetub kihvade ja habemega mehe pea.
works.de: In the foreground the figure of a woman, against whose back rests the head of a man with tusks and a beard.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 31.0 cm; lehe laius: 46.5 cm
works.d: Vasakul poollängu kasvanud suure puu all kaks ebamäärast figuuri. Paremal istuv figuur.
works.de: On the left, under a large tree grown at a slant, two indistinct figures. On the right a seated figure.

works.d: Lopsakate pintslilöökidega maalitud suureleheline toataim roosakas potis punasel taburetil. Foonil on aimata akna ja toa kontuure. Külmades sinistes ja kollakates toonides.
works.de: Large-leaved houseplant in a pinkish pot on a red stool, painted with lush brushstrokes. In the background the contours of a window and a room can be discerned. In cold blue and yellowish tones.

works.d: Tumedal, rohekal ja sinakasrohekal foonil lill kahe punase õiekobaraga pikkade varte otsas.
works.de: Against a dark, greenish and bluish-green background, a flower with two red clusters of blossoms on long stems.

works.d: Sombuse taevaga varakevadine maastik. Lumine esiplaan lage. Teisel plaanil tumedad metsatukad ja kaks lumise katusega maja. Tagaplaanil sinine riba (veekogu?). Taevas väga rahutu. Jõulised ja laiad pintslilöögid.
works.de: Early-spring landscape with an overcast sky. Snowy bare foreground. In the second plane, dark patches of forest and two houses with snowy roofs. In the background a blue strip (a body of water?). The sky is very restless. Vigorous and broad brushstrokes.

works.d: Kolm dekoratiivset kannu, korv ja kolm pudelit lillakas-pruuni ja halli kangaga kaetud alusel. Paremal nurgas tükk valkjat draperiid, vasakul paistab alusraamile kinnitatud lõuendi tagupool.
works.de: Three decorative jugs, a basket and three bottles on a base covered with purplish-brown and grey fabric. In the right corner a piece of whitish drapery, on the left the reverse side of the canvas attached to the stretcher is visible.

works.d: Elusuuruses heledate pikkade juustega hallis kleidis noore naise põlvportree otsevaates (seisev figuur). Vasakus alumises nurgas viis kollast orhideed. Foon pruunides, ookri- ja rohelistes toonides, tihedate nähtavate pintslilöökidega läbi maalitud.
works.de: Life-size knee-length portrait of a young woman with fair long hair in a grey dress, in frontal view (standing figure). In the lower left corner five yellow orchids. Background in brown, ochre and green tones, painted through with dense, visible brushstrokes.

works.d: Helepruunide, veidi laines õlgadeni ulatuvate juustega, tugevate põsesarnadega, noore naise istuv kolmveerandfiguur. Seljas lühikeste varrukatega, ümara kaelusega sinakasroheline kleit. Käed vabalt süles.
works.de: Seated three-quarter figure of a young woman with light-brown, slightly wavy shoulder-length hair and strong cheekbones. Wearing a bluish-green dress with short sleeves and a round collar. Hands resting loosely in her lap.

works.d: Istuva noore naise poolfiguur. Pea otsevaates, keha kerges pöördes paremale. Seljas tume kirju hommikumantel.
works.de: Half-figure of a seated young woman. Head in frontal view, body slightly turned to the right. Wearing a dark patterned morning gown.

works.d: Üleelusuuruses habemiku, kannatava ilmega trepil seisva paljasjalgse mehe figuur: seljas pruun mungarüü, süles suuri punaseid käsi meenutavad objektid. Paremas ülaservas, kaarjas ukseavas, millest paistab jupp kirgast ererohelist maastikku.(eesti)
works.de: An over-life-size figure of a bearded, suffering-looking barefoot man standing on stairs: wearing a brown monk's robe, in his lap objects resembling large red hands. In the upper right corner, in an arched doorway, a glimpse of a bright green landscape.

works.d: Groteskne stseen klounidega. Esiplaanil keskne figuur seisab paljajalu punasel alusel, pruunis riides, kroon peas, eest avatud kombinisoonist sirutub välja roosa olend inimkätega; parempoolne figuur ülestõstetud jalaga, vasakpoolne kasvatab tiritamme. Taga publik nagu pruunides maskides, helendavate silmaavadega.(eesti)
works.de: A grotesque scene with clowns. In the foreground, a central figure stands barefoot on a red pedestal, dressed in brown, wearing a crown; from an open coverall in front, a pink creature with human hands protrudes; the figure on the right has a raised leg, the figure on the left is growing a dandelion. Behind them, an audience as if in brown masks with glowing eye openings.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 20.3 cm; lehe laius: 13.6 cm
works.d: Alasti seisev naisfiguur interjööris. Taustaks läbi ukseava paistev aknaga sein. Akna all diivanil kaks istuvat figuuri.
works.de: A standing nude female figure in an interior. Background of a wall with a window visible through a doorway. Under the window, two seated figures on a sofa.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 15.8 cm; lehe laius: 14.7 cm
works.d: Ees keskel interjööris seisev alasti naisfiguur en face, käed kuklal. Taga, akna juures kahe naise ja ühe mehe figuurid.
works.de: In the middle foreground, a standing nude female figure en face, hands behind the head. Behind, by the window, figures of two women and one man.

works.d: Esiplaanil lumised aiad üksikute suurte raagus puudega. Tagapool majad.
works.de: In the foreground, snowy gardens with individual large bare trees. Houses behind.

works.d: Rohumaal kaks valge - pruunikirjut lehma söömas. Fooniks pilvine taevas.
works.de: On a meadow two white-and-brown-spotted cows grazing. Background of cloudy sky.

works.d: Eestvaates istuv pruunide kõrvadega koer (skits).
works.de: A dog with brown ears sitting, front view (sketch).

works.d: Esiplaanil kergelt rohtunud lagendik. Taga kollakasrohelistes toonides mets.
works.de: In the foreground, a slightly grassy clearing. Behind it, a forest in yellowish-green tones.

works.d: Kasvuhoone katuse all pottides valged alpikannid.
works.de: White alpine lilies in pots under a greenhouse roof.

works.d: Kasukas karusnahkse mütsiga, vurrude ja lõuahabemega vanema mehe rinnapilt peaaegu en face.
works.de: Bust portrait of an older man almost en face, in a fur coat with a fur hat, with a moustache and a chin beard.

works.d: Lesiva noore blondi naise poolfiguur kerges pöördes vasakule. Kirjuruuduline jakk, helehall seelik. Selja tagant paistab kapp, paremalt äärelt lõuendi serv.
works.de: Half-figure of a reclining young blonde woman in a slight turn to the left. A checkered jacket, light grey skirt. Behind her back a cupboard is visible, on the right edge the edge of the canvas.

works.d: Hallidest, mustadest, kollastest geomeetrilistest pindadest kompositsioon. All servas keskel must tütarlapse rinnasiluett profiilis, sellest paremal noormehe hall siluett en face. Sama fragment kordub vähendatult paremal, ülemises neljandikus.
works.de: Composition of gray, black, yellow geometric surfaces. At the bottom edge in the center a black chest-silhouette of a girl in profile, to its right a gray silhouette of a young man en face. The same fragment repeats in reduced size on the right, in the upper quarter.

works.d: Esiplaanil kõrgendikult orgu suunduva tänava ääres üksikud 2-3 kordsed majad paremal pool. Vasakul laternaposti kohal plats. Paremal kõnniteel inimesi, põiktänav, hobune reega. Kaugemal majade siluetid.
works.de: In the foreground, along a street leading from a height down into a valley, single 2-3 storey houses on the right. On the left a square above a lamp post. On the right people on the pavement, a cross street, a horse with a sledge. Further away, the silhouettes of houses.

works.d: Kirjul foonil pruunikas, kõrge vaas mitut sorti aialilledega.(eesti)
works.de: On a colourful background, a brownish, tall vase with several kinds of garden flowers.

works.d: Esiplaanil heinamaa heinasaadudega. Taamal mets.
works.de: In the foreground, a meadow with haystacks. In the distance, a forest.

works.d: Esiplaanil kaks istuvat figuuri. Keskel vasakul ja paremal suured puud, mille kroonid ülal moodustavad võlvi. Neist pisut tagapool, vee ääres õitseva põõsastiku taustal valges rüüs seisev ja punases rüüs istuv naisefiguur.
works.de: In the foreground two seated figures. In the centre, on the left and right, large trees whose crowns form a vault above. A little further back, against a background of flowering shrubbery by the water, a female figure standing in a white robe and one sitting in a red robe.

works.d: Kõrgel mäekallakul, ees rohul istuv figuur. Taga kõrgemal, naisfiguur kahe musta põlevasilmse kassiga.
works.de: On a high mountain slope, in front a figure sitting on the grass. Behind, higher up, a female figure with two black cats with burning eyes.

works.d: Töö joonistatud kahte ossa: ülemine 3/4, alumine 1/4. Ülal merest välajulatuval ebamäärasel mereelukal (või kivil) üks istuv ja üks seisev alasti naise figuur. All, merepõhjas kaks ebamäärast figuuri.
works.de: The work is drawn in two parts: the upper 3/4, the lower 1/4. Above, on an indeterminate sea creature (or rock) emerging from the sea, one sitting and one standing nude female figure. Below, on the sea floor, two indeterminate figures.

works.d: Ees tohutul kaljurahnul ja jõekaldal kolm lamavat, kolm kalju vastu toetuvat alasti inimfiguuri. Paremal, jõel purjepaat.
works.de: In the foreground on an enormous rocky boulder and riverbank, three reclining and three leaning nude figures against the rock. On the right, a sailboat on the river.

works.d: Esiplaanil vees seisev alasti naisfiguur. Tema taga kaldal lamavad ja istuvad naisfiguurid.
works.de: In the foreground, a nude female figure standing in the water. Behind her on the shore, female figures lying and sitting.

works.d: Vasakul tõmmude figuuride keskel paremal seisvale mehele karikat ulatav alasti naine. Taga paremal vesi.
works.de: On the left, among swarthy figures, a naked woman offering a goblet to a man standing on the right. Water in the background on the right.

works.d: Keskealise, pikliku näoga mehe portree otsevaates. Tumedate juuste piir on otsmikult kahe kaarena taandunud prillid, hele särk, tumesinine lips pisut viltu. Foon hallikasroheline, kollaste helkidega.
works.de: Portrait of a middle-aged man with an elongated face, in a frontal view. The hairline of dark hair has receded from the forehead in two arcs glasses, light shirt, dark blue tie slightly askew. Background greyish-green, with yellow highlights.

works.d: Toolil istuv mehe täisfiguur, parem jalg üle vasema, küünarnukid tooli käsipuudel, ilme tõsine, mõtlik. Foonil pikad pintslitõmbed, rõhutatud vertikaalseid jooni.(eesti)
works.de: Full-length figure of a man sitting on a chair, right leg over the left, elbows on the armrests of the chair, expression serious, pensive. In the background long brush strokes, emphasised vertical lines.

works.d: Istuva tüseda vanema mehe kolmveerandfiguur otsevaates. Lai äärega peakate, avatud kaelusega särk, roheline vest, rohekasbeež ülikond. Foon rohekais toonides.(eesti)
works.de: Three-quarter figure of a seated, stout, elderly man in full-face view. A wide-brimmed headgear, a shirt with an open collar, a green waistcoat, a greenish-beige suit. Background in greenish tones.

works.d: Vasakul puu all kaldal istuv naisakt luigega. Üle põlvede laotatud kollane läbipaistev linik.
works.de: On the left under a tree on the bank a seated female nude with a swan. A yellow transparent cloth spread over her knees.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 86.2 cm; lehe laius: 55.0 cm
works.d: Habemes alasti mehe täisfiguur peaaegu en face, pea kerge pöördega paremale. Käed ristamisi rinnal.
works.de: Full figure of a bearded naked man almost en face, head turned slightly to the right. Arms crossed on the chest.

works.d: Esiplaanil lage rohumaa seda tagapool piirava põõsastiku ja puudega.
works.de: Open meadow in the foreground bordered behind by shrubbery and trees.

works.d: Harkisjalu alasti naisfiguur eestvaates. Pea kerge pöördega vasakule. Käed toetavad reitele.
works.de: Full figure of a nude woman standing with legs apart, frontal view. Head turned slightly to the left. Hands resting on the thighs.

works.d: Esiplaanil muru, keskel paremal ja vasakul lehtpuude rühmi mille vahelt paistab taamal valge hoone.
works.de: Grass in the foreground, groups of deciduous trees in the middle right and left, a white building visible beyond between them.

works.t: Kunstnik Carl Friedrich Christian Buddeuse portree
works.d: Vanema mehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale, hallide käharate juuste ja tumeda ülikonnaga. Taustaks maastik - õlgkatusega majake ja naisefiguur puu all paremal.
works.de: Bust of an older man in half-profile to the right, with grey curly hair and a dark suit. Background is a landscape - a small thatched-roof house and a female figure under a tree on the right.

works.d: Rohelistes toonids kompositsioon kahuritorude, püsside ja kiivrites sõduritega mererannal.(eesti)
works.de: Composition in green tones with cannon barrels, rifles and soldiers in helmets on a seashore.

works.d: Erksates sinistes, punastes ja rohelistes toonides antud maastik, mis mõjub peaaegu abstraktsete värvilaikude kombinatsioonina. Esiplaanil kõrget paljast kaljurüngast meenutav küngas, mille taga vasakul samasugune rohelusega kaetud kõrgendik. Kõrge silmapiir jätab vaid ülaosas pisut ruumi erksinisele ja roosale taevale.
works.de: A landscape in vivid blue, red and green tones, which reads almost as a combination of abstract colour patches. In the foreground, a high bare rocky knoll resembling a hillock, behind which, at left, a similar elevation covered with greenery. The high horizon leaves only a little room at the top for the vivid blue and pink sky.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul kolm sammuvat meest, käed püksitaskuis, pintsakud õlgadel. Kahel peas sonimütsid, ühel barett. Eemal veel rühm tööriietuses mehi ja suitsevate korstnatega tehasehooned.
works.de: In the foreground on the left three striding men, hands in trouser pockets, jackets over their shoulders. Two wearing sonim caps, one a beret. Further away another group of men in work clothes and factory buildings with smoking chimneys.

works.d: Värviplahvatusena mõjuva värvikäsitluse ja pintslitööga maastik. Keskel metsalagendik üksiku kelpkatusega talumajaga. Majast vasakul ja maja taga puud ja põõsastik. Sama võib aimata ka esiplaanil paremal. Taevas ülal sinine, kaetud rahutute kollaste ja punakasroosade pilvetriipudega.
works.de: A landscape with a colour treatment and brushwork that has the effect of a colour explosion. In the middle a forest clearing with a lone farmhouse with a hipped roof. To the left of the house and behind the house, trees and shrubbery. The same can also be sensed in the foreground on the right. The sky above is blue, covered with restless streaks of yellow and pinkish-red clouds.

works.d: Tumedas pruunikaspunases seinas, ülalt punane, alt roheline plekkradiaator, mille keskel valge pitsiline taskurätik monogrammidega "K" nurkades. Radiaatori kohal kolmest ruudukujulisest osast koosnev lai madal tumeroheliste raamidega aken. Sellest avanab vaade valgete postidega traatvõrkaiaga piiratud pargile. Keskel sinakas-punakas, ääres roheline ümmargune klump, väikeste pügatud põõsaste ning pargiteega läbi selle. Keskel kõrge, lopsakas eksootiline taim. Tara taga puisniit punakates ja pruunikasrohelistes toonides.
works.de: In a dark brownish-red wall, a sheet-metal radiator, red at the top and green at the bottom, with a white lace handkerchief with monograms "K" in the corners in its middle. Above the radiator a wide low window with dark green frames, consisting of three square sections. From it opens a view of a park enclosed by a wire-mesh fence with white posts. In the centre a bluish-reddish, green-edged round clump, with small trimmed bushes and a park path running through it. In the centre a tall, lush exotic plant. Behind the fence a wooded meadow in reddish and brownish-green tones.

works.d: Heledale ookertoonides maapinnale esiplaanil joonistub tumedana raagus puude vari. Keskplaanil puude vahel valgete seintega maja.
works.de: On a light ochre-toned ground in the foreground the dark shadow of bare trees is drawn. In the middle ground among the trees a house with white walls.

works.d: Elusuuruses naise portree istuvas asendis, otsevaates, valges rikkalikult pitsidega ja volangidega kaunistatud, sügavalt dekolteeritud kleidis. Vasemas käes lehvik, kaelas pärlikee. Naisest paremal, laud valge lindiga seotud lilled, mille vahel lebab kass. Lindi paremale otsale tikitud 1887.
works.de: Life-size portrait of a woman in a seated position, frontal view, in a white dress richly decorated with lace and flounces, deeply décolleté. In her left hand a fan, a pearl necklace at her neck. To the right of the woman, a table tied with a white ribbon holding flowers, among which a cat lies. Embroidered on the right end of the ribbon is 1887.

works.d: Ristilöödust paremal, profiilis vasakul põlvili naine. Parema käega laubale toetatud pea on allapoole kallutatud. Ristilöödust vasakul mehe ja naise figuurid. Mees toetab tahapoole langevat naist, mehe parem käsi hoiab naise paremat kätt. Ristil ülaosas pooleldi rullunud papüüros kirjaga:
works.de: To the right of the crucifixion, in profile, a kneeling woman on the left. Her head, supported by the right hand at the forehead, is inclined downward. To the left of the crucifixion, the figures of a man and a woman. The man supports the woman as she falls backward, the man's right hand holding the woman's right hand. At the top of the cross a half-unrolled papyrus scroll with an inscription:

works.d: Esiplaanil üksikud puud ja tara, paremal talumaja, keskel oruniidul kari, taamal nõlvakuil sügisvärvides mets.
works.de: In the foreground solitary trees and a fence, on the right a farmhouse, in the middle a herd on a valley meadow, further back a forest in autumn colours on the slopes.

works.dm: laius: 45.5 cm; kõrgus: 35.0 cm (vm.   ); kõrgus: 36.5 cm; laius: 44.2 cm (vm.   )
works.d: Esiplaanil keskel madalas sinises vaasis mitmevärvilised lilled, paremal vaasi kõrval kaks astriõit. Ees vaasi ja astriõite peegeldus. Taust pruunikais toonides.
works.de: In the foreground, in the centre, in a low blue vase, multicoloured flowers, on the right beside the vase two aster blooms. In front, the reflection of the vase and the asters. Background in brownish tones.

works.d: Ees veekogu. Vastaskaldal paremal ühekordne kivihoone. Taga vabrikuhoonete kompleks.
works.de: In front a body of water. On the opposite bank on the right a single-storey stone building. Behind, a complex of factory buildings.

works.d: Tumedal foonil mustas kleidis vanema naise poolfiguur, käed vaheliti rinnal. Ühes käes võtmekimp. Peas punasest riidest tanu, pitskaunistustega.
works.de: Half-figure of an older woman in a black dress against a dark background, hands crossed on the chest. In one hand a bunch of keys. On her head a red cloth bonnet with lace trimmings.

works.d: Peaaegu abstraktselt antud värvilaikude kombinatsioonina on esiplaanil sinises seelikus, kollases pluusis, rohelise näo ja lillakaspunaste juustega tütarlaps kitarri mängimas. Esiplaanil allservas mustaga joonistatud väljasirutatud käed. Keskplaani figuurist paremal ja vasakul aimub teisi tütarlapsi. Foon abstraktsete värvipindade kombinatsioon.
works.de: As an almost abstract combination of colour patches, in the foreground a girl in a blue skirt, yellow blouse, with a green face and purplish-red hair is playing the guitar. In the lower foreground edge, outstretched hands drawn in black. To the right and left of the middle-ground figure, other girls can be sensed. The background is a combination of abstract colour surfaces.

works.d: Heleroheline pind krobestatud mitmesuguste materjalidega. Vasakul servas vertikaalne, veidi kaardus lillakas-roosakas-tumedam veidi kõrgem krobeline joon. Teine sarnane paremal all servas. Maali ülaosas ja ka all horisontaalsed, veidi eenduvad kõrgendikud-mügarikud. Rohelise värvi alt kumab siin-seal läbi punast.
works.de: Light green surface roughened with various materials. On the left edge a vertical, slightly curved purplish-pinkish, darker, somewhat higher rough line. A similar one on the lower right edge. In the upper part of the painting and also below, horizontal, slightly protruding elevations-bumps. Red shows through here and there beneath the green paint.

works.dm: laius: 212.6 cm (koos raamjalgadega); kõrgus: 79.0 cm (puidust pind); kõrgus: 112.0 cm (koos raamjalgadega); laius: 212.6 cm (puidust pind)
works.d: Puidu pinda uuristatud ning värvidega kaetud horisontaalselt lebav profiilne naisakt. Pea paremal, pisut kuklasse painutatud. Vasak jalg põlvest kõverdatud, parem jalg sirge. Taiese alumine pool on punane, ülemine must. Naise koloriidis domineerivad roosad, kollased, helesinised sähmud. Naise kohal kolmnurksete sakkidega pilvelaadne kujund.(eesti)
works.de: A horizontally lying female nude in profile, carved into the surface of the wood and covered with paint. The head on the right, tilted slightly backward. The left leg bent at the knee, the right leg straight. The lower half of the work is red, the upper black. In the woman's colouring, pink, yellow and light blue flecks dominate. Above the woman, a cloud-like form with triangular jagged edges.

works.d: Töötajate figuure linnamajade ja varemete taustal. Kavand.
works.de: Figures of workers against a background of city buildings and ruins. Sketch.

works.t: Etüüd Dneprilt. Jõe forseerimise koht Nõukogude vägede poolt Kiievi vabastamisel Saksa okupantidelt
works.d: Paremast nurgast diagonaalselt vasakule suunduv tükike randa põõsaste ja lootsikutega. Kaugemal jõel üksik paat sõudjaga.
works.de: A stretch of shore with bushes and small boats running diagonally from the right corner to the left. Farther away on the river a solitary boat with a rower.

works.d: Tugitoolis istuva mehe põlvpilt poolprofiilis paremale. Parem käsi toetatud tooli käetoele, vasak põlvele. Taustaks tumeroheline sein kuldraamis maaliga paremal.
works.de: Knee-length portrait of a man sitting in an armchair, in half-profile to the right. Right hand resting on the armrest, left hand on the knee. Background is a dark green wall with a painting in a gold frame on the right.

works.d: Intensiivsetes sinistes, punastes ja kollastes toonides panoraammaastik, maalitud peaaegu abstraktsete ekspressiivsete värvilaikude kombinatsioonina. Paremal, horisontaalsest keskjoonest kõrgemal erksinine veekogu. Taevas tumesinine.
works.de: A panoramic landscape in intense blue, red and yellow tones, painted as a combination of almost abstract expressive patches of colour. On the right, above the horizontal centre line, a bright blue body of water. The sky dark blue.

works.d: Toolil istuva keskealise mehe täisfiguur, gitarr põlvedel. Tooli kõrval põrandal mapp ja vaas. Paremal tumeda linaga kaetud laua nurk, millel klaas ja pudel.
works.de: Full figure of a middle-aged man sitting on a chair, a guitar on his knees. Beside the chair on the floor a portfolio and a vase. On the right the corner of a table covered with a dark cloth, on which a glass and a bottle.

works.d: Võlvitud keldris, millesse vasakus ülemises nurgas olevast aknaavast langeb nõrka valgust, kaks mehefiguuri tegevuses nende vahel oleva pooleldi avatud kirstu ees. Vasakpoolne figuur  vaimuliku rüüs hoiab paremas käes laternat, vasakus paksu raamatut. Parempoolne, ilmselt noore mehe figuur, poolkummargil kirstu kohal, hoiab paremas käes mingisugust laternatule valguses kiirgavat eset, kuna vasakuga asetab midagi vaimuliku käes olevale raamatule. Meeste vahel oleva kirstu poolavali kaane alt upitub välja ronima seal lamanud kuju. Tagaplaanil vasakul teisi kirste, mis on ka lahti kistud. Visand tehtud mustaga grisaille-tehnikas.
works.de: In a vaulted cellar, into which weak light falls from a window opening in the upper left corner, two male figures engaged in an activity in front of a half-open coffin between them. The left-hand figure, in clerical robes, holds a lantern in his right hand and a thick book in his left. The right-hand figure, apparently a young man, half-bent over the coffin, holds in his right hand some object glowing in the light of the lantern, while with his left he places something on the book held by the clergyman. From under the half-open lid of the coffin between the men, a figure that had been lying there is pushing itself up to climb out. In the background on the left, other coffins, also pried open. The sketch is done in black in the grisaille technique.

works.d: Grupp madalaid punaste viilkatustega kivimaju, mille ees kuuritaoline ehitis. Vasakul osa kollasest hoonest. Taevas lillas - punases koloriidis.
works.de: A group of low stone houses with red gable roofs, with a shed-like structure in front. On the left, part of a yellow building. Sky in a purple - red colouring.

works.d: Õu Tallinna vanalinnast. Esiplaanil vasakul vanker. Taamal teravaid majaviile kivikatustega.
works.de: A courtyard in Tallinn's Old Town. In the foreground on the left a cart. Sharp gables of houses with tiled roofs beyond.

works.d: Lumega kaetud puudealune kuuvalgel. Esiplaanil tume veepind, mille paremal kaldal kolm raagus puud, vasemal kaks raagus puud, mille taga hoone.
works.de: Snow-covered ground under trees in moonlight. In the foreground a dark water surface, on the right bank of which three bare trees, on the left two bare trees, behind which a building.

works.d: Kolm tumedapäise tütarlapse seisvat kolmveerandfiguuri - parempoolsel käed pea kohale tõstetud, vasakpoolsel vasak käsi juuste piiril, pilk maha suunatud; keskmisel figuuril vasak käsi vöö kõrgusel.
works.de: Three standing three-quarter figures of dark-haired girls - the one on the right with hands raised above the head, the one on the left with left hand at the hairline, gaze directed downward; the middle figure with left hand at waist height.

works.d: Pildi keskel kaks naise figuuri - üks istub kandadel, ülakeha taha painutatud, teine põlvitab, käes tõstetud silmade kõrgusele. Ülal paremal mehe täisfiguur kummargil asendis, pea kätel. All paremal naine lapsega, vasakul noormehe figuur, pea langetatud õlale. Koloriit tume - pruunid, rohelised toonid. Keksed figuurid veidi säravamas koloriidis.
works.de: In the centre of the picture, two female figures – one sits on her heels, upper body bent backward, the other kneels, holding something raised to eye level. Above on the right, the full figure of a man in a stooped position, head on his hands. Below on the right, a woman with a child, on the left the figure of a young man, head lowered onto his shoulder. The colouring is dark – brown, green tones. The central figures are in a slightly brighter colour scheme.

works.d: Laua ääres istuvad kaks noort naist poolfiguuris, üks en face, teine profiilis ja vasakpoolse pildi servaga äralõigatud. Nende taga kolme mehe poolfiguurid, neist keskmine seljaga, teised kaks profiilis. Vasakpoolsel meesfiguuril habe.
works.de: Two young women sit at a table, half-length, one en face, the other in profile and cut off by the left edge of the picture. Behind them, half-length figures of three men, the middle one with his back turned, the other two in profile. The male figure on the left has a beard.

works.d: Talvine vaade uuslinna tänavaristmikule õhtul. Esiplaanil lumega ääristatud rohekashall autotee, värviliste liiklusmärkidega laigud paremal. Kaugusesse koonduvad laternapostid, heledad majadeblokid sinkjasrohelise taeva foonil. Maalitud hoogsalt, eskiislikult.
works.de: A winter view of a street crossing in a new town in the evening. In the foreground a greyish-grey car road bordered with snow, patches with coloured traffic signs on the right. Lamp posts converging into the distance, light-coloured blocks of houses against a bluish-green sky background. Painted boldly, in a sketchy manner.

works.d: Ümaral laual tumesinine vaas lopsaka kimbuga. Lillakashallid, punakad, küpsed ookertoonid. Hoogne, väga pastoosne maal.
works.de: On a round table, a dark blue vase with a lush bouquet. Lilac-grey, reddish, ripe ochre tones. Vigorous, very pastose painting.

works.d: Telliskivipunasel taustal kahvatulillade õitega sirelikimp kitsas vaasis. Laiade pintslitõmmetega, suure üldistusega maalitud.
works.de: Against a brick-red background, a bouquet of lilac-coloured flowers in a narrow vase. Painted with broad brushstrokes, with great generalisation.

works.d: Mattides rohekais, lillakais ja pruunikais toonides külamaastik hoonete ja puudegruppidega. Taevas helesinine.
works.de: A village landscape in muted greenish, purplish and brownish tones, with buildings and groups of trees. The sky is light blue.

works.d: Vasakul valge draperii taustal roheline, korgiga klaaspudel. Paremal kaks kõrget, pruuni savipudelit. Nende ees valge kauss kahe roheka õunaga.
works.de: On the left against a white drapery backdrop, a green glass bottle with a cork. On the right two tall, brown clay bottles. In front of them a white bowl with two greenish apples.

works.d: Roosakaspunastes ja rohalistes toonides figuraalne kompositsioon: keskel suletud silmadega alasti naisefiguur, Berenike all vasakul hoiab ekstaasis mehefiguur naise kätt. Mõlemat keskset figuuri ümbritsevad peamiselt alastifiguuridena antud mütoloogilised olevused või inimjäsemete puntrad. Berenike kohal maskis, rohelisse rõivastunud mees, kellel kaelal ratsutab alasti naisefiguur. Allservas paremal kolm loori hoidvat graatsiat, vasakul hoiab loori alasti mees, selg vaataja poole.(eesti)
works.de: A figural composition in pinkish-red and greenish tones: in the centre, an alasti [nude] female figure with closed eyes, Berenice; lower left, a man's figure in ecstasy holds the woman's hand. Both central figures are surrounded mainly by nude figures given as mythological creatures or clusters of human limbs. Above Berenice, a man in a mask, dressed in green, on whose neck rides a nude female figure. In the lower part on the right, three graces holding a veil, on the left a nude man holds a veil, his back to the viewer.

works.d: Selgepiirilistest, dekoratiivsetest, geomeetrilistest kujunditest kompositsioon. Allosas kujutatud läbilõiget autobussist, juhi ja kolme reisijaga siluettidena, portreefiguuridena, profiilis vasakule. Ülal vasakul, hallis ruudus neli kollast inimese portreefiguuri siluetti, hallikas-rohekaid püramiide, mustal pinnal siniseid ringe. Keskel kaks vertikaalset, kaks korrapärastest ristkülikutest laotud tulpa. Paremal vasakpoolsete elementide kordusi.
works.de: A composition of clearly outlined, decorative, geometric shapes. In the lower part, a cross-section of a bus is depicted, with the driver and three passengers shown as silhouettes, portrait figures, in profile facing left. Upper left, in a grey square, four yellow silhouette portrait figures of people, greyish-green pyramids, blue circles on a black surface. In the middle, two vertical columns built up of two regular rectangles each. On the right, repetitions of the elements on the left.

works.d: Esiplaanil roosa näo ja nahka otsekui pragudena sisse lõigatud suu ja sinakasroheliste silmadega nägu, erkpunaste juuste ja pruuni kuuega, kaelas oranži värvi orgaaniline moodustis. Figuurist vasakul ja paremal õlgade kohal kaks punaste silmadega maski.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground a pink face with a mouth cut into the skin as if by cracks and bluish-green eyes, bright red hair and a brown coat, an orange organic formation on the neck. To the left and right of the figure, above the shoulders, two masks with red eyes.

works.d: Ülevalt vaade rohetavate puudega väikesele pargile ja punakaspruunidele linnamajadele selle taustal. Vasakul torniga hoone, kiiver helesinise taeva foonil. Värelev maalilaad, lõuend kohati läbi kumamas.
works.de: A view from above of a small park with greening trees and reddish-brown town houses in the background. On the left a building with a tower, its helmet against a light blue sky background. A shimmering painting style, the canvas showing through in places.

works.d: Kirjul taustal kimp kirevatest lilledest.
works.de: A bunch of colourful flowers on a patterned background.

works.d: Esiplaanil merekallas varnas kuivavate võrkudega. Tagapool kaldale hiivatud ja vees olevaid sõu- ja purjepaare. Tagaplaanil taevaga ühtesulav veepind.
works.de: In the foreground a seashore with nets drying on a rack. Behind it, pairs of rowing and sailing boats hauled onto the shore and in the water. In the background a water surface merging with the sky.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul jõekallas kahe inimfiguuriga ja suurte puudega. Paremal vesi, tagaplaanil mets.
works.de: In the foreground on the left a riverbank with two human figures and large trees. On the right water, forest in the background.

works.d: Esiplaanil veekogu. Keskplaanil vasakul kindluse müürid torniga; keskel müüride taga torniga kirik. Paremal sild.
works.de: In the foreground a body of water. In the middle ground on the left fortress walls with a tower; in the middle behind the walls a church with a tower. On the right a bridge.

works.d: Akna taustal istuva tütarlapse kolmveerandfiguur poolpöördes vasakule, pea suunatud vaatajale. Tüdrukul õlgadeni helepruunid juuksed, seljas sinised püksid, valge krae ja mansettidega helepunane sportjakk. Taga vasakul punasetriibuline kardin ja aknavaade maastikumotiiviga.
works.de: A three-quarter figure of a girl sitting against a window, in a half-turn to the left, head turned towards the viewer. The girl has light brown hair to her shoulders, wears blue trousers, a bright red sports jacket with a white collar and cuffs. Behind on the left a red-striped curtain and a window view with a landscape motif.

works.d: Ees valkjatest lilledest ülekülvatud aas. Vasakus servas kask. Selle taga madal, punase katusega, valge pikk hoone. Paremal, maja otsast algab metsaviirg.
works.de: In front, a meadow strewn with whitish flowers. In the left margin a birch. Behind it a low, long white building with a red roof. On the right, a strip of forest begins at the end of the house.

works.d: Pruunid potid valgete ja punaste tulpidega. Vasakus servas lillepotid punase, valge ja sinise hüatsindiga.
works.de: Brown pots with white and red tulips. In the left margin, flowerpots with red, white, and blue hyacinths.

works.d: Esiplaanil heledad sinakasbeežid lamedad luited, tagapool madalad männid, põõsad. Vasakul kaks kõrgemat, jändriku tüvega mändi, puukroonid õrnlillaka taeva taustal. Maalitud õhukese värvikihiga, paber kumab läbi.
works.de: In the foreground, light bluish-beige flat dunes, behind them low pines and bushes. On the left two taller, gnarled-trunked pines, tree crowns against a background of pale lilac sky. Painted with a thin layer of paint, the paper shows through.

works.d: Ülaltvaade kaubasadamale. Esiplaanil paremal suitsu- ja aurupilvedes sadamakai ääres kolm laeva, kraanad, masinad. Vasakult läheb rong, vagunite-masinate vahel kaks inimese siluetti. Tagaplaanil paremal hallis vines taeva taustal Oleviste kirik, vasakul Toompea tornid.
works.de: A bird's-eye view of a cargo harbour. In the foreground on the right, three ships by the harbour quay amid clouds of smoke and steam, cranes, machines. A train runs from the left, with two human silhouettes between the wagons and machines. In the background on the right, against a grey hazy sky, St. Olaf's Church, on the left the towers of Toompea.

works.d: Süngetes lillades ja rohelistes toonides temaatiline kompositsioon kalurite elust. Esiplaanil grupp kalureid võrgud või muud kalapüügiriistad õlal. Nende taga tühjad võrguvaiad ja post laternaga. Vasakul viilkatusega maja, tuli aknast kumamas, taamal võrgukuivatamise vaiade taga viis kuuri. Taamal keskel kergelt lainetav taevas. Kohati maalitud tihedate sapsivate pintslilöökidega.(eesti)
works.de: A thematic composition in sombre purple and green tones about the life of fishermen. In the foreground a group of fishermen with nets or other fishing gear on their shoulders. Behind them empty net stakes and a post with a lantern. On the left a house with a gable roof, light glowing from a window, further back, behind the net-drying stakes, five sheds. In the middle background a slightly rippling sky. Painted in places with dense, jagged brushstrokes.

works.dm: kõrgus: 26.8 cm (km.   ); laius: 33.5 cm (lm.   ); laius: 31.5 cm (km.   ); kõrgus: 30.6 cm (lm.   )
works.d: Laua ümber istumas neli meest. Parempoolne figuur 3/4 pöördes vaataja poole. Tagaplaanil, vasakul seisev mehefiguur.
works.de: Four men sitting around a table. The figure on the right turned 3/4 towards the viewer. In the background, on the left, a standing male figure.

works.d: Tänava ääres helesinise taeva taustal madalad puu - ja kivimajad. Majedegrupi taga viilkatusega torn kukega katusel. Esiplaanil paremal puu.
works.de: Along the street low wooden and stone houses against a light blue sky background. Behind the group of houses a gabled tower with a rooster on the roof. On the right in the foreground a tree.

works.d: Esiplaanil kollakal alusel olevas klaasvaasis kolm roosat tulpi. Tagapool paremal vaas kollaste lilledega. Taust tumesinine.
works.de: In the foreground, three pink tulips in a glass vase on a yellowish stand. Behind on the right a vase with yellow flowers. The background dark blue.

works.d: Esiplaanil taluõuel põrsad. Keskel vana õlgkatusega talumaja. Paremal kivimüür. Vasakul madala aia taga puid.
works.de: In the foreground of a farmyard, piglets. In the middle, an old thatched-roof farmhouse. On the right, a stone wall. On the left, trees behind a low fence.

works.d: Rohtunud künklik maastik vasakul üksiku lehtpuu, paremal lehtpuude grupiga. Taamal mets.
works.de: A grassy hilly landscape with a solitary deciduous tree on the left, a group of deciduous trees on the right. Forest in the distance.

works.d: Avar, üksikute mööbliesemete ja figuuridega täidetud ruum. Esiservas, heleda laua taga istuvad pruuni ja määrdunud kollast tooni figuurid. Neist vasakul, all nurgas, veinipunane, silindrikujuliste otsapatjadega diivan, roosa padi keskel. Ruumi tagaseinas, pruunis niššis kõrgete otstega helepruun voodi, milles kollase teki all pikutab roosa inimene. Nišši kõrval asuvast ukseavast on vaade kõrvalasuvasse ruumi. Ruumide seinad erinevates toonides punased.(eesti)
works.de: A spacious room filled with a few pieces of furniture and figures. In the front edge, behind a light-coloured table, sit figures in brown and dirty yellow tones. To their left, in the lower corner, a wine-red sofa with cylindrical end cushions, a pink cushion in the middle. In the back wall of the room, in a brown niche, a light brown bed with tall ends, in which a pink person lies under a yellow blanket. From a doorway next to the niche there is a view into an adjacent room. The walls of the rooms are red in different tones.

works.d: Esiplaanil suured kivid mererannal. Paremal meri. vasakul taga kõrge paekallas ja puud ning põõsad, nende keskel näha sõiduauto.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground large rocks on the seashore. On the right the sea. On the left behind, a high limestone bank and trees and bushes, among which a car can be seen. (Estonian)

works.d: Kolme - ja neljakorruselised punakaspruunid majad tänavanurgal. Taevas hele.
works.de: Three- and four-storey reddish-brown houses on a street corner. Sky bright.

works.d: Visand kaheksast punasest õunast.
works.de: Sketch of eight red apples.

works.d: Esiplaanil keskel maja üksikute suurte puudega vasakul.
works.de: In the foreground in the middle a house, with single large trees on the left.

works.d: Kasvuhoone laual rida potte punaste tulpidega.
works.de: In the greenhouse, a row of pots with red tulips on the table.

works.d: Alasti ratsur tumedal hobusel profiilis vasakule.
works.de: A naked rider on a dark horse in profile to the left.

works.d: Kiilaspäise keskealise mehe pea poolprofiilis paremale. Suus suitsev sigarett.
works.de: The head of a bald middle-aged man in half-profile facing right. A smoking cigarette in the mouth.

works.d: Pildil esiplaanil vasakul kihutav inimenevalgel hobusel. Ratsaniku kostüüm kollastes toonides, peakate rohekassinine. Taustaks loodus väga rikkalikes värvitoonides.
works.de: In the foreground on the left of the picture a person galloping on a white horse. The rider's costume in yellow tones, the headwear greenish-blue. The background nature in very rich colour tones.

works.d: Mägine Krimmi maastik: paremal esiplaanil mustriline kivist tänavarinnatis ja paljastunud kivirahnud, mille peal ja vahel kasvavad puud. Rinnatisele nõjatudes avaneb vasakul panoraamne vaade metsaga kaetud madalatele mägedele, mis kauguses on antud sinaka mäemassiivina. Mägede kohal valged pilvekuhilad, ülal helesinine taevas.(eesti)
works.de: Mountainous Crimean landscape: in the right foreground a patterned stone street parapet and exposed boulders, on and among which trees grow. Leaning on the parapet, a panoramic view opens on the left of forested low mountains, given in the distance as a bluish mountain massif. Above the mountains white cloud banks, above a light blue sky.

works.d: Punases polsterdatud tugitoolis istuva mehe poolfiguur poolprofiilis paremale. Käed toetatud lauale.
works.de: Half-figure of a man sitting in a red upholstered armchair, in half-profile to the right. Hands resting on the table.

works.d: Kolm laua ääres istuvat naist poolfiguuris. Laual malendid. Vasakpoolsel naisel süles koer.
works.de: Three women sitting at a table, in half-figure. Chess pieces on the table. The woman on the left has a dog in her lap.

works.d: Taraga piiratud ühe - ja kahekorruselised viilkatusega majad tänava ääres. Esiplaanil vasakul kaks prügiurni.
works.de: One- and two-storey gabled houses along a street, enclosed by a fence. In the foreground on the left, two rubbish bins.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul hallis kleidis naine võrku parandamas, kaks meest ja kaks naist vintsi juures töötamas. Vasakul telliskivipunases seelikus valge rätiga naine võrke kuivama panemas. Taamal sinine veekogu, mille liivasel kaldal purjepaadid.
works.de: In the foreground on the left, a woman in a grey dress mending a net, two men and two women working at a winch. On the left, a woman in a brick-red skirt with a white kerchief hanging nets out to dry. Beyond, a blue body of water, with sailboats on its sandy shore.

works.d: Kerajas vaasis kimp valgeid kollasesüdamelisi õisi.(eesti)
works.de: A bunch of white yellow-hearted flowers in a spherical vase.

works.d: Keskosas õhtuse tänava taustal rõdul seisev naine otsevaates, nõjatumas rõdu balustraadile. Seljas lühikeste varrukatega kollane pluus, sinine seelik. Tumedad juuksed on seatud soengusse. Temast vasakul avatud rõduuks. Taustal majaderida, puud, valgustuspostid. Tumedad sinkjad, kollakad toonid, tumedad kontuurid, detailid maalipinda sisse kraabitud.
works.de: In the middle section, against the backdrop of an evening street, a woman stands on a balcony in a frontal view, leaning on the balcony balustrade. She is wearing a yellow blouse with short sleeves and a blue skirt. Her dark hair is arranged in a hairstyle. To her left an open balcony door. In the background a row of houses, trees, lamp posts. Dark bluish, yellowish tones, dark contours, details scratched into the paint surface.

works.dm: kujutise laius: 22.5 cm; lehe kõrgus: 23.1 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 17.9 cm; lehe laius: 30.6 cm
works.d: Esiplaanil tee ja põllud. Taga üle põõsastiku vaade eluhoonete katustele ja kirikule nende keskel. Kujutis ovaalis.
works.de: A road and fields in the foreground. Behind, a view over shrubbery of the roofs of dwellings and a church among them. The image is in an oval.

works.d: Ees meri purjekatega. Mere keskkohal lootsik kahe sõudva mehe figuuriga. Tagaplaanil Tallinna siluett.
works.de: In the foreground the sea with sailboats. In the middle of the sea a rowing boat with the figures of two rowing men. In the background the silhouette of Tallinn.

works.d: Murtud, muldjates toonides maalitud vanalinna siseõu eelhoovi ja tagahooviga, mida lahutab plank väravapoolteta läbikäiguga keskel. Tagaplaanil keskteljest veidi vasakul kõrge viiluga keskaegse maja otsakülg kõrge korstnaga paremal pool katusel. Selle ees veidi vasemal samasugune madalam maja. Esiplaanil vasakul osa rohekashalli maja fassaadist, kahe uksega, teisel korrusel ühe aknaga. Keskplaanil paremal ookerkollane klassitsistlikus stiilis kahekorruseline maja suure varikatusega vaatajapoolsel küljel, selle all hobuvanker. Esiplaanil vasakus kuldlõikes õuel vanker.
works.de: Broken, earth-toned painting of an old town courtyard with a front yard and back yard, separated by a fence with a gateless passage in the middle. In the background, slightly left of the central axis, the end wall of a high-gabled medieval house with a tall chimney on the right side of the roof. In front of it, slightly to the left, a similar lower house. In the foreground on the left, part of the façade of a greenish-grey house, with two doors, and one window on the second floor. In the middle ground on the right, an ochre-yellow, classicist-style two-storey house with a large canopy on the side facing the viewer, with a horse-drawn cart beneath it. In the foreground, in the golden section on the left, a cart in the yard.

works.d: Tänavanurk lehtpuu ja valgustiga. Tänava ääres madalad lamedate katustega hooned, mille tagant paistmas kahe kõrgema maja otsafassaadid.
works.de: A street corner with a deciduous tree and a lamp post. Along the street low buildings with flat roofs, behind which the end façades of two taller houses are visible.

works.d: Kiilaspäise keskealise mehe rinnafiguur otsevaates, pea kerges pöördes paremale. Mehel seljas helesinine särk ja pruun pintsak, ees pruun lips.
works.de: Bust of a bald middle-aged man in frontal view, head slightly turned to the right. The man wears a light blue shirt and a brown jacket, with a brown tie in front.

works.t: a) Istuv mees; b) Naise portree
works.d: Istuva mehe täisfiguur otsevaates, pea pööratud kergelt paremale. Õlgadel tume mantel.
works.de: Full figure of a seated man in frontal view, head turned slightly to the right. Dark coat on the shoulders.

works.d: Kivisel maapinnal üksikuid madalaid puid ja põõsaid. Maalitud kergete pintslitõmmetega heledates hallides, kollakas-pruunides toonides.
works.de: A rocky ground with a few low trees and bushes. Painted with light brush strokes in light grey, yellowish-brown tones.

works.d: Tänavanurk kahekordsete majadega. Ärklikorrusega roosa kivimaja ees suur lehtpuu.
works.de: A street corner with two-storey houses. In front of a pink stone house with an attic storey a large deciduous tree.

works.d: Keset merd kaks purjekat, neist üks otse - teine külgvaates. Horisondil paremal kauge purjeka siluett.
works.de: In the middle of the sea two sailboats, one seen head-on, the other in side view. On the horizon at right the distant silhouette of a sailboat.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasemal hoone nurk kolme talumehega; paremal kaks tahapoole jooksvat hobust - ühel ratsanik, parempoolse hobuse kõrval jookseb mees; keskel mees.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground on the left, the corner of a building with three farmhands; on the right two horses running backward - one with a rider, a man running beside the right-hand horse; a man in the middle.

works.d: Esiplaanil all kollastes ja rohelistes toonides säpsivate pintslilöökidega antud veepind. Taamal sadamakai, mille ääres seisab neli kalalaeva. Kail paremal bordoopunased, ookritoonis katusega sadamahooned. Laevade taga vasakul lõiguke suvemaastikku. Ülaservas helesinine, roosakas pilvesäbrus taevas.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground below a water surface rendered in yellow and green tones with choppy brushstrokes. Further back a harbour quay, by which four fishing boats are moored. On the quay on the right, burgundy-red, ochre-roofed harbour buildings. Behind the boats on the left a strip of summer landscape. At the top edge a light blue, pinkish curly-clouded sky.

works.d: Esiplaanil viis nurgeliselt antud figuuri rinnatisel istumas: vasakult esimene on flööti puhuv mees siniste pükste ja pluusiga, teine pikas rohelises kleidis poolpikkade tumedate juustega naine aupaiste pea ümber, kolmas rohekassinises pikas kleidis naine istub valgel linal, süles valge õis, neljas sinises kleidis ja valge rätikuga naine on antud profiilis, viies naine on lühikeses sinises kleidis ja rätikus kaheharulist vilepilli puhumas. Foonil kitsad lahesopid ja sinakasroosad mäed.
works.de: In the foreground, five figures given at angles, sitting on a parapet: the first from the left is a man playing a flute, in blue trousers and a blouse, the second a woman in a long green dress with shoulder-length dark hair and a halo around her head, the third a woman in a long greenish-blue dress sitting on a white cloth, with a white blossom in her lap, the fourth a woman in a blue dress and a white kerchief is given in profile, the fifth woman is in a short blue dress and kerchief, playing a double-piped whistle. In the background narrow bay inlets and bluish-pink mountains.

works.d: Vanema mehe rinnaportree veerandpöördes paremale. Mehel peas rohekas, pisut kuklasse lükatud kaabu, seljas punakaspruun pintsak, valge särk ja tumesinine, värviliste triipudega lips. Mehel pikk, tõsine nägu, ninajuurel ja suu ümber tugevad kortsud. Ninal tumedate raamidega prillid.
works.de: Bust portrait of an older man, three-quarter turned to the right. The man wears a greenish hat, pushed slightly toward the back of his head, a reddish-brown jacket, a white shirt, and a dark blue tie with coloured stripes. The man has a long, serious face, with strong wrinkles at the bridge of the nose and around the mouth. On his nose, glasses with dark frames.

works.d: Osa tänavast kolme kahekorruselise majaga. Paremal taraga ümbritsetud muruplats, mille taga madalamad majad.
works.de: Part of a street with three two-storey houses. On the right a fenced lawn, behind which are lower houses.

works.d: Kaks suurt haralist puud, mille võred katavad suure osa maalist, nii et vasakule jääb väike osa madala silmapiiriga pilves taevast. Samas kitsas riba veekogu (teisel see puudub). Puude vahel ja vee kaldal lehmad. Erinevus teisega veel selles, et puudub veel figuur.
works.de: Two large branching trees, whose crowns cover a large part of the painting, so that a small part of a cloudy sky with a low horizon remains on the left. In the same place a narrow strip of water (absent in the second one). Between the trees and on the water's edge cows. Another difference from the second one is the absence of a figure.

works.d: Kunstnik istub punasel toolil kerges pöördes paremale. Pilk suunatud vaatajale, sigaretti hoidev käsi toetub põlvedele. Kunstnikul seljas veinipunane kuub, hallikassinine särk, tumedad püksid. Peas must barett, mille alt paistavad kõrvade juures terashallid juuksed. Selja taga ookerkollane sein, vasakul servas molbert puhta lõuendi või paberlehega.
works.de: The artist sits on a red chair, slightly turned to the right. Gaze directed at the viewer, the hand holding a cigarette rests on the knees. The artist is wearing a wine-red coat, a greyish-blue shirt, dark trousers. On his head a black beret, from under which steel-grey hair shows near the ears. Behind him an ochre-yellow wall, on the left edge an easel with a blank canvas or sheet of paper.

works.d: Tumedajuukselise poisikese poolakt profiilis vasakule. Foon punakaspruun.
works.de: Half-nude of a dark-haired boy in profile to the left. Background reddish-brown.

works.d: Istuva prillidega mehe poolfiguur en face vene kiriku tornide taustal. Peas kõrge valge peakate, üll lilla käisteta rüü, kaelas rist ja ovaalne raha. Vuntsid, hele tömp habe. Käed süles, vasak asetatud rinnale.(eesti)
works.de: Half-figure of a seated bespectacled man en face against a background of Russian church towers. On his head a tall white headdress, wearing a purple sleeveless robe, on the neck a cross and an oval coin. Moustache, light blunt beard. Hands in the lap, left placed on the chest.

works.d: Hõbehalliga summutatud värvivalikuga küps suvemaastik: keskel, vertikaalsest keskjoonest paremal mäkke suunduv teerada. Sellest esiplaanil, kahel pool hallid kivid ja lopsakad kirevad lillepuhmad. Ülal kahel pool rada tuhmkollased viljapõllud, silmapiiril vasakul talumaja paari puuga, paremal kaks väikest halli maja ja tuulik.
works.de: A mature summer landscape in a muted silver-grey colour palette: in the centre, to the right of the vertical midline, a path leading up a hill. In the foreground of it, grey stones and lush colourful flower clumps on both sides. Above, on both sides of the path, dull yellow grain fields, on the horizon a farmhouse with a couple of trees on the left, on the right two small grey houses and a windmill.

works.d: Viis spordirõivas jalgratturit maanteel vaataja suunas kihutamas. Tee ääres mustjaspruun põld. Üldistav maalilaad, figuurid tumeda kontuurjoonega ümbritsetud.
works.de: Five cyclists in sportswear racing on a highway towards the viewer. Beside the road a blackish-brown field. Generalised painterly style, the figures outlined with a dark contour line.

works.d: Esiplaanil kokamütsis ja valges põlles kondise näoga mehe poolfiguur. Seljas sinine pluus, prillid ees, käes vaheliti põlle all. Mehe selja taga kaaristu, foonil majad, lahesopp ja roosad mäed, kohati maalipind faktuurne (pahtli või noaga silumisjäljed).
works.de: In the foreground, the half-figure of a bony-faced man in a chef's hat and white apron. Wearing a blue blouse, glasses on, hands crossed under the apron. Behind the man's back an arcade, in the background houses, a bay and pink mountains, in places the paint surface textured (traces of smoothing with putty knife or palette knife).

works.d: Geomeetriliselt stiliseeritud kompositsioon selgvaates naisfiguuriga esiplaanis keskel. Naisel lühikeseks lõigatud paksud juuksed, mustad sukad ja pesu, jalas punased kõrge kontsaga kingad. Naise ees ovaalne peegel, tualett-tarvetega kaetud laud. Peeglis peegeldumas osa figuurist. Allservas paremal, varjuna mõjuv kübara ja kepiga mehe siluett. Fooniks geomeetrilistest kujunditest kompositsioon. Valitsevad mustad, hõõguvpunased ja sinised toonid.
works.de: A geometrically stylized composition with a frontal-view female figure in the centre foreground. The woman has short-cropped thick hair, black stockings and underwear, and red high-heeled shoes. In front of her, an oval mirror, a table covered with toiletries. Part of the figure is reflected in the mirror. Lower right, the shadow-like silhouette of a man with a hat and a cane. The background is a composition of geometric shapes. Black, glowing red and blue tones predominate.

works.d: Esiplaanil ülestõusjate relvastatud grupid. Taga vasakul ja paremal taluhooned talvemaastikus.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground armed groups of insurgents. Behind, on the left and right, farm buildings in a winter landscape.

works.d: Värvilistest plekkpurkidest kompositsioon. Ülaosas helesinine-valge pilvelaadne kujund. Alaosa must, mõningate värviliste aksentidega. All paremal elektronkella oranž number 13:46.
works.de: A composition of coloured tin cans. In the upper part a light blue-white cloud-like form. The lower part black, with some coloured accents. Lower right the orange number 13:46 of an electronic clock.

works.d: Esiplaanil veekogu ääres kõrkjate sees rebane ja neli põgenendes lendu tõusvat parti.
works.de: In the foreground, by a body of water among sedges, a fox and four ducks taking flight while fleeing.

works.d: Esiplaanil sadam paatide ja laevadega, tagapool vaade hoonetele.
works.de: In the foreground a harbour with boats and ships, behind it a view of buildings.

works.t: Oranje ja Nassau printsi Wilhelm II portree
works.dm: kõrgus: 106.0 cm (tervik, arm.   ); laius: 87.5 cm (tervik, arm.   )
works.d: Poisi poolfiguur, poolprofiilis vasemale, XVII sajandi riietuses, rinnaturvisega. Parem käsi toetub kepile, vasak mõõgapidemele.(eesti)
works.de: Half-figure of a boy, in half-profile to the left, in 17th-century attire, with a breastplate. Right hand resting on a staff, left hand on a sword hilt.

works.d: Ovaalis vanema mehe rinnaportree vaatega vasakule. Heledad siledad ja lühikesed juuksed, heledad silmad, valgel kaelasidemel helepunase paela otsas orden. Taust ühtlaselt tume.
works.de: Oval bust portrait of an older man, looking to the left. Light, smooth and short hair, light eyes, an order on a bright red ribbon on a white necktie. Background uniformly dark.

works.d: Tiheda, taevast varjava lehestikuga tammik, mille tüvedele paistab vasakult päikesevalgus.
works.de: An oak grove with dense foliage shading the sky, sunlight shining on the tree trunks from the left.

works.d: Õunapuu all naise poolfiguur, käes korv õuntega. Eredalt oranzil foonil lillakad ihutoonid, pluus rohekas, lehestik tume lillakate toonide domineerides.
works.de: Under an apple tree the half-figure of a woman, holding a basket with apples. Against a bright orange background, purplish skin tones, the blouse greenish, the foliage dark with purplish tones dominating.

works.d: Esiplaanil istuv rahvarõivais naine - karjus kitse ja kolme lehmaga (kaks magamas). Tagaplaanil põllud viljarõukudega, vasemal metsasaludega palistatud järv ja agulimajad; paremal vaade Viljandi linnale. Taevas pilves, serv roosakas.
works.de: In the foreground, a seated woman in folk costume - a herder with a goat and three cows (two sleeping). In the background, fields with grain stacks, on the left a lake fringed with groves of trees and suburban houses; on the right a view of the town of Viljandi. The sky cloudy, the edge pinkish.

works.t: Eestimaa tsiviilkuberner Paul von Benckendorffi portree
works.d: Interjööris istuva mehe täisfiguur poolprofiilis paremale, parem käsi toetatud rohelise kattega lauale. Uksest avaneb vaade kõrvalruumidesse. Figuuri taga seinal musta riidega kaetud tsaariportree (ilmselt Nikolai I).
works.de: Full figure of a man seated in an interior, in half-profile to the right, right hand resting on a table with a green cover. Through a door a view opens into adjoining rooms. Behind the figure on the wall a portrait of the tsar (apparently Nicholas I) covered with black cloth.

works.d: Suverohelusse uppuv päikesepaisteline maastik: paremal suure hallikasrohelises lehestikus leinapaju all pink, mille istub valges pearätikus vana naine. Vana naise ees punases pluusis naine valge kitsega. Naiste taga tara ja selle taga puuriit. Vasakul servas veekogu, paat ja suurem paadikuur. Fooniks metstükk ja kollakashall taevas.
works.de: A sunny landscape sinking into summer greenery: on the right, under a large weeping willow with grey-green foliage, a bench on which sits an old woman in a white headscarf. In front of the old woman a woman in a red blouse with a white goat. Behind the women a fence and behind it a woodpile. On the left edge a body of water, a boat and a larger boathouse. In the background a patch of forest and a yellowish-grey sky.

works.d: Aknalaual vaas suure kimbu lillade sirelitega. Vasakul paistab aknast heleda taeva taustal sinakas maja siluett.
works.de: On the windowsill a vase with a large bunch of purple lilacs. On the left, through the window, the bluish silhouette of a house is visible against a light sky.

works.d: Sinises kleidis prillidega naise rinnafiguur otsevaates. Taust hallikas - rohekaspruun.
works.de: A bust of a woman in a blue dress with glasses, in a frontal view. The background is greyish-greenish-brown.

works.d: Pruunides, samblastes summutatud sügistoonides põikitriibuline abstraktne kompositsioon. Maalipinnase kinnitatud triipudena hõredalt riiet, paberit, köit jm., mis mitmekihiliselt, kohati voolavate niredena üle maalitud.
works.de: An abstract composition in brown, mossy, muted autumn tones with cross-striped pattern. Sparsely attached to the painting ground as stripes are fabric, paper, rope etc., which are painted over in multiple layers, in places as flowing rivulets.

works.d: Keskelt lahku kammitud juustega tumedapäise habemiku mehe rinnapilt en face. Pea kallutatud alla.
works.de: Bust portrait en face of a dark-haired bearded man with hair combed apart in the middle. Head tilted down.

works.d: Esiplaanil sügavusse suunduv kõnnitee jalgrattaga, paremal hooned, vasemal kaldaäär. Vihmane päev.
works.de: In the foreground a footpath running into the depth with a bicycle, on the right buildings, on the left a riverbank. A rainy day.

works.d: Öine merevaade. Esiplaanil rannaäärsete kivide vahel paadinina püsti vahuses vees. Vasakul pimeduses aimatav paat kahe tulega pardal. Üle vee rannatuled peegeldumas merre. Tume, mustjassinine koloriit tugevasti lakitud pind.(eesti)
works.de: Night seascape. In the foreground, among coastal rocks, the bow of a boat standing upright in foamy water. On the left, in the darkness, a boat with two lights on board can be discerned. Shore lights reflecting into the sea across the water. Dark, blackish-blue colour scheme, heavily varnished surface.

works.d: Esiplaanil lage plats üksikute suurte mändidega; aia taga puude ja põõsaste vahel üksikud majad. Horisondil mets.
works.de: In the foreground an open area with individual large pines; behind a fence, among trees and bushes, individual houses. Forest on the horizon.

works.d: Eest vasakult kerge pöördega paremale alla orgu laskuval teel seljakoti ja kepiga mehe figuur (en face); paremal künka harjal grupp puid. Kaugemal org ja järsud kaljuahelikud. Mägede jalamil lahtpuude vöönd kahe madala hoonega vasakul.
works.de: In front, on a path descending with a slight turn from left to right into a valley, the figure of a man with a backpack and a stick (en face); on the right, on the crest of a hillock, a group of trees. Further away a valley and steep rocky ridges. At the foot of the mountains a belt of deciduous trees, with two low buildings on the left.

works.d: Sürrealistlik rannamotiiv. Esiplaanil liival lebab akti poolfiguur. Sinakais-roosakais toonides naisaktist on näha lopsakate vormidega torso. Naise parema käe sõrmed hoiavad meresinise "rätiku" serva. Taamal pruunikas-sinises meres hulbib vasakul üksik kõrv.
works.de: A surrealist beach motif. In the foreground, a half-figure nude lies on the sand. The female nude in bluish-pink tones shows a torso with lush forms. The fingers of the woman's right hand hold the edge of a sea-blue "kerchief". In the background, in a brownish-blue sea, a single ear floats on the left.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal on aimata suurt, kaarduvajunud okstega puud, mille fooniks abstraheeritult antud künklik ja puudesaludega kaetud maastik. Erksates sinistes, punastes, kollastes toonides. Maalitud laia ekspressiivse pintslilöögiga.
