works.d: Esiplaanil hallides toonides jõgi, taga paremal Pirita kloostri varemed ja rohelusse uppunud kloostri surnuaed. Vasakus servas osa väikesest majast. Ülal jupike erinevates sinistes toonides antud taevast. Määrdunud hallides ja rohelistes toonides, kohati värvikiht väga pastoosne ja pintslivarrega modelleeritud.
works.de: In the foreground a river in grey tones, behind it on the right the ruins of Pirita Convent and the convent cemetery submerged in greenery. In the left edge part of a small house. Above, a patch of sky given in various shades of blue. In dirty grey and green tones, in places the paint layer is very impasto and modelled with the brush handle.

works.d: Esiplaanil kartulipõld. Vasakul õlgkatusega palkhoone, mille taga kõrged puud. Paremal kaugemal teine madal õlgkatusega hoone.
works.de: In the foreground a potato field. On the left a thatched log building, behind which tall trees. Further on the right another low thatched building.

works.d: Keskel klaasist vaas aprikoosidega. Vasakul maisipea. Paremal viinamarjad ja õunad.
works.de: In the center a glass vase with apricots. On the left a corn cob. On the right grapes and apples.

works.d: Kaljuse ranna mägimaastikul esiplaanil pikas pruunis nööriga vöötatud kuues paljasjalgne ja palja peaga seisev mees, laiali sirutatud kätega. Paremas käes raamatuke; ümbritsetud mitmesugustest lindudest.
works.de: In a rocky coastal mountain landscape, in the foreground a barefoot and bareheaded man standing in a long brown coat tied with a cord, arms outstretched. A small book in his right hand; surrounded by various birds.

works.d: Esiplaanil rohtunud järsu kalda serv üksiku meesfiguuriga. Keskel näha kalda langusel ja orus kasvava lehtmetsa ladvastikku. Kaugemal jõgi tõusva vastaskaldaga.
works.de: In the foreground the edge of a steep, overgrown bank with a solitary male figure. In the centre, the treetops of a deciduous forest growing on the slope and in the valley below are visible. Further away a river with a rising opposite bank.

works.d: Taluõuel punase jaki ja valge pearätikuga naine hanekarja keskel, vitsik käes. Vasakul roigasaed, tagaplaanil pikk elu- ja majapidamishoone. Paremal paistab lauda ots lakka viiva redeliga. Redeli juures kaks siga.
works.de: In a farmyard, a woman in a red jacket and white headscarf amid a flock of geese, a switch in her hand. On the left a pole fence, in the background a long dwelling and outbuilding. On the right the end of a barn is visible with a ladder leading up to the loft. Beside the ladder two pigs.

works.d: Loomanaha kujuga atsetaatkilest alus, mille ülemistes nurkades metallrõngad kinnituseks. Kile toonitud aerosoolvärvidega pronksikarva.
works.de: A base made of acetate film in the shape of an animal skin, with metal rings in the upper corners for fastening. The film tinted bronze-coloured with aerosol paints.

works.d: Esiplaanil palke kandvad inimesed. Taga taluhooned. Paremal lõke.
works.de: In the foreground people carrying logs. Farm buildings behind. A campfire on the right.

works.d: Naise portree profiilis vasakule, peakattes, valge žabooga. Foon hele. Pastoosselt maalitud.
works.de: Portrait of a woman in profile to the left, wearing headwear, with a white jabot. Light background. Painted impasto.

works.dm: laius: 496.0 cm (mõõdud raamiga); laius: 171.0 cm (mõõdud raamita); sügavus: 4.0 cm (mõõdud raamita); kõrgus: 121.0 cm (mõõdud raamita)
works.d: Neljaosaline maal. Üle maalipinna ulatub hiiglaslik lamav naisakt. Profiilne pea paikneb paremas ülanurgas. Üle pea sirutatud käsi pildilt ei nähtu. Kompositsioonilt kaarjas, veidi U-kujuline. Akti parem jalg põlvest kõverdatud, kolmnurkselt püsti. Vasak asetseb kõverdatuna horisontaalselt. Parema jala laba varjab maali vasakus nurgas paiknev pea, mis on paigutatud külili vaatega veidi diagonaalselt üles. Pea on rohekas-hallikais toonides. Taust määrdunud pruuniaks - punastes, hallides, mustades toonides. Raam maali ülaosas.(eesti)
works.de: A four-part painting. A gigantic reclining female nude extends across the picture plane. The profile head is located in the upper right corner. The arm stretched over the head is not visible in the picture. The composition is arched, somewhat U-shaped. The nude's right leg is bent at the knee, upright in a triangular shape. The left leg lies bent horizontally. The foot of the right leg is obscured by the head located in the left corner of the painting, which is placed in a sideways view, slightly diagonally upward. The head is in greenish-grey tones. The background is a soiled brown - in red, grey, black tones. The frame is in the upper part of the painting.

works.d: Esiplaanil rikkalikult kaetud laud. Ees must ja valge lastud lind, keraamiline nõu sangaga (ornamentidega kaunistatud); kõrvits, millest lõigatud viil lebab laual. Kõrvitsa taga korv viinamarjade ja viinamarjaväätidega. Korvi ees paremal kolm virsikut, tumedad ploomid ja väike viinamarjakobar üle laua ääre rippumas. Foon ühtlaselt pruunikas.
works.de: In the foreground a richly laid table. In front a black and white shot bird, a ceramic vessel with a handle (decorated with ornaments); a pumpkin, from which a cut slice lies on the table. Behind the pumpkin a basket with grapes and grapevines. In front of the basket on the right three peaches, dark plums and a small bunch of grapes hanging over the edge of the table. Background evenly brownish.

works.d: Nooremapoolse mehe portree, pea pööratud paremale. Vasakult tulev valgus vormib tugevate refleksidega kõrgete põsesarnadega musklilise näo, sirge nina ja tumedad kulmud. Seljas tume kuub valge särgiga ja tumeroheline, laia paelaga kaabu. Foon hallikaspruun.
works.de: Portrait of a somewhat younger man, head turned to the right. Light coming from the left models a muscular face with strong reflections, high cheekbones, straight nose and dark eyebrows. Wearing a dark coat with a white shirt and a dark green wide-brimmed hat with a wide ribbon. Background greyish-brown.

works.d: Roosa linaga kaetud laual avatud raamat (ees vasakul), teisi raamatuid, kaitsekorviga pudel, gloobus, küünal, tindipott hanesulega.
works.de: On a table covered with a pink cloth an open book (front left), other books, a bottle with a protective wicker cover, a globe, a candle, an inkpot with a goose quill.

works.d: Sinepikollases punase kaelusega riietuses musta peakattega naise rinnafiguur profiilis vasakule.
works.de: Bust of a woman in mustard-yellow clothing with a red collar and a black headdress, in profile to the left.

works.d: Erksates värvides maastik. Veidi vasakul keskel väike valge, musta katusega maja. Sellest vasakul kolm elektriposti. Maali vasakus servas ning ka paremas sinakad madalad mäed. Eespool erkroheline küngas, millel hallikas teerada. Paremal järsk kallas ning veidi säravsinist merd. Esiplaanil punakas-roosa taimevaht, milles neli väiksemat hallides toonides kivi või tulpa. Taustaks kirgassinise-valge värvilahendusega pilvine taevas.
works.de: A landscape in vivid colours. Slightly left of centre, a small white house with a black roof. To its left, three electricity poles. At the left edge of the painting and also at the right, bluish low mountains. In front, a bright green hill with a greyish path on it. At right, a steep bank and a bit of bright blue sea. In the foreground, reddish-pink plant foam, in which there are four smaller stones or tulips in grey tones. In the background, a cloudy sky in a bright blue-white colour scheme.

works.d: Ees veekogu keskel vaataja poolt vette tungiv maanina üksiku suure puuga. Paremal paat sõudjatega. Taga vasakul kallas hoonete ja kaljusse raiutud loss - kindlusega.
works.de: In front, in the middle of a body of water, a spit of land jutting into the water towards the viewer with a single large tree. On the right a boat with rowers. Behind on the left a bank with buildings and a castle - a fortress - carved into the cliff.

works.d: Hollandlik öine maastik. Vasakule jääb suur lehtpuu, aia sees olev maja ning üksik teekäija. Paremal jõgi ja tagaplaanil paistev tuulik. Taevas täiskuu. Maal kaetud paksu, tumeda lakikihiga.
works.de: A Dutch-style nocturnal landscape. On the left a large deciduous tree, a house within a garden, and a lone traveller. On the right a river and a windmill visible in the background. Full moon in the sky. The painting is covered with a thick, dark layer of varnish.

works.dm: kõrgus: 78.5 cm (km.   ); laius: 101.0 cm (pm.   ); laius: 97.5 cm (km.   ); kõrgus: 82.0 cm (pm.   )
works.d: Kasvuhoone sisemuses paremal laud, mille taga istuv töötav mees, ees tool, kastekann ja punase õiega lill potis. Vasakul ja paremal tagapool rohelisi taimi ja lilli.
works.de: Inside a greenhouse on the right a table, behind which a working man sitting, in front a chair, a watering can and a flower with a red bloom in a pot. On the left and right behind, green plants and flowers.

works.d: Noore pikajuukselise mehe poolfiguur, jeha pöördega paremale, nägu en face, vaade suunatud üles, rohelist tooni rüü. Paremal, laual avatud raamat ja mehe käte vahel pärgamendi rull. Tagapool karikas, millest kerkib üles madu.
works.de: Half-figure of a young long-haired man, torso turned to the right, face en face, gaze directed upward, wearing a robe of green tone. On the right, on a table, an open book, and between the man's hands a scroll of parchment. Behind, a chalice from which a serpent rises.

works.d: Esiplaanil kaldaäärne tänav inimeste ja hobustega. Pildi keskosas jõgi diagonaalselt vasakult paremale suunduva sillaga, millel sõidavad punased trammid. Üle jõe ühtlane majade rida.
works.de: In the foreground a street along the shore with people and horses. In the middle of the picture a river with a bridge running diagonally from left to right, on which red trams are traveling. Across the river an even row of houses.

works.dm: laius: 310.0 cm; kõrgus: 130.0 cm; kõrgus: 170.0 cm
works.d: Paremale tõusev kolmeastmeline kompositsioon erivärvilistest, erinevate võtetega teostatud maalipindadest. Lõuendile on kleebitud rebitud servadega pappi, kortustatud paberit jm. Maalitud kohati voolavate värvidega.
works.de: A three-step composition rising to the right, made of painted surfaces of different colours and different techniques. Cardboard with torn edges, crumpled paper etc. glued onto the canvas. Painted in places with flowing paints.

works.dm: laius: 33.3 cm (arm.   ); kõrgus: 43.1 cm (vm.); kõrgus: 44.2 cm (arm.   ); laius: 32.1 cm (vm. )
works.d: Poollangetatud laugudega naise poolfiguur, poolprofiilis vasemale, rinnakõrgusel kokkupandud kätega, peas lai must rätt valge äärega otsaesisel, valge kaelus, valged kätised.
works.de: Half-length figure of a woman with half-lowered eyelids, in half-profile to the left, hands clasped at chest height, wearing a wide black headscarf with a white edge on the forehead, a white collar, white cuffs.

works.d: Katuse all paat pukkidel, eemal madalad hooned.
works.de: A boat on trestles under a roof, low buildings in the distance.

works.d: Esiplaanil raagus puuvõre. Tagaplaanil vaade kivimajadele. Talviselt sompus taevas.
works.de: In the foreground a bare tree lattice. In the background a view of stone houses. Wintry, gloomy sky.

works.d: Kahvatubeežil taustal puuvõra-taoline abstraktsetest värvilistest pindadest kujund, kus domineerivad lillakashallid, roosad, sinised ja beežid toonid.
works.de: Against a pale beige background a tree-crown-like shape formed of abstract coloured surfaces, in which purplish-grey, pink, blue and beige tones dominate.

works.d: Päikeseloojang peegelsileda pinnaga, ees ja horisondil sinakasrohelise, keskplaanil oranžika, tumeoranžika ja sinakasroheliste viirgudega vee kohal. Keskplaanil vasemal vaatajast kergelt vasemalt mööduv kahemastiline kuunar selle juures (vasakul) asuva aerupaadiga. Taeva keskosas läbi kogu kompositsiooni laiuses tume sinakashall rünkpilvede mass, mille alt keskel viirab loojuv päike.
works.de: A sunset over a mirror-smooth surface of water, bluish-green in the foreground and on the horizon, with orange, dark orange and bluish-green streaks in the middle ground. In the middle ground on the left, slightly passing the viewer on the left, a two-masted schooner with a rowing boat beside it (on the left). In the central part of the sky, across the entire width of the composition, a dark bluish-grey mass of cumulus clouds, from beneath which, in the middle, the setting sun shines through.

works.d: Esiplaanil kivisel teel mees eesliga, keskel rida hooneid, taamal kõrged mäetipud.
works.de: In the foreground, on a stony road, a man with a donkey; in the middle a row of buildings, in the distance high mountain peaks.

works.d: Kahel (sinisel ja punasel) teibal kõndiv fantastiline neljajalgne elukas: kere eestpoolt sinine ja tagant punane, nahk laiguline, tugev saba otsast rullis. Peas sarvetaoline moodustis, suured pungis silmad, pikk punane keel ripub suust välja. Foon alt lillakassinine, ülalt tume, erinevates toonides lilla.(eesti)
works.de: A fantastic four-legged creature walking on two stilts (blue and red): the body blue in front and red behind, the skin spotted, a strong tail curled at the end. On its head a horn-like formation, large bulging eyes, a long red tongue hanging out of its mouth. Background purplish-blue below, dark above, in various shades of purple.

works.d: Seitse sinistes toonides heeringat pruunil võrgul. Ülal võrguserv kollaste ujukorkidega. Võrgu piirkonnas värvikihti risti-rästi kraabitud võrgusilmi markeerivad jooned. Pruunides, mustades, tumerohelistes toonides foon.(eesti)
works.de: Seven herrings in bluish tones on a brown net. Above, the edge of the net with yellow floats. In the area of the net, lines scratched crosswise through the paint layer marking the meshes of the net. Background in brown, black, dark green tones.

works.d: Heledapäise pikajuukselise tütarlapse rinnapilt tumedas kleidis, poolprofiilis vasakule.
works.de: Bust portrait of a fair-haired, long-haired girl in a dark dress, half-profile to the left.

works.d: Kolmest istuvast naisest kompositsioon: vasakpoolsel sinised rõivad ja jalg üle põlve, parempoolsel seljas oranžikaskollased riided, käes ridikül või raamat, juustes punane lill. Maalitud tihedate, vibreerivate pintslilöökidega.
works.de: A composition of three seated women: the one on the left in blue clothing with a leg crossed over the knee, the one on the right wearing orange-yellow clothing, holding a handbag or a book, with a red flower in her hair. Painted with dense, vibrating brushstrokes.

works.d: Maali kesksel kohal kollastes toonides seisva naisakti kolmveerandfiguur. Ülesvaatava pea ümber peene kollase joonega aura. Rinnad veidi reljeefsed. Ülalt paremast nurgast alla vasaku nurgani ebakorrapärase diagonaalina moduleeritud kollastes toonides värvipind. Paremal keskel musta värvigammaga punaste aktsentidega nelinurk, millest voolab välja sinistes ja rohelistes toonides kosk. Maali ülaosas, vasakul sinisel taustal kollasega markeeritud nelinurk. Üldmõjult maal veidi abstraktsionistlik ning kohati pastoosselt maalitud.
works.de: At the centre of the painting stands a three-quarter figure of a female nude in yellow tones. Around her upward-looking head is an aura marked by a thin yellow line. The breasts are slightly relief-like. From the upper right corner to the lower left corner runs an irregular diagonal area of colour modulated in yellow tones. On the right in the middle is a rectangle in a black colour scheme with red accents, from which flows a waterfall in blue and green tones. In the upper part of the painting, on the left, on a blue background, is a rectangle marked in yellow. The overall effect of the painting is somewhat abstractionist and in places painted pastosely.

works.d: Ees kai, mille ääres kaks purjekat. Tagaplaanil laev ja hooneid.
works.de: In front a quay with two sailboats by it. In the background a ship and buildings.

works.d: Esiplaanil, paremal ja keskel madal jõekallas. Tagapool vasakul kulgevat jõge palistavad üksikud raagus kased. kaugemal, paremal, kahekorde eluhoone otsavaade. Taamal mäeahelik.
works.de: In the foreground, on the right and in the middle, a low riverbank. Further back on the left, solitary bare birches line the flowing river. In the distance, on the right, the end view of a two-storey dwelling house. In the distance, a mountain range.

works.d: Esiplaanil lage maastik. Keskel paremal ja vasakul lehtpuusalud. Taamal mets.
works.de: In the foreground an open landscape. In the middle, on the right and left, groves of deciduous trees. Forest in the distance.

works.d: Esiplaanil ratsanikud ja jahikotkad, taamal mägine maastik.
works.de: Riders and hunting eagles in the foreground, a mountainous landscape beyond.

works.d: Helesinise kleidis naise rinnaportree, kaelas kollakas-roheline sall. Pea kerges pöördes paremale. Juuksed tumedad, kergelt laines, kõrged kulmud, tumedad silmad.
works.de: Chest portrait of a woman in a light blue dress, a yellowish-green scarf around her neck. Head slightly turned to the right. Dark, slightly wavy hair, high eyebrows, dark eyes.

works.d: Poisi rinnapilt en face, blondide juustega, valge krae pööratud sinakale pluusile.
works.de: Chest-portrait of a boy en face, with blond hair, a white collar turned over a bluish blouse.

works.d: Vaade Tallinnale Kalamaja kandist mere poolt: esiplaanil allservas ja paremal punakaspruunid laia põhjaga aurikud, vasakul allnurgas kai üksikute inimfiguuride ja tünnidega. Taamal Tallinna vanalinn, mille üle kõrgub Oleviste kirik. Ülal lillakashall, sünge pilvine taevas. Maalitud tumedates hallides ja pruunides toonides, esiplaanil veepind kohati pastoosselt antud.
works.de: View of Tallinn from Kalamaja seen from the sea side: in the foreground, at the bottom edge and on the right, reddish-brown broad-bottomed steamships, in the bottom left corner a quay with a few human figures and barrels. Beyond, the Old Town of Tallinn, above which rises St. Olaf's Church. Above, a purplish-grey, gloomy cloudy sky. Painted in dark grey and brown tones, the water surface in the foreground given pastose in places.

works.d: Lopsakas lõunamaine maastik: esiplaanil kirevad lilled, kollaste ja punaste õitega põõsad ja puud. Keskel telliskivikarva rannariba ja sügavsinine merelaht. Tagaplaanil vasakul mäed ja majad mäenõlvakul. Ülal helesinine taevas. Maalitud teravate, nähtavate pintslilöökidega.
works.de: A lush southern landscape: in the foreground colourful flowers, bushes and trees with yellow and red blossoms. In the centre a brick-coloured shoreline and a deep blue sea bay. In the background on the left mountains and houses on a mountain slope. Above, a light blue sky. Painted with sharp, visible brushstrokes.

works.d: Naise rinnafiguur musta ahviga paremal õlal. Naise džemper kirsipunane, heledad lühikesed lokkis juuksed, ahvil seljas oranž jakk. Taust maalitud värviliste laikudena.
works.de: Bust of a woman with a black monkey on her right shoulder. The woman's sweater is cherry red, light short curly hair, the monkey wears an orange jacket. The background is painted as coloured patches.

works.dm: laius: 44.7 cm (koos klaasiga   ); kõrgus: 33.3 cm (vm.   ); kõrgus: 34.7 cm (koos klaasiga   ); laius: 43.3 cm (vm.   )
works.d: Kompositsiooni keskteljele suubuv lumine kitsenev tänav paremal pool tagaplaanil kahekorruselise ja keskplaanil ühekorruselise majaga. Vasakul poolel esiplaanil plank, keskplaanil pikk ühekorruseline maja gaasilaternaga tänavafassaadi vaatajapoolses osas. Taamal keskteljel Oleviste kiriku torn, vasakul poolel keskplaanil paistab üle müüritise linnamüüri katusteta kaitsetorn. Tänaval tagapool suur kelk, eespool mees lapsega.
works.de: A narrowing snowy street leading to the central axis of the composition, on the right in the background a two-storey house and in the middle ground a single-storey house. On the left in the foreground a fence, in the middle ground a long single-storey house with a gas lamp on the street façade facing the viewer. In the distance on the central axis the tower of St. Olaf's Church, on the left in the middle ground a roofless defence tower of the town wall shows above the masonry. On the street further back a large sledge, in front a man with a child.

works.d: Esiplaanil lai rukkipõld. Keskplaanil peaaegu maali keskel rukkipõldude vahel veoauto. Veoauto kastist paistavad kaks naisepead ja pika varre otsas lehviv punane lipp. tagaplaanil maanteel kaks veomasinat ja kolm poisikest. Nendest paremal asuval põllul rukkilõikusmasin ja tütarlaps jalgrattaga käe kõrval.
works.de: In the foreground a wide rye field. In the middle ground, almost at the centre of the painting, a truck among the rye fields. From the truck bed two women's heads and a red flag fluttering on a long pole can be seen. In the background on the road two harvesting machines and three boys. In the field to their right a rye harvester and a girl with a bicycle by her hand.

works.dm: kõrgus: 35.0 cm (vm.   ); laius: 27.4 cm; laius: 30.1 cm (vm.); kõrgus: 34.0 cm
works.d: Noore naise poolfiguur en face; punases vestis ja sinises lühikäiselises pluusis.
works.de: Half-figure of a young woman en face; in a red waistcoat and blue short-sleeved blouse.

works.d: Suvine maastik veekoguga esiplaanil. Veekogu paremal kaldal maja inimfiguuridega. Tagaplaanil elumaja puude keskel.
works.de: A summer landscape with a body of water in the foreground. On the right bank of the water, a house with human figures. In the background a dwelling house amid trees.

works.d: Ees vasakul jõgi paadisillaga, paremal kai. Pisut tagapool sild. Silla juures kai ääres purjepaadid.
works.de: In the front on the left a river with a pontoon bridge, on the right a quay. A bit further back a bridge. Sailing boats by the quay near the bridge.

works.d: Kollasel laual keskel tumesinine keraamiline vaas suurte daaliate, jorjenite, krüsanteemide jt. hilissuviste lillede kimbuga. Vaasist vasakul kaks õuna ja kolm banaani, paremal servas kaks karpi, küünlajalg, tikutoosihoidja. Foon sinakashall, paremalt servast punane.
works.de: In the centre of a yellow table a dark blue ceramic vase with a bouquet of large dahlias, gerberas, chrysanthemums and other late-summer flowers. To the left of the vase two apples and three bananas, on the right edge two boxes, a candlestick, a matchbox holder. Background bluish-grey, red from the right edge.

works.d: Noore tüdruku portree. Nägu ookertoonides, suured silmad, lühikestel juustel laiaääreline õlgkübar. Seljas valge kraega helepunane pluus ja hallikas jakk.
works.de: Portrait of a young girl. Face in ochre tones, large eyes, on short hair a wide-brimmed straw hat. Wearing a light red blouse with a white collar and a grayish jacket.

works.d: Musta mütsi ja punase salliga naise rinnafiguur otsevaates, pilk suunatud paremale. Taust pruunis - rohelises koloriidis.
works.de: Bust figure of a woman in a black hat and red shawl, in direct view, gaze directed to the right. Background in brown-green coloring.

works.d: Pastelsetes sinistes, kollastes, tumepunastes toonides rangelt ühesuurusteks ruutudeks jaotatud maalipind. Iga ruudu üks serv otsekui läbikumavalt heledamaks maalitud.
works.de: In pastel blue, yellow, dark red tones, a painting surface strictly divided into equally sized squares. One edge of each square is painted as if lighter, shining through.

works.d: Vasakul pikk, õlgkatusega rehielamu; sellest paremal suur puu, kelder ja osa õlgkatusega kõrvalhoonest. Keldri poolt tuleb naine esiplaanil vasakul asetseva pika laua poole, mille ümber istub grupp inimesi.
works.de: On the left a long, thatched-roof threshing barn dwelling; to its right a large tree, a cellar and part of a thatched-roof outbuilding. From the cellar a woman comes toward a long table in the foreground on the left, around which a group of people is sitting.

works.d: Värviline, peaaegu abstraktselt mõjuv kompositsioon, millest aimuvad ülalt vasakult diagonaalis alla liikuvad figuurid. Esiplaanil all mikrofoni koos statiiviga käes hoidev laulja. Ekspressiivne maalimislaad.
works.de: A colourful, almost abstract-seeming composition, in which figures moving diagonally from upper left to lower right can be discerned. In the foreground below, a singer holding a microphone with a stand. Expressive painting style.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul tugipiitadega tugimüür, paremal plekk-katus korstnaga. Keskel tõusvas järjestuses maju, nende vahel lehtpuid. Taama paremal üle puude ja katuste paistab Toomkiriku torni kiiver.
works.de: In the foreground on the left a retaining wall with buttresses, on the right a sheet-metal roof with a chimney. In the middle houses in ascending order, with deciduous trees between them. In the distance on the right, above the trees and roofs, the spire of the Cathedral tower is visible.

works.d: Istuva naise põlvportree poolpöördes vasakule. Tumedad juuksed kuklasse kammitud, käed ristatult vasakule jalale toetatud. Seljas kinnise kaelusega tume kleit.
works.de: Knee-length portrait of a seated woman in a half-turn to the left. Dark hair combed back into a bun, hands crossed and resting on the left leg. Wearing a dark dress with a closed collar.

works.d: Ees keskel Virumaa rahvarõivais seisva mehe ja naise täisfiguurid. Ülal, paremal nurgas talumaja.
works.de: In the front centre full figures of a man and a woman standing in Virumaa folk costume. Above, in the right corner, a farmhouse.

works.d: Järvamaa rahvarõivais seisva neiu ja noormehe täisfiguurid. Ülal paremal kirik.
works.de: Full figures of a young woman and a young man standing in Järvamaa folk costume. A church in the upper right.

works.d: Ovaalis tumedate juuste ning täishabemega pruunisilmse noore mehe portree, poolpöördes paremale. Pilk suunatud üles, huuled veidi paokil. Seljas helepruun kuub ja avatud kaelusega särk. Foon ovaalis sinakashall, selle ümber pruun.
works.de: Portrait in an oval of a brown-eyed young man with dark hair and a full beard, in half-turn to the right. Gaze directed upward, lips slightly parted. Wearing a light brown coat and an open-collared shirt. Background bluish-grey within the oval, brown around it.

works.d: Roosakas - lillakas kleidis istuva naise kolmveerandfiguur, kerges pöördes paremale. Pilk suunatud otse ette; vasak käsi tõstetud kleidikaeluse juurde. Foon sinakates, rohekates toonides. Maalitud hoogsate pintslilöökidega, mis osaliselt hajutavad figuuri piirded, sulatades need taustaga ühte.
works.de: Three-quarter figure of a woman seated in a pinkish-purplish dress, in a slight turn to the right. Gaze directed straight ahead; left hand raised to the neckline of the dress. Background in bluish, greenish tones. Painted with vigorous brushstrokes that partly dissolve the contours of the figure, blending them into the background.

works.d: Nõmmemaastikus heledakarvaline, tumedate laikudega koer. Parem esikäpp tõstetud, keha kolmveerandpöördes vasakule. Maalitud hoogsalt; kasutatud vineeripinda, jättes viimase tahtlikult värvivabaks.
works.de: In a heathland landscape a light-coated dog with dark spots. Right forepaw raised, body in a three-quarter turn to the left. Painted vigorously; a plywood surface is used, the latter deliberately left free of paint.

works.d: Esiplaanil, mööda erkrohelist nõlvakut mäkke tõusev pruunikas looklev tee. Mägede vahel paremal ja ülal vasakul üldistavalt lahendatud metsatukad. Ülal ja paremal tükike valgete pilvedega sinist taevast. Maalitud pastoosselt, stiliseerivalt.
works.de: In the foreground, a brownish winding road rises up a mountain along a bright green slope. Among the mountains, on the right and at the upper left, generally rendered stands of forest. At the top and on the right, a patch of blue sky with white clouds. Painted pastosely, in a stylising manner.

works.d: Suure, valge õie ja lopsakate lehtedega potilill. Selle kõrval, vasakul, kolju ülemine osa. Foon hallikas. Õieosas värvipind faktuurne.(eesti)
works.de: Potted flower with a large white blossom and lush leaves. Beside it, on the left, the upper part of a skull. Background greyish. The paint surface of the flower area is textured.

works.d: Päikesepaisteline suvemaastik. Vasakul kõrge aed ja üle selle paistev kahar puukroon. Paremal roostik. Taamal paistab tumeda joonena mets. Maalimislaad detaili järgiv.(eesti)
works.de: A sunny summer landscape. On the left a high fence and a bushy tree crown visible above it. On the right a reed bed. In the distance a forest is visible as a dark line. Detailed painting style.

works.d: Noore naise profiilportree. Ülakeha ettekummardatud; parem käsi väljasirutatud, vasak kõverdatud keha alla. Pilk suunatud vaatajale. Taust rohelistes toonides.
works.de: Profile portrait of a young woman. Upper body leaning forward; right hand extended, left bent under the body. Gaze directed at the viewer. Background in green tones.

works.d: Lillal, kaarjal pinnal neli, kollase pastelliga joonistatud naisefiguuri. Kolm seisavad, käed kõverdatud kukla taha; üks istub, käed ümber põlvede.
works.de: On a lilac, curved surface, four female figures drawn with yellow pastel. Three are standing, arms bent behind the neck; one is sitting, arms around her knees.

works.d: Suvise maastiku taustal kolm meest. Keskmisel seljas kollane lühike kuub ning peas sama värvi müts. Paremalt embab teda õlgadest, vööl lühikest mõõka kandev mees. Vasakul, küljega vaataja poole seisev noormees, hoidmas keskmise mehe vasakut kätt; pea kergelt langetatud. Kõigil üle parema õla loomanahad.
works.de: Three men against the background of a summer landscape. The middle one wears a short yellow coat and a cap of the same colour. On the right, a man embraces him by the shoulders, wearing a short sword at his belt. On the left, a young man standing sideways to the viewer, holding the middle man's left hand; his head slightly lowered. All of them have animal skins over their right shoulder.

works.d: Veekoguga maastiku taustal kolmest naisaktist kompositsioon. Esiplaanil diagonaalselt paigutatud kaks lamavat figuuri valgel linal. Eespool külili asendis selgvaates, käed kõverdatult pea juures. Tema vastas oleva naise pea toetub kätele. Tagapool vasakul käele toetuv istuv figuur. Maal etüüdilik, figuurid punakate piirjoontega markeeritud.
works.de: A composition of three female nudes against the background of a landscape with a body of water. In the foreground two reclining figures arranged diagonally on a white sheet. In front, a figure lying on her side in a lateral view, arms bent near the head. Opposite her, the woman's head rests on her hands. Behind, on the left, a seated figure leaning on her hand. The painting is sketch-like, the figures marked with reddish outlines.

works.d: Vanema naise pea otsevaates, helepruun valge kaelusega riietus. Tagapõhi pruun.
works.de: Head of an older woman in frontal view, light brown clothing with a white collar. Brown background.

works.d: Kuldsete sibulkuplitega kiriku taustal kolm meest hoiavad vene õigeusu risti. Vasakul kõrval keiser Konstantinus, paremal keisrinna Helena. Neist allpool vasakul ja paremal gruppidena pühamehed.
works.de: Against the background of a church with golden onion domes, three men hold a Russian Orthodox cross. On the left beside them Emperor Constantine, on the right Empress Helena. Below them, in groups on the left and right, holy men.

works.d: Keskel ülal istub Maarja. Allpool ringis kaksteist apostlit. All keskel tumepruunil taustal krooniga mehe poolfiguur, kes hoiab kätel linikut. Juurde kirjutatud Kosmos. Ülal keskel stiliseeritud päikesekiired.
works.de: At the top centre sits Mary. Below, in a circle, the twelve apostles. At the bottom centre, against a dark brown background, a half-figure of a man with a crown, holding a cloth in his hands. The word "Kosmos" is written next to it. At the top centre, stylised sun rays.

works.d: Uhke hoone taustal keskel seisab Kristus seljas rohekas mantel ning roosakas rüü. Tema kõrval vasakul poolkummargil punases riietuses mees küünitamas kätt Kristuse paljastatud külje poole. Kummalgi pool kõrval inimeste grupid.
works.de: Against the background of a magnificent building, Christ stands in the centre wearing a greenish mantle and a pinkish robe. Beside him on the left, a man in red clothing half-bent, reaching his hand towards Christ's bared side. Groups of people on either side.

works.d: Ikooni keskel õnnistamiseks tõstetud (oranta) kätega jumalaema istuv kolmveerand figuur. Pruunjas tume keep kapuutsiga langeb eest põlvedeni, tagumine osa ilmselt suurem, vooder roosakas, volditud. Laubal ning kummagi õla kohal asuvad kuldsed tärnid. Rinna kohal kaks sõõri, millede sees asub pühaku poolfiguur. Pühaku alusrõivas on roheline, keep - mantel oranz kullaga. Vasak käsi rinna kohal ristimärki tegemas, paremas hoiab kirjarulli. Jumalaema rüü ported kaunistatud väikeste pärljate täppidega ning kuldse mustriga. Alumine riie on aga sinine. Rüü mansetid kaunistatud kuldse musrtiga. Veidi sinist paistab ka näo juures kapuutsi servast (justkui turban vm. peakate). Nimbus Jumalaema pea ümb
works.de: In the centre of the icon, the Mother of God is seated as a three-quarter figure with hands raised in blessing (orans). A brownish dark cloak with a hood falls to the knees in front, the back part apparently larger, the lining pinkish, folded. Golden stars are located on the forehead and above each shoulder. Above the chest are two roundels, inside which is a half-figure of a saint. The saint's undergarment is green, the cloak-mantle orange with gold. The left hand above the chest is making the sign of the cross, the right hand holds a scroll. The borders of the Mother of God's robe are decorated with small pearl dots and a golden pattern. The lower garment, however, is blue. The cuffs of the robe are decorated with a golden pattern. A little blue is also visible near the face at the edge of the hood (as if a turban or other headdress). The nimbus around the Mother of God's head

works.d: Keskealise mehe rindportree otsevaates. Peas alla lastud kõrvadega pruun karusnahkne müts.
works.de: Frontal chest portrait of a middle-aged man. Brown fur hat with lowered ear flaps on his head.

works.d: Ovaali komponeeritud noore naise rinnaportree, pea pöördes paremale, pilk üle õla veidi küljele-alla suunatud. Naisel pehmed näojooned, tumedad silmad, sirge nina, kulmujoon. Keskelt lahkukammitud pikad lokilised ruuged juuksed langevad paljastatud õlgadele, juustes paremal erksavärvilised õied: edelveiss, moon, rukkilill rohelise oksaga. Ümber õlgade hele läbipaistev sall-rõivas. Summutatud pruunikad, hõbedased toonid, pehme akadeemiline kujutamisviis. Kuju sulandub fooni, valgus suunatud näole, õlale. Nikerdatud ovaalne puitraam.
works.de: A bust portrait of a young woman composed within an oval, the head turned to the right, the gaze directed slightly to the side and down, over the shoulder. The woman has soft facial features, dark eyes, a straight nose, an eyebrow line. Long curly reddish-blond hair, parted in the middle, falls onto her bared shoulders; in her hair, on the right, brightly coloured flowers: edelweiss, poppy, cornflower with a green twig. A light transparent scarf-garment is wrapped around her shoulders. Muted brownish, silvery tones, a soft academic manner of depiction. The figure blends into the background, the light directed onto the face and shoulder. Carved oval wooden frame.

works.d: Mehe rindportree poolprofiilis vasakule, silmad sinised, vurrud üleskeeratud otstega. Terav põskhabe.
works.de: Bust portrait of a man in half-profile to the left, blue eyes, moustache with upturned ends. Sharp goatee.

works.d: Vanema naise rinnapilt en face. Tume kleit valge äärisega kaelusel, tumedatel juustel pitstanu. Lõua all piklik rinnanõel.
works.de: Bust portrait of an older woman en face. Dark dress with a white-edged collar, a lace cap on dark hair. Below the chin an elongated brooch.

works.d: Valges rõivastuses istuv figuur. Vasak käsi tõstetud. Etüüd maalitud varasemale portreevisandile.
works.de: Seated figure in white clothing. Left arm raised. Study painted over an earlier portrait sketch.

works.d: Paremal esiplaanil maja tume siluett. Vasemal väike laik veepinda ja osa laeva mastist. Fragment.
works.de: In the right foreground the dark silhouette of a house. On the left a small patch of water surface and part of a ship's mast. Fragment.

works.d: Pildi vasakul poolel noore mehe pea (kuni õlgadeni), nägu piklik, lühikesed juuksed, ilme mõtlik. Pluusi kaelus ümarik, punases toonis. Foon hele, paremale jääb mäe siluett.
works.de: On the left side of the picture the head of a young man (down to the shoulders), an elongated face, short hair, a thoughtful expression. The blouse collar is rounded, in a red tone. The background is light, on the right the silhouette of a mountain.

works.d: Esiplaanil madal kruusane kallas. Paremal pildi sügavusse suunduv tee, keskel rühm kõrgeid puid; vasakul kääruline jõgi.
works.de: In the foreground a low gravelly bank. On the right a road leading into the depth of the picture, in the middle a group of tall trees; on the left a winding river.

works.d: Šarž kunstnikust: seisva mehe täisfiguur profiilis vasemale; töötamas enda ees seisval alusel oleva skulptuuri kallal.
works.de: Caricature of an artist: full figure of a standing man in profile to the left; working on a sculpture placed on a stand in front of him.

works.d: Ees paremal veekogu, keskel inimfiguur karjaga, vasakul ja tagaplaanil puud. Kavand.
works.de: In front on the right a body of water, in the centre a human figure with a herd, on the left and in the background trees. Sketch.

works.d: Šarž kunstnikust: mehe põlvpilt profiilis vasakule. Sabakuues. Vasak käsi taskus. Suus suitsev sigaret.
works.de: Caricature of the artist: half-length portrait of a man in profile to the left. In a tailcoat. Left hand in pocket. A smoking cigarette in his mouth.

works.d: Šarž kunstnikust: seisva mehe täisfiguur. vasakus kaenlas mapp. Ees paremal ristikheina õis.
works.de: Caricature of the artist: full figure of a standing man, a folder under his left arm. In front on the right a clover blossom.

works.d: Šarž kunstnikust: mehe täisfiguur, poolprofiilis vasemale. Vasakus käes palett, paremas pintsel.
works.de: Caricature of the artist: full figure of a man, in half-profile facing left. In his left hand a palette, in his right a brush.

works.d: Päikesepaistes halli plangu foonil istuv lillakasse kuube ja sonimütsi riietatud poisike (vaatab pildist välja). Tema ümber seisavad kolm kitse. Vasemal väike valge kitsetall, keskel hall kits ninaga poisi poole. Paremal suur valge kits vaatab ettepoole üle halli selja.(eesti)
works.de: In sunshine, against a grey fence background, a boy dressed in a purplish coat and a knitted cap sits (looking out of the picture). Around him stand three goats. On the left, a small white kid; in the middle, a grey goat with its nose towards the boy. On the right, a large white goat looks forward over a grey back.

works.d: Tumedajuukselise naise rinnapilt punases mantlis. Küünarnukkidele toetuvaile ristatud kätele toetuv pea pööratud kergelt vasemale. Taustaks ruuduline kangas.
works.de: Bust portrait of a dark-haired woman in a red coat. Her head, resting on crossed arms propped on the elbows, is turned slightly to the left. Checked fabric as background.

works.d: Eesti talumehe põlvportree - nägu kuivetunud, lühike hall lõuahabe, terane pilk paremale suunatud; peas pruunikas-karvane talvemüts; vasak käsi hoiab suu juures piipu; vöötatud tume vammus sulab tumedasse fooni. Käsi ja nägu valgustatud, heledaim laik tumedal maalil kitasa valge kaelarätt.
works.de: Portrait bust of an Estonian peasant man - a gaunt face, short grey stubble beard, sharp gaze directed to the right; a brownish, furry winter cap on the head; the left hand holds a pipe near the mouth; a striped dark tunic blends into the dark background. The hand and face are lit, the brightest spot on the dark painting being the white neckerchief.

works.dm: kõrgus: 53.0 cm (vm  ); laius: 72.0 cm (arm  ); laius: 71.0 cm (vm ); kõrgus: 54.7 cm (arm  )
works.d: Esiplaanil tahapoole suunduv tee, vasakul aed, mille taga raagus kased ja maja. Keskel tagapool okaspuid ja kaski. Paremal heinamaa, maja ja puid. Kauguses mets.
works.de: In the foreground a road leading into the distance, on the left a garden, behind which are bare birches and a house. In the middle, further back, conifers and birches. On the right a meadow, a house and trees. A forest in the distance.

works.d: Esiplaanil seisev mees, peas pruun läki-läki. Jalas pastlad. Käes rohelised käpikud, kaelas sall. Paremas käes kirves. Lumine väli. Taustaks tume lillakas taevas.
works.de: A man standing in the foreground, wearing a brown fur cap. Wearing bast shoes. Green mittens in his hands, a scarf around his neck. An axe in his right hand. A snowy field. Background of a dark purplish sky.

works.d: Esiplaanil kivihunnikul istuv roosas kleidis tütarlaps. Vasakul palkmaja nurk, taga metsa siluett. Taevas pilvine.
works.de: In the foreground, a girl in a pink dress sitting on a pile of stones. On the left, the corner of a log house, behind it the silhouette of a forest. The sky is cloudy.

works.d: Kaheksast seisvast ja istuvast talupojast koosnev figuraalne kompositsioon. Talupoegadel seljas valged särgid, hallid vammused ja sonid, kaabud või kõrvikud peas. Kõrtsiruumis laud, toolid ja kapp. Laual pudelid ja klaasid. Kõigi tegelaste elav huvi on koondunud vasakule kahe talupoja täringumängule. Mängivate talupoegade vahel lahtiste hõlmadega kuues, ülestõstetud parema käega talumees. Hallikaspruun värvigamma.
works.de: A figural composition consisting of eight standing and sitting peasants. The peasants wear white shirts, grey jackets and coats, hats or fur caps on their heads. In the tavern room a table, chairs and a cupboard. On the table bottles and glasses. The lively interest of all the characters is concentrated on the left, on the dice game of two peasants. Between the playing peasants a peasant man in an open coat, with his right hand raised. Greyish-brown colour scheme.

works.d: Geomeetriliste värvipindade taustal ning neist moodustatud ruumiliste kujundite vahel grupp viiest inimesest, kellest kolm väljuvad osaliselt kehaga pildiväljast. Paremas kuldlõikes ees punasesse riietatud neiu kehaga en face, pea profiilis paremale. Tema taga pildivälja tsentris paljastatud ülakehaga noormees, seljaga vaataja poole, pea "profil perdu" vasakule. Paremal pildiäärel keskel sinises seelikus ja rohelises varrukateta pluusis neiu, käed vaheliti rinna ees, parem küünarnukk toetatud abstraktsele barjäärile. Kompositsiooni ülemises vasakus nurgas noormees abstraktse kuubi taga, küünarnukiga sellel toetuva püstitõstetud vasema käsivarrega; vasak käsivars lebab samal kuubil. Vasakus a
works.de: Against a background of geometric colour surfaces and among the three-dimensional forms created by them, a group of five people, three of whom partly extend their bodies out of the picture field. In the right golden section, in front, a girl dressed in red, body en face, head in profile to the right. Behind her, in the centre of the picture field, a young man with a bared upper body, back to the viewer, head in "profil perdu" to the left. On the right edge of the picture, in the middle, a girl in a blue skirt and a green sleeveless blouse, arms crossed in front of her chest, right elbow resting on an abstract barrier. In the upper left corner of the composition, a young man behind an abstract cube, with his elbow resting on it and his raised left arm; the left arm lies on the same cube. On the left

works.d: Mehe rindportree tumedas palitus üleskeeratud kraega. Peas roheline kaabu. Vasakus kinnastatud käes jalutuskepp konksuga vastu õlga.
works.de: Bust portrait of a man in a dark coat with a turned-up collar. On his head a green hat. In his gloved left hand a walking stick with a hook resting against his shoulder.

works.d: Paremalt taha keskele suunduval teel kaks selgvaates inimkogu. Teest paremal künka kaldal väike majake ja lehtpuugrupp; vasakul rohtunud lagendikul üksikud kased. Taamal mets. Üle maastiku pilvine taevas.
works.de: On a path leading from the right to the back center, two clearly visible human figures. To the right of the path, on the slope of a hill, a small house and a group of deciduous trees; on the left, on a grassy clearing, solitary birches. In the distance a forest. Over the landscape a cloudy sky.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal veekogu, mille madalad kaldad kaetud koltunud muruga. Samas üksikuid sügisvärvides puid. Taamal mets.
works.de: In the foreground on the right a body of water, its low banks covered with yellowed grass. Also individual trees in autumn colours. In the distance a forest.

works.d: Ees veekogu vasemalt keskelt taha paremale ulatuva kalda ja männimetsa peegeldusega. Silmapiiril kaldajoon metsaga.
works.de: In front a body of water with the reflection of a shore and pine forest extending from left-centre back to the right. On the horizon a shoreline with forest.

works.d: Ees vasakul veekogu. Paremal lagendik üksikute hoonetega. Vasakul raagus puud.
works.de: In front on the left a body of water. On the right a clearing with individual buildings. On the left bare trees.

works.d: Esiplaanil rannik suurte kividega. Tagapool lainetav meri. Horisondil saare siluett.
works.de: In the foreground a coastline with large stones. Behind it a rippling sea. On the horizon the silhouette of an island.

works.d: Maali keskel suure puu all istub valgete juuste ja habemega punases pikas rüüs mees. Parem käsi sirutatud üles, vasak hoiab kannelt. Temast paremal inimhulk püsti ja istuvas asendis, vasakul jõe kaldal neljast inimesest koosnev grupp. Sellest grupist vasakul paadi kõrval üksik inimene istumas. Esiplaanil keskel selgvaates tütarlaps murul istumas, paremal seisab ema lapsega. Ema kohal profiilis ettepoole kallutatud, nägu pööratud vasakule. Pilk on suunatud tema külge klammerdunud lapsele.
works.de: In the centre of the painting, under a large tree, sits a man with white hair and beard, in a long red robe. His right hand is stretched upward, his left holds a kannel [Estonian zither]. To his right, a crowd of people standing and sitting, on the left, on the riverbank, a group of four people. To the left of this group, beside a boat, a single person sitting. In the foreground in the centre, seen frontally, a girl sitting on the grass, on the right stands a mother with a child. Above the mother, in profile, leaning forward, her face turned to the left. Her gaze is directed at the child clinging to her.

works.d: Esiplaanil rühm väikseid vanu puust onne. Onnide taga vasakul suurema maja pruun katus korstnaga. Tagaplaanil paremal roheline aas ja osa veekogust. Silmapiiril madalad metsaga kaetud kõrgendikud. Taevas sinakates - kollakates toonides.
works.de: In the foreground a group of small old wooden huts. Behind the huts on the left the brown roof of a larger house with a chimney. In the background on the right a green meadow and part of a body of water. On the horizon low forested elevations. Sky in bluish-yellowish tones.

works.d: Keskel tumesinises kleidis ja valges põlles vana naine, käed kokkupandult süles, pruunil nikerdatud toolil istumas. Hallid juuksed üle pea kammitud ja kuklal kinnitatud, õlgadele visatud tume jakk. Vasakul servas linaga kaetud, toekate jalgadega valge laud, millel rohelise servaga tass ja klaaspurk. Foon punane.
works.de: In the middle an old woman in a dark blue dress and a white apron, hands folded in her lap, sitting on a carved brown chair. Grey hair combed back over the head and fastened at the nape, a dark jacket thrown over the shoulders. On the left edge a white table covered with linen, with sturdy legs, on which a cup with a green rim and a glass jar. Background red.

works.d: Keset lehte paelaga kokkusõlmitud lilleoksad. Vasakpoolse õie kohal helesinine liblikas.
works.de: In the middle of the sheet flower branches tied together with a ribbon. Above the flower on the left a light blue butterfly.

works.t: a) Punase rätikuga naise portree; b) Tänavavaade
works.d: Heledal pruunikal foonil noorema naise rinnafiguur kerges pöördes paremale. Naisel peal punane rätik, mille alt paistab salk tumedaid juukseid. Riietatud tumedamais pruunides toonides.
works.de: On a light brownish background, the chest figure of a younger woman in a slight turn to the right. The woman wears a red kerchief, from under which a shock of dark hair shows. Dressed in darker brown tones.

works.d: Suurte lehtpuude taustal ümmargune peenar punaste lilledega, selle keskel lilledega täidetud aiavaas kõrgel alusel.
works.de: Against the backdrop of large deciduous trees, a round flowerbed with red flowers, in its centre a garden vase filled with flowers on a tall stand.

works.d: Lumises maastikus nõkku kogunenud lahtist vett. Vasakul raagus puud ja põõsad. Taga okaspuumets. Paremal avaneb puude vahelt vaade lumelagendikule. Taevas pilvine.
works.de: Open water gathered in a hollow in a snowy landscape. On the left, bare trees and bushes. Behind, a coniferous forest. On the right, a view opens between the trees onto a snowy clearing. Sky cloudy.

works.d: Neljakandiline, erinevate küljepikkustega pilt. Rohelisele foonile maalitud sinine nelinurk, mille parempoolsed nurgad on ära lõigatud.
works.de: A quadrangular picture with sides of different lengths. A blue quadrangle painted on a green background, whose right-hand corners are cut off.

works.d: Pruunides toonides figuraalne kompositsioon, mis koosneb vasakult paremale liikuvast meesteväest ja nendega koos kõndivast tähnilisest leopardist vasakul all. Leopardi vasak esikäpp üles tõstetud. Meestel seljas pruunid püksid ja kuued, esimesena sammuval mehel on kuub ruuduline. Kõigi astujate pilgud suunatud diagonaalselt üles. Vasakult foon tume, punaste laikudega; paremalt paistavad sinised madalad mäed ja hall taevas nende kohal.(eesti)
works.de: A figural composition in brown tones, consisting of a host of men moving from left to right, accompanied by a spotted leopard walking with them at the lower left. The leopard's left front paw is raised. The men wear brown trousers and coats; the man walking foremost has a checked coat. All the walkers' gazes are directed diagonally upward. On the left, the background is dark with red patches; on the right, low blue mountains and a grey sky above them are visible.

works.d: Tööst 1/3 maastiku, 2/3 taeva all. Mäeahelike vahelt, keskelt, näha kiriku torni ja suitsu. Vasakpoolse aheliku külg kaetud metsaga. Taevas äikesepilved. Paremal äärel sadav vihm.
works.de: The work is 1/3 landscape, under 2/3 sky. Between the mountain ranges, in the centre, a church tower and smoke are visible. The side of the left-hand range is covered with forest. Thunderclouds in the sky. On the right edge, falling rain.

works.d: Noore naise rinnapilt kerge pöördega paremale. Kõrvas kõrvarõngad, kaelas pärlikee; seljas punane sügavalt dekolteeritud kleit. Üle paljastatud õlgade õhuke sall.
works.de: Chest portrait of a young woman with a slight turn to the right. Earrings in her ears, a pearl necklace around her neck; wearing a red, deeply décolleté dress. A thin scarf over her bared shoulders.

works.t: Hedwig Alma de La Trobe portree
works.d: Noore naise rinnafiguur poolpöördes paremale. Seljas tume kleit, rinnas kimp margareetaõisi.
works.de: Bust figure of a young woman in half-turn to the right. Wearing a dark dress, a bunch of marguerite flowers on the chest.

works.d: Prillidega vana mehe istuv kolmveerandfiguur, pöördes paremale. Parem käsi lebab tooli käetoel, parem jalg tõstetud üle põlve. Peas must barett.
works.de: A sitting three-quarter figure of an old man with glasses, turned to the right. Right hand resting on the armrest of the chair, right leg raised over the knee. Black beret on his head.

works.d: Avatud uksel seisab poiss uisud paremal õlal. Vasakus käes kepp. Seljas tume palitu, pikad pruunid püksid. Peas kõrvadega talimüts, käes kindad.
works.de: A boy stands in an open doorway with skates on his right shoulder. A cane in his left hand. Wearing a dark coat, long brown trousers. On his head a winter hat with ear flaps, gloves in hand.

works.d: Kahel kolmandikul pildipinnast heledates toonides rohtunud liivakünkad. Nende taga, silmapiiril tume riba.
works.de: On two-thirds of the picture surface, light-toned grassy sand dunes. Behind them, on the horizon, a dark strip.

works.d: Üksikud valgustatud akendega tumedad ja punakad majad, keskel kolm krikutorni, paremal vabrikukorsten.
works.de: Individual dark and reddish houses with lit windows, in the middle three crane towers, at right a factory chimney.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 24.0 cm; lehe laius: 40.0 cm
works.d: Ees vasakul ja keskel kaljuseina ääres neli seisvat figuuri. Paremal lamav figuur, vaade veekogule. Üsna kalda lähedal purjelaev (ühemastiline paat).
works.de: In front, on the left and in the centre by a rock face, four standing figures. On the right a reclining figure, gazing at a body of water. Quite close to the shore a sailing ship (a single-masted boat).

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 16.3 cm; lehe laius: 10.4 cm
works.d: Ees keskel, valge samba taustal püssiga seisev figuur.
works.de: In the center foreground, a figure standing with a rifle against a white column.

works.dm: kujutise laius: 51.0 cm; lehe kõrgus: 40.7 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 36.0 cm; lehe laius: 54.0 cm
works.d: Ees keskel suurte puude all veekogu, mille paremal kaldal poolalasti kivil istuv naine; vasakul kükitav triton.
works.de: In front, in the middle, under large trees a body of water, on the right bank of which a half-naked woman sits on a stone; on the left a crouching triton.

works.dm: lehe laius: 43.5 cm; lehe kõrgus: 33.5 cm
works.d: Keskel ülestõusmine, külgedel stseenid "Simsonist ja Delilast".
works.de: In the centre the Resurrection, on the sides scenes from "Samson and Delilah".

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 23.5 cm; lehe laius: 34.3 cm
works.d: Vasakul, kitsal astmestikul istuv tume figuur. Tema ees profiilis seisev alasti naisfiguur.
works.de: On the left, a dark figure sitting on a narrow flight of steps. In front of it, a naked female figure standing in profile

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 21.5 cm; lehe laius: 41.8 cm
works.d: Diivanil lamava naise alasti täisfiguur. Nägu peidetud käsivarte vahele.
works.de: Full-length nude figure of a woman lying on a sofa. Face hidden between the arms.

works.d: Ees paremal laternaposti all inimgrupp. Tagapool vasakult paremale suunduva turuputkade rea ees inimsumm. Taga teater "Estonia" hoone tellingutega.
works.de: In front on the right, under a lamppost, a group of people. Behind, in front of a row of market stalls running from left to right, a throng of people. In the back, the "Estonia" theatre building with scaffolding.

works.d: Peaaegu abstrakteste värvilaikude kombinatsioonina antud värvilistest puudest ja kolletavast rohust koostatud sügismaastik. Paremal sügavhall, valgete ja roosade viirgudega taevas.
works.de: An autumn landscape composed of coloured trees and yellowing grass, given as an almost abstract combination of colour patches. On the right a deep grey sky with white and pink streaks.

works.d: Kaks rohekas-halli potti roosakate hortensiatega pruunil foonil.
works.de: Two greenish-grey pots with pinkish hydrangeas against a brown background.

works.d: Roosakaslillades ja tumerohelistes toonides metsamassiiv. Esiplaanil kollakasrohelise kuluga maapind, ülal valkjashall taevas. Maalitud pikemate, selgelt eristuvate pintslilöökidega.
works.de: A forest mass in pinkish-purple and dark green tones. In the foreground ground with yellowish-green dry grass, above a whitish-gray sky. Painted with longer, clearly distinguishable brushstrokes.

works.d: Esiplaanil noore jumeka tütarlapse põlvportree: pikad lahtised juuksed, vasak labakäsi toetab paremat käsivart - istub toolil ja loeb paksu raamatut. Paremal vaas mitmesuguste taimedega. Tütarlapse pea kohal aken, mis katab üle poole pildi pinnast ja sealt avaneb vaade Tallinna majadele, nii et keskele jääb Toompea torn. Maalitud kollakas-pruunis gammas.
works.de: In the foreground, a knee-length portrait of a young rosy-cheeked girl: long loose hair, her left hand supports her right forearm - she sits on a chair and reads a thick book. On the right a vase with various plants. Above the girl's head a window, which covers more than half of the picture surface, and from there opens a view of Tallinn's houses, so that Toompea Tower is in the centre. Painted in a yellowish-brown range.

works.d: Pastelsetes toonides kahefiguuriline kompositsioon suvise looduse taustal. Paremal esiplaanil profiilis, pea poolprofiilis vasemale istub maali keskel ees asetseva valge linaga kaetud väikese laua ääres peadligi liibuvate tumedate juustega, hingestatud tumedate silmadega, tundelise suuga poiss oranžis lühikeste käistega pluusis, käes vabalt laual, paremas käes roheline õun. Laual taldrik kahe õunaga, ees paremal punetav õun. Esiplaanil kompositsiooni vasakul äärel istub en face, kerges pöördes paremale pikkade vabalt langevate juustega lugev noor neiu siniseruudulises pikkade käistega pluusis ja beežides pikkades pükstes. Tagaplaanil lehtpuusalu, vasakul üksiku taljumajaga. Vasakus kuldlõike
works.de: A two-figure composition in pastel tones against a background of summer nature. In the foreground on the right, in profile, head in half profile to the left, sits a boy with dark hair closely framing his head, soulful dark eyes and a sensitive mouth, wearing an orange short-sleeved blouse, at a small table in the middle of the painting covered with a white cloth, his hand resting loosely on the table, a green apple in his right hand. On the table a plate with two apples, in front on the right a reddening apple. In the foreground, at the left edge of the composition, a young girl with long, loosely falling hair sits en face, slightly turned to the right, reading, wearing a blue-checked long-sleeved blouse and beige long trousers. In the background a grove of deciduous trees, on the left a single house with a hipped roof. In the left golden section

works.d: Sinise kleidi ja pikkade ruugete juustega istuva tüdruku kolmveerandfiguur otsevaates. Foon sinine.
works.de: Three-quarter figure of a seated girl in a blue dress with long auburn hair, front view. Blue background.

works.d: Poisikese kolmveerandfiguur en face toolil istumas, käed põlvede vahel. Seljas punakas kampsun ja roosa pluus, jalas rohelised püksid.
works.de: Three-quarter figure of a boy sitting on a chair en face, hands between his knees. Wearing a reddish sweater and a pink blouse, green trousers.

works.d: Lapse portree 3/4 pöördes vasakule. Tumedad juuksed, pruunid silmad, valge pluus.
works.de: Portrait of a child in 3/4 turn facing left. Dark hair, brown eyes, white blouse.

works.d: Paljufiguuriline kompositsioon, mille esiplaanil pruunis rüüs sõrmeni väljasirutatud vasaku käega küljetsi figuur, parem käsi all otsevaates mehe pealael. Alumise ja seisva figuuri taga mitu nägu. Foonil maastik punastest tellistest müüri, küngaste ja künkail asuvate kindlusemüüridega ülaservas. Taevas roosakaspunased pilved. Paremas ülanurgas leegid. Mitmes pruunis toonis üldkoloriit.(eesti)
works.de: Multi-figure composition, in the foreground a figure in a brown robe seen from the side with the left hand outstretched to finger's length, the right hand below in frontal view on a man's crown. Behind the lower and the standing figure several faces. In the background a landscape with a wall of red bricks, hills and fortress walls situated on hills at the upper edge. The sky with pinkish-red clouds. In the upper right corner flames. Overall colouring in several shades of brown.

works.d: Esiplaanil üleni kollane, mokahabeme, pikkade teravate otstega vurrude ja punaste silmadega mees üle õla vaataja poole vaatamas. Fooniks tühi tumepruun ruum, mille kaarjast väljapääsust paistab jupp maastikku. All vasakus nurgas lillakaspruun kolme punase triibu ja punase ovaaliga (silmaga?) kujund (olend?).(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground, an entirely yellow man with a moustache-beard, long sharp-tipped whiskers and red eyes, looking over his shoulder at the viewer. The background is an empty dark brown room, through whose arched exit a piece of landscape can be seen. In the lower left corner a purplish-brown shape (creature?) with three red stripes and a red oval (an eye?).

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 31.2 cm; lehe laius: 27.6 cm
works.d: Istuv alasti naisfiguur poolprofiilis vasakule, parem jalg üle vasaku. Ülakeha painutatud sügavalt ette.
works.de: A sitting female nude in half-profile to the left, right leg over the left. Upper body bent deeply forward.

works.d: Vanalinna tihedalt majadest ümbritsetud tagahoov: vasakul ja paremal madalad hallid majad, vasakul viib puutrepp katuse alla, parempoolse maja mitme ukse ja kõrge korstnaga alumine osa läheb üle kõrgemaks punase katuse, valgeks krohvitud seinte ja säärvatidega majaks. Tagaplaanil kolmekorruseline halli katusega ja pisut kõrgem punakaspruuni katusega maja. Viimase kangialusest paistab valgus. Paremal hoovinurgas väike puu, ülaservas tinahall taevas. Pastoosselt maalitud.
works.de: A backyard in the old town, densely surrounded by houses: on the left and right, low grey houses, on the left a wooden staircase leads under the roof, the lower part of the house on the right, with several doors and a tall chimney, turns into a taller building with a red roof, white-plastered walls and shutters. In the background, a three-storey house with a grey roof and a slightly taller house with a reddish-brown roof. From under the latter's gateway/passage light is showing. On the right, in the corner of the yard, a small tree, at the upper edge a tin-grey sky. Painted in a pastose manner.

works.d: Esiplaanil peegelsile jõgi, kallastel tihe võsa. Paremal kaldal kaks inimfiguuri.
works.de: In the foreground a mirror-smooth river, dense scrub on the banks. On the right bank two human figures.

works.d: Mustas, pikas kleidis naine istub peegli ees, seljaga vaataja poole. Peeglilaual vaas punaste lilledega.
works.de: A woman in a black, long dress sits in front of a mirror, her back to the viewer. On the dressing table a vase with red flowers.

works.d: Talvine vaade. Esiplaanil vasakul lillakas-sinine merelaht, paremal kollakas-valkjas rand. Tagaplaanil kollakas-valkjas tõusev rand, keskel sinajas mets, paremal tumeroheline mets. Taevas helesinise, kollakas-valkjate pilvedega.
works.de: Winter view. In the foreground on the left a purplish-blue sea bay, on the right a yellowish-whitish shore. In the background a yellowish-whitish rising shore, in the middle bluish forest, on the right dark green forest. Sky light blue, with yellowish-whitish clouds.

works.d: Pildi keskosas valge, kitsa raamiga piiratud ruumis kolm figuuri, kaks istuvad malelaua taga, kolma seisab. Pildi servades kahel pool malendeid meenutavad kujundid, allservas kaks liivakella, ülaservas raami kohal kroon.(eesti)
works.de: In the middle of the picture, in a space bordered by a narrow white frame, three figures, two seated at a chess table, a third standing. On both sides of the picture's edges, shapes resembling chess pieces, at the bottom two hourglasses, at the top above the frame a crown.

works.d: Paksu lumekihi all ees maapind, tajad taga, puud keskplaanil. Maalitud pastoosselt, laiade pintslilöökidega.
works.de: Ground in the foreground under a thick layer of snow, distance behind, trees in the middle ground. Painted pastosely, with broad brushstrokes.

works.d: Esiplaanil metsalagendik. Paremal ja taga tihe metsamüür.
works.de: In the foreground a forest clearing. On the right and behind a dense wall of forest.

works.d: Esiplaanil kolm suurt, tuulest sasitud kaske. Nende vahelt vasakult paistmas hoone nurk.
works.de: In the foreground three large birches tousled by the wind. Between them a corner of a building visible on the left.

works.d: Ees vasakul längus puule toetuv alasti naise figuur. Paremal profiilis istuv alasti mees figuur. Puu otsas madu.
works.de: In front on the left, a nude female figure leaning against a slanted tree. On the right a nude male figure sitting in profile. A snake at the top of the tree.

works.d: Lillaka maastiku kohal kollastel pilvedel kolm kihutavat ratsurit: kollane, punane ja tumehall.
works.de: Above a purplish landscape, on yellow clouds, three galloping riders: yellow, red and dark grey.

works.d: Esiplaanil vees kaks ebamäärast figuuri. Tagapool vasakul kaljurahnul, hobuse seljas alasti naise figuur.
works.de: In the foreground in the water two indistinct figures. Behind, on a rock on the left, a naked female figure on horseback.

works.d: Mere kohal, oranži-lillaka taeva foonil viis lendavat lindu.
works.de: Above the sea, against an orange-purplish sky, five flying birds.

works.d: Paremal roheline meri, vasakul taimkatteta punakad kaljud.
works.de: Green sea on the right, reddish rocks without vegetation on the left.

works.dm: kõrgus: 24.9 cm (vm.   ); lehe laius: 33.4 cm; laius: 27.6 cm (vm.); lehe kõrgus: 26.2 cm
works.d: Naise pea lamavas asendis, profiil vasakule.
works.de: Woman's head in a lying position, profile facing left.

works.d: Tumedajuukselise, rinnale langetatud peaga naise akt (poolfiguur). Keha en face, pea pöördega vasakule.
works.de: Nude of a dark-haired woman with head lowered to the chest (half-figure). Body en face, head turned to the left.

works.d: Tänavanurk. Esiplaanil oleval kollasel majal silt "Toiduained", vasakul hoovivärav.
works.de: A street corner. On the yellow house in the foreground a sign "Toiduained", on the left a courtyard gate.

works.d: Käänuliste teedega maastiku taustal tumedajuukselise keskealise mehe istuv kolmveerandfiguur, käed kokkupandult süles. Näos tugevad kortsud, seljas nahkjopp, mille läikivat materjali on edasi antud.(eesti)
works.de: Against the background of a landscape with winding roads, a sitting three-quarter figure of a dark-haired middle-aged man, hands clasped in his lap. Strong wrinkles on his face, wearing a leather jacket, the shiny material of which is rendered.

works.d: Kirjul foonil vaas kolme roosa gladiooli ja hulga gladioolilehtedega.(eesti)
works.de: On a patterned background a vase with three pink gladioli and a number of gladiolus leaves.

works.d: Lillas ja pruunis riietuses mehe ja naise figuur ühise nimbuse all. Foon nende taga punane.(eesti)
works.de: The figures of a man and a woman dressed in purple and brown under a shared halo. The background behind them red.

works.d: Vasakul tumedanahaliste ebamääraste inimfiguuride grupi keskel paremal istuvale tumedas rüüs mehele karikat ulatav naisakt.
works.de: On the left, in the middle of a group of vaguely rendered dark-skinned human figures, a female nude on the right hands a goblet to a man in a dark robe who is sitting.

works.d: Ees lamaval hülgel istuv naine, ülakeha paljastatud; ümber puusade ja jalgade punane loor. Taustaks meri.
works.de: In front, a woman sitting on a reclining seal, upper body exposed; a red veil around the hips and legs. Background of sea.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 63.0 cm; lehe laius: 40.8 cm
works.d: Seisva mehe alasti täisfiguur, nägu otsevaates, keha kerge pöördega paremale. Käed tõstetud üle pea.
works.de: Full figure of a standing nude man, face in frontal view, body slightly turned to the right. Arms raised above the head.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal põõsastikus üksik puu. Vasemal puude vahelt paistmas veekogu.
works.de: In the foreground on the right a single tree in shrubbery. On the left a body of water visible between trees.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal lagendik. Vasakul kiviaia taga puid. Taga serval ( ? ) karjavärav. Paremal puid.
works.de: Open ground in the foreground on the right. Trees behind a stone wall on the left. A cattle gate (?) at the back edge. Trees on the right.

works.d: Vees istuv naine otsevaates, lühikeses aluskleidis. Üle õlgade tuules lendlev supelmantel. Taustaks meri.
works.de: A woman sitting in the water, in frontal view, in a short undergarment. A bathing coat fluttering in the wind over her shoulders. Background of sea.

works.d: Ees paremal ettepoole madalduv valgendav lagendik. Vasakul tumeda taimkattega kolmnurkne ala, mida tagapool palistab kõrgetüveline männimets.
works.de: In the front right, a whitish clearing sloping forward. On the left, a triangular area with dark vegetation, bordered further back by a tall-trunked pine forest.

works.d: Naturalistlikult elusuuruses kahe noormehe kaardimängustseen. Paremapoolsel noorukil tumehall ülikond ja tumedad lühikesed juuksed, toetub parema käega lauale, vasaku käega, milles kaardid, aga tooli seljatoele. Vasakpoolne, mustas ülikonnas noormees, istub laua taga, vasak käsi üles tõestetud. Laual pakk mängukaarte ja metallraha. Foon ühtlaselt tume.
works.de: A naturalistic, life-size card-game scene with two young men. The young man on the right wears a dark grey suit and has dark short hair, leaning with his right hand on the table, with his left hand, in which he holds cards, on the back of a chair. The young man on the left, in a black suit, sits at the table, left hand raised. On the table a deck of playing cards and metal coins. The background is uniformly dark.

works.d: Säravoranzi taevaga künklik maastik. Ees ja vasakul kuusemets, keskel lillakais toonides lagendik, selle taga sinakasrohekais - kollakais toonides riba. (eesti)
works.de: A hilly landscape under a bright orange sky. In front and on the left a spruce forest, in the centre a clearing in lilac tones, behind it a strip in bluish-green – yellowish tones.

works.d: Tõmmu, tumedate juustega ning habemega ja valges särgis mehe rinnafiguur. Esiplaanil ja foonil lilled. Maalitud väga pastoosselt.(eesti)
works.de: Bust of a swarthy man with dark hair and beard, in a white shirt. Flowers in the foreground and background. Painted very pastosely.

works.d: Helesinises, kollaste, punaste ja lillade horisontaalviirgudega vees keskplaanil vasemast servast keskpaigani kahe teravatipulise koonilise võraga puuga (vasemal) lopsaka taimestikuga laid. Selle taga tagaplaanil paremas kuldlõikes teine laid. Pruunikas-punane taevas paremal kollakate, lillakate ja punaste pastoossete ristjoontega pilv. Faktuurne maalikäsitlus.(eesti)
works.de: In light blue water with yellow, red, and purple horizontal streaks, in the middle ground from the left edge to the middle, an islet with lush vegetation and a tree with a sharp-tipped conical crown (on the left), two such trees. Behind it in the background, in the right golden section, another islet. The brownish-red sky on the right with a cloud of yellowish, purplish, and red pastose cross-hatching. Textured painting technique.

works.d: Paremal servas kogu pildipinna suuruses rõhutatud kontuuriga maalitud mehefiguur. Vasakul veel neli mehefiguuri. Tagaplaanil auto ja meri. Maas suured teokarbid.(eesti)
works.de: On the right edge, a male figure painted with emphasised contour, the size of the entire picture surface. On the left, four more male figures. In the background a car and the sea. On the ground, large conch shells.

works.d: Kõrge kaljune kallas asulaga rannal tumesinise vee ääres.(eesti)
works.de: A high rocky shore with a settlement on the bank by dark blue water.

works.d: Hilissügisene maastik sompus ilmaga. Esiplaanil vasakule liikuv härjavanker vana naisega vankril. Härja ees kõnnib vana naine kepiga. Keskplaanil teivasaed kogu kompositsiooni laiuses peaaegu parema ääreni, selle lõpus paremal ühekorruseline hall majake; aia ees kaks raagus kaske. Aia taga avara lagendiku ess laiguti lund, silmapiiril vasemal ja paremal metsaviirg. Taevas hallides pilvedes, hohati sinetades.
works.de: A late-autumn landscape in gloomy weather. In the foreground an ox cart moving to the left with an old woman on the cart. In front of the ox an old woman walks with a stick. In the middle ground a pole fence spanning almost the whole width of the composition to near the right edge, at its end on the right a single-storey grey house; in front of the fence two bare birches. Behind the fence, in front of an open clearing, patches of snow, on the horizon left and right a strip of forest. The sky in grey clouds, here and there tinged blue.

works.d: Esiplaanil latt-tara, mille taga punases särgis vanem mees hobuse seljas ja seisev mees valges särgis lapsega süles. Keskplaanil hooneid ja üksikuid puid. Tagaplaanil mets.
works.de: In the foreground a plank fence, behind which an older man in a red shirt on horseback and a standing man in a white shirt with a child in his arms. In the middle ground buildings and single trees. In the background a forest.

works.d: Mehe rinnapilt, kolmveerand profiilis paremale; vurrude ja täishabemega.
works.de: Bust portrait of a man, in three-quarter profile to the right; with a moustache and full beard.

works.d: Paremal esiplaanilt taha suunduv tee, mis kahelt poolt ääristatud vanade raagus puudega. Maapind kaetud lumega, millel puude sinakad varjud.
works.de: On the right a path leading from the foreground to the back, bordered on both sides by old bare trees. The ground covered with snow, on which bluish shadows of the trees.

works.d: Alasti, pikkade, heledate lahtiste juustega noor naine kaljult vette lahkumas. Keha poolprofiilis vasemale. Pea pööratud paremale. Tema vastu sirutab mõlemad käed välja veekogust ilmuv vesineitsi. Paremal kaldajärsakul näha osaliselt nelja munka tõrvikute valguses, kelledest vasakul pool olev tõstab Lorelei suunas risti.
works.de: A naked young woman with long, light, loose hair is leaving the water from a cliff. Her body is in half-profile facing left. Her head is turned to the right. A water nymph emerging from the water stretches both arms out towards her. On the right, on the steep bank, four monks are partly visible in torchlight, of whom the one on the left raises a cross towards Lorelei.

works.d: Keskealise mehe pea, kerges pöördes vasemale. Pikad juuksed, valge püstkrae. Tume riietus.
works.de: Head of a middle-aged man, slightly turned to the left. Long hair, white stand-up collar. Dark clothing.

works.d: Mustajuukselise noore neiu rinnapilt profiilis, pöördega paremale. Kõrvas kõrvarõngad.
works.de: Bust portrait of a dark-haired young girl in profile, turned to the right. Earrings in her ears.

works.d: Keskaegne õu. Paremal müür. Vasakul aed puudega, taga keskaegse telliskivikatusega maja. Korstna kõrval redel.
works.de: A medieval courtyard. On the right a wall. On the left a garden with trees, behind it a house with a medieval tiled roof. A ladder by the chimney.

works.d: Mererannal vasakul hoone nurk ja paadid. Esiplaanil kitsas rannariba, millel võitlushoos talupojad punase lipu ja relvadega lahinguks valmistumas. Taevas pooleldi pilvedega kaetud.
works.de: On a sea shore, on the left the corner of a building and boats. In the foreground a narrow strip of shore, on which peasants in the heat of battle are preparing for combat with a red flag and weapons. The sky partly covered with clouds.

works.d: Valgeks maalitud puidust kapiuks, mille ülakolmandikus on veidi diagonaalne valge horisontaaljoon, mis ei ulatu kummastki otsast servani. Keskel, horisontaaljoone taga on ülalt alla, alt veidi vasakule diagonaalne laiem (u. 19 cm) valge joon, mille otsad samuti ei ulatu maali servadeni.
works.de: A cupboard door of wood painted white, in whose upper third there is a slightly diagonal white horizontal line that does not reach either edge. In the centre, behind the horizontal line, a wider (approx. 19 cm) white line running diagonally from top to bottom, slightly to the left at the bottom, whose ends likewise do not reach the edges of the painting.

works.d: Esiplaanil lagedal karjamaal vasakul kaal piimakaalujatega, paremalt paistab osa piimakärust. Tagapool arvukas punane kari, mitu naist lüpsmas. Kõik töötajad valgeis kitlites ja valgete pearättidega.
works.de: In the foreground on an open pasture, on the left a scale with milk-weighing equipment, on the right part of a milk cart is visible. Further back a numerous red herd, several women milking. All the workers in white smocks and white headscarves.

works.d: Linnavaade (Tallinna vanalinnast). Esiplaanil väravaga lõppev umbtänav. Paremal äärt piirav majanurk, keskel kivi ja pappkatusega maja. Nende üle paistvaid lehtpuid ja taamal taeva foonil teravaviiluline katus.
works.de: A city view (of Tallinn's Old Town). In the foreground, a dead-end street ending in a gate. On the right, the corner of a building bordering the edge, in the middle a house with a stone and cardboard roof. Above them, deciduous trees visible, and in the distance, a sharp-gabled roof against the sky.

works.d: Vasakult paremale taha suunduv tänav vanade madalate kivimajadega.
works.de: A street with old low stone houses receding from left to right.

works.d: Valdavalt sinistes-punastes toonides, osalt peenes pintslikirjas, osalt ühtlastest värvipindadest fantaasiamaastikku meenutav abstraktne kompositsioon. Tumedate sinakate pindade vahel, justkui punaka valgusega kaetud, pildi sügavuses helendav sõrestikuline ulmelinn.
works.de: An abstract composition, predominantly in blue-red tones, partly in fine brushwork, partly of even colour surfaces, resembling a fantasy landscape. Between dark bluish surfaces, as if covered by a reddish light, a glowing lattice-like futuristic city in the depth of the picture.

works.d: Mingisugusel astmel istuva vanema habemiku mehe figuur poolprofiilis vasakule, parem jalg tõstetud kõrgemale, kerge joonega märgitud astmele, selle põlvele toetub pead toetava parema käe küünarnukk. Vasak käsi süles. Mehe riietuseks karusest riidest hallid põlvpüksid, punakat tooni kuub ja punane vest, peakatteks laiaääreline, kirju paelaga kaunistatud kaabu.
works.de: The figure of an older bearded man sitting on some kind of step, in three-quarter profile to the left, right leg raised higher, marked with a light line on the step, on the knee of which rests the elbow of the right hand supporting the head. Left hand in his lap. The man's clothing consists of grey knee breeches of a furry fabric, a reddish coat and a red waistcoat, and a broad-brimmed hat decorated with a colourful ribbon as headgear.

works.d: Esiplaanil eest taha järve äärde suunduv tee kahe inimfiguuriga selgvaates. Kahel pool teed suured puud. Vastaskaldal põõstastiku ja veest tõusva udu läbi paistmas hoone kuppelkatus.
works.de: In the foreground a road leading from front to back toward a lake, with two human figures in clear view. Large trees on both sides of the road. On the opposite shore, through the bushes and mist rising from the water, the domed roof of a building is visible.

works.d: Sangprillidega, kolmveerandpöördes paremale, istuva noormehe poolfiguur, käed põlvedel, vasakus käes põlev pabeross. Põhitoon: karmiin, sinakas - hall.
works.de: Half-figure of a young man with dark glasses, seated in a three-quarter turn to the right, hands on his knees, in his left hand a burning cigarette. Main tone: carmine, bluish-grey.

works.d: Vasakul akna all laud ja tool. Samas vasakul nurgas voodi.(eesti)
works.de: On the left under the window a table and chair. In the same left corner a bed.

works.d: Esiplaanil jõekallas palgivirnadega. Tagapool vasakul müüri taga maju ja kirikutorne. Paremal üle puuplangu paistmas ühekordseid äärelinna maju ja paljude sibulakujuliste kuplitega tornidega kirik.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground a riverbank with piles of logs. Further back on the left, houses and church towers behind a wall. On the right, above a wooden fence, single-storey suburban houses and a church with towers of many onion-shaped domes can be seen.
