works.dm: kõrgus: 96.0 cm (vm   ); laius: 200.0 cm (arm); laius: 199.0 cm (vm   ); kõrgus: 97.0 cm (arm   )
works.d: Esiplaanil vasakule kihutavat kaks meeskondadega varustatud tanki, vasakul teeääres süttinud saksa tank. Tagaplaanil vahutavais laines lahesopp, millest vasemal kolletav mets. Tagaplaanil Tallinna siluett.
works.de: In the foreground two tanks equipped with crews racing to the left, on the left by the roadside a burning German tank. In the background a bay inlet in foaming waves, to the left of which a yellowing forest. In the background the silhouette of Tallinn.

works.d: Kaks tütarlast ja kolm noormeest neljanurgelise laua ümber seismas või istumas. Maalitud kollakais ja punakais toonides, vaid äärmisel parempoolsel noormehel on smaragdrohelised püksid.
works.de: Two girls and three young men standing or sitting around a four-cornered table. Painted in yellowish and reddish tones, only the young man on the far right has emerald green trousers.

works.d: Üle lihtsate pintslitõmmetega vihjamisi antud madala horisondiga maastiku, millel paremal aimata varemeid ja põõsapuhmast, laiub rünkpilvis taevas, kattes ca 85% pildipinnast.
works.de: Over a landscape with a low horizon, suggested by simple brush strokes, on the right ruins and a bush can be discerned, spreads a sky of cumulus clouds, covering about 85% of the picture surface.

works.d: Noore, tumedajuukselise, vurrudega mehe pea poolprofiilis vasakule. Ümber kaela näha valge kraeääris, altpoolt näha katmata krunti. Taust antud rohekas toonis, ebamääraselt kaarja piirjoonega.
works.de: Head of a young, dark-haired man with a moustache, in half-profile to the left. A white collar edge visible around the neck, uncovered ground visible from below. Background given in a greenish tone, with a vaguely arched outline.

works.d: Hallijuukselise, pika täishabeme ja sorakil vurrudega vanamehe pea poolprofiilis paremale, vaade suunatud üles.
works.de: Head of a grey-haired old man with a long full beard and unkempt moustache, in half-profile to the right, gaze directed upward.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul rahvariides istuv naisefiguur, pea pööratud paremale. Keskel võlvitud värava all seisev rahvariides naisefiguur, paremas käes sirp, vasak käsi toetub väravale. tagaplaanil näha heledalt valgustatud rukkipõld ja maastik kaugete metsadega.
works.de: In the foreground on the left a seated female figure in folk costume, head turned to the right. In the middle, under an arched gate, a standing female figure in folk costume, a sickle in her right hand, left hand resting on the gate. In the background a brightly lit rye field and a landscape with distant forests can be seen.

works.d: Esiplaanil diagonaalselt paremalt vasakule rannajoon. Kaldaäärses vees suured kivid. Vasakult paistev Tallinna panoraam. Merel laevad ja üksikud lendavad kajakad.
works.de: In the foreground a shoreline running diagonally from right to left. Large stones in the water by the shore. The panorama of Tallinn visible from the left. Ships at sea and scattered flying gulls.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 43.8 cm; lehe laius: 65.0 cm
works.d: Ees paremal rohtunud kaljuplatoo üksikute põõsaste ja puudega eespool, kahe hoone ja varemetega tagapool kaljujärsakutel. Vasakul ja taga mäed.
works.de: In the foreground on the right a grassy rocky plateau with sparse bushes and trees, further back two buildings and ruins on rocky cliffs. Mountains on the left and in the background.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 20.0 cm; lehe laius: 29.9 cm
works.d: Ees, keset lagendikku paremal oleva veekogu ääres kõrge kaljurahn. Lagendikulk hajutatult üksikuid hoonete gruppe. Tagaplaanil mäed.
works.de: In front, in the middle of a clearing, by a body of water on the right, a tall rock boulder. Scattered across the clearing, isolated groups of buildings. Mountains in the background.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 26.6 cm; lehe laius: 36.0 cm
works.d: Järsuseinalised kaljurahnud põõsastikuga parempoolses kaljulõhes.
works.de: Steep-walled rocky boulders with shrubbery in the crevice on the right.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 23.4 cm; lehe laius: 31.5 cm
works.d: Vaade alt üles lõhenenud kaljukaldale. Ülal servas näha rippumas üksikuid rohututte.
works.de: View from below upward at a cracked rocky bank. At the top edge solitary tufts of grass can be seen hanging.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul jõekallas laudadest teega ja puudega tagapool. Jõe keskel saareke puuga. Paremal kaldal puud ja künkal kaks mehefiguuri. Taga mets ja kirik.
works.de: In the foreground on the left a riverbank with a path of planks and trees further back. In the middle of the river a small island with a tree. On the right bank trees and on a hillock two male figures. Behind, forest and a church.

works.d: Taamal rida hooneid, kust väljub inimparv täites kogu pildi esiplaani.
works.de: In the distance a row of buildings, from which a crowd of people emerges, filling the entire foreground of the picture.

works.d: Pildi pind jaotatud vertikaalselt kaheks musta pinnaga, mida läbib pikuti hele triip. Vasakul sinise ning punase horisontaaljoonega lõhestatud roheline kvadraat; paremal ülal tumedast, rohelise ringiga lõppevast diagonaaljoonest läbistatud punane, all kollane nelinurk. Kogu töö pinnal kahes suuruses punased, mustad, kollased, sinised, rohelised ja pruunid ringid. Puhtad lokaaltoonid; ühtlane maalipind. Üldmulje dekoratiivne.
works.de: The surface of the picture is divided vertically into two black areas, through which a light stripe runs lengthwise. On the left a green quadrangle split by a blue and a red horizontal line; on the upper right a red quadrangle pierced by a dark diagonal line ending in a green circle, below a yellow quadrangle. Across the whole surface of the work, red, black, yellow, blue, green and brown circles in two sizes. Pure local tones; even paint surface. Overall impression decorative.

works.d: Kahel pool tänavat, mis suundub paremast servast maali sisse, madalad majad mändide all. Vasakpoolne telefonipost ristub tänavaga.
works.de: On both sides of a street that leads into the painting from the right edge, low houses under pine trees. The telephone pole on the left crosses the street.

works.d: Valdavalt soojades kollastes toonides pargivaade. Kollased teed ümbritsevad põõsaste ja raagus puude gruppe. Tagaplaanil tumepunased ja kollased roheliste katustega majad. Taevas kollane.
works.de: A park view predominantly in warm yellow tones. Yellow paths surround groups of bushes and bare trees. In the background dark red and yellow houses with green roofs. The sky yellow.

works.d: Toolil istuva valges särgis mehe portree poolpöördes vasakule, käed põlvedele toetatud. Foon tumepruun.
works.de: Portrait of a man in a white shirt sitting on a chair, in half-turn to the left, hands resting on his knees. Background dark brown.

works.d: Naivistlikult lahendatud erksatoonilise ojaga maastiku taustal keskaelise habeme ja vuntsidega mehe rinnaportree otsevaates. Mehel peas sügavpunane barett, seljas kollane särk.(eesti)
works.de: A naively rendered frontal bust portrait of a middle-aged man with a beard and moustache, against the background of a landscape with a brightly toned brook. The man wears a deep red beret on his head and a yellow shirt.(eesti)

works.d: Pruuni- ja ookrikarva ruudulisel väikesel laual kõrge, ülalt laienev klaasist vaas punaste, roosade ja kollaste roosidega. Kogu pildi ulatuses paistab hõreda värvikihi alt lõuend. Foon kaetud lillakaspunaste hõredate pintslilöökidega.
works.de: On a small brown and ochre chequered table a tall vase widening towards the top, of glass, with red, pink and yellow roses. Throughout the picture the canvas shows through the sparse layer of paint. The background covered with sparse brushstrokes of purplish-red.

works.d: Vitstest punutud korvis kolm leekivpunaste õitega mooni. Foon tume.
works.de: Three poppies with flaming red blossoms in a wicker basket. Dark background.

works.d: Pruunikal tähnilisel foonil pisut paremal tume, ümar, ajaga vaas, milles bukett neljast valgest roosiõiest.(eesti)
works.de: On a brownish speckled background, slightly to the right, a dark, round, antique vase with a bouquet of four white rose blossoms.

works.d: Vasakul, puude vahelt paistas taraga ümbritsetud madal kollase otsafassaadiga elumaja. Paremal majapidamishooned.
works.de: On the left, through the trees, a low dwelling house with a yellow gable front, surrounded by a fence, was visible. On the right, farm buildings.

works.t: Parun Edward III (Ned) James Archibald Percival von Ungern-Sternbergi portree
works.d: Noore mehe portree valgel hobusel pöördega paremale, kaardiväelase mundris, paljastatud mõõk õlal, taustaks mägimaastik linnustega.
works.de: Portrait of a young man on a white horse turned to the right, in a guardsman's uniform, a drawn sword on his shoulder, against a background of mountain landscape with birds.

works.d: Esiplaanil Neeva kai üksikute jalakäijate ja hobusõidukitega. Keskel, vasakult taha keskele suunduv (üle Neeva) valgustatud sild. Taga, vastaskaldal majad ja kirik.
works.de: In the foreground the Neva embankment with individual pedestrians and horse-drawn vehicles. In the middle, an illuminated bridge leading from the left to the back centre (across the Neva). Behind, on the opposite bank, houses and a church.

works.d: Hallikaspruunides ja rohelistes toonides suvine agulivaade sillutatamta tänavaga esiplaanil. Sellest vasakul üksteise külge ehitatud hallid agulimajad põõsastega seina ääres ja sinistest lippidest tara eraldamaks väikest aeda. Teest paremal põõsad, otse paar suuremat pruuni maja. Ülal, läbi hõrdeda roheluse paistev kollakashall taevas. Maalitud pastoosselt, kohati pintslivart või puupulka kasutades.
works.de: A summer suburban view in greyish-brown and green tones with an unpaved street in the foreground. To its left grey suburban houses built against one another with bushes along the wall and a fence of blue slats separating a small garden. To the right of the road bushes, directly behind them a couple of larger brown houses. Above, a yellowish-grey sky showing through sparse greenery. Painted pastosely, in places using the butt end of a brush or a wooden stick.

works.d: Esiplaanil lagendik. Tagapool vasakul mansardkatusega elamu, paremal rida hooneid üksikute puudega. Keskel ja paremal servas kuused.
works.de: In the foreground a clearing. Behind it, on the left, a dwelling with a mansard roof, on the right a row of buildings with individual trees. In the centre and on the right edge, spruce trees.

works.d: Esiplaanil rannariba seisvate figuuridega. Kaks keskset naiskuju valges rõivastuses, nende taga istub pruun koer. Vasakus servas, vees ratsanik hobusel. Silmapiiril tumeroheline metsaviirg. Maalitud hoogsate pintslilöökidega. Koloriit hele.
works.de: In the foreground a strip of beach with standing figures. Two central female figures in white clothing, behind them a brown dog sitting. On the left edge, in the water, a horseman on a horse. On the horizon a dark green strip of forest. Painted with vigorous brushstrokes. Colouring light.

works.d: Lillas turbanis üles suunatud pilguga noore naise rinnapilt. Tema ees laual anum, millest tõstab tangidega mitmesuguseid ebamäärase kujuga tükke.
works.de: Bust portrait of a young woman in a lilac turban, gaze directed upward. In front of her on the table a vessel from which she lifts various indeterminately shaped pieces with tongs.

works.d: Vasakul aia taga, sinise taeva taustal hele kirikuhoone. Paremas servas üksik mänd.
works.de: On the left behind a fence, against a blue sky background, a light-coloured church building. In the right edge a solitary pine.

works.d: Kolmefiguuriline grupp lahesoppide, jõesuudme, kanalitega ülaltvaates nähtud maastiku taustal. Ees keskel Maad sümboliseeriv alasti naise kolmveerandfiguur otsevaates, käed tema kõrval seisva kahe külgvaates noore mehe õlal, kaelal. Vasakpoolsel mehel pea püsti, käed vaheliti kõhul, parempoolsel pea langetatud, käed seljal. Figuuride lahendus tinglik. Peade kohal üksikute helenduvate pilvedega roosakas kumas taevas. Maalil ühtlaselt kahvatusinakas, helerohekas koloriit.
works.de: A three-figure group against the background of a landscape with bays, a river mouth, and canals seen from above. In front, in the centre, a three-quarter figure of a naked woman symbolising the Earth, seen frontally, her hands on the shoulder and neck of two young men standing beside her, seen in profile. The man on the left has his head upright, hands crossed on his stomach, the one on the right has his head lowered, hands behind his back. The treatment of the figures is conventional/stylised. Above the heads, a pinkish glowing sky with solitary luminous clouds. In the painting, a uniformly pale bluish, light greenish colouring.

works.d: Roosakas - punase linaga kaetud väikesel ümmargusel laual on kesksel kohal suur ümarik pruun vaas erkoranžide - kollaste saialilledega. Vaasist paremal kaks kollakas toonis karbikest, vasakul väike jalgadega hõbejas toos. Tagaplaanil pruunil seinal ripuvad kolm maali. Kahte alumist varjab peaaegu täielikult lillebukett, keskmine ülal kujutab valget hobust ratsanikuga. All paremas servas on suur rohelise polstriga tooli seljatugi ning näha veidi ka käetuge.
works.de: On a small round table covered with a pinkish-red cloth, a large round brown vase with bright orange-yellow marigolds occupies the central place. To the right of the vase two yellowish-toned little boxes, to the left a small silver footed container. In the background, on a brown wall, three paintings hang. The two lower ones are almost entirely hidden by the flower bouquet, the middle one above depicts a white horse with a rider. In the lower right corner, the backrest of a large chair with green upholstery is visible, along with a bit of the armrest.

works.d: Šarž kunstnikust: kujutatud kukena, mehe peaga profiilis vasakule. Rinnas lill.
works.de: Caricature of the artist: depicted as a rooster, with a man's head in profile facing left. A flower on the chest.

works.d: Istuvas, avaras rõivastuses naise kolmveerandfiguur kollakal - rohekal foonil. Teostatud vabas, skitseerivas laadis.
works.de: Three-quarter figure of a seated woman in loose clothing against a yellowish-greenish background. Executed in a free, sketch-like style.

works.d: All kaks habemikku mehenägu poolprofiilis paremale; ülal vasakul pruun käsi, paremal vasak käsi.
works.de: Below, two bearded men's faces in half-profile facing right; above, on the left a brown hand, on the right a left hand.

works.d: Tumeroheliste mändidega grupp lumisel lagendikul.
works.de: A group of dark green pines on a snowy clearing.

works.d: Esiplaanil lagendikul lambad ja lehm. Üle taevavõlvi vikerkaar.
works.de: In the foreground on a clearing sheep and a cow. A rainbow across the sky.

works.d: Kaks alasti naisratsurit. Vasem - punasel, parempoolne valgel hobusel. Hobused jalgupidi vees.
works.de: Two nude female riders. The left one on a red horse, the right one on a white horse. The horses standing in water up to their legs.

works.d: Esiplaanil lage rannaäärne heinamaa üksikute suuremate kividega esiplaanil ja siniste puudega silmapiiril. Vasakul meri, ülal suuremat osa pildist enda alla võttev tihedalt pilvedega kaetud taevas. Maalitud hõredalt, lõuendit alt paista lastes.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground, open coastal meadow with a few larger stones in the foreground and blue trees on the horizon. On the left, the sea, above, a densely cloud-covered sky taking up most of the picture. Painted sparsely, letting the canvas show through underneath.

works.d: Esiplaanil lage plats; tagapool puude rea taga nõmmistul üksikud figuurid. Taustaks kõrged kivihooned.
works.de: In the foreground an open square; behind, beyond a row of trees, individual figures on the heath. Background of tall stone buildings.

works.d: Esiplaanil kioskid ja materjalivirnad, keskel taastatav Estonia veokite ja inimfiguuridega ees; taamal vaade linnale.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground kiosks and stacks of materials, in the centre the Estonia [theatre] under restoration with trucks and human figures in front; in the distance a view of the city.

works.d: Tumesinisel veekogul neli paati sõitmas, vasakul kalda ääres kaks purjekat seismas. Esiplaanil vasakul purjekas kolme mehega. Keskel punane paadinina ja selle kohale kummarduva mehe pea roosa tuttmütsiga. Vasakul kollane paat naise ja mehega, kellel käes aerud.
works.de: Four boats sailing on a dark blue body of water, two sailboats standing on the shore on the left. In the foreground on the left a sailboat with three men. In the middle a red bow of a boat and above it the head of a man bending over, wearing a pink tufted cap. On the left a yellow boat with a woman and a man holding oars.

works.d: Rohelises kleidis naise põlveportree, käed süles, tumedad langevad juuksed (ülalt servaga lõigatud), punased pärlid kaelas.(eesti)
works.de: Knee-length portrait of a woman in a green dress, hands in her lap, dark falling hair (cropped at the top edge), red beads around her neck.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul kaljune rand üksiku kotkaga suurel rahnul, vasemal keskel ja tagaplaanil kaljud, paremal puude vahel hooned, taustaks pilvedesse ulatuvad mäed.
works.de: In the foreground on the left a rocky shore with a lone eagle on a large boulder, on the left in the middle and background cliffs, on the right buildings among trees, background of mountains reaching into the clouds.

works.d: Esiplaanil sinakasroheline merepind, taga pastoossete pintslilöökidega põgusalt markeeritud paadid ja sadamahooned. Ülaservas sinine, valgete kiudpilvedega kaetud taevas.
works.de: In the foreground, a bluish-green sea surface, behind it boats and harbour buildings briefly marked with pastose brushstrokes. In the upper edge, a blue sky covered with white fibrous clouds.

works.d: Nelja sambaga portikusega hoone puude vahel. Paremal taga osa punasest lameda katusega kivimajast.
works.de: A building with a four-column portico among trees. On the right behind, part of a red flat-roofed stone house.

works.d: Esiplaanil kaks naist valgete pearättikutega võrke parandamas. Tagapool vasakul paat, mille poole kaks meest minemas. Üks kannab midagi õlal, teine kaenla all. Taamal tumesinine meri valge purjekaga.
works.de: In the foreground two women with white headscarves mending nets. Further back on the left a boat, towards which two men are walking. One is carrying something on his shoulder, the other under his arm. In the distance a dark blue sea with a white sailboat.

works.d: Lahesopp kahe purjekaga külgvaates. Neist esimesel näha kaks inimfiguuri.Vasakul ees kitsas kaldariba, kaugemal pikalt merre ulatuv neemik, mille tagant paistab laevamaste.
works.de: A bay inlet with two sailboats in side view. On the first of them two human figures can be seen. On the left in the foreground a narrow strip of shore, further away a headland extending far into the sea, behind which a ship's masts appear.

works.d: Esiplaanil valge hobune kahe ahviga seljas. Paremal kloun punases kostüümis, vasakul haukuv koer. Tagaplaanil kaks pruuni hobust tagantvaates.
works.de: In the foreground a white horse with two monkeys on its back. On the right a clown in a red costume, on the left a barking dog. In the background two brown horses seen from behind.

works.d: Helehall veekogu paadisilla ja paatidega. Esiplaanil liivane kallas. Taamal kallas halli ribana.
works.de: A light-grey body of water with a boat landing and boats. In the foreground a sandy shore. In the distance the far bank as a grey strip.

works.d: Püstjuustega noormehe rindportree, 3/4 profiilis paremale, pilk vasakule suunatud. Seljas tume rõivas, rohelise kaelusega. Pruun taust.
works.de: Chest portrait of a young man with upright hair, in 3/4 profile to the right, gaze directed to the left. Wearing dark clothing with a green collar. Brown background.

works.d: Põskhabemega mehe poolfiguur poolprofiilis vasakule. Esindusmundris, narmasõlakutega, parem käsi vööl.
works.de: Half-figure of a bearded man in half-profile to the left. In formal uniform with braided epaulettes, right hand on his belt.

works.d: Esiplaanil kolm siga ja kaks põrsast aedikus põhkudel lamamas. Seaaia taga paistab kuuri sein väikese aknaga. Osa aedikust ja kuuri seinast päikesevarjus, osa heleda päikese käes. Eriti põhk pastoosselt maalitud. Hallikaspruun koloriit.
works.de: In the foreground three pigs and two piglets lying on straw in a pen. Behind the pig pen the wall of a shed with a small window is visible. Part of the pen and the shed wall in shadow, part in bright sunlight. The straw in particular painted pastosely. Greyish-brown colouring.

works.d: Realistlik varakevadine maastik pildi sügavusse suunduva ojaga esiplaanil paremal. Oja kallastel sulamata lumi, taamal paremal kaks hallikat talumaja. Oja mõlemal kaldal raagus puud, tammedel küljes mullusügisesed lehed. Silmapiiril vasakul väike tammik ja metsaviirg. Ülal selge sinine kevadine taevas.
works.de: A realistic early-spring landscape with a brook running into the depth of the picture in the foreground on the right. Unmelted snow on the banks of the brook, in the distance on the right two greyish farmhouses. On both banks of the brook, bare trees, the oaks still bearing last autumn's leaves. On the horizon on the left, a small oak grove and a strip of forest. Above, a clear blue spring sky.

works.d: Suure habemega mehe poolfiguur istuvas asendis poolpöördes paremale. Keha veidi tahapoole kallutatud. Toetudes istme seljatoele paremas käes pintsel, vasakus palett. Paremas servas üleval näha kuldraamis maali vasak serv.
works.de: Half-figure of a man with a large beard, seated, in half-turn to the right. Body leaning slightly backward. Leaning on the back of the seat, a brush in his right hand, a palette in his left. In the upper right corner the left edge of a painting in a gilt frame is visible.

works.d: Linnavaade Tallinna vanalinnast. Diagonaalis vasakult paremale kulgeval vasakul tänavapoolel kõrge terava otsaviilu ja gooti portaaliga kivimaja. Selle kõrval madalamad kivihooned.
works.de: A city view of Tallinn's Old Town. On the street side to the left, running diagonally from left to right, a stone house with a high pointed gable end and a Gothic portal. Next to it lower stone buildings.

works.d: Esiplaanil rohtunud rannaäär. Kaugemal kitsas mereriba kolme paadiga. Taevas kaetud pilvedag. All vasakus nurgas kiri: Hapba.
works.de: In the foreground a grassy shoreline. Further away a narrow strip of sea with three boats. The sky covered with clouds. In the lower left corner an inscription: Hapba.

works.d: Noore naise poolfiguur otsevaates, laps kätel. Naisel peas punane rätt, kõrvas kõrvarõngad, kaelas pärlikee. Heledajuukselisel lapsel (otsevaates( käes kaks viinamarjakobarat. Taustaks kahel pool asuvate lehtpuude vahelt paistev pilvine taevas.
works.de: Half-figure of a young woman in frontal view, a child in her arms. The woman wears a red kerchief on her head, earrings in her ears, a pearl necklace round her neck. The fair-haired child (in frontal view) holds two clusters of grapes in its hands. The background shows a cloudy sky visible between deciduous trees standing on either side.

works.dm: laius: 123.0 cm (osa II (reljeefi kõrgus 5 cm)); kõrgus: 210.0 cm; kõrgus: 210.0 cm; laius: 123.0 cm (osa I (reljeefi kõrgus 5 cm))
works.d: Kaheosaline ruumiline kompositsioon. Osaliselt kortsutatud ja rebitud kirevalt ülemaalitud paberiga kaetud alusele kinnitatud valdavalt pronksivärvi plastikplaadi tükke, metalliosi, sinise köie jupp jms. detaile esemetest. Kinnitatud materjal on alusele paigutatud astmeliselt: vasakul äärel all, horisontaalselt pinna keskel ja ülal paremal äärel.
works.de: A two-part spatial composition. Pieces of predominantly bronze-coloured plastic sheet, metal parts, a piece of blue rope and similar object details are attached to a base covered with partially crumpled and torn, colourfully overpainted paper. The attached material is arranged on the base in steps: at the bottom on the left edge, horizontally in the middle of the surface, and at the top on the right edge.

works.d: Pildi alumises servas patsiga naise rinnafiguur ning roheline vaas. Tagapool kolm mehe poolfiguuri. Tagumisel mehel suitsev piip suus. Koloriit summutatud, ülekaalus sinakad toonid.(eesti)
works.de: At the bottom edge of the picture the bust of a woman with a braid and a green vase. Behind, three half-length figures of men. The rearmost man has a smoking pipe in his mouth. The colour scheme is muted, bluish tones predominate.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasemal karjapoiss lammaste ja koeraga, keskel keerudes sügavusse suunatud teel rahvariides naine selgvaates, paremal nõmmemaastik üksikute põõsastega. Nende taga veekogu (järvesopp), mille vastaskaldal lehtpuude rühmi ja üksik taluhoone. Keskel vasemal üksikute tammede taga taluhooneid, nende kohal teel kaks meest. Taamal asuv mets liitub järve tagakaldal asuvate puuderühmadega. Taevas pilvine.
works.de: In the foreground on the left a shepherd boy with sheep and a dog, in the centre on a winding road leading into the depth a woman in folk costume seen in profile, on the right a heath landscape with solitary bushes. Behind them a body of water (a bay of a lake), on whose opposite shore groups of deciduous trees and a solitary farm building. In the centre left, behind solitary oaks, farm buildings, above them on the road two men. The forest in the distance merges with the groups of trees on the far shore of the lake. The sky is cloudy.

works.d: Äärelinna tänav nelja jalakäijaga. Keskel roosakates toonides kiviaiaga piiratud hoonetegrupp. Taevas päike.
works.de: A suburban street with four pedestrians. In the centre a group of buildings in pinkish tones enclosed by a stone wall. Sun in the sky.

works.d: Eest paremalt Z-kujuliselt heinamaade keskel taha keskele kulgev oja. Taga vasakul ja taamal paremal mets.
works.de: In the foreground, a stream running in a Z-shape from the right through the middle of the meadows toward the back center. Behind, on the left and in the distance on the right, forest.

works.d: Noore naise rinnapilt profiilis paremale. Seljas valge, pitsääristusega pluus ja rohekashall pihik, mille õlapael libisenud üle õla. Peakatteks valge rätt. Ehteks korallkõrvarõngad ja kaelakee.
works.de: Bust portrait of a young woman in profile facing right. Wearing a white lace-trimmed blouse and a greenish-grey bodice, the shoulder strap of which has slipped off the shoulder. Headwear a white kerchief. Jewellery consists of coral earrings and a necklace.

works.d: Naise poolfiguur otsevaates, õlgadele rippuvate juustega. Vasakul pott suureõielise lillega.
works.de: Half-figure of a woman in frontal view, with hair falling onto the shoulders. On the left a pot with a large-flowered plant.

works.d: Keskealise naise portree visand profiilis paremale. Brünettides juustes roosa ehe.
works.de: Sketch of a portrait of a middle-aged woman in profile to the right. A pink ornament in her brunette hair.

works.dm: laius: 65.7 cm (üle alusraami); kõrgus: 80.0 cm; kõrgus: 82.5 cm (üle alusraami); laius: 63.0 cm
works.d: Keskealise rokokoo parukas mehe poolfiguur 3/4 profiilis paremale, sinises punase vestiga mundrikuues, kaenlas kolmnurkne müts.(eesti)
works.de: Half-figure of a middle-aged man in a rococo wig, in 3/4 profile to the right, in a blue uniform coat with a red waistcoat, a tricorn hat under his arm.

works.dm: kõrgus: 52.0 cm (vm. ovaal); laius: 39.0 cm (vm. ovaal)
works.d: Noore naise rinnapilt poolprofiilis vasakule. Peas sinine turban, mille alt ulatuvad välja paksud seljale langevad punased juuksed.
works.de: Bust of a young woman in half-profile to the left. On the head a blue turban, from under which thick red hair falling onto the back emerges.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal jäme jändrik mustjas-pruun puutüvi. Puu taga väike lumine kallak hõreda raagus võsaga. Tagaplaanil keskel väike punaka katusega maja. Ülal erksinine taevas.
works.de: In the foreground on the right a thick, gnarled blackish-brown tree trunk. Behind the tree a small snowy slope with sparse bare scrub. In the background in the centre a small house with a reddish roof. Above, a bright blue sky.

works.d: Rohekashalli rätiga kaetud sinisel laual paremal pealtvaates valge taldrik kolme kalaga. Vasakul külgvaates roheline pudel. Maalitud üldistavalt, suurte pindadena.
works.de: On a blue table covered with a greenish-grey cloth, a white plate with three fish, seen from above on the right. On the left, a green bottle in side view. Painted in a generalized manner, in large areas.

works.d: Kollakasrohelistes, hallides ja punastes toonides abstraktne kompositsioon dünaamilises värvilaikude liikumises.
works.de: Abstract composition in yellowish-green, grey and red tones in a dynamic movement of colour patches.

works.d: Pika halli habemega tugitoolis istuva mehe kolmveerandfiguur, parem käsi põlvel, vasak hoiab prille rinna kohal. Tagaplaanil paremal musta-punase vöödliline drapereering.
works.de: A three-quarter figure of a man with a long grey beard sitting in an armchair, his right hand on his knee, his left holding glasses at chest level. In the background on the right, a black-and-red striped drapery.

works.d: Esiplaanil kitsa rohtunud kaldaribaga jõgi punases kuues sõudjatega keset vett asuvas paadis. Tagaplaanil kogu pildi laiust haarav kivist sild. Nelja võlvkaarega sillal üksik naisfiguur, taga paremal mets.
works.de: In the foreground a river with a narrow grassy strip of bank, with a boat in the middle of the water containing rowers in red coats. In the background a stone bridge spanning the full width of the picture. On the bridge, with four arches, a solitary female figure, a forest behind on the right.

works.d: Meri kaljurahnudega paremal. Keskel kaks purjelaeva. Taevas täiskuu.
works.de: The sea with rocky boulders on the right. In the middle two sailing ships. Full moon in the sky.

works.d: Vasakul pildipoolel kõrge künka jalam ülalpool suurte põõsaste, kahe väikese lehtpuu ja liivakivirahnuga. Tagaplaanil kaks lehtpuud ja silmapiiril paremal puudesalu. Helesinine taevas valgete ja hallide pilverüngastega. Künka jalam ulatub järsu, peaaegu püstloodis seinana esiplaanil diagonaalselt voolava madala kivise allikani, mis kaob varjuliste puude ja põõsaste vahele esiplaanil maali paremal poolel. Allikal küljega vaataja poole tütarlaps valges pluusis ja punases vestis, anumaga käes.
works.de: On the left side of the picture the foot of a high hill above large bushes, two small deciduous trees and a sandstone boulder. In the background two deciduous trees and a grove of trees on the horizon to the right. Light blue sky with white and grey cumulus clouds. The foot of the hill extends as a steep, almost vertical wall to a low stony stream flowing diagonally in the foreground, which disappears between shaded trees and bushes in the foreground on the right side of the painting. At the stream, in profile facing the viewer, a girl in a white blouse and red vest, holding a vessel.

works.d: Mustajuukselise, põskhabeme ja prillidega keskealise mehe poolfiguur kerge pöördega vasakule.
works.de: Half-figure of a middle-aged man with black hair, side-whiskers and glasses, slightly turned to the left.

works.d: Vaas valge sirelioksaga ja kollaste, punaste, roosade tulpidega valgel alusel. Samas vasakul kuldpruun kohvitass, paremal karp. Taust hele.
works.de: A vase with a white lilac branch and yellow, red, pink tulips on a white base. In the same scene, on the left a golden-brown coffee cup, on the right a box. The background is light.

works.d: Vurrude ja lõuahabemega keskealise mehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis pöördega vasakule, ninal prillid. Tume pintsak, valge tärgeldatud krae, must kaelaside.
works.de: Bust portrait of a middle-aged man with a moustache and chin beard, in half-profile turned to the left, glasses on his nose. Dark jacket, white starched collar, black necktie.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakule pöörduv linnatänav, kõnniteel inimesi. Keskel tänavaäärseid maju, tagaplaanil Olevimäe nõlvakul paremal linnamüüri torn ja rida maju, mille tagant paistab Oleviste kiriku torn.
works.de: In the foreground a city street turning to the left, people on the pavement. In the middle street-side houses, in the background on the slope of Oleviste Hill on the right a city wall tower and a row of houses, behind which the tower of St. Olaf's Church is visible.

works.d: Kahekorruseline, osaliselt mustaks, osaliselt kollaseks värvitud maja tänava ääres. Paremal tara taga raagus puud.
works.de: A two-storey house, painted partly black, partly yellow, by the roadside. On the right, bare trees behind a fence.

works.d: Laual, vasakul punutud korv siniste viinamarjadega, paremal lahtilõigatud arbuus. Vasakul, laua nurgal nuga.
works.de: On a table, on the left a woven basket with blue grapes, on the right a cut-open watermelon. A knife at the corner of the table on the left.

works.d: Eest taha suunudval kitsal rohtunud kaljuplatool sööv ja mäletsev kari. Paremal näha allapoole laskuval kaldal kasvavate puude latvu. Vasakul künkaline kaljukallas.
works.de: On a narrow grassy rocky plateau receding from front to back, a herd grazing and ruminating. On the right the treetops of trees growing on a bank descending downward are visible. On the left a hilly rocky bank.

works.d: Noore naise rinnapilt poolprofiilis vasemale. Peas sulega ääristatud kübar. Seljas kõrge kaelusega tumepunane kleit.
works.de: Chest portrait of a young woman in half-profile to the left. A feather-trimmed hat on her head. Wearing a high-collared dark red dress.

works.d: Esiplaanil meri, keskel suur purilaev, tagaplaanil rand laevade ja mägedega, pilvede vahel täiskuu.
works.de: In the foreground the sea, in the middle a large sailing ship, in the background a shore with ships and mountains, a full moon among the clouds.

works.d: Ees keskel, veekogu ääres kahe kõrge  (lõuendi alumisest servast ülemiseni ulatuva) kalju seina vahel vesi.
works.de: In the centre foreground, by a body of water, water between two tall cliff walls (reaching from the lower edge of the canvas to the upper).

works.d: Ees taha vasakule suunduv jõgi. Vasakul paat sõudjatega. Vastaskaldal pooldeldi vees põõsastikuriba, mille tagant tõuseb järsk kallas selle harjale viiva trepiga vasakul. Kaldaharjal kirik. Taga vasakul üksik kivihoone.
works.de: In front a river running back to the left. On the left a boat with rowers. On the opposite bank a strip of shrubbery half in the water, behind which rises a steep bank with steps leading up to its ridge on the left. On the ridge of the bank a church. Behind on the left a solitary stone building.

works.dm: laius: 59.8 cm (vm.   ); kõrgus: 69.7 cm; kõrgus: 69.2 cm (vm.   ); laius: 60.0 cm
works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul kõrge telliskivist majanurk, paremal madal kuuriehitis üle katuse ulatuvate lehtpuuokstega. Keskel üksikuid lehtpuid, taamal puitlaud-tarade taga näha majade katuseid.
works.de: In the foreground, on the left, the tall corner of a brick building, on the right a low shed structure with deciduous tree branches reaching over the roof. In the middle a few solitary deciduous trees, in the distance the roofs of houses behind wooden plank fences.

works.d: Vaade portjääriga uksest heledasti valgustatud ruumi, milles skulptuur postamendil.
works.de: View through a portièred door into a brightly lit room, in which a sculpture on a pedestal.

works.d: Paremal kaks aurikut ahtrist kaile rippuvate trossidega, teist mehed värvimas veepinnal, vasakul kai ääres mees, tagapool laevad ja suitsud heledal taeva foonil.(eesti)
works.de: On the right two steamers with ropes hanging from the stern to the quay, on one men painting at the waterline, on the left a man by the quay, further back ships and smoke against a light sky background.

works.d: Pruunides toonides foonil samas gammas maalitud noore naise poolfiguur veerandpöördes vasakule. Naise nägu ja kaelaosa heledasti valgustatud, silmad maha löödud. Naisel lühikesed, tumedad, potina lõigatud juuksed, seljas tume, suure kollase mustriga riidest kleit. Foon, kaela- ja peaosa maalitud pastoosselt.
works.de: Half-figure of a young woman painted in brown tones against a background in the same gamut, in a three-quarter turn to the left. The woman's face and neck brightly lit, eyes downcast. The woman has short, dark, pot-cut hair, wearing a dark dress of fabric with a large yellow pattern. The background, neck and head areas painted pastosely.

works.d: Esiplaanil kaljul kotkas kalaga, tagapool laht, paremal kaldariba hoonetega.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground on a cliff an eagle with a fish, further back a bay, on the right a strip of shore with buildings.

works.d: Kollane teetamm elektriliiniga, kaugemal majad ja kraanad.
works.de: Yellow road embankment with an electric line, houses and cranes further away.

works.d: Mägimaastiku taustal pikkade allarippuvate vurrudega keskealise paraadvormi riietatud mehe rinnapilt, pöördega kergelt vasakule. Mehel rinnas ja kaelas ordenid ja üle rinna lai punane kollase ääristusega ordeni pael.
works.de: Against the background of a mountain landscape, bust portrait of a middle-aged man with long drooping moustaches, wearing a parade uniform, turned slightly to the left. On the man's chest and around his neck orders, and across the chest a broad red order ribbon with a yellow border.

works.d: Kollakaspruunil alusel, mis katab maali alumise kolmandiku, asetsevad vasakus kuldlõikes kõrvits, millest väljalõigatud lõik asetseb paremal. Ees kaks virsikut. Kõrvitsalõigu taga paremal taldrik siniste ploomidega, osaliselt varrelehtedega, selle taga paremal kooniline pokaal punase veiniga. Taldriku ees kolm punast ploomi ja ploomioksake, mille leht ulatub üle lauaääre. Tagaplaanil vasakul pildiäärel sinine ploom varre ja lehtedega.
works.de: On a yellowish-brown base covering the lower third of the painting, in the left golden section lies a pumpkin, a cut-out piece of which is placed on the right. In front, two peaches. Behind the pumpkin piece on the right a plate with blue plums, partly with stems and leaves, behind it on the right a conical goblet with red wine. In front of the plate three red plums and a small plum branch, whose leaf extends over the edge of the table. In the background on the left edge of the picture a blue plum with stem and leaves.

works.d: Keskealise naise rinnaportree otsevaates. Tumedad juuksed, kitsad kulmukaared ja suu, lihav nina, lohkuvajunud põsed. Seljas tumeda kraega punane riietusese valge maniskiga, millel suured nööbid. Foon heleroheline.
works.de: Chest portrait of a middle-aged woman, frontal view. Dark hair, narrow eyebrow arches and mouth, fleshy nose, sunken cheeks. Wearing a red garment with a dark collar and a white cuff with large buttons. Background light green.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakult paremale suunduv rühm muistses relvastuses mehi, sõjakalt zhestikuleerimas. Paremal linnuse värav, mida osa mehi püüab lõhkuda. Tagapool keskel näha mehi müüri najale toetatud redelitelt ründamas müüril asuvaid ristirüütleid.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground, a group of men in ancient armament moving from left to right, gesturing belligerently. On the right, the gate of a fortress, which some of the men are trying to break down. Further back in the middle, men can be seen attacking, from ladders leaning against the wall, the crusader knights positioned on the wall.

works.d: Ees pesukorv diagonaalselt triikimislaua alla asetatud, selle taga naisfiguur laualt alla rippuvat lina triikimas; taga ripub lina ja paremal näha ahju nurk.
works.de: In front a laundry basket placed diagonally under the ironing board, behind it a female figure ironing a sheet hanging down from the board; behind, a sheet is hanging, and on the right the corner of a stove can be seen.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal madal rand sügiseselt kolletavate vahtrapuudega, mis kaarjalt haarab vasakult poolelt keskele ulatuvast lahesoppi üksiku, madalas kaldavees seisva lootsikuga. Tagapool järsult kõrgenev maastik, milles näha üksikuid hooneid (Tallinna Maarjamäe rajoon). Vasakul, silmapiiril, sinav Pirita rand.
works.de: In the foreground on the right a low shore with autumn-yellowing maple trees, curving from the left side to a bay inlet reaching to the centre, with a single boat standing in shallow shore water. Behind it a landscape rising steeply, in which single buildings are visible (the Maarjamäe district of Tallinn). On the left, on the horizon, the bluish Pirita beach.

works.d: Esiplaanil kaarjalt paremalt vasakule kulgev kivine liivarand, millelt keskel ulatub pinnalt merre paadisild. Selle taga kahemastiline kaljas. Paremal eemal merel liuglev purjekas, taga silmapiiril suitseva korstnaga aurik. Taga vasakul rannal kolm hoonet. Üle poole pildi pinnast haarab vasakul pool tumedais pilveis taevas.
works.de: In the foreground a curving stony sandy beach running from right to left, from which in the middle a boat pier extends from the shore into the sea. Behind it a two-masted galliot. Further away on the right a sailboat gliding on the sea, behind it on the horizon a steamer with smoking chimney. Behind on the left on the shore three buildings. Over half of the picture surface on the left is taken up by a sky in dark clouds.

works.d: Esiplaanil keskel eest taha suunduv veekogu, mille kaldail hõre mets. Metsa all lumelaike.
works.de: In the foreground, in the middle, a body of water receding into the distance, its shores lined with sparse forest. Patches of snow beneath the forest.

works.d: Ees vasakul veekogu, paremal ja taga metsad, keskel inimfiguur.
works.de: In front on the left a body of water, on the right and behind forests, in the centre a human figure.

works.d: Biedermeier rõivastuses vanema mehe poolfiguur poolprofiilis vasakule. Taustaks stiliseeritud lumised kuused.
works.de: Half-figure of an elderly man in Biedermeier attire, in half-profile to the left. Background of stylised snowy spruces.

works.d: Avar hallikas põld töötavate naistega. Esiplaanil kolm naist kõblastega vaataja suunas, vasakpoolne kummargil. Eemal vasakul figuure. Kollakashalli taeva all kauge silmapiir.
works.de: A broad greyish field with women working. In the foreground three women with hoes facing the viewer, the one on the left bent over. Figures in the distance on the left. A distant horizon under a yellowish-grey sky.

works.d: Punase lava taga seisev mees loeb ette üleskutset. Temast paremal istub laua taga nokkmütsiga mees ja kirjutab valgele paberile. Teda varjab osaliselt laua parema serva ääres seisev mees, kes vasaku käega nõjatub lauale. Seisva mehe paremat jalga varjab pink. Pingi taga näha kolme naist ja üks mees. Lauast vasakul pool 12 inimest osalt istudes, osalt seistes; kuulamas üleskutset. Nendest esiplaanil oleval pingil istuvad valge särgi ja talimütsiga mees ja punase rätikuga naine. Inimeste rühma tagant paistab aken. Akna ja värava vahel oleval seinal ripub plakat.
works.de: A man standing behind a red stage reads out an appeal. To his right a man wearing a peaked cap sits at a table and writes on a white sheet of paper. He is partly obscured by a man standing at the right edge of the table, leaning on the table with his left hand. The standing man's right leg is obscured by a bench. Behind the bench three women and one man can be seen. To the left of the table 12 people, some sitting, some standing, listening to the appeal. Of these, on the bench in the foreground sit a man in a white shirt and winter cap and a woman with a red kerchief. Behind the group of people a window can be seen. On the wall between the window and the gate hangs a poster.

works.d: Paremal ees leel kookudes rippuvad kaks pada, nende ees vasakul pingil istuv vanem naine käed põlvedel. Põhitoon pruun ja ooker.(eesti)
works.de: On the right in front, two pots hanging over the hearth being stirred, in front of them on the left an elderly woman sitting on a bench with her hands on her knees. Main tone brown and ochre.

works.d: Paremalt vasakule suundub rongkäik, taustaks paremal kindluse siluett, vasemal mets.(eesti)
works.de: A procession moves from right to left, with the silhouette of a fortress in the background on the right, forest on the left.

works.d: Hallipäise esindusliku välimusega mehe rinnaportree kerges pöördes paremale. Mehel pisut taandnud juustepiir, tihedad vuntsid ja väike kolmnurkne lõuahabe. Mehel seljas must pintsak, valge kõrge kraega särk ja must ristlips. Foon ühtlaselt tume.
works.de: Bust portrait of a gray-haired, distinguished-looking man, slightly turned to the right. The man has a somewhat receded hairline, a thick mustache and a small triangular chin beard. The man wears a black jacket, a white high-collared shirt and a black cross tie. The background uniformly dark.

works.d: Roosakassinise taeva all kollastes, kirsipounastes toonides lagendik puudega. Maalitud lühikeste, täppivate pintslilöökidega.(eesti)
works.de: Under a pinkish-blue sky, a clearing with trees in yellow, cherry-brown tones. Painted with short, dabbing brushstrokes.

works.d: Ülalt vaade ees avanevale mereäärsele. Põõsatuttide, roosade ja ookertoonides põldude vahel üksikud heledad majad. Tagapool sinetav meretriip kahvatu taeva all. Hoogne, laiade pintslitõmmetega maalilaad.
works.de: Aerial view of a seaside opening in front. Among clumps of bushes and pink and ochre-toned fields, scattered light-colored houses. Behind, a bluish stripe of sea beneath a pale sky. A vigorous painting style with broad brushstrokes.

works.d: Kirevalt visandlikult maalitud ülaltvaade vasakul asetsevale lahesopile. Esiplaanil ja paremal aimatavad puukroonid ja nõlvakud.
works.de: Colourfully sketch-like painted bird's-eye view of a bay located on the left. In the foreground and on the right, discernible tree crowns and slopes.

works.d: Kahkjates rohekates-hallides toonides kõrkjate vahel truubi valkjas sõõr. Esiplaanil tume, siniste-lillakate-roheliste refleksidega veepind ning määrdunud pruunikates-valkjates värvides, kohati musta kontuuriga rõhutatud risu joon. Kõrvuti graafiliselt peen ja vaba lai pintslilöök; sile ning kergelt faktuurne maalipind.
works.de: In pale greenish-grey tones, among sedges, a whitish disc of a culvert. In the foreground, a dark water surface with blue-purplish-green reflections and, in dirty brownish-whitish colours, a line of debris here and there accentuated with black contour. Fine graphic work alongside broad free brushstrokes side by side; a smooth and slightly textured paint surface.

works.d: Interjööris istuva keskealise mehe 4/5 figuur veerandpöördes vasakule, pea pööratud paremale. Mehel kõrge laup, sirge nina, pisut tõstetud kulmude vahel sügav korts. Vasak käsi toetub toolileenile, parem lauanurgale, millel vaasid, raamat, linoollõikenoad. Allpool asetseval laual hulk värvikate kaantega raamatuid. Mehel seljas laiade revääridega rohekashall kuub, jalas pruunikad püksid. Vasak jalg üle teise.
works.de: In an interior a 4/5 figure of a middle-aged man seated, turned three-quarters to the left, head turned to the right. The man has a high forehead, a straight nose, a deep furrow between slightly raised eyebrows. His left hand rests on the back of a chair, the right on the corner of a table on which there are vases, a book, linocut-cutting knives. On a lower table a number of books with colourful covers. The man wears a greenish-grey coat with wide lapels, brownish trousers. Left leg crossed over the other.

works.d: Tubases interjööris esiplaanil vasakul istuv mees otsevaates, seljas hele särk, tume vest. Paremas, süles olevas käes klaas. Põrnitseb altkulmu. Tema ees potilill. Tagapool paremal roosakas pükskostüümis naine istub sohval, jalg üle põlve, pea poolpöördes paremale. Maalitud lopsakate pintslilöökidega tumedais, lillakasmustjais toonides.
works.de: In an indoor interior, in the foreground on the left a man sits facing forward, wearing a light shirt and a dark waistcoat. In his right hand, resting in his lap, a glass. He stares from under his brows. In front of him a potted plant. Further back on the right a woman in a pinkish trouser suit sits on a sofa, one leg over the other, her head turned in half-profile to the right. Painted with lush brushstrokes in dark, purplish-blackish tones.

works.d: Vooremaa lainjas maastik. Paremalt lõikub sellesse kolnurkselt põõsaste - puude salu. Taevas kaetud raskete, madalate, sügishallide pilvedega.
works.de: The undulating landscape of Vooremaa. From the right a triangular grove of bushes and trees cuts into it. The sky is covered with heavy, low, autumn-grey clouds.

works.d: Lage maastik. Keskel, vastu sinist, pilvitut taevast, üksik mänd. Puust paremal ja vasakul põõsaste grupid. Silmapiiril kitsas veekogu viirg ja selle taga paistev metsajoon.
works.de: Open landscape. In the middle, against a blue, cloudless sky, a solitary pine. Groups of bushes to the right and left of the tree. On the horizon a narrow strip of water and beyond it a visible line of forest.

works.d: Tumedal künklikul maastikul esiplaanil vasakul valge hobune selgvaates, paremal viis lammast söömas. Tagaplaanil üksikud kivid, paremal jändrik mänd. Silmapiiril üksikud puud rünkpilvise taeva taustal. Maalitud täppivalt, pastoosselt.
works.de: On a dark hilly landscape, in the foreground on the left a white horse in profile, on the right five sheep grazing. In the background solitary stones, on the right a stunted pine. On the horizon solitary trees against a background of a cumulus-cloud sky. Painted in dabs, pastosely.

works.dm: kõrgus: 100.0 cm; laius: 96.0 cm; laius: 101.0 cm; kõrgus: 96.0 cm
works.d: Värvilistel ja mustrilistel draperiidel natüürmort: kõrge vaas tumesinise jala ja ülaosaga; vaas tugevalt paisuva keskosaga, sangad sissepoole pööratud; all taldrikul ja draperiil suured õunad.
works.de: A still life on colourful and patterned drapery: a tall vase with a dark blue foot and upper part; the vase with a strongly bulging middle section, the handles turned inward; below, on a plate and on the drapery, large apples.

works.d: Abstraktne ekspressiivne kompositsioon musta ja valge erinevaid tooninüanssides. Kahel teineteisele asetatud nelinurgal domineerib vasemas servas valge, paremas must. Keskosas roosa nelinurkne kujund, alumises paremas neljandikus kumab siin-seal sinist värvi. Kohati maalifaktuur pastoosne.
works.de: Abstract expressive composition in various tonal nuances of black and white. Of the two rectangles placed one against the other, white dominates the left edge, black the right. In the middle section a pink rectangular shape, in the lower right quarter blue colour shimmers here and there. In places the painting texture is impasto.

works.d: Vasakul lahtise uksega lambalauda nurk, uksel seisab halli jaki ja sinise rätiga naine külgvaates. Lauda otsas virn teibaid, päikselisel õuemurul regi. Paremal, karjaaia taga orus poolraagus lehtpuusalu, okste vahelt paistab eresinine taevas. Maalitud värvikalt, detaili jälgivalt.(eesti)
works.de: On the left the corner of a sheep barn with an open door, a woman in a grey jacket and blue kerchief stands by the door in profile. At the end of the barn a pile of poles, a sledge on the sunlit yard grass. On the right, beyond the pasture fence, a half-bare grove of deciduous trees in the valley, bright blue sky showing through the branches. Painted colourfully, attentive to detail.

works.d: Kompositsioon ülesehitatud kaarja ülaosaga väljale. Laia, diagonaalse pinnana läbib seda vahutav veevool. Ees, kaldal kaks jooksvat figuuri - lehvivate juuste ning rõivastega naine ja tema kannul mees, vasak käsi haardevalmilt ettesirutatud; parem mõõgaga peakohale tõstetud. Kaare kohal, ülemises vasakus ja paremas nurgas kaks kolba kujutist.
works.de: The composition is built on a field with an arched upper part. A wide, diagonal plane of foaming water flows through it. In front, on the shore, two running figures - a woman with flowing hair and garments and, following her, a man, his left hand outstretched ready to grasp; his right hand raised above his head with a sword. Above the arch, in the upper left and right corners, two depictions of flasks.

works.d: Mereäärsel kaldapealsel poollamavas asendis mees, keha katab loomanahk; parema käsivarre ümber kuldne võru. Punastes ja kollastes toonides leekiva taeva taustal hiigelsuur kotkas, pea pööratud paremale, mehe suunas.
works.de: On a seaside shore a man in a half-reclining position, his body covered with an animal hide; a golden band around his right forearm. Against the background of a blazing sky in red and yellow tones a huge eagle, its head turned to the right, towards the man.

works.t: a) Istuv tütarlaps; b) Rannal Visand
works.d: a) "Istuv tütarlaps" (lõpetamata).
works.de: a) "Seated girl" (unfinished).

works.d: Esiplaanil erksinine merepind, taamal vees peegelduvad sadamahooned, paadid ja kraanad. Ülaservas sinine, ekspressiivselt maalitud valgete pilvedega taevas. Kohati maalipind pastoosne, valdavalt sinistes, pruunides ja valgetes toonides.
works.de: In the foreground a bright blue sea surface, further away harbour buildings, boats and cranes reflected in the water. At the top edge a blue, expressively painted sky with white clouds. In places the paint surface is pastose, predominantly in blue, brown and white tones.

works.d: Kollastes-sinistes-lillakasroosades toonides vaade Pirita jõele ja selle kaldal ehitusjärgus olevale purjespordikeskusele. Kolme kraana vertikaalset rütmi kordavad paremal servas purjekate mastid. Taevas mere kohal kollane, ülaosas sinakam.(eesti)
works.de: A view in yellow-blue-lilac-pink tones of the Pirita River and, on its bank, a sailing sports centre under construction. The vertical rhythm of three cranes is echoed on the right edge by the masts of sailboats. The sky above the sea yellow, more bluish at the top.

works.d: Pildi sügavusse ahenev, 3-5 korruseliste majadega piiratud tänav. Siin-seal inimesed. All keskel, otsevaates mehe- ja naisefiguur. Ülal vasakul ning keskel paistab majade vahelt tükike sinist taevast.
works.de: A street narrowing into the depth of the picture, lined with 3-5 storey buildings. People here and there. At the bottom centre, a man's and a woman's figure seen frontally. At the top left and in the middle, a piece of blue sky is visible between the buildings.

works.d: Noore naise rinnaportree poolpöördes vasakule, pilk suunatud tema ees olevasse ovaalsesse peeglisse. Naisel peas barett, poolpikad lokkis juuksed seljal ja paremal põsel, mida kohendab mõlema käega. Seljas ovaalse dekolteega lühikeste käistega kleit. Maalitud punastes-pruunides ja ookertoonides.
works.de: Bust portrait of a young woman in half-turn to the left, her gaze directed into an oval mirror in front of her. The woman wears a beret, semi-long curly hair on her back and on her right cheek, which she is adjusting with both hands. She wears a dress with an oval décolleté and short sleeves. Painted in red-brown and ochre tones.

works.d: Esiplaanil, madala kai ääres vees paadid. Samast algab paarikorruseliste agulimajade rivi. Taevas kahvatu sinine. Üldkoloriit hele.
works.de: In the foreground, boats in the water by a low quay. From there begins a row of two-storey suburban houses. Pale blue sky. Overall light colouring.

works.d: Valge linaga kaetud ümmargune laud, millel tordid, puuviljad, lilled, taldrikud, veinikarahvin ja klaasid.
works.de: A round table covered with a white cloth, on which are cakes, fruit, flowers, plates, a wine decanter, and glasses.

works.d: Esiplaanil murul lapsed, vasakul põld ja talumajad, paremal kõrgendikul puud, taamal meri.
works.de: Children on the grass in the foreground, a field and farmhouses on the left, trees on a rise on the right, the sea beyond.

works.d: Esiplaanil bassein, mille tagaosast tõuseb astmeliselt fontäänide rida kuni tagaplaanil kõrgemal terrassil asetseva barokse lossini. Keskosas vasemal terrassiline pargimaastik, domineerivalt okaspuudega.
works.de: In the foreground a pool, from the rear of which a row of fountains rises in steps up to a baroque castle situated on a higher terrace in the background. In the central part on the left a terraced park landscape, dominated by conifers.

works.d: Paremal püstkatusega kalurionn, selle ees kõrge lipuvarras tuulelipuga. Onni ees seisab naine kahe lapsega (üks neist süles), veidi eespool kolm meest. Vasemal esiplaanil suured kivid palgiokstega, tagapool kividega palistatud rand, suured puud ja kalurionnid. Kaugemal Tallinna siluett - peamiselt Toompea ühes linnusega ning Tõnismägi (tuulikuga).
works.de: On the right, a fisherman's hut with a pitched roof, in front of it a tall flagpole with a weather vane. In front of the hut stands a woman with two children (one of them in her arms), a little further forward three men. In the left foreground, large stones with tree branches, behind them a shore lined with stones, tall trees and fishermen's huts. In the distance, the silhouette of Tallinn – mainly Toompea with a castle and Tõnismägi (with a windmill).

works.dm: lehe laius: 171.0 cm; kõrgus: 250.5 cm; lehe kõrgus: 257.0 cm; laius: 164.5 cm (arm.   )
works.d: Mehe täisfiguur peaaegu en face. Kõrges peakattes, mundris (valged püksid, roheline kuub), millel ordeneid ja rinnalint. Paremas käes kepp, vasem puusas. Üks-neljandik figuurist maastiku taustal.
works.de: Full figure of a man, almost en face. In a tall headdress, in uniform (white trousers, green coat) with orders and a sash. In his right hand a cane, left hand on his hip. One-quarter of the figure against a landscape background.

works.d: Otsevaates kompositsioon nelja figuuriga. Esiplaanil all keskel heledama koloriidiga maalitud tumedapäise naise rinnafiguur. Temast paremal - imik. Naise seljataga kolme seisva inimese poolfiguurid. Vasakul rohekas rõivas mees, keskel otsevaates oranžikas - pruunikais toonides riietusega naine, paremal äärel kollakas - rohekais rõivais naine. Kõigi kolme pilgud suunatud keskele alla. Keskel asuva naisfiguuri parem käsi tõstetud esiplaanil oleva naise pea kohale. Paremal seisja seljataga paistab punakais toonides vari. Esiplaanil oleva paljastatud õlgadega noore naise pea kerges pöördes paremale, suunatud imikule.
works.de: A composition in frontal view with four figures. In the lower foreground, centre, the bust of a dark-haired woman painted in a lighter colouring. To her right - an infant. Behind the woman, half-figures of three standing people. On the left a man in greenish clothing, in the centre, facing front, a woman dressed in orangish-brownish tones, on the right edge a woman in yellowish-greenish clothing. The gazes of all three are directed down towards the centre. The right hand of the woman in the centre is raised above the head of the woman in the foreground. Behind the person standing on the right, a shadow in reddish tones is visible. The head of the young woman with bared shoulders in the foreground is turned slightly to the right, directed towards the infant.

works.d: Keskplaanil Joakim ja Anna kummardumas paremale ning osundavad kätega nende ees seisvale väikesele Maarjale. Maarjast paremal seisab pjedestaalil Zahharias ning õnnistab Maarjat. Vasakul, Maarja vanematest veidi tagapool, hulk inimesi rohekates rõivastes ning punaste pealismantlitega. Kõige vasakpoolsemal käes põlev küünal. Taustaks arhitektuurielemente ning vasakul kõrgem tornjas maja. Paremas ülemises nurgas trooniv Maarja ingliga. Ikooni tonaalsus rohekas - pruunikas, rõivaste kaunistused, pühakute nimbused ja inglitiivad kuldsed.
works.de: In the middle ground Joachim and Anna bow to the right and point with their hands to the small Mary standing before them. To the right of Mary, Zacharias stands on a pedestal and blesses Mary. On the left, somewhat behind Mary's parents, a crowd of people in greenish garments with red outer mantles. The leftmost of them holds a burning candle. In the background architectural elements and, on the left, a taller tower-like house. In the upper right corner Mary enthroned with an angel. The tonality of the icon is greenish-brown, the decorations of the garments, the halos of the saints and the angel wings are golden.

works.dm: laius: 13.5 cm; paksus: 3.5 cm (raamat); kõrgus: 21.0 cm
works.d: Ruuduliste lehtedega raamat, musta emulsioonkattega kaanele maalitud habemes kühmus karikeerne kuju, ümbritsetud ristimärkidega.
works.de: A book with checkered pages, on the cover with a black emulsion coating painted a bearded hunched caricature-like figure, surrounded by cross marks.

works.d: Laeva lastimistöid kujutav olustikustseen. Esiplaanil kuus tööriietes ja sonides meest laevas kaupa tõstmas ja trosside külge kinnitamas. Lossitava laeva taga vasakul ja paremal suurte laevade ninad ja kai, millel kõnnivad inimesed. Taamal sadama laohooned. Hallides ja pruunides toonides. Kohati pastoosne faktuur.(eesti)
works.de: A genre scene depicting ship-loading work. In the foreground, six men in work clothes and sou'westers are lifting cargo on the ship and fastening it to ropes. Behind the ship being unloaded, at left and right, are the bows of large ships and a quay along which people are walking. In the distance, harbour warehouse buildings. In grey and brown tones. In places a pastose texture.

works.d: Kujutatud metsatalu põlemist. Keskel rookatusega hoone suitsus, sädemeid ja tulekuma ümberringi. Esiplaanil, keskmest paremal talumehe kolmveerandfiguur ähmi täis näoga, paokil suu. Tema ees metsaräga, kaks karjaaia posti tulest valgustatud.
works.de: Depicts the burning of a forest farmstead. In the middle, a thatched-roof building in smoke, sparks and a glow of fire all around. In the foreground, right of centre, a three-quarter figure of a farmer with a face full of alarm, mouth agape. In front of him a wattle fence, two pasture-fence posts lit by the fire.

works.d: Lõuendi tükk, mille paremas servas kujutis oranzist loojuvast päikesekettast, mille peegeldus veepinnal.
works.de: A piece of canvas, on the right edge of which a depiction of an orange setting sun disc, with its reflection on the water surface.

works.d: Šarž kunstnikust: kujutatud jooksva hobusena mehe peaga.
works.de: Caricature of the artist: depicted as a running horse with a man's head.

works.d: Esiplaanil maapinaale langev jändriku puu vari. Pildi keskel jändrik raagus puu. Maapinnal üksikuid lumelaike.
works.de: In the foreground the shadow of a gnarled tree falling on the ground. In the centre of the picture a gnarled bare tree. Solitary patches of snow on the ground.

works.d: Barokses tualetis ja -soengus noore naise poolfiguur poolprofiilis vasakule.
works.de: Half-figure of a young woman in baroque attire and hairstyle, in half-profile to the left.

works.d: Poollamava mehe akt pöördes paremale. Toetub käega punase draperiiga kaetud pingile. Vasak käsi tõstetud pea juurde.
works.de: Half-reclining male nude figure turned to the right. Leaning with hand on a bench covered with red drapery. Left hand raised to the head.

works.d: Laual suur pudel, kaks poolikut kõrvitsat, sibul, peet, kurk. Paremal sinine draperii, mis ulatub pudeli alla, vasakul pruunikas õhemalt maalitud riie. Foon helehall.(eesti)
works.de: On the table a large bottle, two halved pumpkins, an onion, a beet, a cucumber. On the right a blue drapery reaching under the bottle, on the left a brownish, more thinly painted cloth. Background light grey.

works.d: Laual kõrvits, apelsinid, korvpudel ja korv viinamarjadega.
works.de: A pumpkin, oranges, a wicker bottle and a basket with grapes on a table.

works.d: Keskel punase särgi, väikese lõuahabeme ning vuntsidega noore mehe rinnafiguur otsevaates. Rinna kõrgusele tõstetud käes hoiab raamatu taolist eset, millel kiri: GULI 7. Paremale jääb lilla pokaal ja pildi servaga äralõigatud inimfiguuri siluett. Vasakul osa õitsvast põõsast. Taust jaotatud sinakates, rohekates ja kollakates toonides pindadeks. Must raam.
works.de: In the centre, a bust of a young man in a red shirt with a small goatee and moustache, seen frontally. In a hand raised to chest height he holds a book-like object, on which is written: GULI 7. To the right is a purple goblet and the silhouette of a human figure cut off by the edge of the picture. On the left, part of a flowering bush. The background is divided into areas in bluish, greenish and yellowish tones. Black frame.

works.d: Kaks oranžides toonides maalitud naisakti - parempoolne lamab, vasakpoolne istub. Foon punakaskollane.
works.de: Two female nudes painted in orange tones - the one on the right lying down, the one on the left sitting. Background reddish-yellow.

works.d: Oranž-punaseis liibuvais rõivais, juukseid kammiva naise kolmveerandfiguur punasel foonil 3/4 pöördes vasakule.
works.de: Three-quarter figure of a woman in orange-red close-fitting clothes, combing her hair, against a red background, in a 3/4 turn to the left.

works.d: Vasakul punaste juuste ja erepunase suu, sirge pisut kongus nina ja mandlisilmadega naise pea. Naise ees tumedate krässus juustega ja suletud silmadega mehe pea. Pildi parem pool ja foon abstraktne värvilaikude kombinatsioon hallikasrohelises ja sinises värvigammas.
works.de: On the left a woman's head with red hair and a bright red mouth, a straight, slightly hooked nose and almond-shaped eyes. In front of the woman a man's head with dark curly hair and closed eyes. The right side of the picture and the background an abstract combination of colour patches in a greyish-green and blue colour range.

works.d: Taluõu, roheline ja liivane. Esiplaanil paremal palkhoone etteulatuva õlgkatusega. Tagaplaanil elumaja õlgkatusega. Ees kaks ruhnu rahvarõivais naist.
works.de: Farmyard, green and sandy. In the foreground on the right a log building with a projecting thatched roof. In the background a dwelling house with a thatched roof. In front, two women in Ruhnu folk costume.

works.dm: laius: 44.6 cm (arm   ); kõrgus: 35.7 cm; kõrgus: 35.3 cm (arm  ); laius: 44.8 cm
works.d: Looduses lõkke ümber tantsiv paar, nendest mõlemal pool istuvad grupid. Vasakul tagapool karjapasunast ja kandlemängijast grupp. Inimfiguurid kõik rahvariietes, naistel punased seelikud, mehed sinistes pükstes.
works.de: A couple dancing around a bonfire in nature, with seated groups on both sides. Behind on the left, a group with a shepherd's horn and a kannel player. All human figures are in folk costumes, the women in red skirts, the men in blue trousers.

works.dm: laius: 100.5 cm; kõrgus: 68.5 cm (arm   ); kõrgus: 53.0 cm; laius: 105.0 cm (arm)
works.d: Roosaka stiliseeritud jõemaastiku taustal paat kahe alasti meesfiguuriga. Üks juhib paati, teine hoiab suurt ambu laskevalmis. Nende vahel paadis mahalastud luiged.
works.de: Against the background of a pink stylised river landscape, a boat with two naked male figures. One is steering the boat, the other holding a large bow ready to shoot. Between them in the boat, shot-down swans.

works.dm: laius: 97.0 cm; kõrgus: 76.3 cm (arm   ); kõrgus: 76.5 cm; laius: 96.4 cm (arm   )
works.d: Varjus asuval esiplaanil suured lehtpuud. Nende vahelt paistab puude vahel asetsev ühekordne, väikeste akendega hoone, osaliselt heledas päikesevalguses.
works.de: Large deciduous trees in the shaded foreground. Between them a single-storey building with small windows is visible, situated among the trees, partly in bright sunlight.

works.d: Ees vasakul veekogu karjaga selle parempoolsel kaldal. Ümber lage maastik. Taga mets.
works.de: In front on the left a body of water with a herd on its right-hand bank. Open landscape around. Forest behind.

works.d: Eest keskelt taha paremale suunduv tee. Paremal müüre üle selle ulatuva lehtpuukrooniga. Vasakul ees väike veekogu (lomp). Selle taga park lehtpuudega.
works.de: A path leading from the front center to the back right. On the right, walls with a deciduous tree crown extending above them. In front on the left a small body of water (puddle). Behind it a park with deciduous trees.

works.d: Keset lõuendit kõrgete rohtunud kallaste vahel vasakult diagonaalselt paremale kulgev jõgi. Teiselpool jõge lehtpuu tukkade tagant näha okasmetsa tumedat ladvikut.
works.de: In the middle of the canvas, a river running diagonally from left to right between high grassy banks. On the other side of the river, the dark treetops of a coniferous forest are visible behind the crowns of deciduous trees.

works.dm: laius: 23.0 cm (arm.   ); kõrgus: 30.2 cm (vm.   ); kõrgus: 28.8 cm (arm.   ); laius: 23.7 cm (vm.  )
works.d: Mehe rinnapilt peapöördega vasakule. Käed vaheliti rinnal. Riietus: tsaristliku vene tumesinine, punasega ääristatud vormikuub narmasõlakutega. Rinnas rida ordeneid.
works.de: Bust portrait of a man with the head turned to the left. Hands crossed on the chest. Attire: a tsarist Russian dark blue uniform coat trimmed with red, with tasselled fastenings. On the chest a row of orders.

works.d: Madalal järil istuva mehe täisfiguur pooleldi selgvaates madala, raamatutega kaetud laua ääres. Vasakul tool paberitega. Laua ja tooli taga põrandal lõuendeid, paremal pudel. Koloriit rohekas-hall.
works.de: Full figure of a man sitting on a low stool, shown half-frontally, at a low table covered with books. On the left a chair with papers. Behind the table and chair on the floor canvases, on the right a bottle. The colouring is greenish-grey.

works.d: Esiplaanilt taha lookleva kiviaia taga grupp õlgkatusega taluhooneid palkidest. All ja paremal servas rohi üksikute kividega, külavahetee ja puu. Ülal hallikate pilvedega kaetud taevas.
works.de: Behind a winding stone wall running from the foreground into the distance, a group of thatched-roof farm buildings made of logs. Below and on the right edge, grass with scattered stones, a village road and a tree. Above, a sky covered with greyish clouds.

works.d: Alt must taust muutub ülasuunas sujuvalt halliks. Sellel sinisest, ülespoole järk-järgult heledamaks, valgeks muutuv ja ahenev patsitaoliselt põimitud kujund, milles nii lainjaid kui nurgelisi diagonaalsuunalisi pindu.
works.de: The black background at the bottom smoothly turns grey towards the top. On it a braid-like interwoven form, blue at first and gradually becoming lighter upwards, turning white and narrowing, containing both wavy and angular diagonal surfaces.

works.d: Punaste õitega suvinelgi oks.
works.de: Branch of summer carnation with red flowers.

works.d: Ülal vasakul oks valge sõstra kobaratega, punase sõstra kobar ja kaks karusmarja. Keskel redis koos lehtedega. Paremal pohla oks, all virsik.
works.de: At the top left a branch with clusters of white currants, a cluster of red currants and two gooseberries. In the middle a radish with leaves. On the right a lingonberry branch, a peach below.

works.d: Poolpikkade juustega noormehe rinnaportree poolpöördes vasakule, käed ees tõstetud palveks. Seljas punase-kollase ornamendiga rüü, põimitud võrk kaeluses, merekarpidega kaunistus rinnal, õlgadel. Noormehe pea tagant rohelist draperiid kujutav osa, tema ees osa loodusmotiividega.
works.de: A bust portrait of a young man with shoulder-length hair, turned three-quarters to the left, hands raised in front of him in prayer. He wears a robe with a red-and-yellow ornament, a woven net at the neckline, decoration with sea shells on the chest and shoulders. Behind the young man's head a part depicting a green drapery, in front of him a part with nature motifs.

works.d: Samblaroheline lage maastik. Esiplaanil vasakul torni varemed, paremal osa müürist lillakashalli mäeaheliku taustal. Silmapiiril vasakul lumiste mägede tipud. Kõrge selge taevas, hommikupäikese kollakas kuma mägede piiril ja müürijuppidel.
works.de: A moss-green bare landscape. In the foreground on the left ruins of a tower, on the right part of a wall against the background of a purplish-grey mountain range. On the horizon on the left snowy mountain peaks. A high clear sky, the yellowish glow of the morning sun on the edge of the mountains and on the pieces of wall.

works.d: Allservas siniseks värvitud väikestest mänguasjadest (rattad, kõrinad, kuubikud, nukud, autod, liivavormid jne.) koostatud kompositsioon. Sellest kõrgemale on maalitud tume koobaltsinine meri, roosalt õhetav silmapiir ja sinakate lammaspilvedega kaetud taevas.(eesti)
works.de: In the lower part a composition made of small toys (wheels, rattles, cubes, dolls, cars, sand moulds etc.) painted blue. Above it a dark cobalt-blue sea is painted, a pinkish glowing horizon, and a sky covered with bluish fleecy clouds.

works.d: Siksakiliste ja kaarjate servadega, musta ja valge ühtlase kontuuriga ümbritsetud pinnalised, üksteisega haakuvad värvilised kujundid. Vasakul ülalt alla järjestades kollane, heleroheline, helehall, punane, paremal roosa, must, tumeroheline, helekollane, tumesinine pind. Nende vahel-peal astmeliselt paigutatud musta kontuuriga valge kujund.
works.de: Zigzag and curved-edged, flat, interlocking coloured shapes surrounded by an even black and white outline. From top to bottom on the left, in order: yellow, light green, light grey, red; on the right pink, black, dark green, light yellow, dark blue surface. Between and above them, arranged in steps, a white shape with a black outline.

works.d: Valgete ja mustade kontuurjoontega geomeetriliste kujundite mosaiigiks jaotatud maalipind. Keskel kollane, roheliste joontega jaotatud värvilaik, millest aimub naisakt. Sellest ülalpool sinisevalgetriibuline, all valge, paremal punane ning vasakul - alt ülespoole liikudes vastavalt pruun, sinine, must, roheline ja kollane pind.
works.de: A painting surface divided into a mosaic of geometric shapes with white and black contour lines. In the centre, a yellow colour patch divided by green lines, from which a female nude can be discerned. Above it a blue-and-white striped area, below white, on the right red, and on the left, moving from bottom to top respectively, brown, blue, black, green and yellow surfaces.

works.d: Kaks õitsvat ja marjadega (viljadega) kartulikasvu oksa.
works.de: Two flowering potato plant branches with berries (fruits).

works.dm: laius: 13.5 cm (km.   ); kõrgus: 17.8 cm (lm.   ); kõrgus: 12.7 cm (km.   ); laius: 20.6 cm (lm.   )
works.d: Ringi kujutatud stiliseeritud puude keskel inimfiguur. Taevas suur päike ja loomad.
works.de: In the middle of stylized trees depicted in a circle, a human figure. In the sky a large sun and animals.

works.d: Vaade ülalt Tallinna vanalinna majade katustele. Erinevat värvi katused põimuvad keerulisteks pinnastruktuurideks. Tagaplaanis puudegrupp keset maju ja kirikuid. Domineerivad tugevad sinised ja tumepunased toonid.(eesti)
works.de: A view from above of the rooftops of houses in Tallinn's Old Town. Roofs of different colours interweave into complex surface structures. In the background a group of trees amid the houses and churches. Strong blue and dark red tones dominate.

works.d: Taraga piiratud kollane elumaja ja majapidamishooned. Õuel paremal raagus puu.
works.de: A yellow dwelling house and farm buildings enclosed by a fence. In the yard on the right a bare tree.

works.d: Nurk sinise seina ja punase põrandaga ruumist. Esiplaanil ümmargune laud, millel suur kupliga lamp, ja kaks tugitooli. Seintel maale.
works.de: A corner of a room with a blue wall and a red floor. In the foreground a round table with a large domed lamp, and two armchairs. Paintings on the walls.

works.d: Tänav madalate majadega. Vasakul mõned suured puud ja inimfiguurid. Kauguses paistab puude vahelt kirikutorn.
works.de: A street with low houses. On the left some large trees and human figures. In the distance, a church tower can be seen through the trees.

works.d: Tagaplaanil kaks tumepruuni puumaja. Nende ees õuel kaks hobust regedega: vasakul tumedas varjupoolses osas pruun hobune, paremal päikesepaistes helekollane hobune. Majade katustel ja parempoolse maja juures pisut lund. Paremal kaks puud. Taustaks soojalt kumav sinine.
works.de: In the background, two dark brown wooden houses. In front of them in the yard, two horses with sledges: on the left, in the dark, shaded area, a brown horse, on the right, in sunshine, a light yellow horse. A little snow on the roofs of the houses and near the house on the right. On the right, two trees. The background a warmly glowing blue.

works.d: Sauna interjöör. Paremal pink kibuga, vasakul ahi ja avatud uks. Keskel lava.
works.de: Interior of a sauna. On the right a bench with a bucket, on the left a stove and an open door. A platform in the middle.

works.d: Esiplaanil kõverate tüvidega lehtpuud, mille vahelt paistab lagendik. Tagaplaanil sinetab mets.
works.de: In the foreground deciduous trees with crooked trunks, between which a clearing is visible. In the background a bluish forest.

works.d: Esiplaanil tahapoole nõjatuv seisev naisakt, parem käsi ülestõstetult kukalt toetamas, nägu välja maalimata. Pehmetes toon-toonile üleminekutes maalitud figuuri taustaks tumedad hallid, pruunid ja mustad seina- ning põrandapinnad.
works.de: In the foreground, a standing female nude leaning backward, right hand raised supporting the back of the head, face left unpainted. The figure painted in soft tone-on-tone transitions, against a background of dark grey, brown and black wall and floor surfaces.

works.d: Vaade tehase õuele. All viis inimest sammumas vasakult paremale, ülal lahtisel platvormil rühm inimesi suundumas vasakul asuva trepi poole.
works.de: View of a factory yard. Below, five people walking from left to right; above, on an open platform, a group of people heading towards a staircase on the left.

works.d: Vana suitsutare sisevaade. Paremal pingil istuv naine, vasakul leease rippuva pajaga, pakk ja luud.
works.de: Interior view of an old smoke sauna cottage. On the right a woman sitting on a bench, on the left a pot hanging on a crane, a bundle and a broom.

works.d: Esiplaanil keskel kulgevast tänavast kahel pool majad: paremal tihedalt paiknevate väikeste akendega hall maja kangialusega, vasakul punane väikeste harvade akendega maja. Keskel hele, punakaspruunide katustega maja, mille üks osa kasvab korruste kaupa kõrgemaks, igal järgul on oma katus. Ülal jupike hallikassinist taevast pastoosselt antud valgete pilvedega. Hallikas ja punakaspruun üldkoloriit.
works.de: In the foreground centre, a street runs with houses on both sides: on the right a grey house with densely placed small windows and an arcade underneath, on the left a red house with sparse small windows. In the centre a light-coloured house with reddish-brown roofs, one part of which grows taller storey by storey, each level having its own roof. Above, a patch of greyish-blue sky given pastosely with white clouds. The overall colour scheme is greyish and reddish-brown.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 31.5 cm; lehe laius: 29.5 cm
works.d: Vasakul jõekaldal istub üks naisakt, teine lamab. Paremal jõgi.
works.de: On the left riverbank sits one female nude, the other is lying down. On the right, a river.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 22.9 cm; lehe laius: 34.1 cm
works.d: Ees vasemal veekogu. Paremal järsuseinaline kaljuahelik. Taga vasakul mäed.
works.de: In front on the left a body of water. On the right a steep-walled rock chain. Behind on the left mountains.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 37.0 cm; lehe laius: 25.8 cm
works.d: Interjööri-vaade piki sammaskäiku. Ees vasakul kaks seisvat, sammaskäigu lõpul olevat inimgruppi ja üles tõusvat suitsu jälgivat figuuri.
works.de: Interior view along a colonnade. In front on the left two standing figures, and at the end of the colonnade a group of people and a figure watching rising smoke.

works.dm: lehe laius: 25.8 cm; lehe kõrgus: 34.5 cm
works.d: Ees väikesel künkal suure puu all naisakt peaaegu en face. Vasakul õla juurde tõstetud käel taldrik.
