works.de: Full profile to the right of a girl with long, dark hair falling onto her bare back.

works.d: Esiplaanil jõekallas kivide ja palkidega. Samas paremal naine pesu pesemas. Temast paremal istub poiss, profiilis vasakule. Nendest vasakul kaks parti. Kalda ääres hobune veevaadiga. Paremal kerkiva liivase jõekalda tagant paistab korstnaga talumaja. Jõel näha paate. Üle jõe puude vahel paistavad hooned.
works.de: In the foreground, a riverbank with stones and logs. There, on the right, a woman washing laundry. To her right sits a boy, in profile facing left. To their left, two ducks. By the shore, a horse with a water barrel. On the right, behind the rising sandy riverbank, a farmhouse with a chimney is visible. Boats can be seen on the river. Across the river, buildings are visible between the trees.

works.d: Pruunist foonist on nõrga kontuuriga eraldatud vaas väikeõieliste, siniste meelespeadega.(eesti)
works.de: Against a brown background, a vase with small-flowered blue forget-me-nots is set off by a faint contour.

works.d: Keskel sfinksi kuju lamavana peata kehal. Selja taga peaga sfinksile toetuv ebamäärane fantastiline elukas.
works.de: In the centre, the figure of a sphinx, headless, lying on a body. Behind it, resting its head on the sphinx, an indeterminate fantastic creature.

works.d: Esiplaanil rohumaa, mida tagapool piirab lehtpuude ja põõsaste vöönd.
works.de: In the foreground grassland, bordered further back by a belt of deciduous trees and bushes.

works.d: Üksikud suured raagus puud kevad  - talvel.
works.de: Solitary large bare trees in spring - winter.

works.d: Esiplaanil eest taha suunduv teerada. Tagapool põõsastik ja puud.
works.de: In the foreground a path leading from front to back. Shrubbery and trees behind.

works.d: Esiplaanil lagendik ( ? ). Taga lehtpuumets.
works.de: In the foreground a clearing ( ? ). Behind it a deciduous forest.

works.d: Kiilaspäise mehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale. Suus suitsev sigarett.
works.de: Bust portrait of a bald man in half-profile to the right. A smoking cigarette in his mouth.

works.d: Kiilaspäise mehe pea en face. Suus suitsev piip. Ebamäärastes rohekaspruunides toonides.
works.de: The head of a bald man, en face. A smoking pipe in his mouth. In indeterminate greenish-brown tones.

works.d: Esiplaanil nõmm; taga männid ja mets; taevas rünkpilved.
works.de: In the foreground a heath; behind, pines and forest; sky with cumulus clouds.

works.d: Mehe põlvpilt poolprofiilis paremale, halli põskhabemega, mundris, paremas käes kiri, taga paremal maal ja raamatuid.
works.de: Half-length portrait of a man in semi-profile to the right, with grey side-whiskers, in uniform, a letter in his right hand, a painting and books behind on the right.

works.d: Pruunijuukselise, vurrude ja täishabemega vanema mehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale. Tume ülikond, kaelaside.
works.de: Bust portrait of an older man with brown hair, moustache and full beard, in half-profile to the right. Dark suit, necktie.

works.d: Noormehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale, valge krae ja musta kuuega.
works.de: Bust portrait of a young man in half-profile to the right, with a white collar and black coat.

works.d: Esiplaanil sügavusse suunduv linnatänav (Müürivahe tn.) majadega mõlemal küljel. Paremal pool üle katuste näha linnamüüri, mille lõpp - punktiks kaitsetorn. Tänaval näha kahte inimkogu. Esiplaanil paremal maja küljes silt "Söögimaja".
works.de: In the foreground a city street receding into depth (Müürivahe tn.) with houses on both sides. On the right, above the roofs, the town wall is visible, ending in a point - a defence tower. On the street two groups of people are visible. In the foreground on the right, on the side of a house, a sign "Söögimaja".

works.d: Peamiselt hallides ja sinistes toonides värvilaikudest kujundatud abstraktne kompositsioon. Osa kompositsiooni kuuluvatest värvilaikudest ja -pritsmetest on kantud klaasile ja raamile.
works.de: An abstract composition formed mainly of grey and blue tone patches. Some of the colour patches and splashes belonging to the composition have been applied to the glass and the frame.

works.d: Tihedalt läbimaalitud, üksteisesse sulavates kollastes, pruunides ja sinistes toonides peaaegu abstraktse pildina mõjuv, vaid aimatavate viidetega reaalsusele komponeeritud maastik. Ülal keskel kollase plahvatusena mõjuv kujund.
works.de: A densely painted landscape, appearing almost as an abstract picture in yellow, brown and blue tones merging into one another, composed with only barely perceptible references to reality. At the top centre a shape resembling a yellow explosion.

works.d: Istuva mehe kolmveerandfiguur, pea kergelt pööratud, üks käsi toetub lauale, teine põlvele, pisut käharduvad hallisegused juuksed, väikese kühmuga nina. Pruun ülikond, valge särk, tumesinine valge kitsa triibuga lips.
works.de: Three-quarter figure of a seated man, head slightly turned, one hand resting on a table, the other on the knee, slightly curling greyish hair, nose with a small hump. Brown suit, white shirt, dark blue tie with a narrow white stripe.

works.d: Esiplaanil lumehanged, paremal maja, vasakul kõrge müür, mille taga raagus puud. Vasak osa kaetud sinaka varjuga, parem valgustatud.
works.de: In the foreground snowdrifts, on the right a house, on the left a high wall behind which bare trees stand. The left part is covered in a bluish shadow, the right is illuminated.

works.d: Esiplaanil rukkiväli, mida läbib keskelt sügavusse suunduv tee. Keskplaanil mõlemal pool teed lehtpuud. Paremal pool teed, esiplaanil rukkikoorem, mille otsas kaabuga mees. Sellest kaugemal paremal kasvavast rukkist pooleldi kaetud põllul tee poole sammuva hobusega rukkikoorem; vasakul heinakuhi. Keset maali, lehtpuude vahelt paistavad sinetava metsaga kaetud mäed.
works.de: In the foreground a rye field, crossed in the middle by a road leading into the depth. In the middle ground, deciduous trees on both sides of the road. On the right side of the road, in the foreground, a load of rye with a man in a hat on top. Further away on the right, on a field half covered by growing rye, a load of rye with a horse walking toward the road; on the left a haystack. In the middle of the painting, mountains covered with bluish forest are visible between the deciduous trees.

works.d: Alasti profiilis vasakule noor naine tumedate lahtiste juustega lehtpuu varjus. Paremas käes granaatõun. Vasaku käega hoiab pea kohal oleva puu oksast kinni. Nägu naeratusega otsevaates.
works.de: A nude young woman in profile facing left, with dark loose hair, in the shade of a deciduous tree. A pomegranate in her right hand. With her left hand she holds on to a branch of the tree above her head. Her face, shown frontally, is smiling.

works.d: Lapse rinnaportree. Siledad, sirged, laubale langevad juuksed ja sinised silmad. Rõivaste osas jäetud valgeks, maalimata. Töö lõpetamata.
works.de: Bust portrait of a child. Smooth, straight hair falling onto the forehead, and blue eyes. The clothing left white, unpainted. The work unfinished.

works.d: Esiplaanil jõgi hoonestatud kallastega (Tartu motiiv). Keskel paremal sild. Tagaplaanil maju.
works.de: In the foreground a river with built-up banks (a Tartu motif). In the middle on the right a bridge. Houses in the background.

works.d: Ees keskel kirjutiivaline liblikas lilleõiel. Selle taga küljeli vajunud puudest üles kistud pinnase kamar juurtega. Taustaks tihe segametsa tüvestik.
works.de: In the centre foreground a butterfly with patterned wings on a flower. Behind it a clump of soil with roots pulled up from trees fallen sideways. Background a dense mixed-forest trunk stand.

works.dm: laius: 69.4 cm; kõrgus: 49.0 cm ( vasak külg 48.8)
works.d: Esiplaanil põld kolme rukkihakiga. Tagapool keskel kaks hoonet; paremal puud ja põõsad, vasakul mitmetüviline puu.
works.de: In the foreground, a field with three shocks of rye. Behind, in the middle, two buildings; on the right, trees and bushes, on the left a multi-trunked tree.

works.d: Poolabstraktne värvikas kompositsioon figuuridega. Ülalpool sinakasroheliste, kollaste geomeetriliste kujundite taustal lendlevad rahvariides figuurid, pead, pasun, lillekimp, sini-must-valge lipu motiive. Allosas paremal hulk pasunatorusid, vasakul juubeldav-tantsiv rahvamass.
works.de: A semi-abstract colourful composition with figures. Above, against a background of bluish-green, yellow geometric shapes, figures in folk costume floating, heads, a trumpet, a bouquet of flowers, motifs of the blue-black-white flag. Below on the right a number of trumpet horns, on the left a jubilant, dancing crowd.

works.d: Tihedasti üksteise kõrvale surutud inimestest figuraalne kompositsioon, mille peamine raskuspunkt jääb horisontaalsest keskjoonest pisut paremale, sest peamine osa inimmassist on koondunud sinna. Inimeste näod kas ähmaselt antud või puuduvad üldse. Iseloomustuseks on antud kas erksas toonis või iseäralik riietusese (barett, džemper, kübar). Vasakul tumedasse riietatud, hallide pükstega mees, ajaleht käes. Foon vasakult valge lubjatud seina meenutav, paremalt tumehall. Valitsevad tuhmid, väljasuretatud toonid.
works.de: A figural composition of people pressed tightly against one another, whose main point of gravity falls slightly to the right of the horizontal centre line, since the main part of the mass of people is gathered there. The faces of the people are either given vaguely or are entirely absent. Characterisation is given either through bright tone or a peculiar item of clothing (beret, jumper, hat). On the left a man dressed in dark clothing, with grey trousers, a newspaper in hand. The background resembles a white limewashed wall on the left, dark grey on the right. Dull, faded tones predominate.

works.d: Sügavates sinistes toonides natüürmort: esiplaanil raamatud, tiigripilt, joonistused. Nende keskel tohutusuur lillekimp, millest eristuvad erksate laikudena valged ja punased õied.
works.de: A still life in deep blue tones: in the foreground books, a tiger picture, drawings. In their midst an enormous bouquet of flowers, from which white and red blossoms stand out as bright patches.

works.d: Talvemaastik sinakates toonides. Esiplaanil kaks valgesse riietatud lamavat inimest saksa sõduri kiivrites. Samas vasakul murdunud puutüvi, eemal tank.
works.de: Winter landscape in bluish tones. In the foreground two people dressed in white lying down in German soldier's helmets. Also on the left a broken tree trunk, in the distance a tank.

works.d: Esiplaanil lumel lamavad hukatud talupoegade kehad. Tagaplaanil neli seisvat sõjaväelast. Taevas tumesinine, lumi heledam.
works.de: In the foreground the bodies of executed peasants lying on the snow. In the background four standing soldiers. The sky dark blue, the snow lighter.

works.d: Järv. Paremal kallas (Sõsarsaare serv) lehestikuga ja haralise vana pajuga, mille üks haru ulatub horisontaalsuunas veepinna kohale. Vasakult paistab Kloostrisaar.
works.de: A lake. On the right, a shore (the edge of Sõsarsaar) with foliage and a branching old willow, one branch of which extends horizontally above the water surface. Kloostrisaar can be seen on the left.

works.d: Sinisilmse tütarlapse pea en face karmiinpunases pluusis erepunaste nööpidega.
works.de: Head of a blue-eyed girl en face in a carmine-red blouse with bright red buttons.

works.d: Esiplaanil käärdus paremalt vasakule sügavusse suunduv jõgi, kallastel vees peegelduvaid lehtpuid ja põõsaid, tagaplaanil künklik maastik puudesaludega.
works.de: In the foreground a river winding from right to left into the depth, on its banks deciduous trees and bushes reflected in the water, in the background a hilly landscape with groves.

works.d: Keskealise daami portree, kolmveerandfiguur, peaaegu en face, keha kerge pöördega vasakule. Taustaks kirju vaip.
works.de: Portrait of a middle-aged lady, three-quarter figure, almost en face, body slightly turned to the left. Background a patterned carpet.

works.d: Ees keskel vasakul varemete ees tänaval kaks inimfiguuri. Taustaks majad Kinga tänava nurgalt.
works.de: In front in the middle-left, in front of ruins on the street, two human figures. Background houses from the corner of Kinga Street.

works.dm: laius: 155.3 cm (arm   ); kõrgus: 156.0 cm; kõrgus: 155.5 cm (arm ); laius: 156.0 cm
works.d: Esiplaanil rannal meesfiguur pooleldi selgvaates võrku lootsikust välja tõstmas. Paadi kõrval vanem mees suuremat kala vaatlemas. Paremal pool rauk piibuga ja noor naine, kartulikorv käevangus, väikene tüdruk kõrval. Tagaplaanil vanem naine korviga. Merel purjekad, silmapiiril metsaviirg.
works.de: In the foreground, on the shore, a male figure lifting a net out of a boat, seen in half-view. Beside the boat, an older man examining a large fish. On the right an old man with a pipe and a young woman with a potato basket on her arm, a small girl beside her. In the background an older woman with a basket. Sailboats at sea, a strip of forest on the horizon.

works.d: Esiplaanil lage rabamaa üksikute kidurate põõsastega. Kaugemal vasakul väike männitukk, paremal üksikute mändide vahel tööriistiade osmik. Taamal raba ääres mets.
works.de: In the foreground open bog land with scattered stunted bushes. Further away on the left a small pine grove, on the right among scattered pines a tool shed. In the distance a forest at the edge of the bog.

works.d: Kuuli tõukava väikestes sportpükstes mehe täisfiguur poolprofiilis paremale. Parem käsi kuuliga õla juures.(eesti)
works.de: Full figure of a man in small sports shorts putting the shot, in half-profile to the right. Right hand with the shot at shoulder level.

works.d: Avatud värvikast pintslite ja pudelitega ja palett värvidega. Kasti taga rippumas valge kittel.
works.de: An open paint box with brushes and bottles, and a palette with paints. A white smock hanging behind the box.

works.d: Keskel riidega kaetud akna all oleva laua juures petrooliumlambi valgel, selgvaates istuv poisike. Paremal rinnuli lauale kummarduv naine.
works.de: In the centre, by a table beneath a curtained window, in the light of a kerosene lamp, a boy sitting in clear view. On the right a woman leaning over the table towards him.

works.d: Ees paremal maja fassaad trepiga ja kahe laternaga. Tagaplaanil keskelt vasakule suure hoone nurk.
works.de: In front on the right the façade of a house with a staircase and two lanterns. In the background, from the middle to the left, the corner of a large building.

works.d: Istuv vanaeit poolprofiilis vasakule, käed toetumas ettesirutatult põlvedele, kuhu langeb vasakult, väljaspool pildipinda asuvast koldest, tulehelki, mis vähesel määral valgustab ka eide nägu. Eide pead katab valge lahtine rätt, seljas rohekat tooni pihikuga seelik ja põll, mille halli tooni täiendab allosas oranž-kollane riba.
works.de: An old woman sits in half-profile to the left, her hands resting outstretched on her knees, onto which falls firelight from a hearth located outside the picture plane on the left, which also slightly illuminates the old woman's face. The old woman's head is covered with a loose white kerchief; she wears a skirt with a greenish-toned bodice and an apron, whose grey tone is complemented at the bottom by an orange-yellow strip.

works.d: Kirevates toonides sügismaastik: esiplaanil söövad kolm musta-valgekirjut lehma, paremal ja vasakul erkkollastes ja -punastes lehtedes väikesed puud. Tagapool kolm majakest, üks neist, punane maja keskel, puude keskel. Ülal helesinine taevas valgete pilveräbalatega.(eesti)
works.de: An autumn landscape in vivid tones: in the foreground three black-and-white cows grazing, on the right and left small trees with bright yellow and red leaves. Further back three little houses, one of them, a red house in the middle, among the trees. Above, a light blue sky with white cloud shreds.

works.d: Kollakas kuuljas vaasis mitmesuguseid aia- ja põllulilli.(eesti)
works.de: In a yellowish glass vase various garden and field flowers.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 30.0 cm; lehe laius: 36.7 cm
works.d: Metsamaastiku oruveerel, vasakul kahe suure kuuse all kaks jahimeest koertega. Üks istub kännul, teine seisab, püss kaenlas. Maal on rohekas-hallides ja pruunides toonides.
works.de: On the slope of a forest valley, on the left under two large spruces two hunters with dogs. One sits on a stump, the other stands with a rifle under his arm. The painting is in greenish-grey and brown tones.

works.d: Vasemal talumaja trepil istuv naine. Paremal kooguga kaev, tagapool madal õlgkatusega hoone; selle ja elumaja vahel roigasaed. Taamal aia taga põllud.
works.de: On the left a woman sitting on the steps of a farmhouse. On the right a well with a sweep, behind it a low thatched-roof building; between it and the dwelling house a pole fence. Beyond the fence, fields.

works.d: Eest keskelt taha paremale suunduvat jõge läbistamas majade poolt veetud palgikoormad; vastaskaldal maju. Keskel kõrgel mäetipul linnuse puutaral askeldavad inimfiguurid.(eesti)
works.de: From the front centre towards the back right runs a river crossed by log rafts towed by houses; houses on the opposite bank. In the middle, on a high mountaintop, human figures busy on the wooden fence of a castle.

works.d: Maali keskel kõnepuldis seisab meesfiguur (Lauristin), kes hoiab vasakus käes valget lehte. Temast paremal ja vasakul poliitbüroo esimehed, eesotsas Staliniga. Tribüüni ees seisavad ENSV delegatsiooni liikmed otsevaates. Rea alguse ja lõpu kohal punased lipud. Kõnepuldist paremal valge, punaste äärtega ja kujutistega lipp. Lipul arv 19 10 05. Saalis oleva rahva taga paremal uks, sellest paremal prozektor. Tribüüni taga oleval seinal Lenini kuju.
works.de: In the centre of the painting, a male figure (Lauristin) stands at a lectern, holding a white sheet of paper in his left hand. To his right and left, the chairmen of the Politburo, headed by Stalin. In front of the tribune, members of the ESSR delegation stand facing forward. Red flags above the beginning and end of the row. To the right of the lectern, a white flag with red edges and images. On the flag, the number 19 10 05. Behind the crowd in the hall, a door on the right, and to the right of it a projector. On the wall behind the tribune, a statue of Lenin.

works.d: Osaliselt jäätunud jõgi lumiste kallastega, paremal esiplaanil jäljed ja paar püsti teivast. Üle jõe metsamaastik pika hoone küljega, vasakul kivialusele rajatud puitehitis helkivate akendega. Põhitoon kahvatu sinine, tumepruun.
works.de: A partially frozen river with snowy banks, in the foreground on the right footprints and a pair of upright poles. Across the river a forest landscape with the side of a long building, on the left a wooden structure built on a stone foundation with glinting windows. Main tone pale blue, dark brown.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul lumine kai aurikuga ja vagunisse kaupa laadiva tõstukkraanaga. Paremal meri puksiiridega ja Tallinna panoraamiga tagaplaanil.
works.de: In the foreground on the left, a snowy quay with a steamer and a lifting crane loading goods into a wagon. On the right, the sea with tugboats and a panorama of Tallinn in the background.

works.d: Kompositsiooni alumisel poolel üle kogu pildi laiuse laud: paremalt poolt poolümmargune, vasemalt nurgeline, mida laudlinana katavad geomeetrilised värvipinnad. Tagaplaanil paremal roheline pudel, sellest veidi eespool, kompositsiooni keskel, lopsaka lillekimbuna suureõielised lilled punakate ja hallikate varjunditega kõrges silindrilises vaasis. Keskplaanil paremas kuldlõikes suur sinisest klaasist, paksuseinaline veinipokaal, paremal pruun savikauss kahe rohelise puuviljaga, vasakul äärel teineteise peal kaks raamatut. Esiplaanil kasutatud "papiers colle`na" eestikeelseid ajalehti. Fooniks geomeetrilised värvipinnad.
works.de: In the lower half of the composition, across the entire width of the picture, a table: semicircular on the right side, angular on the left, covered as if by a tablecloth with geometric colour planes. In the background on the right a green bottle, slightly in front of it, in the centre of the composition, large-flowered blossoms in reddish and greyish shades as a lush bouquet in a tall cylindrical vase. In the middle ground, in the right golden section, a large thick-walled wine goblet of blue glass, on the right a brown clay bowl with two green fruits, on the left edge two books stacked on top of each other. In the foreground, Estonian-language newspapers are used as "papiers collés". The background consists of geometric colour planes.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 51.3 cm; lehe laius: 37.8 cm
works.d: Kahelt poolt üles kerkivate kõrgete kaljude vahel kitsas kärestikuline juga väikese sillakesega (purdega) üle selle.
works.de: Between high cliffs rising on both sides, a narrow rapid stream with a small bridge (footbridge) over it.

works.d: Esiplaanil meri paljude kitsaste saarekestega. Tumeda pilve tagant keset taevast nähtavale tulevad äsjatõusnud päikese kiired mähivad merepinna kollakasse valgusesse.
works.de: In the foreground the sea with many narrow small islands. From behind a dark cloud, in the middle of the sky, the rays of the just-risen sun become visible, wrapping the sea surface in yellowish light.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 55.0 cm; lehe laius: 37.6 cm
works.d: Kahel pool olevate kaljujärsakute vahel kitsas, eest taha koonduv veekogu. Taga keskel hoonetegrupp. Taamal lumise harjaga kaljuahelikud.
works.de: Between rocky cliffs on both sides a narrow body of water narrowing from front to back. In the middle background a group of buildings. In the distance mountain ranges with snowy ridges.

works.d: 2/5 ülemisest maaliosast ühtlane kirsipunane, alumine vaarikapunane taust, millel paikneb lilla ristkülik.
works.de: 2/5 of the upper part of the painting is a uniform cherry-red, the lower part a raspberry-red background, on which a purple rectangle is placed.

works.d: Grupp punaste viilkatustega maju, paremal osa Niguliste kirikust.
works.de: A group of houses with red gable roofs, on the right part of the Niguliste church.

works.d: Pruunikal taustal punaserombilises kostüümis poolfiguur otsevaates. Pisut külgede poole hajuv nägu, üksteisest eemal asetsevad silmad. Peas kahe kuljusega narrimüts.(eesti)
works.de: Half-figure in frontal view wearing a red-rhombus-patterned costume against a brownish background. Face slightly diffused towards the sides, eyes set apart from each other. On the head a jester's cap with two bells.

works.d: Punakaspruuni lauaplaadi ümber lillakasinistes riietes kolm inimest: keskmine otsevaates, pikkade juustega, käte vahel pooleks murtud leivatükk. Külgmistel pottmütsi taolised peakatted, parempoolsel käed laual, pilk leival, vasakpoolsel pilk suunatud jagajale. Taustal erksinine taevas, sinetav maastik.(eesti)
works.de: Around a reddish-brown tabletop three people in purplish-blue clothing: the middle one in frontal view, with long hair, a piece of bread broken in half between the hands. The ones on the sides wear pot-hat-like headwear, the one on the right has hands on the table, gaze on the bread, the one on the left has gaze directed at the one dividing it. In the background a bright blue sky, a bluish landscape.

works.d: Vertikaalsest keskteljest pisut vasakule nihutatud ümar vaas suure, peaaegu abstraktse värvilaikude kombinatsioonina antud lillekimp. Domineerivad külmad sinised ja rohelised toonid. Foon lillakashall. Maaliline, kogu pildi ulatuses tihedalt pintsliga läbi töötatud.
works.de: A round vase, shifted slightly to the left of the vertical central axis, with a large bouquet of flowers given as an almost abstract combination of colour patches. Cool blue and green tones dominate. Background purplish-grey. Painterly, worked densely with the brush throughout the entire picture.

works.d: Värvikal rohekas-pruunil taustal istuva noore neiu poolfiguur otsevaates, parem käsi puhkab süles, vasak toetub tooli seljatoele. Tütarlapse helepruunid lokilised juuksed langevad seljale. Neiul seljas lillakas rüüžidega pluus ja punakaslilla seelik.
works.de: Half-figure of a seated young girl seen frontally against a colourful greenish-brown background, right hand resting in her lap, left resting on the back of the chair. The girl's light brown curly hair falls down her back. She wears a lilac blouse with ruffles and a purplish-lilac skirt.

works.d: Esiplaanil sügavsinine meri, taamal erinevates sinistes ja hallides toonides antud kõrged kaljud silmapiiril. Ülal süngevõitud taevas.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground a deep blue sea, in the distance high cliffs on the horizon rendered in various shades of blue and grey. Above, a darkly painted sky.

works.d: Erkkollasel foonil koonilistel pruunikatel kujunditel deformeeritud inimfiguuridest rüselev grupp vehklevate kätega. Kollaste, oranžide, punaste, siniste kujude pead hajuvad pilvedesse.(eesti)
works.de: On a bright yellow background, on conical brownish forms, a struggling group of deformed human figures with flailing arms. The heads of yellow, orange, red and blue figures dissolve into clouds. (Estonian)

works.d: Pärnu peatänav kõnniteelt piki tänavat nähtuna. Ees keskel laternapost, tee äärde parkinud sõiduautod. Vasakul, üle tee tellistest hoone, selle ees inimesi. Paremal, vaataja suunas astumas naine, võrk käevangus, laps kükakil.
works.de: Pärnu's main street seen from the pavement along the street. In front in the centre a lamp post, cars parked along the roadside. On the left, across the street, a brick building, with people in front of it. On the right, a woman stepping toward the viewer, a net bag on her arm, a child crouching.

works.d: Vanema, täishabet kandva mehe portree. Pilk suunatud otse vaatjale. Ninajuurel ja suu ümber sügavad kurrud. Kaelusest paistab punane rätt. Taust helesinine.
works.de: Portrait of an elderly man with a full beard. Gaze directed straight at the viewer. Deep wrinkles at the bridge of the nose and around the mouth. A red scarf shows from the collar. Background light blue.

works.d: Laua ääres oleval toolil istuv läki-läkiga mees. Parem käsi toetatud toolileenile, vasak lauale. Laua nurgal küünal ja ajalehed.(eesti)
works.de: A man with sideburns sitting on a chair at a table. Right hand resting on the chair's armrest, left hand on the table. A candle and newspapers at the corner of the table.

works.d: Akna all ruumis triipmustrilise lianaga laud täis kuhjatud igat liiki aiasaadusi, nõusid, lillevaasid põrandal, vilju ja anumaid aknalaual ja alustel akna ees. Ees keskel suur laud, millel vasakult kaks taldrikut õuntega, poolitatud roheline kõrvits, taldrik viljadega. Linal oakaunu, õunu, peete, baklažaan, keskel jalaga vaagnal pirnid. Paremal lehti, oksi viljadega. Põrandal vasakul vaas punaste gladioolide, ees kirju kimbuga. Maali ülaosas aknast paistab päikeseline rohelus. Vaba impressionistlik laad, tingilkult vorme markeeriv.
works.de: Under the window, in the room, a table with a striped tablecloth is piled high with all kinds of garden produce, vessels, flower vases on the floor, fruits and containers on the windowsill and on stands in front of the window. In front, in the middle, a large table on which, from the left, two plates with apples, a halved green squash, a plate with fruits. On the tablecloth beans, apples, beets, an aubergine, in the middle pears on a footed dish. On the right leaves, branches with fruits. On the floor on the left a vase of red gladioli, in front a colourful bouquet. In the upper part of the painting, sunny greenery is visible through the window. A free impressionistic manner, conditionally marking forms.

works.d: Paljufiguuriline kompositsioon, mille kesksel kohal sõimes lebav Kristus, tema kõrval istuv Maarja. Sõime päitsis ning jalutsis härg ja eesel. Keskel vasakul Kristuse poole tulemas kolm tarka. Paremas servas seisab pasunaga karjane. Ikooni allosas kaks stseeni pühakutega. Ülaosas vasakul ja paremal inglid, keskel Püha Vaimu sümboliseeriv kujutis.
works.de: A multi-figure composition, at the centre of which Christ lies in a manger, beside him the seated Mary. At the head and foot of the manger, an ox and a donkey. In the middle on the left, three wise men approaching Christ. On the right edge stands a shepherd with a horn. In the lower part of the icon, two scenes with saints. In the upper part, on the left and right, angels, in the centre a depiction symbolising the Holy Spirit.

works.d: Vasakul ja paremal rohelised puud ja põõsad. Vasakul tagapool näha kosk ja jõgi, mis diagonaalselt suundub esiplaanil paremale.
works.de: Green trees and bushes on the left and right. In the back on the left a waterfall and a river are visible, running diagonally toward the foreground on the right.

works.d: Šarž kunstnikust: mehe täisfiguur, peaaegu en face. Käes lippudega kaunistatud hoone mudel.
works.de: Caricature of an artist: full figure of a man, almost en face. In his hand a model of a building decorated with flags.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 33.3 cm (lm.   ); kujutise laius: 19.3 cm (km.   ); lehe laius: 24.3 cm (lm.   ); kujutise kõrgus: 24.5 cm (km.    )
works.d: Noore täidlase naise rinnapilt, pea 1/2 profiilis paremale. Näoprofiil tugev juuksed ja silmad pruunid, juukselahk keskel, juustes rohelise peaga nõel.
works.de: Bust of a young plump woman, head in half-profile to the right. Strong facial profile, hair and eyes brown, hair parted in the middle, a pin with a green head in the hair.

works.d: Vaasis kaks valget ja kaks roosat roosiõit. Taust tume.
works.de: In a vase two white and two pink rose blossoms. Dark background.

works.d: Vasakul kergelt lainetav rannaäärne meri purjekatega. Paremal kivine kallas.
works.de: On the left a slightly rippling seaside sea with sailboats. On the right a rocky shore.

works.d: Roosad ja valged hortensiad ja tulbid pottides.
works.de: Pink and white hydrangeas and tulips in pots.

works.d: Keskel kaks jalgupidi naela külge riputatud lindu. Vasakul servas valge kaelapidi naela otsa riputatud lind.(eesti)
works.de: In the centre, two birds hung by their feet from a nail. At the edge on the left, a bird hung by its white neck from a nail.

works.d: Prillidega, hallis kleidis naise rinnafiguur poolpöördes paremale. Nägu en face.
works.de: Half-figure of a woman in glasses and a grey dress, in half-turn to the right. Face en face.

works.d: Tuhmrohelises avatud hõlmadega mantlis vabalt rippuva salliga, sinises särgis ja pruuni kübaraga peas istuva mehe poolfiguur kerges pöördes paremale, käed toetuvad põlvedele, vasema käe sõrmede vahel sigarett, pea kergelt kallutatud vasemale; klaasistunud pilk, mis vaatab enda ette maha. Foon kohati kariinvioletne, kohati punakaspruun. Pastoosne, vorme lihtsustav pintslikäsitlus.
works.de: A half-length figure of a man seated, wearing a dull green coat with open lapels and a loosely hanging scarf, a blue shirt, and a brown hat on his head, in a slight turn to the right, his hands resting on his knees, a cigarette between the fingers of his left hand, his head slightly tilted to the left; a glassy gaze looking down in front of him. The background in places karmine-violet, in places reddish-brown. A pastose, form-simplifying brushwork.

works.d: Grupp inimesi, osa neist ratsa. Keskel langetatud lipud, paremal tume hoone ja kaks paati.
works.de: A group of people, some of them on horseback. Lowered flags in the middle, a dark building and two boats on the right.

works.d: Fragment alasti käteta naisekehast. Alumisest poolest väljaulatuv pea kaelaosaga puitalusel. Lühikeste juustega pea pisut taha kallutatud, veerandpöördes paremale, suletud silmad, must kõrvarõngas kõrvas. Kehaosa keskjoonest veidi paremal pikuti lõigatud. Kahvaturohekad, beežid toonid.(eesti)
works.de: A fragment of a nude female body without arms. From the lower part protrudes a head with a neck section on a wooden base. The head, with short hair, is tilted slightly back, in a quarter-turn to the right, eyes closed, a black earring in the ear. The body part is cut lengthwise slightly to the right of the centre line. Pale greenish, beige tones.

works.d: Visand kaheksast õunast.
works.de: Sketch of eight apples.

works.d: Kaheksa punast õuna.
works.de: Eight red apples.

works.d: Esiplaanil viis keedetud vähki. Nende keskel likööripudel.
works.de: Five boiled crayfish in the foreground. A liqueur bottle among them.

works.d: Esiplaanil tumepunasel vaibal vasakule küünarnukile toetuv poollebav noore naise alasti figuur. Taustaks lillakas-rohelised eesriided.
works.de: In the foreground, on a dark red carpet, a half-reclining nude figure of a young woman leaning on her left elbow. Purplish-green curtains as background.

works.d: Esiplaanil üks valge, üks must ja kaks pruuni hobust vankrite ette rakendatud. Hobuste taga etüüdliku üldistusega antud agulimajad. Rohelised, hallid ja pruunid toonid. Maalitud laia pintsliga, kohati lõuendit läbi paista lastes.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground, one white, one black and two brown horses harnessed to carts. Behind the horses, suburban houses rendered with sketch-like generalisation. Green, grey and brown tones. Painted with a broad brush, in places letting the canvas show through.

works.d: Punakas-pruunil alusel väike valge, siniseõielise mustriga vaas, lilladest õitsest kimbuga. Vasakul, lillede tagant paistab kahekorruselise maja serv.(eesti)
works.de: On a reddish-brown base a small white vase with a blue floral pattern, with a bouquet of purple blossoms. On the left, behind the flowers, the edge of a two-storey house is visible.

works.d: Esiplaanil väli viljakuhjadega. Taustaks põõsastiku ja puude vöönd.
works.de: In the foreground a field with haystacks. In the background a band of shrubs and trees.

works.d: Esiplaanil üksikute õitekobaratega rohumaa, mida vasakult ääristavad puud ja põõsad, paremalt jõgi. Jõe vastaskaldal astmeliselt kerkivad põõsastikud ja puudegrupid.
works.de: In the foreground a meadow with scattered clusters of blossoms, bordered on the left by trees and bushes, on the right by a river. On the opposite bank of the river, bushes and groups of trees rising in tiers.

works.d: Ärklikorrusega kollane maja otsafassaadiga tänava poole. Ees paremal lame hoone kõrge korstnaga. Taevas sünge.
works.de: A yellow house with an attic storey, its gable facing the street. In front on the right a low building with a tall chimney. The sky is gloomy.

works.d: Esiplaanil asuva balustraadi taga istuva ja vasema käsivarrega balustraadile nõjatuva tumedajuukselise noormehe portree, suunaga vasemale; pea poolprofiilis vasemale. Käte vahel raamat. Paažisoengul madal barett. Taustaks sammasarhitektuur ja läbi aknaava paistev maastik. Balustraadi äärel paremal medaljon ja ringi asetatult MDX  AXXV  DOMINICUS
works.de: Portrait of a dark-haired young man sitting behind a balustrade in the foreground and leaning with his left forearm on the balustrade, facing left; head in half-profile to the left. A book between his hands. Low beret with a page hairstyle. Background of column architecture and a landscape visible through a window opening. On the right at the edge of the balustrade a medallion with, arranged in a circle, MDX AXXV DOMINICUS

works.d: Vasakul tumedapinnaline mägijärv paadiga, paremal valgustatud kruusasel kaldal naine, kahel pool mäed puudega, tagaplaanil lumised kõrged mäed.
works.de: On the left a dark-surfaced mountain lake with a boat, on the right a woman on an illuminated gravelly shore, mountains with trees on both sides, high snowy mountains in the background.

works.d: Pehmetest, voolavatest kujunditest põimitud abstraktne kompositsioon, siin-seal vilksatab mõni silma- või sõrmekujund. Pastelsed sinised, kollased, lillad toonid, vormide ümarust ja läbikumavust rõhutav maalimislaad.
works.de: An abstract composition woven from soft, flowing forms, here and there a hint of an eye or finger shape flashes by. Pastel blue, yellow, violet tones, a painting style emphasising the roundness and translucency of the forms.

works.d: Karusnahkses mütsis hallipäise habemiku mehe rinnapilt peaaegu en face. Vaade suunatud vasakule.
works.de: Bust portrait of a grey-haired bearded man in a fur cap, almost en face. Gaze directed to the left.

works.d: Esiplaanil kaks inimeste gruppi: vasakul kolmest inimesest koosnev grupp, paremal hulk inimesi, korvidega istuv naine kõige ees. Inimestest viib tee pildi sügavusse, teest kahel pool ümaralt antud tumerohelised puud ja põõsad. Tagaplaanil taeva taustal puude vahel suure geomeetrilise üldistatusega antud majad. Maalitud kohati üksteisesse sulavates, sügavates värvitoonides.
works.de: In the foreground two groups of people: on the left a group of three people, on the right a number of people, a woman with baskets sitting at the very front. A path leads from the people into the depth of the picture, on both sides of the path dark green trees and bushes rendered roundly. In the background, against the sky between the trees, houses given with great geometric generalisation. Painted in deep colour tones, at places merging into one another.

works.dm: laius: 32.3 cm (aluspapi mõõt); kõrgus: 19.2 cm (lm.); kõrgus: 28.8 cm (aluspapi mõõt); laius: 20.7 cm (lm.)
works.d: Esiplaanil käsipuudega ääristatud Rannaväravassse suunduv tänav (Pikk tn.), millel üksi jalutav valvesõdur püssiga õlal. Vasemale poole jääb Paks Margareta. Kahel pool tänavat rohelisi põõsaid, taga paremalt paistavad katused ja korstnad.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground, a street bordered by handrails leading to the Beach Gate (Pikk Street), on which a lone sentry soldier walks with a rifle on his shoulder. To the left is Fat Margaret. On both sides of the street green bushes, behind which roofs and chimneys are visible on the right.

works.d: Helesinistes ja kollakates toonides merevaade sadamaga esiplaanil: pildi allservas kai kastide, tünnide, gaasiballoonidega. Kai ääres on ankrus mitmed väiksemad kalalaevad. Taamal lahesopp veest väljaulatuvate kividega. Ülal helesinine horisontaalne valge pilvetriibuga teavas.(eesti)
works.de: A seascape in light blue and yellowish tones with a harbour in the foreground: at the bottom edge of the picture a quay with boxes, barrels, gas cylinders. Several smaller fishing boats are anchored by the quay. In the background a bay inlet with rocks protruding from the water. Above, a light blue horizontal sky with a white cloud stripe.

works.d: Tumedajuukselise, suurte kõrvarõngastega keskaelise naise rinnapilt. Paeaegu en face. Seljas sinine tumeoranži kraega kleit.(eesti)
works.de: Bust of a dark-haired, middle-aged woman with large earrings. Almost en face. Wearing a blue dress with a dark orange collar.

works.d: Kõrge lauba ja pügatud vuntsidega tõsiseilmelise keskealise istuva mehe poolfiguur poolpöördes vasakule, käes keerdunud paberilehed tekstiga:
works.de: Half-figure of a seated, serious-looking middle-aged man with a high forehead and trimmed moustache, in a half-turn to the left, holding curled sheets of paper with text:

works.d: Esiplaanil keskel ümaral laual pruun kann kolmeõielise erepunase amarüllisega. Laua taga noore prillidega naise poolfiguur pisut pöördes vasakule, seljas karusnahkse kraega mantel. Maalitud valkjate pastelsete laikudena.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground, in the middle, on a round table, a brown jug with a three-blossomed bright red amaryllis. Behind the table the half-figure of a young woman with glasses, slightly turned to the left, wearing a coat with a fur collar. Painted in whitish pastel patches.

works.d: Päikesepaisteline metsamaastik, esiplaanilt taha poole suundub liivane, kergelt rohtunud tee. Kahel pool teed kõrged lehtpuud. Tagaplaanil paistavad kõrgete puude tüved.
works.de: A sunlit forest landscape, a sandy, lightly grassed path leading from the foreground into the distance. Tall deciduous trees on both sides of the path. In the background the trunks of tall trees can be seen.

works.d: Mustrilise riidega diivani nurgas istuva poisi põlvportree, käed vaheliti süles. Seljas sinakas pluus, jalas lühikesed sinised püksid, peas punane müts. Draperii taga punakas.
works.de: A knee-length portrait of a boy sitting in the corner of a patterned-cloth sofa, hands clasped in his lap. Wearing a bluish blouse, short blue trousers, a red cap on his head. Behind him a reddish drapery.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 46.0 cm; lehe laius: 66.0 cm
works.d: Esiplaanil veeloigu ääres lauatükke ja koormat mahalaadivate veoautodega ja raudtee valtsiga, keskel taga kõrgete akendega, kahe ümmarguse korstnaga tehase hoone.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground, by a puddle of water, pieces of boards and trucks unloading a load, and a railway roller, in the middle behind a factory building with tall windows and two round chimneys.

works.d: Esiplaanil kivine rand, taamal meri üksikute purjepaatidega.
works.de: In the foreground a rocky shore, in the distance the sea with solitary sailboats.

works.d: Spordidressis noormehe põlvpilt en face. Kaenlas suusad.
works.de: Knee-length portrait of a young man in a sports tracksuit, en face. Skis under his arm.

works.d: Lopsakalt täppivas laadis maalitud varakevadine maastik: esiplaanil väikesed, laiguti lumega kaetud künkad. Taamal lopsakad männid, ülal hallikassinine taevas. Maalitud tumedated rohelistes ja ookritoonides.
works.de: An early spring landscape painted in a lushly dabbed manner: in the foreground small hills covered patchily with snow. In the distance lush pine trees, above a greyish-blue sky. Painted in dark green and ochre tones.

works.d: Tumedal, maailmaruumi markeerival foonil vasakul, otsekui hallil kaljul või pilverüngal seisev figuur külgvaates, kapuutsi- ja juusteosa maaliliselt fooni hajutatud.(eesti)
works.de: Against a dark background marking the expanse of the universe, on the left a figure in side view standing as if on a grey rock or cloud mass, the hood and hair area painterly blended into the background.

works.d: Esiplaanil tükati lumega kaetud põld, üksikute viljarõukudega. Taga horisondil mets.
works.de: In the foreground a field partly covered with snow, with solitary grain stacks. Behind, on the horizon, a forest.

works.d: Tänavanurk madalate majadega, mille tagant paistmas koonusekujuline torn. Paremal kõrged lehtpuud.
works.de: A street corner with low houses, behind which a cone-shaped tower can be seen. On the right tall leafy trees.

works.dm: kõrgus: 43.0 cm; laius: 73.0 cm; laius: 70.0 cm; kõrgus: 47.0 cm
works.d: Rohtukasvanud jõekäär paadisillaga esiplaanil. Sinisel veel silla all paat, vasakul ujuvad pardid.
works.de: An overgrown river bend with a boat bridge in the foreground. A boat on the blue water under the bridge, on the left ducks swimming.

works.d: Tumerohelises vaasis roosa- ja valgeõieliste segalillede bukett, kus domineerivad suured punased moonid. Paremal vaasi ees üks valge õis. Foon rohekais toonides. Pastoosne lai pintsli löök.
works.de: Bouquet of mixed flowers with pink and white blossoms in a dark green vase, in which large red poppies dominate. On the right in front of the vase one white blossom. Background in greenish tones. Pastose, broad brushstroke.

works.d: Portselannõudest ja relvadest koostatud natüürmort. Keskel ümara vormiga tirin, selle ees vasakul väike kitsa suuga nõu ja taga karikavormiga anum. Tirinast paremal tume, pika kitsa kaelaga anum ja sinise glasuuriga väike kauss. Esiplaanil vanaaegne püstol ja kaunistatud käepidemega pistoda. Fooniks kirju idamaine vaip.
works.de: A still life composed of porcelain vessels and weapons. In the centre, a round-shaped tureen, in front of it at left a small vessel with a narrow spout, and behind it a goblet-shaped vessel. To the right of the tureen, a dark vessel with a long narrow neck and a small bowl with blue glaze. In the foreground, an antique pistol and a dagger with a decorated handle. The background is a colourful oriental carpet.

works.d: Valgejuukselise vana daami rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale. Peas must pitstanu, seljas must pitskraega kleit nööbinguga keskel. Kaelus kinnitatud kuldprossiga. Ümber kaela pikk peenelüliline kuldkett, mille otsas, rinnale kinnitatuna, kuldkell.
works.de: Bust portrait of a white-haired old lady in half-profile to the right. On her head a black lace bonnet, wearing a black lace-collared dress buttoned in the centre. The collar fastened with a gold brooch. Around her neck a long fine-linked gold chain, at the end of which, fastened to the chest, a gold watch.

works.d: Punasele pinnale on veidi kaootiliselt paigutatud mitmesugused kujundid. Maali keskosas ülakolmandikus on lillaka varjundiga veidi reljeefne nelinurk, mida diagonaalselt poolitab reljeefne joon. Nelinurk on ühendatud vasakul asuva trepilaadse kujundiga. All, vasakus servas on ebakorrapärane roosa-lilla ja punaste värvinüanssidega mitmest ristkülikust koosnev nelinurk. Maali keskosast veidi paremale jäävad kaks kujundit. Allpool punane kolmnurk, millel punakasvalge ruut. Sellest paremale jääb kõrge trapetsilaadne sinakas-punakas kujund, millest kasvab välja reljeefne silmustega kaarjoon, mis tipneb hõõguvpunase maalitud ristkülikuga. All paremas servas sinine rant.
works.de: Various shapes are arranged somewhat chaotically on a red surface. In the upper third of the middle part of the painting there is a slightly relief quadrangle with a purplish tint, diagonally bisected by a relief line. The quadrangle is connected to a stair-like shape located on the left. At the bottom, in the left margin, there is an irregular quadrangle composed of several rectangles in pink-purple and red colour nuances. Slightly to the right of the middle of the painting there are two shapes. Below is a red triangle with a reddish-white square on it. To the right of it is a tall, trapezoid-like bluish-red shape, from which grows a relief looped arched line culminating in a glowing red painted rectangle. In the lower right margin there is a blue edge.

works.d: Esiplaanil sügavusse suunduv kitsas tänav, paremal majade grupp, vasakul majanurga taga lehtpuu latv.
works.de: A narrow street leading into the depth in the foreground, a group of houses on the right, treetop of a deciduous tree behind the corner of a house on the left.

works.d: Kolmest figuurist komponeeritud etüüd: vasakul servas laias mantlis seisev naisefiguur, paremas servas osa toolikorjust, laud paralleelselt pildi allservaga ja laudade taga istuvad kaks mehefiguuri. Kollakaspruun värvigamma.
works.de: A study composed of three figures: on the left edge a female figure standing in a wide coat, on the right edge part of a chair's back, a table parallel to the lower edge of the picture and behind the tables two seated male figures. A yellowish-brown colour range.

works.d: Akna juures tugitoolis istuva mehe kolmveerandfiguur poolprofiilis vasakule, käed süles. Aknast vaade lumistele mändidele.
works.de: Three-quarter figure of a man sitting in an armchair by a window, in half-profile to the left, hands in his lap. From the window a view of snowy pines.

works.d: Roosakaslillas pilvevahus seisev alasti noormees veerandpöördes paremale. Paremal valgel tormaval hobusel alasti naisfiguur poolselgvaates, vasaku kõverdatud käega ulatab erekollase päikeseketast tema ees seisvale noormehele. Maal roosas, lillas, ultramariinsinises koloriidis, erksad valguslaigud figuuridel.
works.de: A naked young man standing in pinkish-lilac cloud foam, in a three-quarter turn to the right. On the right, on a white galloping horse, a nude female figure in half-profile, with her bent left hand reaching out a bright yellow sun disc to the young man standing before her. The painting in pink, lilac, ultramarine blue coloring, bright patches of light on the figures.

works.d: Lokkispäise põskhabemega prillidega mehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale. Tumeda kuue revääri alt paistab ordenitäht.
works.de: Chest portrait of a curly-haired man with sideburns and glasses, in half-profile to the right. An order star is visible under the lapel of a dark coat.

works.d: Esiplaanil raudteetööliste majade tagant paistab keskel Tallinna Balti jaama hoone. Selle taga, puiestiku äärest kerkib Toompea nõlvak, seal asuvate majade reaga, mille lõpus paremal Pika Hermanni torn. Üle majade paistab Toomkiriku katus torniga.
works.de: In the foreground, past the railway workers' houses, the building of Tallinn's Baltic Station is visible in the centre. Behind it, beyond the edge of the boulevard, the slope of Toompea rises, with a row of houses on it, at the end of which, on the right, the Tall Hermann Tower. Above the houses the roof of the Dome Church with its tower is visible.

works.d: Mererohelisel foonil neli alasti naisfiguuri.
works.de: Four nude female figures on a sea-green background.

works.d: Talvine Tartu äärelinna vaade: esiplaanil lumme mattunud tehaseõu, lumiste katustega pikad laohooned. Keskel punakas, mitmejärguline tehase peahoone, korsten selle juures suitsemas. Vasakul ja taamal paremal raagus puud ja põõsad. Ülal kollakas talvine taevas.
works.de: A winter view of a Tartu suburb: in the foreground a factory yard covered in snow, long warehouse buildings with snowy roofs. In the middle a reddish, multi-tiered main factory building, a chimney beside it smoking. On the left and further back on the right, bare trees and bushes. Above, a yellowish winter sky.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul lahekääruna paremale ulatuv järv, millesse paremalt sissetungiva neemiku ninas keskaegses ehituslaadis linnus. Linnusesse viib paremalt poolt kõrgenavalt kaldalt väravaga kindlustatud sildtee. Paremal, kaldaäärsel rajal jahimees koeraga. Vasakult paistab üle järve lumise tipuga mägi. Kergelt pilvises ehapunane taevas peegeldub järve peegelpinnal ja annab süngele linnusele osaliselt rõõmsa punaka värvuse.
works.de: In the foreground on the left a bay-like inlet of a lake extending to the right, with a castle in medieval architectural style at the tip of a headland intruding from the right. A causeway fortified with a gate leads to the castle from the rising shore on the right. On the right, on a path along the shore, a huntsman with a dog. On the left a mountain with a snowy peak is visible across the lake. A slightly cloudy, sunset-red sky is reflected on the mirror-like surface of the lake, giving the gloomy castle a partly cheerful reddish colouring.

works.d: Noore naise rinnapilt end face. Sinised silmad ja heledad juuksed. Lilla kleit, valge lehv.
works.de: Bust portrait of a young woman en face. Blue eyes and light hair. Purple dress, white bow.

works.d: Tuhmis, põhiliselt hallikas koloriidis geomeetriliste pindade kompositsioon; keskplaanil kaks esiletungivat oranzi kvadraati. Pildi keskel tugevalt stiliseeritud naise rinnafiguur.(eesti)
works.de: Composition of geometric surfaces in a dull, mainly greyish colour scheme; in the middle ground two prominent orange squares. In the centre of the picture a strongly stylised female half-figure.

works.d: Noore mehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale ovaalina märgitud taustal. Tumedad juuksed lühikeseks lõigatud, seitel vasakul küljel. Nägu piirabpõskhabe. Rõivastus maalimata.
works.de: Chest portrait of a young man in semi-profile to the right against a background marked as an oval. Dark hair cut short, with a side parting on the left. The face is framed by sideburns. Clothing not painted.

works.d: Keskealise mehe rinnapilt otsevaates. Heledad juuksed ja vurrud. Valge rinnaesine, kaelaside ja püstkrae. Must kuub.
works.de: Bust portrait of a middle-aged man in frontal view. Light hair and moustache. White shirt front, cravat and stand-up collar. Black coat.

works.d: Laua taga istuva prillidega paljaspäise mehe poolfiguur en face. Vasak käsi lebamas laual avatud raamatu kõrval, paremas paberileht. Tagaseinas suur kapp ja pilte.
works.de: Half-figure en face of a bareheaded man with glasses sitting at a table. His left hand rests on the table next to an open book, in his right hand a sheet of paper. A large cupboard and pictures in the back wall.

works.dm: laius: 38.4 cm (papi mõõt   ); kõrgus: 43.2 cm (lm); kõrgus: 44.6 cm (papi mõõt); laius: 37.5 cm (lm)
works.d: Tumedajuukselise pika habemega alasti mehe põlvpilt täisprofiilis vasakule.
works.de: Knee-length portrait of a dark-haired man with a long beard, nude, in full profile to the left.

works.d: Ees hiigelsuure lehtpuu all grupp inimesi einestamas. Nende taga laiuvad küpsest viljast kollendavad põllud. Tagapool, paremal, grupp kummargil viljasidujaid.
works.de: In front, under a huge deciduous tree, a group of people having a meal. Behind them stretch fields yellow with ripe grain. Farther back, on the right, a group of sheaf-binders bent over.

works.d: Maali keskel seisab mees merel. Parem käsi üles tõstetud, vasemaga puudutab pildi paremas nurgas vees lamava mehe pead. Tagaplaanil paremal purjelaevad.
works.de: In the centre of the painting a man stands on the sea. His right hand is raised, with his left he touches the head of a man lying in the water in the right corner of the picture. In the background on the right, sailing ships.

works.d: Tänava ääres kahekorruselised majad. Vasakpoolne, ärklikorrusega maja taraga piiratud.
works.de: Two-storey houses along the street. The one on the left, with an attic floor, is enclosed by a fence.

works.d: Naisakt, parem käsi tõstetud rinnale. Labakäsi puudub. Pea kallutatud paremale. Vasakul serval ornamentaalne joonistus.
works.de: Female nude, right hand raised to the chest. The hand is missing. Head tilted to the right. On the left edge, an ornamental drawing.

works.d: Hallipäise mehe rinnapilt en face, valges pluusis.
works.de: Bust portrait of a grey-haired man en face, in a white blouse.

works.d: Veekogu-äärne kaldanõlv madalate agulimajade, kuuride, raagus puude, poollagunenud plankaiaga sügistuules. Esiplaanil vee ääres naine pesukorviga, hele riie käes lehvimas. Terav kollakas valgus langeb keskmes olevale maja keskel. Akvarellilikult roosakaspruunid toonid.
works.de: A sloping bank by a body of water with low suburban houses, sheds, bare trees, a half-ruined plank fence in the autumn wind. In the foreground by the water, a woman with a laundry basket, a light-coloured cloth fluttering in her hand. A sharp yellowish light falls on the house in the middle. Watercolour-like pinkish-brown tones.

works.d: Esiplaanil kaldaribal ankrus kaks paati, kuni silmapiirini hall meri, paremal vähe tumenev. Kauguses paistavad majaka siluetid. Taevas heledam.
works.de: In the foreground on the shore strip two anchored boats, a grey sea to the horizon, darkening slightly on the right. In the distance the silhouettes of lighthouses can be seen. The sky is lighter.

works.d: Esiplaanil lumiste katustega majad ja puud. Vasakul Oleviste kirik. Tagaplaanil Toompea panoraam.
works.de: In the foreground houses and trees with snowy roofs. On the left the Oleviste Church. In the background a panorama of Toompea.

works.d: Suure habemega vana mehe rinnaportree otsevaates. Seljas rohekaspruun kuub, mille kraed ja rinnaesist katab habe.
works.de: Bust portrait of an old man with a large beard, frontal view. Wearing a greenish-brown coat, its collar and front covered by the beard.

works.d: Esiplaanil keskel madal roheline diagonaalse katusega hoone, mida kolmest küljest ümbritsevad kahekorruselised viilkatusega kivimajad. Taevas hele.
works.de: In the foreground in the middle a low green building with a diagonal roof, surrounded on three sides by two-storey gabled stone houses. The sky is light.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasemal vanamees kokkurullitud riidega õlal ja väike poiss aerudega õlal. Keskel rahvariides naise, lapse ja madruse figuurid. Paremal kaks madrust selgvaates. Nende taga rahvarõivais naisi. Taustaks meri.
works.de: In the foreground on the left an old man with rolled-up cloth on his shoulder and a small boy with oars on his shoulder. In the middle figures of a woman in folk costume, a child and a sailor. On the right two sailors seen from the back. Behind them women in folk costume. Background of the sea.

works.d: Halli taustaga maali keskpinda täidab suur valge, mustade piirjoontega spiraalne kujund. All ja üleval valged, mustade joontega detailid, mis meenutavad kannelüüringut. Spiraalsel kujundil vasakul kollane, paremal punane vööt, paremal ülasfääris paikneb must ebakorrapärane kera.
works.de: The middle of the painting, against a grey background, is filled with a large white spiral form with black outlines. Below and above, white details with black lines resembling a kannel's tuning pegs. On the spiral form, yellow on the left, a red band on the right, and in the upper right sphere a black irregular sphere is placed.

works.d: Kollakaspruunides ja roosades toonides linnatänav: esiplaanil kaks hobust kergete voorimehe troskadega, tumedasse riietatud voorimehed pukis. Tagaplaanil visandlikult antud tänavaäärsete majade rivi. Ülaservas riba kollakashalli taevast.
works.de: City street in yellowish-brown and pink tones: in the foreground two horses with light cabman's droshkies, cabmen dressed in dark clothing on the box. In the background a sketchily rendered row of houses along the street. At the top edge a strip of yellowish-grey sky.

works.d: Esiplaanil pildi sügavusse suunduv kitsas vanalinna tänav majaderägastikuga kahel pool. Vasakul nurgas hall otsaviilu, pilastrite ja kangialustega maja ning heledad punaste katuste ja pikkade korstnatega hooned. Ülal keskel jupike halli taevast. Hallikaspruun koloriit.
works.de: In the foreground, a narrow old-town street receding into the depth of the picture, with a maze of houses on both sides. In the left corner, a grey gable-end house with pilasters and archways, and light-coloured buildings with red roofs and tall chimneys. Above in the middle, a patch of grey sky. Greyish-brown colouring.

works.d: Sinakat tooni rätikul tume pudel ja kaks õuna.(eesti)
works.de: On a bluish-toned cloth, a dark bottle and two apples.

works.d: Esiplaanil tee, kaugemal puude vahel talumajad.
works.de: Road in the foreground, farmhouses among trees further away.

works.d: Pikkade pruunide juuste ja vurrudega keskealise mehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale.(eesti)
works.de: Chest portrait of a middle-aged man with long brown hair and a moustache, in half-profile to the right.

works.d: Rannaliival paat tagantvaates, pöördega paremale, toega vasemal. Taga vasemal tõusev kallas kahe põõsaga ja paremal veepind, mille lähedal liival ankur. Taamal vasakul, lageda rannariba taga mets.(eesti)
works.de: A boat on the beach sand, seen from behind, turned to the right, with a support on the left. Behind on the left a rising bank with two bushes, and on the right a water surface, near which an anchor lies on the sand. In the distance on the left, beyond a bare strip of shore, a forest.

works.d: Sinakasrohelistes ja kollastes toonides maastiku foonil seisev ja istuv meesakt. Seisva akti parem käsi kõverdatud kuklale, vasakus käes valge rätik. Istuva akti parem käsi toetub vasakule õlale, pea kergelt kallutatud, silmad suletud.(eesti)
works.de: A standing and a sitting male nude against a landscape background in bluish-green and yellow tones. The standing nude's right hand is bent behind the neck, a white towel in the left hand. The sitting nude's right hand rests on the left shoulder, head slightly tilted, eyes closed.

works.d: Esiplaanil külavahetee, mida kahelt poolt piirab roigasaed. Sellest vasakul üksik puu ja tuuleveski keset koplit, taamal taluhoone. Esiplaanil paremal õlgkatusega taluhooned puudega nende taga. Taevas tume, pilvine. Maalitud kohati pastoosselt, rohelistes ja pruunides toonides.
works.de: In the foreground a village road, bordered on both sides by a pole fence. To its left a solitary tree and a windmill in the middle of a paddock, in the distance a farm building. In the foreground on the right, thatched-roof farm buildings with trees behind them. The sky dark, cloudy. Painted in places pastosely, in green and brown tones.

works.d: Laua ääres istuva lapse portree otsevaates. Lapse lauale toetuvate käte ees joogitass alustassil. Pildi kuju ovaalne.
works.de: Portrait of a child sitting at a table, frontal view. In front of the child's hands resting on the table a cup of tea on a saucer. The picture is oval in shape.

works.d: Puudega piiratud lagendik, kus esiplaanil punased lehmad, vasakul tütarlapse figuur. Eemalt puude vahelt paistavad majakatused.
works.de: A clearing bordered by trees, with red cows in the foreground and a girl's figure on the left. House roofs visible in the distance through the trees.

works.d: Valge padjaga pahmeks muudetud istmel istub lühikeste, lahkukammitud juustega tütarlaps, pea pisut paremale kallutatud, pilk vaatajale suunatud. Tüdrukul seljas valge kraega tumesinise põhjaga väikesemustrilisest riidest kleit, ees valge põll. Tüdruku süles magab pisike kollakashall, triibuline, valge kõhualusega kass. Tüdruku vasak käsi kassi seljal. Foon sulavates veinpunastes ja rohelistes toonides.
works.de: On a seat made shapeless by a white cushion sits a girl with short, parted-combed hair, her head tilted slightly to the right, her gaze directed at the viewer. The girl wears a dress of small-patterned fabric with a dark blue ground and a white collar, and a white apron in front. In the girl's lap sleeps a small yellowish-grey, striped cat with a white underbelly, asleep. The girl's left hand rests on the cat's back. The background is in blending wine-red and green tones.

works.d: Ees vasakul lage maastik, paremal nõlvak ja eest taha paremale suunduv tee kahe kihutava ratsanikuga.
works.de: Open landscape on the left in the foreground, a slope on the right and a road leading from the front to the right into the depth with two galloping riders.

works.d: Hallide juuste, terava nina ja lõuaga tumedas jakis vana naise rinnaportree veerandpöördes vasakule. Ninal peenete tumedate raamidega prillid, mille helkivate klaaside tagant on vaevu silmi näha. Maalitud pühkivas, kontuurehajutavas maneeris.
works.de: Bust portrait of an old woman with grey hair, a sharp nose and chin, in a dark jacket, in a quarter-turn to the left. Spectacles with thin dark frames on the nose, through whose glinting lenses the eyes are barely visible. Painted in a sweeping, contour-blurring manner.

works.d: Esiplaanil oja kaldal vasakul ja paremal kased, tagaplaanil mets.
works.de: In the foreground birches on the left and right bank of a stream, forest in the background.

works.d: Kahe-osaline kompositsioon värvitud plekkpurkidest puitraamistuses. Ülemisel, helesinisel taustal üks terve ja pool kuuekandilise numbrilauaga kella, must kontuur, värvilised osutid. Alumisel osal oranžil taustal valgega kiri SEIS peegeldusega, selle all elektronkella näit 2106. Allääres kollasel taustal number 2016.
works.de: Two-part composition in painted tin cans within a wooden frame. On the upper, light blue background one whole and half of a clock with a hexagonal dial, black contour, coloured hands. On the lower part, on an orange background, the word SEIS [STOP] in white with a reflection, below it the reading of an electronic clock 2106. At the bottom edge, on a yellow background, the number 2016.

works.dm: laius: 73.5 cm; kõrgus: 96.1 cm (arm.   ); kõrgus: 96.0 cm; laius: 73.4 cm (arm.   )
works.d: Eest paremalt diagonaalis taha vasakule suunduva tänava ääres majaderivi. Taga paistab üle majade õigeusu kiriku katus ja tornikiiver. Taevas pilvine.
works.de: In the front, from the right, a diagonal street leading to the back left lined with a row of houses. Behind, over the houses, the roof and spire of an Orthodox church can be seen. Sky cloudy.

works.d: Künklik panoraammaastik: esiplaanil paremal kaks pruuni katusega maja, nende taga puud. Majadest paremalt kulgeb küngaste vahele tee. Mäekuplite vahel rohelised metsatukad, silmapiiril keskel suurem metsaga kaetud mägi. Taevas tume ja pilvine. Maalitud tumedates külmrohelistes ja hallides toonides, "sezannistlikult".
works.de: A hilly panoramic landscape: in the foreground on the right two houses with brown roofs, trees behind them. From the houses a road runs to the right between the hills. Green clumps of forest between the hill tops, a larger forest-covered mountain in the centre of the horizon. The sky dark and cloudy. Painted in dark cold-green and grey tones, in a "Cézannist" manner.

works.d: Hallikas-pruunikas gammas maalitud hoovinurk: kahel pool kõrgemad majad, mille vahelt tara tagant tõusevad raagus puud, majakatus ja rohekad kuuseladvad. Oksade konkretiseerimiseks värvikihti pintsliotsaga süvendatud.
works.de: Painted in a greyish-brownish gamut, a courtyard corner: on both sides taller houses, between which, behind a fence, bare trees rise, a house roof and greenish spruce tops. To render the branches the paint layer has been incised with the tip of the brush.

works.d: Hall veekogu laevaga esiplanil, mille vari langeb veepinnale. Samas paate, kaugemal purjekaid. Vastaskallas laugjas.
works.de: Grey body of water with a boat in the foreground, its shadow falling on the water's surface. Also boats, sailboats further away. Opposite shore is flat.

works.d: Naise rinnapilt poolprofiilis vasemale. Juustel diadeem, sügava dekolteega kleidil poolkuukujuline rinnanõel.
works.de: Bust portrait of a woman in half-profile to the left. A diadem in her hair, on her deep-cut dress a crescent-shaped brooch.

works.d: Halli fooni taustal on lauale asetatud kaks vaasi kirjute lillede ja okstega. Vaasidest eespool kaks rohelist õuna. Väga pastoosne maalimismaneer, määrdunud-summutatud värvitoonid.(eesti)
works.de: Against a grey background, two vases with colourful flowers and branches are placed on a table. In front of the vases two green apples. Very pastose painting manner, dirty-muted colour tones.

works.d: Toolil istuva mehe põlvpilt poolprofiilis paremale, käed toetumas tooli käsipuudele. Vasak käsi hoidmas süles olevat silindrit. Taustaks suurem lehtpuu ja selle tagant paistev põõsastik.
works.de: Knee-length portrait of a man seated on a chair, in three-quarter profile facing right, hands resting on the arms of the chair. The left hand holds a top hat in his lap. In the background a large deciduous tree and, behind it, visible shrubbery.

works.d: Esiplaanil lage veepind, taga künklik kallas metsaga.
works.de: In the foreground an open water surface, behind it a hilly shore with forest.

works.d: Ühtlase tumeda sinakashalli tausta keskel hele, valkjasbeezis toonis pikkade helepruunide lehvivate juustega naisakt poolpöördes paremale. Figuuri ülakeha veidi ette painutatud, käes ees kõrval, pihkudega alla suunatud. Istmik ja vasak kõverdatud jalg toetuvad hallikaspruunile kaljunukile, parem jalg sirgelt alla libistatud. Naise tõstetud peas kuldne kroon, ehmunud-vihane pilk suunatud üleõla.
works.de: In the centre of an even dark bluish-grey background, a light, whitish-beige-toned female nude with long light brown flowing hair, half-turned to the right. The figure's upper body bent slightly forward, hands out to the side, palms turned down. The seat and the bent left leg rest on a greyish-brown rock outcrop, the right leg slid straight down. On the woman's raised head a golden crown, a startled-angry gaze directed over the shoulder.

works.d: Tumedajuukselise, hõreda põskhabemega keskealise mehe rinnapilt en face.
works.de: Bust portrait of a middle-aged man with dark hair and sparse side-whiskers, en face.

works.dm: laius: 50.0 cm (ovaal  ); kõrgus: 61.0 cm; kõrgus: 60.0 cm (ovaal); laius: 51.0 cm
works.d: Ovaali maalitud mehe portree vaatega paremale, lühikesed siledalt tahapoole kammitud juuksed, vuntsid ja põskhabe. Foon hallikas, õlgade kohal pruunikat.
works.de: Oval painted portrait of a man looking to the right, short hair combed smoothly back, moustache and side-whiskers. Background greyish, brownish above the shoulders.

works.d: Esiplaanil viljapõld hakkidega. Vasakul üksik suur pihlakas. Tagaplaanil meri.
works.de: In the foreground a grain field with stooks. On the left a single large rowan tree. In the background the sea.

works.d: Aknaaluse töölaua ääres istuv-töötav prillidega poolkiilaspäine vuntsidega töömees profiilis paremale. Mehel ülekeeratud käistega sinine särk, põll ees. Hoogne, visandlikult markeeriv maalilaad.
works.de: A half-bald, moustached workman with glasses, sitting-working by a worktable under a window, in profile facing right. The man wears a blue shirt with rolled-up sleeves and an apron. A vigorous, sketchily gestural painting style.

works.d: Ühtlaselt sügavpunaseks maalitud foonil keskel ema, laps süles. Maalitud räigetes sinistes, kollastes, rohelistes toonides äärmiselt ekspressiivsete laiade pastoossete pintslilöökidega figuure ja nägusid markeerides. Punasel foonil väljaspool figuure abstraktsed pastoossed värvilaigud.
works.de: On a uniformly deep-red painted background, in the middle a mother with a child on her lap. Figures and faces painted in glaring blue, yellow and green tones with extremely expressive broad pastose brushstrokes. On the red background outside the figures, abstract pastose patches of colour.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul kivine lahesopp üksiku paadiga kalda lähedal, selle juures inimfiguur, paremal veepiiri lähedalt liivane rannariba kivide vahele kaldale veetud paadiga. Paremal keskel niidul üksik suurem puu ja vasakule suunduv roigasaed, mille lõpp-punktiks õlgkatusega hoone. Vasakul horisondil piirab lahesoppi sinav rannaviirg.
works.de: In the foreground on the left a rocky bay with a lone boat near the shore, beside it a human figure; on the right, near the waterline, a sandy strip of shore with a boat pulled ashore among the stones. In the middle right, on a meadow, a single larger tree and a pole fence leading to the left, ending at a thatched-roof building. On the left the horizon is bordered by a bluish coastal strip closing off the bay.

works.d: Paremal meri, vasakul kivine rand paadiga ja võrgukuivatamise puudega.
works.de: On the right the sea, on the left a rocky shore with a boat and net-drying poles.

works.d: Realistlikus laadis maalil suures plaanis laudpingil suudlevad noored. Prillidega pruunide juuste ja pruuni pintsakuga noormees istub ning hoiab paremas käes avatud punast vihmavarju. Teine käsi on ümber poisi süles lebava noore naise kaela. Noormehe jalad on põimitud ümber neiu keha. Jalas sinised teksad ning mustad ketsid. Neiu pea on 3/4 pöördes üles, pilk silmanurgast piidlemas vaatajat. Tema juuksed on heledad, seljas tume kleit ja valkjas-hallikas mantel. Kleit on eest avatud, paljastades osaliselt rinna, ka reied on katmata. Taustaks on tumehall kivimüür, pruunikas maapind. Tüdruku kõrval pingil on väike valge udusulg.
works.de: In a realistic style, the painting shows in close-up a young couple kissing on a wooden bench. A young man with glasses, brown hair and a brown jacket is sitting and holding an open red umbrella in his right hand. His other arm is around the neck of a young woman lying in his lap. The young man's legs are wrapped around the girl's body. He is wearing blue jeans and black sneakers. The girl's head is turned 3/4 upward, her gaze glancing at the viewer from the corner of her eye. Her hair is light-coloured, she is wearing a dark dress and a whitish-grey coat. The dress is open at the front, partially revealing her breast, and her thighs are also uncovered. The background is a dark grey stone wall, brownish ground. Next to the girl on the bench is a small white down feather.

works.d: Rohekates toonides, pastoosselt maalitud fooni taustal väikest kübarat kandva pruunide, õlgadele langevate juustega noore naise rinnaportree, poolpöördes vasakule. Paremas käes heleroosa roos. Maalipind pastoosene; koloriit rohalistes toonides.(eesti)
works.de: Bust portrait of a young woman wearing a small hat, with brown hair falling to her shoulders, in three-quarter turn to the left, against a pastosely painted background in greenish tones. In her right hand a light pink rose. The paint surface is pastose; the colouring is in greenish tones.

works.d: Hallides toonides Toomkiriku vaade kirikut ümbritsevate madalate, punaste katustega majadega. Esiplaanil rohuga kaetud õu ja kaks kana. Majade taga vasakul paistavad kollakasroheliste lehtedega puukroonid. Suure osa foonist katab erksinine, tihedalt hallide pilvedega kaetud taevas.(eesti)
works.de: A view of the Cathedral in grey tones, with the low, red-roofed houses surrounding the church. In the foreground a grass-covered yard and two hens. Behind the houses on the left, tree crowns with yellowish-green leaves can be seen. A large part of the background is covered by a bright blue sky densely covered with grey clouds.

works.d: Valge astmeline lameda katusega maja sinise taeva taustal.
works.de: White stepped flat-roofed house against a blue sky background.

works.d: Keset lagedat välja pasteldes mehe täisfiguur labidaga, vasakul pooleli ehitatud hoone kahe mehega, horisondil mets.
works.de: In the middle of an open field, in pastel, a full figure of a man with a spade, on the left a building under construction with two men, forest on the horizon.

works.d: Pastoosselt, laiade jämedate pintslitõmmetega maalitud maastik kirgastes värvitoonides. Geometriseeritud vormid on maalitud pea ühe pintslitõmbega, ümardatud vormid (puudekroonid) aga piiritletud põhitooniga kontrasteeruvates värvitoonides jämedate kontuuridega. Esiplaanil kergelt künklik taluõu mitme värvitooniga ning varjuga rohukattega. Tagaplaanil frontaalselt vaatajaga, vasakul tihe salu kaharate ümarate kroonidega lehtpuudest, paremal osa punakaspruunides toonides aidast mustade ukse- ja aknaavadega.
works.de: A landscape painted pastosely, with broad, thick brushstrokes in bright colour tones. The geometricized forms are painted with almost a single brushstroke, while the rounded forms (tree crowns) are delineated with thick contours in colour tones contrasting with the main tone. In the foreground, a slightly hilly farmyard with grass cover in several colour tones and shadow. In the background, facing the viewer, on the left a dense grove of deciduous trees with broad rounded crowns, on the right part of a barn in reddish-brown tones with black door and window openings.

works.d: Tervet maali kattev kohkunud ilmega, veidi punnis- pruunisilmne habeme ja vuntsidega mehe nägu otsevaates. Heleda juuksetüükaga kaetud pea, kortsus otsmik, veidi paokil suu. Kollasetriibuline särgikaelus pisut paistmas. Valge, oranži, pruunikaga maalitud nägu, ooker-kollane taust. Popilik kujutamisviis. Paremal äärel allpool kiri ülalt alla: VANAMEES.
works.de: The whole painting is covered by the frontal face of a startled-looking, slightly bulging brown-eyed man with a beard and moustache, viewed frontally. Head covered with light hair stubble, wrinkled forehead, mouth slightly ajar. A yellow-striped shirt collar showing slightly. The face painted in white, orange and brownish tones, ochre-yellow background. A pop-like manner of depiction. On the right edge below, an inscription reading from top to bottom: VANAMEES.

works.d: Esiplaanil madalad hooned, mille taga lehtpuud. Eemal sinakashall veekogu, millel jahid. Vastaskallas laugjas.
works.de: In the foreground low buildings, behind which deciduous trees. In the distance a bluish-grey body of water with yachts. The opposite shore is low.

works.d: Esiplaanil keskel suurte tumeroheliste puude grupp, mille taga lillakassinine jõgi. Jõe ääres, puudest paremal, üksik kübaras mees kala püüdmas. Taamal metsatukad ja niidud, vasakul grupp valgeid punaste katustega maju. Silmapiiril tumesinine viirg, ülal tume, ähvardavailmeline taevas.
works.de: In the foreground, centre, a group of large dark green trees, behind which a purplish-blue river. By the river, to the right of the trees, a solitary man in a hat fishing. In the distance, patches of forest and meadows, on the left a group of white houses with red roofs. On the horizon a dark blue streak, above a dark, ominous-looking sky.

works.d: Veekogu kitsa madala poolsaarega, millel grupp inimesi. Ees paremal tükike rohu ja põõsastega kaetud kallast. Veekogul purjekad. Vastaskallas laugjas.
works.de: A body of water with a narrow low peninsula on which a group of people stands. In the foreground on the right a piece of shore covered with grass and bushes. Sailboats on the water. The opposite shore is gently sloping.

From the record a hand extends, pointing to an arm below the record clenched into a fist with a twisted cord and a stick, another hand on the left pointing in the same direction. In the background a domed landscape with lake eyes and a sky with blue clouds.

works.d: Valdavalt ookerkollastes, tumepunastes toonides maastikuvaade hallika veekoguga esiplaanil. Üle vee vasakul paar pajupuud, kaldanõlval punakate lääpas katustega hooned, künka tipul kähar puu. Poolläbipaistev pühkemaneeris tehnika.
works.de: A landscape view predominantly in ochre-yellow, dark red tones with a greyish body of water in the foreground. Over the water on the left a couple of willow trees, on the slope of the bank buildings with reddish hipped roofs, a curly tree on the top of a hill. Semi-transparent technique in a sweeping manner.

works.d: Heledal taustal kaks hallikates hajutatud toonides kõrvuti seisva mehe figuuri otsevaates. Realistlikult on maalitud meeste paljad labajalad.
works.de: On a light background, two frontal figures of men standing side by side in dispersed greyish tones. The men's bare feet are painted realistically.

works.de: In the first part: An abstract composition from the lower left in dark red tones, which as they rise turn into lighter ones ending at the top with yellow.

works.d: Lillakassinkja taeva all tumeroheline hämar maastik aimatava veekoguga paremal. Ees erksavärviline oranž-kollane maapind, keskel püramiidne tumeroheline puu. Ekspressiivne kujutamisviis.
works.de: Under a lilac-bluish sky a dark green, dim landscape with a hinted body of water on the right. In front, brightly coloured orange-yellow ground, in the middle a pyramid-shaped dark green tree. Expressive manner of depiction.

works.d: Intensiivsetes rohelistes toonides põõsaste ja puude grupid nende vahelt paistva tumesinise taeva taustal. Esiplaanil, puude-põõsaste ees kirev oranži-ookertoonides lage ala.

works.de: A bust portrait of an elderly man against a blackish background, wearing light and dark blue clothing with an open collar. The sitter's head is turned slightly to the right, his hair is thin, but a dark beard covers most of the lower part of his face. His expression is sombre, his serious gaze crowned by light eyebrows.

works.d: Heledal taustal seljaga vaataja poole kandadel kükitava mehe tumedates toonides alastifiguur, pea pööratud poolprofiilis paremale.
works.de: Against a light background, a dark-toned nude figure of a man crouching on his heels with his back to the viewer, head turned in profile to the right.

works.d: Erksates värvides linnavaade, majade ees kaldale tõmmatud paadid, taustal rohekas sinine mägi helerohelise taeva all.
works.de: A cityscape in vivid colours, boats pulled up on the shore in front of the houses, a greenish blue mountain in the background under a light green sky.

works.d: Sinistest-punastest pindadest ulmeline ruum perspektiivis. Keskmes laua taga tõstetud kätega alasti naisfiguur, sinised laines juuksed lehvimas üle maali.
works.de: A fantastical space made of blue-red planes, in perspective. At the center, behind a table, a nude female figure with raised arms, blue wavy hair fluttering across the painting.

works.d: Visand merre ulatuvast neemest, millel paremal pool kuuskede vahel väike majake.
works.de: Sketch of a headland extending into the sea, with a small house among spruces on the right side.
