works.de: An emerald-green painted surface divided by a cord into ten equal vertical stripes, of which the outermost right one is painted, with an uneven brush-bristle stroke from top to bottom, a mother-of-pearl grey. The other divisions are covered with white, directed upward. The painting is surrounded on the sides by a regular row of nails covered with paint.

works.de: A string stretched diagonally on canvas forms triangular shapes on the painted surface. The white background is painted with uneven vertical brush strokes in pink, so that the ground shows through. A regular row of paint-covered nails runs around the sides of the painting.

works.de: A string stretched diagonally across the canvas forms an acute angle at the left and upper edge of the painting. The white background is painted with uneven pink brushstrokes so that the underlying surface shows through. Around the edges of the painting a regular row of nails covered with paint.

works.de: A string stretched diagonally across the canvas forms an acute angle at the left of the painting and two acute angles at the upper edge. The white background is painted with uneven vertical brush-bristle strokes of pink so that the underlying surface shows through. The sides of the painting are covered all around with paint.

works.de: A cord stretched diagonally on the canvas forms an acute angle at all edges of the painting. The white background is painted with uneven vertical pink brush-bristle strokes so that the underlying surface shows through. Around the sides of the painting a regular row of nails covered with paint.

works.de: A string stretched diagonally across the canvas forms an acute angle at the top, bottom and right edges of the painting. The white background is painted with uneven vertical brush-bristle strokes of pink so that the underlying surface shows through. A regular row of nails covered with paint runs around the sides of the painting.

works.de: A string stretched diagonally across the canvas forms one acute angle at the left edge of the painting and two at the bottom edge. The white background is painted with uneven vertical brush-bristle strokes of pink so that the background shows through. A regular row of nails covered with paint runs around the sides of the painting.

works.d: Lõuendi kollane taust valgega korrapäraste laiade paaris pintsli-harjatõmmetega risti-põiki ruuduliseks maalitud nii, et kollasest taustast paistab kolm paralleelset vertikaalset triipu.
works.de: A yellow ground on the canvas painted crosswise with white, regular, wide paired brush-bristle strokes into a checkered pattern, so that three parallel vertical stripes of the yellow ground show through.

works.dm: kõrgus: 131.0 cm; laius: 100.0 cm (alusraam); kõrgus: 125.0 cm (alusraam); laius: 106.0 cm
