works.de: The yellow background of the canvas painted crosswise with regular broad paired brush-bristle strokes in white to form a checkered pattern, so that four yellow horizontal stripes are visible. Around the sides of the painting a regular row of nails covered with paint.

works.dm: kõrgus: 131.0 cm; laius: 100.0 cm (alusraam); kõrgus: 125.0 cm (alusraam); laius: 106.0 cm
works.d: Lõuendi kollane taust korrapäraste laiade paaris pintsli-harjatõmmetega risti-põiki valgega ruuduliseks maalitud nii, et kolm kollast paralleelset vertikaaltriipu nähtaval on. Maali külgedel ümberringi värvitud naelte korrapärane rida.
works.de: The yellow background of the canvas is painted in a checkered pattern with regular broad paired brush-bristle strokes crosswise in white, so that three yellow parallel vertical stripes remain visible. Around the edges of the painting a regular row of painted nails.

works.dm: kõrgus: 131.0 cm; laius: 100.0 cm (ausraam); kõrgus: 125.0 cm (alusraam); laius: 106.0 cm
works.d: Lõuendi kollane taust korrapäraste laiade paaris pintsli-harjatõmmetega risti-põiki valgega ruuduliseks maalitud nii, et maali ülaosas kolm kollast vertikaaltriipu, allpool kaks lühemat horisontaaltriipu nähtaval on. Maali külgedel ümberringi värviga kaetud naelte korrapärane rida.
works.de: The canvas's yellow background is painted with regular wide paired brush-bristle strokes crosswise into a checkered pattern with white, so that in the upper part of the painting three yellow vertical stripes are visible, and below two shorter horizontal stripes. On the sides of the painting, all around, a regular row of nails covered with paint.

works.dm: kõrgus: 131.0 cm; laius: 100.0 cm (alusraam); kõrgus: 125.0 cm (alusraam); laius: 100.0 cm
works.d: Lõuendi kollane taust korrapäraste laiade pintsli-harjatõmmetega risti-rästi valgega ruuduliseks maalitud nii, et maali keskel kolm kollast vertikaaltriipu nähtaval on. Maali ümbritseb külgedel värviga kaetud naelte korrapärane rida.
works.de: The yellow background of the canvas is painted crosswise in a checkered pattern with regular broad brush strokes in white, so that three yellow vertical stripes remain visible in the centre of the painting. The painting is bordered on the sides by a regular row of nails covered with paint.

works.d: Hämaras ruumis klaveri taga musitseeriv noor mees külgvaates, käed klahvidel, pea pööratud vaatajale. Mehel ümar laup, pisut punnis silmad. Tumeda pintsaku alt hele kaelus paistmas. Tausta interjöör maalitud laiade mehaaniliste täppivate tõmmetega imiteerides klaveril asetseva oranži lambi värelevat kuma. Valdavalt tumedad sinkjaslillad, rohekad mürgised toonid.
works.de: In a dim room, a young man making music at a piano, seen in side view, hands on the keys, head turned towards the viewer. The man has a rounded forehead, slightly bulging eyes. A light-coloured collar shows beneath the dark jacket. The interior background is painted with broad, mechanical, precise strokes imitating the flickering glow of an orange lamp standing on the piano. Predominantly dark bluish-purple, greenish poisonous tones.

works.d: Heledapäise noore naise poolfiguur tugitoolis istumas veerandpöördes paremale, käed süles. Naise pea pisut rinnal, pilk vaatajale suunatud. Seljas hele kleit, lopsakas hele sall õlgadel. Taustal tubane interjöör klaveriga, nipsasju sellel. Värvikas maalilaad, domineerivad erksad rohekad, sinkjaslillad toonid.
works.de: Half-figure of a fair-haired young woman sitting in an armchair, turned a quarter to the right, hands in her lap. The woman's head is slightly lowered towards her chest, gaze directed at the viewer. She wears a light-coloured dress, a lush light-coloured shawl on her shoulders. In the background a room interior with a piano, knick-knacks on it. Colourful painting style, dominated by bright greenish, bluish-purple tones.

works.dm: kõrgus: 40.1 cm (A-pool); laius: 40.1 cm (B-pool); kõrgus: 32.5 cm (B-pool); laius: 32.5 cm (A-pool)
works.d: Tumedajuukselise naise portree. Teisel poolel seened ja sinine anum linikul
works.de: Portrait of a dark-haired woman. On the other side mushrooms and a blue vessel on a cloth

works.t: Kompositsioon võtme ja lusikaga (Composition with Key and Spoon)
works.d: Lainelise horisontaaljoonega punaseks ja mustaks jaotuv, üleni värviga kaetud assamblaaž. Punasele osale kinnitatud värvitud puitklots, puitliist ja kaks ümmargust metallist tehnilist detaili. Mustale osale kinnitatud puitliist, puitklots, plastmassist tehniline detail, lusikas ja võti, mille rõngaava värvitud valgeks. Assamblaaži värvipind läikiv, kaetud ühtlaselt krakleega.
works.de: An assemblage entirely covered with paint, divided by a wavy horizontal line into red and black. Attached to the red part a painted wooden block, a wooden batten and two round metal technical parts. Attached to the black part a wooden batten, a wooden block, a plastic technical part, a spoon and a key, whose ring opening is painted white. The painted surface of the assemblage is glossy, evenly covered with craquelure.

works.d: Ühtlase ultramariinsinise tausta keskel roostepruun võrdkülgne kolmnurk tipuga ülal, mille parem alumine nurk maha lõigatud. Pinnaline selgepiiriline kujutamisviis.
works.de: In the middle of an even ultramarine blue background a rust-brown equilateral triangle with the apex up, whose lower right corner is cut off. A flat, clearly outlined manner of depiction.

works.d: Ultramariinsinise tausta keskel roostepruun võrdkülgne kolmnurk, mille kaks alumist nurka ära lõigatud. Selgepiiriline kujutamisviis.
works.de: In the centre of an ultramarine blue background, a rust-brown equilateral triangle with its two lower corners cut off. Clear-outlined manner of depiction.

works.d: Ultramariinsinise tausta keskel roostepruun võrdkülgne kolmnurk, mille kõik nurgad ära lõigatud. Selgepiiriline kujutamisviis.
works.de: In the centre of an ultramarine-blue background a rust-brown equilateral triangle with all corners cut off. Clearly defined manner of depiction.

works.d: Sinistes toonides abstraktne kompositsioon, mille moodustavad ebaühtlased laiad pintsli-harjatõmbed nii, et tumesiniste kraapsude alt paistavad helesinised ja valkjad laigud.
works.de: An abstract composition in blue tones formed by uneven wide brush-bristle strokes, such that light blue and whitish patches show through beneath the dark blue scratches.

works.dm: kõrgus: 108.0 cm; laius: 106.0 cm (koos naeltega); kõrgus: 114.0 cm (koos naeltega); laius: 100.0 cm
works.d: Sini-punases toonis abstraktne kompositsioon, kus lillakassinisel taustal korallpunasega maalitud laiad vonklevad kujundid, mis omakorda ühtlaste vertikaaltriipudega kaetud. Alusraamis külgedel väljaulatuvad naelad.
works.de: An abstract composition in blue-red tones, where against a purplish-blue background broad winding shapes are painted in coral red, which are in turn covered with even vertical stripes. Protruding nails on the sides of the stretcher frame.

works.dm: kõrgus: 108.0 cm; laius: 106.0 cm (koos naeltega); kõrgus: 114.0 cm (koos naeltega); laius: 100.0 cm
works.d: Abstraktne kompositsioon sinise ja pruuniga. Lillakassinine taust risti-rästi üle maalitud laiade pintsli-harja tõmmetega khakipruuniks võrgustikuks nii, et sinised laigud läbi kumavad. Maali külgedel kuus naela välja turritamas.
works.de: Abstract composition in blue and brown. A purplish-blue background painted over crosswise with wide brush-strokes into a khaki-brown network, so that the blue patches shine through. On the sides of the painting six nails protruding.

works.dm: kõrgus: 178.0 cm; laius: 106.0 cm (koos naeltega); kõrgus: 184.0 cm (koos naeltega); laius: 100.0 cm
works.d: Abstraktne kompositsioon erineva raadiusega ringjoonte lõikumisel tekkinud kujunditest. Ebaühtlaselt maalitud sinistel vertikaaltriipudel domineerivad ringidest kujund maali ülemises osas ja kaks mustjat kolmnurka tippudega keskmes. Sini-must-valge koloriit üksikute kuldsete triipudega. Maali kulgedel värviga kaetud eenduvad naelad.
works.de: An abstract composition of shapes formed by the intersection of circular lines of varying radius. On unevenly painted blue vertical stripes, a shape formed of circles dominates the upper part of the painting, along with two blackish triangles with their tips meeting in the centre. A blue-black-white colour scheme with a few golden stripes. Along the edges of the painting, protruding nails covered with paint.

works.dm: kõrgus: 178.0 cm; laius: 106.0 cm (koos naeltega); kõrgus: 184.0 cm (koos naeltega); laius: 100.0 cm
works.d: Valgel taustal mustade ebaühtlaste joontega sirkli-meetodil maalitud kahe poolringi lõikumisel tekkinud kujund nii, et ringi keskmed kahel pool külgedel. Maali vasakul äärel ühtlaselt mustjassinine vertikaalne pind. Maali külgedel värviga kaetud eenduvad naelad.
works.de: On a white background, a form created by circle-drawn (compass-method) intersecting black uneven lines of two semicircles, so that the centres of the circles lie on either side. Along the left edge of the painting a uniformly blackish-blue vertical surface. On the sides of the painting, protruding nails covered with paint.

works.dm: kõrgus: 125.0 cm; laius: 106.0 cm (koos naeltega); kõrgus: 131.0 cm (koos naeltega); laius: 100.0 cm
works.d: Kollane taust valgete laiade pintsli-harjatõmmetega korrapäraselt triipudeks maalitud nii, et ülal 8 võrdset vertikaalset jaotust, allpool põikitriibud. Valgete pindade peale paigutatud korrapäraselt punaste numbrite templijäljed. Maali külgedel kollasega värvitud eenduvate naelte rida.
works.de: A yellow background painted regularly into stripes with wide white brush-bristle strokes so that above there are 8 equal vertical divisions, below cross stripes. On the white areas, regularly placed stamped impressions of red numbers. On the sides of the painting a row of protruding nails painted yellow.

works.dm: kõrgus: 125.0 cm; laius: 106.0 cm (koos naeltega); kõrgus: 131.0 cm (koos naeltega); laius: 100.0 cm
works.d: Roheline taust valgete laiade pintsli-harjatõmmetega kaheksaks vertikaaltriibuks maalitud, keskel kaks põiki jaotust. Valgete pindade peale punaste numbrite templijäljed korrapäraselt paigutatud. Maali külgedel roheliseks värvitud naelte rida.
works.de: Green background painted with wide white brush-strokes into eight vertical stripes, with two crosswise divisions in the middle. Stamped impressions of red numbers regularly arranged on the white surfaces. A row of nails painted green along the sides of the painting.

works.d: Sinistes toonides tausta keskel valge tuuletiivik illusoorses liikumises. Vasakul ülanurgas väiksem tiivik heledas sõõris.
works.de: Against a background in blue tones, in the middle a white wind vane in illusory motion. In the upper left corner a smaller vane in a light disc.

works.d: Keskel esiplaanil avatud raamat, rohelised sibulad ja punased marjad, paremal vaas punaste lilledega, vasakul pudel ja plekknõu.
works.de: In the middle foreground an open book, green onions and red berries, on the right a vase with red flowers, on the left a bottle and a tin vessel.

works.d: Mustjates üleminekutoonides kuplilisel taustal valdavalt kollastes, oranžides värvides ümarate nurkadega abstraktsetest kujunditest kuhi. Selgepiiriline dekoratiivne kujutamisviis.
works.de: On a domed background in blackish transitional tones, a heap of abstract shapes with rounded corners, predominantly in yellow and orange colours. A clearly outlined decorative manner of depiction.

works.d: Militaarsete sümbolitega (viisnurgad, nööbid, pagunid) dekoreeritud kolm teravatipulist kujundit üksteise vastas helesinise laotuse taustal. Roosakaspunane valgete laikudega kera nende kohal. Allosas tankide ja suurtükkidega illusoorne maastik.
works.de: Three sharp-pointed shapes decorated with military symbols (five-pointed stars, buttons, epaulettes) facing one another against a light blue expanse background. A pinkish-red sphere with white spots above them. In the lower part an illusory landscape with tanks and cannons.

works.d: Selgepiirilistest geomeetrilistest kujunditest heledavärviline kompositsioon, kus domineerivad diagonaalselt üle maali paigutatud kuus valget ringi.
works.de: A light-coloured composition of clearly defined geometric shapes, dominated by six white circles arranged diagonally across the painting.

works.d: Kahvatu laotuse all kuplilised luited sürreaalsete (silmamuna, labajalg, loomakolju) kujunditega. Vasakul hõljumas  korviga triibuline õhupall.
works.de: Under a pale sky, domed dunes with surreal shapes (an eyeball, a foot, an animal skull). On the left a striped hot air balloon with a basket floats.

works.d: Mustade kulissidega piiratud hallitriibulisel näilisel laval kaks sürreaalset figuuri vastastikku. Vasakpoolne raudrüüd meenutavas varustuses, paremal värvilistest lappidest kombineeritud kuju.
works.de: On an ostensible stage bounded by black wings with grey stripes, two surreal figures face each other. The figure on the left in gear reminiscent of armour, on the right a figure composed of coloured patches.

works.d: Tumesinisel taustal näiliselt lendlevatest selgepiirilistest, justkui volditud abstraktsetest kujunditest kuhi.
works.de: On a dark blue background a pile of seemingly floating, sharply outlined, as if folded abstract shapes.

works.dm: kõrgus: 46.3 cm; sügavus: 3.5 cm; laius: 38.5 cm
works.d: Mustal taustal sidemesse mässitud peaga sürreaalne poolfiguur, üle õla visatud erkpunase usskraega roheline mustriline rõivas.
works.de: Against a black background, a surreal half-figure with its head wrapped in bandages, wearing a green patterned garment with a bright red ruff collar thrown over the shoulder.

works.d: Sinkjal krähmulisel taustal erksavärvilistest kolmnurkadest, ringidest, rombidest koosnevat stiliseeritud figuuri üksteise kõrval rivis.
works.de: On a bluish, crumpled background a stylised figure composed of brightly coloured triangles, circles and rhombi, standing in a row side by side.

works.d: Tervet maalipinda katmas kadakatest mets: teravatipulised püramiidsed rohelistes toonides
works.de: A forest of junipers covering the entire painting surface: sharp-tipped pyramidal shapes in green tones

works.d: Erksates toonides maalitud siseõu. Vasakul serval kaks kõrvuti seisvat sinist ühekorruselist puumaja, selle taga, keskplaanil vasakus kuldlõikes sinine kuur. Paremas servas kitsa fragmendina suurem kivimaja. Tagaplaanil paremal väike tänav rohelise lumise aia ja väravaga ning selle taga kõrge katusega madalam hoone. Sinine taevas, horisondil kollakasroheline.
works.de: A courtyard painted in bright tones. On the left edge, two blue single-storey wooden houses standing side by side, behind them, in the middle ground on the left in the golden section, a blue shed. On the right edge, a larger stone house as a narrow fragment. In the background on the right, a small street with a green snowy garden and gate, and behind it a lower building with a tall roof. Blue sky, yellowish-green at the horizon.

works.d: Abstraheeritud figuuraalkompositsioon: paremal laua taga käsipõsakil prillidega kuju otsevaates. Vasakul kolm väiksemat kolmnurksetes peakatetes figuuri poolkülgvaates. Türkiisroheline, sinkjas koloriit, mustja kontuuriga tüüpe markeeriv laad.
works.de: Abstracted figural composition: on the right, behind a table, a figure with glasses resting its cheek on its hand, seen frontally. On the left three smaller figures in triangular headgear, seen in half profile. Turquoise-green, bluish coloring, a manner marking the types with blackish contours.

works.d: Linnasiluetti kujutav minimalistlik metafüüsiline kompositsioon. Kolmeks horisontaalseks pinnaks jagatud maal, millest alumine osa valge, keskmine rohelisest siniseks üleminekutoonis, ülemine musta siluati kohal sinistes üleminekutoonides laotus.
works.de: A minimalist metaphysical composition depicting a city silhouette. The painting is divided into three horizontal planes, of which the lower part is white, the middle part in a transitional tone from green to blue, and the upper part, above a black silhouette, spreads out in transitional shades of blue.

works.d: Erksavärviline (valdavalt sini-punane) abstraktne kompositsioon, mille allosa keskel neljakandiliseks jaotatud pindades mitmesugused tinglikud kujundid (liivakell, poolkaar, paberkollaaź jm) ja valge merekarp. Kirev pind ümbritsetud sinistes toonides lõikuvate kaarte, üksikute erkpunaste kujunditega.
works.de: A brightly coloured (mainly blue-red) abstract composition, in the lower centre of which, in surfaces divided into quadrangles, various conventional shapes (hourglass, semicircle, paper collage, etc.) and a white seashell. The colourful surface is surrounded by intersecting arcs in blue tones, with isolated bright red shapes.

works.d: Kirev abstraktne kompositsioon, mille alumisel poolel domineerivad sügavsinised, ülal punakad toonid, kõikvõimalikud erksavärvilised kujundid nende foonil.
works.de: A colourful abstract composition, in the lower half of which deep blue tones dominate, above reddish tones, against their background all manner of brightly coloured shapes.

works.d: Kompositsioon stiliseeritud kaladest. Punaka kahvatu tausta keskel lestakala, millel dekoratiivne männa-kujund oranži kettaga keskel. Paremal kaks, vasakul üks pisem kala. Allosas aimatav tume taimestik.
works.de: Composition of stylized fish. In the middle of a reddish pale background a flatfish, bearing a decorative pine-shape figure with an orange disc in the center. On the right two, on the left one smaller fish. At the bottom, dark vegetation is discernible.

works.d: Roosades, lillades ja sinistes toonides mäed. Kontuurid hajuvad. Ülal servas valge pilveriba.
works.de: Mountains in pink, purple and blue tones. The contours are blurred. At the top edge a white strip of cloud.

works.d: Ülaltvaade Tallinna vanalinna punastele katustele ja hallikatele majaplokkidele, mille vahel kõrgub vasakul Niguliste tornikiiver, paremal Toomkiriku torn valgete rünkpilvedega kaetud tumeda taeva taustal. Selgepiiriline illustratiivne maalilaad.
works.de: A view from above of the red roofs and grayish house blocks of Tallinn's Old Town, among which on the left rises the spire of St. Nicholas' Church, and on the right the tower of the Cathedral, against the background of a dark sky covered with white cumulus clouds. A clear-outlined, illustrative painting style.

works.d: Keskealise mehe portree poolpöördes paremale - punakas habe ja vuntsid, seljas tumesinine pikk kuub, pruunikad püksid, parem käsi taskus, vasakus käes prillid ja paberileht.
works.de: Portrait of a middle-aged man in a half-turn to the right - reddish beard and moustache, wearing a dark blue long coat, brownish trousers, right hand in pocket, in his left hand glasses and a sheet of paper.

works.d: Keskealise daami portree - istumas tugitoolis käsipõsakil, küünarnukk kõrvalasetsevale lauale toetumas, seljas karusnahkse kraega mantel, peas kübar, prillid.
works.de: Portrait of a middle-aged lady - sitting in an armchair with her chin resting on her hand, her elbow resting on the table beside her, wearing a coat with a fur collar, a hat on her head, glasses.

works.dm: kõrgus: 240.0 cm; laius: 200.0 cm (koos raamiga); kõrgus: 250.0 cm (koos raamiga); laius: 190.0 cm
works.d: 8-nurkne kompositsioon kahest vastastikku asetsevast naisaktist külgvaates, parem põlvitav, vasak istes. Naiste pead kummargil, pikad mustad juuksed rippu, käed teineteise pea ümber. Ekspressiivne laad, tumedad mustjad toonid, lai pintslikiri.
works.de: 8-cornered composition of two female nude figures placed facing each other in profile, the right one kneeling, the left one seated. The women's heads bowed, long black hair hanging loose, arms around each other's heads. Expressive manner, dark blackish tones, broad brushwork.

works.dm: laius: 550.0 cm (terviku mõõt); kõrgus: 250.0 cm (terviku mõõt)
works.d: Viiest ebakorrapärase kujuga neljakandilisest püstjast osast koosnev figuraalne kompositsioon: üle kõigi osade kujutatud mees ja naine teineteise embuses lebamas kandilise päikesekettaga heleda laotuse all. Ekspressiivne laad, tume sinkjasmust värvikontrast helehalliga.
works.de: A figural composition consisting of five irregularly shaped upright quadrangular parts: across all the parts a man and a woman are depicted lying in an embrace under a bright sky with a rectangular sun disc. Expressive style, dark bluish-black colour contrast with light grey.

works.d: Lühikeste tumedate juustega noore naise portree otsevaates - seljas punane pluus, pilk suunatud vasakule kaugusesse. Pea pisut kallutatud, nukker.
works.de: Portrait of a young woman with short dark hair, in a frontal view - wearing a red blouse, gaze directed into the distance to the left. Head slightly tilted, mournful.

works.d: Suvine Tallinna vanalinna tänav: keskmes, tänava ääres üksteise kõrval teravate viilude ja oranžikate katustega kolm heledat hoonet. Vasakul hoonete taga osa Oleviste tornist paistmas. Kaugemal jalakäijad. Heledad toonid, vaba maalilaad.
works.de: Summer street in Tallinn's Old Town: in the centre, along the street, three light-coloured buildings with sharp gables and orangish roofs standing side by side. On the left, part of the tower of St. Olaf's Church visible behind the buildings. Pedestrians in the distance. Light tones, free painterly style.

works.d: Diivanil istuva hallipäise naise poolfiguur otsevaates. Naisel tumesinine kleit, prees kinnisel, ruuduline sall õlgadel. Taustal punaka kattega diivani selg, seinal paistmas osa viiulist. Sinkjad, pruunikad tumedad toonid, realistlik laad.
works.de: Half-length frontal portrait of a grey-haired woman sitting on a sofa. The woman wears a dark blue dress, closed with a brooch, a checked shawl over her shoulders. In the background the back of a sofa with a reddish cover, part of a violin visible on the wall. Bluish, brownish dark tones, realistic style.

works.d: Lühikese soenguga noore naise kolmveerandfiguur istumas, ülakeha pööratud vaataja suunas. Jalg üle põlve, käed ristamisi süles. Naisel lühikeste varrukatega kolmnurkse dekolteega alt volditud türkiisrohekas kleit. Ühtlane pruunikas foon. Realistlik maalilaad.
works.de: Three-quarter figure of a young woman with a short hairstyle, seated, upper body turned toward the viewer. Leg crossed over the knee, hands crossed in her lap. The woman wears a turquoise-green dress with short sleeves and a triangular neckline, gathered at the bottom. Uniform brownish background. Realistic painting style.

works.d: Poolabstraktne kompositsioon nelja autos istuva figuuriga. Figuurid deformeeritud orgaanilisele elule viitavas sürrealistlikus laadis. Üleval keskel markeeritud auto tagaaken, all paremal autorool, kogu kompositsioon punastes ja kollastes toonides.
works.de: Semi-abstract composition with four figures seated in a car. The figures are deformed in a surrealist style suggesting organic life. At the top centre a marked rear window of the car, at the bottom right the car's steering wheel, the whole composition in red and yellow tones.

works.d: Erinevatest vaatepunktidest antud fantaasiamaastik: esiplaanil lamab punaste juustega alasti naine erkrohelisel, metsmaasikaid täispikitud rohul. Vasakul, paepangal, kaks lillakasroosat, kerade ja püramiididega lõppevat sammast, mille vahel kügeleb rohelises läbipaistvas rüüs lõvipäine inimene. Keskel voolab lume ja raagus puudega kaetud väljade vahel lai jõgi silmapiiril asuva erksinise mere poole. Paremal, mere kaldal, leeke välja viskava Pirita kloostri tillukesed varemed ning nende taga hiiglaslik mõtlejapoosis alasti mees. Otsekui mere ja silmapiiri taga mõjub unenäolinnana topograafiliselt moonutatud Toompea siluett. Ülaservas kollane ja lillakassinine taevas.
works.de: A fantasy landscape given from different viewpoints: in the foreground lies a naked red-haired woman on bright green grass thickly studded with wild strawberries. On the left, on a limestone bank, two lilac-pink columns ending in spheres and pyramids, between which crouches a lion-headed human figure in a green translucent robe. In the middle, between fields covered with snow and bare trees, a wide river flows towards a bright blue sea on the horizon. On the right, on the shore of the sea, the tiny ruins of the Pirita convent throwing out flames, and behind them a gigantic naked man in the pose of a thinker. As if beyond the sea and the horizon, the topographically distorted silhouette of Toompea appears like a dream city. At the top edge, a yellow and lilac-blue sky.

works.d: Suitsuse tähistaeva all kooniliste kuuskedega metsaveerel, lagendiku keskel lõõmava lõkke ümber pinkidel ja maas istuvad inimesed, õllekapad käes. Tulekuma figuuridel ja selle tekitatud varjud vaataja suunas. Vasakul tagapool inimhulk lõõtspilli saatel tantsimas. Paremal puude all rohelise kastiga veoauto PX-8-02 ja väiksemaid sõidukeid. Stiliseeritud vormidega selgepiiriline kujutamisviis. Valdavalt samblarohelised, oliivtoonid, erksinine taevakaar.
works.de: Under a smoky starry sky at the edge of a forest with conical spruces, in the middle of a clearing around a blazing bonfire, people sit on benches and on the ground, holding beer mugs. The glow of the fire falls on the figures and casts shadows toward the viewer. On the left, further back, a crowd of people dancing to the accompaniment of an accordion. On the right, under the trees, a truck with a green box, PX-8-02, and smaller vehicles. A clearly outlined manner of depiction with stylised forms. Predominantly moss-green, olive tones, a bright blue arc of sky.

works.d: Suitsevate vulkaanimägedega hõõguvpunasel-kollasel maastikul ees kahel pool kaks vastamisi seisvat raudrüüs figuuri. Nende vahel, vaataja suunas ettepoole kummargil vürflit viskav monstrum. Selgelt välja maalitud vürfel, millel 6 silma peal, figuuride jalgade juures maas.
works.de: In a glowing red-yellow landscape with smoking volcanic mountains, in front on both sides two armour-clad figures standing facing each other. Between them, bending forward towards the viewer, a monster throwing a die. Clearly painted die, showing 6 pips uppermost, lying on the ground at the figures' feet.

works.d: Üle terve sinaka üldkoloriidiga pinna krähmuliselt, hajuvalt-tinglikult maalitud poolkükakil mehefiguur, lopsaka ninaga piklik tume nägu üle õla vaatajale suunatud. Kuju kohale, peale maalitud mitmeid erinevaid süžeesid. Ülal paremal kaks seisvat inglit, vaasid liiliatega nende ees, vahel sädelev kiirtesära. Figuuri keskpaigas uduselt paistmas avatud puusärk naisega, suur heleroosa avatud õiega vesiroos pea kohal. Kirstu ümber kaetud laud, mis toetub haprale galerii-taolisele kujundile. All vasakul, figuuri põlvede kohal, paat seisvate alasti figuuridega veerandpöördes paremale. Mehe ja naise käed sirutatud ette, pilgud suunatud alla, poisil käed-jalad laiali, pilk ülal.
works.de: Over the entire surface with a bluish general colouring, a crouching male figure painted in a crumpled, diffuse-conventional manner, a lush-nosed elongated dark face turned over the shoulder towards the viewer. Above the figure, several different subjects are painted. Upper right two standing angels, vases with lilies before them, between them a shimmering ray of light. In the middle of the figure an open coffin with a woman is dimly visible, a large light pink open-blossomed water lily above her head. Around the coffin a covered table, resting on a fragile gallery-like structure. Lower left, above the figure's knees, a boat with standing nude figures turned a quarter-turn to the right. The man's and woman's arms are stretched forward, their gazes directed downward, the boy with arms and legs spread, gaze upward.

works.d: Valgel taustal, tumedal alusel klaaspurk kimbu lillaõieliste kanarbikuokstega. Detailitäpne, peene pintsliga maalitud.
works.de: On a white background, on a dark base, a glass jar with a bunch of heather twigs with purple flowers. Precisely detailed, painted with a fine brush.

works.d: Mere ja taeva taustal kaabuga noormehe poolfiguur veerandpöördes paremale, käte vahel kokku pigistatud purjeriie. Mehel piklik nägu, pilk alla suunatud. Seljas hele kuub, särk. Tema taga vasakul paistmas kaabulotiga vanamehe pea. Tuhmid tumedad pruunikasrohekad toonid.
works.de: Against a background of sea and sky, the half-figure of a young man in a hat, in a quarter-turn to the right, holding a bundled sailcloth between his hands. The man has an elongated face, his gaze directed downward. Wearing a light-coloured coat and shirt. Behind him on the left, the head of an old man in a peaked cap is visible. Dull dark brownish-green tones.

works.d: Raagus puuga lumise talvemaastiku taustal ja sellest välja kasvava heledapäise pikkade juustega noore naise 7/8 figuur otsevaates, pilk paremal. Naise keha katab kolme kase, puude ja majakestega lumise aia kujutis. Portree osa pilvetupsudega helesinise taeva taustal realistlikult, värvikalt maalitud.
works.de: Against the background of a snowy winter landscape with a bare tree, and growing out of it, a 7/8 figure of a young fair-haired woman with long hair, seen frontally, gaze to the right. The woman's body is covered by the image of a snowy garden with three birches, trees and small houses. The portrait part is painted realistically and colourfully against the background of a light blue sky with tufts of cloud.

works.d: Kompositsioon suvises puuviljaaias laua taga istuva kübaras, kollases kleidis ja punastes kingades naisega. Naise ees laual kaks punastes kaantes raamatut, suurem neist avatud, väiksem suletud.
works.de: A composition of a woman sitting at a table in a summer orchard, wearing a hat, a yellow dress and red shoes. In front of the woman on the table two books with red covers, the larger one open, the smaller one closed.

works.d: Kollasel taustal habemega vana mehe portree poolprofiilis paremale. Maalitud õrnalt geometriseerivas üldistuses, kohati pastoosselt, viimistletud pahtliga.
works.de: Portrait of a bearded old man against a yellow background, in half-profile to the right. Painted in a gentle geometricizing generalisation, in places pastose, finished with palette knife.

works.d: Kompositsioon poolelioleva maaliga. Alusele toetuva maali keskmes lilla maalipind, mis on paberiribadega heledast maalimata pinnast eraldatud. Maali alt turritab suur kortsus paberitükk.
works.de: A composition with an unfinished painting. In the centre of the painting resting on an easel a purple painted surface, separated from the light, unpainted surface by strips of paper. A large crumpled piece of paper juts out from beneath the painting.

works.t: Heinrich Otto Zoege von Manteuffeli portree
works.d: Heinrich Otto Zoege von Manteuffel/geb: 9 Dec 1779/...1818/gest:10 Sept 1833(saksa). Asukoht objektil: lõuendil maali tagaküljel
works.de: Heinrich Otto Zoege von Manteuffel/geb: 9 Dec 1779/...1818/gest:10 Sept 1833 (German). Location on object: on the canvas, on the reverse of the painting

works.d: Kompositsioon jahimehega metsas. Esiplaanil püssi hoidva jahimehe täisfiguur, tagaplaanil kolm raagus puud, põõsad ja loom. Maalitud naivistlikus laadis ja hallikates murtud toonides, hõõrutud, läbikumavate värvikihtidega.
works.de: Composition with a hunter in a forest. In the foreground the full figure of a hunter holding a rifle, in the background three bare trees, bushes and an animal. Painted in a naive manner and in greyish broken tones, rubbed, with translucent layers of paint.

works.d: Sürrealistlik maastik punaste katustega tornidega. Esiplaanil asuvate tornide vaateakendest paistavad punaste silmadega haralised pead. Tagaplaanil tumedad püramiidjad, tornjad ja käekujulised vormid ning silmadega rinnakujulised olendid.
works.de: A surrealist landscape with towers with red roofs. Through the viewing windows of the towers in the foreground, branching heads with red eyes can be seen. In the background dark pyramid-like, tower-like and hand-shaped forms, and breast-shaped beings with eyes.

works.d: Poolabstraktne piklik kompositsioon markeeritud silma ja näojoonega. Maalitud kruntimata lõuendile laiade vertikaalsete pintslitõmmetega, roosakates toonides silm ja näojoon markeeritud mustaga.
works.de: A semi-abstract elongated composition marked with an eye and a facial line. Painted on unprimed canvas with broad vertical brushstrokes, an eye and facial line in pinkish tones marked with black.

works.d: Ruudukujulisest keskosast ja kolmnurgakujulistest tiibadest koosnev geomeetriline triptühhon. Keskosal ratastel käru markeerivad valged kujundid, mille kohal kiivrit ja turvist markeerivad rohelised ja hallid kujundid, taustaks hallidest ja valgetest ristkülikutest koosnevad plokid ja nende kohal punased teravatipulised kolmnurgad. Tiibadeks punased teravatipulised võrdhaarsed kolmnurgad.
works.de: A geometric triptych consisting of a square central section and triangular wings. In the central section white shapes mark a cart on wheels, above which green and grey shapes mark a helmet and armour, with a background of blocks made of grey and white rectangles and above them red sharp-pointed triangles. The wings are red sharp-pointed isosceles triangles.

works.d: Geomeetriline kompositsioon kahe musta A-kujulise figuuri ja oranži poolkeraga. A-kujulised figuurid viibutavad haamreid oranži poolkera suunas, maapind tumesinine, taust punane.
works.de: A geometric composition with two black A-shaped figures and an orange hemisphere. The A-shaped figures swing hammers towards the orange hemisphere, the ground dark blue, the background red.

works.d: Triptühhon naise portree, puuviljade ja lilledega. Vasakpoolsel osal kärbes tumedal, rohelise kumaga taustal. Keskmisel osal lilled ja plekilised puuviljad tumedal, rohelise ja punase kumaga taustal. Parempoolsel osal tumesinise pluusi, lühikese soengu ja punaste huultega naine punasel taustal, tema ees plekilised puuviljad, lilleõis ja kärbes.
works.de: Triptych of a woman's portrait, fruits and flowers. On the left-hand section a fly on a dark background with a greenish tinge. On the middle section flowers and spotted fruits on a dark background with a greenish and reddish tinge. On the right-hand section a woman in a dark blue blouse, with short hair and red lips, against a red background, before her spotted fruits, a flower bloom and a fly.

works.d: Kolmeks horisontaalseks värvipinnaks jaotatud kompositsioon jalgratturitega. Eri tooni rohelisi pindu lahutavad tumesinised jooned: keskmisel pinnal kahe sinistel ratastel naisjalgratturi täisfiguurid, alumisel pinnal kaks suurt liiliaõit ja kolme meesjalgratturi õlgadest ja jalgadest kadreeritud kehad, käed siniste jalgrataste lenksadel.
works.de: A composition with cyclists divided into three horizontal colour planes. Green surfaces of different tones are separated by dark blue lines: on the middle plane the full figures of two female cyclists on blue wheels, on the lower plane two large lily blossoms and the bodies of three male cyclists framed from the shoulders and legs, hands on the handlebars of blue bicycles.

works.d: Kolmeks kaldega vertikaalseks värvipinnaks jaotatud kompositsioon kahe naise ja lilleõitega. Keskmisel helesinisel värvipinnal kahe identse rohelises kitlis blondi naise poolfiguur, näod üksteisel poole veerandpöördes. Mõlemal pool asuval tumesinisel värvipinnal valged galla- ja liiliaõied.
works.de: A composition divided into three sloping vertical colour fields with two women and flower blossoms. On the middle light-blue colour field, half-figures of two identical blonde women in green smocks, their faces turned three-quarters toward each other. On the dark-blue colour fields on either side, white calla and lily flowers.

works.d: Suvine stseen veekogu, vett kandva naise ja pesunööriga. Vasakul jalgupidi vees punase kleidiga naine, veeämber käes, paremal paadisild ja kaldale tõmmatud, vett täis paat. Esiplaanil kallas kõrkjate, vankriratta ja puupostile toetuva pesunööriga, millel ripub kolm heledat riideeset.
works.de: A summer scene with a body of water, a woman carrying water and a clothesline. On the left, a woman in a red dress standing in the water, a water bucket in her hand, on the right a boat pier and a boat pulled up onto the shore, full of water. In the foreground the shore with reeds, a cart wheel and a clothesline attached to a wooden post, on which three light-coloured garments are hanging.

works.d: Kompositsioon inimpeade, erinevate esemete ja vormidega. Vasakul sinine mehepea ja hall rätikuga naisepea, keskel pikkade juustega naisepea. Nende ümber ja vahel suur krussi keeratud polt, lehtedega puuoksad, puidust taburet ning suuremaid-väiksemaid hõljuvaid kuule üle terve pildi pinna, taustaks telliskivisein ja sinine taevas.
works.de: A composition of human heads, various objects and forms. On the left a blue man's head and a grey-kerchiefed woman's head, in the middle a woman's head with long hair. Around and between them a large curled bolt, leafy tree branches, a wooden stool and larger and smaller floating balls across the entire surface of the picture, with a brick wall and blue sky as background.

works.d: Kompositsioon nelja kunstniku autoportreega. Esiplaanil omavahel vestlemas kunstniku neli habemega poolfiguuri erinevat värvi särkides. Tagaplaanil punased kardinad, mille vahelt paistab pilvine kaevandusega maastik.
works.de: A composition with self-portraits of four artists. In the foreground four bearded half-figures of the artist, conversing with one another, in shirts of different colours. In the background red curtains, through which a cloudy landscape with a mine is visible.

works.d: Kompositsioon pildistava poisiga, taustal viltune vana seinakell ning fotod kurgede ja troopiliste taimedega tapeedil. Esiplaanil teravustamata värviline kogum, poisi ja tapeedi vahel ja ees hõljuvad klaasist torud.
works.de: A composition with a boy taking a photograph, in the background an old crooked wall clock and photos of cranes and tropical plants on the wallpaper. In the foreground an unfocused coloured mass, glass tubes floating between and in front of the boy and the wallpaper.

works.d: Neljast osast koosnev kompositsioon kostüümides ja soengutes subkultuursete tegelaste ja nende jalutsis lamava alasti meesfiguuriga. Ülemise keskosa alläärde maalitud punasega "Kalevipoja surm", kompositsiooni taustaks siksakilised kujundid ja ääristeks mustad siksakilised vineerist tiivad.
works.de: A composition of four parts with figures of subcultural characters in costumes and hairstyles and a nude male figure lying at their feet. At the bottom edge of the upper middle section is painted in red "Kalevipoja surm" ["The Death of Kalevipoeg"], the composition's background consisting of zigzag shapes and bordered by black zigzag plywood wings.

works.d: Kompositsioon nelja kaelakuti mehega suvises linnamiljöös. Meestel parem jalg astumiseks õhku tõstetud, taustaks pragunev majasein ja selle tagant paistev veesilm puudega.
works.de: Composition with four men standing shoulder to shoulder in a summer urban milieu. The men's right legs are lifted as if stepping, background with a cracking house wall and behind it a glimpse of water with trees.

works.d: Esiplaanil meri ankrupostide, purjepaatide ja gondlitega. Taamal linna siluett tornidega.
works.de: In the foreground the sea with mooring posts, sailing boats and gondolas. In the distance the silhouette of a town with towers.

works.dm: kõrgus: 66.4 cm; laius: 83.5 cm; kõrgus: 77.0 cm (raamiga); laius: 94.0 cm (raamiga)
works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul suure rändrahnu kõrval põõsas, keskel üksik kuusk, tagaplaanil vasakul tuulik, paremalt puude vahelt paistab valge paviljon.
works.de: In the foreground on the left, next to a large boulder, a bush, in the middle a solitary spruce, in the background on the left a windmill, on the right through the trees a white pavilion is visible.

works.d: Kompositsioon võrku merest paatidesse sikutavate kaluritega. Kahel pool võrku paatides viis kaabudes meest, taustal vette ehitatud aedikud, taamal kallas puude ja hoonetega.
works.de: Composition with fishermen pulling a net from the sea into boats. On either side of the net, five men in hats in boats, in the background enclosures built in the water, further back a shore with trees and buildings.

works.d: Sürreaalne kompositsioon lendavate lindude ning abstraheeritud pilvede ja maastikuga.
works.de: Surreal composition with flying birds and abstracted clouds and landscape.

works.d: Geomeetrilisteks pindadeks jaotatud kompositsioon abstraheeritud vormide ja sürreaalsete olenditega.
works.de: A composition divided into geometric planes with abstracted forms and surreal beings.

works.d: Tumepunasel taustal mehe nägu en face. Peas kergelt vasakule kaldu sonimüts. Kujutatu vasak silm sinakashalli ja parem silm punase täpina. Ekspressiivne ja geomeetriseeriv kujutamisviis, näo osad antud eri toonis värvilaikudena.
works.de: A man's face en face against a dark red background. On his head a sonimüts [sonyi] cap tilted slightly to the left. The subject's left eye is bluish-grey and the right eye has a red dot. Expressive and geometricising manner of depiction, the parts of the face rendered as colour patches in different tones.

works.d: Kollases, papaaha laadses mütsis prillidega mehe rindportree poolpöördes vasakule. Figuurist paremal ripub lambipirn, vasakul õla juures suunaga alla sõitev allveelaeva meenutav masin. Taust kollase ja pruuni värviga kaheks jaotunud. Maalitud skitseerivas laadis.
works.de: Bust portrait of a man in a half-turn to the left, wearing a yellow, papakha-like hat and glasses. To the right of the figure a light bulb hangs, near the left shoulder a machine resembling a submarine descending downward. The background divided into two by yellow and brown colour. Painted in a sketchy style.

works.d: Valgel taustal, markeeriva joonega maalitud mustades prillides mehe pea poolpöördes vasakule. Näo alaosa voolava värviga markeeritud. Visandlik maalilaad.
works.de: On a white background, painted with a marking line, the head of a man in black glasses, in half-turn to the left. The lower part of the face marked with flowing paint. Sketch-like painting style.

works.d: Värvilisel taustal abstraktne rindportree pöördes vasakule. Kujutatu näo eri osad antud suurte ekspressiivsete värvilaikudena. Laia sinise pintslitõmbega raamitud kollane nina. Punasega markeeritud pea- ja seljajoon.
works.de: On a coloured background, an abstract bust portrait turned to the left. The different parts of the depicted person's face are given as large expressive patches of colour. A yellow nose framed by a broad blue brushstroke. Head and back line marked in red.

works.d: Ergastes toonides kubistlikus laadis maal, mille keskosas kaks, üldistatult kujutatud figuuri. Vasakpoolsel peas silmi varjav kübar, käes valge kinnas. Parempoolsel lühikesed juuksed, õlgadel türkiissinise varjundiga rõivaese. Esiplaanil pruunikas abstraktne vorm, millel sinakas puuviljakorv, peekritaoline ese, kuhjas dokumendid ja pruuni värvi kinnas. Maalimise käigus on värvi kraabitud mustreid ja kujundeid. Kujutiste piirjooni markeerivad kohad kergelt pastoossed.
works.de: A painting in vivid tones in a cubist style, with two generalised figures in the central part. The left-hand figure has a hat covering the eyes, a white glove in the hand. The right-hand figure has short hair, a garment with a turquoise-blue tinge on the shoulders. In the foreground a brownish abstract form, on which is a bluish fruit basket, a goblet-like object, a pile of documents, and a brown-coloured glove. In the process of painting, patterns and shapes have been scraped into the paint. The places marking the outlines of the images are slightly impasto.

works.d: Esiplaanil madala rohuga tume, varjus olev küngas, mille paremal serval kaks, tippudest risti kasvanud puud, neist vasakul madalam puu, siin-seal kivisid. Paremal taamal veekogu, vasakul künka taga aimatav sinakas mets. Päikeseloojangu eelne taevas antud sinakasroheliste triipudena, keskosas päike, ülaosas üksikud kollased jooned. Taeva osa maaling ei kata paberit üleni. Katsetuslik teostuslaad.
works.de: In the foreground a dark, shadowed hillock with low grass, on whose right edge two trees growing crosswise from their tops, of which the left one is lower, here and there some stones. In the distance on the right a body of water, on the left behind the hillock a bluish forest can be discerned. The sky before sunset is rendered as bluish-green stripes, the sun in the middle section, isolated yellow lines at the top. The painted sky does not cover the paper entirely. Experimental manner of execution.

works.d: Tumedal taustal vanema naise ¾ portree, pea kerges pöördes vasakule. Vaheliti sõrmed toetatud sülle. Seljas hele, puhevil käistega pluus ja kõrge värvliga helehall seelik. Rinnal punane lillemotiiviga pross, peas hele, punakate tikanditega kirjatud tanu. Realistlik kujutamisviis,  lõuendi ääred osaliselt läbimaalimata.
works.de: A ¾ portrait of an older woman against a dark background, the head slightly turned to the left. Fingers interlaced, resting in her lap. Wearing a light blouse with puffed sleeves and a light grey skirt with a high collar. On the chest a red brooch with a floral motif, on the head a light cap embroidered with reddish embroidery. Realistic manner of depiction, the edges of the canvas partially left unpainted.

works.d: Punase, rohelise, sinise ja tumelilla värviga antud abstraheeritud ruumi taustal tõsise ilmega heledate juustega mehe rindportree en face. Seljas hele, türkiissinakas kaelusega pullover, tumelilla pintsak.
works.de: Against a background of abstracted space rendered in red, green, blue and dark purple, a bust portrait en face of a serious-looking, fair-haired man. Wearing a light, turquoise-blue collared pullover, a dark purple jacket.

works.d: Rohelisel taustal, sinist mütsi kandva, kätega pead toetava  tumedajuukselise naise rindportree. Pea kergelt paremale kallutatud, käed toetatud lauale, millel tass ja raamatulaadne ese.
works.de: Against a green background, a bust portrait of a dark-haired woman wearing a blue cap, holding her head with her hands. Head slightly tilted to the right, hands resting on a table on which there is a cup and a book-like object.

works.d: Maalipinda katavad rohekas-pruunika fooniga, geomeetrilised, teineteise sisse koonduvad vormid. Kontrasti lisavad vormide heledalt antud osad. Teose keskel ümarjas, nägu meenutav kujutis, millel eristatavad silmad, roheline nina ja suu.
works.de: The painted surface is covered with geometric, mutually converging forms on a greenish-brown background. Contrast is added by the lightly rendered parts of the forms. In the middle, a roundish, face-like image with distinguishable eyes, a green nose and mouth.

works.d: Eri varjundites sinisel taustal pruunis toonis hallide, tahakammitud juustega mehe rindportree pöördes vasakule. Valge kaelusega sinine riietus. Ekspressiivne laad, pind siin-seal jäetud läbimaalimata.
works.de: Against a background of various shades of blue, a brown-toned bust portrait of a man with grey, combed-back hair, turned to the left. Blue clothing with a white collar. Expressive style, the surface left unpainted in places.

works.d: Väikeste pintslilöökidega antud, veekogu kaldal tumerohelise põõsastiku najale toetuv heleda pearätikuga punases riietuses istuva naise täisfiguur. Käes kalavõrk, paremal liivase rannaga veekogu ääres kaks paati. Maali aluspind kohati läbikumav, naise salli ja kalavõrgu struktuur antud värvipinda kraabitud sälkudena.
works.de: Given with small brushstrokes, the full figure of a woman in red clothing with a light headscarf, sitting by a body of water leaning against dark green shrubbery. A fishing net in her hands, on the right two boats by the sandy shore of the water. The painting's surface is partly translucent, the structure of the woman's scarf and the fishing net rendered as notches scratched into the paint layer.

works.d: Esiplaanil punaste juustega alasti naine puusast saati vees seismas, pea kallutatud paremale, üles seljataha tõstetud käed hoiavad roosakas-lillakat läbipaistva moega kangast. Taamal, päikeseloojangust lillakaks värvunud taeva  taustal  kaks tumedates toonides gorillat/ahvi.
works.de: In the foreground a red-haired nude woman standing in water up to her hips, head tilted to the right, hands raised up behind her back holding a pinkish-purple, translucent-looking fabric. Further back, against a sky coloured purple by the sunset, two dark-toned gorillas/apes.

works.d: Heledafooniline avar maastikuvaade, paremal keskel tuulik, selle ees seisva figuuri ja hobusega. Esiplaanil vasakul madalad muud, taamal paistab tume metsaviirg.
works.de: A wide landscape view with a light background, on the right in the middle a windmill, in front of it a standing figure with a horse. In the foreground on the left low mounds, in the distance a dark strip of forest can be seen.

works.d: Tinglikult antud linnavaade jõega keskel, mille ääres paremal hooned, vasakul puud. Esiplaanil vasakul ääres kolm seisvat figuuri.
works.de: A conventionally rendered cityscape with a river in the middle, along which there are buildings on the right and trees on the left. In the foreground, on the left edge, three standing figures.

works.d: Pastelsetes toonides, rohekas-sinakal foonil geometriseeritud, abstraktsena mõjuv kompositsioon. Vasakul liikuvat figuuri meenutav, ekspressiivsete pintslilöökidega antud kujutis, millel justkui käed üles pea kohale tõstetud, mustad juuksesalgud lehvimas. Nägu markeerib roosakas-lillal foonil mustaga antud silma kujutis. Paremal ülal nurgas kollane ring.
works.de: A composition in pastel tones, geometrized against a greenish-bluish background, giving an abstract impression. On the left, an image resembling a moving figure, rendered with expressive brushstrokes, as if with hands raised above the head, black strands of hair fluttering. The face is marked, against a pinkish-purple background, by a depiction of an eye given in black. In the upper right corner a yellow circle.

works.d: Kollasel taustal värviline, abstraktne kujutis, milles tõuseb aktsendina esile laia pintsliga maalitud must struktuur.
works.de: On a yellow background, a colourful, abstract image in which a black structure painted with a broad brush stands out as an accent.

works.d: Tumesinise veekogu ääres, roosat tooni rannaliival grupp inimesi supelkostüümides. Osa liival pikutamas, teised seismas. Ligi poole maalipinna ulatuses kujutatud valgete pilvedega tumesinine taevas.
works.de: By a dark blue body of water, on pinkish-toned beach sand, a group of people in bathing costumes. Some lying on the sand, others standing. Almost half of the painted surface depicts a dark blue sky with white clouds.

works.d: Pruunikal foonil, puidust laual sinisel taldrikul puuviljad, mille kõrval läbipaistvas vaasis lilleõis, õie südamik maalitud silmana. Vasakul nurgas seisab värvipaletti käes hoidev figuur.
works.de: On a brownish background, on a wooden table on a blue plate fruits, beside which in a transparent vase a flower bloom, the flower's centre painted as an eye. In the left corner stands a figure holding a palette.

works.d: Sinakasrohelise taevaga üksikute puuvõradega soomaastik kolme veesilmaga, paremal nurgas kaks lendavat lindu.
works.de: A bog landscape in bluish-green sky with solitary tree crowns and three pools of water, in the right corner two flying birds.

works.d: Esiplaanil rohelisel niidul seisev roosa rätikuga naine silitamas varssa. Nende taga kolm hobust.
works.de: In the foreground a woman with a pink headscarf standing on a green meadow, stroking a foal. Behind them three horses.

works.d: Veekogu ääres viilkatusega maja, mille ees aimatavad paat ning kaks seisvat figuuri. Kujutised antud värvipinda kraabitud joonte abil.
works.de: A house with a gabled roof by a body of water, in front of which a boat and two standing figures can be discerned. The images are rendered by lines scratched into the paint surface.

works.d: Punakaspruuni fooniga ruumis valge lõuendi ees istuv kiilaspäine, pintslit käes hoidev kunstnik maalimisega alustamas. Pingil vasakul aimatavad erinevad nõud ja esemed.
works.de: In a room with a reddish-brown background, a bald-headed artist holding a brush, sitting in front of a white canvas, about to begin painting. On the bench on the left, various vessels and objects can be discerned.

works.d: Läbikumav, pastelsetes rohekassinakates toonides maastikuvaade. Keskel jõgi, mille paremal järsakul mets. Vasakul äärel põõsaid, väiksemaid puid esiplaanil
works.de: A translucent landscape view in pastel greenish-blue tones. In the middle a river, on the right a steep bank with forest. On the left edge bushes, smaller trees in the foreground.

works.d: Raamaturiiuli ees oleval laual ümar vaas erinevate suvelilledega, mille ees kaks raamatut. Vasakult langeb lauale hele kardin.
works.de: On the table in front of the bookshelf a round vase with various summer flowers, in front of it two books. A light curtain falls onto the table from the left.

works.d: Maastikuvaade  lookleva jõega keskel. Taamal jõe mõlemal kaldal mets, esiplaanil vasakul üksik puuvõra, paremal kolm põõsast peegeldumas vees.
works.de: Landscape view with a winding river in the middle. In the distance forest on both banks of the river, in the foreground on the left a solitary treetop, on the right three bushes reflected in the water.

works.d: Maastikuvaade, esiplaanil vasakul üksik kidur puu, taamal puudesalu ääres valge katusega hoone.
works.de: Landscape view, in the foreground on the left a single stunted tree, in the background near a cluster of trees a building with a white roof.

works.dm: kõrgus: 8.2 cm (vm); kujutise laius: 13.5 cm (km); kujutise kõrgus: 8.6 cm (km); laius: 12.3 cm (vm)
works.d: Helesinises toonis maastikumotiiv. Taamal olev küngas, millel üksikuid maju ja puid, läheb sujuvalt üle veekoguks, millel kaks figuuri kahe paadi kõrval.
works.de: Landscape motif in light blue tones. A hill in the distance, with a few houses and trees, merges smoothly into a body of water, on which two figures are seen beside two boats.

works.dm: kujutise kõrgus: 8.5 cm; laius: 12.5 cm; kõrgus: 8.6 cm; kujutise laius: 12.7 cm
works.d: Rohekas-sinaka fooniga veekogu, mille kaldal hooned ja puud.
works.de: A body of water with a greenish-blue background, with buildings and trees on its shore.

works.dm: kujutise laius: 13.5 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 8.0 cm
works.d: Esiplaanil, rohekal maastikul inimeste grupp toimetamas madala ehitise ümber, mille kõrval hobune. Taamal puudesalu.
works.de: In the foreground, on a greenish landscape, a group of people busy around a low structure, next to which a horse. A grove of trees in the distance.

works.d: Töö keskel alt vasakust nurgast üles paremale kujutatud sild. Esiplaanil vasakul kõrged tihedad puud. Tagapool paistab värviküllane linnavaade. Impressionistlik maalilaad.
works.de: In the middle of the work a bridge depicted from the bottom left corner up to the right. In the foreground on the left tall dense trees. Behind, a colourful view of the city can be seen. Impressionist painting style.

works.d: Abstraheeritud ruumi taustal profiilis (seljaga vaataja poole?) kujutatud tumedate juuste ja punase mütsiga naise rindportree.
works.de: Bust portrait of a woman with dark hair and a red hat, depicted in profile (back turned to the viewer?) against an abstracted spatial background.

works.d: Heleroosa taeva taustal õrn sinakas-rohekates toonides maastikuvaade veekoguga, mille mõlemal kaldal puid, esiplaanil veekogu kaldal üksik figuur, taamal paistavad kõrgendikud.
works.de: Against a background of a pale pink sky, a landscape view in delicate bluish-greenish tones with a body of water, trees on both its shores, in the foreground a solitary figure on the shore of the body of water, elevations visible in the distance.

works.d: Metsalagendik, esiplaanil langetatud puid laasivad figuurid, ees paremal istub piipu suitsetav, kirvest põlvedele toetav mees. Tagapool hobuvanker ja mets.
works.de: A forest clearing, in the foreground figures trimming felled trees, in front on the right a man sits smoking a pipe, resting an axe on his knees. Behind, a horse cart and forest.

works.d: Impressionistlik linnavaade jõega, esiplaanil üks alus vees, kaldas paadid.
works.de: Impressionist cityscape with a river, in the foreground a vessel in the water, boats on the bank.

works.d: Helesinise fooniga, linna läbiv jõevaade kahe paadiga. Mõlemal pool hooned, siin-seal kaldal paate, ees paremal jalutavad figuurid, taamal paistab sild. Impressionistlik kujutamisviis.
works.de: A view of a river running through a town, with a light blue background and two boats. Buildings on both sides, here and there boats on the shore, in front on the right strolling figures, in the distance a bridge can be seen. An impressionistic manner of depiction.

works.d: Sinakasrohelisest teravkaar aknast paistva taeva taustal punakaspruunide, kõrgesse soengusse seatud juustega kahvatu jumega naise rindportree, poolpöördes vasakule. Riietus helelilla, kuldse kaunistusega.
works.de: Bust portrait of a pale-complexioned woman with reddish-brown hair arranged in a high hairstyle, turned half-left, against the background of a sky visible through a bluish-green pointed-arch window. Her clothing is light purple with golden decoration.

works.d: Pastelsetes toonides ja impressionistlikus laadis maalitud vanema mehe poolfiguurportree otsevaates. Prillide, punase lipsu ja hallika pintsakuga mees seisab sinakal abstraktsel taustal, üks käsi taskus ja teine käsipuul.
works.de: Half-figure portrait of an older man, painted in pastel tones and in an impressionist manner, in frontal view. A man with glasses, a red tie and a grey-ish jacket stands against a bluish abstract background, one hand in his pocket and the other on a handrail.

works.d: Rohekates toonides istuva noore mehe portree poolprofiilis paremale. Hallikas pintsakus lahku kammitud soenguga mees istub kangaga kaetud toolil, üks käsi asetatud toolileenile, teine sülle.
works.de: Portrait of a seated young man in greenish tones, in half profile to the right. The man, with hair combed apart, wears a greyish jacket and sits on a chair covered with fabric, one hand placed on the armrest, the other in his lap.

works.d: Rahvariidesärgis ja tume vestiga habetunud hallipäise vanamehe portree poolpöördes vasakule, taustaks palkmaja sein ja lõikemustriga rahvakunstiese.
works.de: Portrait of a bearded, grey-haired old man in a folk costume shirt and dark vest, in half-turn to the left, with a log-house wall and a folk-art object with a cut-out pattern as background.

works.d: Toolil istuva sinises pluusis, miniseelikus ja kontsakingadega noore naise portree, käed põlvedel. Tugev vormiüldistus, taustaks rohekas sein ja punakas-violetne põrand.
works.de: Portrait of a young woman sitting on a chair, in a blue blouse, a miniskirt and heeled shoes, hands on her knees. Strong formal generalisation, background a greenish wall and a reddish-violet floor.

works.d: Rohelise pearätiga pruunis riietuses vanema naise portree kolmveerandpöördes vasakule, vasak käsi toetatud lauale. Visandlik käsitluslaad.
works.de: Portrait of an elderly woman in brown clothing with a green headscarf, in three-quarter turn to the left, left hand resting on a table. Sketch-like manner of treatment.

works.d: Hallil taustal kompositsioon joova mehe taha kallutatud täisfiguuriga. Mehel paremas käes plastikupudel, jalas heledad tossud ja seljas tumedad dressid. Figuur põlvedest lõuani viimistletud valgele krundile söetehnikas.
works.de: On a grey background a composition with the full figure of a drinking man leaning back. In the man's right hand a plastic bottle, on his feet light-coloured sneakers and dark tracksuit. The figure from the knees to the chin executed in charcoal technique on a finished white ground.

works.d: Sinise taeva taustal ⅔ maali pinnast enda alla võttev suvine maastikuvaade kahe seisva figuuriga keskel. Vasakpoolsel, rohelises riietuses mehel käes teravatipulised pulgad (maamõõtmise riistad?), paremal punases seelikus naine seljaga vaataja poole. Figuuride vahel roheline käru, mille ümber erinevaid esemeid.
works.de: Against a blue sky, a summer landscape view taking up ⅔ of the picture's surface, with two standing figures in the middle. On the left, a man in green clothing holds pointed sticks (land-surveying instruments?), on the right a woman in a red skirt with her back to the viewer. Between the figures a green cart, around which various objects are placed.

works.d: Kaksikportree elegantselt riietatud vanemast- ja noorest naisest. Maalitud lakoonilises laadis, foon oranžides-pruunides toonides.
works.de: Double portrait of an elegantly dressed older and young woman. Painted in a laconic style, background in orange-brown tones.

works.d: Rindportree naisest vasakus profiilis. Portreteeritul pruunid soengusse sätitud juuksed, seljas lilla kostüüm pruuni prossiga. Taustal tumesinised ja hallid värvipinnad.
works.de: Half-length portrait of a woman in left profile. The sitter has brown hair arranged in a hairstyle, wearing a purple costume with a brown brooch. Background in dark blue and grey colour planes.

works.d: Kolm naist seisavad väikese laua ümber. Laud on kaetud valge linikuga ning selle serval seisab sinine kauss. Neiud on kirevalt riides vastavalt ajastu moele järgnevates värvides: kollane, punane, roheline.
works.de: Three women stand around a small table. The table is covered with a white cloth, on the edge of which stands a blue bowl. The girls are dressed colourfully in the fashion of the period, in the following colours: yellow, red, green.

works.d: Rindportree en face noorest naisest, kelle pilk on suunatud alla. Portreteeritul on õlgadeni pruunid juuksed, seljas tumepunane kampsun. Foonil tumedad pinnalaotused.
works.de: Bust portrait en face of a young woman whose gaze is directed downward. The subject has brown hair to the shoulders, wearing a dark red sweater. Dark surfaces in the background.

works.d: Punakates toonides orgaanilisteks värvipindadeks abstraheeritud inimfiguuriga kompositsioon. Keskmes kollase sõõri ääres põlvitav labidaga inimfiguur, taustal abstraktsed postjad vormid.
works.de: A composition with a human figure abstracted into organic colour fields in reddish tones. In the centre, beside a yellow disc, a human figure kneeling with a spade, in the background abstract pillar-like forms.

works.dm: lehe laius: 31.8 cm; lehe kõrgus: 26.7 cm
works.d: Roosaka taeva taustal rehehoone, taamal paistmas hobune.
works.de: A threshing barn against a pinkish sky, a horse visible in the distance.

works.dm: lehe laius: 50.0 cm; lehe kõrgus: 32.5 cm
works.d: Rohekassinakal foonil linnavaade, hooned antud pruunides toonides. Esiplaanil jõgi, paremal paadid. Keskel ja vasakul suitsevad korstnad.
works.de: Cityscape against a greenish-bluish background, buildings rendered in brown tones. In the foreground a river, boats on the right. In the middle and on the left, smoking chimneys.

works.dm: lehe laius: 36.2 cm; lehe kõrgus: 20.7 cm
works.d: Skitseerivas laadis kujutatud lamav triibuline kass.
works.de: A lying striped cat depicted in a sketchy style.

works.dm: lehe laius: 48.0 cm; lehe kõrgus: 31.7 cm
works.d: Skitseerivas laadis tumedates toonides kujutatud lamav koer.
works.de: A lying dog depicted in dark tones in a sketchy style.

works.dm: lehe laius: 35.7 cm; lehe kõrgus: 31.2 cm
works.d: Skitseerivas laadis natüürmort erinevate esemetega laual.
works.de: Sketchy-style still life with various objects on a table.

works.d: Istuva naise täisfiguurportree veerandpöördes vasakule. Naisel punane poisipea,  seljas pruun kampsun ja seelik. Süles pruunide kõrvadega valge kass. Taustal päikseline aed erinevate taimede ja pruunide aialippidega.
works.de: Full-figure portrait of a seated woman in quarter turn to the left. The woman has a red bob haircut, wearing a brown cardigan and skirt. On her lap a white cat with brown ears. Background of a sunny garden with various plants and brown garden fence pickets.

works.d: Kivi peal istuva naise ja mehe täisportree. Blondil mehel käes kirves, peas müts ja jalas räbaldunud lühikesed püksid, rind paljas. Naisel seljas valge kleit punaste lehtedega ja punane peapael. Nende vahel valge riidega kaetud korv, mille seest paistab roheline pudel. Neist paremal küüni uks ja vasakul auto.
works.de: Full-length portrait of a woman and a man sitting on a stone. The blond man holds an axe, wears a cap and tattered short trousers, his chest bare. The woman wears a white dress with red leaves and a red headband. Between them a basket covered with white cloth, from which a green bottle shows. To their right the door of a barn and to the left a car.

works.d: Kivil istuvate naise ja meheakti täisportree. Suurte proportsioonidega mees embamas pikkade blondide juustega rahvuslike motiividega rohelises kleidis naist, kelle pilk suunatud maha. Taustal männid ja rannik.
works.de: Full-length double portrait of a woman and a man's nude figure sitting on a rock. A man of large proportions embraces a woman with long blonde hair wearing a green dress with national motifs, her gaze directed downward. Pines and coastline in the background.

works.d: Rohekas-sinakal taustal smokingus ja musta kikilipsuga mehe rindportree veerandpöördes vasakule, pilk suunatud kaugusesse.
works.de: Bust portrait of a man in a tuxedo and black bow tie against a greenish-bluish background, in a quarter-turn to the left, gaze directed into the distance.

works.d: Aknalaual kõrges rohelises klaasvaasis valged vesiroosid milledest paremal  roosa-sinine pall. Aknast avaneb vaade valgele mõisale ja mändidele.
works.de: On the windowsill, in a tall green glass vase, white water lilies, to the right of which a pink-blue ball. The window opens onto a view of a white manor house and pine trees.

works.d: Hallil taustal pruuni laua ja valge liniku peal seismas sinine lilledega vaas. Sellest paremal pruun tühi vaas ümmarguse ornamentikaga ja vasakul nelinurkne hobusepäid-meenutavate detailidega nõu. Taust hall.
works.de: On a grey background, a blue vase with flowers stands on a brown table with a white cloth. To its right, an empty brown vase with round ornamentation, and to the left a rectangular vessel with details resembling horse heads. Grey background.

works.d: Värvilise mustrilise servaga hallikal riidel päevalilled ovaalses kirjus vaasis. Paremal võõrasemad klaasanumas, vasakul tühi triibuline vaas.
works.de: Sunflowers in an ovoid patterned vase on a greyish cloth with a coloured patterned edge. On the right pansies in a glass vessel, on the left an empty striped vase.

works.d: Altpoolt ahaneval pruunil ovaalsel vaasil kujutatud oranži siniste täppidega lilleornamentikat ja lehe motiive meenutavat mustrit.
works.de: On a brown oval vase that narrows towards the bottom, an orange pattern with blue dots depicting floral ornamentation and leaf-like motifs is depicted.

works.d: Töö keskel kaks Pähklipurejat meenutavat posti. Lumises siseõues raagus puud ja taimed, õu ümbritsetud liistudest aiaga. Lumes jalajäljed ja üle aia paistavad teiste majade katused.
works.de: In the middle of the work two posts reminiscent of Nutcracker figures. In a snowy courtyard bare trees and plants, the yard surrounded by a lath fence. Footprints in the snow and the roofs of other houses visible over the fence.

works.d: Hõreda metsa taustal suur kivi.
works.de: Large stone against the background of a sparse forest.

works.d: Künklikul maastikul oranžid ja lillakad varemete „blokid“, kõige eesmisel sinine aknataoline ava ja munakive meenutavad piirjooned. Taamal mõned puud, taevas sinine roosa triibuga.
works.de: On a hilly landscape, orange and purplish 'blocks' of ruins, in the very foreground a blue window-like opening and outlines resembling cobblestones. Behind, a few trees, the sky blue with a pink stripe.

works.d: Vaade kahe korstnaga, punase katuse ja valgete seintega mõisale mida ümbritseb kivist aed ümmarguste ornamentidega. Hooneni viib väike tee künkast üles.
works.de: View of a manor house with two chimneys, a red roof and white walls, surrounded by a stone wall with round ornaments. A small path leads up the hill to the building.

works.d: Istuva mehe rindportree pöördes vasakule. Mehel käes pliiats ja joonistusplokk, pilk suunatud enda ette. Seljas tumesinine pintsak. Seintel erinevad maalid, tema ees laual raamatud ja suur värviline nõu.
works.de: Chest portrait of a seated man turned to the left. The man holds a pencil and a drawing pad, his gaze directed in front of him. He wears a dark blue jacket. Various paintings on the walls, in front of him on the table books and a large colorful vessel.

works.d: Varakevadine lumine maastikuvaade talutare ja üksiku inimfiguuriga. Esiplaanil kaks lähestikku seisvat kõrget mändi, taamal üksik raagus puu. Taamal veel üksikuid taresid ja mände, taustal päikeseloojangu ja linnuparvega õhtutaevas.
works.de: An early-spring snowy landscape view with a farmhouse and a solitary human figure. In the foreground two tall pines standing close together, further back a solitary bare tree. Further off a few more farmhouses and pines, in the background an evening sky with sunset and a flock of birds.

works.d: Kompositsioon seisvate, urbanistlikule subkultuurile viitavates soengutes ja rõivastuses noorte inimestega. Esiplaanil olev inimgrupp vaataja poole seljaga, tagaplaanil olev inimgrupp vaataja poole näoga. Taust tumedates toonides abstraktne.
works.de: A composition with standing young people with hairstyles and clothing referring to urban subculture. The group of people in the foreground has their backs to the viewer, the group in the background faces the viewer. The background is abstract in dark tones.

works.d: Kompositsioon seisvate, urbanistlikule subkultuurile viitavates soengutes ja rõivastuses noorte inimestega. Kompositsiooni keskmes kaks vaataja poole pööratud figuuri, taust heledates toonides abstraktne.
works.de: A composition with standing young people in hairstyles and clothing referring to urban subculture. At the centre of the composition two figures turned towards the viewer, the background abstract in light tones.

works.d: Poolabstraktne, sinakas-hallikates toonides ateljeevaade, mille keskmes kaks skulpturaalset objekti ja üksteise najale asetatud pildiraamid.
works.de: A semi-abstract studio view in bluish-grayish tones, at the centre of which are two sculptural objects and picture frames leaning against one another.

works.d: Sinakates-hallikates toonides ateljeevaade skulpturaalsete objektide ja nende taustal olevate piltidega.
works.de: Studio view in bluish-greyish tones with sculptural objects and pictures behind them.

works.d: Abstraktne merepõhja meenutav kompositsioon rohekates ja pruunikates toonides.
works.de: Abstract composition reminiscent of the sea floor, in greenish and brownish tones.

works.d: Abstraktne merepõhja meenutav kompositsioon rohekates ja kollakates toonides.
works.de: Abstract composition reminiscent of the seabed, in greenish and yellowish tones.

works.d: Tuhmis rohekas koloriidis tänavavaade, mille keskel kergelt paremale käänduv tänav ja selle servades majad.  Majade allkorrustel poed, kaugelt paistab kirikukuppel.
works.de: A street view in a dull greenish colouring, in the middle of which a street curving slightly to the right and houses on its edges. On the ground floors of the houses shops, in the distance a church dome is visible.

works.d: Mehe portree veerandpöördes paremale. Mehel helepruunid juuksed, pruunid silmad ja pruun jakk, parema silma juurest kulgeb paks must triip või ristkülik. Ümberringi värvilised laigud ja värvipritsmed, taamal paremal hägune auto kujutis.
works.de: Portrait of a man in a three-quarter turn to the right. The man has light brown hair, brown eyes and a brown jacket; a thick black stripe or rectangle runs from near his right eye. Around him are coloured patches and splashes of paint, in the background on the right a blurred depiction of a car.

works.d: Valge abstraktne kompositsioon, mille ühest nurgast teise ulatuv voogav kujund maalitud tilgutades-reljeefselt.
works.de: A white abstract composition, with a flowing shape extending from one corner to the other, painted in a dripped-relief manner.

works.d: Tumedates toonides öine vaade aiaga ümbritsetud hoonetegrupile. Esiplaanil vasakul ristikujuline post, taamal hoonetegrupi taga väike majake.
works.de: Night view in dark tones of a group of buildings surrounded by a fence. In the foreground on the left a cross-shaped post, behind the group of buildings a small house.

works.d: Punastes toonides abstraktne maastikuvaade.
works.de: Abstract landscape view in shades of red.

works.d: Punastes toonides maastikuvaade, mille keskmes inimfiguure meenutavad vormid, taamal vasakul taeva poole sirutuv loodusvorm.
works.de: A landscape view in reddish tones, with forms resembling human figures at its centre, in the distance on the left a natural form reaching towards the sky.

works.d: Kollakates toonides linnavaade erinevate majade fassaadide ja katustega.
works.de: Townscape in yellowish tones with facades and roofs of various houses.

works.d: Mustvalge rahvusliku stilisatsiooniga geomeetriline kompositsioon, mille keskmes käänduvad nurgelised suured vormid, ülaosas kuustahuka kujulised väikevormid.
works.de: A black-and-white geometric composition with national stylisation, at its centre large angular forms bending, at the top small forms shaped like a cube.

works.d: Mustvalge rahvusliku stilisatsiooniga geomeetriline kompositsioon, mille keskmes käänduvad nurgelised suured vormid, nende vahel kuustahuka kujulisi väikevorme.
works.de: A black-and-white geometric composition with a national stylisation, in the centre of which large angular forms curve, between them small forms shaped like cubeoctahedra.

works.d: Mustvalge rahvusliku stilisatsiooniga geomeetriline kompositsioon, mille keskmes nurgelised suured vormid, nende vahel kuustahuka kujulisi väikevorme.
works.de: Black-and-white geometric composition with national stylization, at its centre large angular forms, between them small forms in the shape of an octahedron.

works.d: Tööstusmaastik jalakäijatesilla, hoonete ja elektrimastidega. Sillal mustad inimfiguurid, taustal punane maastik.
works.de: Industrial landscape with a pedestrian bridge, buildings and electricity pylons. Black human figures on the bridge, red landscape in the background.

works.d: Stiliseeritud mägimaastiku vaade, mille mägine osa maalitud skemaatiliselt-mustvalgelt, taustal olev taevas kaetud ühtlaselt kollaselt.
works.de: View of a stylised mountain landscape, whose mountainous part is painted schematically in black and white, the sky in the background covered evenly in yellow.

works.d: Stiliseeritud mägimaastiku vaade, mille mägine osa maalitud skemaatiliselt-mustvalgelt, taustal olev taevas kaetud ühtlaselt kollaselt.
works.de: View of a stylised mountain landscape, whose mountainous part is painted schematically in black and white, the sky in the background covered evenly in yellow.

works.d: Rohelistes toonides abstraktne kompositsioon, mille keskmes rohelistest, lilladest ja sinistest värvipindadest koosnev siluett valgel taustal.
works.de: Abstract composition in green tones, at its centre a silhouette made up of green, purple and blue colour surfaces on a white background.

works.d: Kunstniku prillidega autoportree veerandpöördes paremale. Seljas tumesinine riideese, taustal paremal arhitektuurne-skulpturaalne vorm.
works.de: Self-portrait of the artist with glasses, in a quarter turn to the right. Wearing a dark blue garment, on the right in the background an architectural-sculptural form.

works.d: Natüürmort pudeli, lillevaasi, kala ja kolme sidruniga heledal linal. Maalitud kuivalt ja viimistletud kraapimistehnikas.
works.de: Still life with a bottle, flower vase, fish and three lemons on a light-colored cloth. Painted dry and finished in a scraping technique.

works.d: Kompositsioon maas istuva naise ja tema ees seisva lapsega. Naisel seljas rohekas kleit, lapsel oranž särk, taustal oranžikas-rohekas maastik.
works.de: Composition with a woman sitting on the ground and a child standing in front of her. The woman wears a greenish dress, the child an orange shirt, in the background an orangish-greenish landscape.

works.d: Tugitoolis istuva noore naise otsevaates portree. Naisel peas müts, seljas mantel ja käes kindad, taust tumepunane.
works.de: Frontal portrait of a young woman sitting in an armchair. The woman wears a hat, a coat and gloves, the background is dark red.

works.d: Punakates toonides maastikuvaade taluhoonetega, taustal silmapiir ja rohekas taevas.
works.de: Landscape view in reddish tones with farm buildings, in the background the horizon and a greenish sky.

works.d: Rohekates-pruunikates toonides metsavaade kõrgemate puude ja palmidega.
works.de: Forest view in greenish-brown tones with taller trees and palms.

works.d: Rohekates-pruunides toonides metsavaade puutüvede ja palmidega.
works.de: In greenish-brown tones a forest view with tree trunks and palms.

works.d: Kompositsioon rituaalsete esemetega, mis asetatud seisma tihedalt üksteise kõrvale.
works.de: Composition with ritual objects placed standing closely next to one another.

works.d: Öine linnavaade väljaku ja majadega, millel kollaažitehnikas reklaampildid.
works.de: Night cityscape with a square and houses, on which advertising images in collage technique.

works.d: Tondoformaadis kunstniku pruunis pluusis portree kerge pöördega vasakule. Maalitud kuivalt, taust rohekas-kollakas.
works.de: Tondo-format portrait of the artist in a brown blouse, with a slight turn to the left. Painted dry, background greenish-yellow.

works.d: Tume tööstusmaastik suitsevate korstende ja tootmishoonetega.
works.de: A dark industrial landscape with smoking chimneys and production buildings.

works.t: Kolmekordne Sotsialistliku Töö Kangelane, Tootmisühistu „Rubiin“ peakonstruktor Trofim Pantelejevitš Ptolomei. Sarjast Siberiaad
works.d: Valgete juuste, habeme ja vuntside ning punase ninaga vana mehe portree, rinnas kolm ordenit.
works.de: Portrait of an old man with white hair, beard and moustache, and a red nose, three orders on his chest.

works.t: Tootmisühistu „Rubiin” kontrollpunkti valveülem alampolkovnik Pjotr Ivanovitš Netšitailo. Sarjast Siberiaad
works.d: Korrakaitsja vormis ja mütsiga mehe portree helesinise taeva ja vaatetorniga maastiku taustal. Pildi alla hariliku pliiatsiga kirjutatud kujutatava nimi kirillitsas: Petr Ivanovits Netsitailo.
works.de: Portrait of a man in a police uniform and cap, against a background of light-blue sky and a landscape with a watchtower. Below the picture, written in pencil in Cyrillic, the name of the person depicted: Petr Ivanovich Nechitailo.

works.d: Maastikuvaade raudtee, elektripostide ja pisikese hoonega, ümber puud ja põõsad.
works.de: Landscape view with a railway, electric poles and a small building, surrounded by trees and bushes.

works.de: Portrait of a laughing fair-haired woman in a frontal view with a slight turn to the left.

works.t: Atšinski linna kooli Nr 3 kaheksanda klassi õpilane, liikumise „Naši“ aktivist Mašenka Medvedkina. Sarjast Siberiaad
