works.de: Photo of three shelves holding flasks and fetuses.

works.dm: kõrgus: 17.0 cm (vm); laius: 40.1 cm (raami mõõt); kõrgus: 31.4 cm (raami mõõt); laius: 23.2 cm (vm)
works.d: Näha neli mensuuri laste loodetega, viies, vasakus servas näha poolikuna. Paremalt esimene anum on kõige madalam. Selles kokkusurutud lapse loode. Selle kõrval teine, veidi kõrgem anum, milles terve loode nähtav. Kolmandas, veel suuremas nõus olevale lootele on tehtud kõhu piirkonda neljakandiline sisselõige, mis toob nähtavale siseelundid. Käed ja jalad on köndistatud. Vasakpoolseim on kõige kõrgem anum. Selles olevale lootele on sisselõige tehtud keha alapiirkonda.
works.de: Four mensurae with foetuses of children can be seen, a fifth, in the left edge, can be seen partially. The first vessel from the right is the lowest. It contains a contracted foetus of a child. Next to it, a second, slightly taller vessel, in which a whole foetus is visible. In the third, even larger vessel, the foetus has a square incision made in the abdominal area, revealing the internal organs. The arms and legs are truncated. The leftmost is the tallest vessel. The foetus in it has an incision made in the lower part of the body.

works.dm: kõrgus: 14.5 cm (vm); laius: 36.7 cm (raami mõõt); kõrgus: 26.2 cm (raami mõõt); laius: 22.5 cm (vm)
works.d: EÜS'i grupipilt. Hulk vanu ja noori mehi, mõned värvimütsides, seisavad EÜS'i maja taustal. Esiplaanil trepil istumas kolm meest, keskmine värvimütsis ja lindiga, käes valged kindad. Tema kõrval kaks vana meest. Keskmise, noorema mehe taga veel kaks värvimütside jalintidega noort meest. Foto paremas servas kaks noormeest, parempoolsem hoiab lippu.
works.de: A group photo of the EÜS. A number of old and young men, some in coloured caps, standing against the background of the EÜS house. In the foreground, three men sitting on the steps, the middle one in a coloured cap and sash, with white gloves in his hand. Beside him two old men. Behind the middle, younger man, two more young men in coloured caps and sashes. In the right edge of the photo, two young men, the one on the right holding a flag.

works.dm: kõrgus: 17.7 cm (vm); laius: 34.2 cm (raami mõõt); kõrgus: 23.0 cm (raami mõõt); laius: 23.5 cm (vm)
works.d: Pargis väikese tiigi kaldal, mille taga paistab nelja sambaga madal kahekordne maja, istub puu all toolil laua ääres prillidega mees. Mehe rõivastus on tume, kaelas on näha jämedat ketti ning väikest valget kraekaunistust. Mees istub 3/4 pöördes paremale. Paremal pool, väikesel ümmargusel laual on armulauakarikas, millest ulatuvad välja pärlid/palvehelmed. Esiplaanil vasakul näha suure puu tüve.
works.de: In a park, on the shore of a small pond, behind which a low two-storey house with four columns can be seen, a bespectacled man sits at a table on a chair under a tree. The man's clothing is dark, a thick chain and a small white collar ornament can be seen at his neck. The man sits turned 3/4 to the right. On the right, on a small round table, is a communion chalice, from which pearls/prayer beads protrude. On the left in the foreground the trunk of a large tree can be seen.

works.dm: kõrgus: 14.0 cm (vm); laius: 28.2 cm (raami mõõt); kõrgus: 20.7 cm (raami mõõt); laius: 21.5 cm (vm)
works.d: Tumedas ruumis langeb valgus paremalt aknast. Valgusvihus seisavad alasti naine ja mees. Figuurid asetsevad foto keskosast veidi paremal. Naine on lühem, väga lühikeste juustega, toetumas mehe najale. Vasak käsi selja taga, parem ümber mehe õla. Keha kerges pöördes paremale. Mees hoiab ühe käega naise ümbert kinni, parem käsi küünrast kõverdatud ning peopesa on suu juures, randmel on kell.
works.de: In a dark room light falls from a window on the right. In the beam of light stand a nude woman and a man. The figures are placed slightly to the right of the centre of the photograph. The woman is shorter, with very short hair, leaning against the man. Her left hand is behind her back, the right around the man's shoulder. Her body is in a slight turn to the right. The man holds the woman with one arm around her, his right arm bent at the elbow with the palm near his mouth, a watch on his wrist.

works.dm: kõrgus: 18.0 cm (vm); laius: 35.1 cm (raami mõõt); kõrgus: 27.7 cm (raami mõõt); laius: 24.4 cm (vm)
works.d: Foto keskosas lahtises auto/traktori kastis seisavad kolm alasti naist. Taga vasakul kiviaed, veidi eespool kaks vanaaegse tegumoega tooli. Taamal mitmel pool põõsad ja puudesalud.
works.de: In the central part of the photo, in the open bed of a car/tractor, stand three naked women. Behind on the left a stone wall, a little further forward two old-fashioned chairs. In the background bushes and groves of trees in several places.

works.dm: kõrgus: 17.7 cm (vm); laius: 41.7 cm (raami mõõt); kõrgus: 30.5 cm (raami mõõt); laius: 23.5 cm (vm)
works.d: Foto keskosas pea alaspidi rippuva sea rümp. Paremal seisab profiilis rahvarõivais mees vikatiga, üks jalg toetumas puupakule. Vasakul seisab otsevaates alasti naine, ülakeha kerges pöördes paremale, pea profiilis. Paremas käes hoiab vikatit. Sea ees seisab pakk, millel seisab äratuskell. Kummalgi pool foto servas ülaosas seina löödud kirved. Foto alaosas vastakuti kaks kummikut. Paremas nurgas piilub väike laps. Taustal mets.
works.de: In the middle of the photo, the carcass of a pig hanging head down. At right, a man in national costume stands in profile with a scythe, one foot resting on a wooden block. At left, a nude woman stands in a frontal view, upper body slightly turned to the right, head in profile. In her right hand she holds a scythe. In front of the pig stands a crate, on which stands an alarm clock. On both sides at the top edge of the photo, axes struck into the wall. At the bottom of the photo, two rubber boots facing each other. In the right corner, a small child peeks out. In the background, forest.

works.t: Leiutaja Andres Murdvee ja maalikunstnik Imat Suumann
works.dm: kõrgus: 17.0 cm (vm); laius: 38.4 cm (raami mõõt); kõrgus: 29.4 cm (raami mõõt); laius: 23.0 cm (vm)
works.d: Kahe mehe rinnaportree. Taga vasakul aken, paremal sein. Ees paremal aimatav terjerilaadse koera pea. Vasakpoolne kiilas mees on otsevaates. Kannab hallikat mantlit, tumedat triibulist pintsakut ning valget särki. Aknast tulev valgus langeb vasakule näopoolele, jättes parema poole varuju. Parempoolne tumedas rõivastuses mees on kerges pöördes vasakule, pilk suunatud aknast välja.
works.de: Bust portrait of two men. Behind, on the left a window, on the right a wall. In front on the right, the barely discernible head of a terrier-like dog can be made out. The bald man on the left is shown frontally. He wears a greyish coat, a dark striped jacket, and a white shirt. The light coming from the window falls on the left side of his face, leaving the right side in shadow. The man on the right, dressed in dark clothing, is in a slight turn to the left, his gaze directed out of the window.

works.dm: kõrgus: 16.9 cm; laius: 38.4 cm; kõrgus: 29.4 cm; laius: 23.0 cm
works.d: Pankrannikut meenutaval kaldapealsel lebav naine toetub vasakule küünarvarrele, parem käsi süles. Seljas tume kostüüm, valge pluus, kaelas heledad pärlid. Juuksed on tuulesasised. Vasakul ja keskosas aimatav suurem veekogu, taamal näha silmapiiril kaldajoont.
works.de: A woman lying on a cliff-like shore, resting on her left forearm, right hand in her lap. Wearing a dark costume, a white blouse, light pearls at the neck. Hair windswept. On the left and in the middle part a larger body of water can be discerned, in the distance a shoreline visible on the horizon.

works.dm: kõrgus: 17.4 cm (vm); laius: 38.4 cm (raami mõõt); kõrgus: 29.3 cm (raami mõõt); laius: 23.4 cm (vm)
works.d: Must-valge foto, mille vasak serv on veidi põletatud. Fotol lage väli kahara tammega. Esiplaanil all keskel seisab poolprofiilis naine pea pöördes vasakule. Naisel on seljas triibuline seelik ja valge pikkade varrukatega pluus. Ehitud mitme preesi ja kaelaehtega.
works.de: Black-and-white photograph, its left edge slightly burnt. In the photo an open field with a spreading oak. In the foreground below in the centre stands a woman in half-profile, head turned to the left. The woman wears a striped skirt and a white blouse with long sleeves. Adorned with several brooches and a necklace.

works.t: Maalikunstnik Imat Suumann, muusik Sass Müller, muusik InBoil
works.dm: laius: 29.4 cm (raami mõõt); kõrgus: 38.3 cm (raami mõõt)
works.d: Kaks fotot ühes raamis. FV 43/1 Ülemine foto. Paarisfotod kolmest alasti mehest ja ühest naisest interjööris.Vasakus servas istub jalg üle põlve käsi põsakil ning vasakus käes ajakirja hoidev tumedapealine alasti mees. Tema kõrval seisab, kes parema käega toetub riidega kaetud alusele, millel on kaalud. Veidi eespool paremal istub tugitoolil naine, ülakeha kerges pöördes vasakule. Pea on profiilis, peas tume kähar parukas, ees tumedad päikeseprillid, süles hoiab karpi kaaluvihtidega. Naise taga paremal seisab mees, käed selja taga, pilk suunatud diagonaalselt alla - naise suunas.
works.de: Two photographs in one frame. FV 43/1 Upper photograph. Paired photographs of three naked men and one woman in an interior. On the left edge sits a dark-haired naked man, leg crossed over the knee, hand on his cheek, holding a magazine in his left hand. Beside him stands one who leans with his right hand on a cloth-covered stand holding scales. A little further forward on the right sits a woman in an armchair, her upper body turned slightly to the left. Her head is in profile, wearing a dark curly wig, dark sunglasses in front, holding a box with weights in her lap. Behind the woman on the right stands a man, hands behind his back, gaze directed diagonally downward - towards the woman.

works.dm: kõrgus: 16.5 cm (vm); laius: 38.2 cm; kõrgus: 29.4 cm; laius: 22.7 cm
works.d: Luksuslikus interjööris istub tumedas ülikonnas lühikese tumeda habeme ning vuntsidega mees. Paremale poole jääb mustrilise linaga kaetud ümmargune laud, millel seisab kinnine pudel vahuveini ja pikk klaasist vaas ühe roosiga. Mehe parem käsi toetub lauale, vasak on põlvel. Pintsaku all on hele särk ning tume lips lipsunõelaga. Mehe selja taga seisab suur pommidega kell. Paremale ja vasakule jäävad kaks suurt peeglit, milledest on aimatavalt näha ülejäänud ruumi. Parempoolse peegli ees põleb väike valge laualamp.
works.de: In a luxurious interior sits a man in a dark suit with a short dark beard and moustache. To the right is a round table covered with a patterned cloth, on which stands a closed bottle of sparkling wine and a tall glass vase with a single rose. The man's right hand rests on the table, his left on his knee. Under his jacket is a light shirt and a dark tie with a tie pin. Behind the man stands a large pendulum clock. Two large mirrors are on the right and left, in which the rest of the room can be dimly seen. In front of the right-hand mirror a small white table lamp is burning.

works.dm: laius: 38.3 cm (raami mõõt); kõrgus: 29.4 cm (raami mõõt)
works.d: Kaks kõrvutiasetsevat fotot ühes raamis. FV 45/1 Siseruum  kahe tooli, kardinate ja väikese raamatukapiga. Foto paremas nurgas on näha laual lillelist lina ning taamal diivaninurka. Foto keskel istub mees. Mehel seljas kirju kampsun, jalas sinakad teksapüksid, heledad sokid ning auguga sussid. Otsevaates mehe käed nõjatuvad tooli käetugedele ning peod on süles. Ülaosas on kirjutatud "Hästikirjutaja Hasso Krull aegunud Ameerika plastpaberil" ning signatuur. FV 45/2 Vasakpoolsel fotol sama interjöör. Ühe tooli asemel valge kolme jalaga taburet, rohkem näha diivanit ning selle kohal olevat pilti. Foto keskel istub mees samas asendis, mis eelmiselgi, seljas roosa kleit, kaelas pärlid, süles hoia
works.de: Two photographs side by side in one frame. FV 45/1 An interior with two chairs, curtains and a small bookcase. In the right corner of the photo a floral cloth is visible on a table and a corner of a sofa can be seen in the background. A man sits in the middle of the photo. The man is wearing a patterned sweater, bluish jeans, light socks and slippers with a hole. Facing forward, the man's hands rest on the armrests of the chair with his palms in his lap. At the top is written "Hästikirjutaja Hasso Krull aegunud Ameerika plastpaberil" and a signature. FV 45/2 The same interior in the left-hand photo. Instead of one chair there is a white three-legged stool, more of the sofa is visible along with the picture above it. A man sits in the middle of the photo in the same pose as in the previous one, wearing a pink dress, pearls around his neck, holding something in his lap

works.d: Interjööris istub prillidega mees. Taustal paremal pool lainelise mustriga kardin, vasakul maale täisriputatud sein. Foto keskel istub tugitoolis hallipäine, heleda särgi ja tumeda vestiga mees,  pea pöördes paremale. Parem käsi toetab lõuga, vasak põlvel. Toa põrandal kaks triibulist kaltsuvaipa, millede peal segipaisatud kortsus ja sirgeid paberilehti. Paremas servas serveerimislaud, millel paberid, tass, klaaskauss jm. esemed. Mehest vasakul väikese tabureti peal suur must kirjutusmasin.
works.de: In an interior sits a man with glasses. In the background on the right a curtain with a wavy pattern, on the left a wall completely covered with paintings. In the centre of the photo sits a grey-haired man in an armchair, wearing a light shirt and dark waistcoat, his head turned to the right. His right hand supports his chin, left hand on his knee. On the floor of the room two striped rag rugs, on which scattered crumpled and straight sheets of paper are lying. On the right edge a serving table with papers, a cup, a glass bowl and other objects. To the left of the man, on a small stool, a large black typewriter.

works.dm: kõrgus: 15.0 cm (vm); laius: 26.1 cm (raami mõõt); kõrgus: 31.2 cm (raami mõõt); laius: 13.7 cm (vm)
works.d: Esiplaanil seisab tumedas ülikonnas kikilipsuga mees otsevaates. Mehe vasak käsi on taskus, parem jalg toetub kastile. Kastil diagonaalselt tekst: Gladiator. Tagapool seisab toa nurgas tumedas rõivais tumedapäine naine. Tuba kaetud lillelise tapeediga, põrand hele.
works.de: In the foreground stands a man in a dark suit with a bow tie, frontal view. The man's left hand is in his pocket, right foot resting on a crate. On the crate diagonally the text: Gladiator. Behind, in the corner of the room, stands a dark-haired woman in dark clothing. The room is covered with floral wallpaper, the floor is light.

works.t: DeStudio fotograafid Herkki E. Merila ja Peeter M. Laurits koos modellidega
works.dm: kõrgus: 17.4 cm (vm); laius: 38.2 cm (raami mõõt); kõrgus: 29.4 cm (raami mõõt); laius: 22.2 cm (vm)
works.d: Fotoateljee interjööris väikesel mustal diivanil istuvad kaks blondi pikajuukselist naist, parempoolsel seljas sinine kleit, jalas mustad kõrgete kontsadega kingad. Tüdruku käed on süles. Vasakpoolsel on seljas kollane kleit, neiu istub jalg üle põlve, jalas mustad nöörsaapad, ühe käega hoiab laubal päikeseprille, teine käsi on süles. Diagonaalselt nõjatub diivanile roosakates pükstes, täpilise särgi, triibulise lipsu ja hallika kaabuga prillidega mees. Paremal pool naisi seisab teine mees. Tema hoiab ülestõstetud käes valgustit, rõivastunud musta, traksid kollakas-rohekad. Mees seisab profiilis pea otsevaates.
works.de: In the interior of a photography studio, two blonde, long-haired women sit on a small black sofa; the one on the right is wearing a blue dress and black high-heeled shoes. The girl's hands are in her lap. The one on the left is wearing a yellow dress, the young woman sits with one leg crossed over the other, wearing black lace-up boots, with one hand holding sunglasses at her forehead, the other hand in her lap. Leaning diagonally on the sofa is a man in pinkish trousers, a spotted shirt, a striped tie and a greyish hat, wearing glasses. To the right of the women stands a second man. He holds a light raised in his hand, dressed in black, with yellowish-greenish suspenders. The man stands in profile with his head facing front.

works.d: Vertikaalasendis käed toetuvad alusele. Vasaku käe sõrmed kõverdatud, parema neljas ja viies sõrm sirgelt, paremale suunatud ülejäänud näpud kõverdatud. Pöial puudutab käe sõrmi. Taust hele.
works.de: Hands resting on a base in a vertical position. Fingers of the left hand bent, the fourth and fifth fingers of the right hand straight, the other fingers, pointing to the right, bent. The thumb touches the fingers of the hand. Light background.

works.d: Kaks soonilist jalalaba. Parempoolsel pöid ja varbad kõverdatud. Taust sinakas ja hele.
works.de: Two veined feet. On the right foot the instep and toes are bent. Background bluish and light.

works.d: Istuv meesakt selgvaates. Vasak käsi sirgelt kõrvale sirutatud, parem diagonaalselt all, sõrmedega toetumas aluspinnale. Pea kerges pöördes vasakule. Vasak jalg põlvest kõverdatud ja püsti, parem kõverdatult horisontaalis. Taust valge.
works.de: Seated male nude, seen frontally. The left arm stretched straight out to the side, the right diagonally down, with fingers resting on the base surface. The head slightly turned to the left. The left leg bent at the knee and upright, the right bent horizontally. White background.

works.d: Istuv meesakt selgvaates. Vasak käsi kõverdatud ja toetub põlvele, parem käsi diagonaalis paremale toetub väljasirutatud sõrmedele. Pea rinnal. Taust hele.
works.de: Sitting male nude in back view. Left hand bent and resting on the knee, right hand resting diagonally to the right on outstretched fingers. Head on the chest. Background light.

works.d: Kaks põlvitavat meesakti, kehad taha kallutatud, üks käsi toetub maha, teine tõstetud kuklale. Taust tume.
works.de: Two kneeling male nudes, bodies leaning backward, one hand resting on the ground, the other raised to the back of the neck. Dark background.

works.d: Kaks põlvitavat meesakti, kehad kallutatud kõrvale. Mõlemil üks käsi kuklal, teisega toetuvad maha. Jalapöiad on kõverdatud. Taust tume.
works.de: Two kneeling male nudes, bodies tilted to the side. Each has one hand on the back of the neck, supporting themselves on the ground with the other. Their feet are bent. Background dark.

works.d: Pilvine taevavaade, all ääres ribana võsaga kaetud maastik. Taevas keskel veidi paremal lendab lennuk. Foto keskosas õhupüssi kuulidega tulistamisest tekkinud augukesed. Pinna sisse jäänud kolm tinakuulikest.
works.de: Cloudy sky view, at the bottom edge a strip of landscape covered with scrub. In the middle of the sky, slightly to the right, an airplane is flying. In the central part of the photo there are small holes made by air rifle pellets. Three tiny lead pellets remain embedded in the surface.

works.d: Foto keskjoonest veidi vasakul seisab nõukogude armee vormis sõdur. Paremas käes õla kõrgusel hoiab püstolit. Vasak käsi sirgelt kõrval. Figuur on otsevaates, jalad veidi harkis. Taustal rohumaa, mille taga metsaserv. Paremal pikk ja madal hoone.
works.de: In the photograph, slightly left of the center line, stands a soldier in Soviet Army uniform. In his right hand, held at shoulder height, he holds a pistol. His left hand hangs straight at his side. The figure is seen frontally, legs slightly apart. In the background grassland, behind which the edge of a forest. On the right a long, low building.

works.dm: kõrgus: 61.8 cm (raami mõõt); laius: 46.1 cm (raami mõõt); laius: 40.0 cm (vm); kõrgus: 56.7 cm (vm)
works.d: Helesinisel taustal viis noort naist, riietunud pruutkleitidesse, looride ja lillekimpudega. Taga seisab kolm, vasakul istub üks valgel toolil, kõige ees keskel istub üks naine maas. Kõik otsevaates, pilgud suunatud vaatajale. Bukettides roosad ja valged lilled. Toolil istujal üleni valge kimp. Foto raamitud valge reljeefse raamiga, millel kullaga toonitud profiil, keskel triip marmoreeringut
works.de: Against a light blue background five young women, dressed in bridal gowns, with veils and bouquets of flowers. Three stand behind, one sits on the left on a white chair, in the very front in the middle one woman sits on the ground. All in frontal view, gazes directed at the viewer. In the bouquets pink and white flowers. The one sitting on the chair has an all-white bouquet. The photograph is framed with a white relief frame, on which a gold-toned profile, in the middle a strip of marbling

works.d: Viis lõbutüdrukut, seljas kombineed, jalas sukad istuvad-lösutavad triibulisel kušetil. Toas kollakas triibuline tapeet, tagaseinal neli pilti. Akna ees pitskardin, vasakul toolil vana ventilaator. Ees keskel suur vana kohver, millel on avatud kommikarp ja tuhatoos konidega. Foto ümber roosa paspartuu, mille allosas on kuldse ja valgega kalligraafiliselt kirjutatud F.F.F.F. Raam plastikust, valge väikese kullatud ornamentikaga.
works.de: Five women of easy virtue, wearing combinations, in stockings, sitting-lounging on a striped chaise longue. In the room, a yellowish striped wallpaper, on the back wall four pictures. In front of the window a lace curtain, at left on a chair an old fan. In front in the middle a large old suitcase, on which there is an open box of sweets and an ashtray with cigarette butts. Around the photo a pink mount, at the bottom of which is written calligraphically in gold and white: F.F.F.F. The frame is plastic, white with small gilded ornamentation.

works.d: Sadamas pingil istub neli reisiootel naist, viies seisab paremal, käes värviline ajakiri, nõjatub metallist barjäärile. Naiste ümber maas erineva suurusega reisikotid. Taustal piletikassad, reklaamid. Rohekas marmorpaberist paspartuu. Hall, kitsa kuldse randiga plastikraam.
works.de: In the harbour four women await travel sitting on a bench, a fifth stands on the right, holding a colourful magazine, leaning against a metal barrier. Around the women on the ground travel bags of various sizes. In the background ticket booths, advertisements. Greenish marbled-paper mount. Grey plastic frame with a narrow gold rim.

works.d: Kompositsioon viie naise ja kuue lapsega. Valges ruumis tumerohelisel diivanil istuvad: šotiruudulise vestiga poiss, tema kõrval sinistes teksades heleda pluusiga naine, kelle käsi toetub diivani käsitoele. Tema kõrval istuval naisel on süles väike kirjus kleidis tüdruk. Paremal istub kahe pika patsiga pidulikult riides tütarlaps. Diivani taga seisavad kolm naist - igal neist väike laps süles.
works.de: A composition with five women and six children. In a white room, sitting on a dark green sofa: a boy in a tartan waistcoat, beside him a woman in blue jeans and a light blouse, whose hand rests on the armrest of the sofa. The woman sitting beside her has on her lap a small girl in a patterned dress. On the right sits a girl with two long braids, dressed festively. Behind the sofa stand three women - each with a small child in her arms.

works.d: Viis rahvarõivais naist Tallinna lauluväljaku taustal. Pilti ääristab rahvariidevööd kujutav raamistik. Alaosas vööga ümbritsetud ristkülikus kiri "Tallinn". Pildi üldtonaalsus punakas-oranžikas, vöökiri punase, musta, kollasega. Üldmuljelt 1980ndate laulupeo plakateid meenutav.
works.de: Five women in folk costumes against the background of the Tallinn Song Festival Grounds. The picture is bordered by a frame depicting a folk costume belt. In the lower part, within a rectangle surrounded by a belt, the inscription "Tallinn". The overall tonality of the picture is reddish-orange, the belt inscription in red, black, yellow. Generally reminiscent of song festival posters of the 1980s.

works.d: Heledas, vanaaegses interjööris istuvad viis lillelistes kleitides naist kohvilaua taga. Laud kaetud kuuele. Serviis peenemustriline, kohvikann valge. Laual jalaga vaagen, millel kook. Klaasvaasis tume roos. Foto imiteerib 1930ndate meeleolu. Paspartuu hallikast papist, ümarnurkse avaga. Mustal raamil kullatud siseserv, millel kärbsemusta jälgi.
works.de: Five women in floral dresses sit at a coffee table in a bright, old-fashioned interior. Table set for six. Finely patterned service, white coffee pot. On the table a footed dish with a cake. A dark rose in a glass vase. The photo imitates the mood of the 1930s. Mount of grayish cardboard, with a rounded-corner opening. Gilded inner edge on the black frame, with traces of fly dirt.

works.d: Viis hommikumantlis naist paneelmaja köögis. Paremal kandiline laud, millel teekann, mõned tassid, lilled jm. esemed. Aknast paistab hall paneelmaja. Kolmel naisel on käes tass, kaks on kummardunud lugemismaterjali kohale.
works.de: Five women in dressing gowns in the kitchen of a panel building. On the right a square table, on which a teapot, a few cups, flowers and other objects. Through the window a grey panel building can be seen. Three of the women hold a cup, two are bent over reading material.

works.d: Hallikas-rohelisele vineertahvlile on rõhknaeltega kinnitatud värviline foto. Foto esiplaanil seisavad rivis viis noort naist, seljas sõduririietus, jalas tumedad nööritavad saapad. Kõik seisavad jalad harkis, käed seljal. Näod maskeerimisvärviga triibutatud. Tagaplaanil suur mustav ümar ava.
works.de: A coloured photograph is fastened with drawing pins to a greyish-green plywood panel. In the foreground of the photo five young women stand in a row, wearing soldier's clothing, dark laced boots on their feet. All stand with legs apart, hands behind their backs. Their faces are striped with camouflage paint. In the background a large blackening round opening.

works.d: Öises miljöös viis nahkriietes noort naist tumeda Fordi ees. Esiplaanil kükakil kaks tugevasti meigitud naist. Keskel auto ees seisab punakate juustega naine, käed värvlil. Tagapool, auto kapotil istuvad kaks naist, vasakpoolsel seljas lühike seelik. Teistel pikad mustad püskid jalas. Iga naise juurde kirjutatud hõbedase markeriga nimi.
works.de: In a night setting, five young women in leather clothing in front of a dark Ford. In the foreground two heavily made-up women crouch. In the middle, in front of the car, stands a woman with reddish hair, hands on the fender. Further back, sitting on the car's bonnet, two women, the one on the left wearing a short skirt. The others wear long black trousers. Each woman's name is written next to her in silver marker.

works.d: Kirvemees ajab mööda korterit taga tõenäoliselt tema enda naist ja kahte last. Naine ja lapsed proovivad ennast igale poole ära peita -  küll diivani või voodi taha või kapi taha või teki alla, aga kirvemees leiab nad alati üles ja siis juhtub midagi. Ja iga kord peale seda midagi on kirvemees ikka rohkem ja rohkem verega koos. Naine ja kaks last aga näevad järjest paremad välja. Ja nii muudkui lõputult. (Marko Mäetamm)
works.de: An axe-man is chasing through the apartment, probably his own wife and two children. The woman and children try to hide themselves everywhere - behind the sofa or bed, or behind the cupboard, or under the blanket, but the axe-man always finds them and then something happens. And each time after that something, the axe-man is more and more covered in blood. But the woman and the two children look better and better. And so it goes on endlessly. (Marko Mäetamm)

works.de: Half-figure of a young man with hands. Head turned half to the right, gaze directed at the viewer. Wearing a patterned blouse. Left hand bent up to under the chin, in the right hand a doll with a broken head, wings and a white dress, with a white pearl necklace at the waist.

works.d: Üksteisele järgnevad topeltkujutised erineva rakursi alt. Vasakult paremale: kaks tumedapealist naist ja üks õmblejanna, seejärel heledapäine naine profiilis, esiplaanil laps, järgnevad kujutised pruudist ja heledapäisest naisest kassiga.
works.de: Successive double images from different angles. From left to right: two dark-haired women and a seamstress, then a fair-haired woman in profile, a child in the foreground, followed by images of a bride and a fair-haired woman with a cat.

works.d: Noor meesakt istub maas parema küljega vaataja poole. Jalad ja parem käsi kõverdatult õhus, toetub vasakule küünarnukile. Pilk suunatud vaataja poole. Taustaks drapeeritud kangas.
works.de: A young male nude sits on the ground with his right side towards the viewer. Legs and right arm bent, in the air, resting on the left elbow. Gaze directed towards the viewer. Background of draped fabric.

works.de: In the video, a view out of a window, outside branches of a tree moving in the wind can be seen. A worn book in an antique binding, tied with gauze, with a cotton pad at the crossing point of the gauze ribbons on the front cover. On "top" of the book a faded white baby's bonnet. The book is placed in the middle in front of the video screen.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal valgete linade vahel külili lamava naise (E.-L. Semper) ülakeha. Naise kätes näo juures väike elus hiir. Taustal jooksevad panoraamid suvistest maastikest.
works.de: In the foreground, on the right, the upper body of a woman (E.-L. Semper) lying on her side amid white sheets. In the woman's hands, near her face, a small live mouse. In the background, panoramas of summer landscapes running past.

works.t: Teos sarjast "X mistakes Y for Z"
works.d: Ülal keskel tekst "All Things Electric". Vahelduvad kaks tehismaastikku kujutavat motiivi ja kaks inglisekeelset tekstiplokki. Ülemisel pildil mees mustas ülikonnas, käes kohver ja kepp. Taevas planeeditaoline objekt. Mehe rinda ja objekti ühendab valge looklev joon. All vasakul draakoni  kujutis. Alumisel pildil tehismaastik, millest tõusevad kaks koonuse kujulist ja üks silinderjas moodustis. Neid ümbritseb puudesalu.  All paremal kõndiv inimfiguur.
works.de: At the top centre, the text "All Things Electric". Two motifs depicting artificial landscapes alternate with two blocks of English text. In the upper image, a man in a black suit, holding a suitcase and a cane. In the sky, a planet-like object. A white winding line connects the man's chest to the object. At the bottom left, a depiction of a dragon. In the lower image, an artificial landscape from which two cone-shaped and one cylindrical formation rise. They are surrounded by a grove of trees. At the bottom right, a walking human figure.

works.d: Interaktiivne video- ja heliinstallatsioon. Videoprojektsioon seinal, mille ees seisab mikrofon. Vaataja peab teose aktiveerimiseks mikrofoni laulma või muul moel häält tegema. Ekraanil liibuvas erksavärvilises spordirõivastuses  naine (Mare Tralla), kes reageerides vaataja häälele hakkab erineval moel laulma, liigutama ja hüppama. Taustaks Tallinna Lauluväljaku lava.
works.de: An interactive video and sound installation. A video projection on the wall, in front of which stands a microphone. To activate the work, the viewer must sing or otherwise make a sound into the microphone. On the screen, a woman (Mare Tralla) in tight brightly coloured sportswear, who, reacting to the viewer's voice, begins to sing, move, and jump in various ways. In the background, the stage of the Tallinn Song Festival Grounds.

works.d: Kolmeosaline fotomontaaž moodustab ühtse tervikliku kujundi lamavast mehest pealtvaates. Mehe käed on tõstetud üles, küünarnukkidest kõverdatud. Pea pöördes vasaku õla suunas, silmad suletud. Kasutatud mosaiikseid, ristkülikulaadseid motiive. Kasutatud ka mängukaardimotiivi. Kujutis on must-valge. II ja III osa kergelt koloreeritud punakates-sinistes toonides. III osal sama motiiv, mis I osal, ent tunduvalt tihedam ja suurem.
works.de: A three-part photomontage forms a unified overall image of a reclining man seen from above. The man's arms are raised, bent at the elbows. The head turned towards the left shoulder, eyes closed. Mosaic-like, rectangular motifs are used. A playing-card motif is also used. The image is black-and-white. Parts II and III are lightly coloured in reddish-blue tones. Part III has the same motif as Part I, but considerably denser and larger.

works.d: Fotokollaaž tükkideks lõigatud ja veidi nihestatult kokku pandud ansambel Röövel Ööbiku liikmete (Tõnu Pedaru, Tarvo Hanno Varres, Raul Saaremets, Allan Hmelintski) fotoportreedest. Must-valgete fotoportreede fragmentide vahel trükitud kujutised linnumotiividega joonistustest, fotodest, mosaiikidest ja maalidest.
works.de: Photo collage of an ensemble cut into pieces and assembled somewhat displaced, of photo portraits of the members of the band Röövel Ööbik (Tõnu Pedaru, Tarvo Hanno Varres, Raul Saaremets, Allan Hmelintski). Between the fragments of black-and-white photo portraits printed images with bird motifs from drawings, photos, mosaics and paintings.

works.d: Kuuest paneelist koosnev fotokollaaž, mida eksponeeritakse tervikuna. Kujutis koosneb värvilistest ja must-valgetest fotofragmentidest, millel on kujutatud erinevaid naisenägusid (teiste seas Ly Unt, Ene-Liis Semper) näo- ja kehaosi, kumminuku detaile, rindade mulaaži, triipkoodi. All paremal servas ulatub kujutise serv (naise puus) pildiraamist väljapoole. Fotopaneeli keskosas ripub raamitud hologrammkujutis - heledapäise naise portree (Maria Avdjuško).
works.de: A photo collage consisting of six panels, exhibited as a whole. The image consists of colour and black-and-white photo fragments depicting various women's faces (among others Ly Unt, Ene-Liis Semper), face and body parts, details of a rubber doll, a breast mould, a barcode. In the lower right corner, the edge of the image (a woman's hip) extends beyond the picture frame. In the centre of the photo panel hangs a framed hologram image - a portrait of a fair-haired woman (Maria Avdjuško).

works.d: "Sugar Free" on autori hullumajakogemusel põhinev installatsioon, milles on kesksel kohal metallvardaga ühendatud poolringis liikuv antiikne puidust kapp. Seinal on 18 fotofragmendist koosnev kujutis hoonest. Selle kõrval fotod autorist, millede all sildid "After" ja "Before". Kapi sisemuses on metalltrossidega rippuma kinnitatud tükksuhkruga täidetud metallist linnupuur, mille kohal põleb kaabli otsas rippuv elektripirn. Kapist kõlab helitaust (esimeses versioonis autor lugemas põhiseaduse paragrahve, teises versioonis katkend Gibson Brothersi palast "Paranoia").
works.de: "Sugar Free" is an installation based on the author's experience of a madhouse, in which the central place is occupied by an antique wooden cabinet moving in a semicircle connected by a metal rod. On the wall is an 18-photo-fragment image of a building. Next to it are photos of the author, under which are signs "After" and "Before". Inside the cabinet, a metal birdcage filled with sugar cubes is suspended on metal cables, above which burns an electric light bulb hanging on a cable. A soundtrack sounds from the cabinet (in the first version the author reading paragraphs of the Constitution, in the second version an excerpt from the Gibson Brothers' song "Paranoia").

works.d: Videoinstallatsioon kahest kõrvuti asetsevast videoprojektsioonist, milledest ühel kujutatud alasti lamavat naist, kelle kehal lebavad kutsikad. Teisel videol kujutatud keskmise suurusega koera. Helitaustaks koera niutsumine.
works.de: Video installation of two side-by-side video projections, one of which depicts a nude woman lying down, with puppies lying on her body. The other video depicts a medium-sized dog. Sound background of a dog whimpering.

works.d: Kohaspetsiifiline installatsioon, mis koosneb 18 transparentsest kleebisest, millel on mustade tingmärkidena kujutatud erinevaid tegevusi ja ikoone. Kleebised on mõeldud KUMU hoone klaasist sise- ja välisustele kleepimiseks. Autorite poolt on ära määratud, millised kleebised millistel ustel paiknevad. Videot eksponeerida vastavalt KUMU näitusteprogrammile.
works.de: A site-specific installation consisting of 18 transparent stickers depicting various actions and icons as black symbols. The stickers are intended to be applied to the glass interior and exterior doors of the KUMU building. The authors have specified which stickers are to be placed on which doors. The video is to be displayed according to the KUMU exhibition programme.

works.d: Videoinstallatsioon "Kuuldud jutt" koosneb kaheksast videost, mis jooksevad kaheksal lameekraanil, ning baldahhiinvoodist. Voodit kattev madrats on kaetud lilla aluslinaga. Madratsil on kaheksa erivärvilist (sidrunikollane, soe kollane, oranž, punane, roheline, helesinine, tumesinine, lilla) puuvillase padjapüüriga patja ja neli erivärvilist (sidrunikollane,  oranž, roheline, helesinine) puuvillase tekikoti sees olevat tekki. Kaheksa patja on asetatud ringikujuliselt voodi keskele. Iga padja peale on asetatud paar kõrvaklappe, mis kannab vastava video numbrit, millega ta on ühendatud. Kaheksa lameekraani on asetatud baldahiinvoodi ülemiste talade külge. Videod mängivad ekraanidel katkematult
works.de: The video installation "Kuuldud jutt" consists of eight videos running on eight flat screens, and a canopy bed. The mattress covering the bed is covered with a purple bottom sheet. On the mattress there are eight cotton pillowcase-covered pillows of different colours (lemon yellow, warm yellow, orange, red, green, light blue, dark blue, purple) and four duvets of different colours (lemon yellow, orange, green, light blue) inside cotton duvet covers. The eight pillows are placed in a circular arrangement in the middle of the bed. On each pillow a pair of headphones is placed, bearing the number of the corresponding video to which it is connected. The eight flat screens are attached to the upper beams of the canopy bed. The videos play continuously on the screens

works.d: Interaktiivne installatsioon. Sinise, kollase ja roosa tekstiiliga kaetud hiiglaslik mobiiltelefon. Esiküljel arvutiekraan, millel kuvatud roosal taustal valge kiri "Astrid". Telefoni klahvid lamineeritud plastikuga. Telefoniga saab klahvidele vajutades helistada riigisisestele telefoninumbritele. Vastuvõtja hääl kostub sisseehitatud kõlaris. Valitud number kuvatakse arvutiekraanil.
works.de: Interactive installation. A giant mobile phone covered with blue, yellow and pink textile. On the front side a computer screen displaying white text "Astrid" on a pink background. The phone's keys are laminated with plastic. By pressing the keys one can call domestic telephone numbers with the phone. The receiver's voice can be heard through a built-in speaker. The dialled number is displayed on the computer screen.

works.t: Üks päev riigiarhiivi töötaja elust (One Day of the State Archivist’s Life)
works.dm: pikkus: 6.0 m (varieeruv); kõrgus: 3.5 m (varieeruv); laius: 9.0 m (varieeruv)
works.d: Riigiarhivaari tööruume markeeriv ruumiinstallatsioon koosneb suuremast ruumist ja selle sisse ehitatud väiksemast ruumist, mida lahutavad vaheseinad ja avatud uks. Suuremas ruumis katkematus reas seinal raamitud ja klaasitud joonistused, millel kujutatud realistlikus laadis väikeseid lindusid, väiksemas ruumis uute tulmete hoidla maast laeni ulatuvate raamaturiiulitega, mis täidetud hooletult hallide purunevate vanapaberi massist raamatukujuliste objektidega, riiulite taga eraldatud nurgas arhivaari töölaud J. S. Bachi teost mängiva raadio, lauale asetatud prillide ja poolelijäänud joonistustega lindudest arhiivblankettidel.
works.de: The spatial installation marking the working rooms of the State Archivist consists of a larger room and a smaller room built inside it, separated by partition walls and an open door. In the larger room, along the wall in an unbroken row, are framed and glazed drawings depicting small birds in a realistic style; in the smaller room is a repository of new accessions with floor-to-ceiling bookshelves filled carelessly with book-shaped objects made from a mass of grey, crumbling waste paper; behind the shelves, in a separate corner, is the archivist's desk with a radio playing a work by J. S. Bach, glasses placed on the desk, and unfinished drawings of birds on archive forms.

works.t: Sein ilma kunstiteoseta (A Wall Without a Work of Art)
works.d: Kohaspetsiifiline fotoinstallatsioon koosneb tühja valgustatud näitusesaali seina kujutavast fotost ja fotol näha oleva pika juhtmega lambist, mis on installeeritud foto kohale täpselt fotol kujutatud viisil, võttes aluseks Kumu kunstimuuseumi modernistliku, valgete seinte ja puitparketiga ekspositsioonipinna.
works.de: The site-specific photo installation consists of a photograph depicting the wall of an empty, illuminated exhibition hall and a lamp with a long cord visible in the photograph, installed above the photograph exactly in the manner depicted in the photograph, based on the modernist exhibition space of the Kumu Art Museum with its white walls and wooden parquet floor.

works.dm: kõrgus: 38.8 cm (km.); laius: 38.0 cm (vm.); kõrgus: 40.8 cm (vm.); laius: 36.5 cm (km.)
works.d: Mustvalgel ateljeefotol mitmekordne fotokujutis kahe tumedates riietes mehefiguuriga (vasakul seisev ja külitav Jaak Kadarik, paremal seisev ja astuv Peeter Laurits). Vasakul markeeritud statiivi jalg, paremal õrn statiivil seisva kaamera kujutis, ees põrandal must kaabu, taustaks valge paber.
works.de: A black-and-white studio photograph, a multiple photographic image with two male figures in dark clothing (on the left, standing and reclining, Jaak Kadarik; on the right, standing and stepping, Peeter Laurits). On the left a marked tripod leg, on the right a faint image of a camera standing on a tripod, in front on the floor a black hat, with white paper as background.

works.dm: kõrgus: 27.5 cm (km.); laius: 25.3 cm (vm.); kõrgus: 32.8 cm (vm.); laius: 22.7 cm (km.)

works.de: In the black-and-white multiple photographic image, through a stone-textured wall the image of a girl with two braids and a school cap shows through, in frontal view, with a slight turn of the head to the right.

works.d: Mustvalgel fotol suletud poe räämas fassaad trellitatud ukse ja akende ning tühja infotahvliga, siltidel venekeelsed kirjad, fassaadil akende kohal kulunud kirjad vabariigiaegse äri nimega, taustal hele taevas.
works.de: In the black-and-white photo, the shabby façade of a closed shop with a barred door and windows and an empty information board, texts in Russian on the signs, above the windows on the façade worn lettering with the name of a business from the republic era, a bright sky in the background.

works.d: Mustvalgel fotol räämas kiriku fassaad, kiriku aias kõrgeks kasvanud rohi ja vanaraud: suured saeterad, autoosad ja kastid, kiriku taga puud ja hele taevas.
works.de: Black-and-white photograph of a dilapidated church façade, in the church garden tall overgrown grass and scrap metal: large saw blades, car parts and boxes, behind the church trees and a bright sky.

works.dm: aeg/ kestus: 24.0 sekund; aeg/ kestus: 11.0 minut
works.d: Performance Andrus Joonase kureeritud Pärnu kunsti ülevaatenäitusel Pärnu Uue Kunsti Muuseumis, kus Mari Kartau ilmub näitusesaali punases kleidis, riietub publiku ees lahti, viskab kleidi koos kaelast ja kõrvast võetud võtmetega näitusesaali krüpti ning kleidi alt ilmub nähtavale metalse võre ja tabalukkudega kokku köidetud voorusevöö. Kunstnik laskub ka ise valgustatud ja valge kangaga vooderdatud krüpti, mille põhjas on laiali pillutatuna punaseid roosiõisi ja võtmed, kinnitab end rihmade abil põrandakonstruktsiooni külge ning hakkab kääridega aeglaselt, kiud-kiu haaval läbi lõikama teda hoidvat kinnitusköit. Protsess kestab seni, kuni köis katkeb ja kunstnik selili krüpti põhja valgele k
works.de: A performance at the survey exhibition of Pärnu art curated by Andrus Joonas at the Pärnu New Art Museum, where Mari Kartau appears in the exhibition hall in a red dress, undresses in front of the audience, throws the dress together with keys taken from around her neck and ear into the crypt of the exhibition hall, and beneath the dress a chastity belt bound together with a metal grid and padlocks becomes visible. The artist herself also descends into the illuminated crypt lined with white cloth, at the bottom of which red rose blossoms and keys are scattered, fastens herself to the floor construction with straps, and begins slowly, fibre by fibre, to cut through the rope holding her with scissors. The process continues until the rope breaks and the artist falls on her back onto the white [cloth] at the bottom of the crypt

works.dm: aeg/ kestus: 50.0 sekund; aeg/ kestus: 10.0 minut
works.d: Installatsioon ja performance Tanel Saare isikunäitusel Haapsalu Linnagaleriis, kus grupp alasti gaasimaskides kunstnikke imiteerivad häälitsuse saatel terade nokkimist näitusesaali põrandalt. Ühel hetkel hakatakse kunstnikke publiku seast pilduma toorete munadega, mispeale kunstnikud ükshaaval näitusesaalist lahkuvad. Seejärel heidab üks kunstnikest põrandale pikali, teised aga hakkavad seinalt sinna ühtlase kihina kinnitatud kanajalgasid korjama ja neid lamavale kunstnikule peale heitma, kuni viimane üleni kanajalgadega kattub. Performance toimus Tanel Saare ärakeelatud isikunäituse avamisel ja lõpetamisel Haapsalu Linnagaleriis 28. märtsil 2001. aastal. Näitus koosnes 5000 näitusesaali se
works.de: An installation and performance at Tanel Saar's solo exhibition at the Haapsalu Linnagalerii, where a group of naked artists in gas masks imitate the pecking of grain from the floor of the exhibition hall accompanied by vocalisations. At one point the artists are pelted with raw eggs from among the audience, whereupon the artists leave the exhibition hall one by one. Then one of the artists lies down flat on the floor, while the others begin to collect chicken feet attached in an even layer to the wall and throw them onto the artist lying down, until the latter is completely covered with chicken feet. The performance took place at the opening and closing of Tanel Saar's banned solo exhibition at the Haapsalu Linnagalerii on 28 March 2001. The exhibition consisted of 5000 chicken feet attached to the exhibition hall wall

works.t: Väike maja perifeerias (Little House in the Periphery)
works.dm: sügavus: 7.0 cm (gabariit); laius: 18.6 cm; kõrgus: 19.8 cm
works.d: Miniatuurne puitalusel installatsioon, mille ühes nurgas üksteise suhtes täisnurkselt kaks peeglit ja nende vahel kullast maja neljandik, mis peegeldustega koos moodustab terviku.
works.de: A miniature installation on a wooden base, in one corner of which two mirrors are placed at right angles to each other, and between them a quarter of a golden house, which together with the reflections forms a whole.

works.de: A black-and-white chalk technique portrait of the artist Gerhard Richter. Imitates a negative photograph – the tonal values are reversed from reality

works.d: Installatsioon koosneb väiksemõõduliselt ekraanilt esitatavast animatsioonist ning kahes erinevas formaadis väljatrükkidest, mis on kinnitatud seinale kahes ühtlases horisontaalses ja ühes vertikaalses rivis.
works.de: The installation consists of an animation shown on a small screen and printouts in two different formats, attached to the wall in two even horizontal rows and one vertical row.

works.t: Kunstnik Urmas Puhkani portree (Portrait of Artist Urmas Puhkan)
works.d: Sinise taeva ja rohelise rohuga taustal istub pruunis tugitoolis vasakule vaatav palja ülakehaga mees. Mehel jalas tumesinised püksid, pealael padi, käed toetatud tooli käetugedele.
works.de: Against a background of blue sky and green grass, a bare-chested man sits in a brown armchair, looking to the left. The man wears dark blue trousers, a pillow on his head, hands resting on the chair's armrests.

works.t: In the Middle of a Movie. Helsinki
works.dm: aeg/ kestus: 4.0 sekund; aeg/ kestus: 21.0 minut
works.d: Videoinstallatsioon 6 monitorile. "Kirjuta stsenaarium filmile, mis leiab aset sinu enda kodus ning kus üks osatäitjatest on noor soome naine!" Jagades sellist kuulutust teadetetahvlitel ja tänavaplankudel otsis Soome kunstnik Tellervo Kalleinen inimestega kontakti kuues erinevas maailma linnas (Helsinki, Tallinn, St. Peterburg, Los Angeles, Hamburg, Seydisfjördur). Aastatel 2001-2003 külastas kunstnik ca. 65 kodu, et näidelda stseenariumite järgi, mida inimesed olid projekti tarbeks välja pakkunud.(eesti)
works.de: Video installation for 6 monitors. "Write a scenario for a film that takes place in your own home and in which one of the performers is a young Finnish woman!" By distributing such an advertisement on notice boards and street hoardings, the Finnish artist Tellervo Kalleinen sought contact with people in six different cities around the world (Helsinki, Tallinn, St. Petersburg, Los Angeles, Hamburg, Seydisfjördur). Between 2001 and 2003, the artist visited approx. 65 homes in order to act out the scenarios that people had proposed for the project.

works.d: Eetriaktsioon "Kodumaa uudised" oli Kanal 2 programmis 27., 28. ja 29. septembril 1996. Päevauudiste põhjal luuakse poeetilised tekstid-luuletused, riimitud banaalsuses. Uudised kajastavad Eestis toimuvaid majandus-, poliitika- ja kultuurisündmusi. Võõristusvahendiks on esitatava riimitus. Seda loevad näitlejad, parem kui naine ja mees korraga kaadris. Neid on eelnevalt instrueeritud. Protsess on viimistletud ja lavastatud. Tulemust esitatakse kolmel erineval päeval Kanal 2 kaudu vahetult enne ametlikke uudiseid. Kogupikkus poolteist kuni kolm minutit.
works.de: The broadcast action "Kodumaa uudised" ["National News"] was on Kanal 2's programme on 27, 28 and 29 September 1996. Based on the daily news, poetic texts-poems are created, rhymed banality. The news covers economic, political and cultural events taking place in Estonia. The alienation device is the lack of rhyme in the delivery. It is read by actors, preferably a woman and a man in the frame at the same time. They have been instructed beforehand. The process is polished and staged. The result is presented on three different days via Kanal 2 immediately before the official news. Total length one and a half to three minutes.

works.d: „Igavene tuli“ on lavastatud dokumentaalfilm armastusest propageeritud eeskujude vastu. Nõukogude vaimus üles kasvatatud tütarlaps õpetatakse lugu pidama kangelastest, kelle meeldetuletusi pronksskulptuuridena oli täis kogu meie linn. Neiu usk ideaalsesse aga leiab väljenduse armastuses pühakuju vastu. Selleks on nõukoguliku ateistliku riigikorra ajal kasvanud tütarlapsele Tõnismäe Pronkssõdur. Sõdur aga ei suuda välja kanda Igavese Armastuse kehastamist...
works.de: "Eternal Fire" is a staged documentary film about love for propagated role models. A girl raised in the Soviet spirit is taught to respect heroes, reminders of whom in the form of bronze sculptures filled our whole town. But the girl's faith in the ideal finds expression in love for a sacred image. For a girl who grew up in the era of the Soviet atheist state order, this is the Bronze Soldier of Tõnismägi. But the soldier is unable to bear the embodiment of Eternal Love...

works.d: Hilissuvine äärelinnavaade, mille tagaplaanil suur roostetav tööstushoone ja kaks paneelmaja, esiplaanil päevalillepõld, mille servades õunapuudega ääristatud niit ja madalam hoonetegrupp. Päevalillepõllu ja niidu vahelisel alal lambad ja karjused hobustel, niidu kõrges rohus täisvarustuses sõjaväelased. Värvigamma hilissuviselt soe, taustal kollakas õhtune taevas. Töö kuulub 13. Veneetsia arhitektuuribiennaali Eesti ekspositsiooni võistlusprojekti „Makrorajoon“, milles Kadarik Tüür Arhitektid jätkavad keskustelu Lasnamäe arenduse teemal. Sari esitab ühe Lasnamäe kvartalifragmendi, mille maastik on muudetud tootvaks ja lokaalselt toimivaks makroasumiks.
works.de: A late-summer suburban view, in the background a large rusting industrial building and two panel buildings, in the foreground a sunflower field, bordered by a meadow lined with apple trees and a lower group of buildings. In the area between the sunflower field and the meadow, sheep and shepherds on horses; in the tall grass of the meadow, fully equipped soldiers. A late-summer warm colour scheme, in the background a yellowish evening sky. The work belongs to the competition project "Makrorajoon" of the Estonian exposition at the 13th Venice Architecture Biennale, in which Kadarik Tüür Arhitektid continue the discussion on the theme of the development of Lasnamäe. The series presents a fragment of a Lasnamäe district, whose landscape has been turned into a productive and locally functioning macro-neighbourhood.

works.d: Hilissügisene linnavaade, mille keskmes suur roostetav tööstushoone, selle ümber raagus puid ja madalamaid hooneid ning ees niit, mille kõrges rohus kollane ekskavaator ja rühm täisvarustuses sõjaväelasi. Värvigamma hilissügiseselt soe, taevas ähvardavalt tume ja pilvine. Töö kuulub 13. Veneetsia arhitektuuribiennaali Eesti ekspositsiooni võistlusprojekti „Makrorajoon“, milles Kadarik Tüür Arhitektid jätkavad keskustelu Lasnamäe arenduse teemal, visandades virtuaalreaalsuse vahendusel nõukogude utoopiat kandva linnajao tulevikku. Sari esitab ühe Lasnamäe kvartalifragmendi, mille maastik on muudetud tootvaks ja lokaalselt toimivaks makroasumiks.
works.de: A late-autumn cityscape, at the centre of which a large rusting industrial building, around it bare trees and lower buildings, and in front a meadow, in whose tall grass a yellow excavator and a group of fully equipped soldiers. The colour range is late-autumn warm, the sky menacingly dark and cloudy. The work belongs to the competition project "Makrorajoon" of the Estonian exposition of the 13th Venice Architecture Biennale, in which Kadarik Tüür Arhitektid continue the discussion on the theme of the development of Lasnamäe, sketching through virtual reality the future of a district that carries a Soviet utopia. The series presents a fragment of a Lasnamäe quarter, whose landscape has been transformed into a productive and locally functioning macro-district.

works.d: Varakevadine pommiplahvatuste ja tulekolletega linnavaade, mille tagaplaanil vasakul tuulegeneraatorid, paneelmajade grupp ja plahvatusest tekkinud tossupilv, paremal kõrgepingeliini kandev torn ja paneelmaja. Esiplaanil raagus puudega ääristatud tühermaa metallist mahutite, lennukirusude ja seakarjaga puude all. Värvigamma pruunjas, taustal poolpilvine õhtune taevas. Töö kuulub 13. Veneetsia arhitektuuribiennaali Eesti ekspositsiooni võistlusprojekti „Makrorajoon“, milles Kadarik Tüür Arhitektid jätkavad keskustelu Lasnamäe arenduse teemal. Sari esitab ühe Lasnamäe kvartalifragmendi, mille maastik on muudetud tootvaks ja lokaalselt toimivaks makroasumiks.
works.de: An early-spring cityscape with bomb explosions and fires, in the background on the left wind generators, a group of panel buildings and a cloud of smoke from an explosion, on the right a tower carrying a high-voltage line and a panel building. In the foreground a wasteland lined with bare trees, with metal containers, aircraft wreckage and a herd of pigs under the trees. Brownish colour scheme, in the background a partly cloudy evening sky. The work belongs to the competition project "Makrorajoon" of the Estonian exposition at the 13th Venice Architecture Biennale, in which Kadarik Tüür Arhitektid continue the discussion on the theme of the development of Lasnamäe. The series presents a fragment of a Lasnamäe district, whose landscape has been turned into a productive and locally functioning macro-neighbourhood.

works.d: Talvine mereäärne linnavaade, mille tagaplaanil vasakul kõrgepingeliini kandev torn koos madala tootmishoonestusega, esiplaanil  jäätunud meri ja sellesse saetud augu ääres jääl mootorsaag ja võrguga toimetav kalamees. Värvigamma talviselt-päikseliselt hele, taustal sinine rünkpilvedega taevas. Töö kuulub 13. Veneetsia arhitektuuribiennaali Eesti ekspositsiooni võistlusprojekti „Makrorajoon“, milles Kadarik Tüür Arhitektid jätkavad keskustelu Lasnamäe arenduse teemal. Sari esitab ühe Lasnamäe kvartalifragmendi, mille maastik on muudetud tootvaks ja lokaalselt toimivaks makroasumiks.
works.de: A winter seaside townscape, in the background on the left a pylon carrying a high-voltage power line together with low industrial buildings, in the foreground a frozen sea and, by a hole sawn into it, on the ice, a chainsaw and a fisherman working with a net. The colour scheme is winterly-sunnily bright, in the background a blue sky with cumulus clouds. The work belongs to the competition project "Makrorajoon" of the Estonian exposition at the 13th Venice Architecture Biennale, in which Kadarik Tüür Arhitektid continue the discussion on the theme of the development of Lasnamäe. The series presents a fragment of one Lasnamäe district, whose landscape has been transformed into a productive and locally functioning macro-neighbourhood.

works.d: Hilissügisene äärelinnavaade, mille tagaplaanil vasakul kauge linn koos püramiidiga, paremal maanteesild, esiplaanil raagus puudega ääristatud karjamaa lehmade, šoti mägiveiste ja lammastega ning grupi täisvarustuses sõjaväelastega maanteesilla all paremal. Värvigamma pruunikas-hall, taustal õhtune poolpilvine taevas. Töö kuulub sarja „Aidu püramiidid“, milles Kadarik-Tüür Arhitektid visandavad Aidu põlevkivikarjääri ladestusalale tulevikurakendust kivijäätmetest rajatud püramiidide parklinnaku näol.
works.de: A late-autumn suburban view, with a distant city and a pyramid at the back left, a motorway bridge on the right, and in the foreground a pasture lined with bare trees with cows, Scottish highland cattle and sheep, and a group of fully equipped soldiers under the motorway bridge at the front right. The colour scheme is brownish-grey, with an evening, partly cloudy sky in the background. The work belongs to the series "Aidu Pyramids", in which Kadarik-Tüür Arhitektid sketch a future use for the deposition area of the Aidu oil shale quarry in the form of a pyramid car park built from rock waste.

works.d: Öine veeäärne linnavaade, mille tagaplaanil vasakul tuledes hooned ja püramiid, esiplaanil vasakul vesi ja paremal rongijaam raudteesõlmega. Värvigamma öiselt tume. Töö kuulub sarja „Aidu püramiidid“, milles Kadarik-Tüür Arhitektid visandavad Aidu põlevkivikarjääri ladestusalale tulevikurakendust kivijäätmetest rajatud püramiidide parklinnaku näol.
works.de: A night-time waterside city view, with lit buildings and a pyramid in the background on the left, water in the foreground on the left and a railway station with a rail junction on the right. The colour scheme is dark, nocturnal. The work belongs to the series "Aidu Pyramids", in which Kadarik-Tüür Arhitektid sketch a future use for the deposition area of the Aidu oil shale quarry in the form of a parking-city built of pyramids made from stone waste.

works.d: Hilissügisene linnavaade, mille tagaplaanil paremal kõrge kaasaegne linnak koos neljarealise autoteega, esiplaanil vasakul hooneosa rõduga, millel seisavad kaks inimest, taustal püramiidide parklinnak, mille horisontaalsetel pindadel väiksemaid hooneid, raagus puid ja inimesi. Värvigamma valkjas-hall, taustal hallide pilveräbalatega hele taevas. Töö kuulub sarja „Aidu püramiidid“, milles Kadarik-Tüür Arhitektid visandavad Aidu põlevkivikarjääri ladestusalale tulevikurakendust kivijäätmetest rajatud püramiidide parklinnaku näol.
works.de: A late-autumn cityscape, in the background on the right a tall modern complex with a four-lane road, in the foreground on the left part of a building with a balcony on which two people stand, in the background a pyramid-shaped parking complex, on the horizontal surfaces of which smaller buildings, bare trees and people. The colour scheme is whitish-grey, in the background a light sky with grey shreds of cloud. The work belongs to the series "Aidu Pyramids", in which Kadarik-Tüür Arhitektid sketch a future use for the deposit area of the Aidu oil shale quarry in the form of a parking complex made of pyramids built from stone waste.

works.d: Hilissügisene linnavaade, mille tagaplaanil valged kõrged paneelelamud, esiplaanil vasakul püramiidide parklinnak, mille erinevatel horisontaalsetel pindadel raagus puid ja inimgruppe, esiplaanil paremal paneelmajade vahelt vooklev maanteesild koos teedesõlmega. Värvigamma valkjas helehall, taustal sudusse mähkuv taevas. Töö kuulub sarja „Aidu püramiidid“, milles Kadarik-Tüür Arhitektid visandavad Aidu põlevkivikarjääri ladestusalale tulevikurakendust kivijäätmetest rajatud püramiidide parklinnaku näol.
works.de: A late-autumn cityscape with tall white panel apartment buildings in the background, a pyramid-shaped car park at the front left with bare trees and groups of people on its various horizontal surfaces, and at the front right a winding motorway bridge with an interchange running between the panel buildings. The colour scheme is whitish light grey, with the sky in the background wrapped in haze. The work belongs to the series "Aidu Pyramids", in which Kadarik-Tüür Arhitektid sketch a future use for the deposition area of the Aidu oil shale quarry in the form of a pyramid car park built from rock waste.

works.t: Audioraamatu peatükk Holger Kaintsi raamatust „Lennukivaatleja“. Soodevahe Muuseum
works.dm: aeg/ kestus: 52.0 sekund; aeg/ kestus: 53.0 minut
works.d: Audioraamatu peatükk Holger Kaintsi raamatust „Lennukivaatleja“ (2009), milles kirjeldatud taasiseseisvumisjärgsest ühiskonnast võõrandunud erakliku minajutustaja tegevust Soodevahe aedlinnakus, kus ta veedab aega Tallinna lennuvälja lennuliiklust jälgides ning sellega haakuvaid vandenõuteooriaid arendades. Taustaks aialappide tehasetöölistele väljajagamise ja Soodevahe aianduskooperatiivi tekkimise lugu. Audioraamatut loeb Rasmus Kaljujärv. Salvestus Timo Toots.
works.de: An audiobook chapter from Holger Kaints' book "Lennukivaatleja" (2009), which describes the actions of a reclusive first-person narrator, alienated from post-independence society, in the Soodevahe garden town, where he spends his time watching the air traffic at Tallinn Airport and developing related conspiracy theories. The background is the story of the distribution of garden plots to factory workers and the emergence of the Soodevahe gardening cooperative. The audiobook is read by Rasmus Kaljujärv. Recording by Timo Toots.

works.d: Heliinstallatsioon koosneb viiest torpeedokujulisest objektist, mis asetsevad metallist statiividel. Torpeedod installeeritakse koos ventilatsioonisüsteemiga, mis asub objektide taga. Torpeedokujulised objektid tekitavad vastavalt tiivikute pöörlemiskiirusele impulssheli. Pöörlemiskiirust muudetakse ventilatsioonitorus asuva reguleerimisklapiga.
works.de: The sound installation consists of five torpedo-shaped objects placed on metal stands. The torpedoes are installed together with a ventilation system located behind the objects. The torpedo-shaped objects produce a pulsating sound according to the rotation speed of the impellers. The rotation speed is adjusted with a regulating valve located in the ventilation duct.

works.t: In the Middle of a Movie. Hamburg
works.dm: aeg/ kestus: 15.0 sekund; aeg/ kestus: 30.0 minut
works.d: Videoinstallatsioon 6 monitorile. "Kirjuta stsenaarium filmile, mis leiab aset sinu enda kodus ning kus üks osatäitjatest on noor soome naine!" Jagades sellist kuulutust teadetetahvlitel ja tänavaplankudel otsis Soome kunstnik Tellervo Kalleinen inimestega kontakti kuues erinevas maailma linnas (Helsinki, Tallinn, St. Peterburg, Los Angeles, Hamburg, Seydisfjördur). Aastatel 2001-2003 külastas kunstnik ca. 65 kodu, et näidelda stseenariumite järgi, mida inimesed olid projekti tarbeks välja pakkunud.(eesti)
works.de: Video installation for 6 monitors. "Write a scenario for a film that takes place in your own home and in which one of the performers is a young Finnish woman!" By distributing such an advertisement on notice boards and street hoardings, the Finnish artist Tellervo Kalleinen sought contact with people in six different cities around the world (Helsinki, Tallinn, St. Petersburg, Los Angeles, Hamburg, Seydisfjördur). Between 2001 and 2003, the artist visited approx. 65 homes in order to act out the scenarios that people had proposed for the project.

works.d: „Igavene tuli“ on lavastatud dokumentaalfilm armastusest propageeritud eeskujude vastu. Nõukogude vaimus üles kasvatatud tütarlaps õpetatakse lugu pidama kangelastest, kelle meeldetuletusi pronksskulptuuridena oli täis kogu meie linn. Neiu usk ideaalsesse aga leiab väljenduse armastuses pühakuju vastu. Selleks on nõukoguliku ateistliku riigikorra ajal kasvanud tütarlapsele Tõnismäe Pronkssõdur. Sõdur aga ei suuda välja kanda Igavese Armastuse kehastamist...
works.de: "Eternal Fire" is a staged documentary film about love for propagated role models. A girl raised in the Soviet spirit is taught to respect heroes, reminders of whom in the form of bronze sculptures filled our whole town. But the girl's faith in the ideal finds expression in love for a sacred image. For a girl who grew up in the era of the Soviet atheist state order, this is the Bronze Soldier of Tõnismägi. But the soldier is unable to bear the embodiment of Eternal Love...

works.d: Ruumiinstallatsioon. Ruumi eraldab kaheks laest maani ulatuv pastelsetes toonides ribadeks lõigatud kardin. Põrandal asetsevad erinevad sarnastes toonides üle värvitud objektid - tekstiilid, valmisesemed, alusraamile tõmmatud lõuendisirmid. Põrand kaetud valge kattega.
works.de: Spatial installation. The space is divided in two by a curtain cut into strips in pastel tones, reaching from ceiling to floor. On the floor lie various objects repainted in similar tones - textiles, ready-made objects, canvas screens stretched on stretcher frames. The floor is covered with a white cover.

works.d: Installatsioon koosneb 70 minimaalist, mis on maalitud 1990ndate algul taasiseseisvunud Eesti Vabariigis käibel olnud ostukaartidele, milledel on kujutatud Tallinna panoraamvaadet. Maalid paiknevad seinal kas ühtlase reana või mitmes reas korrapäraselt üksteise alla paigutatuna.
works.de: The installation consists of 70 minipaintings, painted on shopping cards that were in circulation in the Republic of Estonia, which regained its independence in the early 1990s, depicting a panoramic view of Tallinn. The paintings are arranged on the wall either in a single even row or in several rows placed regularly one below the other.

works.t: Loo_oma_aed (oma elutuppa Lasnamäel)/Create_Your_Garden (in Your Living Room in Lasnamäe)
works.dm: aeg/ kestus: 22.0 sekund; aeg/ kestus: 5.0 minut
works.d: Eestist juba Nõukogude ajajärgul lahkunud filmimees Ilmar Taska ja tema õde, Tõnis Vindi koolkonnast välja kasvanud kunstnik Marje Taska rekonstrueerivad nende emale kuuluva Lasnamäe korteri, käsitledes akendele suunatud videoprojektsioonides unistusi maailmast, mille sarnasust Eedeni aiaga rõhutavad Californias üles filmitud aiad.
works.de: Filmmaker Ilmar Taska, who already left Estonia in the Soviet era, and his sister Marje Taska, an artist who grew up out of Tõnis Vint's school, reconstruct their mother's flat in Lasnamäe, addressing, in video projections directed at the windows, dreams of a world whose resemblance to the Garden of Eden is emphasised by gardens filmed in California.

works.d: Installatsioon koosneb: vastu sammast või seina toetuv Diasec foto, mis on kinnitatud ülaosas õhukompressori spiraalvoolikuga ning mille põrandale toetuvate nurkade all on sinised silikoonist pehmendused. Kobalti sinise pigmendiga värvitud mereliivast moodustatud "loikudel" paiknevad  kaks UV prindiga trükitud pleksiklaasist skulptuuri ja tahvelarvuti hoidja, millel on UV prindiga kuumtöödeldud pleksiklaas. Monitoris mängib video koos kõrvaklappidest tuleva heliga. Monitori ees 3 tumehalliks värvitud fiboplokki, mis on pehmendatud memory foami ning wondergel’ist istmepehmendustega.
works.de: The installation consists of: a Diasec photograph leaning against a column or wall, attached at the top with an air compressor coil hose, with blue silicone cushioning under the corners resting on the floor. On "puddles" formed from sea sand painted with cobalt blue pigment are placed two UV-printed plexiglass sculptures and a tablet holder with UV-printed heat-treated plexiglass. A video plays on the monitor with sound coming from headphones. In front of the monitor are 3 fibo blocks painted dark grey, cushioned with memory foam and wondergel seat cushioning.

works.d: Renessansskunsti ja popkultuuri motiive ühendav animatsioon Tommy Cashi muusikavideotele omases absurdi ja huumorit kasutavas võtmes. Kesksed tegelased on Tommy Cashi ja Rick Owensi animeeritud alter egod. Teos on valminud näitusele "Tommy Cash ja Rick Owens. Süütud ja neetud".
works.de: An animation combining motifs of Renaissance art and pop culture, in the absurd and humorous key characteristic of Tommy Cash's music videos. The central characters are the animated alter egos of Tommy Cash and Rick Owens. The work was created for the exhibition "Tommy Cash and Rick Owens. The Innocent and the Damned".

works.de: The work depicts an old Seto woman wearing a headscarf and white clothing, holding her right index finger near her mouth and her left hand on her chest. The woman is wearing a backpack.

works.d: Installatsioon koosneb postamendile paigutatud naisekujust (autori keha kipsjäljend), mis on kaetud soola ja marjadest valmistatud kettidega, seda ümbritsevatest 30 väikest seinale kinnitatud sahtlist marjadega ning teises ruumis eksponeeritavast 30 A3 formaadis maajumalanna kujutisega fotost (valikuline).
works.de: The installation consists of a female figure placed on a pedestal (a plaster cast of the author's body), covered with chains made of salt and berries, surrounded by 30 small drawers with berries fixed to the wall, and, exhibited in another room, 30 photographs in A3 format depicting the earth goddess (optional).

works.d: Punane tahukakujuline maja lameda katusega, neljas nurgas teiba otsas kuldsed nikerdused (käelaba, valitsejakepi ots jne) Aknad maalitud: lille- (emaka)motiiv, must looma vms. figuur kollasel taustal, kontsentriline ring jm. Sees valged madratsid, lagi pitsitaolisest kangast, seinad määrdunud-valged. Maja juurde kuulub jupp valgeks värvitud lippidest aeda.
works.de: A red cuboid-shaped house with a flat roof, at each of the four corners golden carvings on top of a pole (a hand, the end of a ruler's staff, etc.). The windows are painted: a flower (uterus) motif, a black animal or similar figure on a yellow background, a concentric circle, etc. Inside, white mattresses, a ceiling of lace-like fabric, walls of dirty white. Attached to the house is a section of fence painted with white flags.

The windows are painted: a flower (uterus) motif, a black animal or similar figure on a yellow background, a concentric circle, etc. Inside, white mattresses, a ceiling of lace-like fabric, walls of dirty white. Attached to the house is a section of fence painted with white flags.

works.d: Kahel vastamisi asetatud ekraanil paralleelselt vaadeldav videofilm. Ühel ekraanil TV puldiga noormees, teisel mitmes plaanis lahtiriietuvad naisterahvad. Naiste tegevust jälgiv noormees reageerib nähtavale vajutades puldil kiirendusele, täpsusele, detailidele jne. Ruum, kus naised poseerivad, on hallikate seinte ning punase põrandaga. Noormees vahetab pidevalt kanaleid, vahepeal sööb komme.
works.de: A video film viewed in parallel on two screens placed facing each other. On one screen a young man with a TV remote, on the other several women undressing in several shots. The young man, watching the women's activity, reacts to what he sees by pressing speed, precision, details, etc. on the remote. The room where the women pose has greyish walls and a red floor. The young man constantly changes channels, meanwhile eating candy.

works.d: Ülal vasakul valge kiri: Academy Award Prizewinners. Ülaltvaates must-valge foto sõjaväeroodudest, kõige ees astuvad kolm meest, keskmine kannab trikoloori. Keset pilti suur erkpunane karvapall. Allä äres eraldi ridades valge kiri: Special Apperance by/ Sir Alfred Tea/A Simon Goldpath Film/Boeuf A La Tartar/they become friends for life. All tumedaga väike kiri: Carbonary Pictures presents. All paremas nurgas logo ja kiri: While Away films
works.de: Upper left, white text: Academy Award Prizewinners. A black-and-white photograph seen from above of military companies, in front three men are marching, the middle one carrying a tricolour. In the middle of the picture a large bright red furball. At the bottom edge, in separate lines, white text: Special Appearance by/ Sir Alfred Tea/A Simon Goldpath Film/Boeuf A La Tartar/they become friends for life. Below in dark small text: Carbonary Pictures presents. In the lower right corner a logo and text: While Away films

works.d: Kõrvuti istuvad indiaanipäraste näojoontega naine ja tema vasaku õla taga naisega samas mõõdus kikkis kõrvadega must sileda karvaga loom. Pilk mõlemal vaataja poole. Naisel seljas lilla valgete ääristega kampsun, käed süles, põlvedel triibuline vaip. Keskel suurte valgete tähtedega: Ellinor Crimson. All väiksemalt: They like nuts for better for worse. Selle all: A Trinidad & Tobago Film. Päris all kollases kirjas: Carbonary Pictures Presents. All parema nurgas logo ja kiri: While Away Films
works.de: Side by side sit a woman with Native American facial features and, behind her left shoulder, an animal of the same size as the woman, with pricked-up ears and black smooth fur. Both gazes are directed at the viewer. The woman is wearing a purple sweater with white trim, her hands in her lap, a striped blanket on her knees. In the centre in large white letters: Ellinor Crimson. Below, smaller: They like nuts for better for worse. Below that: A Trinidad & Tobago Film. At the very bottom in yellow lettering: Carbonary Pictures Presents. In the lower right corner a logo and text: While Away Films

works.d: Foto ümarast tornist, millel on suurte punaste tähtedega kirillitsas kiri "Mai". Pildi alumist osa katab punalipp, selle taustal paistab tumeda peaga tüdruk peas punane kapuuts. Keskel helesiniste tähtedega kiri: Obivilion Bugs. All valge kiri: Carbonary Pictures presents. All Paremal nurgas logo, vasakul kiri: While Away Films.
works.de: A photo of a round tower bearing an inscription in Cyrillic in large red letters reading "Mai". The lower part of the picture is covered by a red flag, against the background of which a dark-headed girl wearing a red hood is visible. In the middle, text in light blue letters: Obivilion Bugs. Below, white text: Carbonary Pictures presents. In the lower right corner a logo, on the left text: While Away Films.

works.d: Esiplaanil tüdruku valgetes põlvikutes ja kõrge kontsaga kingades jalad tagantvaates. Tagaplaanil vasakul kükitav valgetes põlvikutes pikkade juustega tüdruk, paremal profiilis aknast välja vaatav mees. Paremal ülal väike kiri: eagles dont use stairs. Keskel suur valge kiri: Charmingly in Charge. All vasakul: Freckie Koala, paremal: Logan Embers. All: Carbonary Pictures presents. All paremal nurgas logo ja kiri: While Away Films
works.de: In the foreground, a girl's legs in white knee-socks and high-heeled shoes, seen from behind. In the background at left, a crouching girl with long hair in white knee-socks, at right a man in profile looking out of a window. At upper right, small text: eagles dont use stairs. In the middle, large white text: Charmingly in Charge. At lower left: Freckie Koala, at right: Logan Embers. At bottom: Carbonary Pictures presents. In the lower right corner, a logo and text: While Away Films

works.d: Must-valge foto lina all lebavast naisest, paistab ainult tumedate juustega pea suures plaanis, pilk pööratud vasakule. Ülal paremal aknaraami nurk, vasakult sirutub naise pea kohale käe vari. Keskel suur must kiri: Thilda Thumb II. Selle all valgega: Enriko Palazzi Ernst Flex. Allservas mustaga: she couldn't help herself. Selle all: Carbonary Pictures presents/ A Mimmi Cria Film. Produced. All paremal nurgas logo ja kiri: While Away Films
works.de: Black-and-white photograph of a woman lying under a sheet, only her head with dark hair is visible in close-up, her gaze turned to the left. Upper right, the corner of a window frame, from the left a shadow of a hand stretches above the woman's head. In the middle, large black text: Thilda Thumb II. Below it in white: Enriko Palazzi Ernst Flex. In the lower part in black: she couldn't help herself. Below it: Carbonary Pictures presents/ A Mimmi Cria Film. Produced. In the lower right corner a logo and text: While Away Films

works.d: Kaks kõrvuti seisvat peata mannekeeni, seljas valged meestesärgid. Taustal puude varjud. Esiplaanil valge karp punase kirjaga How to Host a Murder, sellel kirevad idamaised kujukesed ja kaks halli silindrikujulist kinnist anumat. Ülal vasakul väike valge kiri: dead men tell no tales. Selle all: How to Host a Murder. Vasaku mannekeeni kohal: Angus Mapple, parema kohal: Bracha Lisson. All paremal nurgas: Carbonary Pictures presents nin logo ja kiri: While Away Films
works.de: Two headless mannequins standing side by side, wearing white men's shirts. In the background shadows of trees. In the foreground a white box with red lettering "How to Host a Murder", with colourful oriental figurines on it and two grey cylindrical closed vessels. At the top left small white text: "dead men tell no tales". Below it: "How to Host a Murder". Above the left mannequin: "Angus Mapple", above the right one: "Bracha Lisson". In the lower right corner: "Carbonary Pictures presents" with a logo and the text: "While Away Films"

works.d: Istuv akt pöördes paremale. Seljatoele ntoetub külje ja vasaku küünarnukiga. Vasak jalg istumise all, parem ees kõverdatult. Istub kollakal riidel, taga paremal sinine, vasakul roosa kangas. Maaliline käsitluslaad.
works.de: Seated nude, turned to the right. Leans against the backrest with her side and left elbow. Left leg beneath the seated body, right leg bent forward. Sitting on a yellowish cloth, behind her on the right blue, on the left pink fabric. Painterly manner of execution.

works.d: See on see pilt, mis viis mind hullumajja. Maalitud 25-26 nov. 1948 a. 2-he lühikeseseansi jooksul pärast Leningradi reisust saadud ergutavaid muljeid. Maalitud vana töö pääle. Õli õrn-, värvi- ja nüansirikas etüüd. See, koos teistega oli mõeldud järgnevalt kavatsetava tõsisema tööperioodi alustuseks - kuna juba tükil ajal tundsin end pahasti ja ei saanud töötada vahepääl. Lakkimisel 28. nov - 1. dets. 1948 a. täielikult riknenud (läks väga tumedaks, poriseks, koloriit kadus, värv sulas üles, jooksis kokku ja aluspõhi tuli mitmest kohast nähtavale, sest et pealmine oli hävinenud. Sellele sündmusele järgnes suur meeleheit ja mitmeks ööks unetus. Edasi arenesid kõige raskemad hingelised läbiel
works.de: This is the painting that drove me to the madhouse. Painted 25-26 Nov. 1948 in 2 short sessions after the stimulating impressions gained from a trip to Leningrad. Painted over an old work. A tender, colour- and nuance-rich oil study. This, together with others, was meant as the beginning of a more serious working period planned to follow - since for some time already I had been feeling unwell and had not been able to work in the meantime. Completely ruined during varnishing 28 Nov - 1 Dec 1948 (became very dark, muddy, the colour scheme was lost, the paint dissolved, ran together and the underlying ground became visible in several places, because the top layer had been destroyed). This event was followed by great despair and sleeplessness for several nights. Further on developed the most difficult mental experi[ences]

works.de: Wall hanging. A tapestry woven using various fabric techniques from woollen yarns of differing thicknesses. On a brownish-toned ground a dark brown pole gate. Beside the gate, in yellow, red and green colours, two trees. On the back of the tapestry a piece of light-coloured fabric is glued on, bearing information about the artist and the year of production, 1985.
