works.d: Elutuba, paremal mängib roosas kleidis tütarlaps klaverit, vasakul istub poiss diivanil ja mängib tšellot. (eesti)
works.de: Living room, on the right a girl in a pink dress plays the piano, on the left a boy sits on a sofa playing the cello.

works.d: Natüürmort karahvini, kahe pitsi ja kollaseid lilli täis vaasiga.(eesti)
works.de: Nature morte with a carafe, two lace pieces and a vase full of yellow flowers.

works.d: Pruunis vaasis sügisene pihlakaoks. Punane kobar paremal, kollakas-rohelised pihlalehed vasakul. Laua pind helesinine.
works.de: An autumn rowan branch in a brown vase. Red cluster on the right, yellowish-green rowan leaves on the left. The table surface is light blue.

works.d: Järv paadisilla ja kahe silla külge kinnitatud paadiga. Järvel purjekad, taamal mets ja üksikud majad. Selge taevas üksikute pilvedega.
works.de: A lake with a boat jetty and a boat tied to two bridges. Sailboats on the lake, forest and single houses in the distance. Clear sky with a few clouds.

works.d: Punaste õite ja sinkjates ning kollastes toonides lehtedega alpikann. Taga aken.
works.de: A cyclamen with red flowers and leaves in bluish and yellowish tones. A window behind.

works.d: Pildil Pärnus olev Munamägi koos sellel asuva paviljoniga.(eesti)
works.de: The picture shows Munamägi in Pärnu together with the pavilion located on it.

works.d: Pildil põld peale maaparandustöid. Kauguses üksik maja metsa ääres. (eesti)
works.de: The picture shows a field after land improvement works. In the distance a solitary house at the edge of the forest.

works.d: Pildil vasakul puud aia sees. Maja taga üksik suur puu, kaugemal tee ääres kuused. Külavahetee on ääristatud kividega, nendest paremal on veekogu.(eesti)
works.de: In the picture on the left, trees within a garden. Behind the house a single large tree, further away by the road spruces. The village road is lined with stones, to the right of them is a body of water.(eesti)

works.d: Poiss ja tüdruk kannavad süsta (en dos). Taamal kaks kuuri, neist parempoolse uks lahti. Kaugemal mõned puud.(eesti)
works.de: A boy and a girl carry a canoe (en dos). In the background two sheds, the right one's door open. Further away some trees.

works.d: Paadisild jõe ääres. Kaks noormeest lasevad süsta vette. Kaugemal jõel on kaks paatkonda. Vastaskaldal majad. Jõepind ja taevas on värvitud sinise akvarelliga.(eesti)
works.de: A boat landing by a river. Two young men are launching a canoe into the water. Further away on the river there are two boat crews. Houses on the opposite bank. The river surface and sky are painted with blue watercolour.

works.d: Koidula ausammas Pärnus, taga hotellihoone, paremal taga puud. (eesti)
works.de: Monument to Koidula in Pärnu, hotel building behind, trees on the right in the background.

works.d: Esiplaanil jõgi, veepinna kohal lendavad kajakad. Vastaskaldal paistavad majad, mille varjud peegelduvad vette. Pilved majade kohal on viirutatud õrnade suletõmmetega. Jõe pind ja taevas on toonitud sinise akvarellvärviga.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground a river, gulls flying above the water surface. On the opposite bank houses are visible, their shadows reflected in the water. The clouds above the houses are hatched with delicate pen strokes. The surface of the river and the sky are tinted with blue watercolour paint.

works.d: Poiss istub kivihunnikul ja joonistab. Joonistuslaud on toetatud põlvedele. Kaugemal aimatavad puude siluetid.(eesti)
works.de: A boy sits on a pile of stones and draws. The drawing board is resting on his knees. Silhouettes of trees can be discerned in the distance.

works.d: Koolipoiss, uisud õlal. Poiss on palja peaga, pluusiväel, sall kaelas. Paremas käes on kindad, vasakuga toetab uiske.(eesti)
works.de: A schoolboy, skates on his shoulder. The boy is bare-headed, wearing a blouse, a scarf around his neck. In his right hand are gloves, with his left hand he supports the skates.

works.d: Esiplaanil pumbakaev, sellest paremal pumpab naine vett, parem jalg toetub kaevu äärele. Tagaplaanil puud ja põõsad.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground a pump-well, to the right of it a woman pumps water, her right leg resting on the edge of the well. In the background trees and bushes.

works.d: Joonistus kipsist käest, mis toetub ristkülikukujulisele alusele. Taust varjutatud tumedaks.(eesti)
works.de: Drawing of a plaster hand resting on a rectangular base. Background shaded dark.

works.d: Joonistus kipsist käest stiliseeritud akantuseoksaga.(eesti)
works.de: Drawing of a plaster hand with a stylised acanthus branch.

works.d: Joonistus kipsist valmistatud lapse peast poolprofiilis vasakule.(eesti)
works.de: Drawing of a plaster-cast child's head in half-profile to the left.

works.d: Kipsist valmistatud Krõlovi maski joonistus otsevaates. (eesti)
works.de: Frontal drawing of a Krylov mask made of plaster.

works.d: Lindu on joonistatud kolmes vaates. Ülemine lind, suurim neist, on vaatega paremale. Keskmine lind on joonistuspaberi paremal serval ja kõige väiksem. Kolmas lind on vaatega vasakule.(eesti)
works.de: A bird is drawn in three views. The uppermost bird, the largest of them, faces right. The middle bird is at the right edge of the drawing paper and is the smallest. The third bird faces left.

works.d: Poiss ja tüdruk, kes toetuvad lauale. Tütarlapsest on joonistatud ainult ülakeha. Laua alumine osa on välja joonistamata.(eesti)
works.de: A boy and a girl leaning on a table. Only the upper body of the girl is drawn. The lower part of the table is not drawn.

works.d: Portreemaal poetess Lydia Koidulast neiuna - Pärnu Kõrgema Tütarlastekooli õpilasena.(eesti)
works.de: Portrait painting of the poetess Lydia Koidula as a young girl - as a pupil of the Pärnu Higher Girls' School.

works.d: Keskel puukirik torniga, esiplaanil üksik rist, selle taga kiviaed koos puuväravaga. Pildi servades osaliselt kujutatud puud.(eesti)
works.de: In the centre a wooden church with a tower, in the foreground a solitary cross, behind it a stone wall with a wooden gate. Trees partially depicted at the edges of the picture.

works.d: Keskel paljajalu inimfiguur laialisirutatud kätega. Tema pea ja käte kohal lendavad stiliseeritud linnud, liblikad ja kiilid. Taamal mets.(eesti)
works.de: In the middle a barefoot human figure with outstretched arms. Above his head and arms fly stylised birds, butterflies and dragonflies. A forest in the distance.

works.d: Esiplaanil vertikaalsetest laudadest ja jämedatest palkidest väravapostidega õuevärav. Vasakul ristpalkidest hoone, paremal samasuguse hoone otsasein. Tagapool puud.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground, a courtyard gate made of vertical boards with gateposts of thick logs. On the left a building of crossed logs, on the right the gable end of a similar building. Trees behind.

works.d: Jõgi kõrge kaldaga, kaldal puud ja põõsad. Kaugemal roheline põld. Koloriit lillakas-hall.(eesti)
works.de: River with a high bank, trees and bushes on the bank. A green field further away. Colouring purplish-grey.

works.d: Lehel rõhtnaela kujutised, keskel jalajäljekujuline vaba pind. (eesti)
works.de: On the sheet, depictions of horizontal nails, in the centre a footprint-shaped blank area.

works.d: Naise nägu, mis on musta värviga taldrikule maalitud.

works.d: Esiplaanil tütarlaps lillesülemiga, kaugemal lendavad kajakad.(eesti)

works.t: Graafika. Suur Taevalik Maailma Esiema - Kalivägi.
works.d: Suure esiema figuur horisondil. Tumeda taeva taustal üksikud tähed.(eesti)
works.de: The figure of a great ancestress on the horizon. Solitary stars against the dark sky.

works.t: Graafika. Kust me tuleme? Kes me oleme? Kuhu läheme? — Kalivägi.
works.d: All servas on kandlele toetuvad  käed. Talumaastik, eemal paistavad kolm mongoliidsete tunnustega nägu, taevast on kummardunud nägu maa poole.(eesti)
works.de: At the lower edge are hands resting on a kannel. A farmland landscape, in the distance three faces with Mongoloid features can be seen, from the sky a face bends down toward the earth.

works.d: Esiplaanil pink kolme leivapätsiga, kõrval seisab naine. Tare uksest paistab kuppelmaastik.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground a bench with three loaves of bread, beside it stands a woman. Through the cottage door a domed landscape is visible.

works.d: Õitsev aas, õite kohal lendleb kiil.(eesti)
works.de: A blossoming meadow, a dragonfly flying above the flowers.

works.d: Must teravnurk, mis läheb üle raamjoone.
works.de: A black acute angle that extends beyond the frame line.

works.d: Valgel foonil mustad kolmnurgad ja ringid.(eesti)
works.de: Black triangles and circles on a white background.

works.d: Valgel foonil must lõik ringist.(eesti)
works.de: A black segment of a circle on a white background.

works.d: Pind jagatud 4. võrdseks osaks. Kaks valget fooni, kaks musta. Mustades sektorites stiliseeritud valged inimfiguurid.(eesti)
works.de: The surface is divided into 4 equal parts. Two white backgrounds, two black. In the black sectors stylised white human figures.

works.d: Kivine maastik, keskel üksikud kidurad puud.(eesti)
works.de: Rocky landscape, with solitary stunted trees in the middle.

works.d: Puidust, oksakohtadega jalutuskepp lebab murul.(eesti)
works.de: A wooden walking stick with knots lies on the grass.

works.d: Maastikul pikkades kleitides naisfiguurid.(eesti)
works.de: Female figures in long dresses in a landscape.

works.d: Sinistes, mustades, pruunides toonides maastikul aimatavad inimfiguurid.(eesti)
works.de: Human figures discernible in a landscape in shades of blue, black and brown.

works.d: Sinistes, mustades, pruunides toonides küngas on kaetud taimede, lillede ja liblikatega.(eesti)
works.de: A hill in blue, black and brown tones is covered with plants, flowers and butterflies.

works.d: Vaade Kardioru lossi fassaadile.(eesti)
works.de: View of the facade of Kardioru Castle.

works.d: Saaremaa kadakane karjamaa.(eesti)
works.de: Juniper pasture in Saaremaa.

works.d: Kiviaedadega külatänav Saaremaal.(eesti)
works.de: Village street with stone fences in Saaremaa.

works.d: Ülemises vasakus servas lopsakas taimestik, vasakus keskmises servas kivimid.(eesti)
works.de: Lush vegetation in the upper left corner, rocks in the middle left edge.

works.d: Ülemises paremas nurgas üksikud majad, keskplaanis suur põlispuu. All servas liblikas ja pohlaoks.(eesti)
works.de: In the upper right corner individual houses, in the middle plane a large ancient tree. At the lower edge a butterfly and a lingonberry twig.

works.d: Tähtkujud, lendav kotkas, kurg ja lennuaparaat.(eesti)
works.de: Constellations, a flying eagle, a stork and an aircraft.

works.d: Paberitega kõndivad mehed: vasakul näoga vaataja suunas, paremal seljaga vaataja poole. Sinistes toonides.(eesti)
works.de: Men walking with papers: on the left facing the viewer, on the right with his back to the viewer. In blue tones.

works.d: stuv mees, kõrval pott aaloega. Tema selja taga suur aken, millest paistab kuppelmaastik.
works.de: A man in a bathrobe, next to a pot with aloe. Behind him a large window through which a dome landscape is visible.

works.d: Terrassil seisab jopes tütarlaps. Kauguses maja ja kõrgepingeliini post.(eesti)
works.de: A girl in a jacket stands on the terrace. In the distance a house and a high-voltage power line pole.

works.d: Riiulil asetsevad nõud, esiplaanil mõrane pudel. Kõrval ja taga vaasid. Aknast paistab linn.(eesti)
works.de: Vessels on a shelf, a cracked bottle in the foreground. Vases beside and behind. A town visible through the window.

works.d: Kõrge kitsas vaas lopsaka lillebuketiga, tagaplaanil vaade Tallinna Raekoja platsile.(eesti)
works.de: Tall narrow vase with a lush bouquet of flowers, in the background a view of Tallinn Town Hall Square.

works.d: Tallinna ajalooliste hoonete ja torni taustal modernne geomeetrilistest kujunditest koosnev monument.(eesti)
works.de: A modern monument composed of geometric shapes against the background of Tallinn's historic buildings and a tower.

works.d: Rannamaastik: kivine laht, kadakane rannakarjamaa. Eemal neemel taluhooned. Lahkuv rändlinnuparv.(eesti)
works.de: Coastal landscape: a rocky bay, a juniper-covered coastal pasture. In the distance, farm buildings on a headland. A flock of migrating birds departing.

works.d: Automagistraal, servades põlevad laternad. Keskel mustas sõõris õunapuuoks kahe õunaga.(eesti)
works.de: Motorway, lanterns burning at the edges. In the middle, in a black circle, an apple tree branch with two apples.

works.d: Põrandal katkine lelu: värviline lind, ümber linnu selle värvilised tükid. Taustaks linnavaade.(eesti)
works.de: On the floor a broken toy: a colourful bird, around the bird its coloured pieces. In the background a view of the city.

works.d: Linnamaastik esiplaanil töötavate inimestega ning tagaplaanil suitsevate korstnatega.
works.de: Cityscape with working people in the foreground and smoking chimneys in the background.

works.d: Linnamaastik raagus puudega. Suures plaanis värviline rändlind.(eesti)
works.de: Cityscape with bare trees. In the foreground a colourful migratory bird.

works.d: Rajune sügisilm raagus puudega. Esiplaanil jahikoer.(eesti)
works.de: Stormy autumn weather with bare trees. A hunting dog in the foreground.

works.d: Taustal Tallinna vanalinna panoraam. Esiplaanil mõttes vanem mees, käed taskus.(eesti)
works.de: In the background a panorama of Tallinn Old Town. In the foreground, deep in thought, an older man, hands in pockets.

works.d: Ülal valge silm, keskplaanis suur ruut. All must silm.
works.de: Above a white eye, in the middle plane a large square. Below a black eye.

works.d: Keskplaanis suur roheline ring toetumas mustale ristkülikule, külgedel kuubid, keskel väike must ring.(eesti)
works.de: In the middle ground a large green circle resting on a black rectangle, cubes on the sides, a small black circle in the centre.

works.d: Keskplaanis suur pruun kuup, millel roheline ring ja must ning oranž kuup.(eesti)
works.de: In the middle ground a large brown cube, on which there is a green circle and a black and orange cube.

works.d: Kompositsioon rohelistes toonides. Keskplaanis suur roheline ring. Kaks suurt rohelist ristkülikut. Ringi sees mitu geomeetrilist kujundit.(eesti)
works.de: Composition in green tones. In the middle plane a large green circle. Two large green rectangles. Several geometric shapes inside the circle.

works.d: Geomeetriline kompositsioon rohelistes, hõbedastes, mustades, pruunides ja roosades toonides.(eesti)
works.de: Geometric composition in green, silver, black, brown and pink tones.

works.d: Geomeetriline kompositsioon sinistes, kreemides, mustades ja lillades toonides. Keskel oranž vili.(eesti)
works.de: Geometric composition in blue, cream, black and purple tones. In the middle an orange fruit.

works.d: Laual kandiline pudel ja peeker, milles mõned taimed ja 2 geomeetrilist vormi.(eesti)
works.de: On the table a square bottle and a goblet, with some plants and 2 geometric forms in it.

works.d: Geomeetriline kompositsioon punastes, oranžides, sinistes ja kreemides toonides.(eesti)
works.de: Geometric composition in red, orange, blue and cream tones.

works.d: Geomeetriline kompositsioon sinistes toonides.(eesti)
works.de: Geometric composition in blue tones.

works.d: Geomeetriline kompositsioon sinistes, rohekas-kollastes, lillades, rohelistes ja kreemides toonides.(eesti)
works.de: Geometric composition in blue, greenish-yellow, purple, green and cream tones.

works.d: Sinistes toonides aedviljad.(eesti)
works.de: Vegetables in blue tones.

works.d: Geomeetriline kompositsioon sinistes, lillades, kreemides ja mustades toonides. Keskel punane kuubik.(eesti)
works.de: Geometric composition in blue, purple, cream and black tones. A red cube in the centre.

works.d: Vasakus servas ülespoole vaatava naise figuur. Ülevalt alla vaatab mehe nägu.
works.de: Female figure looking upward in the left margin. A man's face looking down from above.

works.d: Külmetavad inimfiguurid, mõni on tõstnud käe silmile, et vaadata kaugusse.(eesti)
works.de: Freezing human figures, some have raised a hand to their eyes to look into the distance.

works.d: Keskel mehe figuur, kelle õla najale toetub naise näo, linnu tiiva ja -kaelaga olend.(eesti)
works.de: In the middle a male figure, against whose shoulder leans a creature with a woman's face and a bird's wing and neck.

works.d: Kaks inimfiguuri, üks toetab teist vöökohast ja osutab käega kaugusse.(eesti)
works.de: Two human figures, one supporting the other at the waist and pointing into the distance.

works.d: All nurgas neli väikest inimfiguuri. Nende peade ümber tumedam viirutus.(eesti)
works.de: In the lower corner four small human figures. Darker hatching around their heads.

works.d: Ülemistes servades: vasakus vana naise figuur, tema näo juures väike noore naise figuur. Paremas servas vana mehe figuur, kes vaatab käsipõsakil noore naise figuuri.(eesti)
works.de: In the upper corners: on the left an old woman's figure, near her face a small figure of a young woman. In the right corner an old man's figure, who, resting his cheek on his hand, looks at the figure of the young woman.

works.d: All nurgas noore naise figuur, käed ette sirutatud; naudib päikest.(eesti)
works.de: In the bottom corner, the figure of a young woman, arms outstretched; enjoying the sun.

works.d: Musitseeriv naine.(eesti)
works.de: Woman making music.

works.d: Keskaegse Tallinna ja Raekoja siluetid, ülemises nurgas naise figuur.(eesti)
works.de: Silhouettes of medieval Tallinn and the Town Hall, a female figure in the upper corner.

works.d: Mustal taustal maastik põlispuudega. Valge kuu all heledamates toonides laine.(eesti)
works.de: A landscape with ancient trees on a black background. Under the white moon a wave in lighter tones.

works.d: Lamav figuur, sinakas toonis.(eesti)
works.de: Reclining figure, in bluish tone.

works.d: Pruunides toonides inimfiguur graafiliselt kujundatud taustal.(eesti)
works.de: A human figure in brown tones against a graphically designed background.

works.d: Kummalistel instrumentidel musitseerivad naisfiguurid. Metsikud mägised maastikud koskedega.(eesti)
works.de: Female figures playing music on strange instruments. Wild mountainous landscapes with waterfalls.

works.d: Kaljumaastik; musitseeriv naisterahvas.(eesti)
works.de: Rocky landscape; a woman making music.

works.d: Ümber Eesti kaardi looduskaitse all olevad objektid. Teose all servas Eesti linnade ja maakondade vapid.
works.de: Around the map of Estonia, objects under nature protection. At the bottom edge of the work, coats of arms of Estonian towns and counties.

works.d: Kreemis toonis glasuuriga kauss musta dekooriga. Kausi põhjas silm, ühe sisekülje peal samuti silm.
works.de: Bowl with cream-toned glaze and black decoration. An eye at the bottom of the bowl, also an eye on one of the inner sides.

works.d: Vanalinna hoovinurk, üle maja katuse paistab linnamüüri torn.
works.de: Old Town courtyard corner, a town wall tower visible above the roof of the house.

works.d: Vana Tallinna siluett, müüri Rannaväravapoolne külg. Müüride kohal kõrgub Oleviste kirik.(eesti)
works.de: Silhouette of old Tallinn, the side of the wall facing Rannavärav. The Oleviste church rises above the walls.

works.d: Autor: Jüri Arrak (1936). (eesti)
works.de: Author: Jüri Arrak (1936).

works.d: Šarž Evald Tammlaanest.(eesti)
works.de: Caricature of Evald Tammlaan.

works.d: Šarž laulja Benno Hansenist.(eesti)
works.de: Caricature of singer Benno Hansen.

works.d: Muinasjuturaamatu jaoks valmistatud päisliist.(eesti)
works.de: A headpiece made for a fairy tale book.

works.d: Muinasjuturaamatu Vaeslapse käsikivi jaoks valmistatud päisliist.(eesti)
works.de: Header vignette made for the fairy tale book Vaeslapse käsikivi.

works.d: Muinasjuturaamatu Tuhkapoiss jaoks valmistatud päisliist.(eesti)
works.de: Header strip made for the fairytale book Tuhkapoiss.

works.d: Muinasjuturaamatu jaoks valmistatud päisliist.(eesti)
works.de: A headpiece made for a fairy tale book.

works.t: Joonistus. Eesti kunsti ja kirjanduse dekaad Moskvas 1956.
works.d: Ülaosas ENSV lipp, keskel kuldkirjas tekst: Eesti kunsti ja kirjanduse dekaad Moskvas 1956. All puna-valge eesti rahvuslik vöökiri.
works.de: At the top the flag of the ESSR, in the centre text in gold lettering: Eesti kunsti ja kirjanduse dekaad Moskvas 1956. Below a red-and-white Estonian national belt-band pattern.

works.t: Joonistus. Eesti kunsti ja kirjanduse dekaad.
works.d: Ülaosas ENSV lipp, keskel tekst: Eesti kunsti ja kirjanduse dekaad Moskvas 1956. All eesti rahvuslik vöökiri.
works.de: At the top the ENSV flag, in the centre the text: Eesti kunsti ja kirjanduse dekaad Moskvas 1956. At the bottom an Estonian national belt pattern.

works.d: Ülaservas rahvusliku mustriga kujundatud ruudud, keskel vana traktor, traktori all tekst: Eesti Põllumajandusmuuseum. Teksti all küntud põld.
works.de: In the upper edge squares designed with a national pattern, in the centre an old tractor, below the tractor the text: Estonian Agricultural Museum. Below the text a ploughed field.

works.d: Ülaosas tankikolonn, alumises servas tankist tankis.
works.de: At the top a tank column, at the lower edge a tankman in a tank.

works.d: Ülaosas suurtükiväe õppus, alumises osas mikrofoni kõnelev sõjaväelane kiivriga.(eesti)
works.de: In the upper part, artillery exercises; in the lower part, a soldier with a helmet speaking into a microphone.

works.d: Paremal pool neli kaitsekiivrites töölist, vasakul pool masinavärk.(eesti)
works.de: On the right four workers in protective helmets, on the left machinery.

works.d: Paremal seisab vanem mees, vasakul rand kalapaadi ja selle kohal lendavate kajakatega.(eesti)
works.de: On the right stands an elderly man, on the left a shore with a fishing boat and gulls flying above it.

works.d: Koosolek, keskel seisavad kolm naist, kellel on suured paberilehed käes ja kes selgitavad midagi juuresolijatele.(eesti)
works.de: A meeting, in the middle stand three women holding large sheets of paper and explaining something to those present.

works.d: Kujutatud läbisegi eri spordialasid, karikat, medalit, õlipuuoksa.
works.de: Various sports disciplines, a cup, a medal, an olive branch depicted intermingled.

works.d: Nelja noore inimese pead jäälillede taustal.
works.de: Heads of four young people against a background of ice flowers.

works.d: Kolm helikopterit, nende all paistab maa, diagonaalselt allservas klaviatuur.(eesti)
works.de: Three helicopters, with land visible below them, a keyboard diagonally in the lower edge.

works.d: Keskplaanil radarid püüdmas signaale. Allosas aparatuur.(eesti)
works.de: Radars catching signals in the middle ground. Equipment at the bottom.

works.d: Geomeetrilised vormid.(eesti)
works.de: Geometric forms.

works.d: Geomeetrilised vormid ja sirgjooned, tagaplaanil klassitsistliku hoone otsaviil koos sammastega, mis on üle viirutatud sirgjoontega.
works.de: Geometric forms and straight lines, in the background the pediment of a classicist building with columns, which is overlaid with straight lines.

works.d: Teose pind on jagatud neljaks. Ühes ülanurgas nõrgaltloetav tekst, ülal paremas servas kraavis lamav inimene, sama motiiv kordub alumistes sektorites.(eesti)
works.de: The surface of the work is divided into four. In one upper corner, faintly legible text; in the upper right edge, a person lying in a ditch, the same motif recurring in the lower sectors.

works.d: Arhitektuursed elemendid, klassitsistlikud viilud, poolkaared.(eesti)
works.de: Architectural elements, classicist gables, semicircular arches.

works.d: Suur, praguline, sammaldunud põllukivi.
works.de: A large, cracked, moss-covered field stone.

works.d: Soomaastik lumesajus. Esiplaanil kidurad sootaimed, tagaplaanil mets.(eesti)
works.de: A bog landscape in snowfall. Stunted bog plants in the foreground, forest in the background.

works.d: Esiplaanil vilepill, foon hele.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground a whistle, background light.

works.d: Esiplaanil roheline inimene tagantvaates, tema peale on kujundatud loodusmaastikke. Tagaplaanil hallides toonides linnamaastik suitsevate tehasekorstnatega.
works.de: In the foreground a green person seen from behind, upon whom natural landscapes are depicted. In the background, in grey tones, a cityscape with smoking factory chimneys.

works.d: Mets rohelistes toonides. All paremal, heledamas nurgas suurendatud kujul tükike alusmetsa.(eesti)
works.de: Forest in green tones. In the lower right, in a lighter corner, an enlarged piece of undergrowth.

works.d: Sahhalini rannik kaldale aetud ajupuudega ja tõusev kaldanõlv. Allosas on suurendatud kala.(eesti)
works.de: Sakhalin coast with driftwood washed ashore and a rising slope. At the bottom an enlarged fish.

works.d: Tehasemaastik, keskplaanis töölt tulevad ulmelised masin-inimesed.
works.de: A factory landscape, in the middle ground fantastical machine-people coming from work.

works.d: Teose pind on jagatud kaheks osaks. Keskplaanis puu ja kaks kõrghoonet, kauguses suitsevate korstnatega linn. Kaks korda trükitud sama motiivi.(eesti)
works.de: The surface of the work is divided into two parts. In the middle ground a tree and two tall buildings, in the distance a town with smoking chimneys. The same motif printed twice.

works.d: Tunnelit läbivad kaks eri suundades sõitvat autoderida. Autode roolis masin-inimesed. Taga tehase siluett.(eesti)
works.de: Two lines of cars driving in different directions pass through a tunnel. Machine-people at the wheel of the cars. A factory silhouette in the background.

works.d: Paremas nurgas relva hoidvad käed, taustaks sõdurite figuurid, vasakus servas samuti käsi, mõned viljapead ja majad.
works.de: In the right corner hands holding a weapon, in the background figures of soldiers, in the left margin also a hand, some ears of grain and houses.

works.d: Paremas nurgas käed kellu ja telliskiviga, taustaks sõjast tulev sõjamees, vasakus servas käsi ahervaremete taustal.(eesti)
works.de: In the right corner hands with a bell and a brick, in the background a soldier returning from war, in the left margin a hand against a background of ruins.

works.d: Keskel käed mürsuga, foonil lahingustseen põleva saksa tanki ja kahe sõduriga.(eesti)
works.de: In the centre hands with a shell, in the background a battle scene with a burning German tank and two soldiers.

works.d: Tallinna vanalinna panoraam, tagaplaanil meri reidil olevate laevadega ja purjekatega lahel.
works.de: Panorama of Tallinn Old Town, in the background the sea with ships in the roadstead and sailing boats in the bay.

works.d: Kalur seisab kalu täis paadis, käed rinnal. All servas eraldi väike pilt võrgusoleva kalaga.
works.de: A fisherman stands in a boat full of fish, arms crossed on his chest. At the lower edge a separate small picture with a fish in a net.

works.d: Kalakastidele toetuv kalur, tagaplaanil paadisillal seisab kaks kalurit, käes aerud. Eraldi pildist väljas kaks kala. (eesti)
works.de: A fisherman leaning on fish boxes, in the background two fishermen stand on a boat jetty, holding oars. Two fish shown separately outside the picture.

works.d: Geomeetrilised vormid, toonid: beež, must, bordoopunane ja valge. Keskplaanis punane muna ja must kuup.(eesti)
works.de: Geometric forms, tones: beige, black, bordeaux red and white. In the middle ground a red egg and a black cube.

works.d: Geomeetrilised vormid, toonid: punane, sinine, kollane, hall, valge.(eesti)
works.de: Geometric forms, tones: red, blue, yellow, grey, white.

works.d: Geomeetrilised kujundid, taustaks sinine kuup.(eesti)
works.de: Geometric shapes, with a blue cube in the background.

works.d: Rohekates toonides, mõnede mustade ruutudega.(eesti)
works.de: In greenish tones, with some black squares.

works.d: Keskplaanis inimese kontuur, mille sees on erinevate inimeste mõtlikud näod. Inimfiguurist lähtuvad erinevad sillad. Ülaosas pruunil foonil erinevad lennuaparaadid, nende kohal oranži ja punase värvi ribad, nende kohal must osa.
works.de: In the middle plane the contour of a person, within which are the pensive faces of various people. Different bridges emanate from the human figure. In the upper part, on a brown background, various flying apparatuses, above them stripes of orange and red colour, above them a black section.

works.d: Esiplaanil vabriku fassaad, keskosas võlvitud kaarega ukseava. Mööda fassaadi looklevad torud.
works.de: In the foreground the facade of a factory, in the central part a doorway with a vaulted arch. Pipes wind along the facade.

works.d: Keskplaanis tehase tootmishoone akende ja pikkade redelitega.(eesti)
works.de: In the middle ground, a factory production building with windows and long ladders.

works.d: Mustal foonil tehase tootmishoone. Mõned aknad on katki ja kinni löödud.(eesti)
works.de: On a black background a factory production building. Some windows are broken and boarded up.

works.d: Sinistes ja rohelistes toonides. Parempoolses servas istuv naisakt, palju esemeid ja mööblit.
works.de: In blue and green tones. A seated female nude at the right edge, many objects and furniture.

works.d: Geomeetrilistest konstruktsioonidest must-valge teos.
works.de: A black-and-white work of geometric constructions.

works.d: Vasakus servas punakates toonides ristkülik. Paremas servas must konstruktsioon.(eesti)
works.de: A rectangle in reddish tones on the left edge. A black construction on the right edge.

works.d: Keskel inimese pea, kõrvaklapid peas. Vasakus servas kahe laulja figuurid, mikrofon ja pasun. Paremas servas läbisegi muusikainstrumendid.(eesti)
works.de: In the middle, a person's head, wearing headphones. In the left margin, figures of two singers, a microphone and a horn. In the right margin, musical instruments jumbled together.

works.d: Rohelistes ja pruunides toonides kompositsioon, keskplaanis erinevad aedviljad.(eesti)
works.de: Composition in green and brown tones, in the middle ground various vegetables.

works.d: Keskplaanis kolm maski, nende kohal köögiviljad.(eesti)
works.de: In the middle ground three masks, above them vegetables.

works.d: Ülemises servas ovaalne kujund, millesse sisenevad allservast kriipsukesed.(eesti)
works.de: In the upper edge an oval shape, into which small lines enter from the lower edge.

works.d: Pruunides, rohelistes ja mustades toonides.(eesti)
works.de: In brown, green and black tones.

works.d: Suitsune linnamaastik. Sirged tänavad, korrapärased kvartalid, keskplaanis suitsevad korstnad. Taevas on suitsust must.(eesti)
works.de: A smoky city landscape. Straight streets, regular blocks, in the middle ground smoking chimneys. The sky is black with smoke.

works.d: Teose pind on jagatud 12-ks võrdseks osaks. Igas üks pilt maaelust.(eesti)
works.de: The surface of the work is divided into 12 equal parts. Each with a picture of rural life.

works.d: Laual niidipool, naelad ja erinevad geomeetrilised kujundid.(eesti)
works.de: On the table, a thread spool, nails and various geometric shapes.

works.d: Allservas kõrge planguga aed, mille keskel ümara võraga puu. Pruunides toonides.
works.de: At the bottom edge, a garden with a high fence, in the middle of which a tree with a round crown. In brown tones.

works.d: Ülemine pinnaosa suurem, kujutab laevalt õhku tõusvat lahinghelikopterit. Alumises osas mikrofoniga sõjaväelane, taustaks mõõteriistad.
works.de: The upper surface part is larger, depicting a combat helicopter taking off from a ship. In the lower part a serviceman with a microphone, with measuring instruments in the background.

works.d: Ülemine pinnaosa suurem, must-valge, kujutab lahinglennuki juures toimetavaid sõdureid. Alumises osas on lendur aparaatide keskel.(eesti)
works.de: The upper part of the surface is larger, black and white, depicting soldiers working by a combat aircraft. In the lower part is the pilot amidst instruments.

works.d: Igas vanuses inimesed seismas, vestlemas, istumas.(eesti)
works.de: People of all ages standing, conversing, sitting.

works.t: Graafika. Tallinna Masinatehase vana kaardivägi. Seppade brigadir J. Lassik.
works.d: Keskplaanis seisab vana tööline, käed risti rinnal ja pilk mõtlik. Taustaks tehas.
works.de: In the middle ground stands an old worker, arms crossed on his chest and a thoughtful gaze. Background a factory.

works.t: Graafika. Tallinna Masinatehase vana kaardivägi. H. Liblik.
works.d: Vana tööline töötamas, taustaks tehaseruum.
works.de: An old worker at work, with a factory room in the background.

works.d: Valminud vilja põld, kauguses talud ja metsad. Hilissuvine pilvine taevas.
works.de: A field of ripened grain, farms and forests in the distance. Late-summer cloudy sky.

works.d: Esiplaanil kaks töölist, kes naerdes vestlevad. Üks neist võtab kiivrit peast. Taustal kaks töötavat töölist.
works.de: In the foreground two workers chatting and laughing. One of them is taking off his helmet. In the background two working labourers.

works.d: Tehas ja kaitsekiivrites töötavad töölised.(eesti)
works.de: Factory and workers working in protective helmets.

works.d: Esiplaanil veab mees kivi, naine kaevab. Taustal purustatud majad ja kiriku varemed.
works.de: In the foreground a man is hauling a stone, a woman is digging. In the background destroyed houses and church ruins.

works.d: Põiki üle pildi on kujutatud filmilinti, millel stseenid jooksjatega, nende finišiponnistused. All suures plaanis jooksev sportlane.
works.de: A film strip is depicted diagonally across the picture, with scenes of runners, their finishing efforts. Below, in a large view, a running athlete.

works.d: Teos jagatud mitmesse ossa. Keskplaanis heina(põhu)pall.(eesti)
works.de: The work is divided into several parts. A hay(straw) bale in the middle ground.

works.d: Tehismaastik. Vasakul naised, paremal majakarbid.
works.de: Artificial landscape. Women on the left, house boxes on the right.

works.d: Tuleviku tehnokraatlik linn. Geomeetrilised arhitektuurivormid.(eesti)
works.de: A futuristic technocratic city. Geometric architectural forms.

works.d: Keskplaanis grupp töölisi, taustaks elektrijaam.
works.de: In the middle ground a group of workers, with a power plant in the background.

works.d: Lenini pea profiilis.
works.de: Head of Lenin in profile.

works.d: Kuus naisakti, esiplaanil lamav akt.(eesti)
works.de: Six female nudes, a reclining nude in the foreground.

works.d: Lenini pea poolprofiilis.(eesti)
works.de: Lenin's head in half-profile.

works.d: Suur kahe sangaga vaas, milles bukett erinevat sorti lilli. Vaasi all drapeering.
works.de: Large two-handled vase with a bouquet of various kinds of flowers. Drapery below the vase.

works.d: Esiplaanil superekskavaator. Vasakus ääres seisab poiss hobuse ja vankri kõrval. Paremal grupp inimesi kopa kõrval. Ülemistes servades naiste portreed.
works.de: In the foreground a super-excavator. On the left edge stands a boy beside a horse and cart. On the right a group of people beside the excavator bucket. In the upper margins portraits of women.

works.d: Teose pind jagatud pooleks. Vasakul uurivad kaks kaitsekiivrites töölist plaani, paremal tulevad kolm töölist tehasest välja.
works.de: The surface of the work is divided in half. On the left, two workers in hard hats are examining a plan, on the right, three workers are coming out of the factory.

works.d: Põhjarannik kõrge paekaldaga, merel üksik laev. Üle teose värviline vikerkaar. Allosas kaks suurt kala ja nöörile aetud lestad.
works.de: Northern coastline with a high limestone bank, a lone ship at sea. A coloured rainbow over the work. At the bottom two large fish and flounders strung on a cord.

works.d: Vasakul naeratavad naine ja mees. Paremal tänavakunstnik. Esiplaanil põlvitab naine fotoaparaadiga. Tagaplaanil seisab grupp inimesi, üks mängib kitarri.
works.de: A smiling woman and man on the left. A street artist on the right. A woman kneeling with a camera in the foreground. In the background stands a group of people, one playing a guitar.

works.d: Teose pind on jagatud neljaks. Ühe ja sama kujundi peegeldus kõrvale ja alla.
works.de: The surface of the work is divided into four. Reflection of one and the same figure to the side and below.

works.d: Palmse mõisahoone kahe poolega uks, üks pooltest on avatud.
works.de: A two-leaf door of the Palmse manor house, one of the leaves is open.

works.d: Kõrge, avatud värav, millest paistab rohelus, põõsad, puud ja tihnik.(eesti)
works.de: A tall, open gate through which greenery, bushes, trees and thicket can be seen.

works.d: Esiplaanil Lenin sonimütsis, taustal madrused ja soldatid.
works.de: In the foreground Lenin in a fur hat, in the background sailors and soldiers.

works.d: Antiik-Rooma varemed, sambad, taust: lõunamaine loodus.
works.de: Ancient Roman ruins, columns, background: southern nature.

works.d: Naisterahvas, keda ümbritsevad tuuled.
works.de: A woman surrounded by winds.

works.d: Küntud põllud Lõuna-Eesti kuppelmaastikul.
works.de: Ploughed fields in the hilly landscape of South Estonia.

works.d: Ülaservas hõljub folkloorses riietuses naine, paremas servas paistavad kolme naise jalad ja seelikud.
works.de: At the top edge floats a woman in folk costume; at the right edge, the legs and skirts of three women are visible.

works.d: Kolme naise figuurid rahvalikes riideis, üks neist sõlmib õlgi. Teose pinnal mitmed sõlmitud õlekimbud.(eesti)
works.de: Figures of three women in folk costumes, one of them tying straw. On the surface of the work several tied bundles of straw.

works.d: Mati Palmi portree, must-valge, lisaks pruunikad ja sinakad toonid foonil.
works.de: Portrait of Mati Palm, black-and-white, with brownish and bluish tones in the background.

works.d: Tuntud kunstiinimesed seistes vestlemas suurte tähtede vahel. Tähtedest kujundatud GEA ülevalt alla ja vasakult paremale.
works.de: Well-known art figures standing and conversing among large stars. The letters GEA formed by stars from top to bottom and left to right.

works.d: Paremal istub O. Terri, vasakul pintsliga käsi paleti kohal. Taustaks valmiv maal.
works.de: On the right sits O. Terri, on the left a hand with a brush above the palette. Background a painting being completed.

works.d: All paremal kurbmõtlik tüdruku nägu, kes vaatab läbi lumesaju. Päris all paremas nurgas sarnane nägu, kuid nagu lapse joonistus.(eesti)
works.de: Below on the right a sad-looking girl's face, looking through falling snow. In the very bottom right corner a similar face, but like a child's drawing.

works.d: Poolprofiilis nägu vaatega allapoole. Ülaservas geomeetrilised kujundid.(eesti)
works.de: Face in half-profile looking downwards. Geometric shapes at the upper edge.

works.d: Paremas servas A. Vinkeli portree, vasakul maastik.(eesti)
works.de: On the right edge a portrait of A. Vinkel, on the left a landscape.

works.d: Pildi pind jagatud kaheks. Ülaosas P.-E. Rummo pea pööratud vasakule, käed risti rinnal, allosas keha alumine pool.(eesti)
works.de: The surface of the picture is divided in two. In the upper part the head of P.-E. Rummo turned to the left, arms crossed on the chest, in the lower part the lower half of the body.

works.d: Vasakpoolsel, kitsamal osal kuusk rahvusornamendiga. Paremal pool istub Igor Tõnurist rahvariietes. Temast paremal üleval mees, hobune ja vanker, all viljahakk ja õlgedest mehike.
works.de: On the left, narrower part a spruce with a national ornament. On the right sits Igor Tõnurist in national costume. Above him to the right a man, a horse and a cart, below a sheaf of grain and a little straw man.

works.d: Pildi pind täis vapikilpide, hauatähiste ja muud aadlisümboolikat.
works.de: The surface of the picture is filled with coats of arms, gravestones and other heraldic symbolism.

works.d: Suure kaarega laval laulavad neli naist, viies saadab neid klaveril. Pildi pind kaetud romantiliste lillebukettidega.(eesti)
works.de: On a stage with a large arch four women are singing, a fifth accompanies them on the piano. The surface of the picture is covered with romantic flower bouquets.

works.t: Graafika. Zootehnik Linda ja lüpsja Mari.
works.d: Esiplaanil kaks profiilis naisefiguuri. Tagaplaanil suurfarm, lauda uksed avatud, kari läheb karjamaale.
works.de: In the foreground two female figures in profile. In the background a large farm, barn doors open, a herd going out to pasture.

works.d: Keskel tahukatest püramiid, osade külgmistest avadest kasvavad välja puuoksad. Püramiidi tipuks on teritatud pliiats. Ümber püramiidi tuntud kultuuri -ja kunstiinimeste fotod.(eesti)
works.de: In the centre a pyramid of blocks, from some of the side openings tree branches grow out. The apex of the pyramid is a sharpened pencil. Around the pyramid photographs of well-known people of culture and art.

works.d: Tagaplaanil Ilmar Torni tööde näituse plakat autori portreega. Esiplaanil teose autor, peas taimedest peakate.
works.de: In the background a poster for an exhibition of Ilmar Torn's works with a portrait of the author. In the foreground the author of the work, wearing a headdress made of plants.

works.d: Keskel vaas kirju lillekimbuga, taustaks kinnitatud kleeppaberi ribadega looduspilt aasaga.(eesti)
works.de: In the middle a vase with a colourful bouquet of flowers, background a landscape with a meadow, attached with strips of adhesive paper.

works.d: asakul rinnatisele toetuv ja kaugusse vaatav tütarlaps. Keskel lopsakas taimepuhmas. Paremal raamatut lehitsev naine. Ülaosas jooksev hobune ja teeviit tekstiga: TOPU TALLINN.(eesti)
works.de: On the left a girl leaning on a railing and looking into the distance. In the centre a lush clump of plants. On the right a woman leafing through a book. In the upper part a running horse and a signpost with the text: TOPU TALLINN.

works.t: Graafika. Karjak Jüri ja traktorist Indrek.
works.d: Esiplaanil seisavad profiilis vastamisi karjak ja traktorist. Taustal suurfarm, mille õuel traktorid ja veoauto.(eesti)
works.de: In the foreground a herdsman and a tractor driver stand in profile facing each other. In the background a large farm, in whose yard are tractors and a lorry.

works.d: Ülal vasakul akti visand, paremal tuulise ilma kujutis. Paremas servas peegel, millelt peegeldub uduselt mehe portree. Vasakus servas ümmargune laud segipaisatud purkide, maalimistarvete, kääride ja paberilehtedega.
works.de: Upper left a sketch of a nude, on the right a depiction of windy weather. In the right margin a mirror, from which a man's portrait is reflected in a blurred manner. In the left margin a round table with scattered jars, painting supplies, scissors and sheets of paper.

works.d: Keskel kükitab poiss, vaadates mõtlikult väikest lõket. Poiss tõmbab pulgaga joont lõkke piiril.
works.de: In the middle, a boy crouches, looking thoughtfully at a small fire. The boy draws a line with a stick at the edge of the fire.

works.d: Hallil taustal sinistes, rohelistes, punastes ja valgetes toonides lillekimp.(eesti)
works.de: On a grey background, a bouquet of flowers in blue, green, red and white tones.

works.d: Paremal keskel lühikeses mustas kleidis ja mustade kinnastega naine, keskel kostüümis, maskiga mees. Tagaplaanil pikas mustas kleidis lamav naine ja kitarr. All servas mustal taustal koer ja erinevad näod.(eesti)
works.de: On the right in the centre, a woman in a short black dress and black gloves, in the centre a man in costume and a mask. In the background a woman lying in a long black dress, and a guitar. At the bottom edge, against a black background, a dog and various faces.

works.d: Paremas servas väikeses ristkülikus väikesed inimfiguurid ja hobused. Keskplaanis ehituse või püramiidi läbilõige.(eesti)
works.de: In the right margin, in a small rectangle, small human figures and horses. In the middle ground a cross-section of a building or pyramid.

works.d: Ugala teatrihoone, mille kohal pilvine taevas. Läbi pilvede paistavad hoone peale päikesekiired.
works.de: The Ugala theatre building, above which is a cloudy sky. Sunbeams shine through the clouds onto the building.

works.d: Mäekülgedel linn, läbisegi antiik- ja moodsa arhitektuuriga. All servas on kujud, mõned postamentidel. Kujud hajuvad antiikseina.
works.de: A city on hillsides, a mix of antique and modern architecture. At the bottom edge there are figures, some on pedestals. The figures dissolve into an ancient wall.

works.d: Mägimaastiku jalamil moodne linn. Õhus lendab dirižaabel. Allservas antiikskulptuurid, keskplaanis naisskulptuur.(eesti)
works.de: A modern city at the foot of a mountain landscape. An airship flies in the sky. In the lower part antique sculptures, in the middle ground a female sculpture.

works.d: Rahvariietes tantsivad figuurid, keskel lõke. All paremal ja vasakul pillimehed.
works.de: Figures dancing in folk costumes, a bonfire in the middle. Musicians lower right and lower left.

works.d: Lenin vaatega poolviltu vasakule.
works.de: Lenin, view at an angle to the left.

works.d: Taustaks Iskra esimese numbri kujutis, mille peal on kujutatud Leninit.(eesti)
works.de: In the background, an image of the first issue of Iskra, on which Lenin is depicted.

works.d: Keskplaanis malelaud malenditega, vasakul P. Keres, tema vastas kolm maletajat.
works.de: In the middle ground a chessboard with chess pieces, on the left P. Keres, opposite him three chess players.

works.d: Taustaks millimeetripaber, keskplaanis riba filmilindist, mis kujutab ühte tervet ja kahte poolikut kaadrit maastikust.
works.de: Background of millimetre paper, in the middle ground a strip of film reel depicting one whole and two half frames of a landscape.

works.d: Teosel on kujutatud ebatasast maapinda.(eesti)
works.de: The work depicts uneven ground.

works.d: Pakkepaberist lahti võetud elektripirn.(eesti)
works.de: An electric light bulb unwrapped from packing paper.

works.d: Latern suurel kivil.(eesti)
works.de: Lantern on a large stone.

works.d: Känd, mille ümber kasvab rohi.(eesti)
works.de: Stump, around which grass grows.

works.d: Kaal, millel erinevad juurviljad. Kaalust paremal kaks sibulat ja vasakul üks sibul.(eesti)
works.de: Scales with various root vegetables on them. To the right of the scales two onions and to the left one onion.

works.d: Punutud kartulikorv lahtisel ajalehel. Kartulikorvis suurte idudega kartulid.(eesti)
works.de: A woven potato basket on an open newspaper. In the potato basket, potatoes with large sprouts.

works.d: Suur sangadega paberkott, millest paistavad sibulad, redised ja lilleõied.(eesti)
works.de: Large paper bag with handles, from which onions, radishes and flower blossoms are visible.

works.d: Leivalõikelaud, millel paber ja sellel päts vormileiba, leiva peal saiapäts.(eesti)
works.de: A bread-cutting board, on which is paper and on it a loaf of moulded bread, on the bread a bun.

works.d: Keskplaanis konveier, mille ees seisab tööline. Teine tööline konveieri ülemises osas annab alumisele klaasitahvleid kätte.
works.de: In the middle ground a conveyor, in front of which stands a worker. Another worker at the upper part of the conveyor hands glass panes down to the one below.

works.d: Esiplaanil klaasikonveier ja selle juures töötav tööline. (eesti)
works.de: In the foreground a glass conveyor and a worker working at it.

works.d: Ülaosas anatoomiline inimese büst, tagaplaanil lendab 3 sputnikut. Allosas avatud kaantega prügikonteinerid, mõni ümber kukkunud. Konteinerite ümber kasvavad lopsakad hõbedased taimed.(eesti)
works.de: In the upper part an anatomical human bust, with 3 sputniks flying in the background. In the lower part garbage containers with open lids, some knocked over. Lush silvery plants grow around the containers.

works.d: Vasakus servas talvejopes ja kapuutsiga inimene, paremas servas põlvitab alasti naine. Valgustatud aken heidab lumele varju, puud on tugeva tuule käes lookas.
works.de: In the left edge a person in a winter jacket and hood, in the right edge a naked woman kneeling. A lit window casts a shadow on the snow, the trees are bent by a strong wind.

works.d: Läbi kasvuhoone klaasi paistavad õitsevad taimed. Esiplaanil üksikud valged pilved.
works.de: Blooming plants are visible through the glass of the greenhouse. Individual white clouds in the foreground.

works.d: Vasakus servas naisfiguur puhumas karjasesarve, teine naine põlvitab, seljaga vaataja poole. Paremas servas stiliseeritud naisefiguur. Ülal paremal laialipaisatud peeglikillud, millel peegelduvad möödunud sündmused ja inimfiguurid.(eesti)
works.de: In the left edge a female figure blowing a shepherd's horn, another woman kneeling, her back to the viewer. In the right edge a stylised female figure. Above, on the right, scattered mirror shards, on which past events and human figures are reflected.

works.d: Läbi vana jändriku männi okste paistab all paremal küntud põld ja selle servalt algav metsatukk.
works.de: Through the branches of an old gnarled pine, a ploughed field can be seen in the lower right, with a small forest starting from its edge.

works.d: Teos vertikaalselt kolmeks osaks jagatud. Keskmises osas laulukaar täis lauljaid, keskel dirigent puldis. Esiplaanil kätest kinni hoidvad rahvariietes naised, nende selja taga mehed. Kahel külgmisel osal on Lõuna-Eesti kuppelmaastik ja järved ning rahvariietes inimesed.
works.de: The work is divided vertically into three parts. In the middle part, a song festival arch full of singers, with a conductor at the podium in the centre. In the foreground, women in folk costume holding hands, with men behind them. On the two side parts, the South-Estonian rolling landscape and lakes, and people in folk costume.

works.d: Keskel V. Kingissepp, vasakus servas käsi, mis käeraudu hoiab, ülaosas püssimees. Mustal teost ääristaval raamil kujutatud kalendrit kuupäevaga 3. mai 1922.
works.de: In the centre V. Kingissepp, on the left edge a hand holding handcuffs, at the top a man with a rifle. On the black frame bordering the work a calendar is depicted with the date 3 May 1922.

works.d: Mustal foonil lilled ja viljad.
works.de: Flowers and fruits on a black background.

works.d: Viljakust sümboliseeriv noore naise kujutis. Peas viljadest ja taimedest moon, põlle sees õunad ja kõrred. Taustal õunapuud.
works.de: A depiction of a young woman symbolising fertility. On her head a headdress of fruits and plants, apples and stalks in her apron. Apple trees in the background.

works.d: Noor ema, kes on tõstnud näo juurde väikese lapse.(eesti)
works.de: Young mother who has raised a small child to her face.

works.d: Tütarlaps seisab küljega vaataja poole ja hoiab käes tassi, milles on taimed. Tema juustesse on põimitud erinevaid taimi.(eesti)
works.de: A girl stands sideways to the viewer and holds a cup with plants in her hand. Various plants are woven into her hair.

works.d: Ülaosas lamab kaks naisakti. Alumises paremas nurgas istub must kass.(eesti)
works.de: At the top, two female nudes are lying down. In the lower right corner sits a black cat.

works.d: Horisontaalne teos. Lamav naisakt, käed risti rinna all.(eesti)
works.de: Horizontal work. Reclining female nude, arms crossed under the chest.

works.d: Pind jagatud vertikaalselt osadeks. Taustal tellistest torn.
works.de: Surface divided vertically into parts. Brick tower in the background.

works.d: Keskel suured vabrikukorstnad. Taga kaks kraanat. Ees paremal neli töötavat töölist.
works.de: In the middle large factory chimneys. Behind, two cranes. In front on the right, four workers at work.

works.d: Esiplaanil tehase ehitused. Taga kolm tuhamäge. All vasakul kolme töölise siluetid.
works.de: Factory buildings in the foreground. Three ash heaps behind. Silhouettes of three workers lower left.

works.d: Teose keskplaanis kummuli kast, mille ees erinevad aedviljad. (eesti)
works.de: In the middle ground of the work an upturned box, in front of it various garden vegetables.

works.d: Keskel suur kast täis aedvilju. Kasti ümber maas kartulid.(eesti)
works.de: In the middle a large crate full of vegetables. Potatoes on the ground around the crate.

works.t: Graafika. Foto kirja lugevast vanast naisest.

works.dm: kõrgus: 40.5 cm (foto); laius: 61.5 cm (pappalus); kõrgus: 49.0 cm (pappalus); laius: 50.0 cm (foto)

works.t: Graafika. Noore mehe portree. Illustratsioon August Sanga luulekogule Laulud.
works.d: Mustal taustal noore mehe portree. Ülaosas lokkispäise prillidega mehe portree, all vasakul käsi piipu hoidmas. (eesti)
works.de: Portrait of a young man against a black background. In the upper part, a portrait of a curly-haired man with glasses, at the lower left a hand holding a pipe.

works.t: Graafika. Illustratsioon II August Sanga luulekogule Laulud.
works.d: Paremal suur sõnajalaleht, all kaks väiksemat. Ülaosas vasakul sirutub nende kohale mehe käsi. (eesti)
works.de: On the right a large fern leaf, below two smaller ones. In the upper left a man's hand reaches over them.

works.t: Graafika. Illustratsioon III August Sanga luulekogule Laulud.
works.d: Motiiv naise ja lapsega. (eesti)
works.de: Motif with a woman and a child.

works.t: Graafika. Illustratsioon August Sanga luulekogule Laulud.
works.d: Ülaosas kaks nägu vastamisi profiilis, allosas kuppelmaastik, mida mööda lookleb tee. (eesti)
works.de: At the top two faces in profile facing each other, at the bottom a hilly landscape with a winding road.

works.t: Graafika. Illustratsioon V August Sanga luulekogule Laulud.
works.d: Domineerib rukkilill. Ülaservas pilved, allservas lamava mehe pea. (eesti)
works.de: Cornflower dominates. Clouds at the top edge, the head of a lying man at the bottom edge.

works.t: Graafika. Illustratsioon August Sanga luulekogule Laenatud laulud I.
works.d: Mustal taustal mehe portree. (eesti)
works.de: Portrait of a man on black background.

works.t: Graafika. Illustratsioon II August Sanga luulekogule Laenatud laulud I.
works.d: Keskmes vene õigeusu kirik, selle kohal taevas 4 valget linnufiguuri, alumises osas kiriku ees valgete tüvedega lehtpuud. (eesti)
works.de: In the centre a Russian Orthodox church, above it in the sky 4 white bird figures, in the lower part deciduous trees with white trunks in front of the church.

works.t: Graafika. Illustratsioon IX August Sanga luulekogule Laenatud laulud I.
works.d: Alasti naisfiguur, seljaga vaataja poole. (eesti)
works.de: Nude female figure, back turned to the viewer.

works.t: Graafika. Illustratsioon August Sanga saksa luule tõlkekogumikule Laenatud laulud II.
works.d: Vanema mehe profiilis portree. (eesti)
works.de: Profile portrait of an older man.

works.t: Graafika. Illustratsioon XII August Sanga saksa luule tõlkekogumikule Laenatud laulud II.

works.d:
Lehe keskel kaks istuvat meest, käed kõhul, jalad harkis. All paremal kolmanda mehe poolfiguur seljaga, nägu pööratud teiste poole, vasakule. Esiplaanil vasakul lõke. Tagaplaanil keskel laudadest sein ning maastikumotiivid.

Tagaküljel ülal vasakul kunstifondi lipik.
works.de:
In the centre of the sheet two seated men, hands on their stomachs, legs apart. Below on the right the half-figure of a third man seen from behind, face turned towards the others, to the left. In the foreground on the left a campfire. In the background in the centre a wall of boards and landscape motifs.

On the verso, upper left, an art fund label.

works.de: Figure of a boy carrying a haystack on his shoulder in a landscape, garment tied with a long belt, wide-brimmed hat on the haystack. Behind, the sea, in front a coastal landscape.

works.d: Heinasülemi peal, puu all, istuva noormehe figuur, põlvpükstes. Lahtine vest särgi peal, peas laiaääreline kaabu, parem käsi väljasirutatud vasakule. Heinte all vikat.
works.de: Figure of a young man in knee breeches sitting on a haystack under a tree. Open waistcoat over shirt, wide-brimmed hat on head, right hand extended to the left. A scythe under the hay.

works.d: Noore naise figuur, metsa maastiku taustal. Liibuva pihaga kleidis, paremas käevangus korv, põll ülestõstetud korvi servale. Peas lõua alla seotud lai rätik.
works.de: Figure of a young woman, against a forest landscape background. Wearing a fitted-bodice dress, a basket on her right arm, an apron lifted onto the edge of the basket. On her head a wide kerchief tied under the chin.

works.d: Noore eesti talunaise seisev figuur kirikuga maastiku taustal. Figuur rõivastatud kaunistatud alläärega seelikusse, mille peal poolpikk kuub. Rinnal rohkesti ehteid ja suur sõlg. Vasakul käsivarrel narmastega rätik.
works.de: Standing figure of a young Estonian farm woman against a landscape with a church in the background. The figure dressed in a skirt decorated at the lower hem, over which a half-length coat. On the chest numerous ornaments and a large brooch. On the left forearm a fringed scarf.

works.d: Maastikus heinavihku õlal kandva poisi figuur, pikas vööga seotud rõivas, laiaääreline kõrge põhjaga kaabu viljavihu peal. Taga meri, ees rannamaastik.
works.de: In a landscape, the figure of a boy carrying a haystack bundle on his shoulder, dressed in a long belted garment, a wide-brimmed tall-crowned hat on top of the sheaf of grain. Behind, the sea, in front a coastal landscape.

works.d: Kaks teineteisel kätest kinni hoidvat figuuri maastiku taustal. Paremal pikas vööga seotud rõivas mehe figuur laiaäärelise kaabuga peas. Õla najal pikk teivas. Vasakul naise figuur pikas vööga rõivas.
works.de: Two figures holding each other's hands against a landscape background. On the right a male figure in a long garment tied with a belt, wearing a wide-brimmed hat on his head. A long pole resting on his shoulder. On the left a female figure in a long garment tied with a belt.

works.d: Naise figuur maastikus. Punases allääres ristitriipudega seelikus, liibuva pihaga jakis, peas kõrge müts. Paremal põõsas, vasakul mäenõlv.
works.de: Female figure in a landscape. In a red skirt with cross-stripes at the hem, fitted-waist jacket, wearing a tall hat. Bush on the right, mountain slope on the left.

works.d: Seisva naise figuur, ristitriipudega seelikus, liibuva pihaga jakis. Peas kõrge lilleline tanu, lahtised juuksed õlgadel. Paremas käes narmastega kindad. Taga maastik kiriku ja puuga.
works.de: The figure of a standing woman, in a skirt with cross stripes, in a jacket with a fitted bodice. On the head a tall floral bonnet, loose hair on the shoulders. In the right hand fringed gloves. Behind, a landscape with a church and a tree.

works.d: Rannamaastikus seisva mehe figuur, pikas pannaldega vööga mantlis, varruka otsad sinise äärisega. Peas laiaääreline kaabu. Pikad lahtised juuksed õlgadel, parema skäes piits.
works.de: The figure of a man standing in a coastal landscape, in a long cloak with a buckled belt, sleeve ends with a blue trim. On his head a wide-brimmed hat. Long loose hair on his shoulders, a whip in his right hand.

works.d: Noor naine seismas tara ees, profiilis vasakule. Lahtiste, õlgadeni langevate juustega. Peas kõrge tanu selja taga lehvivate värviliste paeltega. Vasaku käe otsas piipkann.
works.de: A young woman standing in front of a fence, in profile to the left. With loose hair falling to her shoulders. On her head a tall cap with colourful ribbons fluttering behind her back. At the end of her left hand a jug.

works.t: Rotermanni maja Tallinnas. Das Rotermann`sche Haus.
works.d: Vaade end. Rotermanni majale Tallinnas. Paremal hoone nurgavaates - nähtav Narva maantee poolne külg ja fassaad. Hoone on kahekordne 19. saj I poole ehitus lihtsustatud klassitsistlikus vormis. Narva maantee poolse majapoole küljes rida poode, mille ees väljakul kaubitsejate ümber tihe rahvahulk. Hoone taga Merepuiestee algus - haljasala puudega. Vasemal Vene turg: ees sillutatud väljak, taga haljasala puudega. Väljakul tõld ja voorimehed. Taga keskel praegune Inseneri tänav ja linna hoonestik ning tornid.
works.de: View of the former Rotermann building in Tallinn. On the right, a corner view of the building - the side and façade facing Narva Road are visible. The building is a two-storey structure from the first half of the 19th century in simplified classicist form. Along the side of the building facing Narva Road is a row of shops, in front of which a dense crowd of traders is gathered on the square. Behind the building begins Merepuiestee - a green area with trees. On the left, the Vene Market: in front, a paved square, behind a green area with trees. On the square a carriage and coachmen. In the middle background, the present-day Inseneri Street and the town's buildings and towers.

works.d: Karikatuur maja ehitamisest. Seinapaneelideks on kasutatud paberlehti lubadustega. Neli meest ehitamas. Redelid. Kraana. Heleinine taust.
works.de: Caricature of building a house. Sheets of paper with promises are used as wall panels. Four men building. Ladders. Crane. Light blue background.

works.d: Karikatuuril habemega nooruk, kaelas magnetofon.
works.de: In the caricature a bearded youth, with a tape recorder around his neck.

works.d: Karikatuuril on all vasakul kaks meest jälgimas kolmandat, kes karahvini otsas kõnelemas, paber käes, prillid ninal.
works.de: In the caricature, lower left, two men watch a third, who is speaking on top of a carafe, paper in hand, glasses on his nose.

works.d: Karikatuuril kahe suitseva korstnaga kõrge hoone, mille juurest paiskvuvad mõlemale poole maja õhku mitmevärvilised (kollane, roosa, helesinine, valge) liblikad, neid püüab liblikavõrguga mees.
works.de: In the caricature a tall building with two smoking chimneys, from which multicoloured (yellow, pink, light blue, white) butterflies are thrown into the air on both sides of the building, a man with a butterfly net is catching them.

works.d: Karikatuuril rohelises ülikonnas prillidega mees uksest väljumas, suu lahti, käsi suu ees ja hüüdmas: Lähen pensionäride sektsiooni: seal on palju lõbusam... Uksel silt: Komsomoli koosolek.
works.de: In the caricature a man in a green suit with glasses is leaving through a door, mouth open, hand in front of his mouth, calling out: I'm going to the pensioners' section: it's much more fun there... A sign on the door: Komsomol meeting.

works.d: Karikatuurne tüüp, kellel õlgadeni sirged oranzid juuksed, silme ees ümmargused väiksed mustad prillid, kaelas kett, seljas pikkade varrukatega liibuv jakk/särk tekstiga: Jeesus Kristus superstar. Jalas alt laienevad püksid. Jalas puukingad (?). Mehe jalge vahel suur oranz rist.
works.de: A caricature-like type, with straight orange hair down to the shoulders, small round black glasses before the eyes, a chain around the neck, wearing a long-sleeved fitted jacket/shirt with the text: Jesus Christ superstar. Wearing trousers that flare at the bottom. Wooden shoes (?) on the feet. A large orange cross between the man's legs.

works.d: Karikatuuril suure toruga grammofoni ees põlvili, käes ees maas meesfiguur. Grammogonil tekst: His masters voice.
works.de: In the caricature, kneeling in front of a gramophone with a large horn, a male figure with hands on the ground in front. Text on the gramophone: His masters voice.

works.d: Karikatuuril teel kaugenev traktor. Tee ääres maas viinapudelid ja maanteepostid. Viidaga: Grunzale - Valga on püsti.
works.de: In the caricature, a tractor moving away down a road. On the roadside, wine bottles and road posts lying on the ground. With the sign: Grunzale - Valga standing upright.

works.d: Karikatuuril viis vana meest reas istumas, neist parempoolsel süles mees sildiga NOOR. Vasakul uks RATS. ETTEPANEKUD.
works.de: In the caricature, five old men sitting in a row, the one on the right holding a man in his lap with a sign NOOR [YOUNG]. On the left a door RATS. ETTEPANEKUD [PROPOSALS].

works.t: Katus peale ja muuseum on valmis
works.d: Karikatuuril kraamihunniku otsas käsi laiutav rõõmus mees, tema kohal tekst: Katus peale ja muuseum on valmis.
works.de: In the caricature, atop a pile of stuff, a happy man with arms spread wide, above him the text: Katus peale ja muuseum on valmis.

works.d: Karikatuuril rohelise traktoriga sõitev mees, vaatab taha paremale. Traktori järele seotud suur kollane mängukaru (kaisukaru).
works.de: In the caricature, a man riding a green tractor looks back to the right. A large yellow toy bear (teddy bear) is tied behind the tractor.

works.d: Karikatuuril mees külgvaates paremale, mastikorvis. Tema pea kohal tekst: Kapten! Ma näen sots.võistluse kokkuvõtet!
works.de: In the caricature a man in profile facing right, in a mast basket. Above his head the text: Captain! I see the summary of the socialist competition!

works.d: Karikatuuril mees mustas riietuses hoogsas liikumises paremale (jalad ees, käed taga), müts pea kohal lennus. Ülal punase värviga suurelt: 13 %
works.de: In the caricature a man in black clothing in vigorous motion to the right (legs forward, arms back), a hat flying above his head. Above, in large red lettering: 13 %

works.d: Karikatuuril naine ja poiss vastamisi seismas, taga vasakul kaks lehma. Naine seletamas poisile. Poisil ehmunud nägu. Taustal päike.
works.de: In the caricature a woman and a boy stand facing each other, behind on the left two cows. The woman explaining to the boy. The boy has a frightened face. Sun in the background.

works.d: Karikatuuril esiplaanil suur mees, käed selja taga, käes hoiab NORMA patareisid. Tagaplaanil kolm inimfiguuri hoidmas toru tekstiga KOMSOM.. PROZEKTOR. Taustal tehase korstnad.
works.de: In the foreground of the caricature, a large man, hands behind his back, holding NORMA batteries. In the background, three human figures holding a pipe with the text KOMSOM.. PROZEKTOR. In the background, factory chimneys.

works.d:
Esikaas: tumeroheliseks värvitud nahal tumepruuni joonega sisse pressitud kellatorn, mille tipus tuulelipp aastaarvuga "1963"; tornil kiri "TARTU"; vasakul sissepressitud joonega, mustaks värvitud tähetorni siluett; ümberringi üksikuid tähti.
Tagakaas; tumepruuniks värvitud pressitud nahk. 
Köidetud tumepruuni nahkpaelaga. 
Lehed hallid.
works.de:
Front cover: a bell tower embossed in dark brown line on leather dyed dark green, with a weathervane bearing the year "1963" at its top; the inscription "TARTU" on the tower; on the left, the silhouette of an observatory tower dyed black with an embossed line; scattered stars around it.
Back cover: pressed leather dyed dark brown.
Bound with a dark brown leather strap.
Leaves grey.

works.dm: kujutise laius: 6.4 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 8.4 cm

works.d:
Esikülg: hallikaspruun; vasakul punakaspruuni värvi ja sissepressitud musta piirjoonega naise pea eestvaates (en face), peas muhu tanu; pisut kõrgemal, paremal profiilis kõrge peakattega pea, mustaks värvitud; peade vahel täheke.
Tagumine külg: hallikaspruun; sissepressitud tumeda joonega geomeetriline kujund.
Äär õmmeldud halli nahkpaelaga. Seesmine pool beežist pressitud nahast. 6 taskut. Taskute vooder beežist voodririidest.
works.de:
Front side: grayish-brown; on the left a woman's head in en face view, reddish-brown coloured with an embossed black outline, wearing a bump-shaped cap on the head; slightly higher, on the right a head in profile with a tall headdress, coloured black; a small star between the heads.
Back side: grayish-brown; a geometric figure with an embossed dark line.
Edge sewn with grey leather cord. Inner side of beige embossed leather. 6 pockets. Pocket lining of beige lining fabric.

works.d: Mati Karmini võistlustööna valminud Tartu raekoja platsi purskkaevu eskiis "Suudlevad tudengid" on muuseumis oluline säilitada, et jäädvustada Tartu linnaruumi kujunemist.
works.de: Mati Karmin's competition entry, a sketch for the fountain "Suudlevad tudengid" ["Kissing Students"] for Tartu Town Hall Square, is important for the museum to preserve in order to record the development of Tartu's urban space.

works.d: Gunnar Neeme mitmeosaline õlimaal "Tartu" jõudis Tartu Linnamuuseumisse Eesti Kirjandusmuuseumi töötaja, Marin Laak,  vahendusel. Gunnar Neeme arhiiv ja maalid jõudsid  Austaaraaliast Eestisse projekti "Rahvuskaaslaste programm" toel.  Antud töö on kena täiendus juba olemasolevale Gunnar Neeme tööde kollektsioonile Tartu Linnamuuseumis. Antud maal on oluline väljendamaks pagenduses elava kunstniku tundeid ja mälestusi seoses Tartuga.
works.de: Gunnar Neeme's multi-part oil painting "Tartu" arrived at the Tartu City Museum through the mediation of Marin Laak, an employee of the Estonian Literary Museum. Gunnar Neeme's archive and paintings arrived in Estonia from Australia with the support of the "Compatriots Programme" project. This work is a fine addition to the already existing collection of Gunnar Neeme's works at the Tartu City Museum. This painting is important for expressing the feelings and memories connected with Tartu of an artist living in exile.

works.d: U. Särev on töötanud kujunduskunstnikuna Tartu Piimakombinaadis ja Tartu kaubandusvalitsuses ja 1969.-1983. aastani tegutses ta Arsi dekooriateljees. Kuna tema looming on suuresti seotud Tartuga, siis on see oluline säilitada kajastamaks Tartu linna ajalugu aastatel 1950- 1990.
works.de: U. Särev worked as a design artist at the Tartu Dairy Combine and the Tartu Trade Administration, and from 1969 to 1983 worked in the Arsi decoration workshop. Since his work is largely connected with Tartu, it is important to preserve it in order to reflect the history of the city of Tartu in the years 1950–1990.

works.d: U. Särev on töötanud kujunduskunstnikuna Tartu Piimakombinaadis ja Tartu kaubandusvalitsuses ja 1969.-1983. aastani tegutses ta Arsi dekooriateljees. Kuna tema looming on suuresti seotud Tartuga, siis on see oluline säilitada kajastamaks Tartu linna ajalugu aastatel 1950- 1990.
works.de: U. Särev worked as a design artist at the Tartu Dairy Combine and the Tartu Trade Administration, and from 1969 to 1983 worked in the Arsi decoration workshop. works.d: Alexandra Milyakina on teinud illustratsioone mitmetele Tartu kohvikutele, baaridele, kultuuriasutustele ja ettevõtetele ning jagab neid tartlaste ja Tartu huvilistega ka sotsiaalmeedia vahendusel. Oluline materjal, et jäädvustada Tartust inspiratsiooni saanud kunstnike tegevust.
works.de: Alexandra Milyakina has made illustrations for several Tartu cafés, bars, cultural institutions and enterprises, and shares them with Tartu residents and those interested in Tartu also via social media. Important material for recording the activity of artists inspired by Tartu.

Vitraažaken, näidis Tartu Jaani kirikule. Moosese põõsas, piimjas klaas.
works.d: Vitraažaken, mis telliti Tartu Jaani kiriku taastamistööde käigus proovitööna ja paigaldati kiriku põhjapoolsele aknale 2019/2000.  Autor Urmo Raus. Proovitöö ei sobinud tellijale (Jaani kiriku kogudusele) ja aken eemaldati. Muuseum peab oluliseks säilitada akent, kui ühte visuaalset osa Tartu linnaruumi ilmestama pidanud teostamata projektist.
works.de: A stained glass window that was commissioned as a trial work during the restoration works of Tartu St. John's Church and installed on the church's north-facing window in 2019/2000. Author Urmo Raus. The trial work did not suit the client (the congregation of St. John's Church) and the window was removed. The museum considers it important to preserve the window as one visual part of an unrealised project that was meant to enliven Tartu's cityscape.

works.d: U. Särev on töötanud kujunduskunstnikuna Tartu Piimakombinaadis ja Tartu kaubandusvalitsuses ja 1969.-1983. aastani tegutses ta Arsi dekooriateljees. Kuna tema looming on suuresti seotud Tartuga, siis on see oluline säilitada kajastamaks Tartu linna ajalugu aastatel 1950- 1990.
works.de: U. Särev worked as a design artist at the Tartu Dairy Combine and the Tartu Trade Administration, and from 1969 to 1983 worked in the Arsi decoration workshop. Since his work is largely connected with Tartu, it is important to preserve it in order to reflect the history of the city of Tartu in the years 1950–1990.

works.d:
Mereakadeemia raamatukogu esemete kollektsioon täiendab  muuseumikogu mitmeid alakogusid.
Laevamudelid, navigatsioonivahendid ja maalid annavad ülevaate merekoolis kasutavatest õppevahenditest ja esindusotstarbeks kasutatavatest esemetest alates 1990.aastatest. 
Materjal on kasutatav näitusetegevuses ja teadustöös.
works.de:
The collection of objects from the Maritime Academy library complements several sub-collections of the museum's holdings.
Ship models, navigation instruments and paintings give an overview of teaching aids used at the naval school and of objects used for representational purposes from the 1990s onward.
The material can be used in exhibition activities and in research work.

works.de: Friedrich Tammik's (b. 1897) oil painting "Suur Tõll", donated to the museum on the occasion of the thirtieth anniversary of the restoration of independence of the Republic of Estonia, complements the collection of paintings of Estonian steamships and the painting collection of the artist Friedrich Tammik. The painting is also a significant addition to the topic of Suur Tõll as a museum ship.

works.d: Esiplaanil all paremal, jõeäärsel jalgteel seismas profiilis paremale mees, otsevaates korviga naine ja poisike profiilis vasakule. Keskel diagonaalis, üle jõe massiivne kividest laotud sild kahel jämedal poolsilindrilisel sambal ja kahe aluskaarega. Silla peal kaks kolmelöövilist triumfikaart. Vasakul äärel, keskel kõrgendikul, aiakese sees puu all seisev inimfiguur vaatamas silla poole. Taamal mitmekordsed linnamajad. Ülal ääres lehtpuu oksad
works.de: In the foreground lower right, on a footpath by the river, a man standing in profile to the right, a woman with a basket in frontal view, and a boy in profile to the left. In the middle, diagonally, across the river a massive bridge built of stones on two thick semi-cylindrical pillars with two supporting arches. On the bridge two three-bayed triumphal arches. On the left edge, in the middle on a rise, a human figure inside a small garden under a tree, looking towards the bridge. In the background multi-storey town houses. Along the upper edge branches of a deciduous tree.

works.d: Eesti geograafilise kaardi piirjooned vappide, portreede, mälestusmärkide ja muude kujutistega. Üleval vasakul ENSV vapp, kaardi nimetus ning autorite nimed. All vasakul Tallinna vanalinn linnulennult, allääres rahvariietes figuurid talude taustal, nende kohal Russalka, Kadrioru lossi, laululava, Pirita kloostri otsaviilu kujutised, portreed jne. All paremal kirjutis: EESTI RAAMAT 1525-1975 koos märgi kujutisega ning autorite loetelu. All kitsalt, eri plaadilt, trükitud seletused kaardi juurde
works.de: The outline of the geographical map of Estonia with images of coats of arms, portraits, monuments and other depictions. Upper left the coat of arms of the ESSR, the title of the map and the names of the authors. Lower left Tallinn's Old Town as seen from a bird's-eye view, along the bottom edge figures in national costume against the background of farms, above them depictions of the Russalka, Kadriorg Palace, the Song Festival stage, the gable of the Pirita Convent, portraits, etc. Lower right an inscription: EESTI RAAMAT 1525-1975 [ESTONIAN BOOK 1525-1975] together with an image of the emblem and a list of the authors. At the bottom, in a narrow strip, printed from a separate plate, explanations to the map

works.dm: laius: 24.0 cm; laius: 1.8 cm; kõrgus: 32.5 cm
works.d:
Exlibris Tartu Ülikooli raamatukogule. Kompositsioonis on kasutatud Parrotit ja Petersoni, Toomel asunud raamatukogu portaali.
Ekslibris on paspartuus ja lihtsa profileeringuga puust raamis, tagaküljel kaks metallist riputusklambrit ja TÜ raamatukogu õnnitluskaart.
works.de:
Exlibris for the University of Tartu Library. The composition uses Parrot and Peterson, the portal of the library located on Toome Hill.
The exlibris is in a mount and a wooden frame with simple profiling, on the back two metal hanging clamps and a University of Tartu Library congratulatory card.

works.d: Visioon Eesti Rahva Muuseumi uuest hoonest,  minimalistlik musta tushi joonis valgel paberil, all paremal  tekst ja signatuur, kaetud plastikuga, raamitud.
works.de: A vision of the new building of the Estonian National Museum, a minimalist black ink drawing on white paper, text and signature lower right, covered with plastic, framed.

works.dm: laius: 38.2 cm; paksus: 1.3 cm; laius: 2.0 cm; kõrgus: 35.0 cm
works.d:
Fototüüpia värvilistest gravüüridest "Vana Petreburi tüübid ja vaated"
Vasakul: linnaväljak, esiplaanil kisellimüüja ja talumees lauasaega, all allkiri vene, saksa prantsuse keeles;
Paremal: taamal elumajad, esiplaanil soojade jookide müüja, all tekst vene, saksa prantsuse keeles.
Fototüüpia on paspartuus, raamitud, klaasitud; tagaküljel paberist sertifikaat ja etikett ning pitsat; metallist peenike riputustross.
works.de:
Phototype of coloured engravings "Types and Views of Old Petersburg"
On the left: a city square, in the foreground a kissel seller and a peasant with a folding table, below a signature in Russian, German and French;
On the right: residential buildings in the distance, in the foreground a seller of hot drinks, below text in Russian, German and French.
The phototype is in a mount, framed, glazed; on the reverse a paper certificate and label, and a stamp; a thin metal hanging wire.

works.d: Õlivärvidega papile maalitud, kujutatud pruunides toonides tumedal foonil stiliseeritud inimpea figuuri, millel peas must kroon, maal kinnitatud puidust raamile, mis on värvitud tumepruunides-kuldsetes toonides, tagaküljel liimitud maali servadesse raami külge kinnitamiseks jõupaber ja raami külge kinnitatud kaks metallist aasa, millest läbi pandud traat riputamiseks, maali alumises nurgas vasakul kunstniku signatuur koos aastaarvuga
works.de: Painted in oil on cardboard, depicting a stylised human head figure in brown tones against a dark background, with a black crown on its head, the painting is attached to a wooden frame painted in dark brown-golden tones, on the reverse kraft paper is glued to the edges of the painting to attach it to the frame, and two metal loops are attached to the frame, through which wire is passed for hanging, in the lower corner of the painting on the left the artist's signature together with the year
