works.dm: pikkus: 67.0 cm; laius: 54.0 cm; pikkus: 73.5 cm; laius: 47.0 cm
works.d: Kaljula Aru rinnaportree maalitud õlivärvidega soome papile, maali foon on rohelistes toonides. Kaljula Aru on kujutatud prillidega, valges ja rohelistes toonides riietuses, punase ja musta värviga lipsuga, paremas käes sigaretiga. Puidust, valgeks värvitud raami tagaküljele on löödud naelad, millede vahele on kinnitatud maal. Maali ülemises vasakus nurgas kunstniku signatuur ja aastaarv.
works.de: A bust portrait of Kaljula Aru painted in oil colours on Finnish cardboard, the background of the painting is in green tones. Kaljula Aru is depicted wearing glasses, dressed in white and green tones, with a red and black tie, with a cigarette in his right hand. Nails have been driven into the back of the wooden frame, painted white, between which the painting is fastened. In the upper left corner of the painting the artist's signature and the year.

works.dm: pikkus: 68.5 cm; laius: 55.0 cm; pikkus: 74.5 cm; laius: 49.0 cm
works.d: Sigrid Aru rinnaportree maalitud õlivärvidega lõuendile, maali fooniks on pruunid ja rohelised toonid. Sigrid Aru kujutatud lillas riietuses, kaelas kuldne kaelakett ripatsiga. Lõuend kinnitatud naeltega puidust raamile, mille ümber omakorda kinnitatud naeltega puidust välimine raam, mis värvitud välisküljelt helepruuniks. Maali tagaküljel raami ülemises servas seinale riputamiseks kaks kruvi ja keskel valge sünteetilisest materjalist pael. Maali ülemises nurgas paremal kunstniku signatuur ja aastaarv.
works.de: A bust portrait of Sigrid Aru painted in oils on canvas, the background of the painting is in brown and green tones. Sigrid Aru is depicted dressed in purple, with a gold necklace with a pendant around her neck. The canvas is fastened with nails to a wooden frame, around which is in turn fastened with nails an outer wooden frame, painted light brown on the outer side. On the back of the painting, in the upper edge of the frame, two screws for hanging on a wall and in the middle a white tape of synthetic material. In the upper right corner of the painting the artist's signature and the year.

works.d:
Õlivärvidega lõuendile maalitud, kujutatud foonil sinist taevast, viljarõukusid, veoautot ja rehepeksumasinat töötavate inimfiguuridega, paremal hobune vankriga ja traktori esiosa, mille kõrval seisev meesfiguur, vasakul veoauto tagantvaates, mille kõrval seisavad kaks meesfiguuri, esiplaanil kaks nais- ja kaks meesfiguuri, kellest üks rattaga ning viljakotid.
Lõuend kinnitatud naeltega raamile, mille nurkades naeltega kinni löödud kolmnurksed puidust osad, välimine raam on valgeks värvitud, tagaküljel üleval ääres tekst ja aastaarv. Maal on signeerimata.
works.de:
Painted in oil on canvas, depicting against a background a blue sky, grain stacks, a truck and a threshing machine with working human figures, on the right a horse with a cart and the front part of a tractor, beside which stands a male figure, on the left a truck seen from behind, beside which stand two male figures, in the foreground two female and two male figures, one of whom has a bicycle, and grain sacks.
The canvas is fastened with nails to a frame, in the corners of which triangular wooden pieces are nailed down; the outer frame is painted white, on the reverse at the top edge there is text and a year. The painting is unsigned.

works.d:
Pruunis ja hallis ülikonnas kaks meest laua ees. Vasak mees laiali sirutatud kätega, kalamehe säärikutega. Tema selja taga laual ämber ja taldrik väikeste kaladega ning silt "Kalurikolhoos "SUUR KALA"".

All tekst: "Mina püüdsin, vaat, niisuguse kala!". "Aga mina kasvatasin, vaat, nii kõrge rukki!"
works.de:
Two men in brown and grey suits in front of a table. The man on the left with arms spread wide, wearing fisherman's boots. Behind him on the table a bucket and a plate with small fish, and a sign "Kalurikolhoos "SUUR KALA"".
The man standing on the right with one hand raised high, behind him on the table a small bag of grain and a sheaf of grain, and a sign "Kolhoos KÕRGE RUKIS"".
Text below: "Mina püüdsin, vaat, niisuguse kala!". "Aga mina kasvatasin, vaat, nii kõrge rukki!"

works.de:
A thatched-roof smoke cottage on a rocky shore. In front of the house stands a woman with a baby in her arms, in front of them sits a dog. Slightly to the right, an old man and a girl. In the foreground on the left, an empty boat. On the right, near the corner, a horse and a cow. In the background on the left, the sea with a boat and gulls, on the right a house with a windmill.

At the bottom of the sheet, written in ink: Eine Fischerhütte an der Küste v.d. Insel Oesel gez. 1810 v. Buddeus.

works.d:
Lahinguvälja kujutus. Ees vasakul seitsmest võitlejast koosnev grupp, mõõkade, kirveste, odade ja kilpidega varustatud käsitsivõitluses, kolm neist on langenud teiste jalge alla. Nende taga ratsanik paljastatud mõõgaga, talle tungivad kallale kolm jalameest.
Pildi kesk- ja tagaplaanil kokku põrkuvad väed: vasakult tsentrumi liiguvad pruunides ja sinistes toonides maalitud eestlaste malevad, paremalt neile vastu liiguvad ristisõdijate väed hobustel, seljas raudrüüd ja lehvivad mantlid. 
Paremal tiival ristisõdijate abivägi - pruunides riietes jalamehed. 
Taamal silmapiiril tume mets ja paremal osa veekogust.
works.de:
Depiction of a battlefield. In the front left, a group of seven fighters, equipped with swords, axes, spears and shields, in hand-to-hand combat, three of whom have fallen under the feet of the others. Behind them a horseman with a drawn sword, attacked by three foot soldiers.
In the middle and background of the picture, colliding armies: from the left towards the centre move the Estonian militias, painted in brown and blue tones, from the right the crusader troops move towards them on horses, wearing armour and flowing cloaks.
On the right flank the crusaders' auxiliary troops - foot soldiers dressed in brown.
In the distance on the horizon a dark forest, and on the right part of a body of water.

works.d: Punasel (purpur) foonil figuraalne kompositsioon. Vasakul punase kullatise ja kahepäise kotkaga harjal tool, sellel istub fretšis (sõjaväekuub), harjasjuustega mees, sirutab paremat kätt kõrvale, kuhu vuntside ja habemega paks mees tool taga sirutab mündi; istuja ees paremal põlvili kiilaspäine mees prillide ja vuntside ning habemega visiitülikonnas, kellel istuja pead silitab. Põlvitaja taga neli väiksematena kujutatud põlvitajat lükkavad teda tagant.
works.de: On a red (purple) background, a figural composition. On the left, on a chair with a golden gilding and a double-headed eagle on the back, sits a bristle-haired man in a fretsch (military coat), stretching out his right hand to the side, where a stout man with a moustache and beard, standing behind the chair, reaches him a coin; in front of the sitter on the right, kneeling, a bald-headed man with glasses, a moustache and a beard, in a visiting suit, strokes the sitter's head. Behind the kneeling man, four smaller-depicted kneeling figures push him from behind.

works.de: On the left in the depths under the window a covered table, at which on the right sits a stout mustached man, who with his right hand lifts a bird leg on a fork to his mouth, in his left hand a wine goblet. Through the window two peasants working in a field can be seen.

works.d:
Vaade kohvikusse, millest näha vasakul ümmargune laud, paremal aken.
Vasakul laua taga kaks kübarates ja karusnahkades daami, ühel sigarett käes, teisel suus, vasakpoolsel koerake süles.
Akna taga kõhn rätikus naine poisi ja tüdrukuga. Vaateaknal tordid. Aknal ülal kaares, peegelpildis kiri KOHVIK.
works.de:
A view into a café, showing a round table on the left, a window on the right.
On the left, behind the table, two ladies in hats and furs, one with a cigarette in her hand, the other with one in her mouth, the one on the left with a small dog in her lap.
Beyond the window a thin woman in a headscarf with a boy and a girl. Cakes in the shop window. Above the window, in an arc, mirror-image lettering reading KOHVIK.

works.d: Seisva mehe figuur 3/4 pikkuses, ateljees maalimas, ees molbert, käes värvipalett. Peakatteta, lühike lokkis juus, särgikäised üles keeratud, heleda särgi krae avatud. Valgus langeb ülalt paremalt.
works.de: The figure of a standing man in 3/4 length, painting in a studio, an easel in front, a palette in hand. Bareheaded, short curly hair, shirt sleeves rolled up, collar of a light shirt open. Light falls from above right.

works.d: Vaade Niguliste kirikule loodest. Ees paremal ja vasakul kõrgete viilkatustega majad. Keskel tänav, mille paremal serval asub kirik. Hoonete katused lumised.
works.de: View of St Nicholas' Church from the northwest. In front on the right and left, houses with tall gable roofs. In the centre a street, on the right side of which stands the church. The roofs of the buildings are snow-covered.

On the right a man and a woman with student caps, gaze turned to the left, where of two boys, newspaper bundles under their arms, one stands and looks to the right, the other runs behind into the depth.
Behind the group on the right a lamppost, against which a man with a student cap stands, coat-flaps spread open, right hand raised holding a bottle.
In the background the outline of a gabled building (a university).

works.de: In the foreground at the left, wreckage of an airplane, on the plane a swastika on the side and tail. On the right two human figures walking on a road, seen from behind. Ahead of them a truck with a load. Along the road some bare trees. On the left, behind the wreckage, a single low building visible against the trees.

works.d: Esiplaanil mehe portre, 3/4-profiilis paremale, vaade otse, lühikesed üle pea kammitud juuksed. Mehest paremal kass. Tagaplaanil neli inimfiguuri, neist vasakult esimene - laps, teine habemega mees, kolmas naine, neljas naine istumas samovari juures. Maalitud sinise ja pruuni tooni värvidega.
works.de: In the foreground a portrait of a man, in 3/4 profile to the right, gaze straight ahead, short hair combed back over the head. To the man's right a cat. In the background four human figures, of whom, from the left, the first is a child, the second a bearded man, the third a woman, the fourth a woman sitting by a samovar. Painted in blue and brown tones.

works.d:
Vasakul kaks meest, äärmine selgvaates ja kalurisaabastega. Teine mees nähtav tormikuues. Kannavad kaste. 
Tagaplaanil avatud ustega kuur, mille ees üks meesfiguur. Kuuri ees kuivavad võrgud, kaldale tõmmatud paadid, tünnid, kastid jms. Parempoolse paadi juures veel üks inimfiguur.
works.de:
On the left, two men, the outermost one seen frontally and wearing fisherman's boots. The other man is visible in a storm coat. They are carrying boxes. 
In the background, a shed with open doors, in front of which stands one male figure. In front of the shed, nets drying, boats pulled up onto the shore, barrels, boxes, etc. Near the boat on the right, another human figure.

works.d: Põskhabemega mehe rindportree, poolprofiilis paremale. Seljas biedermeieri aegne kuub ja vest. Kaelas tume kaelarättside.
works.de: Chest portrait of a man with side-whiskers, in half-profile to the right. Wearing a Biedermeier-era coat and waistcoat. A dark neckerchief around the neck.

works.d: Visand zooloogia muuseumist: ees vaatajate figuure, taga mammutite luukered ja topitud elevant.
works.de: Sketch of the zoology museum: in front, figures of viewers, behind, skeletons of mammoths and a stuffed elephant.

works.t: Tehumardi öölahingus langenute eesti rahvuskorpuse võitlejate matmispaigad

works.d: Vaade jõele. Esiplaanil paadisild, mille juures lootsik. Jõe keskel väike laev. Paremal purjepaat. Jõe vastaskalda ääres mitu laeva sadamas, kaldal majad, neist üks varemeis. Taevas 1/3 pildi pinnast. Ülal paremal lendavad linnud.
works.de: View of a river. In the foreground a boat bridge, with a small boat nearby. In the middle of the river a small ship. On the right a sailboat. Along the opposite bank of the river several ships in harbour, houses on the shore, one of them in ruins. The sky takes up 1/3 of the picture's surface. Above on the right flying birds.

works.d: Linnavaade. Esiplaanil paremal rühm võitlejaid kuulipilduja juures, seljaga vaataja poole. Neist eespool kaitsekraavides paremal ja vasakul kiivritega võitlejaid. Jõe äärse rinnatise tagant avaneb vaade Tartule. Vasakul osa Kaubahoovist, sellest paremal varemeis maja. Paremalt avaneb vaade väljakule, mille taga Raekoda. Taevas kolm lennukit.
works.de: A city view. In the foreground on the right a group of fighters at a machine gun, their backs to the viewer. In front of them in the trenches, on the right and left, fighters with helmets. Behind the parapet by the river a view opens onto Tartu. On the left part of the Kaubahoov (Trade Yard), to its right a ruined house. On the right a view opens onto the square, behind which the Town Hall. Three airplanes in the sky.

works.d: Vaade lagendikule mägise maastiku taustal. Eest paremalt kulgeb taha vasakule muldonnide rida. Lagendikul grupp marssivaid sõdureid. Ees vasakul 6-meheline grupp laua ümber.
works.de: View of a clearing against a background of mountainous landscape. From the right in front to the left in back runs a row of earthen huts. In the clearing a group of marching soldiers. In front on the left a group of 6 men around a table.

works.d:
Mehe rindportree ovaalis. 3/4-pöördes vasakule. Näol prillid, täishabe. Ovaal ümbritsetud ehisraamiga, millel lint C.R. Jakobsoni teoste pealkirjadega (Kolm isamaa kõnet; Meie kaubalaeva...; Teadus ja seadus; Wäikene geograafia; C.R. Linnutaja laulud; Wanemuine kandle healed; Kooli lugemise raamat; Helmed tüttarlased). Ehisraami (loorberilehed) ülal neiu ja noormehe figuurid rahvarõivais, nende vahel kahe raamatu all ajaleht tekstiga Sakala. Ajalehe all kaks palmioksa. Selle taga kiirtekaar. 
All keskel tekst: 
C.R. Jakobson
sündinud 14. Julil. 1840.
surnud 7. Märtsil 1882
works.de:
Bust portrait of a man in an oval. In 3/4 turn to the left. Wearing glasses on his face, with a full beard. The oval is surrounded by a decorative frame, on which is a ribbon with the titles of C.R. Jakobson's works (Kolm isamaa kõnet; Meie kaubalaeva...; Teadus ja seadus; Wäikene geograafia; C.R. Linnutaja laulud; Wanemuine kandle healed; Kooli lugemise raamat; Helmed tüttarlased). Above the decorative frame (laurel leaves) are figures of a young woman and a young man in folk costumes, between them, under two books, a newspaper with the text Sakala. Below the newspaper are two palm branches. Behind this an arc of rays.
Below in the centre the text:
C.R. Jakobson
sündinud 14. Julil. 1840.
surnud 7. Märtsil 1882

works.d: Üldvaade suurele tehnilisele seadmele. Esiplaanil veoauto juures kuus inimfiguuri. Paremal maas torude hunnik, selle juures inimesed. Tagapool veok torukoormega.
works.de: General view of a large technical apparatus. In the foreground six human figures by a truck. On the right a pile of pipes on the ground, with people beside it. Behind, a truck loaded with pipes.

works.d: Üldvaade linnale. Esiplaanil vasakul ja paremal kasvavate puude vahelt paistmas linnamajad ja kirik kõrge torniga (Oleviste), mis osaliselt pildi servaga ära lõigatud. Taevas üksikud pilved.
works.de: General view of the town. In the foreground, on the left and right, between growing trees, town buildings and a church with a tall tower (Oleviste) can be seen, partly cut off by the edge of the picture. In the sky, isolated clouds.

works.d: Esiplaanil labidate ja kanderaamidega töötavad inimesed. Tagaplaanil kirik (Niguliste) varemed, osaliselt pildi servaga ära lõigatud.
works.de: In the foreground people working with spades and stretchers. In the background the ruins of a church (Niguliste), partly cut off by the edge of the picture.

works.t: A. ja R.Sagrits einetamas Jaroslavli ühisateljees

works.d: Lihtsas interjööris vasakul tugitoolis voki ees istuv vanem naine profiilis paremale. Paremal ahjupingil istuv paljasjalgne tütarlaps poolprofiilis vasakule.
works.de: In a simple interior on the left, an older woman sits in an armchair in front of a spinning wheel, in profile facing right. On the right a barefoot girl sits on a stove-bench, in half-profile facing left.

works.d: Keskel kanal, vasakul ja paremal kanali äärsed kõrged majad. Taga kaares sild ja kanalil paate.
works.de: In the middle a canal, on the left and right tall houses along the canal. In the background an arched bridge and boats on the canal.

works.d: Esiplaanil lambakari, paremal karjuse figuur. Keskel tara ääres üksikud puud. Taga paremal puud. Õhtune taevas.
works.de: In the foreground a flock of sheep, on the right the figure of a shepherd. In the middle single trees by a fence. Trees in the background on the right. Evening sky.

works.d: Künklik maastik. Vasakul madala onni ees istuv figuur, keskel suur haraline puu. Paremal põõsaspuude ees üksikud kivid. Taga paremal mäed, vasakul mets.
works.de: Hilly landscape. On the left, a figure sitting in front of a low hut, in the centre a large branching tree. On the right, single stones in front of shrubby trees. In the background, mountains on the right, forest on the left.

works.t: Kirchenruine in Untersteier. Kiriku varemed Alam-Steieris. Leht albumist
works.d: Ees vasakul looklev jõgi. Paremal üksikud puud, puude all naise figuur. Taga vasakul puude vahel gootikaareliste akendega kiriku varemed.
works.de: In front on the left, a winding river. On the right, solitary trees, under the trees a female figure. In the back on the left, among trees, the ruins of a church with Gothic-arched windows.

works.t: Der Militär Friedhof in Salzburg. Salzburgi sõjaväe surnuaed. Leht albumist
works.d: Esiplaanil üksikud hauakivid ja ristid. Keskel leinalooriga naise figuur, taga suured lehtpuud.
works.de: In the foreground individual gravestones and crosses. In the middle the figure of a woman with a mourning veil, behind her large deciduous trees.

works.d: Ees paremal veekogu ääres haavatult lamav põder. Keskel kivil istuv kull, vasakul veekogu. Taga paremal samas lähedal kaljukivil kaks kulli ja kaljude vahel põõsad ja puud. Taamal veel üks kull lendamas.
works.de: In front on the right, by a body of water, a wounded elk lying down. In the middle a hawk sitting on a rock, on the left a body of water. Behind on the right, nearby on a rocky boulder, two hawks, and between the rocks bushes and trees. In the distance another hawk flying.

works.d: Interjööris vasakul avatud raamatuga puldi ees istuv prillidega mees profiilis paremale. Mehe tooli juures lamab koer. Paremal seisavad noor naine imikuga kätel ja noormees maha vaatava pilguga. Paremal avatud uksest sissepiiluva naise figuur.
works.de: In the interior, on the left a bespectacled man sits in profile facing right in front of a lectern with an open book. A dog lies by the man's chair. On the right stand a young woman with an infant in her arms and a young man with a downward gaze. On the right, through an open door, the figure of a peering woman.

works.d: Lihtsas interjööris keskel pingil istuv habemik vanamees, põlvedel asetsevat puupulkadest lõksu kokku seadmas. Tema kõrval paremal pingil lamav poiss ja vasakul vanamehe põlve najal seisev tütarlaps vanamehe tegevust jälgimas.
works.de: In a plain interior, a bearded old man sitting on a bench in the middle, assembling a trap made of wooden sticks resting on his knees. Beside him, on the right, a boy lying on the bench, and on the left a girl standing leaning against the old man's knee, watching the old man's activity.

works.t: Aussieht auf der Anhöhe bey der Rasenmühle

works.d: Karikatuuril esiplaanil mees ja naine teineteise kõrval, rinnas punased märgid. Tagaplaanil palju inimfiguure.
works.de: In the caricature in the foreground a man and a woman next to each other, red marks on their chests. Many human figures in the background.

works.d: Kõndiva naise täisfiguur 3/4-pöördes vasakule, õlgadeni ulatuvad pruunid lokkis juuksed; kannab rahvarõivaid, taustaks põõsaste tagant paistmas linnamüür ja kirikutornid (Oleviste).
works.de: Full figure of a walking woman in 3/4 turn to the left, brown curly hair reaching to the shoulders; wearing folk costume, background showing the town wall and church towers (Oleviste) behind bushes.

works.d: Maastik lindudega: raagus puude all okstel suuremaid ja väiksemaid linnukesi. Taga vasakul puude vahel tornidega hoone.
works.de: Landscape with birds: larger and smaller birds on the branches under bare trees. In the background on the left, a building with towers among the trees.

works.t: Nach dem Kampfe. Pärast võitlust. Leht albumist
works.d: Metsas suurte puude all kaks isapõtra pärast võitlust: vasakul maaslamav ja paremal seisev võitja. Paremal taimestiku vahel kaks põdravasikat.
works.de: In the forest, under large trees, two bull elk after a fight: on the left the one lying down, and on the right the standing victor. On the right, among the vegetation, two elk calves.

works.t: Wallachisches Fuhrwerk. Valahhi veok. Leht albumist
works.d: Ees sillale vasakult paremale sõitev kuue kihutava hobusega vanker koormaga. Taga paremal madalad elamud. Vankril püstiseisev pika piitsaga kutsar.
works.de: In front, a wagon with a load drawn by six galloping horses crossing a bridge from left to right. Behind on the right, low dwellings. On the wagon a standing coachman with a long whip.

works.t: Nähe des Wolfes. Hundi lähedus. leht albumist
works.d: Maastikus esiplaanil tihedates gruppides lambakari, vasakul lammaste vahel mehe figuur püssiga käes. Teine mehe figuur eesli kõrval vasaku käega paremale näidates.
works.de: In the landscape in the foreground a flock of sheep in dense groups, on the left among the sheep a man's figure with a gun in his hand. Another male figure next to a donkey, pointing to the right with his left hand.

works.t: Gänsemarkt in Krakau. Krakovi haneturg. Leht albumist
works.d: Ees vasakul kahehobusega rakendatud vankri najal seisev habemik mees, pikavarrelise piibuga. Mehe ees hanede kari ja kummarduv mees hanega käes. Paremal kaks poisikest. Taga kaubitsejate figuure ja vasakul lahtise trepi ja rõdudega puumaja.
works.de: In front on the left a bearded man stands leaning against a cart harnessed with two horses, holding a long-stemmed pipe. In front of the man a flock of geese and a bending man holding a goose. On the right two boys. In the background figures of traders and on the left a wooden house with an open staircase and balconies.

works.d: Metsamaastikus, rippuva draperii ees, loomanahal lamav naisakt (bakhanditar), pea vasakul, käed tõstetud üle pea.
works.de: In a forest landscape, in front of hanging drapery, a female nude (bacchante) lying on an animal skin, head on the left, arms raised above the head.

works.d:
Lihtsas interjööris paremal mureliku ilmega seisev mees ja pingil istuv naine magava lapsega süles. Keskel põlvitav kummargil pingile toetuv tütarlaps, seljaga. 
Vasakul hunnikus maas mitmesuguseid majatarbeid. Taga avatud ukse kõrval istuv mehe figuur pika kepiga, mütsiga.
works.de:
In a simple interior, on the right a man standing with a worried expression and a woman sitting on a bench with a sleeping child in her lap. In the middle, a girl kneeling, bent over, leaning on the bench, seen from the back.
On the left, various household items lying in a heap on the ground. In the back, next to an open door, a seated male figure with a long stick, wearing a hat.

works.t: Scheuende Ochsen. Lõhkuvad härjad. Leht albumist
works.d: Metsamaastikus töövankri ette rakendatud peruks muutunud kolm härga, vasakul haukuv koer. Vankris inimfiguur.
works.de: In a forest landscape, three oxen turned rear-ward are harnessed to a work cart, on the left a barking dog. In the cart a human figure.

works.t: Faust und Wagners Abendspaziergang. Fausti ja Wagneri õhtune jalutuskäik. Leht albumist
works.d: Õhtuses maastikus ees väikese veekogu ääres kaks pikkades rõivastes mehe figuuri, vasakul jooksev koer.
works.de: In an evening landscape, by a small body of water in the foreground, two figures of men in long garments, on the left a running dog.

works.t: Aus der Gesellschaft. Seltskonnast. Leht albumist
works.d: Teatri loožis vestlevaid õhturiietuses daame ja sõjaväelaste rõivastuses mehi.
works.de: Ladies in evening dress and men in military attire conversing in a theatre box.

works.d: Tirooli talutoas, noor naine lapsega süles, vasakul piipu suitsetav mees. Paremal kõrgete kübaratega kaks noort naist lapsele mänguasja ulatamas, ühel naisel vihmavari käes. Inimgrupi ees koer.
works.de: In a Tyrolean farmhouse room, a young woman with a child on her lap, on the left a man smoking a pipe. On the right, two young women in tall hats offering a toy to the child, one woman holding an umbrella. A dog in front of the group of people.

works.d: Maastikus kolm mehe figuuri maas istuvas asendis, kahel käes püssid. Vasakul meeste selja taga tapetud linde.
works.de: In a landscape three male figures in a seated position on the ground, two of them holding rifles in their hands. On the left behind the men's backs, killed birds.

works.d: Vurrudega mehe kolmveerand figuur "en face", kindralivormis, parema käe pöial kuueääre vahele pistetud. Samas käes hoiab sõdurimütsi.
works.de: Three-quarter figure of a moustached man "en face", in general's uniform, thumb of the right hand tucked between the coat lapels. The same hand holds a soldier's cap.

works.t: Sm. Alliku haud Velikije Luki lähistel

works.d: Naise täisfiguur, seismas 1/4 pöördes paremale, parem käsi tõstetud pea kohale, vasak puusas. Pruunid õlgadeni ulatuvad juuksed, suu lahti, kannab rahvarõivaid, taust õrnalt akvarelliga markeeritud.
works.de: Full figure of a woman, standing in a 1/4 turn to the right, right hand raised above the head, left hand on the hip. Brown shoulder-length hair, mouth open, wearing folk costume, background lightly marked with watercolour.

works.d: Karikatuuril vasakul fotograaf statiiviga aparaadi taga seismas, must kate üle pea. Paremal kaks inimfiguuri poseerimas.
works.de: In the caricature on the left a photographer standing behind an apparatus on a tripod, a black cover over the head. On the right two human figures posing.

works.d: Karikatuuril suur hulk sportlasi, nende kohal suur naise kuju laulmas, kõrval toruga grammofon.
works.de: Caricature featuring a large number of athletes, above them a large female figure singing, next to her a gramophone with a horn.

works.d: Karikatuuril vasakul suur kükitav mees, kellel jutumull: Alustada ma muidugi võin, aga ega ma ei lõpeta...! Mehel sinine müts, kollane spordisärk (varrukateta, tekstiga Õhtukool), mustad lühikesed spordipüksid. Temast paremal seisv mees, kollase särgiga (logo HZ), mustad pikad püksid.
works.de: In the caricature, on the left, a large crouching man with a speech bubble: I can certainly begin, but I won't finish...! The man wears a blue cap, a yellow sports shirt (sleeveless, with the text Õhtukool), black short sports trousers. To his right stands a man in a yellow shirt (logo HZ), black long trousers.

works.d:
Vaade rahvast täidetud õuele kahe kahekordse majaga. Parempoolse inimgrupi keskel pikk varras, mille otsas rippuvad peakatted. Üks mees on varda tippu ronimas. 
Ees vasakul muusikud õllevaatide otsas mängimas. Pilt ümbritsetud kolmekordsest joonraamist.
works.de:
View of a courtyard filled with people, with two two-storey houses. In the centre of the group of people on the right a long pole, from the top of which headwear hangs. One man is climbing to the top of the pole.
In front on the left, musicians playing atop beer barrels. The picture is surrounded by a triple-lined frame.

works.t: Maastik õngitseja ja veistega. Leht albumist
works.d: Ees paremal tara ees kaks lamavat veist, tara taga suured puud, keskel vee sees seisev veis. Vasakul veekogu kaldal seisev õngitseja (kalamees). Tema taga katkise katusega hoone.
works.de: In front on the right, two lying cattle in front of a fence, behind the fence large trees, in the middle a cow standing in the water. On the left, an angler (fisherman) standing on the bank of a body of water. Behind him a building with a broken roof.

works.d:
Pihtimisstseen kirikust. Kiriku seina ääres paremal pingil istuvad figuurid: mees palvenööriga käes, pea toetatud nägu katvale paremale käele. Mehe kõrval naise figuur väikese poisikesega, kel korv käes. 
Vasakul barokses pihtimistoolis istuv preester, paremal põlvitav pihtija naise figuur. Pihtimistoolist vasakul põlvitav naise figuur palveraamatuga käes.
works.de:
Confession scene from a church. Figures sitting on a bench on the right by the church wall: a man with a rosary in hand, head resting on the right hand covering the face. Beside the man a woman's figure with a small boy holding a basket. 
On the left a priest sitting in a baroque confessional, on the right a kneeling figure of a woman confessing. To the left of the confessional a kneeling woman's figure with a prayer book in hand.

works.d: Karikatuuril vasakul neli inimfiguuri ( 1 naine, 3 meest) pikkade juustega, meestel habemed. Paremal kepile toetuv nende poole rääkv mees jutumulliga: Lubasid ikka noori saata, aga siin ju kõik puha pensionärid...!
works.de: In the caricature on the left four human figures (1 woman, 3 men) with long hair, the men with beards. On the right a man leaning on a cane speaking to them with a speech bubble: You promised to send young ones, but here everyone is a pensioner...!

works.d: Karikatuuril paks kaust tekstiga "Sotsialistliku võistluse materjalid", kaustast on uss läbi närinud, poolenisti väljas ja  jutumulliga: Ma jõudsin poole aastaga kõik materjalid läbi võtta... Paremal mees sildi juures: ELKNÜ Tartu Linnakomitee.
works.de: In the caricature, a thick folder with the text "Sotsialistliku võistluse materjalid" [Materials of the socialist competition], a worm has gnawed through the folder, half out, with a speech bubble: Ma jõudsin poole aastaga kõik materjalid läbi võtta... [I managed to go through all the materials in half a year...] On the right a man by a sign: ELKNÜ Tartu Linnakomitee.

works.d: Esiplaanil käsi laiutav mees, kelle juures neli naist. Naistel käes ajakirjad: Pikker, Dikobraz, Szpilki, Krokodill. Naiste selja taga pikk rida inimesi, kõik kujutatud karikatuurselt.
works.de: In the foreground a man gesturing with his arm, next to him four women. The women are holding magazines: Pikker, Dikobraz, Szpilki, Krokodill. Behind the women's backs a long row of people, all depicted in a caricatured manner.

works.d: Esiplaanil kõrgete kaljuseinte vahel veekogu. Paremal kõrge kalju äärsel teel üksik mehe figuur. Vasakul kõrge mäe kallakul barjäär ja taga väike maja. Taga kaljud.
works.de: In the foreground a body of water between high rocky walls. On the right, on a path by a high cliff, a solitary male figure. On the left, on the slope of a high mountain, a barrier and behind it a small house. Cliffs behind.

works.d:
Vasakul mehe rinnaportree poolprofiilis paremale, peas kaela ümber ulatuvate volangidega tanu ja ilma põhjata püstiseisvate sulgkaunistustega peakate. 
Paremal pool naise rinnaportree poolprofiilis vasakule. Nina küljes rippuvad kaunistused, kõrvalehe ümber helmeskaunistus. Riietuse kraeosa kaunistatud.
works.de:
On the left a man's bust portrait in half-profile facing right, on his head a bonnet with frills reaching around the neck and a bottomless upright feather-decorated headdress. 
On the right a woman's bust portrait in half-profile facing left. Decorations hanging from her nose, a beaded decoration around the ear flap. The collar part of the clothing is decorated.

works.d: Kolm naist ja väike tütarlaps. Paremal ja vasakul naised selgvaates, keskel naine en face. Tüdruku riietus kollane, peas punane peakate. Naised mustas. Taustal taluhoone, roigasaed, aia ees küna.
works.de: Three women and a small girl. On the right and left the women are seen from the side, in the centre a woman en face. The girl's clothing is yellow, on her head a red headdress. The women are in black. In the background a farm building, a pole fence, in front of the fence a trough.

works.d: Traditsiooni kohaselt kindlas järjekorras sammuv pulmaliste rida, ees mehed, taga naised. Naistel käes lauluraamatud.
works.de: According to tradition, a row of wedding guests walking in a fixed order, men in front, women behind. The women hold hymn books.

works.d: Ümmarguste prillidega mehe rindportree pöördega vasakule, põskhabemega. Figuur kannab laiade revääridega tumedat biedermeierkuube ja kaelas tumedat kaelasidet.
works.de: Chest portrait of a man with round glasses, turned to the left, with sideburns. The figure wears a dark Biedermeier coat with wide lapels and a dark cravat at the neck.

works.d:
Rohkefiguuriline stseen interjööris: ees paremal põlvele toetuv põske rätikuga kinni hoidev figuur, keskel vihase ilmega, laiaäärelise kaabuga ja kroogitud kraega keppi vibutav mees. Vasakul grupp pealtvaatajaid, kaks naist lapsega ja mehed. Nende ees koer. Grupi taga suure pesukorviga naised. 
Paremal ruumi seintel sarvedega põdrapeade kolm trofeed. 
Taga kaarvõlviga uksest nähtav ülesse viiv trepp.
Põrand ruudustiku mustriga.
works.de:
A scene with many figures in an interior: in front on the right a figure kneeling, holding a cheek with a kerchief; in the middle a man with an angry expression, a wide-brimmed hat and a ruffled collar, brandishing a cane. On the left a group of onlookers, two women with a child and men. In front of them a dog. Behind the group women with a large laundry basket.
On the right, on the walls of the room, three trophies of antlered elk heads.
In the back, through an arched doorway, a staircase leading up is visible.
Floor with a chequered pattern.

works.d: Müüripingil istuva kõhna naise akt: tõstetud põlvedega profiilis vasakule lahtise riidega seljal. Pingi ees maas, paremal kõrge kitsa kaelaga savikann, vasakul tapetud kana.
works.de: A nude of a thin woman sitting on a stone wall bench: in profile facing left with raised knees, an open cloth on her back. In front of the bench on the ground, on the right a tall narrow-necked clay jug, on the left a slaughtered chicken.

works.d: Ees paremal väike veekogu ja koer, keskel loomakari. Taga veise seljas ratsutav poiss.
works.de: In the foreground on the right a small body of water and a dog, in the middle a herd of animals. Behind, a boy riding on the back of a bovine.

works.de: In front on the right a shepherd sitting on the riverbank, on the left a herd of cows in a shallow river, and behind, along the opposite bank, a group of houses with solitary trees. Low horizon.

"Aga selle eest peate sõdima minu huvide eest".
Ameerika lipuvärvides mütsiga mees annab mehele relva ja kiivri. Taga seismas ema lapsega, lapsel kala käes.

A man wearing a cap in American flag colours hands a man a weapon and a helmet. Behind stands a mother with a child, the child holding a fish.

works.de: In the foreground a low flooded landscape. On the right by the shore a boat, behind it houses among groups of trees. The landscape is evening, dark trees in the foreground against a light sky.

works.d:
KOOPIA MAALIST:
Nikolai Kalmakovi maal „24. veebruar 1918”, millel on kujutatud Eesti Päästekomitee liikmeid Konstantin Päts, Jüri Vilms, Konstantin Konik Eesti iseseisvust välja kuulutamas.

Maali allosas daatumid:
Vasakul alumises nurgas 18.11.1917 ja paremal alumises nurgas 24.02.1918.
works.de:
COPY OF A PAINTING:
Nikolai Kalmakov's painting "24. veebruar 1918", depicting the members of the Estonian Salvation Committee Konstantin Päts, Jüri Vilms, Konstantin Konik proclaiming Estonia's independence.

At the bottom of the painting there are dates:
In the lower left corner 18.11.1917 and in the lower right corner 24.02.1918.

Vaade rukkipõllule, kus neli inimest tööl rukkilõikusel, vikatite ja sirbiga. Taga paremal künkal tuulik, puude tagant paistab kirikutorn. Selle lähedal veski. 
Maalimislaad naiivne.
works.de:
View of a rye field where four people are working at the rye harvest, with scythes and a sickle. On the right a row of rye stooks, in front on the left grows a birch, from whose base a road leads to the right, to a hill, from where farm buildings with red roofs and a well can be seen. Behind on the right hill a windmill, behind the trees a church tower can be seen. Nearby a mill.
The painting style is naive.

works.d: Tõnis Laanemaa (1937), kes kuulus 1964-1969 Tallinnas tegutsenud rühmitusse ANK’ 64, on aktiivne kunstnik kuni tänaseni. Kolm varast oforti on Laanemaa assotsiatsioonidele rajaneva, emotsionaalselt loetava stiili tüüpilised näited. Oma põlvkonna graafikute seas eristub Laanemaa sotsiaalsete teemade poole pöördumisega, mis suhestuvad murrangutega ühiskonnas.
works.de: Tõnis Laanemaa (1937), who belonged to the group ANK' 64 active in Tallinn 1964-1969, remains an active artist to this day. The three early etchings are typical examples of Laanemaa's style, based on associations, emotionally readable. Among the graphic artists of his generation, Laanemaa stands out for turning to social themes, which relate to the upheavals in society.

Naine seletab joonistuse abil teletorni vallutamise katset. Seejärel selgitab Edgar Savisaare rolli selles sündmuses. Inimesed seletavad mälestusi Savisaarest. Näidatakse videokaadreid sündmustest.  
Lõpus näidatakse kaustikut ja muusikavideot
works.de:
A woman explains with the help of a drawing the attempt to capture the television tower. She then explains Edgar Savisaar's role in this event. People share memories of Savisaar. Video footage of the events is shown.
At the end a notebook and a music video are shown

works.d:
Kunstiteos koosneb kolmest dialoogist: esimene video kujutab
kunstnikku, kes on mitme enesetapukatse tagajärjel maailmast võõrandunud.
Teine video on kunstnikust vahetusüliõpilasena Inglismaal
räpast tööd tegemas. Kolmas video näitab kellasseppa, kes hoolitseb
suurte kellamehhanismide eest. Kõik kolm karakterit otsivad õnne
ja identiteeti just nii, nagu seda on teinud ka varasemad põlvkonnad.
works.de:
The artwork consists of three dialogues: the first video depicts
the artist, who has become alienated from the world as a result of several suicide attempts.
The second video shows the artist as an exchange student in England
doing dirty work. The third video shows a clockmaker who takes care
of large clock mechanisms. All three characters seek happiness
and identity, just as previous generations have done.

works.d: Must ekraan, rongimürin. Pikkamööda avaneb aken, seejärel näidatakse kiiresti mööduvat maastikut. Liikumine aeglustub ja kiireneb, korra jääb seisma, pärast sõidab alevist läbi. Kaks korda näidatakse teed, mida mööda läheb kaks inimest. Aken läheb vahepeal kinni. Lõpuks meri - see pilt pole enam aknast. Mere mühin, päikeseloojang. Siis pilt valgeks ja lõpp.
works.de: A black screen, the rumble of a train. Gradually a window opens, then a quickly passing landscape is shown. The movement slows down and speeds up, stops for a moment, then drives through a small town. Twice a road is shown, along which two people walk. The window closes in between. Finally the sea - this image is no longer through the window. The roar of the sea, sunset. Then the image turns white and it ends.

works.t: Mutant a'la carte I. Varbaküünte värvija
works.d: Prillidega lillakas-punase peaga roosas siidpluusid naine, kellel puudub põlvest saadik parem jalg. Värvib patjadele nõjatudes terve jala varbaküüsi. Kõrval lebab kark.
works.de: A woman with glasses, a purplish-red head, in a pink silk blouse, missing her right leg from the knee down. Leaning on cushions, she is painting the toenails of her whole leg. A crutch lies beside her.

works.d: Paremal valges heegeldatud pitsiga pluusis lillakas-punaste juustega tugevalt mingitud naine istub nõjatudes poolikule vasakule jalale. Vasakpoolses pildid osas valgel taustal sama naise hägune käsi.
works.de: On the right, a woman with reddish-purple hair, strongly permed, wearing a blouse with white crocheted lace, sits leaning on her half-bent left leg. In the left part of the picture, on a white background, the same woman's blurred hand.

works.d: Köök gaasipliidi ja valamuga. Ratastoolis istuv heledat hommikumantlit kandev ühe jalaga naine küünitab midagi kapist võtma.
works.de: A kitchen with a gas stove and a sink. A woman with one leg, sitting in a wheelchair and wearing a light-coloured dressing gown, reaches to take something from the cupboard.

works.t: Mutant a'la carte IV. Kinga kängitseja
works.d: Baretiga, mantel õlgadel ja pika seelikuga ühe jalaga naine paneb olemasolevasse jala kinga pannalt kinni. Pilk suunatud vaatajale. Vasakul vastu seina toetatud kark, paremal maas käekott.
works.de: A woman with a beret, a coat on her shoulders and a long skirt, with one leg, fastens the buckle of the shoe on the leg she has. Her gaze directed at the viewer. On the left a crutch leaning against the wall, on the right a handbag on the floor.

works.t: Mutant a'la carte V. Lõuna sööja
works.d: Mustapäine beežis kleidis ühe jalaga naine toetub vastu uksepiita ja sööb mahavaadates õuna.
works.de: A dark-haired woman in a beige dress, standing on one leg, leans against a doorpost and eats an apple while looking down.

works.t: Mutant a'la carte VI. Trepist ronija

works.t: Mutant a'la carte VII. Diivanil lamaja

works.de: A woman with short black hair, wearing a dark green smock, with one leg, lies on a divan partly covered with a patterned cloth. The stump of her left leg is bound with a white bandage. She leans on her left elbow, her face turned away, her right hand covering her face.

works.d: Blond, must-valges kleidis ühe jalga naine toetub karkudele ja vaatab üle parema õla tagasi. Foto seljatagant. Jalas must sukk ja must kõrge kontsaga king. Taust valge.
works.de: A blonde woman in a black-and-white dress with one leg leans on crutches and looks back over her right shoulder. Photo from behind. Wearing a black stocking and a black high-heeled shoe. Background white.

works.d: Pika punase kleidi ja musta keebiga naine sõidab ratastoolis. Ümber kiiskavad kollased tänavatuled.
works.de: A woman in a long red dress and black cape rides in a wheelchair. Around her, yellow street lights glare.

works.d: Musta Kleopatra soenguga naine. Õlapaeltega kleit, rinnaees punased roosid. Istub jalad laiali, jalas mustriga sukad. Vasak küünarnukk toetub vasaku jala põlvest maha lõigatud köndile. Suu avatud.
works.de: A woman with a Cleopatra hairstyle in black. A dress with shoulder straps, red roses at the chest. She sits with legs apart, wearing patterned stockings. Her left elbow rests on a stump cut off below the knee of her left leg. The mouth open.

works.d: Klaverimuusika. Kiilas, valge kleidiga tüdruk loeb ümmarguse laua taga raamatut. Siis tõuseb, läheb poomisnööri juurde, ronib toolile, paneb silmuse kaela, tõmbab pingule, vaade liigub alla toolile see läheb ümber, jalad kõlguvad, siis stopp ja lint sama tegevusega hakkab tagurpidi jooksma lõpeb lugemiseha, siis tõuseb püsti läheb teisele poole, võtab klaveri äärest püstoli ja teeb nagu tulistaks, kukub istuma, kargab püsti laseb kuuli pähe, kukub istuma. Tõuseb, läheb laua juurde ja hakkab lugema.
works.de: Piano music. In a swing, a girl in a white dress reads a book at a round table. Then she rises, goes to the hanging rope, climbs onto a chair, puts the noose around her neck, pulls it tight, the view moves down to the chair, it tips over, the legs dangle, then it stops and the film with the same action starts running backwards, ending with the reading, then she stands up, goes to the other side, takes a pistol from the edge of the piano and pretends to shoot, falls sitting, jumps up, shoots herself in the head, falls sitting. Rises, goes to the table and starts reading.

works.d: Kelomees seisab seljaga vaataja poole ja käed laiali või sõrmed harali embab erinevaid objekte maastikus. Seda tehtud paljude Tallinna,Tartu, Jõhvi ja Toila  tuntud hoonetega. Vahele pikitud pilte keskaegsetest käsikirjadest ja reprodest. Kõike seda saadab avangardne puhkpillimuusika.
works.de: A log man stands with his back to the viewer, arms outspread or fingers splayed, embracing various objects in the landscape. This is done with many well-known buildings of Tallinn, Tartu, Jõhvi and Toila. Interspersed with images from medieval manuscripts and reproductions. All of this is accompanied by avant-garde brass music.

works.d: Interjööris seismas ja vestlemas kaheksa rikkaliku voldistikuga, maani rõivais meest. Esiplaanil vasakul palja pealae ja habemega mees profiilis paremale, vasak käsi parema õla juures, parem küünarnukist kõrverdatud ees. Paremal, turbaniga peas, habeme ja vuntsidega mees, profiilis vasakule, käes all ristamisi. Keskel siledate, pikemate juuste ja lühikese habemega noorem mees otse, parem käelaba rinna ees vertikaalselt, vasak küünarnukist kõverdatud vöökohal. Vasakul vanem mees profiilis paremale, taga nähtavad nelja mehe pead, kõigil habemed, kolmel turbanid peas
works.de: In an interior, eight men in rich-folded, floor-length garments stand and converse. In the foreground on the left, a bare-headed, bearded man in profile facing right, left hand at the right shoulder, right arm bent at the elbow in front. On the right, a man with a turban on his head, beard and moustache, in profile facing left, hands crossed below. In the centre, a younger man with smooth, longer hair and a short beard, facing forward, right hand vertically in front of the chest, left arm bent at the elbow at waist level. On the left, an older man in profile facing right, behind whom the heads of four men are visible, all with beards, three with turbans on their heads.

works.d: Pimeduses paremale sammuv inimeste rühm, kõige ees lehvivate mantlihõlmadega naine, vasaku kaenla all suur mapp, paremas väiksem mapp ja rahakott. Tema taga vanem naine, laps süles ja paremas käes seotud komps, tagapool tume mehe poolfiguur, kaabuga mees, suur kott seljas, paremas käes kohver, ja naine, pakk parema kaenla all. Vasakul, all nurgas, habemik vanamees kolmveerandfiguurina poolprofiilis vasakule, ette poolkükkis, käes suurel kompsul. Taamal põlev maja
works.de: A group of people walking to the right in darkness, at the very front a woman with fluttering coat flaps, a large portfolio under her left arm, a smaller portfolio and a purse in her right hand. Behind her an older woman, a child in her arms and a tied bundle in her right hand, further back the dark half-figure of a man, a man with a hat, a large bag on his back, a suitcase in his right hand, and a woman with a bundle under her right arm. On the left, in the lower corner, a bearded old man as a three-quarter figure in half-profile to the left, crouching forward, holding a large bundle. In the distance, a burning house

works.d: Linnas (Tartu linnaruumis), varemete taustal (ülal vasakul Vanemuise teatri varemed), esiplaanil seitse töötavat meest. Vasakul, profiilis paremale seisev mees, käte vahel vertikaalselt kang. Paremal kaks meest kõrvuti, vaataja poole püsti upitamas jämedat toru. Taga, vasakul kõrvuti kaks seisvat meest: vasakpoolne profiilis paremale, paremal õlal labidas; teine otsevaates, vasak käsi näitab paremale, keskele, samas suunas ka mehe pilk. Paremal serval kaks meest: üks seisab selgvaates, pea profiilis paremale; teine tagapool, otsevaates seismas, käte vahel kirka, pea profiilis paremale
works.de: In a city (in Tartu's urban space), against the background of ruins (upper left, the ruins of the Vanemuine Theatre), seven working men in the foreground. On the left, a man standing in profile facing right, a bar held vertically between his hands. On the right, two men side by side, hoisting a thick pipe upright towards the viewer. Behind them, on the left, two standing men side by side: the left one in profile facing right, a shovel on his right shoulder; the other frontal, his left hand pointing to the right, towards the centre, his gaze in the same direction. At the right edge, two men: one standing in full view, head in profile facing right; the other further back, standing frontally, a pickaxe between his hands, head in profile facing right

works.de: In the foreground on the right, the face of a woman in a headscarf tilted to the left, eyes closed, a hand with spread fingers under her chin. On the left, partly in the woman's shadow, the bust portrait of a man, bearded face, his head also tilted to the left, eyes directed towards the woman. On the man's shoulder a cross. works.d: Kunstnik seisab suure valge alusraami taustal ja räägib inglise keeles. Algul naeratab, keskel tõsine, lõpuks hakkab naerma. "Tere! Mu nimi on Kai Kaljo. Ma olen eesti kunstnik. Ma kaalun 92 kg. Ma olen 37 aastat vana, aga elan ikka koos emaga. Ma ei ole abielus. Ma töötan Eesti Kunstiakadeemias õpetajana 90 dollari eest kuus. Arvan, et tähtsaim asi kunstnikuks olemise juures on vabadus. Ma olen väga õnnelik." Tema tekstile vastab mõnitav naer.
works.de: The artist stands against the background of a large white stretcher frame and speaks in English. At first she smiles, in the middle she is serious, at the end she starts to laugh. "Hello! My name is Kai Kaljo. I am an Estonian artist. I weigh 92 kg. I am 37 years old, but I still live with my mother. I am not married. I work at the Estonian Academy of Arts as a teacher for 90 dollars a month. I think the most important thing about being an artist is freedom. I am very happy." Her text is answered by mocking laughter.

works.d: Kaljo Põllu huvi hõimurahvaste ajaloo ja müütide vastu viis muuhulgas kunstiüliõpilastega korraldatud ekspeditsioonideni. Paralleelselt uurimistööga toimus ka materjali loominguline mõtestamine: nõnda tegeleb monumentaalne graafikasari „Kalivägi“ (1978–1984) soomeugri etnograafilise ja mütoloogilise pärandiga kunstilise tõlgendamise kujul. 65-leheliseks monumentaalseks narratiiviks välja kasvanud unikaalne sari ei ole Eesti Kunstimuuseumi kogudes esindatud täiskujul, mistõttu on oluline sellest võimalikult tervikliku komplekti koondamine.
works.de: Kaljo Põllu's interest in the history and myths of kindred peoples led, among other things, to expeditions organised with art students. Parallel to the research work, there was also a creative interpretation of the material: thus the monumental print series „Kalivägi“ (1978–1984) engages with Finno-Ugric ethnographic and mythological heritage in the form of artistic interpretation. The unique series, which grew into a 65-sheet monumental narrative, is not represented in full in the collections of the Art Museum of Estonia, which is why it is important to assemble as complete a set as possible.

Kalda ääres vees kolm inimest, paremal väikesel lauajupil kaks poisikest kala püüdmas. Vastaskaldal, avaral platsil palju inimesi istumas, joomas, tantsimas, palli mängimas, kiigel. works.de: A grassy clearing by the river filled with a celebrating crowd of people. In the foreground a body of water in a narrow horizontal strip, on the left below a boat with three people, a fourth holding on to the edge of the boat in the water. By the shore in the water three people, on the right on a small piece of board two boys fishing. On the opposite bank, on an open ground, many people sitting, drinking, dancing, playing ball, on a swing. In the background on the right under a large tree two trucks, on the left-hand one people on top.

works.d: Värviline digitrükk kleebitud kapaplaadile. Kaks tüdrukut mängivad hobust. Vana räämas hoov, vareme taustal taga sinises käisteta kleidis tüdruk, pikad roosad kindad käes ja roosa tutt juustes hoiab laia paelaga (must pits?) kinni eespool jooksvat tüdrukut (pael ümber puusade). Ees jooksval tüdrukul seljas ereroheline pluus ja lühike seelik. Peas tumeroheline lai pael. Taga paremal ripub nööril pesu.
works.de: Colour digital print glued onto foam board. Two girls playing horse. An old, dilapidated yard, against the background of a ruin, behind, a girl in a blue sleeveless dress, with long pink gloves in her hands and a pink tuft in her hair, holding with a wide ribbon (black lace?) the girl running in front (the ribbon around her hips). The girl running in front wears a bright green blouse and a short skirt. On her head a dark green wide ribbon. Behind on the right, laundry hangs on a line.

works.d: Mustvalge digitaaltrükk kapaplaadil. Vana laguneva puumaja ees tänaval seisavad vastamisi kolm tüdrukut ning hüppavad parajasti korraga õhku, käed üles tõstetud. Kaks tüdrukut, kes paremini näha on samad, kes pildil V.
works.de: Black-and-white digital print on Kapa-line board. In front of an old dilapidated wooden house on the street stand three girls facing each other, jumping into the air all at once, arms raised. Two of the girls, who are more clearly visible, are the same ones seen in the picture with V.

works.d: Värviline digitaaltrükk kapaplaadil. Ees paremal sinises kleidis tüdruku pool pead - pikk hobusesaba roosa lehviga ja õlg. Tema taga rohelises tüdruk kergelt kummargil parem käsi näpib kaelakut. Silmad kinniseotud laia valge-musta mummulise rätikuga. Tagaplaanil kivisein ja muru.
works.de: Colour digital print on cover board. In front on the right, half the head of a girl in a blue dress – a long ponytail with a pink bow, and a shoulder. Behind her, a girl in green, slightly bent over, right hand plucking at a necklace. Eyes covered with a broad white-and-black polka-dot kerchief. In the background a stone wall and grass.

works.d: Mustvalge digitaaltrükk kapaplaadil. Ees keskel seisab tedretähnidega tüdruk (kujutis vööni). Kaelas kaks keed. Vaatab paremale. Tema taga nööril kuivab valge pesu, selle taga telliskivisein.
works.de: Black-and-white digital print on foam board. In the centre foreground stands a freckled girl (depicted to the waist). Two necklaces around the neck. Looking to the right. Behind her white laundry drying on a line, behind that a brick wall.

works.d: Värviline digitaaltrükk kapaplaadil. Võrdlemisi musta akna taustal seisab tüdruk. Seljas hall, roosidega kittel - kõhu peale topitud, nii et jääb mulje nagu ootaks ta last. Parem käsi toetab maast kerkivat gladiooli. Vasakus käes hoiab roosat lutti imevat nukku. Kaelas oraanzhid pikad pärlid. Peas roosa gaassall.
works.de: Colour digital print on Kapa-line board. Against a relatively black window background stands a girl. She wears a grey smock with roses, stuffed at the stomach so as to give the impression that she is expecting a child. Her right hand supports a gladiolus rising from the ground. In her left hand she holds a doll sucking on a pink pacifier. Around her neck long orange pearls. On her head a pink gauze scarf.

works.d: Mustvalge digitaaltrükk kapaplaadil. Vana maja ukse ees trepil istuvad kolm tüdrukut. Keskmisel seljas pikk kleit ja süle suure valge lillega kimp. Vasak käsi üleval, parem naabri õlal. Temast vasakul pikkade lahtiste juustega tüdruk, parem käsi süles, teine selja taga. Jalad siivsalt koos. Paremal mustade lühikeste patsidega tüdruk vaatab allapoole, käes kimp nelke? Istub jalad laiali, paistavad valged püksid.
works.de: Black-and-white digital print on foam board. Three girls sitting on the steps in front of the door of an old house. The one in the middle wears a long dress and holds in her lap a bouquet with a large white flower. Her left hand is raised, her right hand on her neighbour's shoulder. To her left a girl with long loose hair, her right hand in her lap, the other behind her back. Legs modestly together. On the right a girl with short black plaits looks downward, holding in her hand a bouquet of carnations(?). She sits with her legs apart, white underpants showing.

works.d: Värviline digitaaltrükk kapaplaadil. Ees paremal poolpöördes käsi puusas tüdruk, kellel padi kõhuks pandud. Kujutis ähmane. Keskel hoiab kardinat rohelises kleidis tüdruk, must mustriline rätik õlgadel. Lutti imev nukk vasakus käes. Vaatab esimese tüdruku kõhtu.
works.de: Colour digital print on cardboard panel. In front on the right, a girl in a half-turn with her hand on her hip, a pillow placed as a belly. The image is blurred. In the middle a girl in a green dress holds a curtain, a black patterned shawl on her shoulders. A doll sucking a dummy in her left hand. She looks at the first girl's belly.

works.d: Värviline digitaaltrükk kapaplaadil. Suur kivikuul, mille all tumeroosa rätik. Kuuli peal mustades tikk-kontsades sukksaabastes jalad - üks (parem) kuuli peal, teine vabalt küljel. Vanaaegsetes valgetes kinnastes käed toetuvad ka kuulile. Vasakus käes must käekott. Ülal paljad jalad ja valge kleidiserv. Taamal mererand
works.de: Colour digital print on cardboard panel. A large stone ball, under which a dark pink scarf. On the ball, feet in black stiletto-heeled boots - one (right) on the ball, the other free at the side. Hands in old-fashioned white gloves also resting on the ball. In the left hand a black handbag. Above, bare legs and the white edge of a dress. In the background a sea shore

works.d: Värviline digitaaltrükk kapaplaadil. Kivist alusel seisab kivikuul. Sellele toetub parema jalaga valges alusseelikus (vanaaegses) tüdruk. Jalas tikk-kontstega mustad vanaaegsed sukksaapad, käes valged vanaaegsed valged kindad, peas must lõua alt paeltega kinni seotud tanu. Parem käsi toetub kuuli peale tõstetud jalale ja hoiab käes musta kotti. Vasak käsi all puusal hoiab kimpu gladioole. Taustaks on tõmmatud erkroosa kangas. Ülalt paistab sinine taevas. Vaade vasakule.
works.de: Colour digital print on Kapa board. A stone ball stands on a stone base. A girl in an old-fashioned white underskirt rests her right foot on it. She wears old-fashioned black lace-up boots, old-fashioned white gloves on her hands, and on her head a bonnet tied under the chin with ribbons. Her right hand rests on the raised leg on the ball and holds a black bag. Her left hand at the hip below holds a bunch of gladioli. The background is a bright pink fabric drawn taut. Above, a blue sky is visible. View to the left.

works.d: Värviline igitaaltrükk kapaplaadil. Mererand. Sinise riidega kaetud alusel suur kivikuul. Sellel seisab seljaga vaataja poole kergelt ettepoole kummargil tüdruk. Jalas mustad paksud sukad või sukksaapad (reieni), seljas vanaaegne võrestikuga valge alusseelik, mis kumab läbi. Vaade tüdruku seeliku alla. Vasakus käes kaks gladiooli, paremas must kott.
works.de: Coloured digital print on cardboard. A seaside. On a base covered with blue cloth a large stone ball. On it stands, with her back to the viewer, slightly bent forward, a girl. She wears black thick stockings or thigh-high stocking-boots (up to the thigh), on her an old-fashioned white underskirt with lattice-work that shows through. A view under the girl's skirt. In her left hand two gladioli, in her right a black bag.

works.d: Värviline digitaaltrükk kapaplaadil. Sini-valgel pilvedega taeva taustal kivikuulil seisev ettepoole kummarduv tüdruk. Seljas valge võrestikuga alusseelik, peas must tanu, käes valged kindad, jalas mustad sukksaapad. Käes hoiab gladioole ja musta kotti. Vaatab vaataja poole. Seisab pildi paremas servas ja kummardub vasakule.
works.de: Colour digital print on foam board. Against a blue-white sky with clouds, a girl standing on a stone sphere, leaning forward. Wearing a white lattice underskirt, a black bonnet on her head, white gloves on her hands, black stocking boots on her feet. She holds gladioli and a black bag in her hands. Looking towards the viewer. She stands at the right edge of the picture and leans to the left.

works.d: Töö vasakpoolsemas pooles  sõuab vees  alasti kiilas naine. Foto trükitud punases toonis. Töö parempoolsemas pooles on näha metalllist eset tumedal taustal.
works.de: In the left half of the work a naked bald woman rows in the water. The photo is printed in a red tone. In the right half of the work a metal object is visible against a dark background.

works.d: Fotol näha blondide juustega kahte poolalasti naist, kes hargnevad ühest kehast. Ühe naise pea on madalamal, kui teise oma. Naiste näod on vastakuti. Foto on mustvalge.
works.de: The photo shows two half-naked blonde-haired women branching from one body. One woman's head is lower than the other's. The women's faces are turned towards each other. The photo is black and white.

works.d: Fotol on kaks samasugust naist. Mõlemad on otsevaates.Vasakpoolsem naine hoiab mõlema käega näost kinni. Temast paremal pool  hoiab naine  ühe käega põsest kinni.
works.de: In the photograph there are two identical women. Both are shown frontally. The woman on the left holds her face with both hands. To her right a woman holds her cheek with one hand.

works.d: Peategija on eakas naine. Ta siseneb majja, jätab oma riided esimesse tuppa ja alustab trepist üles minema. Tema möödu lähevad inimesed. Trepi üleval on tuba, kus asub pjedestaal, mille peale naine astub.
works.de: The main character is an elderly woman. She enters the house, leaves her clothes in the first room and starts going up the stairs. People pass by her. At the top of the stairs is a room with a pedestal, onto which the woman steps.

works.d: Noor naine peseb oma nägu roosast värvist roosas vannitoas. Sündmused on näidanud tagasikäigus. Video lõpus naerab noor naine roosa värviga näol roosa seina vastas.
works.de: A young woman washes her face with pink paint in a pink bathroom. The events are shown in reverse. At the end of the video the young woman laughs with a pink-painted face against a pink wall.

works.d: Kaadris on valge sein, mille vastas seisab ja jookseb naine mustas kleidis (ise kunstnik). Video keskel tuleb veel kuus samasugust naist. Kõik naised lähevad ära video lõpus.

works.d: Keskel abstraheeritud inimsiluett, mida moodustavad mõtliku ilmega inimpeade motiivid (Leonard da Vinci). Silueti mõlemal küljel, tiibade sarnaste kujutise taustal, mitmesugused mehhanismide, (inseneri)konstruktsioonide ja sildade skeemid, nende seas aga Ikarost meenutav kuju. Taust jaguneb pruuniks ja mustaks alaks, mille vahel lainelised oranž ja roosa riba. Tausal sputnik, rakett, langevari, Kuu jm, suure siluetiga punktiirjoonega ühendatuna. Ülal paremal figuur varauusagselt puulõikelt: teadlane universumi "sfäärist" läbi tungimas
works.de: In the centre, an abstracted human silhouette formed by motifs of pensive human heads (Leonardo da Vinci). On both sides of the silhouette, against a background resembling wings, various schemes of mechanisms, (engineering) constructions and bridges, among them a figure reminiscent of Icarus. The background is divided into brown and black areas, between which run wavy orange and pink stripes. In the background a sputnik, a rocket, a parachute, the Moon etc., connected to the large silhouette by a dotted line. Upper right, a figure from an early modern woodcut: a scholar penetrating through the "sphere" of the universe

works.d: Helgi Hirve „Tartu motiiv“ on oma aja kontekstis üpris märkimisväärne: erinevalt 1950. aastate Nõukogude Eesti ametlikus kunstis soositud sotsialistliku riigi ja ühiskonna ülesehitamisele keskendunud maastikukäsitlustest, esitab see teos Tartu linnavaadet, kus on esil subjektiivne ja poeetiline vaatepunkt ning nõukogude aja märgid pigem tõrjutud. Arendades nõukogude kunstikäsitluses taunitud sügavtrükitehnikat, täiendab see leht hästi Eesti Kunstimuuseumis olevat Helgi Hirve nimetatud tehnikas valminud lüürilist vaategraafikat.
works.de: Helgi Hirv's „Tartu motiiv“ is quite notable in the context of its time: unlike the landscape treatments favoured in the official art of Soviet Estonia in the 1950s, which focused on the building of the socialist state and society, this work presents a view of the town of Tartu with a subjective and poetic viewpoint, in which the signs of the Soviet era are rather suppressed. Developing the intaglio print technique, which was disapproved of in Soviet art conception, this sheet complements well the lyrical view-graphics by Helgi Hirv in this technique held in the Art Museum of Estonia.

works.d: Vello Vinna teosed on tähelepanuväärne näide 1960. aastate lõpus – 1970. aastate alguses esile tõusnud eesti graafikutepõlvkonna loomingust, kus erijooneks on terviklik ja rõhutatult isikupärane kujutav süsteem. Vello Vinna 1970.–1980. aastate ofordid, fotosöövitused ja kollaažid, mis annavad tunnustuse tema sümmeetrial, kujundi- ja sõnamängudel põhineva süsteemi kujunemisest ja arenemisest, on Eesti Kunstimuuseumi graafikakogu oluliseks täienduseks.
works.de: Vello Vinna's works are a remarkable example of the creative output of the generation of Estonian graphic artists that emerged in the late 1960s – early 1970s, whose distinguishing feature is a coherent and emphatically individual pictorial system. Vello Vinna's etchings, photo-etchings and collages from the 1970s–1980s, which give recognition to the formation and development of his system based on symmetry and play on images and words, are an important addition to the Art Museum of Estonia's graphic art collection.

works.d: Vello Vinna (s. 1939) teosed on tähelepanuväärne näide 1960. aastate lõpus – 1970. aastate alguses esile tõusnud eesti graafikutepõlvkonna loomingust, kus erijooneks on terviklik ja rõhutatult isikupärane kujutav süsteem. Eesti Kunstimuuseumi kogudes on Vello Vinna 1970. aastate looming – kunstniku üks kõrgperioode – esindatud väga hästi oforditehnikas valminud töödega, mille fantaasiarohked kompositsioonid on autori poolt äärmiselt detailselt läbi joonistatud. Sama perioodi Vinna söövitused eristuvad julge sürrealistliku fotokollaaži kasutuse poolest. works.de: The works of Vello Vinna (b. 1939) are a remarkable example of the creative output of the generation of Estonian graphic artists who rose to prominence in the late 1960s – early 1970s, whose distinguishing feature is a coherent and markedly individual pictorial system. In the collections of the Art Museum of Estonia, Vello Vinna's work of the 1970s – one of the artist's peak periods – is very well represented by works made in the etching technique, whose fantasy-rich compositions are drawn out by the author in extreme detail. Vinna's etchings from the same period stand out for their bold use of surrealist photo collage. works.d: Tegemist on eesti 1970. aastate graafika ühe tähelepanuväärseima ja omanäolisima autori loomingu tugeva näitega, mis täiendab hästi Marju Mutsu kollektsiooni Eesti Kunstimuuseumikogudes. Nagu ka ofordid „Mets“, „Suvi“, „Suvi on punane“, „Kaev“ jt, esindab kõnealune kompositsioon 1970. aastate Mutsu graafikale omast käsitlust, kus loodusnähtusi ja aastaaegu esitatakse inimkujundeid ja loodusmotiive ühendava allegooriana.
works.de: This is a strong example of the work of one of the most notable and distinctive Estonian printmakers of the 1970s, which is a good addition to Marju Mutsu's collection in the collections of the Art Museum of Estonia. Like the etchings "Mets" [Forest], "Suvi" [Summer], "Suvi on punane" [Summer is Red], "Kaev" [Well] and others, the composition in question represents an approach typical of Mutsu's graphic art of the 1970s, in which natural phenomena and seasons are presented as an allegory combining human figures and nature motifs.

works.d:
Antropoloogiline dokumentaalfilm "Rock´n´rolli lapsed" 
Rezhisöör: Jasper Zoova 
Käsikiri ja maanteenäituse "Kiirus II" kuraator: Siram (Sobu) 
Operaatorid: Õnne Luha ja Mailis Toompuu 
Muusika: Tarvi Laamannn 
Rezhisööri assistent: Taave Tuutma 
Road-movie dokumenteerib bussireisi, mille sooritasid grupp noori kunstnikke kahe päeva jooksul mööda Eestit. Peamiseks dokumenteerimisobjektiks on meeleolu, mida mõjutasid väga paljud tegurid alates tarbitud õllest kuni ülemaailmse majanduskriisini. Meeleolu on edasi antud läbi kunstiliste vahendite ja vihjete enne meid olemasolevatele visuaalkultuuriproduktidele. Muuhulgas näeb reisiseltskond oma teekonnal ka maanteenäituse "Kiirus II" teoseid.
works.de:
Anthropological documentary film "Children of Rock'n'Roll"
Director: Jasper Zoova
Script and curator of the road exhibition "Speed II": Siram (Sobu)
Camera operators: Õnne Luha and Mailis Toompuu
Music: Tarvi Laamannn
Director's assistant: Taave Tuutma
The road movie documents a bus trip made by a group of young artists over two days across Estonia. The main object of documentation is the mood, which was influenced by very many factors ranging from the beer consumed to the global economic crisis. The mood is conveyed through artistic means and allusions to visual culture products that existed before us. Among other things, the travelling company also sees along their journey the works of the road exhibition "Speed II".

works.d: Lõunamaise loodusmaastiku taustal neli erinevates asendites okaapit, esiplaanil vasakul seisev okaapi otsevaates, pea pööratud kõrval oleva, tagakehaga vaataja poole seisva okaapi suunas, veidi eemal seisev okaapi poolprofiilis paremale, pea tagakehaga vaataja  poole oleva, maas lamava, okaapi suunas.
works.de: Against the background of a southern natural landscape four okapis in different poses, in the foreground on the left a standing okapi in frontal view, its head turned toward a nearby okapi standing with its hind body toward the viewer, a little further away a standing okapi in half-profile to the right, its head toward another okapi lying on the ground with its hind body toward the viewer.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 60.0 cm; graafikaplaadi laius: 30.0 cm; graafikaplaadi kõrgus: 38.2 cm; lehe laius: 50.8 cm
works.d: Lehe vasakust nurgast välja kasvav kaameli pea poolprofiilis paremale, kaameli silmi kaitsmas pikad ripsmed, kõrvasid tihe karvastik, avatud suust näha alumine hammasterida, ülejäänud plaadipind jäetud tühjaks.
works.de: A camel's head growing out of the left corner of the sheet, in half-profile facing right, the camel's eyes protected by long eyelashes, dense fur on the ears, the lower row of teeth visible through the open mouth, the rest of the plate surface left empty.

works.d: Kristjan Tederi portree on Richard Kaljo graafikaloomingus mõnevõrra erandlik teos. Erinedes oma kuivavõitu maneeriga autorile omasest vahetust ja mahlakast karakterikäsitlusest, peegeldab see kunstniku mõnevõrra kohmetut katset kohaneda sotsrealismi pealesurutud kujutamisviisiga. Maalijat Kristjan Tederit mõni aasta enne ENSV Kunstnike Liidust välja heitmist kujutav portree pakub huvi ka kultuuriloolisest vaatepunktist.
works.de: The portrait of Kristjan Teder is a somewhat exceptional work in Richard Kaljo's graphic oeuvre. Differing from the direct and vivid treatment of character typical of the author's rather dry manner, it reflects the artist's somewhat awkward attempt to adapt to the imposed depiction methods of socialist realism. The portrait, depicting the painter Kristjan Teder a few years before his expulsion from the Estonian SSR Artists' Union, is also of interest from a cultural-historical viewpoint.

works.d: interjööris ees vasakul molberti ees istuva mehe kolmveerandfiguur, süles palett, vasakus peos pintslid. Keskelt paremale kolm naisakti poodiumil: vasakpoolne tantsimas, parem jalg ette üles, kõrgele tõstetud, paremas käes ees all lehvik. Keskmine seismas, käed puusadel. Parempoolsel peas rätik, jalad sokid ja viisud. Naiste peade kohal looklev pael kirjaga: FORMALISM REALISM NATURALISM
works.de: In an interior, in front on the left, a three-quarter figure of a man sitting in front of an easel, a palette in his lap, brushes in his left fist. From the middle to the right, three female nudes on a podium: the one on the left dancing, right leg raised forward and lifted high, in her right hand in front, below, a fan. The middle one standing, hands on hips. The one on the right has a headscarf on her head, feet in socks and bast shoes. Above the women's heads a winding ribbon with the inscription: FORMALISM REALISM NATURALISM

works.d:
Dokumentaalsetel jutustustel põhinev lugu inimestest, kes olid sunnitud 70 aasta eest põgenikena Eestist lahkuma ja neist inimestest, kes alles hiljuti on põgenikena Eestisse saabunud. Paguluses pika elu elanud eestalased jagavad mälestusi neid vastu võtnud maa külalislahkusest. Venemaa piirist 1,8 km kaugusel, hüljatud küla läheduses asuvas Eesti ainsas varjupaigataotlejate vastuvõtukeskuses pikki kuid asüüliotsust ootavad inimesed räägivad oma läbielamistest.  

Teos on filmitud 2013. aastal Stockholmis ja Eestis Illuka vallas Jaama küla lähistel
works.de:
A story based on documentary narratives about people who were forced to leave Estonia as refugees 70 years ago, and about those people who have only recently arrived in Estonia as refugees. Estonians who have lived long lives in exile share memories of the hospitality of the country that received them. At Estonia's only reception centre for asylum seekers, located 1.8 km from the Russian border near an abandoned village, people who have been awaiting an asylum decision for many months tell of their experiences.

The work was filmed in 2013 in Stockholm and in Estonia near the village of Jaama in Illuka Parish.

works.dm: aeg/ kestus: 25.0 sekund; aeg/ kestus: 44.0 minut
works.d:
Kai Kaljo video on tema kunstnikust isa Richard Kaljo kirjadest talle ja tema emale Mia Kaljole.
Kirjad avavad kunstniku värvikat olemust, tema suhteid lähedastega ja kiindumust Tartusse, kus möödus tema noorusaeg. 
Kalligraafiliselt nauditavaid kirju loeb Peeter Volkonski.
works.de:
Kai Kaljo's video is based on the letters of her artist father Richard Kaljo to her and her mother Mia Kaljo.
The letters reveal the artist's colourful character, his relationships with those close to him and his attachment to Tartu, where his youth was spent.
The calligraphically enjoyable letters are read by Peeter Volkonski.

works.dm: kujutise kõrgus: 23.0 cm; laius: 51.0 cm; kõrgus: 46.6 cm; kujutise laius: 29.0 cm
works.d:
Toomas Kalve on Tartu Kõrgema Kunstikooli õppejõud ja rahvusvaheliselt tuntud fotokunstnik, kes pildistab alates 1987. aastast erinevatele klaasplaatidele ja filmidele, kasutades puust plaatkaameraid. Ta jäädvustab must-valgelt natüürmorte, maastikke, interjööre, linde ja modelle.  Must-valged kontaktkoopiad toonib Kalve pruuniks. 
Antud juhul on tegemist pildiseeriaga tema natüürmortidest.  Natüürmortide lavastamiseks eelistab ta kasutada vanu asju, ehk nagu kunstnik on ise öelnud, asju, millel on mingi oma stabiliseerunud energia. Vanadele fotodele omase väljanägemise annab tehnika.
works.de:
Toomas Kalve is a lecturer at the Tartu Art College and an internationally known photographic artist who, since 1987, has been photographing onto various glass plates and films, using wooden plate cameras. He captures still lifes, landscapes, interiors, birds and models in black and white. Kalve tones the black-and-white contact prints brown.
In this case it is a series of images of his still lifes. To stage his still lifes he prefers to use old objects, or, as the artist himself has said, objects that have a certain stabilised energy of their own. The technique gives them the appearance characteristic of old photographs.

works.d: Näide Malev Toomi isikupärasest portreteerimisoskusest. Pildil on  juudi päritolu Eesti semiootik, kirjandusteadlane ja kulturoloog, üks Tartu-Moskva semiootikakoolkonna rajajaist ning kauaaegne Tartu Ülikooli professor Juri Lotman, keda sel hetkel filmitakse telesaate jaoks.
works.de: An example of Malev Toom's distinctive portraiture skill. The picture shows the Estonian semiotician of Jewish descent, literary scholar and culturologist, one of the founders of the Tartu-Moscow school of semiotics and long-time professor at the University of Tartu, Juri Lotman, who is being filmed at that moment for a television programme.

works.d: Eesti fotokunsti klassiku Herkki-Erich Merila ja filmirežissööri Arbo Tammiksaare koostööst sündinud vaimukas portreedesari. Tartu Kunstimuuseumi Eesti kaasaegse fotokunsti näitusel oli see liigitatud rubriiki „Foto kui agent“. Kujutatud on  oma ajastu reaalseid inimesi ja objekte, mis kokkupanduna mõjuvad siiski millegi ebareaalsena.
works.de: A witty portrait series born from the collaboration of Herkki-Erich Merila, a classic of Estonian photographic art, and film director Arbo Tammiksaar. At the Tartu Art Museum's exhibition of Estonian contemporary photographic art, this was classified under the rubric „Foto kui agent“ ["Photo as Agent"]. Depicted are real people and objects of their era, which nevertheless, when put together, appear as something unreal.

works.d: Seeria on sündinud kahe kunstniku omavahelisest dialoogist, mida autorid pidasid teineteisele fotosd saates. Anu Vahtra töövahendiks on fotoaparaat, Na Kimil skanner. Tervik moodustub mitme foto kõrvuti asetamisel, seeriasse kuulub 16 fotot.
works.de: The series was born out of a dialogue between the two artists, which the authors conducted by sending each other photographs. Anu Vahtra's tool was a camera, Na Kim's a scanner. The whole is formed by placing several photographs side by side; the series consists of 16 photographs.

works.d: Laura Põld on tuntust kogunud poeetiliste ruumiinstallatsioonidega. Need sisaldavad maale, videoid, keraamilisi esemeid, loodusobjekte. Ise on ta öelnud: «See on kollektsioon paikadest, ruumikogemustest, värvidest, materjalidest ja valgusest stuudio seinal, mida küll olen püüdnud kaardistada, aga mille tegelik olemasolu muutub iga päeva järel ebatõenäolisemaks,». Antud töö on osa tema seni suurimast väljapanekust, see leidis aset 2016. aastal Tartu Kunstimuuseumis. Näitus kandis pealkirja „Sada ulma keset merd“
works.de: Laura Põld has gained recognition for her poetic spatial installations. These include paintings, videos, ceramic objects, natural objects. She has said of herself: «It is a collection of places, spatial experiences, colours, materials and light on the studio wall, which I have indeed tried to map, but whose actual existence becomes more improbable with each passing day.» This work is part of her largest exhibition to date, which took place in 2016 at the Tartu Art Museum. The exhibition was titled "A Hundred Dreams in the Middle of the Sea"

works.d: Teos Tartu Kunstimuuseumis  toimunud näituselt „M-i märg unenägu“. Kunstnik jätkab talle juba varasemast omast teemat soorollide ja nendega seotud mentaliteetide ümber. Julgete ja otsekoheste avaldustega autor on tähelepanuväärne meie kultuurikontekstis.
works.de: Work from the exhibition "M's Wet Dream" held at the Tartu Art Museum. The artist continues a theme already familiar from his earlier work, revolving around gender roles and the mentalities associated with them. With bold and forthright statements, the author is remarkable in our cultural context.
