works.t: III vihik illustratsioonide mapist F.Tuglase "Väikesele Illimarile"
works.dm: lehe laius: 21.0 cm; lehe kõrgus: 30.0 cm
works.d: Teos kuulub Märt Laarmani poolt korrastatud visandite mappi (6 vihikut). Joonistused ja gravüürid on eeltööd Fr. Tuglase "Väikesele Illimarile." Vihikus on 50 erinevat kavandit, millest Muisi üles laetud 5 foto. Kavanditel ja proovitõmmistel on kujutatud kukk 3, vares 2, magav laps 8, õunapuu 4, lõnga haspeldav naine 8, konn 2, vihm 7, maskid 4, kahe korstnaga hoone 4, kaks istuvat figuuri 2, saunas 3, talvetee 2, kuuseoks küünaldega 4 korda.
works.de: The work belongs to a folder of sketches (6 notebooks) arranged by Märt Laarman. The drawings and engravings are preliminary works for Fr. Tuglas's "Väike Illimar" ("Little Illimar"). The notebook contains 50 different designs, of which 5 photographs have been uploaded to Muis. The designs and proof prints depict a rooster 3 times, a crow 2 times, a sleeping child 8 times, an apple tree 4 times, a woman winding yarn 8 times, a frog 2 times, rain 7 times, masks 4 times, a building with two chimneys 4 times, two seated figures 2 times, in a sauna 3 times, a winter road 2 times, a spruce branch with candles 4 times.

works.dm: lehe laius: 21.0 cm; lehe kõrgus: 30.0 cm
works.d: Teos kuulub Märt Laarmanni poolt korrastatud visandite mappi (6 vihikut). Joonistused ja gravüürid on eeltööd Fr. Tuglase "Väikesele Illimarile." Ühes vihikus on 50 erinevat kavandit, neist Muisi üles laetud 5 fotot. Kujutatud on: rähn - 2, puiestee - 3, peegel - 7, koerad 5, mõisahoone - 2, mees piibuga 4, mäger - 10, naine lapsega - 6.
works.de: The work belongs to a folder of sketches (6 notebooks) arranged by Märt Laarmann. The drawings and engravings are preparatory works for Fr. Tuglas's "Väikesele Illimarile." One notebook contains 50 different designs, of which 5 photographs have been uploaded to Muis. Depicted are: woodpecker - 2, avenue - 3, mirror - 7, dogs - 5, manor house - 2, man with a pipe - 4, badger - 10, woman with a child - 6.

In the lower half of the sheet a fence of horizontal boards, behind it deciduous trees. Further back a stone wall, behind it trees, between which two gable roofs and a tall church tower are visible.
In the upper half of the sheet, in the foreground a bare landscape, in the distance the roofs of low farmhouses closely grouped together.

works.d: Kõrgelt nähtud fragment teemaja interjöörist kolme laudkonnaga. Esiplaanil olevast laudkonnast koorib vasakpoolne mees kartulit, keskmine hoiab pudelit käes ja parempoolne joob alustassilt teed. Taga vasakul - eit ja habemik vanamees samovari taga, taga paremal kaks meest, kellest üks kallab klaasi viina. Ülal keskel aken, millel kiri: ЧАЙ. Dekoratiivsete elementidena ära kasutatud ka firmamärgid metallis (all keskel 1 II 14 Н.ЖАРОВЪ С.П.Б. ja ülal keskel ВАГНЕРЪ И СЫНОВЪЯ НОССЕНЪ)
works.de: A fragment of a teahouse interior with three tables, seen from above. At the table in the foreground, the man on the left is peeling a potato, the middle one is holding a bottle, and the one on the right is drinking tea from a saucer. In the back on the left – an old woman and a bearded old man behind a samovar, in the back on the right two men, one of whom is pouring a glass of vodka. At the top centre a window with the inscription: ЧАЙ. Company trademarks in metal have also been used as decorative elements (bottom centre 1 II 14 Н.ЖАРОВЪ С.П.Б. and top centre ВАГНЕРЪ И СЫНОВЬЯ НОССЕНЪ)

works.d:
I Keskel, ristkülikus avaral suvemaastikulkask, kuguses vasakul üksik kask, taamal paremal metsaviirg. 
II Vasakul stiliseeritud ornamendiga püstises ristkülikus maastik teerajaga, mille ääres paremal puu. Taama lmetsaviirg. Keskel stiliseeritud joonornament, all kiri: EXLIBRIS
III Paremal püstises ristkülikus suvine heinamaa üksiku puuga, mille ees roigasaed. Ülal kiri: EX LIBRIS All paremal nurgas kiri: HANS WAIN
works.de:
I In the centre, within a rectangle, a spacious summer landscape with a birch, in the distance on the left a solitary birch, further off on the right a strip of forest.
II On the left, in an upright rectangle with a stylised ornament, a landscape with a path, beside which on the right a tree. Further off a strip of forest. In the centre a stylised line ornament, below text: EXLIBRIS
III On the right, in an upright rectangle, a summer meadow with a solitary tree, in front of it a pole fence. Above text: EX LIBRIS. In the lower right corner text: HANS WAIN

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 12.1 cm; lehe laius: 23.3 cm
works.d:
I Vasakul talvemaastik, esiplaanil veekogu, mille kaldal puu, taamal metsaviirg tõusva kuu või päikese poolkeraga.
II Keskel, püstises ristkülikukujulises raamis talvemaastikul, vasakul jõgi mille kaldal raagus puu. Taamal vasakul põõsas, kauguses tõsusva kuu/päikese poolkera. 
III Paremal esiplaanil veekogu, kaldad lumised. Kuaguses tõusva kuu/päikese poolkera. 
IV Paremal äärel üksik puu, mis hargneb u-kujuliseks.
works.de:
I On the left a winter landscape, in the foreground a body of water, on the bank of which a tree, further off a strip of forest with the semicircle of a rising moon or sun.
II In the centre, in an upright rectangular frame, a winter landscape, on the left a river on the bank of which a bare tree. Further off on the left a bush, in the distance the semicircle of a rising moon/sun.
III On the right in the foreground a body of water, snowy banks. In the distance the semicircle of a rising moon/sun.
IV At the right edge a single tree, branching into a U-shape.

works.d:
otsavaade neljakorruselisele majale, mille igal korrusel kolm pidulike kardinate või kaunistustega akent. Igas aknas oma süžee, stseen:
1. alumisel korrusel, vasakult paremale: kaunistustega kapp; avatud uks, mille külgedel suured liblikatiivad ning avas lendlev liblikas; vaade viilkatusega paviljoni sisse.
2. teisel korrusel: heledate kardinate vahel säramas taevatähed; vaade klaasustega saali, kus laeg ehispärg; kingipakiga lauake ruutudega akna ees, millest avanemas vaade metsale. 
3. kolmandal korrusel: paelte ja lehvidega seotud kingipakk; nelja ruuduga aken; jääsolev aken.
4. neljandal korrusel: kaheteistkümne ruuduga aken, millest paistmas murul ehituse alumine osa; valge linaga kaetu
works.de:
an end view of a four-storey building, on each floor of which are three festively curtained or decorated windows. In each window its own subject, scene:
1. on the ground floor, from left to right: a decorated cabinet; an open door, on the sides of which large butterfly wings and a fluttering butterfly in the opening; a view into a pavilion with a gabled roof.
2. on the second floor: stars of the sky shining between light curtains; a view into a glazed hall, where a chest with a decorative wreath; a small table with a gift package in front of a window with panes, from which a view opens onto a forest.
3. on the third floor: a gift package tied with ribbons and bows; a window with four panes; a frosted window.
4. on the fourth floor: a window with twelve panes, through which the lower part of a building on the lawn is visible; something covered with a white sheet

works.d:
otsevaade neljakorruselisele kivimajale: all, keskel kahepoolne, ülaosast kaarjas uks-värav, mille vasak pool avatud ning millest avanemas vaade heledale, looklevale teerajale läbi kangialuste. Ukse paremal poolel kirjakasti ava juures lendlev lind. 
Teisel korrusel kolm suletud luukidega akent, luugid veidi praokil.
Kolmandal korrusel kolm luukidega, mis raudlattidega suletud, akent. Neljandal korrusel kolm aknaava
works.de:
a direct view of a four-storey stone house: below, in the centre a two-leaved door-gate with an arched top, its left leaf open, revealing a view of a light, winding path through the gateways. On the right leaf of the door, by the mail slot, a flying bird.
On the second floor three windows with closed shutters, the shutters slightly ajar.
On the third floor three windows with shutters closed with iron bars. On the fourth floor three window openings

works.de:
In the foreground a woman playing the piano on a high-backed chair, behind her on the left a child on a similar smaller chair, also turned half toward the right. Torni all rühm muistseid sõjamehi piikidega torni kõigutamas. Paremal, tagapool, murdunud tornidel tekst: ühel tornil TALLINN ja teisel tornil: VÕRU. Vasakul, tagaplaanil, tervel tornil istub raudrüüs, kilbiga mees ja tornil tekst: TARTU.
works.de: In a moraine landscape, three broken round towers scattered about, and on the left, in the background, one intact round tower. In the foreground, on a collapsing round tower, sits a man in black armour, with the text PÄRNU on the tower. Below the tower a group of ancient warriors with spears is shaking the tower. On the right, further back, on the broken towers is text: on one tower TALLINN and on the other: VÕRU. On the left, in the background, on the intact tower sits a man in armour with a shield, and on the tower the text: TARTU.

Kristus - rõõm

Christ - joy
Joy is the highest thing in the world
Love every ray of the sun. To me, love is joy and love is joy - Love everything in the world

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 61.3 cm; lehe laius: 43.0 cm; kujutise laius: 19.5 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 33.0 cm
works.d:
Kübaraga, lehvivate juuste ja kleidiga naine mererannal. Juures tekst:
Variatsioon XLI Aili Vindist. Taamal olev salapäraselt romantiline meri on tegelikult hoopiski jõgi ning ei oma seetõttu Ailiga mingit seost.
works.de:
A woman with a hat, flowing hair and dress, on a seashore. Accompanying text:
Variation XLI on Aili Vindi. The mysteriously romantic sea in the background is in fact a river and thus has nothing to do with Aili.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 61.5 cm; lehe laius: 43.1 cm; kujutise laius: 27.5 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 29.0 cm
works.d:
Mõtisklev mees teekannuga. Kujutise all tekst:
Teema "Kunstnik ja modell" on ilmselt oma erilise intiimsuse tõttu leidnud eesti kunstis vähe kasutamist. Nüüd lisandub sellesse nappi galeriisse siiski üks joonis, millel on jäädvustatud sugestiivse esemelikkuse meistermaailja Olev Maran.
works.de:
A pensive man with a teapot. Below the image, the text:
The theme "The Artist and the Model", presumably due to its particular intimacy, has found little use in Estonian art. Now this sparse gallery is joined by yet another drawing, capturing the master of suggestive materiality, Olev Maran.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 61.3 cm; lehe laius: 42.5 cm; kujutise laius: 20.5 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 24.5 cm
works.d:
Naise pea ja parem käsi, peol kaks mehebüsti. Kujutise all tekst:
Mare Mikofi meistrikäe ja mehi mõistva pilgu vahendusel saavad tulevasedki põlved näha, millised toredad ja armsad poisid elasid XX saj. lõpukümnendite Eestis.
works.de:
A woman's head and right hand, with two male busts in her palm. Below the image, text:
Mare Mikofi meistrikäe ja mehi mõistva pilgu vahendusel saavad tulevasedki põlved näha, millised toredad ja armsad poisid elasid XX saj. lõpukümnendite Eestis.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 61.4 cm; lehe laius: 39.4 cm; kujutise laius: 20.8 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 32.0 cm
works.d:
Musta riietatud kübaraga mees istuva blondiini taga. Kujutise all tekst:
Deemonlikke võtteid kasutav Mati Unt korraldas Kalamajas kuuvarjutuse ühe naisterahva hingeelu valgustamiseks. Undi ütlust mööda teeb ta sellist tööd "lihtsalt elades". Tuleks aga ikkagi kontrollida, mis elamine see selline on.
works.de:
A man dressed in black with a hat behind a seated blonde woman. Text below the image:
Using demonic methods, Mati Unt staged a lunar eclipse in Kalamaja to illuminate the inner life of a certain woman. According to Unt, he does such work "simply by living". However, it should be checked what kind of living that is.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 61.3 cm; lehe laius: 43.0 cm; kujutise laius: 20.0 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 33.0 cm
works.d:
Naine kaksiratsa maja katusel, mida veab käruga vana naine, taustal puud, siga ja päike. Kujutise all tekst:
Seitsmenda rahukevade tulekut ootav Viivi Luik teadis kindlalt, et õppides ja töötades vaid rahva heaks ikka, võib ta neljakümne esimesse rahukevadisse jõudnuna süüa suhkrut niipalju kui iganes soovib.
works.de:
A woman astride the roof of a house, drawn on a cart by an old woman, in the background trees, a pig and the sun. Below the image the text:
Awaiting the coming of the seventh spring of peace, Viivi Luik knew for certain that, by studying and working only for the good of the people, having reached her forty-first spring of peace, she could eat as much sugar as she ever wished.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 61.4 cm; lehe laius: 42.3 cm; kujutise laius: 19.0 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 32.6 cm
works.d:
Kirjulipsuline kaabuga mees ja kübaraga daam koos veiniklaasiga. All tekst:
Et Heino Mandri on teatrikuradile kolm tilka verd andnud, selles kahtlustati teda juba ammu, kuid alles siinsel joonistusel leiab see sündmus ka dokumentaalse kinnituse.
works.de:
A man with a coloured tie and a hat, and a lady with a hat, with a glass of wine. Below the text:
That Heino Mandri has given three drops of blood to the demon of theatre has long been suspected, but only in this drawing does the event find documentary confirmation.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 61.5 cm; lehe laius: 43.0 cm; kujutise laius: 18.1 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 28.1 cm
works.d:
Tumedapäine vuntside ja habemega mees vikatit teritamas. Kujutise all tekst:
Paul-Eerik Rummo on sügisel maale elama takerdunud, luiskab halastamatus deestetiseerimise ihas ajaviiteks vikatit, aistib loodust ja igasuguseid dekoratiivseid vidinaid kõrvale heites targutab oma elust.
works.de:
A dark-haired man with a moustache and beard sharpening a scythe. Below the depiction, text:
Paul-Eerik Rummo has got stuck living in the countryside in autumn, in a merciless urge for de-aestheticisation whittles a scythe to pass the time, senses nature and, casting aside all sorts of decorative gadgets, philosophises about his life.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 61.6 cm; lehe laius: 43.0 cm; kujutise laius: 20.0 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 30.0 cm
works.d:
Prillidega mehe pea, tema ees kübaraga naisakt, vintpüss kaenlas. Kujutise all tekst:
Tundmatu kunstniku seniavaldamata rindejoonis Evald Okasest. Näeme meistrit porisel põlluteel, põlenud "Tiigri" lähedal, täis temale omast avali huvi ümbritseva elu vastu.
works.de:
The head of a man with glasses, in front of him a nude woman with a hat, a rifle under his arm. Below the image text:
A hitherto unpublished front-line drawing of Evald Okas by an unknown artist. We see the master on a muddy field road, near the burnt-out "Tiger", full of his characteristic frank interest in the life around him.

works.dm: lehe laius: 39.5 cm; kujutise laius: 23.2 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 34.1 cm; lehe kõrgus: 61.1 cm
works.d:
Kükitav prillidega pikajuukseline alasti mees koos sirbiga. Kõrval seisev naisfiguur haamriga. Kujutise all tekst:
Aina rõõmsamaks läheb meel Tõnis Vindi mõttemängulisest vabadusest. Litograafias "Hommikune hingus. Kahekesi sambaga." on ta oma süsteemi piiridesse jäädes leidnud uusi inspiratsiooniallikaid - seekord meie rahulikust ja loovast tööst.
works.de:
A crouching long-haired nude man wearing glasses, with a sickle. Beside him a standing female figure with a hammer. Below the image, text:
Aina rõõmsamaks läheb meel Tõnis Vindi mõttemängulisest vabadusest. Litograafias "Hommikune hingus. Kahekesi sambaga." on ta oma süsteemi piiridesse jäädes leidnud uusi inspiratsiooniallikaid - seekord meie rahulikust ja loovast tööst.

works.dm: lehe laius: 39.4 cm; kujutise laius: 20.3 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 37.4 cm; lehe kõrgus: 61.0 cm
works.d:
Prillidega mehe pea, paremal kaks rahvarõivaid laulvat naist. Kujutise all tekst:
Jaan Eilart. Koidu-Hämariku lõkkehõngutuste suvejalgsetes tantsutuurides väsimatu valgusse vaatajana talletanud ajukurdude sadeviirgu kogu meie looduse vilukõheduse vaimuhõõge.
works.de:
The head of a man with glasses, on the right two women in folk costume singing. Below the image the text:
Jaan Eilart. In the summer walking tours of dawn-and-dusk bonfire fragrances, an untiring witness to the light has stored in the folds of the brain the sparkling trail of the spiritual glow of the coolness of our whole nature.

works.dm: lehe laius: 39.2 cm; kujutise laius: 19.0 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 33.0 cm; lehe kõrgus: 61.0 cm
works.d:
Poolpaljas mees rististes, taga seisev naine rahvarõivamütsiga ja istuv mees, mõlemad palja ülakehaga. Kujutise all tekst:
Jaan Kaplinski lapsemeelselt rõõmsa pilgu all jäädvustavad eesti kunstnikud morsakihvadele meie kaduva ja ohustatud värvilise maailma ilu.
works.de:
A half-naked man on skis, behind him a standing woman with a folk-costume cap and a seated man, both bare-chested. Below the image the text:
Under Jaan Kaplinski's childishly joyful gaze, Estonian artists capture on walrus tusks the beauty of our vanishing and endangered coloured world.

works.dm: lehe laius: 61.0 cm; kujutise laius: 19.0 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 35.9 cm; lehe kõrgus: 39.0 cm
works.d:
Ülesvaatav prillidega mees, ülal lendav metssiga. All tekst:
"Vaikselt nagu hommikune koit astub läänemeresoome kultuurimaastikusse Ime." Lennart Meri
works.de:
A man looking upward wearing glasses, above him a flying wild boar. Below, text:
"Quietly, like the morning dawn, the Miracle steps into the Finnic cultural landscape." Lennart Meri

works.dm: lehe laius: 43.0 cm; kujutise laius: 19.0 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 36.0 cm; lehe kõrgus: 61.5 cm
works.d:
Istuv neljakandiliste prillidega mees, süles maja, käes raamat, kõrval inglikujuke. Kujutise all tekst:
Äsja teatas kunstiteadlane V.Raam sensatsioonilisest leiust. Pirita kloostris, kus vallatlevad õpilasmalevlased kangutasid nunnade sulushoomestikus algsest asukohast lahti piscina, mille allküljele oli raiutud eriti haruldane kompositsioon nn. Villem ise esimene, mille fragmenti siin näete.
works.de:
A seated man with square-framed glasses, a house in his lap, a book in his hand, an angel figurine beside him. Below the depiction, text:
Art historian V.Raam has just announced a sensational find. At the Pirita convent, where student work-brigade volunteers, romping about, pried loose the piscina from its original position in the nuns' bricked-up wall niche, on the underside of which was carved an especially rare composition, the so-called Villem ise esimene, a fragment of which you see here.

Naerev habemega mees, pikk ürp seljas ja porgand käes. Kujutise all tekst:
Jüri Arraku õlimaal "Jänku kuldse porgandikesega" on selline kena pilt, millele pilguheit pühadejärgsel hommikul sisendab usku algava aasta õnnestumisse.
works.de:
A laughing bearded man, wearing a long robe and holding a carrot. Below the image the text:
Jüri Arrak's oil painting "Bunny with a Little Golden Carrot" is such a nice picture that a glance at it on the morning after the holidays instils faith in the success of the coming year.

"Kriitika ülesandeks on leida kunstiteostest see mõte, mille olemasolust kunstnikul enesel aimu ei ole." Arvo Valton
works.de:
A man pointing a finger at a little man rummaging through books. Accompanying text:
"The task of criticism is to find in works of art the thought whose existence the artist himself has no inkling of." Arvo Valton

works.d: Hämaras metsas keskel istuv vanamees poolprofiilis paremale. Vanamehel peas lame mütsike, pikad heledad juuksed, habe ja vuntsid kiirtena laiali, põlvedel ussi peaga keelpill, mehe sõrmed pilli keeltel. Vasakul all hundi pea, koon vanamehe poole ja kaks inimese nägu poolprofiilis paremale, üles. Vasakul keskel üksikud silmad pimeduses. Paremal all kahe uluva hundi pead, ükskik silm, ülal kolm kuuske paremale kaldu.
works.de: In a dim forest an old man sitting in the centre, in half-profile to the right. The old man wears a flat little cap, has long light hair, a beard and moustache spread out like rays, on his knees a stringed instrument with a snake's head, the man's fingers on the instrument's strings. Below on the left a wolf's head, muzzle turned toward the old man, and two human faces in half-profile to the right, upward. In the centre left solitary eyes in the darkness. Below on the right the heads of two howling wolves, a single eye, above three spruces leaning to the right.

Vasakul all maapinnal kaks silma, paremal ülal profiilis uluv hunt. Taamal puid
works.de: In a landscape, in the centre, in profile facing left, a young man kneeling on the ground in laced shoes, chest bent forward. A sword with a handle resting on the ground upright and thrust into the young man's chest, left hand stretched behind the back, hair standing up at the nape of the neck. Below left on the ground two eyes, above right a wolf howling in profile. Trees in the distance.

works.de: From both edges of the sheet a thick dark line runs toward the lower right corner. From the top centre a bundle of lighter lines runs downward, reaching about the midline of the sheet. At the height of the middle of the left edge, a short thick dark line and three thin lines run from top to bottom.

works.de: Most of the sheet is filled by a vertical plane running from top to bottom, formed of lighter lines. Lower left a dense surface formed of darker, thicker lines running from top to bottom, at places awkwardly hatched, which partially covers the aforementioned surface and ends abruptly

works.de: On the sheet, on a light quadrangular surface, two branching black vertical lines and an elongated blotch. The rest of the sheet's surface is divided into three. Of these the middle one is the lightest, the side ones somewhat darker. All parts have small blotches resembling paint splatters.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 53.0 cm; lehe laius: 120.0 cm
works.d: Kaks eraldiseisvat pilti. vasakpoolsel kergelt lainelise veepinna all paistmas kalad. Keskel üks heledam ja laiguline ning tume kala, ujuvad paremale. Vasakul avatud suuga hele kala otsevaates, samas osa tumedast kalast.. paremal ülal väikse tumeda kala keha esipool, nina vasakule. Parempoolsel pildil tumedasilmse noore mehe pea ostevaates, veidi paremale pööratud. Näo ees nina ja suud kattev krobeline kivistis.
works.de: Two separate pictures. On the left, under a slightly rippling water surface, fish can be seen. In the middle a lighter, spotted fish and a dark fish, swimming to the right. On the left a light-coloured fish with an open mouth, seen frontally, and alongside it part of the dark fish. On the upper right the front part of the body of a small dark fish, nose to the left. On the right-hand picture, the head of a dark-eyed young man, seen frontally, turned slightly to the right. In front of his face a rough fossil covering the nose and mouth.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 53.0 cm; lehe laius: 120.0 cm
works.d: Kaks eraldi seisvat pilti. Vasakpoolsel noore krokodilli keha profiilis vasakule. Pea ninaosa ja saba jäävad pildist välja.parempoolsel pildil noore naise naeratav nägu otsevaates, veidi vasemale keeratud. Silmad kaetud suurte teokarpidega, kuid vasak silm paistab selle tagant välja. peas poolpilvitu kübar. Kollakas -hallid toonid.
works.de: Two separate pictures. On the left picture, the body of a young crocodile in profile to the left. The tip of the snout and the tail extend beyond the picture. On the right picture, the smiling face of a young woman in frontal view, turned slightly to the left. The eyes are covered by large seashells, but the left eye shows through from behind it. On the head a half-open hat. Yellowish-grey tones.

works.d:
Sõõris ümara habemega mehe portree, paremas käes riidehari. Kujutise all tekst:
Mait Summatavetil oli seitsme kiire töö vahel siiski nii palju aega, et jõudis auraha jaoks oma eesrindliku rinna "Ugala" interjööri tegemise ja ümbertegemise tolmust puhtaks harjata.
works.de:
Portrait of a round-bearded man within a circle, a clothes brush in his right hand. Below the image the text:
Mait Summatavet, amid seven urgent tasks, still found enough time to brush the dust off his progressive chest -- the making and remaking of the "Ugala" interior -- for the prize money.

works.t: Šarž Jüri Arrak ja Rein Raamat
works.dm: lehe laius: 43.0 cm; kujutise laius: 22.0 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 31.5 cm; lehe kõrgus: 61.5 cm
works.d:
Kaks meest hiiglase embuses, juures tekst:
Siin näete ühte õnnelikku perekonda: Jüri Arrakut, Rein Raamatut ja nende ühist pojukest, ligedal ja kaugel kuulsaks saanud Suurt Tõllu.
works.de:
Two men in a giant's embrace, with text:
Here you see one happy family: Jüri Arrak, Rein Raamat and their common little son, Suur Tõll, famous near and far.

works.dm: lehe laius: 43.0 cm; kujutise laius: 22.0 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 31.0 cm; lehe kõrgus: 61.3 cm
works.d:
Palja ülakehaga seisev mees kivil, juures tekst:
Maailja Mudist varjunimelise figuurina kevadisel Parnassil Niket ootamas.
works.de:
A man with a bare torso standing on a rock, with text next to it:
Maailja Mudist, as a pseudonymous figure, waiting for Nike on the spring Parnassus.

works.dm: lehe laius: 43.0 cm; kujutise laius: 22.0 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 32.0 cm; lehe kõrgus: 61.5 cm
works.d:
Prillide, laiaservalise kaabu ja keebiga mees klaverit mängimas, kujutise all tekst:
See klaveril ´La Cumparsitat´ mängiv mees pole Al Capone, vaid Vilen Künnapuu üks pingestuse tekitajaid meie noores arhitektuuris ja vanas arhitektuurielus.
works.de:
A man with glasses, a wide-brimmed hat and a cape playing the piano, text below the image:
This man playing "La Cumparsita" on the piano is not Al Capone, but Vilen Künnapuu, one of the creators of tension in our young architecture and old architectural life.

works.dm: lehe laius: 43.0 cm; kujutise laius: 22.0 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 32.5 cm; lehe kõrgus: 61.5 cm
works.d:
Väike tumedas ülikonnas mehike tugitoolis istuvat mees-kolossi lükkamas. Kujutisel tekst:
Mikk Mikiveri poolt Draamateatri laval pöörlema pandud Eugen Jannseni pöördtool on koos Heino Mandriga pöörelnud nüüd mitmel mandril ja nii kaua, et tekitab kahtlusi pöörlemapanemise seadustest möödahiilimises.
works.de:
A small man in a dark suit pushing a colossal seated man in an armchair. Text on the image:
The swivel chair of Eugen Jannsen, set spinning on the stage of the Drama Theatre by Mikk Mikiver, has now, together with Heino Mandre, spun on several continents and for so long that it raises suspicions of circumventing the laws of setting things in motion.

works.dm: lehe laius: 43.0 cm; kujutise laius: 22.0 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 33.5 cm; lehe kõrgus: 61.5 cm
works.d:
Kikilipsuga mees tütarlapsele sõrmust sõrme panemas, juures tekst:
Eksivad need, kes peavad seda hollywood likku stseeni H. Valgu poolt salakavalalt "Sirpi" sokutatuks uinutamaks toimetuse valvsust. Ei! Joonis on süvateadusliku väärtusega ja sellel näeme meie kuulsaimat naiadoloogi sm. E. Vetemaad rõngastamas näkki "mehelemb-lõõritaja" Endla järve roostikus.
works.de:
A man with a bow tie putting a ring on a girl's finger, with the text:
Those are mistaken who consider this Hollywood-like scene to have been slyly slipped into "Sirp" by H. Valk in order to lull the editorial board's vigilance. No! The drawing has a deeply scientific value and in it we see our most famous naiadologist com. E. Vetemaa ringing a water-sprite, "the courting warbler," in the reeds of Lake Endla.

works.dm: lehe laius: 39.5 cm; kujutise laius: 22.0 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 32.5 cm; lehe kõrgus: 61.5 cm
works.d:
Lainetavate prillidega mees, all päikeseprillidega tütarlaps mõõdulindiga. Kujutise all tekst:
Hiidlaste kunstipreemia ei tulnud Olev Soansile kergelt. Pildil näete teda metsiku stiihia oludes mõõdistustöödel oma premeeritud "Eesti meresõiduajaloo kaardi" tarbeks.
works.de:
A man with wavy glasses, below a girl with sunglasses and a tape measure. Below the image the text:
The Hiiumaa art prize did not come easily to Olev Soans. In the picture you see him doing survey work in wild elemental conditions for his award-winning "Map of Estonian Maritime History".

works.dm: lehe laius: 43.0 cm; kujutise laius: 19.0 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 31.5 cm; lehe kõrgus: 61.3 cm
works.d:
Turris juuste ja habemega mees, raamat kaenla all. Tema taga lamav naisakt. Kujutise all tekst:
Enn Põldroos loodab, et head vaimud kaitsevad teda kriitikute eest, kes tema töis otsib sümboleid või tähendamissõnu nais-inimese kujutamisel. Ei hakka siis ka selle pildi tegija neid Ennu töödes otsima.
works.de:
A man with tousled hair and beard, a book under his arm. Behind him a reclining female nude. Text below the image:
Enn Põldroos hopes that good spirits will protect him from critics who seek symbols or parables in the depiction of the female figure in his works. So the maker of this picture will not go looking for them in Enn's works either.

works.dm: lehe laius: 43.1 cm; kujutise laius: 19.3 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 31.5 cm; lehe kõrgus: 61.4 cm
works.d:
Mehe nägu ja vasakusse kätte pigistatud säärsaabas ja pintslid. Kujutise all tekst:
Jüri Palm. Mees, kes maalikunsti vahenditega uurib linnatsivilisatsiooni ja selle elufragmente tehisvalguse ja vaimupimeduse piiril.
works.de:
A man's face and a Wellington boot and brushes pressed into the left hand. Below the image the text:
Jüri Palm. A man who, by the means of painting, studies urban civilisation and its fragments of life on the border of artificial light and spiritual darkness.

works.dm: lehe laius: 42.8 cm; kujutise laius: 19.0 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 33.7 cm; lehe kõrgus: 61.2 cm
works.d:
Kaabuga mees laua taga, tema taga naisefiguur. Laual gloobus, redised ja jänesekuju ning silt: K.Jermakoffi kasvatatud redised. Kujutise all tekst:
Kalle Jermakoffi kirjutuslaud-muuseumi nooremteadur Mihkel Mutt on liigutatud haruldasest eksponaadist, gloobusest, millega K.J. -le pähe löödi ja mille nüüd muuseumile annetas K.J. -i loomingu rahvusvaheliselt tuntud uurija Lucrezia Wörtzjerv.
works.de:
A man in a hat behind a table, behind him a female figure. On the table a globe, radishes and a rabbit figure and a sign: Radishes grown by K.Jermakoff. Below the depiction, text:
Mihkel Mutt, junior researcher of the Kalle Jermakoff Writing-Desk Museum, is moved by a rare exhibit, a globe with which K.J. was struck on the head, and which was now donated to the museum by Lucrezia Wörtzjerv, an internationally known researcher of K.J.'s oeuvre.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 32.5 cm; lehe laius: 23.7 cm
works.d:
Niidiga kokkuõmmeldud käsitrükis autoriraamat 14 lehega. Lehed kollakast madalakvaliteedilisest paberist. Kaaned akvarelliga marmoreeritud. Kaanel tekst: JAAN VAHTRA 
BLANC ET NOIR
works.de:
Hand-printed author's book sewn together with thread, with 14 pages. Pages of yellowish low-quality paper. Covers marbled with watercolour. On the cover the text: JAAN VAHTRA
BLANC ET NOIR

Upper right an elk's head, in the centre a little man looking out of a window opening, and on the left stairs ending in an arched doorway.

A) Ebakorrapärasel pinnal üleval paremal pikajuukselise habemiku vanamehe pea poolpöördes vasakule. Suus suitsev piip, pilk langetatud. All vasakul lapse pea otsevaates. Lühikesed juuksed tukaga laubal, pilk vaatajale, ilme tõsine.
B) Lehel lõvi otsevaates (lõvi pea). Alaosas numbrid 24532, 5898 jt.
works.de:
A) On an irregular surface, at the top right, the head of a long-haired, bearded old man in a half-turn to the left. A smoking pipe in his mouth, gaze lowered. At the bottom left, the head of a child in frontal view. Short hair with a fringe on the forehead, gaze directed at the viewer, serious expression.
B) On the sheet a lion in frontal view (lion's head). At the bottom numbers 24532, 5898 etc.

II Plaadil habemiku vanamehe pea kerges pöördes paremale, tornide taustal.
works.de:
I In the background a factory and towers, against which three working figures are set. The work is done in an expressionistically angular form.
II On the plate the head of a bearded old man, slightly turned to the right, against a background of towers.

works.d: Tegemist on Richard Kaljo tööga, mille teised tõmmised Eesti muuseumide kogudes meile teadaolevalt puuduvad. Kõnealuse töö on Kaljo teostanud õpingute ajal Kõrgemas Kunstikoolis Pallas ning see annab tunnistust noore autori isikupärase kunstnikukäekirja ja temaatika kujunemisest. Richard Kaljo graafikalooming on Eesti Kunstimuuseumi graafikakogus esindatud mitmekesiselt ja eri perioodide vältel, kõnealune leht on siinkohal heaks ja asjakohaseks täienduseks olemasolevale kollektsioonile. Puugravüür "Mustlaspoiss" koos samanimelise linoollõikega („Mehe pea (Mustlaspoiss)“) on Kaljo puhul huvitavaks näiteks ekspressiivse lõiketehnikaga katsetamisest portree valdkonnas, millest Eesti Kunstimuuse
works.de: This is a work by Richard Kaljo, other impressions of which are not known to us to exist in Estonian museum collections. Kaljo made this work during his studies at the Pallas Higher Art School, and it testifies to the development of the young author's distinctive artistic style and thematics. Richard Kaljo's graphic oeuvre is represented in the Art Museum of Estonia's print collection in a varied manner and across different periods, and the print in question is here a good and appropriate addition to the existing collection. The woodcut "Gypsy Boy" together with the linocut of the same name ("Head of a Man (Gypsy Boy)") is an interesting example, for Kaljo, of experimenting with an expressive cutting technique in the field of portraiture, of which the Art Museum of Estonia

works.dm: lehe laius: 55.0 cm; lehe kõrgus: 131.5 cm
works.d: Raul Meel esindab 1970.–1980. aastate eesti kunstiuuenduse radikaalset tiiba ning teda tuntakse eesti kunsti kõige nimekama autodidakti ja autsaiderina. Meele soov rääkida üht keelt Lääne kunstiuuendusega tähendas lahtiütlemist tavapärastest, Eesti kunstisüsteemist endast välja kasvanud võimalustest ja tähistajatest. Inseneritaustaga kunstnik alustas 1970. aastal kunsti ja täppisteaduse dialoogi, mis rajas tee kontseptualistliku kunstimõiste tulekule Eestis ja tõestas, et ka kujutav kunst suudab kajastada kaasaegsete arengute poolt esilekutsutud vaimselt keerulisi probleeme. Meel oli esimene eesti kunstnik, kes pälvis laiema rahvusvahelise tunnustuse ja võttis oma töödega osa Euroopa avangar
works.de: Raul Meel represents the radical wing of Estonian art renewal of the 1970s–1980s and is known as the most famous autodidact and outsider in Estonian art. Meel's desire to speak the same language as Western art renewal meant renouncing the customary possibilities and signifiers that had grown out of the Estonian art system itself. An artist with an engineering background, he began in 1970 a dialogue between art and exact science, which paved the way for the arrival of the conceptualist notion of art in Estonia and proved that visual art too is capable of reflecting the spiritually complex problems brought about by contemporary developments. Meel was the first Estonian artist to receive wider international recognition and took part with his works in European avant-gar

Inseneritaustaga kunstnik alustas 1970. aastal kunsti ja täppisteaduse dialoogi, mis rajas tee kontseptualistliku kunstimõiste tulekule Eestis ja tõestas, et ka kujutav kunst suudab kajastada kaasaegsete arengute poolt esilekutsutud vaimselt keerulisi probleeme. Meel oli esimene eesti kunstnik, kes pälvis laiema rahvusvahelise tunnustuse ja võttis oma töödega osa Euroopa avangar

Leonhard Lapini 1972. aasta tuši- ja guašijoonistused „Kägar I“ ja „Kägar II“ ning 1966. aasta kollaaž „Mustamäe“ olid eksponeeritud Kumu kunstimuuseumi avanäitusel 2006-2007.

works.de:
Leonhard Lapin's 1972 ink and gouache drawings "Kägar I" and "Kägar II" and the 1966 collage "Mustamäe" were exhibited at the opening exhibition of the Kumu Art Museum in 2006-2007.
These original works hold a special place in the early oeuvre of the well-known architect, writer and graphic artist due to their exploratory nature, in which clear connections with pop art can be seen.

works.d:
Väino Tõnissoni (1925-1991) vabagraafilised lehed iseloomustavad autorit üsna hästi, olles täienduseks ta loomingu ülevaatele Eesti Kunstimuuseumi graafikakogus. 
Mere-, sadama-, saarelanike jne teemad on nõukogude-aegsele eesti graafikale tüüpilised, nagu ka üldistav, nurgeline ja mustvalge käsitlus. Väino Tõnisson oli tuntud ka eksliibrisekunstniku ja illustraatorina.
works.de:
Väino Tõnisson's (1925-1991) free graphic prints characterise the artist quite well, serving as a supplement to the overview of his work in the print collection of the Art Museum of Estonia.
Themes of the sea, harbour, island dwellers etc. are typical of Soviet-era Estonian graphic art, as is the generalising, angular and black-and-white treatment. Väino Tõnisson was also known as an exlibris artist and illustrator.

Väino Tõnisson's (1925-1991) free graphic prints characterise the artist quite well, serving as a supplement to the overview of his work in the print collection of the Art Museum of Estonia.
Themes of the sea, harbour, island dwellers etc. are typical of Soviet-era Estonian graphic art, as is the generalising, angular and black-and-white treatment. Väino Tõnisson was also known as an exlibris artist and illustrator.

works.de: Tõnis Laanemaa (1937), who belonged to the group ANK' 64 active in Tallinn 1964-1969, remains an active artist to this day. The three early etchings are typical examples of Laanemaa's style, based on associations, emotionally readable. Among the graphic artists of his generation, Laanemaa stands out for turning to social themes, which relate to the upheavals in society.

Kuivõrd kunstnik tegi oma plaatidest vähe tõmmiseid, on tema selle perioodi graafikapärand Eesti muuseumides väga tagasihoidlikult esindatud.
works.de: The woodcuts and linocuts of the 1930s, primarily known through the works of Eduard Wiiralt, Arkadio Laigo, Hando Mugasto and Paul Liivak, were joined in the latter half of the decade by the work of Richard Sagrits, with its distinctive and painterly treatment. Since the artist made few prints from his plates, his graphic legacy from this period is very modestly represented in Estonian museums.

works.d: Ülo Õuna neljafiguuriline teos „Õieke ja sammud sinnapoole“ on üks väljapaistvamaid kunstniku varasema loomeperioodi töid. Teos on restaureeritud Eesti Kunstimuuseumis seoses Ü. Õuna näitusega aastal 2009. Vaba, voolav modelleering, sürrealistlik vormikäsitlus ja osaliselt säilinud polükroomia on teosele omased ning väärtuslikud Ülo Õuna loomingu ülevaates.
works.de: Ülo Õuna's four-figure work "Õieke ja sammud sinnapoole" is one of the most outstanding works of the artist's earlier creative period. The work was restored at the Art Museum of Estonia in connection with the Ü. Õuna exhibition in 2009. Free, flowing modelling, a surrealist treatment of form and partially preserved polychromy are characteristic of the work and valuable in an overview of Ülo Õuna's oeuvre.

On the lower rim of the jug and to the left of the handle a high-relief plant ornament.

The cup of the goblet is decorated with a coat of arms bearing the image of St. Knud (Canute). Beneath it is engraved the donation date: d. 18. Maerz 1860. The cup is also engraved with the names and occupations of nine guild brothers (among them also the goldsmith Michelsen, who made the goblet): F. Sporleder, Tischler; G. Katzman(n), Drechsler; G. Hetzer, Buchbinder; L. Michelsen, Silberarbeiter; J. Reinhardt, Sattler; D. Grenlund, Schumacher; W. Heinrichson, Schumacher; J. Berg, Schumacher; O. Wenzel, Schumacher.

works.d:
Leonhard Lapini 1972. aasta tuši- ja guašijoonistused „Kägar I“ ja „Kägar II“ ning 1966. aasta kollaaž „Mustamäe“ olid eksponeeritud Kumu kunstimuuseumi avanäitusel 2006-2007.
Need originaaltööd on tuntud arhitekti, kirjaniku ja graafiku varases loomingus erilisel kohal oma otsingulise olemusega, milles on selged seosed popkunstiga.
works.de:
Leonhard Lapin's 1972 ink and gouache drawings "Kägar I" and "Kägar II" and the 1966 collage "Mustamäe" were exhibited at the opening exhibition of the Kumu Art Museum in 2006-2007.
These original works hold a special place in the early oeuvre of the well-known architect, writer and graphic artist due to their exploratory nature, in which clear connections with pop art can be seen.

Pikk 26 majal võib näha miniatuurset vennaskonna lippu. Nõu esikülge kaunistab Mustpeade Vennaskonna vapp, mille alla on graveeritud pühendus vennaskonna esimees-vanemale Ernst Sporlederile.
works.de: On the lid of the goblet there is a model of the brotherhood's buildings at Pikk Street 26 (the House of the Blackheads) and Pikk Street 24 (the former House of the Olaf Guild, which had belonged to the Blackheads since 1806). On the Pikk 26 building a miniature flag of the brotherhood can be seen. The front side of the vessel is decorated with the coat of arms of the Brotherhood of Blackheads, beneath which is engraved a dedication to the brotherhood's chief elder Ernst Sporleder.

works.de: A cylindrical drinking jug stands on three walnut-shaped feet. On the lid a rich relief disc with grapevine tendrils, in the center of which, in relief, two men carrying grape clusters. This is a scene from the Old Testament: the envoys Joshua and Caleb return from the land of Canaan, carrying a giant cluster of grapes.

Kaanel reljeefne tammelehtedega kaunistus ja nupuks Mustpeade vapp. Karika äärel MICHELSEN.
works.de: A cup depicting a moose's leg, with a relief oak-leaf lower part, gilded rim and interior. Text engraved on the cup: Herrn Rittmeister Carl August von ? vom Corps der Schwarzenhäupter am 29. März 1869. On the lid, a relief oak-leaf decoration with the coat of arms of the Brotherhood of Blackheads as the knob. On the rim of the cup MICHELSEN.

works.d: Hirvejala kujuga bokaali jalg. Kaane nupuks on Mustpeade Vennaskonna vapp; selle küljes ripub keti otsas väike medal 1828.–1829. aasta Vene-Türgi sõja mälestuseks.
works.de: Foot of a goblet in the shape of a deer's leg. The knob of the lid is the coat of arms of the Brotherhood of Blackheads; attached to it on a chain hangs a small medal commemorating the Russo-Turkish War of 1828–1829.

works.d: Hirvejalga kujutava tüvega. Jalga ja karikat ühendab kullatud stiliseeritud lehtedest võru. Pokaali ühel küljel on medaljon Aleksander I monogrammiga, teisel küljel mustpeade vapp.
works.de: A foot depicting a deer leg. The foot and the cup are joined by a gilded wreath of stylised leaves. On one side of the goblet is a medallion with Alexander I's monogram, on the other side the Blackheads' coat of arms.

works.d:
Veinikann kaanega. 
Veinikann rokokoo imitatsiooni ornamendiga kaanel, tilal, kõrval ja jalusel. Ornamendi osas kullatud, ülejäänud pind hõbetatud. 
Kannu korpuselt on kaduma läinud Kolgata-grupp – seda detaili võib näha 1943. aastal vendade Parikaste tehtud fotol.
works.de:
Wine jug with lid. 
Wine jug with rococo-imitation ornament on the lid, spout, handle and foot. The ornamented parts are gilded, the rest of the surface is silvered. 
The Calvary group has been lost from the body of the jug - this detail can be seen in a photograph taken by the Parikas brothers in 1943.

works.d: Reljeefne, rokokoo motiiviline kohrutatud ebaühtlane äär. Esiküljele on graveeritud: Fridrich Joachim Büll, Aeltermann des Festbäcker Amtes von 1830 bis 1839.
works.de: A relief, rococo-motif, undulating uneven edge. Engraved on the front: Fridrich Joachim Büll, Aeltermann des Festbäcker Amtes von 1830 bis 1839.

works.d:
Reljeefne,  rocai-motiiviline, ebaühtlase kujuga.
Esiküljel on köösnerite embleem – kaks tagajalgadel seisvat lõvi, mõõgad käes, hoiavad endi vahel karusnahka – ning graveering: G.W. Donath, 1754. 
Meistrimärk puudub.
works.de:
Relief, rocaille-motif, of irregular shape.
On the front side the furriers' guild emblem - two lions standing on their hind legs, swords in hand, holding a fur pelt between them - and an engraving: G.W. Donath, 1754.
No maker's mark.

works.d:
Rikkalik reljeefne rocai- ääristus, mis moodustab ebaühtlase ääre. 
Esiküljel on kujutatud laeva; selle alla on graveeritud annetajate nimed ja daatum: Schif(fer) Otto Ocken v(on) Bergen, Joh(ann) Fri(edrich) Krönelin v(on) Berg(en), Joh(ann) Nils Hustensunt v(on) Anendahl, Abrah(am) Waldemann Goltschmidt von Reval. A(nn)o 1756 d(en) 7 May.
works.de:
A rich relief rocaille border, forming an uneven edge. 
On the obverse a ship is depicted; below it are engraved the names of the donors and the date: Schif(fer) Otto Ocken v(on) Bergen, Joh(ann) Fri(edrich) Krönelin v(on) Berg(en), Joh(ann) Nils Hustensunt v(on) Anendahl, Abrah(am) Waldemann Goltschmidt von Reval. A(nn)o 1756 d(en) 7 May.

works.d: Pokaali tüveseks on kilbile toetuv rooma sõduri figuur, mis sarnaneb Zanderi valmistatud Wrangeli pokaali tüvesefiguuriga (ese EKM B 312).  Kaanel oda kandva rooma sõduri kuju.
works.de: The stem of the goblet is a figure of a Roman soldier leaning on a shield, resembling the stem figure of the Wrangel goblet made by Zander (item EKM B 312). On the lid a figure of a Roman soldier carrying a spear.

works.d:
Kaanel pasunat puhuv amor ja rikkaliku reljeefse ornamendi vahel tekst: Salus et Victoria. Herculis Munus, Nisi qui legitime certaverit. 
Tüveseks oleva rooma sõduri kilpi kaunistab emaileeritud mustpeade vapp. Kupa ülaosas on ovaalide sisse graveeritud annetajate vapid ja nimed: Thomas Remingt, William Beaumo(n)t, Robert Maisters, Thomas Donn, Robert Mallabar, John Cary, Gabriel Donker, Beniamin Benson, Richard Sykes, William Sill, Richard Cooke. Karikas on kaetud rikkaliku taimornamendiga ning seisab kolmel lehekujulisel jalal.
works.de:
On the lid, a cupid blowing a trumpet, and between rich relief ornament the text: Salus et Victoria. Herculis Munus, Nisi qui legitime certaverit. 
The stem, in the form of a Roman soldier's shield, is decorated with an enamelled coat of arms of the Moor's heads. In the upper part of the cup, the coats of arms and names of the donors are engraved within ovals: Thomas Remingt, William Beaumo(n)t, Robert Maisters, Thomas Donn, Robert Mallabar, John Cary, Gabriel Donker, Beniamin Benson, Richard Sykes, William Sill, Richard Cooke. The cup is covered with rich plant ornament and stands on three leaf-shaped feet.

works.d: Ovaalne, reljeefne stiliseeritud taimornament  moodustab ebaühtlase ääre. Serv laineline, põhja keskel reljeefne risitga vapp. Valatud töö.
works.de: An oval, relief stylised plant ornament forms an uneven border. The edge is wavy, at the centre of the base a relief coat of arms with a cross. Cast work.

works.d:
Roiestatud kabjaga, seest kullatud. Kupa ülemisel äärel graveeritud Kanuti pildiga vapp ja tekst: J. E. Born, Böttcher, G. A. Michelson ?,
H. L.  Koch, Böttcher, C. E. Sopha Instrumentmacher 1846.
Kabja äärel meistrimärk GW WULF.
works.de:
Ribbed hoof, gilded on the inside. On the upper edge of the cup there is an engraved coat of arms with an image of Kanut and the text: J. E. Born, Böttcher, G. A. Michelson ?,
H. L.  Koch, Böttcher, C. E. Sopha Instrumentmacher 1846.
On the edge of the hoof the master's mark GW WULF.

works.dm: lehe laius: 63.0 cm; lehe kõrgus: 65.0 cm
works.d: Raul Meel esindab 1970.–1980. aastate eesti kunstiuuenduse radikaalset tiiba ning teda tuntakse eesti kunsti kõige nimekama autodidakti ja autsaiderina. Meele soov rääkida üht keelt Lääne kunstiuuendusega tähendas lahtiütlemist tavapärastest, Eesti kunstisüsteemist endast välja kasvanud võimalustest ja tähistajatest. Inseneritaustaga kunstnik alustas 1970. aastal kunsti ja täppisteaduse dialoogi, mis rajas tee kontseptualistliku kunstimõiste tulekule Eestis ja tõestas, et ka kujutav kunst suudab kajastada kaasaegsete arengute poolt esilekutsutud vaimselt keerulisi probleeme. Meel oli esimene eesti kunstnik, kes pälvis laiema rahvusvahelise tunnustuse ja võttis oma töödega osa Euroopa avangar
works.de: Raul Meel represents the radical wing of Estonian art renewal of the 1970s–1980s and is known as the most famous autodidact and outsider in Estonian art. Meel's desire to speak the same language as Western art renewal meant renouncing the customary possibilities and signifiers that had grown out of the Estonian art system itself. An artist with an engineering background, he began in 1970 a dialogue between art and exact science, which paved the way for the arrival of the conceptualist notion of art in Estonia and proved that visual art too is capable of reflecting the spiritually complex problems brought about by contemporary developments. Meel was the first Estonian artist to receive wider international recognition and took part with his works in European avant-gar

An artist with an engineering background, he began in 1970 a dialogue between art and exact science, which paved the way for the arrival of the conceptualist notion of art in Estonia and proved that visual art too is capable of reflecting the spiritually complex problems brought about by contemporary developments. Meel was the first Estonian artist to receive wider international recognition and took part with his works in European avant-gar

works.d: Tunnustatud läti graafik Aleksandrs Dembo (1931-1999) osales korduvalt Tallinna Graafika Triennaalil ning leidnud oma teostega ka äramärkimist (1968, 1980). Läti Kunstimuuseumi kingitusena omandatud "Balti laulud" on siiani ainukeseks näiteks Dembo loomingust Eesti Kunstimuuseumi kogus.
works.de: The acclaimed Latvian printmaker Aleksandrs Dembo (1931–1999) took part repeatedly in the Tallinn Print Triennial and received recognition for his works there (1968, 1980). "Baltic Songs", acquired as a gift from the Latvian Museum of Art, remains to this day the only example of Dembo's work in the Art Museum of Estonia's collection.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 50.0 cm; graafikaplaadi laius: 44.5 cm; graafikaplaadi kõrgus: 28.5 cm; lehe laius: 67.5 cm
works.d: "Rahutus" on Eduard Wiiralti üks viimaseid suuremaid töid ning seda võib pidada tema luigelauluks, mida Wiiralt hakkas kavandama juba 1949. aastal ja mille kallal töötas ta aastatel 1950-1952. "Rahutus" on teostatud  segatehnikas (nimetatud ka sünteetiliseks tehnikaks), mis oli Wiiralti loomingule iseloomulik juba 1949. aastast ning baseerus peamiselt pehmelakil. Arvestades teose krestomaatilist iseloomu on Eesti Kunstimuuseumi jaoks oluline säilitada lehe erinevaid seisundeid ja esimesed tõmmised tiraažist.
works.de: "Rahutus" ("Unrest") is one of Eduard Wiiralt's last major works and can be considered his swan song, which Wiiralt began to plan already in 1949 and on which he worked in the years 1950-1952. "Rahutus" is executed in a mixed technique (also called a synthetic technique), which had been characteristic of Wiiralt's work already from 1949 and was based mainly on soft-ground etching. Given the canonical nature of the work, it is important for the Art Museum of Estonia to preserve various states of the sheet and the first prints from the edition.

works.dm: lehe laius: 60.0 cm; lehe kõrgus: 44.0 cm
works.d: Ants Laikmaa ateljeekoolis ning Pallases haridust omandanud maalikunstnik Priidu Aaviku (1905-1991) 1964. aastal Nigeerias teostatud akvarell on iseloomulikuks näiteks juba eelneva kümnendi lõpul Eesti kunsti sisenenud uuest teemast, milleks oli reisimuljete jäädvustamine rahvaste sõpruse edendamise eesmärgil.
works.de: The watercolour made in Nigeria in 1964 by the painter Priidu Aavik (1905-1991), who was educated at Ants Laikmaa's studio school and at Pallas, is a characteristic example of a new theme that had already entered Estonian art at the end of the previous decade, namely the recording of travel impressions for the purpose of promoting friendship between peoples.

works.d: Ants Laikmaa ateljeekoolis ning Pallases haridust omandanud maalikunstnik Priidu Aaviku (1905-1991) 1960. aastate tööd on iseloomulikeks näideteks mainitud kümnendi kunsti soositud teemadest - kerge koloriidiga ning hoogsalt visandlikud akvarellid Kohtla-Järve põlevkivitööstusest sobituvad nn. kaasaegse industriaalmotiivi kujutamise praktikasse.
works.de: The painter Priidu Aavik (1905-1991), who received his education at Ants Laikmaa's studio school and at Pallas, produced in the 1960s works that are characteristic examples of the themes favoured in the art of that decade - lightly coloured and boldly sketch-like watercolours of the Kohtla-Järve oil shale industry fit into the practice of depicting the so-called contemporary industrial motif.

works.dm: lehe laius: 63.0 cm; lehe kõrgus: 65.0 cm
works.d: Raul Meel esindab 1970.–1980. aastate eesti kunstiuuenduse radikaalset tiiba ning teda tuntakse eesti kunsti kõige nimekama autodidakti ja autsaiderina. Meele soov rääkida üht keelt Lääne kunstiuuendusega tähendas lahtiütlemist tavapärastest, Eesti kunstisüsteemist endast välja kasvanud võimalustest ja tähistajatest. Inseneritaustaga kunstnik alustas 1970. aastal kunsti ja täppisteaduse dialoogi, mis rajas tee kontseptualistliku kunstimõiste tulekule Eestis ja tõestas, et ka kujutav kunst suudab kajastada kaasaegsete arengute poolt esilekutsutud vaimselt keerulisi probleeme. Meel oli esimene eesti kunstnik, kes pälvis laiema rahvusvahelise tunnustuse ja võttis oma töödega osa Euroopa avangar
works.de: Raul Meel represents the radical wing of Estonian art renewal of the 1970s–1980s and is known as the most famous autodidact and outsider in Estonian art. Meel's desire to speak the same language as Western art renewal meant renouncing the customary possibilities and signifiers that had grown out of the Estonian art system itself. An artist with an engineering background, he began in 1970 a dialogue between art and exact science, which paved the way for the arrival of the conceptualist notion of art in Estonia and proved that visual art too is capable of reflecting the spiritually complex problems brought about by contemporary developments. Meel was the first Estonian artist to receive wider international recognition and took part with his works in European avant-gar

works.d:
Osvald Timmas (1913-2005) oli üks kõige tuntumaid eesti eksiilkunstnikke ning Kanada kuningliku kunstiakadeemia liige. Saaremaal sündinud kunstnik õppis 1937-1944 Tartu ülikoolis majandust ja pühendus kunstile alles pärast emigreerumist, Kanadas, 1960. aastatel. 
Timmase peamine ala oli akvarell, milles ta oli väga novaatorlik, kujutas mikro- ja makrostruktuure, veealust maailma, kivimeid jne. Ta rikastas akvarelli tehnikat rauarooste kasutamisega.
1990. aastal oli Adamson-Ericu muuseumis Osvald Timmase isiknäitus. Eesti Kunstimuuseumis leidub 28 teost graafika ja 2 teost maalikogus. Ants ja Lia Juurupi kogust saabunud pärandus 8 Timmase tööga (aastatest 1963-1982) kujutab endast suurepärast
works.de:
Osvald Timmas (1913-2005) was one of the best-known Estonian exile artists and a member of the Royal Canadian Academy of Arts. Born on Saaremaa, the artist studied economics at the University of Tartu in 1937-1944 and devoted himself to art only after emigrating, in Canada, in the 1960s.
Timmas's main field was watercolour, in which he was highly innovative, depicting micro- and macrostructures, the underwater world, rocks, etc. He enriched watercolour technique by using iron rust.
In 1990 the Adamson-Eric Museum held a solo exhibition of Osvald Timmas. The Art Museum of Estonia holds 28 works in the print collection and 2 works in the painting collection. The bequest of 8 works by Timmas (from the years 1963-1982) received from the Ants and Lia Juurupi collection represents an excellent

Meel's desire to speak the same language as Western art renewal meant renouncing the customary possibilities and signifiers that had grown out of the Estonian art system itself. An artist with an engineering background, he began in 1970 a dialogue between art and exact science, which paved the way for the arrival of the conceptualist notion of art in Estonia and proved that visual art too is capable of reflecting the spiritually complex problems brought about by contemporary developments. Meel was the first Estonian artist to receive wider international recognition and took part with his works in European avant-gar

works.d:
Ümmargune vaagen kolmel lehekujulisel jalal. Vaagna põhjal kilbikujulisel kullatud pinnal graveeritud rokokoo ornamendi grupp, mille keskel embleem: sirkel, vinkel, höövel jne. All tekst: An(n)o 1775 d. 27.Sept. Vaagna sisemine, laineline äär peene profileeringuga ja rokaidega jalgade kohal. 
Peal meistrimärk IGD.
works.de:
A round platter on three leaf-shaped feet. On the bottom of the platter, on a shield-shaped gilded surface, an engraved group of rococo ornament, in the centre of which an emblem: compass, set square, plane, etc. Below, text: An(n)o 1775 d. 27.Sept. The platter's inner, wavy rim with fine profiling and rocailles above the feet.
On top, maker's mark IGD.

works.d: Evi Tihemets on üks juhtivaid eesti graafikuid.Ta on loonud väga erinevates tehnikates ja laadides teoseid ninga pälvinud mitmeid auhindu. Selle joonistuse näol on tegemist varase teosega, milles näeme kunstniku isiksust kujunemas. Samas iseloomustab see reisijoonistus ajastut, vabamaks ja liberaalsemaks muutumise õhustikku. Pärast kunstiülikooli lõpetamist 1958. aastal ei olnud Evi Tihemetsal, nagu tolleaegsetel noortel kunstnikel üldiselt, võimalik end täiendada maailma kunstikeskustes, seda asendasid matkad Nõukogude Liidu eri paikadesse.
works.de: Evi Tihemets is one of the leading Estonian graphic artists. She has created works in very different techniques and styles and has received numerous awards. This drawing is an early work, in which we see the artist's personality taking shape. At the same time, this travel drawing characterises the era, the atmosphere of becoming freer and more liberal. After graduating from the art university in 1958, Evi Tihemets, like young artists of that time in general, did not have the opportunity to further her education in the world's art centres, which was replaced by travels to various places in the Soviet Union.

works.d:
Anna Triik-Põllusaar (1902-1999), sünninimi Anja Põllusaar, hiljem Anna Kompus, oli üks esimesi eesti naiskunstnikke. Kunstikooli Pallas lõpetas ta 1926 maalikunstnikuna. 1944 põgenes Saksamaale, 1949 asus Austraaliasse.
Nikolai Triigi õpilase ja abikaasana on temas Triigi loomingu mõjutusi, kuid tema teoseid, eriti portreid iseloomustab eriline tundlikkus.
Anna Triik-Põllusaare joonistused ning akvarellid eri loominguetappidest on väärtuslikuks täienduseks Eesti Kunstimuuseumi kogule.
works.de:
Anna Triik-Põllusaar (1902-1999), born Anja Põllusaar, later Anna Kompus, was one of the first Estonian female artists. She graduated from the Art College Pallas in 1926 as a painter. In 1944 she fled to Germany, in 1949 she moved to Australia.
As the student and wife of Nikolai Triik, influences of Triik's work can be seen in her, but her works, especially portraits, are characterised by a particular sensitivity.
Anna Triik-Põllusaar's drawings and watercolours from various stages of her creative work are a valuable addition to the collection of the Art Museum of Estonia.

works.d: Nii tassile kui ka alustassile on graveeritud Tartu vaated: tassil domineerib raekoda koos Raekoja platsi hoonetega, taldriku serval Inglisild. Lisaks Tartu vaadetele kaunistab taldriku serva graveeritud paelornament ja kaks lillemotiivi. Taldriku põhja alt on maha hõõrutud kolmerealine tekst, millest on näha üksikuid tähti. Huvitaval kombel on Nagel kasutanud tassil ja taldrikul erineva kujundusega meistrimärki: taldrikul on gooti, tassil antiikva tähed.
works.de: Both the cup and the saucer are engraved with views of Tartu: the cup is dominated by the town hall together with the buildings of Town Hall Square, and the rim of the plate by the Inglisild (English Bridge). In addition to the views of Tartu, the rim of the plate is decorated with an engraved ribbon ornament and two floral motifs. A three-line text has been rubbed off from the underside of the plate, of which only individual letters are visible. Interestingly, Nagel has used differently designed maker's marks on the cup and the plate: on the plate Gothic letters, on the cup antiqua letters.

On the front of the box there is a relief coat of arms, above which is a crown. The upper part of the handles is shaped as a coiling stylised plant leaf.

On the upper, smooth part of the bowl is engraved the Rehbinder coat of arms (3 crowned serpents and 10 stars). The knop is likewise divided into six convexities, the foot is hexagonal, with a small sharp point after every two facets.

The upper candle socket with the wax tray is removable, beneath it there is another, narrower smooth-edged socket intended for a thicker candle. Plaster has been cast into the foot as a weight.

works.de: The body of the jug is entirely covered with relief ornament: frolicking putti against a landscape background, holding garlands of flowers, a shepherd's crook and a horn. On the base and lid a lush plant ornament. In the centre of the lid a relief alliance coat of arms. In the centre of the S-shaped handle a female figure (herm).

works.de: The lid of the bowl is fitted with three lion's-paw feet, so that it can also be used as a platter. A raised ornamental band around the lid, on which shields alternate with medallions depicting putti against a landscape background. The lion's-paw feet are shaped as flower buds.

works.d: Vaagen on üleni kaetud kohrutatud ornamendiga: serval keerdus akantuslehed, puuviljad ja mehebüstid lippudega. Keskosal võib näha jumalanna Athenat lipu ja kilbiga, peas kiiver, jalge ees öökull ja raamat. Temast ühel pool on arhitektuurne motiiv, teisel pool lahingustseen (4 võitlevat ratsanikku, jalamees ja langenu). Vaagna kohrutus on keskosas jäänud lõpetamata: mõlemad stseenid on visandatud graveeritud joontega. Alur Reinans oletas, et põhjuseks oli kullassepp Holsti surm katku 1710. aastal.
works.de: The dish is entirely covered with repoussé ornament: on the rim, twisted acanthus leaves, fruits and men's busts with flags. In the central section one can see the goddess Athena with a flag and a shield, a helmet on her head, an owl and a book at her feet. On one side of her is an architectural motif, on the other a battle scene (4 fighting horsemen, a foot soldier and a fallen man). The repoussé work of the dish has been left unfinished in the central section: both scenes are sketched with engraved lines. Alur Reinans surmised that the reason was the death of the goldsmith Holst from the plague in 1710.

works.d: Vaagna keskel pastoraalne stseen suvemaastiku taustal. Serval kohrutatud akantusväädid, lille- ja puuviljamotiivid.
works.de: In the centre of the basin a pastoral scene against the background of a summer landscape. On the rim, curled acanthus vines, floral and fruit motifs.

works.d: Varreotsal graveeritud taimemotiiv ja rombikujuline lint initsiaalidega EV.
works.de: Engraved plant motif at the end of the shaft and a diamond-shaped ribbon with initials EV.

works.d: Kannu kerele on graveeritud ülaserva looklevat profiili järgiv ornamendiriba taimemotiivide ja diagonaalsete lintidega, riba keskel (tila all) asub kilp initsiaalidega HM. Sangal kerkib kahe taimelehe vahelt välja kotka või greifi pea.
works.de: On the body of the jug an ornamental band following the undulating profile of the upper edge is engraved with plant motifs and diagonal ribbons, in the middle of the band (below the spout) is a shield with the initials HM. From the handle, between two plant leaves, rises the head of an eagle or griffin.

works.d: Kere alumine pool kaetud graveeritud püsttriipudega.
works.de: The lower part of the body covered with engraved vertical stripes.

works.d: Kere alumine osa ja kaas kaunistatud rõõnetega, madal jalg profileeritud, sang ja kaanenupp mustaks värvitud puidust.

works.d: Kere allosa, tila ja kaas kaunistatud rõõnetega, ka madal jalg rõõnestatud. Kere keskosas ornamendiriba stiliseeritud taimelehtedega. Jala ja kere ühenduskohal kitsas ornamendiriba meandriga.
works.de: The lower part of the body, the spout and the lid decorated with fluting, the low foot also fluted. In the middle section of the body an ornamental band with stylised plant leaves. At the junction of the foot and body a narrow ornamental band with a meander.

works.d: Kaanega toos toetub kõrgele jalale. Kaanenupuks on ovaalsel platvormil lamav ümarplastiline lõvi, sangade ülaosas „egiptusepärased” laialisirutatud tiibadega kotkabüstid. Jala ja kaane allosa ümbritsevad stiliseeritud viinapuulehed, toosi keskel kitsas riba taimornamendiga. Kaane serva sees ava lusika jaoks.
works.de: A lidded box resting on a high foot. The lid knob is a rounded lion figure lying on an oval platform, on the upper part of the handles "Egyptian-style" eagle busts with outstretched wings. Stylised vine leaves surround the foot and the lower part of the lid, a narrow band with plant ornament in the centre of the box. Inside the edge of the lid an opening for a spoon.

works.d: Suhkrutoosi kere jaotub eenduvate püstjoonte abil kuueks väljaks, toosi ülaservas stantsitud ornament keerduvate taimelehtedega. Kaas jaotub samuti kuueks väljaks, servas lusikaava. Kaanenupp sile ja ümar, vaheketas mustaks värvitud puidust. Madalal jalal on looklev serv.
works.de: The body of the sugar bowl is divided by projecting vertical lines into six fields, on the upper rim of the bowl a stamped ornament with curling plant leaves. The lid is likewise divided into six fields, with a spoon-shaped rim edge. The knob of the lid is smooth and round, the intermediate disc of wood painted black. The low foot has a wavy edge.

works.d: Sõela lainelist serva kaunistab kitsas stantsitud ornamendiriba keerduvate lehtede ja teokarbimotiividega. Sõela põhi liigendub kaheksaks õielehekujuliseks väljaks, augud on ümmargused. Varreotsal reljeefne palmett.
works.de: The wavy edge of the sieve is decorated with a narrow stamped ornamental band with twisting leaves and shell motifs. The bottom of the sieve is divided into eight petal-shaped fields, the holes are round. A relief palmette at the end of the handle.

works.d: Ümmarguste aukudega sõel, vars kaunistamata.
works.de: Sieve with round holes, handle undecorated.

works.d: Kannu ülemisele poolele on graveeritud ornamendiriba, kus diagonaalsed lindid vahelduvad stiliseeritud lehtornamendiga. Kannu allosal graveeritud kolmnurkadest ja sõõridega lõppevatest püstjoontest koosnev ornament. Sanga ülaosas kerkib kahe lehe vahelt välja ümarplastiline kotka- või greifipea. Madal baas rõõnestatud.
works.de: On the upper part of the jug an ornamental band is engraved, in which diagonal ribbons alternate with stylised leaf ornament. On the lower part of the jug an ornament engraved, consisting of triangles and vertical lines ending in circles. At the top of the handle, a rounded, three-dimensional eagle's or griffin's head rises from between two leaves. The low base is fluted.

works.d: Kannu tila on kujundatud kotka või greifina, noka vahel valamistoru. Kaanenupuks laiali sirutatud tiibadega kotkafiguur, jalge all graveeritud õis. Kannu serv ja baas rõõnestatud. Kere ülaosale on graveeritud ornamendiriba, kus diagonaalsed lindid vahelduvad stiliseeritud lehtornamendiga, riba keskel tühjaks jäetud kilp. Kere allosas graveeritud kolmnurkadest ja sõõridega lõppevatest püstjoontest koosnev ornament. Sang mustaks värvitud puidust, sanga ülemise otsa all on kerele kinnitatud reljeefne merikarbi kujutis.
works.de: The spout of the jug is shaped as an eagle or griffin, with a pouring tube between its beak. The lid knob is an eagle figure with outstretched wings, an engraved flower beneath its feet. The rim and base of the jug are beaded. The upper part of the body is engraved with a band of ornament, in which diagonal ribbons alternate with stylised leaf ornament, with a blank shield in the middle of the band. On the lower part of the body is an engraved ornament consisting of triangles and vertical lines ending in circles. The handle is of wood painted black; below the upper end of the handle a relief depiction of a sea shell is attached to the body.

works.d: Käepidemel on graveeritud taimornament ja ristuvad lindid.
works.de: A plant ornament and crossing ribbons are engraved on the handle.

works.d: Urnikujulisel nõul on kaks kõrget sanga. Toosi ülaserva ja kaant ning kere ja jala ühenduskohta kaunistab helmisnöör. Kaas tipneb odakujulise nupuga. Kaane serval lusikaava. Toosi ümarat jalga ümbritseb reljeefne loorberipärg, jalg toetub omakorda nelinurksele siledale baasile.
works.de: The urn-shaped vessel has two tall handles. The upper edge of the box and the lid, and the junction of the body and the foot, are decorated with a beaded cord. The lid tapers to a spear-shaped knob. There is a spoon groove on the edge of the lid. The rounded foot of the box is surrounded by a relief laurel wreath, the foot in turn resting on a smooth rectangular base.

works.d: Kannu alumine pool on kaunistatud rõõnetega, nende kohal on graveeritud ornamendiriba. Sang on kujundatud maona, mille selg on kaunistatud reljeefsete rombidega ja kõht lülidega, mao graveeritud pea kinnitub kannu ava külge. Madal, ovaalse kujuga jalg on profileeritud.
works.de: The lower part of the jug is decorated with fluting, above which is an engraved ornamental band. The handle is shaped as a snake, whose back is decorated with relief rhombuses and whose belly is decorated with segments, the snake's engraved head attaches to the mouth of the jug. The low, oval-shaped foot is profiled.

works.d: Varrele graveeritud stiliseeritud taimornament, varreotsal asuva kilbikujulise kartuši sisse graveeritud nimetähed R M L ja aastaarv 1809.
works.de: A stylised plant ornament engraved on the stem, with the initials R M L and the year 1809 engraved into a shield-shaped cartouche at the end of the stem.

works.d: Tangide otste siseküljed kaetud reljeefsete rombidega.
works.de: The inner sides of the tongs' ends are covered with relief diamonds.

works.d: Ovaalset silti ümbritseb lehepärg, keskel asub graveeritud saabas.
works.de: An oval label is surrounded by a leaf wreath, with an engraved boot in the centre.

works.d: Kaheksatahuline käepide on kaunistatud graveeritud ornamendiga.
works.de: The octagonal handle is decorated with engraved ornament.

works.d: Stiliseeritud õie kujulise kaha keskel reljeefne palmett, kaha ja varre ühenduskohale on kinnitatud valatud taimelehed. Puidust varre otsas luust nupp. Ühe lusika vart on parandatud. Lusikate täpne otstarve pole selge, ent peenike puidust vars viitab sellele, et neid kasutati millegi kuuma, ent samas võrdlemisi kerge (nt kastme, lihaleeme või magustoidu) tõstmiseks.
works.de: In the middle of a stylised flower-shaped bowl a relief palmette, at the junction of the bowl and the stem cast plant leaves are attached. At the end of the wooden stem a bone knob. The stem of one spoon has been repaired. The exact purpose of the spoons is not clear, but the thin wooden stem suggests that they were used for lifting something hot yet relatively light (e.g. sauce, broth or dessert).

works.d: Benjamin Vasserman’i (sünd. 1949) teos "Avarus I" on suurepärane näide tuntud eesti graafiku uuemast loomingust. Vasserman alustas 1980. aastatel värvilise sügavtrükiga (ofort, akvatinta) ning on liikunud suurte formaatide ja keerulise digitaalse tehnika suunas. Tema teostes on ruumilisus ühendatud geometrismiga. Sarjas "Avarus" ("Space", alustatud 2014) tegeleb kunstnik selliste probleemidega nagu värvi intensiivsus, ulmeruum, kosmose ja mikromaailma kokkupuude, variatsioonide paljusus ja visioonid alateadvuses.
works.de: Benjamin Vasserman's (b. 1949) work "Avarus I" is an excellent example of the recent creative work of the well-known Estonian printmaker. Vasserman began in the 1980s with colour intaglio printing (etching, aquatint) and has moved towards large formats and complex digital technique. In his works spatiality is combined with geometrism. In the series "Avarus" ("Space", begun in 2014) the artist deals with problems such as the intensity of colour, science-fiction space, the meeting of the cosmos and the microworld, a multiplicity of variations and visions in the subconscious.

works.d:
Ese koosneb kahest eri ajal valmistatud osast. Kellukest ülaosas kaunistav miniatuurne kompositsioon “Rüütel taras” on eriti väärtuslik ja haruldane, pärinedes gooti perioodist (15. saj. II pool). Rüütli ühes käes on lipp, teises Tallinna vapiga kilp.  Tegemist on vanima Eesti Kunstimuuseumi kogus oleva profaanotstarbelise hõbenõuga. 
Alumise osa, s. t. lauakella valmistas Kanuti Gildile 1799. aastal kullassepp J. J. Öhrmann, kes monteeris selle külge ka “Rüütli taras”.
works.de:
The object consists of two parts made at different times. The miniature composition "Knight in the Fence" decorating the upper part of the bell is particularly valuable and rare, dating from the Gothic period (2nd half of the 15th century). In one hand the knight holds a flag, in the other a shield with Tallinn's coat of arms. This is the oldest secular-purpose silver vessel in the collection of the Art Museum of Estonia.
The lower part, i.e. the table bell, was made for the Kanuti Guild in 1799 by the goldsmith J. J. Öhrmann, who also mounted the "Knight in the Fence" onto it.

The object may have been used as a basket for sweets.

works.de: On the lid of an oval vessel is a fully modelled mythological creature – a hippocampus, a sea-horse with a horse's head and a fish's tail. The handles of the vessel are formed as projecting eagle heads, with a ring between the beaks. The upper rim and foot of the bowl are fluted. The body is encircled by an engraved ornamental band with ribbons and stylised plant decoration, with an empty shield left in the centre. On the lower part of the body an ornament of engraved triangles, and on the end of the stem, knobs. On the edge of the lid, relief vine leaves.

works.d: Kere allosa on kaunistatud rõõnetega, madal jalg samuti rõõnestatud. Kere keskosas ornamendiriba stiliseeritud taimelehtedega, jala ja kere ühenduskohal kitsas ornamendiriba meandriga.
works.de: The lower part of the body is decorated with gadroons, the low foot also gadrooned. In the middle part of the body a band of ornament with stylised plant leaves, at the junction of the foot and the body a narrow band of ornament with a meander.

works.d: Ovaalse toosi ülaservas kitsas ornamendiriba stiliseeritud lehtedega. Sangadeks lõvimaskaroonid, mille lõugade vahel on rõngas. Võrdlemisi kõrge ovaalne jalg toetub rombikujulisele baasile. Jala serva ümbritseb reljeefsetest loorberilehtedest pärg. Tüvese krae ja kaane võlvuv keskosa on kaetud rõõnetega. Kaane nupuks on ümarplastiline stiliseeritud käbi.
works.de: In the upper edge of the oval box a narrow ornamental strip with stylised leaves. The handles are lion masks, with a ring between their jaws. A relatively high oval foot rests on a rhombus-shaped base. The edge of the foot is surrounded by a wreath of relief laurel leaves. The collar of the stem and the vaulting central part of the lid are covered with fluting. The knob of the lid is a rounded, plastically formed stylised pine cone.

works.d: Toosi alumist poolt ümbritseb reljeefsetest tammelehtedest korv, ülemisele osale on graveeritud ornamendiriba lintide ja stiliseeritud taimdekooriga. Kõrgete sangade ülemine ots on kujundatud reljeefse kalasabana. Ovaalse jala allserva ümbritsevad samuti reljeefsed tammelehed. Jalg toetub rombikujulisele baasile, mis omakorda toetub neljale kuuljalale. Toosi serval segmendikujuline ava lusika jaoks.
works.de: The lower part of the box is surrounded by a basket of relief oak leaves; the upper part is engraved with an ornamental band with ribbons and stylised plant decoration. The upper ends of the tall handles are formed as a relief fish tail. The lower edge of the oval foot is likewise surrounded by relief oak leaves. The foot rests on a rhombus-shaped base, which in turn rests on four hoofed legs. On the edge of the box a segment-shaped opening for a spoon.

works.d: Tirin, selle madal jalg ja kaas on kaunistatud looklevate püstvagudega. Kaane tipus dekoratiivne ümarplastiline roosinupp, mille varre allosas kinnituvad kaanele reljeefsed lehed. Kujult südant meenutavate, taimevartena kujundatud sangade ühenduskohal tirinaga on samuti reljeefsed taimelehed.Ovaalne alusvaagen on lainelise profileeritud servaga, südamekujulised sangad imiteerivad taimevart.
works.de: A tureen, its low foot and lid are decorated with winding vertical grooves. At the top of the lid a decorative, roundly modelled rosebud, at the lower part of whose stem relief leaves attach to the lid. At the joining point with the tureen of the heart-shaped handles, formed as plant stems, there are likewise relief plant leaves. The oval serving plate has a wavy, profiled edge, the heart-shaped handles imitate a plant stem.

works.d:
Osvald Timmas (1913-2005) oli üks kõige tuntumaid eesti eksiilkunstnikke ning Kanada kuningliku kunstiakadeemia liige. Saaremaal sündinud kunstnik õppis 1937-1944 Tartu ülikoolis majandust ja pühendus kunstile alles pärast emigreerumist, Kanadas, 1960. aastatel. 
Timmase peamine ala oli akvarell, milles ta oli väga novaatorlik, kujutas mikro- ja makrostruktuure, veealust maailma, kivimeid jne. Ta rikastas akvarelli tehnikat rauarooste kasutamisega.
1990. aastal oli Adamson-Ericu muuseumis Osvald Timmase isiknäitus. Eesti Kunstimuuseumis leidub 28 teost graafika ja 2 teost maalikogus. Ants ja Lia Juurupi kogust saabunud pärandus 8 Timmase tööga (aastatest 1963-1982) kujutab endast suurepärast
works.de:
Osvald Timmas (1913-2005) was one of the best-known Estonian exile artists and a member of the Royal Canadian Academy of Arts. Born on Saaremaa, the artist studied economics at the University of Tartu in 1937-1944 and devoted himself to art only after emigrating, in Canada, in the 1960s.
Timmas's main field was watercolour, in which he was highly innovative, depicting micro- and macrostructures, the underwater world, rocks, etc. He enriched watercolour technique by using iron rust.
In 1990 the Adamson-Eric Museum held a solo exhibition of Osvald Timmas. The Art Museum of Estonia holds 28 works in the print collection and 2 works in the painting collection. Leonhard Lapini 1972. aasta tuši- ja guašijoonistused „Kägar I“ ja „Kägar II“ ning 1966. aasta kollaaž „Mustamäe“ olid eksponeeritud Kumu kunstimuuseumi avanäitusel 2006-2007.
Need originaaltööd on tuntud arhitekti, kirjaniku ja graafiku varases loomingus erilisel kohal oma otsingulise olemusega, milles on selged seosed popkunstiga.
works.de:
Leonhard Lapin's 1972 ink and gouache drawings "Kägar I" and "Kägar II" and the 1966 collage "Mustamäe" were exhibited at the opening exhibition of the Kumu Art Museum in 2006-2007.
These original works hold a special place in the early oeuvre of the well-known architect, writer and graphic artist due to their exploratory nature, in which clear connections with pop art can be seen.
