works.de: Portrait of a young girl. Hair fluffed on the forehead. Head placed on an open quadrangular pedestal.

works.d: Pikas mantlis  mehe täisfiguur, vasak jalg sammuks ettepoole tõstetud, paremas käes binokkel.
works.de: Full figure of a man in a long coat, left leg raised forward in a step, binoculars in the right hand.

works.d: Talvine loodus, keskplaanil kosk. Paremal raagus põõsas. Kose kohale kaardub suur raagus puu.
works.de: Winter landscape, a waterfall in the middle ground. A bare bush on the right. A large bare tree arches over the waterfall.

works.dm: laius: 34.0 cm; kõrgus: 17.0 cm; sügavus: 13.2 cm
works.d: Kätega trepile toetuva lamava naise figuur. Naise käte vahel imik. Temast paremal kössi tõmbunud väike poiss
works.de: Figure of a lying woman leaning on the stairs with her hands. An infant between the woman's arms. To her right a small boy crouched up

works.d: Eesti väljapaistvate kunstnike Ants Laikmaa ja Erich Lepsi tööd
works.de: Works by outstanding Estonian artists Ants Laikmaa and Erich Lepsi

works.d: Täisfiguur. Raudrüüs punase mantliga, mille servad on palistatud hermeliiniga. Parem käsi kõrvale välja sirutatud ja vasak toetumas puusale. All paremas nurgas annetajate nimed ja vapid.
works.de: Full figure. In armour with a red cloak, the edges of which are trimmed with ermine. Right hand extended to the side and left resting on the hip. At lower right corner the names and coats of arms of the donors.

works.t: Rinde tagalas. Eesti Laskur Deviisi sõdurid teed ehitamas suvel 1943 (Tšaharkino külas)
works.d: Figuraalne kompositsioon maastikus. Kõrge horisont. Väikesed lagunenud vene küla hooned tagapool. Esiplaanil ja keskplaanil rokesti sõdurite figuure, kes on tegelemas palkide kandmisega, kaevamisega jmt. Esiplaanil paremal kolm sõdurit suurt kivi kangutamas. Tekst tagaküljel: Rinde tagalas Eesti L. Diviisi sõdurid teed ehitamas suvel 1943 (Tšaharkino külas)
works.de: A figural composition in a landscape. High horizon. Small dilapidated buildings of a Russian village further back. In the foreground and middle ground, Rokesti [sic] soldiers' figures engaged in carrying logs, digging, etc. In the foreground on the right, three soldiers levering a large stone. Text on the back: Soldiers of the Estonian L. Division building a road in the rear of the front in the summer of 1943 (in the village of Tšaharkino)

works.d: Vasakul ja paremal suured akantuselehed. Keskel vapikilp, millel kolm lõvi kroonidega peas. Kilbi kohal kiiver ja selle peal kroon, mis on aluseks seisvale naisefiguurile.
works.de: Large acanthus leaves on the left and right. In the center a coat of arms shield, on which three lions with crowns on their heads. Above the shield a helmet and on it a crown, which serves as a base for a standing female figure.

works.d: Tallinna magistraadi alamkohtu uksepealdis. Polükroomne puitnikerdus. Väänlevatest lehtedest piiratud ovaalsel tahvlil tekst: "1646. Gott gebet den Richten/.../  Tahvlit kroonib Justitia figuur.
works.de: Door lintel of the Tallinn Magistrate's Lower Court. Polychrome wood carving. On an oval panel bordered by winding leaves, text: "1646. Gott gebet den Richten/.../ The panel is crowned by a figure of Justitia.

works.t: Detail pingi külgtoest Veronika räti kujutisega
works.d: Polükroomne puunikerdus. Reljeefse Kristuse palgega stiliseeritud rätt, mida hoiab käes naine.
works.de: Polychrome wood carving. A stylised cloth with the relief face of Christ, held by a woman.

works.d: Nikolai II täispikkuses portree. Seisab teel, maastiku taustal, vasak käsi toetumas mõõgale.
works.de: Full-length portrait of Nicholas II. He stands on a road, against a landscape background, his left hand resting on a sword.

works.t: Keila-Joa loss ja park (21 vaadet ühel lehel)
works.d: 21 Keila-Joa mõisa ja pargi vaadet. Keskel vaade lossile jõe vastaskaldalt. Keskese suurema vaate ümber 20 väiksemat vaadet pargirajatistest ja enrinevatest mõisaansamblisse kuuluvatest hoonetest.
works.de: 21 views of Keila-Joa manor and park. In the centre, a view of the manor house from the opposite bank of the river. Around the larger central view, 20 smaller views of park structures and various buildings belonging to the manor ensemble.

works.d: Puuskulptuur, mis kuulub raekoja pingi (Simson ja Delila külglaua otsa). Mehe pea.
works.de: Wooden sculpture belonging to the town hall bench (end of the side table depicting Samson and Delilah). Head of a man.

works.d: Dekoratsioonikavand. Esiplaanil kolm mändi, nende taga lainetav meri. Puude ladvad on pildi äärega lõigatud.
works.de: Set design sketch. In the foreground three pines, behind them a rippling sea. The tops of the trees are cut off by the edge of the picture.

works.d: Vaade Tallinnale Tartu maanteelt Lasnamäelt. Esiplaanil vasakult paremale alla linna suunduval teel kelpkatustega valge hoone. Vasakul kivist aiaga piiratud nõlvakul kariloomad, tagaplaanil puid. Taamal Tallinna linna siluett.
works.de: View of Tallinn from Tartu Road on Lasnamäe. In the foreground, on the road going from left to right down towards the town, a white building with hipped roofs. On the left, on a slope enclosed by a stone fence, livestock; trees in the background. In the distance, the silhouette of the city of Tallinn.

works.dm: laius: 97.5 cm; kõrgus: 194.0 cm; laius: 99.0 cm; kõrgus: 190.0 cm
works.d: Rootsi kuninganna Kristiina täisfiguuriga portree. Ruumis musta-valge ruuduline põrand ja kuninganna seismas akna all, paremas käes riigiõun, vasak käsi sirutatud akna suunas ja osutab sealt paistvale linnale. Pildil võib aimata ülemaalitud valitsuskepi piirjooni.
works.de: Full-figure portrait of Queen Kristina of Sweden. In the room a black-and-white checkered floor and the queen standing under a window, an orb in her right hand, left hand extended towards the window and pointing to the town visible from there. The outline of an overpainted sceptre can be discerned in the picture.

works.d: Esiplaanil riba paeastanguäärsest. Järsaku all paisavad Kadrioru hooned, paremal meri ja vasakul linn sadamast Tõnismäe veskini.
works.de: In the foreground a strip of limestone slope edge. Below the cliff the buildings of Kadriorg spread out, on the right the sea and on the left the town from the harbour to the Tõnismäe mill.

works.d: Pikas kleidis, seisev naisefiguur, käed tõstetud rinnale, pea kergelt langetatud, silmad suletud.
works.de: A standing female figure in a long dress, hands raised to the chest, head slightly lowered, eyes closed.

works.d: Maali esiplaanil stiliseeritud mehe ja naise pead. Naise nägu on eespool, silmad suletud, punakad juuksed tõmmatud külgedelt ette. Tumedajuukselise mehe pea on tagapool, huuled surutud naise oimukohta. Taustaks stiliseeritud dekoratiivsed taimed ja suur oranž päikeseketas.
works.de: In the foreground of the painting, stylised heads of a man and a woman. The woman's face is in front, eyes closed, reddish hair pulled forward from the sides. The dark-haired man's head is behind, lips pressed to the woman's temple. The background features stylised decorative plants and a large orange solar disc.

works.d: Dekoratsioonikavand. Vasakul mõned kuused, paremal tugevate juurtega mänd. Nende vahel veekogu.
works.de: Set design sketch. On the left some spruce trees, on the right a pine with strong roots. Between them a body of water.

works.d: Nurrev naine pea käte vahel toetumas alusele jalad põlvest kõverdatud, nägu peidetud käte ja aluse vahele.
works.de: A grumbling woman with her head between her hands, resting on a base, legs bent at the knee, face hidden between the hands and the base.

works.d: Vasakul ja paremal tagumistel käppadel seisvad lõvid. Esikäppade vahel vapikilp Püha Mauritiuse kujutisega. All lint, millel tekst: AUT VINCENDUM AUT MORIENDUM
works.de: Lions standing on their hind paws on the left and right. Between the front paws a coat of arms shield with the depiction of Saint Mauritius. Below, a ribbon with the text: AUT VINCENDUM AUT MORIENDUM

works.d: Aleksander II mundris paraadportree maastiku taustal. Parem käsi tõstetud vöökohale, vasakus kiiver.
works.de: Parade portrait of Aleksander II in uniform against a landscape background. Right hand raised to waist level, a helmet in the left.

works.d: Lenini portree, 3/4 profiilis paremale, tumedas ülikonnas, valge särgi ja tumeda lipsuga
works.de: Portrait of Lenin, 3/4 profile to the right, in a dark suit, white shirt and dark tie

works.d: Maalil EV väljakuulutamine Päästekomitee poolt 1918. aastal. Sesavad: Jüri Vilms, Konstantin Päts ja Konstantin Konik. Päts keskel, parem käsi ette sirutatud, teises käes paberileht. Neid ümbritsevad kuulavad inimesed. Kolmikust vasakul rahva hulgas Jaan Poska. Tagaplaanil ümarkaarsed aknad.
works.de: In the painting, the proclamation of the Republic of Estonia by the Salvation Committee in 1918. Depicted are: Jüri Vilms, Konstantin Päts and Konstantin Konik. Päts in the middle, his right hand stretched forward, in the other hand a sheet of paper. They are surrounded by listening people. To the left of the trio, among the people, Jaan Poska. In the background, round-arched windows.

works.d: Vaade tuledes linnale. Esiplaanil kõndivad ja rinnatisele toetudes linna vaatavad inimesed. Taamal värvikirev linn, tornide ja majade siluettidega.
works.de: View of a city in lights. In the foreground people walking and looking at the city while leaning on a railing. In the distance a colourful city with silhouettes of towers and houses.

works.d: Kostüümikavand mehele. Sinepikarva jakk, tumesinised, laiad püksid, valge karvamüts. Mehe vasak käsi toetub mõõgale.
works.de: Costume design for a man. Mustard-coloured jacket, dark blue wide trousers, white fur hat. The man's left hand rests on a sword.

works.d: Esiplaanil tee ja selle äärsed puud, paremal servas bastion, keskel madalad hooned ja puiestee, mille taga paistab Kaarli kirik.
works.de: In the foreground a road and trees along it, on the right edge a bastion, in the middle low buildings and an avenue, behind which Kaarli Church is visible.

works.d: Vaade Pärnu maanteele Tallinna Vineeri- ja Mööblivabriku piirkonnas. Esiplaanil tänava ääres lammutamisele minevad madalad puumajad, nende taga kõrgemad nn. hruštšovkad.
works.de: View of Pärnu Highway in the area of the Tallinn Plywood and Furniture Factory. In the foreground, low wooden houses along the street awaiting demolition, behind them taller so-called "khrushchyovkas".

works.d: Linnaväljak, millel inimesed. Teipool väljakut, pildi keskel tumepruun kõrge maja (praegune linnavalitsuse hoone), vasakul praegune Vene teater. Paremal haljasala.
works.de: A town square with people on it. Beyond the square, in the middle of the picture, a tall dark-brown building (currently the city government building), on the left the current Vene Theatre. On the right a green area.

works.d: Vaade lauluväljaku juurest Tallinna vanalinna suunas. Esiplaanil maastik, kus paistab laulukaar ja puude vahel majad. Tagapool meri. Merest paremal vanalinna tumelilla siluett.
works.de: View from near the Song Festival Grounds towards Tallinn Old Town. In the foreground a landscape where the song festival arch is visible and houses among trees. Beyond it the sea. To the right of the sea the dark purple silhouette of the Old Town.

works.d: Esiplaanil lumine, kõrgete raagus puudega haljasala, kus jalutavad inimesed. Veidi tagapool autotee ja teispool teed vanalinn. Paremal Suur Rannavärav, mille taga kõrgub Oleviste. Rannaväravast vasakul vanalinna majad.
works.de: In the foreground a snowy green area with tall bare trees, where people are walking. Slightly further back a road, and across the road the Old Town. On the right the Great Coastal Gate [Suur Rannavärav], behind which St. Olaf's Church [Oleviste] rises. Left of the Coastal Gate the buildings of the Old Town.

works.d: Vaade Kadrioru lossile ja selle esisele platsile. Pildi keskel loss vaadatuna luigetiigi poolsest küljest. Lossi ümber suured puud.
works.de: View of Kadriorg Palace and the square in front of it. In the center of the picture the palace, viewed from the side of the swan pond. Large trees around the palace.

works.t: Kujundus H. Leberechti raamatu "Valgus Koordis" sisekaantele
works.d: Sotsrealistlik idüll. Esiplaanil helgete nägudega mees ja naine, nende ümber õitsvad puud ja taamal künnab traktor sulni mürina saatel põldu
works.de: A socialist-realist idyll. In the foreground a man and woman with radiant faces, around them blossoming trees, and in the distance a tractor ploughing a field to the accompaniment of a gentle hum.

works.d: Pildi esiplaanil, vaataja poole seljaga turuleti ees seisvad inimesed, teispool letti baretiga müüja
works.de: In the foreground of the picture, people standing with their backs to the viewer in front of a market stall, on the other side of the counter a seller wearing a beret

works.d: Esiplaanil rannaäärne tee Kadriorus, illel jalutajad, vasakul kõrged puud, paremal põõsad ja nende taga meri. Teispool lahte vanalinna tume siluett
works.de: In the foreground a seaside path in Kadriorg, strollers on it, tall trees on the left, bushes on the right and the sea behind them. On the other side of the bay the dark silhouette of the Old Town

works.d: Pildil vaade raekoja platsile, esiplaanil Kullassepa tänava algus ja raekoda, millest vasakul, teisel pool platsi majad.
works.de: The picture shows a view of the Town Hall Square, in the foreground the beginning of Kullassepa Street and the Town Hall, to the left of which, on the other side of the square, buildings.

works.t: Vaade Toompealt Balti jaamale ja Kalinini rajoonile
works.d: Vaade ülalt Snelli tiigi äärsele pargile ja Balti jaamale. Esiplaanil tiik ja park raagus puudega, tagapool tänav, mille ääres paremal pool jaamahoone. Pildi pöördel tekst: Karl Burman junior "Vaade Toompäält Balti jaamale ja Kalinini rajoonile" Akvarell Hind rbl. 3000.-
works.de: View from above of the park by Snelli Pond and the Balti Jaam (Baltic Station). In the foreground the pond and park with bare trees, behind it a street, along which on the right side stands the station building. On the verso of the picture, text: Karl Burman junior "View from Toompea to the Baltic Station and the Kalinin District" Watercolour Price rbl. 3000.-

works.d: Pildil kitsas, pildi sügavusse kulgev tänav, tänava lõpus paistab Nikolai Imetegija kirik ja selle kuppel, mille taga Oleviste kiriku torn. Tänaval seisavad vastamisi kaks inimest.
works.de: The picture shows a narrow street receding into the depth of the picture, at the end of the street the Church of St. Nicholas the Wonderworker and its dome can be seen, behind which the tower of Oleviste Church. Two people stand facing each other on the street.

works.d: Esiplaanil kõrge väravakaare alt läbi kulgev munakivisillutisega tänav. Teispool väravat paistab ristmik ja selle ääres oleva maja uks ning osaliselt ka aknad. Ukse kõrval tänavavalgustuslatern.
works.de: In the foreground, a cobblestone-paved street running through under a high gateway arch. Beyond the gate, a crossroads is visible, along with the door and partly also the windows of a house at its edge. A street lamp beside the door.

works.d: 2/3 lehest katab kavand, millel kujutatud rannapromenaadi, kovikute ja jalutusteedega. Esiplaanil vaatetorniga muul. Pildi all eesti ja venekeelne tekst: Tallinna mereäärne park. Vaade lehelt.
works.de: 2/3 of the sheet is covered by a design depicting a seaside promenade, pavilions and walking paths. In the foreground, a pier with a lookout tower. Below the picture, Estonian and Russian text: Tallinn seaside park. View from the sheet.

works.d: Glehni neogooti stiilse lossi vaade. Esiplaanil lossiesine plats rohu ja jalgradadega. Loss ise raagus puude vahel pildi keskel.
works.de: View of Glehn's neo-Gothic castle. In the foreground the square in front of the castle with grass and footpaths. The castle itself amid bare trees in the middle of the picture.

works.d: Ülaltvaade praeguse Viru väljaku ala planeerinugle. Paremal Narva maantee, keskel Keskväljak raekojaga, vasakul kultuuri- ja haldushooned, tagapool vanalinn.
works.de: Aerial view of the planning of the area of the present Viru Square. On the right Narva Road, in the centre Central Square with the town hall, on the left culture and administrative buildings, in the background the Old Town.

works.t: Vaade Tallinna vanalinnale Paksu Margareeta poolt
works.d: Esiplaanil Rannaväravamägi. Paremal Paks Margareeta ja selle juurest vasakult paremale kulgev hooneterivi. Majade tagant paistab Oleviste kirik. Diagonaalselt üle pildi elektritraadid
works.de: In the foreground Rannavärava Hill. On the right Paks Margareeta and next to it a row of buildings running from left to right. Oleviste Church can be seen behind the houses. Electric wires diagonally across the picture.

works.d: Taani kuninga aed, esiplaanil all-linna kohal plats, millel kaks raagus puud, taamal paistab märtsipommitamisest räsitud linn, varemetes Niguliste kirikuga.
works.de: The garden of the Danish king, in the foreground a square above the lower town, on which two bare trees, in the distance the town battered by the March bombing is visible, in ruins, with St. Nicholas' Church.

works.d: Vasakul neli torni tihedas reas. Pildi keskel õu, mille ääres väikesed majad. Tagapool paistab Toompea. Pildi vasakus servas puu.
works.de: On the left four towers in a dense row. In the centre of the picture a courtyard, bordered by small houses. Toompea is visible behind. In the left margin of the picture a tree.

works.d: Vaade Toompea nõlvale Pika Hermanni torni juures. Paremal kõrged puud, neist vasakul, pildi keskel, Pikk Hermann ja osaliselt paistev Toompea kindlus.
works.de: View of the slope of Toompea by the Tall Hermann tower. On the right tall trees, to the left of them, in the middle of the picture, Tall Hermann and the partially visible Toompea fortress.

works.d: Pildi paremal poolel Kiek in de Köki torn, vasakul puude vahel kulgev Komandandi tänav. Tagaplaanil Pikk Hermann. Pildi all tekst: Handsteindruck
works.de: On the right side of the picture, the Kiek in de Kök tower, on the left, Komandandi Street running between the trees. In the background, Pikk Hermann. Below the picture, text: Handsteindruck

works.d: Vaade Toompealt all-linnale. Kolmnurksete otsaviiludega majade katused ja Pühavaimu kiriku torn
works.de: View of the lower town from Toompea. Roofs of houses with triangular gables and the tower of the Church of the Holy Spirit

works.d: Pildil Toompea. Esiplaanil majad, nende tagant paistab Toomkiriku katus ning torn.
works.de: The picture shows Toompea. In the foreground houses, behind which the roof and tower of the Dome Church (Toomkirik) can be seen.

works.d: Toompea linnuse vaade loode suunast. Esiplaanil puud-põõsad, nende kohal keskel linnuse loodenurk Pika Hermanni torn riigilipuga. Lehe koloriit rohekas. All tekst: Tallinn. Toompea linnus. Ofort II 17/100
works.de: View of Toompea Castle from the northwest. Trees and bushes in the foreground, above them in the middle the northwest corner of the castle, the Pikk Hermann tower with the national flag. The colouring of the sheet is greenish. Below, text: Tallinn. Toompea linnus. Etching II 17/100

works.d: Kitsas õu, vasakul müür ronitaimedega, paremal maja. Keske, hoovis oleva jalgraja lõpus uks, mis viib väikesesse hoovimajja. Pildi all tekst: Hoov Laial tänaval
works.de: A narrow courtyard, on the left a wall with climbing plants, on the right a house. In the middle, at the end of a footpath in the courtyard, a door leading to a small courtyard building. Below the picture the text: Hoov Laial tänaval [Courtyard on Lai Street]

works.d: Pika Jala tänav. Kahel pool kõrged müürid, pildi keskel väravatorn ja majad, selle tagant paistab Oleviste kirik.
works.de: Pikk Jalg Street. High walls on both sides, in the middle of the picture a gate tower and houses, behind which St. Olaf's Church is visible.

works.d: Õu vanalinnas. Esiplaanil madalad majad ja väike puust kuur. Hoonete tagant paistab Toomkiriku torn
works.de: A courtyard in the old town. In the foreground, low houses and a small wooden shed. Behind the buildings, the tower of Toomkirik is visible

works.d: Pildil Uue tänava lõpp, vasakul sein ja paremal puu. Keskel madalad majad, mille kohal nõlval kõrgemad hooned ja Oleviste kiriku torn. Pildi all tekst: "Vana Tallinn" linool
works.de: In the picture the end of Uue Street, on the left a wall and on the right a tree. In the centre low houses, above which on the slope are taller buildings and the tower of St. Olaf's Church. Below the picture, text: "Vana Tallinn" linool

works.d: Pildil kitsas tänav (Katariina käik), millest kahel pool hooned. Üle tänava katusekividega kaetud tugikaared.
works.de: In the picture a narrow street (Katariina käik), with buildings on both sides. Across the street support arches covered with roof tiles.

works.d: Vaade Taani kuninga aeda. Keskosas kaks suurt puud, vasakul servas Lühikese Jala tänavale viiv värav ja majad. Paremal All-linna majade katused. All tekst: Vana Tallinn ofort
works.de: View of the Danish King's Garden. In the centre two large trees, on the left edge the gate leading to Lühikese Jala street and houses. On the right the roofs of the Lower Town houses. Below, text: Vana Tallinn ofort

works.d: Jalgrattaga sõitvad valgetes kleitides ja valge rätiga naised. Pildi all tekst: "Hommikul" Õ. Eelmaa 1962 a
works.de: Women in white dresses and white headscarves riding bicycles. Text below the picture: "Hommikul" Õ. Eelmaa 1962 a

works.d: Esiplaanil saviauk, selle paremal servas ekskavaator ja vasakul vagunid. Sinkakashall üldtoon, taevas ja veepeegeldused rohekad. All tekst: Savikarjäär. värviline linoollõige
works.de: In the foreground a clay pit, on its right edge an excavator and on the left wagons. Zinc-grey overall tone, sky and water reflections greenish. Below, text: Savikarjäär. värviline linoollõige

works.d: Pildil valge lumelagendik, mille ees kolm kuuske ja kolm last, teisel pool lagendikku oranž maja, mille kõrval kaks raagus puud.
works.de: The picture shows a white snowy clearing, in front of it three spruces and three children, on the other side of the clearing an orange house, beside which two bare trees.

works.d: Violetse taeva taustal helesinine jääväli, millel usiutamas kolm värvikirevates rõivastes last.
works.de: Against a violet sky, a light blue ice field on which three children in colourful clothing are skating.

works.d: Keset lehte külgvaates pruun karu, tema ümber rohekates toonides mets
works.de: In the center of the sheet, a brown bear in side view, surrounded by a forest in greenish tones

works.d: Pildil suure akna all, laua taga istuv koolivormis tüdruk joonistamas
works.de: In the picture, a girl in a school uniform sitting at a table under a large window, drawing

works.d: Jänes lillede vahel
works.de: Hare among flowers

works.d: Kiviplaadil seisev naisakt, parem käsi peegliga üles tõstetud, pilk suunatud peeglisse. Vasak käsi kausiga langetatud. All rokokoolikus kartuššis autori nimi ja daatum
works.de: A female nude standing on a stone slab, right hand raised holding a mirror, gaze directed into the mirror. Left hand lowered holding a basin. Below, in a rococo-style cartouche, the author's name and date

works.d: Tallinna Toompea ja vanalinna aksonomeetriline vaade edela suunast. Esiplaanil Toompea linnus Pika Hermanni tornig, tagapool kõigi Tallinna vanalinna kirikute tornid. Taamal meri purjelaevadega. Lehe ülaosas linna suur vapp, lint tekstiga "Tallinn" ja suur ning väike vapp. Lehe alumises vasakus nurgas linna pitsat ja tekstid. Alla kirjutatud: Tallinn II sügavtrükk 23/100
works.de: An axonometric view of Tallinn's Toompea and the Old Town from the southwest. In the foreground, Toompea Castle with the Tall Hermann Tower, behind it the towers of all the churches of Tallinn's Old Town. In the background, the sea with sailing ships. At the top of the sheet, the large coat of arms of the city, a ribbon with the text "Tallinn" and the large and small coats of arms. In the lower left corner of the sheet, the city's seal and texts. Below is written: Tallinn II gravure 23/100

works.d: Tume karukujutis
works.de: Dark bear figure

works.d: Sadama akvatoorium, esiplaanil vasakul purjelaeva vööritääv, paremal raudlaev, mille taga väiksem puksiir. Tumedal taustal Oleviste siluett.
works.de: The harbour waters, in the foreground on the left the bow of a sailing ship, on the right an iron ship, behind which a smaller tugboat. Against the dark background the silhouette of Oleviste.

works.d: Öine rannamaastik, esiplaanil tumedad majade siluetid, taamal meri. Horisont kõrge, taevas tume, must ja lilla. Tagaküljel Kunstiinstituudi metoodilise fondi etikett.
works.de: Nocturnal seaside landscape, dark silhouettes of houses in the foreground, the sea beyond. High horizon, dark sky, black and purple. On the verso the label of the Art Institute's methodological fund.

works.d: Tallinn Tornide väljak nelja linnamüüri torniga ja Oleviste kiriku siluetiga tagaplaanil. Pildi all paremas nurgas iri TALLINN. All vasakul: "Tallinn. Tornide väljak" puugravüür 1963
works.de: Tallinn, Tornide väljak with four town-wall towers and the silhouette of Oleviste Church in the background. In the lower right corner of the picture the inscription TALLINN. Lower left: "Tallinn. Tornide väljak" woodcut 1963

works.d: Esiplaanil Toompea lossi hoov Riigikogu hoone fassaadiga. Tagaplaanil linna põhjaosa toomkiriku ja Oleviste kiriku tornidega, taamal meri. Lehe koloriit rohekas. Alla kirjutatud: Tallinna vaade Pikk-Hermanni tornist. Ofort 26/100
works.de: In the foreground the courtyard of Toompea Castle with the facade of the Riigikogu building. In the background the northern part of the city with the towers of the Dome Church and St. Olaf's Church, the sea in the distance. The colouring of the sheet is greenish. Below written: View of Tallinn from Pikk Hermann Tower. Etching 26/100

works.d: aluspaberile kleebitud must paber, millel kavand. Kavandil on kujutatud kõrgel soklil ratsamonumenti, mille ees sepisvõre
works.de: black paper glued onto a backing paper, with a design. The design depicts an equestrian monument on a high plinth, in front of it a wrought-iron grille

works.d: Tumbal istuva naise figuur, seljas avar trapeeritud seelik, peas rätt, vasak käsi toetab raamatut, parem käsi tema juures lugeva lapse õlgadel.
works.de: Figure of a woman sitting on a stool, wearing a full draped skirt, a headscarf, her left hand resting on a book, her right hand on the shoulders of a child reading beside her.

works.d: Kivist alusele nõjatuv puto, seljaga vaataja suunas. Vasakus käes vibu, parem toetumas kiviblokile. Puto taga sambabaas ning vaas taimega
works.de: A putto leaning on a stone base, back turned towards the viewer. In his left hand a bow, right hand resting on a stone block. Behind the putto a column base and a vase with a plant.

works.d: Arhitektuursetel detailidel istuv naine. Vasakus käes kivitahvel, paremas raamat, rinna kohal lendav tuvi. Pilk suunatud ülesse.
works.de: A woman sitting on architectural details. In her left hand a stone tablet, in her right a book, above her chest a flying dove. Her gaze directed upward.

works.t: Lavakujundus A. Jakobsoni "Kaitseingel Nebraskast" III vaatus
works.d: Rohelises papist paspartuus lavakujunduse kavand etendusele "Kaitseingel Nebraskast". Kavandi ülaosas tekst: Kirjutake nõnda, et ükskõik kes usuks ükskõik mida". Ruumis on kujutatud paremal kirjutuslauda, vasakul diivanit ja malelauamustris põrandat. Tekst paspartuul: A. Jakobson "Kaitseingel Nebraskast" III vaatus
works.de: In a green cardboard mount, a stage design sketch for the production "Kaitseingel Nebraskast" ["Guardian Angel from Nebraska"]. At the top of the sketch the text: "Write so that anyone would believe anything". The room depicts a writing desk on the right, a sofa on the left and a chessboard-patterned floor. Text on the mount: A. Jakobson "Kaitseingel Nebraskast" Act III

works.d: Toompea linnuse läänekülje vaade loodest alates Pilstickerist kuni Pika Hermanini. Esiplaanil puud. Lehe koloriit - sinakas. Alla kirjutatud: Tallinn Toompea linnus kevadel. Ofort ja akvatinta
works.de: View of the western side of Toompea Castle from the northwest, from Pilsticker to Pikk Hermann. Trees in the foreground. The colouring of the sheet - bluish. Inscribed below: Tallinn Toompea Castle in spring. Etching and aquatint

works.d: Pildil heledal taustal tumeda siluetina laevad, sadamakraanad, vintsid jne. Tekst lehel: "Sadam" linoollõige
works.de: In the picture, ships, harbour cranes, winches etc. as dark silhouettes against a light background. Text on the sheet: "Sadam" linocut

works.d: Rohelisse paspartuusse kleebitud kostüümikavand tegelasele Samuel. Ruudulises ülikonnas, prillidega mees, lilla vestiga, ning taskust pasitva uuriketiga. Paspartuul kiri: A. Jakobson "Kaitseingel Nebraskast" 1964
works.de: Costume design pasted onto a green mount for the character Samuel. A man in a checked suit, with glasses, a purple waistcoat, and a watch chain peeking out of his pocket. Inscription on the mount: A. Jakobson "Kaitseingel Nebraskast" 1964

works.d: Rohelisest papist paspartuusse kleebitud kostüümikavand tegelasele Linnapea. Violetsest ülikonnas jalutuskepiga, pikkade vuntside ja kaabuga mees. Paspartuul kiri: A. Jakobson "Kaitseingel Nebraskast". Pildi ülal tekst: Linnapea
works.de: Costume design for the character Linnapea, glued onto a green cardboard mount. A man in a violet suit with a walking stick, long moustache and a hat. Inscription on the mount: A. Jakobson "Kaitseingel Nebraskast". Text above the picture: Linnapea

works.d: Pallil seisva lapse figuur, vasakus käes sarv, millest pudeneb raha ja aumärke, paremas kepp, silmad lindiga kinni seotud. Tagaplaanil maastik puude ja kindlusega.
works.de: Figure of a child standing on a ball, in the left hand a horn from which money and medals are falling, in the right hand a stick, eyes blindfolded with a ribbon. In the background a landscape with trees and a fortress.

works.d: Oleviste kiriku, Suure-Rannavärava ja ümbruse vaade lõuna suunas. tagaplaanil näha Stoltingi, raekoja, Pühavaimu kiriku ja Niguliste kiriku tornid ning Nevski katedraali, Pikk- Hermanni ja Toomkiriku tornid.  Lehe koloriit - rohekas.
works.de: View of the Oleviste Church, the Great Coastal Gate (Suur-Rannavärav) and its surroundings, looking south. In the background the towers of Stolting, the town hall, the Church of the Holy Spirit and St. Nicholas' Church, and the Nevsky Cathedral, the Pikk Hermann tower and the Dome Church towers can be seen. The colouring of the sheet is greenish.

works.d: Kolme õe fassaadid Tallinnas Pikk 71 vaadatuna loode suunas. Esiplaanil lõik tänavasillutist. Lehe koloriit pruunikas. Alla kirjutatud: Kolm õde Tallinnas sügavtrükk 21/100
works.de: The facades of the Three Sisters in Tallinn at Pikk 71, viewed from the northwest. In the foreground a section of street paving. The colouring of the sheet brownish. Below, written: Kolm õde Tallinnas sügavtrükk 21/100

works.d: Vaade linnamüürile Taani kuninga aiast. Keskel Neitsitorn, sellest kahel pool linnamüür kaitsekäiguga ja vasemal lehe serval Kiek in de Kök. Lehe koloriit rohekas. All tekst: Tallinna linnamüür Neitsitorniga Ofort 100/100
works.de: View of the town wall from the Danish King's Garden. In the centre the Virgin's Tower [Neitsitorn], on both sides of it the town wall with a defensive walk, and on the left edge of the sheet Kiek in de Kök. The colouring of the sheet is greenish. Text below: Tallinna linnamüür Neitsitorniga Ofort 100/100

works.d: Vaade linnamüürile Gustav Adolfi Gümnaasiumi hoovis edela suunas. Keskel Saunatorn, vasakul Nunnatorn. Selle kõrval läbikäik linnamüüris. Lehe koloriit rohekas. All tekst: Tallinna linnamüür Nunnaväravaga. Ofort 97/100
works.de: View of the town wall in the courtyard of Gustav Adolf Gymnasium, facing southwest. In the centre the Sauna Tower [Saunatorn], on the left the Nuns' Tower [Nunnatorn]. Next to it a passage through the town wall. The colouring of the sheet is greenish. Text below: Tallinna linnamüür Nunnaväravaga. Ofort 97/100

works.d: Tumesinisel laual roosa alpikann kollaste lehtedega. All tekst: Alpikann litograafia.
works.de: On a dark blue table a pink alpine bellflower with yellow leaves. Below text: Alpikann litograafia.

works.d: Pildil triipudega kollakas kohvikann, sellest paremal oranž lillepott kaktusega. All tekst: "Natüürmort" linool 62. a. Klar
works.de: In the picture a yellowish striped coffee pot, to its right an orange flowerpot with a cactus. Below the text: "Natüürmort" [Still life] linocut 62. a. Klar

works.d: Kostüümikavand, millel kujutatud punase särgi ja musta mantliga meest, vasak käsi toetumas mõõgale, peas karvamüts
works.de: Costume design depicting a man in a red shirt and black coat, left hand resting on a sword, wearing a fur hat.

works.d: Kostüümikavand naisele. Tumesinine seelik ja pluus, veidi heledam jakk. Peas lilla rätik.
works.de: Costume design for a woman. Dark blue skirt and blouse, a slightly lighter jacket. On the head a purple scarf.

works.d: Kännul istuv meesakt. Paremas käes nool, kaelas jahisarv vasak käsi toetub kännule. Mehe kõrval jahikoer.
works.de: Male nude sitting on a stump. In his right hand an arrow, a hunting horn around his neck, his left hand resting on the stump. Beside the man a hunting dog.

works.d: Toompea vaade ida suunas. Esiplaanil puud ja põõsad. Tagaplaanil keskel hoone Toom-Kooli tn 21 läänefassaad, sellest paremal Toomkiriku torn ja vasakul osa hoone Toom-Kooli tn 23 fassaadist. Lehe koloriit rohekas. All tekst: Tallinn Toomkirikuga Ofort 79/100
works.de: View of Toompea looking east. In the foreground trees and bushes. In the background, in the middle, the west facade of the building at Toom-Kooli St. 21, to its right the tower of the Dome Church and to the left part of the facade of the building at Toom-Kooli St. 23. The sheet's coloring greenish. Below, text: Tallinn Toomkirikuga Ofort 79/100

works.d: Kostüümikavand, millel palju tegelasi. Ees paremal kolm pikkades mustades rüüdes preestrit. Neist vasakul tumepuastes hõlstides mehed, kes hoiavad hallides kaltsudes vange kettide otsas.
works.de: Costume design with many characters. In front on the right three priests in long black robes. To their left, men in dark cloth cassocks, holding prisoners in grey rags on the ends of chains.

works.d: Kostüümikavand. Pildil kõvera mõõgaga ja punaste laiade pükstega mees. Seljas oranž särk ja valge vest, mille ümber kuldne vöö. Peas valge karvamüts türkiissinise kaunistusega.
works.de: Costume design. In the picture a man with a curved sword and wide red trousers. Wearing an orange shirt and a white vest, around which a golden belt. On the head a white fur hat with turquoise-blue decoration.

works.d: Vaade Toompeale edela suunas. Esiplaanil puud, nende kohal Toompea majad. Tagaplaanil keskel Pika Hermanni torn, sellest paremal Toomkirik ja vasakul Aleksander Nevski katedraal. Lehe koloriit pruumikas. All tekst: Tallinn. Vaade Toompeale. Ofort. 60/100
works.de: View of Toompea looking southwest. In the foreground trees, above them the houses of Toompea. In the background, in the centre, the Tall Hermann tower, to its right the Dome Church and to the left the Alexander Nevsky Cathedral. The sheet's coloring brownish. Below, text: Tallinn. Vaade Toompeale. Ofort. 60/100

works.d: Esiplaanil Toompea hooned taga Niguliste kiriku torn. Taamal hotell "Olümpia". Lehe koloriit pruumikas. Alla kirjutatud: Tallinn. Vaade Nigulistega. Ofort 9/100
works.de: In the foreground the buildings of Toompea, behind them the tower of St. Nicholas' Church (Niguliste). In the distance the hotel "Olümpia". The colouring of the sheet is brownish. Written below: Tallinn. Vaade Nigulistega [View with Niguliste]. Ofort 9/100

works.d: Kostüümikavand kahele nunnarüüs naisele. Pildil kaks tumedas pikas rüüs naist, kes hoiavad käes ikoone. Peas rätid.
works.de: Costume design for two women in nun's habits. In the picture two women in long dark robes, holding icons in their hands. Scarves on their heads.

works.d: Palvetav meesakt. Ühele põlvele laskunud, küünarnukk toetumas suurele kivikvaadrile, kivi taga puu külge seotud rist.
works.de: Praying male nude. Kneeling on one knee, elbow resting on a large stone block, behind the stone a cross tied to a tree.

works.d: Lehe keskel ovaal, milles kaks putofiguuri. Vasakpoolne, püsti seisev puto seob parempoolse põlvitava puto tiiba.
works.de: In the middle of the sheet an oval, in which two putti figures. The left one, standing upright, binds the wing of the kneeling putto on the right.

works.d: Pildil vette astuv naine, seljas punutud korv, miles laps, teine, suurem laps naisest vasakul. Lapse käes pambud. Nende seljataga põõsastik
works.de: In the picture, a woman stepping into the water, wearing a woven basket on her back with a child in it, another, older child to the left of the woman. The child holds bundles. Behind them, shrubbery

works.d: Lugev meesakt, vasakul suur raamat, mille all kolju, raamatu kohale püstitatud roigastest kokku pandud rist.
works.de: Reading male nude, on the left a large book, under it a skull, above the book a cross made of poles.

works.d: Aluspaberile kleebitud detailid gravüürist. Ovaalse raami sees profiilis mehe portree, selle all vasakul ja paremal, meistrite nimed ning ovaali alla keskele kleebitud pildil kujutatud mehe nimega silt
works.de: Details from an engraving glued onto a backing paper. Within an oval frame a portrait of a man in profile, below it on the left and right the names of the masters, and glued to the centre below the oval a label with the name of the man depicted in the picture.

works.d: Antiikses riietuses naisefiguur, jumalanna Ceres, vasakus käes põlev tõrvik, selja taga, paremal viljavihud, vasakul koletis.
works.de: A female figure in antique dress, the goddess Ceres, in her left hand a burning torch, behind her, on the right sheaves of grain, on the left a monster.

works.d: Seisva, trapeeritud riietuses mehe kujutis. Vasak käsi puusal, paremas kirjarull
works.de: Depiction of a standing man in draped clothing. Left hand on hip, a scroll in the right hand

works.d: Ringikujulisel pildil kaks alasti naist sõnajalgade taustal pärgadega peas. Ümber pildi tekst: Foto aastapreemia, kolhoos "Viru"
works.de: In a circular picture two naked women against a background of ferns, with wreaths on their heads. Around the picture the text: Photo annual prize, kolkhoz "Viru"

works.d: Lapse tehtud pilt mänguväljakust talvel. Esiplaanil ema lapsega, nende ümeber mängivad lapsed.
works.de: A picture made by a child depicting a playground in winter. In the foreground a mother with a child, around them children playing.

works.d: Vaade sõjas hävitatud Harju tänavale. Esiplaanil haljasala, paremal tellinkutes ehitis. Vasakul Kullasepa tänava äärse maja ehitus, taamal tellingutes raekoja torn.
works.de: View of Harju Street, destroyed in the war. In the foreground a green area, on the right a building in scaffolding. On the left the construction of the building on Kullassepa Street, in the distance the town hall tower in scaffolding.

works.d: Erksates värvides pilt linnast. Esiplaanil võlvkaare all väike punaste pükstega poiss, vasakul kõrvuti kolm terava otsaviiluga maja ja nende tagant osaliselt välja paistev tramm. Pöördel tekst: Rein Raamat Nukufilm "Peetrikese unenägu"
works.de: A picture of a city in bright colours. In the foreground under an arch a small boy in red trousers, on the left three houses side by side with pointed gables and behind them a tram partially visible. On the verso text: Rein Raamat Nukufilm "Peetrikese unenägu"

works.d: Vaade tihedasse metsa, kõrgemate puude tüved, madalamad kuused ja põõsad
works.de: View into a dense forest, trunks of taller trees, lower spruces and bushes

works.d: Horisontaalsete torude vahel tellingud ja redelid. Tellingute ja torude vahel paistavad mustade siluettidena töötavad inimesed. All tekst: Gaasitehase ehitusel. Linoollõige
works.de: Between horizontal pipes, scaffolding and ladders. Between the scaffolding and pipes, working people are visible as black silhouettes. Below, text: Gaasitehase ehitusel. Linoollõige

works.d: Kavandileht kostüümiks. Pildil räbaldunud rohkekas ürbis habetunud vanamees. Õlal kott ja käes kepp.
works.de: Costume design sheet. The picture shows a bearded old man in tattered, loose robes. A bag over his shoulder and a stick in his hand.

works.d: Vaade Tallinnale Toompealt. Esiplaanil vanalinna katused, tagaplaanil Pühavaimu kiriku torn. All vasakul tekst: Vaade Toompealt. Puugravüür 50/100
works.de: View of Tallinn from Toompea. In the foreground, roofs of the Old Town, in the background the tower of the Church of the Holy Spirit. Lower left, text: Vaade Toompealt. Woodcut 50/100

works.d: Tallinna raekoda. Vaade Raekoja põhjafassaadile. Kahel pool raekoda majad. Lehe ülaosas "Tallinna Raekoda 1404", selle ell paremal linna suur vapp. All vasakul pliiatsiga "Tallinna raekoda" Söövitus 17/100
works.de: Tallinn Town Hall. View of the north façade of the Town Hall. Buildings on either side of the Town Hall. At the top of the sheet "Tallinna Raekoda 1404", to the right of it the large coat of arms of the city. Lower left in pencil "Tallinna raekoda" Etching 17/100

works.d: Karjamaa, esiplaanil kolm lehma ning kaks kana ja neid karjatavad peremees ja perenaine. Tagapool majad, laudad ja kaev.
works.de: Pasture, in the foreground three cows and two hens and a farmer and farmer's wife herding them. Further back houses, barns and a well.

works.d: lapsed lillede ja õhupallidega, taamal tumesinise taeva taustal kolm puud
works.de: children with flowers and balloons, in the background against a dark blue sky three trees

works.d: Esiplaanil hall laud, laual kolm taldrikut. Laua taga kolm koolivormis tüdrukut. All paraemal servas: Liina
works.de: In the foreground a grey table, on the table three plates. Behind the table three girls in school uniform. Lower right corner: Liina

works.d: Vaade sadamakaile, esiplaanil võrke laiali tõmbavad kalurid, taamal meri, millel kalapaatide udused siluetid
works.de: View of the harbour quay, in the foreground fishermen spreading out nets, in the distance the sea with the hazy silhouettes of fishing boats

works.d: Lapikul kivist alusel seisva Veenuse figuur. Kummaski käes peegel. Parem käsi üles tõstetud ja pilk suunatud selles olevasse peeglisse. Tema parema jala juures upitab väike Paan.
works.de: Figure of Venus standing on a flat stone base. A mirror in each hand. Right hand raised and gaze directed into the mirror it holds. Near her right leg a small Pan peeps up.

works.d: Keskel harki vibutava Poseidoni figuur, tema jalgade juures hobused, taevas tuult puhuvad putod
works.de: In the centre a figure of Poseidon swinging a trident, at his feet horses, in the sky putti blowing wind

works.d: Naisefiguur antiikses rõivastuses. Paremas käes küllusesarv, milles puuviljad, vasakus lehekimp
works.de: Female figure in antique dress. In her right hand a cornucopia with fruits, in her left a bunch of leaves

works.d: Läänemere kaart. Ülaservas ajalooliste purjelaevade kujutised. All purjesõidu ajaloo kronoloogia.
works.de: Map of the Baltic Sea. Along the upper edge depictions of historical sailing ships. Below, a chronology of the history of sailing.

works.d: Esiplaanil meri eri tüüpi võistluspurjekatega. Tagaplaanil Tallinna siluett.
works.de: In the foreground the sea with various types of racing sailboats. In the background the Tallinn skyline.

works.d: Vaade Kadrioru pargile. Esiplaanil puude vahel oleval välul inimesed. Tagaplaanil, Lasnamäe nõlval tuletorn.
works.de: View of Kadriorg park. In the foreground people in a field among the trees. In the background, a lighthouse on the slope of Lasnamäe.

works.d: Postkaardiks volditud graafiline leht. Esiküljel kompositsioon Tallinna motiiviga. Kõrgete viilkatustega majad ja Pühavaimu kirik. Linna kohal kokkupõimitud lilled. Kaardi vahel eraldi leht Prantsuse Kultuurikeskuse uusaastasoovidega.
works.de: A print folded into a postcard. On the front a composition with a Tallinn motif. Houses with tall gabled roofs and the Church of the Holy Spirit. Above the town intertwined flowers. Between the card a separate sheet with New Year's greetings from the French Cultural Centre.

works.d: Paremal ja taga lumiste katustega linnamüüritornid ja majad. Tornist vasakul naine ja laps.
works.de: On the right and behind, city wall towers and houses with snowy roofs. To the left of the tower a woman and a child.

works.d: Pruunist paksust paberist mapp 8 pildi ja sisukorralehega. Kaanel vaade Tornide väljakule ja tekst: "Alt Reval. Album. 8 Kunstdruckblätter von Friedrich Jürgenson"
works.de: Portfolio of brown thick paper with 8 pictures and a table of contents sheet. On the cover a view of Tornide väljak and text: "Alt Reval. Album. 8 Kunstdruckblätter von Friedrich Jürgenson"

works.d: Tiitellehel:Tallinn; Sculpsit: Olev Soans; Litterarum nogis adoravit: Villu Toots; Rerum continentia explicavit: Rein Zobel; Manuexpressit: Olev Eskola. Mapis 4 pilti: vaade põhjast, vaade lõunast, vaade idast, vaade läänest; 3 tekstilehte
works.de: On the title page: Tallinn; Sculpsit: Olev Soans; Litterarum nogis adoravit: Villu Toots; Rerum continentia explicavit: Rein Zobel; Manuexpressit: Olev Eskola. In the folder 4 images: view from the north, view from the south, view from the east, view from the west; 3 text sheets

works.d: Kompositsioon Tallinna vanalinna motiividel. Vasakul all-linn kirikute ja raekoja torniga. Paremal Toompea. Esiplaanil purjelaevad. Ülal tekst: Head uut aastat!
works.de: Composition on motifs of Tallinn's Old Town. On the left the Lower Town with the towers of churches and the town hall. On the right Toompea. In the foreground sailing ships. Above, the text: Head uut aastat! [Happy New Year!]

works.d: Esiplaanil merekallas, seisev paat, kaks inimest ja hoburakend. Tagaplaanil paepank.
works.de: In the foreground a sea shore, a standing boat, two people and a horse-drawn carriage. In the background a limestone bank.

works.d: Vaade lossi tagusesse aeda. Esplaanil rida põõsaid, veidi eemal jalutusteed, millel inimesed. Tagapool puude vahel loss.
works.de: View of the garden behind the castle. In the foreground a row of bushes, a little further away walking paths with people on them. Further back a castle among trees.

works.t: Tallinna panoraam Lasnamäelt vaadatuna. Leht "Tallinna albumist" (pool panoraami)
works.d: Pool üle kahe lehe ulatuvast panoraamvaatest. Esiplaanil lage pangaserv. Mille taga, allpool paistab tihe puistu. Eemal meri laevadega. Teispool lahte patarei ehitised.
works.de: Half of a panoramic view spanning two sheets. In the foreground a bare cliff edge, behind which, lower down, dense woodland is visible. In the distance, the sea with ships. On the other side of the bay, battery buildings.

works.d: Leht, mille mõlemal küljel visandid. Paberil vesimärk J. Whatman. Ühel lehe küljel pliiatsi ja akvarelliga pilt Narva maanteest vaatega vanalinna poole. Tänaval rohkesti visandeid mitmesugustest hobusõidukitest. Kahel pool tänavat madalad majad, taamal vanalinn. Alaosas vaade Suurele Rannaväravale. Tesiel küljel. Kerge visand jämedast puust ja pingist selle ümber. Ilmselt on tegemist Lucca suvemõisaga.
works.de: A sheet with sketches on both sides. Watermark J. Whatman on the paper. On one side of the sheet, a pencil and watercolour picture of Narva Road with a view towards the Old Town. On the street numerous sketches of various horse-drawn vehicles. On both sides of the street low houses, in the distance the Old Town. In the lower part, a view of the Great Coastal Gate. On the other side. A light sketch of a thick tree and a bench around it. Apparently this is Lucca summer manor.

works.t: Vaade Kadrioru tuletornile pargist. Leht "Tallinna albumist"
works.d: Esiplaanil puude vahel välu, millel inimesed.  Veid paremal kaarduv jalgtee jalutajatega. Pildi tagaosas Lasnamäe klint ja selle peal tuletorn.
works.de: In the foreground, a clearing among trees with people. Slightly to the right, a curving footpath with strollers. In the background of the picture, the Lasnamäe cliff with a lighthouse on top of it.

works.t: Peeter Suure majake Kadriorus. Leht "Tallinna albumist"
works.d: Pildi keskel, puude taga Peetri majake. Esiplaanil tee ja sellel inimesed.

works.de: The picture shows Kadriorg Palace viewed from the sea. In the foreground, the road leading up to the palace and behind it a square in front of the palace. On the left, the palace. People walking on the road and in the square.

works.t: Striekberg bei Reval, Maarjamäe. Leht Tallinna albumist
works.d: Esiplaanil suurte kividega merearand, veidi tagapool meri, kus madalasse vette tõmmatud paat. Eemal, paremal paejärsak. Tagapool, keskel hooned.
works.de: In the foreground a sea shore with large stones, somewhat further back the sea, where a boat is drawn into shallow water. In the distance, on the right, a limestone cliff. Further back, in the centre, buildings.

works.d: pildi esiplaanil rand ja veepiirile tõmmapud paat. Paadi juures võrke vankrisse tõmbav mees ja korviga naine. Taustal Põhja-Eesti pankrannik.
works.de: In the foreground of the picture a shore and a boat pulled up to the waterline. Near the boat a man pulling nets into a cart and a woman with a basket. In the background the cliff coast of Northern Estonia.

works.t: Vaade Koselt Pirita kloostri suunas. Leht Tallinna albumist
works.d: Esiplaanil murul mängivad lapsed ja juttu ajavad täiskasvanud. Paremal, künkal paistab nurk balustraadi, mille taga vaadet imetlevad inimesed. Vasakul kulissiks kaks puud. Üle jõe, taamal Pirita kloostri varemed.
works.de: In the foreground children playing on the grass and adults chatting. On the right, on a hill, the corner of a balustrade is visible, behind which people admire the view. On the left two trees as a coulisse. Across the river, in the distance, the ruins of Pirita Convent.

works.t: Pirita kloostri varemed. Leht Tallinna albumist.

works.de: In the foreground a shepherd with sheep, a little further away a meadow, behind which a river. On the other side of the river the ruins of Pirita Convent.

works.d: Esiplaanil mere ja maa piiril väike tüdruk hanekarja ja koeraga. Tagapool vasakul talumaja. Taamal mets, millest paisab suvemõis.
works.de: In the foreground, at the border of sea and land, a small girl with a flock of geese and a dog. Behind on the left a farmhouse. Beyond, a forest, from which a summer manor emerges.

works.t: Vaade Tallinnale reidilt. Leht Tallinna albumist.

works.de: View of the Tallinn skyline from the sea. In the foreground a rowboat, to its left, slightly further back, a sailboat. Further away some smaller vessels. In the distance the city.

works.t: Artelleria-arsenali taga valli ääres. (Tornide väljak). Leht Tallinna albumist

works.de: Park area with people walking. On the left Lindamägi, on the right the tall Hermann Tower.

works.d: Esiplaanil puust sadamakai, millel inimesed, vankrid jne. Kai ääres rohkelt laevu. Väikese ariku ahtris paistab laeva nimi: "Leda Dunde". Tagaplaanil Tallinna linna siluett.
works.de: In the foreground a wooden harbour quay, on which people, carts etc. Along the quay numerous ships. On the stern of a small vessel the ship's name is visible: "Leda Dunde". In the background the silhouette of the city of Tallinn.

works.d: esiplaanil tänav, millel kõrge heinakoormaga vanker. Jalutavad inimesed. Teed ääristab kiviaed. mille taga, eemal paistab teine tänav ja ülesse Toompeale suunduv tee. Toompeal paistab loss ja sellest paremal Lindamägi.
works.de: In the foreground a street with a cart with a tall load of hay. People walking. The road is bordered by a stone wall, behind which, further away, another street can be seen and a road leading up to Toompea. On Toompea a castle can be seen, and to the right of it Lindamägi.

works.t: Haljasala Harju värava ja Kiek in de Köki juures. Leht Tallinna albumist

works.de: The front of Pirita convent. On the right a wooden fence, on the left a limestone house with a gable roof. To the right of the house the convent gate. Behind it the gable of the convent church.

On the right, above the roof of a house, the tip of the spire of Oleviste can be seen. On the verso, in pencil, the price 150 kr and the date 9.III.37.

works.d: Paralleelselt pildi alaäärega jõe kallas, selle keskel tee, millel seisavad kolm inimest ja koer. Kaldaga paralleelselt jõgi , mille keskel üleveoparv. Jõe vastaskaldal keskel Pirita koostrikiriku varemed, sellest paremal jõe kaldal kolm talumaja. Varemete ees üksik maja puuga, selle kõrval taamal surnuaia väravatorn, sellest vasakul puuderühm, mille taga kelpkatusega maja. kõige kohal avar taevas.
works.de: Parallel to the lower edge of the picture, the bank of a river, in the middle of it a road on which stand three people and a dog. Parallel to the bank, a river, in the middle of which a ferry raft. On the opposite bank of the river in the middle, the ruins of Pirita convent church, to the right of it on the riverbank three farmhouses. In front of the ruins a solitary house with a tree, beside it in the distance a cemetery gate tower, to the left of it a group of trees, behind which a house with a hip roof. Above everything a broad sky.

works.t: Grupiportree laskurkorpuse formeesimise ajast Porošino külas
works.d: Osa grupiportreest. Pildil kolme mehe portreed, pilotkad peas ja rohelised mundrid seljas.
works.de: Part of a group portrait. The image shows portraits of three men, wearing garrison caps and green uniforms.

works.d: Meheportree otsevaates. Peas pilotka.
works.de: Portrait of a man in frontal view. Wearing a garrison cap.

works.d: Vaade teele, mille ette on asetatud tõkkepuu. Väravas vahisõdur.
works.de: View of a road with a barrier placed in front of it. A guard soldier at the gate.

works.d: Lage talvemaastik purustatud tankidega, vasakul servas inimesi.
works.de: Bare winter landscape with destroyed tanks, people at the left edge.

works.d: Punase värvipliiatsi ja hariliku pliiatsiga joonistatud meheprotree. Poolprofiilis, pilotka peas ja munder seljas. Tagaküljel: pv. Ardel
works.de: Portrait of a man drawn with red and ordinary pencil. In semi-profile, wearing a garrison cap and a uniform. On the reverse: pv. Ardel

works.d: sarž naissõjaväelasest. Roheline munder ja punased sukad, käes suistev sigaret
works.de: caricature of a female soldier. Green uniform and red stockings, a dangling cigarette in her hand

works.d: Pildil kahele kõrgele pukile toetuv palk, mida saevad kaks meest, üks ülal palgi peal, teine all. Nende ümber seisavad neli meest. Taustal mets.
works.de: In the picture a log resting on two tall trestles, being sawn by two men, one above on the log, the other below. Around them stand four men. In the background a forest.

works.d: Pildi keskel raudahi, millel potid, selle ümber kolm toitu võtvat sõdurit.
works.de: In the middle of the picture an iron stove with pots on it, around it three soldiers eating.

works.d: Kaks pilti. Lehed omavahel ülemisest servast kinnitatud. Mõlemal pildil enam vähem üks ja seesama stseen: viis meest raudahju ümber. Esimene pilt on koloreeritud värvipliiatsitega ja teine akvarellidega. Kummagi pildi all selle pealkiri.
works.de: Two pictures. The sheets are joined together at the upper edge. Both pictures show more or less one and the same scene: five men around an iron stove. The first picture is coloured with coloured pencils and the second with watercolours. Below each picture is its title.

works.d: Hõbedase taeva taustal vanalinn. Esiplaanil ja vasakul müüritornid, müüride vahel katusemaastik, mida kroonib Oleviste kiriku torn.
works.de: Old town against a silvery sky. Wall towers in the foreground and on the left, a roofscape between the walls crowned by the tower of St. Olaf's Church.

works.d: Hobuse taha rakendatud väliköögi katel, esiplaanil katla poole vaatav sõdur, taamal pliiatsiga visandatud inmesi, puid, põõsaid ja kaev. All vasakus nurgas 18.07.44
works.de: A field-kitchen cauldron harnessed behind a horse, in the foreground a soldier looking towards the cauldron, in the distance people, trees, bushes and a well sketched in pencil. In the lower left corner 18.07.44

works.d: Akna all kastil istuv mees, põlvedel joonistusalus.
works.de: Man sitting on a box under a window, a drawing board on his knees.

works.d: Värviline visand madalast palkonnist puude vahel
works.de: A coloured sketch of a low balcony among trees

works.d: Õhukesele raamatukaanele (pildi pöördel pealkiri) joonistatud kolm visandlikku portreed.
works.de: On a thin book cover (title on the verso of the picture) three sketch-like portraits drawn.

works.d: Visand rusuhunnikust metsas
works.de: Sketch of a pile of rubble in a forest

works.d: Poolprofiilis naise portree, peas med. õe rätik, pöördel poolik pliiatsijoonistus
works.de: Semi-profile portrait of a woman, on her head a medical nurse's kerchief, on the verso a partial pencil drawing

works.d: Pliiatsivisand istuvast mehest, käes nuga ja leivapäts
works.de: Pencil sketch of a seated man, holding a knife and a loaf of bread

works.d: Õhukesele paberist raamatukaanele värvipliiatsiga visandatud profiilis mees, pöördel poolik portreevisand.
works.de: On a thin paper book cover, a man sketched in profile with coloured pencil, on the verso a partial portrait sketch.

works.d: Lehel seitse väikest illustratsioonikavandit, pöördel luuletuse tekst.
works.de: On the sheet seven small illustration designs, on the verso the text of a poem.

works.d: Istuv mees külgvaates, sonis pea ette kallutatud. Käes nuga ja kartul.
works.de: Seated man in profile, head bent forward in a doze. Holding a knife and a potato.

works.d: Telk metsas, vasakul telgi ees vahisõdur, telgi ümber männid.
works.de: A tent in the forest, on the left in front of the tent a sentry, pine trees around the tent.

works.d: Panoraamvaade linnale. Esiplaanil põõsastik üle mille paistab linn - kirikutornid, kindlus, majakatused.
works.de: Panoramic view of the city. In the foreground shrubbery over which the city is visible - church towers, a fortress, roofs of houses.

works.d: Esiplaanil kahe tanki rusud.
works.de: In the foreground, the ruins of two tanks.

works.d: Profiilis mundris ja pilotkaga mehe portree.
works.de: Portrait of a man in profile, in uniform and forage cap.

works.d: Vaade külale,esiplaanil paremal kaks sõdurit suundumas mööda teerada majade poole. Vasakul puud, tagapool kaks palkonni
works.de: View of a village, in the foreground on the right two soldiers moving along a path towards the houses. On the left trees, further back two balconies

works.d: Vaade varemetes linnatänavale. Paremal ühekordse, kõrgete etikutreppidega maja varemed. Vasakul tänav, millel liigub tank.
works.de: View of a ruined city street. On the right the ruins of a single-storey house with tall stoop stairs. On the left the street, on which a tank is moving.

works.d: Pilotkaga mehe poolprofiilis protree, kaelas punane rätt. Pildi all paremal nimi: Korjus. Pildi pöördel signatuur: H. Vitsut.
works.de: Half-profile portrait of a man with a forage cap, a red scarf around his neck. Below the picture on the right the name: Korjus. On the verso of the picture the signature: H. Vitsut.

works.d: Mehe portree profiilis. All vasakul: A. Koemets 11.03.1944 Kotlõ; all paremal Voldemar Klink punatähe ordeni kavaler
works.de: Portrait of a man in profile. Lower left: A. Koemets 11.03.1944 Kotlõ; lower right Voldemar Klink, holder of the Order of the Red Star

works.d: Metsaserva, kännul istuv sõdurimundris mees. Parem käsi toetumas põlvele.
works.de: A man in soldier's uniform sitting on a stump at the edge of the forest. Right hand resting on the knee.

works.t: Djudino külas. Diviisi staap Velikije Luki lähedal
works.d: Vaade külale, esiplaanil vasakul puust sild. Veidi tagapool lähestikku asetsevad väikesed talutared. Taamal metsa siluett.
works.de: View of a village, in the foreground on the left a wooden bridge. A little further back small farmhouses standing close together. In the distance the silhouette of a forest.

works.d: Lehe ühel küljel sõdurite magamisruum vaadatuna kõrgemast kohast. Kahel pool narid puhkavate sõduritega all vasakus nurgas signatuur; pöördel raudahju ümber kolm istuvat meest. Keskmisel käes lõõtspill. All: Ma tahaksin kodus olla, kui õunapuud õitsevad...
works.de: On one side of the sheet, soldiers' sleeping quarters seen from a higher vantage point. On both sides bunks with resting soldiers, at the lower left corner a signature; on the verso, around an iron stove three seated men. The middle one holds an accordion in his hands. Below: Ma tahaksin kodus olla, kui õunapuud õitsevad...

works.d: Poolprofiilis väikeste vuntisidega mehe protree, peas sõdurimüts.
works.de: Portrait in half-profile of a man with a small moustache, wearing a soldier's cap.

works.d: Taluõu, paremal kaev, millest vasakul mõned puud. Puude taga kastiga veoauto. Kaevu taga, pildil paremal, palkmaja nurk. All vasakul: "Tasuja" trükikoda Luuga lähistel. Paremal: A. Koemets 3.08.44
works.de: A farmyard, on the right a well, to the left of which a few trees. Behind the trees a truck with a box body. Behind the well, on the right of the picture, the corner of a log house. Lower left: "Tasuja" printing house near Luga. Right: A. Koemets 3.08.44

works.d: Kaks sõdurit metsas puhkamas. Esiplaanil paremal noor kuusk, keskplaanil seljaga vaataja poole külitav sõdur, tema taga vasakul lõkke juures põlvitav sõdur. All vasakul: Vahepuhkus; all paremal: A. K. 10.09.44
works.de: Two soldiers resting in the forest. In the foreground on the right a young spruce, in the middle ground a soldier lying with his back to the viewer, behind him on the left a soldier kneeling by a campfire. Below on the left: Break time (Vahepuhkus); below on the right: A. K. 10.09.44

works.d: kolm visandit sõduritest. Kaks vasakpoolset seisavad, parempoolne istub. All paremal: A. Koemets 16.06.1944
works.de: three sketches of soldiers. The two on the left are standing, the one on the right is sitting. Lower right: A. Koemets 16.06.1944

works.d: Pilotkaga mehe poolprofiilis portree. All: Riibak, Rebak, Rõbak; 5.03.1944
works.de: Portrait in half-profile of a man wearing a forage cap. Below: Riibak, Rebak, Rõbak; 5.03.1944

works.d: Õlgkatusega palkmaja. All premal: A Koemets 15.06.1944; keskjaam Künka külas
works.de: Log house with straw roof. Lower right: A Koemets 15.06.1944; central station in Künka village

works.d: Raudahju ees puupakul istuv sõdur. All vasakul: Päevnik; all paremal: A. K. 15.03.44
works.de: A soldier sitting on a wooden block in front of an iron stove. Lower left: Päevnik; lower right: A. K. 15.03.44

works.d: Suure laua juures, millel kirjad kirju sorteeriv pilotkaga mees. Tagaplaanil puude võrad. All tekst: Sõjaväe posti sorteerimine; all paremal: A. Koemets Kuramaal 28.04.45
works.de: At a large table, a man in a peaked cap sorting letters. In the background, tree crowns. Below, text: Sõjaväe posti sorteerimine [Sorting of military mail]; lower right: A. Koemets Kuramaal 28.04.45

works.d: Sõdurid metsas, kolm tükki paremal istumas ja neljas vasakul püssiga seismas. All: Nõupidamine enne väljaastumist; 06.07.44 Luuga mets.
works.de: Soldiers in the forest, three sitting on the right and a fourth standing on the left with a rifle. Below: Meeting before setting out; 06.07.44 Luga forest.

works.d: Lauast vasakul seisev mees, kes parandab tema ees laual olevat raadioaparaati. All vasakul: keskjaama korrastamas; all paremal: A. Koemets 24.09.45
works.de: A man standing to the left of a table, repairing the radio set on the table in front of him. Lower left: keskjaama korrastamas; lower right: A. Koemets 24.09.45

works.d: Visandlik joonistus vanalinna varemetest. Esiplaanil rusuhunnikud, veidi tagapool varemete müürid, taamal tornid.
works.de: Sketchy drawing of ruins of the old town. In the foreground heaps of rubble, slightly behind the walls of the ruins, in the distance towers.

works.d: Mehe täisporfiilis portree, peas pilotka. All vasakul: A. Koemets 10.05.43; all paremal Must.
works.de: Portrait of a man in full profile, wearing a forage cap. Lower left: A. Koemets 10.05.43; lower right: Must.

works.d: Vaade külale kahe lahingus kannatada saanud palkmajaga.
works.de: View of a village with two log houses damaged in battle.

works.d: Mehe portree profiilis. All: A. Laines mõisnik
works.de: Portrait of a man in profile. Below: A. Laines, landowner

works.d: Maastikul kuulipliduja taga kaks kõhuli lamavat sõdurit, peas pilotkad. All paremal tekst: Laske asendis PA. 43
works.de: In a landscape, behind a machine gun two soldiers lying on their stomachs, wearing field caps. Lower right text: Laske asendis PA. 43

works.t: Muldonni ehitamine Borisõvi külas 249 ELD tagalas
works.d: Männimetsas puust onni ehitamine. Püstitatud on sõrestik, mida ümbritsevad noored männid. All vasakul: Borisõvi külas 249 ELD tagalas 43 P. A.; all keskel: P. Aavik 43 a.; pöördel trükitud prantsusekeelne luuletus; pliiatsiga kirjutatud tekst: Muldonni ehitamine väeosas 43. a. Orehova külas.
works.de: Building a wooden hut in a pine forest. The frame is erected, surrounded by young pines. Lower left: Borisõvi külas 249 ELD tagalas 43 P. A.; lower centre: P. Aavik 43 a.; on the verso a printed French-language poem; text written in pencil: Muldonni ehitamine väeosas 43. a. Orehova külas.

works.d: Vaade ruumi, kus töötavad mundrites mehed. Esiplaanil vasakul suur plekkvaat.
works.de: View of a room where men in uniforms are working. In the foreground on the left a large tin barrel.

works.d: Visand ratastel kahurist. All initsiaalid: PA.
works.de: Sketch of a cannon on wheels. Below, initials: PA.

works.d: Visand kuulipildujast. All paremas nurgas P. Aavik 43
works.de: Sketch of a machine gunner. In the lower right corner P. Aavik 43

works.d: Istuva mehe portree. Käed ristamisi põlvedel, nägu poolprofiilis. Seljas munder. All vasakul nurgas: 1. X 44; all keskel: Leitnant Kiviloo.
works.de: Portrait of a seated man. Hands crossed on his knees, face in three-quarter profile. Wearing a uniform. Lower left corner: 1. X 44; lower centre: Leitnant Kiviloo.

works.d: Nokaga vormimütsis mehe portree. Poolprofiilis. All vasakul Illisson
works.de: Portrait of a man in a peaked cap. In half-profile. Lower left Illisson

works.d: Portree pilotkaga mehest. All vasakul tekst: V.seersant Kraus; eesrindlik virgats
works.de: Portrait of a man in a field cap. Lower left text: V.seersant Kraus; eesrindlik virgats

works.d: Kolm portreevisandit. Alumine kiivris poolprofiilis, ülal kaks profiilis pilotkaga. All vasakul: Punaväelane Udras PA. 43 a.
works.de: Three portrait sketches. The lower one in a helmet, in three-quarter view, above two in profile wearing field caps. Lower left: Red Army soldier Udras PA. 43 a.

works.d: Täisfiguur sõdurist. Paremal õlal kuulipilduja toru. All paremas nurgas tekst: R. kuulipilduja toru kandmas "Turovos" 1943 a. PA.
works.de: Full figure of a soldier. On the right shoulder the barrel of a machine gun. In the lower right corner text: R. carrying the barrel of a machine gun in "Turovo" 1943. PA.

works.d: Seisev mundris mees, käes automaat, kõrvale eraldi joonistatud veel automaat (juures tekst: vana tüüp) koos padrunisalvedega. Lehe pöördel prantsusekeelne luuletus.
works.de: A standing man in uniform, holding an automatic rifle, next to him a separately drawn automatic rifle (with the text: old type) with cartridge magazines. On the verso of the sheet a poem in French.

works.d: Täisvarustuses sõdur, seljaga vaataja poole, käes vintpüss. All paremas nurgas: Püssimees P A 43. Lehe pöördel trükitud prantsusekeelne luuletus.
works.de: A fully equipped soldier, back to the viewer, holding a rifle. Lower right corner: Püssimees P A 43. On the verso of the sheet, a printed French-language poem.

works.d: Kolme mehe profiilis visandlikud portreed, kõrvale kirjutatud nimi.
works.de: Sketchy profile portraits of three men, with a name written beside them.

works.d: Esiplaanil tellistest laotud kerge kolle ja selle peal nõud, taamal mets ja telk. All vasakul: A. Koemets 15.04.1944
works.de: In the foreground a light hearth built of bricks with vessels on top, in the distance a forest and a tent. Lower left: A. Koemets 15.04.1944

works.d: Pliiatsivisand talukompleksist. Majadekomplesist paremal väike puudegrupp. Majade ees telk. Vasakul üksik puu. Vasakul all: Luureroodus 30. juunil 1943.
works.de: Pencil sketch of a farmstead complex. To the right of the group of buildings, a small group of trees. A tent in front of the buildings. On the left, a single tree. Lower left: Luureroodus 30. juunil 1943.

works.t: Värviring. vitraažakna kavand Tallinna Reaalkooli jaoks
works.d: Mustade kaantega mapp mille sisse köidetud kiletaskud. Taskutes vitraažikavandid, eksplikatsioon ja klaasinäidised.
works.de: A folder with black covers, inside which plastic sleeves are bound. In the sleeves stained-glass designs, an explication and glass samples.

works.d: Poolprofiilis mehe portree, rinnas viisnurk. Portreest paremal: A. Mildeberg. Paspartuul vene tähtedega: st. leit. Põldra.
works.de: Portrait of a man in half-profile, a five-pointed star on his chest. To the right of the portrait: A. Mildeberg. On the mount in Russian letters: st. leit. Põldra.

works.d: Keskealise mehe portree, seitlisse kammitud juuksed, kitsad ninaalused vuntsid. Seljas munder.
works.de: Portrait of a middle-aged man, hair combed into a quiff, narrow moustache. Wearing a uniform.

works.d: Visandid puhkavatest meestest. Kolm figuuri ja üks portree. All tekst: peale laskmist
works.de: Sketches of resting men. Three figures and one portrait. Below text: peale laskmist

works.d: Profiilis vasakule, peas sõdurimüts, suus piip. All paremal: E. Okas 31. mail 1942 Cebakuli laager"
works.de: In profile to the left, wearing a soldier's cap, a pipe in the mouth. Lower right: E. Okas 31. mail 1942 Cebakuli laager"

works.d: Kasukas ja punases pearätis naise figuur, käes vintpüss. All paremal: E. Okas 14. 01. 43 Moskva
works.de: Figure of a woman in a fur coat and a red headscarf, holding a rifle. Lower right: E. Okas 14. 01. 43 Moskva

works.d: Vasakul istuv sõdur, tema ees, kaks last. Veidi paremal kolm naist. Taamal visandlikult hooneid ja sõdureid. All paremal: E. Okas 2. juunil 1943 Pestavo külas
works.de: On the left a seated soldier, in front of him two children. Slightly to the right three women. In the background sketchily rendered buildings and soldiers. Lower right: E. Okas 2. juunil 1943 Pestavo külas

works.t: Med. San. Pat. köögi ehitamine 18. juunil 1943
works.d: Ehitustööd männikus. Noorte mändide vahel palkidest, osaliselt maa sisse ehitatud pooleliolev, palkidest katusega onn. Kaks sõdurit onni katusel, kaks sellest natuke vasakul. All paremal tekst: Med. San. Pat. Köögi ehitamine. Vasakul all: M. Bormeister. Tagaküljele lisaks töö pealkirjale märgitud ka tehnika ja kuupäev: 18. juunil 1943.
works.de: Construction work in a pine forest. Among young pines an unfinished log hut with a partly dug-in, log-built, partly earthen roof. Two soldiers on the roof of the hut, two a little to the left of it. Lower right text: Med. San. Pat. Building the kitchen. Lower left: M. Bormeister. On the verso, in addition to the title of the work, the technique and date are also noted: 18. juunil 1943 [18 June 1943].

works.d: Noore mehe portree, näoosa põhjalikumalt välja joonistatud, riietus visandlik. All paremal: E. Okas 22. II 44 Jaroslavl
works.de: Portrait of a young man, the facial area worked out in more detail, clothing sketch-like. Lower right: E. Okas 22. II 44 Jaroslavl

works.d: Vaiadele toetuv katusealune. Vasakul ja paremal ratastega katlad, katuse all kõnnivad inimesed. All paremal: E. Okas juuli 1942
works.de: A roof resting on posts. On the left and right kettles with wheels, under the roof people walking. Lower right: E. Okas juuli 1942

works.d: Suvine maastik. Esiplaanil maasse kaevatud nelinurkne veekogu, millesse astub mees. Veidi tagapool vasakul kaks istuvat meest ja paremal puude vilus grupp rohelistes mundrites mehi istumas. All paremal: Med. San. Pat. supelbassein. Vasakul: M. Bormeister; Tagaküljel: Med. San. Pat. supelpassein 24. juuni 1943
works.de: Summer landscape. In the foreground a rectangular body of water dug into the ground, into which a man is stepping. A little further back on the left two seated men and on the right, in the shade of the trees, a group of men in green uniforms sitting. Lower right: Med. San. Pat. supelbassein [bathing pool]. Left: M. Bormeister; on the back: Med. San. Pat. supelpassein 24. juuni 1943

works.d: Vaade Harju tänava varemtele, majavaremete taga keskel Niguliste kiriku põlenud torn. All paremal: E.Okas 1945; all vasakul Harju tänav. Tagaküljel: E. Okas Tallinn 19. III 1945, Harju tänav. Süsi. 1945
works.de: View of the ruins on Harju Street, behind the house ruins in the centre the burnt tower of St. Nicholas' Church (Niguliste kirik). Lower right: E.Okas 1945; lower left Harju tänav. On the reverse: E. Okas Tallinn 19. III 1945, Harju tänav. Charcoal. 1945

works.d: Siseruum, milles relvi korrastavad mehed. Vasakul raudahi. Tagapool lai avatud uks, millest paistab valgust. All vasakul: E. Okas 43 Moskva; tagaküljel: E. Okas 15. jaan. 1943 Moskva "Rindele sõit"
works.de: An interior in which men are cleaning weapons. On the left an iron stove. Further back a wide open door, from which light shines. Lower left: E. Okas 43 Moskva; on the verso: E. Okas 15. jaan. 1943 Moskva "Rindele sõit"

works.d: Palkonni interjöör. Laetalad tugipalkidega kindlustatud. Paremal raudahi. Paremal ülal: 28.III 42.a. Signatuur tagaküljel: M Bormeister
works.de: Interior of a balcony. Ceiling beams reinforced with supporting logs. On the right an iron stove. Upper right: 28.III 42.a. Signature on the verso: M Bormeister

works.d: Onni interjöör. Paremal pliit ja kapp, keskel uks, vasakul pink ja laud. All paremal: Auto-roodu kom. mudm. juun. 1943; all vasakul: M. Bormeister.
works.de: Interior of a hut. On the right a stove and a cupboard, a door in the centre, a bench and a table on the left. Lower right: Auto-roodu kom. mudm. juun. 1943; lower left: M. Bormeister.

works.d: Esiplaanil sinelis sõdur, kellest vasakul paksu valge kasukaga medõde, kellel paremas käes side. Ülal paremas nurgas: M. Bormeister; Ülal vasakul: Med. San. Punkt
works.de: In the foreground a soldier in a greatcoat, to the left of him a nurse in a thick white fur coat, with a bandage in her right hand. Upper right corner: M. Bormeister; upper left: Med. San. Punkt

works.d: Seitlis juustega mehe portree, seljas munder, rinnas viisnurk. All paremal: A. Mildeberg 23.04.1943. All paremal: K. Uibo. Tagaküljel: Al. polk. Kaarel Uibo portree
works.de: Portrait of a grey-haired man, wearing a uniform, a five-pointed star on his chest. Lower right: A. Mildeberg 23.04.1943. Lower right: K. Uibo. On the verso: Portrait of Colonel Al. Kaarel Uibo

works.d: Vaade kortermajade vahelisele hoovile. Vasakul ja tagaplaanil kõrgemad kortermajad, paremal madalad puukuurid. Keskel ehitustöödel askeldavad inimesed. Vasakul all: Märt Bormeister Jaroslavl 1943. a.
works.de: View of a courtyard between apartment buildings. On the left and in the background taller apartment buildings, on the right low wooden sheds. In the centre people busy with construction work. Lower left: Märt Bormeister Jaroslavl 1943. a.

works.d: Esiplaanil lattaia juures sõdurid. Vasakul pool kergelt visandatud hoone kontuurid. All vasakul tekst: Miinipilduja patarei; all paremal: M. Bormeister
works.de: In the foreground soldiers by a fence. On the left, lightly sketched outlines of a building. Lower left text: Miinipilduja patarei; lower right: M. Bormeister

works.d: neli istuvat meest, seljas sõdurimundrid. Paremal all nurgas: E. Okas 4. juuni 1942
works.de: four seated men, wearing soldiers' uniforms. In the lower right corner: E. Okas 4. juuni 1942

works.d: Mehe rindportree. Peas sõduri pilotka. Joonistatud kontrastsete värvidega. All: A. Bachverk; all paremal: E. Okas 6. aug. 1942 Cebakul; tagaküljel: Albert Bachverk 925 polk 5 rood
works.de: Bust portrait of a man. Wearing a soldier's forage cap. Drawn with contrasting colours. Below: A. Bachverk; lower right: E. Okas 6. aug. 1942 Cebakul; on the verso: Albert Bachverk 925 polk 5 rood
