works.d: Keskealise reipailmelise mehe poolfiguur 3/4 pöördes vasakule. Mehel ümmargune nägu, seljas frakk. Käed küünarnukkidest kõverdatud. Mehe siledate taha kammitud juuste piir taandunud, ees prillid.
works.de: The half-figure of a middle-aged, cheerful-looking man in a 3/4 turn to the left. The man has a round face, wearing a tailcoat. Arms bent at the elbows. The line of the man's smooth hair combed back has receded, glasses in front.

works.d: Vanema ümmarguse mehe pea koos kaelusega 1/4 profiilis vasakule. Mehe pea poolkiilas, suurte silmade ees prillid, pisike nina, pruntis suu, ümmargune lõug, kael peaaegu sama jäme kui pea. Lipsul 3 diagonaalset noodijoonestikku nootidega.
works.de: Head of an older, roundish man with a collar, in 1/4 profile to the left. The man's head half-bald, glasses in front of large eyes, small nose, pursed mouth, round chin, neck almost as thick as the head. On the tie 3 diagonal music staves with notes.

works.d: Vanema mehe pea otsevaates. Rohkem joonistus. Mehel kohevad juuksed, lai ja kõrge otsmik, tugevalt kortsus nägu, vasak kulm kõrgem, ilme mõtlik.
works.de: The head of an older man in front view. More of a drawing. The man has tousled hair, a broad and high forehead, a strongly wrinkled face, the left eyebrow higher, a thoughtful expression.

works.d: Agulitänav lagunenud puumajadega. Vana naine kübaraga, millel sinilillekimp ja loor.
works.de: Suburban street with dilapidated wooden houses. An old woman with a hat, on which a bunch of cornflowers and a veil.

works.d: Šarži visand. Vana naerva mehe pea.
works.de: Caricature sketch. Head of an old laughing man.

works.d: Keskealise teravate näojoontega pika ninaga naise vasakprofiilis pea. Naisel pikad lokkis juuksed, kaela ümber noodijoonestik.

works.de: Pencil sketch of an older woman's head in left profile. The woman has shoulder-length curly hair, a round forehead, a convex nose, a protruding mouth, a sharp chin.

works.d: Keskealise laianäolise kohevate juustega mehe täisfiguur. Käes hoiab mees pasunat, millest väljuvad noodid. Vasaku kaenla all hunnik noodilehti.
works.de: Full figure of a middle-aged, broad-faced man with tousled hair. The man holds a horn, from which musical notes emerge. Under his left arm a pile of sheet music.

works.d: Keskealise suure nina ja suuga prillidega härrasmehe figuur sammumas vasakule. Mehe kohevatest lokkis juustest on pealaele jäänud ainult püstine tutt. Vasak käsi on mehel puusas, paremas hoiab suurt, ümber vasaku jala keerduvat noodipaberit, millel on pealkiri "Operett". Noodipaberi alumises osas kujutatava allkiri.
works.de: Figure of a middle-aged gentleman with a large nose and mouth, wearing glasses, striding to the left. Of the man's fluffy curly hair only an upright tuft remains on the crown of his head. His left hand is on his hip, in his right he holds a large sheet of music curling around his left leg, bearing the title "Operett". At the bottom of the sheet of music the signature of the person depicted.

works.d: Keskealise mehe poolfiguur otsevaates. Mehe piklikku nägu ümbritseb 2 kohevat juuksepahmakat, pealael paar karva, nende keskel noodivõti. Mehel prillid, jõuline nina, paksud huuled. Kummisrinnaline keha pööratud veidi vasakule, parem käsi uljalt puusas. Kaelas lennukas kikilips.
works.de: A frontal half-figure of a middle-aged man. The man's elongated face is framed by 2 fluffy tufts of hair, a few hairs on the crown, with a treble clef between them. The man wears glasses, has a strong nose, thick lips. His rubbery-chested body is turned slightly to the left, right hand jauntily on the hip. A flying bow tie at the neck.

works.d: Keskealise kongusninalise mehe pea vasakprofiilis. Mehel esileulatuv lõug, sirged juuksed turris ja sassis.
works.de: Head of a middle-aged man with a hooked nose, in left profile. The man has a protruding chin, straight hair tousled and dishevelled.

works.d: Nooremapoolne naise pea otsevaates. Laia põsesarnad, keskelt lahku kammitud juuksed lainelised, poolpikad. Kaela ümber kõrge lai krae.
works.de: A young woman's head in front view. Broad cheekbones, hair parted in the middle, wavy, medium-length. A high wide collar around the neck.

works.d: Keskealise esile tükkiva lõuaga mehe täisfiguur. Mehel ees ümmargused prillid, käes otsast rullikeerdunud noodipaber.

works.d: Keskel kurvameelse ilmega keskealise mehe šarž, mehel käes taktikepp. Ülal vasakul noorepoolse naeratava naise pea. Ülal paremal poisikeseliku ilmega teravaninalise noore mehe pea vasakprofiilis. All vasakul suurenäolise muheda ilmega keskeas mehe pea. All paremal pikaks venitatud näoga kavalilmelise keskealise mehe pea.
works.de: In the centre a caricature of a middle-aged man with a melancholy expression, holding a baton in his hand. Upper left the head of a youngish smiling woman. Upper right the head of a boyish-looking, sharp-nosed young man in left profile. Lower left the head of a large-faced, good-humoured middle-aged man. Lower right the head of a middle-aged man with an elongated face and a sly expression.

works.d: Keskealise mehe suure peaga täisfiguur veerandpöördes paremale. Mehel veidi kongus nina, nägu täidlane, topeltlõuaga. Seljas frakk, käed külgedele välja sirutatud, paremas käes taktikepp. All paremal istuv ammulisuine poisiklutt.
works.de: Full figure of a middle-aged man with a large head, in a quarter-turn to the right. The man has a slightly hooked nose, a full face, a double chin. Wearing a tailcoat, arms stretched out to the sides, a conductor's baton in the right hand. Below on the right a sitting open-mouthed young boy.

works.d: Vana mehe pisut paremale pööratud täisfiguur suure kohevate juustega peaga. Mehel paksud kulmud, nina jõuline. Seljas frakk, parema kaenla all loorberipärg, vasakus käes raamat ja taktikepp.

works.d:
Laval Othello ja Desdemona on osad vahetanud. Paremal lavastaja. Joonistuse all rõõmus ja kurb teatrimask ja arv 73. 
Joonistuse all tekst:"Pidage! Ega te kodus ole, laval toimub see tehing vastupidi".

On stage Othello and Desdemona have exchanged roles. On the right the director. Below the drawing a merry and a sad theatre mask and the number 73. 
Text below the drawing: "Wait! You are not at home, on stage this transaction happens the other way round."

works.d: Keskealine paar sammumas ette vasakule, mõlemal seljas M. Lermontovi "Maskeraadi" peategelaste kostüümid. Mehel sügavate joontega nägu, parem käsi suunatud rikkalikule žaboole, vasakus kõverdatud käes kaasaegne kohver, millel silt "Moskva". Suuresilmse väga lokkis juustega noorema naise nägu varjab osaliselt lehvik, mida ta hoiab vasakus kõverdatud käes. Samal käsivarrel ripub kaasaegne käekott.
works.de: A middle-aged couple walking forward to the left, both wearing the costumes of the main characters of M. Lermontov's "Masquerade". The man has a deeply lined face, his right hand directed towards a rich jabot, in his bent left hand a modern suitcase with a label "Moskva". The face of the younger woman, with large eyes and very curly hair, is partially hidden by a fan, which she holds in her bent left hand. On the same arm hangs a modern handbag.

works.d: Kaks keskealist meest sammumas ette vasakule, mõlemal seljas frakid. Vasakpoolne mees lühem, täidlane, hõredate juustega, prillikandja. Parempoolne pikem sale mees hoiab paremas käes noodilehti, tema fraki rinnataskust paistavad 2 südant.
works.de: Two middle-aged men walking forward to the left, both wearing tailcoats. The left-hand man shorter, stout, with thinning hair, wearing glasses. The right-hand man taller and slender holds sheet music in his right hand, from his tailcoat's breast pocket 2 hearts are visible.

works.t: Estraadiõhtu Jüri Järvet ja Eino Baskin. 1954
works.d: Rohelise poolavatud eesriide vahelt kätlevad kaks nooremat meest. Vasakpoolse lühema mehe kohal kiri "Jüri Järvet". Mehel otsmikul taandunud pruunid lokkis juuksed, suured silmad, pikk terav nina. Parempoolse pikema mehe kohal kiri "Eino Baskin". Mehel täidlane nägu, mustad lokkis juuksed, pikk nina. Mõlemal seljas mustad ülikonnad täpiliste kikilipsudega.
works.de: Between the parted green curtain two younger men shaking hands. Above the shorter man on the left the inscription "Jüri Järvet". The man has brown curly hair receding at the forehead, big eyes, a long sharp nose. Above the taller man on the right the inscription "Eino Baskin". The man has a full face, black curly hair, a long nose. Both wear black suits with spotted bow ties.

works.d: 9 suurepäist täisfiguuri sammumas paremalt vsakule. Ees lokkispäine A. Randviir, tema järel tüse piibuga A. Suurorg. Siis M. Möldre, kelle käe otsas väike R. Tarmo. M. Lutsu järel tahavaatav A. Särev, siis K. Ots ja A. Mihklisoo. Nende ees ümmargune prillidega A. Teetsov.
works.de: 9 full-length figures striding from right to left. In front, curly-haired A. Randviir, followed by stout, pipe-smoking A. Suurorg. Then M. Möldre, with little R. Tarmo at the end of his arm. After M. Luts comes A. Särev looking back, then K. Ots and A. Mihklisoo. In front of them, round, bespectacled A. Teetsov.

works.t: Õhtulehe karikatuurivõistluse töö: Kuidas tõsta näitlejameisterlikkust
works.d:
Kahest kõrvuti pildist koosnev karikatuur.
Mõlemal on sama mees.
Vasakpoolsel kardina tagant keegi kõbitab teda talla alt, naerab; all tekst: ... komöödias. Parempoolsel keegi torgib meest suure nõelaga, nutab; all tekst: ... tragöödias.
works.de:
A caricature consisting of two pictures side by side.
The same man is in both.
On the left one, someone is tickling the sole of his foot from behind a curtain, he laughs; text below: ... in comedy. On the right one, someone is poking the man with a large needle, he cries; text below: ... in tragedy.

works.t: Õhtulehe karikatuurivõistluse töö: Kas peale teatrit restorani läheme...
works.d:
Minikleidis, pikkade saabastega tütarlaps ja pusaga, alt laienevates pükstes, kaelaketiga noormees vestlemas.
"Kas peale teatrit restorani läheme?
"Mis sa nüüd! Kes meid sinna saabastes ja ilma lipsuta sisse laseb!"
works.de:
A girl in a mini-dress and long boots and a young man in a hooded top with trousers widening at the bottom, wearing a neck chain, are talking.
"Shall we go to a restaurant after the theatre?
"What are you thinking! Who would let us in there in boots and without a tie!"

works.t: Õhtulehe karikatuurivõistluse töö: Kas see on mõni kuulus näitleja.... Üks pilet etendusele
works.d:
Vasakul rahvamass, mille keskel üks mees hoiab kõrgel käes väikest paberit. Paremal 2 meest vestlemas:
"Kas see on mõni kuulus näitleja?"
"Ei, too mees pakkus üht piletit tänasele etendusele."

Taga teatri hoone.
works.de:
On the left a crowd of people, in the middle of which one man holds a small piece of paper high in his hand. On the right two men talking:
"Is that some famous actor?"
"No, that man was offering a ticket to today's performance."

Behind, a theatre building.

works.d: Vasakul ovaalne peegel. Selle ees ebamäärases eas daami täisfiguur, pea vasakprofiilis, keha veerandpöördes paremale. Naisel pikemad lokkis juuksed, eriti pikad ripsmed, parem käsi kergitab kleidisaba, vasak graatsiliselt tõstetud. Seljas poolpikk käisteta kleit satsidega kaeluses ja allääres, kaelas pärlid, kätel võrud. Naise vasaku käe tagant paistab süngeilmelise pikajuukselise mehe pea. Peeglist paistab veerand naise figuuri.
works.de: On the left, an oval mirror. In front of it, the full figure of a lady of indeterminate age, her head in left profile, her body in a quarter-turn to the right. The woman has longer curly hair, especially long eyelashes, her right hand lifting the hem of her dress, her left hand raised gracefully. She wears a mid-length sleeveless dress with frills at the neckline and hem, pearls around her neck, bracelets on her arms. Behind the woman's left hand, the head of a gloomy-looking long-haired man is visible. A quarter of the woman's figure is reflected in the mirror.

works.d: Noorepoolse kõhna mehe täisfiguur seismas vasakprofiilis. Mehel kohevad tuules lehvivad juuksed, kõhn kõrgete põsesarnadega nägu, suured silmad. Käed ristatud rinnale, seljas kõrge kaelusega kampsun ja pikem kuub, jalas kõrge säärega kalurisaapad. Mees seisab kaljupangal näoga tormise mere poole. Kõrge kõrgem laine moodustab paberipoogna, millel tekst TORMIDE RAND (LIBRETO).
works.de: The full figure of a rather young, thin man standing in left profile. The man has hair fluttering in the wind, a thin face with high cheekbones, large eyes. His arms are crossed on his chest, he wears a high-collared sweater and a longer coat, and high fisherman's boots on his feet. The man stands on a cliff, facing the stormy sea. A high, higher wave forms a sheet of paper on which is the text TORMIDE RAND (LIBRETO).

works.d: Noorepoolse kõhna mehe täisfiguur seismas vasakprofiilis. Mehel kohevad tuules lehvivad juuksed, kõhn kõrgete põsesarnadega nägu, suured silmad. Käed ristatud rinnale, seljas kõrge kaelusega kampsun ja pikem kuub, jalas kõrge säärega kalurisaapad. Mees seisab kaljupangal näoga tormise mere poole. Kõrge kõrgem laine moodustab paberipoogna, millel tekst TORMIDE RAND (LIBRETO).

His arms are crossed on his chest, he wears a high-collared sweater and a longer coat, and high fisherman's boots on his feet. The man stands on a cliff, facing the stormy sea. works.d: Keskealise kõhna laiaõlgse mehe 3/4 figuur 3/4 pöördes vasakule. Mehel tumedad lokkis juuksed, teravate joontega nägu - paksud kulmud, pikk nina, esiletungiv suu, terav lõug. Paremas kõverdatud käes hoiab pealuud, vasak käsi puusas. Seljas tume kostüüm valge krookkrae ja -kätistega.
works.de: A 3/4 figure of a middle-aged thin broad-shouldered man in a 3/4 turn to the left. The man has dark curly hair, a face with sharp features - thick eyebrows, a long nose, a prominent mouth, a sharp chin. In his bent right hand he holds a skull, his left hand rests on his hip. He wears a dark costume with a white ruffled collar and cuffs.

works.d: Vanema täidlase mehe pea koos kaelusega poolpöördes vasakule. Mehel pikemad pisut lokkis juuksed, prillid teravaotsaline nina, etteulatuv lõug. Kaelas nootidega lips.
works.de: Head of an older stout man with a collar, in half-turn to the left. The man has longer, slightly curly hair, glasses, a sharp-tipped nose, a protruding chin. Around his neck a tie with musical notes.

works.d: Noorem balletipaar L. Austeri "Tiina" kostüümides sammumas ette vasakule. Naise tumedatel lokkis juustel pärg, suuresilmne nägu pööratud paremale, vasakul kõverdatud käel hoiab hundinahka. Heledapäise mehe samm väga hoogne, vasak käsi puusas.
works.de: A younger ballet couple in costumes from L. Auster's "Tiina", stepping forward to the left. The woman's dark curly hair is adorned with a wreath, her large-eyed face turned to the right, in her left bent arm she holds a wolf pelt. The fair-haired man's step is very energetic, his left hand on his hip.

works.d: Esiplaanil nooremapoolse harkisjalgse ette sirutatud kätega mehe täisfiguur poolpöördes vasakule. Mehel kohevad juuksed, ammulisuisel näol ehmunud-üllatunud ilme. Seljas ülikond tumedate pükste ja diagonaalruudus pintsakuga. Tagaplaanil sama imestunud tumedajuukseline triibulises kleidis noor naine. Mehel kõrval heina kuhi, taga maas ajaleht, naise taga põõsas.
works.de: In the foreground, the full figure of a rather young man with legs apart and arms stretched out forward, in a half-turn to the left. The man has tousled hair, an open-mouthed, startled-surprised expression on his face. He is wearing a suit with dark trousers and a diagonally checked jacket. In the background, a young woman with the same astonished expression, dark-haired, in a striped dress. Beside the man a haystack, behind him on the ground a newspaper, behind the woman a bush.

works.d: Vanema eriti ümmarguse mehe täisfiguur seismas - pea vasakprofiilis, keha poolpöördes vasakule. Mehel sirged hõredad juuksed, terava otsaga kaares nina, kõrvaauguks noodivõti. Mehe käed kehast veidi eemal, vasak käsi rusikas. Seljas frakk, rinnataskus rätik, mille number 60. Ümber parema õla ja üliümara kõhu nootide lint.
works.de: Full figure of an elderly, particularly rotund man standing - head in left profile, body in half-turn to the left. The man has straight sparse hair, a nose curved with a sharp tip, and a treble clef as an ear-hole. The man's arms are held slightly away from the body, the left hand clenched into a fist. Wearing a tailcoat, in the breast pocket a handkerchief bearing the number 60. Around the right shoulder and the extremely round belly a ribbon of sheet music.

works.d: Keskealise mehe täisfiguur vasakprofiilis pikal sammul tõttamas. Mehel lennus kohevad juuksed, paksud kulmud, laia otsaga nina, täidlane suu. Seljas tume ülikond, mille kuuetaskust paistab tennisereket, vasakus käes üle pea kasvanud noodipaberite rida pealkirjadega "PÜHAJÄRV", "TORMIDE RAND", "KÄSIKÄES". Paremas käes kirjatöös sulepea.
works.de: Full figure of a middle-aged man in left profile, hurrying along in a long stride. The man has hair fluffed up in the wind, thick eyebrows, a nose with a wide tip, a full mouth. Wearing a dark suit, from whose breast pocket a tennis racket protrudes, in his left hand a row of sheet music grown up over his head with titles "PÜHAJÄRV", "TORMIDE RAND", "KÄSIKÄES". In his right hand a pen, writing.

works.d: Poolkiilaspäise naerva mehe poolfiguur, pea vasakprofiilis. Mehel suured silmad, pikk terav nina, terav lõug, parem käsi puusas, vasakus hoiab krooni. Seljas - paremal pool ajalooline krookkraega kostüüm, vasakul lühikese käisega lahtise kaelusega särk.
works.de: Half-figure of a half-bald laughing man, head in left profile. The man has large eyes, a long sharp nose, a sharp chin, right hand on hip, holding a crown in his left hand. Wearing - on the right an historical costume with a ruff collar, on the left a shirt with short sleeves and an open collar.

works.d: Kaks keskealist meest sammumas ette vasakule. Vasakpoolne mees lühem, tumedate siledate juustega, heledas ülikonnas. Parema kaenla all noodilehed, mille kirjad: "Tasuleegid", "Kullaketrajad". Vasakus käes hoiab noodivõtit. Parempoolsel frakis mehel kohevad lokkis juuksed, jäme nina, jõuline suu, parem kaenla all noodilehed kirjaga "Käsikäes", vasakus käes taktikepp. Fraki rinnataskus tennisereket.
works.de: Two middle-aged men walking forward to the left. The man on the left is shorter, with dark smooth hair, in a light-coloured suit. Under his right arm sheet music with the titles: "Tasuleegid", "Kullaketrajad". In his left hand he holds a tuning key. The man on the right, in tails, has fluffy curly hair, a thick nose, a strong mouth, under his right arm sheet music with the title "Käsikäes", in his left hand a conductor's baton. In the breast pocket of his tailcoat a tennis racket.

works.d: Keskealise mehe pea koos õlgadega veerandpöördes vasakule. Mehel kohevad juuksed, kolmnurksed kulmud, pikk õhuke nina, kandiline lõug. Seljas ülikond, lipsu mustriks noodijoonestik.
works.de: Head and shoulders of a middle-aged man, quarter-turned to the left. The man has fluffy hair, triangular eyebrows, a long thin nose, a square chin. Wearing a suit, the tie patterned with a musical staff.

works.dm: lehe laius: 10.1 cm; lehe kõrgus: 14.3 cm
works.d: Elektrikitarr- ja orel lähevad Mi kogusse ning neid kasutatakse 2018. aastal avataval näitusel Noodid ridade vahel. Eesti levimuusika ajalugu. Peep Tõldsepa karikatuurid moodustavad terviku ning on ajastu näide ERSO orkestrantidest ja külalisdirigentidest.
works.de: The electric guitar and organ will join the Mi collection and will be used in the exhibition opening in 2018, Noodid ridade vahel. Eesti levimuusika ajalugu. Peep Tõldsepa's caricatures form a whole and are an example of the era's ERSO orchestra members and guest conductors.

works.d: Vanema mehe pea koos kaelusega 1/2 profiilis vasakule. Mehel külgedelt üles hoidvad lahku kammitud juuksed, kõrge ja lai otsmik, teravate joontega kortsus nägu, varem kulm kõrgem. Seljas lahtise kaelusega särk.
works.de: Head of an older man with a collar, in 1/2 profile to the left. The man has hair combed apart and held up at the sides, a high and wide forehead, a wrinkled face with sharp lines, the eyebrow raised earlier. Wearing a shirt with an open collar.

works.d: 3 pliiatsivisandit vanema naerva mehe peast. Ühel lehe küljel mehe pea vasakprofiilis. Mehel siledad üle pea kammitud juuksed, pikk terav nina, suur suu. All kiri Endel Pärn. Lehe teisel küljel 2 visandit mehe peast 1/4 profiilis vasakule. Neilt on näha, et mehe vasem kulm on kõrgem. Otsmikul juuksepiir taandunud.
works.de: 3 pencil sketches of the head of an elderly laughing man. On one side of the sheet the man's head in left profile. The man has smooth hair combed back over his head, a long sharp nose, a large mouth. Below an inscription Endel Pärn. On the other side of the sheet 2 sketches of the man's head in 1/4 profile to the left. From these it can be seen that the man's left eyebrow is higher. His hairline has receded at the forehead.

works.d: Pliiatsivisand keskealise mehe peast koos kaelaga vasakprofiilis. Mehel kohevad lokkis juuksed, madal otsmik, pikk õhuke nina, esileulatuv suu ja lõug.
works.de: A pencil sketch of a middle-aged man's head with neck in left profile. The man has fluffy curly hair, a low forehead, a long thin nose, protruding mouth and chin.

works.d: Keskealise poolkiilaspäise mehe pea koos kaelusega, veidi vasakule pööratud. Mehel ümmargune punapõskne nägu, kõrvade kohal 2 kollast krussis juuksekahlu, silmad sinised, suu roosinupu sarnane. Selja frakk.
works.de: Head of a middle-aged half-bald man with a collar, turned slightly to the left. The man has a round ruddy-cheeked face, 2 yellow curly tufts of hair above the ears, blue eyes, a mouth like a rosebud. Wearing tails.

works.d: Keskealise mehe pea koos kaelusega vasakprofiilis. Mehel lauge madal otsmik, jõuline jäme nina, pruntis huuled, etteulatuv lõug. Seljas frakk.
works.de: Head of a middle-aged man with a collar, in left profile. The man has a low sloping forehead, a strong thick nose, pouty lips, a protruding chin. Wearing a tailcoat.

works.d: Keskealise mehe poolfiguur vasakprofiilis. Mehel kohevad lokkis juuksed, piklik nägu, eriti pika ninaga, alahuul etteulatuv, vasak käsi püksitaskus.
works.de: Half-figure of a middle-aged man in left profile. The man has fluffy curly hair, an elongated face, a particularly long nose, a protruding lower lip, left hand in trouser pocket.

works.d: Keskealise mehe pea vasakprofiilis. Mehel toekama kaelaga, tahakammitud juuksed ees lokkis, nina ja alahuul eriti jõulised, topeltlõug. Kaelas kikilips.
works.de: Head of a middle-aged man in left profile. The man has a sturdy neck, hair combed back curling in front, nose and lower lip especially prominent, double chin. A bow tie at the neck.

works.dm: lehe laius: 19.6 cm; lehe kõrgus: 14.6 cm
works.d: Majade vahelt lähevad pillimehed, trummid jm kaasas.
works.de: Musicians walking between houses, carrying drums and other instruments.

works.dm: lehe laius: 16.0 cm; lehe kõrgus: 20.0 cm
works.d: Peetrus pilvedel vastu võtmas 6. mail hukkunud saksa lendureid.
works.de: Peter on the clouds receiving German pilots killed on 6 May.

works.t: Kto poslednij ja sa vami. 1942. Kes on viimane, ma olen teie järel
works.dm: lehe laius: 16.4 cm; lehe kõrgus: 20.5 cm
works.d: Peetrus võtmega väravas. Vasakul ingel, järjekorra lõpus Hitler pilve peal. Vasakul maakera keelt näitamas.
works.de: Peter with a key at the gate. On the left an angel, at the end of the queue Hitler on a cloud. On the left the globe sticking out its tongue.

works.dm: lehe laius: 15.7 cm; lehe kõrgus: 19.5 cm
works.d: Esiplaanil mees "ankeediga", tema kõrval järjekord. Üleval pilvel mees saksa kiivriga.
works.de: In the foreground a man with a "questionnaire", beside him a queue. Above on a cloud a man with a German helmet.

works.dm: lehe laius: 11.2 cm; lehe kõrgus: 16.0 cm
works.d: Seinal "plaan", selle juures istumas mees, kaks eesti rahvariides last süles.
works.de: On the wall a "plan", next to it a seated man, two Estonian children in national costume on his lap.

works.dm: lehe laius: 18.2 cm; lehe kõrgus: 24.8 cm
works.d: Pea poolpöördes paremale. Rõhutatud nahakurrud.
works.de: Head in three-quarter view facing right. Emphasized skin folds.

works.dm: lehe laius: 18.0 cm; lehe kõrgus: 24.8 cm
works.d: Pea poolpöördes vasakule. Siledad lühikesed juuksed, naerev nägu.
works.de: Head in half-turn to the left. Smooth short hair, laughing face.

works.dm: lehe laius: 14.8 cm; lehe kõrgus: 20.0 cm
works.d: Täisfiguur en face. Suur piip, millest väljuvad noodivõtmed.
works.de: Full figure en face. A large pipe from which musical clefs emerge.

works.d: Pea profiilis vasakule. Taustaks must eesriie.
works.de: Head in profile to the left. Black curtain as background.

works.d: Noorem kandiliste näojoontega prillidega mees auto roolis. Mehe selja taga õngeritv. Auto radiaatoril noodijoonestik, auto heitgaasideks samuti noodid.
works.de: A younger man with angular facial features and glasses at the wheel of a car. Behind the man's back a fishing rod. On the car's radiator a musical staff, the car's exhaust fumes are also musical notes.

works.d: Keskealise pikaninalise mehe täisfiguur sammumas vasakule. Mehel jalas säärikud, paremas käes lill, vasakus käes õlale toetuv õngeritv, mille nööri otsas noot ja noodivõti.
works.de: Full figure of a middle-aged, long-nosed man walking to the left. The man wears boots, in his right hand a flower, in his left hand a fishing rod resting on his shoulder, at the end of its line a note and a treble clef.

works.d: Vanema sirgete juustega kõhna teravate näojoontega prillidega mehe poolfiguur. Mehel käes alt rulli keerdunud noodipaber, suus piip, millest samuti väljub noot.
works.de: Half-figure of an older thin man with straight hair, sharp facial features and glasses. The man holds a sheet of music rolled up from below, a pipe in his mouth, from which a note also emerges.

works.d: külgvaates, naine sinises balletikleidis lendamas musta-valge triibulise linnu seljas
works.de: in side view, a woman in a blue ballet dress flying on the back of a black-and-white striped bird

works.d: Pea profiilis vasakule. Kaelale järgneb südame kujutis.
works.de: Head in profile to the left. A depiction of a heart follows on the neck.

works.d: Keskealise mehe vasakprofiilis pea lindiga kinni seotud noodipaberite kimbus. Mehel peadligi hõredad juuksed, pungis silmad, pikk nina, esiletungiv suu, üsna jäme kael. Väljapoole keerdunud noodilehtedel pealkirjad KALEVIPOEG, TASULEEGID, VABADUSE LAULIK.
works.de: Head of a middle-aged man in left profile, tied with a ribbon in a bundle of music sheets. The man has nearly thin hair, bulging eyes, a long nose, a protruding mouth, a rather thick neck. On the outward-curled music sheets, titles KALEVIPOEG, TASULEEGID, VABADUSE LAULIK.

works.d: Keskealise mehe vasakprofiilis pea koos õlapartii ja kätega. Mehel siledad hõredad juuksed. Kõhn terava-jooneline nägu kõrgete põsesarnade ja pika ninaga. Käes hoiab sarve, millest puistab libretopahmakaid, milledel tekstid VABADUSE LAULIK (LIBRETO), KÄSIKÄES (LIBRETO), TASULEEGID (LIBRETO).
works.de: Head of a middle-aged man in left profile, together with the shoulder area and hands. The man has smooth, sparse hair. A thin, sharp-featured face with high cheekbones and a long nose. He holds a horn from which bundles of librettos spill out, bearing the texts VABADUSE LAULIK (LIBRETO), KÄSIKÄES (LIBRETO), TASULEEGID (LIBRETO).

works.d: Väga kõhna vanema mehe poolfiguur poolpöördes vasakule. Mehel hõredad juuksed, paksud eriti lennukad kulmud, pikk kongus nina, täidlane suur suu, kandiline lõug, eriti pikk kael. Parem käsi puusas, vasakus käes hoiab nelja eriilmelist teatrimaski. Seljas ülikond rombimustrilise lipsuga, rinnataskus ratsu ja kuningas.
works.de: Half-figure of a very thin elderly man in a half-turn to the left. The man has sparse hair, thick, particularly flyaway eyebrows, a long hooked nose, a full large mouth, a square chin, an especially long neck. Right hand on hip, in his left hand he holds four masks of theatre with different expressions. Wearing a suit with a diamond-patterned tie, in the breast pocket a knight and a king [chess pieces].

works.d: Esiplaanil keskealise mehe pateetilises poosis täisfiguur 3/4 pöördes paremale. Mehel kohevad lokkis juuksed, silmad suletud, vurrud uhkelt kaardus, suu avatud, ristatud sõrmedega käed rinnale surutud, jalad graatsilises poosis. Pikema kuu käistest paistavad krookmansetid, jalas kitsad triibulised püksid ja kõrgekontsalised lehvidega kingad. Paremalt kulisside vahelt piilub täpilises kleidis helepäine neiu. All pliiatsikirjas tekst: Monoloog pidi olema hea. Kõik oli siin peenelt välja töötatud.
works.de: In the foreground a full-figure of a middle-aged man in a pathetic pose, in a 3/4 turn to the right. The man has fluffed curly hair, closed eyes, moustache proudly curved, mouth open, hands with crossed fingers pressed to his chest, legs in a graceful pose. From the sleeves of a longer coat frilled cuffs are visible, wearing narrow striped trousers and high-heeled shoes with bows. From between the wings on the right a fair-haired maiden in a spotted dress peeks out. Below, in pencil, the text: The monologue was supposed to be good. Everything here was finely worked out.

works.d: Paremal noorepoolse mehe täisfiguur - pea vasakprofiilis, sõjakas poosis keha enam-vähem seljaga esiplaani poole. Mehel kohevad poolpikad juuksed, eriti püstine nina, käed kõverdatud. Tema vastas noorepoolsed mees ja naine seismas poolpöördes paremale, mõlemad üsna kohkunud.
works.de: On the right, the full figure of a fairly young man - head in left profile, body in a warlike pose more or less with his back to the foreground. The man has fluffy shoulder-length hair, an especially upturned nose, arms bent. Facing him, a fairly young man and woman standing in a half-turn to the right, both quite startled.

works.d: Vanema naise vasakprofiilis poolfiguur. Naisel poolpikad lokkis juuksed, suured silmad, püstine nina, võimukas lõug. Naise käed küünarnukkidest kõverdatud, Seljas tume kleit valge pitsiservalise krae ja kätistega.
works.de: Half-figure of an older woman in left profile. The woman has semi-long curly hair, large eyes, a straight nose, a commanding chin. The woman's arms bent at the elbows. Wearing a dark dress with a white lace-edged collar and cuffs.

works.d: Vanema täidlase mehe poolfiguur poolpöördes vasakule. Mehel üle pea kammitud juuksed, lai kitsaste silmadega muhedailmeline nägu. Parem käsi rinnale surutud, vasak ette sirutatud. Seljas frakk.
works.de: Half figure of an older stout man, half-turned to the left. The man with hair combed over his head, a broad face with narrow eyes and a genial expression. Right hand pressed to the chest, left hand stretched forward. Wearing tails.

works.d: Ümmargusevõitu vurrukestega ja poolkiilaspäine mees istumas vasakprofiilis ja õngitsemas. istmeks noodipaberi rull, kõrval kauss nootidega, õngenööri otsas noot.
works.de: A roundish man with little moustaches and a half-bald head sitting in left profile fishing, seated on a roll of music paper, beside him a bowl with sheet music, at the end of the fishing line a note.

works.d: Šarži visandid vanema pikaninalise mehe peast profiilis. 2 visandit poolikud, 1 lõpetatum. Pöördel vana profiilis mehe pea. Mehel suur täishabe ja prillid.
works.de: Caricature sketches of the head of an older, long-nosed man in profile. 2 sketches unfinished, 1 more finished. On the verso, the head of an old man in profile. The man has a large full beard and glasses.

works.d: Vanema mehe täisfiguur, pea ja ülakeha pööratud vasakule, jalad otse, jalapöiad väljapoole pööratud. Mehe pea on peaaegu täiesti kiilas, nina eriti jõuline, selle all vurrutups. Seljas topeltlipsuga triibuliste pükstega ülikond, paremas käes jalutuskepp, vasak veidi kõveradatud.
works.de: Full figure of an older man, head and upper body turned to the left, legs straight, feet turned outward. The man's head is almost completely bald, the nose especially strong, with a moustache tuft beneath it. He wears a suit with a double-tied tie and striped trousers, a walking cane in his right hand, the left slightly bent.

works.d: Keskealise poolkiilaspäise mehe täisfiguur seismas 3/4 pöördes vasakule. Mehel käes viiul, mille kaelal loorberipärg pika lindiga, millel numbrid "50" ja "45". Paremas käes oleva viiulipoogna alt väljuvad noodid. Mehel seljas frakk.
works.de: Full figure of a middle-aged partially bald man standing in a 3/4 turn to the left. The man holds a violin, on the neck of which is a laurel wreath with a long ribbon bearing the numbers "50" and "45". Notes emerge from under the violin bow held in the right hand. The man is wearing a tailcoat.

works.d: Vanema mehe täisfiguur seismas 3/4 pöördes paremale. Mehel kohevad juuksed ja kulmud, nina eriti pikk ja terav, ees ümmarguste klaasidega prillid. Vasaku õla üle riputatud loorberipärjast ripuvad alla väikseõielised taimed. Parema kaela all noodileht ja kurvameelne teatrimask.
works.de: Full figure of an older man standing in 3/4 turn to the right. The man has fluffy hair and eyebrows, an especially long and sharp nose, round glass-lensed spectacles in front. Small-flowered plants hang down from a laurel wreath draped over his left shoulder. Under his right neck, a sheet of music and a sorrowful theatre mask.

works.d: Ludvig Juhti portree on täiendus muuseumi maalikogusse. Teos omab kultuuriloolist väärtust.
works.de: The portrait of Ludvig Juhti is an addition to the museum's painting collection. The work has cultural-historical value.

works.d: Keskealise kohevate juustega naerva mehe pea paremprofiilis. Mehe juustepiir taandunud, silmad suletud. Kaelas krae ja noodikirjaline lips.
works.de: Head of a middle-aged laughing man with fluffy hair, in right profile. The man's hairline is receding, eyes closed. Collar and a music-notation-patterned tie around the neck.

works.d: Vanema täidlase mehe pea 3/4 profiilis paremale. Mehel taha kammitud juuksed, kongus nina, pruntis suu, esiletungiv lõug. Kaelas paistab osa täpilisest lipsust.
works.de: Head of an older stout man in 3/4 profile to the right. The man has hair combed back, a hooked nose, pursed mouth, and a prominent chin. Part of a spotted tie is visible at the neck.

works.d: Keskealise mehe suurepäine täisfiguur. Mehe pea pisut paremale pööratud, nägu kandiline, juuksed sirged. Mehe käed külgedele välja sirutatud. Paremas käes taktikepp, vasakus pasun. Seljas frakk.
works.de: Large-headed full figure of a middle-aged man. The man's head turned slightly to the right, face angular, hair straight. The man's arms stretched out to the sides. In the right hand a baton, in the left a horn. Wearing tails.

works.d: Noorema mehe pisut vasakule pööratud suurepäine täisfiguur. Mehel piklik veidi lokkis juustega pea. Seljas frakk, käed külgedele sirutatud, vasakus käes taktikepp.
works.de: Full figure of a younger man with a large head, turned slightly to the left. The man has an elongated, slightly curly-haired head. Wearing a tailcoat, arms stretched out to the sides, a baton in the left hand.

works.dm: lehe laius: 14.0 cm; lehe kõrgus: 20.0 cm
works.d: Keskel lehm, kellel akordion kaelas ja must müts peas. Ees mees pasunaga. All tekst: Ega elul pole viga...
works.de: In the middle a cow with an accordion around its neck and a black cap on its head. In front, a man with a horn. Below, the text: Ega elul pole viga...

works.d: Vanema tüseda mehe poolfiguur, pea vasakprofiilis. Mehel väikesed silmad, suurevõitu terav nina, kottis põsed, lott lõua all. Keha on peaga võrreldes õieti jõuline. Seljas frakk, mille nööpideks on noodid.
works.de: Half-figure of an elderly stout man, head in left profile. The man has small eyes, a rather large sharp nose, baggy cheeks, a double chin. His body is actually more powerful than his head would suggest. Wearing tails, with musical notes as buttons.

works.d: Keskealise mehe pea koos kaelusega 1/4 profiilis vasakule. Šarž paigutatud paberile diagonaalselt. Mehel kohevad lokkis juuksed, paksud kulmud, jäme lühike nina, paksuhuuleline suu, seljas frakk.
works.de: The head of a middle-aged man with a collar, in 1/4 profile to the left. The caricature is placed diagonally on the paper. The man has fluffy curly hair, thick eyebrows, a thick short nose, a thick-lipped mouth, wearing a tailcoat.

works.d: Vanema mehe pea koos õlgadega, pisut vasakule pööratud. Mehel pikk nägu, krussis juuksetukk, silmad välisäärtest allapoole, nina pikk, suu kitsas, ilme muhelev. Paistab üks (vasak) kõrv. Seljas frakk. Šaržil paistab ka vasak käsi, mille kahe esimese sõrme vahel on taktikepp.
works.de: The head of an older man together with the shoulders, turned slightly to the left. The man has a long face, a curly forelock, eyes below the outer corners, a long nose, a narrow mouth, a smiling expression. One (left) ear is visible. Wearing a tailcoat. In the caricature, the left hand is also visible, holding a conductor's baton between the first two fingers.

works.d: Noorepoolse naise pea koos õlgadega vasakprofiilis. Portreed võib lugeda rohkem joonistuseks. Naisel mustad lainelised poolpikad juuksed, tumedad erksad silmad, pikk sirge nina, lõua all väike lott. Seljas midagi rohelist.
works.de: Head and shoulders of a fairly young woman in left profile. The portrait can be read more as a drawing. The woman has black wavy semi-long hair, dark lively eyes, a long straight nose, a small fold under the chin. She is wearing something green.

works.d: Keskealise mehe poolfiguur vasakprofiilis. Mehel juuksepiir taandunud, suured silmad, pikk ülespidi otsaga nina. Kummis rinna kohal noodijoonestikuga lips. Käsi pole kujutatud.
works.de: Half-figure of a middle-aged man in left profile. The man has a receding hairline, large eyes, a long nose with an upturned tip. A tie with a musical staff pattern over the chest area. The hand is not depicted.

works.d: 3 erinevat näoilmet, 1/2 pöördes vasakule: tõsine, tähelepanelikult vaatav, veidi muhelev.
works.de: 3 different facial expressions, in 1/2 turn to the left: serious, attentively looking, slightly smiling.

works.d: Teatrikunstnik Kustav-Agu Püümani (s 1937) kavanditekogu annab tervikliku ülevaate tema elutööst teatrites. Alates 1994. aastast töötanud kunstnikuna Tallinna Linnateatris, teinud töid ka teistele teatritele. Püüman on loonud kujundusi pidulikele kontsertidele, laulu- ja tantsupidudele, vabaõhulavastustele, telesaadetele ja filmidele ning teinud kostüüme varieteele. Püümani käe all on õppinud suur arv kunstitudengeid Eesti Kunstiakadeemias.
works.de: The collection of sketches by theatre artist Kustav-Agu Püüman (b. 1937) provides a comprehensive overview of his life's work in the theatres. Working as an artist at the Tallinn City Theatre since 1994, he has also done work for other theatres. Püüman has created designs for festive concerts, song and dance festivals, open-air productions, television programmes and films, and has made costumes for variety shows. A large number of art students at the Estonian Academy of Arts have studied under Püüman's guidance.

works.d: Boris Kõrver (portreemaal), 1969. Eesti operetimeister ning levi- ja rahvaliku muusika looja Boris Kõrveri (1917 – 1994) 3/4 portree on ajast, mil Kõrver oli Eesti Heliloojate Liidu esimees. Maali lakooniline laad jätab heliloojast rahuliku ja hillitsetud mulje, tema sügavam loomus jääb vaatajate eest peidetuks. Maali pastelne heledates toonides koloriit toob eriliselt hästi esile Kõrveri tõmmu nahavärvi ning erksinised silmad. /tekst Liisi Aibel, 2013/
works.de: Boris Kõrver (portrait painting), 1969. The 3/4 portrait of the Estonian master of operetta and creator of popular and folk music, Boris Kõrver (1917 – 1994), dates from the time when Kõrver was chairman of the Estonian Composers' Union. The laconic style of the painting leaves a calm and restrained impression of the composer, his deeper nature remaining hidden from viewers. The pastel, light-toned coloring of the painting especially brings out well Kõrver's swarthy complexion and bright blue eyes. /text Liisi Aibel, 2013/

Sellest annab tunnistust asjaolu, et pea täpselt samasugune portree Urbelist on ka Kristjan Tederil (VIIDE: ETMM ML160). Einmann on Urbelit kujutanud puhkehetkel murelik-mõtlikul ilmel sigaretti suitsetamas. 1946. aastal lavastas Urbel Vanemuise teatris Prokofjevi „Romeo ja Julia“, võimalik, et maal on tehtud ajal, mil käis antud lavastuse prooviperiood. Legendaarset ja pikaaegset balletilavastajat on Einmann kujutanud võrdlemisi realistlikult ja 1940. aastatele omases vaikelulikus laadis. /tekst Liisi Aibel, 2013/
works.de: Ida Urbel (portrait painting), 1946. The 3/4 portrait of Vanemuine's ballet master and director Ida Urbel (1900 – 1983) was apparently painted either as a hand exercise or during joint painting sessions in the studio. This is evidenced by the fact that an almost identical portrait of Urbel also exists by Kristjan Teder (REFERENCE: ETMM ML160). Einmann has depicted Urbel during a moment of rest, smoking a cigarette with a worried-pensive expression. In 1946 Urbel staged Prokofiev's "Romeo and Juliet" at the Vanemuine theatre, and it is possible that the painting was made during the rehearsal period of this production. Einmann has depicted the legendary and long-serving ballet director in a relatively realistic manner and in the still-life-like style characteristic of the 1940s. /text Liisi Aibel, 2013/

works.d: Teatrikunstnik Kustav-Agu Püümani (s 1937) kavanditekogu annab tervikliku ülevaate tema elutööst teatrites. Alates 1994. aastast töötanud kunstnikuna Tallinna Linnateatris, teinud töid ka teistele teatritele. Püüman on loonud kujundusi pidulikele kontsertidele, laulu- ja tantsupidudele, vabaõhulavastustele, telesaadetele ja filmidele ning teinud kostüüme varieteele. Püümani käe all on õppinud suur arv kunstitudengeid Eesti Kunstiakadeemias.
works.de: The collection of sketches by theatre artist Kustav-Agu Püüman (b. 1937) provides a comprehensive overview of his life's work in the theatres. Working as an artist at the Tallinn City Theatre since 1994, he has also done work for other theatres. Püüman has created designs for festive concerts, song and dance festivals, open-air productions, television programmes and films, and has made costumes for variety shows. A large number of art students at the Estonian Academy of Arts have studied under Püüman's guidance.

works.d: Aleksei Rodionov (portreemaal), dateerimata. Näitleja, lavameistri ja ühe Pärnu Eesti Teatri asutaja Aleksei Rodionovi (1877 – 1969) 1/3 portree on loodud realistlik-akadeemilises laadis. Rodionovi puhul on kunstnik rõhutanud tema silmapaistvamaid karakteristikuid – punajuukselist lokkis soengut ja uhkeid ülespoole keeratud otstega vuntse, mis harmoneeruvad kaunilt maali rohekashalli üldkoloriidiga. Tema pilk on veidi ehmunud – silmad kaugusesse pööratud ning suu kergelt paokil. See loob mulje nagu oleks tegu foto, mitte maaliga. Maali juurde kuulub ilunuppudega lai tumepruun puitraam. /tekst Liisi Aibel, 2013/
works.de: Aleksei Rodionov (portrait painting), undated. The 1/3 portrait of actor, stage master and one of the founders of the Pärnu Estonian Theatre, Aleksei Rodionov (1877 – 1969), was created in a realistic-academic manner. In Rodionov's case, the artist has emphasised his most distinctive characteristics – curly reddish hair and proud upward-curled moustache ends, which harmonise beautifully with the painting's overall greenish-grey colouring. His gaze is slightly startled – his eyes turned into the distance and his mouth slightly open. This creates an impression as if it were a photograph rather than a painting. The painting has a wide dark brown wooden frame with decorative knobs. /text Liisi Aibel, 2013/

works.d: Hugo Raudsepp (portreemaal), 1946. Eesti näitekirjaniku ja teatri- ning kirjanduskriitiku Hugo Raudsepa (1883 – 1952) 3/4 portree kujutab teda käsikirja lugemas. Võimalik, et Väli on portree maalimiseks inspiratsiooni saanud mõne Raudsepa näidendi esitluselt (1946. aastal ilmus kirjanikul lausa kaks näidendit – „Rotid“ ja „Tagatipu Tiisenoosen“). Portree laad on realistlik. Näitekirjanikku kujutatakse vanema kõhnapoolse härrasmehena, kes on süvenenud käsikirja ettelugemisse. Tema taga lauale on vaasiga asetatud kevadlilled ning üldine atmosfäär mõjub sõbraliku ja helgena. /tekst Liisi Aibel, 2013/
works.de: Hugo Raudsepp (portrait painting), 1946. The 3/4 portrait of Estonian playwright and theatre and literary critic Hugo Raudsepp (1883 – 1952) depicts him reading a manuscript. It is possible that Väli found inspiration for painting the portrait from a presentation of one of Raudsepp's plays (in 1946 the writer published as many as two plays – "Rotid" and "Tagatipu Tiisenoosen"). The style of the portrait is realistic. The playwright is depicted as an older, rather thin gentleman, absorbed in reading aloud from the manuscript. Behind him on the table stand spring flowers in a vase, and the overall atmosphere feels friendly and bright. /text Liisi Aibel, 2013/

works.d: Klaudia Maldutis (portreemaal), 1943. Estonia balletisolisti ja varieteetantsija Klaudia Maldutise (1910 – 1995) 3/4 portreemaal on valminud aasta enne seda, kui nii portreteeritav kui ka kunstnik Eestist põgenesid – Maldutis esmalt Rootsi ning Kõks Saksamaale. Hoogsa pintslitehnikaga „õhuline“ portree kujutab tantsijannat peene daamina, kelle uhke kübar, hinnaline kaelakee ja tugitooliga harmoneeruvalt punaseks värvitud suu eiravad väljaspool ateljeed valitsevat sõjaolukorda. /tekst Liisi Aibel, 2013/
works.de: Klaudia Maldutis (portrait painting), 1943. The 3/4 portrait painting of Estonia ballet soloist and variety dancer Klaudia Maldutis (1910 – 1995) was created a year before both the sitter and the artist fled Estonia – Maldutis first to Sweden, and Kõks to Germany. The "airy" portrait, executed with vigorous brush technique, depicts the dancer as a refined lady, whose proud hat, valuable necklace, and mouth painted red to harmonise with the armchair disregard the state of war prevailing outside the studio. /text by Liisi Aibel, 2013/

works.d: Paul Pinna (portreemaal), 1943. Pisiformaadis 1/3 portreemaal legendaarsest eesti näitlejast Paul Pinnast (1884 – 1949) on valminud Jaroslavis, NSV Liidu tagalas, kus nii kunstnik kui ka portreteeritav kuulusid ERKA-sse (Eesti Riiklikud Kunstiansamblid Jaroslavis). Portree on psühholoogilis-realistlik ning märgatav on vene realismi mõju. Maalitehniliselt on kunstnik kasutanud laia ja kiiret pintslilööki ning sõjaaegsetele meeleoludele vastavat tumedat koloriiti. /tekst Liisi Aibel, 2013/
works.de: Paul Pinna (portrait painting), 1943. This small-format portrait painting of the legendary Estonian actor Paul Pinna (1884–1949) was completed in Yaroslavl, in the rear of the USSR, where both the artist and the sitter belonged to ERKA (the Estonian State Art Ensembles in Yaroslavl). The portrait is psychologically realistic and shows a noticeable influence of Russian realism. In terms of painting technique, the artist has used broad and swift brushstrokes and a dark colour scheme corresponding to the wartime mood. /text by Liisi Aibel, 2013/

works.d: Arno Suurorg (portreemaal), 1958. 1/2 portree Draamateatri näitlejast Arno Suurorust (1903 – 1960) on lahtise pintslikäsitlusega loodud realistlik maal. Suurorg on jõuline ja domineeriv, tema poos on uhke ning väärikust lisab tema käes olev jäme puidust jalutuskepp. Maali koloriidis sulanduvad soojad ja külmad toonid, mis loovad kirju ja rahutu üldmulje. /tekst Liisi Aibel, 2013/
works.de: Arno Suurorg (portrait painting), 1958. A 1/2 portrait of the Drama Theatre actor Arno Suurorg (1903–1960), created with loose brushwork, is a realistic painting. Suurorg is vigorous and dominant, his pose is proud, and dignity is added by the thick wooden walking cane in his hand. The colouring of the painting blends warm and cold tones, creating a varied and restless overall impression. /text Liisi Aibel, 2013/

works.d: Linda Sellistemägi (a-st 1943 Moor) (portreemaal), 1948. Väli 1/2 portreemaal Estonia ooperisolistist ja estraadinäitlejast Linda Sellistemägist (1909 – 1981) on loodud psühholoogilis-realistlikus sõjaaegsetele ja -järgsetel aastatele omases hillitsetud, kuid ausas laadis. Sellistemägi kujutatakse keskealise mõtliku daamina, kel juustes juba pisut halli. Käte vahel hoiab lauljanna raamatut, mida ilmselt võib pidada noodiraamatuks. Nii raamat kui ka käed toetuvad tumedale juugendstiilis lauale. /tekst Liisi Aibel, 2013/
works.de: Linda Sellistemägi (from 1943 Moor) (portrait painting), 1948. A 1/2 portrait painting of Estonia opera soloist and variety actress Linda Sellistemägi (1909 – 1981), created in a psychological-realistic, restrained yet honest manner characteristic of the wartime and post-war years. Sellistemägi is depicted as a middle-aged, thoughtful lady, with hair already slightly grey. Between her hands, the singer holds a book, presumably a sheet music book. Both the book and the hands rest on a dark Art Nouveau-style table. /text by Liisi Aibel, 2013/

works.d: Raimund Kull (portreemaal), 1929. Pastell- ja söeportree eesti heliloojast, dirigendist ja puhkpillimängijast Raimund Kullist (1882 – 1942) on ilmselt valminud suvepuhkuse ajal Narva-Jõesuu kuurordis. Suvisele ajale vihjab Kulli seljas olev kerge ülikond ning avatud nööpidega triiksärk, samuti kollakas, suvist valgust meenutav varjutus taustal. Maali keskpunktiks on helilooja ümmarguste prillide tagant paistvad helesinised silmad, mis harmoneeruvad tema ülikonna tooniga. /tekst Liisi Aibel/
works.de: Raimund Kull (portrait painting), 1929. The pastel and charcoal portrait of the Estonian composer, conductor and wind instrument player Raimund Kull (1882 – 1942) was probably made during a summer holiday at the Narva-Jõesuu resort. The light suit worn by Kull and his shirt with open buttons hint at the summer season, as does the yellowish shading in the background, reminiscent of summer light. The focal point of the painting is the composer's light blue eyes showing behind his round glasses, which harmonize with the tone of his suit. /text by Liisi Aibel/

works.d: Vasakul klaveri taga keskealine paremprofiilis mees. Mehel taha kammitud juuksed, eriti suured silmad, suur nina, seljas frakk. Tema kõrval klaveri taga paremprofiilis keskealine pikas kleidis daam. Daamil poolpikad veidi lokkis juuksed, range ilme. Parema käega toetub viimasele klaverile täidlane frakis mees, kelle hõredate juustega pea on pööratud vasakule. Mehel prillid, vasak käsi pisut kõverdatud. Paremal vasakprofiilis keskealine frakis mees dirigeerimispoosis. Mehel kohevad lokkis juuksed, madal otsmik, paksud kulmud.
works.de: On the left, behind the piano, a middle-aged man in right profile. The man has hair combed back, particularly large eyes, a large nose, and wears a tailcoat. Beside him, behind the piano, a middle-aged lady in right profile wearing a long dress. The lady has semi-long, slightly curly hair and a stern expression. A stout man in a tailcoat, with sparse hair, leans with his right hand on the latter piano, his head turned to the left. The man wears glasses, his left arm slightly bent. On the right, a middle-aged man in a tailcoat, in left profile, in a conducting pose. The man has fluffy curly hair, a low forehead, thick eyebrows.

works.d: akvarell, akrüül, värvipliiats. Paber. Maalil kuldne kitsas raam, klaasitud. Maali mõõdud: kõrgus 71 cm x laius 51 cm. Kirjeldus: vertikaalsed orhideetaimed, kuldsete õitega. Taustal pildi keskel ümmargune kollane kuu. Taustavärvideks vertikaalsed laiad värvialad: vasakul valge, keskel sinine, paremal roheline. Valgel osal vertikaalsed tekstid (orhidee nimetused): kaheleheline käokeel (ametlik nimetus), viinalill, ilusahaisugaroos, ööviiul (rahvakeeles). Pildi all vasakus servas 3 eri suurusega signeeringut: kasti sees TT08.
works.de: watercolour, acrylic, coloured pencil. Paper. The painting has a narrow gilt frame, glazed. Dimensions of the painting: height 71 cm x width 51 cm. Description: vertical orchid plants with golden blossoms. In the background, in the centre of the picture, a round yellow moon. The background colours consist of vertical broad colour zones: white on the left, blue in the centre, green on the right. On the white area, vertical texts (orchid names): kaheleheline käokeel (official name), viinalill, ilusahaisugaroos, ööviiul (in vernacular). At the bottom left edge of the picture, 3 signatures of different sizes: within a box TT08.

works.d:
Pildi tagaküljel tekst autorilt:
Kuidas elu läheb? Kuidas tervis on? Kuidas raamatukirjutamine edeneb?
Minu elu läheb vana viisi. Juunis mu noored sõbrannad tegid mulle suure näituse. Panin 120 tööd välja. Oli edukas näitus. Kas saatsin Teile kataloogi?
Juulis käisin Kaare Kolbrega Põhja-Itaalias. Oli vägailus ja huvitav reis, kuid kliima oli liiga palav minu jaoks. Aga eluga ja tervena tulin tagasi. Nüüd teen jälle graafikat, mis mu meele värske hoiab. Plaadid on küll palju väiksemad, sest jõud ei jaksa suuri tõsta ja produtseerin vähem. Mõni töö tuleb päris kena ja huvitav. Hea seegi.
     Tervitades Ilse Leetaru.
works.de:
Text from the author on the back of the picture:
How is life going? How is your health? How is the book-writing progressing?
My life goes on in the old way. In June my young friends put on a big exhibition for me. I put up 120 works. It was a successful exhibition. Did I send you the catalogue?
In July I travelled with Kaare Kolbre to Northern Italy. It was a very beautiful and interesting trip, but the climate was too hot for me. But I came back alive and healthy. Now I am doing graphic art again, which keeps my mind fresh. The plates are indeed much smaller, since my strength no longer allows me to lift large ones, and I produce less. Some works turn out quite nice and interesting. That is good too.
     Greetings, Ilse Leetaru.

works.t: 12 puugravüüri Marta Sillaotsa lasteraamatule "Trips, Traps, Trull"
works.d: Jüri Haini koostatud kogumik Eduard Järve 12ne puugravüüriga Marta Sillaotsa lasteraamatule "Trips, Traps, Trull" võetakse UTKK kogusse vastu lähtuvalt kogumispõhimõtete peatükis 2.3. Muuseumikogu täiendamise üldpõhimõtted ja sisulised kriteeriumid, olevast punktist 1) Muuseumi kogudesse võetakse valikuliselt vastu Marie Underi, Artur Adsoni, Friedebert ja Elo Tuglase ning Paul Reetsi esemelist ja vaimset pärandit ning esemeid ja kirjavara nende ja nende kaasteeliste kohta; ja 2) Muuseumi kogudesse võetakse valikuliselt vastu Teise maailmasõja eelse modernismiga seotud materjale, millel on seos ka eelmainitud kirjanikega.
works.de: The compilation of Eduard Järve's 12 woodcuts for Marta Sillaots' children's book "Trips, Traps, Trull", compiled by Jüri Hain, is accepted into the UTKK collection based on the collection principles chapter 2.3. General Principles and Substantive Criteria for Supplementing the Museum Collection, point 1) The museum collections selectively accept the material and spiritual heritage of Marie Under, Artur Adson, Friedebert and Elo Tuglas, and Paul Reets, as well as objects and written works about them and their contemporaries; and 2) The museum collections selectively accept materials related to pre-World War II modernism that also have a connection to the aforementioned writers.

works.d: Võetud UTKK kogusse vastu lähtuvalt Kogumispõhimõtete peatükis 2.3. Muuseumikogu täiendamise üldpõhimõtted ja sisulised kriteeriumid välja toodud punktidest 1) Muuseumi kogudesse võetakse valikuliselt vastu Marie Underi, Artur Adsoni, Friedebert ja Elo Tuglase ning Paul Reetsi esemelist ja vaimset pärandit ning esemeid ja kirjavara nende ja nende kaasteeliste kohta, 2) Neist kirjanikest lähtuvalt kogutakse teise maailmasõja eelse modernismiga seotud materjale, mis on seotud nähtusega eesti kultuuris, aga ka laiemalt – rahvusvaheliselt – nii, nagu see oli näiteks Friedebert Tuglase elutöös ning vajalik kirjandusuurimuseks, 3) Seotuna asutuse uurimistemaatikaga võetakse valikuliselt vastu Väli
works.de: Accepted into the UTKK collection based on the points listed in the Collection Principles chapter 2.3. General principles and substantive criteria for supplementing the museum collection: 1) The museum's collections selectively accept the material and intellectual heritage of Marie Under, Artur Adson, Friedebert and Elo Tuglas, and Paul Reets, as well as items and correspondence related to them and their fellow travellers, 2) Based on these writers, materials related to pre-World War II modernism are collected, connected to the phenomenon in Estonian culture, but also more broadly – internationally – as it appeared, for example, in the life's work of Friedebert Tuglas, and as necessary for literary research, 3) Connected to the institution's research topics, Väli [material] is selectively accepted

works.d: Gravüür "Wittenstein in Lieffland Paide". Faksimiilegravüür, mustad jooned valgel pinnal. Päises valge ovaal, mida ümbritseb figuraal- ja taimornament. Alumises osas Paide linna skemaatiline plaan 14.-15.saj. Ülemises osas kiri "Wittenstein in Lieffland". Heledas pappraamis, mis altservast veidi katki. Tagaküljele kleebitud pruun paber katkine.  Korras, kulunud
works.de: Engraving "Wittenstein in Lieffland Paide". Facsimile engraving, black lines on a white ground. In the header a white oval surrounded by figural and plant ornament. In the lower part a schematic plan of the town of Paide from the 14th–15th centuries. In the upper part the inscription "Wittenstein in Lieffland". In a light cardboard frame, slightly torn at the lower edge. Brown paper glued to the back is torn. In order, worn

works.d: Guashshmaal "Paide turg", koopia originaalist paberil. Kujutatud Paide Keskväljakut (Turuplats). Tagaplaanil keskel kirik, paremal kauguses varemetes lossitorn. Kiriku kõrval vasakul üksik maja, kahekordne, punase katusega. Maja kõrvalt läheb tänav.  Kiriku kõrval kahel pool majad. Väljakul turg - 4 hobust vankritega, ratsanik ja inimesed kahe- ja kolmekaupa koos jalutamas ja äritsemas. All ääres: F.Wilbrg 1856. Pleekinud, servadest kortsunud
works.de: Gouache painting "Paide turg", a copy of the original on paper. Depicts Paide Central Square (Turuplats). In the background, in the middle, a church, in the distance on the right a ruined castle tower. Next to the church on the left, a single house, two-storey, with a red roof. A street runs from beside the house. On both sides of the church, houses. In the square a market – 4 horses with carts, a rider, and people walking and trading in twos and threes. At the bottom edge: F.Wilbrg 1856. Faded, corners worn at the edges

works.d: Õlimaal. O. Hoffmann.  Koolmeister. Koolmeistri portree poolprofiil vasakule. Hõredad kaelani ulatuvad juuksed, kõrge laup, tugevad kaarjad kulmud, sirge nina, sinised silmad, vähemärgatav põskhabe. Hele särgikaelus, tume kuub. Puidust raam, kolmeosaline, äärmine osa kaetud rikkaliku  kipsist ornamendiga, mis üle kullatud. Osaliselt värvikiht ära tulnud. Kulunud
works.de: Oil painting. O. Hoffmann. Schoolmaster. Portrait of a schoolmaster, half-profile to the left. Sparse hair reaching to the neck, high forehead, strong arched eyebrows, straight nose, blue eyes, barely noticeable side-whiskers. Light shirt collar, dark coat. Wooden frame, three-part, the outer part covered with rich plaster ornament, which is gilded over. Paint layer partially peeled off. Worn

works.d: Õlimaal. G. Hippius. Dr. Ackermann`i portree. Poolportree. Seljas tume jakk, jaki all valge särk püstkraega, kaelas must kaelaside. Särgi peal valge vest 3 nööbiga. Rinnal peenikese keti otsas ripub ripats. Tumeda jaki revääri vasakusse nurka on kinnitatud punase-sinise värviga märk. Portreel on vasak käsi küünarnukist kõverdatud. Teise ja kolmanda sõrme vahel põlev sigaret. Teises sõrmes tumeda kiviga sõrmus, neljandas sõrmes väiksem ilma kivita sõrmus. Nägu asub pool-profiilis.Tumedad juuksed kammitud vasakule, küljelt seitliga. Lõuendil väiksemad täkked ja kriimustused
works.de: Oil painting. G. Hippius. Portrait of Dr. Ackermann. Half-length portrait. Wearing a dark jacket, under the jacket a white shirt with a stand-up collar, a black necktie at the neck. Over the shirt a white waistcoat with 3 buttons. On the chest a pendant hangs on a thin chain. A red-and-blue coloured badge is attached to the left corner of the dark jacket's lapel. In the portrait the left arm is bent at the elbow. A burning cigarette between the second and third fingers. On another finger a ring with a dark stone, on the fourth finger a smaller ring without a stone. The face is in half-profile. Dark hair combed to the left, parted at the side. The canvas has small dents and scratches

On the left bare-branched trees, beneath them flows a narrow river, on whose banks the snow has partly melted. Further back a forest, with dwelling houses partly visible among it. In the lower left corner the author's signature and the year 1964. The painting has been freshly glazed and framed. The frame is of natural wood.

Keskel on seljaga vaataja poole talumees istumas reel ja sõitmas maja poole .Rege veab hobune, ree kõrval jookseb koer. Lumel on reejäljed.Maal on raamitud, klaasitud, tagaküljel andmed autori kohta.
works.de: The painting depicts a winter landscape of Estonia with a bare grove on the left and an old farmhouse with a smoking chimney on the right. In the centre a farmer, seen from behind, is sitting on a sledge and riding towards the house. The sledge is pulled by a horse, a dog runs beside the sledge. There are sledge tracks in the snow. The painting is framed, glazed, on the reverse data about the author.

Asimese , suure nelinurga alläärel on pliiatsiga kirjutatud ESTLAND 2001 ja kunstniku signatuur.Maal on raamitud, klaasitud, laia valge paspartuuga.
works.de: The painting depicts green ground in the foreground and dark blue sky above it. In the foreground on the right and further back in the middle are quadrangles considerably lighter than the background, the first one larger than the rear one. At the lower edge of the first, large quadrangle is written in pencil ESTLAND 2001 and the artist's signature. The painting is framed, glazed, with a wide white mount.

works.de: In the lower centre of the picture a narrow brown path, on the left side of the path a green bush and a tree mottled in green and yellow. In the distance on the left and right green patches of forest, in the background forests glowing purplish. The grass is predominantly yellow, but there are also dark green patches. The sky is light blue, in places greyish or white. The painting is framed.

works.d: Portree pastell, värviliste kriitidega maalitud papile. Värv püsib mehhaanilise pinnakatreduse tõttu. Hoogsate pastellitõmmetega on näole ja riietusele toodud kollakaid, rohekaid ja sinakas-halle toone. Portrees on tabatud Jaan Lintropi väline sarnasus ja karakter, psüühika ja tugev tahtejõud. Portree otsevaates, tõsine, mõtlik, juurdlev. Taust tume. Portree ovaalne, puidust pronksitud raami äärestab kipsornamendiga raam. Puidust raamil koiauke, kipsraam osalioselt murenenud. Portree kinnitatud kruviga läbi papi puuklotsile
works.de: Pastel portrait, painted with coloured chalks on cardboard. The colour is preserved due to mechanical surface fixation. With vigorous pastel strokes, yellowish, greenish, and bluish-grey tones have been brought to the face and clothing. The portrait captures Jaan Lintrop's external resemblance and character, his psyche and strong willpower. The portrait is in frontal view, serious, thoughtful, contemplative. Dark background. The portrait is oval, framed by a wooden bronzed frame bordered with a plaster ornament frame. The wooden frame has woodworm holes, the plaster frame is partially crumbled. The portrait is fastened with a screw through the cardboard onto a wooden block

works.d: akvarellil viis eesti sõdurit ja valge hobune. Vasakul pruunis jakis, pasteldes, mütsiga sõdur, paremas käes kirves, vasakus kilp ja kolm noolt. Tema kõrval ees mees raudvestis nuiaga, vasakul käes kilp ja vibu. Tema tagavasakul sõdur pruunis jakis, vööl kirves, vasakus käes kolm noolt ja kip. Edasi vasakult mees hobuse selljas, paremas käes oda, üle vasaku õla vibu. Vasakuga hoiab rakmetest hobust.Ees paremal seisab pikas pruunis mantlis sõdalane, paremas käes otsaga maha toetatud oda., üle vasaku õla vibu, seljas nooled, kilp käes
works.de: watercolour depicting five Estonian soldiers and a white horse. On the left, a soldier in a brown jacket, bast shoes, and a cap, holding an axe in his right hand, a shield in his left, and three arrows. Next to him, in front, a man in a chainmail vest with a club, a shield in his left hand and a bow. Behind him to the left, a soldier in a brown jacket, an axe at his belt, three arrows and a quiver in his left hand. Further to the left, a man on horseback, a spear in his right hand, a bow over his left shoulder, holding the horse by its harness with his left hand. In front on the right stands a warrior in a long brown coat, a spear in his right hand resting on the ground, a bow over his left shoulder, arrows on his back, a shield in his hand.

works.d:
Tormine meri purjekatega. Vasakul linnalinnakindluse müürid ja majakas, kaugemal mägi. Esplaanil vasakul kolm-mastiline purjekas, selle taga kaks purjekat, mis ühemastilised. Keskel paremal kaugemal 3-mastiline purjekas, ees paremal ühe-mastiline purjekas. Paremal kaldajässak puudega. Ees all sadamakai, mille kaldal paadid meremeestega. Vasakul kai ääres ujub üksik tünn, merel kajakad. Taevas on tormieelselt sünge.

Graafiline leht raamimata, määrdunud, rebenenud, servadest murtud. Ülalt paremast nurgast pikk rebend alla ( u. 11 cm graafilisel lehel), nurk välja rebenenud. Vasakus ülanurgas ristirebend. Lehe servad koltunud, kollakate täppidega, kortsunud.
works.de:
Stormy sea with sailing ships. On the left, the walls of a city fortress and a lighthouse, a mountain further away. In the foreground on the left a three-masted sailing ship, behind it two ships that are single-masted. In the middle further to the right a three-masted sailing ship further away, in front on the right a single-masted sailing ship. On the right a rocky shore with trees. Below in front a harbor quay, on the shore of which boats with sailors. On the left, by the quay, a lone barrel floats, seagulls on the sea. The sky is gloomy, as before a storm.

Print unframed, soiled, torn, edges broken. From the upper right corner a long tear downward (approx. 11 cm on the print), the corner torn off. In the upper left corner a cross-shaped tear. The edges of the sheet are yellowed, with yellowish spots, wrinkled.

works.d:
Graafilisel lehel kujutatud merelahingut, vasakul põlev laev, mille suits hajutab kogu nähtavuse. Keskel suurem laev nikerduste ja kujukestega, paremal veel üks purjekas. Hulgaliselt väikesi paate ümber laevade. 
Ees vasakul paat, milles lahingu juhataja, samas paadis puhutakse sõjapasunat.
Ees keskel on üks paatiest ümber läinud, päästetööd käivad. Samas kõrval käib käsivõitlus, tulistamine naaberpaadis. Ees näha hukkunuid. 

Graafiline leht kortsunud, servad rebenenud, rullunud, määrdunud. Kaks sügavat rebendit poolde graafilisse lehte.
works.de:
The print depicts a naval battle, on the left a burning ship whose smoke obscures all visibility. In the centre a larger ship with carvings and figurines, on the right another sailing vessel. Numerous small boats around the ships.
In front on the left a boat containing the battle commander; in the same boat a war horn is being blown.
In front in the centre one boat has capsized, rescue work is underway. Next to it hand-to-hand combat is taking place, shooting in a neighbouring boat. In front, the dead can be seen.

The print is creased, the edges torn, curled, soiled. Two deep tears running halfway across the print.

All kogu Paide linna makett, linnamüüri sees eristatav kirik, valli kindlus. Ümber linnamüüri imiteeritud metsa ja põllumaad üksikute graafiliste joontega.

Kõike seda ümbritseb 6mm laiune ovaalide kee-vööt, millel nii sees kui väljaspool 2 joont.

Gravüür kleebitud papile, pleekinud ja määrdunud.
works.de:
framed together with K 132, see also K 189

Above, an ornament: 2 angels hold with one hand an oval ring located in the centre, with the other hand a surrounding flower ornament depicting flames. From below, in the centre, ribbons of a laurel wreath extend to both sides, in the centre, at the knot, an angel's head is visible.

Below, a model of the whole town of Paide, inside the town wall a church and the fortress of the rampart can be distinguished. Around the town wall, imitated forest and farmland with individual graphic lines.

All of this is surrounded by a 6 mm wide belt of ovals with 2 lines both inside and outside.

Engraving glued onto cardboard, faded and stained.

works.d: laud tammepuust plaadi ja kasepuust jalgadega. valmistatud kunstnik August Roosilehe kavandi järgi. Laud koosneb kolmest tammelauast, toetub kahele massiivsele jalale, mille küljed sügavate puulõigetega. Laua jalgu ühendab põikpuu, mille ots ulatub jalast välja ja on ühendatud puidust kiiluga. Jalgade küljelauad kaarjate sisselõigetega.
works.de: A table with an oak top and birch legs. Made according to the design of the artist August Roosileht. The table consists of three oak boards, resting on two massive legs, whose sides have deep wood carvings. The legs are joined by a crossbar, whose end protrudes from the leg and is joined with a wooden wedge. The side panels of the legs have curved cutouts.

works.d: Ees vasakul mees, palja peaga, seljas hall pikkade käistega pluus, selle peal lühikeste varrukatega sinine pluus, vöö peal. All pikk roosas toonis jakk.Jalas sinised püksid, paremas käes kirves, vasakus kilp. Tema kõrval paremalteine sõdalane, vasakus käes kirves, parem õlale tõstetud, seljas punane pluus ja rohelised püksid, peal pikk hall karusnahkne vest, peas kiiver. ees keskelsõdalane seljaga, näha pikk sinine mantel, all pruunid püksid, peas kiiver. Jakil vöö mõõgaga, mõõk tupes. Tema kõrval sõdalane , käes oda otsaga maha toetatud ja kilp. Sinakashall pikk jakk, peal vöö. Tagapool näha veel kaks sõdalast. Ees tihe rohi, põõsas.
works.de: In front on the left a man, bare-headed, wearing a grey long-sleeved blouse, over it a short-sleeved blue blouse, with a belt over it. Below, a long pink-toned coat. Wearing blue trousers, an axe in his right hand, a shield in his left. Beside him, on the right, another warrior, an axe in his left hand, his right raised to his shoulder, wearing a red blouse and green trousers, over which a long grey fur vest, a helmet on his head. In front, in the middle, a warrior seen from the back, a long blue coat visible, brown trousers below, a helmet on his head. On the coat a belt with a sword, the sword in its sheath. Beside him a warrior, holding a spear with its point resting on the ground, and a shield. A long bluish-grey coat, a belt over it. Further back two more warriors are visible. In front, thick grass, a bush.

works.d: Keskel on Ungerni vapp, millel on kujutatud kolm liiliat ja seitse tähte. Vapikilpi ümbritsevad stiliseeritud akantuselehed; kiivriehisel on liilia stiliseeritud kujutis. Vapp on ümbritsetud ülevalt kaarja profileeringuga. Vapi suurus u 57 x 54 cm. Vapi all ja kohal on u 7 cm laiune lihtsa profileeringuga karniis. Ülemise karniisi kohal asuva friisi muster koosneb reljeefsetest rikkalikult kaunistatud geomeetrilistest kumeratest ( 2 tk ) ja püramiidjatest nelinurksetest ( 3 tk ) motiividest. Alumise karniisi all keskel on lapsepea, millest kummalgi pool on puuviljakobar (?)
works.de: In the centre is the Ungern coat of arms, depicting three lilies and seven stars. The shield is surrounded by stylised acanthus leaves; on the helmet crest is a stylised depiction of a lily. The coat of arms is surrounded above by an arched profiling. The size of the coat of arms is about 57 x 54 cm. Above and below the coat of arms is a cornice about 7 cm wide with simple profiling. The pattern of the frieze located above the upper cornice consists of relief, richly decorated geometric convex (2 pcs) and pyramidal quadrangular (3 pcs) motifs. In the centre below the lower cornice is a child's head, on either side of which is a bunch of fruit (?)

works.d:
Keskel ülestõusnud Kristus, kelle kohal on raiddekst kahes reas: ECCEVICITLEO /
DE TRIBV IVDAT. Vapi all ja kohal on u 7 cm laiune lihtsa profileeringuga karniis. Ülemisel karniisil on tekst: APOC.Ülemise karniisi kohal asuva friisi muster koosneb reljeefsetest geomeetrilistest kumeratest ( 2 tk ) ja püramiidjatest nelinurksetest ( 3 tk ) motiividest ( muster analoogiline : 19 ja : 20, kuid lihtsam). Alumise karniisi all keskel on inglipea väljasirutatud tiibade vahel.

In the centre the risen Christ, above whom is a carved text in two lines: ECCEVICITLEO /
DE TRIBV IVDAT. Below and above the coat of arms is a cornice about 7 cm wide with simple profiling. On the upper cornice is the text: APOC. The pattern of the frieze located above the upper cornice consists of relief geometric curved (2 pcs) and pyramidal quadrangular (3 pcs) motifs (pattern analogous to: 19 and : 20, but simpler). Below the lower cornice, in the centre, is an angel's head between outstretched wings.

works.d: Ristkülikukujuline. Plaati ääristab u 13 cm laiune tekstivöönd. Reljeefse trükitähe kõrgus on 6 cm. Tekst on säilinud vaid osaliselt: vasakul - MYLLER IN GOT. Üleval on tekst olnud kahes reas, millest on säilinud AN ja selle all EN. Tekstivööndi katkestab üleval vasakus nurgas süvendatud stiliseeritud roosiõis läbimõõduga u 29 cm. Plaadi keskele on süvendatud Mölleri perekonnavapp. Vapikilbil on kolm topelthaaki, seda ümbritsevad stiliseeritud akantuslehed; kiivri ehisel on topelthaak. Vapi all on osaliselt säilinud tekst kahes reas: ANNO 1586 / MYLL. Tähed on süvendatud, kõrgusega 5 cm.
works.de: Rectangular. The plate is bordered by a text band about 13 cm wide. The height of the relief printed letters is 6 cm. The text has survived only partially: on the left - MYLLER IN GOT. At the top the text was in two lines, of which AN has survived and below it EN. The text band is interrupted in the upper left corner by a recessed stylised rose blossom about 29 cm in diameter. In the centre of the plate the Möller family coat of arms is recessed. On the shield are three double hooks, surrounded by stylised acanthus leaves; on the helmet crest is a double hook. Below the coat of arms partially preserved text remains in two lines: ANNO 1586 / MYLL. The letters are recessed, with a height of 5 cm.

works.t: Raidvapp von Aderkasi ja von Stackelbergi
works.dm: kõrgus: 720.0 mm; paksus: 100.0 mm; laius: 695.0 mm
works.d: Kivi keskele on raiutud kaks kõrvutiasetsevat vappi - Aderkasi ja Stackelbergi. Aderkasi vapil on näha jahipistrik ja vapi kohal üleval stiliseeritud jaanalinnusuled. Stackelbergi vapil on näha üks pärnavõsu lehega ja vapi kohal kiiver. Vappide all on näha kaks diagonaalselt asetatud kahuritoru. Raidkivi all ääres on osaliselt säilinud 6 cm laiune, külgedelt ülespoole kaarduv lihtne ornament, mis koosneb tihedatest peenikestest süvendatud joontest. Vapp asub laudadest kastis.
works.de: In the center of the stone two adjacent coats of arms are carved - those of Aderkas and Stackelberg. On the Aderkas coat of arms a hunting falcon can be seen, and above the coat of arms stylized ostrich feathers. On the Stackelberg coat of arms a linden sprout with a leaf can be seen, and above the coat of arms a helmet. Below the coats of arms two diagonally placed cannon barrels can be seen. Along the lower edge of the carved stone a partially preserved 6 cm wide simple ornament, curving upward at the sides, consisting of dense thin incised lines, has survived. The coat of arms is located in a box made of boards.

works.d:
Koosneb kahest tükist.
1. Tükk viie nurgaga. Ülemine 2 cm kõrgune serv eendub nõgusalt u 5 cm. Tekstiga külgede laius on 63,2 ja 12 cm. Reljeefse gooti kirjas tekstiga. Tähe kõrgus kuni 5 cm. Tekst: Die Edle Ehr und Tugendreiche m..
2. Tükk kuue nurgaga. Siin jätkub tekst, mis sellel tükil on kahes reas. Alumise rea tähe kõrgus on u 3 cm. Tekst ülemises reas: ... husen, Jürgen von Ungern nachgelasne witwe ...; tekst alumises reas: disen predikstul zur Ehre gottes gegeben
works.de:
Consists of two pieces.
1. Piece with five corners. The upper 2 cm high edge protrudes concavely by about 5 cm. The width of the sides with text is 63.2 and 12 cm. With relief Gothic-script text. Letter height up to 5 cm. Text: Die Edle Ehr und Tugendreiche m..
2. Piece with six corners. Here the text continues, which on this piece is in two lines. The letter height of the lower line is about 3 cm. Text in the upper line: ... husen, Jürgen von Ungern nachgelasne witwe ...; text in the lower line: disen predikstul zur Ehre gottes gegeben

Below the lower cornice, in the centre, is a child's head, with a bunch of fruit on either side (?)

works.d: Saarlasest kunstniku Kaljo Simsoni (1929-2017) teosed on seni muuseumi kunstikogus esindamata ja tema töid pole ka senini laiemale üldsusele läbi personaalnäituste tutvustatud, kuna need on valdavalt olnud erakollektsioonides. works.de: The works of Saaremaa-born artist Kaljo Simson (1929-2017) have so far not been represented in the museum's art collection, and his works have not yet been introduced to the wider public through personal exhibitions, as they have predominantly been held in private collections. The paintings are in good condition and are therefore suitable for display at various exhibitions. In determining the price, previous practice in making similar purchases has been taken as a basis, local art experts have been consulted, and similar transactions on internet auction platforms have been reviewed.

works.d: Kaua aega tegutsenud Saaremaa harrastuskunstnike ühenduse liikme Kalev Koeli (s 1964) teosed on seni muuseumi kunstikogus esindamata. Maalil kujutatud saarlasest ooperilaulja Ain Anger (s 1971) on oodatud külaline kõikides olulistes ooperimajades üle kogu maailma ning hinnatud solist kontserdilavadel. Maal on heas seisukorras ja seetõttu kasutatav mitmesugustel näitustel. Hinna määramisel on lähtutud senisest praktikast sarnaste ostude tegemisel ning on konsulteeritud teiste Saaremaa Kunstiklubi liikmetega.
works.de: The works of Kalev Koel (b. 1964), a long-active member of the Saaremaa amateur artists' association, have so far not been represented in the museum's art collection. The opera singer Ain Anger (b. 1971), a native of Saaremaa, depicted in the painting, is a welcome guest at all major opera houses around the world and a highly regarded soloist on concert stages. The painting is in good condition and therefore usable for various exhibitions. The price was determined based on previous practice with similar acquisitions and in consultation with other members of the Saaremaa Art Club.
