works.d: Heli Tuksami vitraaž on loodud EKAM monumentaalmaalide kavandite kollektsioonis oleva kavandi alusel ning on heaks näiteks Eesti Kunstiakadeemia eelkäija ENSV Riikliku Kunstiinstituudi monumentaalmaali eriala õppest 1980. aastatel. Klassikalise tinavitraaži tehnikas musitseerimise teemalises teoses avaldub autori isikupärane käsitluslaad, lahendus on nii sisult kui ka vormilt sobilik kunagisele noorte huvikoolile. Vitraažid jäid omal ajal paigaldamata tehnilistel põhjustel.
works.de: Heli Tuksam's stained-glass window was created based on a design held in the EKAM collection of monumental painting designs, and is a good example of the monumental painting specialty studies at the ENSV State Art Institute, the predecessor of the Estonian Academy of Arts, in the 1980s. In this work on the theme of music-making, executed in the classical technique of leaded glass, the author's personal manner of treatment is expressed; the solution is fitting, both in content and form, for what was once a school of interest for young people. The stained-glass windows were left uninstalled at the time for technical reasons.

works.dm: kujutise kõrgus: 43.5 cm; sügavus: 25.0 cm; kujutise laius: 25.5 cm
works.d:
Jaan Varese tulevase abikaasa Maimu portree on modelleeritud üsna õpingute alguses. Teos ilmutab noore skulptori meisterlikkust vormi tabamisel – nägu on modelleeritud peenemalt ja tundlikumalt, võimas juuksepahmakas aga antud edasi suurema üldistusega. Tulemus on hingestatud ja samas suursugune.
Tulevane kauaaegne ERKI rektor Jaan Vares alustas skulptuuriõpinguid 1946. aastal Tartu Riiklikus Kunstiinstituudis, kuid lõpetas 1952. aastal juba uue nimega kooli – Eesti NSV Riikliku Kunstiinstituudi (asukohaga Tallinnas) Tartu osakonna.
works.de:
The portrait of Maimu, the future wife of Jaan Vares, was modelled quite early in his studies. The work reveals the young sculptor's mastery in capturing form – the face is modelled more delicately and sensitively, while the powerful mass of hair is rendered with greater generalisation. The result is soulful and at the same time noble.
Jaan Vares, who would later become the long-serving rector of ERKI, began his sculpture studies in 1946 at the Tartu State Art Institute, but graduated in 1952 already from a school with a new name – the Tartu Department of the Estonian SSR State Art Institute (located in Tallinn).

works.t: Munatempera tehnikas laemaali kavand Metsamajanduse ja Looduskaitse Ministeeriumi saalile
works.dm: kujutise laius: 48.5 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 29.5 cm
works.d: Urve Dzidzaria loodud monumentaalmaali kavandid on heaks näiteks Eesti Kunstiakadeemia eelkäija ENSV Riikliku Kunstiinstituudi monumentaalmaali eriala õppest 1970. aastate keskel. Mõlema kavandi põhjal – nii Metsamajanduse ja Looduskaitse ministeeriumi saali laemaali kui ka lastekodule kavandatud diplomitöö vitraaži alusel valmisid arhitektuuriga seotult suured materjalis teosed, mis mõlemad on tänaseks hävinud.
works.de: The designs for the monumental paintings created by Urve Dzidzaria are a good example of the study of monumental painting at the ENSV State Art Institute, the predecessor of the Estonian Academy of Arts, in the mid-1970s. Based on both designs - the ceiling painting for the hall of the Ministry of Forestry and Nature Conservation as well as the stained-glass window designed as a diploma work for a children's home - large works in materials were created in connection with architecture, both of which have now been destroyed.

works.d: Dolores Hoffmanni diplomitöö raames omaaegsesse Tallinna "Rahu" kinno loodud monumentaalmaali "Hommik (Rahu)" fragment. Eestis vähe viljeldud freskotehnika näide, mis iseloomustab 1960. aastate monumentaalmaali. Kuulub Dolores Hoffmanni varasesse loomeperioodi.
works.de: A fragment of the monumental painting "Hommik (Rahu)" created within the framework of Dolores Hoffmann's diploma work for the former "Rahu" cinema in Tallinn. An example of fresco technique, rarely practiced in Estonia, characteristic of the monumental painting of the 1960s. Belongs to Dolores Hoffmann's early creative period.

works.t: Keeris. Tallinna Veepuhastusjaama välisseinale kavandatud pannoo materjalis fragment. Osa diplomitööst
works.dm: kujutise laius: 45.0 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 46.5 cm
works.d: Ivika Luisk poolt loodud mosaiigi fragment on heaks näiteks Eesti Kunstiakadeemia monumentaalmaali eriala õppest 1990. aastate esimesel poolel. Süvareljeefiga spiraalina keerduv mosaiik näitab selle tehnika uudse kasutamise võimalusi  ruumilise mosaiigi loomisel.
works.de: The mosaic fragment created by Ivika Luisk is a good example of the studies in monumental painting at the Estonian Academy of Arts in the first half of the 1990s. The mosaic, coiling as a spiral with deep relief, shows the possibilities of a novel use of this technique in creating spatial mosaics.

works.d: Jüri Kase loodud monumentaalmaali kavand on heaks ja erandlikuks näiteks Eesti Kunstiakadeemia eelkäija ENSV Riikliku Kunstiinstituudi monumentaalmaali eriala õppest 1960. aastate lõpus; antud teos näitab, et vaatamata ideoloogilisele survele ja realismi raamidega piiratud väljendusvabadusele, said üliõpilased siiski arendada oma isikupärast käekirja.
works.de: The sketch for a monumental painting created by Jüri Kask is a good and exceptional example of the monumental painting speciality studies at the ENSV State Art Institute, the predecessor of the Estonian Academy of Arts, in the late 1960s; this work shows that despite ideological pressure and the freedom of expression limited by the framework of realism, students were still able to develop their own individual style.

works.d: Dolores Hoffmanni diplomitöö raames omaaegsesse Tallinna "Rahu" kinno loodud monumentaalmaali "Hommik (Rahu)" fragment. Eestis vähe viljeldud freskotehnika näide, mis iseloomustab 1960. aastate monumentaalmaali. Kuulub Dolores Hoffmanni varasesse loomeperioodi.
works.de: A fragment of the monumental painting "Hommik (Rahu)" created within the framework of Dolores Hoffmann's diploma work for the former "Rahu" cinema in Tallinn. An example of fresco technique, rarely practiced in Estonia, characteristic of the monumental painting of the 1960s. Belongs to Dolores Hoffmann's early creative period.

works.t: Mitu aastat juba Sind oodanud ma, armas (Autoportree). 1. kursuse õppetöö
works.d: Maaliüliõpilase teos esindab zoomi ajastu kaug-õppetöö tulemit, kus tudeng ei saanud kasutada modelli koolis, vaid töötas kodus ja kasutas modellina iseennast, maalides etteantud kaudsete juhendite alusel autoportree, mis pidi sisaldama nii „hea“ kui ka „halva“ maali komponente.
works.de: The painting student's work represents the result of distance learning during the era of zoom, where the student could not use a model at school but worked at home and used themselves as a model, painting a self-portrait based on indirect given instructions, which had to contain both "good" and "bad" painting components.

works.d: Ede Peebo õppetöö, aktimaal meesaktist, on hea näide kunstiinstituudis 1950. aastatel rakendatud õpetamismeetoditest, mis põhinesid akadeemilisel realismil ja hindasid anatoomia täpset edasiandmist.
works.de: Ede Peebo's study assignment, a nude painting of a male figure, is a good example of the teaching methods applied at the art institute in the 1950s, which were based on academic realism and valued the precise rendering of anatomy.

works.d:
Ukraina kunstniku Marina Škarupa teos oli eksponeeritud XXIX aktinäitusel MEES JA NAINE Uue Kunsti Muuseumis, 2022 suvel. 
Teos täiendab ukraina kunstnike kooslust UKM'i kogus.
works.de:
The work by Ukrainian artist Marina Škarupa was exhibited at the XXIX nude exhibition MAN AND WOMAN at the Museum of New Art in the summer of 2022.
The work supplements the collection of Ukrainian artists in the UKM collection.

works.d: Teos täiendab Uue Kunsti Muuseumi graafika ja joonistuste kogu.
works.de: The work supplements the collection of prints and drawings of the Museum of New Art.

works.d: Teos oli eksponeeritud XXX aktinäitusel MEES JA NAINE-EUROPE RÖÖVIMINE. Täiendab Ukraina kunstnike kogu UKM kollektsioonis.

works.d: Teos täiendab UKM graafika-joonistuste kogu ning loob terviku Uno Roosvaldi teiste teostega, mis kuuluvad UKM kogusse.
works.de: The work complements the UKM collection of graphic prints and drawings and forms a whole with other works by Uno Roosvald belonging to the UKM collection.

works.d:
Võtta vastu teos UKM maalikogusse.

works.de:
To accept the work into the UKM painting collection.
Alessandra Barbierato's work "Ava" was created at the Pärnu New Art Museum in 2016. The work was created as part of the 23rd international exhibition MAN AND WOMAN: NEWCOMERS.

works.d: Esiplaanil keskel seisavad 2 meest otsevaates ja hoiavad enda vahel sirgelt ülestõstetud kätes pikka punast paberit venekeelse trükitud tekstiga, pealkirjaks "Декреть о миръ". Vasakul mees sonimütsi ja ülikonnaga, paremal nokkmütsi ja sineliga. Meeste selja taga dekoratiivne rõdutaoline raamistik, mis kaardudes täidab maali mõlemad ääred ja musta ribana ülaääre. Läbi selle raami avaneb vaade nagu ekraanile, mida täidab silmapiirini sonimütsidega meeste peade tihe mass. Selle kohal erksinine riba valgete rünkpilvedega taevast.
works.de: In the foreground, in the centre, 2 men stand in a frontal view and hold between them, in outstretched arms, a long red paper with printed Russian text, titled "Декреть о миръ". On the left, a man in a sonim cap and suit, on the right, a man in a peaked cap and greatcoat. Behind the men's backs is a decorative balcony-like framework, which curves to fill both edges of the painting and forms a black band along the upper edge. Through this frame a view opens as if onto a screen, filled to the horizon by a dense mass of men's heads in sonim caps. Above it a bright blue strip of sky with white cumulus clouds.

works.d: Kõrge seljatoega punasest puust, pruuni sametiga toolil istuva, halliseguste juustega ja hallide vuntsidega mehe 3/4 figuur, nägu otsevaates, keha pöördes paremale, mõlema käe küünarvarred toetatud tooli käetugedele, seljas must pintsak, tumehallid püksid. Foon hallikas-roosakates toonides.
works.de: 3/4 figure of a man with grey-mixed hair and grey moustache, sitting in a high-backed chair of red wood upholstered with brown velvet, face in frontal view, body turned to the right, forearms of both hands resting on the armrests of the chair, wearing a black jacket, dark grey trousers. Background in greyish-pink tones.

works.d: Punasest puust, punase sametiga toolil istuva prillidega mehe 3/4 figuur, veidi pöördes vasakule, tumedas ülikonnas. Parem käsivars toetub tooli käetoele, vasak käsi kellaga randmel asetatud paremale käele. Vasak jalg tõstetud üle parema põlve. Parempoolne kirjutuslaua nurk kolme raamatu (neist üks roheliste kaantega) ja kirjapressiga. Foon ühtlaselt pruun.
works.de: 3/4 figure of a bespectacled man sitting on a chair of red wood with red velvet, slightly turned to the left, in a dark suit. Right forearm resting on the chair's armrest, left hand with a watch on the wrist placed on the right hand. Left leg raised over the right knee. Right corner of the writing desk with three books (one of them with green covers) and a letter press. Background evenly brown.

works.d: Halli habeme ja hallide vurrudega, kõrge palja laubaga mehe rindportree en face. Tumesinine vestiga pintsak, valge kikilips. Foon heledam sinine.
works.de: Frontal chest portrait of a man with a grey beard and grey moustache, a high bare forehead. Dark blue vest and jacket, white bow tie. Background lighter blue.

works.d: Esiplaanil kidurad puud, rohu sees suured kivid. Keskplaanil kõrgub silmapiirini sirendav lage suur mäemassiiv (Gora Kruglitsa mägi, Taganay rahvuspargis Tšeljabinski oblast, Venemaa Föderatsioonis). Selle kohal hele kollakas-sinine taevas.
works.de: In the foreground stunted trees, large stones amid the grass. In the middle ground rises a bare massif reaching to the horizon, gleaming in the distance (Gora Kruglitsa mountain, in Taganay National Park, Chelyabinsk Oblast, Russian Federation). Above it a light yellowish-blue sky.

works.d: Esiplaanil istuva naise 1/2 figuur, pea profiilis vasakule, vasak käsi raamatul. Istuva naise kohal keskplaanil seisev naine otsevaates pea 1/2 pöördes vasakule, käes avatud raamat. Tema kõrval ette kallutatud peaga mees otsevaates käes raamat. Koloriit tumepruunikas. Üldistav, stiliseeriv käsitluslaad.
works.de: In the foreground a 1/2 figure of a seated woman, head in profile facing left, left hand on a book. Above the seated woman, in the middle ground, a standing woman in frontal view, head 1/2 turned to the left, holding an open book in her hand. Beside her a man with his head bent forward, in frontal view, holding a book. The colouring is dark brownish. A generalising, stylising manner of treatment.

works.d: Laudamotiiv. Kaks lammast lamavas asendis, kolmas selgvaates, seisab. Keskmise lamba juures on kaks talle, vasemal esialal kaks kana. Tumedat interjööri valgustab eest vasemalt langev valgus. Tumepruun üldtoon.
works.de: A tabletop motif. Two sheep in a lying position, a third seen from the side, standing. Next to the middle sheep are two lambs, on the left foreground two hens. The dark interior is lit by light falling from the front left. Overall dark brown tone.

works.d: Punasest puust, tumerohelise sametiga toolil istuva tumedajuukselise vuntsidega mehe 3/4 figuur pöördes vasakule, nägu profiilis, tumedas vestiga ülikonnas. Parem käsi toetub üle vasaku jala tõstetud parema jala põlvele, vasak küünarvars tooli käetoele. Foon ühtlaselt tume sinakashall.
works.de: 3/4 figure of a dark-haired man with a moustache, sitting in a chair of red wood upholstered with dark green velvet, turned to the left, face in profile, wearing a suit with a dark vest. The right hand rests on the knee of the right leg, which is raised over the left leg, the left forearm on the armrest of the chair. Background uniformly dark bluish-grey.

works.d: Esiplaanil laudpõrandal puust tool, seljatugi paremal. Tooli ees keskplaanil neljakandiline lihtne tumepruun laud. Fooniks tumepruun avatud uks paremal, laua kohal hele ukseava, edasi vasakul tumepruun sein.
works.de: In the foreground, on a wooden floor, a wooden chair, backrest on the right. In front of the chair, in the middle ground, a simple square dark brown table. As background a dark brown open door on the right, above the table a bright doorway, further left a dark brown wall.

works.d: Lillakaspruunil foonil hallipäise prillidega mehe rindportree en face rohelises pluusis.
works.de: Bust portrait en face of a grey-haired man with glasses in a green blouse, on a purplish-brown background.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul peaaegu maali ülaääreni ulatuv küünlajalg ja must piip, selle taga vaagnal 2 pruuni pirni. Koloriit tume-pruun, käsitluslaad üldistav, pinnaline.
works.de: In the foreground on the left a candlestick and a black pipe reaching almost to the top edge of the painting, behind it on a plate 2 brown pears. The colouring dark brown, the manner of treatment generalising, flat.

works.d: Esialal laineline maastik rohumaa, põõsaste ja kividega, tagaaelal sinetav kõrgmäeahelik. Taevas rünkpilvedes. Käsitletud maaliliselt. Värvkate kergelt pastoosne, pintslilöögid nähtavad.
works.de: In the foreground a wavy landscape of grassland, bushes and stones, in the background a bluish high mountain range. The sky with cumulus clouds. Treated pictorially. The paint layer is slightly impasto, brushstrokes visible.

works.d: Sinisel maleruudulisel laudlina markeerival foonil suur hele taldrik pooleks lõigatud lilla kapsapeaga. Taldrikust paremal puupeaga nuga ja erekollane sibul, vasakul kaks erepunast piprakauna. Käsitluslaad rõhutatult tasapinnaline, dekoratiivne.
works.de: On a blue checkered tablecloth-marking background, a large light-coloured plate with a purple cabbage head cut in half. To the right of the plate a knife with a wooden handle and a bright yellow onion, to the left two bright red pepper pods. The treatment style is emphatically flat, decorative.

works.d: Toanurgas paremal punasest tellisest ahi, selle soemüüri niššis heleroheline keraamiline kann. Ahju kõrval esiplaanil laudpõrandal rohekast klaasist pudel, selle taga neljajalgne järi. Järi taga vasakul seina ääres madalal pruunil kast-laual valge teekann, gaasipriimus ja rest taldrikutega. Tumepruunil palkseinal naelte otsas tahmase põhjaga pannid, tormilaternad ja teised tarbeesemed.
works.de: In the corner of the room on the right, a red brick stove, in the niche of its heating wall a light green ceramic jug. Beside the stove, in the foreground on the plank floor, a greenish glass bottle, behind it a four-legged stool. Behind the stool, on the left by the wall, on a low brown chest-like table, a white teapot, a gas primus stove and a rack with plates. On the dark brown log wall, on nails, sooty-bottomed pans, storm lanterns and other household items.

works.d: Esikohal sadamakai suurte torudega, keskel kai kraanadega, selle ääres tagantvaates valge "laev".
works.de: In the foreground a harbour quay with large pipes, in the middle a quay with cranes, beside it a white "ship" seen from behind.

works.t: Pidulik aktus Tartu Ülikooli aulas. Kavand
works.d: Punaste lippude ja loosungitega dekoreeritud ülikooli aula pikivaates. Taga seinal J. V. Stalini ovaalne maalitud portreepea profiilis, raamistatud punase riidega. Aula ja rõdud täis inimesi.
works.de: A longitudinal view of a university assembly hall decorated with red flags and slogans. On the back wall an oval painted portrait head of J. V. Stalin in profile, framed with red cloth. The hall and the balconies are full of people.

works.d: Esiplaanil pruunil laual keskel punased keedetud vähid (osa taldrikul, osa laual), vasakul ja paremal õunad. Laua paremal serval klaasist karahvin, selle kõrval kokku volditult valge laudlina. Vähkide taga laual valgete sulgedega surnud kana. Taga laua nurgal paremal suur potilill. Foon tumepruun, vasakul riba volditud tumesinist riiet.
works.de: In the foreground, on a brown table in the middle, red boiled crayfish (some on a plate, some on the table), apples on the left and right. On the right edge of the table a glass decanter, next to it a white tablecloth folded up. Behind the crayfish on the table a dead hen with white feathers. Behind, on the corner of the table on the right, a large potted plant. Background dark brown, on the left a strip of folded dark blue cloth.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul noore mehe 1/2 figuur 1/2 pöördes paremale, parem käsi pintsliga täisnurkselt ees. Mehe juuksed, nägu ja kael tumeroosad, seljas erkroheline pluus, mille vasak pool tumedam, parem heledam. Mehe kõrval paremal istub lillaka-roheka tooniga naisakt 1/2 pöördes vasakule, pikad juuksed helelillad, vasak käsi süles, mida varjab vasak kõverdatud põlv. Foon ere, rohekates ja sinakates toonides.
works.de: In the foreground on the left, a half-figure of a young man in 1/2 turn to the right, right hand with a brush extended forward at a right angle. The man's hair, face and neck are dark pink, wearing a bright green blouse, its left side darker, right side lighter. Beside the man on the right sits a female nude in purplish-green tones, in 1/2 turn to the left, long hair light purple, left hand in her lap, covered by the bent left knee. The background is bright, in greenish and bluish tones.

works.d: Tumepunase volditud sametiga kaetud alusel rikkalik natüürmort. Keskplaanil keskel mustjas savivaasis suur kõrge ümar põõsalaadne kimp heledatest astriõitest. Selle ees esiplaanil katkise servaga heledal taldrikul õunad, sametil taldriku ümber pirnid, lillkapsad, kurgid, kimp peatsetega porgandeid. Vasakul ääres külili paberkott, osa puuvilja valgunud sametile, ja savinõud ning külili tühi piimapudel. Paremal ääres korv kapsapea ja juurviljadega, korvist ulatub lauale heledam punane riie, millel lillkapsas; kõrval valkjas narmastega pearätik. Fooniks voldiline must riie.
works.de: A rich still life on a base covered with folded dark red velvet. In the middle ground, in the centre, a large, tall, round, bush-like bouquet of light-coloured asters in a blackish clay vase. In front of it, in the foreground, apples on a light-coloured plate with a broken edge, around the plate on the velvet pears, cauliflowers, cucumbers, a bunch of carrots with their tops. On the left edge a paper bag lying on its side, some of the fruit spilled onto the velvet, and clay vessels and an empty milk bottle lying on its side. On the right edge a basket with a cabbage head and root vegetables, from the basket a lighter red cloth extends onto the table, on which a cauliflower; beside it a whitish fringed headscarf. The background is a black cloth with folds.

works.d: Vasemal ja paremal puudegrupid, keskel mägisele maastikule avanev vaade kaljuastanguilt langevate jugadega. Mäekülje keskel ja paremal karjused karjaga. Vaatepiiri lähedal ja vasemal taevas pilves, muus osas selge. Mäekallak paremal heledamas valguses.
works.de: Groups of trees on the left and right, in the middle a view opening onto a mountainous landscape with waterfalls falling from rocky ledges. In the middle and on the right of the mountainside, shepherds with their flocks. Near the horizon and on the left the sky is cloudy, elsewhere clear. The mountain slope on the right is in brighter light.

works.d: Paremale tõusva mäenõlvaku pruunikas-rohekalt dekoratiivselt maapinnalt kõrguvad esi -ja keskplaanil ülaääreni 7 musta puutüve. Tagaplaanil madalate raagus puude võrad sinakas-pruunikate spiraalsete dekoratiivsete pilvedega taeva taustal. Motiiv Tartu karlova pargist (autori teatel)
works.de: From the brownish-greenish decorative ground of a hill slope rising to the right, 7 black tree trunks tower up to the upper edge in the foreground and middle ground. In the background, the crowns of low leafless trees against a sky with bluish-brownish spiral decorative clouds. Motif from Tartu's Karlova park (according to the author)

works.d: Esiplaanil telliskiviseina taustal musta raudvõre ees selgvaates blondi erksinises pulloveris noormehe 1/4 figuur. Tema pea kohal pildi ülaääres avatud aknal punases käisteta kleidis tütarlapse 1/4 figuur en face, mustal taustal, pilk suunatud alla noormehele.
works.de: In the foreground, against the background of a brick wall, in front of a black iron grille, in frontal view, a 1/4 figure of a young man in a bright blue pullover. Above his head, at the upper edge of the picture, in an open window, a 1/4 figure of a girl in a red sleeveless dress, en face, against a black background, her gaze directed down at the young man.

works.d: Keskel kallastega kitsas jõgi. Vasakul tuulemurd, eemal mõned männid ja vaadet piirav kuusemets. Paremal avar vaateväli, horisondil metsaviirg. Taevas valdavalt selge, helesinine. Käsitlusviis lähedane I. Šišnikini perioodi maalikoolile.
works.de: In the middle a narrow river with banks. On the left windfall, in the distance a few pines and a spruce forest bounding the view. On the right an expansive view, a strip of forest on the horizon. Sky mostly clear, light blue. The treatment is close to the painting school of I. Shishkin's period.

works.t: Rootsi kuninga Gustav II Adolfi portree. Koopia.
works.d: Kuninga esindusportree. Seisev täisfiguur pöördes paremale, pilk vaatajale suunatud. Parem käsi puusas, toetub kepile. Vasak käsi välja sirutatud laual oleva krooni ja muu kuningavõimu sümboliseerivate esemete suunas, laud kaetud raske punaka sametkattega. Riietust täiendavad lint ja särp. Vasakul tume neutraalne foon, paremal laiades voltides portjäär.
works.de: A representative portrait of a king. A standing full figure turned to the right, gaze directed at the viewer. Right hand on hip, resting on a cane. Left hand extended towards a crown and other objects symbolising royal power lying on a table, the table covered with a heavy reddish velvet cloth. The attire is completed by a ribbon and a sash. On the left a dark neutral background, on the right a curtain in wide folds.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakust nurgast diagonaalselt paremal kiviaed puust väravatega, nende kõrval keskplaanil keskel ait, aia taga eluhoone. Esiplaanil keskel kollakas maantee, mis aida kõrvalt keerab vasakule. Teekäänus keskplaanil paremal ääres õitsevate sirelite taga talumaja. Kõik hooned ümarpalkidest, kõrgete roost kelpkatustega. Taamal pruunikasrohelised künklikud põllulapid. Silmapiiril puudetukad, vasakult paistab katus. Taevas helesinine, selgete rünkpildevega. Maali raamistavad vasakust ja paremast äärest kõrged juugendlikud väänlevad puud (vasakul õitsevad sirelid).
works.de: In the foreground, from the left corner diagonally to the right, a stone wall with wooden gates; beside them, in the middle ground, in the centre, a barn, behind the wall a dwelling house. In the foreground, in the centre, a yellowish country road, which turns left beside the barn. At the bend of the road, in the middle ground on the right edge, behind blooming lilacs, a farmhouse. All the buildings are of round logs, with tall thatched hip roofs. In the distance brownish-green undulating fields. On the horizon clumps of trees, on the left a roof is visible. The sky is light blue, with clear cumulus clouds. The painting is framed on the left and right edges by tall, Art Nouveau-like winding trees (on the left blooming lilacs).

works.d: Esiplaanil keskel seisva mehe 3/4 figuur otsevaates, vaatamas üles taevasse. Tema selja taga vasakul seisab teine mees otsevaates gaasimaskiga, punases riietuses. Paremal ääres mehe siluett. Fooniks kubistlik linnavaade. Majade vahel veidi tumepunast taevast. Üldkoloriit pruunikas-punane.
works.de: In the foreground, in the centre, a 3/4 figure of a standing man in frontal view, looking up at the sky. Behind him on the left stands another man in frontal view wearing a gas mask, dressed in red. On the right edge, the silhouette of a man. Background a cubist cityscape. Between the houses a bit of dark red sky. Overall colouring brownish-red.

works.d: Dekoratiivne maastikumotiiv Bahtšisarai ümbrusest. Keskel tee ääres püramiidpaplid. Tagapool paremal lillaka varjundipoolse küljega mäeseljak. Taevas valkjad pilved.
works.de: Decorative landscape motif from the surroundings of Bahtšisarai. In the middle, pyramidal poplars by the road. Further back on the right a mountain ridge with a purplish-tinted side. Whitish clouds in the sky.

works.d: Tumehallil foonil seisavad kõrvuti kolm kogu maali täitvat täisfiguuri. Vasakul mustajuukseline naisakt otsevaates, hoiab kahe käega paremal puusal tumedat nõud sinakasroheliste puuviljadega. Keskel kõrge valge kaabuga tumedapäine mees selgvaates, seljas tumesinine pintsak valgete pükstega, vasak käsi püksitaskus, parem külg toetatud kepile. Paremal kõrge halli kaabuga mees otsevaates puhumas flööti, seljas helesinine pullover hallide pükstega.
works.de: Against a dark grey background stand three full figures side by side, filling the entire painting. On the left, a black-haired female nude in frontal view, holding with both hands on her right hip a dark vessel with bluish-green fruits. In the middle, a dark-haired man in profile-side view, wearing a tall white top hat, a dark blue jacket with white trousers, his left hand in his trouser pocket, his right side resting on a cane. On the right, a man in a tall grey top hat, in frontal view, playing the flute, wearing a light blue sweater with grey trousers.

works.d: Punasest puust, sinise sametiga kaetud põhjaga toolil istuva hallipäise, hallide vuntside ja habemega, palja pealaega vana mehe 3/4 figuur 1/2 pöördes vasakule. Parem käsi toetub paremale põlvele, vasak küünarnukk tooli käetoele. Riietus pidulik, seljas must vestiga ülikond. Tooli taga paremal nurgas marmorsamba alumine pool. Fooniks valkjas-lillakas sein, vasakus nurgas eenduv piilar.
works.de: Half-length figure of an old, grey-haired man with grey moustache and beard, bald crown, sitting 3/4 turned to the left on a chair of red wood with a base covered in blue velvet. His right hand rests on his right knee, his left elbow on the armrest of the chair. His attire is formal, wearing a black-vested suit. Behind the chair, in the right corner, the lower half of a marble column. The background is a whitish-lilac wall, with a protruding pillar in the left corner.

works.d: Erkrohelisel veepinnal esiplaanil kahe punakaspruuni kaarja paadisilla juures maali servast servani 10 suuremat ja väiksemat tumedat paati, nende taga helepruun rohekate puude ja põõsastega maanina. Selle taga kitsas tumesinine triip merd. Ülaääres kitsas heleroheline valgete rünkpilvedega triip taevast.
works.de: On a bright green water surface in the foreground, by two reddish-brown arched pontoon bridges, from edge to edge of the painting there are 10 larger and smaller dark boats, behind them a light brown headland with greenish trees and bushes. Behind that a narrow dark blue strip of sea. Along the upper edge a narrow light green strip of sky with white cumulus clouds.

works.d:
Suure pea ja väikese kehaga otsevaates meesfiguur, seljas keskaegsed lihtsad rõivad. Figuur tõmbab peast timuka- või narrimütsi, kaelas Tartu Ülikooli medal keti otsas. Parem jalg on toetatud raamatuvirnale, paremas käes vastu maad püsti joonlaud. Raamatute ümber teklid. Tagaplaanil inimvarjud. 
Mehe ilme kurjakuulutav, isikupäraste näojoontega.
works.de:
A frontal male figure with a large head and a small body, wearing simple medieval clothing. The figure is pulling off an executioner's or a jester's cap from his head, on his neck the medal of the University of Tartu on a chain. The right foot rests on a stack of books, in the right hand an upright ruler resting on the ground. Around the books are academic caps. In the background human shadows. 
The man's expression is sinister, with distinctive facial features.
