works.d: Väikese keha ja suure peaga tõsise ilmega mehe täisfiguur. Jalad harkis on astunud läbi tähekombinatsiooni. Parema käega osutab oma meelekohale ja vasaku sõrmega otse üles. Pilk on suunatud vasakule.
works.de: Full figure of a serious-looking man with a small body and a large head. His legs, spread apart, have stepped through a combination of stars. With his right hand he points to his temple and with his left forefinger straight up. His gaze is directed to the left.

works.dm: lehe laius: 21.0 cm; lehe kõrgus: 29.6 cm
works.d:
Haigevoodi taga seisab tüse, suure peaga dr Nina (kitlil rinnal silt). Vaatab läbi prillide tema ees voodis magavat meest. Paremas ülesse tõstetud käes on võlukepike, vasakus käes nina. Voodi on peaotsaga parema lehe serva poole. Magajal kerkivad õhku tähekestega joad. Rinnal, teki peal silt UNEUURINGUTE KESKUS. 
Seinal, tagaplaanil paremal ülal plakat "UNE MATI FÜSIOLOOGIA".
works.de:
Behind the sickbed stands the stout, big-headed Dr Nina (a badge on the chest of her coat). She looks through her glasses at the man sleeping in front of her in the bed. In her raised right hand is a magic wand, in her left hand a nose. The bed's headboard is toward the right edge of the sheet. Streams with little stars rise from the sleeping man. On his chest, on top of the blanket, a sign reading UNEUURINGUTE KESKUS.
On the wall, in the background upper right, a poster "UNE MATI FÜSIOLOOGIA".

works.dm: lehe laius: 29.6 cm; lehe kõrgus: 42.0 cm
works.d: Suure peaga, rõivas musta siluetina kujutatud meesfiguur eestvaates. Laia heleda habeme ja vuntsidega, ees prillid. Pigistab enda ees veidi vasakul oleva viinapudeli kaela mõlema käega. Pudelil on korgi peal sarved, käed ja kiri: Viin.
works.de: A male figure with a large head, depicted as a black silhouette in clothing, frontal view. With a wide light beard and moustache, glasses in front. Squeezing the neck of a vodka bottle in front of him slightly to the left with both hands. The bottle has horns, hands on the cork, and an inscription: Viin.

works.dm: lehe laius: 29.6 cm; lehe kõrgus: 42.0 cm
works.d: Koguka vanema mehe täisfiguur eestvaates seisab jalad harkis, paremas käes võrguga maakera, vasakus käes võrgus tühjad klaaspudelid. Riietatud talviselt, jalas karvased toasussid. Nägu habetunud, mees piilub kissis silmadega vasakule.
works.de: The full figure of a stout older man, frontal view, stands with legs apart, in his right hand a globe in a net, in his left hand empty glass bottles in a net. Dressed for winter, wearing furry house slippers. Face bearded, the man squints, looking to the left with narrowed eyes.

works.dm: lehe laius: 20.9 cm; lehe kõrgus: 29.6 cm
works.d:
Suure peaga tumedas ülikonnas tüse mees seisab, vasakus kaenlas raamat kirjaga AJALUGU. Parema käega haaranud vasakul üleval rippuvast mikrofonist. Peas suured kõrvaklapid, ees prillid.
Taustal üleval paremal nurgas päikesena nõukogude vapp, jalge ees maas moodustab tume vari tagurpidi venekeelsed tähed KГБ.
works.de: A stout man with a large head, in a dark suit, stands, holding a book with the inscription AJALUGU [HISTORY] under his left arm. With his right hand he has grasped a microphone hanging above on the left. On his head large headphones, glasses in front. In the background, in the upper right corner, the Soviet coat of arms as a sun; at his feet on the ground a dark shadow forms the reversed Russian letters KГБ.

works.dm: lehe laius: 29.6 cm; lehe kõrgus: 42.0 cm
works.d: Kujutatud on nooremapoolse mehe poolfiguur otsevaates suure pea ja kätega. Mehel naeratav ilme, prillid, lühike soeng ja seljas triiksärk. Parema käega osutab enda ees pildil paremal olevale kõvakübarale, kust tõmbab vasaku käega kõrvupidi välja jänest.
works.de: Depicted is the half-figure of a youngish man in frontal view with a large head and hands. The man has a smiling expression, glasses, short hairstyle and wears a dress shirt. With his right hand he points to a bowler hat in front of him on the right side of the picture, from which he pulls a hare out by the ears with his left hand.

works.dm: lehe laius: 30.5 cm; lehe kõrgus: 43.0 cm
works.d: Karikatuurne joonistus suure pea, hiigelsuurte kõrvade ja väikese kehaga hüppavast keskealisest mehest. Ülal vasakul nurgas täht, mida püüab haarata parema käega. Pea ja keha külgvaates vasakust küljest, piilub silmanurgast vaataja poole.
works.de: A caricatural drawing of a jumping middle-aged man with a large head, huge ears and a small body. In the upper left corner a star, which he tries to grasp with his right hand. Head and body in side view from the left, peeking at the viewer out of the corner of his eye.

works.dm: lehe kõrgus: 21.9 cm; lehe laius: 44.2 cm; lehe kõrgus: 33.5 cm; lehe laius: 12.2 cm
works.d: Vana mehe seisev täisfiguur profiilis vasakule, toetub karkudele. Mehel on hallid juuksed ja pikk valge habe, seljas pikk kuub. Suu kergelt avatud (vt ka JO 252)
works.de: Standing full figure of an old man in profile facing left, leaning on crutches. The man has grey hair and a long white beard, wearing a long coat. Mouth slightly open (see also JO 252)

works.dm: lehe laius: 21.0 cm; lehe kõrgus: 29.8 cm
works.d: Laineliste juustega, vormika näoga vanema mehe büst veerandprofiilis paremale. Tema ees läbi paberite torgatud kirjasulepea.
works.de: Bust of an older man with wavy hair and a shapely face, in three-quarter profile facing right. In front of him a pen stuck through papers.

works.dm: lehe laius: 21.0 cm; lehe kõrgus: 29.8 cm
works.d: Mustas ülikonnas meesfiguur profiilis vasakule. Tema ees on joonia stiilis sammas ja selle najal avatud raamat. Sambal nr "75" rohelisega. Nägu ja käsi on toonitud roosakaks.
works.de: A male figure in a black suit in profile facing left. In front of him is a column in the Ionic style with an open book leaning against it. On the column the number "75" in green. The face and hand are tinted pink.

works.dm: lehe laius: 12.2 cm; lehe kõrgus: 13.0 cm
works.d: Tumeda baretiga noormehe portree, istub, seljas karusnahkse kraega mantel, kaelas sall, vasakul lahtine raamat, tagaplaanil ümarkaarne väikeste ruutudega aken.
works.de: Portrait of a young man with a dark beret, seated, wearing a coat with a fur collar, a scarf at the neck, an open book on the left, in the background a round-arched window with small panes.

works.dm: lehe laius: 17.8 cm; lehe kõrgus: 16.0 cm
works.d: Keskel pilvedel troonil istuv Zeus, troonist paremal kotkas, vasakul põlvitav naisefiguur.
works.de: In the middle Zeus enthroned on clouds, to the right of the throne an eagle, to the left a kneeling female figure.

works.dm: lehe laius: 12.3 cm; lehe kõrgus: 16.6 cm
works.d: Lehe keskel seisev habemega mees, sööb lusikaga kausist, kõrval maas kaabu, kepp ja vasakul suur seljakott. Tagaplaanil visandatud pliiatsiga ukseavast paistvad teised ruumid.
works.de: In the center of the sheet a standing bearded man, eating with a spoon from a bowl, beside him on the ground a hat, a cane, and on the left a large backpack. In the background, sketched in pencil, other rooms visible through a doorway.

works.dm: lehe laius: 28.3 cm; lehe kõrgus: 21.0 cm
works.d: Kõrged puud vasakul, paremal veepind ning lahtine taevas, puude all karjused juhivad karja vee äärde.
works.de: Tall trees on the left, on the right a water surface and open sky, under the trees shepherds are driving a herd towards the water.

works.dm: lehe laius: 32.4 cm; lehe kõrgus: 22.5 cm
lehe laius: 22.4 cm; lehe kõrgus: 19.0 cm
works.d: Keskplaanil kõrgete müüride ja torniga itaalia linnake (kindlus), esiplaanil paremal grupp vestlevaid inimesi.
works.de: In the middle plane an Italian small town (fortress) with high walls and a tower, in the foreground on the right a group of conversing people.

works.d: Esiplaanil maskeeritud põõsad, nende taga keskel visandlikult maalitud noor seisev mees külgvaates vasakule. Suletud silmadega, avatud suuga nägu pööratud veidi paremale. Mehe vasak harali sõrmedega käsi sirutatud ette, parem tõstetud laubale. Ümber mehe lendavad ringi kajakad. Pruunikas-hallikas üldkoloriidis.
works.de: In the foreground camouflaged bushes, behind them in the centre a sketchily painted young standing man in side view facing left. His face, with closed eyes and open mouth, is turned slightly to the right. The man's left hand, fingers spread, is stretched forward, his right hand raised to his forehead. Gulls fly around the man. Overall brownish-grey colouring.

works.d: Esiplaanil keskel vanema mehe täisfiguur otsevaates, nägu pruunikas, peas helesinine barett, seljas valkjas pluus, sinised dressipüksid, jalas mustad kummisäärikud. Kahe suure tugeva käega hoiab enda ette maha toetatud labidat. Mees seisab vööni ulatuvas turbaaugus; selja taga paremal ja keskplaanil vasakul turbamätastest aunad ning pruun soo. Taevas helesinine.
works.de: In the foreground, in the centre, the full figure of an older man in a frontal view, his face brownish, wearing a light blue beret, a whitish blouse, blue tracksuit trousers, black rubber boots. With two large strong hands he holds a spade propped in front of him. The man stands in a peat pit reaching to his waist; behind him on the right and in the middle ground on the left there are heaps of peat sods and brown bog. The sky light blue.

works.d: Tumerohelistes toonides hilissuvine maastik. Esiplaanil kõrgete kallastega jõgi. Taamal lagendik piiratud silmapiirilt männimetsa ribaga. Helehall pilvine taevas.
works.de: Late-summer landscape in dark green tones. In the foreground a river with high banks. In the background an open area bordered on the horizon by a strip of pine forest. Pale grey cloudy sky.

works.d: Esiplaanil keskel seisva töömehe 1/2 figuur profiilis paremale, hoiab kahe käega paremale suunatud vintpüssi. Tema selja taga keskplaanil 2 seisvat meest. Üks profiilis vasakule, sirge parem käsi revolvriga suunatud üles vasakule, teine selgvaates 1/2 pöördes vasakule, vasak käsi hoiab üles vasakule suunatud püssi. Meeste kõrval vasakul kükitab selgvaates mees, vasak käsi hoiab üles vasakule suunatud püssi. Meeste kõrval paremal kõhuli ettesirutatud kätega langenud võitleja 1/2 figuur. Meeste riietus: mantlid ja sonimütsid,  foon summutatud lillakas punases üldkoloriidis.
works.de: In the foreground, in the centre, the 1/2 figure of a standing workman in profile to the right, holding with both hands a rifle pointed to the right. Behind him, in the middle ground, 2 standing men. One in profile to the left, straight right arm with a revolver pointed up to the left, the other in full view, turned 1/2 to the left, left hand holding a rifle pointed up to the left. Beside the men on the left crouches a man in full view, left hand holding a rifle pointed up to the left. Beside the men on the right, the 1/2 figure of a fallen fighter lying on his stomach with arms stretched forward. The men's clothing: coats and campaign caps, the background in a muted purplish-red overall colour scheme.

works.d: Maali poolitab vertikaalselt sinakas, allosas rohekas riba, millest kahel pool kollakas-pruunid õied, osa kujutatud läbilõikes. Üldistatud pinnalises dekoratiivses käsitluslaadis.
works.de: The painting is divided vertically by a bluish, greenish strip in the lower part, on both sides of which are yellowish-brown flowers, part depicted in cross-section. In a generalised, flat, decorative manner.

works.d: Lahtine turg ostjate ja müüjatega. Esiplaanil noor neiu käes taldrik puuviljadega. Riietus: valge pluus, lillakas vest, põll ja seelik. Impressionistlik maalimisviis, värvkate kergelt pastoosne.
works.de: An open-air market with buyers and sellers. In the foreground, a young girl holding a plate with fruits. Attire: white blouse, purplish vest, apron and skirt. Impressionistic painting manner, the paint layer slightly pastose.

works.dm: kõrgus: 68.0 cm; laius: 71.2 cm; kõrgus: 58.2 cm; laius: 74.0 cm

works.d: Istuva noore naise 3/4 figuur, nägu otsevaates, keha veidi pöördes vasakule, parem põlv üle vasaku, käed risti vöö kohal. Pikad juuksed erkpunased, näo ja käte nahk tumeroosa, lühikeste käistega pullover oranž, seelik lilla. Tüdruku õla taga vasakul kõrge roosa toolileen. Foon tumedam sinakas-roheline.
works.de: A 3/4 figure of a seated young woman, face in frontal view, body turned slightly to the left, right knee over the left, hands crossed above the waist. Long hair bright red, skin of face and hands dark pink, short-sleeved pullover orange, skirt purple. Behind the girl's shoulder on the left a tall pink chair back. Background darker bluish-green.

works.d: Esiplaanil punasele diivanile markeeritud lamava pikas riietuses paljaste jalgadega naise figuur. Naise põlvede kohalt tõuseb keskplaanile keskele redel, edasi õhus tool. Foonil vasakul aknakujuline sinine kuju, millele markeeritud tume mehe poolfiguur. Pruunikas-punases üldkoloriidis, sürrealistlikus käsitluslaadis.
works.de: In the foreground, marked on a red sofa, the figure of a reclining woman in long clothing with bare feet. Above the woman's knees a ladder rises into the middle ground in the centre, further up a chair floats in the air. In the background on the left a window-shaped blue form, on which a dark male half-figure is marked. In an overall brownish-red colouring, in a surrealist manner of treatment.

works.dm: kõrgus: 94.5 cm; laius: 73.0 cm; kõrgus: 92.2 cm; laius: 75.5 cm
kõrgus: 87.0 cm; laius: 55.2 cm; kõrgus: 50.1 cm; laius: 72.0 cm

works.d: Laboratooriumi sisevaade. Keskel istub pöördtoolil vormiriietuses noor mees profiilis paremale, vasakul žgutiga kinni seotud käsi pistetud läbi ümara ava kõrvalruumi, kust paistab valge peakattega med.-õe pea. Mehe kõrval esiplaanil vasakul seisab selgvaates kitli ja peakattega med.-õde käes žgutt.
works.de: Interior view of a laboratory. In the centre a young man in uniform sits in a swivel chair, in profile to the right, on the left an arm tied with a tourniquet is put through a round opening into an adjoining room, from which the head of a nurse in a white cap is visible. Beside the man, in the foreground on the left, stands, in frontal view, a nurse in a gown and cap holding a tourniquet.

works.d: Maal on pandud kokku neljast ühesuurusest vineeriruudust, vahega keskel 1 cm. Keskele kinnitatud tüüblitega 2 eenduvat orgaanilisest klaasist tahvlit 56x56 cm. Nende vahele liimitud selili lamava paberist imiku ca 21 cm pikkune figuur (joonistus välja lõigatud). Foon klaasi taga hall, selle ümber pruunikad lainelised pastoossed spiraalid, maali nurkades ühtlane must pind.
works.de: The painting is assembled from four equal-sized plywood squares, with a 1 cm gap in the middle. In the centre, attached with dowels, are 2 protruding panels of organic glass, 56x56 cm. Between them is glued a lying-on-its-back paper figure of an infant about 21 cm long (the drawing cut out). The background behind the glass is grey, around it brownish wavy pastose spirals, in the corners of the painting an even black surface.

works.dm: kõrgus: 162.5 cm; laius: 196.0 cm; kõrgus: 160.8 cm; laius: 198.0 cm
works.d: Rohelise fooni täidavad hõljuvad erksavärvilised helesinised, helelillad, lillakaspunased, kollased geomeetrilised kujundid ja sürrealistlikud esemed, taimed, linnud jms.
works.de: The green background is filled with floating brightly coloured light blue, light purple, purplish-red, yellow geometric shapes and surrealistic objects, plants, birds and the like.

works.d: Esiplaanil pruunikasrohelisel murul valgel linal horisontaalselt üle maalipinna selili lamava naisakti 3/4 figuur pikkade juustega pea vasakul. Keskplaanil helesinine suur järv tumerohelise matsamassiiviga kaetud saartega. Silmapiiril tumesinine metsaviirg, selle kohal kitsas helesinine taevatriip.
works.de: In the foreground, on brownish-green grass, on a white sheet, a 3/4 figure of a female nude with long hair lying on her back horizontally across the picture plane, head on the left. In the middle ground a large light-blue lake with islands covered by a dark-green forest mass. On the horizon a dark-blue strip of forest, above it a narrow light-blue strip of sky.

works.d: Allääres paremal tantsiva paari pead, naine otse-, mees selgvaates. Nende kohal paremas ääres vertikaalse ribana kohakuti 2 tantsivat paari, paremas nurgas ülaääres toolil istuva naise figuur. Vasakus ääres kohakuti 2 tantsivat paari vertikaalse ribana, ülaääres vasakul kitarrimängija ja trumm. Figuuride riietus tume, foon punane. Dekoratiivne.
works.de: At the lower edge on the right the heads of a dancing couple, the woman frontal, the man in profile. Above them, on the right edge, a vertical strip with 2 dancing couples aligned, in the upper right corner the figure of a woman sitting on a chair. On the left edge, a vertical strip with 2 dancing couples aligned, at the upper edge on the left a guitar player and a drum. The figures' clothing dark, background red. Decorative.

works.d: Allääres paremal väike valge liiliaõis. Punakaspruunil abstraktses laadis foonil aimatavad naisaktid.
works.de: In the lower edge on the right a small white lily blossom. Against a reddish-brown abstract background, female nudes are discernible.

works.d: Esiplaanil tumehallides ja pruunikates toonides nelinurgal sirp, valkjas käepide vasakul. Sirbi kaares keskel mustjaspruun koonusekujulise kauss. Selle kõrval paremal püsti ülaääreni ca 7,5 cm laiune reljeefsete inimese ja loomamaskidega valkjas-kollakas puust laud. Foon mustjas.
works.de: In the foreground, a sickle in dark grey and brownish tones on a rectangular ground, with a whitish handle on the left. In the middle of the sickle's arc, a blackish-brown cone-shaped bowl. Next to it, on the right, standing to the upper edge, a ca. 7.5 cm wide whitish-yellow wooden board with relief human and animal masks. The background is blackish.

works.dm: kõrgus: 85.0 cm; laius: 70.0 cm; kõrgus: 81.0 cm; laius: 74.0 cm
works.d: Keskel mustjas-sinisel foonil erkroheline ruumiline ristkülikutest toolilaadne kujund, sellel väike helesinine lennuk. Kujundi ees oranžide õitega lilled. Maali vasakul ja paremal küljel stiliseeritud lopsakad taimed tumedates rohelistes, sinistes ja pruunikates toonides.
works.de: In the centre, against a blackish-blue background, a bright green three-dimensional chair-like form made of rectangles, with a small light-blue airplane on it. In front of the form, flowers with orange blossoms. On the left and right sides of the painting, stylised lush plants in dark green, blue and brownish tones.

works.d: Istuva halliseguste juustega ja vuntsidega mehe 3/4 figuur otsevaates, pea 1/2 pöördes vasakule, jalad harkis, käed põlvedel. Seljas rohekas tuulepluus, valge lahtise kaelusega särk, jalas tumepruunid püksid. Heledal hallikas-lillal foonil, mehe vasaku õla taga, laia vertikaalse ribana tume lillakaspunane riie.
works.de: 3/4 figure of a seated man with greying hair and a moustache, in frontal view, head 1/2 turned to the left, legs apart, hands on knees. Wearing a greenish windbreaker, a white open-collared shirt, dark brown trousers. Against a light greyish-lilac background, behind the man's left shoulder, a wide vertical strip of dark purplish-red fabric.

works.d: Allääres keskel hele kollakas-valge merekarp, selle taga pikad leegikujulised pruunikad "merelohud", nende taga vasakul rohekas-sinine laik. Foon tume lillakaspruun. Ülaääres kollaažina metallist neetidest "lainetavad" ribad.
works.de: At the bottom centre a light yellowish-white sea shell, behind it long flame-shaped brownish "sea grooves", behind them on the left a greenish-blue patch. The background is dark purplish-brown. Along the top edge, a collage of "undulating" strips of metal rivets.

works.d: Noormees ja neiu istumas kõrvuti pingil - paremal sinise pulloveri, tumelillade pükstega noormehe figuur 1/2 pöördes vasakule, käed põlvedel. Tema kõrval keskel pruuni pulloveri, sinise seelikuga lühikeste pruunide juustega tüdruku figuur profiilis vasakule. Foon heledates külmades toonides.
works.de: A young man and a girl sitting side by side on a bench - on the right the figure of a young man in a blue pullover and dark purple trousers, half-turned to the left, hands on knees. Next to him in the middle, the figure of a girl with short brown hair, wearing a brown pullover and a blue skirt, in profile to the left. Background in light cool tones.

works.d: Lühikeste mustade juustega naise rindportree en face. Seljas erkpunane ühtlase pinnana maalitud džemper, mille kaelusest paistab valge pluusi krae. Foon ühetooniline tumesinine.
works.de: Bust portrait of a woman with short black hair, en face. Wearing a bright red sweater painted as a flat surface, from whose collar a white blouse collar shows. Background monochrome dark blue.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul kirju pearätiku ja põllega istuv vana naine profiilis paremale, käed risti süles. Tema kõrval paremal veidi tagapool, halli habeme ja vuntsidega, palja pealaega vanamees otsevaates, pea 1/2 pöördes paremale, tumehallis riietuses. Foon mustjaspruun.
works.de: In the foreground on the left, an old woman sitting in profile to the right, wearing a colourful headscarf and apron, hands crossed in her lap. Beside her on the right, slightly behind, an old man with a grey beard and moustache and a bald crown, in frontal view, head turned 1/2 to the right, dressed in dark grey. Background blackish-brown.

works.d: Keskel brüneti naise 3/4 figuur en-face, käed risti süles, seljas tumesinine avara kaelusega pikka kaela rõhutav pullover ja must kahar seelik. Foon sinakates toonides, maalitud pastoossete pintslilöökidega.
works.de: In the centre a 3/4 figure of a brunette woman en face, hands crossed in her lap, wearing a dark blue pullover with a wide neckline emphasising a long neck, and a black flared skirt. Background in bluish tones, painted with pastose brushstrokes.

works.d: Keskel tumeroheliste pikkade juustega, punapõselise, pruunisilmse tüdruku kogu maalipinda täitev rindportree en-face, seljas tumepunane õlakutega kleit, rinnas helekollane märk. Foon tüdruku pea taga sinine.
works.de: In the centre a chest portrait en face, filling the whole painting surface, of a girl with dark green long hair, rosy cheeks, brown eyes, wearing a dark red dress with shoulder straps, on the chest a light yellow mark. Background behind the girl's head blue.

works.d: Maalitud väikese musta mööblidetaili, kapiukse süvendisse. Erkkollase peaga hele-valge naise rindkere siluett profiilis vasakule, mustal foonil. Allääres naisest vasakul ja paremal, samuti ribana paremal ääres ülal erksinised leegikujulised motiivid. Kollaažiks kasutatud paberit ja ornamenteeritud puitu.
works.de: Painted on a small black furniture piece, in the recess of a cabinet door. The silhouette of a light-white woman's bust with a bright yellow head, in profile facing left, against a black background. At the lower edge, to the left and right of the woman, as well as as a strip on the upper right edge, bright blue flame-shaped motifs. Collage paper and ornamented wood were used.

works.d: Abstraktses laadis, ainult vasakus ääres kujutatud erkpunane mooniõis. Keskel valged, ülaääres sinised, allääres pruunikad toonid. Pastoosne värvkate vaheldumisi õhukesega ja kohati katmata alusmaal loovad mitmekesise faktuuri. Maalitud ka raami sisekülgedele. Kollaažiks kasutatud volditud valget pappi, võrgutükke jm.
works.de: In an abstract style, only at the left edge a bright red poppy flower is depicted. In the centre white, at the top edge blue, at the bottom edge brownish tones. A pastose paint layer alternating with a thin one and in places an uncovered ground creates a varied texture. Also painted on the inner sides of the frame. Folded white cardboard, pieces of netting etc. used for the collage.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul seisva tumedapäise poisi 1/2 figuur otsevaates, nägu 1/2 pöördes paremale, käed külgedel, seljas tume punakas-pruun dressipluus. Poisi ees kitsas ovaal tumepruunist ümmargusest lauast, sellel pruunis vaasis 3 pruunikas-hallikat nartsissi. Paremas servas kaarjas riba heledamast pruunist mustrilisest kardinast. Põrand tume, mustjas. Fooniks tume, hallikas-pruun sein, sellel poisi pea kohal helesinine alaosa mustas raamis maalist.
works.de: In the foreground, on the left, the 1/2 figure of a dark-haired boy standing in a frontal view, face in 1/2 turn to the right, arms at his sides, wearing a dark reddish-brown tracksuit top. In front of the boy, a narrow oval of a dark brown round table, on which stands a brown vase with 3 brownish-grey narcissi. On the right edge, a curved strip of a lighter brown patterned curtain. The floor is dark, blackish. The background is a dark, greyish-brown wall, on which, above the boy's head, is the light blue lower part of a painting in a black frame.

works.d: Esiplaanil tumeroheline muruplats, selle vasakus ääres punane kloostrihoone. Platsi taga kaarjalt ühtlase seinana pildi ülaääreni kahekordsed tornikestega hallikas-rohelised kloostrihooned.
works.de: In the foreground a dark green lawn, on its left edge a red monastery building. Behind the lawn, in an arching, uniform wall up to the top edge of the picture, two-storey greyish-green monastery buildings with little towers.

works.dm: kõrgus: 91.0 cm; laius: 71.2 cm; kõrgus: 84.9 cm; laius: 77.5 cm
works.d: Maali jagab pooleks horisontaalne tumesinine 2 cm laiune sirgjoon. Sellest allpool suurel helesinirohekal pinnal paremas nurgas all tumeroosa nägu helekollaste juustega; vasakust nurgast diagonaalselt paremale lamava naise pikaksvenitatud figuur selgvaates, tumepunastes pikkades pükstes, sinises pluusis. Tumesinisest joonest ülalpool sakiline ühtlases rohelises toonis metsa markeerib riba, selle kohal helekollane riba, edasi analoogiline "metsa" riba ja ülaääreni ühtlane tumeroosa "taevas", tumepunase suure kolmnurgaga keskel. Paremas nurgas ülal erksinine mängulennuk.
works.de: The painting is divided in half by a horizontal dark blue straight line 2 cm wide. Below it, on a large light blue-green surface, in the lower right corner a dark pink face with light yellow hair; from the left corner diagonally to the right the elongated figure of a reclining woman in full view, in long dark red trousers, in a blue blouse. Above the dark blue line a jagged strip in an even green tone marks a forest, above it a light yellow strip, then a similar "forest" strip, and up to the upper edge an even dark pink "sky" with a large dark red triangle in the centre. In the upper right corner a bright blue toy airplane.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul nurgas pearätikuga vanema naise 1/2 figuur otsevaates, süles koerapoeg, paremal pikkade juustega blondi tütarlapse 1/4 figuur profiilis vasakule. Paremas servas puuvõra meenutaval mustal pinnal õunapuu oks 3 õunaga. Maastik figuuride taga maalitud eritooniliste roheliste pindadena. Keskplaanil figuuride helerohelised rõugud. Taamal stiliseeritud tumedamad rohelised majade kuubikud, nende taga tumeroheline ca 9,5 cm laiune riba "metsa". Üle poole maalist ühetooniline helesinine taevas kahe halli ovaaliga keskel.
works.de: In the foreground, in the left corner, a 1/2 figure of an older woman with a headscarf, seen frontally, with a puppy in her lap; on the right a 1/4 figure of a blonde girl with long hair, in profile facing left. In the right margin, on a black surface reminiscent of a tree crown, an apple-tree branch with 3 apples. The landscape behind the figures is painted as areas of green in various tones. In the middle ground, light-green patches around the figures. Further back, stylised darker green cubes of houses, behind them a dark-green strip of "forest" about 9.5 cm wide. Over half of the painting is a uniform light-blue sky with two grey ovals in the centre.

works.d: Maalipinnast 2/3 täidavad lopsakad erksates toonides köögiviljad - helerohelised kapsapead ja hernekaunad, punased tomatid jm. Esiplaanil ees keskel suur sinakas läbipaistev klaaspurk, sellest paremal murul ovaalne peegel ja suur punane juuksehari, vasakul köögiviljade vahel roheline hambahari. Köögiviljade kuhila keskelt kõrgub ülaääreni triibuline kollakas metalltala, murtud ülalt täisnurkselt vasakule. Paremal köögiviljade taga tükike valkjas-halli müüri, lillevaasiga müürinurgal. Taamal horisontaalne riba heledat kollakas-rohelist maapinda ja ülaääres kõrge helesinine valgete pilverüngastega taevas.
works.de: Two-thirds of the painting's surface is filled with lush, brightly coloured vegetables - light green cabbage heads and pea pods, red tomatoes, etc. In the foreground centre, a large bluish transparent glass jar, to its right on the grass an oval mirror and a large red hairbrush, to the left among the vegetables a green toothbrush. From the middle of the pile of vegetables rises a striped yellowish metal beam reaching the upper edge, bent from above at a right angle to the left. On the right behind the vegetables a piece of whitish-grey wall, with a flower vase at the corner of the wall. In the distance a horizontal strip of light yellowish-green ground and at the top edge a high light blue sky with white cloud masses.

works.dm: kõrgus: 72.0 cm; laius: 80.2 cm; kõrgus: 68.2 cm; laius: 82.4 cm
works.d: Abstraktne käsitluslaad. Maali äärel aimatavad lehemotiivid. Ülaääres horisontaalne ca 5,5 cm laiune pruunikas luiteid meenutav riba, selle all helesinised nelinurgad, edasi allääreni laiad spiraalsed punakas-pruunid ribad. Punakas-pruunis üldkoloriidis.
works.de: Abstract manner of treatment. At the edge of the painting, hints of leaf motifs. At the top edge a horizontal brownish, dune-like strip about 5,5 cm wide, below it light blue quadrangles, further towards the bottom edge broad spiralling reddish-brown stripes. In an overall reddish-brown coloring.

works.d: Esiplaanil keskel kuuri kõrge otsasein. Selle tagant paistab osa teise kuuri otsaseinast, kahepoolse uksega. Paremal keskplaanil kolmanda kuuri otsasein ja külgsein uksega. Kuurid tumedad, maa ja katused lumised. Kuuride ümber lookleb kollakas teerada. Kuuride vahelt paistab silmapiirini tumesinine meri. Taevas heleroheline, suurte valgete pülverünkadega.
works.de: In the foreground centre the tall gable end of a shed. Behind it part of the gable end of a second shed with a double door is visible. On the right in the middle ground the gable end of a third shed and its side wall with a door. The sheds are dark, the ground and roofs snowy. A yellowish path winds around the sheds. Between the sheds a dark blue sea is visible to the horizon. The sky is light green, with large white cumulus clouds.

works.d: Keskel peaaegu ülaääreni ulatuv seisva mehe 3/4 figuur otsevaates. Riietus toretsev. Tumesinise pintsaku revääri nööpaugus punane nelk, heledama sinise vesti nööpaugus kuldkett, valge kõrge kõvakrae, tumesinised püksid. Näo üks pool valge, teine sinakas, juuksed punakad. Hallikas-sinisega maalitud käed sirgelt ees, kinni seotud köiejupiga. Foon käte värvi hallikas-sinine. Maal kujutab portreemaali, sest äärtele maalitud rohekas ülalt kaarjas pildiraam.
works.de: In the centre, reaching almost to the upper edge, a 3/4 figure of a standing man, frontal view. Attire showy. In the buttonhole of the dark blue jacket lapel a red carnation, in the buttonhole of the lighter blue vest a gold chain, a white high stiff collar, dark blue trousers. One side of the face white, the other bluish, hair reddish. Hands painted in greyish-blue, held straight in front, tied with a piece of rope. Background the same greyish-blue as the hands. The painting depicts a portrait painting, since a greenish picture frame, arched at the top, is painted at the edges.

works.d: Esiplaanil keskel oranži-valgeruudulise linaga kaetud laua ees mees en face, nägu helelilla, seljas oranž pullover, peakate valge. Mehe vasaku õla juures naturalistliku asjalikkusega maalitud pruunika vedelikuga korgitud pudel. Keskplaanil mehe selja taga laual tumeroheliste lõikudega heleroheline kauss, paremal kolm selgelt loetava venekeelse tekstiga margariini pakki ja venekeelse sildiga pudel. Heledale valkjale foonile markeeritud vasakule väike helesinine mööbliese otsevaates.
works.de: In the foreground, in the centre, a man en face in front of a table covered with an orange-and-white checkered cloth, his face light purple, wearing an orange pullover, headwear white. Near the man's left shoulder, painted with naturalistic matter-of-factness, a bottle corked with a brownish liquid. In the middle ground, behind the man, on the table, a light green bowl with dark green sections, on the right three margarine packs with clearly legible Russian-language text and a bottle with a Russian-language label. Against a light whitish background, marked to the left, a small light blue piece of furniture in direct view.

works.d: Paberist välja lõigatud stiliseeritud pikad sihvakad figuurid kleebitud kogu maali pinda täitva massina aluspapile. Kollaaž õhukeselt kaetud eredates kollakates, punastes, rohelistes, sinistes, roosades toonides õlivärvidega. Käsitluslaad dekoratiivne.
works.de: Stylised long slender figures cut out of paper, glued as a mass filling the whole surface of the painting onto a backing board. Collage thinly covered with oil paints in bright yellowish, red, green, blue, pink tones. Treatment is decorative.

works.d: Kollažiks kasutatud vanaaegsetest ajalehtedest ja marlist lõigatud tükke, need kohati hallikas-valge õlivärviga üle värvitud. Sellel makulatuuriga kaetud seina imiteerival foonil ripuvad keskel pruunikas-mustad puulusikad ja jäme kett, vasakul ülal seinal kaks musta võtit.
works.de: Pieces cut from old newspapers and gauze used for the collage, in places painted over with greyish-white oil paint. On this background imitating a wall covered with waste paper, brownish-black wooden spoons and a thick chain hang in the centre, with two black keys on the wall at upper left.

works.d: Esiplaanil riba rohelist põõsastikku hekina, avaga vasakul, kust paistab hall sõidutee trammi tagumise otsaga. Heki kohal keskel kõrguvad üle sõidutee kaks tänavavalgustit. Silmapiiri sõidutee taga suleb kõrge lehtpuude massiiv, mille kohal paremal kirikutorni tipp. Kõrge suvetaevas maalitud ühtlase helesinise pinnana.
works.de: In the foreground a strip of green shrubbery forming a hedge, with an opening on the left, through which a grey roadway with the rear end of a tram can be seen. Above the hedge, in the centre, two street lamps rise above the roadway. On the horizon behind the roadway a massif of tall deciduous trees closes the view, above which on the right the tip of a church tower. The high summer sky is painted as a uniform light blue surface.

works.d: Esiplaanil keskel jooksuraja ääres punases spordisärgis, mustades pükstes tugevasti päevitanud brüneti noormehe 3/4 figuur profiilis vasakule, vaatlemas vasakul käeseljal ronivat tigu. Keskel ühtlase ererohelise pinnana muruväljak. Selle taga jooksurajal  vasakul 2 jooksvat meessportlast. Silmapiiril lehtmets. Üle poole maalipinnast taevas, metsa kohal heledates kollakates-sinistes, ülal tumesinistes toonides.
works.de: In the foreground, in the middle, by the edge of a running track, the 3/4 figure of a strongly tanned young brunet man in a red sports shirt and black trousers, in profile to the left, observing a snail crawling on the back of his left hand. In the middle an even bright green surface of a lawn. Behind it, on the running track on the left, 2 running male athletes. On the horizon a deciduous forest. More than half of the painting's surface is sky, above the forest in light yellowish-blue tones, higher up in dark blue tones.

works.d: Peaaegu kogu lõuendit täitev noore mehe rindportree en face. Juuksed ja paksud kulmud tumepruunid, veidi ette kallutatud suur nägu helepruun, silmad eresinised. Seljas erk sinakasroheline kampsun, heledam sinakas pluus ja lips. Fooniks mehe pea taga ühtlane sinakas-must pind, ülaääres ca 4,5 cm laiune sinine triip.
works.de: A bust portrait of a young man filling almost the whole canvas, en face. Hair and thick eyebrows dark brown, the large face, tilted slightly forward, light brown, eyes bright blue. Wearing a bright bluish-green sweater, a lighter bluish shirt and a tie. As background behind the man's head a uniform bluish-black surface, at the upper edge a blue stripe about 4.5 cm wide.

works.d: Esiplaanil vasakul käepidamisega vaasi ülemine osa, selles koltunud lilled kollakaspruunides ja sinakashallides toonides. Tagapõhi paremal pruun, vasakul sinakaslilla, keskel sinine nagu tükike taevast.
works.de: In the foreground on the left the upper part of a vase with a handle, containing withered flowers in yellowish-brown and bluish-grey tones. The background on the right is brown, on the left bluish-purple, in the middle blue like a piece of sky.

works.d: Esiplaanil heledas suvepluusis tumedates pükstes poisike en face. Selja tagant paistvas päikesevalguses on nägu ainult markeeritud. Fooniks skitseerivalt maalitud pruunikaga toonitatud roheline lehestik.
works.de: A boy en face in the foreground, wearing a light summer blouse and dark trousers. In the sunlight showing through from behind, the face is only indicated. The background is sketchily painted greenery toned with brownish hues.

works.dm: kõrgus: 92.3 cm; laius: 115.1 cm; kõrgus: 88.8 cm; laius: 118.5 cm
works.d: Esiplaanil peaaegu kogu lõuendit täitev abstraktses laadis tume lillakas-sinakas-rohekas kimp sügisesi põllulilli ja oksi. Kimbus realistlikult maalitud valged karikakraõied keskel, vasakul pihlakaoks punaste marjakobaratega ja paremal suur sõnajalaoks, milles osa lehti kollaažina. Lillekimbu taha paremale keskplaanile ülemisse nurka eresinise-valge taeva taustale markeeritud ülikooli peahoone fassaad 6 sambaga. Lillekimbu taga vasakul foon pruun.
works.de: In the foreground, filling almost the entire canvas, an abstract-style dark purplish-blue-greenish bouquet of autumn field flowers and branches. In the bouquet, realistically painted white oxeye daisy flowers in the middle, a rowan branch with red clusters of berries on the left, and a large fern branch on the right, part of whose leaves are done as collage. Behind the bouquet, in the upper corner of the right middle ground, the facade of the university's main building with 6 columns is marked against a bright blue-white sky background. Behind the bouquet on the left, the background is brown.

works.d: Punasel ümmargusel laual heledas neljakandilises vaasis valged lilled. Vasakust nurgast keskplaanile keskele markeeritud sinakas-valge kattega diivaninurk. Foon tumedates sinistes-punastes toonides.
works.de: On a round red table in a light-coloured four-sided vase, white flowers. From the left corner toward the centre of the middle ground, a corner of a sofa with a bluish-white cover is marked. Background in dark blue-red tones.

works.d: Krobelise faktuuri saamiseks plaadile ebaühtlase kihina liimitud jämedaid puukiude. Keskel kollakal laual sinises vaasis kimp soojatoonilisi lilli. Foon pruunikas.
works.de: Thick wood fibres glued to the board in an uneven layer to achieve a rough texture. In the centre, on a yellowish table, a bouquet of warm-toned flowers in a blue vase. Background brownish.

works.d: Maali vasakust nurgast tõuseb keskele mäkke, Inglisilla alt läbi talvine Läte tänav. Vasakpoolsele kõnniteele markeeritud jalakäijad. Kahel pool tänavat lumiste katustega majad ja suured raagus lumised puud. Taevas nagu maapindki sinakasvalge.
works.de: From the left corner of the painting, the winter Läte tänav rises to the hill in the centre, passing under the Inglisild [Englishman's Bridge]. Pedestrians are marked on the left-hand pavement. On both sides of the street, houses with snowy roofs and large bare snowy trees. The sky, like the ground, is bluish-white.

works.d: Keskel ülempreester Kaiva, tema ümber Kristust süüdistavad kirjatundjad ja vanemad. Vasakul troonil Rooma prokuraator; vasakul esialal mees seljaga ja kirjutaja. Paremal rahvale väljaantud Kristus prokuraatori, sõjameeste ja oma poolehoidjate keskel.
works.de: In the middle, high priest Caiaphas, around him the scribes and elders accusing Christ. On the left on a throne the Roman procurator; on the left foreground a man with his back turned and a scribe. On the right, Christ handed over to the people, among the procurator, soldiers and his own supporters.

works.d: Esialal kerges laintevahus meri, mille kallas on astanguliselt mägine. Paremal serval mäeküljel on rida rohelise võraga puid. Tagaala kõrgmäestik on heledasti valgustatud, osaliselt jäävad mäed roosakate pilverünkade varju.
works.de: In the foreground a sea with light wave-foam, its shore rising in terraced mountains. On the right edge, on the mountainside, a row of trees with green crowns. In the background the high mountains are brightly lit, with parts of the mountains lying in the shadow of pinkish cumulus clouds.

works.d: Ovaalne nägu en face, suured pruunid silmad, pruun sirge juus, vasakpoolne kõrv nähtav, üle pea seotud punane lint. Pruun kleit valge kaeluse ja hallide-valgete triipudega. Värvkate õhuke, katmisviis sile.
works.de: Oval face en face, large brown eyes, straight brown hair, left ear visible, a red ribbon tied over the head. Brown dress with a white collar and grey-white stripes. Thin paint layer, smooth application.

works.d: Esialal jõgi, puudegrupp ja põõsaid. Keskalal lai jõgi ja mets, paremal värskeltsadanud lumega maa ja kõrguv metsatukk siluetina. Rünkpilvede vahelt hajub maastikule helendavat päikesevalgust. Koloriit hallikas ja lillakas varjundis. Pintsliköök lai, laiklik, lõuend kohati katmata.
works.de: In the foreground, a river, a group of trees and bushes. In the middle ground, a wide river and forest, on the right freshly fallen snow on the ground and a rising grove of trees as a silhouette. Through the cumulus clouds, glowing sunlight diffuses over the landscape. The colouring is in greyish and purplish hues. The brushwork is broad, patchy, the canvas left bare in places.

works.d: Esiplaanil kollakas põld, kaugemal metsad. Tagaplaanil riba heledat taevast.
works.de: In the foreground a yellowish field, forests further away. In the background a strip of light sky.

works.d: Allääres ca 28 cm laiune must pind, sellest ülalpool geomeetrilise abstrakstionismi laadis tumesinised, sinakasrohelised, lillakaspunased, sinakashallid kujundid. Värvkate õhuke.
works.de: Along the lower edge a black area about 28 cm wide, above it, in a geometric abstractionist style, dark blue, bluish-green, purplish-red, bluish-grey shapes. The paint layer thin.

works.d: Keskel maja ja kirik, krundi ümber puud, põõsad ja kivitara. Samas kaks vastlevat paari. Taamal vasemal mäed ja loss.
works.de: In the middle a house and a church, around the plot trees, bushes and a stone fence. Also two dueling pairs. In the distance on the left mountains and a castle.

works.d: Lage talvemaastik võseriku ja paremalt kumava päikesevalgusega. Esialal kihutav hibune, parempoolne hobunekukkunud. Paremal jälitajate ratsajõuk, esimesed vibutavad mõõku, teistel odad püsti. Pahtlitehnika, värvkate kergelt pastoosne.
works.de: An open winter landscape with scrubland and sunlight glimmering from the right. In the foreground a galloping horse, on the right a fallen horse. On the right a pack of pursuing horsemen, the front ones brandishing swords, the others with spears upright. Putty technique, paint layer slightly impasto.

works.d: Esi -ja keskplaanil keskel küngaste vahel org. Org ja künkad kaetud põllulappide ja üksikute lehtpuudega. Taamal vasakul orunõlvale markeeritud taluhooneid, orus järv, ümbritsetud paremalt ja silmapiirilt metsaga, mille kohal kitsa ribana hele suvetaevas.
works.de: In the foreground and middle ground, in the centre, a valley between hills. The valley and hills covered with field patches and single deciduous trees. In the distance on the left, farm buildings marked on the valley slope, in the valley a lake, surrounded on the right and at the horizon by forest, above which a narrow strip of bright summer sky.

works.d: Hallipäise, väikeste vurrudega, kõrge laubaga mehe rindportree en face. Seljas tume pintsak. Foon rohekas pruuniga.
works.de: Chest portrait en face of a greying man with a small moustache and a high forehead. Wearing a dark jacket. Background greenish-brown.

works.d: Halliseguste juustega mehe rindportree en face. Seljas tumepruun pintsak vestiga. Foon helepruunikas.
works.de: Bust portrait of a man with greying hair, en face. Wearing a dark brown jacket with a waistcoat. Background light brownish.

works.dm: kõrgus: 78.0 cm; laius: 100.0 cm; kõrgus: 73.0 cm; laius: 105.3 cm
works.d: Esiplaanil kollakal murul paremal lambakari söömas, vasakul ees kadakad. Keskplaanil kõrgendikul kõrge taeva foonil reas tiibadeta pukktuulik, tiibadega pukktuulik, tiibadega kivist tuulik ja selle kõrval vasakul osa kolmandast tiibadega pukktuulikust. Tuulikute kõrval paremal kaks taluhoonet. Taevas madala horisondi kohal tumesinine, valkjate rünkpilvedega.
works.de: In the foreground, on yellowish grass on the right, a flock of sheep grazing, junipers in front on the left. In the middle ground on a rise, against the background of a high sky, in a row: a wingless post mill, a post mill with sails, a stone mill with sails, and beside it on the left part of a third post mill with sails. Beside the mills on the right two farm buildings. The sky above the low horizon dark blue, with whitish cumulus clouds.

works.d: Esiplaanil kirjutuslaua ääres istuva hallipäise mehe 3/4 figuur 1/2 pöördes paremale, seljas tume ülikond, hallika särgiga, parem küünarvars toetub kirjutuslaua tooli seljatoele, vasak kirjutuslaua servale. Maali paremast nurgast diagonaalselt keskele osa tumepruunist kirjutuslauast. Laual esiplaanil avatud noodiraamat, selle taga tindipotid ja hall topsik pliiatsite ja sulepeadega, laua vasakul serval raamatud. Foon pruunikas-rohekas.
works.de: In the foreground, the 3/4 figure of a grey-haired man sitting at a writing desk, in 1/2 turn to the right, wearing a dark suit with a greyish shirt, his right forearm resting on the back of the desk chair, his left on the edge of the desk. From the right corner of the painting, diagonally to the centre, part of a dark brown writing desk. On the desk in the foreground, an open sheet music book, behind it ink pots and a grey cup with pencils and pen nibs, on the left edge of the desk, books. The background is brownish-green.

works.d: Kollase paberiga kaetud mista kirjutuslaua taga, kõrge seljatoega puutoolil istuva, lugeva noore tumedajuukselise mehe 1/2 figuur, 1/2 pöördes paremale, mõlemad käed laual, kus avatud roheliste kaantega raamat. Mehel seljas tumepruun pintsak, punane lips ja valge kittel. Laua taga seina ääres paremal kõrge raamaturiiuli nurk erksavärviliste köidetega. Fooniks rohekas sein.
works.de: A 1/2 figure of a young dark-haired man reading, sitting 1/2 turned to the right at a writing desk covered with yellow paper, on a wooden chair with a high back. Both hands on the table, where an open book with green covers lies. The man wears a dark brown jacket, a red tie and a white coat. Behind the table, by the wall on the right, the corner of a tall bookshelf with brightly coloured bindings. Background a greenish wall.

works.d: Esiplaanil paremal võimas hele vaoauto eestvaates, avatud kabiini uksel inimese figuur, veokastis roosad marmoriblokid. Fooniks hele mitmevärviline mäestikumassiiv. Ülaääres valkjassinine taevas.
works.de: In the foreground on the right, a powerful light-coloured truck in front view, on the open cab door a human figure, in the cargo bed pink marble blocks. The background is a light-coloured, multi-coloured mountain massif. At the top edge a whitish-blue sky.

works.d: Esiplaanil keskel raudsõrestikul istub helevalge tüdruk erksinistes jalatsites 1/2 pöördes vasakule. Tema kõrval seisab sõrestikule toetudes tumepruun mehefiguur mustades kummikutes 1/2 pöördes vasakule. Figuuridele fooniks hele linnavaade, millest keskplaanil vasakul eraldub üksik roosakas kõrghoone otsevaates. Taamal heledad paljad värvilised mäed. Ülaääres riba valkjat taevast. Heledas üldkoloriidis, visandlikus laadis.
works.de: In the foreground, in the middle, a bright white girl sits on an iron lattice, in bright blue shoes, in a 1/2 turn to the left. Beside her stands a dark brown male figure leaning on the lattice, in black rubber boots, in a 1/2 turn to the left. The figures are set against a light cityscape background, from which, in the middle ground on the left, a single pinkish high-rise building stands out in a frontal view. In the distance, light bare coloured mountains. Along the upper edge a strip of whitish sky. In a light overall colour scheme, in a sketchy manner.

works.d: Maali täidab esiplaanilt vasakul diagonaalselt taha paremale suunduva kaherealiste autoteedega silla kõrge hele värviline tihe kandetalastik. Sillale fooniks vasakul rohekad mäed, paremal heledad marmormäed. Ülaääres roosakas-valkjas taevas.
works.de: The painting is filled from the foreground left, diagonally receding to the back right, with a tall, light-coloured, dense supporting truss structure of a bridge with two-lane roads. On the left the bridge is set against a background of greenish mountains, on the right pale marble mountains. At the top edge a pinkish-whitish sky.

works.d: Kivisel kollakal rannaribal vasakul grupp inimesi poolringis - esiplaanil keskel istub kivil helerohelise pluusiga mees selgvaates 1/2 pöördes vasakule, tema vastas istub halli habemega tumedas riietuses vanamees otsevaates, tema selja taga seisab püsti beeži pulloveriga mees 1/2 pöördes vasakule, selle kõrval seisab visdi ette kummargil palja ülakehaga mees, tema ees istub kivil punase pearätiga naine profiilis paremale. Kõigil käes kividele laotatud võrgulina. Grupi taga vasakul ääres paadinina. Keskplaanil paremal ääres 3 meest puudele tõstetud võrgu juures, nende kõrval veepiiril kükakil punase pearätiga naine. Taamal paremal lükkavad mehed vees paate. Hele sinakas-hall avar veeväli silm
works.de: On a stony yellowish shore strip on the left, a group of people in a semicircle - in the foreground in the middle, a man in a light green blouse sits on a stone in a clear 1/2 turn to the left, opposite him sits a gray-bearded old man in dark clothing in a frontal view, behind him stands an upright man in a beige pullover in a 1/2 turn to the left, next to him stands a bare-chested man bent over toward the wattle, in front of him sits a woman with a red headscarf on a stone in profile to the right. Everyone has fishing net spread on the stones in their hands. Behind the group on the left edge is a boat's bow. In the middle ground on the right edge, 3 men are at a net raised on trees, next to them at the waterline a woman with a red headscarf crouches. In the distance on the right, men push boats in the water. A light bluish-gray open expanse of water fills the eye

works.d: Halliseguste juustega tumesinises ülikonnas istuva mehe 1/2 figuur en face sinisel foonil. Parem käsivars toetub tooli seljatoele, vasak käsi üle parema jala tõstetud vasaku jala põlvel.
works.de: 1/2 figure of a man with greying hair, wearing a dark blue suit, seated en face against a blue background. Right forearm resting on the back of the chair, left hand raised over the right leg, resting on the knee of the left leg.

works.d: Esiplaanil keskel istub taburetil hallikas kitlis mees profiilis paremale, tema ees kast pooleldi taimi täis istutatud. Paremal kõrval seisab sinises kitlis mees otsevaates ulatamas taime istutamiseks. Meestele fooniks roheline tihe lopsakas lehestik. Vasakul keskplaanil seina ääres ämber ja labidas, nende kohal laial diagonaalselt paremale suunduval aknalaual tihedalt pruunid savipotid roheliste madalate ja üksikute kõrgemate lilledega.
works.de: In the foreground in the middle sits a man in a greyish smock on a stool, in profile to the right, in front of him a crate half-filled with planted plants. On the right beside him stands a man in a blue smock, in frontal view, handing over a plant for planting. The background behind the men is dense, lush green foliage. On the left in the middle ground by the wall, a bucket and a spade, above them, on a wide windowsill running diagonally to the right, densely packed brown clay pots with green low and single taller flowers.

works.d: Stseen haige lapse voodi juures. Rohelise kupliga lambi valgussõõris keskplaanil keskel voodi magava väikelapsega. Voodi serval istub rõõmsailmeline naine profiilis vasakule, käed kahel pool last ja vaatab last. Esiplaanil vasakul kollase linaga laua kõrval seisab selgvaates 1/2 pöördes paremale tumedapäine tumedas riietuses poisike ja vaatab last. Esiplaanil paremal pruunikirjul vaibal ümmarguse põhjaga puust tool tuubikestega. Tooli kõrval seisab selgvaates 1/2 pöördes vasakule valges kitlis naine, vasak käsi valge rätikuga rinnal ja vaatab rõõmsal ilmel last. Fooniks ühtlaselt rohekas-pruunikas sein, millel riputatud maal. Akadeemilises realistlikus laadis.
works.de: Scene by a sick child's bed. In the circle of light of a green-shaded lamp, in the middle ground at the center, a bed with a sleeping small child. On the edge of the bed sits a cheerful-looking woman in profile facing left, hands on either side of the child, looking at the child. In the foreground on the left, next to a table with a yellow cloth, stands a dark-haired boy in dark clothing, in clear view, turned 1/2 to the right, looking at the child. In the foreground on the right, on a brownish patterned carpet, a wooden chair with a round seat and turned legs. Next to the chair stands, in clear view, turned 1/2 to the left, a woman in a white coat, her left hand with a white cloth on her chest, looking at the child with a cheerful expression. The background is an evenly greenish-brown wall, on which a painting is hung. In an academic realist style.

works.d: Keskplaanil keskel seisavad kõrvuti otsevaates kaks töömeest lillakas-pruunil foonil. Nende ees neli tumelillat raudtala. Meestest vasakul ja paremal erksad mitmevärvilised geomeetrilised pinnad. Meeste peade kohal taamal erksa kollase taeva foonil maali ülaääreni reas erivärvilised kraanasõrestikud. Koloriit kirju, käsitluslaad stiliseeriv
works.de: In the central plane, in the middle, two workmen stand side by side in a frontal view against a purplish-brown background. In front of them are four dark purple iron beams. To the left and right of the men are bright multicoloured geometric surfaces. Above the men's heads, in the distance against a bright yellow sky background, a row of differently coloured crane trusses extends to the upper edge of the painting. The colouring is varied, the treatment stylising.

works.d: Esiplaanil helepruunil laual malelaud malenditega. Laua taga istuvad kaks mustjaspruunis riietuses meest. Vasakul mees profiilis paremale, parem käsi küünarnukiga laual, peopesa suu juures. Teine mees istub keskel otsevaates vaidi kummargil ette, vasak käsi tõstetud suu juurde. Paremal laua kõrval noore naise seisev 3/4 figuur profiilis vasakule, pea veidi langetatud. Figuuride peade taga foon helepruun, maali külgedel mustjaspruun, üldistav käsitluslaad, figuurid musta kontuurjoonega.
works.de: In the foreground, on a light brown table, a chessboard with chess pieces. Two men dressed in blackish brown sit behind the table. On the left, a man in profile facing right, right hand with elbow on the table, palm near his mouth. The other man sits in the middle in a frontal view, hunched forward, his left hand raised to his mouth. On the right, next to the table, the standing 3/4 figure of a young woman in profile facing left, her head slightly lowered. Behind the figures' heads the background is light brown, the sides of the painting blackish brown, generalized manner of treatment, figures with a black contour line.

works.d: Abstraktsed loodusvormid maali vasakul küljel punakates ja oranžides toonides, paremal küljel rohekas-pruunides ja pruunides toonides. Pinnaline käsitluslaad.
works.de: Abstract natural forms on the left side of the painting in reddish and orange tones, on the right side in greenish-brown and brown tones. Flat manner of treatment.

Tulvistel ees prillid, habe, hoiab parema käega kaelas rippuvat ametiraha.

The surgeon is cutting a chair off from the buttocks, the backrest of which has the shape of the six columns and pediment of the university's main building. Above, an operating room lamp. Tulviste has glasses on, a beard, and holds with his right hand an official medal hanging around his neck.

works.d:
Oluline ajalooline väärtus ülikooli jaoks - arvestades rektor Parrot’ tähendust ning rolli ülikooli taasavamises. Ajalooline seos ülikooliga – portree oli algselt tellitud ülikooli peasaali tarvis. 19. sajandi rektoritest portreed ülikooli kogudes puuduvad. Rektor Parrot’-st on visuaalne materjal äärmiselt napp, seni on Parrot’ välimus meile tuttav kadunud portree järgi valmistatud graafilise lehe kaudu. 
Kõrge kunstiväärtus - otsustades fotode järgi, on maal teostatud detailse läbimaalinguga, kunstilist mõju ei kahjusta ka maali vanusest tulenev kraklee (lakikihi pragunemine) ega paar pinnavigastust. Fotode järgi on kõnealuse maali detailid elavamad, mulje vahetum ning koloriit Kügelgenile
works.de:
An important historical value for the university - considering the significance and role of rector Parrot in the reopening of the university. Historical connection with the university – the portrait was originally commissioned for the university's main hall. Among the 19th-century rectors, portraits are absent from the university's collections. Visual material of rector Parrot is extremely scarce; until now Parrot's appearance has been known to us through a print made after a lost portrait.
High artistic value - judging by the photographs, the painting is executed with detailed, thorough painting technique; the artistic impact is not diminished either by the craquelure (cracking of the varnish layer) resulting from the painting's age or by a couple of surface damages. According to the photographs, the details of the painting in question are more vivid, the impression more immediate, and the colouring more akin to Kügelgen

works.d:
Karl Eduard von Liphart (1808–1891) oli kunstihuvilistest Raadi mõisnikest tuntuim kunstikollektsionäär, vanagraafika ning Itaalia renessansskunsti ekspert.  Tartu Ülikooli kunstimuuseumis on siiani hoiul osa tema kuulsast graafikogust, mille viimane Raadi mõisahärra 1920. aastal Eestist lahkudes ülikoolile kinkis.

Siiani ei ole teada olnud ühtegi Karl Eduard von Lipharti poolt maalitud maali. Kunstikoguja maaliharrastus on samas igati ootuspärane, arvestades ka asjaolu, et tema poeg Ernst Friedrich von Liphart oli tunnustatud ning edukas maalikunstnik.

Maal on küllaltki suur, 80 x 58 cm raamita, signeeritud, annetaja tellimusel juba varasemalt konserveeritud ning raamitud. Sellisena põnev
works.de:
Karl Eduard von Liphart (1808–1891) was the most famous art collector among the art-loving Raadi manor lords, an expert on old prints and Italian Renaissance art. The University of Tartu Art Museum still holds part of his famous print collection, which the last lord of Raadi manor donated to the university in 1920 when leaving Estonia.

Until now, no painting painted by Karl Eduard von Liphart has been known. The art collector's painting hobby is, however, entirely to be expected, considering also the fact that his son Ernst Friedrich von Liphart was a recognized and successful painter.

works.d:
Värvilito tehnikas palja ülakehaga mees. Atleetlik, keha pingestatud, nägu profiilis, käed ülesse laiali sirutatud. Ülakeha, pea ja käed suunatud paremale (mehest lähtudes). Üle mehe pea moodustub kaar, parema käe juures maanduv paberlennuk. Mehe keha on värviline- leidub nii rohelist, oranži, erinevaid kollaseid, lillat, halli, musta valgeid selgelt piiritletud värvilaike. Kaar ja lennuk samuti mitmevärvilised. Puusakohast allapoole on mehel taustaks lillade korrapäraste joontega plank. Vöökohast ülespoole jääb taustaks linnapilt, majad, tornid, puud, põõsad. Värvigamma on hall. Taust ja esiplaan kontrastsed. Käsitsi signeeritud: Kaar (värv.lito) 16/30 M.Üksine 1997.a.
Kingitus Harju Maaval
works.de:
In the color lithograph technique, a bare-chested man. Athletic, body tensed, face in profile, arms stretched wide upward. The torso, head and arms are directed to the right (from the man's perspective). Above the man's head an arc forms, with a paper airplane landing near the right hand. The man's body is colorful - there are green, orange, various yellows, purple, gray, black, and white clearly delineated color patches. The arc and airplane are also multicolored. Below the hip level, the man has a background of a fence with purple regular lines. Above waist level, the background is a cityscape - houses, towers, trees, bushes. The color scheme is gray. The background and foreground are contrasting. Hand-signed: Kaar (värv.lito) 16/30 M.Üksine 1997.a.
Gift from Harju Maaval

works.d: Tekst all servas. Pildil on otsevaates kaks hoonet, vasakpoolne on väiksem ja s.o. kohvik " Gnoom ", parempoolne on massiivsem ja s.o. apteegi hoone. Kahe maja vahel on veel autopood. Apteegi hoone ees on eristatav kolm inimfiguuri. Pilt on värvirikka koliriidiga.
works.de: Text at the lower edge. The picture shows, in a frontal view, two buildings, the left-hand one is smaller and is the café "Gnoom", the right-hand one is more massive and is the pharmacy building. Between the two buildings there is also a car shop. In front of the pharmacy building three human figures can be distinguished. The picture is done in a colourful palette.

works.d: Pildil on kujutatud talu köök. Vasakul nurgas on suur peaaegu laeni köögipliit, millel on pott ja kulp, pliidi all on tuli. Vasakusse seina jääb ka aken, millel ees potisinine kardin ja tumekollase linaga kaetud laud. Laua kõrval pakul istub mees profiilis ja suitsetab piipu, käes hoiab ahjuroopi, tema taga seisab säärsaapaid hoidev naine valge kitli ja oranžikate juustega. Otsevaates on lahtine ukseava, kus seisab rohelist sinelit ja mütsi käeshoidev naine. Sineli varrukal on sini-must-valge tähis. Naine on pruunis, tema jalge alla jääb sinine vaip. Otseseinas ripub kell ja püss ning selle seina ääres seisab pruunis ülikonnas mees, käsi rinnal. Tema ees näoga pildiava poole istuvad laua äär
works.de: The picture depicts a farmhouse kitchen. In the left corner is a large stove almost reaching the ceiling, on which there is a pot and a ladle, with fire beneath the stove. A window is also in the left wall, with a pot-blue curtain in front of it and a table covered with a dark yellow cloth. Next to the table, a man sits on a block in profile, smoking a pipe, holding an oven rake in his hand, behind him stands a woman holding tall boots, wearing a white smock and with orangish hair. In frontal view is an open doorway, where a woman stands holding a green overcoat and cap. On the overcoat's sleeve is a blue-black-white insignia. The woman is dressed in brown, with a blue carpet beneath her feet. On the front wall hangs a clock and a rifle, and next to that wall stands a man in a brown suit, hand on his chest. In front of him, facing the picture's opening, people sit at the edge of the table

works.d: Asta Eenoki joonistatud pilt, arvatavasti munadepühadeks. Kujutab mune korvis ja pajuoksi. Taha on kirjutatud „Onule. Rõõmsaid kevadpühi kirjude munadega. Soovib Asta Siberist“. Joonistatud pliiatsitega. Pilt saadetud Asta hoidjatädi Magdaleena Veiksalu mehele Kustas Veiksalule vangilaagrisse.
works.de: A picture drawn by Asta Eenok, presumably for Easter. Depicts eggs in a basket and pussy-willow branches. On the back is written "To Uncle. Wishing a joyful spring holiday with colourful eggs. From Asta in Siberia". Drawn with pencils. The picture was sent to Asta's guardian-aunt Magdaleena Veiksalu's husband Kustas Veiksalu at the prison camp.

works.d: “Lilleflirt I”. Kõigepealt hallil, siis punasel puidust alusel ja rohelisel taustal on KGB agendi aruande blanketile trükitud “Lilleflirdi” sünnilugu Andres Toltsi allkirjaga. Selle kõrval poolik samasugune blankett, mis on kortsus, ilmselt lillede ümber olnud. Selle all on must-valge foto Vabaduse väljaku äärsest lilleletist. Kõige üleval on ümmargune must embleem, millel ääres kollane ring ja keskel punane kujutis.
works.de: "Lilleflirt I". First on a grey, then on a red wooden base and against a green background, the birth story of "Lilleflirt" is printed on a KGB agent's report form, with Andres Tolts's signature. Next to it a half of a similar form, which is crumpled, apparently having been around flowers. Below it is a black-and-white photo of a flower stall at the edge of Vabaduse väljak. At the very top is a round black emblem, with a yellow ring on the edge and a red image in the centre.

works.d: Noore Arnold Vilderseni värviline joonistus geomeetriliste kujunditega. Arnold Vildersen (hiljem Vaharo) arreteeriti Nõukogude võimude poolt 10. novembril 1940. Arreteerimise hetkel oli Arnold alles 18-aastane. Eelmisel päeval, 9. novembril 1940, laulis ta koos tädipoeg Artur Sikutiga Eesti hümni. Arnold Vildersen viidi Venemaale Kirovi vangilaagrisse. Tema edasine saatus, täpne surmaaeg ja koht on teadmata. Artur Sikut arreteeriti NKVD poolt koos Arnold Vilderseniga samal päeval. Artur viidi koos Arnoldiga samuti Venemaale Kirovi vangilaagrisse. Artur suri 24. aprillil 1941 Kirovi vangilaagris näljasurma, olles ainult 19-aastane.
works.de: A colour drawing with geometric shapes by young Arnold Vildersen. Arnold Vildersen (later Vaharo) was arrested by the Soviet authorities on 10 November 1940. At the time of his arrest Arnold was only 18 years old. The previous day, on 9 November 1940, he had sung the Estonian national anthem together with his cousin Artur Sikut. Arnold Vildersen was taken to Russia, to the Kirov prison camp. His subsequent fate, exact date and place of death are unknown. Artur Sikut was arrested by the NKVD together with Arnold Vildersen on the same day. Artur was likewise taken together with Arnold to the Kirov prison camp in Russia. Artur died of starvation in the Kirov prison camp on 24 April 1941, aged only 19.

works.d: Maal „Captains of Peace“, autori kunstnikunim Mia Kaims. Maali tehnika on akrüülvärvid üle maalitud õlivärvidega, maal on valminud Melbournis 2009, raamatu „Kui sõjamüra oli vaibunud“ koostamise viimasel aastal. Maali mõte oli, et kõik Geislingeni lapsed lahkusid laia maailma, nende tahe oli kuidagi ehitada rahu maailmas.
works.de: Painting "Captains of Peace", by the artist under the pseudonym Mia Kaims. The painting's technique is acrylic paints painted over oil paints, the painting was completed in Melbourne in 2009, in the final year of compiling the book "Kui sõjamüra oli vaibunud" ["When the Noise of War Had Subsided"]. The idea of the painting was that all the children of Geislingen went out into the wide world, their will was somehow to build peace in the world.

works.d: “Lilleflirt II”. Hallil alusel on kile vahel tühi KGB agendi aruande blankett. Selle all on väike must-valge pilt Vabaduse väljaku äärsest alast. Esiplaanil 3 puud, tagaplaanil Vabaduse väljaku kunstigalerii hoone majanurk. Pildi kõrval on teine pilt, millel graafiline kujutis beežil taustal. Sellest pildist kõrgemal ja blanketi kõrval veidi suurem pilt valgetest anemoonidest tumedas vaasis, mis asetseb valgel roheliste ja punaste kaunistustega alusel. Taustal on sinist, punast ja roosat. Andres Tolts 2002.
works.de: "Lilleflirt II". On a grey base, between plastic film, is an empty KGB agent's report form. Below it is a small black-and-white picture of the area around Freedom Square. In the foreground 3 trees, in the background the corner of the Freedom Square art gallery building. Beside the picture is another picture with a graphic image on a beige background. Above this picture, and beside the form, a somewhat larger picture of white anemones in a dark vase, standing on a white base decorated with green and red ornaments. In the background there is blue, red, and pink. Andres Tolts 2002.

works.d: Asta Eenoki joonistatud pilt lillekimbust vaasis. Taha on kirjutatud „Asta joonistatud õied. Saadan sulle – sina kui lillede sõber. Ei tea, kus Asta ise jookseb, on jõel või marjul. Ei ole teda päeval näinud lastel palju siin jooksmast.“. Joonistatud rasvakriitidega.
works.de: A picture drawn by Asta Eenok of a bouquet of flowers in a vase. On the back is written "Flowers drawn by Asta. I am sending them to you – as a friend of flowers. I don't know where Asta herself is running off to, whether she's at the river or picking berries. The children haven't seen her running around here much during the day." Drawn with wax crayons.

works.d: Lilia Sink on seotud Valgamaa Taheva vallaga, kus 1956. aastal lõpetas kunagise Taheva 7-kl kooli, 1961. aastal  Tartu Kunstikooli ja 1975. aastal Eesti Riikliku Kunstiinstituudi maali erialal. Õlimaal on kunstniku varasema perioodi töö, mis on hästi jõuline, koloriitne ning kannab kontseptuaalset tähendust – tule läbi sündinud järv. Tegemist on kunstniku ühe parima tööga.
works.de: Lilia Sink is connected to the Taheva parish in Valga County, where she finished the former Taheva 7-grade school in 1956, the Tartu Art School in 1961, and the Estonian State Art Institute, painting speciality, in 1975. The oil painting is a work from the artist's earlier period, which is powerfully vigorous, colourful, and carries a conceptual meaning – a lake born through fire. It is one of the artist's best works.

works.dm: laius: 18.0 cm; sügavus: 21.0 cm; kõrgus: 29.0 cm

works.d:
Istuv mehekuju. Mehel on suur nina, tugevad kulmud ja keerdusotsaline lühem habe. Mehe juuksed on pikad, üle selja laiali ja moodustavad Skandinaavia-pärase põimmustri. Mehel on seljas umbkuub, mille käiseotstes on svastikaornament, püksid, sääremähised ja saapad, millel on 2 kinnist. Kõige peal on keebilaadne ülevise. 
Kuju on valgest savist, sinise glasuuriga osaliselt kaetud. Kuju on seest õõnes.
works.de:
A seated male figure. The man has a large nose, strong eyebrows and a shorter beard with curled ends. The man's hair is long, spread out over his back and forms a Scandinavian-style interlace pattern. The man wears a long tunic-like garment, the cuffs of which bear a swastika ornament, trousers, leg wrappings and boots with 2 fasteners. On top there is a cloak-like outer garment.
The figure is made of white clay, partially covered with blue glaze. The figure is hollow inside.

Pastell. Ants Laikmaa. Mehe portree. 1925. 39*33,5 cm.
works.dm: kõrgus: 39.0 cm; laius: 37.5 cm; laius: 33.5 cm; kõrgus: 43.0 cm
works.d:
Mehe Portree. Autor: Ants Laikmaa. 
Dateering: 1925. 
Töö teostatud pastellitehnikas pastellipaberile. Mõõtmed raamita 39*33,5.
Pildil on kujutatud vasakule 3/4 vaates noorem meesterahvas. Mees on pruunide juustega, kannab ümmargusi kitsastes raamides prille. Kannab tumesinise-valge triibulist lipsu, valget püstide krae ja allamurtud kraenurkadega päevasärki ning tumesinist kuube. 
Töö vasakus ülemises nurgas diagonaalselt signatuur: A. Laipman ja selle all 1925. 
Raam: Kitsas pronksivärviline. Raami äärel kitsas kipskaunistuste riba, raam pealt sile, altpoolt krobeline.
Tagapapi siseküljel valge pastellkriidiga kiri: 21.I.1926

Inventeeris Eve Otstavel
12. veebruaril 2009.a.
works.de:
Portrait of a Man. Author: Ants Laikmaa.
Dating: 1925.
Work executed in pastel technique on pastel paper. Dimensions without frame 39*33.5.
The picture depicts a younger man in a 3/4 view turned to the left. The man has brown hair, wears round glasses in narrow frames. He wears a dark blue-and-white striped tie, a white standing collar with a day shirt with turned-down collar corners, and a dark blue jacket.
In the upper left corner of the work a diagonal signature: A. Laipman and below it 1925.
Frame: Narrow, bronze-colored. The frame edge has a narrow strip of plaster decorations, the frame is smooth on top and rough on the bottom.
On the inner side of the backing board an inscription in white pastel chalk: 21.I.1926

Inventoried by Eve Otstavel
on 12 February 2009.

Maal. Virve Kurist - Lihula kindlus, 1990nd algus, tempera, krunditud papp
works.d:
Pildil on kujutatud Lihula linnusemäel asuvat veskit. 
Pildil näha tüvikoonuse-kujuline paekivist veski, paremal näha peasissepääas, vasakul teine sissepääas. Mõlema ukse kohal aknaavad. Veski parema nurga juures puu, esiplaanil keskel põõsas.
Veski lähivaates, ulatudes vasakus servas raamini välja. Pilt hallikates-sinakates toonides. 
Pildi raam valge, profiiliga. Pilt kinnitatud klambritega, ühenduskoht teibiga kaetud. 
Pildi tagakülje paremasse ülemisse nurka kirjutatud:
Virve Kurist (Tikenberg)
"Lihula linnus"
45x55 cm
- 90da algus
Vasakusse ülemisse nurka kleebitud valgel lehel samad andmed.
works.de:
The picture depicts a mill situated on the Lihula hillfort mound.
The picture shows a frustum-cone-shaped limestone mill, with the main entrance visible on the right, and a second entrance on the left. Above both doors are window openings. Near the right corner of the mill there is a tree, and a bush in the centre foreground.
The mill is shown in close view, extending to the frame at the left edge. The picture is in greyish-bluish tones.
The picture's frame is white, with a profile. The picture is attached with clamps, the joint covered with tape.
Written in the upper right corner of the back of the picture:
Virve Kurist (Tikenberg)
"Lihula linnus"
45x55 cm
- early 90s
In the upper left corner a white sheet is glued on with the same information.

works.t: Maal. Eduard Hollberg. Othello. XIX saj. II pool. Õli papil.
works.d: Täiendus perekond Hollbergide materjalidele muuseumi kogus. Omab kultuuriloolist ja ajaloolist väärtust ning on kooskõlas muuseumi kogude poliitikaga. Väärtust lisab portreele asjaolu, et tegemist on autoporteega Othellona.
works.de: An addition to the Hollberg family materials in the museum's collection. It has cultural-historical and historical value and is consistent with the museum's collections policy. The value of the portrait is enhanced by the fact that it is a self-portrait as Othello.

works.d:
Hillar Tatar on üks omanäolisemaid Haapsalu kunstnikke, kes on maalinud paljude Haapsalu tuntud isikute portreesid. Omandatud joonistused on lisanduseks juba muuseumis olevatele õlimaalidele ja täiendavad muuseumis säilitatavate Haapsalus tuntud isikute portreede kogu. 
Esemete omandamine on kooskõlas muuseumi kogude täiendamise poliitikaga.
works.de:
Hillar Tatar is one of the most distinctive artists of Haapsalu, who has painted portraits of many well-known figures of Haapsalu. The acquired drawings are an addition to the oil paintings already in the museum and complement the museum's collection of portraits of well-known figures of Haapsalu. 
The acquisition of the items is in accordance with the museum's collection development policy.

works.d:
Tuššijoonis, "Hiiu eit jagab kindaid" Autor: Varmo Pirk. 
Varmo Pirk, Valve Janov ja Kaja Kärner tahtsid 1944. a. sügisel
Eestist põgeneda Hiiumaa kaudu. Hiiumaal on Pirk sellel ajal teinud mõned etüüdid. Ära sõita neil ei õnnestunud ja tagasiteel püüdsid nad sulanduda kartulivõtjate sekka, et mitte tähelepanu äratada.
Võib-olla on see joonistus tehtud Hiiumaal.
Mai Levin, Eesti Kunstimuuseum kommentaar: Varmo Pirk (1913-1980) sai kunstihariduse "Pallases" 1938-40, Kõrgematel Kujutava Kunsti Kursustel 1942-44 ja 1944-45 Tartu Riiklikus Kunstiinstituudis. Töötas õpingute ajal 1937-39 Tartu Töölisteatri dekoraatorina ja 1941-44 ajalehe "Postimees" toimetuses illustraatorina. Arreteeriti 1945.
works.de:
Ink drawing, "Hiiu Eit Distributes Gloves" Author: Varmo Pirk.
Varmo Pirk, Valve Janov and Kaja Kärner wanted, in the autumn of 1944,
to flee Estonia via Hiiumaa. On Hiiumaa Pirk made some studies at that time.
They did not manage to leave, and on the way back they tried to blend in among the potato pickers so as not to attract attention.
Perhaps this drawing was made on Hiiumaa.
Mai Levin, Art Museum of Estonia comment: Varmo Pirk (1913-1980) received his art education at "Pallas" in 1938-40, at the Higher Courses of Fine Art in 1942-44 and in 1944-45 at the Tartu State Art Institute. During his studies he worked in 1937-39 as a decorator at the Tartu Workers' Theatre and in 1941-44 as an illustrator at the editorial office of the newspaper "Postimees". He was arrested in 1945.

works.d: Polükroomne maastik lindudega. Esiplaanil jämeda tüvega puu taustal keskel uhke kukk, tema ees kana jt linnud. Paremal nurgas tiigis valge hani (tutiga) oma 4 pojaga. Puuokstel 3 lindu (peoleo, rähn), taevas lendavad pääsukesed. Lossi aia purskkaevu juures jalutavad faasanid ja luiged.
works.de: Polychrome landscape with birds. In the foreground, against the background of a thick-trunked tree, a proud rooster stands in the centre, with a hen and other birds in front of it. In the right corner, a white goose (with a tuft) with its 4 goslings in a pond. 3 birds (an oriole, a woodpecker) on the tree branches, swallows flying in the sky. Near the castle garden fountain, pheasants and swans are strolling.

works.de: Lagorio, Leo (1826, Feodosia – 1905, Petersburg). Born in Crimea into the family of the Neapolitan vice-consul. Studied in 1839–40 under Ivan Aivazovsky and in 1843–50 at the Petersburg Academy of Arts under professors Alexander Sauerweid, Maxim Vorobyov and Bogdan (Gottfried) Willewalde. In 1850 won the grand gold medal in the Petersburg Academy of Arts competition, earned the title of free artist and a foreign stipend. The foreign trip was postponed, as in 1851 the Academy of Arts sent him to the Caucasus to document the customs posts there. In 1852 the artist was granted Russian citizenship. In 1853–60 worked as an Academy of Arts stipendiary and, on the commission of Empress Alexandra Fyodorovna, in Paris, Italy and Switzerland. Lat[er]

works.de:
Fokin, Nikolai (1869, St. Petersburg – 1908,
St. Petersburg). Studied 1891–96 at the St. Petersburg
Academy of Arts in the landscape painting class
under Aleksandr Kisselyov. In 1902 he received the title
of professional artist and a scholarship for further training
for the painting "Early Snow".
Exhibited at exhibitions of the Academy of Arts and the group New Society of Artists. His short-lived
work abroad consists of
sensitive and lyrical landscape paintings,
of which the better-known one is a cycle of winter nature views
painted in the Urals.

works.de: Juon, Konstantin (1875, Moscow – 1958, Moscow). Studied painting in 1892–98 at the Moscow School of Painting, Sculpture and Architecture under Abram Arkhipov, Konstantin Korovin and Nikolai Kasatkin. In 1898–1900 furthered his studies in Valentin Serov's studio. Belonged to the Mir Iskusstva group, exhibited at its exhibitions. From 1903 participated in exhibitions of the Union of Russian Artists, was a founding member of the group. From 1900–17 taught painting in his own studio, in the Soviet era founded several art schools and worked as a lecturer at the Moscow State V. Surikov Academic Art Institute. In 1947 was named a full member of the USSR Academy of Arts, defended a doctorate in art history. Painted landscapes, portraits, also worked as a graphic artist and theatre [artist]
